Concubine Rong doesn’t care about this at all. She must protect the people she wants to protect.
“When Su Yue comes out, I will give her the jewel hairpin at the bottom of my dressing box as a reward. I will also grant her another month’s leave and give her ten taels of silver to her parents and brothers outside the palace.” Concubine Rong never treated the people around her badly.
After hearing this, Su Xin and Su Qiu wished they were the ones who rushed out at that time.
After everything was arranged, Concubine Rong couldn’t wait to ask, “Where is the emperor? Why can’t I see him?”
The Queen Mother did come before this, and after seeing that the Queen was resting and was not seriously injured, she sat for a while and then left.
The Queen made this trip out of dignity, but the Emperor never showed up from beginning to end.
I heard from the people in front that the meeting should have ended long ago.
The Emperor…probably didn’t come on purpose.
The nanny and the maids looked at each other, not knowing whether they should tell the truth. They were also afraid that if they told the truth, the imperial concubine would be sad.
Just at this moment, the little prince who was originally sleeping soundly suddenly moved.
Gu Shao was awakened by hunger. He found that the child really could not tolerate hunger and needed to be fed every one or two hours.
At this time, it had been more than three hours since he last ate.
Seeing the little baby in front of her gurgling as if in great pain, as weak as a little mouse as if he would die in the next second, Concubine Rong immediately panicked: “What happened to him?”
At this time, Concubine Rong no longer cared about whether the emperor came or not.
Even though she liked the emperor very much, she was now completely attracted by the little thing in front of her.
“The little prince must be hungry.” Seeing this, the nanny did not panic but breathed a sigh of relief.
Soon, the entire delivery room was in chaos.
At the same time, in Chengming Palace, Emperor Jingwen was lying on the dragon bed in his pajamas, unable to fall asleep.
It’s not that he has no feelings for the imperial concubine, but he had no choice but to treat her like this.
Emperor Jingwen felt both annoyed and enjoyed it when he thought that whenever he favored any of his concubines, the woman would become jealous and throw a tantrum at him.
Although she is arrogant and unreasonable by nature, she cannot leave himself for a moment.
I hope she won’t be too sad this time. She shed a lot of tears during the confinement period, which may hurt her eyes easily…

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Heredity
chapters.content:
On the other side, in the side hall of Shu lan zhai——
Hearing the commotion coming from the main hall, the faint sounds of comforting and the weak cry of a baby, Zhao Chongrong subconsciously placed his hand on his lower abdomen, as if she was immersed in something.
A child once came here.
She was a little princess, she was already five months old, but in the end she couldn’t be saved.
Zhao Chongrong had been in poor health in her early years. She finally got pregnant but failed to keep the baby, so she could no longer have children.
And she is not the only one in the harem who is infertile.
Listening to the noise coming from the main hall, Zhao Chongrong felt even more uncomfortable.
Zhao Chongrong’s family background was ordinary, far inferior to that of Concubine Rong, so she definitely needed a child to consolidate her favor. Otherwise, even if she was Chongrong, no one in the palace would take her seriously, and the Ministry of Internal Affairs would be even more neglectful.
Zhao Chongrong thought that even if she had a princess, she would have someone to rely on for the rest of her life.
Unfortunately, God refused to let her realize even this wish.Because everyone was living together temporarily, and the queen had been here before, Zhao Chongrong had taken a look at the little prince when the nanny brought him out.
Gu Shao was sleeping soundly at that time and he didn’t know it.
When Zhao Chongrong saw it, she felt that it was a very beautiful child, with good looks, but the child looked a little weak, probably because he was born prematurely.
Come to think of it, God is really blind. Even a woman like Concubine Rong has a child, but she has nothing.
The more he thought about it, the more unwilling he felt. The lights in Shu Lan Zhai remained on until late at night.
Three days passed in a flash, and Concubine Rong had barely gotten used to Gu Shao and her identity as a mother. Finally, she was no longer as averse to her son’s closeness as she was at the beginning.
There’s nothing we can do. Who can blame this guy for being such a clingy guy? He’s so clingy that Concubine Rong has lost her temper.
As soon as he saw her, the boy started whining and looked pitiful, as if he was about to cry. If you didn’t know better, you would think that his nanny was bullying him.
When she was in the boudoir, her parents and brothers gave in to her. After she got married, even the emperor had to tolerate her temper from time to time.
Only this little thing in front of her regarded her as a support.
Depend on her!
Concubine Rong had never thought that these two words would be applied to her one day. She found it novel and incredible, but more of it was anxiety and uneasiness.
Do I really have such ability?
For the first time in her life, Concubine Rong examined herself. In terms of appearance, she was indeed top-notch, but when it came to knowledge, talent, and even temper, Concubine Rong could not say a good word about her against her conscience.
The Zhen Mansion was composed entirely of military generals; even the only daughter could not escape.
When Concubine Rong was young, she would get a headache whenever she saw a book, so she could only recognize a few words roughly, and she couldn’t understand anything more deeply.
The Duke of Zhen didn’t care. In his eyes, no one would dare to despise his daughter even if she was like this. If she didn’t want to learn, then she didn’t have to.
Concubine Rong never thought there was anything wrong with this before, but now that she has a child, she suddenly feels a sense of crisis.
Among all the people in the palace, Concubine De has read the most books and is the one who can help the eldest prince the most. As for me…how can I help the child?
Another thing is that Concubine Rong had never been exposed to the secretive tactics used in the inner palace. Although her father had two concubines, they were both honest and obedient. In addition, the children were in the hands of the lady, so there was no room for them to use tricks. Therefore, Concubine Rong was naturally raised in a simple way.
During the years of being married to Emperor Jingwen, Concubine Rong gained a lot of experience and realized that the deep palace was not as simple as it seemed.
Even the Shufei, the Defei, and the Xianfei had lost their children one after another, let alone others.
[Pure Consort (淑妃;
shūfēi
)
Virtuous Consort (德妃;
défēi
)
Worthy Consort (賢妃;
xiánfēi
)]
Is it really all due to the mother’s weakness? No one would believe this.
Especially the first child of Concubine Shu, who was raised with great difficulty until the age of five. He didn’t even have time to be included in the imperial genealogy until he was six, and he didn’t even have time to be ranked in the order of seniority. He was gone overnight.
Concubine Rong entered the palace late and had never seen the child.
You don’t feel pain unless the knife falls on your body. In the past, Concubine Rong didn’t feel anything at all. Anyway, Concubine Shu gave birth to several more children later, and it didn’t seem to have any impact.
It was not until Concubine Rong became a mother herself that she thought about what would happen if the little thing in front of her suddenly died one day… Just thinking about it made Concubine Rong shudder.
No, I can not let something happen to him!
Her child will definitely grow up safely, look better than anyone else, and live longer than anyone else!
“Mother will never let anything happen to you!” She will never let go of anyone who dares to hurt him!
Seeing that the woman in front of him seemed to be thinking about something and was suddenly filled with murderous aura, Gu Shao was stunned. Oh no, could he have gone too far?
Seeing that she seemed to have frightened the little thing in her arms, Concubine Rong quickly regained her tenderness: “Whatever you want, mother will find a way to get it.”
Is there any better position in the world than that?
[T/L NOTE:- She is referring to the throne.]
“Although it may seem a bit unfair to say this, my son must have the best of everything.” Guilt only flashed across her mind, and Concubine Rong selectively ignored it.
The prince’s kindness is not enough after all.
For some reason, Gu Shao always felt that his mother was becoming more and more like a villain.
“With your grandfather’s power and the help of your six uncles, your mother will do her best to let you sit in that position.” There was only Concubine Rong around, and the little thing was still young and couldn’t understand, so she spoke in a voice that was almost a whisper, with almost no scruples.
Gu Shao: “…………”
NoNoNoNoNo…! ! !
He doesn’t want it!!!
Emperor, a miserable job that requires one to get up earlier than a chicken and sleep later than a dog. 996 still has weekends, but the emperor has no days off all year round.
[996 working system = Under official Chinese law, employees can work a maximum 44-hour workweek and any work beyond that requires extra pay for overtime.]
The most important thing is that he worries too much. The rise and fall of an entire country depends on the emperor alone. The pressure is unimaginable.
In modern times, Gu Shao was exhausted from managing a company and wanted to quit, let alone being an emperor.
In ancient times, emperors often had short lives. If they were wise, they would be exhausted to death, and if they were incompetent, they would be killed by rebellion. In short, it was a high-risk job.
Gu Shao has been a poor boy since he was young. He never had the great ideal of sleeping on the lap of a beautiful woman and ruling the world when he is awake. After all, wealth and glory will eventually become empty. You can’t bring them with you when you are born, and you can’t take them with you when you die.
Besides, being an emperor is really useless.
Except for having more beauties around him, other aspects cannot be compared with modern times, and Gu Shao himself is not a lustful person.
There is everything in modern times. Gu Shao dares to say that the things he has enjoyed in modern times are not available to the emperor.
Gu Shao stood on the shoulders of giants, so naturally he looked down on the ancient emperor, who was relatively tall.
As a person who has enjoyed a smart toilet, Gu Shao wanted to ask, after becoming an emperor, does that mean he no longer needs to wipe his butt when he goes to the toilet?
Even if someone else helps you wipe it, don’t you still have to wipe it?
So, refuse.
Gu Shao felt that being a prince was pretty good. He was second only to the emperor and above everyone else, also at the top of the pyramid, but without that much pressure. It would be even better if he could meet a cautious emperor. Once all the burdens were lifted, all that would be left was eating, drinking and having fun.
When he was short of money, he would ask his brothers for it. If his brothers were a little respectable, they would definitely give him some. Or he would simply take all the money, which would be enough for him to spend for a lifetime, while his father was still alive.
Gu Shao felt that being a prince was quite good. He was simple, shy and easy to talk to. He couldn’t stand it when the maidservant beside his beautiful mother knelt down in front of him. He was a soft persimmon.
Unable to see her son’s urgency and fear at the moment, Rong Guifei shouted in delight, “Suxin, go, ask Zhao Chongrong to bring me two books.”
Since she had to plan so much for her son, Concubine Rong felt that she should also work hard.
Su Xin looked as if she had seen a ghost. For a moment, she quickly lowered her head, replied “yes”, and hurried out.
Half an incense stick later, Concubine Rong opened the “Great Learning” in front of her with great ambition.
After one stick of incense, Concubine Rong’s expression began to become stiff.
After two incense sticks, Concubine Rong began to feel dizzy.
After three incense sticks, Concubine Rong decisively closed the book again.
“Oh, I have a headache.” Under the teasing gaze of the nanny, Concubine Rong lay back down.
Just before she fell asleep, Concubine Rong tilted her head and couldn’t help but admonish, “Little thing, when you grow up, don’t learn from your mother.”
You are going to be the emperor!
“Ahh.”
Gu Shao blinked his eyes and looked as well-behaved as possible, but he couldn’t help but sneer in his heart.
I’m sorry, mom. I must have inherited your problem of getting a headache whenever you read!
Not only do I want to inherit it, I also want to develop, promote, shine and expand it.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Discovery
chapters.content:
She had no idea what her son was thinking at the moment. If Concubine Rong knew, she would probably be furious.
After a good sleep, Concubine Rong realized that the person she had been waiting for with such joy had never shown up from beginning to end.
Today is the third day since the little prince’s birth, and also the little prince’s third-day baptism ceremony, but Emperor Jingwen did not even come.
Now, even Concubine Rong can no longer deceive herself.
This neglect came out of nowhere. I had helped him give birth to a prince smoothly, so why was he still unhappy?
Not only Concubine Rong couldn’t figure it out, but the entire Duke Zhen’s Mansion couldn’t figure it out either.
How come their family had worked so hard for the royal family, fought off foreign enemies, and tried their best to maintain the stability of the Great Zhou, but the emperor turned against them so suddenly?
Today, the Duke of Zhen was reprimanded for the first time during the court session. When he returned home, he couldn’t understand why this happened.
The most crucial thing is that the emperor actually let the eldest prince replace the third prince in the army.
The eldest prince is only 17 years old now. He can participate in the management of the military camp, but he is far from being able to lead troops into battle and become the commander-in-chief of an army.The Duke of Zhen couldn’t help but argue with the emperor in the court. As a result, for some unknown reason, Emperor Jingwen seemed to get even angrier and even ordered him to go home and not to attend court for seven days.
The Duke of Zhen was so angry that he was still muttering and cursing as he walked on the street.
Little did he know that his every word and action was recorded and reported to Emperor Jingwen.
Because the man was far away and had been specially trained, even a veteran like the Duke of Zhen who had fought on the battlefield for most of his life did not notice him.
When the Duke of Zhen returned home, he felt a little better.
Then he remembered that the palace had sent him a message that today was exactly the third day since the imperial concubine gave birth, and it was also the third day of her grandson’s baptism ceremony.
“Have you prepared the gifts for your sister and nephew?”
“It’s been prepared a long time ago, and someone is already preparing to send it to the palace.” According to folk customs, the uncle has to do a lot of work. So the six of them did not dare to neglect it at all and picked out the things early.
According to etiquette, they cannot enter the palace to visit, but it is okay to send some gifts.
When he thought of his daughter, the Duke of Zhen no longer cared about the things happening in the court.
“Wait, don’t go yet, take this with you.” As he said this, the Duke of Zhen took out a longevity lock from his arms.
This thing was carved by a craftsman a month before Concubine Rong gave birth. It was made from the same piece of jade and was of high quality. All the legitimate grandchildren in the Duke Zhen’s Mansion had one. Normally, it should not be given to a daughter’s child, after all, he is a grandson. But the Duke Zhen was unreasonable!
After all, he only had one daughter in his life, and the Duke of Zhen naturally regarded the child born by Concubine Rong as his own grandson.
Even if he is of royal blood, doesn’t he have half of the Wei family’s blood flowing in his body?
“And you too.”
The Duke of Zhen’s tiger eyes flashed across the faces of the six men: “Even if your sister gets married, she is still a member of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion. Do you understand? Don’t let me hear any unpleasant words, otherwise you just wait for me!”
The six men looked at each other, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.
How dare they do that? They can’t even love her enough.
“That’s good enough.” The Duke of Zhen was finally satisfied.
As for the fact that he was reprimanded by the Emperor in the court, the Duke of Zhen naturally would not let anyone tell Concubine Rong about it, and it would be too late to hide it from her.
But Concubine Rong finally found out.
After all, she is not a fool, right?
Such big news, even if she didn’t know it, others would find ways to tell her.
Concubine Rong was really hurt this time, and tears were falling like crazy.
Inexplicably, she suddenly felt a little panic in her heart, and she grabbed the hand of the nanny beside her and refused to let go: “Mammy, tell me, has the emperor changed his mind? Has he started to hate me?”
How could the nanny know what the emperor was thinking? She could do nothing but comfort her against her will.
Gu Shao, who was standing by, listened and was not so pessimistic.
After all, in his opinion, when one really wants to get rid of someone, he will never make such a big fuss.
The fact that the emperor still cursed proved that he had not completely given up on the Duke of Zhen in his heart, and that he still had some affection for his grandfather in his eyes.
If one day his mother was suddenly promoted to Imperial Noble Consort, or the Emperor began to highly praise the line of the Duke of Zhen, then he would be truly doomed.
If you want to destroy it, first make it crazy.
Even when hunting, it is necessary to paralyze the prey first, so that when the prey struggles, the noise will be minimized.
Then took the prey by surprise and killed it with one blow.
As for the reason why the emperor suddenly turned against him, Gu Shao also vaguely guessed it.
Concubine Rong couldn’t get out of bed these days, and Gu Shao heard her talk to him a lot, about the Defei, Shufei, and Xianfei. By the way, he also found out how many children they had given birth to, and who was ahead of him.
Gu Shao never imagined that the emperor already had eight sons before him, and he was the ninth. It took Gu Shao, an only child, a long time to accept the reality.
The current crown prince is not the emperor’s eldest son. Before the crown prince there were the first prince and the second prince, and after the crown prince there are the fourth prince, the fifth prince, the sixth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince.
Among them, the eldest prince was 17 years old, the second prince was 16 years old, and the crown prince was 15 years old.
The rest were ten, seven, five, four and three years old.
Judging from the age arrangement, the order after the Crown Prince is obviously not so tight, especially between the Crown Prince and the Fourth Prince, there is a full five years difference in age.
If the eldest prince and the second prince were born to improve their competitiveness, then the crown prince, the legitimate son, was born to inherit the country.
There was such a long interval in between, Gu Shao didn’t believe it was a coincidence or that the emperor suddenly died.
It is obvious that they are afraid that the remaining princes are too close in age to the crown prince and will have disputes with the crown prince.
It was not until the prince’s biological mother died that the number of children in the palace gradually increased.
In this case, how can Gu Shao fight for it?
Even if he is not a salted fish, he can’t get it.
My cheap dad is so biased. Isn’t it obvious who is the true love, and who is the gift given as a gift after topping up his phone bill?
[T/L NOTE:- He is pointing that other princes are kind of mistakes or that they were allowed to be born just to assist the crown prince.]
Unfortunately, his mother couldn’t understand it now and thought that the emperor no longer loved her.
The key point is that the emperor never seemed to love her…
What Gu Shao didn’t understand was how he was born under such circumstances. It shouldn’t have happened.
Gu Shao was puzzled, and then suddenly, he remembered the red pill he saw when he first opened his eyes.
No way…
Is it so cruel???
His eyes changed slightly, and Gu Shao couldn’t help but shudder.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Return
chapters.content:
My dad wants to kill me!
This thought flashed through Gu Shao’s mind quickly.
It’s not that Gu Shao suffers from paranoia, but all signs indicate that the emperor and the crown prince are the most suspicious.
You see, the current queen has no children yet. Even if she has a child, the biggest threat to her is still the crown prince, so Gu Shao has to take the back seat.
As for other concubines, those who have children haven’t even established their own children yet, so how can they start to eliminate threats?
As for those who don’t even have children, unless they are desperate, no matter how angry they are, they can only curse behind their backs.
Besides, his mother was a royal concubine after all, and ordinary people couldn’t reach here.
But if it was the crown prince, it doesn’t make sense.
If the crown prince really wanted to kill him, he would not have saved his mother. He would have just avoided that road and done nothing but watch the mother and son get into trouble.
So, after ruling out the suspicion of other people, the more Gu Shao looked at his cheap father, the more suspicious he felt.…Gu Shao took note of this account.
While thinking, the nanny gradually recovered from her panic and became rational: “Madam, the auspicious time is almost over, let’s hold the third baptism ceremony for the little prince first.”
We can’t just keep dragging it on like this until the emperor comes.
When she noticed that she was crying, the little baby next to her seemed to feel something and looked like it was about to cry but didn’t. Concubine Rong wiped away her tears almost subconsciously.
“I’m sorry, I’m sorry. It’s mother’s fault. It’s mother’s fault.” Concubine Rong felt extremely guilty because she had caused him to start worrying about her.
Soon, order was restored in the main hall, and the baptism ceremony was carried out in an orderly manner.
Then Gu Shao saw the original owner of Shu Lan Zhai.
Zhao Chongrong originally didn’t want to come because she was afraid of causing trouble, but she couldn’t pretend to be blind, right?
Zhao Chongrong had no choice but to ask her maid to pick out a pair of bracelets and brought them to the main hall.
It was a pair of plain silver bracelets. Although they were made of plain silver, the patterns on them were extremely beautiful and had good meanings. It was obvious at first glance that they were carefully selected styles.
There are two bells on it, which jingle when shaken, and it is lively and cute.
This was a gift that Zhao Chongrong had prepared for her daughter. However, the incident happened suddenly and there was really no other gift that could be given to the child. After thinking about it, Zhao Chongrong asked the maid to take it out from the warehouse.
As a result… Concubine Rong didn’t appreciate it at all.
Concubine Rong didn’t know the inside story, she just felt that the silver bracelet was too plain, and the pattern was only popular a few years ago.
Concubine Rong has seen a lot of fine things, so ordinary things are naturally not to her liking.
Is this Zhao Chongrong trying to fool her?
However, on such a happy day, Concubine Rong was too lazy to argue with the other party.
“Alright, I understand, you can leave now.”
Noticing the indifference and undisguised contempt in Concubine Rong’s eyes, Zhao Chongrong almost crushed the handkerchief in her hand.
“…Yes, Your Majesty.”
She lowered her head, and the original expectation gradually turned into cruelty and resentment without knowing when.
“…………”
Seeing that a pair of bracelets was about to cause a bloody murder, Gu Shao hurriedly reached out his hand: “Ah, ah.”
The little baby seemed to be attracted by the bell in front of him, and his eyes were full of eagerness.
Concubine Rong was stunned. She didn’t expect that her son would be so unambitious. He was so interested in just a pair of silver bracelets.
Zhao Chongrong was also stunned. She didn’t expect that the child in front of her would like it.
For a moment, the silhouette of the little baby overlapped with that of his daughter.
In my dream, if my daughter could be born safely, she would be fair, tender and ignorant like this.
Zhao Chongrong’s dissatisfaction gradually dissipated.
Seeing this, the nanny nearby took a quick check and found nothing unusual, so she nodded to Concubine Rong. After getting Concubine Rong’s consent, the nanny gave the bracelet to the little prince in the cradle.
Unfortunately, at this time, Gu Shao was a useless person who couldn’t even hold a bracelet.
With a “click”, the bracelet fell back again.
Gu Shao: “…”
Concubine Rong couldn’t help but burst out laughing.
Zhao Chongrong’s eyes trembled slightly.
“Didn’t you say you were leaving? Why are you still standing there?”
Hearing this, Zhao Chongrong seemed to gain courage, and on impulse, she spoke: “My Lady, can I hold the little prince in my arms?”
Concubine Rong paused while teasing her son.
The maids and the others also looked at Zhao Chongrong.
The atmosphere seemed a little weird for a moment.
Just when Zhao Chongrong thought the woman would definitely refuse, who knew that Concubine Rong actually agreed.
It’s just that the tone isn’t very good.
“Be careful not to fall, or you’ll get hurt.”
As soon as the swaddling clothes fell into her hands, Zhao Chongrong had no idea what the other person was saying.
The child in my arms is so small and soft, and looks so cute.
Gu Shao originally wanted to be intimate with the lady in front of him, and he could see that the other party was not being false at the moment.
However, just as Gu Shao was about to make his move, Concubine Rong narrowed her eyes instantly.
Gu Shao got scared at that time.
The child stayed quietly in Zhao Chongrong’s arms for a while, and before Concubine Rong’s patience was about to run out, Zhao Chongrong reluctantly returned the child to her.
“Thank you, Your Majesty. I will take my leave now.”
This person must have experienced something before.
But what does this have to do with me?
In just a moment, Concubine Rong forgot about Zhao Chongrong.
After the third bathing ceremony, two days later Concubine Rong was able to walk normally again.
Other people’s palaces are definitely not as comfortable as her own. Being able to endure such a shabby environment for so long is already Concubine Rong’s limit.
As soon as she was able to get out of bed, Concubine Rong immediately asked the palace maids and eunuchs to pack up and leave.
Zhao Chongrong was the only one left. Without the baby’s occasional crying, she actually felt a little uncomfortable.
The Shu Lan Zhai seems to be even quieter than before.
Gu Shao originally didn’t understand why his mother disliked Shu Lan Zhai so much. Gu Shao felt that the environment of Shu Lan Zhai was already very good. The furniture was all made of solid wood and was new. What was so unbearable about it?
Until he came to Qiuwu Palace.
As soon as he entered the door, he was stunned by the hot air that hit him in the face.
There’s actually a ground dragon here!
Even the incense burned in the incense burner is priceless agarwood.
The walls around are painted with pepper mud, which looks warm and luxurious.
“Little thing, from today on, this is where you live.”
The side hall was prepared as early as when she became pregnant. The Ministry of Internal Affairs spent countless amounts of good materials. Now that September has passed, the flavor has almost disappeared.
If it were someone else, they would only feel delighted when seeing such a luxurious palace. However, when Concubine Rong asked the Ministry of Internal Affairs to renovate the side hall, she secretly made many people jealous.
However, Gu Shao felt as if he was facing a formidable enemy.
The palace is nice, but… the walls are painted with cinnabar!
Anyone who has been to school should know what cinnabar is.
So now the question is, how should he tell his mother?
Completely unaware, Concubine Rong was still holding her son, enthusiastically introducing the various arrangements in the room, and inhaling the poisonous gas around her.
Gu Shao: “…”
Help, help.
The other side.
Finally, Concubine Rong left. The things in the main hall needed to be taken apart and washed. The maids and eunuchs were busy for a while.
Zhao Chongrong was the mistress of a palace after all, so it was impossible for her to use things that had been used by others.
It is the same even if that person is a royal concubine.
Zhao Chongrong sat there absent-mindedly, not knowing what he was thinking about.
Soon, her thoughts were interrupted.
It turned out to be Zhao Chongrong’s personal maid, who accidentally discovered something while giving orders.
“Huh? What is this?”
She subconsciously stretched out her hand and a bright red pill appeared in her palm.
When Zhao Chongrong heard the noise, she looked over unconsciously.

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Sweet Dates
chapters.content:
Zhao Chongrong thought it was a red bean or something else, but when she put it on the table and dipped her finger in tea, it actually melted.
It’s medicine!
Zhao Chongrong was immediately stunned.
“Go and ask the Beast Taming House for a rabbit.”
It was not known whether it was because Zhao Chongrong wanted them urgently or because the Beast Taming House was negligent, but in the end the young eunuch only brought back two little rabbits that looked not much bigger than a palm.
The medicine was given in the morning and the rabbit died that evening.
Seeing that one of the rabbits gradually died, Zhao Chongrong was so shocked that he almost cried out.
After she realized what was happening, she covered her mouth tightly, her eyes full of horror.
Zhao Chongrong didn’t think anyone would harm her. She was not young anymore, and her appearance was not top-notch before, let alone now? She didn’t have any children, so she couldn’t stand in anyone’s way.
If there is anything eye-catching in Shu Lan Zhai recently, it is only Concubine Rong who just gave birth.That medicine… is for the little prince!!
In this palace, there are very few people who dare to attack the little prince.
Zhao Chongrong suddenly thought of something and a layer of sweat instantly appeared on his back.
With a “crash”, the cup in front of him accidentally fell out and broke into pieces.
“My madam!”
“I’m fine, don’t make it known!” Zhao Chongrong shouted immediately.
Looking around at her confidants in the room, she spoke word by word, “No one of you is allowed to tell anyone about what happened today. Do you hear me?”
Although they were puzzled, after being startled, everyone still responded subconsciously: “Yes, yes, Madam.”
After everyone had left, Zhao Chongrong realized that most of her body was cold.
Zhao Chongrong has no other talents in her life, and she has survived to this day entirely because of her intelligence.
Considering the recent trend in the palace, how could she not guess what was going on?
I just couldn’t imagine that person could be so cruel that he wouldn’t even let his own child go.
You know, even a tiger won’t eat its own cubs, so what kind of heart does one have to have the heart to hurt an innocent child?
Zhao Chongrong suddenly felt that beneath Emperor Jingwen’s seemingly majestic face, his heart was so cold and terrifying.
It’s really… chilling.
Did he really regard those people other than the late queen and the crown prince as extraordinary people?
At the same time, in the Qinzheng Hall——
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt an itchy nose for some reason.
“A-choo!”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t think anything of it, but the chief eunuch beside him was frightened: “Your Majesty, have you caught a cold? Do you want to call the imperial physician to take a look?”
“No need.” The emperor waved his hand.
Then, he thought of something and said, “Oh, right, ask Xiao Dongzi to pick some things from my private storehouse and send them to the imperial concubine.”
I think the imperial concubine must be sad this time.
After waiting for a few days, he couldn’t bear it anymore.
Thinking of the time when Concubine Rong got angry with him and her eyes turned red, Emperor Jingwen paused holding the red brush.
“…By the way, give the Dongzhu Pearl that she has always wanted. Oh, and this, too.”
The emperor pointed to the fine jadeite Qilin on the jade table, and a complex emotion flashed in his eyes: “This, take it to the Ninth Prince to play with.”
It seems that the emperor may not have no feelings for the imperial concubine at all.
“Yes.” The eunuch Wang Ziquan’s mind moved, and then he suppressed the thought in an instant.
After that, Emperor Jingwen said nothing and made no sound.
The other side.
Concubine Rong originally wanted to put the child in her arms on the bed to let him get used to it, but as soon as she let go, the next moment, the little baby in the cradle started crying as if his life was threatened.
He exerted so much force that he nearly passed out.
Concubine Rong was shocked. She had never seen the child cry so miserably since he was born.
How can Gu Shao not work hard?
In a toxic environment full of mercury, it is still a question whether he can survive past his first birthday.
Although there is no evidence, Gu Shao heard people say in modern times that the emperor of a certain dynasty had children who died one after another, and even the emperor himself was not in good health. It is probably because he used cinnabar as paint to paint the red walls.
The maids and wet nurses around Concubine Rong came forward one after another, looking at and touching Gu Shao with nervous expressions. Finally, even the imperial physician was alarmed. After the imperial physician came to check, it was found that there was nothing abnormal about the little prince except that he was a little stunted.
The imperial physician couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Thinking back to what had just happened, when Imperial Concubine Rong looked as if she was going to tear you to pieces if you can’t cure him, the imperial physician groaned inwardly.
In the past, Concubine Rong was difficult to deal with, and now that she has a little prince, she is even more difficult to deal with.
After staring at the baby for a while, the imperial physician tentatively guessed, “Perhaps… the little prince doesn’t want to leave the imperial concubine?”
Upon hearing this, Concubine Rong frowned and was about to put the swaddling clothes on the bed again.
Sure enough, the little thing started crying again as soon as it touched the quilt.
After this happened several times, Rong guifei completely lost his temper.
The imperial physician heaved a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, I guessed it right.
“How troublesome.” Concubine Rong couldn’t help but mutter, but she didn’t seem angry. Instead, she seemed to enjoy it.
The nanny at the side couldn’t help but joked: “The little prince is close to the imperial concubine and can’t leave her.”
Concubine Rong burst out laughing.
Gu Shao: “…”
Ah, this…
Forget it, as long as you are happy.
The imperial physician standing by realized that he had nothing to do here and withdrew tactfully.
The moment the curtain was opened, in a corner where no one noticed, the imperial physician couldn’t help but let out a sigh.
A loving mother often spoils her son. With the way the imperial concubine raises children, it would be strange if the Ninth Prince does not have problems when he grows up.
Shaking his head, the imperial physician left Qiuwu Palace without stopping.
Gu Shao didn’t know whether the imperial concubine would spoil him by doing this. He only knew that if the imperial concubine hadn’t been reluctant, her son might not even have the chance to grow up.
Because Gu Shao was too resistant, Concubine Rong simply decided to keep him in the main hall until he was one year old.
The nanny next to her wanted to say that it was against the rules, but she directly refuted it: “I want to see which little hoof dares to gossip.”
Since she said so, what else can Mammy say?
Gu Shao lay on his mother’s soft big bed, happily playing with the longevity lock around his neck.
The longevity lock was sent from the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion on the third day of the baby’s birth. It was said that his grandfather had specially asked the best carving master to carve it.
In his previous life, Gu Shao was quite knowledgeable. This longevity lock felt warm to the touch and was obviously made of top-quality material.
Gu Shao couldn’t help but feel a great favor for this grandfather whom he had never met.
Just when he was feeling drowsy from the heating in the house, a report suddenly came from outside.
It turned out that the emperor sent someone to deliver something.
Tsk, my cheap dad finally remembered to ask for compensation?
Looking at the various rare treasures being brought into the house one by one, Gu Shao had to admit that his cheap father probably spent a lot of money this time.
These things are rare even for the emperor.
However, Gu Shao really didn’t care about these mere external objects.
“Your Majesty, these were specially selected by the Emperor. Look at this oriental pearl, it’s bigger than the tribute this year… And this unicorn, look, its quality is so good, the Emperor spent a lot of effort to find it…” Wang Ziquan was worthy of being someone close to the Emperor, and he praised several items to the sky.
Gu Shao was not very interested at first, but when he heard that the emperor had taken great pains to find the raw materials and had the craftsmen from the Imperial Household Department carve it, he immediately became interested.
“Ahh.”
Seeing the little prince stretching out his hand as if wanting it, Wang Ziquan was delighted. Without waiting for the nanny beside him to speak, he handed over the pair of green little unicorns.
This thing was originally meant for the Ninth Prince to play with. It would be great if the Ninth Prince was interested in it.
In the blink of an eye, Wang Ziquan had figured out how to describe it to Emperor Jingwen later, and also figured out what needed to be polished so that it would appear warm and joyful.
However, things did not develop as he imagined.
Wang Ziquan vaguely saw the little prince seem to wink at him, but when he looked closely, it seemed like an illusion.
The quality of the Jade Qilin is good, but it doesn’t have much water. However, it seems that this kind of dry green was more popular in ancient times.
I just don’t know what it would be like if it fell.
You can experiment.
Thinking of this, Gu Shao threw one of the Qilins out in front of everyone.
Halfway through his words, Wang Ziquan felt a flash before his eyes, followed by the sound of jade falling to the ground.
“Bang”, the Qilin fell to pieces.
Broken into pieces.
Broken.
…
The voice stopped abruptly, the smile on his face froze, and Wang Ziquan’s eyes suddenly widened.
Wang Ziquan subconsciously took a breath of cold air: “The things bestowed by the emperor cannot be destroyed, this, this, this…”
What should I do?
Really? There is still this rule?
Gu Shao raised his eyebrows.
The next moment, it was the familiar parabola again.
Good things come in pairs. Since that one is gone, there is no need to keep this one.
After a long time, looking at the mess on the ground, Wang Ziquan instinctively turned around.
Gu Shao looked at him innocently.
Sorry, my hand slipped.
Beating someone with a stick and giving him a sweet date, this is not enough for a sweet date.
Wang Ziquan broke out in a cold sweat, and in that instant, only one thought remained in his mind –
Finished.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Patience
chapters.content:
Eunuch Wang Ziquan felt that he had encountered the most difficult challenge in his career.
Because no one has ever had the courage to do this before.
Not to mention him, even Concubine Rong beside him was stunned.
After realizing what was happening, the eunuchs and palace maids around them knelt on the ground, their legs trembling and sweating profusely.
There was a dead silence in the air.
But Gu Shao on the side was still playing happily as if nothing had happened. Compared with others around him, he looked so comfortable.
As it happens, even if he was like this, no one dared to scold him.
In the end, Wang Ziquan didn’t even know how he walked out. He was just thinking frantically in his mind about how to report to the emperor later.
Oh my god, why did I do that just now? If I didn’t give him the pair of Qilin, wouldn’t everything be fine?
Wang Ziquan’s face turned pale, and he wished he could slap himself twice.The eunuch behind him was like a mute, not daring to say a word. He almost dug out his eyes and pretended that he didn’t see it.
However, no matter how slowly they walked, the road from Qiuwu Palace to Qinzheng Palace was only so long, and Wang Ziquan and the other eunuchs still had to face reality.
After standing at the door for two full breaths, Wang Ziquan finally mustered up the courage to lift the curtain in front of him.
He can’t be slow, after all, the emperor is still waiting for him to come back and report.
As expected, Emperor Jingwen had not rested yet late into the night and was still reviewing memorials with the lights on.
Emperor Jingwen was much more diligent than the previous emperor, but also much more strict.
If it were the late emperor, Wang Ziquan might not have been so panicked.
Such a thought flashed through his mind quickly, and before Emperor Jingwen looked over, Wang Ziquan had already secretly put in his utmost effort.
The next moment, a voice followed closely –
“Has the stuff been delivered?”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even raise his head. In his opinion, rewarding the women in the harem with some rare treasures was not a big deal.
“It’s delivered…”
Noticing the eunuch’s nervousness, Emperor Jingwen paused holding the pen and asked, “Why? The imperial concubine doesn’t like it?”
While speaking, Emperor Jingwen’s brows had already frowned quietly.
“No, no, no.” Wang Ziquan waved his hands repeatedly: “Your Majesty, Imperial Concubine liked it. The Imperial Concubine likes it very much, especially the box of pearls. The Imperial Concubine said that she will ask the people in the Ministry of Internal Affairs to make some jewelry for her to wear tomorrow.”
“Oh?” Emperor Jingwen felt relieved all of a sudden, and his brows relaxed.
“What about the little Qilin? Have you told the imperial concubine? I had to find the material with great difficulty when I was the crown prince.”
The Qilin he had created had been on his desk for more than ten years.
So Emperor Jingwen wanted to give the child something precious. He heard that the child was born prematurely, so he wanted him to share in the blessing.
It would have been better if Emperor Jingwen hadn’t said anything. After he said that, Wang Ziquan’s heart suddenly tightened.
Here it comes, the biggest test is finally here!
“Hmm? Why don’t you say——”
Before Emperor Jingwen finished speaking, Wang Ziquan could no longer bear it and knelt down with a thud: “Your Majesty, that Qilin, that Qilin… fell, fell…”
Facing the gaze of Emperor Jingwen, Wang Ziquan suddenly prostrated himself on the ground.
The next moment, the emperor’s furious voice was heard –
“Bold!”
“How dare Concubine Rong disrespect the emperor!” The things bestowed by the emperor symbolize favor and glory. When you take them back, you can only keep them and never knock or bump them. If you knock or bump them, you will be beheaded, not to mention just throwing them away.
Emperor Jingwen felt his anger rising to the top of his head: “It seems that I have spoiled her too much on weekdays. Someone come!”
“Yes!”
Seeing that something serious was about to happen, Wang Ziquan spoke at the fastest speed in his life: “Your Majesty, it’s not the imperial concubine, it’s… it’s the little prince!”
Because Gu Shao is still young and has not yet been given an order of seniority, he is simply called the little prince.
Emperor Jingwen was stunned: “…You mean, it wasn’t the imperial concubine who dropped it, but the little prince?”
“Yes.” Wang Ziquan told the whole process without hesitation.
Emperor Jingwen was stunned for a moment.
If they were imperial concubines, they could be dealt with. Even if they were not imperial concubines but the eldest prince, Emperor Jingwen would definitely punish them severely.
But… the little prince is only a few days old now, what should we do?
The guards on the side waited for a long time without any follow-up, and the head guard could not help but ask tentatively: “Your Majesty, look at this… do you still want to order punishment?”
Penalty? How?
It is ridiculous to punish a child who can’t even speak.
“…No need.”
Emperor Jingwen sat down with a stern face, and no one noticed that his heart was bleeding at this moment.
There are some that are of better quality than the Qilin. He has a lot of them in his private vault.
But this Qilin is more commemorative, as it has been with him for ten whole years.
But what could Emperor Jingwen do?
Resisting the urge to vomit blood, Emperor Jingwen waved his hands to everyone: “…Everyone, please leave. Let me be quiet for a while.”
Unable to control himself, he asked again: “Did the little prince really dropped it?”
Wang Ziquan nodded: “Absolutely true.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
In the Qiuwu Palace——
After Eunuch Wang and the others left, Concubine Rong raised her hand to spank her son: “How dare you throw anything? Do you want to die?”
The nanny beside her was shocked when she saw this: “Your Majesty, you can’t do this!”
Such a young child, it would be a shame to beat him up again.
However, Concubine Rong was just pretending and didn’t use any strength in the slap.
Sitting down on the bed, Concubine Rong looked worried: “What should I do?”
Even she should know that damaging something given by the Emperor is a grave sin.
Back then, her father received a wine cup as a gift from the late emperor, and even built a shrine to worship it. However, she and her brothers and sisters-in-law were not allowed to even look at it, let alone touch it.
But this little thing is so brave that it not only touches but also throws things down.
Now that Qiuwu Palace is in this state again, how can Concubine Rong not be worried?
Seeing this, Gu Shao on the side still showed no sign of remorse.
It’s not that he came from modern times and doesn’t know the majesty of the imperial power. The main reason is that he is just a child, and the emperor’s biological son.
No matter how petty the emperor was, he would never beat him.
Since he couldn’t hit or scold his son, the little prince, the emperor could only endure it.
What happened next was similar to what Gu Shao had guessed. The emperor didn’t say anything and there was no punishment.
It’s just that he hasn’t looked very happy since he went to court for the past few days.
Gu Shao then silently added a sentence to the label of the emperor in his heart:
He is not a tyrant who does not know right from wrong. If you are a little careful, you can bully him.
At the same time, the harem was in an uproar.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Regret
chapters.content:
Originally, the matter of Concubine Rong’s childbirth was almost becoming a joke in the palace.
Everyone knows now that Concubine Rong had a hasty labor and almost gave birth in the Imperial Garden.
Just by listening to other people’s descriptions, the concubines could imagine how miserable Concubine Rong was at that time.
She is a noble concubine with graceful appearance and extraordinary temperament!
If this were mentioned in public, you can imagine how interesting the imperial concubine’s expression would be.
Unfortunately, no one had the courage to do so. If they were torn apart by the angry and humiliated imperial concubine, it would be a waste of time and effort.
They thought that the Emperor would be very pleased with the birth of a son, and with his favor, it would not be difficult for her to be conferred with the title of Imperial Noble Consort.
The Queen of Changchun Palace was so nervous that she couldn’t sleep for several nights. What was unexpected was that after Concubine Rong gave birth to a healthy prince, her rank was not promoted, but she was treated with unprecedented coldness.
It would have been fine if the emperor was busy handling government affairs on the day of the birth, but he didn’t even attend the subsequent third-day bathing ceremony, which clearly showed that he didn’t value this prince.
Even the powerful Duke Zhen was severely reprimanded for this.Thinking back to the day when the imperial concubine was about to give birth, she had an argument with the emperor. Everyone felt that the imperial concubine might have been too petty and eventually angered the emperor.
There were too many people in the palace who were laughing at the joke, and only a very few people with discerning eyes understood that this was not the case.
There is no way the emperor would punish the imperial concubine for such a small matter. After all, the root of the problem lies with the little prince.
If only the crown prince hadn’t saved Concubine Rong.
The two groups of people couldn’t help but think so at the same time.
After noticing the emperor’s attitude, everyone was waiting to see Qiu Wu Palace make a fool of himself.
Let’s see how proud she will be in the future!
Without the emperor’s blessing, can the imperial concubine still be the imperial concubine she used to be?
It was not until today, when the little prince smashed the pair of emerald unicorns, that everyone suddenly woke up.
No matter how much the emperor dislikes him, the prince is still a prince after all. He is the emperor’s bloodline and is different from a concubine.
Even if the other party dropped the gift from the emperor, the emperor would not say anything. What if he tried changing a concubine?
To put it bluntly, some concubines had not been in the palace for as long as the pair of unicorns!
At the thought of this, the atmosphere of gloating in the harem suddenly wilted like a popped balloon.
In the Qiuwu Palace——
When Concubine Rong heard that rumors about her had been circulating in the palace, she was so annoyed that it was beyond words.
“What’s so funny about women giving birth? It’s as if they don’t have this day!”
“If it were their turn, they might be worse than we!”
Just like the founding emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty, wasn’t Emperor Gaozu born in the wild?
At that time, Gaozu’s mother was working in the fields and had no time to return home, so she found a haystack and gave birth to the child on her back.
Gaozu was still healthy and eventually led troops to fight and became emperor.
There were also women who gave birth in carriages, under willow trees, in pavilions, and in Buddhist temples… Do these women not want to live?
Seeing that Concubine Rong thought this way, the nanny and Gu Shao beside her both felt relieved.
That’s right, it’s just a woman giving birth, it’s such a normal thing, is there any need to make such a fuss about it?
Nanny and Gu Shao nodded in agreement secretly.
After getting angry, Concubine Rong said indignantly: “Just wait for me!”
When the little one grows stronger and is two months old, she will take it out. They will be so envious then.
Concubine Rong secretly made a decision in her heart that she would make sure they looked good when the time came.
On the other side, the Qinzheng Hall——
After listening to the report from the man in brown clothes, Emperor Jingwen was speechless and put down the imperial brush in his hand: “In your eyes, do I have such a leisurely life every day?”
Even the trivial matters in the harem had to be reported to him.
It’s nothing more than a sour quarrel between women, which is really not worthy of being discussed in public.
The man was immediately stuck when he heard this.
But, apart from this, there really isn’t anything important happening in the harem recently…
“Okay, you can leave now.” As if sensing the other party’s confusion, Emperor Jingwen waved his hand impatiently. He still had to continue reviewing memorials.
“Oh, right.”
Then he thought of something, and just before the other party disappeared, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but add: “If it’s still like this in the future, there’s no need to come here and talk to me.”
“…yes.”
After the man left, Emperor Jingwen subconsciously reached for a corner of the jade table, but as expected, his hand found nothing.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
…I forgot that the pair of emerald unicorns are no longer there.
Now, in his spare time, he doesn’t even have anything to play with.
After a long time, Emperor Jingwen could not help it and asked Wang Ziquan to bring a pair of lions and place them on it.
But this new one is not as convenient as the old one after all.
While reviewing memorials, Emperor Jingwen became distracted, which was rare for him.
The days passed one by one, and more than a month passed in the blink of an eye.
During this month, the emperor did not come once, and he looked like he would not give up until he had clearly drawn a line between himself and this son who was not part of his plan.
He loved the crown prince to the core.
At first, Concubine Rong would cry and make a fuss, and even sent people to block the emperor. However, because she went too far, she was almost accused by the emperor of spying on him. After that, Concubine Rong never dared to do that again.
If it were in the past, Concubine Rong would have felt as miserable as if she were dead if she was treated like this by Emperor Jingwen.
When she was first welcomed into the palace, Concubine Rong would be sad for a long time whenever Emperor Jingwen did not come to Qiuwu Palace.
Even before she gave birth, when she was pregnant, Concubine Rong would feel jealous all night when she saw Emperor Jingwen visiting the newly selected beauties.
But now…for some reason, Concubine Rong always felt that the feelings in her heart were not as strong anymore.
The main reason is that the little guy is really too active and can’t sit still. He often wants to be hugged and touched. Even hugging and touching is not enough. I also have to kiss his face from time to time and play close to him.
How could there be such a clingy little thing in this world?
Perhaps because she was too busy, Concubine Rong gradually forgot to be sad.
She has been obsessed with making a hat for Gu Shao recently.
The reason was that she was afraid that his head would be cold, so Su Xin wrapped a handkerchief around him when she opened the window for ventilation. Then, Concubine Rong seemed to have opened the door to a new world, and suddenly became interested in Gu Shao’s head.
The child is like a snowball, with tender and smooth skin, and looks good in anything he wears.
Even Concubine Rong’s dog-eat-dog craftsmanship now seems amazing. No wonder she is interested in these things.
“The little prince has become more and more handsome recently.” Since the 20th day, the baby’s appearance has changed almost every day, which surprised the nanny beside him.
“If we wait until the future, when the little prince reaches the age to get married, I wonder what the situation will be like.” But I don’t know if the two of them will be able to see that day.
The two maids had smiling faces, and there was no sign of regret in their hearts.
“When he comes to discuss marriage in the future, I will make sure to choose carefully for him. Girls who are not from aristocratic families will not be selected. Even girls from famous noble families will not be able to catch my eye.” Concubine Rong was extremely picky.
Gu Shao discovered that his mother in this life was not only a villain, but also a very difficult mother-in-law.
In modern times, the woman would be able to run for a train at night in no time.
…If this continues, can his cheap dad’s patience really last until he grows up?
Just when Gu Shao was thinking about something, the imperial edict finally arrived.
Gu Shao is now one month old. Even if his stepfather is still holding him back, it is time to give him a name.
Otherwise, you can’t let his mother call him “little thing” all the time, right?
——Ye Shuo.
He is not very outstanding, and even seems very mediocre compared with the eldest prince Ye Liancheng, the second prince Ye Hezhi, and the crown prince Ye Chengzuo.
Three words have become two words, the contrast is too obvious.
As expected, the closer it gets to the end, the more perfunctory they become. I really wonder if my cheap father has a few more children, will they just become passersby like Ye Yi?
Gu Shao, who has changed his name to Ye Shuo, didn’t think it was a big deal. After all, his cheap father has been hypocritical for a long time.
But Concubine Rong obviously couldn’t accept it.
She could tolerate Emperor Jingwen’s inexplicable neglect, but she would never accept her children being treated differently.
But now she really had no other choice but to swear secretly –
“Sooner or later I will let him know that the child he favors is nothing comparable to this little thing!”
The former Gu Shao, the current Ye Shuo: “…”
That’s not necessary.
Really, I can bear it.
Change your way of thinking. It’s difficult to step on everyone, but it’s easy to be more useless than everyone else. You can still achieve your goal.
By then, my cheap dad will still regret giving me such an ordinary name…
Perhaps because she was feeling resentful, Concubine Rong was dissatisfied with everything recently and even couldn’t stand staying in Qiuwu Palace.
Choosing a rare sunny day, Concubine Rong asked a nanny to hold the child, and the group went out in a grand manner.
Sometimes, people can only see people who are luckier than themselves, but cannot see people who are less fortunate than themselves.
Just like Concubine Rong, she could only see the eldest prince, the second prince and the crown prince who had good names, but she couldn’t see the fourth prince who had a name even more perfunctorily than her own son.
Ye Ming is the sixth prince born to an ordinary palace maid. He just turned five this year and has just been ranked. Because his mother was of humble origin, he was like a nobody. After the death of the palace maid, Emperor Jingwen did not even point out a foster mother for him. His name was also randomly given to him when he happened to look up and saw the plaque above his head when he named the 6th prince.
Normally, the Sixth Prince and his maidservant never dared to meet the ladies, for fear of causing a conflict. But today, by coincidence, they happened to meet the one whom they could not afford to offend the most.
The Sixth Prince immediately noticed the silk swaddling clothes in the Nanny’s arms. The pattern on the swaddling clothes alone was worth more than his entire body.
After just one glance, the Sixth Prince lowered his head and dared not look again.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Foul Language
chapters.content:
I am so envious of my younger brother, who has such a beautiful mother and a status that is born nobler than others.
The rank of Noble Consort is only below the Empress and the Imperial Noble Consort. Now that the position of Imperial Noble Consort is vacant, there is only the Noble Consort left.
If the Queen makes a mistake, the Imperial Concubine can perform the Queen’s duties, hence the saying that her position is equal to that of the Vice Queen.
Now in the entire palace, the only one whose status can be compared with the newborn prince is the crown prince.
The others, even the eldest prince, are slightly inferior to him.
Under such circumstances, it is not an exaggeration to say that Ye Shuo was born under the spotlight of everyone. Except for the crown prince, he is the most precious person in the entire palace.
Even though Concubine Rong has been a little unhappy recently, as long as her position remains, the little prince’s status will not be shaken.
This is why Emperor Jingwen has acted this way recently.
However, the Sixth Prince is only five years old now. Even if he is precocious, he can’t think so much in his little head.
He just simply felt that he was so envious…“Please, please be well, Madam Rong…”
When passing by, the slightly trembling and shivering sound of the child made the graceful and elegant Concubine Rong subconsciously stop.
In the past, she never paid attention to the people and things under her feet, but after giving birth to a child, she seemed to have suddenly become sensitive to children.
“Whose child is this? Why have I never seen him before?” Glancing at the ground, Concubine Rong noticed that the cuffs of the child’s clothes were frayed and no one was helping to sew them. She couldn’t help but frown.
The nanny beside him couldn’t help but blush after hearing this: “Your Majesty… this is the Sixth Prince…”
Then the nanny lowered her voice and said, “You have seen it before…”
“Really? Why don’t I have any impression of it?” Concubine Rong was puzzled.
Because at that time you never even lowered your head to look at the Sixth Prince, Your Majesty!
The Sixth Prince was young and small in stature. The nanny had noticed that every New Year when the palace maids took him to kowtow to the Emperor and the Empress, the Imperial Concubine had passed by him twice.
Before the Sixth Prince could even call out the stumbling Empress Rong, Concubine Rong had already disappeared.
Concubine Rong: “…”
“This is impossible, Mammy, please don’t slander me.” Concubine Rong flatly denied it.
There was no way she could be so cruel to a child.
Upon hearing this, the nanny looked at her helplessly and said, “How dare I lie to you?”
Concubine Rong was forced to accept the fact that she was once a scumbag.
Ye Shuo watched with great interest from the side.
Now that he is one month old, his ears can hear more clearly and his eyes can see farther, so he can fully see his mother’s embarrassment.
“Ahem…you should get up.” Seeing that the Sixth Prince really didn’t dare to say a word, Concubine Rong coughed lightly and spoke indifferently.
Caught off guard, the Sixth Prince was stunned.
In the past, Empress Rong never wanted to talk to me, so why today…
“I’m asking you to get up.” Concubine Rong was a little impatient.
The Sixth Prince was startled and stood still.
The palace maid beside him also felt her heart skip a beat.
When Concubine Rong saw them, she became even more displeased. She was not that scary at all. Why were the two of them like quails?
If it were in the past, Concubine Rong would have turned around and walked away without even looking at the two of them, but today, for some reason, she actually asked a few more questions: “It’s still so cold, why are you wearing only two pieces of clothing and coming out? Are the servants being so slow?”
Looking at Ye Shuo in the nanny’s arms, he was wrapped in three layers of clothes. He was neither too hot nor too cold, but very warm.
Hearing this, the maidservant beside the Sixth Prince turned pale and fell to her knees with a plop.
The imperial concubine suddenly asked this what should we do…
The palace maid couldn’t help but secretly glance at the face of the Sixth Prince next to her, and a hint of pleading flashed in her eyes.
To say that she did not serve him wholeheartedly would be a lie. The prince was still a prince after all, and he was not someone that servants like them could humiliate.
But if I say I have done my best, it would be a lie.
By following other princes, her future would be bright and rewards would be inevitable. However, following the sixth prince of low status, she would get nothing.
As time went by, the palace servants around him naturally became negligent.
“No need to look at him, I want to hear what he says himself.” Concubine Rong gave a look, and the young eunuch next to her did not hesitate and pressed the maid to the ground.
Sensing that something was wrong, the maid could not help but plead loudly, “Sixth Prince, Sixth Prince, save me!”
There was an obvious struggle in the child’s eyes, but after a long time, the struggle calmed down again, and the initial timidity was much less.
“Thank you, Madam Rong.”
Under Concubine Rong’s playful gaze, the Sixth Prince bowed to her politely.
“It’s just that the palace servants were negligent. It’s not their fault. If I can stand up, they naturally won’t dare to stand up. If I can’t stand up, it won’t make any difference no matter how many batches of palace servants I change.”
Is this really something a five-year-old could say?
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but be a little surprised.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at him. Two seconds later, Ye Shuo’s eyelids twitched violently.
Although the child in front of him was weak, he was also patient.
Although he was shivering, his eyes were bright, as if there was a fire hidden in them.
…This person is definitely not content with the status quo, and will most likely become an ambitious person in the future.
Ye Shuo made this judgment in his heart.
Concubine Rong, who was standing by, was also shocked when she heard this, but she was not panicked because this child was far inferior to her son.
Although the Sixth Prince’s words did not arouse Concubine Rong’s sense of crisis, they did arouse her interest, the kind of interest that comes from teasing a pet.
“It just so happens that I am going to take Shuo’er out for some fun today, so you can come along.”
The tone, which sounded like alms, made the Sixth Prince a little stunned. However, before he could say anything, Concubine Rong and her entourage were ready to leave.
After hesitating for a long time, the Sixth Prince finally followed.
They said they were playing together, but in fact it was just the Sixth Prince playing with Ye Shuo.
Although Ye Shuo is only one month old now, Concubine Rong has already found a future follower for him.
Concubine Rong was planning to let her son sit in that position. If she wanted to compete with the Crown Prince, she had to find help. The Sixth Prince, who was of humble status, was a good choice.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Realizing what his mother was thinking, Ye Shuo was speechless.
Who would dare to want such assistance?
Maybe instead of providing assistance, I’ll just give up and let this guy reap the benefits.
Concubine Rong didn’t think too much about it, but subconsciously felt that the poor little thing would definitely not dare.
They arrived at a lawn, where someone had laid out several thick layers of bedding. Then the nanny slowly and carefully placed the little prince in her arms.
When the Sixth Prince was pushed over, he was confused at first. After he came to his senses, he couldn’t help but clench his palms.
When the Sixth Prince guessed what Concubine Rong meant, his first reaction was humiliation, but soon he thought of something and his eyes gradually became calm.
When you lower your head and raise your head, you see two different faces.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Good job.
In this case, he might as well borrow Concubine Rong’s power. At the very least, his situation will be better than it is now.
An idea suddenly flashed through his mind, and the Sixth Prince understood the pros and cons as if he had learned it by himself.
Soon, the Sixth Prince took the rattle handed to him by the nanny very naturally.
When Concubine Rong saw this, she couldn’t help but nodded with satisfaction.
Ye Shuo’s face was full of black lines.
It is a beautiful spring day today, and many concubines have come to the Imperial Garden. Each of them is dressed up carefully, as if they want to blend into the spring.
Since Concubine Rong can remember to take her children out to bask in the sun, others can naturally do so as well.
The fourth prince and the fifth prince were the sons of Concubine Xian and Concubine Shu respectively. Because their mothers had a good relationship, the two often stayed together.
As for the Seventh Prince, he was the child of Xu Guirong from Concubine Shu’s palace. Since they came from the same palace, the Fifth Prince would often play with the Seventh Prince, who was only four years old.
It was said to be playing, but in fact it was just not ‘playing’ with the Seventh Prince.
The Fifth Prince often bullied the Seventh Prince because he was young and ignorant, and the Fourth Prince kept shaking his head when he saw this.
The fourth prince, who was already ten years old, reminded the fifth prince many times, but the fifth prince never changed his ways and turned a deaf ear to the warnings.
The two were about to quarrel again. Seeing that his fourth brother was about to get angry again, the fifth prince quickly diverted his attention: “Fifth brother, look who’s coming?”
The fourth prince frowned: “You are trying to play tricks on me again——”
“I really didn’t lie this time. If you don’t believe me, just look!” The fifth prince wanted to turn his head away.
But thinking of his brother’s character, the Fifth Prince immediately gave up the idea.
The Fourth Prince then turned around doubtfully.
It turned out to be the newly born prince.
The news of the little prince’s birth has spread throughout the harem, and the excitement has lasted for a whole month.
However, the fifth prince was somewhat disdainful.
He is also the son of the emperor, how precious can he be?
The fifth prince was spoiled by nature, so he was naturally dissatisfied when he heard such news.
He rolled his eyes and looked at the little baby lying there. Suddenly, an idea came to his mind: “Why don’t we…”
“Don’t even think about it!” The Fourth Prince rejected it without hesitation.
“I’m warning you, Concubine Rong is not someone you can afford to offend. You’d better give up this idea.”
The fourth prince was already old enough to know affairs at the age of ten, and he had long since learned how to behave.
But how could the Fifth Prince listen to him?
“If you don’t want to do it, I can do it by myself, right?”
“You–” Seeing that he not only did not stop, but became more and more aggressive, the Fourth Prince threw his sleeves in anger and walked away.
The fifth prince couldn’t help but make a face at his back.
But having said that, you really can’t do this by yourself.
When the fifth prince lowered his head, he happened to see the confused seventh prince.
In an instant, the Fifth Prince came up with a plan.
On the other side, Ye Shuo was basking in the sun comfortably, thinking that it was great to be a child. If he were an adult, he would never be so carefree.
As for the two sneaky figures on the rockery not far away, Ye Shuo didn’t take them seriously. He just thought that they were princes from a palace just like himself.
The opponent’s hiding skills are really not that good. Look, even the Sixth Prince beside him discovered it.
After a few breaths, the other party seemed to throw something over.
Seeing those parabolas, Ye Shuo instinctively felt that something was wrong.
Su qiu also felt something and couldn’t help but exclaim.
The Sixth Prince was stunned at first, then he used his body to tightly block the swaddling clothes that were so close to him.
Ye Shuo’s eyes blurred, and then he saw the Sixth Prince’s tense little face.
“Gulu”, something fell on the lawn.
It turned out to be a small stone.
The Sixth Prince himself didn’t know what he was thinking. By the time he reacted, he had already picked up one of the bullets. While no one was paying attention, he gritted his teeth and scratched his forehead with it.
The next second, blood gushed out.
Then came the angry scolding of Concubine Rong and the voice of the nanny shouting to arrest people.
At first, the Fifth Prince didn’t take it seriously. It was just a handful of stones. What could go wrong?
He just doesn’t like the kid and wants to teach him a lesson, so what?
He and his fourth brother used to fight all the time when they were young. How come Concubine Rong’s son is so precious that he can’t be touched at all?
It was not until the Fifth Prince saw the child standing in front of the cradle looking back at him with blood on his face.
The fifth prince’s heart suddenly skipped a beat.
It’s over, something happened.
He instinctively wanted to run, but it was too late now.
He was caught red-handed by Concubine Rong.
The entire imperial garden suddenly became chaotic.
Looking at the Sixth Prince who was bleeding, then at the Fifth Prince who was calm and composed, and then at the Seventh Prince who was obviously tricked and now scared silly, Ye Shuo, who had watched the whole process, had his chest heaving and was stunned.
After two breaths, he couldn’t control himself and cursed fiercely in his heart –
Grass!!!!
[T/L NOTE:- Grass {slang} = An informer, police informer; one who betrays a group (of criminals, etc.) to the authorities.]

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Winner
chapters.content:
Each of them is a tough guy.
He is just a few years old, and he is already like this. What will happen when he grows up?
Ye Shuo felt his scalp tingling just thinking about it. This scene made him even more determined to never participate in the fight for the throne.
After hearing Su Qiu’s exclamation, Concubine Rong appeared in front of Ye Shuo almost immediately.
Subconsciously, she hurriedly pushed away the obstacle in front of her, and then nervously checked Ye Shuo’s condition, fearing that he might be hurt.
Seeing that the little baby only had a little dust on his face and was not injured, Concubine Rong breathed a sigh of relief.
She didn’t think too much about it at the time, so she didn’t notice what the obstacle was that she pushed away.
Caught off guard, the Sixth Prince felt himself being thrown away by a strong force. By the time he reacted, he had already fallen heavily to the ground.
Seeing that everyone was surrounding the little prince nervously, without even giving him a glance, the Sixth Prince was extremely silent for a while, then he brushed off the grass debris on his body and stood up.
Ye Shuo felt that he was being manipulated and was completely dizzy.After a long while, Concubine Rong finally remembered to look back, and then she saw the scratch on the Sixth Prince’s forehead.
Concubine Rong was stunned at first, then became furious.
If the Sixth Prince had not reacted in time, it would be her son who would have been injured!
Concubine Rong couldn’t bear to think about how painful it would be if such a long cut appeared on her son’s head!
The more serious the Sixth Prince’s injuries were, the angrier Concubine Rong became.
Without giving it much thought, she spoke loudly,
“Mammy Jing, Mammy Yu, the two of you, bring someone to capture those two people on the rockery!”
“Yes!”
The two maids received the order and rushed forward aggressively with a few young eunuchs.
The fifth prince and the seventh prince were caught red-handed.
When he was caught, the Fifth Prince remained very calm. After all, he was not the one who did it, so couldn’t he just push the responsibility away?
Unfortunately, the Fifth Prince was still too young and didn’t know that once someone determined you were guilty, no matter how you defended yourself, it would be useless.
Concubine Rong was almost laughing at his words: “How old is the Seventh Prince? Without your help, can he climb up the rockery?” Concubine Rong was a little impatient, but it didn’t mean she was a fool.
When the Fifth Prince heard this, he couldn’t help but secretly say “bad news”.
I actually forgot about this.
It was indeed he who pulled the seventh prince up there at that time.
However, the Fifth Prince remained calm, as he already understood what his status as a prince meant.
Even the Queen Mother would not punish them easily, let alone a mere Concubine Rong.
“You slave dogs, let me go quickly. If you hurt me and my brother, can you bear the consequences?”
As if he was saying this on purpose for Concubine Rong to hear, the Fifth Prince kicked the eunuch who was holding his arm.
After hearing this, the palace maids around did not dare to move anymore. They turned around and looked at Concubine Rong with embarrassment.
This… this is the emperor’s offspring. If anything goes wrong with him, they really won’t be able to explain.
Seeing them retreat, the Fifth Prince became even more proud, and even looked up at Concubine Rong provocatively.
I had heard from my mother a long time ago that this woman was rampant and annoying, and when I saw her today, she was just like that.
Just consider it as revenge for my mother.
Concubine Rong noticed his expression and her face turned blue with anger.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo, who was held tightly in Concubine Rong’s arms, couldn’t help but sigh.
This kid is still too young. If he didn’t live in this palace, there would be plenty of ways to torture him.
Ye Shuo, a newcomer, came up with a lot of ideas in just a few breaths, not to mention his mother, a veteran in the palace.
By then, the Fifth Prince would probably want his mother’s people to catch him and beat him up.
It is true that Concubine Rong may be short-sighted in some aspects, but she is really not stupid.
The Fifth Prince really pissed her off this time.
“Since you want to see it, I will let you see it today.” When it comes to arrogance and domineering, Concubine Rong is number one in the palace. Who is the Fifth Prince?
“Someone, please bring Concubine Shu and Xu Guirong over to me!”
The Fifth Prince finally started to panic: “What do you mean, what do you want to do by inviting my mother here???”
Silly child, my mother can’t touch you, but can’t she touch your mother?
Although Shufei and Xu Guirong were indeed innocent, especially Xu Guirong, her son was the one who took the blame, and she was also implicated, which was really miserable.
But now Ye Shuo couldn’t speak, so naturally he couldn’t plead for them mother and son. He could only spend more time with his mother, hoping that she would calm down soon.
When Concubine Shu received the news, her head suddenly buzzed.
Tell me, why would my own son provoke her for no reason?
Didn’t he see that even the Queen couldn’t do anything to her? He even attacked her son. What’s the difference between this and pulling out a tiger’s beard?
Shufei is already a mother, and she has also lost a child, so she naturally understands what the newborn little prince means to Rong Guifei.
She had no choice but to secretly ask her personal maid to pass the message to the emperor, hoping that the emperor would save them for the sake of the second prince.
About half an incense stick of time later, Concubine Shu and Xu Guirong hurried to the Imperial Garden. When they saw the blood-stained cloth on the ground, their hearts skipped a beat at the same time and their faces turned pale.
Then they took another look at the swaddling clothes in Concubine Rong’s arms… Fortunately, it wasn’t this child.
As for the Sixth Prince standing aside, he was subconsciously ignored by the two.
