The Sixth Prince couldn’t tell what he was feeling, he just felt that his little brother was becoming more and more dependent on him.
What should I do…
The Sixth Prince frowned slightly, looking a little distressed.
A night passed like this, and when Ye Shuo woke up the next day, there was no one around him.
There is no doubt that the Sixth Prince must have gone to the study.
Ye Shuo was in high spirits and let the palace servants change his clothes. After changing his clothes and washing up, he went out and happened to run into Emperor Jingwen who had finished his breakfast and was about to go to court.
When Emperor Jingwen saw him, he narrowed his eyes and said abruptly, “My dear concubine, please do not forget what you promised me yesterday.”
What did mom promise to cheap dad?
Ye Shuo was a little confused at first, but he soon understood.
It turned out that he was asked to move out of the main hall!
Originally, the emperor would not take such a small matter to heart, and he even brought it up on purpose when he came. He must have said that to make fun of himself on purpose.
Isn’t it because of what he said last night that this is revenge?
Tsk, childish.
Even if Emperor Jingwen didn’t mention it, Ye Shuo would have told it himself.
After all, he is already one and a half years old. Although he likes to stick to his mother, he is not a mama’s boy after all. It will definitely become more and more inconvenient for him as he grows up.
Especially now that his stepfather comes over occasionally, Ye Shuo is afraid that he might see something he shouldn’t see.
So after hearing what his cheap father said, Ye Shuo really didn’t feel anything at all.
Emperor Jingwen’s entire night of anticipation was dashed as he failed to get the reaction he had imagined.
The revenge failed, and instead Emperor Jingwen felt even more depressed.
This shouldn’t be the case. He is so close to the imperial concubine, shouldn’t he be crying and making a fuss?
Ye Shuo pretended to be indifferent. After a while, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t wait for what he wanted, so he left with a cold face and full of doubts.
“Farewell, His Majesty.” Imperial Concubine Rong and the palace maids saluted.
Looking at his back, Ye Shuo’s heart was filled with joy.
Want to see him make a fool of himself, tsk, my cheap dad is still a little naive.
After finishing his breakfast in a good mood, Ye Shuo went out for a walk as usual.
He is now one and a half years old. His legs and feet are much more agile than when he first learned to walk, and gradually he is no longer satisfied with staying in Qiuwu Palace.
Ever since the Sixth Prince went to the study, Ye Shuo had almost no time to play with him. Without someone to play with, Ye Shuo was inevitably bored, and on a whim, he thought of going out to take a look.
Ye Shuo decided to expand his range of activities by fifty meters.
He was also afraid of encountering danger and did not dare to leave too far. Besides, he was accompanied by Nanny and Su Yue, so Concubine Rong did not stop him.
Qiuwu Palace was relatively close to Emperor Jingwen’s Qinzheng Hall and Chengming Hall, so Ye Shuo was lucky enough to meet the crown prince on his way to court.
When the prince went to court in the morning, Ye Shuo was taking a walk.
The prince came back hungry at noon. Ye Shuo had already finished his lunch and was now eating the mung bean ice cream that Su Yue brought from the kitchenette of Qiuwu Palace.
The prince finished his lunch in a hurry, and was suddenly summoned by Emperor Jingwen when the sun was at its hottest in the afternoon. When he passed by, Ye Shuo was enjoying the cool air in a pavilion not far away. He was lying on a bamboo chair, and a palace maid was fanning him. The cool breeze blew by, and he felt very comfortable.
In the evening, the prince finally came back from the government meeting and ran into Ye Shuo squatting facing the sunset, playing in the mud. From time to time, Su Yue would break off a small piece of dessert and put it in his mouth.
Prince: “…………”
The prince was out of control and stopped abruptly.
[T/L = Referring to the crown prince.]

chapters.title: Chapter 21: The Crown Prince
chapters.content:
Noticing Su Yue’s hand stretched out in front of him, Ye Shuo opened his mouth without thinking.
“Ah……”
Ye Shuo didn’t feel embarrassed at all. It was normal for a one-year-old child to be fed.
The most important thing is that he was kneading the mud at the critical moment, and he couldn’t free his hands at all.
His little hands were so dirty that even if he wanted to eat it himself, Su Yue would not be happy.
His eyes didn’t even leave the clay figurine in his hand. He kept kneading it and eating the small piece of dessert in his mouth. After a while, Ye Shuo felt a little dry in his mouth, so he said, “Water, water…”
Su Yue hurriedly took the mung bean soup from the eunuch’s tray.
Mung bean soup is still warm, and drinking it in the summer is the best way to cool down.
Although mung bean ice is delicious, it is icy. Concubine Rong was afraid that the child was weak, and his stomach could not handle it, so she did not dare to let him eat more. Half a bowl a day was already the limit.
The little prince, who is already over one year old, has been carefully cared for by his nanny and wet nurse since he was one month old. The weakness caused by premature birth has gradually disappeared, and his body has become stronger and stronger.The little prince is very active and has a strong fire energy. He suffers the most from summer heat. A bowl of hot mung bean soup will probably make him even hotter.
Su Yue was prepared for the little prince to lose his temper, but… the little prince finished the whole bowl of mung bean soup. It was so hot that sweat broke out on his forehead, but he remained silent and focused on fiddling with the clay figure in his hand.
Su Yue felt at that time that there was no other child in the world who was easier to take care of than the little prince.
Of course, all this is based on the premise that he stays there and doesn’t move or run around.
Once he starts moving, ordinary people can’t resist him.
Su Yue is unmarried and has never experienced sex, so it stands to reason that she shouldn’t be overly maternal in love.
But who can resist an eyelash-lengthening green tea essence?
When the little prince is well-behaved, he is really well-behaved. The most important thing is that he can understand what others say, and he almost never makes trouble. He will not beat or scold his servants for no reason. If he wants something, he will just stand there and look at you eagerly, and then say pitifully: “Su Yue… want…”
Su Yue was no longer able to bear it at that time.
If it weren’t for the imperial concubine’s order, Su Yue would have fed him the whole plate of snacks.
Relying on his coquettish and naive nature, Ye Shuo can do whatever he wants in Qiuwu Palace.
After he finished drinking the bowl of mung bean soup, Su Yue was even considerate enough to use a handkerchief to wipe the soup stains on the corners of his mouth, and then she changed the handkerchief to wipe the sweat off his forehead.
“Here, here!”
Ye Shuo raised his chin, and Su Yue cooperated with him and wiped his neck.
The entire process was seen by the crown prince who was not far away.
Normally, the prince would not take such trivial matters to heart. This was the case almost every day, and he was often called by his father to participate in government affairs.
The prince never felt bitter, even at this moment. After all, not everyone can have such a blessing, and he is the only one in the world.
Didn’t you see that the eldest prince and the second prince were sharpening their heads, but the emperor never even looked at them?
Originally, the prince was happy from the bottom of his heart. The more his father was like this, the more it showed that he valued him. Even if it was a bit hard and tiring, the prince was willing to do it.
But for some reason, he didn’t feel as happy as usual today. Because of the scorching heat, he hadn’t had any water for several hours and his mouth was very dry.
When the prince came to his senses, he wanted to leave, but was seen by the sharp-eyed servant first.
“Greetings to His Royal Highness the Crown Prince. Greetings to His Royal Highness the Crown Prince.”
Su Yue was startled for a moment, then quickly picked up the little prince and saluted.
“Greetings to His Royal Highness the Crown Prince. Greetings to His Royal Highness the Crown Prince.”
“Hey, hey, hey!” Slow down, my clay figure!
The fruits of an afternoon’s labor were almost destroyed, and Ye Shuo hurriedly reached out to grab them.
The prince paused, and had no choice but to stop: “Well, get up.”
This is the second time I have seen my little brother since he was born.
The child has become even more handsome than when he was just born. He is worthy of being the son of the imperial concubine. His appearance is really impeccable.
Just as the prince was looking at Ye Shuo, Ye Shuo was also looking at him.
I haven’t seen him for more than a year. The boy who used to be a junior high school student has grown a lot taller and seems more reserved than before. Of course, his temperament has also improved.
After all, the other party had saved his and his mother’s lives. Also, when the Fifth Prince threw stones at him in the Imperial Garden, his mother severely punished Concubine Shu.
The fifth prince is still young, only eight or nine years old this year, and has not yet achieved much. But the concubine has an older son, the second prince, who is seventeen years old this year and has already participated in court affairs two or three years ago.
Although he is now the son of the imperial concubine and has a noble status, the other party has power and will not buy it at all.
As for the possibility that the second prince might not hold a grudge, that is basically impossible.
Firstly, there is a bond between mother and son, and secondly, in this palace, everyone prospers together and suffers together. How could the Second Prince not feel resentful?
He couldn’t count on his stepfather anymore. Ye Shuo estimated that he was no match for the Second Prince for now after checking his own strength. He had to find a way to get close to him. Although it was still early for him to leave, it was better to be prepared.
Prepare early to avoid being passive later.
So Ye Shuo didn’t even think twice, he raised his head, opened his mouth and said loudly: “Brother!”
The prince was shocked instantly.
He has many younger brothers, but no one has ever called him that before.
The prince moved his lips, feeling that it was unreasonable and seemed to want to correct it, but then he thought that he was just a child after all, how could he take a child’s words seriously?
When he grew up, he naturally became distant from me.
Others were like this before.
But since Ye Shuo had already spoken, the prince couldn’t keep a straight face any longer, so he squatted down and asked, “What are you doing here, little prince?”
Only then did Ye Shuo suddenly remember his clay figure.
Fortunately, it was not crushed and not broken.
Ye Shuo felt that his craftsmanship was pretty good, so he generously presented his work to him.
To be honest, Ye Shuo’s level is indeed quite good, and he is not like a real child.
The prince could clearly tell that this was the appearance of Concubine Rong; even the eyebrows and eyes were so lifelike, with a hint of charm in them.
But mud is just mud after all. Even if you can mold flowers into it, it is still mud.
The prince praised it casually, but he didn’t really take it that seriously.
In addition, it was getting late, and the prince was extremely hungry, so he wanted to leave.
Everything was fine, but the problem was that out of politeness, before leaving, he asked the little prince in front of him two questions as he would ask others normally –
“It’s getting late, has your Royal Brother already had dinner?”
Seeing the child shaking his head, the prince asked again: “In this case, why don’t you go with me to the East Palace to get some?”
“Yeah!”
“Since you don’t want to, just wait for another day. In that case, I will first… hm?” The prince replied halfway out of habit before he realized something was wrong.
Wait, what did he just say?
He agreed? ?
He actually agreed!!
Humph, it didn’t go as you predicted. Are you dumbfounded?
Ye Shuo had an innocent look on his face, and before the prince could react, he grabbed his hand in time: “Brother, brother… let’s go… let’s go…”
As he said this, the child pulled him and was about to leave.
The prince was a little confused. When he said this before, no one had ever really agreed. After all, who would take polite words seriously?
The prince now received the same lesson as Emperor Jingwen. This trick doesn’t work on children because they don’t understand what adults say and will really nod their heads.
Su Yue, who was standing by, was almost getting anxious seeing this. She couldn’t just say he couldn’t go, right?
Suspecting the crown prince is a capital crime.
But the sheep that was about to fall into the tiger’s mouth was completely unaware and even waved at them: “No, you are not allowed to follow me…”
“Go back… tell Mother, I won’t be back at night…”
His cheap father asked him to move out today, but time was too tight and Ye Shuo didn’t know how to tell his mother about the problem with the palace wall. He didn’t dare to live in a house with excessive heavy metal content. So Ye Shuo simply decided to stay in his cheap brother’s palace for a night first.
Anyway, the prince hasn’t married yet, so it won’t have much impact.
However, after understanding what he meant, Su Yue almost screamed out.
Little prince, he he he actually planned not to come back tonight???
Not to mention Su Yue, even the prince’s forehead began to sweat. He had not expected that his royal brother would dare to climb up by following the pole.
But there’s nothing I can do. The words have already been said. I can’t go back on my word, right?
So, in this situation, people who care about their reputation always suffer losses.
Su Yue watched the dazed crown prince and his attendants leave. After they disappeared completely, Su Yue ran towards Qiuwu Palace without a second thought.
“——My Lady! Something happened!”
The other side.
“Quick, quick…”
Hearing the child’s urging from time to time, the prince couldn’t help but wonder whether he should go back to his own palace or his palace?
Why does it feel like everything is upside down?
Qiuwu Palace is neither long nor short from the East Palace. It is not diagonally located, but it separates the two sides. In short, it is not something a one-year-old child can withstand.
When he had walked almost halfway, Ye Shuo suddenly stopped.
The prince’s heart also began to beat faster.
After what happened just now, the prince has become extremely alert.
Without making any noise, the prince spoke with a hint of expectation: “Shuo’er, do you regret it? How about… asking Mo Shu to send you back?”
How should I put it? The crown prince is still too naive.
He should have known the result when he took the initiative to invite me. It is too late to struggle now!
Ye Shuo was simply tired from walking.
He has never been a person who likes to swallow his grievances silently and pretend that nothing happened. Ye Shuo said what he wanted to say and took the initiative to open his arms to the prince: “Hug…”
Crown Prince: “…”
The crown prince’s face turned cold instantly.
Then he watched the child in front of him as his eyes filled with tears in just a few breaths, as if they were about to burst at any moment, and his nose even began to deflate in advance.
The crown prince’s scalp tingled, and he immediately picked him up from the ground.
Now the child stopped crying and sniffling, and he immediately became energetic. There was no trace of the tearful look just now.
Prince: “…………”
The prince suspected that he had been deceived.
No, I was definitely cheated!
At the same time, the Sixth Prince also returned from the study.
While walking on the road, he was still worrying about what to do since his little brother wanted to sleep with him tonight.
Although the little prince’s sleeping posture was not bad, the Sixth Prince still felt that he was delaying his studies.
Just when he was worrying about what to do, as soon as he stepped into the gate of Qiuwu Palace, the Sixth Prince heard such news—
The little prince went to the East Palace for dinner today, and he doesn’t plan to come back all night.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Free and Easy
chapters.content:
Logically speaking, the Sixth Prince should be very happy to hear this news.
Finally, no one came to disturb him.
But the fact was not so. Instead, the Sixth Prince felt inexplicably uncomfortable in his heart.
Now that my younger brother has another prince brother, does that mean he… no longer cares about me?
That’s right, people naturally love the crown prince more than him.
The Sixth Prince curled his fingers.
It just so happened that Concubine Rong really didn’t have the time to pay attention to him at this time, so the Sixth Prince said something to her and then left.
Returning to the side hall and opening the book, the Sixth Prince couldn’t calm down.
“…asshole!”
After all, the Sixth Prince was still young, and he couldn’t hide things very well. He became emotional and couldn’t help but pounded the table.The Sixth Prince thought that although he felt annoyed with him in his heart, he never showed it on his face.
He had become accustomed to asking about his younger brother’s well-being.
In the end, the little prince still did the same thing and followed the man he was told to go.
The point is, he had never met His Royal Highness the Crown Prince before.
The Sixth Prince gritted his teeth and said, “You little heartless thing…”
At this time, in the main hall of Qiuwu Palace——
Ever since Su Yue brought the news that her son was taken away by the prince and that the palace maids were not allowed to follow him, Concubine Rong has been a little at a loss.
Shuo’er doesn’t have anyone around him. What should she do if the crown prince wants to harm him?
The person involved was confused, but soon a word from the nanny beside her enlightened her.
“So many people saw the little prince follow the crown prince. If something really happens to the little prince, the crown prince will not be able to escape responsibility.”
So the crown prince would not hurt him but would protect him instead.
Only then did Concubine Rong suddenly wake up.
Soon, she fell into a new dilemma: “Then…then can we really let Shuo’er sleep in the East Palace for a night?” This, this is too shameful.
The nanny thought for a moment and said, “After dinner time, the queen should send someone to greet him. The little prince should still come back.”
How can a child of this age say that he doesn’t miss his mother?
When it would be completely dark, the child would start crying and make a fuss, asking for his mother.
So, Concubine Rong really believed it.
The other side.
The prince looked at the child sitting opposite him, eating with relish, and thought that the child had a very big heart.
Didn’t the imperial concubine teach him not to eat food given by strangers?
The same goes for the imperial concubine herself. She hasn’t sent anyone from the palace to say hello for such a long time. Isn’t she afraid that I will use this chance and find a way to harm him?
You know, there are many poisons in this world that can kill people but are still undetectable.
Holding the bowl and chopsticks, the crown prince seemed a little absent-minded.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about that and just ate the delicious food in front of him.
Although he wasn’t as messy as a real kid, Ye Shuo’s speed was not slow at all.
“This, this, and this…”
His small arms and legs made Mo Shu, who was standing beside him, very busy. Basically, before he put down his chopsticks, he would pick up new ones.
Ye Shuo used to think that the chefs in Qiuwu Palace were very skilled, not inferior to the chefs in modern five-star hotels.
It was not until today when he came to the crown Prince’s Palace that he realized that there is always a mountain higher than the other.
That’s right. After all, the imperial concubine is just a favorite concubine, while the prince is the future emperor. It is obvious which one is more important.
If the Eastern Palace is like this, I wonder what the real imperial chef is like. If I get the chance, I will definitely go to my stepfather’s palace to try it.
The most important thing is that as for the crown prince, he has never raised a child and will not restrict him at all. Ye Shuo can basically eat whatever he wants.
Ye Shuo, who hadn’t eaten greasy or meaty food for a long time, couldn’t control himself anymore.
So the prince watched helplessly as his little brother’s belly swelled up little by little.
“Hmm…” So full…
When he was about 80% full, Ye Shuo finally stopped.
Looking at the prince opposite, he had only eaten a bowl of white porridge so far, and Ye Shuo hardly saw him move his chopsticks.
“Brother, is it not to your taste?” This time Ye Shuo spoke more clearly.
The prince was stunned for a moment, then replied, “It’s just because the weather is hot, I have no appetite.”
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but take a look at the two huge ice basins placed in the hall. The amount of ice in these ice basins was even more considerable than that in his mother’s palace.
The crown prince is the future emperor, and his food, clothing and other expenses are only slightly inferior to those of the emperor and empress.
The East Palace is actually not hot at all, it’s even a little cool.
Ye Shuo understood. The child was not feeling hot at all, but was clearly under a lot of pressure, which was why he couldn’t eat.
Sixteen years old is still a child in modern times, and the law recognizes that. But now the sixteen-year-old prince has begun to participate in state affairs. How can he not be under pressure?
After dinner, it was already dark. Ye Shuo was carried by Mo Shu to take a hot bath, and then he finally waited for Nanny Jing to arrive.
Seeing the crown prince’s stiff expression, Ye Shuo decisively rejected Nanny Jing’s request to take him back to the palace. By the way, he also asked Nanny Jing to go back to Qiuwu Palace to pack some clean clothes for him to wear tomorrow.
Change of clothes…what does he mean???
The ominous premonition became stronger and stronger. The crown prince watched helplessly as his younger brother used his hands and feet to climb onto his bed and even waved at him.
“Brother, come quickly.”
The prince’s eyes went dark.
The nanny standing by felt relieved when she saw that her young master was full of life and more energetic than when he was in Qiuwu Palace.
If the little prince could live in the Crown Prince’s Palace for a period of time, it would also be a good thing for the palace servants in Qiuwu Palace.
They could finally take a good rest and no longer have to run around following the little prince.
When you think about it this way, this doesn’t seem like a bad idea.
So the nanny answered yes and turned around and left with her people.
The crown prince was immediately dumbfounded.
If he were given another chance, he would never say those two sentences.
What the prince regretted most was that he shouldn’t have stopped to look at them a little longer when he passed by, and was then discovered by the palace servants around his little brother.
Seeing how lively the little prince is, I guess he can’t sleep well either.
The prince was now prepared to have a sleepless night.
But when he actually lay down, the prince discovered that things were not as serious as he had imagined.
After all, Ye Shuo came here to stay for free, so he knew some basic etiquette.
Be quiet and peaceful, never make trouble, and never cause trouble to the owner.
So there was just a little meat ball next to the prince, and everything else was no different from usual.
Anyway, the bed in the East Palace is big enough, so it doesn’t matter if there is Ye Shuo again.
Even when the little meat ball got up at night, there was almost no noise. He knew to crawl down from his feet and tiptoe. If the crown prince had not been unable to sleep, no one would have even noticed him.
When Ye Shuo came back, he found that the prince had not slept at all.
It was already three o’clock in the morning and Ye Shuo had already taken a nap.
Normally he sleeps very well. If his child’s bladder did not allow it, he could sleep all night and till dawn.
The prince has started to suffer from insomnia at such a young age. I wonder if his hairline will be able to hold up in a few years.
The prince noticed that the child seemed to look up at his head. Before he could say anything, he saw his little brother lying down next to him, stretching out his little hand and gently patting his chest.
The prince’s mind moved, and after a moment, he asked: “…What are you doing?”
“Brother… go to sleep…”
It turned out that he was trying to coax himself to sleep.
“Is this how Concubine Rong usually coaxes you to sleep?” Looking at the curtain above his head, the prince didn’t know what he was thinking at the moment.
The prince vaguely remembered that his mother had coaxed him in this way when he was sick as a child, but after he started to remember things, she never did that again.
Ye Shuo was silent after hearing this.
That’s not the case. He doesn’t need anyone to comfort him when he goes to sleep. He falls asleep as soon as he touches the pillow.
However, it would be too cruel to tell this to an insomniac like the prince, so Ye Shuo decisively chose to keep his mouth shut.
“Are you… worried about me?” noticing the change in the child’s eyes, and the crown prince spoke tentatively.
This time Ye Shuo had no psychological burden at all and nodded heavily: “Worried…brother…”
Nonsense, whether he can continue to live such a pampered life and maintain such a standard of living all depends on his stepfather and his brother. How can he not worry about their health?
“Shuo’er… must… rely on brother…”
The crown prince misunderstood.
The crown prince was deeply moved.
So by the time the crown prince realized that he had been moved too early, it was already too late.
When the crown prince went to court in the morning, Ye Shuo was still sleeping.
When the crown prince came back at noon, Ye Shuo had finished his lunch and was taking a nap on the chaise longue.
When the crown prince left in the afternoon, Ye Shuo was drinking the bird’s nest brought from the East Palace’s kitchen. The bird’s nest needed to be soaked in advance, which took a long time, and it was not always possible to make it when the prince was free.
The crown prince left in a hurry, so Ye Shuo accepted the bird’s nest with a smile.
There is also the ice basin in the East Palace, which has a fixed quota every day. If the prince doesn’t use the ice, it will melt, and it cannot be shared with other people in the palace. If the prince uses it one day and there is no ice left, it would be the dereliction of duty of the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
So even though the crown prince himself was not there, the ice in the East Palace was still replaced every 12 hours.
Not to mention the kitchen, which also provides food in fixed portions. Even if it is not used up at the end of the month, there is no such thing as returning it. Some ingredients will go bad or rot and will have to be thrown away.
Ye Shuo felt that the crown prince especially needed someone to share the burden with him, otherwise it would be a waste.
Ye Shuo never caused trouble for his adopted brother. He only picked out the food that he couldn’t finish or didn’t have time to eat.
Anyway, Ye Shuo is thick-skinned and doesn’t care about that much.
But because of this, after a few days, the crown prince became depressed.
Because there was so much food that he didn’t have time to eat, and it all ended up in Ye Shuo’s stomach.
Even Emperor Jingwen noticed something was wrong and couldn’t help asking, “How has Shuo’er been these days?”
The news that the little prince was taken to the Eastern Palace by the Crown Prince had almost spread throughout the entire court.
The crown prince opened his mouth, but he really didn’t know how to start. Finally, he said helplessly: “I don’t know whether this is a good thing or not. Why don’t you… why doesn’t your majesty come to my palace and take a look in person?”
Emperor Jingwen initially thought that no matter how naughty a one-year-old child could be, there was a limit to how naughty he could be.
It was not until he stepped into the gate of the East Palace that he saw a recliner between two ice basins, and his youngest son was lying on the recliner.
Next to him was a musician kept in the palace, who was playing the guqin gently. The music was soft, melodious and very pleasant to the ears.
His little son opened his mouth from time to time, and every time he opened his mouth, a grape would fall into his mouth accurately.
As for the others who were fanning, reading, massaging shoulders and beating legs…there’s no need to mention them.
I don’t know what his hobby is, but there is someone who specializes in pinching his ears.
The always diligent Emperor Jingwen was immediately shocked by this scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Acting
chapters.content:
When the late emperor was alive, he indulged in pleasure, and therefore had a very bad reputation among the people.
Although he could not be called a tyrant, the extent of his being a tyrant was very limited.
But even so, the late emperor seldom allowed people to serve him like this. On the contrary, although his youngest son is only a little older this year, he has already surpassed his father, the late emperor.
With just one glance, Emperor Jingwen’s face turned pale, and then the following scene happened –
“The Emperor has ordered that the little prince be confined to his house for six months from today onwards. After he recovers, he is not allowed to enter the East Palace for a year. In addition, Imperial Concubine Rong has failed to educate her son properly, so she will be punished to serve for one month. I decree this!”
Ye Shuo knelt on the ground with his head lowered. When he heard that his adoptive father would not allow him to leave Qiuwu Palace within half a year, he could not help but raise his middle finger in his heart.
You can’t enjoy it yourself, and you don’t let him enjoy it either. Couldn’t his cheap dad afford to have fun?
When he was still in the Eastern Palace, Emperor Jingwen severely reprimanded him, saying that he was so arrogant and licentious at such a young age and was simply lawless.
God knows, how could he be so arrogant and extravagant, so ignorant of the sufferings of the world?
Even if he wasn’t there, the ice would have to be released. But with him around, the ice could be put to good use.And there is a team of musicians. They have been kept in the palace since the time of the previous emperor. Are you just keeping them and not using them, leaving them to collect empty salaries?
When he asked people to invite the musicians, those musicians were so idle that they had nothing to do. Because Emperor Jingwen was diligent, the entire harem did not dare to indulge in entertainment. Those musicians were not doing their jobs all day long. Wasn’t he just a disguised way of asking these people who were paid for nothing to tighten their strings?
As for grapes and the like, there’s no need to mention them. They were picked from the farms outside the capital and would soon rot before their turn to be eaten by his brother, the Crown Prince. Rare items like lychees were still lining up in front. A few bunches of grapes were nothing. How could they be called a luxury!
There were also people fanning, reading, and massaging… These were even more normal in the palace.
How did they combine to become an unforgivable crime in the eyes of my cheap father? I really don’t understand.
Also, what does it mean that he is not allowed to enter the Eastern Palace within a year? Why is he guarding against him like he is guarding against a thief?
He was only a little over a year old, how could he have led the crown prince, who was already sixteen years old and half an adult, astray? Is it possible? Is it possible?
Ye Shuo was quite angry.
Ye Shuo felt even more indignant when he thought that his wonderful life had been interrupted just two days ago.
I finally caught such an easy-to-talk-to prince, but the result… Alas!
While Ye Shuo was gritting his teeth and sighing, he didn’t know that Concubine Rong and the maids beside him were almost terrified. After hearing the content of the oral instruction, Concubine Rong’s eyes went dark, and she almost fainted.
House arrest order for a little kid who is just over one year old!
There seemed to have never been such a precedent in the Great Zhou Dynasty before, and her son was the only one.
What must he has done to make the emperor so angry!
“Your Highness, please accept the order and express your gratitude?” Eunuch Wang Ziquan had been watching the whole process from beginning to end, and his eyes were filled with amazement as he looked at the little prince.
This time, he really broadened his horizons.
For some reason, Eunuch Wang thought of his master, who had to get up before dawn every day to attend court. Not only did he have to deal with government affairs every day, but he also had to find time to appease the harem. Whenever something broke out outside, it was common for the emperor to not be able to sleep for two or three days.
The same goes for His Royal Highness the Crown Prince, who also has to get busy.
The two most powerful men in the world are not as free as a little kid… Realizing that he had seriously overstepped the boundaries, Eunuch Wang begged for forgiveness in his heart and quickly pulled his thoughts back.
Concubine Rong thanked him in a daze, but when she learned that her son was reluctant to come back because he didn’t like the room she had prepared for him, which led to such a disaster, she burst into tears.
“If you don’t like it, then don’t like it. Just tell your mother directly. At worst, you can ask the Ministry of Internal Affairs to tear it down and rebuild it…”
Concubine Rong didn’t think this was a big deal at all.
Perhaps she was a little sad that the little thing didn’t like the side hall she decorated with her own hands, but what made Concubine Rong most sad was that he was punished now.
She can’t care about anything else.
Ye Shuo never expected that he would end up losing himself just by using the luxury.
“I’m sorry, mother…”
Without noticing that her son could speak fluently all of a sudden, Concubine Rong took him into her arms, and the mother and son hugged each other and cried bitterly.
It’s just that Concubine Rong was crying about her son’s future, while Ye Shuo was crying about the house arrest order, and it would take him half a year to find a way to get back at his wits’ end.
The time span is too long, and he feels really unhappy.
But no matter what, we can’t just let this matter go!
It’s just half a year, he can wait.
Then the oral order spread like wildfire throughout the palace.
The little prince was under house arrest. As his biological mother, how could Concubine Rong be any better?
The honor and favor that was finally restored is likely to be lost again. What sin did the imperial concubine commit in her previous life? Could this child be here to collect the debt?
Moreover, once the word “arrogant, extravagant and debauched” was uttered, the child was most likely doomed. If they were imperial concubines, they would have been considering whether to give birth to another prince while they were still young and strong.
Instead of worrying about a child who is disliked by the emperor, it is better to raise a good one.
The consorts, the concubines, and the ladies, including the Queen, were all laughing behind her back.
“With a son like this, it will be difficult for the imperial concubine’s lineage to achieve success.” Gently brushing away the layer of foam on the teacup, several people thought so at the same time.
But they are not imperial concubines after all.
Concubine Rong did not feel burdened at all. Instead, she was worried about the child’s sensitive mind. What if he could not accept the scolding from his father for a while?
Haven’t you seen many princes who became devastated, depressed and even died because of this?
However, Concubine Rong soon realized that her worries were unnecessary.
Ye Shuo hasn’t had much reaction since he was confined to his room. He still eats and drinks as usual every day, and still runs and plays like before. Except for not being able to leave Qiuwu Palace, nothing else has changed.
The Crown Prince shared the same concerns as Concubine Rong, and since he was the one who led his father over, he felt even more guilty.
The crown prince had not expected that his father would be so angry, so after the house arrest order, he hesitated for a while, but finally sent the letter.
Then Mo Shu told him about the scene he saw of the little prince playing the ball-throwing game with the palace maids and eunuchs.
The crown prince discovered that his younger brother seemed to be no ordinary person.
The crown prince was silent for a moment, then asked, “…Anything else?”
“Uh… the young prince asked me to ask if the Crown Prince could give him the lychees that were newly tribute this year if he really has no appetite. The young prince said that the basket of lychees will go bad if they are not eaten…” Mo Shu gritted his teeth and repeated Ye Shu’s words, then lowered his head, not daring to look at his master’s expression.
The Crown Prince: “…”
After a long while, the prince finally spoke again: “Since he has spoken, give it to him.”
“Yes……”
The Sixth Prince felt mixed emotions after hearing that his younger brother was forcibly brought back by his father’s guards.
I didn’t expect that my little brother could cause so much trouble just by going for a free meal.
The most important thing is that he actually lived in the Prince’s Palace for so many days.
After the incident, the crown prince specially sent someone to deliver a basket of lychees.
If the Sixth Prince remembered correctly, the south sent a total of six baskets of lychees as tribute this year. Emperor Jingwen kept two baskets for himself, gave two baskets to the empress, two baskets to the crown prince, and the rest did not even belong to the imperial concubine.
Therefore, after Concubine Shu received the reward, the Fifth Prince was very proud in class. He kept fiddling with the five lychees over and over again without getting tired of it. Finally, the Fourth Prince couldn’t stand it anymore and said a few words to him, and the Fifth Prince finally restrained himself.
And now, he has lychees of his own.
After the little prince got the lychees, he first gave most to the imperial concubine, and then it was his turn.
A full basket weighs at least ten pounds, and he will get at least one or two pounds. One or two pounds can contain five lychees. If he takes it to the upper study tomorrow, it will definitely embarrass the Fifth Prince.
But in the end, the Sixth Prince did nothing.
He didn’t even eat the lychees. He waited until the lychees went bad without peeling even one.
Half a year is neither long nor short. In Ye Shuo’s opinion, it goes by very fast. It just flies by as he eats, drinks, plays and plays every day.
In the blink of an eye, Ye Shuo is already over two years old.
It was early summer on the day the ban was lifted. Ye Shuo changed into a thin shirt, and the moment the palace gate opened, he rushed out with a “whoosh”.
It’s been so long that he’s really getting frustrated.
No matter how big Qiuwu Palace is, it is only about one and a half acres of land. Now, the clay figures made by Ye Shuo can almost fill up the entire decorative shelf.
Su Yue and the others hurriedly followed behind him, fearing that something unexpected might happen.
But this time Ye Shuo did not do as they wished. Instead, he asked them to stay away.
Could it be that the little prince has begun to get tired of them?
Su Yue couldn’t help feeling a little sad.
But in fact, Ye Shuo had other intentions when he asked them to stay away, which was that he just couldn’t tell them for the time being.
“Let’s build a swing here.” The two-year-old child could already speak clearly, and Ye Shuo’s articulation also became fluent.
Although the young eunuchs were puzzled, since their master had already said so, they naturally had to do so.
Although the little prince had never had such an intention before, children always change very quickly. Maybe he heard about or saw a swing somewhere and wanted one too?
In this way, Ye Shuo wandered around for many days, and finally waited for the person he wanted to see most.
Emperor Jingwen habitually wore casual clothes. While relaxing in the imperial garden, he accidentally saw someone swinging on a swing.
He thought it was another trick thought up by one of the concubines in the harem, but when he got closer, he found out it was his own son.
Emperor Jingwen vaguely recalled that half a year had passed. If he remembered correctly, his youngest son had just celebrated his second birthday two months ago.
After such a long time, Emperor Jingwen was no longer angry.
It is inevitable for children to be greedy for enjoyment. I believe that after this six-month confinement, he should have corrected his behavior and will not commit the same mistake again.
But the child was sitting there alone, without even anyone to serve him, and this place was so secluded, weren’t they afraid of any accidents?
Yes, naturally no one would care about a prince who is disliked by the emperor.
The imperial concubine was probably taking her anger out on him because she was being ignored.
Having seen the ups and downs of the palace, Emperor Jingwen naturally knew that such things happened frequently, and useless people would be discarded like abandoned chess pieces.
But Emperor Jingwen could not have imagined that the imperial concubine would be like this.
…These dogs and slaves who presumptuously speculate on the emperor’s will!
When did he ever say in person that he wanted to give up his son!
Looking at the child who was almost unable to be born smoothly because of his own mistakes, and who finally survived but became like this now, no longer as lively as before, Emperor Jingwen felt a sudden pain in his heart and a surge of guilt. He wondered if he had spoken too harshly when he asked him to be confined to his home, which led to misunderstanding by others.
But there was not a single word about anything else in the oral instruction!
The words “arrogant, extravagant, and debauched” were also said behind people’s backs.
And in the past six months, he has never asked about it.
Emperor Jingwen walked quickly through the peach forest, waved away the branches in front of him, and just as he was about to say something, he saw the child looking up. He was first startled by the sudden appearance of someone, and then his face was full of confusion: “Who are you, and why are you here?”
Who are you…
who is he…
who…
After not seeing him for half a year, his youngest son, who is not even old enough to remember, can no longer recognize him!
It was not until this moment that Emperor Jingwen suddenly realized that six months was such a long time for a child.
Emperor Jingwen was shocked and then stood there in a daze.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Teasing
chapters.content:
“Tell me quickly, who are you? Otherwise, I will call for help!”
The child’s timid and panic-stricken look hurt Emperor Jingwen’s eyes even more.
He still remembered how willful and lively his son was half a year ago, but now he was like a wounded little animal licking his wounds alone in a corner.
Emperors are all suspicious and thoughtful people. Even the smallest details will be magnified infinitely in their eyes.
For such a young child, it is normal to forget someone after not seeing him/her for just one or two months, let alone half a year.
Emperor Jingwen fell silent, suddenly not knowing how to start.
Wang Ziquan, who was standing by, didn’t think too much about it, and subconsciously reminded him: “Your Highness, this person is…”
“Step back.” However, before he could finish, Emperor Jingwen interrupted him.
Wang Ziquan was stunned.
Ignoring the reaction of his personal eunuch, Emperor Jingwen walked straight forward. Wang Ziquan quickly understood his master’s intention and hurriedly retreated with the eunuchs and palace maids.The Emperor probably wants to repair his relationship with the young prince.
It seems that the emperor still cares about this son.
Wang Ziquan thought about it for a moment, and then he had an idea.
It seems that the little prince’s blessings are far from over, and they are just speculating recklessly.
Fortunately, he had not been disrespectful to Qiu Wugong before. After recalling the past, Wang Ziquan realized that he had been extremely polite to the imperial concubine no matter when she was in glory or in decline. He immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
“Be careful in the future, think carefully before doing anything, and don’t offend people you shouldn’t offend. Do you hear me?” Looking around, Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but remind him.
The other palace maids and eunuchs had now figured out what was going on and quickly agreed.
The other side.
Although Emperor Jingwen had many children, this was the first time he faced such a situation.
A child used to be lively and willful, but now he is timid and submissive. Such a big contrast has brought a strong shock to the person involved.
Didn’t you see that even the emperor couldn’t stand it?
The emperor couldn’t help but feel waves rising in his heart.
“If you don’t speak anymore, this prince will leave.” After saying this, the child quickly jumped off the swing.
Seeing the little creature getting angry as he approached, Emperor Jingwen grabbed his arm without saying anything.
“Let go! Let go!”
“If you don’t let go, I will call for help!”
As if he didn’t expect the other party to be so bold, the two-year-old child could no longer hold back, his eyes full of panic.
“Do you know who I am? I’m telling you my father is the emperor. Be careful or I’ll tell him and have him punish you for disrespect!”
It seems that the little thing really doesn’t remember himself.
Also, his situation didn’t seem to be very good. He could only speak empty words without any threat.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen finally responded: “Oh? You said you are a prince? Do you have any evidence?”
Emperor Jingwen looked him up and down, and when his eyes fell on the untied cuffs of his sleeves, his brows suddenly furrowed and anger rose in his heart.
Are these damned slaves really so flattering? A prince has torn clothes!
Emperor Jingwen took a closer look and found that the style of the clothes was also from last year.
And the imperial concubine, is it possible that the love between mother and son is not worth the so-called favor?
Emperor Jingwen was angry and disappointed at the moment, his eyes were full of fire, but he still said: “I have seen that all the other princes are dressed in brocade and gorgeous clothes, and when they travel, they are followed by groups of palace servants. How come you don’t have a single servant around you?”
“You still say you are a prince, are you lying to me?”
Tsk, my cheap dad really acted with me.
It turns out that all emperors like this.
Then, Ye Shuo seemed to be insulted, his face flushed: “…You are talking nonsense!”
Emperor Jingwen continued: “Also, why have I never seen you by His Majesty’s side? So, you are lying.”
“I didn’t!”
Hearing this, Ye Shuo seemed to finally be unable to bear it anymore, and finally told the truth: “I, your Highness, just made a mistake, so my father refused to come to see me. Wait, wait a while, my father will definitely come to see me again!”
After saying that, the child raised his little face and said viciously: “So if you dare to tell me your name, I will make you pay.”
Noticing the flash of loneliness, deep regret and confusion in his eyes when he talked about his mistakes, Emperor Jingwen felt as if his heart was pricked by a needle.
For the first time, he began to wonder if he was being too harsh on the kid.
After all, he was only a little over one-year-old at the time and still a child who knew nothing. How could he know what he should and should not do?
As a result, he imposed such a severe punishment on impulse, and caused the imperial concubine to lose face, so now she even ignores her own son.
Emperor Jingwen was silent for a moment, then asked: “Since you made a mistake, do you know where you went wrong?”
“I, I don’t know either…”
Speaking of this, Ye Shuo decisively counted on his fingers and said, “The ice is used regardless of whether I am there or not. The musician is also kept in the palace. I saw that no one was using him, so I invited them to use. The crown prince doesn’t eat grapes either. And there is…”
So where exactly did he go wrong? He was clearly making use of waste!
After his calculation, Emperor Jingwen miraculously felt that there was nothing wrong with the child.
Then the image of him lying on the recliner flashed through his mind, and Emperor Jingwen calmed down instantly.
…I was almost led into a ditch by him.
It is still wrong. If the prince does this and the news spreads to the people and everyone rushes to imitate him, what should we do?
Emperor Jingwen then said: “As a prince, you should put the overall situation first and not be so arrogant and carefree.”
“But… I’m not the one in charge. What does setting an example have to do with me?” Please, my cheap father and cheap brother are the real masters of the family. He is just a scoundrel. As long as he doesn’t do anything harmful or break the law, how can he have such a big impact?
Who would care about a prince who has nothing but a fart listening to music and eating grapes?
Ye Shuo looked aggrieved.
“Isn’t it enough to have my father and brother as role models for the people of the world?” Why drag him into this?
When Emperor Jingwen heard this, he choked up. He and the crown prince worked so hard, and when it was finally time to enjoy themselves, he had to do it, right?
In fact, Emperor Jingwen should be happy that the child of the imperial concubine and the grandson of the Duke of Zhen could have such thoughts.
His words proved that he had no ambitions and that he acknowledged the Crown Prince’s status as heir to the throne. If he could maintain this status, it would be perfectly in line with Emperor Jingwen’s wishes.
But for some reason, when Emperor Jingwen really heard these words, he was not happy at all. Instead, he felt inexplicably suffocated.
However, you can’t take the words of a two-year-old seriously. When he grows up, he will naturally understand how ridiculous his current thoughts are.
When he thought of this, Emperor Jingwen felt a little gloomy, and he became more determined not to let the two sides meet, to prevent the Duke of Zhen from teaching his son some bad things.
Soon, after getting rid of these unfounded years, Emperor Jingwen pretended not to care and asked, “Hearing you say that, don’t you hate the emperor very much?”
To be honest, if it were him, he would probably be dissatisfied with being punished so severely when he felt he had done nothing wrong.
“How could it be!” The next second, the child in front of him jumped up instantly as if his hair stood on end.
“Listen, I won’t let you say bad things about my father!”
Seeing that the child in front of him was full of grievances but still subconsciously defended himself, Emperor Jingwen felt mixed emotions and couldn’t help but soften his tone: “Yes, yes, it’s my fault.”
Although the emperor was apologizing to him, his gentle attitude still made Wang Ziquan’s eyes pop out, and his gaze towards the little prince changed several times.
The child was satisfied after hearing this.
The two of them were in a stalemate for a long time, and in the end, the younger one was the first to give in: “…Forget it, I forgive you, but you are not allowed to say such things again in the future.”
“By the way, you haven’t told me who you are yet?”
In the blink of an eye, countless thoughts flashed through Emperor Jingwen’s mind, but in the end, he still asked calmly: “Your Highness, who do you think I should be?”
Tsk, it looks like my cheap dad doesn’t intend to end it like this, so I’ll just continue to act with him.
Ye Shuo thought about it, and then his eyes lit up: “Recently, I heard that the new top scholar will enter the palace to meet the emperor. You are this year’s top scholar, right?”
“Yes, that must be the case. Mother said that the number one scholar is very impressive, so there are so many people following you, right?”
This silly child is so out of date with the news after being under house arrest.
The spring exam was held in March, and it is already May, two full months have passed. Moreover, the new number one scholar went to the palace to meet the emperor through the main gate of the palace – Chengtian Gate, and would not pass by the harem at all.
However, seeing how much he was looking forward to it, Emperor Jingwen, for the first time in his life, did not spoil the boy’s fun, so he nodded and said, “Yes, I am the top scholar this year. Your Highness is really smart.”
Now it was Ye Shuo’s turn to choke.
“…”
Wow, my cheap dad is so shameless that he actually nodded and acknowledged this identity.
The top scholar is not even thirty yet, and is in the prime of his life. How old is he now? He will be forty soon, right?
Seeing that the child seemed to be silent, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but ask: “What’s wrong? Is there something wrong?”
Ye Shuo shook his head and said, “No, I just feel that you are very familiar to me.”
“It feels like… like my father.”
Perhaps because he was a little embarrassed, he seemed a little hesitant in the end.
Could it be that… the little guy is going to recognize me?
Emperor Jingwen raised his eyebrows.
Afterward, perhaps he had finally mustered up the courage, Emperor Jingwen heard him say: “Um… I don’t know if you mind, my Lord, letting me hug you.”
Emperor Jingwen was stunned, as if he didn’t hear clearly: “…What?”
“Because, because I haven’t seen my father for a long time, so, so…”
Facing the child’s eager and anxious eyes, Emperor Jingwen’s heart softened immediately: “…Of course, Your Highness can hold me as long as you want.”
Since he said so, Ye Shuo certainly didn’t hesitate and climbed up in his arms.
The next moment, Emperor Jingwen was embraced by him.
Having never been so close to any of his sons, Emperor Jingwen felt a little uncomfortable. After a long time, he casually put his hand on the child’s head.
Only then did he realize that his son had grown a lot taller after not seeing him for half a year.
“Sir, do you have anything to do today? If not, could you stay a little longer?” The child’s voice became hoarse and muffled, as if with tears in it.
Emperor Jingwen was shocked and remained silent for a while before nodding.
Seeing that his son was alone here, Emperor Jingwen finally rolled up his sleeves to help him push the swing, just because he said: “It’s been a long time since anyone played with me.”
The Sixth Prince studies all day long, and can’t go to the Crown Prince’s east palace. Ye Shuo doesn’t want to bother the Imperial Concubine, because, after all, she is his biological mother, and he really can’t bear to pester her. He has been feeling really empty and lonely lately.
Emperor Jingwen misunderstood.
So he put aside the political affairs at hand and stayed with his youngest son for a whole afternoon.
Finally, Ye Shuo got tired of playing and climbed onto the back of Emperor Jingwen.
Bold!
Presumptuous!
Emperor Jingwen was furious and frowned subconsciously. He wanted to refuse, but before he could do anything, Ye Shuo’s two small hands had already wrapped around his neck.
“Even the smell on your body is similar.”
“But, Father will never carry me like this…”
The childish words touched people’s hearts the most. Facing this son whom he owed a lot, Emperor Jingwen held on for two breaths, but was overwhelmed by guilt when he turned his head. The hand that had been holding his wrist slowly let go.
Just once, no big deal.
As the sun sets, the afterglow of the setting sun on the blue stone road stretches the shadows of the father and son very long.
The palace maids, eunuchs, and even concubines who passed by couldn’t help but widen their eyes when they saw this scene: “Emperor, Emperor…”
But before they could salute, Emperor Jingwen glanced over.
Now he is so immersed in role-playing that he cannot extricate himself. How could he be willing to be exposed by others?
Emperor Jingwen was still waiting to tell the child in person when he arrived at Qiuwu Palace. By then, he would surely be very surprised.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but curl his lips, not knowing what he was thinking of.
Eunuch Wang Ziquan standing by was moved by this heartwarming scene. He, an outsider, was moved by this, let alone the emperor?
Along the way, Ye Shuo chattered incessantly, spouting nice words as if they were free, acting out the image of a son who adores his father to the fullest.
Emperor Jingwen was overjoyed when he heard this. He hadn’t been so happy for a long time.
After all, there is a difference between the admiration of one’s own son and the hypocritical praise from outsiders.
But the good times didn’t last long, Ye Shuo never expected that even though he had already explained everything in advance, Su Yue still went to complain to his mother.
Of course, Su Yue also had good intentions. After all, a two-year-old child had to be left alone, and she, as a servant, couldn’t stop him, so she had to let someone who could take care of him do it.
So when he saw his mother standing at the end of the road, Ye Shuo instinctively felt that something was wrong.
“Greetings to His Majesty, may His Majesty be blessed with good health and good health.”
It’s bad. The imperial concubine acted too quickly and Emperor Jingwen didn’t have time to discuss it with her.
All the hiding along the way was destroyed in an instant.
Emperor Jingwen felt a sinking feeling in his heart when he saw that his identity was exposed so quickly. If the child on his back found out that he had been deceived, he would surely be very disappointed.
In a flash, Emperor Jingwen had already thought of words of comfort.
But the subsequent development of events seemed a little different from what he had imagined.
Ye Shuo was even more nervous than his father and tried his best to wink at his mother. But how could Concubine Rong know that her son was so bold that he even dared to deceive his father, the emperor, relying on the fact that he was the emperor’s son.
So after she stood up, without thinking, Concubine Rong immediately scolded him: “What’s wrong with you recently? Why do you always like to run around in this ragged clothes? Why don’t you ask Su Yue and the others to follow you?”
“Where did you get this dress? Didn’t I ask Aunt Jing to throw it away? You, you, you want to piss off mother to death, don’t you?”
This time the imperial concubine was really furious. He was only two years old. If something happened to him, wouldn’t it be the end of her life?
No wonder Concubine Rong was so angry.
The emperor was worthy of being an emperor, and he quickly grasped the key points of the two sentences.
Wait a minute, it’s not that the imperial concubine doesn’t want to change the old clothes, but that the child himself refuses to change them.
Moreover, it wasn’t that the palace servants didn’t follow him, but he deliberately sent them away.
The most important thing is that Concubine Rong’s eyes were red, and she didn’t look like she was going to give up her son at all.
So, he did it on purpose.
He deliberately pretended to be pitiful and was waiting for me there.
And everything that happened today, in fact… is fake.
With a loud “boom”, Emperor Jingwen’s brain exploded instantly. He grabbed the child who was about to sneak out with his backhand and brought him in front of him without saying a word.
Things have come to this point, and it is useless for Ye Shuo to struggle unilaterally. He who knows how to adapt to the times is a wise man. If he behaves well, he might be able to have an easier time later.
Facing his awkward yet polite smile, at this moment, Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he was shaking all over!

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Digging a Hole
chapters.content:
Shock, shame, anger…all surged into his heart.
It has been so many years since Emperor Jingwen was so angry.
Seeing the hand pointing at him trembling constantly, Ye Shuo, who had no way to escape, couldn’t help but swallow.
Oops, looks like this is too much.
“Father, please calm down. Please listen to your son’s explanation…”
However, at this time, Emperor Jingwen had almost lost his mind.
His mind kept recalling how he helped him push the swing, carried him back, and felt proud and self-satisfied when he heard his exaggerated praises.
Facts have proved that when people are extremely embarrassed, they will really get angry and lose their minds.
Especially since the person in front of him is the emperor, an emperor for whom face is of paramount importance.
As guilty as Emperor Jingwen felt before, he is as angry now.He was actually teased by his own son!
Emperor Jingwen had never beaten his children before. If his children made mistakes, as long as he pointed them out, they would naturally correct themselves. Even their mothers would have taken the initiative to scold them, so it was never Emperor Jingwen’s turn to take action.
What’s more, Emperor Jingwen has always looked down upon the use of force to solve problems. Using force is only for short-term gain and does not fundamentally solve the problem. Instead, it will make his children resentful.
The children are just afraid, they haven’t changed.
But today, as if he had learned it all by himself, Emperor Jingwen instinctively looked around to see if there was anything that could help him. When he realized what was happening, he already had a feather duster in his hand.
The maids and eunuchs in Qiuwu Palace were cleaning the room, but unexpectedly the emperor rushed in and instantly grabbed the feather duster in the vase.
“Get out of here!” Before beating the children, the emperor did not forget to clear the area.
The palace servants had never seen such a scene before and were terrified.
Wang Ziquan, who was used to seeing big storms, couldn’t help but be stunned. How could the scene of loving father and filial son change so suddenly? ?
Although Ye Shuo had never been beaten by his biological father, he was not unfamiliar with this process.
After getting the weapon, the next step is to give him a good beating.
Ye Shuo suddenly shuddered, and before the emperor could make a move, he shouted at the top of his voice: “Mother! Mother, help me! Dad is going to beat me to death!”
Bastard!
He hasn’t even started yet!
If people don’t know, they might think the emperor really wants to kill his son.
With the volume of his voice, I’m afraid the people in the surrounding palaces could have heard it.
“Shut up! What nonsense are you talking about!” Emperor Jingwen was almost mad at him.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about that and shouted everything he could: “Brother, brother! Come and save me!”
Then almost half of the people in the palace were alarmed, and soon the crown prince also heard the news.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly came to his senses. If this matter were to get out, he would really lose both his face and dignity.
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously covered his son’s mouth, gritting his teeth as he did so: “Shut up, you still think it’s not chaotic enough, right?”
“Mmmmm…” It was obviously you who started it first!
Ye Shuo’s face flushed red as he made this accusation with his eyes.
Emperor Jingwen guessed what he meant at once, so he lowered his voice and said, “You were the one who lied to me first!”
When he thought about the fact that he had played the game of No. 1 Scholar and Prince with him for a long time, Emperor Jingwen’s face turned pale.
He thought he was the one playing the game, but he was played by his own son.
Who knows how this little bastard is laughing at me in his heart.
When Emperor Jingwen thought of this, his hands began to tremble again.
Calm down, calm down, calm down!
Ye Shuo stared at the feather duster in his hand, not daring to breathe.
Things have come to this point. Unless I strangle this little bastard to death and kill Wang Ziquan and other palace servants and destroy the bodies, I can’t pretend that this incident never happened.
After a long time, Emperor Jingwen, who had realized the reality, suddenly calmed down and said, “Tell me, how can you not tell anyone about this?”
Oh my God, the emperor is actually negotiating with a little kid!
Seeing such emotions in the eyes of the little bastard in front of him, Emperor Jingwen’s calmness, which had been so hard to calm down, was almost ruined again.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Ye Shuo immediately restrained himself: “If you beat me, I won’t tell you.”
Emperor Jingwen narrowed his eyes suddenly, and his mood became bad again: “You dare to threaten me? Do you know that you are committing the crime of deceiving the emperor?”
If it were someone else, even the prince, hearing this, he would probably kneel on the ground with a pale face and unable to get up.
There is no other reason. The crime is so serious that you may lose your head if you are not careful.
Ye Shuo was not afraid at all. He suddenly became serious and did not answer but asked instead. His eyes were clearly black and white and showed unprecedented seriousness: “Father, do you treat your son the same way you treat your subjects in the court? Do you also need to be careful about your words and actions?”
The child’s face was still childish, and he possessed an innocence that the older princes did not have.
No wonder Emperor Jingwen thought he was naive. If it were someone else, who would have the guts to ask this question? Even if he was a few years older, he wouldn’t dare to do so.
No one had ever asked him this question before.
The relationship between the ruler and his subjects, father and son should first be between the ruler and his subjects, then father and son. This is how it should be for people in the royal family.
Emperor Jingwen should have told him this, but for some reason, he suddenly couldn’t bring himself to say it.
Although they are king and subject, they are also father and son.
Caught off guard, Emperor Jingwen was stunned for a moment.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Ye Shuo asked again: “Since we are father and son, how can we talk about deceiving the emperor?”
His hands suddenly tightened, and Emperor Jingwen said reflexively: “…How outrageous!” But for some reason, he felt a little lacking in confidence.
Although he had been a father for so many years, he had never encountered a child like this, and for a moment he didn’t know where to start.
Ye Shuo struck while the iron was hot and continued: “Father, look, if this happened between an ordinary father and son, it would be just a trivial matter. Why are you so angry?”
“In an ordinary family, the father and son would probably still talk about it from time to time and make it a joke years later.”
Is it really… like this?
Seeing his cheap father’s hesitation, Ye Shuo’s face became serious. He didn’t feel guilty at all and nodded very affirmatively: “Really!”
No matter what, let’s get through this hurdle first.
Emperor Jingwen might really have little experience in this area, and he was really intimidated by him.
After calming down, Emperor Jingwen heard the frantic knocking on the door outside.
Oh, I forgot to mention that Emperor Jingwen felt ashamed, so when he drove the palace servants out, he locked the door of the main hall as well.
His behavior made Concubine Rong very anxious. Coupled with her son’s screams just now, Concubine Rong’s heart was beating fast. Her hands turned red from clapping, and she was sweating all over.
“Your Majesty, Your Majesty, if Shuo’er has made any mistakes, please forgive him for his young age. If you really want to punish me, please punish me—”
Before she could finish her words, she heard a creaky sound and the door in front of her suddenly opened.
Concubine Rong was delighted, but before she could say anything, she saw Emperor Jingwen casually throwing something at her.
Taking a closer look, this fiery red ball, who else could it be but her son?
Concubine Rong hurriedly went to take him. When she turned around again, she could only see the emperor’s back, and along with it, his deep voice –
“My dear, Shuo’er is naughty and needs to be taught well in the future.”
At first, Emperor Jingwen wanted to punish him again, but then he changed his mind. This little bastard was only two years old after all. Moreover, he had just been released from prison more than ten days ago, and he was going to be imprisoned again today. Emperor Jingwen felt that it was too frequent.
The most important thing is that he dared to do such a thing after being locked up for half a year last time. God knows what tricks he can come up with next time.
Emperor Jingwen decided to let him go this time, and also let himself go.
After his stepfather left, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but let out a long sigh of relief.
Fortunately, fortunately, I managed to fool him.
He was not worried at all that his mother would be angered. Although his stepfather was a scumbag, he was not so shameless.
Even Ye Shuo was not that worried about himself.
As I said, when you are young you can do whatever you want. The most you will get is a beating or be put in solitary confinement for half a year, nothing else will happen.
Now I didn’t get beaten, and I didn’t get put in solitary confinement, it was a real win.
Next time, let’s do it this way again.
Ye Shuo was thinking happily, but when he turned around, he met Concubine Rong’s fiery eyes.
Oops, oops, I just send one away, and there is still one!
Ye Shuo broke out in a cold sweat: “Mom, Mom, please listen to my explanation!”
After a long time, the little prince’s screams were heard again in Qiuwu Palace.
The other side.
The impact of being teased by a two-year-old child was greater than Emperor Jingwen had imagined.
He even thought about it before going to bed at night.
Scene after scene kept repeating itself again and again before Emperor Jingwen’s eyes.
The more one want to forget, the harder it is to forget.
Sensing the low pressure in the bedroom, Wang Ziquan didn’t dare to breathe.
After all, he was one of the parties involved, and he wished he could disappear from the emperor’s sight as soon as possible, so that the emperor wouldn’t see him and remember what happened that day.
Wang Ziquan, who was used to many ups and downs, was even shocked at the courage of the little prince.
For some unknown reason, Emperor Jingwen finally asked several ministers indirectly what they would do if this happened to them.
The results were all the same without exception –
“How dare he! Break his legs!”
Emperor Jingwen then realized that he had been deceived again.
Even if he was an ordinary person, he couldn’t escape the beating. It was a pity that I believed his words at that time!
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help himself and accidentally smashed the cup next to him.
The little bastard was so skilled and calm, and he dug two big holes in a row, which made it hard to believe that he was a first-time offender.
At the same time, scenes from the past flashed quickly through the emperor’s mind.
I still remember that when he was a little over one-year-old, he was greatly humiliated because of the imperial concubine’s sleeping with him.
Emperor Jingwen now felt more and more that he did it on purpose.
As for the matters of grasping the week-old and throwing the jade unicorn, there is no need to mention it.
Emperor Jingwen was startled, and then a thought flashed through his mind: Could it be that his son was born bad?

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Playing Cards
chapters.content:
No, it’s not bad, it’s just plain irritating.
He is like this when he is just over two years old. What will happen when he grows up?
Because the crown prince and other princes were so diligent, obedient, and conscientious, Emperor Jingwen had the illusion that he was particularly good at raising children.
It was not until today that Emperor Jingwen realized that all his previous children were raised in vain. All of them combined were not as troublesome as this one.
The other party would even stop him with words like emperor and subject, father and son.
Listen to this, does this sound like something a two-year-old child would say?
But he couldn’t really say anything like “the emperor and his subjects were the first to rule over him”. Everyone knew it, but they couldn’t put it in the open, as it would ultimately hurt the relationship between father and son.
Therefore, this question has no solution.
For the first time in his life, Emperor Jingwen was not thinking about state affairs before going to bed, but was troubled by the upbringing of his youngest son.
At the same time, the East Palace——When the commotion broke out in Qiuwu Palace, the crown prince had already received the news. However, before he could go to check what was going on, the farce had already stopped.
“Looking at this commotion, I’m afraid that my royal brother has done something to displease father again.” He is worthy of being the crown prince. He has already gotten a glimpse of the truth after only meeting Ye Shuo twice, and his guess is so accurate.
“Oh? From what I’ve seen from your Highness’ words and actions, the little prince seems to be a little naughty?” The tutor beside him had never seen the true appearance of the little prince, but after hearing him say this, he became interested.
The prince twitched his lips when he heard this: “Grandmaster, you don’t know that my brother is more than just naughty.”
The Taifu is the crown prince’s teacher. When facing his teacher, the crown prince has nothing to hide.
So he told everything he had seen.
Then the tutor stopped talking.
Just by lying on a recliner and eating grapes, and having musicians and masseurs, the Taifu thought that it was fortunate that he was not the crown prince, otherwise he would have been a tyrant if he ascended the throne one day.
Fortunately, the one he was assisting was the Crown Prince, so the more useless the other princes were, the better.
“Judging from the current situation, the little prince doesn’t seem to be a cause for concern.” The Grand Tutor had been worried about the Duke of Zhen for two years, and now he finally felt a little relieved.
“But it’s inevitable that those people who go to the study room will have to work hard in the future.”
After all, we are all in education, so we naturally know each other.
As the saying goes, people of the same profession look down on each other, and this is especially true for scholars. Even the Taifu is no exception.
As luck would have it, the person in charge of the upper study now is his old rival, Lord Jin Zhe.
It’s obvious that Concubine Rong dotes on her child. The Emperor has to worry about so many things every day, so it’s basically impossible for him to discipline his child personally, so in the end, the responsibility falls on the prince’s teacher.
Even though the little prince is only a little over two years old now, and it will take him nearly two years to go to the upper study, the Grand Tutor has already anticipated the scene when the little prince goes to the upper study.
Thinking of his old rival’s headache, the Taifu couldn’t help but smile.
When the time comes, I must watch the fun carefully.
On the other hand, as Emperor Jingwen’s mood changed, the hearts of everyone in the harem also fluctuated.
It was thought that the six-month-long house arrest had crushed the little prince to death. As a record breaker, in the eyes of the concubines, the little prince would never be able to turn over again.
Who knows how long it would take before someone saw the emperor carrying him around the palace.
Note, it is carried on the back.
Not to mention other princes, even the crown prince does not have this honor.
The emperor is a typical strict father. Apart from holding the prince when he is born, there is nothing more he does, let alone carrying him on his back.
Even in the homes of lower-level ministers, it was rare for a father to carry his child on his back.
What does father mean? It means unshakable authority and the most untransgressed existence in a family or even a clan.
If you are too close to your children, won’t they lose their sense of awe?
After hearing the news, the Concubine Shu and the others, who had been gloating at first, twisted their handkerchiefs to pieces and felt a sense of crisis. However, before they could come up with a solution, they heard that the Emperor was furious and almost beat the little prince.
What is this about? ?
Emperor Jingwen changed his attitude so quickly this time that the Queen and the others were really confused.
Does the emperor love or is he angry with the little prince?
Not to mention them, even Concubine Rong, his own mother, is almost having a headache. Her son is only two years old, and he is already like this. What will she do when he grows up?
Looking at the child playing wildly in the palace as usual, Concubine Rong decided to let him study in advance.
It is said that books contain beauty and golden houses. Perhaps after he reads the books and understands the principles in them, he will naturally become sensible.
For some reason, Ye Shuo, who was watering the plants and mixing the mud, suddenly felt a chill on his back, as if something bad was about to happen.
Soon, when he saw Su Yue coming over with a pile of books, Ye Shuo realized that it was not an illusion, but something bad was really going to happen.
So Ye Shuo ran away before Concubine Rong could say anything.
“Mom, I suddenly remembered that I have something else to do. Bye bye~”
He is just a two-year-old kid, what the hell is there for him to do?
The child’s back gradually walked away, and Concubine Rong’s expression changed from pretending to be gentle at the beginning to completely losing her trick and turned into anger.
“What are you all standing there for? Why don’t you bring him back to me?”
“Today, even if he says something ridiculous, he must recite this Thousand Character Classic to me!”
“yes!”
…
Although Ye Shuo has small arms and legs, he is not slow at all when running. And because of his small body, he can hide better.
However, Ye Shuo also had his limits in mind. The palace was so huge, and with his small body, if he made a mistake, he might be swallowed up by someone with ulterior motives.
Although on the surface he is quite safe as the son of the imperial concubine, it is always better to be safe than sorry.
If anything happened, her mother, as a royal concubine, would definitely avenge him, but he would be dead by then, so revenge would be useless.
So Ye Shuo deliberately avoided accident-prone areas such as rockery, pools, wells, etc.
Just as he was wandering alone in the Imperial Garden, thinking about what to do next, he suddenly thought of a good place.
If it’s there, it should be fine.
With his sixth brother going to school and unable to enter the Eastern Palace, Ye Shuo felt that it was time to find another good place to go.
