Ye Shuo did what he said, and walked towards the destination with his calves.
Not long after Ye Shuo left, Su Yue and the others arrived, panting.
That’s not right. I just saw the little prince here, how come he’s gone in the blink of an eye?
Su Yue couldn’t understand why. The little prince had only been to the Imperial Garden a few times, and the swing he had set up before was not in this location. So how did he remember the route so clearly and even knew where it was better to hide without being discovered?
If Su Yue had not seen the abilities of these young eunuchs before, she would have really thought they were useless.
But now is not the time to talk about this, the most important thing is to find the little prince.
Just as Su Yue was wandering around the Imperial Garden like a headless fly, Ye Shuo had already appeared at the door of Shu Lan Zhai.
He remembered that Concubine Zhao lived here.
Looking at the tightly closed palace gate in front of him, Ye Shuo stood on tiptoe and took great effort to barely reach the door knocker on it.
“Boom boom boom”, “Boom boom boom”.
At that time, Zhao Chongrong was taking medicine.
Since the loss of her child, her health has not improved as before, and she has basically been taking herbal medicine every day.
As a result, just as she picked up the bowl, she heard a knock on the door.
As her place was seldom visited by anyone, Zhao Chongrong initially thought she had misheard. Later, after being reminded by her maid, she asked the eunuch who was serving her to go out and check.
With a creaky sound, the heavy door opened. The young eunuch looked out. Eh? No one was there. Could it be haunted?
Then he heard a clear child’s voice coming from below.
“Excuse me, is Madam Zhao here?”
The young eunuch lowered his head subconsciously. When he saw the red dress, he was stunned at first, and then startled: “Greetings, young prince. Good luck to you, young prince.”
A look of surprise flashed across Zhao Chongrong’s face. When she came to her senses, the little kid had already run towards her.
Zhao Chongrong is not good at dealing with people, including children. Fortunately, Ye Shuo is a chatterbox, so there is no need to worry about awkward silence.
“Why is Concubine Zhao taking medicine? Is Concubine Zhao sick recently?”
Facing the little kid’s slightly worried eyes, Zhao Chongrong felt warm in his heart: “It’s just to take care of my health.”
After saying that, she drank the medicine in front of her, then handed the medicine bowl to the maid beside her and asked her to deal with it.
Wiping his mouth with a handkerchief, Zhao Chongrong asked, “Why is the young prince here?”
The most important thing is that he still remembers her.
“I don’t know why, but I felt a sense of familiarity when I thought of Concubine Zhao, so I came here.” Ye Shuo didn’t feel embarrassed at all when he lied.
“If Madam Zhao finds me annoying, I will leave now…”
The little baby looked so pitiful when he looked depressed.
Zhao Chongrong hesitated for a moment, but finally accepted the trouble: “Wait a minute.”
Zhao Chongrong sighed: “If your Highness doesn’t mind, you can stay with me as long as you want.”
Ye Shuo immediately perked up, no longer feeling aggrieved: “I don’t mind, I don’t mind!”
Seeing that he seemed curious about her palace, Zhao Chongrong thought that there was nothing in it that couldn’t be seen by the light, so she took the initiative to hold his hand and show him around.
When he reached one of the drawers, Ye Shuo suddenly stopped.
This thing… should be ancient playing cards, right?
Although he had recognized what was in the box, Ye Shuo still asked with a curious expression: “Madam Zhao, what is this?”
“You are talking about this… This thing is called Madiao.” Before Zhao Chongrong got married, she often played with her sisters.
Later, she married Emperor Jingwen, who was still the crown prince, and it has been fifteen or sixteen years until today.
This sling was brought here as a souvenir, and now it is old.
Ye Shuo: “Is Madiao a toy?”
Zhao Chongrong hesitated and said, “This…should be considered as such, right?”
Ye Shuo was waiting for this. His eyes lit up, and he looked up and said, “Then let’s play this!”
“Um?”
Zhao Chongrong refused without thinking: “This is not something that children can play with.”
As well as……
“Mahjong is fun only when four people play together, and there are only two of us.”
It’s just a lack of people, that’s easy to handle.
“Concubine Zhao, wait for me. I’ll go call the queens from the two neighboring palaces!” He had noticed when he came that this area was exceptionally quiet. It was not as lively as the Qiuwu Palace at all. It was probably because there were concubines here whose situations were similar to Zhao Chongrong’s.
There was no time to stop him. Zhao Chongrong could only watch the little kid run away.
Zhao Chongrong was stunned.
“Eh???”

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Quiet
chapters.content:
When they heard the knock on the door, the other two ladies, like Zhao Chongrong, did not react for a long time.
Why did the little prince suddenly come to them?
Children in the palace sometimes mean trouble. The prince is of noble status, and they cannot afford to bear the consequences if something goes wrong. The two of them subconsciously wanted to decline, but who knew that the little prince would speak up next.
“Madam, can you play mahjong? We are short one.”
It sounded as if there were already three people, and only herself was missing.
It’s just like playing games in modern times, there’s only one person missing from a five-person team, so you’re asked if you’ll come.
Most people would get up and play a few rounds even if they were very sleepy and had taken off their clothes.
In this situation, anyone with a slightly weak mind would be fooled away in just a few words. Normally, it would be too difficult to refuse, and the two ladies were no exception.
When they arrived at Shu Lan Zhai, they found out that they had been deceived. The little prince used the same excuse to the other party.
In other words, he obviously had no one at the time, but he just relied on the phrase “missing one player” to get them together.However, it is too late to leave now.
This clever little ghost. The three of them thought so in their hearts without any prior agreement.
Zhao Chongrong and the other two looked at each other, and since they were all elders living in the palace and had no children, their ranks were similar, so they bowed to each other.
As the host of Shulanzhai, Zhao Chongrong hurriedly asked the palace maids and eunuchs to prepare hot tea and snacks.
By the time the servants came into the courtyard with the snacks, Ye Shuo had already come out with the mahjong cards.
As for Madiao, it was very popular in the Zhou Dynasty and was considered one of the most popular gambling games at that time.
The other two ladies were not unfamiliar with it either, as they often played with their sisters during their boudoir years.
But now, so many years have passed, and their hands are numb.
Looking at the slightly worn cards in front of them, the three people’s eyes flashed with nostalgia at the same time, and the restraint and strangeness in their hearts also dissipated a lot.
Xu Chongyi couldn’t help but take a sip of tea and said with a smile: “I haven’t seen this thing for a long time. The younger sisters should give in to me later.”
[
Favored Assistant (充衣;
chōngyī
) or Lady of Complete Deportment (充儀;
chōngyī
)
]
Xu Chongyi was the oldest and was the first to serve Emperor Jingwen, who was still the crown prince, so there was nothing wrong with calling herself “sister”.
Hearing this, Li Chongyuan covered her mouth with her fan and smiled: “That’s what I was thinking too. My two sisters, please go easy on me later.”
Zhao Chongrong pursed her lips and said nothing. At this moment, she was thinking whether to let them go later.
Apart from anything else, Zhao Chongrong can definitely be considered the best when it comes to card skills.
Among the boudoir, among that group of young ladies, Zhao Chongrong believed that no one could match her.
But that was before they got married, so the sisters didn’t need to care so much about it. When they arrived at the palace, it was a completely different scene.
If she won too much, Zhao Chongrong was afraid that it would damage the harmony.
So she decided to let go when the time came. It was just entertainment, so how could she take it seriously?
The sooner we can get through today, the sooner our lives will return to their normal peace.
Ye Shuo looked at this, then looked at that, and always felt that something was strange. Everyone seemed to be extremely cautious and couldn’t let go at all.
But he wasn’t worried about not having enough fun. After all, when the fun really started, he wouldn’t be able to control himself even if he wanted to.
So Ye Shuo took the lead and reached out to grab the cards first.
Zhao Chongrong and three others followed closely behind.
‘Good cards!’
Such thoughts arose in the minds of the three people almost at the same time, only Ye Shuo had a bitter face as he looked at the handful of dregs in his hand.
Does this card have eyes? It gives all the bad ones to his side.
He had taken all the small cards, so the cards in the ladies’ hands must be good.
“Ten thousand strings of cash.” It was Xu Chongyi’s turn, and she casually threw out a card.
Ye Shuo rolled his eyes: “Thirty thousand strings of cash.”
Li Chongyuan paused while holding the cards. Oh no, she could just bet on it and get rid of the few useless cards on the board.
But if this is the case, it would be very difficult for me to lose.
In the end, Li Chongyuan couldn’t resist the temptation and paid 40,000 strings of cash.
After several rounds of confrontation, the two games were over quickly. Zhao Chongrong, who had originally wanted to conserve her strength, gradually discovered that the two opponents did not seem to be trying their best.
It turns out that everyone has the same idea, which is to give in.
The two people opposite were pretending to be novices and inexperienced really well. If my level was lower, I would have been fooled by them.
Li Chongyuan and Xu Chongyi, who also put themselves in a position to let others go, frowned. Wait, something is wrong.
Things seem to be a little different from what I imagined.
Ye Shuo played two cards in a row, which were caught by three people in time, and then was taken away by a set of tricks. He couldn’t help but fall into deep thought.
Question: If we randomly pick three people to play Mahjong, what is the probability that all three of them are experts?
Perhaps it was because their opponent aroused their desire to win, or perhaps it was because the dignity of a master could not be challenged. The three of them went from being reserved at the beginning, to cautious probing, and finally to swordplay and back and forth, all in less than five games.
Later on, Zhao Chongrong and the other two used various methods, including card splitting and card counting. If Ye Shuo was really an ordinary two-year-old child, he would have been beaten so badly that he couldn’t even get up.
Although, he is not much better now.
Ye Shuo’s card skills are not bad, and can even be called superb, but modern poker is different from this mahjong, and he still needs to adapt.
[Mahjong = Madiao]
The most important thing is that the three ladies agreed to explain the specific rules to him when they played cards, but when the game started, they forgot everything.
Just like that, the three of them fought back and forth, and in the end only Ye Shuo was injured.
By the time Zhao Chongrong and the others reacted, Ye Shuo’s wallet was empty. All the New Year’s money he had saved for two years was lost.
Looking at the child’s empty wallet and aggrieved face, Zhao Chongrong and others suddenly woke up.
…Oops, I forgot about the little prince.
Looking at the pile of silver beans at hand, Zhao Chongrong and the others all showed a hint of embarrassment on their faces.
“Your Highness…”
For fear of making him cry, Zhao Chongrong was just about to draw something, but the next moment, the palace door of Shu Lan Zhai was pushed open again.
It turned out that Concubine Rong had finally brought people here to look for her.
Seeing the anger and anxiety on her face, Zhao Chongrong and the others were startled at first, and then they wanted to salute.
Concubine Rong was the same, she was about to curse, but Ye Shuo didn’t even give her the chance.
Concubine Rong watched her son rush towards her, and then stuffed something into her hand.
“Mother, save me!”
When Concubine Rong heard this, she didn’t bother to scold him. She just thought that he was bullied when she was not around.
When he looked down, he found that what he put into his hand was actually a Mahjong deck of cards.
“Mother, your son has lost all his New Year’s money. Please help him win it back, okay?”
Concubine Rong’s attention was indeed diverted.
Nanny Yu, who was holding a copy of Thousand Character Classic behind her, looked a little embarrassed at this moment.
“I’ll settle the score with you later.” Concubine Rong glared at the little thing, but in Ye Shuo’s eyes, it didn’t have much deterrent power.
Then Concubine Rong approached and sneered: “You three teamed up to bully a child, what kind of ability do you have?”
Zhao Chongrong opened her mouth, but for the first time, she was speechless.
After all, what the other party said makes sense.
With a quick glance, she found her son’s seat and sat down in front of everyone: “How about I play a few games with you?”
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo spoke up immediately: “Mother, you are amazing. Mother, you are great.”
But…can she really succeed?
Ye Shuo had seen the card skills of Zhao Chongrong and the other two, which were beyond the reach of ordinary people.
Ye Shuo smacked his lips, not holding out much hope.
The three dared not disobey the imperial concubine’s order, so they sat back at the card table.
After Zhao Chongrong and the others calmed down, they originally wanted to give up their cards, and wait until the imperial concubine was happy, and the matter would be over.
However, no matter how they planned, they could never have imagined that the imperial concubine’s card skills were so bad.
Fearing that she would be discovered if she did it too obviously, Xu Chongyi played a card when the time was almost right, thinking of sending the imperial concubine away.
As a result…the imperial concubine refused to accept it.
If she goes out again, the imperial concubine still won’t want it.
Xu Chongyi was stunned.
What she didn’t know was that the imperial concubine was also in a difficult situation. At first, she wanted to let it go, but later on, she found that she suddenly couldn’t get up anymore.
Xu Chongyi had no choice but to play her last card.
The atmosphere suddenly fell into an eerie silence.
“…Come again, come again.” The imperial concubine narrowed her eyes. She just didn’t believe it.
Ye Shuo on the side blinked his eyes, pulled her sleeve and said, “Mother, mother, stop playing, we should go back to study.”
“Wait a moment, Nanny Yu, please watch him first, and let me do it again.”
Ye Shuo looked innocent when he heard this.
This is what his mother said herself, it has nothing to do with him.
However, this wait took most of the day.
From the bright sunshine in the afternoon to the dim sunset in the evening, although Concubine Rong won a few times, she still lost more often.
Even so, Zhao Chongrong and the others did not try their best.
Finally, mother and son joined forces to gradually turn the situation around.
Concubine Rong suddenly found that mahjong was quite interesting. It would be nice to play it in her spare time when she was bored in the palace.
“Tomorrow afternoon, the three of you must remember to come to Qiuwu Palace to find me.”
How could Ye Shuo not see that his mother was addicted.
It just so happened that there was something to catch his mother’s attention, so she didn’t have to force him to study all the time.
Zhao Chongrong was not particularly averse to hearing this. After playing cards for an afternoon, the three of them found that although the imperial concubine looked unhappy when she lost, she did not vent her anger on them and was generous when paying. She was considered a good player.
At first, Concubine Rong didn’t want her son to get involved. What would happen if he was so young and indulged in pleasure?
However, she found that without the little thing beside her to guide her from time to time, she really couldn’t win.
So often, when Concubine Rong was frustrated with losing, she would drag Ye Shuo over and let him take the field, while she would sit aside and watch.
After understanding the rules, with the training of three mahjong masters and the foundation he had learned before, Ye Shuo’s mahjong skills improved by leaps and bounds.
At first, Zhao Chongrong and the others thought he was a child and gave in to him, but gradually, the three of them felt it was too much and could only play with him at their true level.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Reminder
chapters.content:
Emperor Jingwen always remembered that he had been too cold to the imperial concubine and her son. Now that the Duke of Zhen had settled down temporarily, he slowly felt guilty and wanted to make amends.
If it had been before, he would have asked the eunuchs around him to inquire and say hello. Why would he have made this trip in person?
It had been a long time since they last met, and Emperor Jingwen thought that the imperial concubine and her son would be very happy to see him, so he blurted out, “I don’t know how that little bastard is doing lately.”
After receiving the order, Wang Ziquan, who was preparing the sedan chair, was startled when he heard this and could not help but secretly glance at the emperor.
The little prince had just played a trick on the emperor. Logically, the emperor should be very disgusted with the little prince. Why did he ask about the little prince’s recent situation so casually?
However, the emperor still seems unaware of it, which is really strange.
“Why are you looking at me like that?” Emperor Jingwen was worthy of being an emperor, he noticed it in an instant.
Wang Ziquan was shocked, but fortunately he reacted in time, so he smiled and said, “I was just thinking that the little prince will be happy to see the emperor later.”
“Of course.” Two months later, Emperor Jingwen had already found a reason for his son in his mind.
The reason why the little bastard behaved like that might be because he had been neglected for too long. Isn’t it said that a child who is not paid attention by his father will try every possible means to attract his father’s attention?Wang Ziquan was used to reading people’s faces, and immediately followed the emperor’s words and said, “Since the little prince has worked so hard in his studies, why doesn’t Your Majesty consider giving him something as a reward? I’m sure the little prince will like whatever Your Majesty gives him.”
Emperor Jingwen thought about it and agreed.
It’s rare that my youngest son is so motivated, so naturally I should give him a small reward.
“Go and ask the Ministry of Internal Affairs to fetch two Hu brushes.” If you want to do your work well, you must first sharpen your tools. Although the youngest son has not formally started to learn calligraphy yet, it is always a good idea to prepare it early.
[T/L = Hu brushes are made with fine horse hairs which is good for scholars as these brushes doesn’t impair easily.]
Emperor Jingwen led his men and walked towards Qiuwu Palace quite easily.
Result……
What is the result? ?
As soon as he approached, Emperor Jingwen heard some unusual movements inside. It seemed that Qiuwu Palace was very lively.
At first, Emperor Jingwen felt a little relieved to hear the laughter of a woman who was different from the imperial concubine.
It would be perfect if the harem could always maintain friendship and harmony.
It was not until Emperor Jingwen quickened his pace and stepped into it quickly that he was caught off guard and saw the following scene –
In the bright afternoon sunshine, my youngest son, who I hadn’t seen for two months, was standing on a stone pier in the yard. From time to time, he was yelling something, while his hands were waving in the air. His hands, which had never held a brush, were now struggling to hold a pile of paper. Judging from the complex patterns on the paper, it was… mahjong tiles???
The little kid, who can barely hold chopsticks for eating and have never touched a brush to write, is already playing mahjong cards with great skill.
From the looks of it, he even seems very skilled.
Looking at the people sitting opposite him, who else could it be but his three concubines?
Emperor Jingwen remembered from afar that these three people were extremely low-key in their daily lives, and their clothes were extremely plain, so they were always quite inconspicuous when seen in the crowd.
Now, everyone has a rosy face and a smile on their face.
But the long strip of paper on their face is really an eyesore.
Emperor Jingwen finally came here, and he saw that his son had prepared such a big “surprise” for him.
Emperor Jingwen only felt a loud bang, and a surge of hot blood rushed to his forehead. By the time he reacted, he had already shouted loudly: “What are you doing!”
This voice sounds familiar…
Emperor Jingwen watched his son turn around and think for a while, which made Emperor Jingwen even more angry.
Oh no, I’ve been so obsessed with playing cards lately that I forgot I have a father.
Ye Shuo quickly threw away the mahjong cards in his hand, pretended nothing happened, and saluted: “Greetings to the emperor, may the emperor be well.”
Ye Shuo spoke first, giving Zhao Chongrong and the others time to tidy up their appearances, and asked the palace maids around them to help take down the note. The three of them were nervous and knelt down hurriedly: “Greetings to the Emperor, may the Emperor be blessed with good health.”
It’s over, I was caught red-handed.
Although Madiao is not a prohibited item, it should not be allowed to entertain people like this in the palace, right?
Emperor Jingwen looked at the three of them steadily, and then looked at Su Yue and the others who were nervous beside him: “Where is the imperial concubine? Where is she now?”
This is Qiuwu Palace, could it be that the Imperial Concubine has no control over this at all? !
As soon as he finished speaking, Concubine Rong came out of the hall in a hurry. Seeing that there were still traces of water on her face that had not been wiped clean, and small pieces of broken paper on her neck, Emperor Jingwen immediately understood what had happened.
Emperor Jingwen’s face began to turn pale. He could never have imagined that the Imperial Concubine had condoned this and was even involved in it.
“Presumptuous!”
“You know that gambling is taboo in the palace!”
The furious emperor made everyone sweat profusely and no one dared to refute him.
Only Ye Shuo was able to remain calm, so he quietly defended himself, “There was no gambling, we were just posting notes.”
The imperial concubine nearly fainted when she heard this, and she wanted to reach out and cover her son’s mouth.
It’s already this time, why don’t you obey your father?
Sure enough, when he looked up, he found that the emperor was getting angrier.
“Zhao Chongrong, Xu Chongyi, Li Chongyuan…” As the emperor read out the names one by one, the three of them couldn’t help but feel a chill in their hearts and their faces turned pale.
Just when they thought that the emperor would at worst demote them this time, they heard the little prince speak.
“Father!”
Without waiting for his cheap father to finish his words, Ye Shuo hurriedly said: “This matter was caused by this son. It was the three ladies that this son found. It has nothing to do with the ladies.”
This is indeed true. If he hadn’t come to their house, Zhao Chongrong and the others wouldn’t have suffered this unexpected disaster.
“If you want to punish someone, please punish this son.”
“Okay!” Emperor Jingwen narrowed his eyes. “Since you’ve said so, then you will bear all the guilt of the four people, including your mother. This time, I will definitely punish you severely!”
“Thank you, father.” Ye Shuo did not feel nervous, but relieved.
The imperial concubine’s face turned pale immediately.
Hearing the emperor say this, I’m afraid he’s going to take drastic measures!
After Zhao Chongrong and the other two realized what was happening, they also started to get anxious.
Having said that, even though it was the little prince who came to them on his own initiative, they did not refuse after all.
If she didn’t refuse, it would mean she agreed. How could we let a two-year-old kid bear the consequences alone?
Zhao Chongrong was the first person to kneel down and plead: “Your Majesty, this is my fault. I shouldn’t have used mahjong cards to seduce the little prince. The little prince is still young and doesn’t know anything. If Your Majesty wants to punish someone, please punish me.”
Anyway, she had nothing to lose by living like a zombie in this palace.
Xu Chongyi and Li Chongyuan broke out in cold sweats. Finally, they gritted their teeth and knelt down.
For a while, the entire Qiuwu Palace was filled with the sounds of women crying and begging, which made Emperor Jingwen feel overwhelmed.
It was clearly their fault, but Emperor Jingwen felt that he had become the bad guy.
Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he laughed.
Without saying a word, he looked at them for a long while. Even so, they showed no intention of retreating. After a while, Emperor Jingwen suddenly waved his hand and said, “Xu Chongyi, Zhao Chongrong, and Li Chongyuan, the three of you can go back to your respective palaces.”
“Emperor–“
“Shut up! If you dare to beg for mercy again, I will punish you too!”
Wang Ziquan stepped forward in time and advised: “Ladies, the emperor has spoken, ladies, please go back first.”
“Someone, send these ladies back to the palace!”
Zhao Chongrong and her companions were unable to resist, and the three concubines/ladies were helpless. When they left, their eyes were almost filled with worry.
However, what Ye Shuo was thinking at this moment was, huh? He only asked the ladies to return to the palace without mentioning any punishment. It seems that his cheap father’s anger has subsided.
Emperor Jingwen still looked extremely furious, but he had no idea that his son had already noticed something.
It’s not anything else, it’s mainly because the little bastard took the initiative to stand up, which made Emperor Jingwen realize that he still has some good qualities.
The fact that he did not shirk responsibility was in line with Emperor Jingwen’s wishes.
However, Emperor Jingwen soon discovered that it was too early for him to be happy.
It turns out that we shouldn’t have any unreasonable expectations of this little bastard.
Wang Ziquan is worthy of being the man who has stood beside Emperor Jingwen since the time of Emperor Qiandi and remains standing today. His work efficiency is astonishingly high.
Taking advantage of the chaos in Qiuwu Palace, he had already figured out the cause and effect of the matter.
He had just noticed Wang Ziquan asking questions nearby, so when his cheap father asked him questions, Ye Shuo didn’t tell a single lie, in order to prevent his cheap father’s mood, which had just calmed down with great difficulty, from getting out of control again.
Although, the effect of telling the truth may be even stronger…
Emperor Jingwen sat at the head of the table, speaking in a deep tone, unable to tell whether he was happy or angry: “Tell me, what have you done in the past two months?”
Ye Shuo knelt there obediently, counting seriously: “Performing artistic creation, relaxing by having fun, and getting up on time…”
“I will only give you this one chance to confess.”
Emperor Jingwen tightened his grip on the beads in his hand, and his eyes became somewhat dangerous.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo immediately changed his words: “Make mud, play cards, eat, play cards, sleep, play cards.”
Eunuch Wang Ziquan standing by nodded affirmatively, His Highness the little prince was right.
Emperor Jingwen: “…………”
“Didn’t you say he should recite the Thousand Character Classic?” Emperor Jingwen gritted his teeth and looked at Concubine Rong beside him.
Only then did Concubine Rong remember that this was what she had in mind when she went to look for him.
Later on, I don’t know how, it became what it is now.
“Your Majesty, it is my fault.” Concubine Rong’s face was filled with shame.
At this point, it is impossible for Emperor Jingwen not to know that it was this little bastard who was causing trouble.
He was only two and a half years old, but he could come up with so many clever ideas. Even Emperor Jingwen had to admire the boy’s intelligence. But… what’s the use of his intelligence if it is not used in the right way?
In fact, the more Ye Shuo did this, the angrier Emperor Jingwen became.
Emperor Jingwen then spoke, with rare patience and earnest teaching: “You are not even three years old yet. As a prince, you don’t do what you should do. You are so distracted by playing with things. How can you achieve anything by playing Mahjong every day?”
This is really hard to say…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at Eunuch Wang standing beside him.
Wang Ziquan hesitated for a while, and finally had to lean over and whisper in Emperor Jingwen’s ear: “Your Majesty, the little prince’s card skills are now better than those of the three ladies…”

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Well-behaved
chapters.content:
Finally, under the threatening gaze of Emperor Jingwen, Wang Ziquan gradually fell silent.
Looking at the little kid kneeling quietly below, Emperor Jingwen felt a headache and difficulty, not knowing where to start teaching him.
Now that he can hold the chopsticks steadily, has he learned to play cards?
Recalling how he was bossing around when he came here today, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
The atmosphere suddenly became stagnant.
At the same time, Ye Shuo also felt very wronged. It was just a game of cards, but his cheap father had to interfere.
It was okay before, but even a little entertainment is not enough.
Ye Shuo felt that being a prince was really tiring, especially with his status and background. If he was too smart, his stepfather would be unhappy; if he was uneducated, his stepfather would also be unhappy. He had to be outstanding, worthy of his status as the son of a dragon and the grandson of a phoenix, and make his stepfather proud. But he couldn’t be too outstanding, as being too outstanding would easily sow the seeds of disaster.
As expected of an emperor, he is so difficult to serve.
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, Emperor Jingwen also changed his words: “…Mahjong is, after all, a minor sport that cannot be put on the stage. Even if it reaches the pinnacle, it is still just that.”Yes, yes, yes. Anyway, anything that cannot help build a beautiful Great Zhou is useless. Even if it can build a beautiful Great Zhou, it probably doesn’t sound high-end and is useless in the eyes of my cheap dad.
But living in modern times, Ye Shuo feels that there are top talents in all 360 professions, and as long as a person has one specialty, it is enough to make a living.
If you are good at playing mahjong, you can also have no worries about food and drink. Not to mention mahjong, making mud well is also a skill. Ye Shuo originally wanted to continue to develop, but he was forced to stop his career just after it started.
As a feudal emperor, Emperor Jingwen would never consult his son’s opinions on future development. Whatever he said was the truth.
Soon, Emperor Jingwen made a decision: “Wu Yi.”
Emperor Jingwen had realized that ordinary people could not do anything to him at all and might even be led astray by him. This kind of matter should be handed over to more reliable people.
At first, when Ye Shuo saw his cheap father shouting at the air, he was a little confused, thinking that his cheap father might have been so angry that he lost his mind. There was no one there.
Result…
Before he finished speaking, a figure rushed out, then quickly stopped and knelt on one knee.
“Master.”
This scene really stunned Ye Shuo, a modern man, and shattered his three views.
This guy, he he he can fly!!
This unscientific!
“…Mother, mother, mother!” Subconsciously, Ye Shuo rolled and crawled to grab Concubine Rong’s clothes, but when he turned around, he saw that his mother seemed to be used to it, as if she was already quite familiar with such scenes.
Concubine Rong was naturally familiar with it. After all, she had seen her father and brothers too many times when she was at home.
Therefore, Concubine Rong was a little puzzled: “What’s wrong, Shuo’er?”
Ye Shuo: “!!!”
Ye Shuo finally reacted at this moment. It turns out that Kung Fu exists in this world.
This was the first time that Emperor Jingwen saw his youngest son frightened like this. Emperor Jingwen thought that he was afraid of Wu Yi, and he was even more satisfied and more determined to let Wu Yi help look after him.
“Wu Yi, from now on you will take my place and keep a good eye on the little prince at all times. Don’t allow him to do anything unnecessary.” As for what unnecessary things are, it goes without saying that they refer to things like playing mahjong.
Emperor Jingwen took great pains to help him quit his gambling addiction.
Ye Shuo was stunned at first, and then his heart was filled with joy.
Yes, Ye Shuo did not feel that he had lost his freedom because of being monitored. Instead, he was quite excited.
Let me ask you which modern person is not curious about martial arts?
Ye Shuo remembered that when he was young in his previous life, he also had a deep yearning for martial arts. Later, when he grew up, he found that these were all fictional, so he gradually gave up the idea.
This has nothing to do with how high your IQ is. It’s purely a yearning for something you can’t do.
But Ye Shuo was afraid that his stepfather would see it. It would be troublesome if his stepfather changed his mind, so he quickly lowered his head before his stepfather looked over.
However, this scene was not what Emperor Jingwen saw. The little kid’s shoulders trembled as if he was extremely scared, which made Emperor Jingwen breathe a sigh of relief.
It’s enough to know to be afraid, so that he won’t continue to be lawless in the future.
The emperor has given an order, and Wu Yi, as a secret guard, dared not disobey. After being stunned for a moment, Wu Yi responded without hesitation: “Yes, Your Majesty, I will definitely take good care of the little prince on your behalf.”
Emperor Jingwen glanced at the little kid. Since he was a secret guard hired by the emperor, he would naturally only listen to the emperor. Even if the little guy said something fancy this time, it would be useless.
The two Hu brushes that I had specially asked the Ministry of Internal Affairs to send to me were wasted.
After sitting for a while, Emperor Jingwen did not stay here overnight. When it was time for dinner, he saw the Sixth Prince coming back from the upper study, and he finally felt much more relieved.
Fortunately, there is still someone in Qiuwu Palace who is doing real work.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but praise the Sixth Prince lavishly, which made the Sixth Prince very excited. Finally, Emperor Jingwen left in a good mood.
After Emperor Jingwen’s figure completely disappeared, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laughed out loud.
“Hey, Hey……”
Wu Yi was stunned and looked over subconsciously. However, the laughter disappeared almost the moment he looked over, so quickly that Wu Yi almost thought it was an illusion.
It seemed that it was no secret that the emperor kept secret guards. Only their deployment, rotation, training, skills, affiliation, directions of responsibility, and number of teams were considered confidential.
Ye Shuo had never asked before, so no one mentioned it.
Even the Sixth Prince knew about it for the first time.
Looking at the man standing like a wooden stake not far away, the Sixth Prince felt a bit complicated.
Although it is a good thing to get the attention of the emperor, and it is indeed enviable, but if it is in this way, the Sixth Prince thought about it and decided to forget it…
No one would consider surveillance as an honor. Only my little brother could do that.
Seeing his little brother acting as if nothing had happened, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but curl his lips: “I’ve told you a long time ago not to touch those things, or our father will be unhappy.”
Living in Qiuwu Palace for the same two months, how could the Sixth Prince not know what the Imperial Concubine and his younger brother were doing?
The Sixth Prince naturally tried to persuade them, but no one listened to him. After trying again and again, the Sixth Prince finally gave up helplessly.
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but roll his eyes at the roof.
He doesn’t care whether his cheap dad is happy or not, as long as he is happy, isn’t that enough?
There are so many things that my cheap father doesn’t like, and it’s impossible to avoid every one of them accurately, that would be exhausting. So it’s better to just let it go, as long as it doesn’t touch the principles, I believe that my cheap father who can become the emperor naturally has his own strengths, and he will accept it sooner or later.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh: “Xiao Ming, you worry about too many things. Be careful not to age prematurely.”
“Call me Sixth Brother!” The Sixth Prince couldn’t help himself and reached out to knock on his brother’s head.
Then, the Sixth Prince felt disappointed.
He also wanted to be as carefree and free as his little brother, doing whatever he wanted, but reality constantly reminded him that he couldn’t.
He did not have the noble status that the younger brother was born with, so he needed to work a hundred times harder to gain a firm foothold among his brothers.
And now, his efforts have finally been noticed by his father.
Thinking back to his father’s praise of him during dinner, the Sixth Prince felt that it was all worth it.
Ye Shuo covered his head and collapsed completely on the Sixth Prince’s bed with his clothes clearly stained with mud.
Coming back to his senses, the Sixth Prince could no longer bear it: “Get up!”
“I won’t, I won’t, I won’t.”
It was midsummer, and the stars were like dust falling on the sky. The moonlight was gentle, passing through the window lattice and scattering on the bedside. The cicadas outside the door chirped, adding to the tranquility of the summer night and matching the leisure and freedom of the two children at the moment.
Just after the hour of guarding, Wu Yi had to speak up: “Your Highness, it’s time to rest.”
This guy, does he even have to take care of my own eating and sleeping?
Ignoring the Sixth Prince’s obviously amused look, Ye Shuo’s face became serious, he patted his butt, and sat up without saying a word.
The Sixth Prince’s smile suddenly stopped.
Something is wrong. Why is my little brother so obedient today?
However, before the Sixth Prince could figure it out, the two of them had disappeared.
*
Back to the side hall, two months have passed, and the side hall has been redecorated. Ye Shuo has specifically instructed that cinnabar is not allowed to be used.
Although they didn’t quite believe what the little prince said about cinnabar being harmful and asking them not to use it again, since the little prince had spoken, the Ministry of Internal Affairs just did what he said.
The new side hall was extremely simple, with almost no paint used, so Ye Shuo had already moved in.
He even asked his mother to add some money to get a slightly bigger bed, so that it wouldn’t matter even if Ye Shuo rolled around on it.
It took about a quarter of an hour to wash and get clean. Ye Shuo climbed onto the bed and covered himself with the quilt without Wu Yi’s reminder.
When Wu Yi saw this, he thought, the little prince doesn’t seem to be as naughty as the master said. Isn’t he quite well-behaved?
After the little man in front of him lay down, Wu Yi was about to jump onto the beam to rest, but suddenly he heard him say, “Wait a minute.”
Wu Yi turned around and looked at him with a bit of confusion: “What do you want, young prince?”
“I usually go to bed at 11:00 p.m. on weekdays. I couldn’t sleep so early today.” Ye Shuo was not lying. As a modern man, he was lucky to be able to fall asleep after 10:00 p.m.
So?
Wu Yi waited quietly for what was to come, and was on guard to prevent the little prince from suddenly starting to act up.
“So, can you tell me a few stories?”
So that’s it.
Wu Yi breathed a sigh of relief, then refused: “I’m sorry, little prince, I’m not good at this. If you really want to listen, I can call the nanny for you.”
“Anything is fine.” Ye Shuo blinked his eyes, looking like His Highness was very considerate and easy to talk to.
“Since you are not good at telling stories, then choose something you are good at, anything will do.”
The only things he was good at were spying, lurking, assassination, etc., but the key was that all of this was confidential and nothing could be told to the little prince.
Wu Yi was troubled. Just when he decided to ignore him and was about to disappear, Ye Shuo spoke again.
“How about you tell me about martial arts? These shouldn’t be relevant, right?”
If we only talk about martial arts, then yes, there isn’t.
Wu Yi thought about it and didn’t find anything taboo, so he sat at the head of Ye Shuo’s bed at his invitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Internal Force
chapters.content:
If you want to learn martial arts, you must first understand its principles and operating mechanisms. It is similar to writing a program. You must first understand the basic structure of the thing itself.
After knowing the algorithm, you can proceed step by step, and play, modify and fill in the algorithm one by one.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo asked a lot of questions, for example –
“Wu Yi, Wu Yi, what exactly is this internal force? How is it formed?”
“Wu Yi, Wu Yi, is there a fixed route for the inner force to run? Does it rely on personal performance, or is there something else? Are there any taboos that must not be touched?”
“Can everyone cultivate this inner strength, or does it require certain conditions to be met?”
“Does learning martial arts require the assistance of a technique? What is the difference between one technique and another?”
…and so on.
Because the little prince asked some very simple questions, basically you can find the answers by flipping through the book.
Besides, Wu Yi had never heard that someone could accomplish anything just by asking questions. If he wanted to get started, he needed someone to watch over him carefully and teach him patiently. Among all the secret guards, Wu Yi was a talented person picked out of a hundred, otherwise he would not have been able to serve the emperor.But despite this, when Wu Yi first started practicing, it took him a full half month to slowly feel the Qi with the guidance of his leader. This is even more difficult for ordinary people who have no foundation and no one to teach them.
Therefore, Wu Yi just thought that Ye Shuo was just curious as a child and answered his question casually.
Afterward, Ye Shuo quickly understood that the so-called internal force was actually just a kind of energy. As for the reason for its formation, no one knew it, but it had always existed from ancient times to the present.
Ye Shuo guessed that this was probably what made this world different from his previous life.
Since anyone with the right physique can practice it, regardless of occasion, time or place, the difference is probably that it exists in the air that everyone can access. It is colorless and odorless, so it exists like oxygen, but is invisible to the naked eye.
Ye Shuo quickly accepted this matter.
As for the differences between the exercises, there are actually differences. Just like mathematics, there are some fixed formulas, but the solutions are very different. The same problem can be solved in many ways, some are more convenient and quicker, and some are more complicated.
But overall, they all lead to the same goal, which is to make the “qi” in the body more solid and powerful.
“You mean, the location of Dantian is here, right?” Ye Shuo opened his eyes, covered his stomach and insisted that it was Dantian.
Wu Yi was caught off guard and subconsciously wanted to correct: “No, my lord. It’s here.” As he said that, he pointed to the place where the Yinjiao, Qihai, Shimen and Guanyuan acupoints intersected below Ye Shuo’s navel.
[T/L = Various
Acupoints
.]
“Then…” Ye Shuo pretended to understand and moved his hand down a little bit: “Is it here?”
Although it is a little lower, it is still far away from the Dantian.
He obviously didn’t understand.
“It’s still not right.”
After several attempts, Wu Yi considered for a moment and said, “My lord, I’m sorry.”
As he spoke, under Ye Shuo’s expectant gaze, Wu Yi gently pressed his palm towards Ye Shuo’s dantian.
In just a moment, Wu Yi withdrew his hand.
In an instant, Ye Shuo felt a heat in his dantian, and something seemed to have appeared in his body out of thin air. He immediately understood that this should be Wu Yi’s internal force.
However, this heat was not Ye Shuo’s own after all. His untrained body was like a funnel. The heat was stored for less than two breaths before it quickly dissipated.
Wu Yi just wanted to answer his question in the simplest and quickest way, so naturally he wouldn’t put in much effort.
Although he looked at Wu Yi with surprise on his face, Ye Shuo secretly noted down the trajectory of the movement of this internal force.
From bottom to top, they are Guanyuan, Mingmen, Zhongshu, Zhiyang, Lingtai, Juque… until Shenting, Baihui and Fengchi.
From top to bottom, they are Qi Hai, Fu She, Hui Yin… Ji Men, Yingu, Sanyin Jiao and Yongquan.
From left to right and from right to left, there are seven acupoints respectively. In total, this heat passes through sixty-four acupoints.
[T/L = If someone really wants the vast knowledge, then click
here
.]
These acupoints are arranged in a certain order. As long as Ye Shuo works his way back in order, he doesn’t even need any written records to know how Wu Yi’s internal force works.
As a subordinate of his cheap father, Wu Yi is always around to protect his cheap father. Even if he is not the strongest, he is one of the strongest.
And the word “Wu” is very telling.
Wu Yi, Wu Yi… It’s hard for Ye Shuo not to have associations.
‘Your technique is great, but now it’s mine.’
Ye Shuo silently recited this sentence in his heart, but his face behaved very well. Soon, he asked the last question –
“I heard that my grandfather was a brave warrior who rarely lost a battle in his life. So… how good is his Kung Fu?”
“The Duke of Zhen’s kung fu is naturally excellent.”
Wu Yi said this without much hesitation.
Ye Shuo saw that although there was admiration in his eyes, there was no longing or fear. Ye Shuo immediately knew what was going on.
As expected, since the royal family is the ruler of this country, their foundation is naturally the strongest.
Ye Shuo felt relieved and also gave up the plan of looking for his mother.
Wu Yi would never have thought that just with a small, unintentional action, his biggest secret was known to others.
During the whole process, he was unaware of anything and even felt that the little prince was easy to take care of and manage, not at all as troublesome as his master had worried about.
Look, after listening to the story, isn’t the little prince planning to go to sleep quietly and obediently?
“Wu Yi, I’m sleepy…I want to sleep…”
Ye Shuo rubbed his eyes, then slowly covered himself with the quilt: “Good night Wu Yi, see you tomorrow.”
Wu Yi vaguely understood that this good night should be a greeting to him. Wu Yi was about to say that this was not in accordance with the rules, but he saw that the little prince had wrapped himself tightly in the quilt and turned away.
Wu Yi was stunned for a moment, then he bowed and disappeared in the blink of an eye. At this moment, he was thinking that if the young prince could be as well-behaved and quiet as he was tonight, he would not mind telling him more insignificant stories like this one.
Wu Yi didn’t know that the moment he turned around, Ye Shuo, who was originally curled up in the quilt, suddenly changed his expression, raised the corners of his lips, and smiled silently.
Done.
Ever since Wu Yi mentioned inadvertently that people who practiced martial arts would have better physiques than ordinary people, Ye Shuo became determined to learn this thing.
In ancient times, when medical conditions were so backward, a cold could kill a person, so Ye Shuo would not miss anything that was said to be good for health.
As a person who had suffered from a serious illness, Ye Shuo would cherish his healthy body too much now.
As for the fact that practicing martial arts requires a strong physique, Ye Shuo thinks this is not a problem at all.
Although there is no conclusive evidence to prove that he inherited genes from his grandfather, but judging from various signs, it is basically certain.
The principle has been figured out, the hardware conditions have been met, and the way the internal force works has also been figured out. Now everything is ready, only the Dongfeng is missing.
[T/L =
Dōng Fēng means easterly wind; refers to the doctor, but here for ‘master’.
]
It’s just the order of the sixty-four acupoints, which is not a problem for Ye Shuo.
There are 52 single acupoints, 309 double acupoints, and 50 extra-meridian acupoints, totaling 720 acupoints in the whole body. When he was researching his family medical history in his previous life, he studied Chinese medicine for a period of time, and now he still remembers them all.
Wu Yi is usually a very cautious person, but he lost here.
After all, it is basically impossible to find someone who can remember hundreds of acupoints, but he was unlucky enough to meet one.
After a while, Ye Shuo checked again. After confirming that Wu Yi was not there, he lifted the quilt and sat up.
Then he reversed the heat trend chart bit by bit in his mind.
Soon, Ye Shuo began to try to find the sense of Qi.
About an hour later, he finally found some feeling.
At the beginning, it was just a wisp of smoke-like airflow like a firefly or candle flame that could be extinguished at any time. Ye Shuo controlled it carefully so that the airflow flowed through the sixty-four acupuncture points in sequence.
Like a star map waiting to be lit up, the air flow was swaying, and it was difficult to move forward.
Ye Shuo was not in a hurry and seemed very patient, pushing forward little by little.
Time passed minutes by minutes, and in the blink of an eye, it was about to dawn.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo, like the Sixth Prince, did not have the habit of having anyone keep watch in the room at night. Besides, the maids and wet nurses all knew that the little prince would be angry if their sleep was disturbed, so there had been no unusual movements in the room.
In the meantime, Ye Shuo vaguely heard the noise of the Sixth Prince opening the door to go to the study room next door. The noise lasted for about a cup of tea and then disappeared.
At some point, beads of sweat suddenly appeared on Ye Shuo’s forehead, and it was obvious that the most critical moment had arrived.
After struggling forward for so long, that trace of energy finally approached the dantian.
After circling for a long time, the airflow finally felt an inexplicable suction force and was completely sucked into the dantian.
With a “boom”, Ye Shuo was shocked. When he opened his eyes again, his eyes became exceptionally bright and energetic. He didn’t look like a man who had been up all night at all.
The same warmth also appeared in his dantian at this moment.
Although it was just a tiny trace that seemed to be about to go out at any time, and was even weaker than Wu Yi’s casual slap, Ye Shuo was already very satisfied.
At least it proves that his conjecture is correct, and all he needs to do from now on is accumulate experience.
As for how to release and apply it…
Ye Shuo thought of the techniques of modern martial arts. Modern martial arts do not have such a thing as internal force. What matters is practicing how to exert force.
To give an example, when you punch, you can’t just punch. No matter how strong the arm muscles are, they are ultimately limited. You have to start from the feet, push the ground with the soles of the feet, exert force with the ankles, go through the knee joints, and then to the thighs and waist and hips. The waist and hips drive the shoulders. What matters is that each part is transmitted and condensed into one.
I think the same principle applies to internal strength. If you want high attack power, you need high burst power.
Ye Shuo’s breath sank, and the gossamer-like internal force in his body instantly spread to the sixty-four acupuncture points. Feeling a force from inside out eager to rush out, Ye Shuo imitated what he saw in TV dramas, put two fingers together, and swung them out quickly.
The next moment, the red candle three meters away went out.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Let Down
chapters.content:
Wow, it seems to be ok.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo was satisfied.
After calming down and feeling it for a while, Ye Shuo found that he did not feel any discomfort in his body. He immediately realized that he should be considered successful.
Although the usage is a bit crude, it is better than nothing.
If Wu Yi were here, his eyes would pop out of his head when he saw this scene.
He released the internal energy outwardly. He actually completed the release of the internal energy just by his own exploration!
Unfortunately, Wu Yi seemed to know that Ye Shuo didn’t like to keep people around when he was sleeping, so he slept on a tree branch outside all night and missed everything perfectly.
Ye Shuo was still young and full of energy, so when he went out, no one noticed that he had not slept all night.
When they reached the main hall, it was just time for breakfast. Ye Shuo sat down on the stool as usual, and Nanny Jing beside him naturally came over with the bowl to feed him.
Well, who isn’t a pampered little darling?Seeing the kindness inadvertently in Nanny Jing’s eyes, Ye Shuo obediently opened his mouth and swallowed the porridge with duck egg yolk and sea cucumber particles in the spoon in one gulp.
When Nanny Jing saw him like this, she smiled and said, “Your Highness, eat slowly. No one will snatch the food from you.”
As she spoke, she picked up a handkerchief and wiped the corners of his mouth.
Nanny Jing is not yet fifty this year, which is still very young in modern times, but here she has reached the age where she can enjoy her grandchildren and live out her days in peace.
Unfortunately, Nanny Jing was alone and had no family to support. There was no turning back once she entered the deep palace, so she could only pour all her love into Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo was also happy to enjoy himself, calling “Mammy, Mammy” every day, which made Mammy Jing’s heart melt. It was rare to see such a well-behaved and obedient child, how could Mammy Jing not like him.
Looking at the imperial concubine beside her, she was obviously used to this scene and didn’t notice anything wrong. She ate the mushroom shredded chicken in front of her slowly and said, “This morning, the kitchen has developed a dessert with ham filling. I think it tastes good. Mammy, you can also pick one for him to try.”
“Okay.”
Taking in the whole scene, Wu Yi couldn’t help but frown secretly.
In his opinion, the little prince’s speech and behavior were totally unlike those of a two-year-old child. He was obviously able to do many things by himself, let alone eating. Why did he need to be fed now?
No wonder the little prince caused his master such a headache, the imperial concubine had a lot to thank for this.
If you keep pampering and spoiling him, when will the little prince be able to stand on his own feet?
Wu Yi secretly observed from the side, preparing to summarize everything he saw and tell it all to the emperor when he asked.
As a secret guard, one must not only be proficient in martial arts, but also think about what the master thinks and worry about what the master worries about.
After finally waiting for Ye Shuo to finish his breakfast, Wu Yi followed him all the time. He discovered that not only the imperial concubine, but even the eunuchs and palace maids in Qiuwu Palace followed him subconsciously.
Especially the senior palace maids such as Su Yue and Su Xin, whose attitudes were exactly the same as that of Nanny Jing.
This is far from the end. Soon, Zhao Chongrong and three others also arrived.
Of course, this time they are not playing mahjong. How could they have the courage to commit such a crime against the law?
But after one night, the three of them could no longer bear the worry in their hearts, so they got up early in the morning and came to Qiuwu Palace.
When the three of them saw each other at the door, they realized that each other’s thoughts were the same as theirs.
Zhao Chongrong and others were just being low-key, not because they were heartless. On the contrary, it was because they had not been in contact with outsiders for a long time that if someone suddenly broke through the defense line, that person would appear to be extremely good and different from others.
It has been really quiet around them for too long.
After two months of getting along, it was impossible for the three of them to remain indifferent.
“Let Concubine Zhao take a look to see if you are injured anywhere?” She never dared to say these words for fear of being blamed by Emperor Jingwen. But after what happened yesterday, Zhao Chongrong seemed to have changed a little.
Ye Shuo did not resist upon hearing this and allowed the three ladies to examine him.
Seeing that he didn’t seem to be seriously injured, the three of them breathed a sigh of relief.
It was said that the emperor didn’t know what was wrong recently and suddenly started beating his son. Zhao Chongrong felt uneasy when she thought of this.
Fortunately, the emperor was not so tactless as to hit a child who was only two years old.
“Your Highness must have been frightened yesterday. Look, what did Concubine Zhao bring you today?” As she spoke, Zhao Chongrong took over from her personal maid… a nine-ring chain?
Playing Mahjong is a waste of time, but Nine Rings is an educational toy. The emperor can’t say anything about it, right?
Wu Yi, who was watching from the side, was wondering what was wrong with Concubine Zhao. The young prince looked so energetic and didn’t look like he was frightened at all.
As a result, before Wu Yi could finish his thought, he saw the little prince in front of him frowning and pouting, and a feeling of grievance suddenly came up.
“Concubine Zhao, you don’t know. Father was so fierce yesterday. I was so scared…”
Wu Yi frowned as he watched.
But what he didn’t expect was that the three concubines fell for it. They comforted and coaxed him, and soon the little prince’s hands were filled with all kinds of toys.
When they were leaving, the three ladies were reluctant to leave, thinking that their children had really suffered a great injustice this time.
Xu Chongyi thought to herself that if this kind of thing happened again in the future, she would think of a way to see if she could ask the empress dowager for help and let her take care of it.
Although the emperor is not the empress dowager’s biological son, but a beautiful empress that the late emperor insisted on establishing despite opposition from his ministers due to his dissolute behavior, there is no affection between the empress dowager and the emperor, and the two have almost no interactions, but if the empress dowager really asks for it, the emperor will have to give her some face no matter what.
And Xu Chongyi was from the Empress Dowager’s family.
Judging from the fact that Xu Chongyi was still just a Chongyi to Emperor Jingwen for so many years, Emperor Jingwen actually did not really trust his stepmother, and was even a little indifferent and ignored her. But isn’t this the only solution? If there is really no other way, this is the only way.
Wu Yi, who had been trained as a leader since he was a child and often walked on the brink of death, couldn’t understand.
As soon as Ye Shuo saw his expression, he knew that this was not something that a secret guard like him could understand.
This person may never know that in order to please the elders, one does not have to be well-behaved and obedient. Appropriate behavior of acting coquettish can better promote the relationship with the elders.
It’s the same principle as it’s easier to build relationships with others if you ask for help appropriately.
If everyone has a cold face, what’s the fun?
Alas, he can’t even figure out such a simple thing. He is hopeless.
Although Wu Yi didn’t understand, it didn’t stop him from drawing conclusions.
He felt that the main reason why the little prince was so obsessed with pleasure was that too many people doted on him.
What the little prince needs now is someone who can control him.
So, Wu Yi took out a copy of Thousand Characters from somewhere, and said in a slightly stiff tone: “Young Prince, it’s time for you to study.”
Ye Shuo was not panicked at all and quickly kicked the ball back: “But you have to teach me first, so that I know what is written on it.”
He has forgotten that he is illiterate, so he has to learn this.
“You have to read it to me first.”
Wu Yi felt that what the little prince said made sense, so he picked up the “Thousand Character Classic” and started reading it.
Ye Shuo took the opportunity to secretly practice internal skills under his nose.
Don’t ask, asking is stimulating.
After about two hours, Wu Yi discovered that the little prince seemed a little…stupid?
After such a long time and with so many words, he could only recognize a few here and there, and those were the simplest ones.
“I know. This is ‘Heaven’ and this is ‘Earth’, right?” Seeing the little prince pointing at the words ‘Heaven’ and ‘Earth’ in the book with a serious look on his face, as if asking for praise, Wu Yi could not say a word of disdain.
Then the little prince asked again: “What are these?”
Wu Yi then noticed that he had picked up a travel book at some point and was comparing the words in the travel book with the Thousand Character Classic one by one, appearing to be very studious.
Wu Yi thought about it and read the travel notes to him.
One travelogue, two travelogues, three travelogues…Finally, in addition to heaven and earth, the little prince learned three other new characters.
Although it was more tiring than his usual shifts, Wu Yi felt that it was all worth it.
“Wu Yi, you teach really well.” As the sun set, Ye Shuo looked up and praised sincerely.
After half a day, he was tired of listening to free travel notes, so he planned to try a storybook tomorrow.
I have to say that Wu Yi’s voice is still okay, and it would be more touching if he read the script.
“Your Highness, I am ashamed to accept your praise.”
A few days passed like this, and Emperor Jingwen was still thinking about this matter. He came to inspect the results soon. However, as soon as his secret guard opened his mouth, Emperor Jingwen immediately found something wrong.
“Hmm? What’s wrong with your throat?”
Emperor Jingwen became alert: “Did Shuo’er cause trouble again?”
As a result, Wu Yi’s answer was somewhat beyond his expectations.
“Your Majesty, the little prince has been very quiet recently and very studious. He has already learned a lot of new words.”
Out of habit, Wu Yi never mentioned a word about his own contributions.
Although Wu Yi’s background as a secret guard meant he could be absolutely trustworthy, Emperor Jingwen’s first reaction when he heard this was still doubt.
Was the son Wu Yi was talking about really his own?
How can that little bastard ever be so calm?
“Are you sure??”
Wu Yi was very sure: “I am willing to guarantee it with my life.”
Hmm? ? So my son suddenly changed his nature?
Sure enough, the decision to let the secret guards watch him was the right one. Only someone like Wu Yi could cure him.
Emperor Jingwen was skeptical, but when he saw that Wu Yi’s expression did not seem fake, he gradually believed what he said.
“Well done.” Emperor Jingwen relaxed his brows, praised him, and decided to use this trick to deal with him if this situation happened again in the future.
Wu Yi was very excited.
Afterward, Wu Yi talked about several ladies.
Sure enough, Emperor Jingwen frowned subconsciously. He did not expect that his youngest son would be so good at pleasing other Concubine.
You know, a loving mother often spoils her son. Having a royal concubine was already a headache for Emperor Jingwen. If there were three more concubines like Zhao Chongrong, Emperor Jingwen would know without a doubt that his son would be ruined in the future.
Neither being too eye-catching nor being too incompetent was the result that Emperor Jingwen wanted.
But he couldn’t issue an order to separate them from the little prince. In this case, he could only let the most trustworthy people around him keep a close watch on them.
As for the executor, you don’t have to think about who it is.
Emperor Jingwen could not help but said in a deep voice: “Wu Yi, now that things have come to this, I can only count on you. I believe that you will not let me down.”
Wu Yi’s face became solemn upon hearing this. Without hesitation, he knelt on one knee and said in a loud voice: “I will definitely live up to my master’s orders!”

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Fever
chapters.content:
Wu Yi was very serious, and was very excited.
After being “entrusted with an important task”, Wu Yi carried out Emperor Jingwen’s orders even more meticulously.
Then his voice became even more hoarse.
Although the training as a secret guard meant that Ye Shuo could not see too many emotional fluctuations on his face, but from his increasing seriousness and the increasingly tight schedule of courses, it can be seen that his stepfather must have told him something.
Needless to say, they basically asked him to keep a close eye on himself.
Wu Yi is a very obedient man, and also a very honest person, he will do whatever his stepfather asks him to do.
But what Wu Yi didn’t know was that the biggest flaw in this matter had already bean himself. As for the fact that Ye Shuo needed to “learn” several new words every day, it really became a trivial matter.
Using something that you are familiar with by heart to exchange for his labor is really like bullying an honest man.
Perhaps it was the secret guard’s behavior that finally aroused Ye Shuo’s few feelings of guilt. Even for a man like Ye Shuo, his conscience began to ache.
It was really embarrassing to bully him anymore, this guy was quite pitiful. Ye Shuo thought about it, then reluctantly reduced the number of times he listened to the story.Wu Yi’s voice gradually got better.
This is probably the real situation, but it is not the case in the eyes of others.
The first one is the imperial concubine. At first, she was very happy to see her son studying. She hopes her son will become successful. Every mother has this idea and no one is immune to it.
But gradually, she found that her son was becoming less and less happy (thinking about practicing martial arts), and he seldom smiled recently (he learned internal skills but did not have the corresponding moves, and was thinking about whether to “transfer” some from Wu Yi, but was afraid that the moves learned by the secret guard would be too obvious to be discovered). The most important thing was that, except for sleeping, Wu Yi had to follow him all the time even when he was eating. If it were her, she would have been unable to bear it a long time ago. How could such a young child bear it?
Just thinking about it made the imperial concubine feel extremely painful.
“Mammy, do you think I am too harsh on Shuo’er? Isn’t this bad?” If she didn’t want her son to sit in that position, he wouldn’t have to do so.
Relying on his status and family background, even if the little thing can’t read a single word in the end, he can still ensure that he will have no worries in his life.
The child who used to be happy no matter what he did now doesn’t even smile. The more familiar people are with him, the easier it is for them to notice the difference.
This day, Concubine Rong could no longer hold it in. She sat in front of the dressing table and couldn’t help showing a look of panic.
The nanny’s hand holding the comb paused. How could the nanny not feel distressed when the little prince was treated like this?
But……
“But this is the fate of royal children, Your Majesty…” Emperor Jingwen was a man of great strategy and wisdom, so how could he tolerate his own children being mediocre and incompetent?
Even so, Concubine Rong still felt distressed: “But Mammy, Shuo’er hasn’t smiled recently.”
Concubine Rong counted them one by one: “No more quarrels about playing mahjong.”
“I don’t make clay figures anymore.”
You know, these two are his favorite things!
Concubine Rong couldn’t help but look at the clay figurines placed on one side of the dressing table. Although Concubine Rong always disliked mud because it was black and dirty, when Ye Shuo gave her his work, Concubine Rong actually didn’t refuse.
While scolding him, the imperial concubine held her handkerchief and placed the clay figurine on her dressing table.
The more she looked at it, the more the imperial concubine felt that the clay figurine seemed quite good.
Although it was the work of a child, if you look closely, it is still very delicate.
Three points of charm plus the fact that his son made it himself, the final product becomes nine points.
The imperial concubine couldn’t help but raise her hand and gently touched the clay figure’s face.
The nanny beside her couldn’t help but feel uncomfortable after hearing this.
However, what happened next made the two of them even more worried.
Ye Shuo started to lose weight.
At first Ye Shuo himself didn’t understand what was going on. He just felt that the clothes that fit him perfectly started to become loose, the baby fat on his face also shrunk a lot, and the lines of his jawline gradually became clearer.
And he hasn’t done anything recently, and his appetite hasn’t decreased. Considering that all this happened after he gained internal strength, Ye Shuo vaguely understood what was going on.
Combined with Wu Yi, Wu Yi also has a great figure. In his previous life, he would have been a standard hunk, which made Ye Shuo yearn for him for a while.
Although he had a good figure in his previous life, it was after all the result of training in the gym. It was only for show but had no real use.
Wu Yi’s inverted triangle figure is real gold and silver.
Ye Shuo had never thought that practicing martial arts could have such an effect. It seemed that he wouldn’t have to worry about such things when he grew up.
Ye Shuo also felt that he was too cute in the past, he ate well and used food well, his figure was a little rounder than that of other children, and now that he has lost weight, it is just right.
Ye Shuo was quite satisfied with this.
However, Concubine Rong, who was watching on the side, felt heartbroken.
After all, she is a mother, so of course she thinks her child is healthier if he is chubby. Although he looks better now that he has lost weight, good looks cannot be eaten.
Look at this little face, it’s so skinny, and the bones are starting to hurt!
“Mom, I’m fine, really.” Feeling a little frightened by his mother’s pitying and annoyed gaze, Ye Shuo moved the embroidery cushion next to him as if to prove that his health had not deteriorated but was much stronger than before.
The embroidered cushion was not much shorter than him, and Ye Shuo could not have moved it before, but now he could easily lift it off the ground.
“Look, Mom, I am very powerful now.”
But it was useless, Concubine Rong had already determined that it was Wu Yi’s problem.
She cannot resist the emperor’s orders, but don’t expect her to accept them willingly.
Now, in her eyes, Wu Yi is the culprit who abused her son. While holding her son in her arms, Concubine Rong looked at Wu Yi with resentment in her eyes.
Wu Yi stood still like a mountain, not thinking that he had done anything wrong. He was just following the orders given by the emperor.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Mom, it’s really not what you imagined, mom!
Later, Zhao Chongrong and others also discovered this matter.
“Look at how thin his face is…” How could a two-year-old child bear so much? The emperor was being too harsh.
Zhao Chongrong’s expression looked as if he was about to rush up and punch Wu Yi once or twice.
“I’m fine, Concubine Zhao. Look, I’m fine.” Ye Shuo finally told the truth, but no one believed him at all.
Zhao Chongrong and the other two looked at him with more and more distressed eyes: “We know, we all know.” No one knew what they knew.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo’s heart tightened.
Oops, I seem to have over-pretended in the past. I wonder if it’s too late to make amends now.
Facing the accusing gazes of the three people, Wu Yi was silent for a moment this time, still unmoved.
The next was the Crown Prince. When the Crown Prince heard that Emperor Jingwen had sent out the secret guards, he was a little concerned. But then he found out that Emperor Jingwen nominally asked him to follow, but in fact he was monitoring him. The Crown Prince felt a little sympathetic to his younger brother.
Although the prince had never seen the true appearance of the secret guards, he knew that they were known for their harshness.
(T/L: Ok guys, my keyboard is not working, so I can’t edit and translate much. So let’s hope for my keyboard to be repaired soon.)
After finally pacifying the ladies, Ye Shuo was just about to go for a stroll in the Imperial Garden.
Because Wu Yi was with him, Ye Shuo was very brave this time. He walked around the ponds, wells, and rockery. He also memorized the route map of the entire palace to avoid being at a loss when he needed it later.
As luck would have it, he ran into the prince who had just returned from the Qinzheng Palace.
Ye Shuo was about to say hello, but he remembered that his step-father’s one-year ban from approaching the Eastern Palace and the Crown Prince had not yet ended, and he suddenly became listless.
Looking at Wu Yi who was following closely behind his younger brother, the prince always felt that his younger brother was like a puppet at the moment. He just smiled, but then he thought of something and his face was full of disappointment. The prince frowned subconsciously.
How come such a good child has become like this?
After all, the prince felt a little different about this child whom he had held in his arms.
So the prince stopped and said, “Shuo’er, it happens that I got a little toy recently. Do you want to go with me to take a look?”
What were he looking at? He couldn’t enter the East Palace. Thinking back to the musician and the maid who had rubbed his ears before, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a pain in his heart.
As expected of someone from the Prince’s Palace, he is so professional, not much worse than a professional ear cleaner.
But now, all of this has become a thing of the past.
Ye Shuo suddenly became somewhat uninterested and waved his hands feebly: “No need, no need.”
The prince couldn’t help but frown even deeper. Since his little brother was unwilling to go, the prince would not force him.
Just when Wu Yi passed by, he said indifferently: “Although it is the order of the emperor, you must know the ultimate goal. Don’t put the cart before the horse.”
Ye Shuo looked up suddenly.
Wait, what does this have to do with Wu Yi?
The prince will not…
However, before Ye Shuo could speak, the prince left.
This time, Wu Yi finally couldn’t control himself and his eyes changed slightly.
He could ignore what others said, but the prince was the heir to the throne, and was a little different from others.
But in the end, after a slight fluctuation, Wu Yi remained the same.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo breathed a sigh of relief.
Well, as long as he doesn’t take it to heart…
Finally, it was the Sixth Prince. Even though he was oblivious to what was happening outside, he couldn’t help but speak up a few days later: “You’ve lost weight.”
As long as he was away from the nanny and the imperial concubine, Ye Shuo’s self-care ability would soar. He peeled an orange and put it in his mouth, saying, “It has become more beautiful.”
The Sixth Prince frowned and disagreed: “Being too thin is not good for your health.”
The Sixth Prince had a deep understanding of this. He was like this when he was a child. He had no memory of being abused by his wet nurse at that time, so as long as he could remember, the Sixth Prince often drank medicine, and all his memories were of bitter medicinal soups.
Later, when he could speak and remember things, things got better, so in his eyes, being thin was associated with poor health.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch his face.
It doesn’t seem to have gotten much smaller, just the jawbone is a little more obvious. Why does it become so serious in their eyes?
Ye Shuo looked at the wrist of the child opposite him, then looked at his own wrist, and could not help but remain silent.
How dare the Sixth Prince talk about him when his wrist, a child less than three years old, is almost thicker than his.
His own arms were white and plump, like lotus roots, while the Sixth Prince was almost skin and bones. It was obvious which one had the real problem.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to prove himself so that they wouldn’t treat him as a glass doll.
As a result, a few days later, Ye Shuo, who was listening to a book, suddenly felt something was wrong. His cheeks felt hot, and the temperature was a little high.
However, because he had always been in good health, he didn’t take it seriously during the day and even ate one more goose leg for dinner than usual.
At night, around three o’clock in the morning, Ye Shuo woke up for the first time and found that his throat was very dry, thirsty, and a little hoarse.
This symptom seems familiar…
Belatedly, he reached out and touched his head.
Well, it’s a little hot.
It looks like he has a fever.
It’s over. This time, Wu Yi can’t wash himself clean even if he jumps into the Yellow River.

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Sleep
chapters.content:
I just said that I was in good health, but it turned out like this…
Ye Shuo sat on the edge of the bed for a long time with a wooden face.
During this time, he tried to circulate his internal energy, but internal energy is not a miracle drug after all, and it cannot cure children’s colds and fevers.
Of course, it may also be related to the fact that he has only been practicing for a short time. The internal strength he has, like a firefly, is really not of much use.
The trace of internal energy in Dantian dissipated. Ye Shuo felt a little bit of heat at first, but in a moment, the internal energy was exhausted, and the heat that had risen with great difficulty went out with a “puff” like blowing out a lamp.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh deeply.
He didn’t want to do this, but… he felt really sorry for Wu Yi!
