You know what, Ye Shuo really thought so. He really didn’t plan to go back today. He planned to stay with his little nephew for a few nights and make the most of the time before school starts.
Although he thought in his heart that it was unlikely that his cheap father would not react by this year, but! What if? What if it works? Wouldn’t that mean another year of happiness?
Ye Shuo didn’t feel ashamed at all to fight for the bed with his own nephew. After all, he had slept in the prince’s bed in the past, so why would he care about the prince’s son?
“Ninth Uncle…” It was the first time that the little grandson of the emperor slept on the same bed with someone else, and he seemed a little shy.
However, the next second, Ye Shuo pushed him back: “You’re just a kid, there’s nothing to be embarrassed about.” When saying this, Ye Shuo completely forgot that when he was three years old, he had specially installed a blackout curtain to prevent the palace servants from peeking.
“Don’t talk, go to sleep.” Then Ye Shuo suddenly remembered something: “By the way, do you still wet the bed at night?”
“Ninth Uncle!!”
“Okay, okay, I won’t tease you anymore, go to sleep.”
Having said that, Ye Shuo immediately closed his eyes.
I don’t know why, but when the little grandson of the emperor broke free from his shame and anger, he always felt that the reaction of the Ninth Prince in front of him was a little strange, as if he was avoiding something.
Then, not long after, Ye Xun probably knew who he was hiding from.
When Wang Ziquan arrived, he heard the news that the Ninth Prince and the little grandson had already gone to bed.
Wang Ziquan immediately gasped. It was over. The emperor was still waiting!
After thinking it over and weighing it for a long time, Wang Ziquan finally decided to go and wake up the Ninth Prince himself.
When he heard the noise outside, Ye Shuo knew something was wrong. When he saw Wang Ziquan walking towards him through the cracks in his eyes, Ye Shuo immediately realized that his stepfather was determined to make him go to school this time, and he was particularly angry.
Otherwise, you wouldn’t know that they have gone to bed, but you still have to wake yourself up.
Seeing that he couldn’t hide anymore, Ye Shuo had no choice but to get up from the bed.
Just as Ye Shuo slowly began to put on his shoes, he saw that Eunuch Wang had already gone out. Ye Xun couldn’t help but ask in a low voice: “Ninth Uncle… is it really scary to go to the study?”
“Of course!” Ye Shuo thought about it.
The scary thing about going to the study room is not the studying, but the fact that you can’t graduate at all. No matter how much knowledge you have learned there, you will not be allowed to skip grades or graduate early. No matter who you are, you must stay there until you are old enough to enter the court. They will let you go, and the connection should not be too tight.
After you have memorized this book, there is still the next book. The worst that can happen is that the difficulty will be increased. Some people even hope that you can read as many books as possible. Unless you have memorized all the books in the world, there will always be new knowledge for you to learn.
In modern times, you can skip grades, or even enter university directly if you have accumulated enough knowledge, but there is no such rule in the study room.
Thinking about having to memorize all the books in the world, even Ye Shuo felt a wave of despair.
In addition, there was no such thing as Saturdays and Sundays as rest days in ancient times. Ye Shuo had learned about it in advance, and there were no winter and summer vacations. There were 365 days in a year, and people could only have one day off on New Year’s Day, Dragon Boat Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, the emperor’s birthday, Tianchang Festival, and one’s own birthday, etc., and the total number of days was less than ten.
Ten days!
You know, nowadays, there are seven days off for National Day!
So once you get in there, it’s basically like being in prison. No wonder Ye Shuo is scared.
This was something he would have resisted from the bottom of his heart even without his grandfather’s family.
But I can’t say this to my little nephew. The child is still young, and I can’t tell him about the dangers of the world so quickly.
“…Anyway, you’ll know soon.” He was lucky, at least he had made it to this point, and he didn’t start school until he was seven years old, but the child in front of him had to go to school at the age of three.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touched the child’s head lovingly.
Without waiting for the other party to resist, Ye Shuo jumped off the bed and followed Eunuch Wang.
“Your Highness, it’s okay—”
On the way back to Qiuwu Palace, Wang Ziquan was about to persuade him not to be nervous, but when he turned around, he saw the Ninth Prince yawning, and the rest of Wang Ziquan’s words were stuck in his throat.
“Ah? What did you say?” Ye Shuo looked confused, as if he didn’t hear clearly.
Wang Ziquan choked, and his eyelids twitched uncontrollably: “…Nothing, nothing.”
If you ask him, the Ninth Prince is really a strange man. You say he is naughty, but he never makes fun of the palace maids. You say he is sensible and obedient, but he finds different ways to make trouble every day and then makes the emperor very angry. It is really hard to understand.
Just when Wang Ziquan was thinking about something in his mind, Qiuwu Palace was already within reach.
Inside the main hall, Emperor Jingwen first saw a corner of fabric flash by. He paused holding the tea, his eyes narrowed instantly, and he was about to get angry, but before he could open his mouth, he saw his son take two or three steps forward, then kneel down with a plop, shouting, “your son knows he was wrong, please forgive me, father.”
The whole set of movements was smooth and flowing, as if it had been rehearsed thousands of times, and it was as skillful as possible.
As the saying goes, one should not hit a smiling person. Ye Shuo admitted his mistake too quickly, and the words of rebuke from Emperor Jingwen were immediately stuck in his throat.
After a long while, Emperor Jingwen felt that this was not enough to relieve his anger, so he sat there and asked with a half-smile: “Oh? Then tell me, where did you go wrong?”
“I don’t know, but if I make you angry, then that’s my fault.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen was completely unable to curse anymore.
The tense atmosphere in the main hall suddenly dissipated.
Emperor Jingwen seemed to want to try harder, but the atmosphere was just not right. After a long time, he could only hold his forehead with his hand and tell him to get up.
Wang Ziquan, who was standing by, was stunned.
Concubine Rong couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief when she saw this.
“Tell me, why are you so reluctant to go to the study?” After an entire afternoon, Emperor Jingwen had figured out the reason. The imperial concubine would be deceived by this little bastard, but he would not.
Ye Shuo did not hide anything and said bluntly: “The school starts too early. We have to get up at 1:00 a.m. It’s not even daylight yet. We finish school after 1:00 p.m. and have dinner right away. We only have one or two hours in between to do some activities. We don’t even have time to take a break. And…”
“Stop, stop, stop.” Seeing that he was counting more and more, Emperor Jingwen interrupted him immediately: “Didn’t others, like your brother, including me, come here in the same way?”
Why is he the only one who can’t accept it?
“Okay, you don’t have to say anything. No matter what, you must report to me in the upper study in three days!”
“Yes, Father.”
“If you dare to say ‘no’…hmm?” Caught off guard, Emperor Jingwen was stunned when he heard the affirmative answer.
Why did this little bastard react so strongly just now and point out so many faults? Emperor Jingwen was even ready to yell at him, but in the end… he actually agreed.
Ye Shuo didn’t really want to do this, but there was no other way. His stepfather coming here today meant that the matter was a foregone conclusion and resistance was impossible. It was better to be honest and avoid suffering.
Emperor Jingwen felt as if he had been punched into cotton, unable to go up or down, it was extremely painful.
He always felt that the little bastard would not compromise so easily, but he didn’t know what method he would use this time.
It has to be said that after such a long time, Emperor Jingwen has already summed up some experience in struggle.
“You are no longer a two-year-old child. If you dare to lie to me again, I will punish you for deceiving the emperor!” Emperor Jingwen was so worried about his son going to school obediently.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo nodded with certainty: “Don’t worry, Father. This time, I will strictly abide by the rules of the study room and will not act against the rules.”
Emperor Jingwen always felt that something was strange, but he really couldn’t put his finger on it.
In the end, failing to find any flaws, Emperor Jingwen left in doubt.
Until Emperor Jingwen disappeared completely, the Sixth Prince seemed to catch a glimpse of cunning in his younger brother’s eyes, but it disappeared before he could take a closer look, as if it was just an illusion.
Although it was a good thing that her son could go to school, Concubine Rong still felt distressed when she thought about him getting up so early and coming back so late every day.
After all this trouble, Ye Shuo had basically digested the meal he had for dinner. He couldn’t help but reach out to grab two desserts. Then Ye Shuo suddenly remembered something and asked, “By the way, Mom, time is so tight, is there still time to find a study partner for me?” Without a study partner, he was alone and felt even more exhausted.
Speaking of this, Concubine Rong suddenly remembered it.
“Actually… when you were two years old, your mother had already arranged for you to be a study companion.”
When he was two years old…Now he is seven years old, which means that the official’s family has been waiting for this event for five years.
If the other person was a few years older than him, given the ancient custom of early marriage and early pregnancy, that person might already be a father.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but almost spit out a mouthful of tea.
“–mother!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Meeting
chapters.content:
The imperial concubine loved her son so much that she naturally arranged everything in advance.
In her plan, since her son would go to the study room at the age of three, it was natural for her to decide on a study companion from the age of two.
What she didn’t expect was that her son had a high fever, and it took so long for him to go to the study.
In the end, she even forgot about the reading companionship until just now.
Although part of the problem is my own, it doesn’t mean that my son has no problems.
Then……
“Why are you shouting so loudly? If you hadn’t made excuses time and again, would your mother have forgotten?” When Concubine Rong thought of how this little bastard had deceived her for so many years, she couldn’t help but get angry.
He pretended to be so miserable at first, but when his father came, everything was fine, right?
He no longer suffers from insomnia and has not lost weight rapidly. Concubine Rong thinks he is doing well.
“If I had known, I would have asked your father to punish you.”Ye Shuo suddenly didn’t dare to say a word.
He hurriedly left this place of trouble. On the way, Ye Shuo was thinking about his study partner, to put it nicely, he is called a nanny, because he would have the responsibility of accompanying and taking care of the prince. Since he has to take care of him, he must be slightly older than the prince.
For example, if his mother originally planned to send him to school at the age of three, it was normal to find a study partner who was four or five years older than him, because children aged seven or eight gradually begin to understand the limits and know how to take care of others.
If he was five or six years old, then it would be fine. After five years, he would be at most twelve or thirteen years old. Even with the current trend of early marriage and early pregnancy, it shouldn’t be considered as a biological child.
So far so good.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Meanwhile, on the other side——
Xing Yucheng, the son of the Minister of Works, knew from the age of seven that he would be a companion to the second most noble prince of the Zhou Dynasty.
Xing Yucheng still remembered that when the palace delivered the news that year, his mother was ecstatic, and his father seemed a little worried, but still very happy. After all, being a companion to the prince was an honor that no one else could ask for.
The most important thing is that given the little prince’s background, it is almost certain that he will become a prince in the future. Even if the Duke of Zhen arouses the suspicion of the emperor, it is only the Duke of Zhen’s family, and will not implicate the imperial concubine and the little prince.
Think about it, he is the prince’s companion, what a great grace and honor, and most importantly, it is very beneficial to his future.
The one who is close to the water gets the moon first, and this is also the most important reason why the princes’ companions are vying for the position.
Xing Yucheng didn’t quite understand at that time, but seeing that his father and mother were so happy, he obediently prepared for this matter according to his parents’ requirements.
Fearing that his knowledge was too shallow and that the little prince might ask him something he didn’t know, Xing Yucheng consciously doubled the amount of study he did on weekdays.
Afraid that he would be too popular and displease the little prince, Xing Yucheng gradually learned how to keep a low profile and not draw attention to himself.
Xing Yucheng accumulated himself day by day, quietly waiting for the call from the palace.
Then he waited for five years.
During the first two years, although his parents were shocked, they did not say anything. After all, the little prince was still young.
In the third year, my parents gradually began to worry.
By the fourth year, my mother began to sigh repeatedly and my father became silent.
God knows, because the news was too surprising at the time, and the servants were not careful with their mouths, it was spread out in no time.
Now that’s good, everyone knows that he is going to be the prince’s companion.
As a result, after such a long time, the little prince still had not entered school. Year after year, more and more people came to watch him make a fool of himself.
Xing Yucheng could not hold it in any longer and asked his father, “Dad, the little prince is already nine years old this year, why hasn’t he gone to school yet?” If the little prince did not go to school, it would not take long for him to finish all the books at home, and he would be able to go directly to the provincial examination.
The Minister of Works was also helpless when he heard this. It would have been fine if the imperial concubine had suddenly changed her mind, but the other party’s attitude was quite firm and honest. After deciding on their family, they never changed their mind. The only problem was that they were delaying too much.
It’s already the fifth year now, and I don’t know when this kind of days will end.
Why doesn’t Your Majesty care about it?
Just when the Minister of Works and his family were sighing, news finally came from the palace.
Perhaps because they had been disappointed too many times before, the family of the Minister of Works did not hold out much hope this time. They thought that, as in the past, they could just give some silver to the eunuch who delivered the message and send him away.
Nowadays, they would not find it strange even if the Ninth Prince waited until he was fifteen years old before going to the study room.
Who knows–
“I want to convey the Imperial Concubine’s words. Please ask the Third Young Master to make preparations immediately and report to the palace in three days.”
Reporting means… the Ninth Prince is finally going to school???
The Minister of Works and his wife were almost crying with joy, and hurriedly gave the eunuch who delivered the message a double red envelope.
Oh my god, this day has finally arrived.
“Thank God, thank God.”
The Shangshu’s wife clasped her hands together and bowed in all directions.
(Shangshu = Minister of Works/documents)
Xing Yucheng next to him fell into a dream.
Am I…finally going to enter the palace as a study partner?
Five years of hard work were finally coming in handy. Three days passed in a flash. Xing Yucheng was so excited and excited about meeting the Ninth Prince the next day that he suffered from insomnia. He slept for less than two hours. Just after the hour of Yin in the morning, without waiting for the servants to urge him, Xing Yucheng sat up from the bed.
Fearing that he would be delayed, he quickly washed up and took the family carriage to the imperial palace.
The other side.
The Sixth Prince woke up at this time as usual, and after the palace servants helped him wash and dress, at the same time, the Sixth Prince, along with his study partner and attendants, went to the upper study.
As usual, the Sixth Prince was about to step out of Qiuwu Palace when he suddenly thought of something and subconsciously turned back.
The Sixth Prince’s companion Lu Jiang was puzzled: “Sixth Prince, what are you doing…”
“I’ll go see if my little brother is awake.” The Sixth Prince suddenly remembered that today was the day his little brother was to go to the study.
Lu Jiang was shocked when he heard this. What? The Ninth Prince is going to enter school this year???
Ignoring his dazed companion, the Sixth Prince walked straight towards the side hall.
As expected, the side hall was still dark at this time.
Through the window, the Sixth Prince called out several times before he heard a vague response from inside. Reassured, the Sixth Prince said, “Today is the time for you to go to the study. Don’t forget to be there before the morning hour.”
“Yeah, yeah… I understand. You go first…”
The Sixth Prince usually arrived half an hour early, but his younger brother certainly couldn’t do that, so the Sixth Prince did not force him to go with him.
The most important thing is that his father has issued an ultimatum, and no matter what, his little brother cannot be so inappropriate, so after waking him up, the Sixth Prince left with peace of mind.
At this time, inside the room, Xiao Luzi looked at the sleepy Ninth Prince and said carefully, “Ninth Prince, it’s past the hour of Yin. How about I call someone to help you change your clothes?”
What’s the point of changing clothes? It’s not even dawn yet.
After being rejected by the Ninth Prince, Xiao Luzi did not think too much about it. After all, it was still early and half an hour later would not matter.
But Xiao Luzi never expected that he would have to wait so long.
When Xing Yucheng hurriedly arrived at Qiuwu Palace, it was only a quarter of an hour before the hour of Mao.
It’s over, it’s over, it’s too late, too late.
Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but feel sad when he thought that he had been looking forward to it for five whole years, but ended up being late on the first day of taking office.
He never expected that because he was too nervous yesterday, he did not sleep well at night and ended up falling asleep in the carriage. When he opened his eyes again, it was already too late.
In addition, due to the palace rules, one is only allowed to walk and not run, so by the time he arrived, the place had become what it is now.
Xing Yucheng felt a chill in his heart when he saw the silence in the side hall of Qiuwu Palace.
It’s over. At this time, the Ninth Prince was probably gone long ago.
These five years of preparation have been in vain.
Just when Xing Yucheng turned around to see if he could stop the Ninth Prince on the way to the study, he accidentally caught a glimpse of Xiao Luzi who was also in a mess.
Then, he saw the Ninth Prince who was still sleeping soundly.
Xing Yucheng was shocked at that time.
“Ninth, Ninth Prince?”
Hearing the noise around him again, Ye Shuo reluctantly opened his right eye a crack, trying to suppress his sleepiness. He looked the other person up and down, and after quickly confirming his identity, he pointed to the bed next to him and said, “Study companion…right?”
“Look, did you see it? It was specially prepared for me.”
What, what do you mean?
Xing Yucheng was a little puzzled, until Ye Shuo said “Let’s sleep together”, which made Xing Yucheng explode instantly.
“Your Highness the Ninth Prince, you can’t sleep anymore, you’re going to be late!” Xing Yucheng’s facial features were twisted into a ball, and his heart was trembling.
Ye Shuo yawned, not taking it seriously, and didn’t even open his eyes. He said vaguely, “Late… so… late…”
If he really got up at three in the morning every day, he was afraid he would not live to adulthood.
No wonder the infant mortality rate in the palace is so high. How could it not be high if this is the case?
Seven years old is still the age for first or second grade in primary school, but modern primary school students start classes at eight or nine o’clock, which is a difference of several hours.
For the sake of his own life, Ye Shuo must ensure that he gets enough sleep no matter what.
“At most… I’ll just get a few slaps on the wrist…”
After all, the prince is a delicate and precious person, and he can’t be beaten too hard or too harshly.
Ye Shuo had studied it and found out that the Shangshufang had a clear rule that if a prince was late for school, he would be given three slaps on the wrist.
Just three prototypes, no big deal.
Now that Ye Shuo has practiced martial arts, let alone practicing martial arts, even if he hasn’t practiced, three slaps would not be a problem for him.
A beating in exchange for a good night’s sleep is really a great deal.
“Okay… I’ll continue… and go to sleep…”
“You guys… feel free to do whatever you want…zzzzzz”
In front of the two of them, Ye Shuo buried his head, wrapped himself in the quilt, turned over and continued to sleep.
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi were left dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Buddha
chapters.content:
After five years, Xing Yucheng finally saw the true appearance of the Ninth Prince, but how to put it, it seemed a little different from what he had imagined.
In Xing Yucheng’s imagination, the prince should be noble and elegant, but now…
Xing Yucheng looked at the Ninth Prince who had wrapped himself like a cocoon, and he felt as if something was broken.
As subordinates and servants, they really have no way to do anything about what the master decides.
Xiao Luzi didn’t even dare to report to the Imperial Concubine.
Although the Imperial Concubine and the Ninth Prince are mother and son, since he is the Ninth Prince’s servant, he can only listen to the Ninth Prince. Not being able to distinguish between the primary and the secondary is a big taboo for a servant. Although Xiao Luzi is still young, he obviously knows this truth in his heart.
Therefore, even if he was anxiously scratching the wall, he could only watch.
Xing Yucheng had felt a little sleepy before, but now he didn’t feel sleepy at all and he felt very energetic.
As for the chaise longue, he did not have the courage of the Ninth Prince, so he did not dare to go up there.
Time passed minute by minute, and after the morning hour, the two were finally in complete despair.It’s over. It’s totally too late.
Gradually, the moon sank, and the sky became bright.
When the imperial concubine woke up, the first thing she looked at was the side hall. It was quiet. It was already past noon, and her son must have already gone to the study.
The imperial concubine felt a little distressed and even lost her concentration while dressing herself up. She thought silently in her heart that she must ask the kitchen to make more delicious food to reward him today.
The imperial concubine never thought that her son would dare not go under such circumstances.
On the other side, in the upper study room——
Upon learning that the Ninth Prince would be attending school this year, Lord Cen, who was in charge of the study, became very anxious.
Although he had never seen this prince before, he had heard many rumors about him.
Out of a teacher’s professional instinct, Mr. Cen felt that it was not good at the time.
After all, the little prince, now the ninth prince, had a reputation for being “ferocious”. When he was one year old, he grabbed an abacus, gold ingots, and a belly band. When he was just over one year old, he was locked up in the palace by the emperor for a full six months… Just imagining it made Lord Cen feel overwhelmed.
Perhaps it was because His Majesty was good at giving birth. Lord Cen had never met such a student before. Even the Crown Prince, the only legitimate son, was polite to him. Therefore, the appearance of the Ninth Prince made him feel very difficult.
Fortunately, the Ninth Prince started school late, and he is nine years old now, which makes Lord Cen feel relieved. However, new problems arise. The Ninth Prince can live such an indulgent life, and it must be the Imperial Concubine who has contributed to this. This makes the Ninth Prince even more difficult to discipline.
But then I thought again, teaching the prince is my duty, the imperial concubine is too doting, and the emperor is busy with government affairs, so ain’t I the only one to worry about?
In addition to the difficult feeling, Lord Cen also inexplicably felt a sense of responsibility and mission in his heart.
Especially since the Emperor had specially asked Eunuch Wang to come and give him some instructions on the eve of the little prince’s enrollment, Lord Cen was even more nervous.
The Majesty has entrusted him with the important task of educating the prince, which shows the Majesty’s trust in him. He must not let the Majesty down.
He was just a nine-year-old child, but Lord Cen still didn’t believe that after decades of teaching, he couldn’t teach a child.
Lord Cen secretly decided that from the moment the Ninth Prince stepped into the upper study, he would discipline him strictly and make sure he got rid of his bad habits!
So early this morning, Lord Cen’s expression was particularly serious, and his clothes were quite solemn. He changed out of his usual comfortable robes and wore his official uniform to teach the princes. He wanted the Ninth Prince to be shocked by him the first time he saw him.
I have to say that this trick was quite useful. At least it scared the little grandson who was also enrolled in the school.
Looking at the young tutor with a sullen face on the stage and the majestic red official robe on him, he, who had originally looked relaxed but had been hanging out with the 9th uncle for years and was somewhat restless, suddenly shuddered and subconsciously straightened his back.
So, so scary…
Just like grandpa…
Lord Cen was pleased when he saw this.
It’s good to know that you are afraid. If you have fear in your heart, you won’t dare to slack off when studying.
Except for Lord Cen, the other princes were also very much “looking forward” to the arrival of their younger brother.
After all, he is the son of the imperial concubine, so they want to see what makes this younger brother so noble.
Especially the Fifth Prince, who still remembers how the Imperial Concubine humiliated his mother. He couldn’t touch the Imperial Concubine, so how could he touch his younger brother?
If this younger brother loses to me in academic studies, even the imperial concubine will not be able to say anything.
When the sixth brother first entered school, he was bullied by him. Later, he relied on his own diligence and hard work to finally impress the young master and won the young master’s favor. The fifth prince did not believe that his ninth brother could do it as well.
Not to mention him, even the Eighth Prince was a little curious. Of course, unlike the Fifth Prince, he was simply curious about his younger brother who was the smallest age difference from him.
For a moment, everyone had different thoughts, but their attention was basically focused on Ye Shuo.
As a result, they waited for two hours.
The Ninth Prince…didn’t come at all.
As soon as the morning hour arrived, Lord Cen could no longer sit still.
The fifth prince was also a little confused. What happened? Didn’t he say he would report today? Could it be that he remembered the wrong time?
Because the Fifth Prince had never seen his younger brother, he didn’t know Ye Shuo at all. He just thought that he had remembered the time wrong, so he began to gloat over his misfortune.
It looks like the Ninth Prince won’t be able to escape being beaten today.
It is unheard of to get a beating on the first day of studying in the study room.
The Sixth Prince standing by knew his younger brother, so his heart skipped a beat.
Oh no, I don’t know what trouble he will cause next.
I shouldn’t have believed that he could go to school peacefully. I should have thought of it earlier and should have asked him to come with me when I came to the study.
After realizing what was happening, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but hold his forehead with his hand.
Oh my god…
Among all the people, only the young grandson of the emperor was relatively innocent. At the moment, he was worried about whether the Ninth Uncle would be sick.
Wuwuwu, Uncle Nine, please don’t be in any trouble…
On the other side, in Qiuwu Palace——
Ye Shuo woke up almost at the same biological clock as usual. Perhaps it was because he was depressed about going to school, but he even slept for fifteen minutes longer than usual.
After all, it was earned through three trials. Wouldn’t it be a loss if I don’t get enough sleep?
Ye Shuo stretched and finally climbed out of bed slowly.
Then Xiao Luzi finally understood why the little prince asked people to save water last night.
Since water had already been prepared in the room, Ye Shuo didn’t even disturb anyone when he washed up.
Ancient clothes were more complicated. Xiao Luzi helped him put on his clothes. Ye Shuo reached out and patted his study partner who was squatting in the corner and kept mumbling. He looked upset and said, “Hey, wake up. It’s time to go.”
It’s too late to go to the study room now!
Xing Yucheng looked at him with despair.
However, the neatly dressed Ninth Prince really looked like the real deal, with an air of nobility that couldn’t be concealed, especially his pair of phoenix eyes. He was completely different from the one who had just been wrapped in a quilt and sleeping.
This is probably the only consolation.
Just when Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi were convinced that they would be discovered before they could even leave Qiuwu Palace, they didn’t expect that the Ninth Prince would take them with him, turn around in several directions, and then they walked out so openly without even alerting anyone. It was simply unbelievable!
This made Xiao Luzi suspicious that his master might have secretly prepared the plan in advance.
In order to skip school, the master really tried his best.
But in fact, it is not really the case. After all, after he has connected the internal energy, both his hearing and vision are much better than before. Ye Shuo can know in advance whether someone is coming from a long distance.
Also, he had observed Wu Yi’s lurking skills and probably knew what to do to be less likely to be noticed.
I wonder if Wu Yi would be so angry that he would cry if he knew that his skills were used in such a place.
Xing Yucheng thought, no matter what, the Ninth Prince should go to the study this time, but… the Ninth Prince turned a corner and went directly to the Imperial Garden.
“Come on, I’ll take you to find something to eat.”
I believe everyone knows the importance of breakfast, so how can we skip breakfast?
When Zhao Chongrong and Xu Chongyi saw Ye Shuo appear in Shulanzhai, they couldn’t help but cover their mouths with handkerchiefs.
“Oh my God, why are you here, little prince?”
Zhao Chongrong glanced at the small sundial outside and couldn’t help but take a breath of cold air: “Your Highness, aren’t you going to report to the study today?”
“In reply to Madam Zhao, I am late.” He casually mentioned the fact that he was late, which made Xing Yucheng’s eyes pop out of his head.
Then Ye Shuo said shamelessly: “Madam Zhao, I’m so hungry…”
When Zhao Chongrong heard the child say he was hungry, she came to her senses and quickly asked the kitchen to prepare something.
It only takes about an incense stick of time to prepare four simple dishes and a soup.
Xing Yucheng felt like he was sitting on pins and needles, glancing at the Ninth Prince from time to time. How could he eat anything now?
Ye Shuo was not in a hurry at all. He said while holding a piece of snack in his mouth, “Why are you in a hurry? Being late for a cup of tea is still late, and being late for a few hours is still late. We don’t mind this little bit. Come, drink this bowl of porridge.”
If he wasn’t afraid of going too far and angering his tutor, Ye Shuo would have been prepared to get a beating at the end of school every day before leaving.
Zhao Chongrong and Xu Chongyi thought about it and felt that he was right. Since they were already late, they might as well eat breakfast.
Zhao Chongrong even nodded and said, “Yes, the imperial physician told me to eat on time, otherwise it would hurt the body.”
But Xing Yucheng couldn’t accept this. In his opinion, he had to go early even if he was late. He never thought there would be such a way. He almost cried.
Xiao Luzi accepted it well. Well, he recovered faster after being beaten with a stick after eating a full meal.
As if he had seen the tragic and heroic spirit behind Xiao Luzi’s reckless eating, Ye Shuo stopped helplessly: “Don’t worry, I have read the rules of the study room in advance, and you won’t be implicated.”
Some were to punish the princes, some were to punish their companions, and some were to punish them all together. Wouldn’t it be enough to just single out the princes for punishment?
“It’s just three blows. Just eat your food. If anything goes wrong, I will take care of it.”
If Lord Cen were here and heard that he had come up with this after studying the rules of the upper study, he would probably vomit blood.
Although the timing was wrong, Xing Yucheng was inexplicably moved when he heard these words.
After all, his father had told him when he was at home that although being a companion to the prince was an excellent job, it was not so easy to do.
The prince was too proud to be punished, so basically his companion would be punished instead. Xing Yucheng had already made preparations, and considering his future, it was nothing. But when he heard this suddenly, he was stunned.
I thought he didn’t care about me and that little eunuch at all…
Xiaoluzi next to him also put down his bowl and chopsticks at some point.
Thinking that the Ninth Prince was only seven years old, and he was already twelve, he would definitely be able to resist better than him, so he blurted out, “It’s okay, Ninth Prince, just let the Master beat me when the time comes.”
“Well, why are you being so polite to me? At most, we can each take a day. Even if the beating is severe, it will help you recover.”
Xing Yucheng: “…”
Xing Yucheng’s newly-felt emotion disappeared in an instant.
“Your Highness, are you planning to be late again in the future?”
“What else?” Ye Shuo didn’t even look at him, only focusing on the roasted bamboo fungus in front of him: “Don’t you think that three boards in exchange for a good night’s sleep is really a good deal?”
Can it still be like this? ?
Xing Yucheng was in a state of complete confusion.
On the other side, after Wang Ziquan shouted “dismiss the court” in a resounding voice, Emperor Jingwen finally left the court.
Thinking that today was the day his son was going to the upper study, the first thing Emperor Jingwen did after leaving court was to call his attendant over and ask, “Where is the ninth prince? Has he arrived at the upper study now?”
Young eunuch: “…”
He had been squatting at the door of the study for a long time, but he didn’t see anyone at all!
“Your Majesty, no, no…”
The young eunuch and Wang Ziquan thought that the emperor would be furious when he heard this, but after waiting for a long time… Eh? He didn’t seem to be angry?
It’s just his expression. Although His Majesty has tried his best to remain calm, one can still detect the subtle pain and helplessness in his expression.
Emperor Jingwen also thought that he would be angry, but he did not expect that after hearing the news, he was not angry at all. Instead, he had a feeling of “as expected”.
At this moment, his heart was very calm, really, very calm, and he even felt like laughing a little.
So he really laughed.
Then, the young eunuch and Wang Ziquan next to them went crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Jealousy
chapters.content:
It’s over, it’s over, His Majesty has finally been driven mad by the Ninth Prince!!!
Just when Wang Ziquan and the eunuch beside him were panicking and didn’t know how to persuade them, the prince seemed to have noticed something unusual and walked forward.
The Prince’s Tutor thought about it and followed closely.
Soon, the prince stood still and asked in a low voice: “Eunuch Wang, what happened?”
Oh my God, the savior is here!
Wang Ziquan told him everything that had happened without reservation, and he was a little flustered: “Your Highness, what do you think I should do in this situation?”
Eunuch Wang has never seen the emperor so angry in all these years.
He was so angry that he couldn’t help laughing. Even when it was the Duke of Zhen, the emperor was just furious and upset and accidentally dropped a teacup. To some extent, the Ninth Prince is more powerful than the Duke of Zhen.
After all, the Duke of Zhen can be killed and beaten, and the Ninth Prince is the emperor’s own son. You can’t beat or kill him just because he doesn’t like to go to school, right?
You can’t just say that the Ninth Prince should be deposed because of this, right? The last time the Ninth Prince was confined for half a year when he was one and a half years old was already unbelievable enough. If the emperor really deposed the Ninth Prince because of this, it would not just be gossip in the harem and court, but would definitely leave a mark in the history books.When he thought that the prince would be recorded by the historians because of this incident… Wang Ziquan suddenly felt that being a eunuch was not bad.
Without offspring, there will never be such troubles.
If anyone else gave birth to a son like the Ninth Prince, he would probably never have a peaceful life.
After hearing this, the prince subconsciously turned his head, and was indeed shocked to see that behind Emperor Jingwen’s seemingly relaxed and happy smile there was a hint of distortion.
The Prince’s tutor at the side listened to the whole process and suddenly felt sympathy for his old rival.
He suddenly felt that although his old rival was hateful, he did not commit such a crime.
But in fact, the Crown Prince, like Emperor Jingwen, did not seem to be too surprised when he heard about this. He just felt a little helpless. His little brother was really brave!
Quickly calming down, the prince said, “Don’t worry, eunuch. I will go and bring my ninth brother back right away.”
In the past two years, Ye Shuo has been hanging out in the East Palace all year round, and is inseparable from his little son. Because the age difference between Ye Shuo and his son is not much, and the prince held Ye Shuo in his arms when he was born, the prince has subtly regarded him as his half son.
The prince decided to have a good talk with his brother.
If time could go back seven years, the prince would never have thought that he would see this day.
However, just as the prince turned around, the voice of Emperor Jingwen came: “You are not allowed to go!”
“This time, no one is allowed to pay attention to him!”
Emperor Jingwen suspected that it was because of his indulgence that he became more and more self-indulgent and lawless.
“Let him go. I want to see what tricks he can come up with on his own.”
Emperor Jingwen had never seen such a person among his sons, and even when he was the crown prince, he had never seen such a person among his brothers.
The royal family has lasted for so many years, and no matter how ridiculous the people in it were, no one has ever said that they really don’t care about face. Emperor Jingwen doesn’t believe that his son really doesn’t care at all.
“Once he loses face, he will naturally learn to restrain himself.”
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen planned to handle the situation coldly this time, and he must cure this problem.
Emperor Jingwen had already understood in advance that the more parents try to control their children’s crying, the worse it will be. If the children think this trick works, and they feel confident, there will be no end to it.
You have to give him the cold shoulder and let him know that he is not that important.
“Isn’t he just relying on the fact that he is my son? He doesn’t even think about the fact that I have so many sons, and I don’t need him anymore.”
Emperor Jingwen was really furious this time. How could he not be angry when a dignified emperor was controlled by a little kid?
The words were so decisive that the prince noticed the cruel look in his father’s eyes and was immediately shocked: “Father!”
“Okay, Chengzuo, you don’t need to say more. This matter has nothing to do with you, and you don’t have to care about it anymore.” After saying that, Emperor Jingwen left with a cold face.
The prince was left feeling anxious, but helpless.
It’s over, it’s over, Ninth Brother, I can’t help you this time.
On the other hand, Ye Shuo had no idea that he had really pissed off emperor this time, and he even said that he wanted to give up on him. However, even if he knew, he would not take it to heart.
It sounds as if his cheap dad has any influence on whether he is good to him or not.
If he treats him well, will he be able to resist suppressing his grandfather’s family? If one side gains, the other side loses, and the suppression may become even more severe.
Being mean to him, can you really ruin him because of this?
his father is so hardworking now, going to court every day to review memorials. If he says that he has no desire to leave his name in history, Ye Shuo will never believe it.
When he reached the position of Cheap Dad, he had already reached the pinnacle of wealth and power, and all he wanted was a good reputation during his lifetime and after his death.
Since his father wanted to leave a good reputation in history, he would naturally not leave any stain because of his son.
Think about it, when the history book introduces Cheap Father, it suddenly says “Because the ninth son didn’t like to study, the emperor was furious and demoted him to a commoner”. Is this reasonable? It seems like a joke.
he is a serious man and would not allow such indecent remarks to appear in his life history.
In fact, when it comes down to it, it’s because Ye Shuo is no longer at the age where he longs for fatherly love.
Ye Shuo does not seek fame, love or profit. He does not ask for anything in his life except for the health of himself and his mother. Naturally, he does not care about the attitude of his cheap father.
As for fatherly love, Ye Shuo had seen the best in his previous life, so anything else would naturally not catch his eye.
The chubby face of Mr. Gu flashed through his mind again. Ye Shuo’s hands tightened for a moment. He was silent for a long time, then strode towards the study room.
Xing Yucheng vaguely saw that the Ninth Prince’s eyes were a little red, and thought that he was finally starting to worry, so he couldn’t help but comfort him: “It’s okay, Your Highness, when the time comes, as long as we admit our mistakes, the Master will definitely forgive us.”
I don’t know whether these words are meant to comfort Ye Shuo or to comfort myself.
“…How can you think that I would think that I am wrong?” Ye Shuo looked at him strangely. Please, this kind of perverted rule is wrong.
Xing Yucheng was almost moved to tears by his self-righteous behavior.
“Your Highness, please, don’t do this…”
“Oh, are you teaching me how to do things?”
Xing Yucheng: “…”
Just as the two were arguing and quarreling, the study room was finally within reach.
Xing Yucheng stopped subconsciously.
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate at all and stepped in casually.
Then, Ye Shuo saw Master Cen with an angry look on his face, the Fifth Prince who was gloating and obviously enjoying the show, the Sixth Prince who looked disapproving and frowned, the Seventh and Eighth Princes who were curious, and the little grandson who almost had the word “worry” written on his face.
Before Master Cen could get angry, Ye Shuo decisively stretched out his hand.
“I’m sorry, Master, I’m late. Please punish me.”
Although Ye Shuo didn’t like the abnormal rules of the study room, he still respected the teacher very much. After all, the teacher was right, so he apologized sincerely.
Master Cen did not have the experience of modern people, so he did not know that Ye Shuo’s quick admission of his mistake meant “Don’t waste time, fight quickly, I have things to do after the fight.” If he had paid attention to the look in the eyes of the Ninth Prince in front of him, or even communicated with Emperor Jingwen more, he would not have been fooled.
Unfortunately, Master Cen did not have it.
Master Cen’s anger subsided a little, but he still said coldly: “Since Your Highness is willing to accept the punishment, I will punish you with three slaps on the hand.”
“Someone, get my ruler!”
For matters like this, the Fifth Prince would naturally be the one to take charge.
Without waiting for the eunuch to make a move, the Fifth Prince personally took down the ruler hanging on the wall for warning. He bowed respectfully to hide the amusement in his eyes: “Master, please.”
“Um.”
Seeing Master Cen raise his arm, Ye Shuo did not dodge, but Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi on the side felt their hearts tighten suddenly.
“Snap”, “Snap”, “Snap”.
After three crisp sounds, Master Cen finally let go of the anger in his heart. He then pointed to the last table and said, “You came the latest, so sit there.”
“Thank you, Master.” Ye Shuo bowed and walked over with his study companion. During the whole process, he seemed not to notice the different looks from the people around him, as if he didn’t know what the last table meant.
By the way, the punishment in the study room was indeed more form than substance, and its purpose was to beat the shame of the princes, rather than corporal punishment. In fact, Ye Shuo didn’t feel anything at all after being hit three times. It was completely different from the modern head teacher he met in the third grade of junior high school who broke several set squares in a year.
I feel like if this is the case, I can definitely subscribe for the whole year…
Also, has the Shangshufang never considered what to do if there is a shameless prince in the royal family?
(Shangshufang = Study room)
Sure enough, as long as people put aside their face, they will find that the world suddenly becomes much brighter. This truth has been applicable from ancient times to the present.
As soon as Ye Shuo sat down, Master Cen announced the end of the get out of class.
Oh, I forgot to mention that the study rooms in the Great Zhou Dynasty also had divided classes, but not as frequent as in modern times. There was only a break once every one or two hours, and each break was only for a quarter of an hour. There was no need to worry about suffocating the growing children.
After the tutor left, the Fifth Prince passed by here with his companion, and glanced over here as if inadvertently.
Amusement, contempt, ridicule…all kinds of emotions.
If it were someone with a strong sense of self-esteem, such as the Sixth Prince, his eyes would probably turn red on the spot, and he would not be able to sleep for several days in a row. All he would think about in his midnight dreams was that he was despised.
This is probably the effect that the study room wants.
Once you are punished, you will not be able to raise your head in front of your brothers.
But it didn’t hurt Ye Shuo at all when it fell on him. He even felt that the ancients were too reserved. What’s the big deal? It won’t cost him a piece of flesh.
However, Xing Yucheng who was standing by could hardly hold back. When the fifth prince’s companion looked at him like this, his face immediately turned red with shame.
“well……”
Ye Shuo sighed, and for the sake of his study partner’s physical and mental health, he thought about it and said, “By the way, let me tell you a story.”
Xing Yucheng was in no mood to listen to any stories.
But Ye Shuo didn’t care about that, so he just started to tell his own story: “The story goes that if a man accidentally offends a wealthy businessman, the businessman wants to humiliate him, so he asks him to kowtow to him, and he gives the man 100 taels of silver for each kowtow.”
“When this person kowtowed for the first time, everyone around him was waiting to laugh at him. When he kowtowed for the tenth time, gradually, everyone stopped laughing. When he kowtowed for a hundred, a thousand, and ten thousand times, everyone began to envy him and wished they could replace him.”
Ye Shuo propped his chin with one hand, playing with the pen in his hand with boredom: “Your Highness is that person. I have only kowtowed for the first time. It is normal for everyone to mock me. Wait until I kowtow a hundred times, a thousand times, and then you will see.”
Xing Yucheng: “…”
What nonsense is His Highness the Ninth Prince talking about? ?
Xing Yucheng didn’t believe it, and after a long pause, he said, “This, this is impossible, right?”
Ye Shuo shrugged: “Whether it can be done or not, just wait and see.”
“Really, Ninth Uncle?” The little grandson came to offer condolences as soon as the young master left. As soon as he got closer, he heard these words, so he couldn’t help but ask curiously.
Ye Shuo nodded affirmatively: “Of course.”
The Sixth Prince in front couldn’t stand it any longer and turned his head: “Shuo’er, don’t teach the child bad things!”
The fifth prince, who had also heard this story, couldn’t help but sneer.
He said he would be jealous, so jealous that he wanted to replace him? Ha, ridiculous!

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Pirate Ship
chapters.content:
The fifth prince couldn’t help but speak: “Isn’t the Ninth Prince hysterical? Why is he talking nonsense in broad daylight?”
Ever since the Fourth Prince began to participate in politics two years ago, the Fifth Prince has been the oldest in the entire Shangshufang, and all the other princes basically follow him as their leader, so the Fifth Prince’s words still carry considerable weight.
At least the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince could only watch from the sidelines and dared not say a word.
Ye Shuo was not afraid of him. After all, the other party could not really rush over and beat him up. Even if a fight really broke out, he would not be the one who suffered.
So Ye Shuo said, “Is this nonsense? How about making a bet with me, Fifth Brother?”
The Fifth Prince was confident that the situation he described would not happen. How could anyone envy such a shameful thing as being slapped on the palm? So he said, “Ninth Prince, you are young, but you have a big mouth. Let’s gamble, but you must not regret it when the time comes.”
The fifth prince didn’t feel embarrassed at all for his fourteen-year-old self to compete with a seven-year-old kid. He raised his chin and said, “Tell me, what’s the bet?”
As for this person, it would be fine if you didn’t know him before, but once there is a comparison, your mentality will easily become unbalanced.
Therefore, Ye Shuo was quite confident about this bet. He ignored the disapproving look of the Sixth Prince beside him, thought for a moment, and said, “Let’s bet on three things. If I win, you promise to do three things for me. Of course, I promise that you can do them all, and vice versa. How about it, do you want to bet?”
This agreement is not so easy to accept, especially the three words “can do it”, which cover such a broad range.But now that so many people were watching, the Fifth Prince certainly couldn’t go back on his word. Most importantly, he didn’t believe he would lose, so he nodded immediately: “Okay, let’s do it!”
He wanted to see what tricks the other party could play.
Because the Fifth Prince was waiting to laugh at him later, he did not continue to embarrass him at this time.
Seeing that Ye Shuo refused to listen, the Sixth Prince was so angry that he turned his head away and ignored him.
Only the little grandson of the emperor looked with anxiously, with a worried look on his face: “Ninth Uncle…”
“Don’t worry.” The poor child didn’t know that he was about to face his fifth uncle’s indiscriminate attack. I hope he can still laugh by then.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo looked at Ye Xun with a little pity.
Why, why do I feel something is strange? The look in the Ninth Prince’s eyes seems so familiar, as if I have seen him before…
The little prince was full of confusion and was tricked by Ye Shuo into returning to his seat.
Soon, another young tutor who taught the princes poetry and songs came into the study.
In addition to the Four Books and Five Classics, poetry and songs were also studied by the princes, which made Ye Shuo sigh that the royal family had very high requirements for their offspring.
While the Fifth Prince and the others were studying, Ye Shuo calmed down and began to observe from the side.
You should not have the intention to harm others, but you must be on guard against others. Although Ye Shuo has no intention of winning the throne, he must always prepare for everything in advance. He does not attack others, but it does not mean that others will not attack him. Taking precautions early will avoid being implicated and falling into a passive position later.
Today was Ye Shuo’s first time to come into close contact with several princes. He would naturally not let go of such a rare opportunity.
After one or two classes, Ye Shuo actually discovered some remarkable things.
For example, from the fifth prince to the eighth prince, none of them was mediocre. No wonder my cheap dad found it so hard to accept him when he saw him.
After all, as the only “stain”, I am really an eyesore…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch his chin. The Sixth Prince was the first among them. Sure enough, the Sixth Prince’s efforts were not in vain. Considering the time he spent on reading every day, it would be unfair for him not to take the first place.
Then there is the fifth prince. Although he doesn’t look like a good person, he is very knowledgeable. In terms of talent, he is even slightly better than the sixth prince.
For the same poem, the Sixth Prince needed less than half an incense stick of time to memorize it, and two incense sticks of time to fully comprehend it and apply it in practice. However, the Fifth Prince only needed 2/3 of the time of the Sixth Prince to memorize it, and it would take even less time if he could apply it flexibly.
The Eighth Prince is even more abnormal than these two. His comprehension is the highest among them. Although his memory is a bit poor, and it takes him a longer time to memorize something, his ability to draw inferences about other situations is not too strong. For the same subject, he can quickly express it on his own after reading it. The key is that what he wrote seems to be quite good. Although it is far inferior to the original work, it has begun to show its charm.
Only the Seventh Prince seemed ordinary among all the others, and his existence seemed to serve as a foil to the three above him.
etc.
If he remembered correctly, the Seventh Prince’s mother was from Concubine Shu’s palace, right?
Ye Shuo watched for a while and saw that when the young master asked them to create independently, the Seventh Prince first picked up the pen and wrote two sentences, then quickly erased them with the brush, changed to a new piece of paper, and started writing again.
Ye Shuo had excellent eyesight, and although he could not see what the fifth prince in the front had written on the paper, he clearly saw the new revision of the seventh prince who was relatively closer to him, which was far inferior to the first two sentences. He immediately understood what had happened.
It seems that sometimes a person looks like a supporting role, but is not necessarily a real supporting role. Instead, he or she is forced to be a supporting role.
Ye Shuo still remembers that the Fifth Prince threw stones and let the Seventh Prince take the blame. It seems that this kind of situation still happens from time to time in recent years.
There are three talented ones, plus one who is obviously talented but pretends to be untalented. These four people are in this situation, not to mention the eldest prince and the second prince whom he has never met.
Especially the eldest prince, who took charge of the army at the age of seventeen. Now, seven years have passed, and he has gradually begun to replace his grandfather’s position in the army. The decline of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion is already a foregone conclusion, it is only a matter of time.
It seems that none of his eight royal brothers are easy to deal with.
If such eight sons were placed in an ordinary family, it would be a blessing that even a wealthy family would wish for. With time, when the eight people have grown up, their family will inevitably achieve a class leap, and the prosperity of the family is just around the corner.
But unfortunately, this is the royal family, and there is no bigger family business for them to work hard for. Without a goal to strive for, internal friction is likely to happen.
It’s not so bad now that we have the crown prince at the top, and no one can resist. But once the crown prince loses power, it will be hard to say.
Although the cheap father dotes on the crown prince, he cannot afford to abandon all his other sons for the crown prince. Moreover, there were many princes in the Great Zhou Dynasty who ascended the throne without being the eldest son or the legitimate son. For a legitimate son like Emperor Jingwen to ascend the throne is a special case. From this point of view, the situation is not good…
A glimpse of the whole picture reveals the whole thing. Ye Shuo’s heart sank again and again as he watched the scene in front of him quietly.
He couldn’t predict the outcome in detail, and Ye Shuo now just hoped that he would not be affected.
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, Xing Yucheng next to him couldn’t help but pushed his arm.
Ye Shuo turned his head to look over, and he looked a little lazy: “What’s wrong?”
“Your Highness, are you really not going to consider writing a few sentences…” The other princes were about to hand in their papers!
It’s true that it’s not the emperor who is anxious, but the eunuchs are. Xing Yucheng was almost dying of anxiety watching from the side.
The Ninth Prince is so free and in the mood to enjoy the scenery over there, why can’t he put pen to paper?
Ye Shuo’s eyes suddenly became a little strange when he heard this: “It seems that you didn’t know about this prince beforehand.”
“What?” Xing Yucheng was stunned.
Then he heard the Ninth Prince in front of him speak: “Your Highness is a well-known illiterate person in the palace. You didn’t even ask me about it. I haven’t even memorized the Thousand Character Classic yet. You asked me to write a poem. Isn’t this embarrassing for me?”
What???
The Ninth Prince is already nine years old, but he still hasn’t memorized the Thousand Character Classic? ?
Seeing the petrified look of the boy in front of him, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh: “By the way, my mother chose you because you must have something extraordinary. Tell me, what is it?”
Xing Yucheng answered subconsciously: “My father, the Minister of Works, was the top scholar in the 23rd year of Heshou.”
“Sure enough.” That’s right. He was wondering why his mother chose him to be his study partner when he had no relation to him. It turned out that he was the son of the former top scholar.
“So I guess you are pretty good at studying, right?”
“It’s okay.” After saying these two words carefully, Xing Yucheng suddenly felt that something was wrong, but at this time, it was too late.
The next moment, he heard the Ninth Prince in front of him say, “That’s perfect. From now on, you will be responsible for my homework.”
“Your Highness, this won’t do…”
“Five taels of silver for one assignment, and I’ll take the blame for anything that happens. Do you want to do it?” Ye Shuo had learned before that the monthly salary of the six ministers was 60 taels of silver, and five taels of silver was equivalent to 1/12 of the salary of a minister of the Ministry of Works.
Since my stepfather ascended the throne, he has been vigorously cleaning up the historical problems left over by the previous emperor, especially the area of ​​corruption. Because the national treasury was almost completely squandered by the previous emperor’s pleasure-seeking in the later period, my stepfather is in urgent need of recovery.
After a few years the court was purged and everyone lived cautiously, fearing that their property would be confiscated and used to fill the national treasury. His grandfather contributed the most among them. After all, his grandfather had soldiers under his command, and anyone who dared to resist would be killed.
It’s not that his grandfather was so honest, but that he had captured countless gold, silver and treasures from the enemy during years of fighting, so he had no shortage of them and had no reason to be greedy, so he was able to stay out of it.
Perhaps it is for this reason that my stepfather still has some affection for my grandfather.
Of course, these were all told to him by his mother. Although Ye Shuo didn’t know how rich his grandfather’s family was, judging from the extravagant lifestyle of his mother, the amount was probably huge. He also spent hundreds or even thousands of taels of silver every month casually.
“Five taels each time, ten times that’s fifty taels, you can save fifty or sixty taels in a month, right?”
Fifty or sixty taels…equivalent to his father’s monthly salary.
You should know that their family’s current expenses are only around thirty taels per month.
Thinking of how his mother would be particularly worried when counting the accounts every month, Xing Yucheng couldn’t help swallowing and couldn’t say no.
He admitted that he was shamefully moved.
“But, but if this is the case, it will be discovered sooner or later…” Although Xing Yucheng was tempted, he was not stupid.
Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows and shook his finger: “No, no, if you started writing for me halfway, it would definitely be discovered soon, but if you started writing for me from the beginning, then it doesn’t matter.”
“Of course, your right-hand writing cannot be used. After all, many people know what your right-hand writing looks like. How about this, I will spend another thirty taels to buy your left-hand writing. From today on, you start practicing left-hand writing, how about that?” Ye Shuo was a businessman in his previous life, and he understood the principle of exploiting cheap labor.
But at least he still had a bottom line, which was to give his companion some money to buy his left-handed handwriting, rather than asking his companion to spend money to buy the qualification to write homework for him.
Xing Yucheng was silent for a long time, but finally couldn’t resist the temptation and nodded with difficulty.
Soon, when the purse containing thirty taels of silver fell into his hands, Xing Yucheng completely lost his mind.
Xiao Luzi, who was standing by, couldn’t help but feel a little envious when he saw this.
As if seeing what Xiao Luzi was thinking, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but encourage him: “See? Having knowledge can make money so quickly. If you want to do the same, why not take this opportunity and start learning.”
yes!
Why didn’t I think of such a good opportunity that I could learn secretly!
“Is it really possible, Your Highness…” Xiao Luzi was still a little nervous. After all, if he was found learning calligraphy as a little eunuch, he would lose his head.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about this. He hoped that his subordinates could be successful, so he nodded affirmatively: “Yes, Your Highness approves.”
Xiaoluzi was ecstatic.
When he came out of the study in the afternoon and took the carriage home, Xing Yucheng gradually realized that he had done nothing all day except breaking the law with the Ninth Prince.
Also, for the sake of these thirty taels of silver, I boarded the Ninth Prince’s pirate ship and could never get off again…

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Adding to the Stakes
chapters.content:
Xing Yucheng initially thought that although he accepted the thirty taels of silver from the Ninth Prince, since it was an equal exchange, it would not have any impact at all.
But gradually, Xing Yucheng found something wrong.
The principle of “a man who has received favors will be soft-hearted and a man who has received favors will be obliged to return favors” applies everywhere. Xing Yucheng suddenly found that he could not open his mouth. When he heard his parents asking him about the Ninth Prince, Xing Yucheng subconsciously spoke well of the Ninth Prince, even though the Ninth Prince was not a good person.
Moreover, he didn’t know how to explain the matter of the silver to his mother. He thought of countless reasons, but they were all overturned in the end.
After getting this money, I feel that I am not as happy as I imagined.
During dinner, Xing Yucheng was feeling conflicted and sad about lying to his parents, and he looked a little depressed. The Minister of Works and his wife thought he was just tired from his first day in the study, and did not think too much about it.
As the family was eating, they somehow ended up talking about the issue of corruption.
Xing Yucheng’s eldest brother has passed the age of coming of age. He just passed the imperial examination this year and is now working as a minor official in the capital. He encountered a problem right after taking office, so he came out of his yard today to ask his father for advice.
“Father, today a wealthy businessman asked your son to do something for him, and he also wants to give him a sum of money. But in fact, the person in charge has already made a decision and the winner is the wealthy businessman. Father, do you think your son can take the money?” In the eyes of Xing Yucheng’s eldest brother, since the verdict has been made, it would be fine for him to do a favor. It would not be against the law, and he could still get the money, killing two birds with one stone.
Now that the young daughter has just been born and is in need of money, and he also has to prepare a dowry in the future, it is inevitable that Xing Yucheng’s eldest brother will be tempted.But he had no experience, so out of caution, he wanted to ask his father, who had been an official for many years, whether there were any particular requirements.
However, the Minister of Industry rejected it without a second thought: “Absolutely not!”
Seeing that his eldest son was puzzled, the Minister of Industry put down his bowl and chopsticks and slowly said, “This matter seems to be beneficial, but in fact it is full of hidden dangers.”
The Minister of Industry tilted his head and said, “Tell me, can you guarantee that the rich businessman can keep the secret? Businessmen value profit, so most of them won’t. When someone comes to you the second time, will you do it? If you don’t want to do it, then what about the first time? If you want to do it, will you still refuse the third or fourth time? By then, the snowball will only get bigger and bigger, and you will get deeper and deeper into trouble, with no possibility of turning back.”
With the current trend in the court and the strength of the secret guards’ execution, even if he is not caught today, he will be caught sooner or later tomorrow or the day after tomorrow.
“There are some things that you think your father cannot do? No, it’s just that your father cannot do them.” Although the Ministry of Works is a notoriously poor government office among the six ministries, he is a minister after all. How is it possible that he cannot get any benefits at all?
“It’s just that this benefit is too hot to handle, and I don’t want to take it.”
“This matter will happen again. Once this loophole is opened, the interests will be increasingly intertwined. By then, there will be no turning back, Yuan’er. Even if you are careful, how are you going to explain the extra money out of thin air?”
Xing Yucheng’s eldest brother thought about it and realized that it made sense, so he stood up and saluted with a serious face: “Thank you for your teachings, father. I will remember it.”
With a “click”, Xing Yucheng was awakened by his eldest brother’s voice. He was not paying attention and the chopsticks in his hand fell accidentally.
“Yes.” The Shangshu nodded with satisfaction.
When he turned around, he saw that his third son’s face looked even uglier than his eldest brother’s.
“What’s wrong with you, Yucheng?”
“No, nothing…”
This child is so strange today.
But since it was his first day in the study, it was inevitable that he had some concerns.
Thinking this way, the Minister and his wife did not notice the slightest despair in their son’s eyes.
Although his elder brother was not greedy, he himself was greedy!
If there is one, there will be another… snowball… getting deeper and deeper… how to deal with the extra money out of thin air…
Returning to his room, Xing Yucheng became more and more anxious the more he thought about it. He did not dare to give the bag of silver given by the Ninth Prince to his mother. He subconsciously began to look for a place to hide it.
Put it under the bed? No, no, no, that won’t work. A maid will come to clean every two days, and it will definitely be discovered by then.
Put it in the closet? But his mother often helps them sort out seasonal clothes, so it’s impossible to hide it.
How about putting it on top of the bed?
After finally climbing up, Xing Yucheng still couldn’t reach and always felt that he would be discovered.
After tossing and turning until late at night, Xing Yucheng had no other choice but to sleep all night holding the bag of silver that looked like a bomb. He silently decided to return it the next day and would not take this job no matter what!
The other end.
Even though he made a bet with the Fifth Prince, Ye Shuo did not plan to do anything unnecessary. After all, as long as he performed normally, he would basically have the upper hand.
There was one thing that Ye Shuo hadn’t expected. He didn’t expect that His father didn’t send anyone to stop him after school. This was a bit strange. He felt that something big had happened.
Along the way, he noticed that people looked at him strangely, and after sending Xiao Luzi to ask around, Ye Shuo easily found out what His father had said in front of the Xuan Zheng Hall.
“Isn’t he just relying on the fact that he is my son? He doesn’t even think about the fact that I have so many sons, and I don’t need him as one.”
Of course not. Ye Shuo had accepted the fact that he was not an only child in this life eight hundred years ago, and there was no need for Cheap Dad to repeat it again.
The love that an only child could receive was something that Emperor Jingwen could never imagine in his entire life. In his opinion, he had already doted on his son quite a bit, but in Ye Shuo’s eyes, well, it was just so-so.
In modern times, he would have dared to say to his father directly, “Your things, including the company and the house, will be mine from now on.” But now, Ye Shuo would not be so bold.
Not to mention him, even if the prince dared to say this, he would be killed by Cheap Dad.
So it doesn’t matter whether you lose it or not.
However, Xiao Luzi next to him was extremely nervous, fearing that his master would be hurt, and was secretly shocked that what the emperor said was too harsh.
“Your Highness, don’t be sad. His Majesty, His Majesty may not mean that…”
“…” Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, and asked curiously: “Which eye of yours saw that I was sad?”
At first, Xiao Luzi thought that his master was forcing a smile, and he felt a little sad. But after observing for a while, he felt that it really wasn’t the case.
“………”
Xiao Luzi was speechless for a moment.
Ye Shuo wasn’t really worried about anything else. He was just worried that his mother wouldn’t be able to accept it. Needless to say, his mother would be particularly angry this time.
On the way back to Qiuwu Palace, Ye Shuo had already thought of how to explain, but as soon as he entered the door –
Ye Shuo found that it was not the case at all, his mother was indeed angry, but it seemed that the person she was angry at was not him.
“What exactly do you mean? What do you mean by Shuo’er is not ‘missing’?” In the eyes of Concubine Rong, her son is unique and cannot be replaced by just any Tom, Dick or Harry. In the eyes of Concubine Rong, she only lacks this one, and she doesn’t care about any other one no matter how good it is.
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen’s words, which seemed to be insignificant to his son, really touched Concubine Rong’s lungs. Perhaps she was too angry and spoke without thinking.
Ye Shuo quickly checked the surroundings and found no trace of the secret guards, so he breathed a sigh of relief.
At least her mother still had some sense, and only left Nanny, Su Yue and the others in the room, so it wasn’t a big deal.
“Mom, don’t be angry…”
Before Ye Shuo could finish his words, Concubine Rong rushed over to him, hugged him tightly, and then burst into tears: “Wow, my poor Shuo’er…”
Ye Shuo: “…”
So what’s so pitiful about him?
Oh yes, losing father’s love is indeed pitiful in the eyes of others.
But with Mr. Gu in front of him, he really couldn’t cry. Even if Cheap Dad looked a bit like his father, Ye Shuo might not be able to stay so calm.
Unfortunately, Emperor Jingwen and Mr. Gu have completely different styles.
So Ye Shuo opened his mouth: “Mother——”
The imperial concubine was completely unaware: “You were just being naughty and having fun. What’s the big deal? Every child has gone through this. Why did the emperor say such harsh words?”
To be honest, the imperial concubine is quite hypocritical and dotes on her children. It’s as if her children are the only children in the world and other people are not even as good as her children. If she were to be seen outside, she would definitely be an extremely annoying person.
But now as the one being double-standardized, Ye Shuo could only feel deeply moved.
“Okay, mother, look, I’m fine, right?”
Concubine Rong took the time to glance at it through her tearful eyes and found that it was true, but she didn’t think so. She even became more sad: “Poor my son, he has to force a smile when he is so young.” Concubine Rong couldn’t help it, and she gritted her teeth and scolded Emperor Jingwen in a low voice.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Forget it, it seems there is no way to explain it.
On the other hand, Emperor Jingwen also received the news that his son had been beaten with three slaps.
“…He really doesn’t feel ashamed at all?”
After receiving a positive reply, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said, “Go and inform the upper study room to increase the number of late three hand boards to six.”
The emperor opened his mouth and immediately doubled the amount of punishment.
“Since he doesn’t mind the pain and shame, there’s no need for me to spoil him.”
My goodness, His Majesty is really going to fight with the Ninth Prince this time.
Wang Ziquan inexplicably felt that the Emperor Jingwen, who was facing off against his son, was inexplicably, well, how should I put it, a little different from usual.
No longer so high and mighty, it turns out that even an emperor, when faced with disobedient children, is as helpless as ordinary people.
He had no idea what Wang Ziquan beside him was thinking. After giving the order, Emperor Jingwen had a blank expression on his face and lowered his head to look at the memorial on the table again.
Only three breaths passed before he started writing again.
The next morning, the Sixth Prince came to call Ye Shuo on time and asked him to go with him today.
The result was as expected, it was impossible to call him.
“Xiao Ming, no, Sixth Brother, please, let me go!” For the first time in his life, Ye Shuo showed deep pleading to the Sixth Prince, whom he had watched grow up.
Really, not everyone in this world can be as curry as him.
“I know you are doing this for my own good, but I really don’t have any big ambitions. I really don’t have such great ambitions.” I’m so sleepy, let me sleep, let me sleep.
“You!” Looking at his little brother who refused to open his eyes, the Sixth Prince broke his composure and showed his anger.
“You are not ambitious and only care about the momentary pleasure… You are on your own, I will not care about you anymore!”
As soon as the Sixth Prince left, Ye Shuo fell down again.
Xing Yucheng also came to Qiuwu Palace early. When he heard him say that he wanted to pay back the money, Ye Shuo, who was woken up again, leaned against the bed and said while yawning, “The deal is done. No changes will be accepted.” Which business contract can be revoked after being signed?
“It’s not a good idea to act impulsively. It’s your fault for not knowing the good things beforehand.”
Ye Shuo said lazily: “Give up on this idea. I will definitely not take the money. Not only will I not take it, but I will give you money frequently in the future. Your money will only increase, increase, and increase.”
With every additional word Ye Shuo said, Xing Yucheng’s face turned paler, until he almost lost all color.
It turned out that what his father said was true.
Once this hole is opened, it can never be closed again.
He had spent a whole night hiding the thirty taels alone. What would he do with the hundreds or thousands of taels in the future?
What Ye Shuo said afterward made Xing Yucheng completely despair.
“Now that you have accepted my money, you will only be tied to me more and more in the future. I guess you will never be able to break free from me in this life. Not only you, but also your father and your family…”
“Your Highness the Ninth Prince, please spare my life!” Xing Yucheng really cried.
Looking at his study companion who was kneeling there and trembling with despair, Ye Shuo touched his chin and thought to himself, this kid is so easy to fool.
But when you think about it, he is indeed well-educated, worthy of being the son of the number one scholar. Now he is only twelve years old and is not much worse than the fifth prince. His father is the Minister of Works, and there is a high probability that he will embark on a career in officialdom in the future.
Since he was going to be an official, no matter whether he was a high-ranking official or a low-ranking official, being honest was always a good thing for the people. So Ye Shuo was less burdened and whispered to the devil beside him: “Remember the feeling of this moment, there are still many days to come…”
