It’s over. I’m only twelve years old, and I’ve already sacrificed my parents and entire family.
Looking at his study partner who was crying loudly, Ye Shuo reflected for a second whether he had gone too far, but it was only a second, and soon he wrapped himself in the quilt and continued to sleep.
As usual, Ye Shuo waited until dawn before getting up, and he was much more arrogant than yesterday. Xing Yucheng watched him walk into the main hall of Qiuwu Palace.
Xing Yucheng thought that if the imperial concubine saw this scene, she would definitely scold the Ninth Prince. He said that he could take the opportunity to tell him about the ghostwriting incident, and then he could get out of it naturally.
As a result… instead of scolding the Ninth Prince, the Imperial Concubine showed concern for him and asked him if he had had a good rest last night!
Xing Yucheng’s face was in a state of confusion, and the glimmer of hope that had just risen in his heart suddenly died beyond all possibility of death.
Half an hour later, Ye Shuo put the bowl on the table and said, “Mom, I’m going to class first. When I come back in the evening, remember to ask the kitchen to stew pigeon soup for me.”
“good.”
Watching her son’s figure gradually disappearing into the distance with a smile, Concubine Rong felt that such a day seemed not bad. It was also a special feeling to personally send her son to school.
Xing Yucheng vaguely heard this and lost control of himself, nearly falling when crossing the threshold.
I’ve seen people spoiling their children, but I’ve never seen one spoiling their children like this. If it were his mother, she would have broken his legs long ago.
By the time Ye Shuo arrived leisurely, as expected, the class was about to end.
Lord Cen’s face turned livid.
Looking at the Ninth Prince who very consciously stretched out his hand, he suddenly realized that the other party had already made such a plan, and what happened yesterday was not an accident at all!
“Master Cen, I’m really sorry. I got up late again today.”
Look, is this human language? !
Lord Cen would not be fooled by him again today. He took a deep breath and repeated to him the imperial edict that the emperor had conveyed last night.
Sure enough, the child in front of him couldn’t hold it anymore.
“What?” When hearing the number “six”, even Ye Shuo couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
Lord Cen breathed a sigh of relief, but it seemed that he was still afraid.
But in fact, what Ye Shuo was afraid of was not the six boards themselves. Not to mention six, even if there were six more, it would not have much impact. What he was afraid of was this terrifying growth rate.
Adding six boards today and six boards tomorrow, the number will accumulate to a pretty scary number in a few days.
Didn’t you say you don’t care? Didn’t you say you don’t need a son like him? ? ?
How can Cheap Dad go back on his word!!!
Lord Cen watched helplessly as the Ninth Prince’s face became uglier and uglier. In the end, he said something that he, as well as the other princes and grandchildren, would never forget in their lifetime –
“Master Cen, can you give me enough beatings for a year… no, a month?”
After thinking about it, I feel that it is not really possible for me to make 2,000 yuan a year for making prototypes, but if I can only make a little over 100 yuan, it should be barely enough.
“Can you give me a month first?”
If it doesn’t work, think of other solutions after a month.
The moment the words fell, the entire study room was silent, and even the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but open his mouth slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Retreat
chapters.content:
He really dares to say it…
The Sixth Prince originally thought that he knew his younger brother well enough, but he never expected that he could always easily fall below his bottom line.
Not to mention the Sixth Prince, even the Fifth Prince next to him was so shocked that he was speechless for a long time, and he didn’t even have time to reveal his signature gloating expression.
The little prince covered his mouth tightly, fearing that he would scream out.
The Ninth Uncle is so brave…
Looking at Lord Cen standing by, his hands were shaking so much that they were about to leave afterimages, and he was so angry that he couldn’t even breathe: “Ridiculous! Absurd!”
It looks like it won’t work.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo didn’t hold out too much hope, fearing that he would upset the young master in front of him, so he quickly apologized, “Master Cen, I’m sorry, please don’t be upset, I just said something wrong.”
In fact, Ye Shuo’s attitude was quite sincere when he admitted his mistake, and it was obvious that he was sincere. But when Lord Cen thought about the fact that he admitted his mistake but did not change, he felt that his face was even more hateful.
“Put your hand over here!!”Perhaps because he was so angry, Lord Cen was particularly ruthless today, making Ye Shuo finally feel what pain was.
But, it still can’t be compared with the previous life.
It’s really pitiful to be a teacher to the prince. You can’t touch him, hit him, or scold him. If you meet someone who is thick-skinned, there is nothing you can do.
Without any awareness of being a nuisance, Ye Shuo sat down, spread out his book, and glanced over today’s study content. It took him no more than a cup of tea before he lost his patience and began to look at the scenery outside the window.
The voice of Master Cen, who was lecturing the princes, changed significantly.
Soon, in less than an hour, Ye Shuo’s “wise words” spread throughout the palace, and even the Duke of Zhen had heard of it.
Facing the ridicule and sarcasm from the civil officials next door, the Duke of Zhen was thinking in his heart, how come the Ninth Prince inherited this problem from their family?
As everyone knows, no one in their family, even their daughter, likes to read. They get annoyed and have a headache when they see a book. Therefore, Duke Zhen not only did not vent his anger on her, but felt a little guilty instead.
Obviously, even the Duke of Zhen knew what it meant for a prince to be unable to read.
As for the harem, the concubines were naturally happy to watch the joke again, especially those who had sons, they were so happy that they could die.
After the Crown Prince’s tutor heard what he said, he felt more sympathetic towards his old rival, and even stopped laughing at him behind his back recently, because he really felt that it was immoral and embarrassing.
Emperor Jingwen was the first to know the news. Although he already knew his son’s nature, he still couldn’t control himself when he first heard it, and his eyes went dark.
It’s the kind of situation where one can still get angry even though one has said that one’s heart is calm.
“More! Keep adding more!”
He just doesn’t believe it, let’s see who can cure whom!
At the emperor’s command, the punishment for being late in the Shangshufang was doubled sixfold, from three boards at the beginning to 18 boards now. Ye Shuo, by his own efforts, made the already strict rules of the Shangshufang even more terrible in just two days.
The key point is that other people were unlucky, but Ye Shuo himself was not hurt at all.
As luck would have it, the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince lived the farthest from the upper study. They were not as active as the Sixth Prince in going to school, so although they would not be late, they still gave themselves at most two cups of tea.
With this rule, the two of them had to get up a quarter of an hour earlier, otherwise they would be in trouble if they encountered any unexpected situation one day.
A quarter of an hour! When the Fifth Prince heard about this, he immediately cursed Ye Shuo in his heart.
What about Ye Shuo? I don’t know if he anticipated that his cheap father would have to change his words, or if he felt that the three extra beatings he received the day before were not worth it and wanted to earn them back, so he delayed his arrival for another two hours.
Okay, just finish your lunch and come right after the afternoon class.
Why! Why can he do this! ?
Although the eighteen blows hit his hands hard, it didn’t seem to hurt at all, and there was no effect at all!
This thought suddenly flashed through his mind, and when he came to his senses, the Fifth Prince realized what he was thinking.
“Oh, you’re jealous already?”
Turning his head, he met Ye Shuo’s teasing gaze. The Fifth Prince’s mind suddenly buzzed, and he immediately exploded: “Huh?! I’m jealous of you? I’m jealous of you, an unlearned person?”
I didn’t expect him to get angry so easily. Ye Shuo found it very interesting: “It’s okay as long as you’re not jealous. After all, if you admit it, you have three requirements.”
The fifth prince suddenly calmed down: “Oh, I tell you, you will never have this opportunity in your life!”
It’s only been two days.
Ye Shuo smiled and said nothing.
On the third day, the number of boards had accumulated to 36, and Ye Shuo even waited until the end of the night before coming, truly fulfilling what he had said unintentionally at the beginning.
Every day he just waits to get the board and leave.
This action shocked Lord Cen and the Sixth Prince as much as what he said three days ago.
Now they have finally broadened their horizons.
“Crash”, when Wang Ziquan walked from outside to the Qinzheng Hall, he heard the sound of cups breaking inside. He probably understood that the emperor’s plan still did not work today.
“Add! Add another hundred!”
Facts have proven that when people become too popular, they will really lose their rationality, and Emperor Jingwen, who was known for his rationality, was no exception.
Wang Ziquan’s heart tightened, and he said with a bitter face, “No, Your Majesty, this will really cripple the Ninth Prince.”
Emperor Jingwen said nothing, but just said: “He asked for it.”
As soon as Emperor Jingwen said this, Wang Ziquan was shocked beyond words.
But what Wang Ziquan didn’t know was that Emperor Jingwen regretted his decision the moment he turned around.
It is not easy for even an emperor to bear the thought of crippling his own son’s hand.
But the emperor’s words were golden and could not be changed once they were spoken, so Emperor Jingwen successfully suffered from insomnia and could not sleep the whole night.
After reviewing memorials at night and not sleeping all night, Emperor Jingwen had a layer of dark circles under his eyes and was not in a good mood.
The next morning, just as Emperor Jingwen was hesitating whether to send the guards to Qiuwu Palace and force him to go to the study, after all, in this way, it would not be considered as breaking his promise.
Before Emperor Jingwen could give any more orders, Wang Ziquan hurried in and said, “Your Majesty, Your Majesty, the Ninth Prince—”
Have you finished beating 136 boards?
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt that he couldn’t breathe, but the next second, he heard Wang Ziquan say: “Your Majesty, the Ninth Prince has now arrived at the upper study!”
Looking up at the sky, it was indeed the Mao hour.
I’m afraid the sun will rise from the west today.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but laugh: “I knew he would not be able to hold on sooner or later.”
Because of Ye Shuo’s schooling, everyone in the palace was in turmoil.
Seeing him sitting in his seat on time, Lord Cen’s eyes almost popped out. He was originally wondering how to punish him today.
It would certainly not work if he really beat him, because by then the prince would be crippled, the emperor would regret it, and he, as his teacher, would be the one who would suffer. But he couldn’t be beaten too lightly, because if he was beaten lightly, he wouldn’t remember it.
As a result, everything is fine now, and he doesn’t have to worry about it anymore.
Lord Cen felt the urge to cry for the first time in a long time.
Not to mention him, even the Fifth Prince had an expression as if he had seen a ghost when he saw his younger brother.
However, just when everyone thought he had no choice but to give in, unexpectedly, after the first get out of class, he disappeared again.
“What? Gone?” After listening to the little eunuch’s words, Lord Cen suspected that there was something wrong with his ears.
But how could it be possible? After the first class, the Ninth Prince really walked out of the study room in a swagger.
After all, Ye Shuo had studied it and found out that there was no such thing as leaving early in the study room, which meant that as long as he showed up and then left, he would not be considered late.
“Your Majesty…” God knows how scared Wang Ziquan was when he told Emperor Jingwen the news.
Sure enough, the next moment, Emperor Jingwen exerted force with his hand and broke the brush he had been using for many years.
Wang Ziquan lowered his head deeply, unable to bear to look any longer.
Of course, Ye Shuo certainly couldn’t do the same as before, taking advantage of every opportunity to take advantage of the situation, otherwise the punishment would increase dramatically within three days. So in the days that followed, he played around with skipping classes, leaving early, and asking for leave, making sure that his cheap father couldn’t figure out the pattern.
Anyway, as long as his stepfather doesn’t show up in person, Ye Shuo won’t be afraid at all.
There was nothing that could be done now that he was there. After all, his stepfather was the emperor, and he could not go too far.
As for why his cheap father hadn’t shown up until now, Ye Shuo could probably guess a little bit, he probably just wanted to deal with it coldly. He didn’t think this would work, didn’t he?
Then, from time to time, this scene would be played out in the study room:
If the temperature suddenly dropped or the sky suddenly darkened, Ye Shuo would definitely just walk away. In his words, he didn’t have enough clothes to wear and the eunuchs who accompanied him didn’t bring any. What if he caught a cold or got sick?
There is also the rain. Although I have an umbrella and a raincoat, I will still be splashed by water vapor. What if I get a fever from the rain? Is there any special medicine?
Seeing how he took care of himself, the princes were speechless.
Especially the little grandson of the emperor, the envy in his eyes was almost overflowing.
He also wanted to be as cool and carefree as the Ninth Prince…
But when he thought that even his own mother would not agree, the little prince became completely discouraged.
Ha, pretending. Seeing him like this, the Fifth Prince couldn’t help but sneer in his heart, but for some reason, his handwriting was a little messier than usual when he wrote.
Also, the weather cannot be too bad, nor can it be too good. After all, in Ye Shuo’s opinion, such good weather is for playing well, and one should not waste the good time on reading which can be done at any time.
So whenever the weather was good, Ye Shuo would basically ask his mother to go with him, and they would have a picnic in the imperial garden, fly kites, etc. In the beginning, Concubine Rong scolded him, but gradually, she let him go.
After all, Ye Shuo said that he would grill the meat for her. It was the meat grilled by his own son. How could Concubine Rong resist such temptation?
Compared to other situations where they have stayed in the inner house for too long, and their sons despise them for being ignorant and annoyed if they say one more word to them, Concubine Rong naturally prefers this.
After all, kites can fly quite high and far. Ye Shuo swore that he didn’t do it on purpose, but it just happened that the Fifth Prince saw it.
The swallow-shaped kite was so conspicuous, and the colors were so bright, flying in the sky made people feel uncomfortable. The fifth prince felt that Ye Shuo was provoking him, and he tore off a corner of the textbook at hand.
asshole!!
The princes had been sitting for an hour and were already feeling extremely tired. Then they saw this scene, and they felt mixed emotions. They couldn’t help but think of the story of the rich businessman that Ye Shuo had told them before.
Actually, that story sounds reasonable…
Even the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but adjusted his position.
I don’t know if it was because he was angry or upset, or because the weather has been a bit unpredictable recently, but the Fifth Prince accidentally caught a cold.
In fact, the situation was not particularly serious. It was just a few mild symptoms, such as nasal congestion and dizziness. In the past, the Fifth Prince would not have taken it seriously at all. He would have taken two doses of medicine and endured it.
In fact, Concubine Shu’s attitude towards him did not change. After asking him about his well-being, she asked him to go to school as before.
After all, studying is the most important thing, and ordinary illnesses should not interfere with studying.
But today, maybe it was because sick people were particularly fragile, or maybe he had a severe cold and dizziness, but the Fifth Prince suddenly had a flashback of Ye Shuo coming and going as he pleased, and the Imperial Concubine never stopped him, always putting his health first.
This was even the case when that bastard was full of energy and nothing happened to him, and the imperial concubine didn’t say anything. But when he himself fell ill, his mother still asked him to go to the study.
Is studying really that important?
A sudden feeling of grievance surged in his heart, and the Fifth Prince’s tone was filled with unprecedented resentment: “Noble Concubine Rong would never call the Ninth Prince like this, and you, my own mother, would only tell your son to study, study, study.”
The moment the words fell, the entire hall fell silent.
On the other side, Qiuwu Palace——
There were still two quarters of an hour left before the Mao hour, when a man in a black robe appeared at the entrance of Qiuwu Palace. The owner of the robe stood at the entrance for almost a cup of tea before he stepped inside.
No one expected that such an unexpected person would appear here at this time. The palace guards were shocked and then thought about paying their respects.
However, the next moment, he was stopped by that man.
“No need, don’t alarm anyone.”
Under the horrified gazes of the palace servants, the man in the black robe walked towards the side hall, and then… entered the Ninth Prince’s room.
Looking at Ye Shuo, who was still sleeping soundly even though it was almost time and had no intention of waking up, the owner of the black robe held the beads in his hand and took a deep breath.
Looking next to them, the son of the Minister of Works and the young eunuch on night watch were not much behind, the only difference was that one was on the chaise longue and the other was at Ye Shuo’s feet.
Oh, I forgot to mention that after such a long time, Xing Yucheng has completely fallen and completely forgotten his original persistence. He sleeps no worse than the prince he serves.
The veins on the forehead of the owner of the black robe twitched twice.
Seeing this, the attendants nearby could not help but remain silent.
“Just watch and see when he—”
“Forget it, just wake him up!”
As if he had thought of something, he quickly changed his words halfway through speaking.
Soon, Ye Shuo felt someone pulling his quilt: “Let go, let go…”
“Your Highness, Your Highness, it’s time to go to school.”
“Nonsense…it’s still early…sleep for five more minutes…”
The visitor could no longer bear it when he saw this: “Come here right now, right now!”
Ye Shuo was startled and sat up suddenly from the bed. At this time, Emperor Jingwen’s face was the same color as the sky outside. He might have been half asleep. Ye Shuo blurted out, “Dad, why are you here?”
Emperor Jingwen was about to curse, but after hearing these words, he was subconsciously stunned.
“What did you call me just now?”
Well, he is an emperor, but he is willing to come and bring only the eunuch Wang with him. The meaning is very clear. Ye Shuo is not so ungrateful, so he yawns and starts to shout repeatedly –
“father.”
“father.”
“father!”
Emperor Jingwen suddenly fell silent. Ye Shuo held his breath, waiting for his next words.
After about a dozen breaths, Emperor Jingwen spoke as if he had accepted his fate.
“Tell me, what do I have to do so that you can go to school honestly.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Ye Shuo’s sleepiness was instantly scared away.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Conditions
chapters.content:
Oh my god, is this person really my cheap dad? Is this something my cheap dad would say?
Could he have been switched by someone?
As if he saw the undisguised shock in his son’s eyes, Emperor Jingwen became angry and humiliated.
Emperor Jingwen actually didn’t want this to happen, but there was no other way. He had tried basically all the tricks, beating, scolding, and ignoring him, but none of them worked. He couldn’t really say that his status as a prince was abolished because of this incident.
If he was to be beaten, his son wouldn’t care at all. This kid had been tough since he was young, and those blows had no effect at all on him.
As for whipping his sense of shame, forget it. If he had any sense of shame, he wouldn’t be late and leave early every day. Haven’t you seen what the concubines and ladies in the entire harem are talking about? They almost said it in front of the little bastard, but they just don’t take it to heart. What can you do?
Emperor Jingwen thought that he had spoken so seriously. If it were any other prince or princess, they would have turned pale and trembled. But he looked like nothing had happened. Emperor Jingwen didn’t know whether to say that he was too confident or too heartless.
The more he was ignored, the more lawless he became. Finally, he dared to go to the study room in the afternoon, where he was beaten and left.
All of the above made Emperor Jingwen realize that his son was totally different from ordinary children, and the methods used to deal with ordinary children were completely inapplicable to him.
Emperor Jingwen was completely at his wits’ end.For other people, it was the father who had the power of life and death over their children. Even when Emperor Jingwen was a prince, he was no exception. He was always careful, fearing that he would offend his father. But when it came to his son’s turn, it was as if he owed him something in his previous life, and his status was suddenly reversed.
Emperor Jingwen had realized that he could not count on the imperial concubine to teach his son. The imperial concubine was not good enough as a mother, and Imperial Concubine Rong was useless. Emperor Jingwen is angry, but there was nothing he could do. In the end, he, the father, had to take over.
What else? You can’t just watch your child become useless, right?
No matter what, they are my own flesh and blood.
When it comes to giving up, an emperor like Emperor Jingwen who is used to being diligent will definitely not be able to beat Ye Shuo. He cannot allow his son to really degenerate. It’s like who does the housework between a couple. In the end, the one with lower tolerance will definitely do more.
Emperor Jingwen lost because he had a low self-esteem and was too concerned about his reputation. He could not compare to someone as shameless as Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo then understood that what his stepfather said was just words spoken in anger.
Suddenly I remembered that my father in my previous life also said things like “If you don’t listen to me, I will let someone else inherit the company, and donate all my property after I die, so that you won’t get a penny.” He also often threatened him with having another child to force him to make progress.
I didn’t expect my cheap dad would know this trick.
Mainly because his cheap father didn’t look like that kind of person on weekdays, Ye Shuo really took his words seriously. He guessed that this must have been a very unpleasant feeling.
While Ye Shuo was in a daze, Emperor Jingwen gradually lost his patience and asked again: “Why are you standing there in a daze? Hurry up and answer me. What do I want you to be quiet and go to school honestly?”
This was the first time that Emperor Jingwen negotiated with his son. He felt something was strange, so his tone unconsciously became heavier, and he adopted the same attitude he had towards his ministers during court sessions.
Xiaoluzi and Xing Yucheng who were nearby were awakened immediately.
The two of them didn’t take it seriously at first. They were half-drowsy and were about to ask the Ninth Prince if it was time to go to school, but when they turned around, they saw Emperor Jingwen standing there with a sullen face.
A black robe, with a golden dragon embroidered with gold thread hovering faintly on the robe, with stern eyes, looking down from the shoulder. One, two, three, four, five… five claws in total. In the entire Zhou Dynasty, there is only one person who can wear this robe.
His Majesty!
Xing Yucheng fell directly off the chaise longue, shaking like a chicken.
It’s over, it’s over, it’s over. My life is over after being caught sleeping in by His Majesty!
he estimated that he would not be able to see the rising sun.
Xing Yucheng, who was only twelve years old, had a blank mind and began to beg for mercy desperately along with Xiaoluzi.
“Shut up.” Emperor Jingwen glanced over, and Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi suddenly felt as if their necks were strangled. Their kowtow movements froze, and they dared not move at all.
Ye Shuo, who was standing by, didn’t think for long and quickly gave an answer: “When you go to the study room to change the rules, I will behave myself.”
hiss.
Wang Ziquan on the side couldn’t help but take a breath. After all, he had never seen someone who wanted to change the rules of the study room as soon as he opened his mouth in his life.
Emperor Jingwen also took a long time to suppress his anger: “…How do you want to change it?”
As if he didn’t notice that his cheap dad was on the verge of exploding, Ye Shuo counted on his fingers: “Starting at Chen shi, classes start at Si shi, take a break for a cup of tea every three quarters of an hour, and finish school on time at noon. Afternoon classes start at two quarters of an hour, and finish school on time at Shen shi.” In other words, he had the same schedule as the elementary school student in his previous life. Classes start at nine in the morning, each class is forty-five minutes, with a ten-minute break every forty-five minutes, and finish school at twelve noon. Classes start at one-thirty in the afternoon, and then finish school at four o’clock.
The daily routine of an elementary school student is already Ye Shuo’s bottom line.
Before he could finish his words, Emperor Jingwen rejected his proposal without even a second thought: “It’s impossible. There has never been such a precedent since the Zhou Dynasty.” Wouldn’t it be absurd to change it so easily?
Also, classes start at 9:00 p.m., and we have to take a break to drink a cup of tea every 35 minutes. What can we really learn?
Emperor Jingwen’s face began to turn dark again.
However, Ye Shuo hasn’t even mentioned that we have to rest for two days every five days. There is also a two-month summer vacation and a one-month winter vacation. If he said this, wouldn’t my cheap dad explode on the spot?
“Is it really impossible?” Ye Shuo did not give up and asked again. Xing Yucheng and Xiaoluzi next to him felt their hearts in their throats.
Emperor Jingwen flatly refused: “No!”
Ye Shuo’s face was full of disappointment, and he suddenly became uninterested. At the same time, he also knew that his stepfather’s appearance here meant that he had no choice.
Although his cheap father cannot destroy him because of this, don’t forget that he can send guards to escort him to school every day.
The fact that his cheap father was willing to come and negotiate terms with him was already a gesture of courtesy before force, and was very respectful to him.
Ye Shuo decided to quit while he was ahead, so he waved his hand and said casually: “If it really doesn’t work, then change it, change it… change it…”
After thinking for a moment, Ye Shuo suddenly remembered something and his eyes suddenly lit up: “It’s your turn to carry me to school every day.”
Since pain is inevitable, you can’t suffer alone, you have to let your cheap father feel it too.
The moment he finished speaking, not to mention Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi, even Wang Ziquan almost knelt down in front of him.
My dear, please stop making trouble. How, how is this possible!
As expected, Emperor Jingwen was easily provoked to anger: “How outrageous!”
Please, Ninth Prince, kindly stop talking nonsense. Xing Yucheng was about to cry.
But after finally coming here this time, Emperor Jingwen finally managed to suppress his anger. He gritted his teeth, stiffened his face, and said, “I can send guards or eunuchs to carry you.” Sending people was already the limit of Emperor Jingwen.
The three people on the side were all shocked by the emperor’s concession, but Ye Shuo was very dissatisfied. In his previous life, when he was a child, he rode on his father’s neck every day. Although his father had given him a big discount in this life, it didn’t mean that he couldn’t even carry him on his back, right?
“What’s the point of sending people here? You are my father, not them. I am your son, not theirs.”
“Dad, how about we make a pact?”
“If you carry me to school, I will behave myself for the whole day, how about that?”
On the other hand, if the cheap dad loses patience and gives up after carrying it for two days, I also have a reason to run away. Who told him to break the appointment first?
If my stepfather persists, then I won’t lose out. Being carried to school by the emperor himself, even if it is still painful, at least I will feel a little comforted.
Ye Shuo’s mind was clattering with calculations, the more he thought about it, the more he felt that this was a good idea.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen was completely confused by the series of “Dad”s from his son.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo said quickly: “Since you are silent, I will take it as your consent. Xiao Luzi, come on, help me change my clothes!”
Xing Yucheng couldn’t control the expression on his face anymore, and it all collapsed.
Without giving his cheap father a chance to regret, Ye Shuo changed his clothes at the fastest speed in his life, without even having time to button his clothes. Seeing that his cheap father seemed to want to say something, he quickly jumped onto his back.
Emperor Jingwen instinctively reached out to support it, and then… nothing happened.
By the time he reacted, the group was already in the corridor in front of Qiuwu Palace.
Wang Ziquan looked dazed, and finally lost the general manager’s usual calmness.
Not to mention Jingwen, who felt the weight behind him and wanted to throw the little bastard down countless times.
Seeing that he looked unhappy, Ye Shuo hurriedly said: “Hey, Dad, be happier, it’s not like you haven’t carried me before.” There is still a long time to live in the future, how can he be so repulsive?
“Besides, isn’t it natural for a father to carry his son on his back? After all, you are my father.”
“…Shut up!” Which father carries his son to school every day?
This isn’t giving birth to a son, this is giving birth to a father, right?
as well as……
Emperor Jingwen closed his eyes and said, “When was the last time I carried you on my back? Why will I carry you on my back this time?”
Ye Shuo recalled and said in surprise: “But I don’t think there is much difference.” His cheap father has taken good care of himself, and it seems that there is no change from five years ago.
Although my cheap dad was full of complaints, his steps were extremely steady, as if he had practiced hard.
Although Emperor Jingwen was somewhat happy that his son praised him for his youth, he was afraid that he might go too far, so he turned his head and glared at him fiercely.
Along the way, this scene stunned countless palace maids, and caused many of them to drop the buckets and basins they were holding.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even look at them, thinking that since things had come to this, he might as well persuade his son more.
Emperor Jingwen was rarely sincere in his words: “Shuo’er, when you get to the upper study, you must study hard. You are not allowed to play around like before. If you don’t study, how can you compare with others?”
“Ministers and common people, as a prince, everyone in the world is watching you.”
Ye Shuo: “It doesn’t matter. Anyway, my father is stronger than all their fathers combined. Just based on this point, they can’t say anything.”
This was the first time that Emperor Jingwen heard someone speak so confidently, but for some reason, he felt inexplicably happy in his heart.
But it was only for a moment, and then Emperor Jingwen’s face tightened again: “What about father, don’t you want to surpass father?”
No matter what the future holds, at least for now Emperor Jingwen hopes that his children will be more successful than himself, generation after generation, so that the Great Zhou can prosper forever.
As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Ziquan, who was standing next to him, felt his heart skip a beat, and he couldn’t help but secretly glance at the emperor’s expression.
Seeing that the emperor was just asking ordinary questions between father and son and had no other intentions, Wang Ziquan gradually relaxed.
“But I’ve surpassed it.”
As if he was unaware of the sensitive topic, he noticed Emperor Jingwen’s furrowed brows and puzzled and suspicious look, as if saying “How dare you say you are better than me”, “In what way are you better than me”, and “This kid is talking nonsense again”.
Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows slightly and said with a smile: “My father is better than your father.”
With a “whoosh”, it was a critical hit.
Emperor Jingwen: “…………”
“…You bastard, stop talking nonsense!”
At the same time, the time for the morning court session was approaching, and the prince walked towards this side from another direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Jealousy
chapters.content:
“You bastard, who allowed you to talk nonsense about the late emperor?” This is simply treason!
After hearing this, Ye Shuo silently rolled his eyes in his heart.
That’s it? Come on, although he had never seen the former emperor, he occasionally heard a few words about him. From the rumors, he knew that although he was not a complete tyrant, he was not much better. He was not good at governing the country and was also lustful. It was only because his father couldn’t save face and didn’t allow people to discuss it publicly, otherwise who knows what the historians would write.
But protection is one thing, and whether it is because of affection for the late emperor or because of one’s own face is two completely different matters.
Just based on the fact that when my stepfather was the crown prince, the late emperor almost deposed him several times and made the son of his favorite beautiful concubine the crown prince, Ye Shuo didn’t believe that his stepfather could have much affection for the late emperor.
The late emperor was really too absurd. His grandfather, the Duke of Zhen, was also raised by the late emperor.
When the previous emperor was in power, he was lazy about state affairs and never exercised control. Plus, his grandfather probably didn’t have a brain and took whatever was given to him. He relied on his military merits to rise to the position of Duke of Zhen. In the end, he had no more titles to offer, but he didn’t have much intention of rebelling, so things became what they are today.
Because my grandfather had deep roots in the military, especially when my stepfather ascended the throne, his power reached its peak. More than 70% of the military officers were from my grandfather’s line. It had reached the point where my stepfather would take action against him regardless of whether he was truly loyal or not.
But the mess that the late emperor left for my cheap father was more than just this. There were so many other things. It would be a miracle if my cheap father could still have no grudges under such circumstances.
But even though he knew it in his heart, Ye Shuo couldn’t say that in public. After all, no matter what, he still had to call him grandfather.“This son spoke out of turn, please don’t blame me.” Anyway, he had already said it, and his stepfather must have felt happy about it, so Ye Shuo decided to stop while he was ahead.
Sure enough, his apology was so perfunctory and Emperor Jingwen didn’t say anything, Ye Shuo knew that he guessed right.
Wow, my cheap dad is really awesome and good at pretending.
“Well, this won’t happen again.”
After clearing his throat and giving a mild reprimand, Emperor Jingwen continued, “Calling us ‘father’ or ‘dad’ is against the rules and is disrespectful. You should always remember to call me father*.”
(*as in respect like – imperial or royal father)
Ye Shuo: “…”
Oh, you feel it’s against the rules now, what were you doing before?
He has been shouting for so long, and now he says no.
It seems that my cheap dad is enjoying his life deep down. It’s just that he has been the emperor for so long that he is no longer honest, and his life is really awkward.
Ye Shuo is best at dealing with parents who say one thing and mean another.
Ye Shuo thought about it, then leaned close to his cheap father’s ear and whispered, “Then I will only call when no one is around, and I guarantee that no one will notice me, is that okay?”
Emperor Jingwen said nothing.
Ye Shuo understood immediately.
Alas–
He silently rolled his eyes in his heart, feeling extremely disgusted. On the surface, Ye Shuo lowered his voice again, and kept shouting, “Dad, Dad, Dad.”
“Daddy, daddy, daddy, daddy…”
In a short while, Emperor Jingwen’s ears were numb from the shouting, and he was almost numb too.
Wang Ziquan always felt that the reason he was able to climb to this position, in addition to being lucky and being assigned to the side of Emperor Jingwen, who was still the crown prince at the beginning, was another particularly important reason: he was very good at reading people’s faces and knew when to say what.
But today he felt that he had lost, lost to the Ninth Prince who was only seven years old.
Sure enough, true feelings are the most touching.
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo’s acting was too natural, or perhaps it was because he didn’t expect a child of such age to be so cunning, and even Wang Ziquan was fooled.
Wang Ziquan looked at the Ninth Prince with new eyes. No matter how lawless or absurd he was, it was his ability that made the emperor keep him in mind all the time.
As for Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi standing by, they were also stunned, especially Xing Yucheng. He was also a son, but he discovered today that there were differences between sons.
For example, if in today’s situation it was his father, and he didn’t study but slept in bed, he would probably kneel down when his father came in.
Look at the Ninth Prince, he acted as if nothing had happened in the face of the furious Emperor.
That’s His Majesty!
Because of his relationship with the Minister of Works, Xing Yucheng had heard a lot about what happened in the court, so he naturally had some understanding and roughly knew what Emperor Jingwen was like on a daily basis.
Xing Yucheng was frightened when he heard about the harsh methods he used to deal with corrupt officials. When he first saw him today, he almost couldn’t stand up.
So how did the Ninth Prince stay so calm?
In just a short time, not only did the emperor calm down, but he also agreed to his ridiculous request to carry him to school every day.
Xing Yucheng, who had been a good boy for so many years, was shocked, and subconsciously remembered the Ninth Prince’s behavior in his heart. Maybe next time, if he encounters such a thing, he can also…
“You are so smooth-talking. I will be angry if you continue like this.” Emperor Jingwen could no longer hold on under the continuous attacks.
Ye Shuo was still there, saying, “But it’s only natural for a son to call his father ‘dad’. How can you be so stingy, dad?”
How come he is so stingy?
Emperor Jingwen was almost laughing out of anger. Who was the one who was lazy and didn’t go to school every day? Why didn’t he reflect on himself?
The prince would pass by Qiuwu Palace when he went to court every day. When he first heard the sound in the corridor, he didn’t pay much attention to it until he turned a corner and saw a dark figure.
“Greetings to the Emperor, may the Emperor be well.” No, it’s almost time for the court session, why is the Emperor here? And why does his expression look so complicated? Half distressed, half helpless, and half happy.
When Emperor Jingwen saw the crown prince, he subconsciously put away the smile on his face and returned to his usual serious and solemn look.
“Well, get up.”
The prince stood up and stood still after hearing this, and Ye Shuo followed his action and popped his head out from behind.
Because it was still dark and visibility was not very good, the Crown Prince did not notice the arm around Emperor Jingwen’s neck at first. When he suddenly saw his ninth brother’s face, he was startled.
“This, this, this…” What on earth happened? ? ?
Ye Shuo chuckled and said, “Hello, Third Brother.”
The prince’s thoughts became increasingly confused.
The Crown Prince saw this scene, and for some reason, Emperor Jingwen felt a little embarrassed. In addition, time was running out, so he said, “You go to Xuan Zheng Hall and wait. I will go there after I send your ninth brother to the upper study.”
“Goodbye, Third Brother. See you later.” Ye Shuo wanted to wave to the prince, but his adoptive father held him down without any explanation.
“Don’t move, or I’ll throw you down.”
Looking at the backs of the two people, the prince couldn’t come back to his senses for a long time.
From what Emperor Jingwen said just now, the Crown Prince already knew what the two were going to do. He didn’t expect that his father would actually send ninth brother to school personally and carry him on his back.
For a moment, the prince felt mixed emotions, that feeling was so terrible that he can’t even describe it.
Because of his mother’s relationship, he was born as the legitimate son and was taught to be cautious and polite. Although his father loved him very much, he also had high hopes for him, so the two of them were rarely truly close.
It is unprecedented for the Ninth Prince to lie on his father’s back and act like a spoiled child like this.
The crown prince is already in his twenties, and his second child is about to be born. He has been unable to recover for a long time, not to mention his younger brothers in the study.
The prince suddenly didn’t dare to think about what consequences would be caused by his father and Xiao jiu appearing in the upper study.
(Jiu = 9)
I hope the royal brothers can control themselves by then…
the other side.
The Fifth Prince was in a very bad mood. He was filled with remorse when he thought about how he would actually say such words to his mother.
Obviously, his mother was also very worried about his condition. She was so restless last night that she didn’t fall asleep until late at night. She even got up before dawn this morning. She even asked the kitchen to make ginger soup to drive away the cold. She had done a great job. How could he…
It’s all the Ninth Prince’s fault, it’s all Ye Shuo’s fault!
If he hadn’t provoked me every day, would I have been able to blurt out such a sentence? !
But thinking about it carefully, even after he said that, his mother still insisted on letting him come to the study, and told him not to compare himself with people like the Ninth Prince, and to work harder so that he could stand out in the future. The Fifth Prince felt complicated again.
Although the Ninth Prince is indeed absurd, it is also true that Concubine Rong dotes on him unconditionally…
Because of a few arguments with Concubine Shu, the Fifth Prince arrived a little late today. After hurrying and hurrying, he finally arrived at the upper study before the hour of Mao.
When he sat down with his study companion, it was exactly time.
Looking at the last table, there was indeed no one there.
Looks like he won’t be able to escape those 136 hand boards today!
Thinking of this, the Fifth Prince suddenly felt relaxed all over. The symptoms of nasal congestion and dizziness were alleviated a lot. He couldn’t even concentrate on reading. He just waited for Ye Shuo to come and watch him get beaten.
136 hand slaps, just take your time!
As for Lord Cen, who was supervising the princes’ morning reading, he couldn’t help but sigh.
Oh, after about a hundred slaps on the hand, I’m afraid I won’t be able to lift my arms after that.
Not long after, Emperor Jingwen and Ye Shuo appeared at the door of the upper study.
Qiuwu Palace is located neither far nor near to Shangshufang. In any case, it is definitely closer than the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince, but it is still quite difficult for Emperor Jingwen.
Although he exercised on weekdays, he was not an expert in it after all. Besides, the seven-year-old Ye Shuo was as strong as a calf, and he would inevitably feel tired after carrying it for a long time.
When he arrived at the door of the study, Emperor Jingwen was already slightly out of breath.
It’s a good thing that his son is in good health, but the scoring situation, for example, Emperor Jingwen is not very happy now.
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously wanted to let him go, but Ye Shuo refused to let him go. Emperor Jingwen immediately became furious, thinking that this little bastard was going to break the agreement again, so he opened his mouth and was ready to curse.
Before he could finish his curse, he heard his son say anxiously, “Hurry up, Dad, help me.”
Emperor Jingwen was stunned for a moment: “What help?”
“Just come closer and you’ll know. It’s just a small favor. It won’t take you too long.”
Emperor Jingwen narrowed his eyes: “…Are you sure you are not lying to me this time?”
“a man of his words.”
Since he said so, then… okay.
Anyway, they had walked such a long distance, so this little bit didn’t matter. So Emperor Jingwen walked closer to a distance of about ten feet.
When he got close to the window, Ye Shuo, without thinking, made a trumpet shape with his hands and shouted towards the window, almost deafening the ears of Emperor Jingwen who was so close.
It can be seen that the child is in good health.
“Fifth Brother, are you there?”
“Come and see!”
When the Fifth Prince heard the noise, he looked over subconsciously.
Looking at Ye Shuo, who was sitting on his father’s back with a malicious look on his face, the Fifth Prince lost control and tore the page of the book, which was already missing a corner.
Emperor Jingwen finally understood what his son meant by “a small favor”.
Looking at his son who was causing trouble everywhere, Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt a headache, a very painful one…

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Fainting
chapters.content:
Why would the emperor suddenly appear here at this time?
Shocked by the scene before them, everyone stood up after they realized what was happening.
“Your Majesty, long live the emperor.”
Then came the princes.
“Your Majesty, I pay my respects to you, Father. May your Majesty be well and at peace.”
While everyone was kneeling, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but whisper, “Dad, the morning court is about to start. Are you sure you don’t want to leave?”
This immediately dispelled Emperor Jingwen’s intention to scold him.
If he really teaches his son a lesson, he doesn’t know how long it will take, and the ministers are still waiting.
This little bastard is really good at timing, it feels like he did it on purpose!
“…Wait! I will come back to deal with you later!”Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath, asked everyone to stand up, praised them briefly, told them to keep up the good work, and soon left with Wang Ziquan.
Ye Shuo patted the non-existent wrinkles on his body and swaggered into the study room under the watchful eyes of everyone.
Since Emperor Jingwen personally carried him to school, he was naturally exempted from the more than one hundred beatings.
Lord Cen and the others watched Ye Shuo almost the entire way he walked.
Lord Cen was completely shocked. What kind of rules are these? ?
The Sixth Prince guessed the truth very quickly. Could it be that his father had finally lost his temper because of Shuo’er?
As a permanent resident of Qiuwu Palace, the Sixth Prince often saw Ye Shuo’s annoying nature. Every day, the Royal Concubine was fooled by his mouth and expression, and she kept backing down and had no bottom line at all. Could Shuo’er… use this trick on his father?
The most unbelievable thing is that my father actually bought into this…
The Sixth Prince took a look at the textbook in front of him, and his heart was in turmoil.
Obviously, the Fifth Prince was not the only one who was shocked by the scene just now.
If the Sixth Prince was like this, let alone the young Seventh and Eighth Princes, especially the Eighth Prince, who was too young to hide things, and looked at Ye Shuo with jealousy and envy in his eyes.
The little prince was completely stunned, and then his eyes couldn’t help but burst into deep admiration.
The Ninth Uncle was really amazing, as he could get the usually serious Emperor to carry him to school on his back. No, after the class is over, he must learn something from the Ninth Uncle!
He also wanted his father to carry him to school…
Ye Shuo seemed not to realize how hateful his action just now was. After all, in modern times, it was quite normal for parents to pick up and drop off their children from school. What was the big deal?
Although my stepfather is the emperor, who made me his son?
Ye Shuo acted so calm, as if the scene just now was just a commonplace. This was even more exciting than having Emperor Jingwen himself carry him to school.
Itchy. My hands started to itch.
The veins on the Sixth Prince’s forehead bulged and jumped several times. He kept breathing in and out. It took him a long time to suppress the urge to beat him up when the prince came over.
Completely unaware that he had inadvertently escaped a disaster, Ye Shuo passed by the fifth prince’s seat and saw the torn page of paper, and immediately understood something.
Hehe, I knew he couldn’t help it.
‘you lose.’
Seeing the other party making such a mouth shape towards him clearly, the Fifth Prince’s head suddenly exploded with a buzz.
He never knew that a seven-year-old child could be so irritating.
“You, you——” The Fifth Prince’s fingers were trembling, and he could feel his heart beating non-stop. His breathing gradually became rapid, and then his eyes suddenly went dark, and he fell backwards uncontrollably.
Ye Shuo was stunned: “Huh???”
Huh???
What happened?
The Fifth Prince wouldn’t just… faint from anger at himself, right? ?
In the last moment when Ye Shuo lost consciousness, the Fifth Prince, who had fainted from anger, finally said his last words:
“Ye Shuo, wait for me…”
Is this person a little too fragile?
Ye Shuo didn’t expect the Fifth Prince to be so frivolous, and he was also frightened.
Or maybe he had a heart attack or cerebral hemorrhage or something, and I just happened to be unlucky and ran into it.
It’s over, it’s over, this time I’m really in trouble.
Ye Shuo had driven countless times in his life, but this was the first time he overturned his car. Fortunately, he noticed the abnormal complexion of the Fifth Prince from behind, and reached out to check it. It was a little hot, so he realized that the Fifth Prince was sick today, and because he was so angry with him, he probably couldn’t breathe and then fainted.
Oh, young people nowadays are so hot-tempered.
If you had told me earlier that you were sick, I wouldn’t have come to bother him today.
Ye Shuo felt a rare sense of guilt, so he quickly asked someone to send him back to Concubine Shu’s palace: “What are you still standing there for? Why don’t you go get the imperial physician!”
Although Ye Shuo is young, he is very organized when giving orders to people.
After a while, he arranged the people and borrowed a sedan chair from the nearby queen. He sent the Fifth Prince back to Concubine Shu’s palace as quickly as possible, and asked Xiao Luzi to invite the imperial physician. He estimated that when the Fifth Prince arrived, the imperial physician would also arrive.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to be obedient and study hard, but this is a special case. I believe his stepfather can understand.
Ye Shuo believed that this incident was caused by him, so he should naturally take the responsibility, so he supervised the whole process and had no intention of escaping.
Looking at the unconscious Fifth Prince in the sedan chair, the Seventh Prince, who was in the same camp as the Fifth Prince, should have helped to denounce the Ninth Prince, but instead of doing so, he felt secretly relieved in his heart.
Oh, you’ve hit a wall. It should have been like this a long time ago. Someone should have dealt with him a long time ago!
The curtain was quickly pulled down, and the Seventh Prince turned his head again, his expression instantly changing to one of indignation and worry.
“Your Highness, how about… let’s get out of the way.” Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but remind him of this while jogging after the sedan chair and sweating profusely.
When he arrived at Concubine Shu’s palace, she saw what her son had become. After asking around, she realized that it would be strange if the Ninth Prince had a good life.
Xing Yucheng originally thought that the Ninth Prince had forgotten about this matter in a hurry, but after he finished speaking, he just said “um”, saying that he knew, and then there was no further news.
In Ye Shuo’s opinion, he had to listen to what the imperial physician said and make sure there was no major problem before leaving.
Xing Yucheng frowned and wanted to persuade him again, but he saw Ye Shuo pointing to the palace gate not far away: “Keep your voice down, Qingyi Palace is coming soon.”
Concubine Shu had already received the news in advance and was now standing at the palace gate, looking around anxiously.
Xing Yucheng shut his mouth instantly.
“Greetings to Her Majesty the Concubine Shu. Good luck to Her Majesty the Concubine Shu.” Perhaps because she was too flustered to hear, or because she was deliberately ignoring him, Ye Shuo’s gesture of bowing and paying respects was simply ignored.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo was not embarrassed. He waited for a while and then stood up by himself.
Concubine Shu subconsciously stepped forward to lift the curtain of the sedan chair. When she saw the Fifth Prince with his eyes closed and teeth clenched inside, her face suddenly turned pale.
After realizing what was happening, Concubine Shu hurriedly called out to the maids and eunuchs beside her: “Quick, help the Fifth Prince to the side hall!”
The palace servants received the order and started to act in a panic.
During the whole process, no one paid any attention to Ye Shuo who was standing next to him. Even Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but feel embarrassed for the Ninth Prince.
Well, the imperial physician hasn’t arrived yet, and hasn’t even examined the Fifth Prince’s pulse. How can Concubine Shu unilaterally determine that it was really because of the Ninth Prince that the Fifth Prince fainted from anger?
It’s not easy for a good person to be upset so easily.
“Your Highness…”
Xing Yucheng had just made a sound and started to speak when he saw Ye Shuo next to him shaking his head slightly at him, signaling him to be quiet.
Xing Yucheng had no choice but to do as he was told.
Ye Shuo also tried to reduce his presence and followed behind the crowd, trying not to get in the way of Concubine Shu’s eyes.
After a period of chaos, the Fifth Prince was placed steadily on the bed in his room. Concubine Shu suddenly realized what was happening and was about to ask someone to call the imperial physician when she saw the imperial physician hurriedly walking in with a medicine box.
“Don’t panic, Madam. Let me check the Fifth Prince’s pulse first.”
This imperial physician was not the one she was used to, but was invited by someone close to Ye Shuo. Naturally, he was the one who had closer relations with the Qiuwu Palace. When the pulse was first taken, Concubine Shu did not say anything. But when she saw that the other party spread out the acupuncture bag and was about to give acupuncture, Concubine Shu had to speak up and said, “Imperial Physician Xu will be here soon. Let’s talk after he arrives.” Her defensive attitude was obvious.
The old doctor was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously looked at the Ninth Prince behind him.
When the Ninth Prince asked the eunuchs around him to invite him, he specifically instructed him to take away the medicinal materials that the imperial concubine had previously stored in the Imperial Hospital.
Although they are all symptomatic medicines, the ones that are older are relatively more effective.
But seeing that the Ninth Prince shook his head slightly at him, the old doctor said nothing and left with the medicine box.
Originally, before leaving, he wanted to tell Concubine Shu about his diagnosis, that the Fifth Prince was not seriously ill, in order to comfort Concubine Shu, but after thinking about it, he thought that she might not believe him, so he gave up.
Concubine Shu quickly sent for Doctor Xu. While they were waiting, perhaps because she felt Ye Shuo was an eyesore or because the sight of the Fifth Prince lying there was too painful, Concubine Shu suddenly spoke, “Ninth Prince, there are too many people in Qingyi Palace right now. It would be bad if you were hurt. I’m sorry that I can’t entertain you for the time being. Please go back, Ninth Prince.”
Upon hearing this, Xing Yucheng subconsciously looked at the Ninth Prince.
Ye Shuo didn’t think there was anything wrong with Concubine Shu’s attitude, it was very normal.
“My Lady Shufei, I want to wait for my fifth brother to wake up and make sure he is okay before leaving.”
This was a perfectly normal sentence, but it sounded so harsh to Concubine Shu’s ears. She tightened her grip on the handkerchief and her expression became even colder. She suppressed her disgust and said stiffly, “No need.”
Unable to hold back, Concubine Shu said sarcastically, “Hong’er cannot bear such ‘kindness’ from you, the Ninth Prince.”
Concubine Shu deliberately emphasized the last two words.
This has happened so many times that Xing Yucheng thought that given the Ninth Prince’s temperament, he would definitely turn the Qingyi Palace upside down.
After all, this is a fierce man who even dares to touch the emperor when he is angry. The Ninth Prince is so lawless, acts arrogantly and has no scruples. How can he tolerate Concubine Shu?
Just when Xing Yucheng thought that a conflict was inevitable, he saw Ye Shuo slowly step forward, and then… bowed to Concubine Shu in a proper manner: “My Lady Concubine Shu, I’m sorry, this is indeed my fault.”
Xing Yucheng’s eyes almost popped out.
This, this, this… is this really the Ninth Prince? ?
Staring blankly at the scene in front of him, Xing Yucheng suddenly felt that the Ninth Prince was not completely without merit.

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Learning
chapters.content:
Concubine Shu also thought that with the Ninth Prince’s character, he would definitely not tolerate it, and she had already prepared herself for this in her heart.
Even if he was the Imperial Concubine’s son, so what? Even if the Imperial Concubine was there, she was in the right anyway, so Shu Fei was not afraid. She just didn’t expect that the Ninth Prince would have such a good attitude this time.
Concubine Shu was stunned for a moment, and suddenly didn’t know what to say.
Doctor Xu arrived soon and also took the pulse first. After a while, under the anxious gaze of Concubine Shu, Doctor Xu said, “Your Majesty, the Fifth Prince is fine. He just didn’t get enough rest recently and caught a cold. He fainted in a hurry.”
The key is still cold, sleep, and fatigue.
“Although the Fifth Prince is still young, in my humble opinion, Your Majesty should not push the Fifth Prince too hard recently. The Fifth Prince needs to take a good rest recently. It is better to put the study aside for the time being.”
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but interrupt: “Isn’t it because he is angry that he’s like this?”
Doctor Xu subconsciously glanced at Concubine Shu, and then thought of the old doctor who had just returned and had also examined his pulse. He knew that this matter could not be lied to, so he said, “Your Highness, there is a relationship, but… not much.”
Ye Shuo finally felt relieved.
Fortunately, the Fifth Prince did not fall ill from anger, otherwise it would have been a lot of trouble.Concubine Shu seemed very embarrassed when she heard this, but she couldn’t just throw dirty water on Ye Shuo and slander him for the sake of her face, so there was really no way to deal with this matter.
After she heard the servants’ description of what happened in the study, she subconsciously formed a preconceived notion.
Concubine Shu thought that Ye Shuo would fight back after hearing this answer, but he heaved a sigh of relief after hearing it, then he bowed to her and said, “In that case, Concubine Shu, I will take my leave first.”
Huh? ? You didn’t hold on to it? ?
Not only was Concubine Shu surprised, even Xing Yucheng was shocked.
After leaving Qingyi Palace, Xing Yucheng couldn’t hold it in any longer and asked.
Ye Shuo was speechless after hearing this: “Do you think that your Highness is so vindictive and aggressive?” He admitted that although he was a little playful and mischievous, he was not so petty, right?
It’s normal for Concubine Shu to be cold to him because she cares about his. Ye Shuo wouldn’t be so intolerant of even this, right?
As for the fifth prince, he was sick, so you can’t blame him for fainting at the wrong time.
The Fifth Prince was so miserable, he insisted on studying even when he was sick, which made Ye Shuo naturally feel a little sympathy for him, and he didn’t bother to care about it.
As for the time when the fifth prince threw stones at him when he was a child, his mother punished him in the end, and the fact that Concubine Shu knelt on the cobblestone path for so long should have offset that.
After all, as long as it doesn’t involve Ye Shuo’s bottom line, everything can be discussed.
After listening to this, Xing Yucheng seemed to realize for the first time that the Ninth Prince was not actually a harsh person.
Especially when he was punished by slapping the hand for skipping classes, he never asked himself and Xiaoluzi to take the punishment.
But! What about that silver?
Just when Xing Yucheng was in great confusion, seeing that it was still early, Ye Shuo returned to the study.
The moment he saw him, Lord Cen was stunned.
I thought he was going to take this opportunity to skip school again…
People who usually find excuses to run away even without any excuses, now have a legitimate excuse and come back obediently. Lord Cen doesn’t understand.
“I can’t help it. I promised my father.” You have to keep your promise, right? Ye Shuo explained helplessly.
Lord Cen suddenly had the same feeling as Xing Yucheng.
It seems that the Ninth Prince is not beyond redemption, especially just now. Most adults would find it difficult to control themselves from shirking the responsibility, let alone a child of a few years old. However, the Ninth Prince did not seem to try to escape from the beginning to the end, and even arranged everything in an orderly manner. This shocked Lord Cen.
This is just like how a bad guy will be remembered as long as he does one good thing. Considering his previous bad deeds, Ye Shuo’s few good deeds seem so precious.
Lord Cen’s expression eased a little. After discovering that Ye Shuo was not a bad person, he was no longer as harsh to Ye Shuo as before.
Ye Shuo touched his chin. He never thought things would turn out like this.
So much so that even when Ye Shuo fell asleep on the table, Lord Cen was not as angry as before.
What happened in Qingyi Palace soon reached the ears of other concubines. The concubines thought that the one in Qingyi Palace would definitely face off against the one in Qiuwu Palace. Also, the Fifth Prince was so angry that he fainted because of the Ninth Prince’s closeness to the Emperor. He was too angry.
As time went by, the concubines discovered that it was not the case. It was Concubine Shu who pushed her son too hard and made him sick. He fainted in the study room when he went to school, and the Ninth Prince was unlucky enough to run into him.
Isn’t this a clear case of fraud?
“She is too impatient. Even if she is anxious, she shouldn’t do it this way.” Even Concubine Xian, who always had a good relationship with Concubine Shu, couldn’t help but say this.
Now the matter has become a big deal. Everyone knows that Concubine Shu treated the Fifth Prince extremely harshly. It was really not worth it.
On the other hand, Emperor Jingwen also heard about this matter after finishing his government affairs and could not help but frowning.
Although Emperor Jingwen hoped that his son would have a bright future, he also wanted to ensure that his health would not be affected. Concubine Shu was really going too far.
“Pass the decree down. Concubine Shu failed to take good care of the prince. She will be punished with a month’s service as a warning to others.”
Wang Ziquan on the side quickly responded “yes”.
Emperor Jingwen then continued to ask: “Where is the ninth prince? Is Xiao jiu okay?” Given his temper, he might even demolish the Qingyi Palace.
Emperor Jingwen was ready.
Result……
“Your Majesty, no. The Ninth Prince left after he learned that the Fifth Prince was fine.”
The young eunuch’s words made Emperor Jingwen feel surprised: “What happened after that? He definitely didn’t go back to the upper study, right?”
In the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, the reason why his son was so obedient must be profitable, and he was ready to see his morning work go to waste.
However, it is still not.
After that little bastard came back from Qingyi Palace, he went back to the study.
After all, he is only a seven-year-old child. Maybe he was sad. He was frightened first and then wrongly accused. It was indeed a bit difficult for him to bear.
After thinking about it, Emperor Jingwen decided to wait until the afternoon when he finished school in the study to comfort him.
It’s been a long time since he’s been so obedient.
As for sleeping in class, those are just small matters.
After school at 3 p.m., Ye Shuo was stunned when he saw his stepfather outside the study.
After he realized it, he couldn’t help but feel a little numb.
So, what kind of image do I have in the eyes of these people? !
On the way, Ye Shuo had to explain again that the reason he did not cause a commotion in Qingyi Palace was because the Fifth Prince was still ill and things had not yet reached that point, and that he came back later to fulfill his promise.
Then Ye Shuo successfully discovered that after the explanation, his cheap father’s expression became even stranger.
“…………”
hiss–
Was he too successful in his previous performance? To the point where even a little bit of positive development astonished his cheap father and the others.
I just feel that I was wrong and I just admit my mistake. Is it that exaggerated?
Emperor Jingwen reached out and touched his son’s head and said, “It’s a pity that you have no estrangement with your fifth brother.” At this time, Emperor Jingwen finally remembered that the fifth prince had thrown stones at this little thing when he was just one month old.
“Dad, you said it yourself. He is my fifth brother, and also my elder brother. He is not an enemy. Brothers shouldn’t care about such a small matter, right?”
Ye Shuo swore that he had just said this casually, and he really thought so.
Although we are half-brothers, if I need money in the future, I can ask the Fifth Prince to borrow it. The Fifth Prince can’t just refuse to give me money, right?
Having one more brother means one more way out, one more way to fleece the sheep… no, one more umbrella of protection, what a good thing.
After he finished speaking, Emperor Jingwen’s expression changed slightly.
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment after seeing this, and quickly wrote down the word “brother” in his little notebook. It seemed that this was also the key word that triggered a certain point in his cheap father’s mind.
“Yes, you are right. I also hope that you brothers can always be united and friendly.”
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said, “Okay, we have arrived at Qiuwu Palace. Wang Ziquan, give the order. I will have dinner here today.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Please, he really has no intention of winning favor for his mother!
Perhaps it was the fact that Ye Shuo fulfilled his promise that made Emperor Jingwen see the effectiveness of his education, and made Emperor Jingwen mistakenly believe that this trick might really be useful, so he prepared to make further efforts.
Considering that he would have to carry him to school tomorrow anyway, and then go from the upper study to the Xuan zheng Hall to attend court, Emperor Jingwen was too lazy to go back and forth, and simply stayed in the Qiuwu Palace tonight.
Emperor Jingwen’s action made the concubines in the harem also start to worry.
His Majesty didn’t like so many obedient princes and didn’t even look at them. But the Ninth Prince’s behavior and the way he made people restless made His Majesty concerned.
Suddenly, a bold idea came to everyone’s mind –
Maybe His Majesty likes noisy and bold children?
It’s not that there weren’t princes born in the palace after Ye Shuo, it’s just that they were too young and haven’t been ranked yet.
These princes are younger and more naive than the Ninth Prince, and are more likely to attract the Emperor’s favor.
Since the Ninth Prince can do it, why can’t their children do it?
The imperial concubine was already very favored, and the Ninth Prince was used to acting like a spoiled brat, so Emperor Jingwen, who seldom walked around the harem, basically had to go to Qiuwu Palace every time he came.
At first, the little prince was fine when he was just born and within two years after his birth. In recent years, he has been basically like this.
The imperial concubine really uses good tactics.
I just wonder, after their children learn this trick, will the imperial concubine still be as proud as she is today?

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Crazy
chapters.content:
You know, if you count all the things the Ninth Prince has done, one by one, which one of them cannot be convicted of the crime of disrespect?
But His Majesty is able to tolerate it every time. Doesn’t this mean that the seemingly serious His Majesty actually has a high tolerance for children?
In that case, that would be great.
There was a high probability that they would not be able to do what the Ninth Prince was like, but it would be no problem if they made a discount.
It can not only reduce risks, but also win the emperor’s favor, killing two birds with one stone.
Among them, Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi are the most prominent. One of their children is three and a half years old this year, and the other is three years old this year. After Ye Shuo, only these two princes were born in the palace in the seven years.
From the perspective of an emperor, Emperor Jingwen was quite restrained. Perhaps he had learned the lesson of his predecessor, and he did not seem to care much about women. However, there were still more than a dozen people in his harem, so occasionally a prince or princess would be born.
Perhaps having too many sons was not a big deal. Even if they gave birth to a prince, the status of Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi would not rise much. Therefore, they were anxious and resorted to this bad idea.
Of course, in just one night, Ye Shuo would definitely not know the undercurrents in the concubines’ palaces. After all, when the concubines were making plans overnight to “teach” their sons, Ye Shuo was still sleeping soundly.
The Sixth Prince believed that he was not so lucky and could not please his father like the Ninth Prince, so he could only continue to use the previous method and study hard.When Emperor Jingwen got up, the Sixth Prince had been gone for a long time.
When Emperor Jingwen heard this, he looked at the sky again and couldn’t help but praise him: “Not bad, he is a good child.”
But now, the most important thing is to get that little bastard out of bed.
Emperor Jingwen had never seen a child stay in bed. When his biological mother passed away, the crown prince was already ten years old. The prince was taught very well by his biological mother and would wake up on his own without his mother urging him. This was so worry-free that Emperor Jingwen thought that all children in the world were like this.
This was the first time that Emperor Jingwen saw a child lying in bed.
The little bastard in front of me just agreed with him verbally, but as soon as I turned my head, he turned over and fell asleep again.
“Wait a moment… wait a moment… I swear, this is the last time…”
Bullshit, this is the third and last time.
After this happened several times, Emperor Jingwen realized that he had been deceived and his face began to turn pale.
Taking a deep breath, Emperor Jingwen reached out and pulled back the quilt in front of him: “I command you to get up now, immediately, right now!”
He was the emperor himself, and he was personally called to get up, yet he dared to be so negligent. It was simply disrespectful!
However, in Ye Shuo’s opinion, staying in bed is the most normal thing. When he was in primary school in his previous life, his father often urged him to do so. If his father could do it in his previous life, why can’t his cheap dad do it in this life?
So Emperor Jingwen watched helplessly as the child in front of him squirmed like a caterpillar after losing his quilt, then curled up into a ball and stopped moving.
Seeing his son shivering from the cold and unwilling to open his eyes, Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he almost laughed.
“You, go and help your master change his clothes.” Emperor Jingwen pointed to the servant next to him.
Xiao Luzi hurried forward.
Result…
Perhaps he was too sleepy, Ye Shuo couldn’t tell what was in front of him at all, and he instinctively put whatever Xiao Luzi took on his head.
When Ye Shuo dove into his pants, Emperor Jingwen could no longer hold it in and the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
“…Forget it, Wang Ziquan, go help him.”
After hearing this, Eunuch Wang was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously responded with a “yes”.
It must be said that Wang Ziquan is worthy of being someone close to the emperor. He is so nimble and efficient, and he is far superior to newcomers like Xiao Luzi.
But Ye Shuo had to be woken up by the torture.
“Eunuch Wang…” Looking at the eunuch in front of him dimly, Ye Shuo’s facial features were wrinkled and distorted.
This made it easy for Wang Ziquan to understand his pain.
Wang Ziquan couldn’t help laughing, “Ninth Prince, the Emperor has ordered me to do this, I dare not disobey, please bear with me.”
Ye Shuo’s eyes became more resentful.
After finally changing his clothes and washing up, Ye Shuo slowly climbed onto his cheap father’s back like a snail.
“Dad, you are so cold and heartless…”
When Emperor Jingwen heard this at first, he couldn’t help but get angry.
Even in this state, you dare say I am still cold and heartless? ?
Why doesn’t he think about whether he is being unreasonable!
As a result, when I turned around, I found that my son’s eyes had closed again without knowing when, and he was talking nonsense at this time.
Perhaps because he was annoyed by his nagging, Emperor Jingwen changed from being extremely angry at the beginning to saying “Yes, yes, yes, deal with it.”
About an incense stick later, when Emperor Jingwen arrived at the upper study, Ye Shuo was still sleeping soundly on his back.
After hesitating for a while, Emperor Jingwen finally called him up.
Looking at the child’s staggering figure and the occasional shouts from his companion and attendants, Emperor Jingwen was stunned for a moment and could not help laughing.
I always feel that this scene looks quite fresh.
However, Emperor Jingwen soon could not laugh anymore. As time passed and the wind blew, he felt a coolness on his neck. He reached out and touched it, and it was wet.
Emperor Jingwen was stunned.
The little bastard drooled on his clothes while he was sleeping!
Emperor Jingwen was trembling all over.
Wang Ziquan knew how much the emperor loved cleanliness, and he took a deep breath and asked hurriedly, “I will have someone prepare a new dragon robe for you right away…”
“…No need.” It was almost time for the morning court session, there was no way he would make it in time.
Emperor Jingwen touched the back of his neck and rushed towards the Xuan zheng Hall in a rage.
Arriving at the upper study room, not long after he sat down, Ye Shuo knew the latest developments in the harem, and also knew the plans of those ladies.
This was reminded by the Seventh Prince. It was called a reminder, but in fact it was a small note that flew over from the front, with this written on it.
Although the Seventh Prince was already quite cautious, not only did he use his left hand, he also specially used the ink and paper distributed by the upper study, but!
He didn’t think that he could hide the fact that he dropped the note, didn’t he?
Ye Shuo was really just in a daze, not blind.
Ye Shuo vaguely understood why he was so cautious, so he didn’t plan to expose him.
After unfolding the note and reading its contents clearly, Ye Shuo’s phoenix eyes immediately widened.
Wow, there really are brave women who dare to learn his tricks!
The reason why Ye Shuo dared to do that was mainly because he was an adult at heart and was able to gauge what could be done and what could not be done. These were things that one had to go through life in society to understand, as well as the rich experience of struggling with his father for nearly thirty years in his previous life. There were very few children born with such high emotional intelligence. If a real child was allowed to do this, wouldn’t it simply teach the child bad things?
Hiss, I dare not imagine that scene.
In the dim light of the moment, the Seventh Prince saw the Ninth Prince destroying the note and then began to rest his chin on his hand, lost in thought, as if nothing had happened. The Seventh Prince could not help but frown.
Why, isn’t he worried at all?
In the eyes of the Seventh Prince, the reason why his Ninth Brother was so favored was because he was special. If other little brothers became like this, wouldn’t he not be special?
Isn’t he… worried at all?
If Ye Shuo knew what he was thinking at this moment, he would definitely nod and worry. How could he not worry? He felt that his brothers might be in trouble…
the other side.
After the morning court session, Emperor Jingwen changed into clean clothes immediately.
Although the nape on the back of his neck had been dry for a long time, Emperor Jingwen still felt uncomfortable, so he simply went back to his bedroom and changed for a new one, and he felt much more comfortable immediately.
Afterward, Emperor Jingwen decided to take a stroll in the Imperial Garden.
Summer is about to begin, the spring floods are almost over, and there is nothing else to worry about, so Emperor Jingwen can relax for a few days.
