Also, the weather this year seems to be exceptionally hot. It can be felt before summer even starts. Maybe we have to go to the garden to escape the heat this year. There is a lot of water in the garden, and given Xiaojiu’s temper, Emperor Jingwen is afraid that something might happen to him. But if he doesn’t take him with him, he’s afraid that he might make a fuss.
Just when Emperor Jingwen was feeling a little confused, the sound of children playing could be heard faintly from not far away.
“What’s the situation over there?” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but ask.
“I will go and ask right away.”
Seeing this, Wang Ziquan took two steps forward and shouted, “Who is making a fuss here?”
Unexpectedly, the emperor came on the first day. Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi were delighted when they heard the news. They felt that this was destined and that God was helping them. So they said, “Your Highness, I pay my respects to you. May you be blessed with good health.”
Emperor Jingwen looked at the two children not far away, and it took him a long time to realize that these should be his tenth and eleventh sons.
Children over three years old should be the most innocent and adorable, but… looking at the two children not far away who were covered in dirt and looked like they had rolled in the mud, Emperor Jingwen’s eyelids twitched violently.
Seeing that His Majesty seemed to be interested, Wang Liangyuan couldn’t help but smile and said, “Your Majesty, the concubines saw that the weather was good today, so they thought of taking the little prince out to play.”
“The little princes don’t like anything else but this dirty mud. I have no choice but to obey them. They also said that they want to make a sculpture of you.”
The Ninth Prince loved playing in the mud when he was young. The little princes also loved playing in the mud. Is that a problem? No problem.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen looked over and saw the lumps of yellow mud stuck together on the ground. He didn’t dare to guess which one was himself.
When Xiaojiu was young, he played with mud in a very serious manner, as if he was doing something important. The clay figurine he gave to the imperial concubine also looked quite realistic, with all the facial features intact. Now look at these lumps of mud in front of you…
“…”
“Ahem… the little princes are in good health. I am very relieved.” Emperor Jingwen suppressed the discomfort in his heart, cleared his throat, and reluctantly said a few words of encouragement.
In addition, the chattering of children gave him a headache, and it was difficult for him to take a break. Emperor Jingwen just wanted to find a quiet place to walk and sit for a while.
Just at this moment, there was a “whoosh” sound. It turned out that two little kids were throwing mud at each other and accidentally threw it over here.
“Your Majesty, be careful!”
Emperor Jingwen took two steps back and waved to Wang Ziquan, signaling him not to be nervous about the child’s play. But at the same time, Emperor Jingwen became more determined to leave.
“You two princes have fun together. I’m leaving first.”
After the words fell, Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi were stunned.
How could this be? Shouldn’t Your Majesty stay and enjoy this hard-earned family happiness?
While Wang Liangyuan was in a daze, the little prince, who was half a year older, suddenly remembered what his mother had told him when he was in the palace. No matter what, he had to find a way to keep his father.
Thinking of this, the Tenth Prince took a step forward, pointed at Emperor Jingwen and said, “You, are not allowed to leave.”
“I want you to play with me!”
What was he saying just now?
Seeing the child’s index finger pointing at his nose, Emperor Jingwen was stunned and couldn’t react at all.
Wang Ziquan, who was standing by, couldn’t help but took a deep breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Comparison
chapters.content:
Are they crazy? Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi are absolutely crazy!
Wang Ziquan looked confused, and then he couldn’t help but yelled, “How dare you!”
Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi just ignored them. In their opinion, the emperor hadn’t said anything yet, so there was no room for a servant like them to make a comment.
See, this trick really works.
However, Emperor Jingwen was not so “moved” by the scene of loving father and filial son that he was speechless. He was clearly so angry that he was speechless! !
Emperor Jingwen lived a long life, and no matter how incompetent the previous emperor was, he never pointed at his nose and scolded him.
But now, he was pointed at in the nose by his own son.
In an instant, an endless storm brewed in Emperor Jingwen’s eyes.
When people are extremely angry, they tend to become unusually calm.
The child’s keen sense made the Tenth Prince flinch for a moment, but then, thinking of his mother’s instructions last night, the Tenth Prince quickly regained his arrogance: “Why are you watching me do this? Don’t you want to play with me?”Then the tenth prince puffed out his chest again: “If you play with me, I can consider calling ‘you’ father.”
Since when did it become something to consider for the prince to call himself father?
Emperor Jingwen smiled as he fiddled with the beads in his hand.
His Majesty smiled!
This scene had different meanings to the people present.
For example, what Wang Ziquan saw was the emperor’s wrath, while what Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi saw was excitement and joy. They both thought their plan worked.
Emperor Jingwen closed his eyes, then looked at the younger one: “What about you? Do you also want me to play with you before you call me father?”
Maybe it was because he was born timid, or maybe it was because his sixth sense was sharper, the younger one failed at the critical moment: “Father, Father…”
The younger one, with a big clown face, met his father’s eyes. He didn’t know why he suddenly became extremely scared and forgot everything his mother had told him.
Wu Liangdi immediately became anxious when she saw this. She had taught her son the whole night, but it was all in vain.
This is a useless thing!
Is it true that a half-year age difference is such a big difference? Or is it that my son is born stupid?
When she thought about how she was trembling with fear and walking on thin ice when she was pregnant with him, and how she finally gave birth to him, she thought she could have a happy mother and a son relation. But it turned out that the emperor did not have this son in his heart at all. In three whole years, the emperor came to see her and the child less than twice.
Another thing is that her son seems to be born with a very small courage, not generous at all, and is always hesitant in doing everything. The more Wu Liangdi expected before, the more disappointed she is now.
Thinking of the past and looking at her son again, Wu Liangdi couldn’t help but feel a hint of resentment in her eyes.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath.
Wang Liangyuan next to her was somewhat proud. Although it was something they had discussed together, the other person’s son was so disappointing that it made her own son seem smarter all of a sudden, which was not a bad thing.
Wang Liangyuan had already prepared to receive the reward, but the next moment, she heard the emperor’s chilling voice, which made Wang Liangyuan feel as if she had fallen into an ice cellar.
“Come here, demote Wang Liangyuan to the position of a dresser, drag her out, and banish her to the cold palace.”
As for the mother of my younger son…
Emperor Jingwen turned his head, his eyes becoming more and more stern: “Wu Liangdi, you harbor hatred towards the prince, and you are sentenced to death!”
Wu Liangdi hadn’t recovered from the aftermath of what had just happened yet, and when she heard the tragic news, she felt like she was struck by lightning.
After they realized what was happening, the two began to desperately beg for mercy: “Your Majesty, please spare my life, please spare my life, Your Majesty!”
However, how could the eunuchs and guards around allow them to get close? Just as the two of them were about to move, they were firmly controlled.
Not to mention the timid Eleventh Prince, even the usually brave Tenth Prince was now frightened to death. He dared not utter the slightest sound, and his eyes were full of fear, which looked particularly funny against the mud marks on their faces.
Although three years old or older is not the normal age for children to remember things, there are special cases, such as when the impression is particularly deep and can be remembered for a lifetime.
It would take the two children many years to recover from the shock of seeing each other again.
Completely unaware and not thinking she had done anything wrong, Wu Liang Di could no longer control herself after struggling and thinking that she would soon die, she said, “Your Majesty, Your Majesty! How can you be so partial? Why can the Ninth Prince do the same thing but my son and I can’t? Could it be that he is the Imperial Concubine’s son?”
“Your Majesty, Your Majesty! I refuse to accept this! I will not rest in peace until I die!”
Hearing this, Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but smack his lips.
Oh my god, no wonder, it turns out he was imitating the Ninth Prince.
But you can imitate just fine, but what about reality? Don’t you pay any attention to it at all?
Just like the Ninth Prince, you are just like him. Don’t you have any sense of propriety at all?
But strictly speaking, it is not the fault of the two little princes. After all, they heard that they just needed to be spoiled, but what is spoiled? The two mothers did not teach them, because they did not know the correct way for children to get along with their father.
In such an environment, people only know awe and respect, but not intimacy.
The two princes were still young and could not tell the difference between pampering and tsundere, so they subconsciously used the words and attitude they usually used to treat servants. In their opinion, this should be pampering, but in reality, it became domineering and bossy, which are completely different things.
No wonder Emperor Jingwen felt humiliated and then became furious.
Seeing that the two were still arguing from a distance, Wang Ziquan quickly asked the guards to shut them up.
Soon, the Imperial Garden finally became quiet.
Emperor Jingwen recovered and barely suppressed his anger, squatting down to comfort the two princes. But because the princes were already scared, when they saw him reaching out his hand, the two princes not only did not dare to reach out to take it, but were frightened and stepped back, looking at him not as if they were looking at their father, but as if they were looking at a man-eating monster.
Emperor Jingwen froze for a moment, but finally stood up again. He then told the palace maids and the wet nurse to take good care of the two princes, and left.
Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but sigh and shake his head in his heart.
Because of Emperor Jingwen’s rage, everyone in the palace got the news soon and was shocked.
It turns out that it wasn’t that the emperor had a special taste. This trick wouldn’t work if it were someone else.
The concubines who had originally had some thoughts about this, when they saw the two concubines’ tragic end, suddenly felt sympathetic and dared not act recklessly anymore.
The other side.
After school, Ye Shuo was dragged by the little grandson of the emperor and walked towards the East Palace.
It was almost time for dinner, and he was almost starving. Ye Shuo found that practicing internal skills consumed a lot of food. His appetite was almost three or four times that of his peers, and it was also increasing.
In this situation, Ye Shuo just wanted to eat something to fill his stomach, but Ye Xun didn’t give him this opportunity at all.
“Ninth Uncle, just come with me.” Relying on his young age, the little grandson began to pester the old man.
Ye Shuo said weakly: “Haven’t I already taught you everything I should have taught you?”
You can’t judge a boy by his appearance. Ye Shuo had no idea that he had such lofty ambitions. He saw his stepfather carrying him to school and was very jealous. He also wanted his father to carry him.
Tsk tsk, the prince is probably in trouble.
Seeing that he was not giving in, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh: “Didn’t I tell you that the prince is your father, your biological father? As long as you don’t go too far and pester him for a while, you will succeed sooner or later.”
Children nowadays have almost mastered this skill by themselves. They can buy whatever they want by just asking.
It’s nothing like here, where you have to be hesitant and cautious when picking up and dropping off students.
The little grandson understood the reason, but he had no idea how to proceed: “But, but I don’t know how to pester my father…”
“…What nonsense are you talking about?” Ye Shuo reached out and knocked on his head: “What do you think you are doing now? Why don’t you just torment him the same way you tormented me?”
“The energy you use to pester me, go and pester your father!”
“If you had chosen the right person from the beginning, you would have gotten it by now.”
The little grandson was stunned for a moment, then he realized belatedly that this was called pestering.
“I understand. Thank you, Uncle Nine. I will definitely succeed!”
Ye Shuo: “…Heh.”
“That sounds nice, but don’t let yourself become mute when you see your father’s face.”
The little grandson of the emperor patted his chest and assured: “Don’t worry, I definitely won’t do that, Uncle Nine!”
…I hope so, Ye Shuo sighed in his heart.
On the other side, the Qinzheng Hall——
In the afternoon, Emperor Jingwen visited a garden, and after being annoyed by the atmosphere, he came back. Then he continued to sit there and review memorials. He gave up the idea of ​​taking a rest. The crown prince was with him, and he did not leave the whole afternoon.
The father and son were not far apart. Because the prince’s eldest son had already entered the study and the second son was about to be born, Emperor Jingwen ordered someone to add another table at the bottom.
Seeing that Emperor Jingwen came back with a bad look on his face, the prince asked an extra question, but seeing that Emperor Jingwen’s face became even uglier, the prince tactfully did not ask another question.
Now that all the miscellaneous matters had been dealt with, Emperor Jingwen’s mood had calmed down, so he suddenly opened his mouth and narrated exactly what had happened in the Imperial Garden.
The prince didn’t know that there were actually people in the harem who dared to imitate Xiaojiu. What Xiaojiu did was not something that others could easily imitate. Not being beheaded was considered a light punishment.
Otherwise, are the princes who serve at the study room stupid?
Even the crown prince found it miraculous, and he didn’t understand how Ye Shuo did it, but he just could do it.
But since this was brought up, the prince hesitated for a while, then tentatively asked, “Father, is it that you carried Xiaojiu to school… a little inappropriate?”
The prince originally thought that yesterday’s incident was just a game between the two of them, but when Emperor Jingwen appeared at the door of the upper study for the second time this morning, the prince had to believe that it was true.
“You don’t…really take this seriously?”
It’s not that the Crown Prince is jealous. Well, a little bit, but not much, and it is completely controllable. It’s just that he is concerned about his other brothers and is afraid that they won’t be able to accept it.
“I am worried about the Fifth Prince and his men…”
“What do they have to worry about?”
Before the prince could finish, Emperor Jingwen blurted out, “How can you compare Xiaowu and other princes with Xiaojiu?”
“No, completely different.” They are two completely different situations.
What does Father mean by this?
The prince was stunned.
[1] Jiu = 9th, Wu = 5th

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Warmth
chapters.content:
The prince was extremely conflicted. He wanted to ask, but he felt too sensitive to ask.
Fortunately, just before the prince repeated the words in his mind for the umpteenth time and almost fell into a trance, Emperor Jingwen finally gave him an answer: “Your brothers are the future backbone of the Great Zhou and the cornerstone of the Great Zhou. As for you, you are the one chosen by the emperor to establish the family in the future. But Xiaojiu…”
Emperor Jingwen felt a headache when mentioning his son. After all, he had beaten and scolded him, but it was of no use.
Emperor Jingwen did not doubt that it was the instigation of the Duke of Zhen or the Imperial Concubine. The two parties worked together to deliberately create this effect. After all, this effect is really not something that ordinary people can create. If you are not careful, the child will really be disabled. Wang Liangyuan and Wu Liangdi are a lesson for the past. Who would use this method to compete for favor? The Duke of Zhen and the Imperial Concubine really don’t have such a brain.
So after thinking about it, it can only be a problem with the child himself.
The emperor was in a lot of trouble and felt helpless: “Xiaojiu… I just hope he can behave himself in the future and stop causing troubles. I will be thankful.”
To put it bluntly, it means that your ninth brother is useless, so why are you competing with him?
Prince: “…”
The prince felt relieved when he heard this, but he was also speechless.
It seems that my father has indeed been tortured by my ninth brother a lot, so much so that he has been asked to surrender again and again, and now it has become that he just wants to avoid trouble.It is said that a child’s future can be predicted at the age of three, and his character can be predicted at the age of seven. In this case, my father will probably not assign any important tasks to Little Nine in the future, let alone give him any substantial power. After all, my father has already branded him as unreliable. In this case, how could my father dare to give him the position?
Unless, Xiaojiu suddenly gets it one day.
But thinking about what his younger brother had done, even the prince felt that… it was indeed unlikely. This child had been particularly greedy for enjoyment since he was young and ignorant.
If the ninth brother knew what he had missed out on because of his mischief, he would probably regret it.
But this world has always been like this, there is never anything perfect, and you must pay for what you get.
Poor ninth brother was so young that he had no idea that he had lost the watermelon and picked up sesame seeds.
Thinking of this, the prince couldn’t help but show more pity in his eyes.
“Okay, I won’t talk to you anymore. I plan to visit the Imperial Concubine tonight.” Perhaps today’s events stimulated Emperor Jingwen. He suddenly felt that although the Imperial Concubine was equally stupid, she was much cuter after all. She never taught the children nonsense, and never used the children as a tool to win favor.
Although Xiaojiu was a bit naughty, Emperor Jingwen miraculously found that he liked him much better.
The most important thing is that both mother and son have simple minds. There is no need to beat around the bush when talking to them. They hardly ever ask for anything from you. You don’t have to worry about ruining the fun while chatting. Except for a little noise, everything else is comfortable, especially suitable for relaxation.
After hearing what Emperor Jingwen said, the Crown Prince was ready to leave: “It just so happens that this son’s Crown Princess is also waiting for me.”
In this way, the father and son walked out of the Qinzheng Palace together, and then one went to Qiuwu Palace and the other returned to the East Palace.
The result was that Emperor Jingwen did not find his son when he went to Qiuwu Palace, and the crown prince saw his younger brother at first sight when he returned to the East Palace.
“…Why is he so willing to go to the Eastern Palace?” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t figure it out.
The imperial concubine next to him couldn’t help but interrupt: “Your Majesty, you forgot that Shuo’er and the little grandson have always had a good relationship.”
The 9th uncle and his nephew hang out together all day long. This combination is really amazing. Doesn’t he, as an uncle, feel ashamed at all?
Alas, I forgot that my son has always been shameless.
Emperor Jingwen finally set his sights on the Sixth Prince who was sitting on the other side of the table. “By the way, Master Cen told me that you have made progress in your studies recently. Tell me, what have you learned recently?”
The Sixth Prince’s heart tightened, and he quickly put down the bowl and chopsticks in his hands, exhaled and inhaled secretly, then he slowly spoke.
The other side.
Seeing the prince taking time out from his meal to test his son’s homework, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but complain in his heart. He was worthy of being the heir chosen by his cheap father. He was simply of the same bloodline as his cheap father. He couldn’t even let his son have a meal in peace.
Didn’t you see that your little son was so nervous that he almost vomited out what he had eaten?
He is just a child less than four years old!
However, when educating children, the most annoying thing is other people’s interference, so Ye Shuo, as an uncle, can only watch from the side and really can’t do anything to help.
Hey, by the way, has the East Palace changed its chef recently? The food here is getting more and more delicious.
While stumbling and trying hard to recall what he had learned, the little grandson of the emperor almost cried when he heard the sound of the eunuch picking up food next to him.
Oh my God, the Ninth Prince is so heartless, it would be fine if he didn’t give any hints, but he was actually eating so happily by himself!
Looking at the Crown Princess who was nervous and worried, and then at his son who couldn’t remember and wanted to cry but couldn’t, and then at his Ninth Prince who seemed like an outsider and was eating deliciously, the Crown Prince endured it for a while, and finally held his forehead helplessly: “Little Nine, don’t you think your behavior is particularly inappropriate?”
When he was young, the Crown Prince knew that his younger brother was different from others. After a few years, he became more and more certain of his original guess.
Seeing that everyone was looking at him, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but be stunned: “Wait, Third Brother, what are you looking at me for?”
In the dull eyes of the child, Ye Shuo pointed his finger at him mercilessly and said, “Go ahead and ask my lovely nephew. It’s him who can’t answer, not me.”
In an instant, the little grandson of the emperor almost vomited blood.
Ninth Prince, how could he do this!
The little grandson of the emperor couldn’t help but jump up and down.
The prince looked at his brother, then at his son, and was silent for a moment. He felt that his brother’s problem was more serious, so he immediately changed his target: “I have already asked all the questions from Xun’er. Since you are here, I will ask you questions as well.”
The Crown Prince was personally taught by the world-famous Crown Prince’s Tutor, so his knowledge would naturally not be bad. Moreover, as an elder brother, he was fully qualified.
Humph! It would have been fine if the Ninth Prince didn’t help just now, but he also made trouble. Now it’s his turn.
Ye Xun felt relieved and soon regained his former energy.
However, the Crown Princess glanced at her brother-in-law and her heart moved slightly.
Seeing the prince’s insistence, Ye Shuo sighed and had no choice but to put down his bowl and chopsticks: “Okay, okay, go ahead and ask, but I have to tell you in advance that my knowledge is not that good.”
“In that case, I’ll just ask something simpler.” The prince was not trying to make things difficult for him. He just kept his word.
Soon, the prince discovered that his brother seemed to be too modest. His academic performance was not only mediocre, but extremely poor.
If it happened to his own son… the prince didn’t even dare to think about it, and suddenly felt that Xun’er was smart enough.
But Ye Shuo was too shameless. When he couldn’t answer a question, he just said so directly. He didn’t feel embarrassed at all, which stunned the little grandson of the emperor next to him.
The young grandson didn’t understand how his ninth uncle could be so self-righteous. Didn’t he have any shame at all?
Ye Xun recalled that whenever he was asked questions, he would feel sad for a long time if he failed to answer any question.
If Ye Shuo knew what he was thinking, he would think, isn’t it just that he didn’t answer the question, what’s the big deal, there are many things in the world that he doesn’t know, no one can guarantee to be omniscient, so what is there to be ashamed of?
The prince soon lost his temper: “How can you not even answer such a simple question?”
Ye Shuo also looked innocent: “Because what you asked is beyond the ability of me to answer at my age!” The questions asked by the prince were beyond the scope!
“Why don’t you say that I answered the first two questions?”
The prince frowned: “A three-year-old child can answer that kind of question.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Fart!
Only a three-year-old child in the royal family could answer this question, so he put it outside and tried again.
Ye Shuo is not stupid, so does he have no idea whether he can answer it?
“Third brother, your requirements are too strict.”
The prince thought for a moment and said, “It’s obvious that you are too indulgent on yourself.”
Then the prince sighed: “Xiao Jiu, you can’t go on like this, you will really regret it if you continue like this.” The prince really couldn’t help but revealed Emperor Jingwen’s intention in a particularly tactful way.
Perhaps people are so contradictory. When the other person poses a threat to them, they hope that he is not good. But when the other person becomes particularly bad, they can’t help but want him to become better.
The prince hoped that the child in front of him could understand the deeper meaning behind his father’s words.
Ye Shuo understood, but he did not behave as the prince expected. His first reaction was –
Is there such a good thing?!
Even when I grow up, I don’t have to work? I can only get some leisurely jobs, or even no jobs at all? Isn’t this getting closer to my goal?
It turns out that I am on the right track. I must keep up the good work in the future.
Noticing the visible light suddenly flashing from his brother’s eyes, the prince’s heart skipped a beat and he immediately had a bad premonition.
The next moment, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but hold the prince’s hand: “Thank you for your reminder, Third Brother. I understand.”
Prince: “…”
Did he really understand or was he just pretending to understand?
The prince always felt that the other party’s understanding was completely different from what he thought.
“Third brother, I’m done eating. I’m leaving first.”
Finally, this day has come. The future is bright. Ye Shuo just feels relaxed all over, and even his mood has improved a bit.
Before leaving, Ye Shuo suddenly thought of something and said, “Oh, by the way, I forgot to tell you that Ye Xun is so envious of me that he wants you to carry him to school. You see, the child is still so young and so pitiful, so just let him do it.”
Ye Shuo had discovered that his nephew was like a mouse seeing a cat when he saw his father. His father asked him several questions which made him very nervous. He thought he could not count on him, so Ye Shuo chose to speak up for him directly.
The prince was stunned for a moment when he heard this, then looked at his son.
Caught off guard, the little grandson of the emperor opened his eyes wide with horror on his face.
Wuwuwuwuwu, Uncle Nine is harming me!!
Ye Shuo soon disappeared, leaving the father and son staring at each other. Finally, the prince spoke first: “Is what your ninth uncle said… true?”
“No, no! Really not!” Ye Xun waved his hands without even thinking.
After a long silence, the prince said softly: “…You are my first child, and also my legitimate son.” But if he really wants, then it’s not a bad idea…
But Ye Xun misunderstood, and felt disappointed. He then raised his head and said quickly: “Son, remember this and won’t act like this again.”
The prince opened his mouth. That was not what he meant…
But in the end, neither the father nor the son said anything else.
For some reason, the atmosphere during the following dinner was much quieter than before.
Returning to Qiuwu Palace, Ye Shuo noticed that Cheap Dad seemed to be particularly kind today, as if he had been stimulated by something.
I guess something happened that I didn’t know about.
Shrugging his shoulders, Ye Shuo shouted at the top of his voice: “Father, Mother, I’m back!”
He looked no different from a child coming home from playing outside.
“Let me see what delicious food you two are eating without my knowledge tonight.”

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Dissatisfied
chapters.content:
“You bastard, what nonsense are you talking about again!” Emperor Jingwen felt that he was happy too early. Before he had relaxed for long, he was angered by his own son again.
However, Ye Shuo was basically immune to it. After seeing that there were just ordinary cakes on the table, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a little disappointed.
Upon seeing this, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but wonder: “Didn’t you eat in the East Palace?” The prince wouldn’t treat him harshly in this regard, right?
Without waiting for the maid to make a move, Ye Shuo poured himself a cup of tea: “But the East Palace is a long way from here.”
After all, there is still a certain distance between the East Palace and the Harem. It would take more than half an hour to walk there if you walk slowly, and at least ten minutes if you walk fast. In addition, Ye Shuo usually only eats until he is 70% to 80% full, so he would habitually eat one or two snacks when he comes back.
Of course, it is also possible that his internal strength has entered a period of rapid growth recently. After five years of accumulation, Ye Shuo’s internal strength may have reached a certain level of quantitative change, so the growth rate is much faster than before.
“Father, Mother, please take a quick look at me. Have I grown taller recently?”
Emperor Jingwen was just about to ask how it was possible that he could digest everything after walking such a short distance, but then he heard this.
Emperor Jingwen spoke almost at the same time as Concubine Rong.
“It still looks the same to me.”“Yes, he has grown a little taller.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Tsk.
Ye Shuo silently looked at Emperor Jingwen with a condemning look, what kind of father is this, he doesn’t even know whether his son has grown taller or not.
Being annoyed by Ye Shuo’s gaze, Emperor Jingwen was a little embarrassed: “What’s that look in your eyes? Are you blaming me?”
After being an emperor for a long time, he would not allow others to have even the slightest dissatisfaction. In his eyes, the slightest dissatisfaction would become an offense, even if the object was his own children or wife.
In the eyes of the emperor, there are no children or wives; they are all subjects and servants.
Don’t you feel cold standing so high?
Ye Shuo sighed helplessly: “It’s not that I’m surprised, I just think, Dad, you should at least pay more attention to your son.”
“Isn’t it enough for me——”
Before Emperor Jingwen finished speaking, he saw his son standing in front of a wall of pepper.
This wall was specially cleared out by Concubine Rong to measure her son’s height.
I saw that the mark on Ye Shuo’s head was almost two inches away from the last mark, about six or seven centimeters. Such a big difference was quite obvious in his childhood.
Emperor Jingwen was speechless for a moment.
Emperor Jingwen began to wonder if he really didn’t care enough about his son.
Wang Ziquan on the side was hesitant to speak. In fact, Wang Ziquan felt that the emperor cared enough about the Ninth Prince. To some extent, he was even more concerned about the Crown Prince. But this was the Emperor’s family affair after all, and it was not appropriate for him, a servant, to interrupt, right?
Concubine Rong next to him was completely unaware and seemed quite happy.
“Yes, you have grown taller. Tomorrow, I will ask the Ministry of Internal Affairs to make you two new sets of clothes. I see that the one you are wearing is old.”
It is really old, not because Concubine Rong is extravagant and feels old.
After all, Ye Shuo is now seven or eight years old, which is the age when clothes and shoes are worn out. He is lively and active, so naturally his clothes and shoes will be worn out faster.
Ye Shuo smiled happily: “Okay, mother, remember to pick some good ones for me.”
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but said, “You are a prince, not a princess, why do you care so much about beauty?” Why do you have to choose patterns when making clothes?
Ye Shuo thought that this was just a love of beauty. In his previous life, he had to specially match his clothes when he went out.
Isn’t this normal?
Ye Shuo’s mind moved, as if he discovered something, and he said, “Eh, eh, eh? Dad, I suddenly noticed that there is another fine line behind your eye?”
“What’s the matter? A real man never cares about these external things.”
Come on, then every time you choose the third place, you have to choose the best-looking one.
Ye Shuo took his mother’s bronze mirror and immediately saw the difference after looking through it.
Among them, Concubine Rong has the best skin. She is 28 years old now and still very young, with skin like that of a young girl. The second is Ye Shuo. As a child, his skin is good before he reaches puberty.
Only Emperor Jingwen is left, and whether in terms of skin color or the smoothness of his facial skin, he is definitely not as good as Ye Shuo and his mother.
Emperor Jingwen frowned subconsciously.
Just as he was about to say something, he noticed that his son was laughing in the bronze mirror. Emperor Jingwen immediately reacted: “Asshole!”
Seeing that the situation was not good, Ye Shuo immediately ran away: “So, Dad, appearance is still important for a man. It’s getting late, this son will take his leave first!”
“Remember to go to bed early, stay up late less, and exercise more!”
Looking at the little bastard’s anxious back, Emperor Jingwen’s slightly dark face finally brightened up.
The other side.
Ye Shuo returned to the side hall, and from Xiao Luzi’s words, he quickly found out what had happened in the Imperial Garden that afternoon.
Xiao Luzi originally thought that this matter had nothing to do with their master. It was Wu Liangdi and Wang Liangyuan who acted on their own initiative and used the prince as a tool to win favor, which would naturally arouse the emperor’s wrath.
As a result, when he looked up, Xiao Luzi saw that his master seemed to be silent.
He was puzzled for a long while. Just when Xiao Luzi was about to say something, he heard his master suddenly say, “It’s better to marry only one wife.”
If you have only one wife, you don’t need to compete for her favor, because all your love and attention belong to her alone.
Xiao Luzi was stunned. He didn’t understand why His Highness suddenly expressed such emotion.
But……
“Except for the poor common people who cannot get concubines, they only have one wife.” As for the rest of the men who have a bit of ability, who doesn’t have three wives and four concubines?
“You don’t understand.” Ye Shuo waved his hands. Just because other people do this doesn’t mean he has to do the same.
Before going to sleep, Ye Shuo was still thinking about what Xiao Luzi said. It was hard to describe how he felt, and in the end he could only sigh softly.
The next morning, when carrying Ye Shuo to school, Emperor Jingwen soon found out that his son had used his grandson to harass his other son.
Emperor Jingwen’s face immediately turned dark.
“What kind of nonsense are you teaching your little nephew?!”
“Well, son, isn’t this also about nurturing their father-son relationship?”
They soon arrived at the upper study. Not seeing the prince along the way, Ye Shuo immediately understood that the boy seemed to have failed.
“This can fail???”
Ye Shuo was stunned.
When Emperor Jingwen heard this, the veins on his forehead jumped violently, and then he warned solemnly: “The Crown Prince and the Emperor’s grandson are different from you. If you teach him recklessly again, I will definitely have someone break your legs. Do you hear me?”
“Yes, son understands…” Ye Shuo replied weakly.
Upon seeing this, Emperor Jingwen left with satisfaction.
Ye Shuo walked into the study room. Meeting his gaze that seemed to be looking at a loser, the little prince couldn’t help but lower his head even lower.
He really didn’t mean it.
“But my father said that I am the legitimate son and cannot…”
“If he says no, then no? Tell me, did he yell at you at that time? No, right? No means we can still discuss it. If we can’t discuss it, he will just get angry and won’t argue with you for so long. The more he talks, the greater the chance… Oh, you are so stupid.”
Ye Shuo was at a loss. How could a kid like Ye Xun, who didn’t dare to say it again after being rejected once, succeed?
“Wait, that’s not right. Why are you so clingy when you’re with me?”
Upon hearing this, Ye Xun couldn’t help but chuckle and said, “Because the Ninth Prince really makes people feel close to him. He is the most easy-going person I have ever met.” The other princes are also his uncles, but they don’t have the feeling that they can say whatever they want.
Just being close to him made Ye Xun feel very relaxed.
“The Ninth Prince never seems to get angry, and he never has a stern face. He smiles all day long.” This is probably one of the reasons why I feel relaxed.
Ye Shuo accepted the other party’s compliment with an expressionless face.
“If you could be half as eloquent to your father as you are to me, it would be fine.”
Ye Xun froze for a moment, then burst into tears.
While the two were chatting, the Sixth Prince seemed to be hesitant to speak. Obviously everyone now knew that it was because his father’s expectations for his Ninth Prince were different from others, which was why he was particularly good to him.
Poor Ninth Prince, he still thought he had gotten such a great bargain.
He is young and doesn’t know what power means. Sooner or later he will pay the price for indulging himself like this.
The Sixth Prince wanted to remind him, but when the words came to his lips, he couldn’t say them.
After all, only when the Ninth Prince was indulgent and unruly would he, who was also in Qiuwu Palace, be remembered and valued by his father. The Sixth Prince had no way to resist this temptation.
If the Ninth Prince rose a little, his own glory would be immediately buried, and he would not get any support from the Imperial Concubine at all.
Therefore, he had no choice but to step on him and climb up.
Therefore, the Sixth Prince finally said: “Don’t worry, Sixth Brother will definitely treat you well in the future and will not ignore you.” If he really won the favor of his father and officially entered the center of power, the Sixth Prince swore that he would not be left out.
Although I don’t know why he suddenly said this, but…
Ye Shuo touched his chin and laughed nonchalantly, “In that case, this younger brother’s future will depend entirely on you, my brother.”
What a humiliation it is for the son of a noble concubine to be inferior to others for a long time, neither high nor low.
The Sixth Prince remained silent and nodded: “Okay.”
Another three days passed in a flash, and the fifth prince, who had been sick in bed, finally recovered.
When he was sick, the Fifth Prince became furious when he thought about how so many people thought he fainted because of that bastard Ye Shuo.
It’s shameful, really shameful!
Rather than being embarrassed, the Fifth Prince was more worried about him asking him for those three conditions. When he came today, the Fifth Prince had already thought of how to shirk those conditions.
There is no way, promises are too important, and the Fifth Prince really doesn’t want to make them so easily.
Result……
Just when the Fifth Prince was gathering all his energy and preparing to confront that bastard Ye Shuo, he saw that the bastard Ye Shuo just glanced at him and had no intention of paying any attention to him at all. He even deliberately took a detour when passing by him.
This guy is quite fragile and fainted at the drop of a hat. Ye Shuo doesn’t dare to get close to him again. What if he gets blamed again?
As for those three conditions, well, if they’re gone, then they’re gone. It’s not a big deal.
At first the Fifth Prince thought it was his illusion, until during the break, the other party was playing with the little grandson of the emperor, and when they saw him coming, they suddenly stopped, and resumed playing after he left. Vaguely realizing something, the Fifth Prince’s face turned red with anger.
He really couldn’t help it, so he took the initiative to look for her after school in the afternoon.
With a “bang”, the Fifth Prince punched Ye Shuo’s desk, gritted his teeth, and stared at him intently: “What on earth do you mean?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Complaint
chapters.content:
Hearing this noise, Ye Shuo instinctively wanted to hide.
However, even such a small action caused great harm to the Fifth Prince.
The Fifth Prince looked at him and immediately began to retreat after seeing him. His face turned green.
“What do I mean? Fifth brother, what are you talking about?” Ye Shuo was still pretending to be stupid.
The fifth prince was immediately furious: “Ye Shuo! Do you think I’m blind?!”
Ye Shuo was surprised: “How could it be, Fifth Brother, how could you think like that? Fifth Brother, you are really wronging me.”
“By the way, Fifth Brother, do you have anything else to do? If not, I’ll leave first. My mother is calling me back for dinner. See you later!”
Seeing the poor acting skills of Old Nine, the Fifth Prince suddenly felt unsteady.
Seeing that he was trying to slip away, the Fifth Prince didn’t even think twice and immediately winked at his attendants and companions.
The attendants and companions understood and responded immediately.Looking at the two people blocking the door, Ye Shuo was helpless: “Fifth brother, what do you want to do? Just tell me.”
“I see you don’t look very well. How about… you sit down and talk slowly. I’m sure your brother is listening.”
Ye Shuo was really afraid that he would not pay attention and lie back on the bed, and then he would be unable to explain himself.
The child’s cautious attitude finally hurt the boy’s sensitive heart. After all, as a prince, no one wants to be mistaken for a porcelain doll by his brother, right?
What’s more, he is a younger brother who is so much younger than me.
“You don’t have to be so nervous. I’m doing this for your own good!” The fifth prince felt that the other party didn’t say anything, but it was more humiliating than if he had said something or even ridiculed him.
In order to clear his name, the Fifth Prince gritted his teeth and said, “Let me ask you, why did you suddenly stop mentioning those three agreements?”
Ye Shuo was puzzled when he heard this. Why did he become unhappy when he didn’t mention it? Wouldn’t it be a good thing not to mention it?
How come there are still people like this?
“The three agreements and the like were just a joke. We are brothers, why should we care so much about them?”
Ye Shuo’s magnanimity made the Fifth Prince’s previous intention to default on his debt seem shameful.
You try your best to avoid something, but others don’t even take it seriously. This feeling is a completely different level of humiliation.
The Fifth Prince’s face flushed red, and he could not help but yell, “Your Highness does not need to give me a way!”
The Fifth Prince couldn’t afford to lose the title of a seven-year-old to a fourteen-year-old.
“Listen carefully, you have to accept these three agreements whether you want them or not!”
“Guixi, Jiangnan, let’s go!”
Unable to stay any longer, the Fifth Prince glared at Ye Shuo and left angrily.
Looking at the other person’s back, Ye Shuo couldn’t come back to his senses for a long time.
Wow, there really are people in this world who try hard to force things into other people’s hands even though others don’t want them.
After a while, Ye Shuo burst into laughter.
There is no way. As a thick-skinned and black-hearted person, he likes to deal with those who are thin-skinned and can’t save face. Because the other party can’t save face, they can only lie down and be taken advantage of by him.
Coincidentally, the entire palace is almost full of such people, including his stepfather. Ye Shuo is so happy staying there, like a fish in water.
“Take the small road, Xing Yucheng, let’s go back to the palace.”
Being in a good mood, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but hum a little tune.
Xiao Luzi and Xing Yucheng looked at each other and suddenly didn’t know what to say.
On the other side, Qingyi Palace——
When the Fifth Prince returned, it was almost time for dinner. The Second Prince was there today. After seeing his younger brother, the Second Prince asked casually, “How did things go?”
Obviously, the second prince also knew that his younger brother had made a bet with the imperial concubine’s son, and he was even the one who came up with the idea of ​​​​defaulting on the debt.
In the second prince’s opinion, it is best not to give out such a promise casually.
The Second Prince gave him many instructions and thought it was a sure thing, but when his own brother heard this, he opened his mouth and said to him –
“I’m sorry, brother. I’ve already promised him.”
“Puff——” Caught off guard, the Second Prince, who was sipping his tea, was nearly choked to death.
“Ahem… Wh, what’s going on? Did he really ask you for it?”
The second prince was puzzled. This shouldn’t be the case. The reason he gave to his brother should be perfect. How could it be that –
The Fifth Prince: “No, he didn’t want it, so I forced it on him.”
For a moment, the second prince suspected that there was something wrong with his ears: “What did you say?”
“What you mean is that the Ninth Prince didn’t ask you for it, but you insisted on giving it to him, right?”
“Brother, you don’t know how infuriating the situation was!” When the Fifth Prince mentioned this, he was furious: “You know, he actually looked down on me!”
“He’s just a seven-year-old kid, looking down on me!!”
Because of his anger, the Fifth Prince’s voice was very loud at the beginning. However, he gradually realized that there was something wrong with his brother’s eyes, and his voice gradually became lower.
Feeling a little uneasy when being looked at by his brother, the Fifth Prince finally shut his mouth completely.
“You…Ah!”
He should have continued speaking in accordance with what his ninth brother said.
But it’s too late to say anything now.
For a moment, the Second Prince felt that this Ninth Prince did it on purpose, and considering his Ninth Prince’s previous deeds, the Second Prince was almost certain that he did it on purpose.
But there was nothing he could do. Even so, his brother still foolishly fell into the trap. If this happened to any prince with a little shame, he would probably fall into the trap.
“Although the Ninth Prince is absurd, he is not stupid.” The Second Prince said, skimming off the foam with the lid and taking a sip of tea.
Apart from anything else, the fact that he can coax his father around shows that he is not a fool.
Although the Second Prince had never seen him, he was very sure of this.
“Remember to be more careful when dealing with him next time.”
After learning from his mistakes, the second prince could only warn his brother again, “Don’t be fooled again.”
“Yes…” the fifth prince replied weakly.
On the other side, inside Qiuwu Palace, Ye Shuo was thinking that since he had made these three agreements, the Fifth Prince was probably pretty much doomed.
Oh, I don’t mean that he is useless, but I mean that he probably won’t be able to play any role in my life from now on.
During dinner, seeing that his son seemed to be in a particularly good mood, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but ask a question.
Seeing his son’s face full of “being forced into a corner” and “I don’t want to do it either”, and then listening to what he said, the corners of Emperor Jingwen’s mouth twitched slightly.
“I swear, I really didn’t mean to take it on my own. It was Fifth Brother who forced it upon me, and I couldn’t refuse it.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Today he probably experienced what it meant to get something for nothing.
“Your fifth brother has just recovered from his illness. Please stop torturing him.”
Ye Shuo was immediately unhappy when he heard this: “What do you mean I’m torturing him? My fifth brother has good character and is honest. He doesn’t even deny his debts to his own brothers. I’m sure he’s very happy to be able to fulfill his promise. Father, please don’t slander him. It seems like my fifth brother is very unhappy that he agreed to my promise.”
Emperor Jingwen fell silent upon hearing this.
If Xiao Wu had the thick skin of Xiao Jiu, he wouldn’t have been trapped by him.
Xiaojiu will soon say that the black is white.
It seems that Xiao Wu has to agree to these three agreements even if he doesn’t want to.
Emperor Jingwen always thought that as long as he could trick the little bastard into going to the study, everything would be fine. Little did he know that raising a child is only the first step in a long journey.
There are ninety-nine difficulties, and this is only the first one.
[1] Refers to parental problems
Emperor Jingwen once thought that with his son’s intelligence, he could lie and play Mahjong at the age of two, so studying would be no problem at all. Emperor Jingwen was even deeply worried about this for a long time, fearing that his son’s excessive behavior would cause the Duke of Zhen to have second thoughts.
At that time, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know that there was a word in this world called “not doing one’s job properly”.
There are so many smart kids in this world, but not every smart kid can use his or her intelligence in the right way.
In addition, Ye Shuo did it deliberately, and under the double attack, Emperor Jingwen was soon called for a meeting with Master Cen as parent.
When he saw Master Cen, Emperor Jingwen didn’t think too much about it. After all, he had never been asked by a teacher to ask his parents for audience in his life.
Emperor Jingwen even had the leisure to ask about the recent situation in the study, but he didn’t notice that Master Cen’s expression was becoming more and more entangled, as if he had something to hide.
At that time, the Crown Prince and several important ministers were present, and Emperor Jingwen was discussing recent state affairs with them when Junior Master Cen happened to come over.
At that time, Junior Master Cen was thinking about reporting to Emperor Jingwen alone after these important ministers left. Unexpectedly, Emperor Jingwen did not think so much at that time. When he heard that Junior Master Cen had arrived, he directly asked Wang Ziquan to call him in as well, making it difficult for Junior Master Cen to speak or not.
“Lord Cen, if you have anything to say, just tell me.” Finally noticing the other party’s dilemma, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but speak.
Exactly two hours had passed, and he and the ministers were all tired. In addition, the prince would have to work in the court in the future, so it would not be a bad idea to let the ministers familiarize themselves with the situation in advance.
What you fear is bound to come true. However, since the emperor has asked, Master Cen has no choice but to speak.
Master Cen wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, lowered his voice, and reminded quietly: “Your Majesty, it’s about the Ninth Prince…”
When Emperor Jingwen heard the word “nine”, he immediately understood.
Even though he had never been called as a parent before, his sixth sense reminded him that asking Master Cen to make the trip in person was probably not a good thing.
Family disgrace should not be made public. Emperor Jingwen regretted it. Just as he was about to go back on his word, he saw Prime Minister He who was sitting below him suddenly became energetic. His original fatigue was swept away instantly. Then he saw the Duke of Zhen who was sitting opposite him, who was the same. His tiger eyes immediately widened.
The Duke of Zhen didn’t expect that after being summoned to the palace by the emperor with great difficulty, he would actually hear news about his grandson here for the first time.
As the chief civil official in the empire, He Xiang had always been at odds with the military general, the Duke of Zhen, and disliked him for being crude, mediocre, and barbaric.
He Xiang had heard of the title of the Ninth Prince, and he didn’t think that there could be any good news from Master Cen from the Upper Study coming over specially. It was ridiculous that the Duke of Zhen seemed to be particularly expectant. He just wondered if the old man would be able to sit still after listening to it.
Although Prime Minister He wanted to see the Duke of Zhen embarrassed, he knew that the Ninth Prince was the Emperor’s son, and this matter was not so easy to bring up. Prime Minister He did not act rashly, but just sat there and stared at Master Cen.
The other adults were equally curious, and they also wanted to see the Ninth Prince who was so favored by the Emperor.
Just like that, almost everyone’s eyes fell on Master Cen, including the Duke of Zhen.
Master Cen immediately felt a surge of pressure.
Emperor Jingwen had already made his announcement, and now he wanted Master Cen to stay and report alone, but he really couldn’t bring himself to do so.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to wave his hand at Master Cen and said, “…Forget it, go on.”
References
↑1Refers to parental problems

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Not Good
chapters.content:
There were eight people in total present, all of them were of the second rank or above, and there was not a single one below the second rank, and all of them were important ministers of the country.
And now, this group of people are quietly waiting to hear how the teacher complains to the students’ parents.
The Shangshu Ling even urged him a little: “Lord Cen, since His Majesty has spoken, don’t keep us in suspense.”
[1] Shangshu = Post in ministry of work
The Shangshu Ling is a genuine second-rank official, and I didn’t expect that he would be interested in such trivial matters.
Master Cen saw that he couldn’t avoid it anymore, so he had no choice but to speak: “Your Majesty, please take a look at this first.”
As he spoke, Master Cen took out a book from his sleeve.
This book belongs to none other than Ye Shuo’s textbook. It was confiscated by Master Cen today and was specially given to Emperor Jingwen to read.
Soon, the book was presented to Emperor Jingwen.
Emperor Jingwen opened it and saw, huh? There didn’t seem to be anything special.Seeing that it was still clean, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
But the emperor was still the emperor after all, and he soon discovered something was wrong: “Why is this book… so clean?”
Master Cen couldn’t hold back when he heard this: “Because His Royal Highness the Ninth Prince has never seen it!”
According to Master Cen’s observation, the Ninth Prince could read for half an hour at most every day.
Half an hour!
Compared with other princes who often spent four to five hours studying a day, half an hour was simply below the bottom line for the other princes.
“The Ninth Prince didn’t even write his name.” In order to prevent being misled, princes would usually write their own names in the books.
Emperor Jingwen closed the book and saw that it was indeed empty, cleaner than his face.
Prime Minister He looked meaningfully at the Duke of Zhen who was sitting opposite him, and couldn’t help but smiled.
The Duke of Zhen felt that he should defend his grandson at this time: “Your Majesty, I think that studying should not be rushed.”
What’s so good about reading that book? It’s hard to remember and understand. Even if you remember it, you won’t know what it means. It’s full of twists and turns and not fun at all.
Moreover, in the eyes of the Duke of Zhen, half an hour was already good. None of his grandchildren, except the eldest grandson, could sit for so long.
Half an hour today, and another half an hour tomorrow, won’t it be enough if it accumulates over time?
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen resisted the urge to curse, and returned the book expressionlessly: “He said he didn’t want to read it, so he didn’t read it? How could Master Cen let him do this?”
“I really have no choice.” Lord Cen was also helpless: “The Ninth Prince said that he gets a headache when he studies for a long time, and half an hour is the limit.”
If he was forced to watch for a while longer, the Ninth Prince would cover his chest and support his head. He pretended so convincingly that for a moment Lord Cen didn’t know whether it was true or not. If it was true, and if something really happened to the prince, he would not be able to bear the consequences.
When the Duke of Zhen heard this, he nodded repeatedly and agreed with his grandson’s words: “That’s right!” Reading is a headache!
Now the other ministers also started laughing.
“…Duke of Zhen, shut up.”
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t hold it in any longer this time, and turned to glare at the Duke of Zhen. Then he took a deep breath, feeling that things were far from being that simple: “Lord Cen, what else?”
“And Your Majesty, please look at these.” Lord Cen came prepared today, and everything that needed to be prepared had been prepared.
When the young eunuch outside the door came in holding a wooden box, He Xiang and the others were all stunned.
If I remember correctly, it hasn’t been long since the Ninth Prince went to the study?
How come he couldn’t have made all of these?
The next moment, Lord Cen confirmed the ministers’ guesses: “Your Majesty, these are some small items that I confiscated from the Ninth Prince during my recent classes.”
When Emperor Jingwen opened it, he saw a mess of all kinds of things inside.
Emperor Jingwen picked up a square piece of jade and took a look at it in his hand. It turned out to be a small seal.
Perhaps because he was a beginner, the seal was carved crookedly and one could only vaguely make out it was a human face.
Curiosity kills the cat, and this is no exception for the emperor.
Driven by curiosity, Emperor Jingwen dipped his seal in his own ink and then stamped it on a blank piece of rice paper.
After seeing clearly what was engraved on it, Emperor Jingwen’s face immediately turned dark.
Long hair… a woman!
But in fact, as an ancient person, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know anything about animation. In addition, Ye Shuo’s carving was rather messy, which made Emperor Jingwen mistakenly recognize it.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly remembered the rouge and belly band he had caught at his one-year-old birthday banquet. Now that the old matter was brought up again, it immediately became a thorn in the side of Emperor Jingwen.
He Xiang and the others watched helplessly as the emperor crumpled up a piece of rice paper and threw it away.
Emperor Jingwen then put the seal aside, deciding to have someone grind it off later.
Emperor Jingwen quickly fished out the second thing from the box. It was… a small wooden stick? ?
The small wooden sticks were half as long as a chopstick. Five or six of them were about as thick as a chopstick and were polished to be very smooth. They were all tied with red silk. There were about a hundred sticks in a bundle.
“What is this for?” Emperor Jingwen was puzzled.
Lord Cen stepped forward, took the wooden stick, untied the red silk, and then personally demonstrated to the emperor and the ministers how to play.
It is to use one of the small wooden sticks to push out the other wooden sticks little by little. During this period, the other wooden sticks cannot move. If they move, you lose.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
It sounds like it’s quite interesting.
“Well, what about this?” With a light cough, Emperor Jingwen pointed to a stack of chessboards hand-painted by his son.
There is one black and one white on the chessboard, which looks like Go, but if you look closely, it is not Go.
Lord Cen took a look and said, “This was invented by His Highness. It’s called ‘Gobang’. His Highness the Ninth Prince said that when the five pieces are in a line, you win.”
What the hell is this?
In addition to the hand-painted chessboard, there are also trap games, which can be played with paper and a pen.
Soon, Emperor Jingwen took out a book that was half the size of his palm and had been bound with thread.
There is a little man holding a sword on every page of the book. The little man is drawn very simply. Although it is called a little man, it is actually just a few lines and circles put together.
“Why did he draw so many of the same thing?” Emperor Jingwen asked again.
His Majesty doesn’t know either. It was only after listening to Ye Shuo that Lord Cen knew how to look at this thing.
So Lord Cen reminded: “Your Majesty, you will understand if you turn the pages faster.”
Emperor Jingwen did as he was told, and then he discovered… the little guy moved!
Chopping, hacking and picking are just some simple movements, but they are quite interesting.
There were also bookmarks made of leaves, sandbags made of rags, etc. The most outrageous thing was that Emperor Jingwen found five things at the bottom that were almost identical in shape and size, and he didn’t know whether they were pig bones or sheep bones.
“What about this? What is it used for?” Emperor Jingwen didn’t want to ask so many questions, but he had no choice because he had never seen it before.
Lord Cen helped demonstrate again.
It’s just that his hands were not that flexible, and could not be compared with Ye Shuo’s dexterous posture when catching stones. Basically, when this bone was thrown up, the sheep bone below had not been caught yet, and the one thrown out had already fallen.
The ministers were stunned by the flustered Lord Cen in front of them.
After being stunned for a moment, He Xiang and the others could not help but be speechless. From the box full of messy things in front of them, they could tell that the Ninth Prince was definitely a man who did not do his job properly.
Fortunately, the emperor only favors him, and fortunately, the person chosen by the emperor to inherit the throne was not him.
A child’s character can be judged by his age at the age of seven. It seems that the Ninth Prince will never have any real power in his lifetime.
He Xiang and the others looked at each other and shook their heads in their hearts.
The prince standing by was silent. He had no idea where his younger brother got so many frivolous ideas from.
The Duke of Zhen didn’t think so much. He thought that playful children were good and playful children were healthy.
“…Okay, okay, let it go. I almost understand it.” Emperor Jingwen didn’t know what to say anymore. He wished he could put some of his attention away from having fun and focus on reading.
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen hurriedly asked: “What about his homework? How is his homework?”
Lord Cen shook his head, his expression unable to hide his grief: “Your Majesty, in such a long time, the Ninth Prince has only completed his homework on time twice.”
Every time he was asked to recite something, he almost never recited it completely.
“When I passed by His Highness the Ninth Prince during morning reading today, This servant, just realized that His Highness the Ninth Prince only opened his mouth but did not make any sound!”
When Lord Cen saw this, his plan was finally completely ruined. He got so excited that he came to the Qinzheng Hall with his box to file a complaint.
Lord Cen was so angry at that time that he couldn’t care less.
“I have tried slapping him on the hand, scolding him, and even making him stand in the corner as punishment. When the class was over, I went out to take a look, and only the bowl of water on the Ninth Prince’s head was still there. The Ninth Prince had disappeared long ago!” Lord Cen knelt down with a plop, accusing him word by word, tears streaming down his face.
He has never taught such a difficult student in his life.
Every new gadget he found was confiscated, but new ones would pop up the next day, like bamboo shoots after a spring rain, with no end in sight. No one knew what was in his little head, and he would have enough for two toys a day.
Looking at the articles written by His Highness the Ninth Prince, he may not be able to write one in ten days.
Lord Cen’s grief was genuine: “Your Majesty, I really can’t teach His Majesty well. I am guilty!”
As confident as Lord Cen was before, he is now as discouraged as ever, and was even angered to tears by a student like Ye Shuo.
He Xiang and others standing by were also stunned by this scene. As colleagues, they knew how stubborn Lord Cen was. Being able to force him into this state, everyone had a further understanding of the Ninth Prince’s stubbornness.
Seeing the miserable state of his old rival, who was still crying at such an old age, the Crown Prince’s Tutor tried to hold back his expression, but finally failed and slightly raised the corners of his lips.
Although he had known that this day would come, when it finally came, the Grand Tutor was still very happy. He just kept silent because of his old rival’s face.
However, perhaps it was due to telepathy or something else, but just when the Grand Tutor’s expression had only lasted for two breaths, Lord Cen, who was kneeling on the ground, suddenly raised his head as if he had sensed something.
As luck would have it, Lord Cen happened to meet the eyes of the Crown Prince’s tutor, and saw the faint gloating in them, which made Lord Cen even more sad and angry.
Laugh, laugh, laugh, what’s so funny!
He just met a student as good as the prince, so he had the time to laugh at himself. If their identities were reversed, this person might be worse than –
Wait.
Identity swap?
Lord Cen was stunned for a moment, and a thought suddenly flashed through his mind.
If you don’t have the skills, you shouldn’t take on this job. If you don’t have the ability, you should let someone more capable teach you.
Didn’t this old guy always boast that his teaching students were better than his own?
The sudden change in Mr. Cen did not escape the eyes of the Taifu. He did not say anything at this time, but for some reason, the Taifu suddenly had a bad premonition in his heart.
References
↑1Shangshu = Post in ministry of work

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Good Things
chapters.content:
Wait, what does this old guy want to do?
As expected, the two of them had known each other for a long time. The moment Master Cen was stunned, the Crown Prince’s Tutor had already seen the clue.
However, before the Crown Prince’s tutor could continue to explore, Master Cen suddenly lowered his head again.
The Prince’s tutor’s anxiety suddenly reached its peak. At this moment, Emperor Jingwen spoke up: “This matter has nothing to do with you, Lord Cen, you should get up first.”
Even though he was an emperor who never felt that he had done anything wrong, he could not say that it was the fault of the Master when he encountered this situation. After all, Emperor Jingwen had also experienced the skills of his son.
However, Master Cen was so excited that he refused to stand up: “I failed to help His Majesty teach the Ninth Prince, and I failed in my duty.”
As Master Cen spoke, he was about to cry again.
The Duke of Zhen who was standing next to him was immediately displeased when he heard this: “The Ninth Prince just played around a bit, he didn’t do anything else.”
Emperor Jingwen ignored him and was thinking about how to appease the young master. After all, there were so many princes besides Xiaojiu.
Soon, Master Cen spoke again: “Your Majesty, don’t worry. The Ninth Prince is very talented. This has nothing to do with him. It’s me, I am not well-educated and cannot take on such an important task.”Before entering the officialdom, Master Cen was considered a great scholar of the time. Wow, to be able to force him to utter the words “not well-educated” shows how powerful the Ninth Prince is.
He Xiang and others looked at each other and couldn’t help sighing.
How come there was a Ninth Prince among the princes?
However, the Crown Prince’s Tutor did not think so. After all, based on his understanding of Master Cen, he was not such a humble person. Master Cen always boasted that his knowledge was no worse than his own, especially in front of him, how could he say such a thing?
There is definitely something wrong here.
So the Prince’s tutor stood up without thinking and said, “Master Cen, you are too modest. Everyone in this world knows that you have many students all over the world and even taught a top scholar. If you, Master Cen, think that you are not capable, who else in this world can do it?”
“No, no, let’s not talk about the past. I am old, and my eyesight is dim now. I am no longer as strong as I used to be. I am far less young and energetic than you, Master.”
Lord Cen is 60 years old this year, and the Prince’s Tutor is 59 this year. The two are only one year apart in age. How can they be young and strong?
Seeing the Grand Tutor and Junior Tutor suddenly becoming modest, He Xiang and the others subconsciously picked up the tea at hand, enjoying it very much.
Master Cen: “No, no, no, Master, you are the crown prince’s teacher, how can I compare with you?”
The Prince’s Tutor: “No, no, it’s just that the Emperor favored me. If we talk about real talent and knowledge, you are still better, Master Cen.”
The prince was confused as he listened to what his teacher was saying.
Finally, the Duke of Zhen couldn’t hold it anymore and slammed the table beside him: “What do you two mean? Can you just say it directly?”
Junior Tutor Cen bowed to Emperor Jingwen and said, “I know that my ability is limited. I am far inferior to the great tutor who is full of knowledge and profound understanding… I am afraid that it will delay the Ninth Prince’s studies, so I propose that we ask the great tutor to teach the Ninth Prince. What do you think?”
I knew that this old guy would suddenly start praising me for no good reason, but I didn’t expect that he had this in mind!
The Prince’s tutor knelt down without a second thought: “Your Majesty, this is against the rules! I am the Prince’s teacher, how can I teach the Ninth Prince instead?”
Master Cen opened his mouth to argue, “Why not? The Ninth Prince is still young, Master Taifu is worrying too much.”
The Ninth Prince is only seven years old, the Crown Prince is already in his twenties, and the legitimate son has been born safely. His position is already secure. In this situation, there is really no need to worry so much. It’s just a matter of taking care of one more child.
But that is not an ordinary child!
When the Crown Prince’s tutor thought of the Ninth Prince’s previous behavior, he immediately became furious.
No, no, absolutely not!
But when the Crown Prince’s tutor looked up and saw that Emperor Jingwen was frowning and seemed to be thinking about this matter seriously, his heart sank immediately.
No, that won’t happen…
In fact, Emperor Jingwen didn’t want to do that, but Master Cen really couldn’t teach him. He couldn’t let the child stay like this forever, right?
Even Master Cen couldn’t teach me anymore. In this palace, there weren’t many teachers better than Master Cen.
Emperor Jingwen’s gaze slowly shifted downwards. In fact, in terms of knowledge alone, Prime Minister He and the others were not bad either, and they were more than capable of teaching Shuo’er. However, they were all powerful officials, and it was really inappropriate for them to have any involvement with the prince, so this was absolutely not allowed.
When Emperor Jingwen’s gaze swept over, Prime Minister He and the others felt their hearts tighten suddenly, and their smiles disappeared instantly. They lowered their heads silently and began to study the pattern on the teacup at the same time.
…So let’s ask the tutor to give it a try.
The Grand Tutor is the Prince’s teacher, and they have a very close teacher-student relationship. Xiaojiu is just a latecomer after all, so he is not afraid of what the Grand Tutor’s future will be like.
Just like Master Cen said, it’s just one more thing to teach the children, and it can be done easily.
Emperor Jingwen then said, “In this case, I will trouble you, Grand Tutor.”
The Crown Prince’s tutor was so excited that he could hardly maintain his expression. He couldn’t imagine what it would be like if the Ninth Prince became his student.
The Prince’s tutor wanted to make another last-ditch effort, but he saw that He Xiang and the others who had been pretending to be dead had “resurrected” one after another, and then they congratulated him one after another, “Congratulations, Master Tutor, you have another student.”
“Congratulations, Master Taifu, congratulations!”
“Master Taifu, it is a great blessing to have a student like the Ninth Prince.”
Once they become officials, and are all high-ranking officials of the first or second rank, how can there not be some conflicts among them?
Seeing that Prime Minister He and the others were just looking for fun, the Crown Prince’s Tutor almost vomited blood. However, he could not say anything bad about the Ninth Prince. After all, the Ninth Prince was the Majesty’s son. If he dared to show a look of disdain, wouldn’t that be a slap in the face of the Majesty?
The Prince’s tutor finally couldn’t help himself, and while accepting these ill-intentioned congratulations, he also said with a fake smile: “My lords, don’t be anxious, and don’t be greedy. You never know when this blessing will come to your family.”
Didn’t I also look at the jokes of my old rival in the same way? As a result, the situation changed, and it ended up in my family.
When the Ninth Prince starts to enter the imperial court in a few years, and is accidentally assigned to work under them, we will see if they can still smile!
Prime Minister He was not worried about this at all. Not to mention that it would take many years for the Ninth Prince to participate in politics. Even if he did, it would be unlikely for him to be assigned to the powerful departments under their control. So, it was estimated that there was no hope in this lifetime. It was impossible for the Ninth Prince to have any intersection with them.
He Xiang and the others looked relaxed, not taking the threat from the Grand Tutor seriously at all.
Master Cen, who was standing by, couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief when he saw this.
In a blink of an eye, he happened to meet the smile on Master Cen’s face. The Crown Prince’s Master was so depressed that he almost vomited blood.
If he had known this would happen, he shouldn’t have smiled that time before! !
The prince’s tutor really regretted his decision.
After finally leaving the Qinzheng Hall, the prince saw that his teacher was still silent and looked unhappy. He could not help but persuade him, “Teacher, don’t worry too much. Although my ninth brother is a little naughty, he is not a bad person after all, and his mind is pure.”
Apart from this, my brother doesn’t seem to have any other advantages…
The prince recalled it carefully, and then fell silent.
“Now that things have come to this, there is nothing we can do.” After all, the Grand Tutor had experienced many ups and downs, and after being depressed for a while, he quickly adjusted himself, and by the way, he found the advantages of this matter for the Crown Prince.
“Don’t worry, Your Highness. I will never let the Ninth Prince become a threat to you.”
Since the Ninth Prince is like this, let him keep it this way. The Crown Prince does not lack this helper. When the Ninth Prince grows up, he will not need to help His Royal Highness the Crown Prince in anything. He can just be a rich and idle prince in the future.
If he not only wins the emperor’s favor, but also learns real skills from me, I’m afraid it will be difficult to deal with him.
Because of the relationship with the Crown Prince, the Grand Tutor would certainly not be able to teach him everything he knows. If so, it would be unfair to the Ninth Prince.
The prince was stunned for a moment, then said: “Teacher, you don’t have to…”
The Grand Tutor shook his head and said, “Your Highness, I have made up my mind. You don’t need to persuade me anymore.”
Being able to keep the Ninth Prince under his nose is actually a good thing if you think about it carefully. Strictly speaking, Master Cen’s incident today was a blessing in disguise.
The prince opened his mouth, and finally sighed helplessly.
The other side.
Ye Shuo lay on the newly tied hammock, basking in the afterglow of the sunset comfortably. Looking at Xiao Luzi and Xing Yucheng beside him, they were like ants on a hot pot, running around in a panic. If you didn’t know better, you would have thought the sky was going to fall.
For Xiao Luzi and Xing Yucheng, wasn’t it like the sky was falling?
Everyone in the upper study room saw that Master Cen was furious when he left with the box. After asking around, it turned out that Master Cen had never been so angry before.
There is no doubt that Master Cen must have gone to the emperor to complain.
That box is full of confiscated gadgets made by the Ninth Prince!
Seeing the Ninth Prince still so leisurely and not worried at all, Xing Yucheng was so desperate that he couldn’t even describe it.
If I had known earlier, I should not have accepted the money from the Ninth Prince. If I hadn’t, they wouldn’t have become so deeply involved.
What would Master Cen do if he knew that the only two articles submitted by His Highness the Ninth Prince were all written by him, and that the Ninth Prince did not change a single word? !
Xing Yucheng was so anxious that he almost cried.
Listening to the increasingly chaotic footsteps, Ye Shuo had no choice but to speak helplessly: “Why are you so anxious? Don’t worry, nothing serious will happen.”
That box of toys is not so ordinary. Modern teachers would not bother to take care of it. They are nothing like Master Cen, whose tolerance is too poor.
“How can it be okay, Your Highness? The Emperor, the Emperor will definitely be angry!”
Ye Shuo closed his eyes and scratched his ears: “Oh, he would be angry, and then what?”
At worst, he can just scold him, what else can happen?
Xing Yucheng was speechless. Okay, that seems to be the reason…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at him. How come after so much time had passed, he still hadn’t gotten used to his cheap father scolding him?
Xing Yucheng opened his mouth and uttered: “Or, maybe, there might be some other punishment this time?”
Ye Shuo yawned: “he can stop me from studying.”
Just at this moment, Wang Ziquan walked over here, and after seeing Ye Shuo, he couldn’t help wiping the sweat from his forehead.
How come the little prince went to such a remote place without any palace servants to serve him? It really made it difficult for me to find him.
After Ye Shuo jumped down from the hammock, Wang Ziquan said, “Pass on the emperor’s order. From now on, Your Highness the Ninth Prince does not need to go to the study.”
A prophecy!
