Xing Yucheng turned around suddenly, and not only him, but also Ye Shuo was stunned.
No way, it’s not a big deal. How could my stepfather be so mad that he doesn’t even let him go to school?
Later, when he heard that the Crown Prince’s tutor was the new teacher, Ye Shuo was stunned at first, and then overjoyed.
It is known that he is the prince who poses the greatest threat to his third brother so far, and the Crown Prince’s tutor is his third brother’s teacher. Under such circumstances, it is impossible for the tutor to teach him well.
Good thing!
I can continue to have fun without having to hide anymore.
Ignoring Xing Yucheng who was hesitant to speak, Ye Shuo kowtowed solemnly and said, “Thank you, father!”

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Progress
chapters.content:
The other side.
Everyone had left, but the Duke of Zhen was still lingering there, and the young eunuch next to him couldn’t help but look at him several times.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to ask proactively, otherwise he felt that the Duke of Zhen could stay here for the whole day.
“Tell me, Lord Zhen, what else do you want to say?”
Upon hearing this, the Duke of Zhen’s eyes lit up immediately: “Your Majesty, I, your servant, just want to meet the Imperial Concubine and the Ninth Prince. I wonder if it is possible.”
There is no way. After hearing them talking about the Ninth Prince all the time today, the Duke of Zhen was really envious.
Emperor Jingwen was silent after hearing this.
Most of the ministers knew what was going on without his orders, and only the Duke of Zhen dared to bring it up on his own initiative.
But Emperor Jingwen would definitely not agree to it.
Even before Xiaojiu entered the court, at least before he was a teenager, he was not allowed to meet the Duke of Zhen.Emperor Jingwen was afraid that the Duke of Zhen would lead his son astray.
The child is still young and so playful that he has no ability to distinguish right from wrong. We must be careful not to let him go astray.
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen did not give a direct answer and quickly changed the subject: “Let’s not talk about this for now. By the way, how are things going at the border?”
How could the Duke of Zhen be a match for Emperor Jingwen? After a while, his attention was diverted. When he left, he felt that something was wrong, as if he had forgotten something.
Oh, forget it, I don’t want to think about it anymore.
After the Duke of Zhen had completely left, Emperor Jingwen subconsciously reached out to touch the memorial beside him, but accidentally saw the wooden box again.
When Master Cen left, he did not take the box with him.
Is this thing really that fun?
Emperor Jingwen scattered the small wooden sticks on the table, and then according to the rules, he picked out one stick first and then used the small wooden stick to pick out the rest one by one.
By the time Emperor Jingwen came to his senses, it was already evening, and he had not yet finished reviewing the memorials.
“…”
After a moment’s silence, Emperor Jingwen tied the small wooden stick with red silk again.
When Wang Ziquan was thinking about how to deal with them, he knew that throwing them away was not an option, and he didn’t know where to put them. The next moment, he heard Emperor Jingwen say, “Put these things in my private vault.”
Wang Ziquan was startled and quickly responded.
“By the way, have you told Xiaojiu about the tutor’s matter? What did Xiaojiu say?” The Prince’s tutor was notoriously strict. Emperor Jingwen was afraid that he would not be able to accept it for a while and worried that he would make a fuss again.
Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but smile when he heard this and replied, “It seems that the Ninth Prince likes the Grand Tutor very much. When I said this, His Highness immediately accepted the order and thanked me.”
“That’s good.” Presumably because Xiaojiu often hangs out in the Eastern Palace, he is no stranger to the Grand Tutor. After hearing what Wang Ziquan said, Emperor Jingwen immediately felt relieved.
The next day, Ye Shuo had already started packing his things, preparing to go to the East Palace to study.
The princes felt mixed emotions and didn’t know what to say.
The Crown Prince’s Tutor is the highest official in the dynasty and also the Prince’s teacher. Wouldn’t being his student mean that you would be treated the same as the Prince?
But when they thought about the fact that the Ninth Prince was sent to the Eastern Palace for discipline because he was too naughty and uncontrollable, the other princes really couldn’t feel jealous. If it were them, they would definitely feel extremely ashamed.
Looking at Ye Shuo again, he seemed fine and even had time to say goodbye to them.
“I’ll be leaving soon, everyone, don’t miss me too much!”
The Fifth Prince couldn’t help but sneer when he heard this: “Who would miss you? I wish you would leave.”
Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows: “Huh? Really? I remember you said the same thing last time.”
Thinking of the three agreements, the fifth prince immediately shut his mouth.
He suddenly began to doubt himself, would he really miss him by then? No, no, definitely not.
The Sixth Prince was speechless upon seeing this. Although he went to the Eastern Palace, he still had to return to Qiuwu Palace at night, so it didn’t have any impact at all.
Looking at the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince, especially the Seventh Prince, as soon as Ye Shuo left, no one could control the Fifth Prince. The Seventh Prince was probably the only one who sincerely hoped that he would not leave.
“Don’t worry. If he dares to bully you again, just tell me and I will help you deal with him.” While everyone was not paying attention, Ye Shuo lowered his voice and spoke in a voice that only the two of them could hear.
The Seventh Prince was stunned, then looked up suddenly.
“Just consider it as a thank you for reminding me last time.” Although the note was of no use, Ye Shuo still kept it in mind.
Ye Shuo didn’t care whether the other party’s motives were pure or not.
The Seventh Prince was stunned: “I’m obviously… okay.”
Seeing the Fifth Prince immediately turned his head away, Ye Shuo patted his shoulder and turned back again.
The Seventh Prince looked at his back, wondering what he was thinking.
Ye Shuo didn’t have much stuff, just a few books, an ink stone and a writing brush. The ink stone looked new, and the writing brush didn’t show many signs of use. Most of the stuff was made from chessboards, and Master Cen got a headache just thinking about it.
And now that this hot potato has finally been thrown away, Master Cen feels refreshed when he thinks that his old rival will become as miserable as himself. He deserves it for letting him laugh at him!
Ye Shuo left very quickly. Originally, Master Cen and the other princes thought that with his departure, the Upper Study would finally return to its former tranquility, which was a good thing.
But gradually, everyone felt that something was missing.
No one is arguing or rolling up their sleeves with the Fifth Prince anymore, no one is pestering the Sixth Prince anymore, the Seventh Prince has to start dealing with the Fifth Prince again, no one is playing sandbags with the Eighth Prince anymore, and no one is making Master Cen angry every day.
During the break, the little grandson didn’t know who to go play with, and everyone became quiet and distant as they were at the beginning, polite and courteous.
Finally, Ye Shuo’s seat in the upper study room also became empty.
*
Halfway through the walk, Ye Shuo suddenly sneezed for some unknown reason.
“It’s over, it’s over. They must be missing me.”
Hearing this, Xing Yucheng’s eyes suddenly became a little strange. Come on, after he left, Lord Cen and the princes were so happy that they didn’t have time to miss him.
“You don’t understand this.” Although he didn’t say anything, Ye Shuo was not stupid, so how could he not know what he was thinking: “I have such good relationships with people, it’s normal for them to miss me.”
Ye Shuo had a lot of experience in this matter. When he was in school in his previous life, there were always a few naughty students in his class. If they were just being naughty, they were actually quite likable.
Xing Yucheng still didn’t believe it, but since this matter was not very important after all, he didn’t continue to dwell on it.
Seeing that the Eastern Palace was within sight, Xing Yucheng finally spoke out what he had been holding back all night: “Your Highness, I think that studying with the Grand Tutor is actually… not a good thing.”
Wow, this guy has become smarter recently.
Ye Shuo was a little surprised. If an old man, who had served in the government for many years, found this, he would not find it strange at all. But after all, Xing Yucheng was only twelve years old. A normal twelve-year-old would not be able to see that deeply.
Although the Grand Tutor has always hated evil and was upright, that was in the past after all.
Now that the daughter of the Grand Tutor has married the Crown Prince and become the Crown Princess, she has also given birth to a little grandson. The nature of the situation has changed all of a sudden.
On the surface, the Grand Tutor is still a minister of his stepfather, but in fact, he is completely the Prince’s man. Even if he wants to stop working for the Prince, he can’t.
Besides, the crown prince, his third elder brother, is helpless in the world. Others, like him, can still hide and avoid them. If he doesn’t want to work hard, then he doesn’t have to. As long as he doesn’t get involved in the power struggle, he can be guaranteed to be a prince, and then there will be no big problem in living his life smoothly.
[1] T/L = He is referring that the chosen one would have to bear the burden, while other princes can live a free life, if they don’t get involved in the power struggle.
Ye Shuo didn’t have that idea originally, but after seeing the Fifth Prince and the others, he became even more determined in his original choice.
Firstly, he really didn’t think there was anything good about being an emperor. He had already enjoyed everything he should have in his previous life.
Secondly, as the old saying goes, wealth and glory cannot be brought into this world and cannot be taken away from this world either. In the end, being an emperor is nothing but empty talk.
Finally, Ye Shuo really couldn’t guarantee that he could win against the eight brothers above him. These eight people were not easy to deal with. If anything went wrong, it would be all over.
In the fight for the throne, even a slight mistake can be fatal.
Fight for one life and nine deaths, or don’t fight for nine lives and one death. Even a fool knows which one to choose.
As the son of his cheap father, he doesn’t have to worry about anything as long as his cheap father is around. It’s simply wonderful.
So even though Ye Shuo’s feelings for his stepfather aren’t as deep as his feelings for his father, deep down he still hopes that he can live a long life, the longer, the better.
Looking at the crown prince again, since he has been appointed as the heir to the throne, he has to fight for it even if he doesn’t want to, because other princes may not necessarily die if they fail, but he will definitely die if he fails.
Not to mention himself, his whole family might be implicated. If he meets a ruthless person, all the flower buds in the East Palace will be pinched out.
So under this circumstance, the crown prince certainly didn’t hope that he could learn anything real.
Ye Shuo could understand the crown prince’s difficulties, so he didn’t think it was a big deal.
Since no one, including Xiao Ming, wants him to be better, then he should never be better. This way everyone can be happy, which is also good.
So when Ye Shuo heard what Xing Yucheng said, he immediately frowned and said in feigned anger: “What do you mean? Third Brother is so good to me, I won’t allow you to slander him!”
“It was my father’s order that I study with the Grand Tutor. How can the Grand Tutor disobey my father’s order?”
“If you say that again, I will be angry.”
Completely unaware of the smile in Ye Shuo’s eyes, Xing Yucheng was scolded and felt bitter in his heart.
This is indeed the case on the surface, but it is not the case inside. The Ninth Prince has a reputation for being naughty, so it is understandable even if the Grand Tutor is not able to teach him well. If it is delayed for a few more years, then wouldn’t the Ninth Prince be completely ruined?
Oh my God, what should I do if I follow a prince who is playful, naive, and gullible?
Ever since he discovered that the Ninth Prince was unreliable, Xing Yucheng had been forcing himself to step in. After all, they were all in the same boat, and if the Ninth Prince was not well, he would not be well either.
Xing Yucheng has been working harder recently than before, but he discovered today that it might not be enough, far from enough.
Xing Yucheng felt that he had to work harder and be by the Ninth Prince’s side all the time to remind him, lest he be tricked to death one day.
In the end, Xing Yucheng, with a sad face, followed Ye Shuo into the East Palace.
References
↑1T/L = He is referring that the chosen one would have to bear the burden, while other princes can live a free life, if they don’t get involved in the power struggle.

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Praise
chapters.content:
Inside the East Palace, the Grand Tutor was already on high alert.
Although the Grand Tutor had no intention of teaching the Ninth Prince real skills, he couldn’t go too far on the surface.
The tutor had already made plans last night. He would teach him, but only the basics, just enough to ensure that his knowledge was above the passing line. He wouldn’t say a word more than that.
But in fact, according to the standards of the Taifu, even just the passing line is enough for most people to benefit from for a lifetime, it’s just that it is not so conspicuous among the princes.
Although the Grand Tutor had selfish motives, he would not go so far as to kill them all. In his opinion, this was enough to ruin a prince.
Wouldn’t the prince who had no ambition be deposed?
Unlike the Crown Prince, who had to learn how to be a monarch, he wanted to teach the Ninth Prince how to be a minister. This two-pronged approach was like double insurance.
Although this is unfair to a child, the crown prince is the legitimate son, and the other princes are only born to concubines after all.
A son born to a concubine should abide by his duties and not covet things that he should not covet. It is only natural for him to learn how to be a minister.
The reason why Emperor Jingwen chose the Taifu as the prince’s teacher was precisely because of this point. The Taifu was a staunch defender of the system of primogeniture. In his eyes, only the children born to the former queen were the only legitimate heirs to the throne. Even the children born to the successor queen had to take a back seat.This is especially true for the Taifu himself. His wife only gave birth to two children in her life, both girls. In today’s world, the Taifu has no intention of taking a concubine.
Therefore, in his eyes, maintaining the status of the crown prince was a matter of course, and he did not feel that he had done anything wrong in teaching the Ninth Prince in this way.
The Grand Tutor sipped the tea in the cup intermittently, appearing a little nonchalant.
Ye Shuo arrived under this circumstance.
“The Ninth Prince has arrived—”
Hearing the eunuch’s message, the Grand Tutor’s already upright sitting posture became even straighter. He had witnessed Ye Shuo’s power before, and now he subconsciously became alert.
The Grand Tutor had even thought about what he would do if the Ninth Prince disobeyed him.
Anyway, no matter what, the idea that the crown prince is the chosen one must be instilled into his mind.
After all, the old man in front of him is the father of the Crown Princess, the grandfather of the little emperor’s grandson, and the in-law of his stepfather. For the sake of these three people, Ye Shuo will not do anything to him.
After Ye Shuo bowed, he knelt obediently below the Grand Tutor, staring at him without blinking, quietly waiting for the other party’s next words.
After all, it doesn’t look like the Grand Tutor has nothing to say.
…Hmm? Something is wrong. Why is the Ninth Prince so obedient today?
Thinking this in their hearts, the teacher and the student stared at each other, looking a little awkward.
When it comes to keeping calm, Emperor Jingwen is no match for Ye Shuo, let alone the Prince’s tutor.
Just as Ye Shuo was about to eat the second piece of dessert, the Grand Tutor finally spoke, and the first thing he said was: “Let me ask you, do you know what the relationship between the ruler and his subjects is, and do you know what the relationship between the subjects is?”
The Master did not keep anyone in suspense and spoke directly to the point right away.
Upon seeing this, Ye Shuo quickly wiped the snack crumbs from the corner of his lips with his hand. As expected, he immediately received the forbearing look from the Master.
Ye Shuo pretended not to see it.
“Replying to the Grand Master, I believe that the king is superior, and the ministers are inferior.”
As for the way to be a minister, there are many different ways to say it, but it all comes down to one sentence:
“Ministers should obey the monarch.”
Ye Shuo’s words were so matter-of-fact that the Grand Tutor was stunned for a moment before he said, “What if the monarch is wrong?”
“How could that be?” As long as the compensation is sufficient, how can the boss be wrong? Everything the boss says is right.
For someone like me, no matter who he works for in the future, even if that person says his fart is not smelly but fragrant, Ye Shuo will accept it.
The other party works so hard, getting up early and going to bed late every day to support himself, and it would be fine if he didn’t enjoy anything, but in the end, he enjoyed it all. In this case, it’s not shameful to just lower your head and be obedient.
“How can a monarch make mistakes? The ones who make mistakes are the ministers. It is the ministers who fail to share the monarch’s worries in time. It is the ministers’ incompetence that troubles the monarch.”
This Taifu’s ideological awareness is not good enough.
Ye Shuo even looked at his current teacher with disapproval on his face: “So in your mind, the emperor can also make mistakes? Have you ever heard of the saying, ‘Thunderbolts, rain and dew are all grace from the emperor’? Whether the emperor is happy or angry, it is a favor to others.”
Ye Shuo spoke so seriously that the tutor was successfully choked.
The Taifu tried to find any trace of lying on his face, but there was none. The Taifu couldn’t find any at all.
That’s really what he thought!
The student was too obedient, so the remarks prepared by the tutor in advance were suddenly useless.
“you……”
The Grand Tutor opened his mouth, but he really didn’t know what to say. In the end, he could only wave his hands helplessly, “…Forget it, let’s stop here for today.”
The Grand Tutor originally wanted to teach Ye Shuo “The Way of a Minister” from Xunzi, to teach him how to be a good minister and what kind of minister he should be.
But now it seems obviously useless.
The Grand Tutor finally changed his mind temporarily: “I see that you are usually restless and playful, so you should first copy Zhuangzi’s “Xiao Yao You” ten times. When you are calm, I will teach you other things.”
Zhuangzi was a Taoist who advocated that sages should do nothing and taught people to let nature take its course and not to force anything in order to be truly free.
This would naturally be no problem if it happened somewhere else, but the Ninth Prince is a prince after all. Isn’t this telling him not to fight?
Fortunately, Xing Yucheng has been reading a lot of books recently, not only limited to the mainstream books of the time, but also some niche books, otherwise he really wouldn’t understand what it meant.
Although “Xiao Yao You” is a classic that has been passed down to this day, it is really not suitable for the Ninth Prince at all.
Therefore, Xing Yucheng subconsciously opened his mouth to argue, but before he could say anything, Ye Shuo next to him had already agreed.
“Please rest assured, Master. In five days, I will bring these ten pieces of “Xiao Yao You” to you for your review!”
As expected, one-on-one teaching is more flexible than large classes. As long as you answer the questions and receive the homework, there is nothing else to do. You don’t have to stay there all the time like in a large class.
As long as the answer satisfies the teacher, it’s fine.
Without giving the tutor any chance to regret, Ye Shuo grabbed his study partner, winked at Xiao Luzi, and was about to leave.
The Grand Tutor always felt that something was wrong. After all, it was just ten chapters of “Xiao Yao You”. It shouldn’t take five days to copy them all, right?
But before the tutor could raise his doubts, Ye Shuo had already disappeared.
From the time he arrived here to the time he left, it took less than an incense stick of time.
Gazing from afar, the Taifu was thinking at the moment, in fact, it was just as good this way, he didn’t want to learn, and I didn’t want to teach either, what a good thing.
The reason why His Majesty was unwilling to let go was because the Ninth Prince was his son, but it was different for him. He had no relationship with the Ninth Prince, so even though he knew that he was playful by nature, he would just turn a blind eye.
At this time, the Taifu was still able to keep his composure.
On the other hand, because he needed to copy books, Ye Shuo took Xing Yucheng directly to the library in the palace.
“Yes, this is my token. With this token, you can come and go here as you please.”
The Great Zhou Dynasty has lasted for over a hundred years, and its heritage is extremely profound. The library has three floors in total, with carved beams and painted buildings, and an ancient charm.
Ye Shuo heard that this library was built a hundred years ago and had to be renovated every few years to maintain its current appearance, but he didn’t know if it was true.
After walking in, Xing Yucheng was immediately shocked by the rows of bookshelves.
His family was a scholarly family, and there had been scholars in the family since his great-grandfather’s generation. Year after year, the family had accumulated quite a large collection of books, but compared with the library in front of him, it was dwarfed.
Ye Shuo ordered the guarding official to find Zhuangzi’s “Xiao Yao You”, and asked Xiao Luzi for the rice paper that had been prepared in advance. He placed the writing brush, ink, paper and ink stone for Xing Yucheng, and skillfully took out five taels of silver. Xing Yucheng immediately understood what he meant.
“Don’t be too picky. Just copy five pages at the front and five pages at the back, and leave the middle blank.” Anyway, the tutor won’t check each page, so even if he says it’s enough ten times, he won’t know it anyway.
Xing Yucheng had never known there was such a method before.
“This, this is not good…”
“Well, what’s wrong with that?” Ye Shuo didn’t care.
“You copy first. I’m going to sleep first. Remember to call me when you’re done, and then we’ll go back together.”
Not sure if it was to conceal his identity, but Ye Shuo took out a pile of books from the bookshelf behind him and used them to block his side. From a distance, one could not tell for a moment whether it was Xing Yucheng, who was sitting next to him, who was writing, or whether he was the one writing.
Xing Yucheng had no choice but to grind the ink and start writing.
Ye Shuo picked up a few books at first and read them. By the time Xing Yucheng finished writing the first page, he had already fallen asleep.
Xiao Luzi, who was standing next to him, skillfully put the cloak he had carried along the way gently over Ye Shuo’s body. After making sure that he would not be cold, Xiao Luzi dipped his hand in tea and secretly began to practice calligraphy.
Xing Yucheng: “…”
I always feel that there is something wrong with this scene.
Xing Yucheng could see clearly in his mind that the Grand Tutor really had no intention of teaching the Ninth Prince well, and the Ninth Prince had no ability to distinguish right from wrong and only wanted to play. He started to learn too late, and now he didn’t understand anything.
Now and even for a long time in the future, you can only rely on yourself.
Xing Yucheng felt that the burden on him was particularly heavy.
After copying the first five pages and the last five pages as requested by the Ninth Prince, Xing Yucheng wanted to take a break, but when he saw the Ninth Prince’s unconscious face, he was startled and sat up straight quickly, then subconsciously picked up the book next to Ye Shuo and started reading.
This is really a coincidence. I didn’t expect that these things that the Ninth Prince picked up would come in handy.
At noon, Ye Shuo woke up slowly and took the two of them to Shu Lan Zhai for a delicious barbecue. The barbecue was done in the yard of Shu Lan Zhai, and the meat was marinated in advance, so it smelled delicious.
Behind closed doors, he secretly played a few rounds of Mahjong with Empress Zhao and the others. In the afternoon, Ye Shuo continued to repeat his behavior in the morning.
However, he couldn’t fall asleep this time, so he closed his eyes and started practicing.
However, in Xing Yucheng’s eyes, this scene was still sleeping, just the movements were different, there was no difference at all.
Xing Yucheng’s awareness of the Ninth Prince’s incompetence became more and more profound.
When he returned home in the evening, Emperor Jingwen was so shocked when he learned that his son had been in the library the whole day.
As expected of a Grand Tutor, he is really good at teaching students.
“It seems that you have adapted to it today.”
Ye Shuo heard this and nodded seriously: “Yes, the tutor’s teaching method is excellent and very suitable for this son.”
Emperor Jingwen was immediately delighted, and the next day after court he began to praise the Grand Tutor profusely, almost making the Prince’s Grand Tutor dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Dumbfounded
chapters.content:
At first, the Grand Tutor thought that Emperor Jingwen was mocking him and was ready to kneel down and apologize, but…
I never expected that Emperor Jingwen really thought so in his heart.
After a little more inquiry, it turned out that it was the Ninth Prince who admitted it himself.
The Taifu felt mixed emotions and suddenly didn’t know what to say.
Only the Ninth Prince would think this was a good thing. If it were any other prince, when he said the word “Zhuangzi”, he would probably make a scene.
Although Zhuangzi is good, it is not suitable for the royal family.
Unaware of this, Emperor Jingwen was still praising him: “It turns out that the Grand Tutor has a good way of teaching. He has helped Xiaojiu settle down. Thank you for your hard work.”
Isn’t it true? After five days of rest, the Ninth Prince must feel good about himself.
The more Emperor Jingwen praised him, the more uncomfortable the Grand Tutor felt.
“I still have some memorials to deal with, so I’ll go ahead.” Finally, Emperor Jingwen left, and the Grand Tutor breathed a sigh of relief.He originally wanted to go back to the East Palace, but halfway through, he finally changed direction.
“Let’s go and take a look at the library.” Since the Grand Tutor is the prince’s teacher and often walks around the palace, and since he is old, there is not much to be shy about.
Holding the prince’s token and under the guidance of the young eunuch, the tutor came all the way to the library.
At that time, Ye Shuo was catching up on his sleep.
There is no way, I got up too early in the morning. My child is still growing, how can he not get enough sleep?
Besides, the library is quiet. It is such a pleasure to sleep in a place filled with the fragrance of books and ink. Today, Ye Shuo even specifically told Xiao Luzi to secretly put a small pillow in his pocket before leaving Qiuwu Palace. Now, Ye Shuo can lie on the table without even worrying about his hands getting numb.
When the tutor arrived, what he saw was Ye Shuo sleeping soundly.
Looking at his attendants and study companions beside him, each one was studying more enthusiastically than the other.
Because of Ye Shuo’s previous reputation, the Grand Tutor had already been prepared, but when he suddenly saw this scene, he still felt excited for a moment.
After all, as a teacher, you have some occupational diseases.
It seems that the suspicion that the Ninth Prince was hiding his abilities and pretending to be naughty can be completely cleared.
The Ninth Prince really doesn’t like studying at all!
The Grand Tutor knew very well in his heart that he came here on a whim, and there was absolutely no possibility that the Ninth Prince had prepared in advance and put on a show for him.
And looking at the indentations on the Ninth Prince’s face, it doesn’t look like they were just made. His face has even turned red.
Xing Yucheng noticed that the palace maids who were sorting books nearby knelt down one after another. He looked up belatedly. The moment he saw the Grand Tutor, he was suddenly startled and hurriedly pulled the clothes of the Ninth Prince next to him.
“Your Highness, wake up, the Master is here…”
“What nonsense are you talking about…” How could the Master come here?
Ye Shuo was woken up in a daze. He was feeling dissatisfied, but when he looked up, he happened to meet the dark old face of the tutor. He was stunned for a moment.
No.
Didn’t we agree not to care?
“T-Teacher?”
It’s okay, it’s okay, it’s good like this.
Comforting himself in this way, the Grand Master tried his best to calm himself down. After a long time, the Grand Master calmed down and asked, “Have you finished copying the ten copies of “Xiao Yao You”?”
Xing Yucheng subconsciously prepared to show him the bound book, but was held down by Ye Shuo the next moment.
Is this guy stupid? It was agreed to be five days, and it’s only the second day. If he hands it in now, won’t there be new homework in the next three days?
We agreed on a five-day holiday, and not a single day can be lost!
So Ye Shuo started to play dumb, and even acted a little nervous: “Reply, reply Master, it hasn’t started yet…”
The Grand Tutor had expected this, so he didn’t find it strange.
The Grand Tutor wanted to say something several times but finally couldn’t hold it in any longer and said, “Don’t eat until you are full all day, and don’t waste a moment of your time. You…you take care of yourself!”
So what on earth did the Grand Tutor come here for this time? Could it be that he came here just to take a look at him?
Looking at the back of the tutor, Ye Shuo looked confused.
Then Ye Shuo sighed. Logically, there wouldn’t be such a change, unless the Grand Tutor had been stimulated by something.
Fortunately, fortunately, I hope there won’t be any problems later.
“You guys continue studying and don’t worry about me. Just remember to call me at lunchtime.” After saying that, Ye Shuo lay down again.
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi’s expressions suddenly became even more confused than the Taifu’s just now, and they studied even harder afterward.
The other side.
After leaving the library, the Grand Tutor felt a little confused.
He always felt that things were a little different from what he had initially imagined.
It is true that the tutor knew that the Ninth Prince was playful, but he had never really seen him. In the tutor’s opinion, no matter how naughty a child could be, how naughty could he be?
The Taifu is surrounded by very ambitious young people, including the Crown Prince, who are also working very hard despite being in a high position.
The Grand Tutor had never known before that there were people who had no sense of urgency at all. Could it be that the Ninth Prince really had no sense of urgency at all?
How could he sleep in such an environment!
For a moment, the Taifu even wanted to yell at him and scold him for his laziness. After he came to his senses, he broke out in a cold sweat.
Perhaps because he had never seen someone retreat so completely like Ye Shuo, the Taifu took a long time to recover.
After that, along the way, the Taifu kept comforting himself that this was exactly what he wanted, with only benefits and no disadvantages, so he should just keep doing it this way.
The Grand Tutor couldn’t help but calm himself down.
Three days passed in a flash, and Ye Shuo slowly handed in the discounted copy of “Xiao Yao You”.
Seeing the tutor take it, Xing Yucheng’s heart almost jumped into his throat.
He always felt that this matter could not be concealed. Think about it, this person is the Grand Tutor. How could His Highness the Ninth Prince do it so obviously?
“Okay, I understand.” After turning two or three pages, the tutor found that the book was covered with tiny handwriting that looked like dog crawling. His eyes hurt, so he closed the book immediately.
Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
Ye Shuo was not panicked at all. Think about it, the Grand Tutor had no intention of asking him to learn anything real, so how could he really check it carefully? Even if he saw it later, he would pretend not to see it.
Ye Shuo just knew it, that’s why he is so brave.
After resting for five days in a row, Ye Shuo originally thought that the tutor would just ask him a few random questions and then assign him a bunch of homework, and that would be all.
Unexpectedly, the Grand Tutor kept him for a whole morning before letting him go.
Compared with the previous cup of tea, the difference of this half day’s effort is simply too great.
Ye Shuo’s first reaction was that this tutor was no good, not cruel enough at all. Since he was going to do it, why didn’t he do it to the end?
If he was cruel enough, wouldn’t things be much better for me?
The Grand Tutor is worthy of being the Grand Tutor. The series of questions made Ye Shuo dizzy and extremely sleepy. He asked questions about literature, history, geography, classics, etc. It was obvious that the Grand Tutor was very knowledgeable, understood everything, and could explain everything.
If I had known earlier, I would have come a little later today, and come back after dawn. Ye Shuo thought that he would be done quickly, but in the end…
What a mistake. What a mistake.
In the end, the tutor didn’t even talk to him about Zhuangzi anymore, and the content of the book he was copying today was changed to “The Analects of Confucius”, which scared Ye Shuo so much that he trembled violently.
Why are you starting to teach the real thing?
Ye Shuo began to reflect on himself, wondering if he had answered too many questions just now. In the future, he must answer a few more questions.
“Don’t worry, Master. Shuo’er will hand in all these articles in seven days.”
About half a cup of tea later, Ye Shuo left with his companion and attendants. After the East Palace became completely quiet, the Grand Tutor gasped for air, feeling a blackness in front of his eyes and a sharp pain in his heart.
Apparently, today’s investigation has made the Grand Tutor feel a little overwhelmed.
The Ninth Prince’s ignorance was completely beyond the Grand Tutor’s tolerance.
Not to mention what happened earlier, the Ninth Prince didn’t even know how the founding emperor of the Ye family gained control of the world, and that was the Ninth Prince’s own great-grandfather!
Also, when he mentioned that there was not only one country, Great Zhou, on this land, but there were two other countries around it that stood opposite to Great Zhou, the Ninth Prince’s expression of disbelief deeply hurt the Taifu’s heart.
The first two questions above would have been fine, but it was the third and final question that completely broke down the Taifu’s psychological defenses.
The Ninth Prince actually felt that the sky above his head and the land under his feet were round.
This is not just ignorance, he doesn’t even have common sense!
But to be honest, this matter is not Ye Shuo’s fault. After all, the time and space he is in is obviously different from his previous life. He dare not answer questions about history randomly.
Also, the country he lived in in his previous life had already completed unification more than two thousand years ago. He thought so purely as a subconscious reaction. How could he have known that his cheap father was like that, and as a result, he couldn’t even achieve the most basic unification, so Ye Shuo never asked about it for all these years.
As for the third question, the sky above my head and the earth under my feet are no different from my previous life. Every day still has 12 hours, the solar terms are still the same, and the sun still rises in the east and sets in the west. It can be basically confirmed that the sky and the earth are still round.
So is he wrong to say that? No!
However, Taifu did not think so. Shocked in his heart, these three questions and Ye Shuo’s reactions when answering the questions became Taifu’s thorns. It was like they were branded in Taifu’s heart, and Taifu would think of them from time to time.
How could this happen? How could something so simple go wrong?
Of course, the Grand Tutor pretended to be very calm on the surface, and it was hard to tell that he was so troubled that he almost vomited blood.
Seven days later, when Ye Shuo came to hand in his homework on time, he didn’t even notice it. He just felt that the tutor was staying late more and more.
After learning from the previous experience, Ye Shuo dared not just say he didn’t know the next two times. Gradually, he was able to answer some questions.
But it was no use now, the initial impression was so deep that it was too late for him to express it now.
Every time he saw him, Taifu’s sanity was on the verge of collapse.
Ye Shuo over there still doesn’t know anything.
After resting back and forth for about a month, Ye Shuo finally felt a little bored staying in the palace. He was seven years old this year and could run and jump. He felt that it was time for him to go out and try his luck again.
That day in the library, Ye Shuo opened his eyes after practicing, looked out at the fiery red sky, and suddenly said, “Why don’t we go play outside the palace?”
Xing Yucheng’s hand trembled, and the piece of paper he was writing on was completely ruined.
Xiao Luzi had never been out since he entered the palace at the age of seven. Now that he was fourteen, he instinctively felt that this idea was too horrifying.
“Your Highness, this is inappropriate!”
“The Imperial Concubine and the Emperor will not agree!”
Could it be that His Highness is planning to make trouble again?
Xiao Luzi accidentally revealed his true thoughts.
“What are you thinking about?” Ye Shuo felt that the two people around him were too unimaginative.
“Isn’t it possible to find a ready-made reason just by looking for it?”
The Grand Tutor can’t be the only one satisfied, he has to do something when necessary, right?
Ye Shuo decided that when the time comes, he would say that it was the Grand Tutor who asked him to go home to teach. As long as it was related to learning about the common usage of ancient and modern times, how could his mother and stepfather not agree?
Besides, the Grand Tutor doesn’t pay much attention to him, so won’t he be allowed to play around as he pleases?
It happened that the third day was the time for a new round of homework submission. Ye Shuo handed in his homework in the morning, and when the Grand Tutor was about to leave the palace, he took Xiao Luzi and hid in the carriage in advance, quietly waiting for the carriage to take them out of the palace.
Oh, I forgot to say that he had already given Xing Yucheng a holiday in advance and asked him to wait outside the palace.
As for whether I told the tutor, of course I didn’t.
Fearing that he would not agree, Ye Shuo simply acted first and reported to him later, without any ambiguity.
Just like that, the carriage slowly drove out of the palace gate, finally ending a day’s hard work. The Grand Tutor was drinking tea happily in the carriage, but after passing the palace gate, he suddenly heard a movement under his butt.
When the Grand Tutor saw the Ninth Prince opening the storage box and coming out, he couldn’t help but spit out all the tea he had drunk with a “puff”.
“Your Highness!?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Girl
chapters.content:
Forced to Ascend the Throne after Transmigrating: Forced to Ascend the Throne after Transmigrating: “Your Highness, why are you here?”
The Master’s face was filled with shock.
Ye Shuo nimbly climbed out of the storage box under the Taifu’s buttocks. Seeing that Xiao Luzi was still standing there in embarrassment, he opened the locker opposite without saying anything.
The Master then discovered that there was someone in the locker opposite.
As for the things originally placed inside, no one knows when they disappeared without a trace.
There are still a lot of tea leaves in there that he has collected and never wanted to drink…
As if sensing the Master’s heartache, Ye Shuo pulled Xiao Luzi out and said, “Don’t worry, Master. I have already asked someone to move the things in your storage compartment to Shu Lan Zhai in advance. You can take them back anytime.”
Two sets of tea sets, a small charcoal stove for boiling tea, a basket of high-quality smokeless charcoal, a blanket, two tea cakes, two clay pots of tea leaves and other miscellaneous things had been secretly taken away by Ye Shuo.
The Grand Tutor felt that this had nothing to do with whether it was a piece of property or not. The most important thing now was to find a way to send the little prince back!
This, this, this is the son of the Imperial Concubine, the most beloved prince of His Majesty. What will happen if something goes wrong when he is away from home? ?After the two came out, most of the seats in the carriage were occupied by them. The tutor was forced to stand there with his back hunched, and subconsciously lifted the curtain next to him to take a look.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but pour a basin of cold water on him: “It’s too late, Master. We are already out of the city gate.”
Are you kidding? How dare he make any noise if he doesn’t even know this?
Want to return the product? No way!
The Grand Tutor saw that this was indeed the case. The gate of the palace was getting farther and farther away. He loosened his grip on the curtain and felt that the situation was hopeless. “…The Emperor and the Imperial Concubine will not allow you to come out alone.”
“How could it be? How could I be alone?”
Ye Shuo first pointed at himself, then pointed at him.
The Master understood what he meant almost instantly: “You, you——”
Great, the other party is leaving the palace under his own name!
Ye Shuo’s subsequent words also confirmed the Master’s guess.
“Don’t worry, Master. I’ve already told my mother in advance that you have something to teach me. So she let me go out of the palace with you and come back after I’ve learned it.”
After a while???
The Master’s eyes widened: “Your Highness, are you not going back tomorrow???”
Upon hearing that, Ye Shuo immediately waved his hand and said, “Of course.” It was not easy for him to come out, so he must have a good time.
“I have to stay outside for at least ten days or half a month, right?” Otherwise, all his efforts would be in vain.
Although in Xiaoluzi’s opinion, his master didn’t put in any effort at all.
The Master couldn’t help but took a deep breath, his expression becoming somewhat serious.
“Your Highness, I’m sorry I can’t agree to this. It will be dark soon, and the palace gates will be locked. I can take you in for one night.” If it was just to let the Ninth Prince sleep in his house for one night, it wouldn’t be a big deal, but…
“But if Your Highness insists on not returning, then I am sorry that I can do nothing about it.”
What he meant was… if I didn’t agree to leave immediately tomorrow, he would completely ignore me… ?
Is there such a good thing???
Just like that, the Grand Tutor watched the little prince in front of him and suddenly became excited.
“Stop the car!” Ye Shuo asked the driver in front to stop without thinking.
“Thank you for your consideration, Master!”
“Xiao Luzi, what are you still standing there for? Why don’t you leave quickly?”
Ye Shuo had already decided to experience the ancient version of the inn first. Although he didn’t know how strong he was now, he thought that protecting himself should be no problem. After all, Ye Shuo had experimented in the palace. He hid somewhere, and the guards and secret guards could not find him, but on the other hand, he could find the other party.
Although this cannot completely prove that he is stronger than the secret guards and bodyguards, it at least shows that his ability to hide is not bad.
If you can’t win, you can hide. If that doesn’t work, you can run.
Ye Shuo had also tried it. If he now poured his internal energy into his feet and only used it to run, it would take more than an hour for his internal energy to be exhausted. Running for three hours was enough for him to run from the palace gate to the outside of Shangjing. Besides, Shangjing was under the rule of the emperor, and the public security was much better than outside. If there were so many criminals in Shangjing, then his cheap father would be too incompetent.
Taking all factors into consideration, it would be completely fine for him to play outside alone for ten days or half a month.
Ye Shuo even prepared the money for going out for fun. He deliberately discarded the silver and gold melon seeds and large-denomination silver bills used as rewards in the palace, and exchanged them for loose change. He had made sufficient preparations in advance.
As soon as the carriage stopped, Ye Shuo jumped off immediately.
The Taifu people were all dumbfounded.
After all, generally speaking, if you tell a seven or eight-year-old child that you would ignore him, he will definitely be scared and cry loudly, and will definitely do whatever you say afterward.
Coincidentally, the Grand Tutor thought so too.
As a result, the Ninth Prince’s reaction far exceeded his expectations.
The Taifu’s scalp immediately felt numb.
He said he didn’t care, but how could he really not care? After all, the Ninth Prince left the palace in his carriage. If something unexpected happened, how could he escape the consequences?
Seeing that the person had already gone down, the Taifu was in a panic and could only cling to Xiaoluzi who was also preparing to leave.
There’s no way. The smaller one is gone, and the larger one can’t be let go.
Xiao Luzi had never seen the Grand Tutor lose his composure like this before, and his voice became stammering: “Grand Tutor, Grand Tutor…”
Master Taifu, you have stepped on my foot!
The Grand Tutor turned a deaf ear and felt his heart suddenly hanging in his throat.
Sure enough, after walking forward about ten meters, he found that the small path had not caught up with him, so Ye Shuo could only look back to see what was going on.
But after lifting the door curtain, Ye Shuo was immediately stunned: “Master, what are you doing…”
Didn’t you say you don’t care? Now it doesn’t look like that.
The Taifu is just like his father. It is difficult to guess what an old man is thinking, and he often goes back on his words.
Seeing him turn back, the Grand Tutor finally breathed a sigh of relief, his expression slightly distorted, and after a long while, his voice finally softened: “Your Highness, it’s not very convenient outside, why don’t you stay at my house for the next ten days.”
Wow, what’s the point of hanging out with an old guy?
Ye Shuo shook his head repeatedly: “No, no, I won’t bother you with this matter, Master.”
“It’s not a bother, it’s not a bother.” The Grand Tutor almost gritted his teeth and said, “Your Highness has come to my house. I am so happy that I can’t wait to see you. How can I feel that it is a bother?”
Just wait, when he returns, he will send someone to inform the emperor immediately that the Ninth Prince has escaped without permission. This time, he must file a complaint with the emperor!
Having said that, your expression doesn’t say that…
Ye Shuo touched his chin and felt that the Grand Tutor definitely did not think so.
So Ye Shuo thought about it and said, “Then when you go back, send someone to tell my father and my mother that you want me to stay in your house for a while.”
His own words alone might be able to fool his mother, but he certainly couldn’t fool his cheap father.
But it would be different if there was testimony from the Grand Tutor. Even if the matter of leaving the palace to study was not true, it would become true after getting the Grand Tutor’s confirmation.
The Master refused without hesitation: “This is impossible!”
Wanting him to help you lie is impossible!
Ye Shuo also had some understanding of the Grand Tutor’s personality. He was very old-fashioned and stubborn. He had heard this from the Crown Princess more than once, so Ye Shuo didn’t hold out much hope.
“In that case, I’ll trouble you to take care of Xiaoluzi.”
The Master was stunned for a moment.
What does he mean?
Are you not going to bring even a personal attendant with you?
Looking at the figure of the seven-year-old child walking away, the two people in the carriage were completely panicked.
Xiao Luzi was about to cry: “Master, Master, don’t you want your servant anymore?!”
The master was also shouting, “Come back, come back! I’ll help you!”
“really?”
“really!”
Ye Shuo thought for a while, and finally decided to jump back into the carriage.
After all, leaving the palace is a big deal, and the Grand Tutor certainly wouldn’t dare to hide it. If his father knew about it, the whole of Upper Kyoto would be shaken to look for me, and that would be bad.
So this is good for now.
After Ye Shuo sat firmly, the Grand Tutor blocked the door of the carriage with his old bones and stared at him intently, fearing that this prince with a naughty nature would do something naughty again.
“Your Highness, you really scared me to death just now.” Xiao Luzi almost didn’t know what to do.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smile at the two of them.
The tutor reacted quickly and felt that things shouldn’t be like this.
It was the Ninth Prince who acted first and reported later. It was clearly him who was in the wrong, so why did I have to beg him in the end?
After Taifu came to his senses, his face suddenly turned dark.
The situation was urgent, and he couldn’t react quickly enough, but now it’s okay. He has figured it all out.
But it was too late.
Just like that, under the stare of the Grand Tutor, Ye Shuo staggered and staggered along the carriage to the Grand Tutor’s residence.
The Prince’s Tutor is a top-ranking official in the current dynasty, so his residence should be very large. However, when he got closer, Ye Shuo found that the house in front of him was pitifully shabby.
Of course, this is only relative. Compared with ordinary people, it is definitely much better, but if compared with the residences of other officials, it is not worth mentioning.
On this street, the house of the Taifu has the most ordinary facade, except for the pair of brand new big lions at the door which make it look more luxurious.
Withdrawing his gaze, Ye Shuo followed the tutor into the room.
Later, Ye Shuo discovered that the inside of the Taifu’s mansion was not as good as the outside. At least the paint on the pillars outside was not peeling, and the basic color was still there. As for the inside of the mansion, Ye Shuo seriously suspected that the Taifu only renovated the outside.
Just as he was daydreaming about something, he walked through the screen wall and came to the hanging flower gate. He heard some noise in the main room and a woman in her fifties came towards him.
Although the woman had taken good care of herself, she was old after all, and her face was beginning to show signs of aging, but her movements were appropriate, and it could be seen that she was a person who had read a lot. There was a hint of calmness between her brows and her eyes were peaceful. From her still bright eyes, it could be seen that she was also a very talented and gentle woman in her time.
Ye Shuo finally knew who the Crown Princess took after. Given the Grand Tutor’s temperament of getting angry at the slightest provocation, Ye Shuo had thought that the Crown Princess was adopted.
Madam Zhen first saw her husband in the lead, and subconsciously said, “The master is back… Eh? Who is this?”
Ye Shuo came out from behind the tutor without saying a word.
After seeing the face of the child clearly, Madam Zhen was stunned for a moment, then blurted out in surprise: “What a beautiful child!”
A person with beautiful appearance and figure is called handsome.
Although the child in front of me is very young, his facial features are so stunning that people can’t help but marvel at him. As expected, in another ten years, I wonder how many girls in Shangjing City will be fascinated by him.
The Grand Tutor’s face turned a little unhappy when he heard this. After all, in his opinion, a man should be upright, well-read, and have a sharp look between his brows. It’s ridiculous for the Ninth Prince to only rely on his face but be empty inside!
Ye Shuo next to him didn’t care. He thought that he was good-looking because he had good genes. Was it a crime to be good-looking?
Therefore, Ye Shuo didn’t care at all, and quickly shouted to Madam Zhen in front of him: “Hello, Master’s wife!”
The Taifu is now his teacher, and Taifu’s wife is naturally his teacher’s wife.
The Grand Tutor couldn’t help but frown upon seeing this. Why was the Ninth Prince acting so pretentiously?
However, when Mrs. Zhen heard that he was her husband’s new student, she couldn’t help herself and a smile suddenly appeared on her face.
“At such a young age, you are very polite.”
“You must be tired after walking all this way with your teacher. Don’t just stand there. Come in and sit down. It’s time for dinner. Let’s have some together.”
See? Why is having good looks useless?
Ye Shuo turned around and winked at the tutor.
The Master’s eyelids twitched suddenly.
Ye Shuo turned around and said softly, “Master’s wife, Shuo’er has nowhere to go recently. Can you take Shuo’er in for a few days?”
Oh, how pitiful.
Madam Zhen said without hesitation: “Of course, there are so many rooms in the house, I will just clean up one for you.”
“Then, what if the teacher doesn’t allow it?” Ye Shuo hesitated.
Mrs. Zhen was stunned. If her husband didn’t allow it…
Seeing her hesitation, Ye Shuo slowly lowered his head.
Madam Zhen couldn’t help but say, “It’s just one room. I think I can still make the decision.”
The hopeful Taifu followed closely behind: “…………”
Just when the tutor lost control and wanted to expose Ye Shuo, a young girl, no more than fifteen or sixteen years old, came out of the yard with two maids, crossed the corridor and came to the main house.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Angry
chapters.content:
The girl was in her prime, with a slender figure and a luxuriant appearance, like a flower bud about to bloom, and she was extremely beautiful. However, there was a hint of sadness between her brows, which made her look like she was forcing a smile. She seemed to want to smile, and her mouth moved, but the corners of her eyes were still slightly drooping.
People who are not born with this type of eyes will behave like this, it means they are really in a bad mood and are just pretending.
Ye Shuo’s first reaction when he saw her was that this girl was worried.
As for Xiao Luzi standing next to him, he was thinking, the Grand Tutor is indeed a hidden talent, his daughters are all prettier than the other, and you can’t tell from the Grand Tutor’s appearance!
I thought the Crown Princess was beautiful enough, but I didn’t expect that her sister was even more beautiful. She was less dignified and graceful than the Crown Princess, but her appearance was better.
Because Xiao Luzi knew that the Grand Tutor had two daughters, he subconsciously thought the girl in front of him was the Grand Tutor’s youngest daughter, and the Crown Princess’s younger sister.
But Ye Shuo didn’t think so. First, the age didn’t match. The Grand Tutor looked to be in his 50s or 60s, so how old was this girl? Giving birth at an advanced age was a very dangerous thing in modern times, not to mention in ancient times.
Even if the Crown Princess is the daughter of the Grand Tutor, she is too young. The Crown Princess is only in her early twenties this year. That is to say, the Grand Tutor was in his thirties when he gave birth to the Crown Princess. It is not easy for her to give birth to another daughter a few years later.
It would be fine if the Taifu was shameless enough to take a concubine at such an old age, but the key point was that along the way, Ye Shuo discovered that the Taifu seemed to have only married this one wife, who was of the same age as the Taifu, and the girl was so young, she really didn’t look like a little daughter.
It’s more like she’s a granddaughter.It’s just that granddaughters of this era basically never appear in their grandfather’s house. Even if they do, they usually just stay for a short time. But looking at the clothes of the two maids next to them, they are all the style of ordinary maids in the Taifu Mansion, and they don’t look like they are just staying for a short time. It’s as if they have always lived here, otherwise it wouldn’t be possible to say that all the personal maids are from the Taifu Mansion.
Plus, the Crown Princess never mentioned anything about her sisters…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh, then shook his head gently at Xiao Luzi, signaling him not to say more or ask more questions later.
Xiao Luzi was confused and a little puzzled.
Soon, the girl walked straight towards this side and said, “Grandfather, grandmother.”
Xiao Luzi was startled, and subconsciously began to guess the identity, appearance, and age of the eldest lady. Only then did he realize what His Highness had meant.
Completely unaware of the little movements of the master and servant, the girl bowed to the Grand Tutor and the Madam, then shifted her gaze to the strange child in front of her.
The girl’s first reaction was similar to the Madam’s. She thought the child in front of her was very cute. However, she was young after all, so her reaction was not as obvious as the Madam’s.
But obviously, she was still interested in Ye Shuo.
“This young master is…”
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo immediately put on his signature smile.
Seeing that he was about to use the same old trick again, the Grand Tutor interrupted him without waiting for him to say anything, and spoke for him: “This is the Ninth Prince. Wen Yin, come here and meet the Ninth Prince.”
This child is actually a prince!
Not to mention the girl, even the Madam next to her was shocked.
There was no way, because Ye Shuo had specially changed out of the prince’s clothes and put on ordinary clothes. Therefore, the Madam just thought that he was a young man from some family and did not think of him as a prince.
Seeing that she had just been talking to him in a condescending manner, Liang Wenyin hurriedly walked down the steps and saluted towards Ye Shuo, saying, “This subject greets the Ninth Prince. I pay my respects to the Ninth Prince.”
Ye Shuo glanced at the Grand Tutor and said helplessly, “No need to be polite, get up.”
Ye Shuo didn’t go forward, but asked Xiao Luzi to help.
“Grandmaster, you are really something. We are all family, why bother with all this?” Ye Shuo didn’t like people bowing to him, and basically avoided it whenever possible. It was probably a habit brought from his previous life, and it would be difficult to change in this life.
Who is his family?
I’ve never seen anyone so familiar.
The Grand Tutor glared at Ye Shuo and said slowly, “Your Highness, etiquette cannot be abolished.”
To be honest, Ye Shuo did not consider the tutor as his own, but he did not want to kneel down to him.
Seeing that the Grand Tutor insisted, Ye Shuo had no choice.
It was already dark when they came out of the palace. The Grand Tutor first held his nose and asked the people in the mansion to pass the message to the palace. After he finished explaining, the Ninth Prince showed a satisfied look, and the Grand Tutor became even more furious.
The Madam was still puzzled. Her husband had clearly supported the crown prince, so why would he bring other princes to his home to spend the night, and stay for such a long time?
Fortunately, the housekeeper came over to inform that dinner was ready, which invisibly resolved a possible conflict.
The dinner at the tutor’s house was just as simple as the house where the tutor lived. It was in no way comparable to the Imperial Palace. There were four people in total, so four dishes and one soup were enough. Finally, because Ye Shuo was there, a dish of roasted ham was specially added today.
It is certainly much better than the food in ordinary people’s homes, but as I said, it doesn’t look like what a first-rank official eats at all.
The Grand Tutor had predicted that the Ninth Prince, who had been living a life of luxury since childhood, would not be able to stand this, and he had already prepared to make a few sarcastic remarks to him when the time came. However… the Ninth Prince not only did not complain, but ate with relish, looking as if he was adapting well, which made the Grand Tutor a little confused.
How so?
But in fact, Ye Shuo is still very easy to feed. If there is good food, he will definitely eat the good ones. If there is nothing good, he will eat other things as well. It’s all fine with him. He is not very picky about food.
Ye Shuo eats a lot, but not fast. He chews every mouthful of rice thoroughly before swallowing it. This minimizes the burden on his stomach and intestines, and doesn’t make the food spilled everywhere.
Then, when the Madam saw this scene, it seemed like he was eating non-stop. The Madam was old, and her appetite was not very good. Her granddaughter had been weak since childhood and ate little. The Madam had hardly seen this scene, and unknowingly followed suit and ate half a bowl more.
Liang Wenyin next to him was even more surprised. She thought that the Ninth Prince seemed to have a big appetite and ate with relish. It seemed that ordinary meals became delicious.
The master didn’t understand. How could a child be so attractive when he was just eating? Why were the two people in the family so interested as if they had never seen it before?
Please forgive me, Master, for not having seen the world and not knowing that the people who watch the most food broadcasts among modern children are their mothers, grandmothers and college students.
Of course, it’s cute when a child’s cheeks puff up!
The Madam was the first to put down her bowl and chopsticks. She just remembered the important matter at this moment. She had planned to discuss it with her husband when he came back today, but who would have thought that a prince would come with them today. For a moment, the Madam didn’t know whether she should mention it or not.
After all, they were an old married couple for many years, so the Grand Tutor could naturally see what his wife was thinking at the moment. In addition, he already had an idea about the matter and really didn’t want to discuss it anymore, so he said, “Don’t talk while eating, and don’t talk while sleeping.”
As expected, the Madam stopped talking immediately.
Ye Shuo, who was watching the excitement, did not hesitate at all and decisively put down his chopsticks: “Master’s wife, don’t listen to my teacher. I am the prince and I have the final say. If you have anything to say, just tell me directly.”
Isn’t it said that etiquette cannot be abolished? Heaven, Earth, the Emperor, parents and teachers, teachers should step back a little.
The Madam was visibly stunned as she never expected that he would speak suddenly.
The Grand Tutor couldn’t help but grit his teeth and looked over to see what the little prince was going to do.
Liang Wenyin looked at this, then looked at that, and couldn’t help but tugged at the Madam’s sleeve nervously: “Grandma, forget it…” What if they started quarreling in front of the Ninth Prince?
The Grand Tutor also exhaled heavily: “Your Highness, this is my family affair, so please don’t worry about it.”
What a coincidence, the more the Grand Tutor doesn’t want him to do something, the more he wants to do it.
Ye Shuo turned a deaf ear to him and stroked his chin: “How about letting me guess?”
Since it was clearly stated that it was a family matter, coupled with the girl’s sad face when they met, combined with her age…
Ye Shuo suddenly had an idea: “Could it be about the young lady’s marriage?”
The Grand Tutor’s breathing suddenly stagnated. He was puzzled. This Ninth Prince was not good at studying, but how come his brain worked so quickly in other aspects?
Could it be that he is only smart in other areas?
Ye Shuo asked again: “But the young lady and the Madam think it is inappropriate, but the old master disagrees?” Based on the old man’s personality, this is the most likely thing to happen.
The old man is stubborn and won’t listen to other people’s opinions at all.
Liang Wenyin was so shocked that she covered her mouth with a handkerchief: “How did you know?”
Ye Shuo spread his hands: “Guess.”
“But it seems that I guessed right.”
The old face of the master has now become as black as the bottom of a pot.
However, the Madam’s psychological defenses were collapsing little by little.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo thought about it. According to common sense, he should not interfere in other people’s family affairs, especially other people’s daughters’ marriages. How could he, an outsider, ask about these things?
But the situation is different now. The Taifu obviously has no intention of listening to the opinions of the two women in the family. He probably thinks that they are just women in the inner house and don’t know as much as he, a great scholar who is the prince’s teacher. Besides, in this day and age, it is popular to have parents’ orders and matchmaker’s words. If the Taifu likes the other party, his granddaughter has no right to intervene at all.
But the Taifu didn’t know that it was the young couple’s life, and just because he thought it was good didn’t mean it was really good. Just because he read a lot of books, would he never make mistakes in his life?
When it comes to marriage, the opinions of the parties involved are the most important.
Ye Shuo is small and weak, and he cannot help everyone in such an era, but at least if he sees something, he will help if he can.
As the saying goes, if you are poor, you should take care of yourself; if you are rich, you should help the world. His status as a prince is not given for nothing, right?
The Crown Princess has already married into the Eastern Palace and is now the daughter-in-law of the royal family. Her behavior is restricted in every way. I guess this is why the Madam didn’t tell her.
In addition, the Grand Tutor insisted on doing so, so the Madam and Liang Wenyin really had nowhere to turn to.
What if he really is a bad guy? We can’t just watch the little girl jump into the fire, right?
In this case, it’s not wrong to interfere in other people’s family affairs.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smile and said, “Since the Grand Master doesn’t want to listen, then Master’s wife and niece Wen Yin should tell me. I have plenty of time, and I don’t mind being annoyed.”
Liang Wenyin is the niece of the Crown Princess, and he and the Crown Prince are brothers. Is it not too much for Liang Wenyin to call him “little uncle”?
The Madam hesitated for a while, but finally spoke out.
Although the Ninth Prince is still young, he is willing to listen. As for whether he can help…what if? What if he can?
“This is what happened…”
After hearing this, Taifu finally lost all control and threw his chopsticks in anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Rage
chapters.content:
The sound of “bang” startled both the Madam and Liang Wenyin.
They have never seen their husband/grandfather so angry…
For a moment, even the Madam began to hesitate.
Ye Shuo turned a deaf ear to it and didn’t take it to heart at all. He didn’t care even if his father was angry, let alone a mere tutor.
“Don’t pay attention to him, Master’s wife, please continue talking.”
Perhaps it was the Ninth Prince’s calmness that gave the Madam confidence. The Madam was not the kind of person who could not distinguish the important from the unimportant. Compared with her husband’s momentary anger and her granddaughter’s lifelong happiness, the latter was obviously more important.
So the Madam settled down again.
The Grand Tutor was fuming and glaring for a long time, and found that no one paid any attention to him. Only his granddaughter looked at him hesitantly and worriedly from time to time. But his granddaughter was obviously not the one who made the decision, which meant that his anger was in vain and had no effect at all.
But the Grand Tutor really didn’t dare to leave. At least he could keep an eye on things here. Once he left, who knows what shocking words the Ninth Prince might say. What if his wife and granddaughter were really led astray by him?
The Master had never felt so aggrieved in his life.There was nothing he could do, no one listened to him, and in the end he could only sit down again feeling frustrated.
The Madam paused for a moment, as if she had discovered some new world. An idea crossed her mind unconsciously –
It turns out that my husband also has times when he is helpless…
The Grand Tutor didn’t understand why someone would be interested in the affairs of a girl. What man would have such a hobby? Looking at the Ninth Prince who moved a stool and sat there, listening with relish, occasionally interrupting and expressing his opinions, the Grand Tutor couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
Tsk, he won’t leave even though I told him to. He’s really used to it. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but curl his lips.
Soon, the Madam told the whole story.
It turns out that Miss Wen Yin’s marriage was arranged by the tutor.
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo could no longer hold back and started to complain: “There are two children, and we can’t tell anything yet. Why is it decided so early? What if the children grow up to be bad?” With Taifu’s personality, he would probably keep his promise even if the children grow up to be bad. Isn’t this just pushing his own children into the fire pit in vain?
It is really not advisable to arrange a marriage or make a marriage contract at a young age.
The Grand Tutor was immediately unhappy: “There are countless people in the world who act like this. Are they all wrong?”
Ye Shuo didn’t even think about it: “When does having more people mean it’s right?”
The two looked at each other, neither of them giving in, and soon turned their heads away.
The Madam continued.
The boy was a few years older than Liang Wenyin. At that time, the two families agreed to wait until the young master of the Cao family came of age. Coincidentally, Liang Wenyin also came of age, and then the two families would immediately fulfill the marriage contract.
Now the agreed date is almost here, and the young master of the Cao family is about to come of age, but something happened in the meantime that has bothered the Madam to this day.
It wasn’t a big deal. It was just two years ago, when Wen Yin was fourteen years old, the young master of the Cao family gave Wen Yin a hairpin on her birthday.
After all, they are an engaged couple, and nowadays, the separation between men and women is not as strict as imagined. As long as young men and women do not give or receive things privately and their parents are present, it is not a big deal for them to give each other gifts.
But the bad thing was that when the Madam went to visit Cao’s house later, she accidentally saw that Mr. Cao’s cousin, who was staying at the house, had a hairpin in her hair that was almost exactly the same as the one on her granddaughter’s head.
After a little inquiry, the Madam found out that it was also sent by the young master of the Cao family. Since that day, the Madam couldn’t help but grumble in her heart. At first, she always felt that there was something going on between her future granddaughter’s husband and her cousin, but there was no substantial evidence, and there were not even any rumors. Gradually, the Madam couldn’t help but become suspicious.
Could it be that I really misunderstood?
Seeing his wife bring this up again, the Grand Tutor couldn’t help but say, “It’s just a hairpin, why are you ladies so particular about it?”
Ye Shuo had a different opinion: “Taifu, what you said is wrong. Hairpins are women’s personal belongings. If close sisters borrow them from each other, it’s fine. But who wants others to have the same things as themselves?”
“It would be fine if they didn’t know each other, and it would be awkward at best if they met. But it happened to be a birthday gift for niece Wen Yin, and it was given by the same person. This young master of the Cao family is really too rude.”
The key point is that it was made by one person, and it is a birthday gift. Who wouldn’t be disgusted?
“Does he think that niece Wen Yin can share everything with others? Can she just give anything away?”
The Grand Tutor couldn’t help but frown when he heard this: “You are just taking advantage of the situation, how can it be so serious?”
The Madam beside her had her eyes slightly lit up: “Yes, yes, that’s what I mean.”
Every time she told her husband about this, he would say she was narrow-minded. Today, finally someone agreed with her.
The Madam previously thought that she was being pretentious, but now it seems that it is not the case.
Seeing that Liang Wenyin next to him hadn’t said anything, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but turn around and ask, “What about you? After hearing about this, do you feel uncomfortable?”
Liang Wenyin hesitated for a moment and nodded: “I am a little… not very happy.”
“It’s right that you’re unhappy. You did nothing wrong in this matter.” Ye Shuo made the final decision, which made the tutor next to him very angry.
Ye Shuo didn’t even look at him, and then asked: “What happened next? Did you go to ask that Master Cao?”
Although Liang Wenyin looked weak, she was, after all, a delicate young lady raised in the Taifu’s mansion since she was a child, so she would naturally speak out if she was unhappy.
So she said: “Yes, he asked, but…but he said I was unreasonable, and said that I was jealous…”
When she finished speaking, Liang Wenyin obviously hesitated for a moment. It was obvious that she had reflected on herself, and the shame in her eyes proved that she also felt that it was her own problem.
In the eyes of the Taifu, it was just unreasonable, but the word “jealous” was too strong, and the Taifu was not very happy to hear it.
Ye Shuo has basically confirmed that this Cao is most likely a scumbag.
He couldn’t argue or felt guilty so he just put the blame on the woman. This is what the old scumbag did.
“Was he very angry at the time? Was he very loud? Was he also a little angry out of shame?”
Liang Wenyin recalled it and nodded hurriedly: “Yes, yes, yes.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
This familiar operation was too familiar to Ye Shuo, a veteran who had been in the business for many years.
When a man feels guilty, he tends to use anger to cover up himself. There’s nothing you can do about it. Who made you hit his sore spot?
Of course, this alone is not enough, Ye Shuo continued to ask: “What else, is there anything else?”
Otherwise…
The Madam thought for a moment and continued, “I didn’t hear anything about it afterward, except that Yin’er saw the young master of the Cao family punishing the servants in his yard a few times. I heard that he was quite harsh and the servants even bled…”
The Taifu next to him couldn’t help but snorted coldly: “Women’s kindness.”
The Grand Tutor felt that women were not good enough, they were soft-hearted and confused. But why couldn’t he be beaten because the servant had dirty hands and feet?
The statements of the Grand Tutor and the Madam were almost completely opposite, but Ye Shuo could hear something different, so he asked, “Grand Tutor, how did you know that the servant made a mistake? You were not there at the time, and you didn’t see it.”
The Grand Tutor answered casually: “Of course, the young master of the Cao family told me.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh: “Look, one is what niece Wen Yin saw with her own eyes, and the other is what Cao explained to you.”
Between the two, even a fool knows which one is more reliable, right?
Upon hearing this, the Grand Tutor was stunned for a moment.
But the Grand Tutor still didn’t believe these things were true. Liang Wenyin was his granddaughter. His eldest daughter died early, leaving behind this daughter. How could he not love her?
Therefore, when choosing a husband for her, the Grand Tutor carefully selected the Cao family.
“The Cao family has a clean and upright family tradition for generations. There is a family motto that a man can take a concubine only when he is 40 and has no children.”
Ye Shuo shook his head: “Don’t believe all rumors. Bad bamboo can produce good bamboo shoots, so how can good bamboo shoots not produce bad bamboo? This can only prove that the Cao family is good, not that Mr. Cao is good.” If he really took a concubine, could the Cao family still kick him out of the house because of this? Think about it, Mr. Cao is the Cao family’s biological son.
The Grand Tutor added, “I have met Master Cao many times. He is truly a gentleman, well-mannered and polite, and a child who knows when to advance and when to retreat.” The Grand Tutor has been watching over him all these years, as he is also afraid that his grandson-in-law will grow up to be a bad person.
Ye Shuo shook his head again: “You can’t know a person’s heart by his appearance. You are the current imperial tutor, a first-rank official. Except for me, everyone in the younger generation is polite when they see you. Doesn’t my third brother have to bow to you when he sees you? He is the crown prince.”
Ye Shuo has been a man for two lifetimes, and he knows very well that if you want to understand a man’s character, you can’t just look at how he behaves when he is in glory. When he is in glory, everyone can pretend, and it is really not difficult. The real way to understand a man’s character is to look at his bottom line when he is down and out.
If the other person can maintain his status quo, or has not fallen too far, then even if he is bad, he is not that bad.
So it’s not enough to just hear about it, you have to try it yourself.
After all, it’s someone’s lifelong happiness, how can you treat it so lightly?
However, the Grand Tutor beside him was almost mad at him. It turned out that the Ninth Prince himself knew that he had no manners at all around him!
Ye Shuo pondered for a long time and felt that these alone were not enough, far from enough.
In this era, the Madam and Liang Wenyin were talking about minor issues that might not even be considered problems in the eyes of others.
There must be more to it than just this, as they both opposed it and even asked the Imperial Tutor to cancel the engagement.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo asked.
…The Ninth Prince is really sharp!
The Madam and Liang Wenyin were both surprised and even shocked by his question.
