There were indeed more reasons for breaking off the engagement. The Madam did not even tell her husband because she and her granddaughter found it absurd, even ridiculous.
The Madam never dared to tell it out loud, because if she did, her husband would get very angry.
But now that the Ninth Prince has brought it up, the Madam finally decided to speak out.
You can’t keep it a secret forever, right?
After a long while, she hesitated and said, “Actually, the reason why Yin’er and I are so opposed is because… because we both feel uncomfortable when we see the young master of the Cao family…”
It’s hard to describe what kind of feeling it is, it’s just annoyance and dislike. The other person hasn’t done anything wrong, but he is just so unlikable.
Sure enough, as soon as the words fell, the Grand Tutor became furious.
After all, this reason seemed like a joke to him.
The marriage had been arranged for so many years, but in the end his wife told his granddaughter that she objected for such inexplicable reasons. How could the Taifu accept this?
The Grand Tutor felt that even the Ninth Prince would be angry this time, and would think that the two of them were not getting along, right?
But when he turned around, he found that the Ninth Prince’s expression was more serious than before. The Taifu’s eyes widened instantly, and he couldn’t even breathe.
Ye Shuo was not pretending, he really felt that the situation described by the Madam and his cheap niece at the end was more serious than the previous ones.
Think about it, if the cheap niece is rejecting the young master of the Cao family from the bottom of her heart, then the young master of the Cao family is useless no matter whether he is good or bad. How can the two of them live on?
It would have been fine if she was the only one feeling this way, but the Madam actually had the same feeling.
Ye Shuo was once a modern man, and he still believed in the concept of chemistry. If he didn’t like someone, then he didn’t like them.
And women’s sixth sense can be quite scary sometimes.
Ye Shuo nodded and said, “I understand, but this is not a solution. The wedding is coming soon and we can’t delay it. How about we think of a way and give it a try first?”
The Ninth Prince actually believed it…
He didn’t even have any perfunctory intentions…
Not to mention the young Liang Wenyin, even the Madam was unable to come back to her senses for a long time.
The Taifu looked at this, then looked at that, and suddenly everything in front of his eyes went dark.
The Master held his chest tightly, unable to hold back anymore, and flew into a rage: “You three, are you listening to me?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Repentance
chapters.content:
“I’m listening, I’m listening.”
“Master, are you tired? Why don’t you sit down and take a rest?”
Although Ye Shuo kept saying that he was listening, anyone who was not deaf could tell that he was being perfunctory.
This was the first time in Taifu’s life that he was ignored so thoroughly.
After all, her granddaughter’s marriage is more important at the moment. Although the Madam is usually very obedient to her husband, she is in no mood to pay attention to him now.
Looking at the old, the young and the child gathered together, whispering to each other about something, the Taifu inexplicably felt like he was left out by the three of them.
In the past, no matter the big or small things in the family, everyone would ask for his opinion.
Only when he nodded, the matter was settled.
Look at it now, has anyone ever asked him even a single question?
Am I still the head of this family?The Master suddenly felt a sense of loss.
But the Grand Tutor really couldn’t bring himself to get involved. After all, it was his daughter’s private matter. What was the point of an old man like him asking about it every day?
The Grand Tutor was puzzled. Why was the Ninth Prince so shameless, and how could he talk about this so confidently?
If Ye Shuo could realize what the Grand Tutor was thinking at this moment, he would definitely reply to him that he deserved it.
Since he is impatient to listen to his wife nagging about the children and thinks that their matters are trivial, naturally there will be others willing to listen, and he just needs to not feel uncomfortable at that time.
Ye Shuo was quite willing to listen and was not annoyed at all. He was even more willing to give his own opinions.
The Madam’s performance was indeed a bit excited.
After all, she finally met someone who was willing to listen. Although he was a little younger, he was not perfunctory at all. He also did not push all the blame onto the two of them, thinking that they were stingy.
The Ninth Prince was often able to point out problems immediately and perfectly summed up the issues that the Madam and Liang Wenyin were struggling with.
Later, there were even tears in the Madam’s eyes.
After all, for a woman like her who lives in a deep house, she has no money and no power, so what’s the point of studying? She still has to rely on her husband. If her husband doesn’t listen to her opinions, then she will be helpless.
And just at this moment, the Ninth Prince appeared.
It was like a life-saving straw. How could the Madam not feel grateful?
“Thank you, Ninth Prince. But will this… be unfair to the Ninth Prince?” Thinking of the method he just mentioned, the Madam couldn’t help but feel a little hesitant.
The man in front of her was a descendant of the emperor. Asking him to come forward and do such a thing made the Madam feel uneasy.
Ye Shuo waved his hand nonchalantly: “Don’t worry, it won’t happen.” He was just pretending to be a beggar. He had never played a role-playing game before, but just thinking about it was exciting.
Although it is not a good idea to test a person in this way, special cases should be treated specially.
In modern times, men and women are free people, and if they can’t live together after marriage, they can just get divorced. In this case, testing each other is indeed a bit excessive.
But this was in ancient times. Once married, a woman was basically tied to her husband for life and could not easily break free. Shouldn’t she be more cautious in this situation?
You can’t just say that no matter whether the young master of the Cao family is good or bad, your cheap niece has to accept it with a pinch of her nose, right?
It is better to find out in advance while things are still not finalized and there is still a chance to regret than to cry your eyes out later.
So if the means are dishonorable, then it’s better to be dishonorable.
Ye Shuo is not the kind of person who only sticks to formalities. How to solve the problem is the most important thing.
“For the time being, we have set three small goals. First, to see if he is two-faced, arrogant at first and respectful later. Second, to see if he really has violent tendencies. Third, if possible, to see if he and his cousin really have an improper relationship between men and women.”
Based on his previous conversation with the Madam, Ye Shuo’s goal was very clear.
Now that we have noticed such signs in the young master of the Cao family, let’s start with these three aspects to verify their authenticity.
“By the way, I forgot to ask, how is the cousin from the Cao family doing recently? Isn’t she not much younger than the young master of the Cao family? If we calculate by age, she should have reached the age of marriage for a long time, right?” The young master of the Cao family has reached the age of coming of age this year, so the cousin should be about eighteen or nineteen years old, a little older than my cheap niece.
the Madam said hurriedly, “When the cousin of the Cao family was in the Cao family, she was already waiting to get married. Her family was not very wealthy, so she thought it would be better to marry out of the Cao family. She got married last year.”
In a nutshell, the cousin from the Cao family came here just to gild herself.
If you’ve already left, it’ll be difficult to deal with.
However, it is enough to just grasp the first two points.
Being smooth is not a big problem, at most it may annoy people. However, it is enough to prove this point, at least it can make the young master of Cao family less perfect in the heart of the Taifu. With this premise, if the cheap niece is too unlucky and ends up getting married unfortunately, when she goes home and cries, she will not say that the Taifu will not listen at all.
Of course, it would be better not to marry. Since she was already tired of him, Ye Shuo felt that this marriage was almost a failure.
“You don’t have to do anything then, just watch the whole process.”
“Don’t worry, if you still don’t want to get married at that time, I, your uncle, will never let you put your trust in the wrong person.” He couldn’t do that for the sake of the Crown Princess.
It was really funny for a seven-year-old child to say such things, but Liang Wenyin not only did not find it funny, but she choked up instead.
In the past year, as the wedding date approached, she hadn’t felt so relaxed for a long time.
After she realized what was happening, Liang Wenyin quickly wiped her eyes with a handkerchief and knelt down jokingly: “Wenyin would like to thank you, little uncle, in advance.”
It can be seen that she was in great distress before. Things were not settled yet, but her spirit was already different.
The Taifu standing by was completely dumbfounded.
What’s going on? Why are you still crying?
Looking at his wife next to him, she didn’t seem to be much better.
As for the discussion process, everyone lowered their voices at the same time, so the Master didn’t hear a single word. He was completely excluded.
Later, the Grand Tutor knew what the highest level of VIP treatment was.
When the Madam ordered the servants to decorate the room, the Grand Tutor watched helplessly as his wife took out all the best things in the house.
That roll of horn curtain was extremely finely crafted. It was originally intended to be used as a dowry for the granddaughter, but now it was also spread on the Ninth Prince’s bed.
Although the weather has been a little hot recently, it is not summer yet. Fearing that he would feel cold in the middle of the night, the Madam asked someone to put a thin mattress on top of the cot. The mattress was so silky and soft that the Grand Tutor had never used it in his life, let alone put it under his body.
See? This is what happens when you refuse to listen to your wife.
Giving the tutor a smug look, Ye Shuo walked leisurely into the room specially prepared for him by the Madam, leaving the tutor standing there with a frozen face.
“Can you tell me what you discussed behind my back?” When he was about to go to bed at night, the Master couldn’t hold it in any longer and asked.
But it’s too late now.
Fearing that he might sabotage her, the Madam pretended to be asleep and didn’t hear anything.
The Grand Tutor stared at the ceiling of the bed, unable to understand why everything had changed so much when the Ninth Prince had only been here for less than one night.
The other side.
When Emperor Jingwen heard the imperial concubine say that her son had left the palace to study with the imperial tutor, his first reaction was disbelief.
How could he not know what kind of temper that little bastard has?
It would be strange if it was really about studying!
Only the imperial concubine was deceived by him every time.
In the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, a dog can never change its own nature. His son’s recent performance has been a little better than before, but he would never believe that he could be so motivated.
Seeing Emperor Jingwen’s face full of suspicion, Concubine Rong immediately became unhappy: “Your Majesty, you look down on Shuo’er too much. Why can’t Shuo’er suddenly come to his senses?”
He? Come to his senses? ?
Emperor Jingwen would not have had such a beautiful dream.
“In this case, Your Majesty, how about you make a bet with me?”
Seeing the imperial concubine’s eyes flickering and her face full of expectation, Emperor Jingwen immediately knew that she must have something to ask for.
Emperor Jingwen raised his eyebrows, showing no fear at all: “Tell me, what are you betting on?”
“How about we bet on the batch of materials that were newly tribute this year?” The imperial concubine said without hesitation, almost blurting out the answer. It was obvious that she had planned this for a long time.
There was no other way. Summer was coming, and it was the time to wear beautiful clothes. Although the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion had also sent a batch of good fabrics, they were certainly not as good as those presented to the emperor.
The imperial concubine overheard it by accident a few days ago, and now she is almost dying of greed.
Emperor Jingwen made a straight hook and Concubine Rong immediately started to jump down.
Emperor Jingwen thought it was something else, but it turned out to be just this?
He couldn’t help but laugh: “It’s just a small matter. I allow you to do it, but…”
Seeing the imperial concubine looking at him eagerly, he had whetted her appetite. It took a long time for Emperor Jingwen to finish his next words: “But if you lose, what will you give me as compensation?”
What could she have to pay? She was already in the palace.
Concubine Rong was trying to get something for nothing: “Just wait and see, I will not lose!”
God bless you, the little bastard must keep his word this time!
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but admire his imperial concubine. She actually dared to place her trust in her son. What kind of person was their son? Could it be that she still——
As he was talking, Wang Ziquan walked in and said, “Your Majesty, someone from the Grand Tutor’s Mansion just came over to deliver a message.”
After a dozen breaths, Emperor Jingwen was stunned after hearing the message.
It’s actually true!
The sun rises from the west!
Emperor Jingwen once again felt heartfelt joy, but no matter what, even if he was the emperor, he could not have imagined that the Taifu, who was so old-fashioned on weekdays, would actually collude with his son.
His son did not turn over a new leaf, but quietly stepped onto a new level.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know, so he is very happy now.
Concubine Rong was also very happy to have obtained several rolls of high-quality cloth for free.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Beggar
chapters.content:
The next morning, Ye Shuo looked at the tattered clothes that the Madam had specially prepared for him, and no matter how he looked at them, they didn’t look like those worn by a beggar.
Perhaps considering his status as a prince, the Madam was still too conservative.
Ye Shuo didn’t say anything at first. After washing up and eating, Ye Shuo asked, “Did the young master of the Cao family respond to you?”
Liang Wenyin nodded: “He has agreed to accompany me to the parade this morning.”
The customs of the people in the Great Zhou were relatively open, and there was no such thing as women being confined to their homes. If women wanted to do some small business, that was still possible.
After all, it was allowed by both parents, and there was nothing wrong with a man and a woman who were engaged going shopping together.
Ye Shuo never imagined that his adopted niece would be rejected by the young master of the Cao family. After all, his adopted niece was the granddaughter of the Grand Tutor, and now she was the niece of the Crown Princess. No matter what the young master of the Cao family thought, he was unlikely to refuse.
After Ye Shuo had eaten and drunk his fill, he always felt that the surroundings seemed too quiet, as if something was missing.
Then he patted his head and remembered that at this time, the tutor was probably going to court.
It’s really hard for him to concentrate on work at this time.But in fact, Ye Shuo overestimated the master by thinking this way. With such a devil in the family, how could the master concentrate on his work?
The prince had seen his teacher distracted more than once or twice.
What’s wrong with the teacher today?
The prince looked puzzled.
“Teacher…Teacher…?”
“Father is calling you.”
He suddenly came back to his senses and met Emperor Jingwen’s approving gaze, and the Taifu felt even more pressured.
I really hope the time will pass sooner…
The Grand Tutor had never felt that attending court was so torturous.
After finally waiting until the end of the court session, the prince came forward with a concerned look on his face: “Teacher, are you okay? By the way, I heard that Xiaojiu is with you? Xiaojiu…”
“I’m sorry, Your Highness, I can’t say much to you. I have to go home early today.” Without even bothering to greet his favorite student, the tutor left in a hurry after saying this.
“If it’s any later, my house will probably be demolished by the Ninth Prince!”
Looking at his teacher’s anxious back, and then at his father who was obviously in a good mood, the prince couldn’t help but took a breath.
The other side.
After Ye Shuo had eaten and drunk his fill, he rolled on the ground several times in front of everyone, and in the process painted his face, neck, and hands, which were most easily exposed, black.
After looking at the bronze mirror, he felt that it would be difficult to fool a real beggar, but if he wanted to fool a rich young master, it should be no problem. Ye Shuo put the mirror down with satisfaction.
The Madam beside him seemed to be hesitant to speak, as if she wanted to persuade him.
Looking at the little Lu Zi next to him, he had already knelt down with a plop: “Your Highness, if you have anything to do, just let me do it. Why do you have to waste yourself like this, Your Highness!”
If the imperial concubine knew about this, I would be in big trouble.
It’s just pretending to be a beggar, he can do it!
But…how could Ye Shuo possibly hand over such an interesting thing to Xiao Luzi? What fun would that be?
Although Ye Shuo is more playful, he does not neglect this operation. Wouldn’t it be better if he could take both into account?
So how could Ye Shuo let Xiao Luzi ruin his gaming experience?
In order to make it more realistic, he even asked the kitchen of Taifu Mansion for some stale water from the previous night and sprinkled it on himself.
Taking a bath is a luxury for beggars. It is impossible for a real beggar to have no smell at all.
Soon, Ye Shuo’s whole body became smelly, which was somewhat similar to the feeling of sweating too much and not washing.
The Ninth Prince in front of him performed his entire set of movements smoothly, which stunned Liang Wenyin, who was a little nervous on the side.
The movements were so smooth, it didn’t feel like it was my first time at all…
Just when Liang Wenyin was stunned, Xing Yucheng also arrived.
After all, Xing Yucheng was also the son of an official, so he must have known more rumors about the young master of the Cao family than a girl like Liang Wenyin who never left her house, so Ye Shuo called him over as well.
Xing Yucheng was not prepared at all. He was shocked when he saw a beggar standing in the main room of the Grand Tutor’s Mansion.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo immediately felt relieved: “It seems that my disguise skills are pretty good.”
If he could even fool his own study partner, the young master of the Cao family should be no problem at all.
Hearing the familiar voice, Xing Yucheng finally reacted: “Your Highness!?”
“Hey, why are you shouting? Don’t be so excited, calm down.” Ye Shuo rubbed his ears and didn’t care.
Xing Yucheng felt dizzy.
Not surprisingly, the Ninth Prince was going to do something weird again.
Xing Yucheng found that he was no longer surprised and became particularly calm. How long had he been with the Ninth Prince? He had already successfully trained himself.
After the Si hour, Ye Shuo heard some noise at the door and guessed it must be the young master of the Cao family.
“If I really want to cancel the engagement, wouldn’t it be a bit too willful? Would it implicate Aunt Wan?” The Aunt Wan that Liang Wenyin mentioned was none other than the Crown Princess.
Women of this era have always been like this. The first thing they consider is not themselves, but the family behind them.
“What if Aunt Wan’s reputation is affected?” Aunt Wan had finally secured her position as the Crown Princess. If she was implicated because of something like this, she would be blamed for her death.
Liang Wenyin tossed and turned all night last night, and the more she thought about it, the more uneasy she felt.
Ye Shuo could understand that when a person takes the first step, it always seems extra difficult.
“You only think about whether it will affect your aunt Wan’s reputation. Why don’t you think about it the other way around? Does the Cao family dare to involve your aunt Wan’s reputation? Will my royal family allow the Cao family to involve the reputation of the Crown Princess?” Ye Shuo had some understanding of his adoptive father. As for the Crown Prince, although he looked easy to talk to, he was actually not a soft person.
Liang Wenyin was stunned.
Ye Shuo immediately made the final decision: “So, go forward boldly and don’t waste such a good status of yours.”
Liang Wenyin finally came to her senses.
They had agreed to act out a play later, so Ye Shuo definitely couldn’t expose himself so early. When Liang Wenyin followed the young master of the Cao family out, Ye Shuo hid behind the screen wall.
After the two of them left, Ye Shuo took advantage of the young master of the Cao family not paying attention and secretly glanced at him from behind.
Judging from his dress and even his appearance, this man does look like a decent human being, but one cannot judge a book by its cover. Ye Shuo has seen many people who look good on the outside but are actually beasts in human clothing.
Knowing that the two of them would go to Baoyu Pavilion later, Ye Shuo hurried towards the Baoyu Pavilion while asking his study partner about the details.
Soon Ye Shuo learned that although the Cao family was not a family of aristocracy, they were also noble for generations, and most importantly, they had a good family tradition. They were indeed a rare good family in Shangjing City.
The head of Cao family now is Cao Luyi, the father of the young master of Cao family. Cao Luyi is over fifty years old. Although he is only a third-rank Si Nong, the post of Si Nong is related to food and people’s livelihood, so he is not treated as an ordinary person.
The youngest son of the Cao family is named Cao Rui. He has three older brothers, all of whom only married one wife. With his three older brothers in the lead, Cao Rui’s marriage will naturally attract a lot of attention, especially those families who love their daughters. They are all eager to find a son-in-law from the Cao family. However, when they heard that Cao Rui had been betrothed by the imperial tutor when he was young, those families gave up.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo felt something was wrong, so he interrupted Xing Yucheng who was talking freely and asked, “How do you know so much about the Cao family?”
Although we are in the same circle, it doesn’t mean that we know everything about them, right?
At first Ye Shuo just wanted to get a general idea, but he didn’t expect that as he listened, he almost understood the situation of the other person’s past three generations.
The most important thing is that Xing Yucheng is only 12 years old now. He is not yet old enough to join the circle, but he is so clear about it. It feels a bit wrong.
Xing Yucheng didn’t think too much about it. After all, the Cao family had a good reputation and was well-known in Shangjing City.
After hearing what he said, Ye Shuo felt even more weird.
Since the other party is known for his upright family tradition, he should not care about false reputation as much as others do. But now it seems that this is not the case.
It seems more like an advertisement that is deliberately put out, as if it is attracting and recruiting something.
Ye Shuo then asked: “Are the daughters-in-law of the Cao family of higher birth than the Cao family itself?”
This was the first time Xing Yucheng heard this question. After thinking about it carefully, he found that it seemed to be true.
It’s not that Xing Yucheng is gossipy, it’s mainly because the Cao family is too famous, and he can’t help but know about it.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smack his lips after hearing this.
“Okay, go on. What is Cao Rui’s reputation?”
Xing Yucheng barely hesitated: “Cao Rui has always had a good reputation. My mother even praised him before.”
“What about the people around him? Especially his friends, what about their reputation?” Ye Shuo still believed in the saying of like-minded people, because people with different values ​​basically can’t get along well.
This question stumped Xing Yucheng: “I don’t know about this… No, wait, I suddenly remembered that Cao Rui seemed to have two playmates who grew up together. I heard that the two playmates were not very good, but because they grew up together, Cao Rui did not alienate them. Many people around me think he is kind and righteous.”
Ye Shuo nodded, indicating that he understood, and then he asked: “What about Cao Rui himself, is he considered outstanding among the children of officials?”
“I don’t think so…” Xing Yucheng hesitated: “I feel he is not as good as me.”
Ye Shuo was somewhat aware of his study partner’s abilities, and he immediately said, “I understand. You are excellent.”
Xing Yucheng was stunned for a moment, then he was overjoyed when he came to his senses.
The Ninth Prince is bragging about himself!
“Don’t be too happy yet. One last question. How is he, compared to his three brothers?” After all, other people’s children are still other people’s children. There is a sense of distance. But your own children are different. That can be seen and touched.
Xing Yucheng forced himself to stop laughing, thought for a moment, and then shook his head: “A little bit inferior. At his age, his brothers have all achieved fame and honor, but he has nothing now.”
“Okay, I think I understand what’s going on.”
After such a thorough investigation, Ye Shuo felt that the possibility that the young master of the Cao family, or even the entire Cao family, was good, was very low.
However, what you hear is not as good as what you see, so it still needs to be verified in the end.
Just like that, Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi watched helplessly as the extremely noble Ninth Prince took out a broken bowl from somewhere, put the bowl there, and then squatted down at the door of the Baoyu Pavilion very skillfully.
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi were stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Inside and Outside
chapters.content:
“Don’t just stand there, why don’t you go somewhere cool?” The two of them here really affected his performance.
Seeing that people passing by had begun to notice this place and cast puzzled glances in this direction, Ye Shuo waved his hands with a look of disgust on his face.
Looking at the enthusiastic Ninth Prince, Xing Yucheng choked and once again deeply regretted that he had followed the wrong person.
But now that things have come to this, there is no way to regret, and in a panic, Xing Yucheng can only find a seat at the noodle soup stall opposite.
As for Xiao Luzi, Ye Shuo assigned him another task.
After everything was ready, Liang Wenyin and the young master of the Cao family slowly appeared at the end of the road not far away.
Ye Shuo specifically asked Liang Wenyin to choose the Baoyu Pavilion which was a little far away. Liang Wenyin was weak and could not walk too fast. If Ye Shuo took a shortcut with Xing Yucheng who was familiar with the terrain of Shangjing, he would be able to arrive before the two of them.
Now it seems that the timing was just right.
Ye Shuo quickly calmed down and got into the role quickly.
On the other side, the palace——After the court session, Emperor Jingwen wanted to praise the Grand Tutor individually, but Wang Ziquan came over and said that the Grand Tutor had left early.
Why did he leave so early today? Usually, didn’t he go to the East Palace to sit for a while?
However, Emperor Jingwen did not think too much about it. After the prince came over, the father and son held each other and prepared to go to the Qinzheng Hall.
On the way, Emperor Jingwen thought of something, so he said to Wang Ziquan: “Oh, by the way, ask the Prince of Jin to come over as well. I have something to tell him.”
His younger brother has been very idle recently. He is over 30 years old and has not accomplished anything. Emperor Jingwen plans to assign him some tasks to prevent him from being idle all day and doing nothing.
So, the Prince of Jin finally waited until the court session was over and was about to go home for a good sleep, but he was blocked by Eunuch Wang and his men.
Prince Jin immediately had a bad feeling in his heart.
What’s wrong with my brother, the emperor? He’s busy as he is, but why can’t he bear to see others having some free time?
Prince Jin wanted to run away, but how could he escape?
There was no choice but to follow Wang Ziquan to the Qinzheng Hall to meet his brother.
As expected, Emperor Jingwen treated Prince Jin mercilessly and assigned him a lot of tasks.
Although these tasks are not very difficult, they are very fragmented and time-consuming.
Prince Jin immediately looked miserable.
But there is no way, things have come to this point, and it seems there is no way to escape.
Before he lost his freedom, the King of Jin wanted to struggle one last time, so he said: “Brother, the weather is so nice today, it would be a pity to waste it. Why don’t you go for a walk outside the palace with your brother?”
King Jin decided to use the tactic of delaying.
How could Emperor Jingwen not know his plan? Just when he was about to say that no matter what he said today, he had to report to the six ministries, Emperor Jingwen suddenly thought of something.
“Well, that’s fine.” He suddenly remembered that he had not left the palace for a long time. Xiaojiu was also outside the palace, so Emperor Jingwen planned to see what his son was learning.
“When the time comes, you can also stop by the Taifu Mansion to see Xiaojiu.” After all, this was his son’s first time out of the palace, and Emperor Jingwen was worried that the child would not be used to it.
The Crown Prince, who was helping to review memorials, heard this and his hands trembled, almost ruining the memorial in his hands.
Although the crown prince didn’t know what his ninth brother had done, judging from his teacher’s expression and state, it didn’t seem like a good thing.
If the Emperor knew about this…
“Father, please take me with you as well.” The prince said hurriedly.
Emperor Jingwen did not doubt him: “Well, it would be good for you to relax with us.”
Prince Jin on the side was a little surprised. He had only mentioned it casually and had not thought it would be successful.
I didn’t expect that both the emperor and the crown prince would be so supportive.
King Jin was a little confused.
Emperor Jingwen quickly changed into his casual clothes with the help of the palace servants. Then, the emperor, the crown prince and the prince, a group of three, left the palace in a carriage.
Outside the palace, there was a lot of noise and everything was lively and orderly. Emperor Jingwen lifted the curtain and took a look, and he couldn’t help but feel satisfied.
After all, under his governance, the people can live and work in peace and contentment. Which emperor would not feel proud?
At the same time, at the Taifu Mansion.
The Grand Tutor hurried back, and when he learned that the Ninth Prince had gone out, he felt terrible.
He didn’t expect that he hurried like this, but still couldn’t make it in time…
For a moment, the Grand Tutor felt that he should ask for leave, but then he thought, the Ninth Prince would be staying with him for ten days or so, and he couldn’t ask for leave for all these ten days, right?
Looking at his wife, who knew something but refused to tell him the truth, the Taifu felt extremely powerless.
Perhaps he was too anxious, the tutor couldn’t help but had a quarrel with his wife.
If it were in the past, the Madam might have given in, but this time, the Madam seemed to be determined and refused to give in no matter what.
This originally gentle person becomes more terrifying than you might imagine when he gets angry.
This concerned the lifelong happiness of his granddaughter. For a moment, even the imperial tutor of the time was overwhelmed by the Madam.
The Madam has now figured it out. Just as the Ninth Prince said, her youngest daughter is already the Crown Princess, and she is the Crown Princess’s biological mother. She doesn’t believe that her husband would dare to do anything to her.
The Grand Tutor had never encountered such a thing in his life. No matter how great a contemporary scholar he was, he was still no match for him.
The housekeeper and servants nearby watched helplessly, not knowing whether to persuade him or not. The whole Taifu’s mansion was in chaos.
On the other side, outside the Baoyu Pavilion——
Originally, beggars were not allowed in places like this. If there were beggars, the ladies and wives of dignitaries would not dare to come.
But there was nothing you could do, Ye Shuo was just too quiet, and obviously a little kid, he didn’t say a word at all, he was quiet and timid, just staring at you with his eyes wide open, those clear black and white eyes made people’s hearts soften.
When a lady or young lady came over, Ye Shuo would take the initiative to move back as if he was afraid of scaring them, for fear of dirtying their clean and bright clothes.
It’s just like the difference between wild monkeys and golden monkeys at tourist attractions. Wild monkeys are blatantly robbing and hurting people, so they are definitely not liked, but golden monkeys are well-behaved and polite, so people are naturally more willing to take the initiative to feed them.
Women are naturally soft-hearted, especially those young ladies who are ignorant of the ways of the world. Seeing this scene, they felt a little sorry.
Some even asked their maids to buy two buns for Ye Shuo from the stall next door. Ye Shuo did not need to get his hands dirty to receive the buns. He just held the bowl and let the maids put the buns in the bowl without touching them the whole time. As a result, the maids who originally disliked him began to like him more.
Xing Yucheng, who was sitting opposite, watched helplessly as within a short while, the Ninth Prince’s feet were filled with candied fruits, meat buns, snacks from the Jixiangzhai next door, and a number of copper coins for the ladies to sweeten their mouths.
What’s more, some people have already started to inquire, asking whether the Ninth Prince is willing to go home with him and become a servant in his own house.
Xing Yucheng: “…”
Xing Yucheng’s jaw almost dropped to the ground.
He saw clearly that the one who asked the Ninth Prince whether he wanted to go with him was Prime Minister He’s granddaughter!
Ye Shuo also found that he was overacting. Looking at the maid in front of him who was speaking softly, Ye Shuo felt a little caught in a dilemma and felt that this was not going to end well.
Fortunately, Liang Wenyin and the young master of the Cao family arrived at this time, and Ye Shuo breathed a sigh of relief.
Liang Wenyin noticed the movement from a distance. At first, she didn’t think too much about it, but when she got closer and saw that it was Ye Shuo, she was immediately startled.
As for the reaction of the young master of the Cao family, it was much more direct.
“Where did this beggar come from, shopkeeper, is this how you do business?”
Noticing the thick layer of black mud marks on Ye Shuo’s hands, feet and neck, Cao Rui, who had always lived a life of luxury, couldn’t help but show a hint of disgust in his eyes.
What Cao Rui was thinking was that he had finally gotten to hang out with Liang Wenyin, so naturally he should perform well.
It would have been fine if no customer had mentioned it before, but now that someone has spoken up, the owner of Baoyu Pavilion will naturally take care of it.
“Go away, little beggar, this is not a place for you to stay! Take your things and leave quickly!”
Ye Shuo took advantage of the waiter’s pushing and shoving to pretend to be panicked, and then the meat bun in his hand slipped out of his hand and happened to hit the clothes of the young master of the Cao family.
With a “smack”, the meat bun left a clear grease mark on Cao Rui’s clothes.
The shopkeeper and the clerks of Baoyu Pavilion took a deep breath at the same time. Ye Shuo seemed to be frightened and did not dare to move at all.
This is the best outfit I put on specially to accompany Liang Wenyin!
A deep gloom flashed across Cao Rui’s eyes uncontrollably.
Ye Shuo felt that there was something wrong with the young man in front of him. He could understand that people would be angry if their clothes were soiled, and this reaction was normal. But if someone soiled your clothes, and you wanted to kill him directly, that was not normal.
Ye Shuo was panicked: “S-sorry, I, I…”
Liang Wenyin reacted instantly and followed suit, “Master Cao, I don’t think this little beggar did it on purpose. We just happened to be near the Jade Pavilion. How about I pick a new one for you?”
[1] Jade pavilion = Baoyu pavilion
Your family is poor, how much money can you spare?
Cao Rui subconsciously wanted to say this, but the moment the words came out of his mouth, he held them back.
Almost the moment he raised his head, Cao Rui’s face was filled with a bright smile again. If Ye Shuo had not been small and paying special attention to him, he would not have noticed it at all.
What Cao Rui said was completely opposite to what he was thinking: “It doesn’t matter, it’s just a piece of clothing. But this beggar looks a bit pitiful.”
Cao Rui’s behavior made the young ladies around him dazzled.
Only Liang Wenyin felt that the uncomfortable feeling from before came back.
“How about this, since you, a beggar, have soiled my clothes, why don’t you come to my house and work as a servant, selling your body to pay off your debt?” Although it was called selling one’s body, for the little beggar in front of him, it was clearly giving him a way to survive.
Being able to work as a servant in an official’s house would at least allow him to have enough food to eat, and he wouldn’t have to rely on begging for a living like he does now.
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo was like a real little beggar, with a strong surprise in his eyes: “Thank you very much, sir, thank you very much, sir, I do!”
He Xiang’s granddaughter, who was standing by, didn’t say much when she saw this, but called her personal maid back.
But in fact, Cao Rui was very angry in his heart, how could he be so kind?
Sometimes, others may think that everyone is having a good time, but in fact, hell is right before their eyes.
He ruined his nice clothes and still wanted to enter the official’s house to enjoy the good life? Dream on!
Cao Rui couldn’t wait to see the little beggar’s desperate expression when his dream was shattered.
The excitement in his eyes flashed by and quickly subsided. Cao Rui winked at the servant beside him: “What are you still standing there for? This is the future servant of our family. Look how dirty he is. Why don’t you take him to wash it quickly?”
Cao Rui’s gentle attitude won him the favor of people around him.
Ye Shuo seemed to be completely unaware and obediently followed the servant beside Cao Rui. After all, he also wanted to know how far Cao Rui could go.
References
↑1Jade pavilion = Baoyu pavilion

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Girl
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo deliberately chose the identity of a beggar in order to find out the true background of the young master of the Cao family.
Most of the beggars in Shangjing City are refugees who have flocked in from other places. They have no household registration and are basically not protected by the laws of the Great Zhou.
In other words, if a person becomes a beggar, anyone can take his/her life. As long as he/she is not beaten to death in the street and is done covertly, few people will pursue the matter.
Now Ye Shuo, who is a beggar, is like a powerless baby in front of Cao Rui, and Cao Rui is the giant who can decide his life and death. In this situation, Ye Shuo wants to know what Cao Rui’s bottom line is.
Ye Shuo wanted to see whether this person would stop before crossing the bottom line when the evil of human nature was infinitely magnified.
After all, the Cao family is a family of officials, and the servants around Cao Rui are all capable. However, Ye Shuo has observed that they only have some basic skills, and he can handle them easily.
So Ye Shuo followed the other party without any psychological burden.
Liang Wenyin was a little worried, but when he was leaving, he gave her a look, as if telling her to stay calm and not reveal her true colors. Liang Wenyin could only suppress her anxiety and hold it down.
God bless you, please don’t let anything happen to you…
As for Xing Yucheng, who was sitting opposite, when he saw the Ninth Prince being taken away, he quickly paid for the noodles, bent over, and followed in a flash.Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo’s beggar performance was too realistic, Cao Rui did not suspect anything. In addition, the Grand Tutor’s attitude had always been firm, and Liang Wenyin looked very easy to control. So Cao Rui did not feel wary at all.
He knew that his men would help teach the little beggar a lesson. Thinking of this, Cao Rui felt much better and even the smile on his face became more genuine.
“Don’t worry about it. Cao Hu will take care of him. Let’s go. I heard that Baoyu Pavilion has just launched some new jewelry and head ornaments this month. I’ll take you to take a look. No matter which one you like, just tell me and I’ll buy it for you.”
[1] Cao Hu = Servants used to have their master’s surname, if they were favored.
Knowing that the person in front of him would not accept anything at all, Cao Rui began to take on a lot of things.
Sure enough, upon hearing this, Liang Wenyin’s first reaction was to refuse.
Just like this, the two of them, one in front and the other accompanying, walked into the Baoyu Pavilion one after another.
The other side.
Ye Shuo noticed that the man in front of him was leading him further and further away, and there were fewer and fewer people around them. He probably had an idea in his mind.
It turns out that the man surnamed Cao is not so honest.
However, the other party’s impatience far exceeded Ye Shuo’s expectations.
He had thought that the other party would at least get him into the mansion before taking action, but he didn’t expect that they couldn’t even wait such a short time.
But if you think about it carefully, you will realize that you are just a little beggar now, just a little beggar. Why go to so much trouble? You can just kill him and throw him aside.
Ye Shuo was very sad, and felt that the man surnamed Cao did not value him at all, so he stopped decisively.
“Is this… really the way to Cao’s residence?”
Cao Mansion? This stupid beggar really thinks he is so lucky that he can really go to Cao Mansion?
Hearing this, Cao Hu couldn’t help but laugh.
A big man suddenly laughed in a very quiet alley. The scene was quite creepy.
If Ye Shuo were a real child, a real little beggar, he would have started trembling by now.
But after all, he had some kung fu skills, so he just felt speechless and nothing else.
But this play still has to go on.
So Ye Shuo pretended to be very scared, and shrank back: “You, what are you laughing at…”
“Of course I’m laughing because I think you’re naive.” Seeing that there was no way forward and this was a dead end, the big man simply let go.
“Don’t you know who you have offended?”
Ye Shuo opened his eyes wide, and seemed a little incoherent: “But, but, Master Cao said…”
“Tsk, little beggar, I forgot to tell you that the person you offended was our young master.” Cao Hu raised his eyebrows, with a playful look on his face: “You don’t think that after you soiled our young master’s clothes, our Cao family will still take you in, right?”
As if he finally realized something was wrong, Ye Shuo’s voice suddenly became louder, and even changed its tone: “Impossible! Master Cao clearly promised me!”
“Yes, he promised you. Of course, the prerequisite is that you can successfully crawl to the gate of Cao’s mansion with your hands and feet broken. How about it, do you want to give it a try?” Cao Hu originally planned to take the little beggar to the river in Shangjing City, use the excuse of cleaning him, and then push him down. But since he was discovered by the beggar, he had to change his strategy.
It makes no difference anyway. A beggar with broken limbs has no choice but to die.
“In your next life, please don’t be so careless again…”
Wow, this Cao guy is really perverted. Just because a beggar soiled one of his clothes, he wanted to cripple the beggar’s hands and feet.
Ye Shuo originally had no good impression of this Cao guy, and now his impression of him has directly dropped to negative.
This was not the first time Cao Hu had done this. He approached a little bit closer, ready to admire the little beggar’s desperate struggle from a close distance.
It must be very painful to fall from a beautiful dream into reality.
When Xing Yucheng arrived breathlessly, what he saw was Cao Hu with a hideous grin on his face, forcing the Ninth Prince into a corner.
Xing Yucheng was shocked, and without thinking, he blurted out: “Stop! Don’t touch him!”
Ye Shuo was touched that his study partner came to save him, but looking at Xing Yucheng’s skinny thighs that were not even as thick as the strong men’s arms, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but be silent for a moment.
It felt like he had to save one more person besides himself.
While Cao Hu turned his head, Ye Shuo reached out silently. Just when he was about to clench his five fingers into a fist and hit Cao Hu hard, Ye Shuo suddenly felt that besides Xing Yucheng, there was another strange breath at the entrance of the alley.
There is a specific rhythm in the other person’s breathing, and his steps are extremely light when he walks. If you don’t listen carefully, you can’t hear them at all. He seems like an expert.
No way, could it be that he was sent by his cheap father to protect him secretly? If so, wouldn’t he be exposed if he made a move?
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, and subconsciously retracted his outstretched hand.
The next moment, he was caught like a chick.
Seeing this scene, Xing Yucheng was horrified. However, before he could open his mouth to reveal Ye Shuo’s true identity, someone was faster than him and came in front of Xing Yucheng almost instantly, making Xing Yucheng hold back all the words he hadn’t said.
Xing Yucheng: “You bastard, you know…”
The man who suddenly passed Xing Yucheng said: “Hurry up and put the beggar in your hand down to me!”
It turned out to be a woman’s voice… No, it was a little girl’s voice.
Ye Shuo blinked, looked in the direction of the voice, and soon saw the other person’s appearance.
The little girl was about ten years old, wearing a brand new red dress. After revealing her true face, she no longer controlled her steps. Perhaps she was not used to the current dress. The two tassels on her head swayed back and forth, and half of the silver hairpin was exposed from one of the tassels, making her look funny and lively.
But once the other party starts to take action, it’s a completely different story.
With a “whoosh” sound, Ye Shuo only felt a flash before his eyes, and the next moment Cao Hu’s screams rang in his ears.
The dart thrown by the little girl cut the back of Cao Hu’s hand so deep that the bone was visible. In pain, he had no choice but to throw Ye Shuo out.
“Tick, tick, tick,” the bright red blood soon dripped all over the floor.
Ye Shuo’s feet were in the air, and just when he was hesitating whether to adjust his falling posture, he accidentally saw that the little girl moved again. Ye Shuo closed his eyes, made up his mind, and pretended that he could not react.
The little girl almost grabbed Ye Shuo’s collar and lifted him to the ground.
“…You’re so heavy.” The girl probably didn’t expect the skinny little beggar to be so heavy. She was caught off guard and almost fell to the ground.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo hurriedly helped her up, and when she stood firmly, he quickly let go.
The little girl first felt a heaviness in her arm, but when she turned her head, she saw nothing, so she shook her head and quickly put this little episode behind her.
Seeing Cao Hu rushing over here, the little girl snorted coldly and said, “Humph, I knew you had bad intentions!”
When the conflict occurred, the little girl in red was standing on the second floor of Baoyu Pavilion and was forced by her master to try on various clothes. After seeing the little beggar being taken away by Cao Hu, she suddenly had an idea, and she made an excuse that she found something wrong, and hurriedly escaped from Baoyu Pavilion.
Saying that she found something wrong was just an excuse. Unexpectedly, after following for a while, the girl found that the excuse she made up actually came true, and the little beggar was so pitiful, she couldn’t hold back her anger and started to beat him up.
“Bah! You two, master and servant, are so shameless to go back on your word!”
The moment he finished speaking, Ye Shuo saw the little girl subconsciously touching her waist, but as expected, she touched nothing. Then she realized that she was wearing a new dress and her soft sword was not on her body. The little girl immediately turned the sword into a palm and faced Cao Hu directly.
“She, she, she…” Perhaps because he had never seen what real Kung Fu was like in his life, Xing Yucheng’s jaw almost dropped.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sweat when he saw this.
In the past, he thought that the internal strength he had cultivated for five years was enough, but when he saw this little girl today, he suddenly realized that it was not enough at all.
Outside the palace, a ten-year-old girl was already so powerful, so what about the others? How about the others?
Ye Shuo suddenly felt a sense of urgency in his heart, and his attitude towards internal strength was no longer as lazy as before.
Relying on her inner strength, the girl defeated Cao Hu in no time.
How come this kid is so strong!
Cao Hu covered his stomach and tried to get up from the ground, but he couldn’t stand up at all.
Turning around, she saw the little beggar was still in a daze. She thought he was frightened. The little beggar had a dirty face and messy hair. He looked very pitiful and confused.
When she thought about how the other party had such high expectations, and it turned out to be just a scam, and looked at the child who was half a head shorter than her, the little girl’s voice softened unconsciously: “Don’t be afraid, the bad guy has been dealt with.”
References
↑1Cao Hu = Servants used to have their master’s surname, if they were favored.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Caught in adultery
chapters.content:
“Are you okay?” The little girl was small, but she looked quite genuine when she was comforting people.
The concerned look in the other party’s eyes made Ye Shuo, the fake child, feel a little uncomfortable for some reason.
But Ye Shuo was so thick-skinned that he recovered in a blink of an eye, then shook his head slightly to indicate that it didn’t matter to him.
“Thank you…”
“Wow, beggar, your voice is so nice.” Just now on the second floor, the little girl was so busy arguing with her master that she didn’t listen carefully at all. Now that she was in close contact, she found that the beggar’s voice was clear and cool, and his pronunciation was also clear, which was very pleasant to the ear.
“You have beautiful eyes, too.”
The black and white are distinct, and the bottom is clear.
The little girl, as if she had discovered a new world, came closer to take a closer look out of curiosity.
As a child, she followed her master outside every day, so she didn’t have so many ideas about the distinction between men and women. The little girl had the mentality of a child and did whatever she wanted.
But Ye Shuo was an adult, and he had no intention of taking advantage of a little girl. When he saw the other party approaching, he could only keep backing away.The more the girl stared at the little beggar, the more handsome he was.
Even the thick layer of black mud on his face could not hide his stunning facial features. Also, his eyelashes were so long, longer than his own, and trembling. At the moment, he seemed to be frightened and kept shaking, looking weak and harmless.
In this way, Ye Shuo was quickly forced into a corner.
Xing Yucheng, who was being ignored, was completely confused and couldn’t react to what was going on.
With a “bang”, Ye Shuo’s back hit the wall, and the little girl suddenly reacted.
Seeing the child’s eyes slightly watery and his gaze constantly dodging, the little girl finally remembered what she had just done.
“Yes, yes, I’m sorry! I didn’t mean it!”
Oh my God, the little beggar is miserable enough, what on earth am I doing!
The little girl was so embarrassed and guilty that she didn’t know where to put her hands and feet.
At the same time, another strange figure appeared outside the alley. When the little girl saw the other person, she immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
Hearing her subconsciously calling out “Master”, Ye Shuo immediately understood the identity of the person.
“Okay, I won’t talk to you anymore. I’ll give you all these things. Leave here quickly. Remember not to get caught again, little beggar.”
Anyway, since she didn’t like all these bits and pieces of things on her head and body, the little girl took them all off without thinking and stuffed them into Ye Shuo’s hands.
Without waiting for Ye Shuo to refuse, the girl ran out of the alley and stood in front of the man.
The man seemed to say a few words to her, and the little girl smiled foolishly. The man was helpless and didn’t say anything else.
Before leaving, the other party seemed to glance over here, but Ye Shuo was not afraid at all. After all, even his cheap master Wu Yi couldn’t tell that he knew martial arts, and Ye Shuo didn’t believe that the other party could tell.
Sure enough, it was just a glance, and the man quickly looked away.
Soon the alley became quiet, with only Cao Hu’s shrill screams remaining.
Xing Yucheng watched the Ninth Prince hesitating for a moment, then put away the two tassels, his brows slightly raised, without any trace of shyness or embarrassment on his face.
Xing Yucheng: “…”
Xing Yucheng felt that the girl had been cheated.
Ye Shuo put the lustrous crystal into his arms and was about to move when he accidentally discovered something.
He walked to Cao Hu belatedly and reached out to pick up the red string with a piece of jade tied to it. Ye Shuo touched it and found that although the quality of the jade was not as good as the one his grandfather gave him on his third birthday, it was not far behind and was also a top-grade jade.
There are two spirit fish carved on it. The shape of the spirit fish is peculiar and not very common.
Ye Shuo turned around subconsciously, trying to find the little girl, but found that the little girl and her master had disappeared.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to give up.
Cao Hu originally thought that everything would be fine after the little girl with extraordinary strength left. Only a little beggar and a young man who came from nowhere were left. They had no choice but to run away when they saw him.
As a result, the two people did not run away. After looking at each other, they walked towards him.
“What are you going to do? I warn you, I am someone close to Master Cao, and if you offend me, you will suffer the consequences—”
“Mmmmm!”
As a result, before Cao Hu could finish his words, he was kidnapped by Ye Shuo and Xing Yucheng.
Xing Yucheng had never done such a thing before. It was basically Ye Shuo who did the work. Ye Shuo’s movements were swift and skillful. Xing Yucheng couldn’t understand the way Cao Hu was tied up. He only knew that the more Cao Hu struggled, the tighter Cao Hu’s belt would be tied, which simply stunned Xing Yucheng.
“Done, done!”
Finally, he forced himself to take off Cao Hu’s socks and stuffed them into Cao Hu’s mouth. After making sure that he could not make any sound, Ye Shuo could not help but clapped his hands.
Cao Hu’s eyes widened, he couldn’t understand why the little beggar who was trembling in his hands just now suddenly became a different person.
At this time, Cao Hu didn’t know what was going on until he accidentally heard Xing Yucheng shout “Ninth Prince”. Cao Hu’s mind went blank.
The Ninth Prince…
How could this beggar be a prince? ?
Because there were households all around, there were actually quite a lot of debris piled up in the alley. Ignoring Cao Hu’s regretful and pleading look, Ye Shuo found a few pieces of debris and covered Cao Hu with them. After making sure that he would not be discovered in a short time, he left with his study companion.
Almost half an hour has passed, and I think Xiaoluzi has already made arrangements.
Ye Shuo went back to Baoyu Pavilion from the small path, and then began to look for Xiaoluzi.
In Baoyu Pavilion, Liang Wenyin barely suppressed the uneasiness in her heart and randomly selected a few pieces of jewelry. When she saw that the agreed time was almost up, she planned to ask the maid beside her to pay the money and then leave.
After all, Liang Wenyin was raised in the Taifu Mansion. Although she was hiding something in her heart, she looked calm on the surface. Therefore, Cao Rui beside her didn’t notice that she was any different today than before.
The two of them walked out of Baoyu Pavilion. After walking about a street away, they saw the prince in the alley nodding at them. Xiaoluzi, who had been waiting here for a long time, took a deep breath and rushed out with a basin of water.
As expected, all the water in Xiao Luzi’s arms was ‘given’ to the young master of the Cao family.
Cao Rui was caught off guard and felt drenched in fear.
Seeing that there were two other servants beside Cao Rui, Xiao Luzi did not dare to delay at all after pouring the water and quickly got into the crowd.
“What are you two still standing there for? Go and follow him!” First his clothes were stained with oil, and now they were soaked through. Cao Rui’s sanity finally collapsed completely.
“No matter who it is, break his arms and legs immediately after you catch him!”
As soon as the words fell, the two servants immediately started to move.
On the street, anyone who is poured cold water on will attract a large crowd of onlookers, and Cao Rui is no exception.
Some people in the crowd even recognized Cao Rui’s identity and were inevitably shocked. In fact, when encountering such a situation, everyone was surprised and curious why such a thing happened. As for those who came up and pointed and laughed at him, they were only a minority after all.
But when Cao Rui saw this scene, he felt that everyone was laughing at him.
Cao Rui’s face suddenly turned red, and he felt that he had never been so embarrassed in his life.
At this moment, Liang Wenyin had already reacted and asked her maid to fetch a cloak that she had just bought for Cao Rui in Baoyu Pavilion. Just as she was about to put the cloak on Cao Rui, Cao Rui pushed her away mercilessly.
It turned out that Cao Rui couldn’t stand the strange looks from everyone, and even Liang Wenyin started to hate him.
Liang Wenyin was caught off guard and staggered immediately.
“You clearly saw that man coming over just now, why didn’t you stop him!”
Tsk, this guy, a grown man, couldn’t even watch him or avoid him, so it’s really unreasonable to expect a woman who never leaves the house to help him stop him.
“That person left, and you didn’t even react. How could you be so stupid!”
Seeing that there was really no one else to vent his anger on, Cao Rui vented all his anger on Liang Wenyin next to him.
A person who seems to be a gentleman in normal times will become completely different once he encounters difficulties.
As he was talking, Cao Rui began to speak without thinking: “If you hadn’t been clamoring to come out today, I wouldn’t have encountered this kind of thing.”
Now, in Cao Rui’s eyes, it was his fiancée who caused him to be in such a miserable state.
“I don’t usually encounter this kind of thing. Why is it that everything changes when I’m with you? Oh, I see. These buns and basins of water are probably aimed at you, right?”
After all, his fiancée was the granddaughter of the Grand Tutor, and she was also very beautiful, so there were many people who admired her openly or secretly. Cao Rui didn’t find it strange at all if one of them did this.
Cao Rui believed that he had never offended anyone in his daily life, and he didn’t think the problem was with him. So, the only one left was his fiancée.
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this was the case. When Cao Rui looked at Liang Wenyin again, his eyes immediately changed.
If this is true, even if the Grand Tutor is a top official, what does it matter? With such a shameless granddaughter, he still can’t hold his head up.
In fact, Cao Rui was not wrong. Today’s incident was indeed caused by Liang Wenyin, but the real situation was completely different from what he thought.
“Tell me, is it the Sixth Young Master of Prime Minister He’s Mansion, or the Third Young Master of Shang Shu Ling’s Family, or… the Young Marquis of Xiang Yinhou’s Family?”
Cao Rui talked more and more, but the people he mentioned had actually only met Liang Wenyin once.
Looking at Cao Rui who was pressing forward step by step, Ye Shuo in the dark couldn’t help but shake his head.
Regardless of whether this man had an affair with her cousin or had other women with him, the two points that had just been discovered were enough for his cheap niece to break off the engagement with him openly.
He is a two-faced person who is arrogant at first and respectful at last. He says one thing to your face and another behind your back. Most importantly, he is cruel and cannot control his temper. He is suspicious, irresponsible, and likes to pass the buck. He is suspected of being jealous and paranoid…
It turned out that my cheap niece and the Madam were right. This man has no good qualities except for his appearance.
Just when Ye Shuo was about to stand up, he heard a crisp “pa” sound, and when he looked closely, he found that his adopted niece was really angry. The girl who usually had a good temper could be quite scary when she got angry. Liang Wenyin slapped him immediately.
Cao Rui, who had been chattering just now, was suddenly confused.
“How dare you, how dare you hit me!?”
For a man like Cao Rui, being slapped by a woman is a great humiliation.
The blood in his body rushed backwards, and Cao Rui took action without thinking.
But since Liang Wenyin had already hit him, she naturally didn’t care about his reaction.
“My grandfather is a high-ranking official, and my aunt is the Crown Princess. If you dare to touch me, just try!”
If Liang Wenyin figured it out, with her current status, she would be able to walk all over the Great Zhou.
When Cao Rui heard this, his expression froze.
But then he thought, so what if her grandfather was a first-rank official? Anyway, her grandfather didn’t listen to her. The Grand Tutor had strongly supported their marriage and even facilitated it.
Most of Cao Rui’s concerns were immediately dispelled.
Liang Wenyin showed no sign of weakness. The arrival of the Ninth Prince undoubtedly gave her great confidence. Even if her grandfather was unreliable, she still had the Ninth Prince.
Seeing that she not only did not retreat, but the determination in her eyes became even stronger, Cao Rui’s aura inexplicably weakened, and he was suddenly not as confident as before.
Could it be possible that the Crown Princess would really help her?
Cao Rui suddenly became somewhat doubtful.
Just when he was hesitating whether to continue, Liang Wenyin first looked at him steadily, then turned and left.
Cao Rui was so angry that he wanted to dig out the eyeballs of the onlookers.
Originally, the matter was over here and there was no need to continue. Xing Yucheng had wanted to leave, but Ye Shuo was thinking, Cao Rui is so angry now, he must find a way to calm down, right?
So Ye Shuo planned to take Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi with him for a while.
Ye Shuo learned the skills of hiding and keeping a low profile from Wu Yi, so tracking a rookie like Cao Rui was no pressure at all.
What Ye Shuo never expected was that his sudden decision would bring him unexpected gains in the end.
Seeing that Cao Rui was wearing wet clothes, he did not choose to go back to Cao’s house. Instead, he turned several corners in a rage and then rushed into a private house near the city.
This might be… fate.
Ye Shuo asked Xiao Luzi to wet Cao Rui’s clothes. Cao Rui was such a face-conscious person that he naturally didn’t want to let his brothers who looked down on him see it, let alone let the servants in the mansion knew. Besides, Liang Wenyin had gone far away anyway, so he decisively chose to come to the small home which was closer to Cao’s mansion.
Lying on the top of the wall, Ye Shuo immediately understood what was going on when he saw the strange woman screaming and throwing herself on Cao Rui, calling him cousin.
Wow, it turns out this pair of cousins ​​have never lost contact at all!
Ye Shuo recalled belatedly that today seemed to be the fifteenth day, which was exactly the middle of the month. For married women, using the excuse of going to the temple to burn incense on the first and fifteenth day of every month was indeed a good excuse to meet their lover in secret.
When Ye Shuo saw their actions, he knew that this matter would not be over for a while, and there might be something even more exciting later.
Ye Shuo did not hesitate and made a prompt decision: “You two stay here, and I will go back to the Taifu Mansion.”
Looking at Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi again, the two young boys who had never seen the world were already blushing because of the noise inside. They didn’t know what to do with their hands and feet. When they heard what the Ninth Prince said, they immediately panicked.
If the Ninth Prince left, they really wouldn’t know what to do.
Xing Yucheng subconsciously grabbed Ye Shuo’s arm and asked stupidly, “What are you going back to the Taifu Mansion for?”
Ye Shuo looked at him like an idiot and said, “Are you stupid? Of course, I’ll call the Master to catch the adulterer!”
Words are not enough. Ye Shuo wants the tutor to see it with his own eyes. He doesn’t believe that this engagement can be successful.
After breaking free from the other party, Ye Shuo took two steps at first, then suddenly thought of something, turned back and reminded him: “By the way, they haven’t started their business yet, don’t rush to blush, when the noise inside gets louder, remember to move away.”
It would be fine if it was just a small thing, but Ye Shuo was afraid that Xing Yucheng was too young to bear the shock and might scare the child to death.
Just like that, under the nearly desperate gazes of Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi, the Ninth Prince, their backbone and their reliance, disappeared in a flash.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Golden Dragon
chapters.content:
After the Ninth Prince disappeared, Xing Yucheng, who was filled with despair, belatedly realized that this was the Ninth Prince’s first time out of the palace. It was no problem for him to lead the way before, but now he is alone, can he find the way back to the Taifu Mansion smoothly?
But it was useless for Xing Yucheng to worry about this matter. The Ninth Prince had already disappeared, and it was too late to catch up with him. He and Xiao Luzi could only hide aside, secretly worried, and quietly observe the movements in the house as instructed.
But in fact, although it was Ye Shuo’s first time out of the palace, he had already memorized the complicated route he passed on the way, so it should not be a problem for him to find the Taifu Mansion.
Seeing that the young master of Cao family had unsteady steps, Ye Shuo estimated that he was a good-looking but useless guy. Afraid that the tutor was slow and would come too late to catch the most exciting scenes, Ye Shuo even used his internal strength in the end.
The people along the street only saw a ragged child suddenly emerge from the alley, run wildly all the way, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
On the other side, Emperor Jingwen and his entourage sat in the most famous restaurant in Shangjing City for a while, and then wandered around. Seeing that the time was almost up, Emperor Jingwen and his two companions, along with a group of eunuchs and servants, staggered towards the Taifu Mansion.
Given the Grand Tutor’s temper and being under his supervision, Xiaojiu would definitely not have the opportunity to go out.
If you tell him about the lively scene outside, he will definitely be extremely envious.
Emperor Jingwen could not help thinking so. When he thought of his youngest son crying and making a fuss later, his mood suddenly improved a lot, and Prince Jin on the side was surprised again and again.
Even Prince Jin discovered that his brother seemed to be particularly concerned about his son.However, the reality seemed to be different from what the three of them thought. What Emperor Jingwen thought in his heart was that his son must be studying and practicing calligraphy with a sad face under the strict supervision of the Taifu.
But when I walked in, I heard the loud quarrel between the tutor and his wife.
Not to mention Emperor Jingwen, even the Crown Prince who had been prepared did not expect that his teacher’s house would be even more lively than the outside world.
The King of Jin was even more surprised, because the Grand Tutor had only one wife in his life, and had no concubines or maids. The deep love between the couple was known to almost the entire court.
But when he saw it today, it seemed that it was not the case at all.
The butler at the side couldn’t help feeling a little embarrassed when he saw this. He was anxious, but had no way to remind him.
He was shocked when the butler opened the door just now.
After all, the Grand Tutor is the prince’s teacher, and the butler has naturally seen the prince in person. As for Emperor Jingwen, although the butler has never seen his holy face with his own eyes, judging from the prince’s attitude and the demeanor of the middle-aged man in front of him, who could not guess?
The butler was about to kneel down when Emperor Jingwen called out to him. After all, Emperor Jingwen came here as a surprise attack today and wanted to see what his son was doing. Naturally, he did not want to alert the people in the Taifu Mansion in advance.
As a result…Emperor Jingwen felt a little regretful. He should have asked them to pass the message earlier.
When Emperor Jingwen and his entourage of three arrived, the quarrel between the Grand Tutor and Madam Zhen was almost over. When a couple quarrels, they usually lose their rationality at the end and both sides start to speak without thinking.
The master must have been furious. He stared at his wife, trembling all over. “Asshole, such an asshole! Look at you. You still look like a lady from a noble family!”
Madam Zhen sneered: “I don’t act like a lady from a wealthy family, but do you act like Yin’er’s grandfather?”
“You only know how to fulfill your promises, but you don’t care about Yin’er’s life or death. Do you think you can do justice to Xuan’er who passed away so early?”
When she thought about her eldest daughter who also failed in marriage and died at a young age, and then about her granddaughter facing the same problem, Mrs. Zhen couldn’t help but feel sad.
“Zhen Zhiyuan, unless you divorce me now, I will never agree to this marriage!”
The Taifu was also annoyed when he heard this. It was precisely because his eldest daughter had chosen her own husband, but ended up meeting a bad man, that he wanted to find one for his granddaughter early on.
Is there anything wrong with him doing this? No!
How could a dignified Grand Tutor be threatened like this by his wife?
The Grand Tutor was quite old, and on impulse he followed Madam Zhen’s words and said, “Divorce! Divorce now!”
Madam Zhen was not afraid at all: “Divorce if you want!”
Although Mrs. Zhen’s dowry was not much, it was enough for her to use. After the divorce, she would take her granddaughter and move out independently. She would go to the government to register as a female household, do needlework every day, write letters to people, copy articles, etc., and maintaining her daily life without any big problem.
Thinking of this, Madam Zhen suddenly made up her mind, and then asked her personal maid to find paper and pen.
“…………”
Emperor Jingwen and his two companions, who had already walked out of the main room, felt a little awkward, not knowing whether to go in or retreat.
Especially the crown prince, he could never have imagined that when he came back, he would happen to run into the divorce scene of his mother-in-law and father-in-law.
The prince complained bitterly for a while.
As the son-in-law of the Grand Tutor, the Crown Prince could not watch the two of them get divorced, otherwise he would not be able to tell the Crown Princess about it when he returned.
The prince had no choice but to step forward.
Strictly speaking, the Grand Tutor and Madam Zhen were also relatives of Emperor Jingwen, so Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to take care of the matter. Among the three, only Prince Jin could stay out of it.
The King of Jin watched with great interest.
I finally pulled my brother out of the palace, only to see a scene like this. I made a profit.
“The Emperor has arrived——”
At this time, nothing could put out the fire better than the emperor’s personal presence.
Sure enough, upon hearing this noise, they subconsciously turned their heads, and Taifu and Madam Zhen knelt down and saluted: “Your Majesty, long live the emperor.”
“Hey, get up.” As if he didn’t see the paper and pen beside him, nor heard the quarrel between the two, Emperor Jingwen sat down in the front of the hall, picked up the teacup, and quickly changed the subject.
“Where’s Shuo’er? Where’s Shuo’er?”
Although the divorce between the Grand Tutor and his wife was their family affair, according to Emperor Jingwen’s understanding of his son, given his son’s personality, it was impossible for him not to get involved. Now that he was not around, Emperor Jingwen felt a little strange.
The moment the words fell, he saw that Taifu’s expression was a little strange. Not only did his eyes look resentful, but his hair almost stood up.
When the prince saw this, an idea suddenly came to his mind –
Could it be that the teacher and his wife were getting divorced just because of this little brother of mine…
No, no way! ?
Didn’t Xiaojiu just come here one night? ? ?
Emperor Jingwen was totally unaware and kept asking, “How is Shuo’er? Why doesn’t the Grand Tutor say anything?”
The Grand Tutor really couldn’t hold it in any longer, and was ready to file a complaint to the Emperor, just like Lord Cen had done before, but at this moment, there was a sudden noise outside.
What a coincidence, Ye Shuo came back at this time.
The servant at the door thought he was a beggar and tried to stop him, but Ye Shuo dodged deftly and rushed directly into the main room.
The Crown Prince and Prince of Jin almost subconsciously called on the guards beside them to protect the emperor. However, the next moment, Ye Shuo looked up, and coincidentally, his eyes met those of Emperor Jingwen.
Emperor Jingwen always felt that the little beggar in front of him looked familiar, especially his eyebrows and eyes, which were exactly the same as his own son.
“Huh? Dad, why are you here?” Because this was outside the palace, Ye Shuo shouted.
Hearing the voice that couldn’t be more familiar, and seeing the other party’s current attire, with black hands, black feet and a black face, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but spit out the tea in his mouth immediately.
Then there was a violent coughing fit, and Emperor Jingwen was shaking all over, not much better than the Taifu just now.
So this is my nephew, he is indeed extraordinary…
Even the usually unreliable Prince Jin couldn’t help but smack his lips.
The guard was stunned for a moment, then pulled his hand back which was less than two feet away from Ye Shuo’s shoulder.
“…You bastard! What have you done again!” Seeing his son who looked like a beggar, the usually clean Emperor Jingwen almost went crazy.
However, Ye Shuo really didn’t have time to pay attention to him at this time. Ye Shuo turned around and was about to speak, but then he thought about the temperament of the tutor. If he told him directly to catch an adulterer, how could he be willing?
The Grand Tutor is so proud that he can’t afford to lose face.
In a flash, Ye Shuo came up with a quick idea and said, “Dad, Third Brother and Teacher, when I was outside just now, I saw a golden dragon falling from the sky into Shangjing City!”
Ah.
Golden dragon.
It would be strange if Emperor Jingwen believed him. He had been out there for so long, why hadn’t he heard about the Golden Dragon?
However, Emperor Jingwen’s disbelief does not mean that others do not believe it.
King Jin’s eyes lit up: “Really?!”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
My younger brother is truly hopeless.
The dragon generally symbolizes the emperor and is a sign of good fortune. It may also be a warning from heaven. Once an unusual phenomenon appears in the sky, it is necessary to check it carefully, let alone a dragon.
The Prince Jin simply did not understand Ye Shuo, and had no idea that he dared to deceive even Emperor Jingwen. The Crown Prince did not know the inside story, nor did he know his brother’s motive for lying, so he did not doubt his purpose.
As for the Grand Tutor, he did notice something was wrong, but he had no choice because Prince Jin was very interested and the Crown Prince also wanted to go with him. He was afraid that something might go wrong, so the Grand Tutor had to go with him. In case the Ninth Prince did something, or something happened next, he could still describe it on the side.
Anyway, no matter what the purpose was, the three of us were together.
Seeing that the most prestigious and distinguished one had no intention of leaving, Ye Shuo did not give up and asked again: “Dad, don’t you really want to go and take a look?”
Emperor Jingwen became more alert when he saw this.
Based on his experience, it was definitely not a good thing.
However, Emperor Jingwen did not expose it. Since Prince of Jin had always wanted to see it, he let him see it.
“No need. I’ve just walked a lot and am a little tired. I’ll just wait here for you to come back and report the news.” Not knowing what was going on, Emperor Jingwen decided to take a step back and take a sip of tea. He looked at his son with a smile on his face.
Tsk.
Seeing that his cheap father was not fooled, Ye Shuo did not force it. After all, it was enough for the Crown Prince and the Grand Tutor to be there.
Just like that, under Ye Shuo’s repeated urging, the group of three hurried to the place where the so-called golden dragon fell to the ground.
At first, Prince Jin did not think there was anything wrong and was even looking forward to and imagining what the legendary dragon looked like.
