After about half an incense stick of time, he arrived in front of a private house. After he approached, when he was about at the door, he heard the faint sounds of “hmm mm and ahhh” between a man and a woman from inside. Prince Jin was stunned.
This, this sound… doesn’t sound right…
Looking at the Crown Prince and the Grand Tutor again, their expressions changed from curiosity and inquiry at the beginning, to shock and panic, and now, they were completely torn.
The crown prince, in particular, turned around and looked at his younger brother in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Fear
chapters.content:
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch his chin.
This movement… Could it be that my eyesight is not as sharp as it was in my previous life? The young master of the Cao family looks weak, but is actually very brave?
Think about it, he ran back to the Tutor’s Mansion from here, chatted with his stepfather and the others for a while, and finally dragged the Tutor and the others over here. The whole process must have taken at least fifteen minutes.
Two quarters of an hour equal thirty minutes, and most people can’t last that long.
This Cao Rui is truly a man who never reveals his true colors.
But in fact, Ye Shuo was thinking wrongly. Even though the two of them were having an affair, they were not so impatient to do it right away upon meeting. What’s the fun in that?
In fact, these two have just begun.
After Cao Rui came into the yard, the two cousins ​​lingered for a while before going to the main house.
Especially Cao Rui’s cousin, who became jealous when she learned that her cousin came to her so late today because he accompanied his fiancée to Baoyu Pavilion.
Baoyu Pavilion might seem ordinary or even unremarkable to the noble ladies outside. They would only go there to stroll around and buy some small items when they really had nowhere else to go. But for Cao Rui’s cousin, it was a luxury.Especially when the family she married into was not that good.
This is also the reason why Cao Rui’s cousin is so obsessed with Cao Rui and is unwilling to let go.
She had been accustomed to a luxurious life in the Cao family, and the gap after getting married was too big, so she clung to Cao Rui desperately, even though she knew that if her affair was discovered, she would be doomed.
But it happened that Cao Rui was in a bad mood today. He was first teased by a beggar, and then a stranger splashed a basin of water on him on the street. In addition, he himself had a bad temper and was even more violent in bed. His cousin’s jealousy was misplaced, which made Cao Rui’s desire for sadism even stronger.
Therefore, the two of them were very active in the house today.
Perhaps it was because the surrounding area was rather desolate with few residents, plus they had been together for a year without any problems, so this wild pair of mandarin ducks were very relaxed.
Hearing the obscene words getting louder and louder, the crown prince’s expression turned pale and blue.
The crown prince usually comes into contact with highbrow things, books, memorials to the emperor, and national affairs. How could he have ever come into contact with these?
Not to mention him, even the usually absurd King Jin couldn’t stand it and felt so embarrassed that he felt uncomfortable.
Look at the Taifu again, a great scholar of the time, a first-rank official, the most old-fashioned and polite person in his life. How could he have encountered such a thing, and he never thought that he would encounter such a thing in his life. He almost fainted.
Only Ye Shuo, the youngest, looks the most natural.
As luck would have it, just when everyone was stunned, there was another wave of men’s growls and women’s gasps, and the three of them suddenly felt their scalps go numb.
The crown prince had said the same thing countless times. He knew his brother was naughty, but he never knew how naughty he would be next time.
“Is this the golden dragon you told me about?!”
The crown prince gnashed his teeth, lost all his composure, and was unusually furious.
“Come back with me, I will make you pay this time!”
The prince didn’t even dare to imagine what would happen to his younger brother when he grew up.
But he had finally tricked the three of them here, especially the Grand Tutor. How could Ye Shuo give up without letting them meet Cao Rui?
Seeing the prince reaching out to grab him, Ye Shuo dodged nimbly, then raised his foot to kick the door in front of him under the almost suffocating gazes of the three people.
“You guys, go to guard the various intersections in the alley, especially the small door in the southwest direction, and don’t let anyone escape!” When Ye Shuo came here, he specially observed that the house in front of him was connected to the house next door, and the exit of the house next door was just in the opposite southwest direction.
No matter how stupid or brainless Cao Rui was, he should have left himself a way out when he did something bad, right?
Just in case, Ye Shuo made a special statement.
Ye Shuo is a prince after all, and the guards accompanying him have to listen to his words.
Seeing that the crown prince did not refuse, the guards hesitated for a moment, then immediately bowed and did as they were told.
“The rest of you, come and help me kick the door.” Ye Shuo was young after all, and had no way to open the wooden door in front of him without exposing himself. He could only ask the guards for help.
“Don’t be anxious, Third Brother, the two of you stand aside. I’ll show you something interesting later.” Upon hearing that the people inside were indeed alarmed, Ye Shuo hurriedly said.
Taifu suddenly had a bad feeling in his heart.
The crown prince couldn’t think of any circumstances under which his brother would eavesdrop on such a thing, but now that things had come to this, the crown prince had no choice but to grit his teeth and sneer, “Wait, if you don’t give me an explanation, you can wait and see how father will punish you!”
Just thinking about how he had tricked himself into coming to such a place and listened to a live sex scene, the prince was so angry that he was shaking all over.
Just as the guards drew their swords and kept slashing, Cao Rui inside could no longer sit still.
Cao Rui was no fool after all. He knew something was wrong immediately when he heard the loud noise outside. He didn’t even go out of the door. He hurriedly grabbed his clothes and rushed into the compartment of the main room. However, he saw an extremely hidden small door in the darkest corner of the compartment.
It turned out that when Cao Rui bought this house, he also bought the house next door, so that he could escape immediately after the truth was revealed.
As for women’s clothes, they were more complicated. Suddenly waking up from the afterglow of what had just happened, his cousin’s hands were shaking in panic.
However, Cao Rui didn’t even look at her. He opened the small door and rushed in.
Just when Cao Rui thought that everything was fine, he was about to leave the house next door. As soon as he showed his head, he was caught by the guards who were waiting there.
The guards in the palace were no pushovers, and with a little force from their hands, Cao Rui was immediately unable to move.
“Who are you? Do you know who I am, and how dare you come to arrest me? You are simply, ah——”
Feeling a sharp pain in his shoulder, Cao Rui couldn’t help but screaming in pain.
Just as he was struggling desperately, trying to break free from the guards’ shackles, footsteps were suddenly heard not far away.
Looking up, the moment he saw Ye Shuo, Cao Rui blurted out: “It’s you!?”
It was the beggar from before!
“Why aren’t you dead yet?”
The moment the words fell, the crown prince, who had just been forced by Ye Shuo to hide aside, was stunned at first, and then his face suddenly darkened.
Even though Xiaojiu behaved absurdly and liked to play tricks on people, he was still his younger brother after all. How could the crown prince not be annoyed when he heard this?
Looking at the Grand Tutor again, he almost fainted when he saw the face of the young master of the Cao family.
Cao Rui appeared here and was caught by the guards again. The truth about ‘who’ the person in the room just now was revealed.
Seeing that his granddaughter-in-law’s future husband’s trouser belt was not fastened properly, and there was an ambiguous mark on his exposed neck, Taifu felt even darker before his eyes.
“Asshole! Asshole!”
Hearing this familiar voice, Cao Rui froze at first, then looked back in disbelief.
When he saw the old face of the Grand Tutor and his eyes that were almost spitting fire, Cao Rui felt a chill in his heart.
Finished.
It’s all over now.
Being caught red-handed by the Grand Tutor, he was afraid that his marriage with Liang Wenyin would be called off, and even the reputation he had built up for so long would be in jeopardy.
But what Cao Rui didn’t know was that not only his marriage and reputation would be implicated, but the entire Cao family would be implicated by him.
Seeing that Cao Rui only knew the Grand Tutor but not the Crown Prince, Ye Shuo at the side had to kindly remind him: “Don’t just look at the Grand Tutor, do you want to guess who the young man standing next to me is?”
The crown prince was a little annoyed when he heard this: “Xiao Jiu!”
Tsk, you’ve already come here and watched the show, why are you still feeling ashamed?
The moment Cao Rui looked over, Ye Shuo chuckled, and under Cao Rui’s almost desperate gaze, he came close to him and whispered, “Let me tell you, this is the Crown Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty.”
“And this one, this one is the emperor’s younger brother. How about it? Do you feel honored?”
A crown prince, a king, and a tutor came in person to catch the adulterer. This lineup was simply luxurious.
“No one has ever enjoyed the treatment you’ve given them, so just be happy.”
Listening to his brother muttering in a low voice to the young master of the Cao family, which made the young master’s face pale, the crown prince couldn’t help but feel a headache.
Prince Jin at the side couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows.
As for the Grand Tutor, he was completely dumbfounded when he saw the woman who followed closely behind him came out in a panic and subconsciously called Cao Rui “cousin”.
Cao Rui then realized how big a mistake he had made in those two sentences he had just uttered subconsciously.
He could still chat and laugh with the Crown Prince’s tutor and the prince. This beggar’s background must be not simple.
Cao Rui just hoped that it would not be what he imagined.
Seeing that he seemed to have finally come to his senses, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smile a little wider: “You must be guessing who I am at this moment.”
“I might as well tell you that it is just what you think in your heart.”
With a “puff” sound, Cao Rui’s hopes were completely shattered.
Anyone who dares to kill the prince will be guilty of a heinous crime punishable by the execution of all nine generations of his clan!
But now it is too late for Cao Rui to take it back. The Taifu and the Crown Prince beside him are the best witnesses.
As if Ye Shuo still thought it was not enough, he slowly said: “As for the Cao family, I found a particularly interesting phenomenon. Do you want to hear it?”
This phenomenon is naturally related to the reputation of the Cao family. Ye Shuo is particularly curious. Could it be that the Cao family is really as spotless as he said?
If they were really spotless, how could it be such a coincidence that all the daughters-in-law of the Cao family were of the same race and had higher family backgrounds than the Cao family itself?
Since they are a family that loves their daughters, their daughters will most likely be raised to be very simple and innocent. Girls with impure personalities will not marry into the Cao family.
Anyone with a little ambition would simply look down upon the Cao family. As for the Cao family, they would also not choose an ambitious daughter-in-law. It was a two-way choice. If either side was lacking, the marriage would not be successful.
Liang Wenyin is a good example. Her grandfather is stubborn, refuses to listen to advice, and hardly ever listens to his children’s opinions. Liang Wenyin herself has a soft personality, making her a perfect marriage candidate.
Girls with this kind of personality and family background are the easiest to be controlled.
Just like Cao Rui, he would suppress Liang Wenyin from time to time when they were together. After a long time, a girl like Liang Wenyin would easily fall into self-doubt.
Ye Shuo suspected that the other three daughters-in-law of the Cao family were also trained in this way. In addition, the world today has many restrictions on women, and girls have been disciplined by various rules since childhood and are well-behaved and sensible. They are not willing to trouble their parents easily. They have not revealed the truth about the Cao Mansion to their parents for so many years, so Ye Shuo believed it.
Ye Shuo even believed that these girls themselves didn’t know there was something wrong with this.
Over time, they have become like animals and have long been domesticated.
However, the girls are stupid, but their parents are not stupid.
Ye Shuo stared at Cao Rui’s eyes carefully and said with a smile: “Tell me, if I spread this matter and tell your sisters-in-law’s parents, what will your sisters-in-law’s parents do?”
Cao Rui couldn’t control himself, his pupils suddenly contracted, and his expression was blank for a moment.
When one’s most secret matters are exposed, unless one’s mental quality is extremely strong, it will be impossible to reveal any flaws.
But such people are rare even after training.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo had a rough idea in his mind.
After he came to his senses, Cao Rui’s anger at being teased, the frustration at being caught, and the panic at running into the Grand Tutor all disappeared, leaving only fear in his heart.
Cao Rui felt that the prince in front of him was particularly scary.
Although he was smiling, his eyes and heart were full of knives.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Reading
chapters.content:
“Someone come!”
“Take Master Cao away for further interrogation!”
Whether Cao Rui intended to murder the prince or committed adultery with a married woman in broad daylight, he deserved punishment.
As for Cao Rui not knowing that Ye Shuo was a prince, what was the use of that? When it came to the prince’s life, there was no such thing as ignorance without guilt in the royal family.
Following the crown prince’s order, Cao Rui was immediately taken away by the guards. It was estimated that the guards went straight to the Dali Temple. The crown prince saw the incident with his own eyes and did not even give Cao Rui a chance to refute.
After Cao Hu finally broke free, he and the other two servants initially chased after Xiao Luzi. After Xiao Luzi disappeared, they saw their young master heading towards the residential area, and they knew that their young master would not be able to finish the task in a short time, so they took this opportunity to slack off.
Everyone, including Cao Rui, felt that their arrangements were flawless. How could the two servants have expected that something unexpected would happen today?
Even if there were three more people keeping watch beside Cao Rui, it would be useless as there were several guards around.
Since Ye Shuo was here, he had no intention of returning empty-handed.
Therefore, as soon as Cao Hu and his men returned, they also faced the situation of being arrested and imprisoned.Cao Rui finally felt scared at this time. He was frightened by Ye Shuo’s last two sentences. Obviously, he also understood that if it was just an affair and murder of the prince, he might have room for maneuver due to the family relationship. After all, the prince in front of him was fine, and he didn’t know he was a prince at that time.
However, once the affairs of the women in the family were exposed, the entire Cao family would not only face a devastating disaster, but would also be ruined.
All the previous business operations of the Cao family would be destroyed.
Cao Rui had kept this secret since he was a child. Over the years, he had regarded it as something that must not be discovered, even worse than murdering the prince.
Now that he was suddenly exposed, Cao Rui was in a panic.
In a panic, Cao Rui couldn’t even figure out how everything happened and why he was targeted.
If he knew that it was just because of the words of his fiancée and Mrs. Zhen that Ye Shuo became suspicious and wanted to verify the truth, I wonder if he would vomit blood.
After all, who would be interested in such things?
In the end, he did it himself and dug so deep in one go.
When the guards dragged Cao Rui away without saying a word, Cao Rui accidentally saw the little prince making faces at him. The look was as weird and terrifying as it could be.
Cao Rui even felt that the person living in the little prince’s body was not a human, but a demon.
But looking at the crown prince on the side, it seemed as if he didn’t notice anything at all, and he even patted the prince’s head with a helpless look, telling him to stop being naughty.
Naughty?
The prince called this naughty???
Cao Rui couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
Cao Rui could not curse or speak, for fear of adding to his crime, and in the end he could only wail aloud to vent his resentment.
Even the crown prince was frightened by the other party’s shrill cry, and Ye Shuo beside him couldn’t help but shiver his arms.
I didn’t realize that the young master of the Cao family has this skill?
“Oh, that’s terrible.”
He knew it was scary, but he didn’t know who had done it.
The corner of Prince Jin’s mouth twitched slightly.
Since Cao Rui and his right-hand men have been arrested, it is estimated that the Cao family is not far away. As for Cao Rui’s cousin, whether to divorce or send her to the government will be handled by her husband’s family.
Only after this farce was completely over did Ye Shuo and his group leave.
On the way, Ye Shuo ignored the defeated look on the face of the tutor and felt that he had saved one or more girls. He was in a good mood and was almost about to sing a song.
As for whether anyone in the Cao family would die because of him, he can only say that if they were truly bad guys, it wouldn’t be a pity no matter how many of them died.
Being kind to criminals is being cruel to victims.
The King of Jin couldn’t hold it in any longer, so he approached his nephew and asked, “How do you know I’m your uncle? I remember we haven’t met before?”
Even though there was so much chaos just now, Prince Jin did not ignore Ye Shuo’s words “This man is the emperor’s younger brother”.
Could it be that my nephew had seen his own portrait? But that portrait didn’t look like him.
King Jin was really curious.
Being in high spirits, Ye Shuo answered casually, “I guessed.”
Ye Shuo pointed to the widow’s peak on his forehead, then to the crown prince’s and the prince of Jin’s.
“Look, they’re all the same.”
Widow’s peak is a dominant trait, my cheap dad also has it, but the probability of inheritance is not high, so it is not easy to bump into someone with the same one.
In addition, he was more casual than the ministers when facing his stepfather, and he looked younger than his stepfather, so Ye Shuo guessed that he might be his stepfather’s younger brother and his uncle.
This is not a big deal, it doesn’t matter even if I guessed wrong, Ye Shuo said so.
Prince Jin was stunned for a moment, then touched his forehead belatedly.
After coming to his senses, he couldn’t help but sigh, what a smart child!
But that’s not right. Such a smart child, and the son of the imperial concubine, there is no reason for the crown prince and the emperor brother to be so kind and attentive to him. Shouldn’t they be on guard against him?
The title of Duke of Zhen is a historical legacy. The current situation was caused by the absurdity of the previous emperor. Even though my brother is a man of great talent and strategy, it will take time to resolve it.
King Jin felt that it was incredible that this child could reach this point.
Not only was he born safely, but he also won the favor of his elder brother in such an environment. The prince also seemed to be not on guard against him. This was completely beyond Prince Jin’s imagination.
He was able to revive a dead end and still thrive. Doesn’t my brother suspect that this kid is pretending?
Then King Jin thought of Ye Shuo’s actions and fell silent.
Yes, if it was really a disguise, no one would dare to make such a joke no matter what. They could even say such nonsense as a golden dragon falling to the ground, and they were deceiving the emperor. This is a crime of deceiving the emperor!
This is why the Prince of Jin was deceived. He never thought that there would be someone in the world who would dare to lie to the emperor.
Prince Jin also felt that this child was a little, no, very stupid.
He is stupid, bold and lawless.
Prince Jin couldn’t help but be curious: “You lied to your father so much, aren’t you afraid that he will punish you?”
“Then what’s there to be afraid of?” Ye Shuo said confidently: “Didn’t the emperor not get fooled?”
If you are not deceived, it is not called deceiving the emperor.
After King Jin sorted out this logic, he was immediately shocked.
Is there such a saying? ?
The King of Jin felt that he had learned something, but if he was asked to put it into practice… The King of Jin thought about it and gave up the idea. He still wanted to live a few more years.
So the King of Jin looked at his nephew with eyes full of admiration.
The King of Jin thought he was ridiculous, but he realized today that he was nothing compared to his ninth nephew.
At least he certainly wouldn’t dare to lie to the late emperor like this.
Both of them were players who were not doing their jobs properly, and they could talk to each other very well. Seeing the two of them getting together in a short time, the prince felt his temples throbbing.
“My dear nephew, if you have time in the future, please come to king uncle’s house often to play.” Prince Jin had never thought that his nephew had so many tricks at such a young age. It was as if the door to a new world had been opened. After listening to him, he felt that he was still not satisfied.
Ye Shuo was not polite: “Okay, okay.”
The child’s casual and non-pedantic appearance immediately suited King Jin’s taste even more.
When the two of them were talking happily and getting along better and better, they completely ignored the changes in their surroundings and did not even notice when they arrived at the Taifu’s house.
“You two, why don’t you come here right now!” When Emperor Jingwen saw the two of them like this, his forehead jumped.
Ye Shuo and Prince Jin fell silent and walked up to Emperor Jingwen with a smile.
“father.”
“Royal brother.”
In the past, seeing just one of them was enough to give Emperor Jingwen a headache, but now that both of them were present, Emperor Jingwen almost couldn’t breathe.
Impatiently pushing his brother aside, Emperor Jingwen looked at his son and said, “Tell me, what happened?”
Ye Shuo blinked and said without any guilt: “Dad, I took my brother the crown prince and my uncle to do good deeds!”
Emperor Jingwen had a blank expression on his face and sneered.
When Ye Shuo was hesitating about what to say in order to satisfy his stepfather, the prince at the side reported the whole story directly.
Even though he was prepared, after hearing this, Emperor Jingwen’s blood instantly flowed back to his head.
“Catching an adulterer?! You actually took your third brother, your uncle, and the Grand Tutor to catch an adulterer???”
Emperor Jingwen stood up from his chair suddenly.
More importantly, he tried to trick himself into going.
Emperor Jingwen could not imagine himself, an emperor, appearing in such an occasion.
The most important thing is that the prince said that when he and his men arrived, the battle there was fierce…
He even dared to say that he was a good person and did good things. Emperor Jingwen became furious.
“How can it not be a good person and a good deed?” Seeing that the fruits of his labor were about to be buried, Ye Shuo could not help but retort: ​​”It is such a great achievement to be able to save the happiness of several girls for a lifetime!”
This little bastard really only has girls, girls, girls in his mind. He is like this at such a young age. Won’t he become a troublemaker when he grows up?
“Do you care about the reputation of me and your third brother?” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t breathe just thinking about that scene.
After the words fell, King Jin was stunned.
Wait, why am I not included?
Doesn’t his face count as face?
Emperor Jingwen was so furious when he saw this little bastard that he couldn’t control himself and rolled up his sleeves to beat him.
“I told you not to lie to me, I told you not to lie to me that you went out of the palace to study!” Emperor Jingwen never imagined that it was not the Taifu who taught him well, but that he successfully led the Taifu astray.
When he was so angry, Emperor Jingwen even forgot about cleanliness and just picked up a handy object to beat his son.
As the saying goes, “If you are beaten lightly, you will take it; if you are beaten hard, you will run away.” Ye Shuo is not a dead man. He has two legs, and they are meant to run.
When Emperor Jingwen saw that he dared to hide, he became even angrier.
“What are you still standing there for! Hurry up and hold him down!”
The guards took action without hesitation.
Seeing that his cheap father was serious this time, Ye Shuo screamed immediately.
“Dad! Dad! Show some mercy, Dad!”
Emperor Jingwen was unmoved and directly ordered the guards to bring him back to the palace. Emperor Jingwen really didn’t want to see him embarrass himself in public anymore.
Ye Shuo, who was pretending, was suddenly dumbfounded.
“Wait a minute, Dad, I’ve only been out for one night!”
“Such a big thing happened in just one night. If you stay for a few more days, you will turn the whole capital city upside down!” If the evidence is conclusive, the Cao family will definitely be sent to prison. Thinking of the Cao family’s daughters-in-law, Emperor Jingwen is almost certain that when he goes to court tomorrow, it will be very lively.
I guess Lord Cao alone is not enough for his relatives to participate.
If there were no other charges, the Cao family would surely be ruined. If something else was found out… then it would be even harder to say.
My son has just come out and there is no third-rank official in the court. If I ask him to stay for a few more days…
Emperor Jingwen made a prompt decision: “You go back to the palace and stay there obediently!”
Ye Shuo was horrified.
His schedule for leaving the palace this time was extremely tight. He hadn’t done many things yet and hadn’t met his grandfather yet. How could he leave so easily?
“No! I won’t go! I won’t go ahhhhhh!”
Under the joint siege of several guards, no matter how much Ye Shuo resisted, it was useless.
Emperor Jingwen hesitated for a moment, but finally followed him. He had no choice. If he didn’t keep an eye on him, he was afraid that the little bastard would run away again.
I heard that when he left the palace with the Grand Tutor, didn’t he want to run away?
Seeing that there was nothing for the King of Jin to do here and that he was very satisfied with the show, he put his hands behind his back and walked away leisurely.
After Liang Wenyin came back, she was celebrating with Madam Zhen.
The crown prince originally wanted to leave, but the Grand Tutor, who had finally recovered from the incident, asked him to stay.
The crown prince looked at his teacher and seemed to have something to say to him. He was puzzled, but he did not refuse.
The two of them quickly came to the corridor. Seeing that there was no one around, the crown prince was about to speak, but the tutor beside him finally couldn’t hold it back and bowed deeply to the prince: “Your Highness, I’m sorry!”
The Grand Tutor felt that if the Ninth Prince continued like this and was not properly disciplined, his own family would be gone.
Although the Ninth Prince has messed it up now…
The Grand Tutor was filled with grief and indignation, and was extremely ashamed: “Your Highness, please forgive me for breaking the promise I made to you.”
Read!
The Ninth Prince must study!
We can’t let him idle around like this any longer!
The crown prince was stunned for a while. After realizing what his teacher meant, he felt a little amused.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: General
chapters.content:
The Ninth Prince is only so old, yet he doesn’t even blush when he sees people having sex, and he even asks them to go and watch together!
This incident was like the last straw that broke the camel’s back, causing Taifu’s psychological defenses, which were already on the verge of collapse, to completely collapse.
The Ninth Prince’s ignorance, lack of common sense and reckless behavior made the Grand Tutor unable to tolerate it any longer.
No matter whether it is the royal family or one’s own students, they must never raise such a person!
The crown prince felt that since Xiaojiu could force the great tutor into this state, he must be a big shot.
The crown prince had no doubt about the tutor’s intentions at all. After all, he saw the whole thing from beginning to end with his own eyes.
Xiaojiu had only been here for one day, but he had already messed up the Taifu family’s house, and almost caused a divorce between a couple who had been in love for decades. Even the crown prince felt ashamed of such terrible destructive power.
The crown prince suddenly remembered that the princess seemed to have started to contradict the tutor only after she came into contact with her younger brother…
The crown prince shuddered suddenly.
“Teacher, there is no need to do this. It is your job to teach Xiaojiu well.” The prince also felt that it was imperative for his younger brother to study well. Although it was a bit offensive to say this, he did not want to have a younger brother like his uncle in the future.“Thank you, Your Highness.”
The Grand Tutor has already decided at this moment that he will teach each of “benevolence, righteousness, propriety, wisdom, and trustworthiness” to the Ninth Prince!
After the crown prince consoled his teacher with a few more words, he knew that his teacher still had things to deal with later, so he did not stay any longer.
After sending the prince away and closing the door of the Taifu Mansion, the Taifu turned around and suddenly didn’t know how to face his wife and granddaughter.
The previous memories quickly came back to him. The thought of the young master of the Cao family who couldn’t control himself during the day and was so indulgent that he actually did such a thing outside made the Taifu feel angry and a little embarrassed.
He didn’t expect that just a hairpin could reflect so many things.
That’s the truth.
Think about it, even if the young master of the Cao family was confused and didn’t understand the intricacies of this, wasn’t there anyone among his cousin, his parents, and so many people in the Cao family who reminded him?
In the final analysis, it’s just that the upper beam is crooked, and the lower beams are crooked.
Cao Rui’s cousin was probably very angry, thinking that it didn’t matter if she was the granddaughter of the Grand Tutor, she still lost to a girl from a small family, so she borrowed this hairpin to show off in front of Madam Zhen.
The reason why the Cao family sat back and watched without saying a word was that they wanted to use this hairpin to test Liang Wenyin’s reaction.
They try to test how Liang Wenyin would react when encountering such a thing, starting from small to large, and gradually increasing the stakes. At first, it might be just a hairpin, but later on, it will gradually become a dowry, a woman, an heir… In the end, Liang Wenyin will be completely turned into a tool for them to climb up.
Facts have proved that the Cao family was actually successful.
If Ye Shuo hadn’t suddenly appeared, the hairpin incident would have ended up in vain, and many other things would have ended up in vain as well.
The Grand Tutor may think a hairpin is a trivial matter today, and may think a piece of clothing is a trivial matter tomorrow. After a few years, when the previous impressions have accumulated deeply enough, will the Grand Tutor think that his granddaughter is being too fussy?
There have been so many disappointments. She knows it’s useless to cry to her grandfather. If Liang Wenyin is wronged in the future, will she come back to tell him?
After all, the process of taming Liang Wenyin is actually the process of taming the tutor.
The Grand Tutor had been in officialdom for many years and had hardly ever used such a sinister trick, so he had no idea how terrible this sinister trick was.
Even until now, the Grand Tutor has not realized the seriousness of the matter.
Even though the Taifu was well-versed in ancient and modern knowledge, he still could not imagine things that he had not seen with his own eyes.
Now, in the eyes of the Grand Tutor, the fact that the young master of the Cao family committed adultery with his cousin and that the Cao family deliberately promoted their own good reputation to curry favor with the powerful only made him angry and upset. He had no idea to what extent the Cao family was rotten inside.
Therefore, at this moment, the Grand Tutor was filled with embarrassment as to how to face his wife and granddaughter.
After standing outside for a long while, the tutor finally raised his feet and walked towards the main room.
However, the fact that the Grand Tutor didn’t know didn’t mean that Madam Zhen didn’t know. Madam Zhen was a woman, so she naturally understood the consequences for a woman if she met such a family.
Mrs. Zhen originally thought that the only bad person was the young master of the Cao family, but she didn’t expect that the entire Cao family was of the same ilk.
Mrs. Zhen shuddered at the thought that her granddaughter almost married into such a family.
So even though her husband swallowed his pride for the first time in his life and begged for peace with her, and even wrote a letter of withdrawal in front of them, Mrs. Zhen still didn’t look kindly upon him.
The Taifu was turned down by his wife and all his sweet words were of no use. He was quite angry, but he was really wrong in this matter, and he was too embarrassed to argue with his wife.
Unable to hold it in any longer, the Taifu finally threw up his sleeves and went to the street angrily.
He really couldn’t stay in this house for even a quarter of an hour!
But the Taifu seldom went shopping on weekdays, and he had no interest in the outside world. He really had no goal. He drank tea to his heart’s content in the tea house, but he couldn’t drink anymore. So the Taifu went downstairs, walking aimlessly, and gradually, he heard a particularly noisy noise not far away.
It turned out that the Grand Tutor had unknowingly arrived at Cao’s residence.
It was already afternoon, almost evening. The news that the young master of the Cao family was caught cheating by the crown prince himself was making headlines. The Cao family’s affair was exposed. After a few hours of fermentation, the people who heard about it for the first time could not help but be shocked.
The three girls who married into the Cao family were the family’s favorite daughters. When something like this happened, even though the result was not known yet, each family had already sent a carriage to pick up their daughter.
When the tutor arrived, he happened to meet Cao Rui’s second sister-in-law picked up by someone.
With disaster imminent, the Cao family naturally refused to release the people, but the other party didn’t care and simply called together the guards and servants to beat up the people in the Cao family.
A gust of wind blew, and the curtain of the carriage opened a crack. Looking through the gap, the next moment, the tutor felt as if he was struck by lightning.
Cao Rui’s second sister-in-law was the daughter of Jinzi Guanglu Doctor, the daughter of a third-rank official. Because of the future marriage relationship between the two families, the Taifu had met his daughter once on the wedding day five years ago.
The girl who was pretty, and charming five years ago has become haggard five years later.
This is what mind control is like. Even if the person involved says that nothing happened, the spirit she exudes cannot deceive others.
However, even though things had come to this point, the woman in the carriage continued to loudly defend her husband’s family, as if she was possessed by a demon, and tried her best to speak well of the Cao family.
Seeing this scene, the Taifu felt a chill.
The Master doesn’t understand why some people can be so bad…
As the sun set, the tutor returned home in a daze.
Mrs. Zhen was surprised to see her husband like this. Then she understood when she heard the servants tell her where her husband had gone today.
Madam Zhen did not say anything, and left it to the Grand Tutor to digest slowly.
When the court was in session the next day, just as Emperor Jingwen had guessed, several ministers listed the crimes of the Cao family in the court without caring about their lives. Lord Cao was sweating profusely and tried his best to refute them.
Looking at the noisy court that was like a vegetable market, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel a headache.
While Emperor Jingwen was pondering, to everyone’s surprise, even the Grand Tutor stood up.
There was no suspense at all now. After the emperor intervened, he found out a lot of other things.
After reading the memorial with a frown, Emperor Jingwen did not hesitate any longer and directly put Lord Cao and his entire family in prison. As the Minister of Agriculture, he embezzled money and shook the foundation of the country. Killing all nine clans of the Cao family was considered a light punishment.
The ministers had not expected that this lawsuit, which was clearly about their children’s family, would involve so many things in the end.
The cause was simply because the Ninth Prince was having fun and went out of the palace…
He Xiang and others couldn’t help but smack their lips.
After the court session, the Grand Tutor went straight to the library.
Upon seeing this, the crown prince couldn’t help but shake his head, with a hint of sympathy flashing in his eyes. He was afraid that Xiaojiu would suffer.
The other side.
Because Ye Shuo helped Concubine Rong win several pieces of precious cloth, Concubine Rong not only did not scold him, but was very happy instead.
“As expected of my son, he is so smart!” Thinking that her son could even fool the Imperial Tutor and even the Imperial Tutor had to help him cover up his lies, the Imperial Concubine felt so proud.
Apart from his own son, which other child in the world has such ability?
Even Ye Shuo couldn’t help but remain silent after hearing this.
I repeat, if he were a serious child, it would be impossible for him not to grow up astray in such an environment.
Although in the eyes of others he could not be crooked anymore.
Xing Yucheng was once again shocked by the imperial concubine’s unconditional doting on her son.
The Sixth Prince on the side kept shaking his head, thinking that if this continued, the Ninth Prince might never grow up in his lifetime.
Ye Shuo was not soft-hearted either. He took the opportunity to extort two new sets of clothes from his mother. Then, early the next morning, he brought his study partner and attendant to the library.
Until this moment, Ye Shuo was still regretting the freedom he had finally gained but which slipped away so quickly.
“I regret so much, I regret not taking the opportunity to have a good look around…” God knows, he hasn’t even visited several famous scenic spots in Beijing!
“I still don’t know what my grandfather, my six uncles, and my eighteen cousins ​​look like…”
The group of guards yesterday were really cruel. They showed no mercy and even pinched his shoulder until it was blue.
Sitting by the window on the third floor, Ye Shuo’s expression was filled with sadness: “I’ve only been out for less than 12 hours…”
Twelve hours!
Ye Shuo has never had such a short weekend life!!!
“With a ‘pop’ sound, happiness is gone.”
“What does this have to do with me? Why did you arrest me? Why won’t you let me go out?”
“Let me out, let this prince out quickly!!!”
At the beginning, Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi were so soft-hearted when they saw how sad and angry he was that they tried to persuade him, but later, after hearing it so many times, they became numb to it.
Anyway, the Ninth Prince was just shouting, and since the Emperor had issued a ban, he couldn’t get out no matter how hard he tried.
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi gradually learned how to read attentively in a noisy environment.
Ye Shuo thought this was miserable enough, but he didn’t expect there would be something even worse to come.
When the Grand Tutor came, Ye Shuo didn’t think anything was wrong. It wasn’t the first time that the Grand Tutor attacked him suddenly, and the old man couldn’t stay for a while and had to leave.
It was not until the Grand Tutor lifted his official robe and knelt down opposite Ye Shuo that Ye Shuo frowned, feeling that something was not right.
In the next two hours, Ye Shuo gradually realized that this was true and not his illusion.
Oh my God!
He obviously did good things, why did the Master repay his kindness with hatred!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Regret
chapters.content:
Why are all the people here like this!?
This has been the nth time, Ye Shuo can hardly count.
We agreed to leave me alone, but in the end, each one of them is stricter than the last. It’s ok for the stepfather, but why is the tutor like this too? ?
Ye Shuo couldn’t understand.
Ye Shuo has a bright mind, but he has already gone to school once in his previous life. If he were to go to school again in this life… Ye Shuo would feel desperate just thinking about it.
Especially in ancient times, going to school was so tiring, with one having to memorize one book after another and never seeing an end. It’s no wonder that Ye Shuo felt repulsed.
Seeing that the Grand Tutor couldn’t leave for a while, Ye Shuo began to daydream while listening to his lecture, with his hands placed below his head and constantly making small movements.
After a long time, it was time for lunch. Even after drinking several cups of tea, he still felt a little thirsty. Closing the book in front of him, the Grand Tutor couldn’t help but look at the Ninth Prince opposite him: “The reality of benevolence is to serve one’s parents; the reality of righteousness is to obey one’s elder brother; the reality of wisdom is to know these two things and not to abandon them; the reality of propriety is to be restrained in these two things…”①
“Everyone has a compassionate heart; everyone has a sense of shame and disgust; everyone has a respectful heart; everyone has a sense of right and wrong. Compassion is benevolence; shame and disgust is righteousness; respect is courtesy; and a sense of right and wrong is wisdom…”
“So, do you understand?”In order to teach the Ninth Prince the basic ethics of propriety, morality, and honor, the Grand Tutor has put in a lot of effort, almost breaking it down and explaining it to him.
However, Ye Shuo’s thoughts had already wandered off to who knows where.
In extraordinary times, extraordinary things need to be done. When something really happens, there is no time to worry about so many things. Some things should be done even if they go against the teachings of sages.
The Master frowned and couldn’t help shouting twice more.
Xing Yucheng, who was standing by, couldn’t stand it anymore, so he quietly nudged the Ninth Prince, who obviously wasn’t listening carefully.
Ye Shuo finally came back to his senses, and by this time the tutor’s face had turned dark.
“What are you holding there? Take it out!”
Sure enough, no matter which era, when faced with students who do not listen carefully in class, teachers’ reactions are the same.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to put his masterpiece on the table.
So the Master saw something that looked like it had a pair of wings…was it a butterfly or something???
The Master’s anger rose immediately: “Do you know how much this piece of paper can be worth to ordinary people? How much corn can it be worth?”
A mere piece of paper was enough for a common person’s food for a day, but it was wasted so casually by the Ninth Prince.
Ye Shuo understood the principle, but… this paper was just discarded by Xing Yucheng.
Without waiting for Ye Shuo to open his mouth to refute, the Grand Tutor asked again: “What is the use of this thing in your hand?” If it has no use, it is just a waste of time.
Hearing him talk about this, Ye Shuo immediately sat up straight and had to say a few words for the fruits of his labor: “Replying to Master, of course there are.”
As he said that, Ye Shuo threw the thing he had carefully folded out of the window.
He had to show Taifu the charm of paper airplane, one of the must-have handmade toys for modern children in their childhood.
Although the writing paper in the palace was soft, it was on an upper floor and was cut into small pieces, so it could still fly.
Just like that, Ye Shuo watched the paper plane swaying and flying far away. When he turned around, he was about to brag about it, but he ran into the dark old face of the tutor.
That’s it?
He thought the Ninth Prince would come up with some new tricks!
The Grand Tutor didn’t hesitate and started scolding Ye Shuo as soon as he caught him.
Ye Shuo felt extremely innocent. Any modern person would surely understand the meaning of airplanes or the various air currents in the air.
This is the world record-breaking way to fold Susan’s paper airplane! Super cool!
Ye Shuo felt that there was a particularly deep generation gap between him and the Taifu, as if the Taifu firmly believed that the sky above his head was round and the land beneath his feet was square, while Ye Shuo believed that they were both round.
“Teacher.” Ye Shuo’s expression suddenly became serious: “It is also very important to properly develop children’s hands-on ability.”
Always reading, reading and reading, but not learning to be creative, the high-pressure environment will make children stupid.
Xing Yucheng, who was standing by, held his forehead with his hand, and he had almost met the fate of the Ninth Prince.
As expected, almost the moment the words fell, the Taifu exploded.
Then came the scolding that was like a violent storm.
Ye Shuo tried to resist at first, but when he saw that he could not resist, he simply changed his mind and continued to daydream.
But it must be said that the Grand Tutor is worthy of being the Grand Tutor. He even quotes classics when scolding someone. Ye Shuo almost couldn’t react to many of the allusions.
However, when Taifu saw this scene, he didn’t understand it at all.
Because in the eyes of the Taifu, anyone who understood what he was saying would not be like this, with no reaction and not even a blush on his face.
I can only say…the Grand Tutor has always underestimated Ye Shuo’s thick skin.
Compared to the teacher Ye Shuo met in his previous life, these words of the Grand Tutor are nothing.
Although Ye Shuo had always been the teacher’s favorite in his previous life, but even if he had never eaten pork, had he seen a pig run?
The Taifu has read so many books and has been deeply influenced by the thoughts of sages. No matter how unpleasant his words could be, how bad could they be?
It just doesn’t hurt.
However, Ye Shuo did not refute, but instead made the tutor angry.
It is so frustrating that students have low education. They don’t understand even if you scold them.
The Grand Tutor was so angry that he threw up his sleeves and left.
Looking at the other person’s angry back, Ye Shuo was at a loss.
What happened? Why did you leave so soon?
The old man’s thoughts are indeed hard to guess.
Xing Yucheng, who was standing next to him, watched the whole process and couldn’t help but feel sympathy for the tutor.
“Ah, I can finally go back to eat. Madam Zhao and the others must be waiting anxiously.” Even in the palace, Ye Shuo’s daily schedule is quite full.
Concubines like Zhao Chongrong were inevitably lonely because they had no children. Several times, Ye Shuo ran into Zhao Chongrong sitting alone in the yard, daydreaming.
There were no entertainment activities in the palace, and people tended to overthink when they had some free time after eating and drinking. A normal person would easily develop mental problems after staying in this small world for decades.
Ye Shuo couldn’t do much, he just hoped that his arrival could add a bit of color and fun to the lives of Empress Zhao and the others.
But in Xing Yucheng’s opinion, the Ninth Prince brought him to eat and drink in various concubines’ palaces all day long, with river fish today and copper pot meals tomorrow. The concubines were really reincarnated Bodhisattvas. Even in this situation, they did not find the Ninth Prince annoying.
As a result, both himself and Xiao Luzi gained a lot of weight.
Compared to the leisurely Ye Shuo, Taifu’s mood was not so good. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became, and his expression became more and more uglier.
As if things weren’t bad enough, at this moment, the Tutor happened to meet Lord Cen, who had just finished class and looked very relaxed.
At this glance, it was like enemies meeting, with eyes full of jealousy.
The relationship between the two had never been very good, and now because of the matter of the Ninth Prince, they were even more at odds with each other.
Lord Cen looked at the Grand Tutor’s expression and felt it was so familiar. Every night when he went home and looked in the mirror, it was exactly the same.
Still feeling frustrated and worried.
Lord Cen immediately understood what had happened, and he was very happy: “Oh, isn’t this Lord Taifu? How come Lord Taifu just came out of the East Palace?”
You old thing, why are you bringing up things that are not relevant? He is asking even though he knows the answer!
The Taifu ignored him, snorted through his nose, and walked straight past him.
Lord Cen was extremely happy. As expected, in a one-on-one fight, the Ninth Prince was much more powerful.
I heard that the Ninth Prince almost broke up the old man’s family?
That’s really amazing.
Even from a distance, the Grand Tutor could still hear Lord Cen’s laughter. The Grand Tutor couldn’t help it, and for the first time in his life, he felt the urge to hit someone.
But there is no other way, we still have to teach.
Just like that, for the next few days, the Grand Tutor repeated the same routine: teaching the Ninth Prince in the morning, being annoyed by the Ninth Prince at noon, thinking frantically about what to teach the Ninth Prince the next day in the afternoon, and staying up late at night to prepare for the lesson, adjust his mentality, and get ready for the next battle the next day.
In order to help the Ninth Prince learn something, the Grand Tutor has tried almost all his strength.
To be honest, when he was not an official, he had hundreds of disciples, but Taifu never felt so tired.
After all, the situations are different. Although some students are a little stupid, they are willing to learn. It is good that diligence can make up for one’s shortcomings.
Look at the Ninth Prince, he is stupid, lazy and doesn’t like to study. The Imperial Tutor has no choice but to chase him and feed him, but he still refuses to open his mouth to eat.
This was the first time that Taifu had experienced such a torment as a teacher.
If his former students saw this, they would probably drop their eyes out. Not to mention other students, at least the crown prince would not be able to accept this contrast.
This went on for about half a month, and Mrs. Zhen watched helplessly as her husband’s hair seemed to be thinner than before, and the previous hair crown would soon have to be remade.
The Grand Tutor has been so busy lately that he doesn’t even have time to care about his granddaughter’s marriage, which makes Liang Wenyin feel relieved.
After what happened with the Cao family, Liang Wenyin seemed to have grown up overnight.
No, it cannot be said that she grew up, but Liang Wenyin suddenly saw some things clearly.
Relying on others is like floating on the water without roots. You can only follow the will of others without any choice. Sometimes even your own grandfather will not help you. You can rely on the Ninth Prince, but how many times can the Ninth Prince help you?
This feeling of having no one to turn to for help is so torturous that Liang Wenyin doesn’t want to experience it again after experiencing it.
But she didn’t know what she should do, and Liang Wenyin was left feeling confused.
Although Liang Wenyin didn’t know what to do, she knew that it would be good to delay such a day longer. So when she saw that her grandfather’s mind was not on her, Liang Wenyin was not anxious but relieved.
The fact that Liang Wenyin was able to notice that something was wrong with Cao Rui and took the initiative to express her wishes to Madam Zhen and the Grand Tutor proves that she is at least not a person without her own opinions, and it is natural for her to think of these things.
Liang Wenyin thought that perhaps she could ask the Ninth Prince what to do.
Although my grandmother has read a lot of books, she has been confined to the inner courtyard all her life. If anyone can give her advice on this matter and keep it secret, it can only be the Ninth Prince.
Liang Wenyin’s heart quickly calmed down.
The Grand Tutor over there had no idea that his granddaughter had quietly changed, and he was still worrying about how to teach the Ninth Prince.
The Grand Tutor became increasingly haggard at a speed visible to the naked eye; even Emperor Jingwen noticed it.
My son is really amazing…
Emperor Jingwen thought about it and finally feared that if he continued like this, the Grand Tutor would retire or some other accident would happen. He had no choice but to bring Lord Cen back.
Lord Cen didn’t feel happy for long before he received such tragic news. He suddenly felt dizzy and could no longer laugh.
The other ministers were even more silent, especially He Xiang and others who were watching the fun from the sidelines, fearing that they would be drafted into the ‘army’. After all, if the trend continued, it was not certain whether they would be included.
If one teacher wasn’t enough, then two teachers would come together, or even Emperor Jingwen himself would take part.
The weather was about to get hot, and Emperor Jingwen planned to go to the temporary palace to escape the heat this year. In his opinion, this was a perfect opportunity to educate his son.
If punishment doesn’t work, bribery might work, right?
Emperor Jingwen didn’t believe that his son, with his love of hustle and bustle, could really hold back and not go to the palace with them, or he could simply take the imperial concubine away and leave him alone to see if he could sit still.
Emperor Jingwen’s original plan was that as long as Xiaojiu could recite ten articles, he would agree to take him this year.
But when flipping through the book, Emperor Jingwen wondered if ten chapters were too many. After all, the point of bribery is not to punish, but to find a way to get him moving.
After deliberating for most of the day and making many deletions and cuts, Emperor Jingwen finally shortened the ten articles to half, leaving only five.
“My two dear ministers, what do you think?” Emperor Jingwen was a novice parent after all, so naturally he had to ask for the opinions of his two teachers.
But whether it was Lord Cen or the Grand Tutor, their expressions were not particularly optimistic.
Even if there are five chapters, it feels like an insurmountable gap for the Ninth Prince.
In their hands, the Ninth Prince had never been able to recite a complete article!
The Grand Tutor spoke tentatively: “Your Majesty, these three articles…what do you think?”
Lord Cen wiped the sweat from his head and said, “Your Majesty, reduce it a little, and then reduce it a little more.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen now suddenly felt extremely regretful. He should not have suppressed his son so severely in the beginning. He should have given his son a good name, a more complete one. “Shuo” means the first day of the month, and it sounds like a bad implication.
Emperor Jingwen sighed deeply, then crossed out two of the five articles he had carefully selected.
The only three remaining articles may be the few that my son can recite, and they are all the essence.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Outrageous
chapters.content:
This person, after making a wrong decision, will often regret it madly afterward, and will think back from time to time, wondering if he had not done this or that, would the outcome have been different.
Including the emperor, Emperor Jingwen was troubled by his own son and even began to put the blame on the naming.
The three of them gathered together to pick and choose, and finally had a few arguments, before finally deciding on the content of the three articles.
If an unaware minister came over, he would think that the three were discussing some national affairs.
The result… was just discussing what books the children should read.
The so-called Four Books and Five Classics, according to the normal order, one should read the Four Books first, and then read the Five Classics. But unfortunately, it is about to enter summer. Spring and summer belong to Yang, and Yang is light and clear. Poetry and music are sounds, and sounds are also light and clear. According to the theory of Yin and Yang health preservation, reading poetry and scriptures in this season is also a good choice.
The crown prince standing aside was speechless when he saw that Emperor Jingwen and the two teachers had even considered these things.
How worrying must my younger brother be that my father and the teachers would treat these three articles as the only three articles they could teach him?
Since this might be the only thing his son could learn, Emperor Jingwen’s attitude naturally had to be more cautious.
Finally, the names of the three articles came out——“Book of Rites: Quli Shang”, “The Great Learning”, “The Analects of Confucius: Learning”
The Book of Rites: Quli Shang has a lot of words, so it was impossible for Ye Shuo to memorize it all. Emperor Jingwen and the three teachers even consciously deleted some of it and only selected the things they wanted Ye Shuo to learn.
It was still early, with nearly half a month left before the scheduled departure date. Assuming that he only had to take this course, Emperor Jingwen felt that his son would be able to recite these three articles.
Compared to other princes who took an average of two or three days to write an article of more than 2,000 words, Emperor Jingwen even gave him twice as much time.
But soon, Emperor Jingwen hesitated again. Just because his other sons could recite it, it didn’t mean that Xiaojiu could do it too.
The other princes were naturally intelligent, and an article of more than 2,000 words was nothing to them, but Xiaojiu…
“Well, I hope it will work.” Being able to make the emperor say the word “hope” is considered a skill.
However, even the Grand Tutor did not think there was anything wrong with what he said. Isn’t it just a hope?
There’s so much content… Never mind, let’s just give it a try, what if it works?
Seeing that the teachers and father said so but actually had no hope in their hearts, the prince couldn’t help but sigh.
Soon the three books were placed in front of Ye Shuo.
Since Xing Yucheng had already memorized these three articles, and what he memorized were not even excerpts, but the complete versions, Xing Yucheng’s first reaction was – this is too easy, there is no difficulty at all!
However, Ye Shuo was thinking, should he go to this palace or not?
The list of names of the accompanying persons has come out today, with the names of his stepfather, the crown prince, the queen, and his mother all on the list. Here, Ye Shuo has to say that his stepfather is really annoying, as he wrote his mother’s name but not his. Isn’t this clearly a trap?
As for the remaining four princes, the fifth prince, the eighth prince, there is no doubt that they will basically go as well.
In such a huge palace, he is the only one left. Isn’t this move by his stepfather too sinister?
Wouldn’t he feel guilty for treating a child like this?
But think about it the other way around. After my cheap father and the others are gone, won’t I be the only one left in this palace? ?
The Empress Dowager knew that she was not popular, so she had little presence in the palace. Even if she was not taken to the temporary palace, she would hardly go out.
In this situation, Ye Shuo is the one with the highest status in the entire palace. Can’t he do whatever he wants then?
The emperor is far away, and his stepfather can’t control him. Even the crown prince and the sixth prince are gone. He is left without anyone to restrain him. Thinking about it, he is actually quite happy.
As for the hot weather, after his stepfather and the others left, the ice in his mother’s share this year would be his, as would the ice in the Sixth Prince’s share, plus his own, the share of a royal concubine and two princes, which would be enough to surround Ye Shuo for 12 hours non-stop. This would feel all right.
Wouldn’t it be wonderful to listen to music and watch plays at that time?
From mid-May to the end of October when he returned from the palace, it was a full half year. Even though Ye Shuo couldn’t leave the palace, he could still have a lot of fun in the palace.
Considering this, Ye Shuo actually tends not to go.
But he was really worried about his mother, things were different now, as the eldest prince’s prestige in the army grew, the protective umbrella of his grandfather was no longer as important as before, if something happened by accident, he would not be able to rush to the rescue in time.
So, my cheap dad is really annoying.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh.
The crown prince went to the temporary palace, and the tutor could follow him. Xing Yucheng had never seen what the temporary palace looked like. Xing Yucheng was feeling happy, but when he turned around, he met the troubled eyes of the Ninth Prince.
Xing Yucheng has a bad intuition.
Wang Ziquan, who came over to deliver a book, felt nervous when he saw this. Although he didn’t understand the Ninth Prince’s idea, no matter what, if the Ninth Prince didn’t go, wouldn’t the emperor and the others have discussed for so long in vain?
Fortunately, Ye Shuo finally took the books in front of him: “Thank you, Eunuch Wang, I understand.” His tone was a little lazy.
Wang Ziquan, however, did not show any dissatisfaction and even breathed a sigh of relief.
No matter what the Ninth Prince’s attitude is, as long as the Ninth Prince can help him complete his task smoothly, he will be happy.
Besides, His Majesty has no way to deal with the Ninth Prince, and it is already quite good that the Ninth Prince is so polite to him.
Wang Ziquan knows how to be content.
“Then I won’t bother the Ninth Prince anymore.” Nowadays, the Ninth Prince’s studies have almost become the most important thing in the palace. Wang Ziquan didn’t dare to disturb him. After getting a positive answer, he left with his people. He left so fast, as if he was afraid that Ye Shuo would go back on his word.
Xing Yucheng was simply stunned.
After flipping through the three books in front of him, Ye Shuo picked out the one with the most words in front of him, without even looking at it, as Xing Yucheng looked incredulous. He then threw it away.
Although Ye Shuo was also curious about what the palace looked like, after all, the temptation of the palace was not that great for him. He only needed to memorize two articles. It would be too much of a loss to ask him to memorize three.
Xing Yucheng was still standing there in a mess: “Your Highness, Your Highness…”
Three articles could be exchanged for nearly half a year’s trip to the palace. In Xing Yucheng’s opinion, it was too good a deal, so he didn’t understand why the Ninth Prince would do this.
You know, other princes have been memorizing books every day but have nothing!
If there were such an opportunity, the other princes would probably fight tooth and nail for it.
“You don’t understand. In fact, parents can be greedy sometimes.” Just kidding. If he really completed the requirements of his cheap dad perfectly this time and fell into his cheap dad’s trap, believe it or not, his cheap dad will dare to double the money next time. Adults are the best at taking advantage of others.
Ye Shuo’s principle is to give his cheap dad a little sweetness to make him feel that this method is useful, and then his cheap dad will throw a bigger bait and give more benefits next time.
When fishing, if you don’t make more nests and put more bait, you still expect to get a harvest? You’re dreaming!
“Just take a look. These two chapters are enough.” Ye Shuo originally wanted to just memorize the few hundred words in “The Analects of Confucius – Learning” and get it over with, but after thinking about it, it seemed a bit too drastic. If he was not careful, it would easily make his stepfather angry, and it would be bad if he really didn’t take him with him.
After thinking it over carefully, Ye Shuo decided to add the 2,000-word article “The Great Learning”.
But we can’t be too hasty about this matter. We have to delay it a bit to whet our cheap father’s appetite, so that he won’t think that what he has memorized is too easy. Next time, when the difficulty is increased, no matter how many articles there are, Ye Shuo will not be able to memorize them.
But Xing Yucheng refused to believe it.
Who is Emperor Jingwen? He is the emperor. How can the emperor go back on his word?
It can only be said that Xing Yucheng understood the emperor, but did not understand the psychology of being a father.
In terms of understanding his biological father, Ye Shuo has reached the pinnacle after two lifetimes of practice.
Sure enough, when Emperor Jingwen heard Wang Ziquan say that his son was not in a very good mood, his heart sank immediately.
You little bastard, you don’t think it’s good to stay in the palace alone, right? ? ?
Thinking about it carefully, it seems that he is indeed not afraid of being alone. The first time he left the palace, he dared to abandon his attendants and tutor and run away.
Emperor Jingwen felt that his painstaking plan was likely to go down the drain.
“How could I have forgotten this…” Emperor Jingwen held his forehead with his hand, feeling somewhat desperate.
Threats were of no use, bribes were of no use, he had been beaten and scolded, but his son was like a copper pea, which could neither be cooked nor crushed, giving him a headache.
The Grand Tutor and Lord Cen were also at a loss. Even though they were the educational experts of the dynasty, they were helpless against the Ninth Prince.
Time passed day by day, and Xing Yucheng saw it and felt anxious.
The Ninth Prince kept saying he would endorse the book, but he didn’t even read the two remaining articles!!!
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye, and tomorrow would be the day to set off for the temporary palace. Xing Yucheng had completely lost hope and felt that he would have to stay in the palace with the Ninth Prince for the next few months.
If possible, Xing Yucheng really wished he could endorse the Ninth Prince. It was really frustrating!
However, at noon, after finishing his lunch, Ye Shuo put down his chopsticks, wiped his mouth, and went straight to the Qinzheng Hall.
Xing Yucheng noticed that the direction he was walking seemed to be different from before. At this time, he did not react until he saw the plaque of the Qinzheng Hall.
“Your Highness, have you finished memorizing that book???”
“Well, I’ve finished reciting it.”
Xing Yucheng was shocked: “Your Highness, w-when???”
I stay with the Ninth Prince all day long, how come I don’t know about this?
But before Xing Yucheng could investigate further, Ye Shuo had already gone in. Xing Yucheng subconsciously followed him and soon forgot about it.
At that time, Emperor Jingwen, who was reviewing memorials, had completely given up the idea. From his initial expectations, he had now given up.
It was not until lunch was over that Wang Ziquan’s voice suddenly came from outside –
“Your Majesty, the Ninth Prince requests an audience.”
Emperor Jingwen was startled at first, almost unable to react, then he thought of something, his eyes lit up, and he didn’t even bother to review the memorial: “Quick, quick, announce it!!”
After about a moment, Ye Shuo stood below with his hands behind his back, and slowly opened his mouth under the expectant gaze of Emperor Jingwen.
Xing Yucheng was very excited at first, but as he listened, he found that the Ninth Prince stumbled when reciting the two articles and often got stuck. However, Emperor Jingwen was not angry at all. Instead, he reminded him in a very good manner. Even if he missed one or two paragraphs or a few words in the middle, Emperor Jingwen barely endured it.
After a whole stick of incense had passed, Ye Shuo had just managed to memorize the two articles.
As for Xing Yucheng who was standing aside, he almost fainted from what he heard.
I thought the Ninth Prince was so confident because he recited it fluently, but in the end, this is it?
“What else? What about the Book of Rites, Part I?”
After asking again and again, the emperor really started to question!
Xing Yucheng held his breath for a moment, watching the Ninth Prince shaking his head. Just when he thought that the emperor would be angry this time, he saw Emperor Jingwen frowning first, and after a long while, his brows gradually smoothed out with great difficulty, as if he had made a very difficult decision. Emperor Jingwen’s mouth moved –
“…good.”
He has memorized it so badly, but His Majesty actually praised him? ? ?
Xing Yucheng’s jaw almost dropped to the ground.
However, this was not the most incredible thing for Xing Yucheng. What made him feel the most incredible was that soon, even Master Cen and Master Tai came…

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Blind Date
chapters.content:
One emperor, two teachers, put down their work and listen attentively to their son/student reciting.
What’s more, they were afraid that he would get nervous and forget what he had memorized with great difficulty, so the three of them didn’t even dare to breathe. They looked much more nervous than Ye Shuo, the person involved.
After Ye Shuo finally finished memorizing the two articles after a long time, the three of them breathed a sigh of relief almost at the same time. They felt like they had survived a calamity, and suddenly they had the urge to cry for joy.
After trying various methods, I finally saw some results today.
In fact, when Emperor Jingwen first heard that Ye Shuo had recited incorrectly, he was about to curse, saying what crap he was reciting, how he was forgetful and nonsense. But when he met Ye Shuo’s eyes, Emperor Jingwen calmed down instantly.
You have to know that the person in front of you is Xiaojiu, not any other son, so you can’t generalize.
It’s quite good that he can achieve this level, we can’t expect too much.
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen changed his mind almost immediately before he could say anything, and turned the words that were meant to scold him into words that praised him.
Xing Yucheng felt that the emperor might be like this, but the two teachers certainly would not, because they were both contemporary masters.
Ye Shuo also felt that he had done well. He smacked his lips, feeling extremely satisfied. He then looked at the two teachers beside him and said, “Master Zhen, Master Cen, what do you think?”He looked so proud, as if he had accomplished something great, and was asking the adults for some candy.
The old faces of the Grand Tutor and Lord Cen trembled almost at the same time.
Finally, they closed their eyes, made up their minds, and said, “…very, very good.”
Xing Yucheng: “…”
The crown prince who had been silent beside him: “…”
The crown prince couldn’t help but look at his teacher with an extremely strange look.
In the past ten years, where had the crown prince seen his teacher like this? Not to mention the “Great Learning” with more than 2,000 words, when he recited all the Four Books, he never saw the teacher praise him so obviously. Just two “OK”s were already the best.
As for Xing Yucheng, his heart was completely dead.
Xing Yucheng and the crown prince didn’t understand that the better they performed, the more their parents and teachers would take their excellence for granted.
If a person already has 95 points, how much further can he improve?
It’s different for players like Ye Shuo who scored zero or even negative points. Any little progress is worth celebrating with firecrackers.
It is a fact that if you do one wrong thing to a good person, you become a bad person, but if a bad person only needs to do one good thing, this good thing will be infinitely magnified.
Of the three articles, Ye Shuo could only recite two, and those were the two with the fewest words. Logically, he should not be allowed to go to the palace, but Emperor Jingwen was afraid of dampening his enthusiasm. If he was not accepted this time, what if he would not take the bait next time?
After considering for a long time, Emperor Jingwen finally nodded reluctantly and added Ye Shuo’s name to the list of accompanying persons.
This matter has both advantages and disadvantages. Although his son did not meet his own requirements this time, it at least gave Emperor Jingwen hope and let Emperor Jingwen know that the path of bribery is feasible.
Ye Shuo was very satisfied with this.
However, Xing Yucheng felt dizzy and didn’t even know how he walked out of the Qinzheng Hall in the end. He had a lot of questions in his mind and wanted to know why.
For not fulfilling His Majesty’s request, His Majesty should scold the Ninth Prince!
Ye Shuo shook his head when he saw this, thinking that it would be difficult for him to understand given his situation as a study partner.
After all, this guy looks like an honest child. He does whatever his parents expect him to do. He has been excellent since he was young, and it is too late for him to give up now.
The two people’s situations are different. Ye Shuo has been bad since he was a child, so Emperor Jingwen got used to it and thought it was nothing. If his study companion started to be bad, then in the eyes of the Minister of Works and his wife, he would be considered decadent.
So, alas, there is no hope in this life, he will try to understand it in the next life.
And the situations of the two are also different. His cheap father wanted to kill him before, but Ye Shuo did these things without any scruples. What is this called? This is called retribution, just debt collection.
As for the Minister of Works and his wife… I can only say that their crimes are not serious enough!
Just like that, under Xing Yucheng’s doubtful gaze, Ye Shuo boarded the last carriage to the palace in a dignified manner.
This made all the ladies in the harem so angry that they almost died. Why, why is the Emperor so good to the Ninth Prince when he is such a waste!
Puzzlement, confusion, jealousy…all kinds of emotions permeated the entire harem.
Ye Shuo pretended not to see it and began to arrange his departure from the palace.
Firstly, there is the ice in my share this year. Ice has to be replaced every year. Fresh water has to be fetched from the river every winter. That is to say, if I don’t use it this summer, I will end up throwing it away.
Ye Shuo thought about it, and then called the Ministry of Internal Affairs, asking them to distribute the ice in their own share equally to Empress Zhao and the others.
Zhao Chongrong, Xu Chongyi and Li Chongyuan were of low rank and not favored, so naturally they were not in the entourage. Ye Shuo did not have the ability to ask his stepfather to add them all into the team. If so, the other concubines would have objections. But if Ye Shuo could make them live a little more comfortably this summer, he could still do it.
Although Concubine Rong didn’t know why her son was always thinking about those three people, she didn’t object, and even gave most of the ice in her share to them.
In this way, even if Zhao Chongrong and the others did not go to the palace, they could still keep cool throughout the summer.
When they received the news from the Ministry of Internal Affairs, Zhao Chongrong and her friends were filled with mixed emotions.
Although the three of them are not favored, they are not stupid. They naturally know who is sincere to them and who is fake.
If the intention is to exploit them, then what value do people like them have?
“Madam, it’s a good thing we opened the palace gates.”
Yes, fortunately the palace gate was opened, but the crown prince forced her to open it with a token, not her own will. Thinking about it now, Zhao Chongrong couldn’t help but feel a little regretful.
Almost at the same time, Zhao Chongrong thought of the red pill again…
The other side.
Almost early in the morning, Ye Shuo crawled out of the bed. His positive look made Emperor Jingwen deeply doubt whether he was pretending to be sleepy when he went to the study room before.
Hearing that everything at the palace was ready, Ye Shuo didn’t pack much and simply traveled light.
The emperor had a sedan chair, the empress had a sedan chair, each concubine and above had a sedan chair, and each concubine below the rank of concubine had a sedan chair for two or three people. In addition, they were accompanied by ministers, guards, palace maids, eunuchs, and all in all, there were thousands of people in total. They left from the Zhengtian Gate in the middle of the palace and the palace gates on both sides in a grand procession.
Thanks to his step-father, Ye Shuo finally got to see what the ancient emperors looked like when they traveled. The scene did look spectacular.
Ancient horse-drawn carriages are not quite the same as we imagine. In fact, they also have shock-absorbing systems, which rely on things called “Fu Tu” and “Dang Tu”. They are located between the floor of the carriage and the axle, especially the “Dang Tu”, which can not only increase stability but also further reduce shock.
The wheels will also be covered with a thick layer of leather, which is equivalent to modern rubber tires.
Overall, it is definitely not as good as the modern shock absorption system, but it is barely adequate, especially since there are thick cushions in the carriage. Overall, it is okay.
After all, we are on an official road, which is paved with blue stone and the road condition is better than ordinary dirt roads.
As if he disdained to associate with women, or perhaps to show off his own strength, no one, including the crown prince, stayed in the carriage. Instead, they all rode horses on both sides of the carriages.
As for the Second Prince and the Fourth Prince…because they performed too well, their stepfather left them in Shangjing City to handle the remaining trivial government affairs.
