See? This is the result of their hard work. The whole family goes out to play without taking them. Although the Second Prince and the Fourth Prince think that this is a sign that their father trusts and values ​​them, and an honor, it is just empty talk in Ye Shuo’s opinion.
The important officials in the court were all taken away by my cheap father. They didn’t come to them for help when there was something going on. Aren’t they just left behind to do hard labor?
Everybody was outside, even the little grandson of the emperor was being taken outside by the guards to see the scenery. Only Ye Shuo was there, resting his head on his mother’s legs, looking extremely leisurely.
What’s fun about riding a horse? It’s not as comfortable as lying down. He can also chat with his mother and Su Yue and Su Xin while lying down.
Suddenly, Ye Shuo thought of something.
“By the way, you guys, don’t you have someone you like yet?” The “you” here refers to none other than Su Yue, Su Xin and the others.
Su Yue and Su Xin were brought into the palace by his mother from the Duke Zhen’s Mansion. Now the youngest is 25 years old and the oldest is 27 or 28 years old, which is considered old maids in ancient times. If they have no plans to get married, it would be fine. But if they do, they still have to make plans early.
Concubine Rong was stunned for a moment when she heard this, and then looked at her maids.
Concubine Rong remembered that she had asked this question a few years ago, but was rejected by the three of them. The three of them did not want to leave the palace either. She didn’t know whether they would change their minds after a few years.
Seeing the Imperial Concubine looking over, Su Yue and the other two all smiled bitterly and shook their heads: “Your Highness, Madam, there really is none.”
Ye Shuo asked again: “Don’t you want to or haven’t met the right person yet?”
They stayed in the palace all year round and hardly saw any men from other places, so naturally they seldom had this opportunity.
Su Yue and the other two were stunned.
Ye Shuo understood.
“You just can’t find the right one, right?”
It’s not that they don’t want to get married and have children.
In this case, it is better to make plans early…
Fortunately, I suddenly thought of this and asked a question.
“That’s great. Take this opportunity to have a good look. If you find someone suitable, just tell me, and I’ll try to help you find one.”
This opportunity is rare. If you miss it, you will never have it again.
People like Su Yue and the others don’t have much contact with people, so every time they miss an opportunity like this, it’s one less chance.
As for getting married, they are not afraid either, because with his mother and him, and even the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion backing them up, they will definitely not be wronged.
Su Yue and Su Xin felt a little embarrassed when they heard this and shook their heads subconsciously.
The Ninth Prince is such a fool. Why would he suddenly ask such a question?
Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows upon seeing this, then opened the curtain a tiny bit and pointed at the team of nearly a thousand people outside.
The team was composed entirely of guards, all of whom had been carefully selected, with neither being too fat nor too thin. They were all trained warriors, with well-proportioned bodies, strong and muscular, and their looks were at least above the passing line. After all, to be qualified to accompany the emperor, their appearance had to pass the test.
As for body shape, they exercise every day, so I guess it won’t be too bad.
Based on the principle of keeping good things for one’s own people, Ye Shuo thought of reminding them.
“You can choose any of these 1,000 guards. Are you sure… you don’t want to consider it?”
“Don’t worry, I will personally help you check it when the time comes.” Ye Shuo’s eyes are not vegetarian.
As the Ninth Prince’s seductive voice rang out, and looking at the cold-faced guards outside, even Su Yue, who was usually the most resolute, couldn’t help but waver.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Selection
chapters.content:
But soon, Su Yue suppressed the impulse in her heart.
Although these tall and cold-faced guards were attractive, they were not within her reach. When Su Yue was outside the palace, she was used to seeing men and women in chaos. Even the servants and boys at home were like this, let alone others.
Even after arriving at the palace, the fighting had not decreased. Su Yue felt that her life now was pretty good. She stayed with the young lady and did not have to worry about food and clothing every day. Now that her qualifications had been improved, she hardly had to do anything herself except serving the imperial concubine. It was a rare peaceful life for her.
Su Yue cherishes everything she has now, so she doesn’t want to break it, but after thinking about it, she decides to just forget it.
“Thank you, Ninth Prince. Thank you for your concern, but… I don’t have such plans.” Su Yue shook her head slightly.
Ye Shuo nodded to show his understanding. Seeing that he was not angry, Su Yue couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
The Ninth Prince cared so much about their lifelong affairs, but Su Yue did not appreciate it. She was worried that the Ninth Prince would be angry.
Soon, Ye Shuo turned around and looked at Su Xin and Su Qiu: “What about you?”
Everyone has their own aspirations and pursuits. Suxin and Suqiu really want to get married, but how can two girls talk about this so openly?
Seeing the two of them being coy, Ye Shuo had to remind them: “In three days at most, our carriages will arrive at the palace. Time is running out. If you miss this opportunity, you will miss it forever. Sometimes, you have to fight for what you want.”Once we arrive at the palace, it will be difficult to see these thousand people again.
“It’s uncertain whether there will be such an opportunity in the future, so you have to think about it carefully.”
Su Xin and Su Qiu had been in the palace for so many years, so they were not fools. After weighing the situation, they immediately stopped being shy.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but nodded when he saw this, and he felt relieved. He knew what he wanted and could tell what was most important. Based on this point, their lives would not be too bad after they got married.
After all, Su Xin and Su Qiu had watched him grow up since he was a child, and Ye Shuo also hoped that they could live a good life in the future.
Live a peaceful and happy life.
There is just one thing. One of them is 25 and the other is already 26. Can they really find the right one? How can a man of this age say he is not married?
As if he could see the two’s worries, Ye Shuo waved his hand and said, “It’s okay. Even if the man is one or two years younger than you, it won’t have much of an impact.”
This gap is nothing, the most important thing is that the two people can see eye to eye.
“As for whether they are married or not, you don’t have to worry about it. I will ask the commander outside later which of his guards are still unmarried.”
Although Ye Shuo, a modern man, doesn’t care, this is ancient times after all. Considering Su Xin and Su Qiu’s good reputation, it is impossible for Ye Shuo to start the election in front of so many people.
I will only tell the leader of the Black Armor Guards about that and I believe that anyone who can reach this position is not a big mouth. He should know what can be said and what cannot be said.
“Don’t worry, I’ll take care of everything.”
Suxin and Suqiu opened their mouths, but were somewhat speechless.
To be honest, it was a blessing for slaves like them to be able to follow such a master. Even the imperial concubine, who was arrogant and domineering in the eyes of outsiders, had never treated them badly.
Su Xin and Su Qiu felt that they had nothing to repay, so they could only try their best to give back a little.
Thinking carefully about what she has now, an idea suddenly crossed Su Xin’s mind. She bit her lower lip and said boldly in a very low voice: “If Your Highness has a candidate in mind, if Your Highness has taken a fancy to someone, this servant… this servant is willing to listen to Your Highness.”
To be valued by the prince, the other party must be from a prominent family. Su Xin no longer wanted the position of the main wife, and she would accept the position of concubine.
Ye Shuo understood her meaning almost instantly. The above sentence rolled over Su Yue’s mind two or three times, and Su Yue soon understood it.
Su Yue was shocked at first, but then she felt it was natural.
If it were her, I think she would make the same choice.
Only Concubine Rong was completely unaware: “When you get married, you will definitely choose the one you like. What’s the use of his likes? It’s not like he will spend his whole life with him. What is Su Xin thinking about?” She thought her maid had something wrong with her brain.
Although the brain waves of mother and son are not on the same channel, they are strangely overlapping at this moment.
Ye Shuo laughed and said, “What mother meant is what I meant.”
He just suddenly remembered that he wanted to arrange a blind date for Su Xin and the others, but why did it end up being so complicated.
Su Xin trembled slightly, lowered her eyes subconsciously, and said nothing more.
“…Thank you, Your Majesty, and thank you, Your Highness.”
“By the way, I have to make it clear in advance that no one is perfect. You have to think clearly about what you want most.” If it is love at first sight, then there is no problem at all. However, love at first sight is only a minority after all, and more importantly, you have to consider the issue of how to live together later.
No one can be said to be perfect. If Su Xin and Su Qiu care about the man’s future, they will have to lower the threshold for other aspects of the man. If Su Xin and Su Qiu care about the man being a family-oriented and loyalty, they will have to try to accept the other party’s mediocrity.
Men who are ambitious and capable face more temptations, while men who care more about their families spend more time at home and have less energy to invest in their careers.
As one thing increases while the other decreases, it is impossible to be perfect. If a person is strong in one aspect, other shortcomings will inevitably appear. Therefore, it is most important to distinguish what you want most.
“This concerns your happiness for the rest of your life, so don’t feel embarrassed and think it through carefully.”
How could he, a child of only a few years old, understand so many twists and turns? He can talk about such things in a very clear and logical way.
Concubine Rong looked at her son with a strange expression.
At this time, Su Xin and Su Qiu were a little confused, but Ye Shuo was not in a hurry and waited quietly for the answers from the two.
Of course, since Ye Shuo is helping to judge, the standards in other aspects cannot be too low. If they are too low, it would be better to keep them both in the palace for the rest of their lives.
After hearing what Ye Shuo said, Su Xin and the others immediately felt relieved and no longer had any worries.
Soon, Suxin and Suqiu made their decisions respectively.
Suxin chose a good future, while Suqiu chose a peaceful and stable life.
Being able to expose her ambition in front of Ye Shuo, Su Xin can be said to have unreserved trust in Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo nodded: “I understand.”
Su Xin breathed a sigh of relief when she saw that the Ninth Prince did not look at her strangely and did not think that she was snobbish.
“Don’t worry, everyone has different tendencies and there’s nothing to be ashamed of.”
Su Xin’s face turned slightly red, but she gradually calmed down.
After a while, when the commander-in-chief of the Black Armor Guard came on horseback for inspection and passed by here, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but waved to him.
“?”
Although he was confused for a moment, the commander-in-chief still rode over when the prince called him.
“Your Highness, what do you want?”
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate to ask directly, “Among your subordinates, how many of the thousand guards in front of you are still unmarried?”
The commander-in-chief: “???”
The commander-in-chief became more and more confused: “Your Highness, what are you doing…?”
“Here’s the thing. I know two girls, in their 20s, who are not engaged yet. I wanted to ask if you have any suitable young people.”
Ye Shuo did not say who it was, but the commander-in-chief was not stupid, and he subconsciously looked inside the carriage. Then he remembered that the imperial concubine was also there, so he was startled and quickly looked away.
In their twenties…the only ones who are still unmarried in their twenties are the personal maids of the imperial concubine in the palace.
The commander-in-chief just couldn’t understand why the Ninth Prince…
Seeing him in a daze, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but urge him, “Don’t be in a daze, are there any? How many are there?”
The commander-in-chief answered subconsciously: “About one or two hundred.”
Ye Shuo was shocked: “There are still so many left?”
“What’s going on? How come there are so many left?” Ye Shuo thought there would be at most a few dozen.
Ye Shuo asked: “Is it a personal reason or a family reason?”
“About half-and-half, mostly due to family reasons.” The Black Armor Guards do have slightly more people with good family backgrounds than the military, but there are nearly 10,000 people in the entire Black Armor Guards, and it is impossible to say that every one of them has a good family background. After all, civilians make up the majority.
Just like among the thousand people accompanying the emperor, at least seven or eight hundred are of commoner origin.
As for those who are still unmarried in their twenties, they are either from extremely poor families with little financial resources and few holidays, or they simply have no parents to worry about them and have been dragging it on until now. Some are exiled by their families, some are illegitimate sons who can’t make it in their families and want to join the army to try their luck, some are legitimate sons whose mothers died and whose fathers married a second wife, and some are completely abandoned by their families, some have parents who are still around but not favored, and some whose parents are no longer around and whose property has been taken away…
There are many Black Armor Guards, and there are all kinds of situations, some of which are due to personality reasons, but those who are not married simply for personality reasons are only a minority.
As they were talking, the commander-in-chief also became interested.
After all, he has so many bachelors under his command, and as the commander-in-chief, he is worried. Now that there is an opportunity, the commander-in-chief also wants to deal with them as many as possible.
Although Suxin and Suqiu are maids, don’t forget whose maids they are.
The imperial concubine’s maids were considered prominent figures even in the imperial palace, and outside the palace only respectable officials could hire them, so apart from the dozens of leaders of the Black Armor Guards, Su Xin and Su Qiu were worthy of anyone.
As for age, the commander-in-chief didn’t care that much. With about a hundred bachelors, it was good enough for him to find a wife. Why be so picky?
Only……
“Your Highness, may I meet these two girls?” the commander-in-chief asked tentatively.
Ye Shuo also expected the other party to do a screening first, so he did not refuse.
Of course, the two of them certainly couldn’t do it so obviously, so when they arrived at the post station, Ye Shuo sent Su Xin and Su Qiu down to fetch water.
The commander-in-chief took a look from a distance. Although the two girls were not stunningly beautiful, they were good-looking and their every move was elegant. They were not worse than ordinary ladies.
As expected of someone close to the imperial concubine, even her maidservants are so well-educated.
The commander-in-chief also understood that the Ninth Prince was so worried about these two people, and he did not want to offend the Ninth Prince over this matter, so he simply removed nearly half of the one hundred people.
It is impossible for the commander-in-chief to remember all the rest of their family situations and personalities, but he has a good understanding of their height and appearance. At least the height and appearance of the rest will not be bad.
It was impossible for Emperor Jingwen not to know about what happened in the convoy. He was extremely curious. What could his son and the commander-in-chief talk about that made them talk for such a long time? So Emperor Jingwen also raised his hand and called the commander-in-chief over.
“You and Shuo’er, what were you two talking about just now?”
“…Your Majesty, I am discussing the lifelong affairs of our respective subordinates with His Majesty the Ninth Prince.”
Emperor Jingwen: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Stunned
chapters.content:
Emperor Jingwen thought of many reasons, but he never expected it to be this one.
Wouldn’t it be better for him to use his time for something useful?
Seeing that His Majesty was silent, the commander-in-chief beside him felt a little embarrassed. He didn’t think much of it before His Majesty didn’t speak, but now that His Majesty pointed it out, the commander-in-chief found that discussing this matter with the prince did seem a little…
Honestly speaking, as the leader of the Black Armor Guards, people like the Second Prince have tried to win him over, but the Commander-in-Chief is not close to anyone and is prepared to stick to his own path until the end.
This was the first time I talked so much with the prince, and it turned out to be about matchmaking.
“…Okay, you can go now.” The emperor and his minister looked at each other in silence. Finally, Emperor Jingwen waved his hand and told the commander-in-chief to leave.
The commander-in-chief hurriedly clasped his fists and saluted.
Now that His Majesty knew about it, the matter was out in the open, and the commander-in-chief suddenly became much bolder. However, on the surface, the commander-in-chief certainly did not say that.
So, under the pretext of patrolling, he moved the fifty or so men to the vicinity of the imperial concubine’s carriage, ensuring that the Ninth Prince would be able to see these people’s faces when he lifted the curtain.
The commander-in-chief was worthy of being the one arranged by his stepfather to guard the stability of the capital. He was highly efficient and not at all slow. He arranged everything in just a cup of tea.Ye Shuo opened the curtain a little, and quickly called Su Xin and Su Qiu over: “Come and take a look, see if you find anything you like.”
Normally, even if the palace maids and servants were to marry, they would be assigned by the master’s family, which was considered a favor. They have never heard of a girl being asked to choose her own husband, and there were so many of them at once.
Even Suxin and Suqiu couldn’t help but feel their hearts pounding.
Because of Ye Shuo’s previous attitude, the two men became bolder.
Such an opportunity is rare, and you would be doing yourself a disservice if you don’t cherish it. This is a treatment that other women don’t have!
She suppressed her shame. Although it seemed that Ye Shuo was watching, in fact, in the corner where no one was paying attention, Su Xin and Su Qiu also had a clear view of those fifty people.
There were fifty handsome men, and the two of them were dazzled by the choice.
“Well, how do you feel about this?” Ye Shuo asked in a low voice as a man with a resolute face passed by.
Su Xin and Su Qiu thought about it for a while and shook their heads at the same time: “It’s too dark.”
I get it, girls don’t like guys with dark skin.
“What about this?” Ye Shuo asked again.
Suxin and Suqiu shook their heads again.
“Then…this?”
This time, before Su Xin and Su Qiu could speak, it was Concubine Rong who helped to reject them: “He has a messy beard, and you can tell at a glance that he doesn’t like to keep clean.”
It turned out that the imperial concubine couldn’t help but look in after seeing how animatedly they were discussing.
This glance was not a big deal, but the imperial concubine discovered that her son’s vision was really worrying.
“How is this sloppy? It’s very manly.” Ye Shuo felt that being strong and not fussy was what a man should be.
However, in the imperial concubine’s view, a man should at least be clean, like Emperor Jingwen, and it would be good enough. At least they would not feel uncomfortable sleeping on the same bed.
Who would like to face a husband who doesn’t wash his feet or shave every day?
Just thinking about the imperial concubine makes me feel suffocated.
Ye Shuo turned his head to look at Su Xin and Su Qiu, only to see Su Xin and Su Qiu nodding hurriedly, obviously agreeing with his master’s words.
Ye Shuo: “…”
“It’s actually quite normal for a man not to shave occasionally…”
Ignoring her son’s opinion, the imperial concubine quickly continued to look over.
Seeing that he couldn’t say, Ye Shuo had no choice but to give up his explanation.
All of them were wearing black armor and their faces were above the passing line. Just when the imperial concubine and the other two were dazzled, one of the young men who had just accidentally slipped away from them seemed to have heard something. He turned back subconsciously, revealing a handsome face under the armor.
The Imperial Concubine was fine, she was used to seeing Emperor Jingwen every day, plus he was the most handsome man in the entire harem and had a very handsome face, so the young man’s appearance was just ordinary in her eyes. It was only because of his young age that she thought he was worth looking at.
Not to mention Ye Shuo and Su Yue. Ye Shuo could have killed the other person in seconds in his previous life, let alone this life. As for Su Yue, she was calm and had no such thoughts at all. In her eyes, the man was nothing more than a pink skeleton.
But Suxin and Suqiu were different. They were two girls who had stayed in the palace for a long time and had never seen the world. With so many ferocious armored guards as a backdrop, each other looked even more handsome.
It’s that kind of… feeling that is completely different from others.
After all, Suqiu was pursuing a peaceful and stable life. After she realized what was happening, she immediately looked away and dared not look again.
As for Su Xin, it was obvious that the girl was moved.
The scumbag radar in Ye Shuo’s heart immediately turned on.
Looking at this angle, looking back, and the contrast between the left and right sides, Ye Shuo would never believe that he didn’t do it on purpose.
But seeing that Su Xin was obviously moved, Ye Shuo didn’t say anything, but secretly memorized this face in his heart.
After more than fifty people took a round, Suqiu quickly chose the person she liked.
Judging from the other party’s face, he looks very honest, but whether he is really honest or just pretending to be honest, Ye Shuo still needs to verify it.
“Okay, leave the rest to me.” It would be difficult for the unmarried girls to come forward. After Ye Shuo had a target, he pushed open the door of the carriage and went out.
Miraculously, Su Xin and Su Qiu who were left inside did not feel nervous at all. Perhaps they believed in the Ninth Prince. Since the Ninth Prince said so, there must be no problem.
The other side.
Not long after Ye Shuo got out of the carriage, the commander-in-chief came over.
“Your Highness, how is your choice?” The commander-in-chief did not consider that it was not he who would see it, but two maids, and subconsciously concluded that as long as the Ninth Prince nodded, the matter would be settled.
Ye Shuo did not refute. After all, asking Su Xin and Su Qiu to choose their own husband was indeed a bit too unorthodox.
“This person, and this person… What is their family situation, Commander-in-Chief? Do you know?”
The commander-in-chief has so many people under his command, how could he remember them all? Then he called his deputy over.
The deputy should be in charge of this, and he brought the basic roster over after a while.
After all, everyone who is following the emperor this time has their identity registered.
After listening to Ye Shuo’s description, the deputy quickly found the corresponding person and turned to the page belonging to the two of them. Their age, hometown, and life story were clearly visible.
“Zhang Yuan, 25, from Huzhou, his family is poor, he has no food to eat, later he joined the army and has been in the army ever since…” Needless to say, this Zhang Yuan is the one Suqiu has taken a fancy to. Judging from the roster, there is really nothing special about him. The only thing that makes him look good is that he has the rank of a ninth-rank deputy lieutenant of benevolence and bravery.
Ye Shuo continued to read.
“Li Yuheng, 22, from Jizhou, both parents are deceased, and he has a younger brother, Li Jun.”
The two characters “Yuheng” should come from the line “Only because of development, ‘Yu’ Youzhao & ‘Heng’ yi” in “Sending Chen Xundao & Ding Neijian Back to Fujian”, which probably means that he hopes his children will be knowledgeable, quick-thinking, and have a strong moral character.
[1] Don’t ask, just read.
Logically speaking, parents who could give such a name should be very knowledgeable, but why is it that when it comes to Li Yuheng’s younger brother, he is so different?
It’s not the case that ordinary parents would suppress their younger children, even if they are illegitimate children.
As Ye Shuo thought about this, a hint of sadness inevitably showed up on his face.
Seeing him frown, the commander-in-chief subconsciously asked, “Your Highness, is there anything wrong?”
Ye Shuo paused, then said casually: “If his parents were still alive, it would be fine. But Li Yuheng’s parents are gone, and he is all alone with a younger brother. If his younger brother gets married in the future, won’t he have to take care of it all? He doesn’t have so much savings, won’t he ask the girl to make up for it when the time comes?”
Ye Shuo said this, but in his heart he was thinking that although Li Yuheng was only a ninth-rank lieutenant of benevolence and bravery, he had done much more than the man above, and had a long list of followers. It was just that the capital had become much more stable since his stepfather ascended the throne, and there was not so much work to do. Even if he had done a lot, he could not be promoted without enough achievements.
Ye Shuo is now almost certain that the other party must have had a purpose when he looked back at him.
It can be seen that this is a very ambitious person.
The commander-in-chief summoned a total of fifty people, all of whom were unmarried. This was such an obvious feature that even if the other party guessed it, Ye Shuo would not find it strange.
Although he is ambitious, he actually meets Su Xin’s requirements. I just don’t know what he is like in other aspects.
Ye Shuo remained calm, and gradually an idea came to his mind.
The commander-in-chief next to him did not doubt anything when he heard this. After all, in the eyes of the public, it was indeed a burden when his parents died early, and he did not have much savings and had a younger brother. It was normal for the Ninth Prince to feel dissatisfied.
“In that case, then I will -“
“Wait, don’t be in a hurry. Keep it for now and add this person in first. If this person doesn’t work, I will consider this person named Li Yuheng.” Ye Shuo flipped through the roster and chose the person behind Li Yuheng based on his memory.
Finally, after closing the roster, Ye Shuo said with a smile, “Please, Commander-in-Chief, please arrange for this person and the one called Zhang Yuan to teach me how to ride a horse. This prince doesn’t know how to ride a horse yet, so this is a good opportunity for me to practice.”
Li Yuheng is a smart man, but the smarter he is, the more likely he is to lose his composure when his plans fail.
He didn’t expect that the Ninth Prince was so serious. He had thought it was just a child’s whim.
It seems that the two girls have quite some face in front of the Ninth Prince.
The commander-in-chief nodded and said, “Okay, I’ll do it right away.”
The other side.
After the patrol was over, Li Yuheng returned to the back of the team and felt that this time he had a sure win.
At first, Li Yuheng didn’t know what the commander-in-chief wanted to do by transferring them from the team, but as more people gathered around him, Li Yuheng gradually understood.
They are all bachelors in the Black Armor Guard who have never married. Gathering these people together, the answer is self-evident.
After careful observation, Li Yuheng even noticed the eyes of the woman behind the lifted curtain in the imperial concubine’s carriage.
After all, the Ninth Prince is young. If one observes carefully, how could he not discover the person behind him?
This was the first time that Li Yuheng saw the Ninth Prince. The moment he saw him, Li Yuheng’s heart began to beat wildly.
He felt that his chance had come.
Judging from the woman’s attire, she should be a maid.
That’s right, if the woman selecting was of noble status, why would it be the turn of guards like them who were born as commoners?
She would straight pick the leading officials’ children.
Although she is just a maid, considering that the Ninth Prince has mobilized so many troops, it would be a great opportunity for me if I could win his favor.
Although he felt that this move was extremely unorthodox, the fact that the Ninth Prince was willing to ask the maid to watch from the side proved that the maid’s opinion was also very important.
Li Yuheng had a very good plan. As long as he could find a way to win the favor of the maid, the rest of the problems would not be a problem.
As for how to win the other party’s favor, Li Yuheng is quite confident in his appearance and knows how to maximize his advantages.
As it turned out, he was successful. Li Yuheng did not miss the maid’s stunned look.
Li Yuheng was a little excited. Just when he thought that it would finally work this time, he saw the commander-in-chief coming over, first called Zhang Yuan’s name, and then looked in his direction.
Li Yuheng was certain in his heart, but before he could laugh, he saw the commander-in-chief move his gaze back an inch and called out the name of the person behind him.
Li Yuheng was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Choice
chapters.content:
How come!
How could it be this person and not myself!
Li Yuheng was shocked and angry when his plan failed.
Then Zhang Yuan and another man named Zhang Wen were suddenly called out. Although they were puzzled, they still followed the commander-in-chief’s order and walked out of the team.
“The Ninth Prince said he wanted to learn how to ride a horse. You two should go and teach him how to ride a horse.”
Upon hearing this, Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen were both surprised and happy.
Being able to get close to an honorable person, and a prince at that, is a blessing that many people would ask for. Even a fool would know that being able to show up in front of an honorable person is simply a godsend. There are nearly 10,000 Black Armor Guards, and how many of them can have this opportunity?
Zhang Yuan is just honest, but there is nothing wrong with his brain.
Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen hurriedly accepted the order: “Thank you, Commander-in-Chief. We will go now!”
“Yes. Oh, by the way, don’t let the Ninth Prince stay too far away from the team, or the Emperor will blame you. Also, you must be careful when teaching the Ninth Prince to ride a horse, and you must not let the Ninth Prince make any mistakes. Do you understand?” The Ninth Prince is now the Emperor’s most beloved prince. If anything goes wrong, not to mention the two of them, he will also be the one to suffer the consequences.The commander-in-chief had to remind him.
Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen couldn’t help but feel nervous at the moment.
After seeing the two off, the commander-in-chief originally planned to leave, after all, he still had things to do.
But when he accidentally saw Li Yuheng standing nearby, the commander-in-chief subconsciously stopped.
It’s just like a leader’s attitude towards his most outstanding employee. No matter what the employee’s level is, at least the leader will have an impression of him or her.
Li Yuheng was one of these people in the Black Armor Guards. Although his rank was not high, he was hardworking, dedicated, and smart, so it was inevitable that he was remembered by the commander-in-chief.
Seeing that the other party lost the election, the commander-in-chief was actually quite regretful.
How come such an outstanding young man failed to catch the eye of the Ninth Prince?
The commander-in-chief sighed inwardly, and then couldn’t help asking, “I heard… you have a younger brother with you?”
Li Yuheng was such a smart man. When he heard this, he immediately understood why he was not chosen by the Ninth Prince, and why the Ninth Prince ignored him even after the maid was obviously moved.
Li Yuheng had planned everything, but he had forgotten to take his younger brother Li Jun into account.
He forgot that in the eyes of others, he was such a burden raising a younger brother all by himself without the support of his parents.
Especially after the parents are gone, according to custom, the elder brother not only has to raise his younger brother, but also has to find a way to marry and have children for his younger brother. The eldest sister-in-law is like a mother, which means that the girl naturally becomes a mother when she marries into the family. In this case, how many girls’ families would be willing to marry their daughters into the family?
But in fact, just as Ye Shuo guessed, Li Jun was indeed not Li Yuheng’s biological brother, and he was not even a concubine’s son. He was just the son of his father’s good friend.
This can be seen from their names. It is impossible for brothers to have such different names.
Li Yuheng was born into a wealthy family. His father was a businessman and was one of the richest businessmen in Jizhou City. In his early years, Li Yuheng’s life was extremely comfortable and happy.
However, the good times did not last long. One time when my father was doing business, he accidentally offended someone he should not have offended, and as a result, he brought disaster upon the whole family, and even his good friends who had come to help him were implicated.
The two families tried their best and only managed to save their own children.
From then on, the seventeen-year-old Li Yuheng began a life of exile with the son of his father’s friend. In order to avoid being hunted down, Li Yuheng changed his own name “Yang” and his father’s friend’s name “Hu” to an unfamiliar name “Li”.
Thanks to the connections left by his father, he was able to regain his household registration in Shangjing City, and he and Li Jun, who was only ten years old, became brothers in the eyes of others.
However, when the disaster of extermination of the family occurred, Li Yuheng was already seventeen years old. How could he forget such a deep hatred?
During the two years of wandering, Li Yuheng tried almost every possible way. He even thought about practicing martial arts. As long as he could kill that dog official, he would not lose out.
But unfortunately, at the age of seventeen, he had already missed the best opportunity to practice martial arts. Even if he tried harder, he could only achieve an upper-middle level and could not even break into the government office.
As for studying, not everyone can become famous. The imperial examination is held every three years and has to go through four stages: the provincial examination, the metropolitan examination, and the palace examination. Even if you pass the exam and become the top scorer, you still have to start as a minor official and then slowly move up. Ordinary people have no way to stand out from so many people.
Finally, Li Yuheng turned his attention to the army.
If there is any place where one can be promoted the fastest, it must be joining the army. What’s more, the dog official is a civil servant and cannot reach the military generals. The military camp is an excellent umbrella of protection for Li Yuheng.
So Li Yuheng signed up for the Black Armor Guard without hesitation. The reason why he fought so hard was because he wanted to avenge the extermination of his family.
What Li Yuheng had not expected was that as the current emperor’s reign lasted longer, his methods of governing the country became more rigorous, and with his diligence and hard work, the chaos around him gradually disappeared.
Without so much chaos, there wouldn’t be so many achievements, and Li Yuheng wouldn’t be promoted.
Three full years passed, and Li Yuheng barely got the rank of lieutenant of benevolence and bravery, a ninth-rank officer.
At this rate, Li Yuheng felt that he would never be able to get revenge in this lifetime. With nowhere else to turn, he could only think of another way.
After so many years of torture day and night, Li Yuheng was on the verge of madness. Li Yuheng no longer cared about anything, and he even secretly swore that as long as he could get revenge, he would do anything and accept anything, and he was willing to pay any price.
Hence, he looked back just now.
But in the end, he still failed because of his father’s good friend’s son, his younger brother.
Maybe God is so cruel. Li Yuheng felt completely hopeless for a moment and suddenly could not see any hope.
Li Yuheng uttered “hmm” in a daze. The commander-in-chief did not get any other response for a long time. He sighed and left.
After all, he was just an ordinary guard, and it was good enough that the commander-in-chief could ask him one more question.
Li Yuheng didn’t even know when he left. By the time Li Yuheng reacted, the commander-in-chief and Zhang Yuan were gone. The remaining black-armored guards looked at him with strange eyes.
After all, in the eyes of other Black Armor Guards, Li Yuheng’s expression was not right when he heard that Zhang Yuan and the other were selected. What else could this be but jealousy?
Normally, this guy is like this, always liking to show off in front of the superiors and thinking he is smart. Now, the Ninth Prince would rather choose Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen than him.
The other side.
Ye Shuo thought about it and always felt that something was wrong.
Apart from Li Yuheng’s younger brother, there was also something strange about his parents.
Normally speaking, if parents died of illness, it would be written as death from illness. If they died of an accident, the word “accident” would also be written. This is a normal human reaction.
Such an incomplete story is extremely rare, unless… there are special circumstances, and then they choose to be vague and pass it over.
Of course, all this is just speculation. No matter what, this person named Li Yuheng is not normal.
Just as Ye Shuo was making all kinds of assumptions in his mind, the commander-in-chief quickly came over with a horse.
This horse was carefully selected by the commander-in-chief based on his own experience. It has a docile temperament and is especially suitable for beginners like the Ninth Prince.
It’s the kind that won’t necessarily get angry even if you hit it with two sticks.
Ye Shuo looked at the chestnut horse in front of him whose mane had turned white and seemed to be about to be buried in the ground. After a moment of silence, he slowly shifted his gaze to the commander-in-chief’s face.
The commander-in-chief was somewhat embarrassed, but there was nothing he could do. The Ninth Prince was still young, and was well-bred in the palace. He had a noble status and was favored. Shouldn’t the commander-in-chief be more careful?
Even if something unexpected happened, this old horse couldn’t run fast anyway, so it was unlikely that anything would go wrong.
The commander-in-chief hasn’t seen this old horse running wildly for nearly two years, so he chose it because it is safe.
Ye Shuo was such a respectful person to the elderly and loving the young that he was too embarrassed to climb onto the back of this old horse.
“…How about this, I’ll lead it to get used to it and walk around twice first.”
The commander-in-chief naturally had no objection at all.
“Zhang Yuan, Zhang Wen, His Highness’s safety is in your hands.”
Hearing this, Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen’s expressions suddenly became serious: “Yes!”
Just like that, Emperor Jingwen, who was having a rare moment of free time in the imperial carriage pulled by six horses and was drinking tea and playing chess with Prime Minister He, watched his son leading a horse, that was so old that it couldn’t be any older, pass by his carriage.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
He Xiang: “…”
The conversation stopped abruptly, and both of them paused.
“What is this little bastard doing there??”
Wang Ziquan: “Your Majesty, the Ninth Prince said he wanted to practice riding.”
What a bullshit riding practice! He was just leading a horse around!
How does he manage to look so careless no matter what he does?
Emperor Jingwen has now reached the point where he feels upset whenever he sees him.
“Tell me, he’s been doing this all day long, can’t he just be quiet for a while?”
Looking at the emperor who was playing chess and muttering unconsciously at the same time, He Xiang was tactful enough to remain silent and just listened to the emperor complaining quietly.
On the other side, Ye Shuo didn’t know that he was in the eyes of his cheap father just because he was leading a horse. He led the horse around for a long time and felt that the horse’s physical fitness was not bad, not as weak as he imagined, so he climbed up with the help of Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen.
After observation, I found that Zhang Yuan was indeed the kind of person who didn’t talk much but was very responsible. He always focused on the reins in his hand and was always alert to the movements of the horse.
As for Zhang Wen, he talked a lot, and he was the one doing most of the talking along the way.
Not long after Ye Shuo got on his horse, he ran into Li Yuheng who was returning from patrol.
Sure enough, Ye Shuo found that his entire aura had changed.
It was just a small failure, so there shouldn’t be such a big reaction.
The reason why Ye Shuo paid so much attention to him was because this person was working hard and had a resume that was obviously different from others, instead of simply relying on nepotism and his own face.
Based on this, Ye Shuo felt that the other party was worth testing, and he would not give up on him just because he saw that he was scheming.
Now that his parents are gone, there is no such thing as parental expectations or family anticipation. I just don’t know why he is so eager to climb up.
After all, people who are born ambitious are still a minority. Most people first need external forces to push them before they have the motivation to move forward.
Li Yuheng noticed that the Ninth Prince passed by his team, and according to the rules, he subconsciously lowered his head.
Just when Li Yuheng thought that the Ninth Prince would leave without looking away, he heard a voice suddenly coming from above –
“So it’s you.”
“Well, look up.”
Li Yuheng was very sure that when he turned around, the Ninth Prince must have seen him, so he was not so surprised that he suddenly spoke to him.
Li Yuheng did not dare to disobey and did as he was told subconsciously.
The next moment, he heard the Ninth Prince looking at himself, talking to himself as if sighing and regretful.
“Oh, everything is good, except why there is a younger brother…”
Li Yuheng clenched his fists.
Before he could reply, Ye Shuo asked again: “By the way, let me ask you, is your brother… your biological brother?”
Li Yuheng has never heard of this question since the household registration was changed. Could it be that the Ninth Prince discovered something? !
The flash of panic in Li Yuheng’s eyes did not escape Ye Shuo’s eyes. Ye Shuo was just asking casually, but he didn’t expect that he could guess it right.
You can’t tell too much to someone as smart as Li Yuheng. If you tell him too much, he will soon know that you are interested in him.
It would be bad if the guest becomes the host.
Without giving Li Yuheng time to react, Ye Shuo casually waved his hand, seeming a little impatient: “Forget it, whether he is your biological brother or not, I only want to ask you one question, can you send your brother away?”
“If you send your brother away, I will let you marry the maidservant next to my mother. How about that?”
The tone was full of dandy arrogance, as if he didn’t care about the other person’s flesh and blood relationship at all.
On one side is the great revenge for the extermination of the family, and on the other side is the son of his father’s best friend, who had died because of working hard for their family.
Faced with such a choice, Li Yuheng’s face turned pale after a few words.

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Fear
chapters.content:
Is it revenge or gratitude?
Li Yuheng was almost driven crazy by this choice. No matter who faced this situation, no one could remain absolutely rational.
Reason reminded Li Yuheng that sending Li Jun away might be his only chance. He believed that Li Jun could understand, after all, his parents also died at the hands of that corrupt official.
But on the other hand, emotions reminded Li Yuheng that driving a ten-year-old child out of the house would be like asking for his life.
A ten-year-old child has no survival skills at all.
Li Yuheng felt hot and cold all over, as if he had been split in half by an axe. His reason and emotions were clamoring wildly, making him wish he could die.
Ye Shuo on the other side seemed not to notice his pain and continued to urge him: “What’s so difficult about this choice? At worst, you can just send your brother to a charity.”
It was particularly easy for him to say this, so it seemed even more cruel.
The charity hall of the Zhou Dynasty was equivalent to an orphanage, which not only contained orphanages and nursing homes, but also other things. It could be considered an ancient version of an official charity organization.
Charitable organizations are not omnipotent no matter where they are located, not to mention that in ancient times when productivity was so backward, even if they could guarantee food and drink for the elderly and babies, their lives would definitely not be easy. That is why so many people would rather struggle for a living outside than go there.Li Jun didn’t become rich following Li Yuheng, but Li Yuheng’s monthly salary was enough for the two of them to have enough food and clothing.
Thinking of this, Li Yuheng suddenly calmed down.
I believe that if my father’s good friend were still alive, he would also feel that keeping his child well-fed and clothed is more important than avenging him.
But inevitably, I will let my parents down.
“I’m sorry, Your Highness the Ninth Prince. Li Jun is my younger brother. I’m sorry that I can’t…” When saying this, Li Yuheng’s heart was bleeding. He only hated himself for being incompetent. He was afraid that he would not be able to avenge his parents and his whole family in this lifetime.
Perhaps because he was in so much pain, Li Yuheng spoke every word with great difficulty.
“Thank you, Ninth Prince, for your kindness…”
Ye Shuo watched this man speak just two sentences. After he finished speaking, he looked like he had been fished out of the water. He was sweating profusely, as if he had used up all his strength. His eyes became empty and numb, like a walking corpse.
Ye Shuo was almost certain that something was wrong.
“Tsk, that’s meaningless.”
Just when Li Yuheng was sure that there was no room for maneuver in this matter, he heard the person above him suddenly ask: “By the way, how is your riding skill?”
Li Yuheng was stunned for a moment, and saw that the Ninth Prince seemed a little impatient. Although he didn’t know what he meant, Li Yuheng still spoke faster than his brain and hurriedly replied: “Your Highness, I am very good at riding.”
Li Yuheng was born into a wealthy family. Although he was a merchant, he could not wear silk clothes, ride in a luxurious carriage, take the imperial examination, or become an official, but there was no hindrance for him to ride a horse.
When Li Yuheng was in his teens, his favorite thing was to go hunting and playing with his friends on horseback in the suburbs. Looking back on those days, he felt very happy.
Li Yuheng also learned his riding skills at that time. Compared with the other guards of the Black Armor Guard who were born as commoners and had rarely seen horses, he could naturally be considered an expert.
Unfortunately, Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen were the kind of guards who had never seen a horse before. So, they were only there to accompany Ye Shuo in horse riding practice, just to protect him from getting hurt. As for controlling and riding the horse, that was really too difficult for them.
There are more than 10,000 Black Armor Guards in total, and there are only a few horses in the entire Great Zhou. People like Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen are lucky enough to be able to practice riding two or three times a year, and others cannot be too demanding.
So Ye Shuo asked again: “Do you know the skills of riding a horse?”
Li Yuheng reacted, and his heart started beating wildly.
Opportunities are rare and will never come again. Li Yuheng spoke decisively: “Your Highness, I understand!”
Ye Shuo: “Okay, then you can take Zhang Yuan’s place and lead the horse for me.”
The saying “When you are surrounded by mountains and rivers, you may think there is no way out, but when you turn around, you will find another village” is just like this. Li Yuheng was stunned for a moment, but after he reacted, his attitude was so cautious that it would not be an exaggeration to say that he was extremely careful.
Zhang Yuan did not hesitate and let go of his hand decisively. He knew his own limitations. In the horse riding competition in the military camp, Li Yuheng had won the top three for three consecutive years. The commander-in-chief praised him highly. Naturally, he was far inferior to him in riding skills, so it was reasonable.
However, there was something clearly wrong with the way Zhang Wen looked at Li Yuheng.
Ye Shuo did not want to waste this free labor that came to his doorstep. After thinking about it, he decided to maximize his role.
So Ye Shuo asked in a voice that only the two of them could hear: “What do you think of… Zhang Yuan?”
It turned out that he came to ask me for information.
Not only did Li Yuheng not doubt Ye Shuo’s intention, but he had a feeling that “it’s as expected”.
No wonder the Ninth Prince suddenly called him out. It turned out that he wanted to find someone who knew the inside story to find out the situation.
The more Ye Shuo acted like this, the more it proved that the maid had importance in his heart, and the more Li Yuheng wanted to be selected and replace Zhang Yuan.
Although there were two maids, the competition was extremely fierce, so any opponent who could be squeezed out was considered a rival.
Zhang Yuan was different from Li Jun. Zhang Yuan had no favors to him or their family, but Li Yuheng had no scruples at all.
In addition, Li Yuheng had no idea who had taken a fancy to him, so he was about to slander without thinking, but then he suddenly came to his senses.
It would be a disaster if fabricating something out of nothing was discovered, and deceiving the Ninth Prince is an even greater crime.
After thinking it over, Li Yuheng found that he could only tell the truth.
But there are some rules to telling the truth. For example, if the rumors already exist among the Black Armor Guards, even if they are untrue, it is not your problem. You are just a messenger.
Just like that, Li Yuheng began to desperately recall what exactly Zhang Yuan’s shortcomings were, even if they were told to him by others.
However, after a long time, Li Yuheng sadly discovered that no one in the Black Armor Guard seemed to have said anything bad about Zhang Yuan. Everyone felt sorry for him. When he was young, his uncle’s family adopted him because they had three daughters in a row and could not have a son.
As a result, the next year, his aunt gave birth to a boy, and Zhang Yuan’s position in the family suddenly became awkward.
In addition, the family was poor, and when Zhang Yuan, who was eighteen or nineteen years old, was at marriageable age, needed money for marriage. Compared with this labor force, the cost of marrying him a wife was higher. After much deliberation, the uncle’s family finally decided to kick him out.
After Zhang Yuan had worked for his uncle’s family for more than ten years, he was driven out by his uncle’s family.
His biological parents didn’t want him, and his uncle’s family exploited him and then ruthlessly abandoned him. He was considered one of the most miserable ones among the Black Armor Guards. Maybe it was a habit he developed since childhood, but Zhang Yuan always did more things than talked, and his personality even seemed a bit dull. For such a person, everyone would only say that he could endure hardships, so how could there be any other gossip?
Li Yuheng opened his mouth and held back for a long time before he could only say one sentence: “Zhang Yuan doesn’t seem to like talking much, and he’s a bit rigid.”
Strictly speaking, being taciturn and rigid is not a big problem. It is better than sweet talk but no action.
What’s more, these two comments are somewhat exaggerated.
With Li Yuheng’s current urgency, if Zhang Yuan had any problems, he would point out every 30% of them.
As a result, Li Yuheng thought for a long time and said this. Ye Shuo probably understood that it seemed that Zhang Yuan was really honest.
But just listening is not enough, you have to see it with your own eyes to feel truly at ease.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo suddenly squeezed the horse’s belly, and the old horse accelerated almost instinctively.
“Drive!”
Li Yuheng and the other two were caught off guard. After they realized what was happening, they hurriedly chased after him.
Ye Shuo didn’t care at all, feeling the gentle breeze passing by his ears. It was not until he ran a long way that he pulled the reins with practiced movements.
“Oh—”
Ye Shuo’s impression on outsiders was that of a spoiled and naughty person, so this behavior was nothing special in the eyes of others.
When Li Yuheng and the other two caught up with them breathlessly, they saw Ye Shuo casually picking up two handfuls of the freshest green grass for the horse. It seemed that he was waiting for the horse to finish eating before continuing to play freely.
It was obvious that the Ninth Prince was in high spirits, and the reactions of the three people were also different.
Because the Ninth Prince had just said directly that if Li Yuheng didn’t have a younger brother, he would have betrothed the maidservant beside the imperial concubine to him. Even the dumbest person would have figured out why the commander-in-chief only called out the two of them.
The most important thing at the moment is whether he can successfully marry the imperial concubine’s maid. After weighing the pros and cons, Zhang Wen chose to turn a blind eye to Ye Shuo’s actions, for fear of offending him.
Li Yuheng was the same. He was afraid of offending the Ninth Prince and did not dare to say a word. However, his skills were much more advanced than Zhang Wen. While the Ninth Prince was not paying attention, he quietly touched the reins of the horse, preparing to find a way to chat with the Ninth Prince while quietly leading the man and horse back to the main force.
As for Zhang Yuan, he was much more direct: “Your Highness, you can’t go any further. If His Majesty knew about this, I’m afraid he would blame you.”
No matter what, the emperor’s orders and the safety of the ninth prince are more important.
Hearing this, Zhang Wen looked at him as if he were a fool. It was not like he didn’t know why the Ninth Prince had called them here, so why was he still –
Ye Shuo took in the reactions of the three people and found them very interesting.
Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows, his eyes darkened, and threatened: “Zhang Yuan, if you continue to behave like this, be careful, or I will not marry my mother’s maid to you.”
The maidservants around the imperial concubine were polite and noble, and Zhang Yuan naturally yearned for them, but…
Zhang Yuan thought about it, and finally shook his head: “Your Highness, it’s time for you to go back.”
Ye Shuo pretended not to hear and suddenly asked, “If your uncle or your biological parents come to visit you in the future, what will you do?”
Hearing the Ninth Prince suddenly mention his life experience, Zhang Yuan felt a sudden pain in his heart.
It is said that lucky people are healed by their childhood, while unlucky people use their whole lives to heal their childhood. Even though Zhang Yuan is now in his twenties and is already an old man in the outside world, he still finds it difficult to let go.
After a moment of silence, Zhang Yuan said, “Your Highness, those people and events have nothing to do with me.”
He is crazy!
He doesn’t even recognize his own parents!
It’s okay for his uncle, but how could he not recognize his biological parents?
Zhang Wen was stunned, and felt that Zhang Yuan was simply committing treason.
His body and hair were given by his parents, how dare he harbor resentment? He should return his flesh and skin to them before saying this!
However, the next moment, the Ninth Prince suddenly burst into laughter.
“Zhang Yuan, I will remember what you said. I hope you can keep your promise in the future.”
“One last question. If I betroth my mother’s maidservant to you two, no matter what happens in the future, whether you are rich or poor, you cannot have other women, let alone concubines. If so… can you do it?”
Your Highness is indeed planning this!
Zhang Wen was delighted and blurted out: “Of course!”
“It is a great fortune to be favored by the girl beside the imperial concubine. Zhang Wen dare not have any second thoughts!”
Zhang Yuan thought for a while before saying, “Your Highness, I can do it.”
Perhaps because he had suffered too much in his childhood and adolescence, Zhang Yuan only hoped that he could marry an ordinary woman in the future, live an ordinary life, and have a real family. This would be enough for his life.
Ye Shuo nodded. Although he was very satisfied with his answer, he did not give him any guarantee at the moment.
But Zhang Wen…
Ye Shuo turned his head to look at him, but shook his head slightly.
What comes out of your mouth without careful consideration is often nothing more than flattery. He made a promise today, and he will naturally break it tomorrow.
Zhang Wen was originally happy, but when he saw that the Ninth Prince didn’t seem very satisfied with him, he immediately felt confused and had no idea what he had done wrong.
Soon, Ye Shuo stopped looking at him.
“No need to follow me, you two can go back first.”
After driving Zhang Yuan and Zhang Wen away, Ye Shuo immediately set his sights on Li Yuheng: “Now you can tell me why you are so eager to climb up.”
The Ninth Prince actually realized that he had turned back on purpose!
In this case, the Ninth Prince must have guessed that Li Jun was not his biological brother, so he deliberately asked those questions.
It’s ridiculous that I claim to be smart. After just one encounter, the Ninth Prince saw through me.
If I had not kept my brother at that time, but chose to send him away——
Thinking about how he had wanted to show off in front of the Ninth Prince, Li Yuheng became terrified and sweated all over. He could not hold on any longer and his knees went weak, and he fell to his knees with a thump.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Do It
chapters.content:
It would be understandable if the Ninth Prince could tell that I turned around on purpose, but what I did was indeed a little too obvious. Everyone was walking normally at the time, only I was different.
But Li Yuheng couldn’t figure out no matter how hard he tried, how he knew that Li Jun was not his biological brother.
Li Yuheng is not the kind of person who likes to rely on luck, maybe he was in the past, but he is definitely not now.
The Ninth Prince hardly left his sight when he was talking to him. He must have discovered something.
Furthermore, the Ninth Prince even discovered that his urgent purpose of promotion was not that simple.
Li Yuheng didn’t know how all this happened, so he felt even more terrified, even… horrified.
Li Yuheng prides himself on being smart, but it seems that his intelligence is vulnerable now.
Ye Shuo’s combined attack and defense directly broke through Li Yuheng’s psychological defenses. Heavy pressure poured down on him. No wonder Li Yuheng couldn’t bear it and could only kneel down and beg for forgiveness.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch the chestnut horse’s mane awkwardly. He felt that he didn’t say anything, so why did Li Yuheng fall down?
In this case, Ye Shuo had no choice but to pursue the victory.It is useless to be gentle when dealing with a smart person like Li Yuheng. Smart people are cunning, and they will only find ways to take advantage of your gentleness.
I must beat him until he is afraid, beat him until he is in pain, and beat him so that a shadow is left in his heart, which becomes an obstacle in his heart that he can never overcome.
At the same time, some benefits should be given. After all, Ye Shuo wants to form a marriage alliance with him rather than make an enemy.
Ye Shuo did not call him by his given name. He just controlled the old horse and said leisurely, “Li Yuheng, Yuheng, this is a good name.”
Zhang Yuan would definitely not understand this incoherent sentence.
But Li Yuheng is different. Li Yuheng is smart, and when dealing with smart people, it is enough to just say half of the words.
Subconsciously following the silent recitation, Li Yuheng’s expression changed slightly after a moment.
Obviously at this moment he also understood how big the gap between Li Yuheng and Li Jun was.
The name that was left behind to preserve the last thought became the biggest flaw.
Ye Shuo continued, “If your parents died of illness, the roster should have written “died of illness”. If they died of an accident, the roster should have written what kind of accident it was. There is no beginning or end, only the four words ‘both parents died’. Does this mean… there is another hidden story?”
Following Ye Shuo’s words, Li Yuheng began to think carefully, and then he was horrified to find that it was indeed true. If one of the parents of other people was no longer around, the reason would basically be clearly stated. After all, birth, aging, sickness, death, and even accidents were nothing to be ashamed of.
Li Yuheng closed his eyes, no longer having any thoughts of resisting.
Ye Shuo took the opportunity to speak: “So tell me, what is it all about.”
Just like that, Li Yuheng revealed the secret that he had kept in his heart for five years.
Ye Shuo then realized that there was such a hidden story behind this. The person that Li Yuheng’s father offended was none other than the brother-in-law of the Jizhou prefect. Although he was called a brother-in-law, he was actually just the brother of the concubine in the backyard.
The concubine’s brother was also a businessman, so it might not be a real offense.
Li Yuheng’s father was very wealthy, so naturally he made others jealous. But who could tell what was true and what was false?
“Jizhou…” Ye Shuo frowned slightly as he silently recited this unfamiliar name.
This incident was different from the one at Taifu’s house. If you really counted it, Ye Shuo did nothing at that time.
He simply asked the Grand Tutor and the Crown Prince to catch the young master of the Cao family committing adultery.
The young master of the Cao family was a commoner, so it was fine to arrest him. What happened to the Cao family later was discovered by the families of the three sisters-in-law of the young master Cao themselves, and it had nothing to do with him.
The prefect of Jizhou was an official of the fourth rank, and Ye Shuo didn’t know which faction the other party belonged to in the court. If he was not careful, he might easily stir up a hornet’s nest.
Although Ye Shuo is kind-hearted, he doesn’t help everyone.
He will help where he can, but he is powerless to help where he cannot. To Ye Shuo, his mother is the most important.
Since Ye Shuo has made up his mind not to get involved in the muddy water of the imperial court in this life, he will naturally not change his mind so easily. If he says he won’t get involved, then he won’t get involved.
So……
“I’m afraid I can’t do anything to avenge your parents and your family.” Call Ye Shuo cold-blooded or cruel, but in his eyes, the lives of Li Yuheng’s family are not as important as the safety of those around him.
When Li Yuheng heard this, the blood in his body seemed to freeze.
If the Ninth Prince couldn’t get anything done, Li Yuheng really didn’t know what else he could do.
“Thank you, Your Highness. I understand.”
Seeing the other party’s desperate expression, as if he wanted to bang his head against the wall and kill himself, Ye Shuo hurriedly said, “No, no, no, don’t think about committing suicide yet. I haven’t finished talking yet, why are you in such a hurry?”
Being happy and sad at the same time can easily lead to extremes. Ye Shuo quickly added: “Although I can’t do anything about it, I still have you. It would be great if you could avenge your family yourself.”
Li Yuheng couldn’t help but smile bitterly when he heard this: “Your Highness is joking.”
He had worked so hard for so many years but was only a ninth-rank lieutenant of benevolence and bravery, which was still a long way from being a fourth-rank prefect. If he relied on himself, there would be no hope at all.
“Whether it’s a joke or not is not up to you to decide.”
A gust of wind blew, and the horse was bored, so it lowered its head and quietly ate grass. Li Yuheng suddenly heard these words:
“What if I say I can help you get promoted?”
Caught off guard, Li Yuheng looked up suddenly.
Ye Shuo casually put a handful of fresh green grass into the horse’s mouth, as if the words just now were not said by him.
Li Yuheng reacted and kowtowed loudly, his voice trembling: “Your Highness, please help me!”
It is really possible, it is really possible!
In his excitement, Li Yuheng almost didn’t care about anything. He had said before that if he could get revenge, he would pay any price.
“If what Your Highness said is true, my life belongs to Your Highness. I am willing to serve Your Highness for all my life!”
Ye Shuo was willing to believe his sincerity at this moment, and was also willing to believe that what he said was true.
But……
“Why should I want your life?” Ye Shuo was speechless. He didn’t intend to kick his cheap third brother down and become the emperor himself.
This guy seems to have lost his way. I just said he was smart, why has he become stupid now?
Wait, could it be that he misunderstood and thought that his usual behavior was just an act, and that he actually had some big plans? ?
Yes, that’s what Li Yuheng thought.
Think about it, a prince is so smart, but he ends up with a bad reputation. Doesn’t this speak volumes?
No matter what he thought, Ye Shuo was too lazy to talk nonsense with him and said directly: “I don’t like this one, change it to another one.”
Li Yuheng was stunned.
In his opinion, this should be the Ninth Prince’s goal. Why does the Ninth Prince seem not satisfied at all…?
“Then…when the time comes, I’ll ask my brother to join the Black Armor Guard as well?”
Hearing this, Ye Shuo’s expression was no longer just cold, he was completely expressionless.
It’s still not right if it doesn’t work. Think about it again, think about it again!
After a while, an incredible thought flashed through his mind, and Li Yuheng tentatively asked: “Can I ask about the maidservant of the imperial concubine… Is it me that His Highness originally had his eyes on?”
This time Ye Shuo finally had some reaction.
“Let me correct you. It’s not me who likes you, it’s Su Xin who likes you.”
It turned out that the maid’s name was Su Xin, and it turned out that his actions were not completely ineffective.
Li Yuheng felt mixed feelings of sadness and joy. How could his heart be so complicated?
But no matter what, Li Yuheng was at least very grateful to this girl named Su Xin. If it weren’t for her, he would definitely not have this opportunity.
Li Yuheng silently memorized the name in his heart and immediately made a decision: “Miss Suxin has been very kind to me. Yuheng has no way to repay her. Yuheng also wishes to have only her in this life and never take a concubine.”
Li Yuheng thought that the Ninth Prince would be satisfied with what he said. However, instead of praising him, the Ninth Prince sneered.
Li Yuheng was almost driven crazy by his attitude.
This doesn’t work, and that doesn’t work either. What does the Ninth Prince want from me?
The next moment, Ye Shuo’s eyes almost looked into Li Yuheng’s heart: “How much of this is true and how much is false, you know it in your heart.”
It’s obvious at first glance that Li Yuheng is a restless person. Moreover, a favor has to come from the heart to be called a favor. Something that is agreed to under duress is just a deal.
Although Li Yuheng was not ungrateful, people like him hated being coerced the most.
Ye Shuo can guarantee that he will remain unchanged for one year, two years, or three years, but he cannot guarantee that he will remain unchanged for his entire life.
Ye Shuo didn’t want to see the scene where Su Xin was affectionate with Li Yuheng at first, but ended up having a grudge against him in the future.
Li Yuheng felt a little embarrassed when he saw this.
Ye Shuo finally said: “I have no other request, I just hope you can treat her well, even if something happens in the future, don’t bully her.”
“Is that all?”
“Well, that’s all.”
Li Yuheng was speechless for a long time.
He couldn’t imagine that the Ninth Prince would go to such great lengths just for such a small matter.
In just a few breaths, Li Yuheng thought a lot. Finally, he bowed deeply and said in a deep voice: “I, Li Yuheng, swear today in the name of my deceased parents that I will never let Miss Suxin down in this life.”
Ye Shuo didn’t comment or say anything, but just said: “It’s getting late, we should go back.”
In fact, it is very simple to solve Li Yuheng’s current predicament. His abilities are there, and the only thing he lacks is someone who can appreciate him.
Isn’t this what the so-called Bole and the Thousand-Li Horse are like?
Ye Shuo himself doesn’t have much power, so he can’t do this job, but others can do!
Ye Shuo rode the old horse slowly back to the team. Emperor Jingwen couldn’t stand to see him wandering around like this, the veins on his forehead jumped violently, and he subconsciously stopped him.
“How long are you going to play?”
Look, isn’t Bole coming to your doorstep?
Ye Shuo was not shy. When his adoptive father called him, he climbed up the pole and quickly got into the imperial carriage. Seeing a cup of freshly poured tea on the table, Ye Shuo did not despise it. He picked up the cup and drank it all in one gulp. His whole set of movements was smooth and flowing. When Emperor Jingwen started to scold, Ye Shuo was already wiping his mouth.
“Mmm… so sweet!”
Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he almost died: “You bastard, I just asked Wang Ziquan to brew tea for me – forget it, Wang Ziquan, go and get me a new set of tea sets!”
This cup has been used by the little bastard and is no longer usable.
Emperor Jingwen had an almost undisguised look of disgust on his face.
Ye Shuo then looked at the small teacup in his hand. Seeing the delicate patterns on it, he could tell it was a masterpiece. So he blurted out, “Since you don’t want it, father, why don’t you just give this tea set to your son?”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t dare to open the door. If he did, in the future whenever he took a fancy to something of his, he would have to hold it and lick it.
Emperor Jingwen believed that he could definitely do such a thing.
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen avoided answering and just asked him: “When will you be able to do something serious every day?”
Ye Shuo looked innocent: “Pairing up older men and women around me and adding more people to my Great Zhou, how can this not be considered a serious matter?”
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and decided not to mess around with a child. He glanced at his son and reminded him, “Matters of love between men and women are not as simple as you think. You’d better not interfere.”
It would be fine if it was just once, but he seemed so interested, could it be that he was planning to be the matchmaker?
Ye Shuo was so thick-skinned that he smiled and didn’t care at all: “Speaking of which, since the emperor mentioned it, why don’t you help your son with some advice?”
He even thought of asking the emperor to help him find a matchmaker!
Ye Shuo took out the roster and spread out the page for Zhang Wen and Li Yuheng respectively: “Here, this is it, and this one, father, which one do you think this son should assign to Su Xin?”
“You bastard, how dare you–” Emperor Jingwen was about to get angry, but when he saw Li Yuheng, he was stunned: “…Huh?”
This young man seems to be quite good.
He has a handsome appearance, a good resume, and seems to be particularly proficient in horse riding. It would be a bit of a waste of his talent if he were only a small guard.
Emperors all have a pair of eyes that are good at discovering.
With a heart of admiration for talent, Emperor Jingwen gradually became interested.
Seeing that her son was still holding up two rosters, he kept chattering: “Although Zhang Wen is ordinary, it is precisely because of his ordinariness that Su Xin can suppress him. As for this Li Yuheng, he is ambitious at first glance. He may not be able to stay with Su Xin alone in the future, so which one should I choose…”
For a moment, the child seemed to be in trouble.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen sneered, “It’s just a fool’s opinion.”
Even so, you have the nerve to let your own son act as a matchmaker for someone else?
In his opinion, it is normal for a man to have three wives and four concubines. How could anyone give up a young man with a bright future for such a reason?
The more he looked at Li Yuheng, the more he felt that he was a good person. Emperor Jingwen pondered for a moment and made an exception to summon him.
When he heard the news, Li Yuheng felt dazed.
The Ninth Prince…actually did it.

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Arrival
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo did not interfere in the subsequent matters. He believed that with Li Yuheng’s ability, as long as he was brought before the emperor, he would definitely not disappoint anyone.
Perhaps it was because Li Yuheng’s birth was too low, and he had no special background. He was just an ordinary guard. There were many people like him in the entire Black Armor Guard.
It will take a long time to see the results of investing in such people. No one will choose them because their efficiency is too low. Promotion is not done in this way. If they are not promoted properly, they may fail halfway, or they may work hard to become a small official who is of no use at all. Therefore, no one doubts anything at all.
Even if you pick out a hundred ordinary guards, not everyone can succeed. It takes a very sharp vision to train your own team in this way.
This trick is fine if used once or twice, but it won’t work if used too many times. It will arouse Emperor Jingwen’s suspicion and eventually implicate himself, so it can almost be concluded that Xiaojiu did it on a whim and accidentally.
This is indeed the case. Ye Shuo did not intend to ask the other party to work for him. He just wanted to lend a hand to Li Yuheng, who was in an already miserable situation, for Su Xin’s sake.
It just provides a foundation for the other party. What will happen in the future depends on his own luck.
However, from Ye Shuo’s perspective, he felt that Li Yuheng’s future achievements would most likely be more than this.
He has brains, perseverance, willpower, is good at seizing opportunities, has a strong psychological endurance, and is appropriately ruthless… He already has some of the necessary factors for success.
With the prefect of Jizhou hanging in front of him, at least Li Yuheng would not let himself fall before that prefect fell.Having finally seized such an opportunity, people like Li Yuheng would spare no effort to climb up, and would try their best to let the people above them see their abilities. For such people, in order to encourage them, it is natural to give their wives and children titles.
When Li Yuheng is promoted to the fifth rank of garrison commander, he will be eligible to request an imperial decree for his wife. Even if the request fails, Su Xin, the wife of an official, will not be able to escape.
This is probably the best arrangement Ye Shuo can give to Su Xin and Su Qiu based on their respective situations.
Needless to say about his height and appearance, he is also younger than the other two. Zhang Yuan is 25 and Li Yuheng is 22, which is the prime of their life. At least there is no need to worry about, ahem, disharmony in that aspect.
By the way, speaking of this, when I have time, I will ask the imperial physician to check the pulses of both of them as a marriage check-up, to prevent them from having any hidden illnesses, which would make it difficult to cancel the marriage once it is decided.
While his stepfather was having a heart-to-heart talk with the talented ‘horse’ he had discovered with his keen eye, Ye Shuo turned around and went back to his mother’s carriage.
Almost at the moment when Ye Shuo opened the curtain, Concubine Rong looked over, as well as the two maids who suddenly appeared.
Sure enough, no matter what one’s status or age, gossip is the nature of human beings.
The moment she saw her son, Concubine Rong couldn’t help but ask, “Did you see those two people? How did you feel?”
Ye Shuo was picky and only said what he could say.
When Su Qiu heard that Zhang Yuan promised to only marry her and never take a concubine in this life, she couldn’t control herself and her eyes lit up slightly.
As for Su Xin, although she did not receive the same guarantee, she felt more at ease when she heard that the emperor had summoned Li Yuheng at this moment.
The two have different emphases in their expectations of their future husbands, so naturally, the things they care about are also different.
Su Xin was the maid carefully selected by the wife of the Duke of Zhen. Although she did not have the quick wit of Su Yue, she was also very smart. After Ye Shuo’s few words, Su Xin knew that the Ninth Prince must have put a lot of thought into it.
How could Su Xin not feel grateful for the fact that her master had done so much?
The three maids Su Xin, Su Yue and Su Qiu have been serving Concubine Rong since they were young. They are loyal to her and after this incident, they wish they could give their lives to their two masters.
This is what is meant by “A ruler treats his ministers with courtesy and a minister serves his ruler with loyalty.”
