The two of them secretly made up their minds that no matter where they were in the future, they would be slaves of the Imperial Concubine and the Ninth Prince for the rest of their lives.
After listening to this, Su Xin spoke without hesitation: “Your Highness the Ninth Prince is so kind, I will definitely…”
“Stop, stop, stop.” Before she could finish, Ye Shuo hurriedly stopped her.
“That’s what I was going to tell you.”
Li Yuheng’s situation is special, so he cannot be treated with common sense.
Su Xin was stunned for a moment.
Ye Shuo pursed his lips, his expression became extremely serious: “Remember, after you two get married, unless something serious happens to you, or you can’t make ends meet, or Li Yuheng bullies you, unless it is necessary, don’t contact Qiuwu Palace, me, or even Su Yue and the others.”
Unless necessary… Doesn’t this mean that I should cut off contact with the Imperial Concubine, the Ninth Prince, and even Su Yue, my sister who grew up with me? ?
Don’t Her Highness and His Majesty want me anymore?
After she came to her senses, Su Xin’s face was filled with panic, and she fell to her knees with a thud.
“Your Highness, why, why…did Su Xin do something wrong?”
This was the maid who had been with her since she was a child. They were not as close as sisters, but there was definitely affection between them. So after Concubine Rong was stunned for a moment, she also turned her head and glared at her son.
“I’ve never heard of a married girl who can’t go back to her parents’ home!” Concubine Rong still hopes that Su Xin will come to Qiuwu Palace often.
Not only can she not go back, but from what my son said, I’m afraid we can’t even exchange letters.
Concubine Rong told herself not to get angry, and stared at her son eagerly, waiting to hear his explanation.
But in fact, it is really difficult for Ye Shuo to explain this matter. If it is spread out accidentally, it will be bad, no matter who it is.
Ye Shuo glanced out the window and saw guards everywhere, and even the commander-in-chief passed by here from time to time.
The situation was completely different from choosing a husband for a maid, so even Ye Shuo could only keep silent.
Does Ye Shuo have to say that this is all in preparation for Li Yuheng’s future promotion?
The Black Armor Guards are different from ordinary troops. They are a team specially assigned to guard the capital. They are the last line of defense of the capital city, and they also guard the safety of the emperor. Their importance is self-evident.
Imagine, how could an emperor allow such a team to be mixed with other interests?
Therefore, those who can climb to high positions are basically loyal ministers and lone ministers who are only loyal to the emperor. Even if the crown prince comes, he will be of no use unless the emperor dies. In that case, the crown prince is the next emperor for sure. Just like the current commander-in-chief is alone, no matter how other princes try to win him over, he will not be moved. Once he joins any camp, it will be time for someone else to take the position of the commander-in-chief.
Although a lone minister in the Black Armor Guard may not necessarily be able to sit in a high position, those who sit in a high position are definitely lone ministers.
Ye Shuo saw it clearly, so he reminded Su Xin early on, to avoid the day when their road to glory would be ruined because of such a small matter.
Only by making plans early can you be prepared for any eventuality.
Since Ye Shuo had no intention of letting Li Yuheng work for him, he naturally didn’t care whether the other party would contact him or not.
“I can’t tell you the specific reason, but mother, Su Xin, it’s enough for you to trust me.”
Concubine Rong looked into her son’s eyes for a long time, then gave up after sighing.
Forget it, forget it. The little bastard has a lot of tricks up his sleeve. Who knows what he is thinking? If you don’t want to contact her, then don’t contact her. As long as he is fine, it’s fine.
Su Xin cried even harder, but out of trust in the Ninth Prince, she did not press for an answer.
Su Xin felt a little regretful. She vaguely understood that the reason why the Ninth Prince said that was because of Li Yuheng, so Su Xin regretted it.
If she had known this earlier, she would not have married.
“Your Highness, if this is really not possible, let’s just call this marriage off…”
Su Xin tightly grasped Ye Shuo’s clothes, tears falling like beads from a broken string: “I suddenly feel that it would be better to be like Su Yue and stay in the palace with the madam and the prince for the rest of my life.”
If getting married means having to endure all these, she would rather not get married.
Ye Shuo opened his mouth, but before he could say anything, Su Yue rolled her eyes and couldn’t help scolding, “You were the one who said you wanted to get married, and now you’re regretting it, too. Why are you so fussy? Do you really think Your Highness isn’t tired?”
Su Xin trembled and cried even harder: “But how should I know, how should I know…”
How did she know things would turn out like this!
“If you want to wear the crown, you must bear its weight.” Ye Shuo sighed, and couldn’t help but squat down and look directly into Su Xin’s eyes: “Since you want to get married, why bother delaying yourself because of this kind of thing?”
In today’s world, the wives of officials, common people, and slaves are all very different.
“Look ahead, good days are ahead.”
Yes, I had made the choice from the beginning, and I should have known that this would happen.
But when this moment really came, Su Xin felt a heart-wrenching pain, and she couldn’t control it even if she wanted to.
In the end, Su Xin’s eyes were swollen from crying.
Not to mention Su Xin and the others, even Concubine Rong’s eyes began to turn red.
Ye Shuo was most afraid of seeing this kind of scene. He didn’t dare to stay any longer and left as if escaping.
After exiting the carriage, before Ye Shuo could catch his breath, he bumped into the triumphant Li Yuheng. Judging from his slightly excited expression, he must have gained a lot from his stepfather.
Since everyone knew that he was summoned by the emperor because of the Ninth Prince, it was a very natural thing for him to come and express his gratitude. Thinking of this, Li Yuheng did not hide from others and knelt on one knee in front of Ye Shuo.
“Thank you very much for your support, Ninth Prince. I will never forget it.”
Ye Shuo shook his head upon hearing this: “It has nothing to do with me. It’s your own ability.”
There was no falsehood in what he said; every word came from his heart.
Li Yuheng suddenly became a little excited when he heard this: “I have tried so many methods but to no avail. If it weren’t for the help of the Ninth Prince, I’m afraid I would never have such an opportunity in my life.”
At this moment, Li Yuheng seemed to have determined this matter, fanatical and persistent.
Ye Shuo looked at him for a long while, then smiled: “I think you made a mistake. You got the order wrong. It’s obviously you who worked hard first, which is why it’s reflected on the roster. If you’re a fool, it would be useless even if I talk till my lips are worn out.”
Li Yuheng was stunned.
Even if this person cannot be used by himself, Ye Shuo does not want to see him go astray and harm innocent people.
So Ye Shuo spoke up and said, “You must remember in the future, never become like the person you hate.”
It would be a joke if he turned into the dog official who exploited the people in his hometown as he said today.
Glancing at the other person, Ye Shuo said meaningfully: “Since I can see through it, others can naturally see through it too. To forge iron, one must be strong himself…”
Li Yuheng shuddered suddenly.
Ye Shuo’s combination of kindness and force today has successfully left a deep psychological trauma on Li Yuheng.
Think about it, something that I have tried to accomplish for so many years but failed, was easily accomplished by the Ninth Prince. Isn’t it scary?
How old is the Ninth Prince, only seven or eight years old? What if it was other princes, the Crown Prince, or even the Emperor?
Just imagining this, Li Yuheng felt a chill and quickly calmed down.
“Okay, I won’t tell you anymore. Just know it in your heart. I’m leaving now.”
The loud noise of wheel ruts and iron hooves around them drowned out their voices.
Li Yuheng deeply engraved the Ninth Prince’s back in his mind.
Three days passed in a flash. Just when the candidates were decided and the marriage of Suxin and Suqiu was gradually taking shape, the summer palace finally appeared before their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Playing Chess
chapters.content:
When Zhang Yuan received the notice that he could start proposing marriage after arriving at the palace, even though he thought he was numb after so many years and all the hardships he had endured, he still felt a surge of genuine joy in his heart when he heard the news.
Even if Zhang Yuan tried his best to keep a straight and honest face, he couldn’t hide the joy spreading in his eyes.
Whether it is sincere or false, you can tell it at a glance.
Although the commander-in-chief said that they would have to wait until October and return from the palace to officially get married, Zhang Yuan had already quietly begun to look forward to it. Where was the dull look at the beginning?
Especially on a certain day on the road, Suqiu got off the carriage and came out to fetch water. Zhang Yuan was even more delighted when he saw her from afar.
As soon as their eyes met, they both couldn’t help but blush before they even spoke.
Suqiu was a shy girl, and after hurriedly fetching some water, she got back into the carriage with a red face, leaving Zhang Yuan feeling lost. It took him a long time to remember what he should do next.
Su Xin and Li Yuheng also saw each other. Unlike Su Qiu and Zhang Yuan, Su Xin and Li Yuheng smiled at each other first. Then Li Yuheng was the first to react and bowed to Su Xin. Su Xin was stunned for a moment, but quickly returned the greeting.
Although the atmosphere between the two was not as strong as that between Su Qiu and Zhang Yuan, it was also filled with a faint friendship.
However, Zhang Wen, the only one who failed to be selected, felt a little uncomfortable.He thought he had shown enough respect to the Ninth Prince, but he still couldn’t get what he wanted. Zhang Wen was angry and jealous, but he could do nothing about it.
In fact, Zhang Wen is not a wicked person, he is just an ordinary man. It is just because he is ordinary that he naturally has the shortcomings of ordinary men.
He is not as smart and capable as Li Yuheng, nor as sincere and loyal as Zhang Yuan, so it is natural that he is not chosen.
Ye Shuo leaned on the window, squinting his eyes, feeling the flowers, plants and trees around him constantly receding, and lazily basking in the sun.
Emperor Jingwen and Prime Minister He stopped moving their hands almost at the same time.
The two people couldn’t understand how their son/the Ninth Prince could remain so leisurely in the imperial carriage under such circumstances. Didn’t he feel nervous?
If it were any other prince, he would be on high alert when facing the emperor and the prime minister, for fear of making a mistake or saying something wrong.
Looking at the Ninth Prince, he seemed much more comfortable than him and the Emperor.
A diligent person hates others being lazy the most. As luck would have it, there is not a single lazy person who can sit in this position, so almost everyone dislikes Ye Shuo when they see him.
Holding back, Emperor Jingwen and Prime Minister He each took a few steps, and seeing that their son/the Ninth Prince was living up to everyone’s expectations and was about to close his eyes, as if he was about to fall asleep in the next second, the two could not hold it back any longer and felt that they could not continue playing this game of chess.
As if that wasn’t enough, Ye Shuo was still fanning the flames and adding fuel to the fire: “Father, Prime Minister He, you two don’t have enough self-control.” He just got to the point, but he couldn’t hold back and was ready to teach someone a lesson.
Before the two of them opened their mouths, Ye Shuo spoke first. What do you call this? This is called the wicked complaining first.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but took a deep breath.
He Xiang’s Qi cultivation skills are pretty good. After all, he is an old fox, so it’s not easy for him to lose his skills.
“Your Highness, since you have nothing to do, why don’t you play a game of chess with me?”
The Ninth Prince was a prince after all, so he certainly couldn’t be scolded, but he could get back on his feet in other ways. He Xiang was cunning and well versed in circuitous tactics.
But is Ye Shuo so easy to deal with?
“We can play chess, but we don’t play Go. How about Gobang?” Ye Shuo had never played Go before. If he played it rashly, he would definitely be beaten badly. He didn’t want to be fooled.
Want to mess with him? No way!
At this time, He Xiang was the one who had the need, so Ye Shuo should take the opportunity to put forward his own request. How could he just accept whatever the other party said?
Sure enough, He Xiang’s expression froze slightly.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but give his beloved minister a look. See, I told you that this little bastard is not so easy to deal with.
Perhaps knowing why His Majesty had been silent just now, He Xiang could not help but clear his throat and said, “Your Highness’s Gobang is something I have never heard of before, so how can I use it to play against Your Highness?”
Come on, last time Master Cen confiscated so many of his little gadgets, Ye Shuo had already heard that Master Cen had already introduced them one by one to his stepfather and the others. Besides, the rules of Gobang are so simple, how could Prime Minister He not understand?
“Since Prime Minister He is not sincere, forget it. Let’s talk about it another day.” Ye Shuo gave up decisively.
He Xiang was caught off guard: “…”
I forgot that the Ninth Prince is not a very particular person.
Seeing that the Ninth Prince really didn’t want to do it, He Xiang thought about it and felt that although they were both black and white chess, he had decades more experience than the Ninth Prince. Moreover, the Gobang he mentioned was indeed not a very difficult game and almost everyone could play it. He felt that he should not lose, so he quickly took a step back.
“Just do as the Ninth Prince says.”
“Okay then.” Ye Shuo quickly got up.
Seeing the two people sitting opposite each other in front of the chessboard, Emperor Jingwen drank tea while silently paying attention to the situation.
He Xiang himself just said that Gobang is a simple game, so experience or not is not very important. If everyone is starting at the same starting line, what difference does it make even if He Xiang has eaten for decades longer than him?
Just like that, Ye Shuo relied on his own abilities and a little bit of skills to kill He Xiang in the first round.
The black and white chess pieces had occupied less than one-third of the middle of the chessboard when the five black pieces in Ye Shuo’s hand formed a line.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but choke.
He Xiang was speechless for a long time.
“Thank you, thank you.” Ye Shuo bowed and retreated after one attack.
Seeing that he was about to leave after only betting one hand, He Xiang was dumbfounded: “Your Highness, wait a moment!”
Ye Shuo turned around, somewhat puzzled: “What’s wrong? Didn’t I already play a game with you?” What else did he want?
It did happen, but the ending was very different from what He Xiang had imagined.
In He Xiang’s imagination, he should torture the Ninth Prince severely, and only after he had tortured the Ninth Prince enough, the subsequent events could be unfolded.
This, this, this…what is this? !
“Your Highness, it’s still early. Please play another round with me.”
This was a request that could not be any smaller, and Prime Minister He fully believed that the Ninth Prince would agree to it without hesitation. However… who knew that the other party would reject it outright.
“Prime Minister He, this won’t do. Think about it, what is your status? You are a well-known prime minister of a country. I finally won a game against you. How nice it would be to tell others about it?”
“If I play another round with you and lose, I will be the one to suffer the consequences.”
Think about it, if you play chess with the prime minister and win in the end, it might even be recorded in the book by the historian. Only a fool would play a second game with him.
“Mr. He, do you think this is the truth?”
No matter how eloquent He Xiang was, he couldn’t find any words to refute it now, because if he thought about it carefully, it seemed to be true.
“Unless……”
Just when He Xiang was thinking about a solution, he suddenly heard these two words. Subconsciously, he said, “Unless what?”
Ye Shuo rolled his eyes and said with a smile: “Unless Prime Minister He gives me some silver.”
It’s just money, something outside of one’s body, and you thought it was something important. He Xiang couldn’t help but feel relieved when he heard this.
Just like that, Emperor Jingwen watched helplessly as his most trusted minister took off the purse from around his waist.
When Emperor Jingwen saw this scene, he knew it was all over.
The first time it was money, the second time it was something else, the third time, the fourth time… Haha, it would be strange if the little bastard didn’t take out all the money from He Xiang.
As the saying goes, a true gentleman watches a game of chess without saying a word. Emperor Jingwen couldn’t bring himself to do this, so he kept silent.
Ye Shuo was very measured and only took the smallest silver ingot and put it on his side. Ye Shuo nodded and said, “This time we have agreed in advance that it is best of three games. If He Xiang loses again, it won’t be so easy if he wants to add more.”
He Xiang heard it and thought it made sense, and there was no trap or anything, so he gave a positive answer: “Of course.”
Then… as expected, Ye Shuo defeated him again.
He added and lost again, lost and added again. Ye Shuo was well aware of the principle of boiling a frog in warm water. He increased the bet slowly, bit by bit. Finally, when He Xiang reacted, he had nothing left except his clothes. Even one of his shoes was stripped off by the Ninth Prince.
Emperor Jingwen watched coldly and discovered carefully that this little bastard was particularly good at laying hooks. He didn’t even try to win ruthlessly. Instead, he defeated He Xiang every time when He Xiang felt he was about to win. He kept He Xiang hanging and made it impossible for He Xiang to control himself and not increase the bet.
“Thank you, Father, and thank you, Lord He, for your compassion. I will take my leave now.”
Ye Shuo felt that it was enough, so he stopped contentedly and ran away with a lot of spoils.
Originally, it was unlikely that the historian would record such a small matter, but now, the original probability of less than 10% has been raised to 80%.
Emperor Jingwen looked at Prime Minister He quietly for a long time, as he was unable to react.
He Xiang suddenly came back to his senses and said quickly: “…Your Majesty, I am guilty!”
He said he was here to help the emperor take care of his son, but now he has gotten himself into trouble.
“…There’s no need to do this.” Emperor Jingwen’s eyes were calm: “It’s good like this now, isn’t it?”
Although he failed to control his son, at least he taught his minister a lesson, so it was worth it.
He Xiang froze for a moment, then lowered his head deeply.
On the other side, Ye Shuo came out with something in his arms, and then he saw the palace not far away. The Sixth Prince and his entourage were ready to go, as if they were discussing something. They were eager to try, and their eyes were full of provocation when they looked at each other.
Of course, it was the Fifth Prince who made the unilateral provocation. After all, given the Sixth Prince’s personality, he would not easily reveal what he was thinking.
The prince was originally having a headache because of the quarrel among his brothers, but the moment he saw Ye Shuo, his eyes suddenly brightened.
“Xiaojiu, you’ve come just in time. Your fifth and sixth brothers are preparing to compete to see who can reach the palace first. Do you want to come too… Hmm? What are you holding in your hand?”
As the prince was talking, he didn’t know why he felt that the thing in his brother’s arms looked familiar.
Especially that pair of boots, it seems like he has seen it somewhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Rest assured
chapters.content:
Tsk, does the prince think that saying this will be useful?
What if Xiaojiu come? Xiaojiu can come too.
The Fifth Prince sneered in his heart, thinking that this was a method thought up by the Crown Prince to divert their attention. However, when the Fifth Prince turned around, he found that, hiss, it really seemed to be the case, the boots did look somewhat familiar.
It’s not anything else, it’s mainly because the cranes embroidered on the boots are not something that everyone can wear.
Anyway, it’s either the Grand Tutor’s or Prime Minister He’s thing.
The Sixth Prince and others subconsciously turned their attention to their younger brother.
Ye Shuo didn’t care at all, he just smiled and said: “You guessed right, this is Prime Minister He’s boots.”
The prince’s expression suddenly froze. How could he have forgotten that in terms of troublesome abilities, even if all his other brothers were added together, they could not compare to the one in front of him.
The fifth prince was even more stunned.
He stole all of He Xiang’s shoes. Isn’t he afraid of offending He Xiang? ?Based on the Sixth Prince’s understanding of his younger brother, he didn’t feel that he was the one who stole it. Although Xiaojiu was naughty, he did not bother to steal.
So the Sixth Prince was silent for a moment, and then asked: “Where did the boots come from?”
“As expected, Xiao–” Ye Shuo was about to shout out “Xiao Ming” when he noticed the Sixth Prince’s angry gaze. After thinking for a while, he decided to save some face for him in front of so many people. Ye Shuo finally changed his words: “As expected, Sixth Brother understands me. I won these boots fair and square!”
After saying this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but glance at the Fifth Prince standing beside him.
The fifth prince was stunned: “No way?”
How could He Xiang lose to a child? Or such a child.
As if it wasn’t enough, Ye Shuo raised his brows slightly: “And I won it by playing chess.”
As for what kind of chess you win at, well, that’s not important.
After hearing what he said, the fifth and sixth princes realized that in addition to the boots, he also held a purse, a fan, a mosquito repellent sachet and a bunch of other miscellaneous items in his arms.
A bad thought flashed through the minds of both of them at the same time. Could it be that he had snatched these things from He Xiang?
Xiaojiu is really not afraid of offending people…
It should be that his father had finished his lecture. Crown Prince noticed that when Prime Minister He came out of the imperial carriage, his clean tabi became dirty immediately after he landed on the ground. Now he was standing on one leg, waiting for the servant to bring him new shoes.
The Crown Prince and Prime Minister He’s eyes met and they both looked away almost instantly. The situation was so awkward that both of them tacitly kept silent.
The Fifth Prince at the side could not help but twitch his lips slightly: “So, what’s the use of this shoe for you…”
“Didn’t you see that there was such a big emerald inlaid on it?” He Xiang was different from the Taifu. He Xiang was so delicate that even his boots were full of little tricks.
It was because He Xiang reacted quickly that he noticed as soon as he moved one of his boots. If He Xiang reacted a little slower, Ye Shuo would have been able to collect every piece of his boots.
A single piece may not have much value, but a whole set is different.
Just for a piece of jade?
Even though the method might be wrong, the Crown Prince was relieved to see that the attention of the Fifth and Sixth Princes was finally successfully diverted.
However, before he could let out a sigh of relief, he heard his brother say this again:
“By the way, what about you guys? What were you doing here just now?”
Prince: “…”
The prince turned his head and began to wink at Ye Shuo, but Ye Shuo pretended not to see anything and continued questioning.
“I just heard Third Brother talking about a competition or something.”
…I’ve never seen Xiaojiu be so tactless before.
The Fifth Prince then remembered what had just happened.
In fact, it was not a big deal. It was just that the Fifth Prince and the Sixth Prince did not get along well. They often tried to show off to each other in the study. In addition, because of Ye Shuo as a comparison, Emperor Jingwen often praised the Sixth Prince recently, and the Fifth Prince disliked him more and more. He always felt that the Sixth Prince looked taciturn on the surface, but was actually very thoughtful.
In short, their fates were incompatible. Just now, the Fifth Prince was even more sarcastic, making fun of him for being only good at studying but extremely weak, so there was the so-called horse riding competition.
This was what the Sixth Prince could not stand the most, so he gritted his teeth and agreed.
Ye Shuo wondered if this kid was stupid. He compared his own weaknesses with other people’s strengths. He really thought he was an Iron Man who could do anything.
Ye Shuo doesn’t really understand perfectionists like Xiao Ming.
But he is still very interested in the competition.
“Then what are you still standing there for?”
Caught off guard, the Fifth Prince was stunned: “Ah?”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but point at the palace which was getting closer and closer: “We are almost there. It will be too late if we don’t compete now. Hurry up!”
Prince: “…”
As expected… I shouldn’t have had any hope for Xiao Jiu…
The little grandson of the emperor standing by was stunned. He had seen many sons of the emperor trying to stop a fight, but this was the first time he had seen someone adding fuel to the fire.
“Ninth Uncle…” The little grandson of the emperor couldn’t help but pull at the corner of Ye Shuo’s clothes, but Ye Shuo dismissed him with a sentence “Kid, go away and don’t interfere in adult affairs.”
The little grandson started to get angry.
After waiting for a long time without seeing the two of them make any move, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but urge them again: “I also want to see who wins and who loses between you two.”
The expression of expectation and anticipation really hurt the Fifth Prince’s eyes, making him feel like a monkey being watched.
Who does he think he is? Why should he compete with me just because he says he is better than me?
The Fifth Prince couldn’t help but grit his teeth as he felt rebellious. “Go ahead and compete with yourself!”
I won’t serve you anymore!
“Huh? What does this have to do with me?” Seeing that the fifth prince seemed to be leaving, Ye Shuo became anxious: “It was you who made the bet that you wanted to compete, how can you go back on your word!”
“I’m still waiting to see!” And try to see if he can open a handicap or something. Ye Shuo has not yet recovered from the afterglow of his victory.
‘Look, you’re looking at shit!’
The Fifth Prince almost blurted out the words, then realized that this was too rude. It would be disastrous if his father heard it, so he gave up.
The Fifth Prince crossed his arms over his chest and looked at Ye Shuo with a sneer. He had made up his mind that he would never get what he wanted no matter what.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to look at the Sixth Prince beside him: “Sixth Brother…”
The Sixth Prince paused, then shook his head: “I’m sorry, Sixth Brother doesn’t have the habit of letting people see me.”
Is it an illusion?
I always feel like he did it on purpose…
Vaguely sensing something, the Sixth Prince was stunned.
Ye Shuo was very disappointed that he couldn’t see the good show.
Meeting his disappointed look, the Fifth Prince couldn’t help but sneer. Disappointed, right? That’s right!
“Your Highness, I have something else to do, so I will take my leave now.” Contented, the Fifth Prince bowed and left leisurely.
The prince was a little overwhelmed as to how this had happened.
“Wow, he is such a boring guy.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but glance back and forth between the Crown Prince and the Sixth Prince.
“In that case, why don’t we…”
“I’m sorry, ninth brother. We’ll be at the palace soon, and I still have things to pack.” Before he could finish his words, he was interrupted by the Sixth Prince.
The prince followed closely behind him, smiling brightly: “I am the same.”
Ye Shuo had no choice but to shift his attention to the little grandson.
Just kidding, if I can’t play with your dad, why can’t I play with you?
Come here!
By the time the little grandson wanted to run, it was obviously too late.
“Ninth Uncle, you, don’t come over here, ahhhhhhhhhh!”
The prince could still hear his son’s screams of resistance from a distance. He was silent and finally chose to pretend he didn’t hear it.
Xiaojiu…should know his limits, right…?
At the same time, Emperor Jingwen also heard what happened outside. At first, he thought that the fifth and sixth brothers were going to quarrel, but he was suddenly interrupted by the ninth brother, and a conflict that was about to break out was avoided without a trace.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even bother trying to stop the fight.
It’s just pitiful that the little grandson who followed his father to stop the fight ended up being caught and used as a toy…
After all, he is the legitimate son of the crown prince, his own grandson. Seeing this, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel a headache: “Zhao An, go and quickly send a few people to watch over him. I hope nothing happens.”
Following his son, Emperor Jingwen’s heart was almost broken.
How could the prince’s legitimate son be played around with casually? Unfortunately, he had no such awareness, and Emperor Jingwen could only help him out.
The commander-in-chief received the order and quickly sent a few skilled fighters on horseback to chase after them.
The other side.
The little prince was put on the horse’s back by Ye Shuo without any resistance. The little prince wanted to run, but Ye Shuo, who had climbed over, held him down.
“If you move again, I won’t be responsible if you fall down.”
The moment the words fell, the little prince did not dare to struggle anymore.
Ye Shuo pulled the reins, and the old horse started to move after receiving the order.
The horse was obviously not very fast, but the little grandson was frightened. He thought frantically, and he couldn’t remember taking equestrian lessons in the study room, which had just started.
“Ninth, ninth uncle.” The little grandson of the emperor’s forced smile looked uglier than crying.
“When did you learn to ride a horse?”
Ye Shuo: “Three days ago.”
Little Grandson: “Ah?”
Ye Shuo cleared his throat, hiding the smile in his eyes, and said seriously, “I just learned it three days ago.”
The little grandson was completely stunned.
Ye Shuo pretended not to see it, and threatened in a calm voice: “That’s why I told you not to move.”
“But but but…” The little emperor’s grandson was still a very young child after all. After hearing this, he was so scared that he couldn’t speak clearly.
Just at this time, the guards sent by the commander-in-chief also caught up.
These guards were different from Li Yuheng and Zhang Yuan. They were typical children of officials. For them, riding a horse was as easy as eating and drinking.
I didn’t expect that even my cheap dad was so worried about me.
The sound of horse hooves was like thunder. Ye Shuo touched his nose and was about to say hello to the few people, but soon he felt the change of the old horse under his butt.
It seemed as if the old horse had changed into a different horse. The lazy aura instantly disappeared and he suddenly became energetic.
“Uh…” Ye Shuo blinked, and a bad premonition arose in his heart.
The next moment, Ye Shuo’s premonition came true.
Seeing that the other party was so powerful, Lao Ma thought they were chasing him.
Well, they were indeed chasing them, but not in the way that Lao Ma imagined.
The old horse was also a dignified horse in his past, so how could he allow the young horse to provoke him like this?
So Lao Ma couldn’t help but get serious.
It’s just a horse, not a human. God knows what’s going on in its mind.
After feeling a shock and a long hiss, the little prince felt that the wind, which was originally very gentle, suddenly became violent.
After realizing what was happening, the little prince couldn’t help but scream.
It’s over, it’s over, the horse suddenly went crazy!
Plus, the Ninth Prince is a beginner… Although the little grandson is still young, a thought still flashed through his mind: My life is over!
Just when the little grandson couldn’t help but feel desperate, he felt the hands holding his belly suddenly tightened, and the next moment, his uncle’s voice suddenly came from above –
“Hold on tight!”
Ye Shuo might indeed be a beginner here, but he had studied horse riding seriously in his previous life. Not only that, he had also rented a horse farm.
So……
“Don’t worry, nothing will happen.”
Ye Shuo took his little grandson with him, bent down slightly and lowered his center of gravity.
He didn’t know if it was an illusion, but for a moment, the little grandson felt that the usually unserious Ninth Uncle suddenly became exceptionally reliable.
It must be said that age is always more important than experience. Even at this old age, the chestnut horse is still kept in the Black Armor Guards. Instead of being abandoned, it is remembered by the commander-in-chief. It is indeed quite capable.
A quarter of an hour later, Ye Shuo pulled the reins suddenly, and the old horse raised its front hooves high. Feeling his body suddenly tilt backwards, the little emperor could not help but close his eyes.
He thought he was going to fall off, but after a while he realized that he was still sitting firmly on the horse.
The little prince was stunned.
Looking at the palace that was so close at hand and the plaque above it, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel happy.
“First!”
The little grandson who just came back to his senses: “…………”
So, what’s so good about this kind of thing? !
The thought that “the Ninth Prince is really reliable” that had just arisen in the little prince’s mind disappeared in an instant.
It was a rare opportunity to run so freely. The old horse was panting with exhaustion, but its hooves were stomping on the ground excitedly.
When Ye Shuo was happy enough, he found that he hadn’t received a response from his cheap nephew for a long time. He turned back subconsciously, and then he was stunned.
Oh wow.
Why are there so many people?

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Summer Vacation
chapters.content:
Lao Ma was very excited, Ye Shuo was also very excited, but they were the only two who were excited. The others were all very scared.
Isn’t it true that when an old horse suddenly accelerates, to someone who doesn’t know the situation, it looks like the horse has suddenly gone crazy?
Upon learning of this, Emperor Jingwen even came up with all kinds of conspiracies.
Seeing that the chestnut horse was carrying the two people faster and faster and farther away, in addition to a few guards, even the commander-in-chief who had not used force for a long time came to chase them personally. No matter whether it was the little grandson or his younger brother, the prince did not want to see them get into trouble, so he showed his true skills in a hurry.
Then came the fifth prince, the sixth prince, the seventh prince, the eighth prince… At the very end, seeing that they could not catch up, Emperor Jingwen almost got on the horse himself.
Although he had been emperor for so many years, Emperor Jingwen’s riding skills had not declined at all.
As a result, as soon as he jumped onto his horse, everyone in the convoy knelt down.
Taifu, He Xiang and his men almost threatened to die, which made Emperor Jingwen very angry.
The combination of various factors has led to the current situation.
The journey, which was originally supposed to take nearly an hour, was shortened by nearly half in one go.Several guards tried their best to catch up and were almost exhausted. Several princes, including the crown prince, had eyes that were almost spitting fire. After such a torment, even the commander-in-chief felt that his old illness was coming back.
Emperor Jingwen drew aside the curtain and came out. After seeing the remaining excitement on his son’s face, how could he not understand what had happened?
Watching his stepfather’s face turn ashen, Ye Shuo took a deep breath and waved his hands hastily, “Wait a minute, father! Wait a minute! Listen to your son’s explanation!”
He really didn’t mean it this time!
Ye Shuo is now like a little lamb surrounded by a pack of wolves, pitiful and helpless.
However, how could Emperor Jingwen trust him again? He immediately ordered several guards around him to hold him down and started to attack him.
How could the current Emperor Jingwen still look as confident as he had sworn before that he would never beat his children?
He threw all the ideas about using force being the lowest way to educate children out of his mind.
Emperor Jingwen finally discovered this. He knew that he couldn’t teach his son any better, so he might as well give him a beating. At least he could vent his anger and feel better.
He is so tough, I don’t think he can be broken.
So there was the following picture——
“I told you to run! I told you to run around!”
“Swish, swish, swish”, the rattan branches danced wildly.
“It would be fine if you were running around by yourself, but you even brought Xun’er with you!”
“Swish, swish, swish”, the frequency of the waving of the rattan became faster and faster.
Ye Shuo could never have imagined that the fried pork with rattan that he didn’t get to eat in his previous life would be made up for in this life.
The most important thing is that even his mother didn’t help him this time. It was obvious that Concubine Rong was also scared by him just now.
Hiss–
My cheap dad didn’t keep his word. He said he wouldn’t hit the child! But it turned out to be bullshit!
After a cup of tea, Ye Shuo covered his buttocks, wanting to cry but without tears.
After being beaten, it was the Sixth Prince who carried him back in the end.
After all, his stepfather was the emperor and rarely beat his children. Seeing Ye Shuo screaming so miserably, he didn’t dare to do it, so he just beat him with an ordinary or even lighter whipping with a rattan stick, and Ye Shuo was not seriously injured.
Ye Shuo felt quite embarrassed being carried by the Sixth Prince like this. With the Sixth Prince’s small physique, Ye Shuo was really afraid that he would get hurt from the exhaustion.
It’s hard for him to not get angry after being tossed around like this. Maybe this is the kind of person who does big things, just different from other people. Feeling a little touched, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say, “Xiao Ming, when you are old, I will carry you like this too.”
The Sixth Prince stopped and wished he could just throw the dead child away.
Tell me, why do you feel so soft-hearted towards him?
The Sixth Prince suspected that at that moment, his brain had been kicked by a donkey.
Just now when he was whipped by his father with a cane, he looked quite miserable indeed. But when I put him on my back, everything changed. His true appearance was revealed all of a sudden. He no longer looked as miserable and choked as if he was about to faint.
He recovered in an instant, and the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but sneer: “I’m only five years older than you.”
“When I get old, how young do you think you can be?”
Ye Shuo leaned on his shoulder and sighed: “But, my health is better than yours.”
Ye Shuo felt worried when he thought about the Sixth Prince’s current physical condition.
No matter when the other party came, and what he was thinking now, as long as he was not too excessive, Ye Shuo was not willing to care and hoped that the other party could live well.
But all along, the Sixth Prince never took his words to heart.
“I’m telling you, if you keep going like this, you’ll die young.” Even the Fifth Prince thought he was weak and bullied him, but as the person involved, he didn’t have this awareness. Ye Shuo could only remind him again and again.
I didn’t expect that when I carried him back with good intentions, he cursed me to die early!
The Sixth Prince couldn’t hold it in any longer, so he took a deep breath and threw his brother down directly.
“…Hey, hey, hey! What are you doing!” Fortunately, Ye Shuo had quick reactions and good balance, otherwise he would have really succeeded.
Ye Shuo was quick to move and quickly grabbed the tree next to him.
“I think you’re fine. If you’re so capable, just go back by yourself.”
After giving him a blank look, the Sixth Prince shook his sleeves and walked away angrily.
Tsk, how could there be someone who refuses to listen to advice?
Ye Shuo had no choice but to call his attendant: “Quick, quick, Xiao Luzi, come and help me.”
Xiao Luzi hurried forward and supported his master’s arm in time. He really couldn’t hold it back any longer, so he reminded him in a low voice: “Master, don’t do this next time.” It was so annoying.
Ye Shuo frowned: “Wow, even you want to teach me a lesson.”
“I dare not!”
“You know nothing, I’m doing this for his own good!”
Alas… I really can’t do anything…
After looking at the direction where the Sixth Prince left for a while, Ye Shuo lowered his eyes, and finally left.
“Forget it, forget it. I’d better go back and have some sleep.”
After three days on the road, although he could sleep in the inn at night, it was not very peaceful. In addition, the clothes he wore were thin in summer, and Ye Shuo’s buttocks and calves were beaten with a rattan stick, which caused burning pain. He urgently needed to rest.
It happened to be cool in the garden, so Ye Shuo lay there for three whole days.
In fact, it wouldn’t take that long to recuperate, but Ye Shuo had no choice but to leave the bed in the garden because it was so comfortable.
The garden manager received news in advance that the Emperor and all the ladies would be coming, so the garden manager started making arrangements half a month in advance.
Each room was cleaned thoroughly, and the carpets, utensils, and furnishings inside were also wiped clean in advance.
Not to mention that his mother had already had the necessary things delivered in advance, including antique vases and embroidered screens, all of which were exquisite items, and their luxury was not much different from that of Qiuwu Palace.
As for the custard mat under Ye Shuo, it was icy cold. It was said that it was captured by his grandfather during the war. There are no more than five of them in the world. One of them was handed over to the late emperor. I don’t know if the one handed over to the late emperor was because his stepfather thought it was not clean or what, so it was never used. The other one was the one Ye Shuo was lying on.
The production of Ya mats was too cruel, and these five mats were strictly banned after the Three Kingdoms period, so they are considered out of print.
Women are prone to coldness, and seeing that her son is afraid of heat, Concubine Rong laid out the unused dining mat for Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo felt a little awkward at first. After all, he had never used such contraband in his previous life. Later, he felt better after learning that it was no longer allowed to be produced.
During these three days, Ye Shuo lay in bed until his bones became weak.
On the third day, Ye Shuo was revived with full health. Just when he was about to start his wonderful adventure in the garden, Emperor Jingwen seemed to have foreseen something. Before Ye Shuo even went out, Wang Ziquan came over and blocked him.
“Ninth Prince, please come with me.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
My cheap dad is really good at sending secret guards to monitor my movements.
Concentrating and observing carefully, Ye Shuo noticed some movement on the tree branch and the corner of his mouth twitched slightly.
Speaking of things like climbing trees, isn’t this a compulsory course for secret guards?
I haven’t seen my cheap master Wu Yi for such a long time. I don’t know what he is doing or whether he is still with my cheap father.
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, Yuqianzhai, where Emperor Jingwen was handling government affairs, was already in sight.
“Your Highness the Ninth Prince, please come in.” Wang Ziquan blocked the back, completely cutting off Ye Shuo’s escape route.
Why are these people guarding against him like a thief?
Ye Shuo had a sullen expression on his face. He had no choice but to give up his plan to escape. He lifted the curtain and walked out.
Later, Ye Shuo discovered that there is no such thing as the most excessive, only more excessive.
Looking at a small table placed in the corner of the room, Ye Shuo was stunned.
I always feel that this location looks very familiar…
So… what does cheap dad mean by this???
Ye Shuo looked up suddenly, but saw that Emperor Jingwen was not in a hurry and didn’t even look at him. He just said, “Hurry up and sit down. That will be your seat in the future.”
Emperor Jingwen decided to keep a close eye on his son. He didn’t believe that even with the current situation, he still couldn’t let his son learn something.
Ye Shuo turned his head and saw the prince who was under his adoptive father nodded to him and called him “Xiao Jiu”. He looked a little helpless and shook his head, indicating that he could do nothing.
God knows how shocked the prince was when he heard his father’s decision.
You know, Yuqianzhai is where my father handles government affairs!
The Second Prince and the Fourth Prince, who have now begun to attend court to discuss state affairs, do not have this treatment.
However, this kind of blessing… whoever wants it can take it, okay? !
It would have been fine to just give him a separate table, but when Ye Shuo saw Lord Cen and the Grand Tutor sitting next to him, one on each side, Ye Shuo could no longer hold back.
Who wouldn’t feel annoyed by this kind of treatment?
Ye Shuo stood up and said righteously: “Father, I think it’s unfair for you to treat my fifth and sixth brothers like this!”
Normally, I’ve never seen this little bastard get so close to the fifth prince.
“Oh?” Emperor Jingwen was unmoved: “You don’t have to worry about this. Your fifth and sixth brothers don’t need a teacher to supervise them. They just know how to study on their own.”
Among all the princes, only this little bastard is unyielding.
It’s not just Lord Cen and the Grand Tutor, but also Prime Minister He and the others. If one teacher gets angry and runs away, then we’ll replace him with the next one.
Emperor Jingwen thought that he had many ministers under him, and even more of them were knowledgeable, so he had to put the knowledge into his brain, even if he had to force it!
Even Ye Shuo couldn’t control himself when he saw his cheap father like this and shuddered violently.
God, so cruel!

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Academic Master
chapters.content:
But what’s the use of this?
A cheap dad can never wake up a person who is pretending to be asleep.
If he is really an ordinary child, with such top resources, he will probably be able to achieve good results in the end.
But Ye Shuo is not an ordinary child.
He knew very well that people were fickle, and that they might be one way today and another tomorrow, so to be on the safe side, it was best to stay still like a turtle.
Ye Shuo would not be fooled by his cheap dad!
Seeing that my cheap dad is so determined, it’s better not to force it for now.
Ye Shuo discovered that his stepfather had changed. He no longer tried to reason with him. When he was unhappy, he would just let the guards surround him and hold him down.
The promise of winning people over with virtue is all a lie!
My cheap dad always changes his face strangely.Ye Shuo weighed the pros and cons and finally sat down.
Emperor Jingwen was very satisfied with his tact, but because of the previous lesson, he still did not let down his guard.
Emperor Jingwen felt very tired every time he faced this son.
Tell me, why doesn’t such a smart child use his intelligence in the right way?
Ye Shuo recalled the videos on the Internet of parents helping their children with homework in his previous life, and he soon had an idea in his mind.
Now that things have come to this, it all depends on who can outlast whom.
Speaking of Taifu and the others, they seem to be quite old…
For some reason, although the Ninth Prince lowered his eyes obediently at this moment, the 60-year-old and 59-year-old Taifu beside him felt a chill in their hearts.
Facts have proven that if children don’t get the hang of homework, it can really drive parents crazy.
Especially regarding the theory that the earth is round, and the sky is square, no matter how many times the Grand Tutor corrected him, the Ninth Prince still firmly believed that the land beneath his feet was round.
How could the ground be round? If it was round, how could they stand so firmly? Shouldn’t they slide down?
This matter is rather difficult to explain. After all, this place is so far from the sea, and they cannot see with their own eyes how the returning ship appears on the horizon. Moreover, the law of universal gravitation is also involved, and it is really not something that can be explained clearly in just a few words.
Ye Shuo’s persistence caused the Taifu’s blood pressure to gradually rise.
Although the Master had no idea what blood pressure was, his red face and thick neck could not deceive anyone.
Emperor Jingwen hurriedly replaced him with Prime Minister He.
Prime Minister He was not as rigid as the Taifu and directly avoided this controversial issue, but the effect was still not very good.
The Ninth Prince always has so many weird excuses, which are simply unheard of and really ridiculous.
In the end, even He Xiang couldn’t help but raise his voice a lot.
“Xiang He, calm down, calm down, don’t be angry, anger is harmful to your health.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but persuade.
However, his slowness not only failed to put out the fire, but instead added fuel to the fire.
Think about it, you are in a hurry, but the other party is as slow as a snail, who wouldn’t be angry?
Even Emperor Jingwen, who was listening in on the side, felt a little restless.
It’s not that they don’t want to learn, or that they can’t, it’s that they simply don’t follow your requirements. Just based on this last point, the first two advantages are equal to zero in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen and others.
After all, there is no such thing as respecting children’s ideas at this time.
Seeing that he could not convince anyone, Prime Minister He was defeated in less than half an hour, and the Minister of the Chancellery took over.
The Minister of the Chancellery gritted his teeth and sat down in front of Ye Shuo.
However, the ideas of both sides are fundamentally different, and they are completely the products of two different eras. Even if a hundred more people were replaced, it would be useless.
In the morning when Ye Shuo came, the supply of herbal tea in Yuqianzhai was more than that of the previous three days combined.
Although Emperor Jingwen and the Crown Prince did not serve in person, they each had a bowl on hand.
After all, the Queen was the ruler of the Imperial Palace and was well-informed. After hearing about this, she specially had someone prepare a decoction to relieve summer heat and maintain health and send it over.
Ye Shuo then remembered that there seemed to be a queen in the palace.
It’s not that Ye Shuo dislikes her, it’s mainly because the Queen’s presence is too low.
Except during festivals when Ye Shuo would visit the other party’s palace, or when they went to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to worship their ancestors, Ye Shuo would follow to pay his respects, but normally Ye Shuo would hardly see the other party.
But I heard that the Queen and his mother had never gotten along well, and they would always quarrel whenever they met, especially when his mother went to pay her respects, basically no one could be at peace, and the other concubines would also join his mother and the Queen in fighting.
Judging from the surface, Ye Shuo always felt that his mother had always been playing the role of a villain. No, she wasn’t even a villain, she was clearly playing the role of cannon fodder.
That kind of arrogant and domineering female supporting role is basically doomed to end up in a very miserable situation.
However, imagination is just imagination, not reality.
After all, my cheap dad likes his mom more in his heart.
Even if this kind of liking is nothing in the eyes of the emperor, but being able to gain a little favoritism and having it fall on one person alone can make a clear difference.
At least the cheap father’s attitude towards his mother and the queen is quite different.
So this matter has its gains and losses. Although his mother lost the position of queen, she at least retained the favor of her cheap father. With this favor, Ye Shuo has the basic qualifications to act recklessly. As for the queen, although she got the position of successor, she also lost the favor of her cheap father and the qualification to have children.
My stepfather would go to the Queen’s palace on the first and fifteenth day of every month, but there had been no news of the Queen’s pregnancy for so many years. Ye Shuo didn’t believe that there wouldn’t be any problems.
After all, it is just to prevent the legitimate sons from fighting with each other.
Emperor Jingwen, who was standing by, did not show any emotion when he heard Wang Ziquan say that the empress’s maidservant outside the door had brought some summer heat-removing medicine. He was obviously used to it. He just said “hmm” lightly and motioned Wang Ziquan to deal with it himself.
The tea-room was now filled with medicines sent by concubines from various palaces. Soon, the medicines sent by the queen were also mixed in, making it difficult to distinguish them.
After all, there are so many nourishing and health-preserving soups and medicines. Even if he only drinks a sip from each one, Emperor Jingwen will have to go to the toilet all the time every day.
Therefore, for the sake of fairness, Emperor Jingwen would not touch any gift no matter who gave it to him, to avoid jealousy and quarrels among the concubines.
But the person who delivered the medicine didn’t think so. Everyone wants to be the most special one. With such a thought and such a result, the person who delivered the medicine naturally felt disappointed.
My cheap father really doesn’t understand women’s hearts. Seeing the maid at the door not leaving after delivering the medicine, watching eunuch Wang’s actions, and finally leaving with a look of disappointment, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but shake his head.
The other side.
When the maid returned, the first thing the queen said was, “Did His Majesty accept it?”
Seeing the maid shaking her head, the queen’s expression suddenly froze.
She clenched her palm subconsciously, and the next second, a piercing pain came from her index finger, making the queen break out in a cold sweat.
It turned out that the queen had personally made those soups and medicines in the kitchen, and had burned her hands in the process. But now, the emperor had thrown them aside like garbage and left them alone.
Not only that, the maid also brought a piece of news that the queen could not accept even more –
The Ninth Prince is now in Yuqianzhai. Like the Crown Prince, His Majesty has specially placed a table for him.
“This is impossible!” Not sure if it was because she couldn’t accept it or because the news was too shocking, the queen’s first reaction was to deny it.
How is it possible? How could His Majesty bring Concubine Rong’s son with him!
But unfortunately, this is the reality.
If it were normal, she would be able to tolerate or even ignore Concubine Rong’s various provocations and lack of face, but today’s news completely broke the Queen’s defenses.
The Queen was not stupid either. She saw it clearly. Although Imperial Concubine Rong seemed to be in great shape and beauty, she was actually just an outward appearance with rotten rags inside. However, the mother and her son were like fools. They were still so ostentatious every day without any restraint.
In the past, although the Queen suffered a loss on the surface, she actually regarded the two of them as a joke in her heart, so she did not take any setbacks seriously. But now, Emperor Jingwen’s decision instantly shattered the Queen’s fantasy.
The queen only now realized that she was the one who was wrong.
If His Majesty did not really care, he would not make such a decision even for the sake of face.
“It was my fault.” The queen laughed bitterly.
The maid next to her opened her mouth, but couldn’t find any words of comfort, so she could only remain silent.
After a while, an idea suddenly crossed the Queen’s mind, and she couldn’t help but speak: “What do you think… if I gave birth to a prince like Concubine Rong, would it be better?”
But in fact, using children to keep a man is the stupidest thing to do.
The Queen is now the Empress. Even if the Crown Prince ascends the throne in the future, she will be the Empress Dowager for sure because of the early death of the Queen Mother. Even if she has no real power, it is not worth it for her to go through such a journey.
But at this time the queen had already gone a little crazy.
In her opinion, since both of them were infertile, there seemed to be no impact after the imperial concubine forced to give birth to a prince, and the emperor did not do anything to her and the Duke of Zhen’s family.
If the imperial concubine can do this, why can’t I?
As long as they find a way to give birth to the child, the child is the emperor’s flesh and blood after all, and the emperor will develop feelings for the child as he raises him over time.
This is the so-called natural relationship between father and son, and it should be so.
The Queen was now in an unbalanced state of mind. She had completely thrown aside the hint given by Emperor Jingwen when he conferred the title upon her, and had also forgotten the principle that one should not be too greedy.
The maidservant at the side was shocked. She instinctively wanted to speak up to persuade her, but when she saw the look in the Queen’s eyes, she shuddered and swallowed back the words that were about to come out.
the other side.
Ye Shuo had no idea that the thing he had been resisting and tormenting himself with had actually become a popular thing in the eyes of others. If he knew, he would definitely give all this blessing to the Queen without saying a word.
Which child would suffer so much at such a young age? While the Taifu and the others were suffering, Ye Shuo didn’t feel well either.
Seven against one, while the Taifu and other important ministers were exhausted, Ye Shuo, who was now carrying the body of a child, was also exhausted!
Ye Shuo was now being forced to practice calligraphy listlessly.
They can’t win the argument with Ye Shuo, so why not let him write?
Seeing that his son had finally behaved himself, Emperor Jingwen heaved a sigh of relief, put down the memorial in his hand, and stood up to take a look.
In the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, whether he was disciplining his ministers or his sons, he had to give them a beating before giving them a sweet reward. Now was the time to give them the sweet reward.
In simple terms, Emperor Jingwen planned to reap the fruits of his labor.
Result……
When Emperor Jingwen walked in and took a look, his originally gentle expression stiffened at a speed visible to the naked eye.
“What are you writing?!”
Looking at the black lumps on the rice paper, Emperor Jingwen’s eyes immediately went dark.
“I’m practicing calligraphy, what’s wrong?” As a modern person, it’s good enough to be able to write like this with a brush. This thing requires years of practice, and even a genius can’t do it well. So Ye Shuo really can’t do it, and this time he is definitely not pretending.
He looked down and seemed quite satisfied with it.
But in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, there was only the word “shame”.
He couldn’t close his eyes even after his death, and he was too ashamed to face his ancestors.
Emperor Jingwen prided himself on being both a civil and military talent, and his calligraphy was a unique skill, so he just couldn’t understand how he could have given birth to such a son.
In order to prevent his eyes from being blinded by his son’s rotten handwriting one day, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath, stepped forward and personally held his son’s hand without saying anything.
You said you would let others teach you, but you didn’t do it yourself, but in the end you still have to do it.
Emperor Jingwen leaned over and dipped the brush in ink again reluctantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Teaching
chapters.content:
“See? To make it like this, the ink cannot be too full or too little. Too much will make it smudge, and too little will make the color not show. It’s best to have neither too much nor too little.”
Emperor Jingwen demonstrated it to him personally while speaking.
After gently scraping the ink stone a few times to clean off the excess ink, Emperor Jingwen calmed down and made his first stroke.
It had been many years since Ye Shuo had his hand held and written for him. The last time was more than 30 years ago, when he was two or three years old and had just started learning to write in kindergarten. His parents took turns holding his hand and doing his homework for him.
There’s nothing we can do about it. This is how kids are when they first start school. Plus, his parents feel sorry for him, so they hold his hand and write for him.
And now, in a blink of an eye, so many years have passed.
“Don’t be distracted. Pay attention.” Because he was writing, even though he noticed that his son was distracted, Emperor Jingwen did not do anything. He just reminded him in a deep voice.
Ye Shuo woke up immediately.
It must be said that his cheap father’s calligraphy is quite good. It ranks among the top five among the authentic works of emperors that Ye Shuo has seen in major museums in his previous life.
Emperor Jingwen’s calligraphy is vigorous and powerful, with sharp strokes. It seems that there is no problem in collecting and mounting it to pass it on to future generations.
Of course, the premise is that if there are really descendants…
Men are always particularly vain, especially when facing their wives and children. The feeling is completely different from facing their subordinates at work. Even the emperor is no exception.
But Ye Shuo was good at speaking directly and was never shy when praising others.
Facing his son’s gaze that was filled with admiration and amazement, Emperor Jingwen felt proud and couldn’t help but curl up the corners of his mouth.
Before he could open his mouth to speak, Ye Shuo’s voice full of amazement came over.
“Father, you are so amazing.” The person standing in front of him was a living calligrapher. It would be great if the emperor’s calligraphy could also be sold for money. But even if it couldn’t, it didn’t stop Ye Shuo from exclaiming in amazement.
Good is good, and good should be praised. This is absolutely normal, but for others except Ye Shuo, it is harder than climbing to the sky.
Others were used to being reserved, so it was inevitable that they felt a little uncomfortable when they suddenly met someone like Ye Shuo.
Upon hearing this, the prince couldn’t help but retract his envious gaze.
When he was two or three years old, his father once held his hand and taught him to write, but after he learned it, his father stopped doing that.
Looking at his brother now, the prince thought about it and felt that he really could not do it or say it, so he thought about it and decided to give up.
The prince is a father of children now, but even if he doesn’t have any, he can’t bring himself to do this.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: ~Fishing
chapters.content:
Feeling that his crappy handwriting looked too shabby to be placed next to the “Yong” written by his cheap father, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but take out a new piece of rice paper from the side and held it in front of his cheap father like a dog.
“Father, please write a few more, Father.”
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel comfortable when he heard this. He was very pleased. It was just a few big characters. Isn’t it easy to get it?
It’s just that the content is not what Ye Shuo wants –
“God rewards hard work.”
Okay, it’s to encourage him to be diligent and motivated.
Noticing that his son’s expression suddenly fell, Emperor Jingwen’s eyelids also twitched.
“Why, not satisfied?”
“No, no.” Ye Shuo blew hard at the big words in front of him, and when the ink dried, he rolled it up immediately.
“Don’t worry, Dad. I’ll have it framed tomorrow and hang it above the bed!”That’s about right.
Emperor Jingwen was finally satisfied.
Oh, I forgot to mention that when Emperor Jingwen saw Ye Shuo’s words just now, a thought flashed through his mind quickly, but he was interrupted by Ye Shuo, and Emperor Jingwen forgot what he wanted to ask just now.
Ye Shuo hadn’t expected that when his stepfather came over, Ye Shuo thought he would be exposed, so he asked Xing Yucheng to help him write his homework.
Who knew that my cheap dad didn’t even notice it, which is really cause for celebration.
But in fact, Xing Yucheng’s left-handed handwriting is that of a beginner, and it is also very bad. Since they are both equally bad, is there any need to distinguish how bad they are?
My eyes hurt just looking at it. Who would have the time to study this?
Haven’t you seen that every time the tutor checks the homework, he just glances at it hurriedly and then quickly closes it?
Ye Shuo’s laziness has not been discovered until now, and the difference in handwriting is a big reason for it.
This was the first time that Ye Shuo had been honest and quietly staying in one place to study for more than two hours.
It was almost time for lunch, and Ye Shuo took the opportunity to put on a pitiful look and looked at his old father: “Father, my hand hurts, let me rest in the afternoon.”
His hand hurts so much!
How many words did he write?
Emperor Jingwen was about to scold him without thinking, but as luck would have it, he happened to meet Ye Shuo’s eyes. Emperor Jingwen then realized that he was like an eggplant hit by frost, completely wilted and looking so pitiful.
Emperor Jingwen thought about it and felt that two hours was nothing for other princes, but it was indeed difficult for Xiaojiu. It was good enough that he could hold on without making a fuss.
Emperor Jingwen finally agreed after his heart softened.
The prince, who had to sit here for more than four hours a day, was silent.
He Xiang who was almost hoarse almost vomited blood when he heard this.
The Grand Tutor felt that they might have to work harder than the Ninth Prince.
On the surface it looked like seven to one, but in reality it was clearly one to seven.
This is like asking several professors from top universities to teach a child what 1+1 equals for the whole morning. This in itself is a torture.
What’s even more torturous is that I haven’t been taught yet.
However, Emperor Jingwen was the monarch and they were his subjects. When the monarch gave an order, the subjects had no choice but to obey.
Just thinking about the fact that they would have to live like this for nearly half a year, He Xiang and the others felt dark before their eyes. It felt like it was much more torturous than helping to handle government affairs.
“Thank you for your consideration, Father. I will take my leave now.”
After Ye Shuo finished speaking softly and weakly, he suppressed the excitement in his heart and walked out.
As soon as he walked out of the door and turned around, Ye Shuo no longer looked listless. He looked as if he had been injected with chicken blood, and his eyes burst into intense light.
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi had been waiting outside for the whole morning. After all, they were not allowed to sit in on the discussion between the emperor and his ministers. Even the prince’s attendant Mo Shu and others were waiting outside.
As soon as he saw the two of them, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but said, “Quick, quick, go back and eat something. I’ll take you fishing in the afternoon!”
As soon as Ye Shuo opened his mouth, he immediately blocked the other two’s greetings.
The Ninth Prince looks so energetic, it seems that nothing is wrong.
“Fish? What fish?” Xing Yucheng, who came here for the first time, looked confused.
“Of course it’s the kind of fish that can be eaten!” Ye Shuo looked at his study partner with a little contempt.
“You’ve been here for three days, don’t you want to find out what’s in the garden?”
Ye Shuo had heard early on that there was a particularly large lake in the garden. When he heard the word “lake”, his first reaction was that he could swim and fish there.
How can you not play in the water in the hot summer?
Xing Yucheng opened his mouth and wanted to say, who would first ask where there are fun places for no reason? Isn’t this just wasting time?
But when he thought that the person in front of him was the Ye Shuo, Xing Yucheng immediately shut his mouth.
Ye Shuo went back in a hurry and ate a few mouthfuls of rice hastily. Then he saw the manager of the garden personally bringing him the fishing rod he wanted.
Although ancient fishing rods are not as advanced as modern ones, especially the “thorn” on the fishhook, which is difficult to make with today’s technology, it actually doesn’t have much impact if the fish is small. As long as the nest is well-made, and the hook is lowered accurately, the fish can still be caught.
As for the bait nests, there are many people fishing in the garden, and these things are prepared in advance.
“The recipe is good, but it might be better if you add some brown sugar and wine yeast.” This recipe was shared with him by a wild fishing expert. Ye Shuo used it several times and found that the effect was indeed good.
Brown sugar…yeast…?
While the steward was stunned, Ye Shuo called Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi who had finished eating and prepared to leave.
Seeing this, Concubine Rong couldn’t help but shout, “Shuo’er, the weather is so hot, why don’t you wait until the afternoon when it’s cooler before going out?”
It was noon and the sun was scorching. Concubine Rong was afraid that her son would be sunburned again.
Especially for those with tender skin, it would be bad if they get tanned.
But for anglers, the sun in June is nothing. They still have to fish even if it means they have to fish.
So Ye Shuo said: “No, mother, my father will only allow me to rest for a while. If I delay any longer, I won’t be able to finish it.”
“By the way, Sixth Brother, are you going?” Ye Shuo looked at the Sixth Prince who was silent beside him.
The Sixth Prince naturally shook his head.
Ye Shuo was not surprised at the other party’s answer, and without further persuasion, he left with Xing Yucheng and the others.
Concubine Rong had no choice but to let him go.
Ye Shuo knew that there were many people in the garden and naturally many people fishing, so he wanted to grab a spot early. However, what Ye Shuo never expected was that even though he was so fast, he still couldn’t get the best fishing spot.
There are already people under the shade of the best willow trees.
The man was about thirty years old, not much younger than my cheap dad, with bronze skin, who knows if it was from being tanned by the sun while fishing, but there was a 川-shaped wrinkle between his brows, and you could tell at first glance that he was a very serious person, and when his eyes looked at me, I couldn’t help but become solemn.
Because the other party was wearing casual clothes, Ye Shuo had no way of judging his identity. However, judging from the material of his clothes, he must be extremely wealthy, and maybe even a royal relative.
After all, most of the ministers who have this ability are still in Yuqianzhai.
I originally wanted to say hello to the other party. No matter who it is, we can get to know each other after chatting for a while. Besides, we all came here to fish, so we knew we were destined to be together.
But before Ye Shuo could force a smile, the other party had already turned his head away, as if he had no intention of paying attention to him.
Okay, now Ye Shuo is sure that the other party is a royal relative.
Looking down at the prince’s uniform that he had not had time to change out of, Ye Shuo was not embarrassed, nor did he disturb the other party. He found a place far away and sat down on the stool.
“Don’t just stand there, come and sit down.” After Xiao Luzi tied a tung oil umbrella to the tree to serve as a parasol, Ye Shuo also invited the two to sit down.
However, the two of them didn’t seem to be very interested in fishing. After sitting down, Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi took out their books to read at the same time.
There is nothing we can do. Since the master is not making progress, the only thing they, the servants/slaves, can do is work hard.
The water in this garden is alive and has never been fished on a large scale. The last time my cheap father brought a large group here was three or four years ago. Now that such a long time has passed, I guess the fish in the water should have multiplied a lot.
Afraid that he would have too much fish and no place to put them, Ye Shuo boldly brought several buckets with him.
The child is small in stature, but very greedy.
Seeing several wooden barrels lined up in a row, Prince Su couldn’t help but laugh. The fish in this lake are very cunning. How could they be so easily——
Before Prince Su could finish his thoughts, he heard a child’s slightly surprised voice coming from the side.
“Huh? You took the bait so quickly?”
I just sat down, it hasn’t even been two minutes, right?
Ye Shuo was stunned when he saw the goose feather that he had tied to the hanging line as a float moving. After he came to his senses, he slowly began to reel in the rod.
Prince Su still felt that it was not so easy for him to catch a fish. Maybe the hook was caught on something else in the water?
But soon, Prince Su watched helplessly as a fish weighing more than a pound was pulled out of the water by him.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Mockery
chapters.content:
It’s probably just a coincidence.
Prince Su fishes all year round, and as an old fishing enthusiast, he has seen this kind of situation before.
Generally speaking, when you are a novice, it is not uncommon to catch fish without knowing why. But after you become proficient and learn the real skills, the number of times you catch fish without knowing ‘why’ may decrease.
Therefore, Prince Su did not take this scene to his heart.
In his opinion, doing it occasionally is not a real skill.
Xiao Luzi and Xing Yucheng on the side were a little surprised. They hadn’t even turned the page of the book in their hands, but His Highness had taken the bait so quickly?
Xiao Luzi and Xing Yucheng originally wanted to help, but they saw Ye Shuo easily remove the hook by himself, and then put the one-pound fish into the wooden barrel.
The fish struggled a few times, but when it saw it couldn’t get free, it quickly gave up.
“I’ll give you a snack when we get back tonight.” Ye Shuo said as he put bait on the fishhook again.
Ancient times were different from modern times. There were few pollution problems in ancient times, especially in the royal gardens, which were well protected. Therefore, although the carp in the lake have many spines, the water quality is good, so the fish raised here are particularly plump. You can tell that the carp meat is good just by looking at it, and it must taste great when you eat it.“By the way, I remember your father is here too, right? I’ll bring you two when I go back tonight.”
In his previous life, Ye Shuo often followed the friends mentioned by Mr. Gu to drive to reservoirs and mountains all over the country to go fishing in the wild and the sea. Ye Shuo and two of them were considered good fishermen. Unless they were particularly unlucky, they would often not be able to eat all the fish they caught. They could take the fish to the market to sell. They were not short of money, so there was no need.
They go fishing mainly for fun. After a day’s fishing, they will release most of the fish and share the remaining ones with whoever they meet. After all… not everyone in a team can catch fish successfully. Well, strictly speaking, except for the three of them who always catch fish, the others almost always catch nothing. The contrast is so terrible that others have always suspected that the three of them hired divers in advance to squat in the water and hook fish on their hooks.
Otherwise, the hook-up rate is unscientific.
The water is the same, the place is the same, even the formula of the bait is the same. The best among the three was forced to hand over the exclusive formula a long time ago, but for some reason, only the three of them can do it, while the others just can’t catch any fish.
Some of them refused to believe it and thought that they had chosen the wrong place. They insisted on switching places with them. After Ye Shuo and the other two were forced to switch places, for some reason, the fish that had been biting the hook suddenly stopped moving, making those people almost vomit blood.
Ye Shuo could catch more than 100 kilograms of fish in four hours, and it was not uncommon for him to catch two fish in a row or two on one rod. However, that was in an artificial fishing ground, and the fish were relatively large, each weighing more than two or three kilograms. The quality of the fishing rods and hooks was also incomparable.
The fish density in the lake in front of him was probably enough, but the quality of the fishing rods was far from enough. If he used separate rods, the strength of the fishing line would probably not be enough. So he didn’t want to catch two or three fish on one rod. Ye Shuo could only fish one by one.
After Ye Shuo finished fishing, he habitually shared the fish with everyone, so he casually said this.
Xing Yucheng didn’t feel anything, and even felt a little touched. After all, His Highness was still thinking about him at this time.
Although His Highness was not very serious, he had nothing to say about him and Xiao Luzi. Otherwise, Xing Yucheng would not have reacted to studying when he felt that his future was uncertain, instead of running away or giving up.
Xing Yucheng didn’t think much about it and thanked him directly: “Thank you for your consideration, Your Highness.”
However, this scene made Prince Su standing by feel both amused and confused.
A seven or eight-year-old child spoke so arrogantly, and more importantly, other people actually took it seriously. Prince Su couldn’t help but find it a little funny.
Fishing is not that simple. If you can catch the first fish, you will definitely catch the second one.
There are countless people who had high hopes but ended up being disappointed.
