Things are still uncertain, he even arranged for family members of his study companions. This kid is really arrogant, and his personality is exactly the same as the rumors say… huh???
Prince Su has always been taciturn and solitary, and he doesn’t interact much with his nephews, so he had no intention of talking to Ye Shuo at the beginning.
Seeing that the kid was fishing there seriously, it didn’t seem like he was just fishing on a whim. It didn’t seem like he was just playing around. Prince Su was excited to see the prey, so he thought of giving him a few reminders and planned to teach him some fishing skills. After all, this was the only nephew Prince Su had met who had the same hobby as himself.
Prince Su has been fishing for many years. Although he cannot be said to be the best in the world, at least he can be called an “expert”.
He took a look into his bucket and saw two carp swimming happily inside. Just as Prince Su was about to speak, he discovered that his nephew’s fish float had moved again.
Prince Su was obviously stunned for a moment.
Noticing the movement, Ye Shuo reeled in the club again.
This time was the same as last time, also a carp weighing more than one kilogram.
Ye Shuo put it into the bucket with a calm expression.
Prince Su was silent for a moment, then looked away.
Prince Su felt that it was time to speed up the process. After all, he had only caught two fish in the whole morning and noon.
Perhaps it was his nephew’s actions that stimulated Prince Su. Although Prince Su had no intention of talking to him, he still unconsciously paid a lot of attention to him.
Just like this, for a whole afternoon, Prince Su watched Ye Shuo catch fish and fish and fish non-stop. He could catch at least seven or eight fish every half hour. The four buckets he brought with him were not enough to hold them and were full in a short while.
Then Prince Su saw him pick and choose again, throwing fish into the water, throwing fish, throwing fish, throwing fish, he didn’t want the ones that were too small, too big, ugly, with fish eggs in their bellies, too skinny… Despite this, his four buckets were never empty.
What Prince Su could not accept the most was that, perhaps because he felt it was boring, his nephew simply put away the fishing rod, broke off a willow branch from the willow tree, and then swung it over the water. Just when Prince Su could not help frowning, he saw a fish suddenly leap out of the water and was caught by his nephew with his quick eyes and hands.
Prince Su: “…………”
Prince Su exerted so much force on his hand that he almost broke the fishing rod that he usually treated as a treasure.
“It jumps so high, and is so motivated. It looks delicious at first glance… It’s decided! It’s you!” So, as a person, no, when cooking fish, you must not be so outstanding, otherwise the bird that sticks out will be shot at, and without absolute strength, there will be no good results.
Ye Shuo casually picked out a fish from the bucket and threw it away, then tied the one he had just caught with a bow on a willow branch as a mark, and left it for his mother to eat in the evening.
After everything was done, Ye Shuo looked at the brilliant sunset in the distance, the sparkling water, and then at the four full buckets at his feet. After a long while, he couldn’t help but sigh deeply.
Few people come to fish in the royal gardens. Those who can come here to fish are not ordinary people. There are not many people in the whole Zhou who are qualified. For fear of spoiling the interest of the nobles, people feed the fish every day, and the fish have been fed silly.
Ye Shuo felt that when he was young, fishing for goldfish in the park was more difficult than this.
“Ah… it’s really boring…”
Hearing these words suddenly, and looking at the five small fish in his bucket, Prince Su couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
He gave two of the buckets to Xing Yucheng and told him to do with them as he pleased. The remaining buckets were given to Ye Shuo and Xiao Luzi, each of whom took them back to kill two fish first and eat the rest in the small kitchen.
If there is no challenge, there is no fun, so Ye Shuo is naturally not very interested.
When passing by Prince Su, the disappointment on his face hurt Prince Su’s eyes.
On the way back to Xiangjingzhai, Ye Shuo happened to meet Prince Jin who was out for a walk.
Although he had only met King Jin once, the two of them got along quite well at the time, so Ye Shuo asked him if he wanted to eat fish.
“This… let’s forget it…” Prince Jin had eaten too much fish over the years, and now he felt nauseous at the sight of fish, so he waved his hands repeatedly.
Ye Shuo didn’t force him. After chatting with him for a few more words, he took Xiao Luzi away.
During the whole process, Ye Shuo’s attitude was very natural, as if they were good friends who had known each other for many years. After Ye Shuo had left for a long time, King Jin finally realized that he had just met his nephew once.
Hey! This guy is really interesting.
King Jin knew King Su’s preferences, and soon found him at the old place. Seeing his nephew’s fishing rod and the two buckets of fish he had just carried, King Jin subconsciously asked, “How is it? Is the catch good today?”
Prince Jin didn’t think so much. In his opinion, if a child could return with a full load, Prince Su, who was an expert in this field, would surely burst all the buckets he brought today.
“Huh? Why don’t you speak?”
Seeing that his master hadn’t received a response for a long time and was still asking questions, the accompanying eunuch couldn’t help but reach out and tug at his master’s sleeve.
Finally receiving some information, King Jin belatedly looked down.
When he saw the five pitiful little fish in the bucket, King Jin blurted out: “Why have you changed your ways? Why did you let all these fish go?”
Upon hearing this, Prince Su, whose already unhappy complexion, turned green.
That’s not right. King Jin doesn’t remember that he had this habit. He always took whatever he caught and never refused anyone.
This time he finally reacted, and King Jin couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
It was so sudden and the noise was so loud that a large number of birds that were temporarily resting on the willow trees flew away in fear. The guards and palace servants passing by could not help but look over.
Prince Su: “…”
the other side.
As it was already evening, the sun was not as scorching as it was at noon, so the ladies from various palaces began to come out to stroll around the gardens.
The guards were constantly patrolling around, and the ministers consciously avoided this period of time. Occasionally, one or two would pass by and avoid them when they saw the concubines.
Ye Shuo, carrying two buckets of fish, was too conspicuous to hide, so almost everyone knew that he was going fishing in the afternoon.
It’s okay, as long as my cheap dad doesn’t know about it.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but pray like this.
However, sometimes, the more people fear something, the more likely it is to happen.
Emperor Jingwen never imagined that after he had finally finished dealing with state affairs and came out to relax, he would coincidentally run into his son who kept saying that he was almost exhausted to death.
Now the little bastard is full of energy, how can he look tired at all?
At both ends of the road, under the shade of trees, a father and son stood facing each other, their eyes meeting, and their expressions changed to varying degrees.
As for the woman following Emperor Jingwen, she was a little curious. Could it be that this… was the legendary Ninth Prince?

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Gods Will
chapters.content:
The woman who could appear next to Emperor Jingwen was naturally no one else. Although she looked unfamiliar, she was also one of Emperor Jingwen’s concubines. It was just that the woman’s status was low, so apart from the concubines, few people had seen her.
Concubine Song was a newcomer chosen to enter the palace during last year’s election. Since Emperor Jingwen did not care much about beauty, Concubine Song was kept in seclusion for nearly a year and was only able to see the emperor’s face recently.
Because of her outstanding appearance, Concubine Song was discovered by Emperor Jingwen two months ago. She was then promoted directly from an ordinary seventh-rank concubine to a seventh-rank lady, and was brought to the garden. She was the only one who made a name for herself among last year’s selection of beauties.
Miss Song was only 29 years old, just like a flower. With the brilliant sunset behind her, she was so beautiful when seen from afar on the bridge by the lake.
Emperor Jingwen happened to pass by and suddenly remembered that he had not summoned her for two or three months since her last sleepover. With an idea in mind, he summoned her to accompany him.
And then, nothing happened.
Things turned out like this, and the amorous thoughts that had just arisen in Emperor Jingwen’s mind were immediately forced to wake up.
Ye Shuo has no time to care about whether a woman is beautiful or not. As a standard ancient emperor, his cheap father should not have too many women around him. Ye Shuo now has a bigger crisis to deal with.
If he argued that the fish was presented to my cheap dad, my cheap dad would definitely not believe him.
In that case…if I don’t run now, when will I?“What are you still standing there for? Why don’t you run?!” If you delay any longer, the guards will be here soon!
After making eye contact with Emperor Jingwen, Ye Shuo picked up the bucket without hesitation, turned around and ran away.
Leaving the small path is neither right nor wrong.
After all, not everyone has the courage of Ye Shuo, and Xiao Luzi dare not run away in front of the emperor.
He knelt down with a plop, Xiao Luzi wanted to cry but had no tears.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even look at him, just a little eunuch. He subconsciously took two steps forward and chased him. He found that this was really damaging to his image, so he directly ordered the guards who came after hearing the news: “Go, go and bring him back to me!”
“Yes!”
The guards took orders and performed their usual actions.
There was no way. The Ninth Prince had gotten into trouble too many times, and they had become accustomed to helping His Majesty catch children.
But Ye Shuo was no pushover. Being chased once or twice was fine, but this was already the third time. How could it be so easy for him to be caught by them again?
Even without using his internal strength, Ye Shuo’s two legs alone were enough.
Ye Shuo moved flexibly, leaving all the guards empty-handed. The fish in his bucket suffered. After a shaking, the surrounding stone roads were covered with water stains. The bucket, which was originally full of water, was now less than half full, and the fish inside were almost shaken unconscious.
“Father, don’t be angry. Wait until tomorrow. I will definitely apologize to you tomorrow!”
Let’s talk about tomorrow tomorrow. As for now, of course, the best thing to do is run!
After Ye Shuo uttered these words, he slipped into the bushes beside him and disappeared in a flash.
“You bastard, my flowers!” Emperor Jingwen’s chest heaved violently as he looked at his monkey-like son.
Concubine Song, who was standing by, had subconsciously dodged when Ye Shuo ran away. Now she reacted and hurried forward to help Emperor Jingwen calm down.
If it were a normal day, with a beauty by his side, leaning on him tenderly, even Emperor Jingwen would have had some feelings floating around, but now, he was not in the mood to do so.
In other words, as long as his son appeared, he had no other thoughts.
It wouldn’t be a good idea to send the guards to rush into the imperial concubine’s palace to arrest someone, but he couldn’t swallow this humiliation, so Emperor Jingwen set his sights on Xiao Luzi.
Xiao Luzi shuddered suddenly. Just when Xiao Luzi was getting extremely nervous, Emperor Jingwen asked Wang Ziquan to come forward and then… took away the bucket that Xiao Luzi was carrying.
Emperor Jingwen took a look and saw that the box was full of fish.
It turned out that the emperor was not looking at himself, but the fish in his hand.
Xiao Luzi couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, but before he could catch his breath, he heard Emperor Jingwen say, “Go back and inform your master that I will order the chef in the imperial kitchen to prepare a fish feast for this bucket of fresh fish tonight.”
There were at least five or six fish in this bucket, and he must have worked very hard to catch them this afternoon. When the time came to fry, roast, and deep-fry them, Emperor Jingwen didn’t believe he wouldn’t feel bad.
Upon hearing this, Xiao Luzi’s expression immediately became hesitant. At this moment, he didn’t know whether he should tell the emperor the truth.
Emperor Jingwen did not notice the change in expression of a servant and thus successfully missed the truth.
After asking Wang Ziquan to take the fish to the imperial kitchen for processing, Emperor Jingwen felt much better.
Only then did Concubine Song mustered up the courage to return to Emperor Jingwen’s side.
Concubine Song is a quiet person by nature and hates noise the most. Ye Shuo is probably the kind of naughty child she hates the most. Moreover, he just made the emperor so angry. Concubine Song thinks that he is really going too far and is a bit… ungrateful.
What’s more important is that the other party was making so much noise that he would bump into her if she wasn’t careful. Now she couldn’t withstand a bump from the Ninth Prince.
But the other party is a prince after all. Although Concubine Song thought so in her heart, she did not dare to show it on her face.
Concubine Song did not mention the Ninth Prince at all. She seemed a little shy, and her rosy face and rosy cheeks were extremely charming.
When Emperor Jingwen saw that Concubine Song had invited him, although most of his initial interest in her had disappeared, at least there was still a little bit left, so he decided to have dinner at Concubine Song’s residence, and asked the imperial kitchen to prepare the fish and send it to Concubine Song.
Lady Song was overjoyed when she heard this.
After about an incense stick of time, the imperial carriage arrived at Xinhezhai. Upon hearing the news, the other concubines who also came to the lakeside felt mixed emotions.
The queen immediately fell silent.
The empress felt that she did not have a beauty as beautiful as the imperial concubine, and she felt that she was no longer young at the age of nearly 30. She was not as young as the young concubine Song Meiren. The empress really did not know what she could rely on to keep the emperor.
Maybe things will get better after having a child.
The queen, who was originally a little hesitant, suddenly made up her mind.
After dinner, under the confused and terrified gazes of a group of confidants around her, the queen tightly closed her eyes, tilted her head back, and drank the secretly brewed black medicine in one gulp.
the other side.
While waiting for dinner, Emperor Jingwen picked up a book and read it. Concubine Song served him. Her long hair brushed against his arm from time to time. The atmosphere around them was somewhat ambiguous and blurry.
After a pause, Emperor Jingwen used the book in his hand to lift Concubine Song’s chin: “I really can’t concentrate if you are like this.”
Although Emperor Jingwen was over forty years old, he naturally appeared mysterious and powerful because of his identity as an emperor.
In addition, he has been the crown prince for thirty years, so his etiquette and bearing are impeccable. A man who is extraordinary, heroic and strong is the most attractive to women.
When meeting Emperor Jingwen’s eyes, Concubine Song’s face turned red uncontrollably.
After a while, Concubine Song’s eyes were blurred. Just when the atmosphere was about to reach its peak, Concubine Song didn’t know why, but she thought of the Ninth Prince and herself now, so she blurted out: “Your Majesty, let me give birth to another well-behaved prince for you, okay?”
If it were before, Emperor Jingwen, who always believed in having many children, would have agreed without hesitation.
As for sons, which emperor would complain about having too many?
But now when he heard this, he immediately thought of Xiaojiu, and Emperor Jingwen calmed down almost instantly.
Having only Xiaojiu in the palace is enough. A well-behaved prince is good, but if there were another one like Xiaojiu, Emperor Jingwen would not be able to bear it.
Just like that, Emperor Jingwen suddenly lost interest.
Lady Song was a little flustered and confused. Did she say something wrong? Why did His Majesty’s expression suddenly change?
“His Majesty…..”
“Okay, let’s go to the front first. The imperial kitchen should have prepared the fish by now.”
Emperor Jingwen handed the book in his hand to the young eunuch beside him, and Wang Ziquan helped him put on his shoes. Then he walked forward without looking back.
Lady Song bit her lip and followed with tears in her eyes.
Although Emperor Jingwen was angry at his son’s indulgence in toys, he had to admit that the fish freshly caught from the lake were fresh, especially the carp which had been carefully selected and were extremely plump and delicious.
Emperor Jingwen moved his chopsticks, and his brows, which had been unconsciously furrowed, gradually relaxed.
Fresh carp is extremely delicious whether it is braised, stewed, or fried. Emperor Jingwen thought it was even more delicious because it was seized from the little bastard.
Originally, Emperor Jingwen planned to stay overnight, but after Concubine Song said that, he immediately gave up the idea.
After dinner, Emperor Jingwen left without even waiting for Concubine Song to finish eating.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know that after he left, Concubine Song immediately had the plates of fish removed from before him.
Lady Song thought that there were no outsiders here anyway, so she didn’t worry too much.
“Pour it out, pour it all out!” Because of the emperor’s silent refusal, Concubine Song was a little out of control. She felt annoyed when she saw so many fish on the table.
She didn’t dare to think about what the emperor meant. Was he saying that he didn’t intend to let her have a child?
Lady Song covered her belly with her hands, looking extremely frightened.
Because Concubine Song’s attention was not here at all, she did not notice that Eunuch Wang Ziquan came back and then left again.
After going outside for some fresh air, Emperor Jingwen thought for a while and felt that he seemed to be too harsh on Concubine Song. After all, Concubine Song knew nothing, so he thought of asking Wang Ziquan to go back and take a look and then reward her with two more things.
Lady Song had good intentions, but he really had no such plans now.
Unexpectedly, Wang Ziquan saw such a scene.
“She really had all those fish dumped out?”
Seeing Wang Ziquan nod, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know why he felt uncomfortable, and his face turned cold.
Wang Ziquan figured it out after a little thought. After all, those fish were caught by the Ninth Prince himself…
It’s not necessary to use an incense burner to offer it, but it’s not good to be so disrespectful…
Emperor Jingwen didn’t say anything, but in his heart he felt displeased with this new favorite.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath, turned around and went to the Queen’s Palace.
If there is anyone who is safe now, it must be the Queen.
Upon hearing the news, the queen was stunned at first, and then overjoyed.
I just drank the medicine, and now the emperor is here. Does this mean that all this… is actually God’s will?

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Smooth
chapters.content:
the other side.
He ran back quickly and closed the door of Xiangjingzhai. Seeing that the guards did not chase him anymore, Ye Shuo immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
“Mom! Look what I brought back!”
Hearing the noise outside, Concubine Rong slowly walked out of the room. Seeing the bucket of lively fish in her son’s hand, Concubine Rong was stunned.
Still, there really is…
“My son is really promising.” As expected of a royal concubine, in her eyes, even if Ye Shuo only caught a few fish, he was as good as someone who saved the world.
Ye Shuo has become accustomed to this.
It was getting dark, and after the fish was cleaned in the small kitchen, Ye Shuo took out the grill, lit the charcoal, put the fish on the grill, and sprinkled salt, cumin, chili powder, etc. on it. Soon the aroma wafted far away.
I have to say here that chili peppers have actually been around for a long time. It is recorded in Lüshi Chunqiu·Xiaoxinglan·Benwei: “Harmony must be sweet, sour, bitter, spicy, and salty”, and “Tongsuwen” even said: “Spicy is called spicy”. From this, we can know that the “spicy” here refers to the spicy taste.
It’s just that the variety of peppers is different. Today’s peppers are more like small rice peppers. Although they lack the fragrance, they are very spicy.After all, he often went camping in his previous life, so Ye Shuo had excellent cooking skills. Soon, the grilled fish under his hands began to sizzle with oil.
Concubine Rong didn’t like this kind of heavy-flavored food, and she couldn’t get used to eating chili peppers, but because the grilled fish smelled so delicious, she couldn’t help but put down the bowl of porridge in her hand.
Seeing his mother looking over here from time to time, Ye Shuo wanted to say something but was too embarrassed to do so, so he laughed and motioned Su Yue to bring a clean small bowl over.
After the small bowl arrived, Ye Shuo took out the belly of the roasted carp, put it in the bowl, and motioned Su Yue to give it to his mother.
The belly of a fish is the essence of the fish. It is rich in fat, tender and boneless, making it the most suitable for eating.
Upon seeing this, Concubine Rong smiled immediately, feeling that this son was not raised in vain. Although he was a little irritating on weekdays, which prince could be as considerate as her own son?
The virtuous concubines, the concubines, and the ladies are not as good as me.
Concubine Rong couldn’t help but pick up a piece of food with chopsticks and put it in her mouth. The rich salty, fresh and spicy taste immediately stimulated her eyes and turned red.
Hiss…
So spicy, so spicy, so spicy!
It was the first time for Concubine Rong to eat such spicy food, and she felt it was actually quite good. She was greedy for a moment and ended up eating a little more.
Ye Shuo thought that there were so many people in the palace, at worst he could just share the remaining ones with Su Yue and the others, so he continued to roast with confidence.
The food from all four fish ended up in Concubine Rong’s stomach alone.
But even without the fish belly, the fish body was still good. In short, everyone in Xiangjingzhai had a very happy meal tonight.
Only when Xiao Luzi came back, the news he brought back made Ye Shuo silent for a while.
I didn’t expect that my cheap dad was so naive. He really thought that taking my bucket of fish was revenge. But it’s good that he thinks so. God bless, I hope my cheap dad will never find out the truth…
The next morning, Emperor Jingwen came out from the Empress’s place and arrived at Yuqianzhai soon after. He saw that the little bastard had not come to apologize as he had promised yesterday, so he waved his hand and ordered the guards to arrest him.
Ye Shuo was almost dug out of his bed by the guards. He had eaten barbecue too late yesterday and went to bed late too. It was only the morning hour now, which could be no more than six or seven at best. Ye Shuo was so sleepy that he could not even open his eyes, and even the guards had to help him put on his clothes.
Seeing that the Ninth Prince refused to get up, and the emperor’s order was hard to disobey, the guards weighed the matter for a moment, and finally carried Ye Shuo directly to Yuqianzhai.
“Just wait, I will remember… you… zzzzz” After barely saying these harsh words, Ye Shuo couldn’t hold on any longer and closed his eyes and fell asleep.
The guards were nervous at first when they heard this, but then they thought it was the emperor’s order and the Ninth Prince was only a prince now, so they didn’t take it too seriously.
When Emperor Jingwen saw his son’s “miserable condition”, he couldn’t help but laughed, and his originally dull and depressed mood was instantly swept away.
Even the crown prince next to him suddenly felt a lot more relaxed when reviewing memorials.
Ye Shuo was too lazy to even open his eyelids, he always felt that these two people were mentally unbalanced and just couldn’t stand seeing others doing well, and would not be satisfied until they made others suffer the same way as themselves.
Ye Shuo felt that his cheap father and the prince were clearly jealous! !
Fortunately, something seemed to have happened this morning and everyone was busy, including the Grand Tutor and Lord Cen. A group of people were making a lot of noise in Yuqianzhai, like a vegetable market. Ye Shuo took this opportunity to lie on the table and catch up on his sleep.
So the following scene appeared in Yuqianzhai:
“Your Majesty, there has been a sudden torrential rain in Yuzhou. I think the river bank dam may be at risk of bursting…”
“Huff, huff, huff.”
“Your Majesty, regarding the matter of the Yangzhou governor, this old minister has something to report.”
“Whirring whirring.”
“Your Majesty…”
“Huff, huff, huff.”
Ministers: “…”
The ministers paused, and then all looked towards the source of the sound.
The veins on Emperor Jingwen’s forehead twitched uncontrollably. He had never known before that his son had the habit of snoring when he slept.
If the little bastard was not pretending, Emperor Jingwen would dare to eat the ink stone at hand.
As if he had noticed his stepfather’s gaze, Ye Shuo’s snoring became louder.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to say, “Go play in the garden first.” He really had no time to take care of him today.
“okay!”
“Thank you, Father. Thank you, Father and all the adults for your hard work. I will take my leave now.”
Ye Shuo stood up with one arm, not even showing the slightest sign of sleepiness.
He could live such a carefree life now, thanks to his stepfather, the Crown Prince, and all the adults, so Ye Shuo’s attitude was naturally very good.
For some reason, everyone felt a little uncomfortable when the Ninth Prince looked at them like this.
Seeing that the other party did not hesitate and fled for his life as if there was a dog chasing him from behind, the ministers could not help but sigh and shake their heads in their hearts.
The Ninth Prince is hopeless. This is the first time I’ve seen a prince so averse to political affairs.
What a great opportunity! It’s really a waste of resources.
After a long while, all the adults and Emperor Jingwen finally found their voices again.
Ye Shuo didn’t care what they thought, he took Xing Yucheng and went straight to the garden.
Fishing here is really boring. Ye Shuo thought about it and couldn’t help but look at the two of them: “Do you two want to swim?”
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi were stunned at first, and then shook their heads.
“Okay then, I’ll go by myself.”
After saying this, Ye Shuo began to take off his clothes.
The heat this year is particularly severe. It is already very hot in June. No wonder my cheap dad made arrangements in advance and brought a large group to the garden to escape the heat.
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi were completely stunned as they watched the Ninth Prince strip off himself until he was left with only his underwear.
After confirming once again that he was not exposed, Ye Shuo began to do warm-up exercises. Then he took a deep breath, and with a perfect entry into the water, Ye Shuo dived into the lake like a fish.
Finished!
The ninth prince fell into the water!
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi immediately panicked, and just as they were about to run and shout for help, Ye Shuo floated up.
The Ninth Prince just floated away like that!
He was seen lying flat on the water, apparently doing nothing, but showing no intention of sinking.
Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi were simply stunned.
“You two are on the shore, do whatever you want.”
Large patches of scorching sunlight sprinkled on Ye Shuo’s face and body. With his head resting on his hands, Ye Shuo could not help but close his eyes. He looked so comfortable.
Well–
This is what summer vacation is. Staying in Yuqianzhai every day is bullshit!
It took Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi a long time to pick up the chin that had fallen to the ground.
Just like that, Ye Shuo began to drift around along the flow of the lake.
When passing by the stone bridge, the commander-in-chief happened to be on patrol here. He lowered his head and glanced down inadvertently. He saw the Ninth Prince floating on the water with his eyes closed. The commander-in-chief was so scared that he almost lost his soul.
In just two breaths, the commander-in-chief even decided where to bury himself.
Until Ye Shuo opened his eyes, waved at him, and said hello: “Hello, Commander-in-Chief.”
The commander-in-chief: “…”
The commander-in-chief and the guards on the bridge saw the Ninth Prince drifting away.
When passing by the lotus pond, Ye Shuo looked at the blooming lotus and couldn’t help feeling a little disappointed.
It is not yet the season for lotus seeds to mature. It looks like we have to wait until next month.
As usual, Prince Su arrived at the best fishing spot early in the morning, put down a chair, hung bait, cast the rod… The whole set of actions seemed to have been practiced thousands of times and could not be more familiar.
It was almost noon and Prince Su hadn’t caught any fish. Just as he couldn’t help but tap his knee with his index finger, he saw a streak of white slowly drifting towards him, then drifting away along the current.
Prince Su was a little dazed for a moment.
Prince Su thought that there was nothing wrong with his eyes. If he was not mistaken, the one in the water should be his nephew…?
As Ye Shuo moved, Prince Su’s gaze also moved.
After Emperor Jingwen finally finished dealing with the matter, he summoned the guards and asked where his son was now, and this was the news he received.
To be honest, Emperor Jingwen had never seen it, and he really couldn’t imagine it.
Driven by curiosity, Emperor Jingwen brought people to the lake.
Just like that, a large group of people, including the Grand Tutor and his companions, came here to watch the Ninth Prince swimming.
To be honest, this scene is indeed quite magical.
Even though his son didn’t move, Emperor Jingwen thought he was dead.
Taking a deep breath, Emperor Jingwen winked at the guard beside him.
The guards understood, and two of them who were good at swimming came out. After taking off their outer clothes, they jumped into the water silently.
But Ye Shuo was such a perceptive person that he sensed something was wrong before the other party even got close.
Ye Shuo suddenly opened his eyes and saw that the two guards were only a dozen meters away from him. Without thinking, he immediately started to move.
Everyone saw with their own eyes that the Ninth Prince was like a duck, not giving the guards any chance to get close to him, and he swam quickly on the water to the other side of the lake.
At first the guards were able to keep up, but later on, the Ninth Prince soon left them behind.
Emperor Jingwen watched his son come ashore, make a face at him, and then suddenly dive into the bushes behind him, and the whole person disappeared without a trace.
There were only two guards left soaking in the water. It was not right to chase him, nor was it right not to chase him.
Emperor Jingwen: “…………”
Seeing the emperor’s chest rising and falling, the ministers looked away tactfully, pretending not to see it.
In this way, for a period of time in the future, Ye Shuo would make trouble whenever he got the chance when his cheap father was particularly busy. At this time, what could a parent do? He could only let the child go so that he could work with peace of mind.
Every time Ye Shuo came out of Yuqianzhai, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, but even so, he still gritted his teeth and refused to tear down the table.
Ye Shuo didn’t know what his stepfather was trying to do. Was he just trying to compete with him?
Thus, as the father and son tortured each other, Emperor Jingwen soon discovered his son’s other skills.
In addition to fishing and swimming, he also learned to climb trees. He could climb to the top of a ten-foot-tall tree in just a dozen or twenty breaths, and climbing a short willow tree was even easier for him.
What’s even more terrifying is that he even used ropes to weave a hammock on the treetops. Emperor Jingwen could often see him curled up in the hammock watching the sunset in the evening.
Sitting on top of this century-old tree, you can have a panoramic view of most of the lake.
The little grandson of the emperor who was watching eagerly below was almost crying with envy.
The Crown Prince had a bad feeling and quickly ordered his son not to follow his uncle and go to such a dangerous place.
It was useless even though the little grandson was drooling.
While Ye Shuo was looking at the scenery, he was still shouting: “Father, Third Brother, are you really not going to consider coming up?”
Go up, go up, go up, shit!
Does he think that everyone is born in the year of the monkey like him?
Emperor Jingwen flicked his sleeves and left in anger for who knows how many times.
After everyone left, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but open his arms and let the wind blow through him. He felt that nothing could be more enjoyable than this moment.
This is what freedom is, it’s fascinating.
The days passed one by one, and throughout the garden, one could often hear the roar of Emperor Jingwen, the escape of the Ninth Prince, and the reconciliation voice of the Crown Prince.
Everyone felt nervous at first, but later on, everyone became numb.
The workload of the guards around Emperor Jingwen was unprecedentedly huge. They just couldn’t understand how the Ninth Prince had so much energy that he didn’t feel tired even after climbing trees and swimming in the lake every day.
As a result of Ye Shuo’s behavior, Emperor Jingwen also had to exercise a lot more. He also had to be prepared for “surprises” from time to time, so his heart became stronger than before.
The days passed one by one like this. After about a month, the queen found that she had not ‘changed her clothes’ for a month. She was so excited that she hurriedly summoned the imperial physician she trusted.
While the imperial physician was taking her pulse, the queen didn’t even dare to breathe.
About an incense stick of time passed, and finally, under the urgent gaze of the Queen, the imperial physician’s brows relaxed and he kowtowed.
“Congratulations, Madam. Congratulations, Madam.”
After realizing what the other party meant, the queen almost cried for joy.
Finally, I have waited for this day.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Birthday
chapters.content:
“Okay, okay, come here, give me the imperial physician reward!” The queen rarely showed such joy, and it was obvious that she was extremely happy this time.
Soon, the imperial physician received a big red envelope.
Upon seeing this, the imperial physician immediately began to struggle over whether to tell or not to tell the truth. After all, although the queen seemed to have successfully conceived, she had taken medicine after all, and the situation was not as optimistic as it seemed.
But in fact, the queens knew what was going on. They had already made preparations when they drank the medicine.
The queen was happy to pay a price in exchange for a child.
Therefore, the queen said bluntly: “No matter what, we must save this child and ensure that he is born full-term.”
“This…” The imperial physician hesitated for a moment, and then met the queen’s sharp eyebrows. His heart trembled, so he subconsciously said: “I will do my best to protect the queen and the little prince!”
Although this baby might not be a boy, the queen clearly wanted a boy, so the imperial physician could only say this.
After the words were spoken, the queen was delighted and let the imperial physician leave.
After the imperial physician left, it took a long time before he gradually came back to his senses from the afterglow of excitement, with joy in the corners of his eyes and eyebrows.Carefully touching her belly which was not yet pregnant, the queen let out a long sigh.
“The future of your mother depends entirely on you.”
After all, my son is the one who crawled out of my belly, so I should favor him.
The emperor would not allow her to have children, so adoption was out of the question. Although the prince was respectful to her, he had a biological mother after all, and his biological mother was the Empress Yuan, so it was impossible for him to really regard her as his mother.
All of the above would be fine, but what the queen could not accept the most was how Concubine Rong could bypass her and give birth to a child smoothly.
It would be fine if His Majesty really treated the two of them as disposable toys, but the Empress could still tolerate Concubine Rong’s repeated acts of disobedience that embarrassed her. After all, who would care about such a mere toy?
But now that the emperor is obviously concerned, the queen has suddenly become a joke, like the last straw that broke the camel’s back. No wonder the queen is mentally unbalanced and takes risky actions.
But in fact, this matter really had little to do with Emperor Jingwen. Emperor Jingwen really did not break the contract on purpose. Before Concubine Rong became pregnant, Emperor Jingwen had already taken precautions. He had tried to have sex after she became pregnant, and even sent someone to feed pills to the child after he was born. It’s just that all these failed.
Of course, the Imperial Concubine cannot be blamed. After all, the reason why the Queen is the Queen is that the mission she received when she was canonized was to compete with Imperial Concubine Rong and prevent Imperial Concubine Rong from dominating alone. Not only the Queen, but also the maternal family behind the Queen, were the mainstays in the fight against the Duke of Zhen for a period of time.
How could the imperial concubine not be annoyed when she was faced with someone who was constantly causing trouble for her, not only herself but also bringing her father to cause trouble for her father?
Although the imperial concubine has a bad temper, she doesn’t get angry at everyone.
As for Ye Shuo, you can’t say that he was wrong for refusing to take the pills obediently. He has people he wants to protect, and he also wants to live a good life!
So everything is just a coincidence.
Although the queen had prepared herself mentally in advance, she had never experienced the pain of pregnancy herself. In addition, the child’s arrival was caused by the use of medicine, so the queen’s reaction was particularly strong in just over a month.
The queen was only able to endure it because of the anger in her heart.
Every day she comforted herself, thinking that everything would be fine once the baby was born.
The Queen counted the days and found that the Emperor’s birthday, which was the Tianchang Festival, was approaching. After careful consideration, the Queen decided to announce the news of her pregnancy on the day of the Tianchang Festival.
After all, that day was the emperor’s birthday. Even if the emperor was angry, he would not be angry for too long.
All monarchs hope to have many sons and be blessed with many children. Moreover, the father and son are connected by heart. How can the emperor not acknowledge this son when the time comes?
If the empress knew what Emperor Jingwen had done, she probably wouldn’t be so confident. If necessary, the emperor would really take action against his own son.
Unfortunately, the queen didn’t know.
On the other hand, Ye Shuo was also worrying about what he should give his cheap father for his birthday. It was okay in the past, because he was still young and could just give him something random.
But this year… Ye Shuo had a feeling that he couldn’t fool people anymore.
You can’t just recite two articles to your cheap dad on the spot, can you?
…wait, this method does seem to work, after all, when giving a gift, it has to touch the heart of the person.
What is the biggest headache for my cheap dad recently? Isn’t it his study problem?
Seeing that his stepfather’s birthday was approaching, Ye Shuo thought about it and decided to be less angry with him and be more restrained during this special period. At worst, he could wait until after his stepfather’s birthday and then resume his behavior.
Just like that, two days before Emperor Jingwen’s birthday, he always felt that something was wrong around him.
I feel like things are too quiet around me lately.
Emperor Jingwen belatedly looked at Xiaojiu who was trapped by the Grand Tutor and the others. Normally, Xiaojiu would have been making a fuss at this time, and his teachers would have been changed several times, but today the Grand Tutor and Lord Cen were not angry, nor did they scold him loudly.
This should have been a very good phenomenon, but for some reason, Emperor Jingwen felt uncomfortable.
His son was so quiet that Emperor Jingwen wondered if he was sick.
He picked up and put down the brush in his hand several times. Finally, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but asked, “Shuo’er, are you feeling unwell?”
The prince next to him finally discovered what was missing today.
Ye Shuo was stunned at first, and then became speechless.
It’s over, my cheap dad has turned into a masochist.
At first, Emperor Jingwen was on guard, wondering what idea he had come up with and whether he was gathering strength. However, when he heard that this was his birthday gift to him, Emperor Jingwen was stunned at first, and then he was inexplicably moved.
Being able to quiet down a son who climbs up and down like a monkey proves that he still has his father in his heart.
It’s like asking a person to give up his or her favorite thing. Doesn’t this prove the other person’s sincerity?
Ye Shuo thought, it was only two days away, so he took out the gift he had prepared in advance.
“What is this?” Emperor Jingwen was stunned when he saw the wooden plaques in the box. He picked up one and saw the words “voucher” written on it.
There are coupons for article purchases, coupons for being obedient, coupons for shoulder and leg massages, etc. There are so many of them, totaling about ten coupons.
“What is this??”
Seeing that his cheap father was puzzled, Ye Shuo immediately explained the purpose of these wooden signs.
Coupons are definitely things that can be used for redemption, like an article voucher, which can be used to redeem one article, while an obedient voucher can make Ye Shuo behave himself for a whole day.
Emperor Jingwen turned over the back of the wooden sign and found that the date and number of times were indeed written on it, making it look like the real thing.
Emperor Jingwen had no idea what was going on in that little head of his, but to be honest, it was quite interesting.
It was not until Emperor Jingwen looked through them all that he realized there were only two coupons for writing good articles and three coupons for being obedient, and the rest were all shoulder-kneading and leg-beating, that his face immediately turned dark.
He has so many eunuchs and servants, do they really need him to massage their shoulders and legs?
“Dad, what you said is wrong.” Ye Shuo immediately became unhappy when he heard this.
“How can palace maids and eunuchs be compared to your son?” He is my biological son, and they are not.
Emperor Jingwen sneered: “I think the palace servants are much more useful than you.” Only the palace servants know how to serve people. How could he, a prince, understand this?
Although Emperor Jingwen said this, he still couldn’t control his curiosity and threw a voucher out to see what the effect would be.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo immediately rubbed his hands together, then walked behind his cheap father and put his two paws on his cheap father’s shoulders.
Emperor Jingwen felt awkward at first. After all, as an emperor, he had never been close to others. But as the little bastard moved, Emperor Jingwen found that it was actually quite comfortable.
Although the little bastard is young, he is very strong. Both the strength and the location of the massage are just right.
Emperor Jingwen was finally satisfied this time.
“It’s amazing that you have specially learned this.” Although he benefited greatly from it, Emperor Jingwen only said this indifferently on his face.
After he finished speaking, Ye Shuo paused.
But what his cheap dad didn’t know was that this was not something he learned specifically. In his previous life, he often waited for his father to come home from get off work and massaged his father’s shoulders. He had accumulated so many years of experience that he became so skilled at it.
The next moment, Ye Shuo returned to normal.
“As long as Father likes it.”
Emperor Jingwen was indeed quite happy. After Ye Shuo and others left, he did not ask anyone to take the box away. Instead, he placed it directly on his desk, ready to use these wooden signs to deal with the little bastard when he got angry again.
After a while, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help laughing.
“Xiaojiu is a child with a lot of clever ideas.”
Noticing the smile in the emperor’s eyes, Wang Ziquan beside him naturally obeyed him and thought to himself that this Ninth Prince was truly extraordinary.
Two days passed in a blink of an eye, and finally it was the Tianchang Festival.
Ye Shuo soon discovered that his brothers were truly richer than each other. Even the eldest prince who lived far away at the border had sent someone to send birthday gifts back in advance, just in time for his step-father’s birthday, not to mention the second and third princes.
Even for the Fifth Prince, who had not yet started court, the gifts he sent were extremely precious because he had the support of Concubine Shu.
Ye Shuo was dazzled by all kinds of rare treasures. Antique calligraphy and paintings, authentic works of celebrities were just trivial things. The eldest prince even gave him a treasure tree. The treasure tree was shaped like a pine tree and was inlaid with gems, symbolizing longevity.
Even the unknowledgeable Ye Shuo was stunned.
Emperor Jingwen himself was not in a good mood. After all, he was the emperor, rich in the world, and had seen all kinds of good things.
However, seeing how hard his eldest son was working at the border, Emperor Jingwen still gave him a few more words of encouragement.
I really want to dig out a gem…
Watching a group of eunuchs carrying the precious tree as they passed by, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a little eager.
But unfortunately, this precious tree was made with extremely good workmanship, and even though it was shaking like that, nothing fell off.
“Well……”
Ye Shuo withdrew his gaze with regret, but when he turned his head, he met the Sixth Prince’s extremely embarrassed and awkward face.
Ye Shuo understood after a little thought.
Now the Sixth Prince was just an oligarch prince, he ate and slept with him and his mother, so naturally he didn’t have any extra money to buy any birthday gifts, so the gifts he sent inevitably looked shabby among everyone else.
What the Sixth Prince gave was a picture of Guanyin that he had painted himself.
Now the fifth prince was laughing at him madly.
“Sixth brother, you are frugal.” Although he was frugal, in the palace where people had to speak in a roundabout way, the fifth prince almost pointed at him and said he was poor.
Ye Shuo was immediately displeased: “That’s wrong. Gifts should be to the liking of the emperor father.”
Seeing him like a cat whose tail was stepped on, the Fifth Prince wanted to mock him at first. He and the Sixth Prince were not real brothers. The Sixth Prince was just picked up by Concubine Rong. It was hard for him to protect him so much.
Until the attendant next to him secretly leaned over to the Fifth Prince’s ear and whispered something.
The fifth prince was startled at first, then he burst into laughter: “I wonder what’s going on.”
It turns out that he wasn’t protecting Old Six.
“You are not as good as him.”
Soon, even the Seventh and Eighth Princes knew about their father’s birthday and the fact that the Ninth Brother only sent a few wooden lumps.
When the Sixth Prince heard the news, he was shocked.
Vouchers…how did he give them away?
When his father gives an order, he has to do whatever he is told to do. Why does he need something like a voucher?
Xiaojiu’s gift was probably equivalent to giving nothing. The Sixth Prince, who had been busy for a month because of the Guanyin painting, could not help but remain silent.
Ye Shuo narrowed his eyes and looked at the group of people in front of him, but what he thought in his heart was, they know nothing!
Sure enough, after noticing the movement here, Emperor Jingwen first frowned, and then said lightly: “Old Fifth, you will enter the court next year, you should learn more from your second brother and be more solemn.”
The wooden sign was quite ingenious, and Emperor Jingwen liked it very much. The Fifth Prince looked down on it, didn’t it mean that he had no taste? Could Emperor Jingwen be happy?
This time it was Ye Shuo’s turn to laugh.
The Fifth Prince’s laughter stopped abruptly, and he looked at Ye Shuo with eyes that were almost spitting fire.
They tried their best but couldn’t get a single word of praise from the emperor, but Xiao Jiu only made the emperor praise him with a few pieces of rotten wood. How could the fifth prince not be angry? I heard that he just picked it up in the garden, and it’s not a precious wood. Is it that serious?
The more they thought about it, the more unbalanced they felt. Several people immediately became jealous and had long forgotten about the Sixth Prince.
The prince felt that Xiaojiu’s ability to bring trouble was becoming stronger and stronger.
Facing the envious, jealous and hateful looks of the Fifth Prince and the others, Ye Shuo’s expression became more and more annoying.
Just when the scolded Fifth Prince was about to step forward and punch him twice, a voice suddenly came from outside –
“The Queen is here!”
“Greetings to Her Majesty the Queen.” Everyone knelt on the ground.
“No need to be polite, everyone. Please stand up.”
In the past, the Queen Mother always came early. What happened today? Why did she come so late?
He was soon allowed to stand up. Just when Ye Shuo was confused, he looked up and saw the face of the Queen.
Although the queen’s face was covered with makeup, her haggardness could not be concealed.
Just when Ye Shuo was wondering if the other party was sick, the queen did not ask him to wait any longer and quickly gave an answer.
It turned out that she was not sick, but pregnant.
After hearing the news, Ye Shuo watched helplessly as his stepfather’s face changed from bright and sunny at the beginning to dark in an instant.
“Queen, you——”
Emperor Jingwen was stunned at first, then furious. Just as he was about to say something, the sound of a woman retching suddenly came from the bottom of the banquet table again.
This time it’s Lady Song.
Concubine Song had been successful the last time she had sex with the emperor three months ago, but she was afraid that someone would harm her, so she kept it a secret for three months and didn’t dare to say a word. When she said that a month and a half ago, she actually did want to test the emperor, but seeing how repulsive Emperor Jingwen was, and Concubine Song had no experience, she panicked and dragged it on until now.
But now, the sweet-scented osmanthus duck at the banquet might have been not handled well by the imperial chef, so it had a strong fishy smell. Concubine Song had a strong reaction and she couldn’t help it. She accidentally retched in front of everyone.
It would have been fine if she didn’t vomit, but her vomiting actually made Concubine Rong feel a little nauseous.
“This Song family is really something, so ungentlemanly, they don’t even know how to avoid people.”
Concubine Rong quickly took a handkerchief to cover herself. She felt a sour feeling rising in her throat and felt that she was about to collapse.
“Quick, quick, quick, Aunt Jing, go get me a clean bowl!”
Ye Shuo looked at this, then looked at his unaware mother, and suddenly thought of something. He was so surprised that his chopsticks fell to the ground with a “click”.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Happy
chapters.content:
No, it’s not what he thinks…
Ye Shuo recalled it bit by bit and carefully. Ye Shuo had an excellent memory and quickly found the details that he had not noticed.
For example, recently his mother has been sleeping longer than usual and is more sleepy. She used to get up at the hour of Mao, but recently she has been getting up at the hour of Chen, which is about half an hour later.
The change in one hour is not big, so Ye Shuo didn’t pay much attention to it before. People feel sleepy in spring, tired in autumn, and take naps in summer. It is normal for people to be a little lazy in the hot summer weather.
His mother’s lunch break time in the afternoon also increased relatively. These are extremely small changes, and no one would pay special attention to them. Only when you look back on them can you feel them.
And his mother’s appetite has also increased recently. On weekdays, she eats a standard bowl of rice, but recently, it has increased slightly from time to time. When they ate grilled fish more than a month ago, his mother even ate four pieces of fish while eating.
What’s more, the place where his cheap father stayed most of the time in the past two years was his mother’s. Out of the ten times he came to the harem, six times he was with his mother, so the probability of him becoming a father is actually quite high.
Why didn’t I think of this before!
The more he thought about it, the more anxious he felt. Ye Shuo was completely dumbfounded.
Looking at the imperial concubine next to her, she was still unaware. After all, she had injured her body a little at the beginning. Ever since giving birth to Ye Shuo, the imperial concubine’s menstruation had been irregular. So even though she had not changed her clothes for the past two months, she did not think about anything else.Ye Shuo was already seven years old, and the imperial concubine had no pregnancy for seven consecutive years, so even she subconsciously believed that Shuo’er was her only son in this life.
After Ye Shuo was born safely, Emperor Jingwen never used medicine on the imperial concubine again. After all, the imperial concubine had already given birth to a son. Based on the principle that too many lice will not itch, and too many debts will not worry, Emperor Jingwen no longer cared about her.
There are only advantages and no disadvantages for the imperial concubine to have more children. If there are too many sons, no matter which one the Duke of Zhen supports, the others will be dissatisfied. If the imperial concubine gives birth to too many sons, it will only deepen their internal conflicts. At the very least, it can divide them and dilute the power in the hands of the Duke of Zhen, so that the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion is no longer a monolithic entity, so it is a good thing.
None of the three of them thought about it in this regard, which led to the current situation.
When Ye Shuo first heard that the queen was pregnant, he was shocked. Why would the queen choose to get pregnant at this time?
Ye Shuo didn’t believe that it was his cheap father’s idea. His cheap father didn’t seem like such a kind person. He wouldn’t suddenly become soft-hearted after persisting for so many years.
In order to prevent the legitimate sons from fighting with each other, the stepfather must have issued a death order, so this matter can only be decided by the Queen herself.
The Queen Mother usually looks cautious and rational, and my stepfather probably didn’t expect that the Queen would suddenly do such a thing to him, so that he was not prepared enough and got caught in the trap.
Ye Shuo could understand the Queen’s desire to be a mother, but! The timing was wrong!
It would be fine if the Queen gave birth to a princess, but if it was a prince, then it would be really all over.
The crown prince is now in his twenties, his position is secure, and the little grandson has been born. The queen’s child is more than twenty years younger than the crown prince. By the time the queen’s child grows up, it will be too late. Except for the queen’s maternal family, which other minister would be so desperate as to abandon the crown prince and turn around to follow a young boy with unknown prospects?
Unless my cheap dad lives an extremely, extremely long life, there is absolutely no hope for this.
Moreover, this child’s situation is different from his original one. No matter how favored his mother is, she is only a concubine after all. No matter how prominent his grandfather’s family is, it is useless and there is no way to make him a legitimate son.
But the child in the Queen’s belly is a definite legitimate son. When the Crown Prince succeeds to the throne in the future, the other brothers will not matter, but this legitimate son must be killed. Even if the Crown Prince has a gentle personality, he will be forced by the situation and have no choice. Otherwise, if he is kept, he will become a source of trouble.
Even if the crown prince is extremely unlucky and ultimately misses out on the throne, no matter which other prince ascends the throne, he cannot be left behind!
If you kill the son, how can you spare the mother? No one can sleep peacefully with a time bomb around.
Unless the Queen can finally create a bright future for her son, she won’t even be able to keep her position as the Queen Mother.
However, let alone the Crown Prince or other princes, even Ye Shuo would not allow such a thing to happen.
It doesn’t matter which other prince comes to the throne, except the queen’s son!
The relationship between the Empress and his mother was extremely antagonistic. It could be said that they were as hostile as fire and water. In fact, the reason why the Empress was the Empress was because her stepfather had asked her to compete with his mother. After years of resentment, Ye Shuo could imagine how the Empress’s son would treat them after he ascended the throne.
So no matter what, Ye Shuo will never let that day come to pass, even if it means his hands are stained with blood, Ye Shuo will not hesitate.
However, Ye Shuo felt that it was not his turn to take action.
Now that the other princes have begun to show their prowess, each of them is as cunning as honeycomb coal, so how can they accommodate newcomers?
If it had happened a few years earlier, when the Seventh and Eighth Princes had not yet entered the Upper Study and started studying, the Empress could have barely caught up with the last train of the competition. But now, the Seventh and Eighth Princes have begun to show their extraordinary abilities in studying, and it is too late for the Empress to interfere.
Unless he is truly the chosen one, able to overpower his eight elder brothers on his own, or his adoptive father has been cursed, and his IQ has suddenly dropped to zero, otherwise Ye Shuo even dares to directly assert that after him, no one else will be able to achieve anything.
Given the age gap and the fact that there are only so many ministers in the court, there simply aren’t enough to go around.
When the later one reaches the age to attend court, the ministers in the court have all lined up. His wolf-like brothers will probably not leave any meat dregs for this so-called legitimate son. How can he want to take the throne without any support? By then, even if his stepfather directly passes the throne, his brothers will be able to overturn the throne from under his buttocks.
He can turn the tide and win even when facing eight opponents at the same time. What kind of strong man must he be!
Ye Shuo thought he couldn’t do it, so he just stayed away from it from the beginning.
Taking all factors into consideration, even if the Queen gave birth to a son as she wished, the possibility of this legitimate son succeeding to the throne is no less than winning the lottery jackpot.
What’s more, this unexpected child will inevitably cause his stepfather to hate him, because the prince is now in his twenties, and his stepfather doesn’t have to do everything by himself like he did in the past and protect the prince like a baby. So he won’t do anything to the queen, but because the queen acted on her own, the result will probably not be good.
According to Ye Shuo’s observation, his stepfather did not have much affection for the Queen herself, and it would be almost harder than ascending to heaven for the Queen to make a comeback later.
So Ye Shuo couldn’t figure out why the other party did this. This… there are people who think that the peaceful life is too comfortable and want to make things more difficult for themselves? ?
As for his mother, Ye Shuo had a hunch that his mother was most likely the one who got it right.
Fortunately, his mother was in her prime when she was pregnant with him or this child. She was a little over 20 years old when she gave birth to him. Although it was not the best childbearing age, she was young and strong, with strong recovery ability. She was not like a young girl whose body had not fully grown yet, so it was not bad. Now his mother is pregnant with a second child at the age of less than 28, which is also within the safety line.
As long as you are careful, there is a high probability that the production will be successful.
Even though he thought so, Ye Shuo still felt a little uneasy.
Regardless of the era, a woman would have to go through the gates of hell when giving birth, even if she had given birth once before. However, Ye Shuo simply could not afford the consequences of losing his mother.
What’s more, it would be a good thing if his mother gave birth to a prince. Ye Shuo dared to guarantee that as long as he showed a hostile attitude towards the child, it would play into the hands of his cheap father, and the crisis would be resolved.
If it was a princess… that would be really fatal.
If the princess said so, Ye Shuo would have no choice but to get involved in this mess.
As for Concubine Song, she was totally out of Ye Shuo’s consideration. Whether she gave birth to a prince or a princess would have no impact on the current situation, so it was better not to mention it.
There is just one thing. Concubine Song revealed the news of her pregnancy today, which has slightly overshadowed the Empress. Under this circumstance, Ye Shuo always feels that the other party’s situation is not optimistic.
However, the Queen is the Queen after all, and her main opponents are not minor concubines like Concubine Song, so she probably would not bother to take action personally.
As long as Lady Song is more alert and careful, there is a good chance that she will give birth to a child smoothly.
While Ye Shuo was thinking, the sour feeling in Concubine Rong’s throat suddenly and miraculously disappeared. As for the mouth bowl, it was naturally forgotten. In addition, everyone’s attention was on the Queen and Concubine Song at the moment, so no one cared about this episode. They just thought that the Concubine was disgusted by Concubine Song.
Influenced by the Duke of Zhen and her brothers, Concubine Rong also liked to have a few drinks in her spare time. In addition, the alcohol content of alcohol in ancient times was low, so she just regarded it as a beverage.
But this time, Ye Shuo didn’t dare to ask his mother to drink in.
No matter how low the alcohol content of the wine is, it still contains alcohol. If your guess comes true, you’re done for.
Seeing that his mother was unaware and was about to put the apricot wine into her mouth, Ye Shuo quickly said, “Mother, Shuo’er wants to drink too.”
Concubine Rong frowned upon hearing this: “Children cannot drink alcohol.”
“But mother can taste it, but Shuo’er can’t. Shuo’er also wants to know what apricot wine tastes like…”
After hearing what he said, the imperial concubine also felt sorry for her son. She could drink, but he couldn’t. It was a bit too pitiful.
But children really cannot drink alcohol, and the imperial concubine did not dare to feed him, for fear of harming her son.
It would be too cruel for her to drink alone under such circumstances.
After struggling for a long time, the imperial concubine finally put down the cup and said, “In this case, is it okay for mother to accompany Shuo’er?”
“Yeah!” This was what Ye Shuo was waiting for, so he nodded vigorously, and at the same time he breathed a sigh of relief.
Ye Shuo didn’t want to be so tactful, but Concubine Song alone was enough to make the Empress hate him, and Ye Shuo didn’t want to implicate his mother as well.
So let’s wait until the banquet is over and then go back to talk about it.
Looking over there, she saw that everyone was looking at her. Concubine Song subconsciously covered her belly with her hands, her eyes full of fear. Seeing Concubine Song’s reaction, how could the Queen not understand what was going on?
The Queen had wanted to tell this matter to the Emperor on his birthday, as it was a special day and perhaps the Emperor would calm down. But now, she has been overshadowed by a little beauty. How could the Queen not be annoyed?
The Queen could barely keep her expression.
While waiting for the imperial physician to diagnose his pulse, Ye Shuo glanced at his stepfather’s face, but what he was thinking in his heart was that this birthday was quite special.
Good news came from the sky, triple good news came at the same time, my stepfather took good care of himself and is in good health.
In the royal family that believes in having many children, the more blessings one has, the stepfather should be extremely happy…
Alas!

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Pregnancy
chapters.content:
If it were before, Emperor Jingwen would definitely be happy. Which emperor would dislike having too many children?
But he really doesn’t have the energy now.
Ever since he had Xiaojiu, he had an inexplicable feeling of being exhausted. If there were a few more people like Xiaojiu, Emperor Jingwen didn’t even dare to think about it.
As a result, just when he was gradually losing interest in having children, the concubines around him became pregnant, especially the queen.
This matter has nothing to do with the crown prince. It’s mainly because the queen acted on her own. What a monarch hates most is someone being clever and going against his will.
The Queen’s action was a blatant challenge to Emperor Jingwen’s authority.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but glance at the person beside him. Although he had a smile on his face, the chill in his expression was suffocating.
For a moment the queen thought she was going to die.
The queen was horrified. She just wanted a child, that was all. Why was the emperor so angry?
The queen’s heart was pounding.“Emperor……”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even look at her.
Just at this moment, the imperial physician’s diagnosis finally finished.
“Congratulations, Your Majesty, Congratulations, Concubine Song is pregnant and is now almost four months pregnant.”
Four months… That is to say, Concubine Song was already pregnant before she came to the palace, and it has been a long time. Counting the days, it should be the first time the emperor favored her.
Lady Song is young and beautiful, and now that she has a child, I’m sure she will rise to fame.
Even Concubine Shu couldn’t help but say something sarcastic after hearing this: “Sister is really good at hiding things, and it’s amazing that she can keep her composure.”
The implication is that you are so cautious, but I don’t know who you are guarding against.
“Maybe she is on guard against us.” Concubine Song’s appearance is only slightly inferior to that of the Imperial Concubine, but she is younger. If she gives birth to a prince, there will inevitably be another rival in the future. Even Concubine De spoke up at this moment.
Where had Concubine Song ever seen such a scene? Now the ones who spoke were all bigwigs in the palace, and two of the three concubines seemed to be somewhat dissatisfied, which made Concubine Song inevitably panic.
If it were before, Emperor Jingwen would probably have felt pity, but now he really wasn’t in the mood to do so.
No matter who encounters this kind of thing on their birthday, they probably won’t be happy.
Seeing that His Majesty knew that Concubine Song was pregnant but had no intention of promoting her to a higher position, I thought that His Majesty was quite fond of this newly promoted beauty and even brought her to the garden. But now it seems that this is not the case.
Concubine Shu and the others were startled, and gradually stopped talking.
Concubine Song looked at Emperor Jingwen with tears in her eyes, hoping that he would make the decision for her. However, she waited for a long time without any further news. She then remembered that she had said before that she wanted to give birth to a prince for the emperor, and the emperor suddenly became cold. Concubine Song turned pale.
After all, Concubine Song was pregnant with his own child, and Emperor Jingwen did not implicate her in his dissatisfaction with the empress.
After taking a deep breath, Emperor Jingwen waved his hand and said, “Reward!”
Just like that, rewards like water were sent to Concubine Song’s residence. As for the promotion, she had just been promoted two months ago, so let’s talk about it after the child was born.
Emperor Jingwen only rewarded Concubine Song but did not mention the Empress at all. Now almost everyone noticed the subtlety between the Emperor and the Empress.
The Tianchang Festival, which was supposed to be a good one, ended up with everyone leaving with a lot on their mind.
After all, the fact that the Empress was pregnant was no less than a bolt from the blue for the other concubines who had sons.
It can be said that during this meal, Concubine Rong was the only one who did not notice the undercurrents in it. She actually enjoyed the meal very much.
However, when he returned to Xiangjingzhai, the first thing Ye Shuo did was to ask Nanny Jing to call the imperial physician.
“What do you want to ask the imperial physician for?” Imperial Concubine Rong was startled, thinking that he was not feeling well. However, after hearing her son’s explanation, Imperial Concubine Rong couldn’t help but feel amused.
“It’s not that easy to get pregnant again.” Concubine Rong still remembered that when she was pregnant with him, she felt extremely uncomfortable from the beginning. Now, it can be said that she has no reaction at all, so it is impossible.
Even an old maid like Madam Jing didn’t think it was possible, after all, there really were no symptoms at all.
Concubine Rong continued: “At that time, mother was just provoked by Concubine Song.”
However, Ye Shuo refused to give in and would not give up until the imperial physician arrived.
Concubine Rong couldn’t persuade him, so she had to go along with him.
When the imperial physician came, the imperial concubine casually stretched out her wrist, just as if she was asking for her pulse, and didn’t take it seriously.
After a long while, the imperial physician said hesitantly, “This… seems to be a slippery pulse.”
The pulse is round and smooth like a bead, which is called a slippery pulse. If it is accompanied by symptoms such as amenorrhea and vomiting, it is most likely that you are pregnant.
I have seen vomiting before, but the other things… Ye Shuo suddenly looked like his mother.
At this time, Concubine Rong was also stunned. Obviously, having had this experience once before, she knew what slippery pulse meant.
The imperial physician then continued, “Although your Majesty’s pulse is not very obvious, based on my humble experience… you are most likely pregnant, but it is still early in the pregnancy, so I was not able to diagnose it when I checked your pulse earlier.”
The imperial concubine couldn’t help but be stunned.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and asked hurriedly, “Do you know whether it’s a boy or a girl?”
The Ninth Prince was surprisingly concerned about whether the Imperial Concubine was giving birth to a prince or a princess. However, the Imperial Physician thought about it and felt that it was understandable. After all, the Ninth Prince had been held in the palm of the Imperial Concubine’s hand since he was born. If he was a prince, he would definitely take away half of the Ninth Prince’s love, so the Ninth Prince would inevitably be anxious.
Not to mention the imperial physician, even Concubine Rong misunderstood.
Seeing her son so excited, Concubine Rong quickly came back to her senses and said more seriously than ever before: “Shuo’er, no matter whether you are a boy or a girl, your mother will treat you the same as before.”
Concubine Rong is not the kind of person who goes back on her word. She will definitely do what she said.
Ye Shuo: “…”
He is already in his thirties, would he still compete for favor with an embryo that has not yet formed? ?
…Well, there is a little bit. After all, his mother only had him in her previous life, and suddenly he has a younger brother and sister in this life. Ye Shuo is indeed a little jealous.
But this kind of thing can be overcome.
It’s all because this is a backward ancient time, where contraceptive measures were not as advanced as modern ones, and I guess even if there were cheap things like sheep intestines and fish follicles, they wouldn’t be used.
It’s all because of the cheap dad who keeps sowing seeds. He still won’t stop even in his old age. If he had been more obedient, wouldn’t this have not happened? !
But think about it, expecting a feudal emperor to awaken himself is as difficult as the sun rising from the west. It is useless to talk about impossible things.
Ye Shuo just felt sorry for his mother. His mother was obviously the one who endured it passively. Even his mother had no choice but to turn around and comfort him.
But it’s all nonsense now. The most important thing is to determine the gender of the baby as soon as possible so that Ye Shuo can make preparations early.
However, even the imperial physician cannot guarantee such a thing now.
Firstly, whether it is taking the pulse to determine the gender of a baby or looking at the face to determine the gender of a baby, it is actually not very accurate and can only be judged based on experience. Secondly, the pregnancy is still young, and if he really wants to have an answer, he has to wait until the third month. It is most accurate to determine the gender of the baby when the baby is three months old.
And now, Concubine Rong has only been pregnant for two months.
This means that if Ye Shuo wants to know the answer, he will have to wait at least another month.
Things are different now, Ye Shuo is not an impatient person, but now he can’t sit still.
Concubine Rong suddenly found out that she was pregnant, but she didn’t feel anything. In fact, she felt that it didn’t matter whether it was a boy or a girl. Concubine Rong had her mother’s family to rely on, so no matter what she gave birth to, it would not shake her position. It didn’t even matter whether she had a child or not, so she was considered the purest person in the palace.
But seeing her son’s restless look, Concubine Rong suddenly hoped that this baby would be a daughter.
If it was a daughter, perhaps Shuo’er wouldn’t be so anxious.
Concubine Rong thought in accordance with the ancient people’s idea of ​​favoring boys over girls, but the reality was just the opposite.
When Ye Shuo heard this, he was immediately shocked: “No, I want my brother!”
“Why?” But if it was his younger brother, wouldn’t that take away his love?
Concubine Rong really had no idea what was going on in her son’s little head.
“Is my sister not good enough?” As a woman, Concubine Rong was quite dissatisfied when she saw this.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smile bitterly in his heart.
If it was my younger brother, he is a prince after all, and the age gap is too big. By the time he consciously wants to fight for that position, everything will probably have been settled.
After all, there are only a few people like the Sixth Prince who are self-taught.
Because of his status as a prince, his brother’s life couldn’t be any worse.
But it’s different for my younger sister. It was fine when my stepfather was around. With his and his mother’s love, her future should not be bad.
But he was afraid that something unexpected would happen along the way. Ye Shuo was not the kind of person who would rely on luck. He felt that he could rest easy now that his cheap father was in good health, could still have three shots, and looked like he would have no problem living to be seventy or eighty years old.
Who knows when an accident might happen.
But in today’s world, a princess can never endure such twists and turns.
If she really was a princess, Ye Shuo would not feel at ease even if his adoptive father was alive and well. Even if his adoptive father was alive, Ye Shuo would have to be on guard against him giving his sister to anyone at any time.
The more noble the princess’s status, the more careful she should be. If she attracts attention, she will naturally be noticed by others.
In this world, women are nothing more than chess pieces and tools in the eyes of men. They are held in their laps when they like them and thrown aside when they don’t. The so-called love between father and daughter cannot compare to the family, country and court.
If this is the case with the biological father, what will happen if the brother who is one generation older succeeds to the throne? There is no need to think too much about this question, the answer is already there.
Ye Shuo was confident that he could protect himself, and even his mother and grandfather’s family, but he could not protect his unexpected sister.
If she wants to live a worry-free life, relying on the love of her stepfather is not enough. If the situation really comes to a head, even if she acts like a spoiled child and foolishly, she won’t be able to change the decision of her stepfather or brothers.
Ye Shuo has always been smart, so he naturally has this understanding in his mind and knows where the limits of this pampering are.
If it was just a trivial matter, it would be fine, but if it was a real matter, it would be far from enough.
The only thing that can protect a princess from harm at all times is tremendous power, which is enough to shake or even change the emperor’s decision.
However, even Ye Shuo would find it difficult to do this. It would require a lot of effort and careful planning.
Since he was born, he had planned to live a happy life and didn’t want to get involved in so many things, so after thinking carefully, he decided it would be better to have a younger brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Studying Medicine
chapters.content:
the other side.
After the banquet, Emperor Jingwen returned to his bedroom, still thinking about what to do about the Queen.
It was exactly as Ye Shuo thought. Even Emperor Jingwen would not kill his own children unless it was absolutely necessary, even if it was not part of his plan.
