However, due to the Queen’s self-willed decision, if Emperor Jingwen was asked to just endure it, he would be very angry.
Therefore, before the child was born, Emperor Jingwen was already somewhat unhappy.
Just as Emperor Jingwen’s expression was becoming increasingly gloomy, a figure suddenly flashed in.
Not surprised by such scenes, Wang Ziquan beside him was quietly doing his own thing.
Soon, the visitor brought a shocking news——
Concubine Rong was just diagnosed with pregnancy!
Why do all of them come at this time?Wang Ziquan’s heart skipped a beat, and he subconsciously looked at the emperor’s expression.
As expected, upon learning of this, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and felt a severe headache.
The harem was a place without secrets, and Concubine Rong did not try to cover it up, so the news of her pregnancy spread quickly.
In just half a day, the teacups and teacups in the Queen’s residence had been replaced almost two or three times.
The Empress had suffered all kinds of discomfort and torture during pregnancy, coupled with the Emperor’s neglect. When she heard the news that the Imperial Concubine was pregnant, she felt a splitting headache. No matter how good her temperament was on weekdays, she could not control it at this moment.
“Why are you all against me?” If it was just a show and done on purpose before, then it has become true after so many years.
At this moment, the Queen hated Concubine Rong even more.
Never had the Empress been so angry before. The palace maids around her were terrified and fell to their knees on the ground.
“My lady, your health is very important!”
Yes, I still have a child. I have paid so much and even suffered the disgust of the emperor because of it. Isn’t it all for this child?
No matter what, nothing must happen to this child.
After taking a few quick breaths, she felt a sharp pain in her lower abdomen. The queen panicked and said, “Quick, go find the imperial physician!”
After a short while, the whole Xiangjingzhai was in chaos.
*
Ever since he found out that Concubine Rong was pregnant, Ye Shuo had been on high alert, especially when he learned that the Empress had broken several sets of cups and plates when she received the news of his mother’s pregnancy, which made Ye Shuo even more alert.
The Queen Mother came from a prominent family and had been well-versed in poetry and literature since childhood. She must have hated him so much that she lost her manners like this. Although Ye Shuo knew in his heart that the Queen Mother would not be so unwise as to take direct action, he was still afraid of the possibility. If there was a possibility, Ye Shuo would not be able to bear the consequences.
So recently, whenever his mother ate any food, Ye Shuo would go to the small kitchen to check it himself.
But even so, someone still took advantage of the loophole.
A few days later, Ye Shuo discovered that the dishes on the table contained several incompatible ingredients.
For example, goose meat and eggs, chicken and mustard greens, etc., are things that will damage your vitality if eaten together, especially goose meat. Even though the kitchen said it was duck meat, Ye Shuo was considered a gourmet back then, so how could he not tell the difference between the two?
The skeletons of duck and goose meat, as well as the quality of the meat are very different.
Although from the perspective of modern science, these so-called food incompatibilities are nonsense, the people here don’t know this, which proves that someone has indeed reached into the small kitchen.
There are already so many things on display, how many more are hidden in the dark?
Ye Shuo had no idea whether there were any added ingredients in the foods that could not be seen with the naked eye.
The people behind the scenes will not take action openly, but they do a lot of small things behind the scenes.
I guess they all wanted to harm her mother’s health, and it would be best if they could save both her and her mother.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and stopped his mother from reaching for the chopsticks: “Wait a minute.”
Concubine Rong stopped, somewhat puzzled.
“Xiao Luzi, go and ask the imperial physician to come over.” Now he already knew that the small kitchen was not clean, but he didn’t know whether the imperial physician had been bribed.
Ye Shuo planned to remain silent, use the opponent’s force to attack him, and test the situation.
“Mom, you don’t have to worry or say anything. Just watch from the side.”
Although Concubine Rong was confused and had no idea what her son was up to, she still stopped obediently.
Soon, the imperial physician arrived in a hurry.
The Imperial Concubine was just beginning her pregnancy, which was a critical time, so the Imperial Physician was naturally on call at all times.
This old doctor was someone his mother was used to employing, and Ye Shuo was unwilling to doubt him, but in an extraordinary period, it was better to be cautious.
So Ye Shuo didn’t wait for him to salute, and hurriedly said: “My mother said she has a stomachache, imperial physician, please come and take a look, is there something wrong with the food?”
How could her own son open his mouth and say that? She was fine, not to mention feeling very safe and secure, so how could he have a stomachache?
Concubine Rong frowned subconsciously, and the next moment, she saw Ye Shuo looking at her.
After all, they are mother and son, so they have some tacit understanding. Concubine Rong immediately showed a look of pain on her face.
The imperial physician’s heart tightened, and he quickly looked at the dishes on the table.
You don’t know until you see it, and you’ll be shocked when you see it.
“How can chicken and shepherd’s purse be paired together?” The imperial physician did not realize that the dish of duck meat was disguised as goose meat, so he only mentioned chicken and shepherd’s purse.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, although the small kitchen is no longer clean, the imperial physician is still safe now.
If something went wrong with the imperial physician, then things would be really bad.
“Thank you, Imperial Physician. I’m sorry to trouble you for making this trip.” After the Imperial Physician took Ye Shuo’s pulse and found that he was fine, Ye Shuo felt guilty and took out a handful of golden melon seeds.
This was indeed Ye Shuo’s petty intention, but in this special period, he had to be on guard.
When the imperial physician left, he was still wondering why he was given so much reward today?
But the old doctor didn’t think much about it. After all, who would dislike a lot of rewards? The reason why the old doctor followed the imperial concubine was because the imperial concubine had no tricks and no intention to harm others. In addition, she was generous. He only needed to do his job. Who wouldn’t want such a master?
Concubine Rong was unable to react for a long time. After she came to her senses, she immediately severely punished the people in the small kitchen.
Although Concubine Rong was a little slow to react, she was definitely not a soft-hearted person. She would never show mercy to the servants who dared to betray her.
The reason why she provided them with huge amounts of silver was so that they would remember her kindness and do things for her. Now, they have taken the silver and want to harm her. If she could endure this, she would not be a royal concubine.
Concubine Rong didn’t even take care of her own body, so blood was seen in the small kitchen that day.
If it was any other day, Ye Shuo would not be able to bear to see such a scene, but now his heart was not moved at all.
Ye Shuo’s kindness and goodwill have always had a bottom line.
The man in the small kitchen didn’t even know how he was discovered. He just felt that he was unlucky. It just happened that the imperial concubine was not feeling well and was caught by the imperial physician.
Incompatible foods will not cause any problems all at once, they will just slowly consume the mother and the fetus. It is not a direct drug, so it should be very safe. How could it be…
It’s a pity that he will never know this.
After the incident in the small kitchen, everything returned to normal quickly, but Ye Shuo still felt uneasy.
Maybe it was because his desire to protect his mother was too strong. Ye Shuo knew in his heart that something was wrong with his current state, but he really didn’t want to experience the powerlessness of Mr. Gu in his previous life again.
It’s just that Ye Shuo disguised himself very well and looked no different from usual, so Concubine Rong didn’t notice it.
But in fact, Ye Shuo just felt that Concubine Rong didn’t notice it.
Concubine Rong may often act foolishly in other things, but as a mother, how could she not feel her son’s emotional changes?
“Madam Jing, do you think this child should not be born?” Concubine Rong has six older brothers, and almost everyone here has brothers and sisters. In the past, Concubine Rong never thought that having more children was a bad thing, but seeing her son’s current performance, Concubine Rong was obviously panicked.
Although she didn’t know what was wrong, she clearly felt that there must be something wrong, but Concubine Rong couldn’t find it. Concubine Rong was so anxious that she suddenly blurted out such a sentence.
Upon hearing this, Nanny Jing was startled: “My Lady, please be careful with your words!”
“The concubine is pregnant with a prince, this must not be done…” This is the Emperor’s child, the Emperor’s bloodline, and it would be a grave disrespect to damage it lightly.
But halfway through the story, Nanny Jing couldn’t quite go on.
The two of them fell silent at the same time, with nothing to say to each other.
the other side.
Ye Shuo couldn’t let go of his worries no matter what. After thinking it over, he felt that it was better to rely on himself than on others. Even the imperial physician couldn’t stay in Xiangjingzhai for 24 hours. It would be bad if something went wrong or something happened that they didn’t notice.
What should we do in this situation? The best solution is to read.
No matter what problems you encounter that you can’t solve, just read. There will definitely be answers in the books.
Just like that, Emperor Jingwen was shocked to find that his son actually started reading the book.
Emperor Jingwen even took a special look out the window and saw that the sun was rising from the east today, which was correct!
Emperor Jingwen approached almost at the same time as the crown prince, and after taking a closer look, he realized that it was a medical book.
There are all kinds of books including “Huangdi Neijing”, “Shennong Bencaojing”, “Compendium of Materia Medica”, “Treatise on Febrile Diseases”, “Treatise on Febrile and Miscellaneous Diseases”, “Treatise on Warm and Hot Diseases”, etc.
I knew this little bastard would never study seriously.
Emperor Jingwen could understand other things, but he really couldn’t understand this book “Emergency Prescriptions for the Elbow”.
Isn’t this book about first aid?
With a casual flip of his hand, the corner of Emperor Jingwen’s mouth twitched slightly.
There is also this book “Acupuncture and Moxibustion Jia Yi Jing”. It seems that his son not only prescribes medicine for people, but also gives them acupuncture.
Emperor Jingwen finally swallowed back the words “If I had known this would work, I would have asked your mother to give birth to a younger brother for you.”
The prince at the side couldn’t hold it in any longer and asked, “Xiaojiu, what are you doing?”
“Study.” Ye Shuo looked up at the other person with a serious expression.
“I don’t feel comfortable leaving my mother to anyone, so I’m going to do it myself.”
When Emperor Jingwen heard this, his first reaction was that it was not a good thing for a prince to be too close to his mother.
However, after hearing this, Emperor Jingwen instantly forgot what he had just said. He suddenly felt that the imperial concubine was too unlucky. It was really unlucky to give birth to such a son.
Emperor Jingwen almost gritted his teeth and said, “Don’t lay a hand on your mother. Do you hear me?”
I hope he won’t get hurt again. Emperor Jingwen, who was standing next to him, couldn’t help but feel terrified.
Even the prince couldn’t help but be silent when he heard such an answer, and suddenly sympathy for Concubine Rong flashed through his heart.
“Come on, can’t you just trust me for once?”
“I have to hurry up and finish reading these books. Father, Third Brother, remember not to let anyone disturb me during this time.”
After saying this, Ye Shuo ignored them and just watched by himself.
Emperor Jingwen and the Crown Prince were really frightened by him for a moment, but it was just a medical book, at least he was serious this time.
Emperor Jingwen and the Crown Prince had the same thought and accepted it reluctantly. As a result… while they were reviewing memorials, he looked up inadvertently and found that he was not reading a book, but was clearly flipping through it.
A page is turned in the blink of an eye, and it only takes a short while to finish a book that is as thick as a little finger.
In just a quarter of an hour, he already had a small pile of books at hand.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Prince: “…”
It’s over, this child is hopeless.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Beauty
chapters.content:
He even treats his mother like this, it seems that we can’t rely on him.
When Ye Shuo left today, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but tell Wang Ziquan, “Go, send some people over.”
He didn’t know what his son might do next, and Emperor Jingwen was really worried.
When Wang Ziquan looked over, Emperor Jingwen spoke word by word: “No matter what, don’t let him get close to the imperial concubine, especially with a needle in his hand!”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know about others, but his own son was really capable of doing such a thing.
This is the first time I see His Majesty showing such concern for a pregnant concubine. The last time His Majesty was so nervous was when the late Queen was pregnant with the Crown Prince.
Although the purposes are slightly different, they lead to the same destination.
Trying hard to suppress his smile, Wang Ziquan quickly replied “yes”.
the other side.
While Ye Shuo was catching up on the half-baked theoretical knowledge he had acquired in his previous life, he was secretly thinking about how to put it into practice.Traditional Chinese medicine is something that can only be achieved through a lot of accumulation. It does not mean that you can really cure diseases by reading a few more books.
So Ye Shuo turned around and went to the Imperial Hospital.
He did these things without hiding anything from others, and the whole process was very open and aboveboard.
Sometimes, the more you cover up, the more suspicious you become. When you put everything out in the open, no one will believe you.
When the imperial physicians in the Imperial Hospital heard that the Ninth Prince wanted to learn this, and that he was learning it for the Imperial Concubine, they were stunned.
“Your Highness, I am here with you. I will do my best to protect you.” So please don’t use the Imperial Concubine as a test, okay? !
When he first heard about this and then saw the serious expression on the Ninth Prince’s face, the old doctor’s heart began to tremble.
“No, I have to do my own things.” Silently memorizing the shape, taste, and state of the medicinal materials before and after processing, Ye Shuo searched around with his eyes. After confirming that he had not missed any details that he could learn, he left the old doctor with horror in his eyes and walked out of the Imperial Hospital.
Walking on the road, Ye Shuo seemed to be appreciating the scenery along the way, but in fact he was secretly digesting what he had learned today.
When Ye Shuo gets serious, his state is completely different from usual.
Ye Shuo was very clear in his mind that there were some things he could be lazy about but some things he couldn’t. As for his mother’s current safety, if he learned more today, he would be more confident tomorrow.
Soon, Ye Shuo was awakened by the laughter of a woman not far away.
When I looked up, it turned out to be Lady Song. As for the person next to Lady Song…
Ye Shuo searched his memory carefully, but did not find any trace of the other party on the day of the banquet. However, the other party’s dress did not seem like that of a palace maid, so Ye Shuo understood immediately.
At this time, Lady Song was chatting and laughing with the other party, and she looked much more relaxed than before.
That’s right, no matter who you are, it’s bound to be nervous when facing someone in a high position.
Just like now, when Concubine Song saw Ye Shuo, she immediately stopped smiling, and the two of them greeted Ye Shuo almost in unison.
“Greetings to the Ninth Prince.”
Although the two were the emperor’s concubines, they were of low status after all. And because of the emperor’s relationship, the prince was half their master if you think about it carefully.
“Please stand up, ladies.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at the person next to Lady Song, paused, and then called out.
What Ye Shuo didn’t understand was why Lady Song was so intimate with someone else even though she was diagnosed as pregnant.
Ye Shuo could understand that most people would subconsciously seek help from those around them when they encountered difficulties, as if this would give them strength. After all, humans are emotional animals, and it is understandable that they subconsciously seek companionship. It is just like modern people will instinctively seek comfort and advice from their friends when they encounter any difficulties. It is a subconscious reaction.
But Lady Song’s situation is special now, so she should be more careful.
The more isolated and helpless you are, the more you need to stay steady, especially in the harem, which is a big melting pot of interests. It is not a good thing to trust someone so easily.
Because of the word “interest”, in the palace, sometimes the people close to you may not necessarily be helpful, and may even become the knife that hurts you.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo wanted to give her a reminder, but just as he was about to open his mouth, he noticed the vigilance and suspicion in Lady Song’s eyes.
She unconsciously placed her hand on her lower abdomen as a subconscious defensive gesture.
Ye Shuo suddenly couldn’t say anything, because he knew that it would be useless even if he said it in this situation.
That’s right, who would trust a stranger instead of the people around them?
When Concubine Song saw the Ninth Prince here, she instantly became nervous, because in her eyes the Ninth Prince was a very tactless person.
Moreover, the Ninth Prince is young and favored. He treats the Emperor like this, let alone himself.
If the Ninth Prince suddenly went crazy and bumped into her, thus hurting the baby in her belly, Concubine Song couldn’t guarantee that the Emperor would punish the Ninth Prince for a child he had never met.
Therefore, in Concubine Song’s eyes, Ye Shuo was a completely dangerous person, and she wished to stay as far away from the Ninth Prince as possible.
But in the end, Ye Shuo kindly reminded her: “After just a few days of not seeing you, I see that Lady Song seems to be more prosperous than before.”
It is not a good thing for the mother to be over nourished and the fetus to be too large.
It is better in modern times, as caesarean section is still possible, but even so it is still quite dangerous, not to mention the ancient times when caesarean section did not exist.
Ye Shuo’s original intention was to remind the other party to pay attention to his weight. The fact that he could be noticed after just a few days of not seeing him proved that his weight gain speed was indeed quite rapid. However, this remark was considered a humiliation by Concubine Song.
The Ninth Prince was laughing at her for being fat!
The woman next to Lady Song felt her heart skip a beat.
Lady Song took a deep breath, her smile a little stiff: “Your Highness the Ninth Prince, you don’t know, this is what happens to pregnant women.”
“I’m really sorry, I feel a little unwell, so I’ll take my leave first.”
Just like that, Ye Shuo watched the other party leave.
The two met briefly on the lakeshore, and parted ways after a few words. Ye Shuo lowered his eyes and finally left.
the other side.
Seeing the Ninth Prince’s figure gradually disappear, Concubine Song breathed a sigh of relief at a speed visible to the naked eye.
“It’s okay, it’s okay, he is finally gone.”
The woman beside Lady Song also calmed down. Hearing this, the woman couldn’t help but joked, “You seem to be particularly repulsive to this Ninth Prince. Why?”
“Sister, you don’t know. When I first met the Ninth Prince, he didn’t even listen to His Majesty.” In modern times, a man like Ye Shuo would be a naughty child that everyone would hate to see. Shouldn’t Lady Song stay away from him?
When Concubine Song thought of the chaotic scene when she first met the Ninth Prince, she was frightened from the bottom of her heart.
“If my child were born, I would definitely not let him become like this.”
Concubine Song will definitely educate him and make him into a good prince who observes etiquette and knows manners.
Hearing this, the woman next to her froze slightly, but quickly returned to normal before Lady Song looked over.
Concubine Song was completely unaware: “Come to think of it, I should thank my sister for accompanying me.” Ever since the Tianchang Festival birthday banquet that day, Concubine Song always felt uneasy, especially when the two concubines Shu & De made sarcastic remarks in public, which made her unable to sleep or eat.
The high-ranking concubines’ arrogant look that day made Concubine Song worried and afraid. In the eyes of the second concubine, she seemed like a disposable toy, so Concubine Song always felt that they would harm her, so she specially found sisters who were familiar with her in the palace to accompany her and give her courage.
But what Lady Song didn’t know was that the closer people are to you, the more likely you are to become jealous.
It has nothing to do with gender, it’s human nature.
Unless it is a sincere and close friendship, it is difficult to control jealousy.
On the contrary, Concubine Shu and Concubine De, whose sons have all grown up, have no direct conflict of interest with Concubine Song. At most, they would just say a few sarcastic words to her face.
We were both concubines, and I entered the palace a few years earlier than her. Why could she get pregnant successfully while I couldn’t?
The gloomy look disappeared in an instant, and the woman smiled: “Sister, you are too kind.”
“If my sister continues to be so polite to me, I will be angry.”
When Lady Song saw this, she naturally called her “good sister”.
By the evening, Ye Shuo finally finished his day’s study.
A few days passed like this, and even the Sixth Prince was alarmed by his affairs.
But when they saw with their own eyes how Xiaojiu was “studying”, the Sixth Prince, like Emperor Jingwen and the Crown Prince, immediately fell silent.
“Come quickly, come quickly, let me take your pulse.” Ye Shuo had just finished reading “Pulse Classic” and was now in need of an experimental subject. It happened that the Sixth Prince came to him, so he pulled the man to his side without thinking.
But how could the Sixth Prince dare to let him touch him? Xiaojiu has always been careless, and how could anything be possible for him if he fell into his hands?
So the Sixth Prince hid while asking, “Madam Rong is pregnant for the second time now, Xiaojiu, you don’t have to be so nervous.”
Especially, don’t look like you are determined to do it yourself, as it looks scary.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frowned when he heard this: “That’s wrong. Let me tell you, any woman giving birth, no matter how many babies she has, the risk is extremely high.”
Having a second child might be smoother, but the risks are still the same, there is no difference.
Suddenly remembering that the man in front of him was also a prince and would marry many wives in the future, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but give him some science explanation.
“Especially for women who are too young. The best childbearing age for women is between 23 and 30 years old. Too early or too late is not good.”
The Sixth Prince was speechless when he saw this: “Why are you telling me this?”
He doesn’t have children.
Haha, I knew these people would never take these things to heart.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said, “Of course I want to remind you, I’m afraid you will bring harm to the girl when you get married in the future!”
Caught off guard, the Sixth Prince blushed a little.
Tsk, even someone like him would feel shy when thinking about his future wife.
Ye Shuo seized the opportunity, pushed him down on the chair, and then touched his wrist.
The Sixth Prince has always known that his younger brother is very strong, but what he didn’t expect is that after a period of time, his strength would increase again.
The Sixth Prince had no choice but to be forced to be a guinea pig.
After a while, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but uttered silently: “Xiao Ming, you are so weak.”
The Sixth Prince: “…………”
“Roll!”
In the following months, Ye Shuo “cured” almost everyone around him. Even Eunuch Wang Ziquan could not escape his clutches. Even the commander-in-chief was blocked by Ye Shuo on the road.
I’ve never seen anyone insisting on seeing a doctor when they are not sick.
But Ye Shuo was a prince after all, so everyone turned a blind eye and let it go.
Think about it, if your boss’s child wants you to play with him, can you refuse?
Emperor Jingwen was so troubled by his son’s sudden enthusiasm, but as long as he didn’t really touch the pregnant concubine, he would let him be.
In this way, we survived the relatively cool June, the scorching July and August, and soon it was September.
In mid-September, Ye Shuo heard the news that Concubine Song was about to give birth.
Concubine Song, who is only eight months pregnant, is about to give birth.
Ye Shuo got the news of Concubine Song’s delivery in the morning, but by the evening, when it was already dark, there was still no news.
It was not until the early morning that Ye Shuo faintly heard a noise outside.
Concubine Song had a difficult delivery.
Concubine Song suffered hemorrhage.
Lady Song…is gone.
The starry sky outside the window on a summer night seemed to be covered with a layer of coldness. Ye Shuo was in a trance as he stared at the ceiling with his eyes open.
You see, the fighting in this palace never stops.
Uncover the hypocritical illusion and you will see bloody scars underneath.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Decision
chapters.content:
Song Meiren gave birth to a princess, and the princess only identified her adoptive mother three days later.
Because Concubine Song had always been on good terms with a talented lady of the same rank when she was alive, the little princess was given to that talented lady to raise.
Now that the Queen is pregnant and in poor health, the Emperor is also unhappy, so he uses this as an excuse to deprive her of her power over the six palaces.
In addition, Emperor Jingwen knew the ability of the imperial concubine, so he directly bypassed the imperial concubine Rong and handed over the power of managing the six palaces to the three concubines Shu, De, & Xian.
After all, Concubine Song gave birth to only a princess, and the princess’s mother was already dead. Under such circumstances, concubines Shu, De, & Xian would naturally not care much.
Without having to think too much, the talented person already knew who it was.
If you clap your hands in this palace, you will end up taking away other people’s flower pots.
Lady Song carried the baby for eight months in fear, but all she did was to make wedding clothes for others.
Zhou Cairen got a child through someone else’s belly without any effort. Even though it was just a princess, it would ensure her a safe life for the rest of her life.
After listening to Xiao Luzi, Ye Shuo was silent for a long time.After quickly calming down, Ye Shuo turned around and went to look for his mother.
“What’s wrong, Shuo’er?” The imperial concubine was taking a walk in the yard at that time. When she saw her son, she keenly noticed his depression, so she squatted down with difficulty and asked.
Ye Shuo didn’t even think about it, and hugged his mother. He opened his mouth, but couldn’t say anything else. He buried his head in his mother’s neck. After a while, he just said in a sullen voice: “I’m fine, mother.”
Even though Ye Shuo didn’t say anything, how could the imperial concubine not feel something unusual?
Concubine Rong was shocked by her son’s rare fragility.
He was like a little bastard and a devil. This was the first time Concubine Rong saw this side of him.
This made Concubine Rong even more panicked than Ye Shuo. She raised her head subconsciously and began to ask for help from the people around her.
‘Aunt Jing!’
However, Nanny Jing had been with the Imperial Concubine all day, so how could she know what had happened?
In the end, it was Xiao Luzi who made the shape of “Song Meiren” with his mouth and reminded them.
Concubine Rong quickly came to her senses. It seemed that Concubine Song’s matter had upset her son. Without thinking, the concubine hurriedly comforted him softly, “Don’t worry, Shuo’er, mother will be fine.” While comforting him, the concubine patted her son on the back.
No matter how powerful the imperial concubine is, she can still think through the basics.
She naturally knew how difficult it was for a child who had lost his mother to be in this palace. The Crown Prince was still the Crown Prince. After losing his mother, didn’t he still have to be cautious and tread on thin ice? Not to mention the Sixth Prince.
Therefore, before her son grew up, Concubine Rong would never let anything happen to her.
When Emperor Jingwen arrived, what he saw was the mother and son crying in the yard with their heads held together.
Emperor Jingwen hesitated for a moment. Firstly, he couldn’t go forward or backward in time. Secondly, he was afraid of the tears of women and children.
But since he was already there, Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to go in.
“Xiaojiu, Imperial Concubine, what are you two doing in the yard?”
Ye Shuo and the imperial concubine looked in the direction of the sound, and soon, Emperor Jingwen received two pairs of rabbit eyes from the mother and son.
I really cried…
Watching this scene, Emperor Jingwen felt his scalp tingling, especially Xiaojiu. After hearing the reason, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
“Don’t worry, your mother will be fine.” Children are children. They would actually be scared by such things.
Reluctantly letting go of the imperial concubine’s hand, Ye Shuo wiped his face with his sleeve and said in a faint voice: “Father, how do you know? You can’t do anything about this matter.” Humph, since this matter is not put on my stepfather, it will be easy for him to talk about it.
Under normal circumstances, Emperor Jingwen would certainly be angry if he was questioned like this.
But when he caught a glimpse of his son’s cat-like face, Emperor Jingwen thought for a moment and decided not to bother with a child.
“I am the emperor, and my words are law.”
“…”
After a moment’s silence, Ye Shuo curled his lips and said, “But Dad, you are the emperor, but you are unwilling to give your son even an imperial edict.” The emperor is so stingy.
Here’s what happened. Didn’t the old doctor say before that the sex of the fetus could be roughly determined when the baby is three months pregnant? Now his mother is five months pregnant, and Ye Shuo had checked his mother’s pulse two months ago.
Ye Shuo flipped through ancient books and found a record in them that said: “If the left pulse of the fetus is fast, it means it is a boy, and if the right pulse is fast, it means it is a girl.”
That is to say, if the left pulse beats faster, it is a boy, and vice versa, it is a girl.
“Men and women have the same pulse, but their wrists are different. Yang is weak and Yin is strong. The left pulse governs the official, and the right pulse governs the government. The left pulse is strong for men, and the right pulse is strong for women.”
The human pulse is divided into three parts, namely “Cun”, “Guan” and “Chi”. “Only Chi is different” means that the “Chi” part is different.
Although I don’t know if there is any scientific basis, this is ancient times after all. In the absence of scientific and technological support, Ye Shuo can only make judgments based on these.
When every aspect of the pulse he took matched the girl’s, Ye Shuo felt like he was struck by lightning and his heart sank.
Murphy’s Law really proves to be true. The more you fear something, the more likely it will come to you.
Ye Shuo was clearly expecting a younger brother, but ended up having a younger sister.
Ye Shuo did not give up and called the old doctor over to examine the patient again.
As expected, the old doctor also said it was a princess.
Ye Shuo felt as if his whole body was in darkness.
It turned out that God couldn’t bear to see him live too smoothly. If he did, sooner or later he would create some trouble for him.
It was like this in my previous life, and it is like this in this life.
Sometimes, being too lucky will indeed lead to being envied by God.
But there is no way, the child is already here, we can’t just stuff her back in, right?
After all, Ye Shuo is not a child anymore. His soul is already that of an adult in his thirties. When he encounters a problem, he always finds a way to solve it.
After nearly a quarter of an hour of turmoil in his heart, Ye Shuo had no choice but to start considering the reality.
Firstly, although he was jealous of the arrival of the child, he was not too opposed to it. He had grown up and was no longer at the age of competing with a baby for milk.
The love that Ye Shuo received from his parents in his previous life was very complete, so complete that as long as he had the memory, this love was enough to support him to keep going.
Ye Shuo was a sentimental person, with a strong ability to love. Even though he had never met this suddenly arrived child, he already had a little fondness for him because of his mother.
This is what is meant by loving someone and loving his dog.
So Ye Shuo’s first reaction was, there are a total of three countries known today, so does the Great Zhou have a history of marriage alliances?
It is known that the queen has no legitimate daughter, and the next child is his mother’s. How could this not arouse concern?
So there was that scene two months ago.
Ye Shuo is not a god and cannot control everyone. All he can do is to prevent those around him from getting hurt.
When Emperor Jingwen saw his son looking up at him and asking if he could issue an imperial decree not to ask his sister to marry, his first reaction was: Is there something wrong with this kid’s brain?
At that time, Emperor Jingwen was full of confusion.
Where did this kid’s sister come from? Why is it linked to a marriage alliance?
When Emperor Jingwen heard Ye Shuo say that the imperial physician diagnosed that the imperial concubine’s baby was a princess, he was speechless.
“You actually asked me to give a clear order to a fetus that is only three months old and whose gender is not yet determined???”
Emperor Jingwen had never heard of such a request in his life.
The child is acting crazy again.
“This is simply nonsense!” This was Emperor Jingwen’s response at the time.
Then, as expected, Emperor Jingwen was entangled. He scolded and scolded the man, and almost beat him.
It’s not because Emperor Jingwen was reluctant to do so. When faced with such a tough and annoying child, even Emperor Jingwen would find it difficult to control his hands.
But, who could blame this little bastard for saying in the middle, “Dad, you can hit me if you want. Dad, just think about how many beatings I have to take to get a word from you. Any number will do. I’ll take as many as your son can bear”, which made Emperor Jingwen so angry that his teeth itched.
Just a few beatings, Ye Shuo thought he could definitely handle it, if he could really succeed, it would be a huge profit.
After waiting for a long time, Emperor Jingwen thought that he would finally behave himself. However, two months later, he still couldn’t forget it, so much so that Emperor Jingwen felt a little tired.
“Why do you worry so much about these things?” Especially the marriage of women. Emperor Jingwen thought that it was outrageous enough for him, a prince, to personally choose a husband for a maid. He didn’t expect that when it came to his own sister, it would be even worse.
The princess hasn’t even been born yet. Isn’t it too early for him to think about this now?
But his son didn’t know that this matter was different from ordinary ones. The marriage was related to state affairs, so Emperor Jingwen naturally would not agree to it easily.
If you promise this this year and promise that tomorrow, how can this be tolerated?
So……
“Just give up on this idea.”
Sure enough, this matter is not that simple. Ye Shuo also knows in his heart that this is just a matter of trying his luck, what if it works?
Who knew that my cheap dad would never give in.
Although he had expected it, Ye Shuo still couldn’t help feeling disappointed.
Seeing his son’s ears and head drooping at a speed visible to the naked eye, he felt more dejected than ever before.
Could it be that my refusal to agree to this matter really had such a big impact on him?
Emperor Jingwen was stunned and almost softened his heart, but then he came to his senses and immediately hardened his heart again.
With a sigh, Emperor Jingwen finally said earnestly: “Shuo’er, it is natural for the princess to marry a foreigner. The princess enjoys the support of the world, so she should naturally plead for the people when necessary.”
Ye Shuo also knew this truth, but truth is truth. When that day really comes, how can Ye Shuo bear it?
Let alone a marriage alliance, even if the princess got married, her mother would be sad. Just for this reason, Ye Shuo didn’t want to see such a scene.
If it can be avoided, why not avoid it?
It’s too early now, he can obviously do it.
It just so happened that today was the day when the imperial physician came to check Ye Shuo’s pulse. Ye Shuo did not give up, and after the old imperial physician finished taking his pulse, he asked the same question for the 23rd time.
“Are you sure it’s definitely the princess?”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
This kid is so annoying.
Not to mention Emperor Jingwen, even the old doctor’s ears were calloused. The old doctor, who was answering the same question for the 23rd time, was already numb: “Based on my experience, it is definitely the princess.”
It has been five months already. The old doctor really wants to advise him, Ninth Prince, ‘stop harboring illusions.’
Emperor Jingwen didn’t care much about it, and was even relieved when he heard that it was a princess. After all, she was also born to the imperial concubine, so the probability that this time it was the second devil was quite high.
If you are a princess, you should always be quiet.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t feel disappointed, so how come his son was even more patriarchal than he was?
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel a little puzzled.
Emperor Jingwen, who had been the crown prince since the day he was born and had not been very close to his brothers and sisters since childhood, naturally could not understand Ye Shuo’s current despair.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but reach out and put his hand on his mother’s slightly bulging belly. Just at this moment, the little thing in her belly moved.
Although I know that fetal movement is completely normal, and the baby is probably healthy, I don’t find it strange that he keeps moving around.
But when the bulge just poked his palm, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel uneasy.
After his stepfather left, Ye Shuo walked out and watched his mother fall asleep. He took a deep breath and immediately looked towards the small path next to him.
“Go and help me check something.”
After calming down, Ye Shuo planned to do a risk survey first.
Ye Shuo never makes decisions blindly. He now needs to consider the future risks comprehensively.
More than a hundred years have passed since the founding of the Great Zhou Dynasty.
During this hundred years, there must have been dozens or even hundreds of princesses. However, due to limited writing materials, only about ten or twenty of them are recorded.
Only about twenty or so made a little splash, and the rest disappeared without even leaving a word.
But even with these twenty or so princesses, the situation is not optimistic.
Princess Mingzhao, daughter of Emperor Gaozu, was born in the early days of the Zhou Dynasty, when the situation was unstable and foreign enemies happened to invade, so she had no choice but to be sent to marry. She died at the age of 22.
Princess Zhenxi, the daughter of Emperor Gaozu, was sent after the death of Princess Mingzhao. She was also married for a foreign mission and died at the age of 31.
Princess Anding, the daughter of Emperor Gaozu and the youngest daughter of Emperor Gaozu, married Marquis Xiao. Three years later, Marquis Xiao was sentenced to death by Emperor Gaozu, and Marquis Xiao was killed for treason. Princess Anding’s son was sentenced to death, and Princess Anding died of depression at the age of 30.
Princess Jing’an, the daughter of Emperor Taizong, was married to the northern Rongdi tribe in order to win over foreign tribes. She died in the wind on the way.
Princess Jingcheng, daughter of Emperor Taizong…………
Princess Minseong, daughter of Emperor Taejong…
The Emperor Gaozu and Emperor Taizong, who were extremely wise in the records of the Great Zhou Dynasty, were like this, not to mention the Emperor Gaozong, who was known for his absurdity. she was the princess of Ye Shuo’s step-grandfather. The fate of Ye Shuo’s aunts was even worse than that of the previous princesses.
Although they did not fall to the point of being forced to marry a foreign prince, they were randomly arranged to marry by the late emperor, who no longer cared about them after the arranged marriages, so they basically did not have a good ending in the end.
The late emperor had a total of seventeen daughters, but only a few are still alive.
There were almost no princesses who lived long lives. The oldest one only lived to be 47 years old. The premature death rate was simply outrageous.
As Ye Shuo browsed through them one by one, he became more and more frightened.
Unlike modern times, where brothers and sisters can take care of their own affairs and perform their own duties, the princess here will really die without the support of her father and brothers.
However, when he came to his stepfather, Ye Shuo found that two princesses had been married into the palace before. Because his stepfather was not as absurd as the previous emperor, he was a diligent emperor who would not neglect his children, so the two princesses were in a good situation now.
According to common sense, there should be no problems while the stepfather is in power.
But, it is only a should.
The princess born by his mother might live a good life, and might even be favored by her stepfather, but it might not be so. The eldest prince is still at the border and has not returned, proving that the border is not very stable.
There are precedents for marriage alliances, so will there be no precedents for them?
The princess may live a safe and peaceful life, or she may be pointed out by her stepfather or brother one day in the future like everyone else. The probability is half-and-half.
What Ye Shuo disliked most was gambling.
He bet that his cheap father was soft-hearted, that the prince would also be soft-hearted after ascending to the throne, and that he would not be able to develop any feelings with this sister he had never met, and he placed all his hopes on others.
Bet! Bet! Bet! It’s all about betting!
It’s still early now, and everything is still possible. Even if the probability is very small, just in case, Ye Shuo is unwilling to regret in the future because of his powerlessness.
There are some things that you can do without, but you can’t live without.
When that time really comes, you can’t act like a spoiled child or a fool like you do now. Personal feelings are nothing but a joke in front of the court and the country.
It’s just the same old path from my previous life.
Now that things have become a foregone conclusion, it is useless to escape.
Slowly closing his eyes, Ye Shuo gradually made a decision in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Preparation
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo is an adult after all, and he has understood one thing: never pin your hopes on others, otherwise all you will get is disappointment.
This is especially true in the current situation.
Only when you hold the sword in your own hands can you attack or defend.
Regardless of whether it will be useful in the future, it never hurts to make arrangements early.
Well, anyway, let’s keep it for now…
But this kind of thing cannot be rushed, as rushing can easily lead to chaos. Anyway, it is still early, so there is plenty of time to make arrangements slowly.
After making up his mind, Ye Shuo stopped wavering, and the anxiety he had felt since the moment Concubine Rong became pregnant also slowly disappeared.
Ye Shuo finally regained his former calmness.
This made Concubine Rong, who had been secretly watching him, feel relieved.
Before, Imperial Concubine Rong had always been worrying about her son’s affairs and had no time to care about other things. Now she finally realised that the little princess would be born in a few months.“When you grow up, you must protect your brother.” Concubine Rong couldn’t help but whisper to the baby in her belly, not caring whether the baby could hear her or not.
The two maids beside her couldn’t help laughing when they heard this: “Your Highness, I’m afraid you said it the wrong way.”
In this world, older brothers protect their younger brothers and sisters. There is no reason for younger brothers and sisters to protect their older brothers.
What’s more, the imperial concubine’s baby is a princess.
The imperial concubine did not correct them when she heard this, but shook her head slightly: “Madam, you don’t understand.”
The imperial concubine used to think so too, she felt that her son was happy every day and heartless, he was the only one who made people angry to death, while she herself was very happy. What could he have worried about under such circumstances?
It was not until now that the imperial concubine saw clearly that the child seemed to be particularly afraid of losing, and would become extremely nervous at the slightest disturbance.
It was as if… he had tried so hard to protect someone before, but the result seemed not to be satisfactory, so he was afraid of repeating the same mistake.
He seemed to have hidden all his worries, not willing to let others see them easily, but in fact, he was not as strong and indifferent as he appeared.
But Shuo’er was obviously just a child of a few years old. Concubine Rong didn’t know why she had such an idea, but she just had such an intuition.
This child’s emotions seem rough, but in fact they are sensitive and delicate.
However, the imperial concubine did not mention all this to anyone else, not even to Nanny Jing and Nanny Yu who were by her side.
Since Shuo’er was unwilling to show it, he probably didn’t want others to know. In this case, the imperial concubine decided to keep this secret for him.
After September, the weather gradually became cooler as October arrived, and soon it was time to set off back to Beijing.
Because the imperial concubine and the queen were both pregnant, Emperor Jingwen kept them behind to avoid any problems during their journey.
Emperor Jingwen originally wanted to take his son with him. After all, the imperial concubine was pregnant, and if he stayed here, it would only cause more trouble. The imperial concubine might have to worry about it, and a child could not help, so how could he really be expected to do anything?
“Come back to the capital with me, so that your mother won’t have to worry about you every day.”
When Concubine Rong heard this, she immediately became nervous.
Ye Shuo didn’t dare to separate from his mother for too long. Could it be that the imperial concubine dared to separate from her son?
Especially since this temporary palace is so far away from Shangjing, if something happens, the imperial concubine won’t even have time to cry.
So the imperial concubine wanted to refuse Emperor Jingwen’s order without thinking twice.
But before she could say anything, Ye Shuo started to make a scene: “No, no, I have to wait for my sister! I want to see my sister!”
In fact, there was no point in seeing a ghost sister. The child hasn’t been born yet so who knows what it will look like. Ye Shuo was really afraid that his mother would be harmed if left alone.
Giving birth is like walking through the gates of hell for a woman. It is very easy to do anything during this time.
Of course Ye Shuo didn’t dare to leave at this time.
But he certainly couldn’t say it directly, because the prince’s excessive dependence on his biological mother was not a good thing in itself, and his stepfather would definitely not agree to it. But it would be fine if he used his sister as an excuse.
As expected, Emperor Jingwen not only did not feel anything, but could not help but jokes: “I still remember, I don’t know who said that – I don’t want a sister but a brother.” Children change their expressions very quickly.
Seeing his son clinging to the pillar and refusing to let go, with an expression of “Don’t even think about taking me away”, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. Finally, after thinking it over, he decided to keep him.
However, in order to prevent his son from causing trouble during the delivery, Emperor Jingwen deliberately left some people on hand, and told them that they could hold the prince down when necessary.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Tsk.
Soon, the large group left leisurely, and the whole garden became deserted.
When saying goodbye, Ye Shuo stood beside his mother and saw the Empress whom he had not seen for a long time. The Empress looked more and more haggard now. The dark circles under her eyes could hardly be concealed. She had lost a lot of weight as well. It seemed that she had been tormented a lot by the child in her belly.
It’s been less than five months, and it will probably be even more painful when the growing fetus presses on the internal organs and spine.
This reminded Ye Shuo of what his nanny had said about how his mother looked when she was pregnant with him, and it was said that she was not much better than this.
Fortunately, his younger sister was relatively well-behaved. Apart from being a little active, she was fine in other aspects. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel relieved.
The gate of the palace slowly closed. The imperial concubine and the queen looked at each other. Finally, the queen and her entourage left first.
She’s just a princess, nothing to worry about.
Fortunately, she won’t give birth to another prince. Thinking of this, the queen felt a little comforted.
Don’t be in a hurry, there is still a lot of time to come.
Finally, the queen left with the careful help of her maid.
“The Queen is coming——”
“Farewell, Her Majesty.”
Seeing that the Queen Mother didn’t even have the strength to compete with his mother, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smack his lips. The Queen Mother was indeed very ferocious.
But Ye Shuo will not relax just because of this.
Now, there are only the queen and his mother left in the garden, and at most a newborn little princess who is not suitable to be moved, but is the easiest to be exploited.
It would be a bad idea if someone were to kill two birds with one stone and divert trouble to someone else.
Ye Shuo didn’t dare to let his guard down even when it came to the Queen.
Therefore, when Concubine Rong went out to visit the garden, Ye Shuo was usually by her side to prevent any accidents.
Ye Shuo uses his perception to basically avoid danger before it occurs.
Just like now.
Noticing the movement in the bushes, Ye Shuo almost subconsciously stood in front of his mother when the other party rushed over.
Ye Shuo stretched out his hand to stop him, but even though he reacted quickly enough, he was still nearly scratched by the other party.
Ye Shuo only touched a little very soft fur.
After being thrown to the ground by Ye Shuo, the other party seemed to be quite frightened, and quickly ran into the bushes and disappeared.
Ye Shuo vaguely saw that the cat-sized creature had black and white fur, but before he could see clearly what kind of animal it was, the creature disappeared.
After Concubine Rong realised what was happening, she was horrified: “Shuo’er, are you okay? Are you injured?”
Everything just happened so fast that in the imperial concubine’s eyes, the only thing left was the scene of her son suddenly rushing in front of her, and then a black shadow crashing into him.
Concubine Rong squatted down hurriedly to check on her son, and was relieved when she found that only the clothes on his arm were torn and he was not injured.
“It’s okay, it’s okay, luckily you are not hurt.”
Ye Shuo was about to open his mouth to comfort her, but he saw the patrolling guards heard the commotion here and hurried over.
“This subordinate pays respects to the Imperial Concubine and the Ninth Prince.”
Because the garden itself is relatively large, and there are mountains, water and everything else around it, wild animals often appear there. Now that most of the nobles in the garden have left, the remaining staff are a little insufficient, and it is inevitable that some small animals will accidentally break in and not be cleared out in time.
As luck would have it, he bumped into the imperial concubine and the prince, and the patrolling guards broke out in cold sweats.
“I failed in my duty. Please forgive me, Your Majesty, the Ninth Prince.”
Ye Shuo didn’t think anything was wrong, after all, he wasn’t really injured.
However, Imperial Concubine Rong was terrified and started scolding the guards, making them unable to raise their heads.
Usually Ye Shuo didn’t dare to interrupt his mother when she lost her temper, otherwise his mother would scold him too, so he really could do nothing to help in such a situation.
Please, guards, take care of yourself…
“I’ll forgive you this time. If it happens again, don’t blame me for being rude!” After a long while, Concubine Rong left with her people after saying this harshly.
“Shuo’er, let’s go.”
“I’m coming.”
Jogging two steps to catch up, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look back. What he was thinking was, did the sable just now really come in by mistake?
For safety reasons, Ye Shuo basically took a different route whenever he took his mother to visit the garden.
Sure enough, nothing like this happened again afterwards.
Autumn goes and winter comes, and in the blink of an eye it is the midwinter season.
In the meantime, his cheap father sent letters from time to time. Seeing that his cheap father was giving him so much face, Ye Shuo couldn’t just ignore him, right?
Of course, Ye Shuo’s replies were basically written by Xing Yucheng. He was not used to using a brush, so he usually dictated and Xing Yucheng wrote.
Almost every time they would talk about the same three things: what we had eaten recently, what we had played, and if it snowed in the garden, they would talk about making a snowman today.
There were no cameras in those days, so Ye Shuo thought about it and drew what the snowman looked like himself.
But when it comes to studying, Ye Shuo didn’t mention a word.
Looking at the ink blob on the rice paper, Xing Yucheng was strangely silent for a moment.
The snowman is obviously so beautiful, with a nose and eyes, how come it turns out to be so ugly.
The Ninth Prince really had no talent in calligraphy and painting.
At the end of the letter, Ye Shuo thought about it, and very thoughtfully added how his mother was doing recently, how the princess in her belly was doing, and whether she was quiet or noisy today.
There was no way. As a man, Ye Shuo naturally knew the bad qualities of men.
Take the matter of giving birth for example. If the cheap father is not involved, it would be strange for him to have any feelings for the princess in his mother’s belly.
“It’s done. It’s all done.”
After handing in the reply, Ye Shuo continued his work of making a snowman.
It has to be said that winter in ancient times that had not experienced global warming was different from the modern winter. In modern times, Ye Shuo had rarely seen such heavy snow since he became an adult.
The only pity was that the roads were slippery due to the snow, so his mother couldn’t enjoy the snowy scenery in the garden with him in winter. She could only stay in Xiangjingzhai every day, which was really a pity.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was watching at this time, Ye Shuo had some fun in the garden.
It is definitely impossible to climb trees in winter, but the lake in the garden is frozen.
The ice was very thick, and it was no problem for an adult to jump on it, let alone a child like Ye Shuo.
He specially asked the manager of the garden to make a few ice skates, and Ye Shuo took Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi and went straight to the lake in the middle of the garden.
At first Xing Yucheng was a little resistant, after all, he was in the arts, not sports, but it didn’t take long for him to discover the fun of skating.
Ice skating in winter is quite fun.
When Xing Yucheng gradually became able to skate and no longer fell down easily, he felt excited and subconsciously wanted to show off to the Ninth Prince.
“Your Highness, look, I——”
As a result, Xing Yucheng turned around and found that the Ninth Prince was having a lot of fun.
After Ye Shuo turned 360 degrees in the air and landed steadily, he noticed the gaze of his study partner, so he stopped and asked, “What’s wrong? What did you say just now?”
“…Nothing.” In the end, Xing Yucheng swallowed back the words that were not yet spoken.
As for Xiao Luzi, well, he is not as good as him.
Xing Yucheng finally found some comfort.
The days passed one by one, and just when Xing Yucheng felt that he was about to be led astray by the Ninth Prince, spring arrived quietly.
Ye Shuo was still thinking about what to do in the spring, but one day, Xiao Luzi came back and brought back a piece of news –
The Queen gave birth prematurely.
The Queen became pregnant in mid-July, and it is only the end of February now, so a total of just over seven months, which is earlier than Concubine Song before.
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo immediately sat up from the couch.
At the same time, Concubine Rong soon learned about this matter.
Originally, Imperial Concubine Rong didn’t think it was a big deal, as she had given birth before. But now that Concubine Song and the Queen had both given birth prematurely, Imperial Concubine Rong couldn’t help but become nervous.
Concubine Rong didn’t say anything for a long time. She held her waist and returned to the dressing table.
About half an hour later, when she came out again, there was an envelope in her hand.
Concubine Rong didn’t know if this time would be as smooth as last time, so she could only do her best to arrange everything for her son.
“Madame Jing, Madame Yu, if anything unexpected happens to me this time, you two must find a way to deliver this letter to my father and my mother.”
The only people Concubine Rong could trust were her parents and brothers.
After realising what she meant, the two maids were horrified and fell to their knees with a plop.
“My queen!”

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Guardian
chapters.content:
“Madam, don’t be nervous. I’m just being cautious.” Until now, Concubine Rong didn’t feel uncomfortable at all, otherwise, with the close care Ye Shuo was taking of her, he would have discovered it long ago. She was just frightened by Concubine Song and the Queen.
However, despite this, the two maids were still very nervous.
Having served the Imperial Concubine for so long, and with the favours that the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion had shown them, the maids had long regarded the Imperial Concubine as their own master. Moreover, the Ninth Prince was so likeable and they had watched him grow up.
The two maids didn’t dare to think about what they would do if something unexpected happened to the imperial concubine.
“Shuo’er is here, quickly put it away.” Looking through the window, the imperial concubine saw the little man walking towards them with his attendants from afar. Fearing that she would be discovered, she hurriedly called out in panic.
Nanny Jing stood up and put the letter into her sleeve.
Ye Shuo was not much better. After hearing the news that the queen had given birth, he almost subconsciously came to his mother.
Seeing that his mother was still standing there quietly, Ye Shuo immediately relaxed.
Noticing that the corners of Mammy’s eyes were slightly red, as if she had just cried, Ye Shuo paused abruptly. The next moment, he quickly returned to normal, so fast that no one noticed.
Although a person in his/her thirties is no longer old enough to act like a spoiled child, as long as his/her mother is still alive, no matter how old he/she is, he/she is still a child in front of his/her mother.Just like Ye Shuo now, he urgently needs to be kissed, hugged and lifted up.
Regarding this point, Concubine Rong would never let Ye Shuo down. She let her son nestle in her arms, patting his back and humming a tune softly.
That’s right, this little thing blocking the way is really an eyesore and seriously hinders him from getting close to his mother.
Ye Shuo lowered his head and looked at his mother’s round belly with an unfriendly expression.
I don’t know if it noticed his gaze, but the little thing was not afraid. Instead, it nodded arrogantly.
A small bulge quickly appeared on the imperial concubine’s belly, as if to show her existence.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sneer: “Ha.”
“Be careful or I’ll beat you up if you do that again.”
Considering her doesn’t mean everything has to go her way, Ye Shuo can still tell the difference.
Seeing that he seemed serious and not joking, maybe she sensed that the atmosphere was not good, or maybe she was simply tired of playing, the little thing quickly quieted down and was as well-behaved as it could be.
Only then was Ye Shuo satisfied.
The imperial concubine next to them looked at the interaction between the two “people” and couldn’t help but feel both amused and sad.
“Oh, right, mother.” Ye Shuo suddenly thought of something, so he opened his big eyes and looked up and said, “After my sister is born, can you let me take care of her?”
It’s not that Ye Shuo is so mean. His younger brothers and sisters also have to help raise the child, and it’s mainly his mother who raises the child… Ye Shuo is really worried.
Thinking back to how his mother raised him, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but be silent.
The way his mother raises children, any child will be raised astray by her.
Ye Shuo believed in his mother’s love for her son, but he really didn’t believe in his mother’s way of education.
No, his mother doesn’t have any educational methods at all. She just spoils him blindly, and she can’t stand it when the child starts to act like a spoiled brat.
The more Ye Shuo enjoyed it in the past, the more scared he is now.
“This…” The imperial concubine hesitated when she heard this.
In her opinion, she should raise her own child. Shuo’er is forced to study by the emperor every day, which is very stressful. If she asks him to take care of the child, the imperial concubine cannot bear it.
However, the imperial concubine did have too much to worry about. There were so many palace servants in the palace. How could Ye Shuo take care of things like dressing and eating?
At most, it’s just a question of the princess’s character.
Seeing his mother hesitate, Ye Shuo’s expression immediately became pitiful: “Mom, just obey your son.”
It is said that what the imperial concubine can’t stand the most is children acting coquettishly in front of her. Once they act coquettishly, the imperial concubine’s IQ drops rapidly.
In addition, the princess has not been born yet, and the imperial concubine’s heart is still with Ye Shuo. After being coaxed by him, the imperial concubine got excited and actually agreed to hand over her daughter to her son for training.
Nanny Jing and Nanny Yu, who were standing by, were unable to stop it and had to watch helplessly as the poor unborn princess was sold by her mother.
Oh my God, what would happen if the princess learned from the Ninth Prince’s lively personality that makes him want to tear down the imperial palace?
Just thinking about that scene made the two maids feel dizzy.
But in fact, although Ye Shuo had never raised a child, he clearly knew the principle that everything will turn into the opposite extreme and that negatives will turn into positives.
It’s like a diligent couple, who will most likely raise a lazy child. Because the couple does all the housework, the child has nothing to do, and over time, they will get used to it and naturally become lazy.
On the contrary, a lazy couple will most likely give birth to very diligent children, because if the couple does not work, the house will be a mess and it will be unbearable to look at, so the children will naturally help.
Although this theory has no scientific basis, it should be correct based on experience, so Ye Shuo thinks it is worth a try.
Women in this era already have many constraints. If they don’t suffer a little early on, they will suffer all the consequences in the future.
so……
I’m sorry, sister!
The poor little princess, who is still an embryo, is unaware of her brother’s sinister intentions and is now having fun in the imperial concubine’s belly.
Half an hour later, Ye Shuo had had enough of his mother. After returning to the room, he took a deep breath and looked at Xing Yucheng beside him.
“Here are five tales of silver, and please help me write a letter.”
In less than a year, he had so much silver that he had no place to put it, and it was difficult to hide it.
Looking at the brand new five taels of silver in front of him, Xing Yucheng almost cried.
But now Xing Yucheng was already stuck in the mud, unable to get out even if he wanted to. He had no choice but to succumb to the tyranny of the Ninth Prince.
What Xing Yucheng didn’t expect was that this time the Ninth Prince asked him to write a…crying letter?
the other side.
The Queen was still struggling in the delivery room. The further she got into the later stages of her pregnancy, the stronger her body’s reactions became, and the more uncomfortable she felt.
Recently, the queen has been feeling a bit short of breath.
Today was an ordinary day. The queen walked around in the garden as usual, following the advice of the imperial physician that more exercise would help with childbirth.
As a result, my water broke just because I walked a little further.
And now, she is only seven months pregnant.
Thinking of this, the queen couldn’t help but panic: “Protect the prince, you must protect my prince!”
The imperial physician naturally knew how much the queen had paid for this pregnancy and did not dare to take it lightly.
“Don’t worry, Your Majesty. I will use all my medical skills to ensure the safety of Your Majesty and the prince.” The imperial physician said quickly, sweating profusely.
After hearing this, the queen felt relieved, but before she could say anything, the next wave of severe pain came like a tide.
“ah–!”
Since the Queen had used drugs during her pregnancy, the pregnancy and delivery were naturally extremely difficult. It lasted for almost a day and a night and it was still not over.
The queen went from struggling to hold on in the beginning to being on the verge of death now.
We can’t go on like this, if we continue like this we’re going to have big problems!
Just as the imperial physician outside was sweating profusely, he suddenly heard someone inside shouting, “Blood! Bleeding!”
The imperial physician’s vision immediately went dark.
After all, the Queen is the mother of a country, and he cannot afford to bear any consequences if something happens to her. If he delays any further, there will surely be two deaths. In this case, he might as well take the risk.
Soon, the imperial physician made a decision in his mind.
He quickly wrote a prescription and told the palace maids to hurry up and boil it. After it was boiled, the doctor brought it over. Without waiting for it to cool down, he asked someone to bring the bowl of medicine to the Empress.
After drinking a bowl of strong medicine, the Queen finally regained some strength.
She had always regarded this child as her only hope, so she held on and made an effort, and finally gave birth to the child.
He is indeed a prince.
But…why is this child silent?
The excitement faded away like the tide, and the midwife panicked when she came to her senses.
I don’t know if it’s because the baby has been holding the food in the stomach for too long, but I saw that the baby’s whole body was blue, and his skin was not as warm as that of a normal child, but instead was emitting bursts of coolness.
Especially the queen’s personal maid, whose eyes were filled with fear.
As if she had noticed something, the queen struggled to get up and asked, “What’s wrong, what’s wrong with the prince?”
As she moved, the blood from her body increased.
“Your Majesty, please wait a moment. I’ll be back soon.” The maid gritted her teeth and hurriedly handed the prince to the imperial physician behind the screen.
When the imperial physician saw the child’s current condition, he was suddenly shocked.
After she reacted, she immediately rubbed the prince’s back, while the remaining doctors quickly gave the queen acupuncture in the hope of stopping her bleeding.
Wake up, wake up!
If anything happens to the little prince, given the queen’s current persistence, they will probably all be buried with him.
The imperial physician’s prayers actually worked, and soon the little prince’s fingers moved, his body temperature gradually returned to normal, and the bruises on his body were not so severe.
The imperial physician saw that the little prince’s eyes seemed to open for a moment, but then quickly closed again due to exhaustion.
“Wow–“
After hearing this cry, the anxiety that everyone had been holding in their hearts finally let out. Everyone’s steps became unsteady, and they were almost exhausted after a day and night of hard work.
However, although the prince was saved, the queen’s condition was not very good.
…………
Five hours later, the queen learned from the imperial physician that because the medicine was too strong, she might not be able to have children again in this lifetime. What’s more, her life span would be shortened and she would suffer from various illnesses. She would have to take medicine for the rest of her life.
Even the queen couldn’t help but be stunned.
Looking at her son who was now sleeping soundly beside her, he was obviously much weaker than other healthy princes because he was premature. She didn’t know whether he could grow up.
If the baby cannot be raised, all my hard work will be in vain.
For a moment, the queen’s expression seemed to be both happy and sad.
On the other side, in Shangjing City, inside the Imperial Palace——
Emperor Jingwen did not express anything after receiving the news that the empress had given birth successfully, and his eyes were unusually cold. As an emperor, he naturally knew the whole process of the empress’s childbirth.
But this path was chosen by the Queen herself, so she has to walk it alone.
Following closely behind was Xiaojiu’s letter.
I inadvertently remembered the snowman picture he drew for me last time. What snowman picture? That was not a snowman picture at all. It was clearly just a blob of ink!
The corners of Emperor Jingwen’s mouth twitched slightly.
Judging from the news from the palace reported by the guards, the little bastard had most likely ignored his orders again.
He hasn’t done a single word of the homework assigned by him and the tutor.
After the imperial concubine gives birth, she will bring people back and then we will see what he will do!
Despite his disgust, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but open the letter.
I thought my son was showing off to me again what he ate and played in the palace, but when I opened the paper inside, I found that it was not the case at all.
This time, the little bastard’s letter was full of panic and fear.
He was frightened by the queen’s childbirth.
Compared to other princes who were always stronger and never willing to show it openly no matter how difficult or painful it was, Ye Shuo really said whatever he had in mind.
In his opinion, if you don’t say some things, the emperor will never think about them at all.
You should tell your cheap dad whatever you want to say, otherwise he won’t know anything at all.
Expecting my cheap dad to guess it himself is harder than climbing to the sky.
Emperor Jingwen vaguely remembered that the little bastard was just a child. Even though he was usually heartless, it didn’t mean he wouldn’t be afraid.
When a child is frightened or suffers, won’t he subconsciously come to look for his parents?
Originally, Emperor Jingwen did not think that it was a big deal for the imperial concubine to give birth to a child, but maybe because his son mentioned it too many times in his letters, he even wrote down whether the little princess kicked today, when she kicked, and what the fetal movement was like. Over time, Emperor Jingwen naturally understood something.
After Ye Shuo’s reminder, Emperor Jingwen suddenly frowned as he thought that if the imperial concubine was like this when she gave birth to a child.
By then, not only Xiaojiu will be scared, but the imperial concubine and the child will also be in trouble.
“Dad, it would be great if you were here right now.”
When Emperor Jingwen saw this sentence in the letter, he felt even more worried.
But there was no way, the imperial palace was too far away from the temporary palace, and Emperor Jingwen was powerless.
After the emperor read the letter from the Ninth Prince, although he didn’t say anything, he was unable to get into the mood for a long time. Wang Ziquan, who was standing by, couldn’t help but smack his lips.
Just like that, when Emperor Jingwen received the news that the imperial concubine was about to give birth more than a month later, he subconsciously tightened his hand holding the cup.
the other side.
The distance between the imperial palace and the temporary palace was long, so Ye Shuo sent someone to send the message out in advance. Almost as soon as he sent the message, his mother followed suit within a few days.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath, and his whole body tensed up like a wound-up spring.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Birth
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo stood in front of the door, his eyes hidden in panic were like a hawk, always paying attention to the people coming in and out, and paying attention to their various movements.
Everyone was in a panic when his mother was giving birth, and this is the easiest time for someone to take advantage of them, so he has to be careful.
If he was more alert at this moment, his mother might be safer.
Through the crack in the door, she saw her son standing there, his little face tense. The imperial concubine would probably never forget this scene for the rest of her life.
It is a great blessing to have such a son.
Therefore, even for the sake of the two children, the imperial concubine must never let anything happen to herself.
The next moment, severe pain came like a tide. Afraid that Ye Shuo would worry if he heard it, beads of sweat the size of soybeans rolled down her temples. The imperial concubine endured it and tried not to cry out.
The palace maids around him came and went, but Ye Shuo remained awake the whole time.
The more critical the moment, the more clear-headed Ye Shuo becomes.
Soon, a palace maid who looked very ordinary came over from the opposite side holding a copper basin of warm water.When she met the Ninth Prince’s eyes, she couldn’t help but feel a little flustered for some reason.
But then she thought that even though the Ninth Prince had a noble status, he was just a child, and she quickly calmed down.
Just when she couldn’t help but want to step inside, she heard the Ninth Prince suddenly say, “Wait a minute.”
The maid was startled, and then she heard him say, “What’s that thing on your waist? Bring it over to me and let me see it.”
“It’s just a sachet that I sewed myself.” The maid said while trying to remain calm.
“Your Highness, please forgive me. I am afraid I have to go first. The queen is still waiting for my hot water.”
The maid thought that the Ninth Prince would let her go after she said that, but she didn’t expect that he didn’t even think about it and winked at the eunuchs next to him. The eunuchs stepped forward and held her down without hesitation.
With a loud bang, the copper basin in the palace maid’s hand fell to the ground, and the hot water inside spilled all over the floor.
“Ninth Prince, what are you going to do, Ninth Prince——”
Afraid that the palace maid’s noise would alarm her mother inside, Ye Shuo directly asked the eunuch to cover her mouth.
“It’s none of your business, just do what you should do.” After being glanced at by the Ninth Prince, the remaining people who were still a little stunned suddenly started and quickly restored order.
When Concubine Rong first started the pain, Ye Shuo had people tie up the cuffs and trouser legs of the palace servants tightly, where they could hide things.
This was inspired by a small red pill that fell from the midwife’s sleeve when he was just born.
The rope wasn’t tied tightly, but it was tight enough to prevent the things inside from falling out.
In this case, if you want to smuggle contraband in, you can only do it out in the open.
Ye Shuo took off the sachet from the palace maid, put it to his nose and smelled it, carefully recalling the smells of various Chinese herbal medicines that he had smelled in the Imperial Hospital. After comparing them, his face changed slightly.
Until this moment, the palace maid was still fantasising that she could get through the danger.
She never expected that when the Ninth Prince studied medicine, it was really no joke, and he actually made some achievements in it.
Ye Shuo quickly handed the sachet to the imperial physician. After the physician smelled it, he was basically certain that there was something inside.
Even if this is the case, it doesn’t matter. After being discovered, as long as I say what I planned, I can still achieve my goal.
The palace maid was just about to speak, but the Ninth Prince didn’t even look at her and just had her taken away.
The Ninth Prince actually didn’t even bother to ask.
The palace maid was completely panicked upon seeing this.
But in fact, there is really no need to ask too much, because there are only a few people who are capable of reaching their hands into this.
“You stay here and I’ll go to the kitchen to take a look.”
After receiving the Ninth Prince’s instructions, Xiao Luzi straightened his back and said, “Yes, Your Highness.”
