With the example of the palace maid, the people who followed became much more obedient.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Ye Shuo came to the small kitchen.
The medicinal soup had just been boiled in the small kitchen and was about to be served to the imperial concubine. Ye Shuo took a look at the oil paper bag next to it and saw that the residue of the medicine was still there. He compared it carefully, and then compared it with the prescription written by the imperial physician before. After confirming that it was correct, Ye Shuo personally poured the medicine juice in the medicine bowl into the bowl.
“Are you sure no one was near you when you were boiling the medicine just now?”
The eunuch couldn’t help swallowing and said, “Yes, yes, Your Highness.”
That’s fine. If anything goes wrong, just come to him directly.
Ye Shuo did not ask anyone else to help him during the whole process of bringing the medicine. He walked all the way to the door of the delivery room and handed the bowl of medicine directly to Su Yue.
The whole process is seamless, and it is difficult for others to tamper with it.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help with childbirth, but apart from that, Ye Shuo would make sure his mother was safe no matter what.
the other side.
Over the past month, the queen has been worrying about her newborn prince.
The prince was already weak and could not withstand the slightest disturbance. The queen was afraid that someone would take advantage of the situation, so she could only drag her broken body to take care of him personally.
The queen knew what those people were doing and didn’t dare let the prince out of her sight.
Even if a wet nurse was feeding the baby, it had to be done under her nose.
As for babies, their sleep time is short and fragmented, and they cry from time to time. The queen has been exhausted since giving birth, and staying up all this time is even more harmful to her health.
However, despite this, the queen still did not dare to let go.
She now had no other way out and could only protect her son.
Fortunately, this baby was indeed a prince, which gave the queen some hope.
After the emperor learned that she had given birth, he didn’t even send anyone to ask about her. But the imperial concubine was fine, but the emperor sent people to express his condolences again and again, and occasionally asked people to bring some good things over, either the fresh fruits that were tributed this year, or some precious medicinal herbs.
Even though he is far away in the imperial palace, the emperor is still thinking about the imperial concubine in the temporary palace.
No matter how much Emperor Jingwen doted on the Imperial Concubine in the past, he had never done this before. In the past, Emperor Jingwen only rewarded the Imperial Concubine within the rules and gave the Empress the dignity she deserved.
But now Emperor Jingwen would not even consider these things, and he even took away the power to manage the six palaces from the Queen. His disgusted attitude could be seen by anyone.
However, the more this happened, the more the queen refused to turn back, because there was no way back. She had no other choice but to place all her hopes on the little prince alone.
As the saying goes, one wrong step leads to all wrong.
Therefore, nothing can happen to the little prince under any circumstances.
In contrast, the Queen’s hatred for Concubine Rong reached its peak, to the point where she wanted to kill her even though she knew she was pregnant with a princess.
Why, why can she have a baby without paying any price?
The Ninth Prince may seem absurd on weekdays, but he has deep feelings for the Imperial Concubine and is willing to put danger in front of him when encountering danger.
How many princes can do this? So even if the Ninth Prince is unlearned, others still envy the Imperial Concubine.
When she heard that the sable jumped out of the garden and was stopped in time by the Ninth Prince so that it did not hurt the imperial concubine, the Queen felt a mixture of emotions.
A thought even suddenly popped up in her mind: it would be better if the imperial concubine could die.
Because there is no logic that a concubine of lower rank can be a concubine of higher rank in Buyeo, if the imperial concubine dies, her two children will definitely fall into her hands.
Considering how favored the Ninth Prince is, His Majesty may change his mind.
With this in mind, the queen took action.
result…
As expected, all her plans fell through.
The people she found didn’t even have the chance to bring those filthy things into the delivery room, and they were all stopped outside the door.
After hearing this, the queen hated the imperial concubine and was jealous of her.
“Son, son, when you grow up, you must be upright and avenge your mother…” What kind of people are those people! How dare a bunch of lowly things act wildly in front of the dignified Queen!
The Queen’s fingers gently slid across the prince’s little face. Although she had a smile on her face, there was some madness in her eyes.
the other side.
Three hours later, Ye Shuo felt relieved when he heard the baby crying in the delivery room.
Soon, Nanny Jing came out holding the little princess.
“Your Highness, look, she really is a princess. The little princess is healthy and everything is fine.”
However, Ye Shuo’s focus was not on this at all: “Where is my mother? How is my mother?”
Nanny Jing was startled for a moment, then after she came to her senses, she smiled and said, “Look at me, this old slave, I almost got confused.”
“Replying to the Ninth Prince, the Imperial Concubine is also doing well.”
Ye Shuo almost fainted after hearing this: “As long as you are safe, as long as you are safe.”
If Ye Shuo had that ability now, he would want to kill his adoptive father.
After a moment, Ye Shuo finally set his eyes on the little princess in the cradle, and then he was startled.
“Why is it so ugly???”
Ye Shuo finally understood why his mother disliked him so much back then.
“Why is this head flat?” It’s all over, it’s all over, my stepfather and mom are the first to be flat and then flat, what should I do?
Seeing that the Ninth Prince was so disgusted that he didn’t even want to touch the princess, he was exactly the same as the Empress did back then. Nanny Jing couldn’t help laughing and repeated what she said back then.
“The little princess’s head was accidentally pinched when she was born. Your Highness, don’t worry. She will gradually grow better. Judging from her facial features alone, the little princess will definitely look good in the future.”
The head is so pointy, can it really become round at the back?
Ye Shuo expressed his disbelief and continued to shake his head like a rattle.
“No, no, no, don’t let her get close to me. Wait until she looks good and then show her to me.”
The imperial concubine, who was feeling a little weak after giving birth, couldn’t help but laugh and cry when she heard the noise.
Although his sister was a little ugly, she was his mother’s biological daughter after all. Just based on the three words “biological sister”, Ye Shuo did not let down his guard in the next few days.
The imperial concubine gave birth to a child, but in the end, the ninth prince was exhausted.
By the time Ye Shuo began to relax, nearly half a month had passed.
He suddenly remembered that he seemed to have forgotten something…
Slapping his head, Ye Shuo hurriedly called Xing Yucheng over.
On the other side, the imperial palace, the Qinzheng Hall.
The longer it had passed since Xiaojiu’s last letter, the longer Emperor Jingwen would be concerned about her.
There has been no news for such a long time, could something have happened?
It was fine when he was dealing with government affairs, but once he had free time, Emperor Jingwen would inevitably think so.
He waited and waited like this, and more than half a month had passed before Emperor Jingwen received the letter that Xiaojiu had asked someone to bring back.
When he saw the news that the imperial concubine and her daughter were safe, even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Then, when he learned that it was not an accident but that Xiaojiu had forgotten him, Emperor Jingwen’s face suddenly turned dark again.
Only he can do such a thing!
Just when Emperor Jingwen was extremely angry, he accidentally turned to the last page and was caught off guard by the abstract painting drawn by his son.
In order to let his stepfather see the little princess’s appearance for the first time and make him feel more involved, Ye Shuo specially changed to charcoal pencil this time, and the pattern he drew was both realistic and clear.
However, even in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, it was still very abstract.
After all, which child has a pointy head?

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Premeditation
chapters.content:
After all, the emperor is not present when every child is born, especially when the mother is of low status.
As for concubines of high rank like Concubine Shu, when they gave birth, the emperor would just take a quick look and that was it.
The only ones that Emperor Jingwen really looked at carefully from beginning to end were the children who had died in infancy, as well as the surviving eldest prince, princess, and crown prince.
More than 20 years have passed, and the memory of the deceased child is now vague. Emperor Jingwen still remembers the eldest prince, the eldest princess, and the crown prince, but these three children were all quite upright when they were born.
No matter how ugly a newborn baby is, how can it be this ugly?
So when the crown prince arrived, Emperor Jingwen didn’t think much about it and just smiled and talked about this with him.
“Come and take a look at Xiaojiu’s painting skills.”
He thought the prince would definitely laugh with him, but when Emperor Jingwen turned his head, he met the prince’s slightly strange look.
The prince hesitated for a while, not knowing whether he should say it or not, but in the end, he still said it.
“Well, father, Xiaojiu didn’t lie this time. A newborn baby is indeed… like this.” As for why the prince was so experienced, it was of course because the concubine’s son was born recently. The prince took a look and saw that the shape of the child’s head was also very irregular, but not as deformed as the little princess’s.In other words, the little princess…really looks like this.
The smile on Emperor Jingwen’s face gradually froze.
Oh my god, if this is what a princess looks like…
Looking down at the painting again, Emperor Jingwen imagined it and felt sick.
Seeing Emperor Jingwen’s behaviour, the crown prince beside him hurriedly comforted him, “Don’t worry, father. Children’s bones are soft and they will grow up in the future.”
“…Are you serious?”
Under normal circumstances, the prince would definitely answer, and of course he would mean it seriously.
But unfortunately, the little princess’s head was too pointy. If it was really like what was shown in the painting, the prince couldn’t be sure.
Xiaojiu is really something, why does he have to be so honest? If the little princess in the future remembers things, how embarrassing it will be for a girl!
The other concubines would try their best to show the good points of their children and hide their bad points for fear that others would see their shortcomings. This was especially true when it came to their father, the emperor, who would praise them to the utmost.
But Xiaojiu was different. Not only did he not cover it up, he almost pointed it out to them.
The father and son looked at each other and almost held their foreheads at the same time.
the other side.
After waiting for a long time until the princess was one month old, Ye Shuo went to take a look and found that although the princess was not as beautiful as the maids said, she was still pretty enough. So he reluctantly looked at her a few more times.
As for the most worrying part, the head, now a month has passed, has recovered a little and is finally not as deformed as it was at the beginning.
“It’s been a month, how come it’s only recovered to this point?” Can the condition really be completely reversed before the child’s skull hardens?
Ye Shuo expressed great concern.
Ye Shuo used to think that he was not obsessed with looks, until now he realised that it was not that he was not obsessed with looks, but that everyone around him was good-looking, so he didn’t feel anything.
To be honest, Ye Shuo was a little uncomfortable with the sudden appearance of an ugly thing.
The nanny at the side saw that the Ninth Prince was so worried that his facial features were squeezed together, and she was so happy that she couldn’t even stand up. She answered the Ninth Prince for the umpteenth time: “The princess has fair skin, small nose wings, a round and full nose bridge, and a pair of almond eyes like the queen. She will definitely have a good future.”
“…Okay.” The nanny saw beauty in everything, so whatever she said was the truth.
Ye Shuo quickly gave up arguing.
Now his mother has finished her confinement and is now recovering from childbirth under the guidance of the imperial physician and the nanny. Watching his mother walking back and forth in the room, Ye Shuo sat down.
Suddenly remembering something, Ye Shuo asked, “By the way, mother, has my sister’s name been chosen yet?”
Except for the eldest princess, few other princesses were given names by the emperor. Most of them were chosen by the ladies themselves, so Ye Shuo asked this question.
Speaking of this, Concubine Rong became very conflicted.
After all, she had not read much, and naming a princess required special care. The name had to sound nice, have a good meaning, and appear cultured, so that people could tell at a glance that this was an extremely noble and beautiful woman. This put the imperial concubine in a difficult position.
The imperial concubine has been struggling with this for almost a month now, and still hasn’t made up her mind.
“How about… asking your father to pick one for her?”
It was obvious that the imperial concubine knew that she was favoured. It was just a name, and she never thought that the emperor would refuse.
The reality is indeed like this. If the imperial concubine asks for it, my stepfather will have to give her some face.
However, giving face does not mean doing your best. Giving a princess a random name and choosing one from a dictionary are two completely different concepts.
Ye Shuo thought about it and said, “Okay, leave it to me.”
Ye Shuo was particularly adept at dealing with his cheap father, and the key was that he could make his cheap father unaware of it.
As for the nickname——
“How about calling you Jianjian as your nickname?” Ye Shuo asked with a blink of his eyes.
The imperial concubine was stunned: “Jianjian?”
What is this name? It sounds weird.
“Why is it called Jianjian?”
Ye Shuo didn’t even think twice and said without hesitation: “Because her head is pointy.”
The head is pointy, so I’m called Jianjian. Is that wrong? No, it’s not wrong!
The moment the words fell, almost everyone in the room fell silent.
Even the imperial concubine couldn’t help sweating, “Shuo’er, this…isn’t this too hasty?”
“What’s the big deal?” In his previous life, a certain emperor was called Little Pig, but it didn’t affect his fame at all, didn’t it?
“A cheap name is easier to keep, so let’s call her Jianjian.”
In the end, Ye Shuo made the final decision.
Concubine Rong: “…”
Concubine Rong couldn’t help but look at her daughter with pity, and then she realised that leaving her daughter to be raised by her son was not a good decision.
But there was no way, she had already agreed, and it was too late to regret now.
I really hope my daughter will never know the origin of her nickname…
After Ye Shuo returned, he decisively asked Xing Yucheng to help him write a letter.
Xing Yuben thought he had become numb, but after listening to the Ninth Prince’s narration, he still inevitably felt shocked.
“Really… want to write it like this??”
Ye Shuo nodded: “Write yours, don’t worry about the rest.”
Xing Yucheng no longer dared to imagine the emperor’s expression after reading this letter.
On the other hand, Emperor Jingwen soon received another letter sent by Xiaojiu.
As he watched, Emperor Jingwen’s blood pressure began to rise.
This kid is like this, he can make people mad even if they are thousands of miles away.
Look at what names he gave the princess!
The prince couldn’t help but secretly glance at the letter. Just one glance made the prince silent on the spot.
Ye Mei, Ye Zhen, Ye Zhu, Ye Baoer, Ye Fugui… These are the names ordinary families give their children. There is absolutely nothing wrong with using names to express good wishes for children, but this is a bit too vulgar!
If you hope that the princess will become beautiful in the future, you can call her Mei. If you hope that the princess will be as precious as a pearl, you can call her Zhen, Zhu, Baoer. And this Fugui…
The prince couldn’t hold it in and laughed out loud.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
How come his son seems to have never been to school? If he had learned a few words, he wouldn’t have been able to come up with such a name.
Oh, I suddenly forgot that this son really didn’t receive much education.
Especially at the end of the letter, the little bastard was still smug and was ready to pick one from here as the princess’s name.
It would take several days to walk from the temporary palace to the imperial palace. If he didn’t hurry up, given his son’s temper, he would really call the princess Ye Mei.
After taking a deep breath, Emperor Jingwen waved his hand and said, “Come here, bring paper and pen!”
Emperor Jingwen, who was always casual in naming his children, was unusually serious about it.
After pondering for a long time, Emperor Jingwen began to write, and soon, three big characters appeared on the rice paper in front of him.
Ye Chen Hei.
The peach tree is young and lush with leaves. The character “熙” symbolises the dawn, which means bright and hot.
“Zhen Xi” has the same pronunciation as “Zhen Xi”, which means “cherish”, so Emperor Jingwen put more effort into choosing this name than most other princes.
It seems that the emperor is really disgusted with Xiaojiu’s naming skills.
The prince was startled at first, then he burst out laughing.
“Go and make sure to hand these words to the Ninth Prince.”
In this way, the messenger arrived at the palace at full speed.
Zhenxi…
It’s just barely okay.
“I don’t think it sounds as nice as Ye Baoer.” Baoer Baoer, down-to-earth and easy to pronounce, what a great name.
Fortunately, there were not many examinations in ancient times, otherwise the princess’s efficiency would be much lower than others just based on these two words.
Ye Shuo sighed.
Xing Yucheng, who was standing by, was about to speak but stopped talking, full of confusion. How could His Majesty have the nerve to think that the name he chose was better than the one chosen by His Majesty?
And… judging from the way the two characters “Zhen Xi” were written, His Majesty must have been very angry at the time…
Looking at the two words that were so powerful that they could be seen through the paper, Xing Yucheng silently wiped the sweat from his forehead.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t care about that and turned around to announce the news to his sister.
“From today on, Jianjian, your full name will be Ye Zhen xi.” She is treated the same as the eldest prince, the second prince and the crown prince, and is unique among the princesses.
Ye Shuo reached out and gently touched the princess’s little face, then spoke with a smile.
“Are you happy? Are you happy?”
The little baby girl didn’t understand any of this, she just felt very uncomfortable that the person in front of her was always fiddling with her, and she kept whining but couldn’t resist, it was so suffocating.
Before the princess burst into tears, Ye Shuo withdrew his claws contentedly.
The wet nurse at the side lowered her head tactfully, angry but not daring to say anything.
The queen almost crushed the spoon in her hand when she received the news.
The princess was just one month old and had not yet returned to the palace, but the emperor had already given her a name and had her sent to him at full speed. In comparison, the prince she had given birth to was already a hundred days old, but the emperor had not even asked a single question. The contrast was so stark, how could the queen not hate him?
Zhenxi… cherish…
These two words were like a stab into the Queen’s heart.
But what else could she do? The queen could only watch helplessly.
The only thing the queen could do was to return to the palace earlier.
She had already been disliked by the emperor. If she didn’t return to the palace soon, she would have no place to stand in the palace.
As for the imperial concubine…I’m afraid she won’t be able to stay here for too long.
His Majesty has no intention of coming to the garden again this year, so she will definitely go back early.
Thinking of this, the queen suddenly had an idea in her mind.
In this way, in July, the Queen proposed to leave. Now the little prince is half a year old. If she was careful, he could be moved, not to mention that there were so many imperial doctors accompanying him.
Although the little princess was only a hundred days old, she was in good health and could already lift her head. The imperial concubine thought about it and did not refuse.
However, when the day of departure approached, news suddenly came that the queen was ill, but the imperial concubine had already packed her things several days ago.
Now that the house has been emptied, it is really troublesome to go back and forth to clean it up.
“Forget it, forget it. If the Queen doesn’t want to leave, let’s go first.” It’s only July now and the weather is not that hot. By August or September, it will be so hot on the road that people will die.
The imperial concubine didn’t think so much about it at all, she just felt that the queen was really pretentious.
She was clearly incapable of taking it, but she still insisted on going back. Now she is feeling better, and she has made herself sick. I don’t know why she was so anxious.
After the eunuch beside the queen finished delivering the message, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frown as he looked at the other person’s back.
Something is wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Return to the Palace
chapters.content:
It’s not that Ye Shuo necessarily wants to throw dirty water on the Queen. In the absence of evidence, it’s not easy for Ye Shuo to insist that there’s something wrong with the Queen.
He just felt that it was not safe to go back alone.
It is known that when my cheap father left last year, he only took 200 people with him, and now there are still 800 guards left in the garden.
The number eight hundred seems like a lot by itself, but it’s not the same thing if you break it down.
No matter how precious a concubine is, she cannot compare to the queen. No matter how unfavored the queen is, she is still the queen.
It is impossible to say that half of the eight hundred people will be assigned to each position. Most of them will have to stay to protect the queen. The departure date is approaching, and it is too late to temporarily transfer guards from the imperial city.
Therefore, the most likely possibility is that his mother took 300 people back to the capital, leaving 500 people to continue guarding the palace. This distribution seems reasonable on the surface.
But if there are only 300 people, it is actually not enough.
Although we are on the official road, there will basically be no foolish people who will cause trouble, but it is better to be safe than sorry.
If they encounter any unexpected situation on the road, such as an assassination, three hundred people are too scarce and cannot withstand a wave of attacks.By then, if a dozen skilled fighters were properly ambushed and focused on rushing towards the carriage, there would still be a good chance of success.
After the division, the troops were weak, and Ye Shuo suggested that they would rather wait a little longer than take the risk.
But he never told his mother about this kind of thing, so Ye Shuo just pulled his mother’s sleeve and said, “Since the Queen is not leaving, then we won’t leave either, okay?”
Anyway, no matter what, it is imperative to walk with the Queen. It is so safe to be with eight hundred guards.
It can also prevent the Queen from taking action, thus reducing a level of danger.
The little prince was weak and could not stand being tossed around, so even if the empress and his mother did not get along, they would not do it when the little prince was present. The empress could not bear any harm to the little prince.
Concubine Rong couldn’t help but feel a little embarrassed when she heard this: “But Shuo’er, everything has been packed.”
She loved luxury the most, and she had the most things in the palace. It was extremely troublesome to move them back and forth. It took the palace servants seven or eight days to finish sorting them out.
When the imperial concubine thought of this, she couldn’t help but hesitate.
Ye Shuo doesn’t care about that. Trouble is always better than danger.
Ye Shuo immediately used his trump card: “Mom, when I go back this time, my father will definitely force me to study again, so please let me have some fun.”
It’s because the Queen is ill, not because they don’t want to leave. What a great opportunity to buy time.
Thinking of this, Concubine Rong couldn’t help but feel a little soft-hearted.
After struggling for a moment, she said helplessly: “…That’s fine.”
“Thank you, mother!” Ye Shuo was so excited that he gave the imperial concubine a big hug, then disappeared in a flash.
Recently Ye Shuo discovered a new recreational activity – boating.
Just get a small boat, cover it with thick straw and a quilt, lie down in it, and let the boat drift in the lake. It’s so comfortable.
Xing Yucheng, who was standing by, looked hopeless when he saw this.
The Ninth Prince has been playing for a whole year, why doesn’t he feel bored yet?
The other companions thought their lives were easy, that all they had to do was play with him every day, but who knew how anxious he was when he couldn’t learn anything!
Looking at her son’s cheerful back until he disappeared, the imperial concubine laughed and shook her head: “This child.”
There is no other way. What else can I do? I can only move back the things I moved out.
When the queen heard the news, she almost broke her teeth.
She had already arranged all the things on her side, but unexpectedly, the imperial concubine didn’t want to leave!
The queen had thought before that if she changed her mind at the last minute, more than half of the eight hundred guards would have to stay, and the remaining half would not be a concern.
After all, most of the Black Armor Guards are guards of commoner origin. They all waited until they were almost adults to start practicing martial arts, so how capable could they be now?
It’s totally incomparable to the masters who have been trained in the family since childhood.
Among the real aristocratic families, which one doesn’t have some background?
The number three hundred sounds like a lot, but that’s just the way it is.
The queen had even sent out the letter, and now the imperial concubine’s behaviour was like a wake-up call to her.
With the imperial concubine’s impatient temper, she would definitely leave once she had made the decision. When she suddenly found out that she was sick and couldn’t return, she would inevitably say a few sarcastic words behind her back, mocking her for her weak body, and then leave triumphantly in front of her.
How come it changes so suddenly now?
The queen looked depressed, so she had to send someone to inquire about her.
As it turned out, it was the Ninth Prince who was clamouring and shouting that he had not had enough fun and insisted on staying.
This Ninth Prince!
After hearing the eunuch’s description, the queen almost vomited blood.
She never expected that her well-planned plan would fail because of her child’s love of play.
They all forgot that if the Ninth Prince seized this opportunity, he would definitely not come back.
At this time the queen still held out a glimmer of hope, thinking that the imperial concubine should not indulge the ninth prince so unlimitedly. As a result, she waited and waited, and a whole month passed. The ninth prince refused to leave even though she did not mention anything, and the imperial concubine did not care at all.
How could there be someone in the world who is a mother like this? !
There was really no way to delay it any longer, and the queen had no choice but to announce the news of her “recovery”.
Alas, happy times are always so short…
It would be better if the Queen could stay “sick” for a little longer…
Upon hearing this sad news, Ye Shuo felt terrible.
Xing Yucheng, who was standing by, heaved a sigh of relief and was extremely grateful to the Queen.
Finally leaving!
On the day of departure, to be on the safe side, Ye Shuo arrived early at the carriage that her mother would be riding in.
Check every part of the carriage from beginning to end.
Seeing that neither the wheel tracks nor the carriages showed any signs of tampering, Ye Shuo heaved a sigh of relief.
Ok, it looks safe.
He stretched out his hands and shook a few important parts. Seeing that the upper parts were not shaking as they should be, he felt relieved and crawled out from under the car body.
Concubine Rong, who happened to be there, was immediately frightened by her cat-like son.
“Shuo’er!”
“Oh my God, hurry up, Xiao Luzi, take him back and change him into clean clothes!”
It’s just a little dirt on my body, it shouldn’t be so exaggerated…
Seeing his mother’s face full of disgust, Ye Shuo could only go back and change his clothes reluctantly.
When Ye Shuo came out after washing his hands and feet, he looked up and saw the wet nurse holding his younger sister Jianjian.
Now, the little Princess Jianjian is almost four months old and can roll over. Every time she rolls over, she raises her head high. It can be seen that she is a strong-willed child.
However, every time when she was about to turn over, Ye Shuo would flip her back, making all the efforts of Princess Jianjian go to waste.
The little princess knew nothing now and could only struggle with his hand foolishly. Ye Shuo never got tired of it every time, and would not stop until Princess Jianjian was so tired that she could no longer get up. Only then would Ye Shuo be satisfied and stop.
Xiaoluzi, who was standing next to him, could hardly bear to watch it anymore and felt that the Ninth Prince had a really bad temper and even spared no children!
Oh, I forgot, the Ninth Prince treated the little grandson of the emperor like this too, making him cry in anger every time. Now it seems that he is not any better to his own sister.
Poor Princess Jianjian…
After four months of recovery, the little princess’s head finally became normal. She was now white and plump, and no longer had the ugly look before. Only then did Ye Shuo reluctantly reach out and hug her.
Jianjian is okay, an angel baby. All she does every day is eat and sleep, and she doesn’t make much trouble. Otherwise, Ye Shuo would really run as far away as possible.
After Ye Shuo held her in his arms, she didn’t react much. She looked dull and stupid, like a little fool.
Before, Ye Shuo suspected that there might be something wrong, so he secretly asked the imperial physician.
The old doctor was silenced immediately by the question. After the old doctor explained, Ye Shuo finally understood that a child of this age would not make trouble, so she naturally looked stupid. It did not mean that the little princess had any brain problems.
Only then did Ye Shuo feel relieved.
When the Ninth Prince stretched out his hand to ask for the child, the wet nurse subconsciously glanced at the Imperial Concubine next to him. The Ninth Prince was only a few years old. What if he bumped into the princess?
But the imperial concubine nodded, and the nurse let go.
Ye Shuo was very strong, and the baby’s summer clothes were thin, so he didn’t have to exert much effort.
Just when Ye Shuo was playing with his sister, the Queen and her entourage finally arrived.
“Greetings to Her Majesty the Queen, may Her Majesty be blessed with good fortune.”
“Well, get up.”
The queen quickly noticed Ye Shuo and the little princess as her eyes slid around.
As expected of a military general, she is in good health, with two consecutive children being so strong. If the princess’s physique were exchanged with her son’s, everything would be fine.
Thinking of her frail son, the queen couldn’t help but feel heartbroken.
The Queen had no intention of greeting the Imperial Concubine and was even afraid that the Imperial Concubine would laugh at her. She straightened her back and stepped into the carriage with the help of others.
But in fact, the imperial concubine was not that careful and would not pay attention to whether her waist was straight.
A gust of wind blew by, and Ye Shuo smelled a faint scent of medicine in the air.
Looking at the little prince born by the queen, he is now seven months old and so weak that he cannot even be held upright. His bones are not that hard, and if he is held upright for a long time, he will become limp and can hardly sit still in an adult’s arms.
It is already midsummer, but he is still wrapped in swaddling clothes, for fear that he will catch a cold in the wind.
The imperial concubine had only heard that the little prince was not in good health before, but today was the first time she saw him, and she was inevitably shocked.
When they got into the carriage, the imperial concubine couldn’t hold back and whispered, “I really don’t know what the queen is trying to do.”
Is it really worth it to ruin your body for the sake of having a child, but the child turns out not to be very healthy?
The Queen’s family background was not much worse than hers, she was also the legitimate daughter of a prominent family. She was completely different from other concubines who needed children. For them, having children was just icing on the cake and was really not necessary.
Even if the queen doesn’t give birth to a child, she is still the queen. Even if she doesn’t give birth to a child, she is still the imperial concubine. There is really no difference.
Therefore, the imperial concubine had not been pregnant and had not used any medicine for many years after entering the palace. Her parents and brother doted on her at home. A favoured girl would always be more pampered. If the two children had not come on their own, there would really be no other way. Imperial Concubine Rong might not have been able to endure this hardship.
Although both children are very cute, Guifei still felt that pregnancy and childbirth were a nightmare.
If possible, she hopes that Shuo’er and Jianjian will be the only children in her life.
The absence of a prince did not affect her competition with the queen, and the imperial concubine did not feel that she was weak, so she could not understand why the queen was so obsessed with the issue of offspring. Wouldn’t it be better for her to be nicer?
Ye Shuo could guess some of it, most likely she was unwilling to accept it.
As the saying goes, those who are involved in the situation are often the most confused. Once people are deeply involved in the situation, it is difficult to see clearly.
I just hope that this prince who is finally born can grow up safely. Otherwise, I don’t know what the queen who has staked her entire fortune on him will do.
As long as the little prince is alive, even if he is not qualified to participate in the competition, he can at least leave a glimmer of hope for the queen.
As long as people have hope, they will not go to extremes.
But this possibility is really small. The little prince is now the only bargaining chip of the queen. In this case, how can the little prince live comfortably in the future…
Based on the relationship between the imperial concubine and the queen, Ye Shuo should be happy, but he really couldn’t be happy.
After all, children are innocent.
In this palace, children are no longer children.
The same goes for Concubine Rong. If it were before, she would definitely laugh at the Queen for paying such a huge price only to give birth to a sickly child. But now that she has children of her own, she doesn’t want to use the children as a weapon to attack the Queen.
“Forget it, forget it. Seeing how terrible she is now, I won’t bother with her.”
The imperial concubine suddenly felt a little bored.
Out of consideration for the little prince’s health, the team took seven days to reach Shangjing City, which was supposed to be a three-day journey.
Emperor Jingwen was busy at that time and did not show up in person, he just sent someone to pick him up.
Ye Shuo didn’t care. His stepfather had been like this for a long time. But if he had to speak harshly, he had to let him see it, right?
Just like that, Ye Shuo held the little princess in his arms and went straight to the Qinzheng Palace.
At that time, Emperor Jingwen was discussing state affairs with his ministers. Not long after the meeting ended and everyone had not yet dispersed, he heard a familiar voice coming from outside.
“Father, father, are you here? Look what your son has brought you!”
Emperor Jingwen and all the ministers were stunned for a moment, and soon they watched the Ninth Prince coming over with something in his hands.
Maybe it was a little heavy, so he had to hold his strength to carry the thing in when he crossed the threshold.
After seeing clearly what the so-called thing was, Emperor Jingwen stood up with a “whoosh”.

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Urgent
chapters.content:
At first, when everyone heard the Ninth Prince’s voice and saw how excited he was, they subconsciously thought that he had brought back some local specialties for His Majesty.
Everyone started to wonder at the same time, what local specialties could be found in the temporary palace?
When they looked closely, it turned out to be a baby.
The little baby girl was about four or five months old. She was being held precariously in the young Ninth Prince’s arms. The Ninth Prince looked exhausted, as if he would collapse in the next moment and drop the little baby girl.
Calculating the date and looking at the baby girl’s clothes and appearance, if nothing unexpected happens, she should be the daughter that the imperial concubine just gave birth to.
Wait…a daughter born to the imperial concubine?
Isn’t that the little princess? ? The ninth prince’s biological sister? ? ?
The ministers turned around suddenly, only to see that the emperor had stood up at some point, pushed away his chair, and was walking towards the Ninth Prince with big strides.
“Xiaojiu, don’t move!” Normally, Emperor Jingwen would not be so nervous, but this was the first time he saw his child in danger in person.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t just ignore what he saw, so he subconsciously stopped the scene and said, “Put the princess down quickly!”Emperor Jingwen gave this order out of fear that he would accidentally drop the child again.
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo, who was rushing towards this side like a cannonball, suddenly stopped, and the little baby girl in his arms shook. Everyone’s heart suddenly rose to their throat.
The crown prince couldn’t help but worry about his young sister.
Seeing the Ninth Prince standing still, everyone’s hearts also settled down.
By the way, if I heard correctly just now, my cheap dad was asking me to put the child down, right?
Ye Shuo did not hesitate and put the pointed little princess on the ground.
As expected, Emperor Jingwen, who seldom picked up a child, took two or three steps forward and without thinking twice, he simply reached out and picked up the child from the ground.
After realising what was happening, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but glare at his son.
The ground is so cold, isn’t he afraid that the little princess will catch a cold? ?
That’s right, he’s just a kid, he knows shit!
The next moment, Ye Shuo seemed to be not satisfied and repeated what he said when he came here. He looked so excited, as if he was introducing a new toy: “Father, father, look! Your son has brought you something good.”
Under normal circumstances, seeing that the little bastard was thinking about him so much, Emperor Jingwen would feel relieved to some extent, but now…
Emperor Jingwen didn’t understand how he could describe the little princess as a local specialty. At first, Emperor Jingwen thought that he was bringing back a local specialty for him, and then he kept asking him to take a look!
It must be said that Emperor Jingwen still missed the little bastard a lot after not seeing him for nearly a year. He always felt that the palace was too quiet without him around.
On the other hand, the little bastard not only doesn’t think about me, but also isn’t very punctual in writing letters. He often forgets about writing while playing, and only suddenly remembers to write back to me when he’s tired of playing.
When Emperor Jingwen received a letter, it was usually ten days or half a month later, and sometimes he didn’t even receive a reply.
When he heard the little bastard’s voice coming from outside the Qinzheng Hall just now, Emperor Jingwen admitted that he was still a little happy.
But now… the feeling of happiness faded away like the tide in an instant, and that familiar headache came to my heart again.
Seeing that he had given him such a big “surprise” just after returning, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel sad.
Taking a deep breath, Emperor Jingwen stated the fact as calmly as possible: “Shuo’er, this is your sister, not your new toy.”
Ye Shuo also looked innocent: “But I promised my mother that I would take good care of my sister, and she agreed.”
And that’s how he took care of me???
The same thought flashed through the minds of everyone, including Emperor Jingwen.
Emperor Jingwen even said it directly: “Is this how you take care of your sister?”
Ye Shuo looked even more innocent when he heard this: “What’s wrong? Is there something wrong?”
He actually had the nerve to ask!
Emperor Jingwen was about to get angry, but when he looked down, he saw the little princess looking arrogant and blowing bubbles to herself.
A four-month-old baby does not have any concept of playing. As long as it is not at night or he is looking for milk or is not holding someone he particularly dislikes, he basically does not care who is holding him, even if the person suddenly changes.
(As per law, ‘he’ word includes ‘she’ also – those law students can relate it….)
Seeing that his cheap father was speechless, Ye Shuo seemed to be adding fuel to the fire: “Look, she is quite good.”
At this moment, everyone in the Qinzheng Hall fell silent.
Seeing that the time was almost up, Ye Shuo spoke up in time: “Father, you have been holding her for a long time. Please return Jianjian to me. I want to show her to Empress Zhao and the others.”
More than a year had passed, but Ye Shuo had not forgotten the three ladies in the palace.
This is a real princess, not a tool for him to show off!
The ministers remained silent. Emperor Jingwen was stunned for a moment but then grasped the key point: “Jianjian?”
“Why is it Jianjian?” Didn’t he already name the princess?
“It’s just a nickname.” As if seeing his stepfather’s confusion, Ye Shuo waved his hand nonchalantly.
Until now, Emperor Jingwen still had a glimmer of hope for his son, so he opened his mouth: “Heart’s Jianjian?”
“No, Father, what are you thinking about? Of course, your head is sharp.”
Ministers: “…”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously looked at the little princess’s head, and when he saw that it was round instead of pointed, he breathed a sigh of relief.
While he was stunned, Ye Shuo had already reached out to hug his sister.
But how could Emperor Jingwen trust him with the child? He turned around subconsciously and raised his arm subconsciously.
Ye Shuo was not discouraged after his hand came up empty-handed. He continued to chase his cheap father and asked: “Father, father, please give my sister to me.”
In this way, all the ministers watched helplessly as one tried to reach it on tiptoe, while the other raised his arm and refused to give it.
The ministers said it was too noisy and they left one after another.
As a result, after leaving the Qinzheng Hall, they could still hear the noisy voices from a long distance away.
The ministers sincerely rejoiced that it was not their own son, but born to the emperor. Let the emperor worry about it himself!
Soon, perhaps because he was anxious, Ye Shuo blurted out: “This is my sister, my biological sister!”
Hearing him talking about this, Emperor Jingwen laughed immediately: “I am her father, and also her biological father.” In terms of closeness, isn’t she ranked higher than him, her elder brother?
As if he hadn’t expected him to say this, Ye Shuo was dumbfounded.
“But I was clearly here first! Father, please give my sister back to me!”
It’s really a child’s temper. Sometimes first come first served is not that important.
Emperor Jingwen then said calmly: “But now, your sister is in my hands.”
…Wow, why does this line sound weird?
Ye Shuo paused strangely, and seeing that things were hopeless, he finally said viciously “Don’t bully the young and poor”, and walked out of the Qinzheng Hall angrily.
When he came, he was holding his little sister in his arms, but when he left, his hands were empty.
After figuring out what he meant by “Don’t despise the young and poor”, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but laugh and cry.
“This Xiaojiu…”
The entire Qinzheng Hall quickly fell silent after Ye Shuo left. Emperor Jingwen still had other things to deal with, and originally wanted to hand the little princess over to Wang Ziquan, but he found that the little princess was very obedient and barely made a sound.
Emperor Jingwen thought about it, and finally put the little princess on his lap.
The prince beside him: “…”
Never mind, it’s not the first time anyway.
After a while, Wang Ziquan hesitated for a long time, and finally couldn’t help but remind him: “Your Majesty, the little princess is less than five months old now, she can’t sit for a long time.”
It turns out there is such a thing.
It happened that Emperor Jingwen was exhausted from reviewing memorials, so he simply picked up the little princess and walked around the hall twice.
Wang Ziquan knew that he was shocked and didn’t need to say more, and then he couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
With these two children, the imperial concubine will have no worries in the future.
On the other side, after seeing his son wandering around, the big, pointed thing in his arms disappeared just like that.
However, out of trust in her son, the imperial concubine did not think much about it and just asked casually, “Where is Jianjian?”
In the past, the imperial concubine looked down on this nickname, but now she has gradually gotten used to it.
Ye Shuo shrugged: “I kept her in the Qinzheng Palace.”
The imperial concubine couldn’t help but be stunned when she heard this.
Qinzheng Palace? ?
“Shuo’er, you are really something. How could you throw Jianjian there?” The imperial concubine had never heard that the emperor could take care of a child. Subconsciously, she thought that her son was forced upon the emperor, so she glared at her son angrily.
“Forget it, I’ll just go and bring her back…”
Seeing that his mother had obviously misunderstood, Ye Shuo hurriedly stopped her: “Don’t.”
Ye Shuo felt wronged: “What do you mean I forced it? It was obviously my father who refused to give Jian Jian back to me.”
Your Majesty, he… don’t want to return? ?
How come the imperial concubine knew the meaning of all the words, but was confused when they were combined.
The imperial concubine was sceptical: “Really?”
Ye Shuo nodded affirmatively: “Really.”
At this moment, the imperial concubine seemed to be dreaming.
It was not until the evening that Emperor Jingwen personally sent the little princess back and had dinner at Qiuwu Palace.
The imperial concubine subconsciously checked with her eyes, and her daughter’s limbs were still intact, and she was actually fine!
If Emperor Jingwen knew that in the imperial concubine’s heart, he, as a father, was not as reliable as Xiaojiu, I wonder how he would feel.
Unfortunately, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know.
Upon hearing the news, even though the concubines had always said that they were numb to it, they were still shocked.
The imperial concubine is truly blessed to have given birth to such a pair of children, and yet each of them is more favoured than the other. Isn’t that infuriating?
However, Ye Shuo didn’t care about that. The most important thing was to strive for more benefits.
Emperor Jingwen thought that he was extremely son-centric. When it comes to son-centricity, who could compare to the feudal emperors?
In the past, Emperor Jingwen never believed that a princess could surpass a prince. A princess would be married sooner or later, and the prince was the future of the Great Zhou and would inherit the bloodline of the Ye family. It was natural that a prince was more valuable than a princess.
However, despite this, when Emperor Jingwen saw the scene of Xiaojiu and Jianjian getting along, he finally couldn’t hold it anymore.
You really can’t bully people like this!
As a brother, it would be fine if he didn’t protect his sister, but how could he be like him? How could he do this?
Jianjian is only a few months old!
Just like that, with Ye Shuo habitually putting his hand on the little princess’s back, no matter how hard the little princess tried, she couldn’t turn over smoothly. She could only scratch on the quilt like a little turtle. Ye Shuo was so happy.
As a result, before he could even laugh a few times, Emperor Jingwen slapped him on the back of his hand with a “slap”.
To be honest, being able to push an emperor into a corner over such a matter is, to some extent, quite impressive…

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Reliable
chapters.content:
Although Emperor Jingwen did not use much force this time, it still hurt.
Ye Shuo jumped up with a cry: “Dad, why did you hit me!”
He covered his arm, his face accusing.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t understand no matter how hard he tried. How could he still have the nerve to feel aggrieved after doing such a thing?
It is true that Emperor Jingwen favoured boys over girls, but he was also very patriarchal.
Since he would not pass on the family business to his daughter, he naturally would not think about letting the princess do anything.
Although he kept saying that it was natural for princesses to marry off to other countries, in fact, none of his own princesses were sent to marry off.
This kind of thing, if you can avoid it, try to avoid it. If you can’t avoid it, then we’ll talk about it later.
Emperor Jingwen would not pass the heavy burden to the princess. In his eyes, the princess only needed to be loved and pampered, and then wait until she reached the age to find a good family to marry.
In Emperor Jingwen’s mind, it was natural for a brother to protect his sister, as if it was as normal as the laws of nature and ethics.All the princes who had younger sisters were very considerate of them. Emperor Jingwen had never heard of anyone like Xiaojiu who would resort to such “poisonous actions” against his younger sister.
“She is not as old as you are, and you didn’t know how to control her strength. What if she gets hurt?” And the imperial concubine was the same. Didn’t you see that the little princess had difficulty turning over? Don’t you know how to take care of her?
They are all his own children, and the back of his hand is also his flesh. How could Emperor Jingwen not feel sorry for them?
Even if I didn’t feel sorry for her before, I couldn’t help but feel sorry for her now when I see what kind of life the little princess is living in the hands of her brother.
But in fact, Concubine Rong is not stupid. How could she not see that the little princess is really upset?
Shuo’er seems absurd on weekdays, but he is actually very sensible.
Besides, isn’t it normal for siblings to fight and quarrel with each other? In Concubine Rong’s opinion, it is abnormal for them to be cold and polite to each other. They don’t look like a family at all.
That would only prove that the brother doesn’t take his sister seriously at all. He calls himself humble, but in fact he just treats his sister as a dispensable thing.
It’s just like treating a pet. You won’t get angry if you don’t take it seriously.
That’s why the imperial concubine never cared about it.
Ye Shuo looked at his hands and thought to himself that he didn’t use much force just now, so why did his cheap father get so angry?
Besides, Jianjian’s arrival disrupted his peaceful life and forced him to prepare for Jianjian’s future early on, and he is not allowed to collect some interest?
Loving and caring for her does not mean giving in to her in everything.
So Ye Shuo thought about it and said, “Dad, I wonder if you have heard that saying?”
What is that little bastard going to do now?
Emperor Jingwen frowned: “What?”
Ye Shuo’s face was serious. “If brothers and sisters are not for ‘playing’, then it will be meaningless.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
“You call this playing, you call this playing!”
After realising what was happening, Emperor Jingwen could no longer bear it and snatched the cane from Wang Ziquan’s hand and tried to beat him.
Why does Eunuch Wang bring his own rattan stick now?
“Daddy, daddy, please show some mercy, daddy!”
However, Emperor Jingwen was so angry at his fallacy that he could not possibly stop.
When Emperor Jingwen left Qiuwu Palace the next day, he was so worried that it was beyond words.
In his eyes at this moment, being born into the imperial concubine’s belly was no longer a way to enjoy happiness, but a way to suffer.
How could there be such a patriarchal mother and such a bad brother?
Emperor Jingwen’s mind quickly played out a scene of how Xiaojiu would bully her when he was not around, and how the imperial concubine treated her coldly from the sidelines, and he couldn’t help but feel a little pity for her.
Poor Jianjian…
the other side.
After his adoptive father left, Ye Shuo finally rubbed his sister happily.
Jianjian is four or five months old and she is already stupid. Not to mention when she just wakes up, no matter how you rub her, she won’t get angry. By the time the poor little girl reacts and is about to get angry, Ye Shuo would have stopped in advance, so basically there will be no trouble.
The little princess didn’t want to cry or anything, she looked so pitiful.
If this scene was seen by the wet nurse nearby, what else could it be but abuse?
The babies around basically sleep however they want. She’s just a baby, what else can she do if not sleep?
But the Ninth Prince just wouldn’t allow it.
He would control how long the princess slept during the day, and if necessary, he would even wake her up from her sleep, which made the wet nurse beside her so angry that she dared not say anything, and was particularly sad.
But in fact, Ye Shuo didn’t want to do that, but there was nothing he could do. Who asked Jian Jian to still stay in his mother’s room? It would be too tiring if he couldn’t sleep through the night, right?
If a baby is not controlled and is allowed to sleep when she is sleepy, how can she develop the habit of sleeping through the night?
Ye Shuo also felt that he had a special sense of accomplishment that Jian Jian could stay awake all night under his training.
But soon Ye Shuo no longer had time to care about these trivial matters.
Now that he has returned to Shangjing City, it is time to make arrangements for the follow-up.
The problem was how to arrange to contact my grandfather.
This result was reached by Ye Shuo after careful consideration and weighing.
Otherwise, no matter how great Ye Shuo’s abilities were, he was just a child now and couldn’t even leave the palace, so he couldn’t display his abilities.
We can only see if we can start with our grandfather for this matter. From what his mother has said over the years, it can be seen that our grandfather’s side should be stable.
Otherwise, if we really wait until the day when he leaves the palace to build his own residence, it will be too late for the opportunity.
He is nine years older than Jianjian. He would leave the palace and set up his own residence at the age of sixteen. Jianjian would already be seven years old at that time.
Seven years old seems very young, still just a child, but this was in ancient times when people were engaged at the age of fourteen and would get married as soon as they reached the age of sixteen.
Although judging by the attitude of my cheap dad, if nothing goes as expected, Jianjian should be kept for two more years.
But the same thing goes, if, if, you can never pin your hopes on if.
What Ye Shuo wanted was a foolproof result.
However, if you want to have a seat in the court and be able to influence the emperor’s decision, it is not something that can be achieved overnight.
Old ministers like Taifu and Prime Minister He must not be touched. Once they are touched, my cheap father will immediately notice it. My cheap father, the emperor, is not a pushover.
Ye Shuo didn’t believe that his cheap father, who had so many secret guards, would be unaware of the little actions of the princes under him.
Ye Shuo never looked down on anyone, and he didn’t think he had the ability to influence this group of important officials.
Without sufficient benefits, no matter how powerful Ye Shuo is, people will not be willing to work for him!
Those people are so smart. If he is not careful, he might be played to death by others before he can play with them.
Li Yuheng and Ye Shuo had no plans to move. Oh, by the way, I forgot to mention that because his mother suddenly became pregnant, his return to the palace was naturally delayed.
She was also afraid that they were too anxious and that sending Suxin and Suqiu away in a hurry would make Li Yuheng and Zhang Yuan look down on them, so her mother insisted on keeping the two girls until two months before the birth and then married them off.
The guard of honour set out from the palace at that time. Although it was not as glorious as that of a real noble, it was also very respectable at that time.
Because of the master-servant relationship that had accumulated over the years, the imperial concubine gave the two of them a lot of favours. Judging from the letters that Su Qiu sent from time to time, her married life with Zhang Yuan should be pretty good, and the words between the lines occasionally revealed the sweetness of the newlyweds.
As for Su Xin, Ye Shuo had never paid special attention to her, but Su Xin was a girl with a strong sense of purpose and she was also smart, so she should be good too.
Ye Shuo had said at the beginning that he did not need Li Yuheng’s loyalty, and naturally he would not change his words now.
Su Xin’s marriage and Jian Jian’s future are two completely different things. One more Li Yuheng won’t make much difference, and one less Li Yuheng won’t make much difference either. There is really no need for that.
Moreover, for a person like Li Yuheng, using favours to blackmail him will only backfire. If he is willing to repay the favor, then it can be called repaying a favor; otherwise, it would be making an enemy.
Ye Shuo thought about it and felt that there was only one way to avoid his cheap father noticing –
Start cultivating from scratch.
Starting from scratch, even the cheap dad would never think of this situation, because no one would do this unless they are fools. The cost is too high, and there are too many uncontrollable factors.
What Ye Shuo needs to do is to turn the impossible into possible.
This is not something that can be accomplished overnight, so time is so important to Ye Shuo.
After a dozen years, this group of people will have established a firm foothold in the court, and should be just in time for Jianjian to get married.
At that time, no matter who Jianjian wants to marry, or whether she wants to stay single for the rest of her life, she can make her choice freely, and no one will say anything.
If you only use this method, you can’t take the path of imperial examinations. First of all, Ye Shuo doesn’t have the ability to train so many top scorers.
You have to know that the top scholar is the first in the national imperial examination. There are always people who are smarter than Ye Shuo. Maybe it would be possible for him to take the exam on his own, but if he is asked to train himself, and he has to train more than one person, Ye Shuo can’t do it even if he is beaten to death.
Second, even if there are so many people who pass the imperial examination and become the top scorer, only a few of them can rise all the way to the top.
After layers of screening, the chance is lower than winning the lottery, so this method is completely unfeasible.
But as a modern man, Ye Shuo always has the advantage of standing on the shoulders of giants.
He planned to use what he had learned, take a technical approach, and rely on technology to help these people get promoted to higher positions.
Ye Shuo had been under his cheap father’s watch for so long, and it wasn’t for nothing after all, so he naturally knew what was bothering his cheap father every day.
It’s no wonder that there are only a few things that my cheap dad has to worry about. If it’s a natural disaster, it’s flood conservancy, if it’s a drought, it’s water diversion and irrigation, if it’s people’s livelihood, it’s textile machinery, and even refined salt purification. If he wants to improve the combat effectiveness of the army, it’s □□ transformation, iron smelting technology and steel smelting.
These are all things Ye Shuo has thought about carefully, and after careful consideration, he found that they can basically be achieved under the current circumstances.
It’s not just a marriage for Jian Jian, it can also benefit the people. It’s a complete win-win situation. Why not do it?
Ye Shuo didn’t care whether he would get all the credit in the end. As long as everyone was happy, it would be fine. All Ye Shuo wanted was a stable life. If all the credit fell on him, he would be in endless trouble.
Of course, the above only applies to Jianjian’s free choice issue, and only allows her to freely choose her own husband.
If one is really unlucky and ends up marrying a foreign prince, having these people supporting him from behind is far from enough.
At that time, he would be the enemy of the entire Great Zhou. If he wanted to turn the tide by himself, he would need something decisive——
food.
No matter where or what dynasty, food is the lifeblood of a country.
Exchanging food for a mere princess is naturally a win-win situation.
Ye Shuo was clear about the principles of hybrid rice. Moreover, the selection of the male sterile line, male sterile maintenance line and male sterile restoration line in hybrid rice was basically done manually until modern times. My grandfather had a lot of people at his disposal, so if he invested a lot of money, he should be able to do it.
But it is useless without matching fertilisers, especially without the indispensable nitrogen fertiliser, hybrid rice still cannot produce that much grain.
The development of agriculture and science and technology have always been complementary to each other. Only when the level of science and technology is reached can the level of agriculture be improved.
Fertiliser sounds simple, but it is not easy to make, especially nitrogen fertiliser, which requires synthetic ammonia technology. Ye Shuo knows the principle, but he simply cannot make it. It is really like a good cook without rice.
If we can crack the technology of synthetic ammonia, we can also make aeroplanes and cannons, and we will no longer need food. We can just defeat the other two countries directly, and there is no need to make any alliances with them.
Even in modern times, many countries still have to rely on imports for fertilisers, not to mention now.
However, if it is just to increase the grain production slightly, Ye Shuo can still do it.
If it really doesn’t work, just see if there is a plate corresponding to South America here. Then we can dig some potatoes or something like that to solve the food problem.
And the Champa rice that amazed the ancients in history, if there was also Champa here.
There are many methods, as long as one of them can solve the problem, then the problem will not be a problem. Ye Shuo doesn’t even need to worry too much about it. He just needs to pass on what he has learned.
As long as there is a reliable person on my grandfather’s side who can cooperate with me, it will be fine.
The other party provides the people and he provides the knowledge, so the crisis of Jianjian and her grandfather’s family can be completely resolved, and they don’t have to worry no matter who comes to power in the future.
This is definitely the simplest of all the links.
He has a grandfather who is the Duke of Zhen, six brave and warlike uncles, and eighteen cousins. He can’t be so unlucky that he can’t find anyone he can trust… right?
That’s impossible.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Success
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo is in a dilemma now. What method should he use to get in touch with his grandfather’s family?
Just looking at my cheap dad’s attitude, it feels really bad.
But what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that he was not fighting alone. His grandfather was also working hard for the meeting, but for a different purpose.
Seeing that the imperial concubine was pregnant again, everyone in the Duke Zhen’s Mansion was looking forward to it.
According to palace tradition, when a concubine is pregnant, her mother can be summoned to stay with her for a while. The Duke of Zhen and his family are thinking that since the emperor didn’t allow it last time, he should agree this time, right?
As a result, the queen didn’t return at all, and gave birth directly in the temporary palace, and it was a princess.
This caused an immediate shock throughout the entire Zhenguo Mansion, which could be regarded as a Buddhist temple.
The feng shui of the Duke Zhen’s family was not that bad; there were still two or three daughters, but without exception, they were all concubine born, not a single legitimate daughter.
Even if the Duke of Zhen and his wife loved their granddaughter, they could not really raise an illegitimate girl as a legitimate one. Otherwise, no matter how generous their daughter-in-law was, she would be unhappy. So love and affection have their limits.
If you put yourself in their shoes, because of the old couple’s restraint, the Duke of Zhen’s daughters-in-law would treat these concubines’ daughters with extra favour, and the slight resentment in their hearts would also dissipate.Therefore, there is actually no difference between these concubines’ daughters and legitimate daughters; they are all raised as legitimate daughters.
Although the Duke of Zhen was a bit confused when faced with the twists and turns in the court, he had one advantage, which was that he would not easily interfere in the affairs between his son and his wife, and all matters between his son and his wife were left to them to resolve themselves.
Unless the two of them made a scene in front of him, he would go and deal with it together with Old Madam Wei.
There are so many people in the Duke of Zhen’s family, but there has never been any conflict over the years. This is because the Duke of Zhen treats everyone equally, never takes sides with his sons, and always listens to whoever is right.
In most cases, the daughter-in-law is right, so…
But the imperial concubine was obviously different. The Duke of Zhen had six sons and only had this one girl. How could he not have a preference?
He did not hide his preference for his only daughter and said it directly. After so many years, the entire Duke of Zhen’s Mansion had already accepted this fact.
Needless to say, the six sons grew up with their sister since childhood, so naturally they have a special relationship with her. The six daughters-in-law also have a special fondness for this sister-in-law.
There’s nothing you can do about it. Who cannot help but feel soft-hearted towards the Imperial Concubine, since she’s so pretty? With such a pretty face and such a pretty body, people can’t help but soften their hearts when facing her.
Moreover, my sister-in-law has a bad temper, but she says whatever she thinks, never hides anything, and never does anything behind people’s backs. It is really a blessing to meet such a family.
When the Imperial Concubine entered the palace, the six brothers were so nervous that they didn’t feel anything, but the six sisters-in-law cried bitterly behind her back.
The six sisters-in-law felt uncomfortable when they thought that such a simple girl was going to that place where people were eaten.
Obviously, with the support of the Duke Zhen’s Mansion, the Duke Zhen and her nephews, the sister-in-law will not suffer any loss no matter where she goes. Why does His Majesty have to interfere?
The only thing in this world that the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion cannot compete with is the royal family, and with her sister-in-law having the same upright character as her father-in-law, she is destined to be unsuitable there.
However, the six sisters-in-law knew about this matter, but they dared not tell their husbands.
As a result, after the imperial concubine got married, the Zhen Mansion was in a gloomy mood for a while, leaving the six brothers puzzled. They couldn’t help but start to wonder whether this was their own sister or their wife’s sister.
At first, the news coming from the palace did prove that the six sisters-in-law were not worried in vain. In just three years, the sister-in-law was promoted to imperial concubine and continued to be honoured and favoured.
But they saw what was hidden under the flowers and were worried about their sister-in-law.
Fortunately, after the Ninth Prince was born, he was favoured by the Emperor, and the situation improved. The six of them breathed a sigh of relief at the same time.
Now that the imperial concubine has given birth to a princess, needless to say, the whole family is delighted.
This is the real thing, a girl born from the imperial concubine’s belly!
In such an environment, the Duke of Zhen also looked forward to it every day, in the morning and in the evening.
Old Madam Wei had even prepared to visit the palace early in the morning.
result……
The whole family waited and waited, from the time the imperial concubine became pregnant to the birth of the princess, and from the birth of the princess to the full moon. The princess has now passed the hundredth day, and will soon be half a year old. If they wait any longer, the two children will have to get married, and the Duke of Zhen can no longer sit still.
During this period, the Duke of Zhen submitted his request countless times, and Madam Wei even went to great lengths to take a carriage to the palace, but without exception, they were all rejected by Emperor Jingwen.
Emperor Jingwen could only use one word – delay, or change the subject.
Emperor Jingwen’s slow and roundabout approach finally drove the Duke of Zhen completely crazy.
Anyway, no matter what, he must see his daughter this time!
Even if I can’t see my daughter, it would be good to be able to see my grandchildren!
“Your Majesty, please agree to my request this time! Let me see Yan’er, or the Ninth Prince and the Little Princess, once again in my lifetime!”
After hearing him mention this matter for who knows how many times, Emperor Jingwen also had a headache.
If it was an ordinary minister, the other party would know what he meant after politely declining once, and would not mention it a second time. But why did this Duke of Zhen seem to not understand what he was saying?
Which minister is still clamouring to see her daughter every day after she gets married?
The imperial concubine married into the palace. If she had married outside, the Duke of Zhen’s family would probably force their son-in-law to live in the Duke of Zhen’s mansion.
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously wanted to use his old trick, but this time the Duke of Zhen refused to fall for it.
After all, no matter how much you lack in something, you can’t still not figure it out after several years.
Seeing that the emperor still disagreed, the Duke of Zhen could not help but feel grief-stricken. He felt so upset that he fell directly to the floor of the Qinzheng Hall and burst into tears.
He was marrying his daughter off, not selling her, so why couldn’t he see her again?
The emperor forbade his family to go to the border to fight in the war, and took away his power bit by bit, but he also didn’t let him see his daughter for so many years.
The more he thought about it, the sadder he felt, and the Duke of Zhen cried even harder, as if he wanted to vent all the sadness in his heart.
Emperor Jingwen and the crown prince beside him were both stunned.
To be honest, the Crown Prince has not seen such a scene in all these years. Not to mention the Crown Prince, has Emperor Jingwen ever seen such a scene?
After all, the Duke of Zhen was a duke, so even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t neglect him, and quickly stood up to help him up: “Duke of Zhen, get up first, the ground is cold.”
The Duke of Zhen was completely broken down now, and it was difficult for him to control his emotions for a while. It was not so easy to get up just by talking about it.
The Duke of Zhen tightly grasped the arm of Emperor Jingwen, and spoke with tears in his eyes: “Your Majesty, I ask myself, I have never done anything to let Your Majesty down in all these years. Why, why…” Why didn’t Your Majesty even let him see his daughter?
The Duke of Zhen couldn’t understand it. He had fought in the wars, contributed his efforts, and even did the most unpopular and disgusting job of debt collection when the emperor first ascended the throne. He almost gave his life to the Great Zhou, but why couldn’t even this little wish be fulfilled?
Sometimes, the most cruel way to kill someone is with a soft knife.
Feeling the pain in his arm, Emperor Jingwen opened his mouth, but was suddenly speechless for a moment.
To be honest, what the Duke of Zhen said was correct. He had never done anything to let him down or to the Great Zhou.
Even Emperor Jingwen knew in the deepest part of his heart that the Zhen family had no intention of rebelling, otherwise he would not have been able to keep them until now.
However, a man is innocent unless he is in possession of a treasure.
It’s like you live with a tiger all the time. The tiger says he is a vegetarian and doesn’t eat humans, but can you really be at ease?
The Duke of Zhen had no intention of rebelling, but he had the ability to shake his throne. For the Duke of Zhen, this was his greatest sin.
But after all, Emperor Jingwen still remembered the other party’s achievements, and he also remembered that after he ascended the throne, he faced an empty treasury and a mess left by the previous emperor. It was the Duke of Zhen who assisted him in stabilising the situation. Therefore, Emperor Jingwen just tried every means to seize his power, but did not really kill him.
No matter which emperor it is, he will definitely not be so soft-hearted.
The reason why he was not asked to contact the imperial concubine was because Emperor Jingwen was very satisfied with the situation and really did not want to cause any more trouble.
But when Emperor Jingwen caught a glimpse of the white hair of Duke Zhen and his crying face, he was silent for a long time, but finally softened his heart.
Just as the Duke of Zhen said, he is old now.
Although the Duke of Zhen’s mansion was still prosperous, the Duke of Zhen himself was no longer what he used to be. Emperor Jingwen still remembered how he was in power and how proud he was.
In the end, Emperor Jingwen compromised.
“…Okay, in three days, I will arrange for Madam Wei to enter the palace.”
Hearing this, the Duke of Zhen, who was in tears, was stunned at first, and then overjoyed: “Thank you, Your Majesty, for your consideration!”
Oh my God! I will go back and tell my wife the good news later!
If he had known crying would work, he would have used this trick earlier.
Looking at the joyful back of the Duke of Zhen as he left, Emperor Jingwen felt quite sad, and after a long while, he could not help but sigh.
However, Emperor Jingwen still cared about Xiaojiu.
After all, once this door is opened, it will be difficult to resolve in the future.
Emperor Jingwen had never cared so much about any of his sons, so naturally he didn’t want to see anything he didn’t want to see happen.
So after reviewing the memorials, Emperor Jingwen came before Ye Shuo.
At this time, Ye Shuo was still worrying about whether he should sneak out of the palace again. As a result, while he was stunned, his stepfather looked indistinct and spoke in a relaxed tone. Then he opened his mouth and asked, “Shuo’er, I remember that you have never seen your grandfather since you were born. It just so happens that your grandfather is free recently, and you are also old enough to practise martial arts. How about I send you to the Zhen Mansion to stay for a few days?”
Oh my god, as soon as I fell asleep, someone brought me a pillow!
When Ye Shuo heard this, he was shocked, and even began to wonder if God had heard his prayers, otherwise this turning point would not have come so timely.
But then, almost instantly Ye Shuo discovered something wrong.
Given my stepfather’s temper, if nothing unexpected happened, he would never bring up this matter in his life. He would like to isolate him from my grandfather’s family as much as possible.
The possibility of my cheap dad suddenly changing his personality is very small, and something must have happened in between for this to happen.
The more urgent it is, the less likely you are to express it.
Sometimes you have to say the opposite.
In a flash, Ye Shuo almost blurted out: “Why? I won’t go.”
“It’s so hot in the middle of summer. I’m staying well in the palace. Why should I go out?”
He never expected this answer. Seeing that Xiaojiu seemed to have no feelings towards the three words “Duke of Zhen”, Emperor Jingwen was stunned: “Don’t you want to see your grandfather at all?”
“Don’t you like your grandfather?”
“Why?”
Tsk, my cheap dad is really stimulated. He would never say so much in the past.
Ye Shuo looked puzzled: “Didn’t they say that my grandfather was a military commander?”
Emperor Jingwen was puzzled: “What about the military generals?”
Ye Shuo grinned and glanced out the window secretly, as if he was afraid of being heard by the imperial concubine. After confirming that the imperial concubine was not there, Ye Shuo hesitated for a long time, and finally whispered in a very low voice: “Vulgar.”
How could he, a prince who lived a life of luxury and wealth, stay with such a rough person?
“There are so many uncles and cousins. I heard they are all muscular and ugly. I can’t stand it. I don’t want to go.”
Noticing the disdain and indifference that his son’s eyes inadvertently revealed, he thought of the scene in which the Duke of Zhen’s hair turned white in the Qinzheng Palace today, and he was so humble that he burst into tears in order to see his daughter, grandson, and granddaughter, and the scene in which the Duke of Zhen would hand over a sign every year, but the look of loss in his eyes when he was rejected by him every year…
