Emperor Jingwen’s head exploded with a buzzing sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Despair
chapters.content:
Perhaps the contrast between the two was too strong. Seeing his son’s nonchalant look, Emperor Jingwen felt terribly disappointed.
“You wicked bastard, that’s your own grandfather!!”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Wow, my stepfather is really amazing. He even remembered that the Duke of Zhen is his grandfather at this time?
But think about it, the ancients attached great importance to filial piety. How my stepfather treats the Duke of Zhen is one thing, but if he does the same, that’s another matter.
In short, I can do it, but you can’t.
It seems that something big happened today, otherwise his stepfather’s emotions wouldn’t be so drastic. Ye Shuo always felt that he was vaguely speaking for his grandfather today, but he didn’t know if it was an illusion.
Emperor Jingwen’s sudden outburst caught Ye Shuo off guard.
But who is Ye Shuo? His reaction speed is not ordinary fast.
“Isn’t it difficult?” From a child’s perspective, Ye Shuo showed just the right amount of confusion.“Dad, why are you so angry? Did your son say something wrong?”
“But, but…Teacher and the others have always said this…”
Ye Shuo really wasn’t lying about this matter, the Taifu and the others were all the leaders of the civil officials, and the civil officials always looked down on the military commanders who only had a bit of strength, even if they were very restrained, they could not help but inadvertently reveal a bit of contempt in their words.
Of course, the Grand Tutor and the others were only talking about those ordinary military generals who were not very particular, and they did not mention any names of the Duke of Zhen.
But in the eyes of a child, grandfather = military commander = vulgar, is there anything wrong with this formula? There is absolutely no problem, right?
“I heard that military commanders are quick to fight with others and are not clean. Your son… your son would rather deal with more polite people…” He comes up shirtless and smells of sweat. Who can stand this?
After hearing Ye Shuo’s words, Emperor Jingwen felt as if he had been hit by a wake-up call.
Yes, how could he forget that no matter what attitude the superiors have towards the Duke of Zhen, the people below will naturally follow suit.
Especially since this is not an ordinary matter, as it concerns military power, all the ministers are very secretive about it. Add to that the relationship between civil officials and military generals, it would be strange for the Taifu and others to say anything good.
Now that Xiaojiu is taught by the Taifu and others every day, he is influenced by them and naturally thinks that the Duke of Zhen is not a good person.
Xiaojiu’s current reaction is the result of everyone’s joint efforts, including myself, who is actually a driving force behind it.
Emperor Jingwen wanted to distance his son from the Zhen family, but he definitely did not intend to make him become ruthless.
When it comes to the relationship with the Zhen Duke’s family, Xiaojiu was well educated, but his blank indifference and the way he treated the Zhen Duke as if he were an insignificant stranger still made Emperor Jingwen’s heart tremble.
Blood relationship is always a very important bond at any time, so Ye Shuo’s behaviour is very abnormal.
No, we can’t go on like this. If we continue like this, there will definitely be big problems!
Soon, Emperor Jingwen made up his mind.
“No, you have to go whether you want to or not!” Originally Emperor Jingwen just tried it out a little, but now he really has this idea in mind.
Ye Shuo was not in a hurry to respond, and he perfectly portrayed the image of a child who was unwilling to go to his grandfather’s house.
Ye Shuo had never eaten pork, but at least he had seen pigs run. When he was a child, one of his friends did the same thing when he heard that he would be sent to his hometown in the countryside during the summer vacation.
“No, no, I don’t want to learn martial arts in such hot weather!”
Emperor Jingwen almost forgot that this child was still suffering from summer pain.
But the more he did this, the more determined Emperor Jingwen became to send him away.
But we can’t send him away for too long, at most ten days, and then we can bring him back.
Just like that, amidst Ye Shuo’s “crying”, Emperor Jingwen remained unmoved and turned away very coldly.
Ye Shuo: “…………”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh out loud after his adoptive father completely left Qiuwu Palace.
Let me tell you, it doesn’t matter whether my cheap dad says it’s easy to fool or not. As long as you master the skills, isn’t it easy to do?
Just like that, three days later, Madam Wei came into the palace. Before Ye Shuo could even see his grandmother, Emperor Jingwen hurriedly packed him up and sent him to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion for labour reform.
Just do the whole show. There are still ten days left, so there is no need to rush.
So Ye Shuo found a way to jump out of the car midway.
Although he knew that his son would not be so honest, when he heard the news, Emperor Jingwen’s face turned green uncontrollably, and he did not hesitate to extend Ye Shuo’s stay at the Duke of Zhenguo’s Mansion by two more days.
Emperor Jingwen even issued a death order, requiring the accompanying guards to find him before lunch no matter what, and to tie him up and take him to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion.
Ye Shuo doesn’t know yet. If he knew, he would be so happy that he would go crazy.
At the same time, everyone in the Zhen Mansion received news that the Ninth Prince would be staying at the Zhen Mansion.
After hearing the eunuch’s report, the Duke of Zhen became alert at a speed visible to the naked eye.
At first he was still depressed because Madam Wei was able to enter the palace to visit their daughter, but he could not. Now, the Ninth Prince is coming, and the Duke of Zhen feels comforted all of a sudden.
Although he felt sad that he couldn’t see his daughter, he felt comforted to see his grandson.
Unexpectedly, this time the emperor was so understanding. Not only did he allow Madam Wei to come to the palace to meet the imperial concubine, he also sent the ninth prince to visit him.
One or two of the sisters-in-law felt that something was strange, but they did not think much about it and quickly asked the servants to clean up the best courtyard in the Duke of Zhen’s mansion and prepare it for the Ninth Prince.
The entire Duke of Zhen’s clan was suddenly busy.
After finally calming down, the Duke of Zhenguo hurriedly called out, “Ping’er, look where your brothers are, and call them back to old man!”
It is unknown how long it will take for them to meet next time, so the Duke of Zhen plans to use this opportunity to let his grandchildren recognize each other, so that they won’t have to figure out who is who among cousins.
Upon hearing this, the one called Wei Ping couldn’t help but said weakly: “Grandfather, I am your grandson…” Isn’t this calling old man “old man” a generation difference?
“Just go when I tell you to go. Why are you talking so much nonsense?” As a result, the old Duke Zhen glared at the young man with a fierce look. The dark-faced young man named Wei Ping shuddered, then ran away with his tail between his legs.
“Grandfather, don’t be angry, I’ll go call for help right away!”
That’s right, this is really difficult to handle.
Wei Ping scratched his head and searched the entire Zhen Mansion, but only found five or six brothers. The rest seemed to have gone out and were not in the mansion.
There was no other way, Wei Ping could only call on these five brothers to go with him to look for someone outside the mansion.
Seeing that one of the cousins ​​was still dozing off, Wei Ping couldn’t help but slap him on the forehead, which woke the cousin up with a yell: “What are you standing there for? Hurry up!”
“Let me tell you, Grandfather pays special attention to this little cousin whom he has never met. If it’s too late, you just have to wait!”
Wei Guang covered his head with his hands grimacing. He was about to fight back, but when he heard the other party mention his grandfather, he immediately wilted.
Never mind, this beating from my cousin is nothing. My grandfather’s beating was too severe and I really couldn’t stand it.
So the five men had to take their servants and split into five groups to look for others.
The youngest among them, Wei Ying, is only ten years old now. In other families, family members would rarely open the door to their grandchildren, for fear that they might get bumped or bruised outside. But in the Wei family, there are no such concerns. All the grandchildren have been playing around since they were young, and many of them are playing outside when they are six or seven years old.
The Duke of Zhen’s Mansion has many children and they were raised roughly, so no one thinks it’s a big deal.
Before leaving, Wei Guang suddenly thought of something, so he said casually: “By the way, Seventh Brother, Big Brother is also at home now, why don’t you go and call him?”
However, Wei Ping is just naive, not stupid.
No one in the family dares to set foot in the eldest brother’s yard.
Wei Ping then shook his head like a rattle and backed away again and again: “You go if you want to go, I won’t go.”
Wei Guang pondered for a moment, and suddenly thought of his elder brother’s smiling face. He shuddered and immediately gave up the idea.
Forget it, although the eldest brother is useful, he is also very fierce.
It’s better not to disturb him easily.
Soon, the six Wei brothers came out one after another.
However, not long after, Wei Wen, the eldest brother as mentioned by Wei Ping and others, the eldest grandson of the house, still felt in his own yard that the Zhen Mansion today was different from usual.
Looking from the window, there were obviously many more maids and servants coming and going outside than usual.
Wei Wen was stunned for a moment, then he called the servant beside him over.
Perhaps because he had to clean up the mess too many times on weekdays, Wei Wen almost subconsciously asked, “Who in the family got into trouble again?”
It’s so lively, there must be guests at home.
Given the current situation of the Zhen Mansion, almost no one would come to visit on their own initiative, except for one situation –
If there was some disobedient kid in the family who beat up someone else’s child, and then the family’s parents came to the door, the Duke of Zhen had no choice but to invite the family to have a meal, and during the meal, the person from whichever room the child had made the trouble would apologise to the family’s parents.
The younger brothers beat people up, and they came to our house. My parents, uncles and aunts invited them to dinner and apologized. Then, after a while, the younger brothers beat people up again, and they came to our house. Then, the Duke of Zhen apologised…
This cycle has been going on for who knows how many years, and Wei Wen has become numb.
This kind of thing happens every other day, and the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion has to spend a large sum of money every year just for an apology.
Fortunately, when the late emperor was alive, his grandfather had a relatively rich fortune from years of wars, and his mother and aunts were quite knowledgeable about business, otherwise the entire Zhen Mansion might not be enough to pay the compensation.
Most of the children in the mansion are lively and energetic. If this situation happened in the past, the worst that could happen would be for their father or uncles to take them to the border, where they would behave themselves after staying there for a while.
But now, not only his father, but also several uncles were gradually restricted and were not allowed to go out to lead the troops. The energy of those little rascals at home had nowhere to vent, so they had to slowly waste it.
But soon, the servant’s answer surprised Wei Wen.
It turns out that no one has gotten into trouble again.
Instead, the Ninth Prince was going to stay at the Duke Zhen’s Mansion, and according to the eunuch who delivered the imperial edict, he would stay there for a while.
The servant thought that the eldest master would be very happy to hear the news, but to his surprise, there didn’t seem to be much joy on his face.
The servant had been with the eldest prince since he was a child, so he didn’t have many reservations when speaking. He asked immediately, “Sir, the Ninth Prince is coming. Aren’t you happy?”
Wei Wen: “…”
Happy? What is there for him to be happy about?
It’s not like he hasn’t heard of the reputation of his little cousin. He heard that he was very naughty and even the current emperor couldn’t control him.
It’s just one more troublemaker. Does God think that Duke Zhen’s Mansion is not lively enough?
Seventeen younger brothers, and now with the addition of a cousin, all eighteen brothers are like this. I’m afraid no one would be able to laugh if they were in his place.
There are also his father, five uncles, and even his beautiful aunt who came to Beijing, they are all exactly the same.
Wei Wen is now 24 years old, and no one knows how he has survived all these years.
And among so many people, not even one person could see that, although this majestic Duke’s Mansion looked flourishing with flowers and luxuriant branches and leaves, it was actually a building about to collapse.
In just a short moment, all the past events came to his mind, and for a moment, Wei Wen’s eyes revealed a hint of despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Bullying
chapters.content:
In the beginning, Wei Wen, as the eldest grandson of the eldest son, was born when the late emperor was still alive. He did not realize anything at that time. He only knew that because of his grandfather, the entire Zhen Mansion was in its heyday.
The Zhen Mansion was so proud at that time. Except for the royal family, no one in the entire Zhou Dynasty dared to challenge it.
At that time, the previous emperor was in power, he was stupid and very licentious, and the other two countries seized the opportunity to cause chaos. As a result, there were constant wars on the border and the people were living in misery. At that time, it was all thanks to my grandfather who led his soldiers to resist wave after wave of attacks and saved the Great Zhou from danger under the double pressure of the two countries.
At that time, among the top military generals in the court, nearly 70% were from his grandfather’s family. They were all on life-and-death basis with his grandfather, so their power was extremely complicated.
Wei Wen watched the Duke Zhen Mansion develop from its peak glory.
Until the death of the previous emperor and the ascension of the crown prince, now Emperor Jingwen, to the throne, Wei Wen, who was only ten years old at the time, did not even feel anything.
Wei Wen gradually realised that something was wrong when he was twelve years old.
The current emperor quickly purged a large number of people within two years of ascending the throne, and the national treasury began to fill up at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Afterwards, the emperor severely dealt with a group of officials in the court who had been appointed by the previous emperor, some of whom had no real talent or learning and had risen to power by flattery. He then promoted people with real talent and learning, such as Prime Minister He, and even invited several famous Confucian scholars of the Zhou Dynasty, such as Grand Tutor Cen, to the palace. Along with these Confucian scholars, there were also many talented people.
With the rapid recovery of the Great Zhou and the presence of the Duke of Zhen, the other two countries, seeing that they could not gain any advantage, had no choice but to gradually restrain themselves.That’s when things started to change.
First, the emperor issued an edict to allow his aunt, who was only a few years older than him, to enter the palace. Then, a few years later, when his little cousin was born, the emperor suddenly announced that the eldest prince, who was only seventeen years old, would lead troops to the border.
In Wei Wen’s memory, his grandfather had a big quarrel with the emperor because of this matter, and the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion also began to decline from that time.
With the treatment and replacement of the confidants of the Duke of Zhen, the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion has long lost its former glory.
My grandfather and father cannot go to the battlefield, and the friction between the three countries is still happening all the time. As time goes by, they will gradually be replaced by others.
In fact, Wei Wen was very happy that he no longer had to go to the battlefield.
Regardless of which dynasty, the casualty rate of military officers was extremely high. Even though his father and five uncles only numbered six people, they were not enough to fight in a real war.
It was precisely because of the emperor’s decision that neither my father nor my uncle died. Although people tend to have children one after another once they have some free time, it is still better than losing one after another.
Anyway, the Duke’s Mansion is well-off, so there is no need to worry about not being able to support the family.
Since he was twelve years old, Wei Wen had always worried that the emperor would one day take action against their family as he had done to other ministers.
The year his little cousin was born, the emperor decided to let the eldest prince lead the army, and Wei Wen’s worries reached their peak.
At that time, Wei Wen was still naively thinking of discussing with his grandfather, father or uncles on how the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion should deal with it. As a result… no one discovered the crisis hidden behind this matter, and no one discovered that this was not a training for the eldest prince, but a precursor to the emperor’s desire to seize power!
Wei Wen’s words seemed like playing the lute to a cow. Wei Wen had no choice but to give up.
It doesn’t matter, it doesn’t matter. Even if grandpa, father, and uncle are unreliable, there are still these cousins ​​one after another. I can always count on them.
In this way, Wei Wen waited and waited, year after year, and finally Wei Wen was completely desperate.
Because he found that when these cousins ​​grew up, they were exactly like their father, only growing muscles but not brains.
In such a huge Zhen Mansion, only the grandmother, mother and several aunts are a little bit smart. However, due to their status as women, they really cannot influence the developments of the court. It is really true that a good cook cannot cook without rice.
In this situation, Wei Wen was unwilling to spread his anxiety. He couldn’t find a way to solve the problem, and speaking out would only cause trouble.
That is to say, for so many years, Wei Wen has been fighting alone.
It’s a miracle that he wasn’t driven crazy by his brothers who kept getting into trouble.
Those little bastards are really good at causing trouble!
But Wei Wen really couldn’t just ignore them. Even though his father, uncles, and brothers were a little stupid and troublesome, they were really good to him and had been like this since he was a child. After so many years, how could Wei Wen give them up?
He could only accept his fate and try his best to support the family.
I just hope that His Majesty can give me a quick death when the time comes and not torture me too much.
Because of this, Wei Wen has not even gotten married until now. Now that his family is unstable, why bother to implicate the girl?
If a child is born, it would be even more of a sin.
Although Wei Wen kept saying that he disliked his little cousin who was of the same type as his younger brothers, when the reputation of his little cousin as a playboy spread, Wei Wen at home was actually relieved.
In this situation, if the aunt gave birth to another smart prince, it would be a death warrant for the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion.
Fortunately, this little cousin is also a stupid one.
Just because he was so stubborn that he single-handedly delayed the death of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion for so many years, Wei Wen was extremely grateful to this little cousin he had never met.
Now hearing that his little cousin was coming, after experiencing the initial despair, Wei Wen, who was already very experienced in dealing with such matters, quickly adjusted his mood, and even changed into a new set of clothes before preparing to go out and wait for people.
Well, I’ve taken care of all seventeen brothers and cousins, and this one cousin is still missing?
Meanwhile, on the other side.
Ye Shuo was holding candied haws and walking on the streets of Shangjing City. In order to prevent the last incident from happening again, he specially visited several places worth visiting in Shangjing City this time.
Even though Xiao Luzi was still being held by the guards, the guards wouldn’t do anything to him, so Ye Shuo wasn’t too worried.
As for avoiding the guards, it was a piece of cake for Ye Shuo now.
The sun was shining brightly and it was almost time for lunch. Seeing that the time was almost up, just when Ye Shuo was about to let himself be caught by the guards, a sudden noise broke out in the distance.
Perhaps it was because the other person’s voice was too loud, Ye Shuo could hear it even from such a long distance.
It must be someone who had a quarrel with someone.
Ye Shuo was not one to join in all the fun, and at first he had no intention of intervening, until he heard the pancake vendor next to him shaking his head and sighing, saying, “I wonder which son of the Duke’s family this time.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Why does it sound like this happens from time to time from the tone of your voice?
Ye Shuo, who had just passed by, suddenly stepped back.
“Boss, give me a portion of pancakes.” Ye Shuo first handed over a copper coin. While the vendor was taking the pancakes, Ye Shuo casually asked, “By the way, you just mentioned the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion. Are all the sons of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion like this?”
“Of course.”
Seeing that the other party did not refute and after confirming that it was the son of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, Ye Shuo’s heart sank slightly.
With Ye Shuo’s top-level social skills and his knack for gossip, it didn’t take long for Ye Shuo to understand what the situation was.
His cousins ​​don’t seem to have a very good reputation outside.
“Thank you.” Ye Shuo took the oil paper bag handed over by the vendor and walked towards the place where the dispute took place.
Across the crowd, Ye Shuo quickly understood what was happening.
It turned out that the young man surnamed Zheng from the opposite side did not pay for the things he bought and bullied the vendor selling rouge and powder. Wei Zhao, who was passing by, saw it and immediately became unhappy, so the two sides started quarrelling.
Wei Zhao’s original intention was good, but he did not consider the plight of the hawkers at all.
Young Master Zheng was not someone a commoner like a peddler could afford to offend. It was just a box of rouge worth a few coins. Even if the other party took it, so what? But the son of the Duke Zhen family suddenly came over and made a big deal out of it.
Therefore, the peddler was not grateful to Wei Zhao for standing up for him. Instead, he resented and hated him, thinking that he had made Master Zheng lose face in public.
What if Mr. Zheng gets angry and starts to hate him, a rouge and powder seller? What should he do?
He just wanted to do some small business to support his family, so how could he afford to offend these big shots?
Therefore, the peddler ignored Wei Zhao’s obstruction, knelt down in front of the young master of the Zheng family, and kowtowed hard, begging the young master of the Zheng family to forgive him.
Ye Shuo stood in the crowd and watched, feeling a chill in his heart.
If his cheap cousin in front of him couldn’t understand it, how could he not understand it?
This young man surnamed Zheng was dressed in gorgeous clothes, and even the pendant of the folding fan in his hand was worth at least a hundred taels. How could he be interested in rouge worth a few cents?
All this was just to lure this cousin of mine, whose rank was unknown, into the trap.
The surname Zheng is also quite interesting. If Ye Shuo remembers correctly, the Queen Mother also seems to have the surname Zheng?
“… Bastard!” While Ye Shuo was thinking, he caught a glimpse of the smug expression and provocative eyes of the young master of the Zheng family. How could Wei Zhao still endure it?
Wei Zhao got angry and clenched his fist to hit that hateful face.
If he had delivered a powerful punch, he would probably have really hurt that Zheng guy.
Comparing the two people’s body shapes, one is as strong as a calf, and the other is as thin as a bamboo pole. There is a natural difference between them. If someone doesn’t read the whole cause and effect, you can imagine who the person will favour.
Given my grandfather’s current tendency to attract bad luck, tomorrow’s morning court will probably be quite lively.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to stand up and said, “Stop!”
Ye Shuo glared at his unknown cousin: “What are you doing to bully him!”
Wei Zhao was stunned when he saw the child suddenly jumping out. Then he pointed at himself and then at the hideous young master of the Zheng family.
“Me? Bully him???”
Is this child blind?

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Hope
chapters.content:
Wei Zhao didn’t even think twice and asked, “Kid, is there something wrong with your eyes?”
Ye Shuo choked, then he said confidently: “Otherwise, look at how tall and heavy he is, and then look at how tall and heavy you are!”
“You’re not the one bullying him, is it possible that he’s the one bullying you?”
Upon closer inspection, this unknown cousin is half a head taller than the young man named Zheng.
Wei Zhao almost laughed out of anger when he heard this: “Who told you that small and thin people are definitely good people?”
How come this child, at such a young age, has already learned to judge people by their appearance?
“I am clearly helping the weak when I see injustice!”
“But, shouldn’t the premise of doing good things be to make others feel at ease? If it adds trouble to others instead, how can it be called a good deed?” Ye Shuo knew that his cousin had good intentions, but…reality and ideals are different after all.
“How not–“
Wei Zhao sneered, and subconsciously wanted to find a few witnesses. However, when he looked around, he only saw rejection and resistance in the eyes of the onlookers, especially the peddler selling rouge and powder, who immediately lowered his head when he saw him looking at him.No matter how slow-witted Wei Zhao was, he realised something was wrong at this moment.
Wei Zhao was stunned immediately.
It’s not easy for the small traders around here to make a living. They don’t have backgrounds like Wei Zhao and Mr. Zheng, so it’s just a fight between gods and the suffering of mortals.
“So you see, you are clearly bullying others!”
After hearing this, and considering the reactions of the people around him, Wei Zhao was somewhat shocked.
No wonder my grandfather’s family has such a bad reputation outside. The cousins ​​are so destructive that ordinary people would subconsciously distance themselves from them. After all, in this situation, it would be in vain to get hit.
But this matter is not just a problem of the cousins. Those who deliberately seduce others are the ones who deserve to be killed!
These are what Ye Shuo discovered, and who knows how many more there are that he has not discovered.
In the end, it’s just a matter of everyone pushing down the wall.
Whatever the emperor’s attitude is, those below who presume to guess his intentions will naturally make many small moves.
Just like this Mr. Zheng in front of him, it was obvious at first glance that he had no good intentions. Ye Shuo would feel sorry for him if he didn’t return his original plan to him intact.
There was quite a commotion here, and soon, almost all the guards sent by his stepfather to escort him had heard the news and rushed over.
He noticed that one of the guards looked around first and soon found himself standing in front of the group, so he hurriedly called out to the others in a low voice, and they slowly surrounded this place from all directions.
Seeing the other party getting closer, Ye Shuo saw the right time and took two or three steps forward. He looked up at Mr. Zheng and said as if he wanted to take credit for it: “Don’t be afraid, Mr. Zheng. Look, everything is fine now. I’m here and I won’t let him bully you.”
The young master of the Zheng family almost vomited blood when he heard this.
His original intention was to lure Wei Zhao into action, and when he was about to succeed, a little kid suddenly appeared out of nowhere and interfered, causing his plan to fail.
Young Master Zheng was so angry that he almost died. How could he have a good face towards this little kid who ruined his plan?
He was considered to have a good temper by not beating the kid.
So when he saw him approaching him, the young master of the Zheng family pushed him without thinking: “Where did you come from, kid? Why meddle in other people’s business? Get out of here!”
The Zheng family is now the Queen’s family, and the father of the young master of the Zheng family is the uncle of the emperor. He is the nephew of the Queen, and there are only a few people in the entire Zhou Dynasty that he cannot afford to offend.
Therefore, the young master of the Zheng family didn’t think so much at all.
However, it was this push that caused a huge disaster.
Those who ‘escorted’ Ye Shuo to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion were all close confidants of Emperor Jingwen. Seeing that someone dared to lay a hand on the Ninth Prince, the guards rushed over and subconsciously protected the Ninth Prince in the middle without thinking.
With a “clang” sound, several guards drew their swords from their waists.
Anyone who dares to attack the prince will be punished with the death of all nine generations of his clan!
Several guards looked across, as if they were looking at a dead person.
From the time the guards rushed over to the time they drew their swords and pointed them at him, the entire process took only a few breaths. By the time Young Master Zheng reacted, he was dumbfounded on the spot.
Wha-what’s happening?
When the people around saw this scene, they immediately dispersed, fearing that if they ran away too late, they would be covered in blood.
This sword shines with a cold light, and it is obvious at first glance that it is not just for show. If you are unlucky enough to be affected by it, it will be a waste of time.
Taking advantage of the chaos, the rouge vendor packed up his stall and disappeared in a flash.
This is the case for ordinary people who are outsiders, let alone the parties involved.
His nose was pointed at by several sabers. He had brought a few servants with him today, but they were of little use. He was afraid that the other party would not know his identity and would kill him on impulse. In a panic, the young master of the Zheng family was timid and said, “Do you know who I am? How dare you attack me? My father is the uncle of the emperor, and my aunt is the queen. If you dare to touch me, you will be in trouble!”
Sometimes, the difference between a great teammate and a bad teammate is just a matter of thought.
If the plan just now succeeds, then we will be great teammates. If not, then we will quickly become bad teammates.
Ye Shuo secretly laughed, based on the other party’s words, there was no need for him to exaggerate and complain to his cheap father. With so many spies around, his cheap father would know it soon.
The guards were stunned when they heard this. If this was the case, then wouldn’t it be that a flood had flushed the Dragon King Temple?
The guards couldn’t help but look at the Ninth Prince in the middle.
Then the guards heard the Ninth Prince muttering to himself, looking very shocked: “This shouldn’t be the case. I clearly helped him, why doesn’t he appreciate it?”
The guards looked at each other, and vaguely understood that something must have happened just now.
Wei Zhao on the side looked at this one, then at that one, and couldn’t hold back his laughter, “Hahahahahahaha, you just scolded me, now you’re fine, aren’t you also doing something bad with good intentions? See if others will pay attention to you, hahahahaha.”
Finally, he met someone who was even less capable than himself, and Wei Zhao felt much more relieved.
Caught off guard, Ye Shuo, who was acting hard with the guards, said: “…”
Just a little bit, just a little bit, Ye Shuo couldn’t continue acting.
Forget it, I won’t bother with such a fool.
Just when the same thought flashed through the minds of both of them, Wei Ping, breathless, finally caught his brother on the street.
“Brother, it’s almost noon, don’t just stand there, come back with me quickly.”
Hearing this, Wei Zhao couldn’t help but frown: “Why are you in such a hurry? I just got out.” Normally, no one would care if he didn’t come home at night. Why did Wei Ping bring people to look for him today?
Wei Zhao only found out on the way that in the morning, an imperial decree suddenly came from the palace, saying that the Ninth Prince would come to stay for a while.
“Ninth Prince?” Wei Zhao couldn’t help but exclaim.
If he remembered correctly, the child born by the imperial concubine’s aunt would be the ninth among the princes, right?
Wei Zhao is seventeen this year. He was only five or six years old when the imperial concubine entered the palace, so he can barely remember things.
Wei Zhao still remembered that his aunt was a very beautiful woman, as beautiful as a fairy from heaven, and she used to play with him and his brothers when they were little.
Wei Zhao subconsciously asked: “What does the little cousin look like?” The little aunt is so pretty, so the cousin should not be bad either.
“How should I know? I haven’t met him yet.” Wei Ping was not in a hurry. Anyway, the decree had come down and they would meet sooner or later.
“As for you, did you get into a conflict with someone again? I think the person standing over there looks familiar. Don’t blame me for not reminding you. If the eldest brother knew, he would definitely scold you again.”
Thinking of his elder brother’s face that was like an iceberg, Wei Zhao shuddered subconsciously.
Wei Zhao was not afraid of anyone at home, not even his uncles or grandfather. If he annoyed them, he would at most be beaten. But if he made his eldest brother angry, it would not be just a beating.
“How could that be possible!” Wei Zhao quickly explained.
“It was really not me who started the trouble today. It was that Zheng who was being servile. He took things from others without paying. How could I tolerate this?”
But at the same time, he also discovered that the vendors didn’t seem to want him to stand up for them.
Speaking of this, Wei Zhao was absent-minded for a moment.
“Forget it, let’s not talk about this.” The depressed mood flashed across his face, and Wei Zhao subconsciously wanted to talk about something happy with his brother.
“You don’t know, this little brat wanted to teach me a lesson at first, saying that I didn’t know anything but was just helping. But guess what, he ended up helping that guy surnamed Zheng, but that guy ignored him and almost pushed him to the ground. Hahahaha, I was dying of laughter.”
Following behind the two of them, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but twitch his lips slightly when his name was called.
Wei Ping also didn’t think too much about it and couldn’t help laughing: “According to what you said, this child is too stupid and naive.”
There are actually people who believe that person surnamed Zheng. It’s obvious that person surnamed Zheng is not a good person!
“Who said it wasn’t? Besides, he also believed that the thin one was the one being bullied, and the strong one must be the one bullying others. Don’t you think that’s right, kid?”
What else can Ye Shuo say at this moment?
“…Yep.”
Wei Ping couldn’t help laughing.
Ye Shuo felt numb all over.
“I’m telling you, if you meet someone like Zheng in the future, don’t be so foolish as to help him. People like him are full of bad intentions. Even if you help him, he won’t appreciate your kindness.”
Wei Zhao saw that he was young, not even as old as his youngest brother, so he couldn’t help but admonish him.
But it didn’t take long for Wei Zhao and Wei Ping to realise something was wrong.
If the boy followed them in the beginning because he was shocked and his soul was wandering subconsciously, then why didn’t he have any intention of leaving now that he has arrived at the gate of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion?
“What are you doing following us around, kid?”
How come they haven’t reacted yet even now? ?
Ye Shuo had completely given up any hope on these two cousins.
But it doesn’t matter. I have eighteen cousins, minus two still has sixteen. If that doesn’t make up for the situation, I still have six uncles. According to probability, there must be a few reliable ones among them.
While Wei Zhao and Wei Ping were stunned, Xiao Lu Zi, who was sent to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion in advance, was about to cry when he saw his master.
“Your Highness, you are finally here!”
“You made me wait so long!”
Xiao Luzi hesitated whether he should practise some Kung Fu in addition to studying, otherwise it would be unacceptable to be thrown down by the Ninth Prince every time!
Wei Zhao and Wei Ping could not help but be stunned.
Your Highness?
When Xiao Luzi rushed down the stairs, the maids, servants and even the housekeeper of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion all knelt on the ground.
“The young ones pay their respects to His Majesty the Ninth Prince.”
Seeing that his two cousins ​​were still in a daze, Ye Shuo sighed, shook his head, and walked past them without saying anything.
In other words, this idiotic kid is their cousin?
The son of His Majesty and my aunt, the ninth prince of the current dynasty?
After realising what was happening, Wei Zhao and Wei Ping were dumbfounded on the spot.
It took about a cup of tea to walk into Duke Zhen’s Mansion. Before Ye Shuo had time to look around, he was stunned by his cousins ​​and uncles who lined up to greet him.
They were all strong men with muscular bodies, dark faces and broad backs. The only difference between them was their age.
Although it is wrong to judge people by appearance, and a strong body does not mean brave but not wise, the silly smiles on these people’s faces are almost identical to those of his two cousins ​​just now, making it hard for Ye Shuo to believe that the person he is looking for is among them.
It’s over…
Ye Shuo’s eyes went dark.
Just when Ye Shuo’s heart, liver and lungs were trembling violently, Wei Wen finally walked out of the crowd.
People who have not seen it with their own eyes will never know how great an impact it was for Ye Shuo to see a fair-skinned, tired-looking, bookish young man walk out from a group of black-faced men.
The moment they saw the young man walk out, the cousins ​​who were originally in a state of excitement suddenly became silent. Even Wei Zhao and Wei Ping, who had rushed into the door, subconsciously stopped and then quickly lowered their heads.
The six uncles standing in front of him almost instinctively shut their mouths. Ye Shuo immediately understood who he should put his hopes on.
Meeting the young man’s warm, calm and slightly numb eyes, Ye Shuo’s heart instantly rekindled new hope.
At the same time, inside the palace, Emperor Jingwen soon received the news that his son was nearly knocked down while helping someone on the street in Shangjing City.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Bottom Out
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The guards escorting Ye Shuo were all the spies of Emperor Jingwen, so it was not surprising that the guards reported this episode to Emperor Jingwen.
When Emperor Jingwen heard that his son subconsciously chose to help another person even though he and the son of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion did not know each other, he felt that it was only natural.
After all, the little bastard said it himself that he didn’t like generals who were prone to violence, and he had an even stronger dislike for people with muscles all over their bodies.
It seems that the little bastard really didn’t lie.
Emperor Jingwen now vaguely discovered that his son seemed to only like good-looking people, not to mention the two guards chosen for the imperial concubine’s maid, and the same was true even for his own sister.
Only when Jianjian gradually grew up would he reach out to hug her. When she was just born, he did not even touch her.
How could anyone identify people in this way?
Emperor Jingwen, who discovered this secret, was speechless for a long time.
The purpose of Emperor Jingwen sending his son to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion was to break his inherent impression, but why did it not only fail but make it more profound?The young master of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion acted in this way, didn’t he just prove what his son said before?
Emperor Jingwen frowned subconsciously, somewhat dissatisfied with Wei Zhao.
After hearing the whole story, Emperor Jingwen found that it was not the case at all.
It was the young master of the Zheng family who took the rouge first and then refused to pay.
Emperor Jingwen was no fool. After a little thought, he realised that the young master of the Zheng family was setting a trap for Wei Zhao.
Moreover, this young master named Zheng is none other than the queen’s nephew.
How could Emperor Jingwen not know why?
The actions of the Queen’s family are becoming more and more absurd. The Queen herself is like this, and so are her family members.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly remembered that the Duke of Zhen seemed to have been reported by the censors many times because of the affairs of his descendants. From time to time, he was singled out by those censors and criticised for not managing his family well.
From the perspective of the past, Emperor Wen really thought that this was the truth, but when he saw it today, it seemed that there was something else going on.
As an emperor, it was quite easy for Emperor Jingwen to find out these little things. Not long after, the secret guards came back with their investigation results.
Emperor Jingwen then realised that the reason why the Zhen family had such a reputation was that there were so many people behind it.
The sons of the township government are unsatisfactory, but there are not many active shots in them. There are seven or eight times in the ten rounds of the other party, but because the final result is basically a unilateral beating by people, the truth in front of the front is covered.
The young master of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion does not seem to be as bullying and hopeless as the rumours say.
There are still some good points, for example… warm-hearted? If he wants to help in any situation, then he is indeed warm-hearted enough.
It’s just that my brain isn’t working very well.
To say that his brain wasn’t working well was an understatement. Emperor Jingwen didn’t understand how someone could be so stupid.
Others’ traps are almost always successful, and the same trick has been used two or three times, but these people in Zhen Mansion are still being deceived. The entire Zhen Mansion does nothing every day except losing money.
What’s even more exaggerated is that someone inside seems to have discovered a business opportunity, and coming here once or twice a month is enough to provide a family with food and drink.
Fortunately, Madam Wei and her daughters-in-law have some business skills, otherwise, no matter how rich the family was, the entire Duke’s Mansion would have been left with nothing after so many years.
Emperor Jingwen had considered that this was all a show at first, until he thought about it later: how much thought must be put into it to be able to do it for more than ten years without revealing any flaws?
So it is basically certain that they are all true.
Holding the pile of letters in front of him, Emperor Jingwen was speechless for a long time.
In his opinion, having a child like Xiaojiu who causes trouble everywhere is already a headache, but there are 17 such children in the Zhenguo Mansion, and the only one who has some ability is the eldest son.
However, no matter how capable the eldest son is, he alone cannot handle the whole thing.
Xiaojiu is smart after all. When he gets into trouble, he can make people hate him but at the same time he can also bring him some comfort. But the group of people in front of him are really stupid.
There is no hope for this Duke’s Mansion.
Emperor Jingwen shook his head after reading it.
the other side.
As the eldest grandson, Wei Wen, despite being exhausted, received his little cousin politely and warmly.
After so many years, his expectations were dashed time and time again. He had become numb and resigned himself to his fate. He no longer held out any hope.
Therefore, he never thought about the good things at all.
“Your Highness, grandpa has been waiting in the main hall for a long time. Please come this way.” On the way, Wei Wen introduced several uncles and cousins ​​to Ye Shuo in an orderly manner.
Although he felt that his cousin would not be able to remember so many people in one go, Wei Wen still called them one by one without any perfunctory attitude.
But everyone whose names he mentioned, including the six uncles, did not show the slightest sign of dissatisfaction.
Seeing Ye Shuo looking at him, he subconsciously responded with a smile that he thought was gentle but was actually naive and scary.
There is no way. It is really difficult to make several strong men who can kill a cow with one punch suddenly become gentle.
Normally, when the children at home are naughty, the six of us would deal with them with our fists, but we can’t do the same to my sister’s children, right?
Not to mention that the other party is a prince and cannot be hit, just look at the small body of my nephew. He is so thin that he may not be able to withstand even a light punch from me.
Royal children are naturally raised in a pampered manner.
Ye Shuo keenly noticed the almost overflowing pity in the expressions of several uncles, and he couldn’t help but remain silent for a while.
Although he didn’t know what his uncles were thinking, Ye Shuo dared to bet that it would not be a good thing.
Along the way, my eldest cousin was in charge of reception almost the entire time. One could tell at a glance who was in charge and who was the boss of the house.
The eldest cousin was very measured in his speech and actions, and his younger brothers were all convinced. No one dared to interrupt him when he was speaking. Seeing this clearly, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but increase his confidence in him.
But speaking of this, if my guess is true, and only one of the eighteen cousins ​​has mutated, then what kind of life has this eldest cousin lived for all these years…
Six uncles and seventeen cousins ​​are equivalent to twenty-three members, and they are the more destructive ones.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel awe for the cousin in front of him.
Wei Wen paused for a moment. For some reason, he felt that his little cousin was looking at him with sympathy.
When he looked carefully, it seemed to be just an illusion. He was standing beside him, and his expression had clearly not changed from beginning to end.
“What’s wrong?” Ye Shuo asked knowingly.
“…Nothing.” Wei Wen had no doubts. Seeing that the banquet in the main hall was already in sight, he stopped and said respectfully, “Your Highness, we are here.”
My cheap father wasn’t that stingy. He even asked the guards to follow him when he ate.
The guards retreated automatically when they saw my uncle and cousin.
Therefore, Ye Shuo didn’t have to be too careful about what he said at this moment.
“Thank you for being polite, cousin. Why should we be so particular between cousins?” Ye Shuo sighed barely perceptible and did not look at him again after he finished speaking. Seeing that his grandfather had already taken the initiative to greet him, Ye Shuo hurried forward.
The young prince walked past him. For some reason, for a moment, Wei Wen felt that the other party had become exceptionally mature.
However, while he was stunned, the Duke of Zhen had already reunited with Ye Shuo.
This was the first time in his life that he saw his grandson. Although his thin physique was not to his liking, he could still see the shadow of his daughter in his features.
The old Duke Zhen’s eyes were sore, and he said in a muffled voice: “Greetings to the Ninth Prince. Greetings to the Ninth Prince.”
Having said this, the Duke of Zhen was about to salute.
But Ye Shuo could not accept this courtesy. Without waiting for his grandfather to kneel, he stepped forward and held his hand tightly: “Grandfather, please stand up quickly. There is no need for this.”
If his mother knew about this, she would probably break his legs.
Not only did Ye Shuo not dare to accept it, logically he should even kowtow to the old Duke Zhen, but… this was not going to work in the end.
An occasional word wouldn’t matter, but if he really knelt down, it would reach his stepfather’s ears within an hour.
Therefore, Ye Shuo could only hold his grandfather’s hand even tighter.
This child is quite strong.
The old Duke Zhen was surprised and stunned for a moment, then after he reacted, he immediately smiled happily.
“Okay, okay, you look like someone from our family!”
…So, in this family, people make their living by strength and force, right?
Feeling his grandfather immediately holding back his grip with greater force, Ye Shuo couldn’t help sweating.
“By the way, His Majesty asked you to come here this time because he wants to give you a martial arts lesson, right?” According to the time, the Ninth Prince has indeed reached the age required by the royal family to practise martial arts. The old Duke Zhen thinks that he has nothing to show for it, but in terms of martial arts, he is definitely a leader.
Even though he is already sixty years old, the old Duke Zhen still dares to say that even this year’s top martial arts champion is not his opponent.
No matter when, a strong body is always very important.
The old Duke Zhenguo planned to pass on all he had learned throughout his life to his grandson, so that the child would not be bullied by others.
“Come, let your grandfather take a look at your foundation first.” He did what he said. The old Duke Zhenguo didn’t think too much about it. He was impatient and wanted to test his grandson’s foundation right away.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to avoid it, but thinking that he was his grandfather and his mother’s father after all, after weighing the pros and cons, he just stood there without moving.
The old Duke Zhenguo was unaware of anything, and the first thing he did was to check the condition of his Dantian.
If the Dantian is damaged, it will be useless no matter how good your bones are.
The old Duke of Zhenguo stretched out his hand and muttered, as if reminding: “Grandfather told you, especially this Dantian, you must protect it at all times. Dantian is the most important thing for martial artists… huh???”
Oh my God!
Where did this kid get such internal strength? ?
As soon as the old Duke Zhenguo touched Ye Shuo’s dantian, he was immediately repelled. Caught off guard, the old Duke Zhen’s voice suddenly changed tone.
Ye Shuo, who was standing next to him, seemed to be unaware of it and looked at him innocently: “Grandfather, what’s wrong with you? Grandfather, why are you silent?”
Come on, talk about it. What the hell is there for me to say?
Why does he need to practise martial arts with his skills?
Wait a minute.
Something seems wrong.
The old Duke Zhen finally reacted. If the emperor really knew that his son had this ability, he would naturally not use this as an excuse.
This means that this child should be self-taught. Maybe His Majesty is not aware of this…
The old Duke of Zhen dared not take it lightly, and subconsciously tried to cover it up: “Ahem… I am in good health in all aspects.”
Ye Shuo was slightly startled when he heard this, and immediately understood something.
“Child, never again–” The old Duke of Zhen lowered his voice and spoke in a voice that only two people could hear. As a result, he was stunned in the middle of his speech.
When he turned his head, he met Ye Shuo’s eyes, which now looked a little complicated, and the old Duke Zhen’s heart skipped a beat.
…over.
At first sight, this kid found out everything about me!

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Madman
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo had not expected this to happen.
The two, one big and one small, looked at each other, and the atmosphere suddenly became awkward.
I never expected that in just a few words, I would be tricked into revealing my secrets.
What to do? What to do? What to do!
The hot blood rushed to his head, and the old Duke Zhen was speechless for a long time. He opened his mouth and tried to argue, but he couldn’t find any good excuse for a while.
Following behind, Wei Wen looked at this, then looked at that, somewhat confused.
Grandfather and my little cousin were talking and laughing just now, why did they suddenly become silent?
Seeing that his grandfather was about to get angry if he didn’t say anything, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but whisper to comfort him, “Grandfather, don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone.”
Judging from his grandfather’s series of reactions just now, Ye Shuo didn’t think that his grandfather was the kind of old fox who hid very deeply.Even a really shrewd person wouldn’t be blown up so easily.
All I can say is that I’m barely protecting myself under the nose of my cheap father.
“Look, you also discovered my secret, so we are even.” Exchanging secrets, they established initial trust.
The old Duke Zhen smiled bitterly, feeling that he was really going backwards as time went by. It was bad enough that he suffered losses everywhere in the court, but now a child of a few years old could lead him by the nose.
The old Duke Zhen had long felt that the capital city was not suitable for him. Every person there was a cunning person. If he kept dealing with these people all day long, he would be eaten to the point where not even a bone would be left.
As it turns out, this is indeed the case.
“Alas, I’m getting old.” The old Duke Zhen couldn’t help but sigh.
But having said that, there has never been such a treacherous person in their family before.
The old Duke Zhen does have some wisdom, but it is basically the result of years of experience and practice. It is far from enough to be used in the court. His real ability lies in leading troops and fighting.
Not to mention his sons and daughter. His sons were forced to be kept in seclusion before they could really hone their talents on the battlefield. Until now, the six of them have had little contact with the court, and they don’t like to study, and are even worse than himself.
As for my daughter, I never thought of marrying her into the royal family at the beginning. After all, she was brought up to be naive.
As for the grandchildren, they are even worse. The six sons have at least seen what the battlefield is like and have stayed at the border for a few years, but the grandchildren have never even left the capital.
What’s the use of having great skills? If you are fed with good food and drink every day but have no official position and can only hang out outside all day, even the best seedling will be ruined after so many years.
To be honest, the old Duke Zhen is already very content with what his grandchildren have become today.
We are lucky enough that there are no extremely evil people among them, nor are there people who exploit the common people and ruin their ancestral property.
The current state of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion is a true reflection of the saying that wealth cannot last for more than three generations.
The decline of the Zhen Mansion is imminent, and the only hope is the eldest grandson with outstanding talent. However, the current situation has forced the eldest grandson to be unable to get married, let alone become an official. How can he revive the family?
Even though the old Duke Zhen was unwilling in his heart, he could only watch.
In the final analysis, the Duke Zhen Mansion is just struggling to survive. If a way out of this impasse is still not found, there will soon no longer be any so-called Duke Zhen Mansion in the Great Zhou.
The current emperor is far from being comparable to the previous emperor. Once there is any unusual movement on his side, the emperor will certainly not show mercy. His secret guards will surely come out in full force and slaughter everyone in the Duke’s Mansion.
Although the old Duke Zhen had never seen what a secret guard looked like, he believed that His Majesty definitely had the ability to do so.
The old Duke Zhen thought that he didn’t have the ability to beat those people, so he could only pull out his own teeth and claws and surrender, maybe he could still have a chance of survival.
But my grandson…
My own daughter knows herself well and feels that she would never be able to give birth to a son like this.
Could it be that the Feng Shui of the royal family is so nourishing?
How old is he…
The old Duke Zhen’s eyes gradually became strange.
Although his grandfather didn’t say it explicitly, Ye Shuo could guess it a little.
“Thank you for your hard work over the years, grandpa.” If it weren’t for his grandfather’s clear vision, he and his mother would not have perished along with the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, but they would certainly not have been able to live as leisurely as they do now.
“What happened to me is nothing, but you…child, you have suffered a lot…” At this point, how could the old Duke Zhen not understand what was happening?
He had been wondering why life at home had become better as the Ninth Prince grew up, and it turned out that the root of the problem was here.
I’m afraid my grandson has contributed a lot.
Thinking that a child of only a few years old had to plan all these things carefully, the old Duke Zhen couldn’t help but feel sad in his heart.
Looking at the old Duke Zhen who suddenly burst into tears while chatting, Wei Wen couldn’t help but be stunned.
Although grandpa was very excited to see my aunt’s son, it shouldn’t be this serious…
The old Duke Zhen was completely unaware and held his grandson’s hand tightly, “You’ve suffered so much over the years. Your mother… must have caused you a lot of worry, child.”
“How could that be?” Ye Shuo shook his head: “It’s my cousins ​​and uncles who should make things more difficult for you.”
There are only two people he needs to worry about, but there are more than twenty people in the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion.
The moment he finished speaking, the old Duke Zhen cried even harder.
He had never been so embarrassed in any battle in his life.
“It’s okay, it’s okay. In fact, it’s your eldest cousin who is worried about the family.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Sure enough, the eldest cousin was the most miserable one.
“Wow, Grandfather, you are really too rude, aren’t you?”
“To be honest, I have no choice. Your eldest cousin is the only one I can rely on in my family. What can I do? By the way, don’t tell Wen’er about this…”
Ye Shuo: “Heh.”
Seeing the grandfather who had established a deep relationship with his little cousin in just less than half an incense stick of time, not to mention Wei Wen, even Wei Zhao and the others were stunned.
What’s more, at the banquet, the old Duke Zhen pulled Ye Shuo to his side, as if he couldn’t leave him even for a moment.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to compromise: “…Don’t be like this, Grandfather, I promise you.”
The old Duke Zhen then reluctantly let him go.
How can a military commander’s family have meals without wine?
“Come on, Dad, let’s go for a walk!” After a few bowls of wine, Ye Shuo’s uncles gradually became bolder.
The old Duke Zhen didn’t care. He took it with a smile and soon started drinking with his son.
After some observation, Ye Shuo found that except for his grandfather and eldest cousin, there were no particularly outstanding figures among his other six uncles or seventeen cousins.
Of course, this only applies to speech, behaviour and interpersonal relationships. I don’t know about the battlefield. After all, it is… difficult to verify.
Before he met his grandfather, Ye Shuo believed that all this was just a coincidence.
As the saying goes, wealth does not last for more than three generations. It is not difficult to understand that by the third generation, due to all kinds of pampering, a family is full of mediocre people.
But now, although his grandfather was not a wise man, he could at least see things clearly. This made it difficult for Ye Shuo not to wonder if his grandfather had deliberately made his cousins ​​useless.
Seventeen grandchildren…
If this is true, it is really too heartbreaking.
Looking at his cousins ​​who were making a mess while eating, and then looking at his grandfather who was sitting upright, looking at everything in front of him with a smile, Ye Shuo wondered if his grandfather had ever felt the same as he did.
But this is not a long-term solution after all.
His grandfather’s goal was too big. Ye Shuo thought about it for a long time and finally decided to find a chance to talk to his unlucky cousin.
Whether it is the suspicion of his stepfather, the decision of his successor, or the future of the Duke’s Mansion, no matter which of the above situations, a way to break the deadlock is needed.
It can’t just keep rotting like this, right?
So when Ye Shuo followed Wei Wen to sneak away, the Duke of Zhen thought about it and did not stop them, and even helped to attract attention.
But at this time, the old Duke Zhen didn’t think much about it. He just thought that the arrival of his grandson might make the family better off?
the other side.
Wei Wen really couldn’t stand the foul smell in the room. He was afraid that if he stayed any longer he would be tempted to curse, so he decisively walked out to get some fresh air on the eve of the outbreak.
However, not long after, Wei Wen discovered that there seemed to be someone following him.
Wei Wen turned his head suddenly and was startled: “Your Highness, why are you here?”
“Are you in urgent need of going to the bathroom? The toilet is right here.”
Wei Wen couldn’t help but point to the west.
However, the little cousin in front of him shook his head and said bluntly: “I’m not looking for the toilet, I’m looking for you.”
As far as the current situation is concerned, my grandfather’s family can be trusted, but whether they can be used is another matter.
Therefore, Ye Shuo did not keep anyone in suspense and spoke directly.
Wei Wen looked around almost subconsciously.
As if seeing his worry, Ye Shuo said: “Don’t worry, I checked when I came here, and the guards are not here.”
Who said that His Majesty would only send guards?
Wei Wen was about to say something, but Ye Shuo spoke before him: “The secret guard you are worried about is also not here.”
This sentence contains too much content.
The perfunctory feeling in his heart faded away in an instant, and when Wei Wen looked at his little cousin again, his expression suddenly became surprised and doubtful.
“Long story short.” When dealing with smart people, you don’t need to explain too much. You just need to make your plans clear. My cousin will weigh the matter in his mind whether to participate or not.
He, his mother and the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion are all of the same blood, and their relationship is complementary. Even if his eldest cousin disagrees, he will not reveal it after hearing it.
Therefore, Ye Shuo did not hide anything and directly told everyone his plan.
At the beginning, Wei Wen listened very seriously, but as time went on, his expression became worse and worse, and more and more distorted. In the end, the corners of his mouth and eyes began to twitch to varying degrees.
It turns out that I shouldn’t have high expectations for my own children. Why can’t I learn from this? ?
If my younger brothers are just a headache, then my little cousin is completely whimsical.
See what he is talking about——
Training a person with no foundation to be an official!
Wei Wen knew every word here, but when they were put together, he suddenly couldn’t understand it.
It would have been fine if my little cousin had just talked nonsense, but the reason he gave in the end was even more outrageous.
Just for the little princess’s future marriage.
Wei Wen: “…………”
Oops.
This kid is a lunatic!
After so many idiots in the family, one finally went crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Gaining Trust
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
How old is the little princess now? Less than five months old, right? It will take at least fifteen or sixteen years for the little princess to get married. What else could this person be but a lunatic?
Even if you are preparing for a rainy day, there must be a limit. The little cousin in front of me has obviously crossed this line and seems very abnormal.
Seeing his elder cousin who almost had a look of “are you sick?” on his face, Ye Shuo also choked.
So what he just said so passionately turned out to be of no use at all, and people even suspected he was mentally ill, right?
But think about it, what I said does seem to be a bit exaggerated, it is normal for others to feel that it sounds like a fairy tale.
Wei Wen’s behaviour made this plan seem even more feasible.
He thought it was impossible, and others would feel the same way.
This mythical story happened in reality, and no one could believe it.
Wei Wen’s gaze towards him did not last long. After all, he had accumulated a wealth of experience in such matters, and he quickly adjusted his mentality.Wei Wen was even in the mood to make fun of himself. He had seen so many fools that it was quite novel to see a madman occasionally.
Wei Wen, who had experienced many ups and downs, had long since learned to find joy in adversity. He knew very well that the more times like this one were, the more one should not provoke the other party, so he began to automatically focus on comforting while speaking.
The best thing to do now is to help my little cousin calm down, otherwise it would be bad if he gets even crazier.
Just like that, Wei Wen not only did not say a word of rebuttal, but he actively agreed: “My little cousin, what you said makes sense. I really admire you.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Although Ye Shuo had never visited mental patients in a mental hospital in person in modern times, he still clearly remembered that this was how doctors in major film and television works coaxed mental patients to take medicine.
Although my cousin has not experienced that era, he has already learned how to treat mentally ill patients without any guidance, which is really cause for celebration.
After Wei Wen saw that his cousin’s emotions had gradually stabilised, he began to think about getting away: “Oh, Your Highness, I suddenly remembered that the jade pendant on my waist seemed to have been left in the bushes. I may need to go look for it. So I’ll leave you now.”
Ye Shuo looked at him with a gloomy gaze: “When you came here today, you only had a mosquito repellent sachet hanging around your waist. When did you ever wear a jade pendant?”
How did he know…
Wei Wen couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment.
The next moment, Ye Shuo exhaled deeply, and said helplessly: “Don’t worry, cousin, I will prove to you that what I said is indeed not aimless.”
Wei Wen still didn’t believe it.
After all, what he said about water conservancy and flood control, water diversion and irrigation, textile machinery, refined salt purification, iron smelting technology… didn’t sound very reliable. It was extremely difficult to pick out any one of them to achieve. Just taking flood control as an example, if it could be achieved so easily, the people and emperors would not have suffered so much because of this for thousands of years.
How did my little cousin know about this problem that even the current emperor couldn’t solve?
If there really is any good solution, His Majesty should know it before his little cousin who is several years older.
Therefore, based on Wei Wen’s overall knowledge, all the things he said were impossible to achieve.
Indeed, Ye Shuo does not have the ability to completely prevent floods. After all, floods still occur from time to time every summer in modern times. However, he can combine the thousands of years of water control history of the country he lived in in his previous life with the modern experience of flood prevention and control to minimise the damage, which will always be much better than now.
Although Ye Shuo did not do everything himself, he believed that the ancients were only limited by backward technology, but they were not fools. As long as he told the other party the principles and methods, he believed that with the wisdom of the ancients, they would be able to do it quickly.
A dozen years is enough time for a person, or a group of people, to grow.
“Just wait and see, cousin.”
No matter how much you explain, it’s useless. In the end, you have to use facts to speak for yourself. Ye Shuo didn’t make any more excuses, but just asked Wei Wen for a crossbow, intending to try it out and gain his trust.
Understanding the principles of various machines is one of Ye Shuo’s specialties.
Even if we can get the materials, all kinds of robots will be no problem.
After all, the little cousin was a prince, so Wei Wen would naturally give him whatever he asked for. What’s more, the old Duke Zhen was a military general himself, so he naturally had a collection of all the popular bows and crossbows.
Soon Wei Wen handed the things to Ye Shuo.
After Ye Shuo observed carefully for a while, he had an idea in his mind.
“Brother, give me one night, and I will give you the result tomorrow.”
After saying that, Ye Shuo called a servant over, handed the crossbow to him, and asked him to put it in his room in the afternoon.
The servant was a little confused at first, but when he saw the eldest master nod, he subconsciously suppressed his curiosity.
Ye Shuo discovered that his eldest cousin seemed to be very good at controlling his subordinates, and even the maids and servants listened to him very much.
“This is the first time we two cousins ​​meet, so I’ll take the initiative to give the crossbow to Your Highness. I hope Your Highness won’t despise it.” And don’t feel any pressure. It’s up to him whether to play with it or take it apart.
Wei Wen had a tolerant look on his face.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Ye Shuo no longer wanted to talk at all.
Soon Ye Shuo returned to the banquet, but Wei Wen waited for a while before coming back.
Perhaps because he was a little excited to see his nephew for the first time, the banquet gradually came to an end until about 3 p.m.
After drinking a few bottles of wine, everyone felt a little dizzy, and gradually lost control of their mouths and tongues. Ye Shuo’s uncle lost control and slapped his nephew hard on the back.
If Ye Shuo wasn’t in good health, he would have been beaten to death by him, but even if Ye Shuo was in good health, he was almost killed by his slap.
Meanwhile, the uncle, totally unaware of his nephew’s suddenly distorted expression, stuck out his tongue and suddenly looked sad: “Look how thin the child is.”
“That’s right. The wind will almost blow it away.” Upon hearing this, the other five uncles couldn’t help but echo one after another.
They wanted to talk about this when they first met. In the eyes of the six people, a real man should be strong and solid.
Looking at my nephew again, he is as thin as a chick, while his cousins ​​are so fat that their arms are almost as thick as his thighs.
But in fact, Ye Shuo’s stature is more slender, and he is completely different from his cousins.
It doesn’t mean that people with thick muscles are necessarily strong. Some people with thin bodies have higher explosive power. But Ye Shuo’s well-proportioned body shape makes him look weak in the eyes of a group of strong men, right?
The eldest uncle couldn’t help but pat his chest and promised: “Tomorrow, I will personally teach you martial arts.” This would prevent his nephew from being bullied in the palace again.
Caught off guard, the old Duke Zhen above couldn’t help but choke and cough.
He is the master already, but you’re still teaching this kid martial arts?
To be honest, if he went back ten years, he might not be this kid’s opponent. Now he only has the advantage of age, and there is not much he can teach.
However, what the old Duke Zhen didn’t know was that Ye Shuo had only practised internal strength and some hidden weapon firing techniques, and he really didn’t know any specific moves.
Over the years, the greatest purpose of Ye Shuo’s internal strength training was just to keep warm, escape, climb trees, hold his breath underwater, and treat colds.
If the old Duke Zhen knew that he actually used his inner strength to do these things, he would probably be furious.
What’s the difference between this and using gold to buy sesame cakes!
However, because of his adoptive father’s attitude changing too quickly, Ye Shuo immediately rejected it sternly.
Anyway, no matter what, his stepfather would force him to learn it even if he had to force him, and it didn’t matter even if his uncle took it seriously.
Sure enough, under heavy pressure, Ye Shuo was soon “forced” to accept it.
If the old Duke Zhen had not felt the rich energy in his dantian, he would have thought that he was particularly averse to practising martial arts.
After agreeing to gather at the martial arts arena at 11:00 a.m. tomorrow, several uncles and cousins ​​returned to their respective courtyards with the help of their servants.
Ye Shuo also returned to the courtyard that his aunts had carefully prepared for him.
All the items were brand new, and things like quilts had been specially dried in the sun, full of dead mites… ah, the smell of sunshine.
Ye Shuo’s heart also felt a little warmer.
Ye Shuo didn’t pay much attention to the crossbow that was already placed on his desk. He even took a nap and started to modify it after getting up.
Since he didn’t have any suitable tools at hand, and it would take some time for Ye Shuo to get started with the ancient tools, he simply took out a stack of rice paper and planned to start drawing directly.
First he disassembled the crossbow, then assembled it, then disassembled and assembled it again. After repeating this process twice, Ye Shuo began to carefully measure the size of each component with a ruler.
Subconsciously, he was about to take a pen to take notes, but… looking at the ink pool on the rice paper, Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, and suddenly remembered that he forgot to ask his cousin to prepare charcoal pencils in advance.
After getting the charcoal pencil, Ye Shuo calmed down and started writing and drawing, and began to improve the crossbow based on the original one.
Before evening, Ye Shuo had almost finished, and in the end he couldn’t even help but draw out another brand new crossbow design in his mind.
Cold weapons such as bows and crossbows are relatively backward. In war, hot weapons such as gunpowder are more powerful.
But there is a problem. The production of simple gunpowder is not complicated, and it is even very easy to copy. Once it is used on the battlefield, the other two countries will soon be able to come up with something similar, and the casualties will only be greater.
Ye Shuo didn’t believe that only his stepfather had secret guards, while the emperors of the other two countries didn’t.
Besides, the power to use gunpowder was not in Ye Shuo’s hands, and Ye Shuo had no way of avoiding the abuse of gunpowder.
By then, all lives will be lost and the only ones who will suffer will be the common people.
And even if we use explosives to destroy those two countries, then what? If productivity can’t keep up, and there are suddenly so many extra mouths, people will starve to death if they don’t have enough food.
So let’s do it little by little, slowly.
After Ye Shuo finished drawing, he handed the two pictures to the servant beside his eldest cousin.
Soon, Wei Wen had two more things in his hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Finished Product
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Because it was just casually delivered by the servant, Wei Wen didn’t take it seriously at first.
It was almost time to go to bed when Wei Wen suddenly remembered this, so he took it out and looked at it in the candlelight.
After a quick glance, Wei Wen was stunned.
Although this drawing is somewhat different from other crossbow designs, it looks quite similar.
Wei Wen knows a little bit about this and has some vision.
Wei Wen hesitated for a while, but finally asked his personal servant to secretly hand the two pieces of paper to the craftsman in the mansion.
“Let Uncle Wei take a look and see if he can do it.”
The old Duke’s surname is Wei, and the craftsman in the mansion is also surnamed Wei. It is easy to imagine what the other party’s relationship with the mansion is like.
Wei Wen was a very smart man, and he was also the eldest grandson of the eldest son. Naturally, he knew who in the mansion could be used, who could not be used, and who had doubts in their hearts.The servant took the order, hid the two drawings in his sleeves, and soon disappeared into the night.
A night passed.
The next morning, Ye Shuo was still immersed in a sweet dream. Before he could even open his eyes, he was carried to the martial arts field by several guards.
The guards had long been accustomed to the Ninth Prince staying in bed, and were very familiar with doing this.
When Ye Shuo arrived, his six uncles and cousins ​​had already practised several sets of boxing. All of them had their upper bodies exposed, their skin was as white as copper, and they were sweating all over.
Ye Shuo, with his rosy lips and white teeth, stood there, looking as weak as he could be, like a rabbit that suddenly broke into a pack of wolves.
My little cousin is too weak. I feel like he can be knocked down with just one finger.
Wei Zhao and Wei Ping, in particular, were filled with worry.
“Come on, come here quickly. I’ll teach you the basics first. Show me how to do a horse stance.” Without saying a word, the uncle took the lead in demonstrating.
The horse stance mainly exercises the lower body. People who practice martial arts must have a stable lower body, otherwise, even the most profound internal strength can be easily caught by others’ weaknesses and broken.
This is common sense. Even if his cheap master Wu Yi didn’t say it, Ye Shuo would know it.
While maintaining the operation of his inner strength every day, Ye Shuo would also secretly stand for a while in his room before going to bed at night. Children are highly malleable and their bones are relatively soft, so over the years he has treated it as a form of physical exercise. From a few seconds or dozens of seconds at the beginning, Ye Shuo can now maintain this for nearly half an hour.
