Less than half an hour is not a lot for a martial artist who has to stand still for an hour or two at any time. But after all, Ye Shuo is not the kind of person who is impatient for success. He is still young and can proceed step by step.
What is important is persistence. Over time, quantitative changes will eventually lead to qualitative changes.
The most taboo thing for martial artists is to steal others’ skills, and the old Duke Zhen’s kung fu was all inherited from his family, so after sending Ye Shuo away, the guards left tactfully.
Ye Shuo half-knelt down as his uncle requested.
Originally, the uncle had already prepared to correct his nephew. Don’t underestimate the horse stance. Although it is the basics, not everyone can do it. If the posture is wrong, it will be useless.
As a result…the uncle was surprised to find that his nephew’s movements were quite standard.
Isn’t it true? Ye Shuo has studied it specially. Fitness also requires standard movements. Otherwise, wouldn’t all his training over the years have been in vain?
“Not bad.” My uncle couldn’t help but praise.
“Keep it like this for half an hour first.”
This, this is too cruel. It took half an hour to get here.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but take a breath.
But Ye Shuo didn’t say anything. There is a saying that goes, nothing is difficult in this world as long as you are willing to give up.
If he really couldn’t hold on any longer, he could just give up. Ye Shuo had never intended to become fat in one go, he had his own exercise plan.
The uncle had no idea that his nephew had such a lack of ambition. Seeing how obedient he was, he nodded with satisfaction and continued to practice with the others.
While Ye Shuo was doing horse stance there alone, he began to observe the moves of his uncle and cousins.
As the saying goes, reviewing the old helps one learn the new. Almost every day, my uncle and cousins ​​would review the skills they had learned so that when they really need them, their bodies can react proactively and they won’t be suddenly dumbfounded when encountering danger.
In this way, Ye Shuo watched everything that his uncle and cousins ​​demonstrated.
The old Duke of Zhen came over at about noon, when it was already bright and his morning exercise was about to end.
Ye Shuo stopped at around forty minutes, about five minutes longer than before, and felt okay.
The most important thing is that the eldest uncle said he would supervise him, but after he started fighting with the second and third uncles in the middle of the martial arts field, his cousins ​​cheered and no one paid any attention to him who was still in the corner.
By the time the uncle had counted for half an hour, was sweating profusely, and looked over with great joy, Ye Shuo had already stopped.
You know, in the eyes of parents, if children are studying when they go out and playing with mobile phones when they come back, it means they are playing with mobile phones all day long.
This phenomenon applies everywhere, including in ancient times.
In addition, Ye Shuo’s head was clean without any sweat. In the eyes of his uncle, wouldn’t it seem that he was just being lazy?
No matter how unmotivated a child is at home, he or she will have a positive attitude towards practising martial arts.
Just when the eldest uncle couldn’t help frowning, the old Duke Zhen happened to arrive.
Then he saw the scene of his elder son criticising his grandson for being unconscious.
Old Zhen: “…”
If my grandson really had no self-discipline, how could he have secretly cultivated his internal strength to this level by himself?
“Okay, I understand. You guys go eat first.”
The moment the words fell, almost everyone looked at the old Duke of Zhen with disbelief.
No matter how much he doted on his grandchildren, the old Duke Zhen had never done this.
The eldest uncle couldn’t hold back and blurted out: “Dad, you were not like this before.”
Isn’t this too much of a spoiling for the child?
Although I can understand that my father cannot see his sister and will inevitably place all his love on his grandson, but, this is not loving him, it is clearly harming him!
The uncle tried to persuade him earnestly, but how could the old Duke Zhen listen to him?
“Is it your turn to teach me how to do things? Go away, go and have dinner.” The Duke of Zhen did not hesitate and drove his son and grandson out of the martial arts field.
The uncles wanted to say something but hesitated, but they could not resist the tough father, and finally they could only leave dejectedly.
A group of cousins ​​couldn’t help but express their deep sympathy to the little cousin.
He has a weak constitution, but my grandfather still dotes on him like this. What will he do in the future?
After the martial arts arena was cleared, the Duke of Zhen asked, “How is your study going?”
Ye Shuo thought about it, then nodded: “It’s OK.”
What will it look like now?
The old Duke of Zhen didn’t understand, so he asked, “Show it to me?”
Ye Shuo did not refuse. The actions of his uncles just now flashed through his mind quickly. Then Ye Shuo imitated them and slapped out with his palm.
The old Duke Zhen always felt that this palm was somewhat familiar, and then he realised, isn’t this the palm method passed down from their family’s ancestors?
The next moment, there was a “click” sound, and the stone pier in front of me cracked.
The old Duke of Zhen was speechless for a long time.
The old Duke Zhen subconsciously looked around.
Ye Shuo knew what he was worried about, so he said, “Don’t worry, no one is watching here.”
My cheap dad is not that idle, he has to send someone to keep an eye on it all the time.
The old Duke Zhen is not like Wei Wen. Having lived to such an old age, he has seen more.
When the old Duke Zhen heard this, he felt something was wrong.
“By the way, I forgot to ask you before, where did you learn this internal strength?” It stands to reason that this child was raised in the deep palace and should not have contact with outsiders.
A thought flashed through the old Duke Zhen’s mind, and the next moment, his premonition came true.
“Who else could it be? I might as well learn ordinary Kung Fu from you.” Ye Shuo is a picky person. He won’t accept anything that is not the best.
Old Zhen: “…”
The old Duke of Zhen finally understood why he knew so well whether the secret guards were nearby.
“You, you wouldn’t be the one who even treats the people around His Majesty as -“
“That’s not the case. I really don’t have that much ability.” Ye Shuo waved his hand quickly: “I learned it from observing my master Wu Yi every day.”
As for secret guards, they are updated and iterated frequently, and are basically produced on an assembly line. For things like hiding and concealing, where can they change to?
Where has the old Duke of Zhen ever seen anyone stealing other people’s skills in this way?
But judging from the skill he just showed, if it were him, maybe it would really work.
Originally, the ten days given by His Majesty were just for him to lay the foundation. Now, he has learned all the basics, and the rest is just to practice and digest them slowly.
The old Duke Zhen thought that there was nothing left for him to teach. He could learn it just by watching from the side. What else could he teach?
But this is just what he thought, Ye Shuo doesn’t think so.
“By the way, grandpa, can you teach me some more practical skills, the kind that can defeat the enemy with one move?” Ye Shuo tried it, and found that the moves practiced by his uncle and others were indeed very powerful, but at the same time, they also consumed a lot of energy.
Whether it looks good or not is not important to Ye Shuo. What is important is its practicality. If he encounters an enemy, the most important thing is to survive.
“…What do you mean?”
Ye Shuo cleared his cough, then stood on tiptoe and whispered something into the old Duke Zhen’s ear.
The old Duke Zhen’s mouth began to twitch gradually. It turned out that he wanted to learn things that were not presentable, such as grabbing people’s eyes and kicking them in the crotch.
“Which serious young man would learn this kind of thing?!” Nowadays, noble families value elegance, especially the royal family. Winning or losing is not important, but appearance is what matters. How can there be someone like him?
“It’s totally corrupting the moral standards!” The old Duke Zhen was indignant.
However, if someone else said this, Ye Shuo might believe it, but what his grandfather said… How can one survive on the battlefield with dignity?
Not to mention that my grandfather rose step by step from the bottom.
Ye Shuo just didn’t believe that his grandfather had never used these dirty tricks.
In the end, under Ye Shuo’s eyes that seemed to see through people, the old Duke Zhen retreated.
“But it’s useless if I teach you alone. It’s useless if you can’t find someone to practice with you.” The boy didn’t dare to show the skills he learned from the secret guards in front of others easily.
Although it is possible to practise the moves alone without using internal energy, but…
“The problem is that your uncles are not good at this.” His six sons and grandsons were all straightforward and could not learn such sinister tricks, so the old Duke Zhen did not teach them.
“Who said no one would practise with me?” Ye Shuo blinked, looking innocent.
“Isn’t there one ready-made?”
The old Duke of Zhen was puzzled at first, but when he saw that he was staring at him, his expression froze when he realised what was going on.
This kid is not thinking…
On the other side, Haitangyuan——
Because the first design was an improvement on the original crossbow, it would take relatively less time to make the finished product.
The crossbow is still the same crossbow, and from the outside it seems that there has been little change.
Until Wei Wen loaded an arrow into the quiver, then aimed at the target and shot it.
With a “whoosh” sound, the arrow pierced into the crack in the wall.
Wei Wen was stunned when he saw this.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Sick
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Wei Wen had seen the appearance of this crossbow before. It had an almost identical shell, but its power was increased by almost 30%.
Don’t underestimate this 30%. One person may not feel it very much, but what if it is a group of people? The effect is quite terrifying.
What’s more, this is just the result of just a few hours.
Wei Wen initially thought he was mistaken, but after trying it again, he found that it was indeed not an illusion.
“Are you sure there is nothing wrong?” Wei Wen asked again subconsciously.
The servant beside Wei Wen did not hesitate and assured firmly: “I have followed your instructions from beginning to end.”
The servant is trustworthy, and Uncle Wei is trustworthy, so the crossbow in his hand is indeed improved according to the drawing given by his little cousin.
Wei Wen was a little surprised.
“What about the other one? How about the second one?” Wei Wen asked hurriedly.But the servant was not Uncle Wei himself after all, and he had no idea what the lines and markings above meant.
However, the servant was still able to describe Uncle Wei’s reaction exactly as it happened.
“At first, Uncle Wei couldn’t quite figure out what the Ninth Prince was drawing, but since it was the eldest son who asked him to do so, he said he would give it a try. Then I didn’t think much about it, so I put the thing down and left.”
“When I go there again today, wow, guess what—” The servant couldn’t help but gesture with his hand.
“With such heavy dark circles under his eyes, I suspect that Uncle Wei didn’t sleep at all last night.”
Uncle Wei had seen many ups and downs with my grandfather. After he was forced to leave the battlefield due to an injury in one eye, he has been raised in the Zhen Mansion.
The mountains of corpses and seas of blood did not change his expression back then, but now after not sleeping for a whole night, I think Uncle Wei must be very excited.
To be able to make a craftsman like him who specialises in making weapons so excited, it seems that the power of these two blueprints of his little cousin is extraordinary.
As the saying goes, seeing is believing, Wei Wen finally decided to go there in person.
When Wei Wen arrived, Uncle Wei was carving wood in the most remote house in the Duke’s Mansion.
Although Ye Shuo drew the components and marked the proportions and sizes, it was difficult to make them out for a while because Uncle Wei had never seen the shapes of many of the parts before.
This was the third time that Uncle Wei had failed, but instead of feeling anxious, he was extremely focused and didn’t even notice the sound of Wei Wen pushing the door.
Wei Wen did not disturb him. He waited until Uncle Wei had finished his work before speaking: “Uncle Wei, thank you for your hard work.”
Uncle Wei was startled when he suddenly heard a voice other than his own in the room. After realising what he was doing, he quickly put down what he was doing and saluted: “Young Master.”
Before he could bend down, Wei Wen reached out and supported him: “Uncle Wei, there’s no need to be so polite. If my grandfather saw this, he would scold me again.”
“To make a long story short, I think Uncle Wei should be able to guess why I came here today. What do you think of the second drawing, Uncle Wei?”
When Uncle Wei heard him talking about this, he immediately stopped caring about other things and suddenly became like a different person. He looked radiant and his only remaining eye seemed to be glowing.
“From the drawing that the eldest son gave me, it should be the design of a repeating crossbow.”
When he heard the word “crossbow”, Wei Wen couldn’t help but frown.
There are crossbows in the military camp, but due to their low power and poor accuracy, they are basically useless.
Unless, this design is particularly different.
As if he could see through his thoughts, Uncle Wei said with certainty: “Based on my many years of experience, this should be something very different.”
Even if we don’t know how powerful it is, we still have to wait until it is made to determine.
Wei Wen naturally believed what Uncle Wei said, but it was precisely because of this that he became more conflicted.
“By the way, young master, can you tell me who made these two pictures?” Although the second finished product has not yet come out, it must be correct judging from the first one.
Especially such a special and clear way of drawing made Uncle Wei feel a little anxious.
Seeing this scene, Wei Wen couldn’t help but have a clearer understanding of his little cousin.
the other side.
His cousin didn’t come to see him the whole day, but Ye Shuo wasn’t worried. He followed his daily routine and did what he was supposed to do.
Such a big thing should naturally be carefully considered. If it is decided in such a hurry, Ye Shuo will really have doubts in his heart.
He still prefers to work with cautious people.
The next day, as soon as Ye Shuo arrived at the martial arts arena, he was called away by the old Duke Zhen, saying that he would be taught individually.
But in fact, both of them knew what to teach.
“Dad, he hasn’t even laid a solid foundation yet…” Isn’t this nonsense?
Despite the old Duke’s tough attitude and the hesitant expressions of his uncle and cousins, Ye Shuo was finally taken away.
The old Duke Zhen hadn’t used those tricks for many years. At his age, he really couldn’t afford to lose face, so after bringing Ye Shuo to his yard, he decisively closed the door of the yard.
Ye Shuo was always more open and aboveboard when he was drawing the blueprints. Comparing the scene now with that when he was drawing the blueprints, the latter looked more like a scene of a thief.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smack his lips: “It’s really that serious.”
“How could it be possible?” A dignified duke, a dignified prince, was studying here how to dig out people’s eyes, kick people’s crotches, and bite people’s ears. What would happen if this got out?
The Duke of Zhen couldn’t help but puff out his beard and glare.
Ye Shuo beside him couldn’t help but add two sentences silently: “There are also hair pulling and breaking people’s little fingers.”
Old Zhen: “…”
If it were a few decades ago, when the old Duke of Zhen was still a small soldier, people might have praised him, saying that a real man is one who can advance and retreat. But now his status is different after all, and even the old Duke of Zhen has to have dignity.
Ever since his status rose, the old Duke Zhen has almost put away those despicable tricks. After all, as a general, when he challenges the opponent’s main general to a duel, he can’t use these tricks in front of everyone. What kind of talk would that be?
What matters in challenging someone is the momentum. Winning must be beautiful and fair to boost the morale of your own side. Otherwise, the other side will look down on you.
If the victory is unfair, the other party will feel humiliated and may end up making things worse in anger.
So now no one knows that he knows all this. If his grandson hadn’t suddenly mentioned it, the Duke of Zhen would never use it again.
But since he has decided to teach, he will definitely teach well.
Although these despicable tricks sound simple, they are not the same at all when they are actually used. You just raise two fingers and go straight to the person’s eyes. How can the person not be on guard?
Anyone with a little bit of kung fu skills can easily dodge it.
The more shady the trick is, the more unexpected, mysterious and unpredictable it is, making it hard to guard against.
The old Duke Zhen was not polite either, he directly grabbed his grandson to practise with him. After all, he wanted to learn it himself, so what was wrong with enduring a little hardship?
Even though Ye Shuo had practised internal skills for more than five years, he was still no match for the old Duke of Zhen, so the old Duke of Zhen told him not to hold back and just attack.
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate and rushed forward using the palm technique he had just learned.
As a result, before he could react, he felt something sticking to him. Ye Shuo subconsciously tried to shake it off, but he couldn’t.
Then the next moment, he felt a huge force coming from his shoulder, and his whole body was shaking with pain.
“See? It’s a dirty trick. You have to hit close to the person’s body.”
There are so many vital points on a person’s body. If you can’t hit the eyeballs, you can still hit the temples. If you can’t hit the temples, you can still hit the back of the head. If the back of the head doesn’t work, you can still hit the neck, two inches below the ribs, the crotch, the perineum…
Go around from front to back and from back to front, within two circles, the person is basically gone.
Ye Shuo vaguely understood, and it all came down to two words: fast and tricky.
The reaction speed must be fast and the movements must be unpredictable.
“…Come again.” Enduring the pain in his shoulder, Ye Shuo gritted his teeth and started the second round of attack.
As expected, the Duke of Zhen discovered that the trick he had just used was indeed learned by him.
But after learning this, there are other things.
Just like that, after enduring a whole morning of beatings, Ye Shuo gradually figured out what kind of reactions to make in what kind of situations, and… how to stick to others so as not to be easily left behind.
At first, the old Duke Zhen didn’t take it too seriously. After all, no matter how talented a person was, he still had decades more experience than him.
But then the old Duke discovered that this kid could do two things at once, or even do more than one thing at a time…
It’s like his left and right hands can make different movements at the same time, including his legs, and it feels like his four limbs can act independently without being affected at all.
That is to say, the old Duke Zhen has to guard against three places at the same time to prevent him from attacking.
He certainly wouldn’t be defeated, otherwise the old Duke would have lived to such an old age and fought on the battlefield so many times in vain. But the fighting was indeed getting more and more strenuous, and he gradually lost the ease that he had in the beginning when he could be knocked down with one move.
From one move at the beginning, it gradually became two moves, three moves, and so on.
Then The old Duke Zhen found that Ye Shuo was particularly suitable for practising this, because this kid was really ruthless, he didn’t care whether it was good or bad, in his eyes winning was the most important thing anyway, in the end he even used his teeth.
“Stop, stop, stop, it’s getting late, it’s time to have lunch.” A hand clasped his shoulder, making the boy unable to move. Then, the old duke, who was almost kicked in the crotch, looked at the calf that almost brushed past his clothes, and couldn’t help but feel a lingering fear.
But he still pretended to be at ease.
Ye Shuo was not so particular. He howled almost the moment he was controlled: “It hurts, it hurts, it hurts, Grandfather, it’s broken, it’s broken, the bone is breaking!”
Ye Shuo was not feeling much better at this time, he found that his grandfather was actually serious and showed no mercy, which made him experience firsthand what it meant to be in excruciating pain.
It turns out that being beaten hurts so much. And this isn’t even with a knife. If a knife were used, it would be so painful!
If this is the case with our relatives, we would never dare to think about it if it were our enemies.
Ye Shuo became more and more determined to practise these dirty tricks to the end, and would never try to fight with others head-on if he could avoid it.
It’s not shameful, but saving your life is more important than anything else.
After lunch, Ye Shuo almost limped back.
After waking up from his nap, Ye Shuo lifted up his inner wear and, as expected, his arms, legs and stomach were almost all bruised.
This is only the first day, and there are still nine days to go. I really don’t know how I’m going to get through the rest of the day.
What Ye Shuo didn’t know was that the old Duke was also thinking about this question in the room.
What if I get hit by that guy in the next few days? He is so cruel that if I get hit once, I will die.
The two of them felt sad at the same time.
Compared to Ye Shuo who was accepting the old Duke’s special training with pain and happiness, Wei Wen was much more conflicted.
The crossbow on the second drawing was already made on the third day, and Wei Wen even tested its power himself.
Although it is a repeating crossbow, its power is not bad, and it is even better than the ordinary single arrow one.
Ten rounds at a time, the power is incomparable.
Wei Wen’s first reaction was to ask Uncle Wei not to tell this matter to anyone. Then he felt that it was necessary to talk to his younger cousin.
Wei Wen originally thought that his little cousin would come to him first, after all, he looked rather anxious. But… Wei Wen waited and waited, but on the ninth day he still didn’t come. Wei Wen couldn’t sit still any longer, so he had to take the initiative to find him.
At that time, Ye Shuo was sitting on the bed, applying medicine to himself with a grimace.
He did learn those dirty tricks, but the price he paid was not small. He was beaten almost all the time, and Ye Shuo almost couldn’t hold on if he had any willpower.
It turns out that experience still needs to be gained through practice…
Seeing Wei Wen coming in, Ye Shuo pointed to the medicine for injuries and sprains next to him and said, “Cousin, you’ve come at the right time. Please help me.”
It hurts anyway, so if we feel the pain together, at least it will end faster.
Wei Wen did not refuse.
Perhaps the situation in the Duke’s Mansion had lasted for too many years, so that he was somewhat exhausted physically and mentally. In addition, the Duke’s Mansion and his little cousin were now in the same boat. If one made any move, the other would immediately follow suit.
Therefore, Wei Wen was too lazy to beat around the bush and asked directly: “What is your purpose?”
After much thought, Wei Wen felt that the reason for the little princess’s marriage was really untenable.
Unless… there’s really something wrong with his brain.
If it weren’t for the little princess, the rest of the answer would be obvious.
Wei Wen’s eyes couldn’t help but turn cold: “If it’s for that position, I might as well tell you straight out that it’s impossible.”
Life was already difficult, and Wei Wen would never allow him to drag the entire Duke’s Mansion into trouble, even if he was his aunt’s son.
As for being hated by his little cousin? The Zhen Mansion has already experienced enough, and this one is not a big deal.
“So just give up on this idea.”
After realising what his eldest cousin was saying, it was now Ye Shuo’s turn to look at him as if he was crazy.
How desperate must one be to think of becoming an emperor!
“…Do you think the prince’s position is not high enough, or do you think being a prince is not as free as being an emperor?”
“Do you think the emperor doesn’t worry enough, or do you think the idle prince doesn’t have enough leisure time?”

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Liberation
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“I don’t do anything, but I’m guaranteed to be a prince. If I fight, I’ll have to face either life or death. If I don’t fight, I’ll have a free life. Why should I fight in this situation?”
“Isn’t it good to be alive? Why would you want to die? If you are not careful, you will bring trouble to the people around you.”
[1] Here, he is referring himself as 3rd party – you
Ye Shuo was puzzled.
“I am a prince, and I can start my career whenever I want. With my personality, no one will entrust me with important tasks. When the time comes, I can go wherever I want and eat whatever I want.”
“With my father and brothers taking care of things, I just need to eat and drink every day. Do you think it’s uncomfortable to live like this?”
“Look at my father, he has to get up before dawn every day and stay awake until dark. He is always worried about this or that. If he is not careful, he will be scolded by the censors. In order to gain a good reputation as a wise ruler, he cannot talk back when he is scolded.”
“Whenever there is a natural disaster or man-made disaster, if it is serious, the emperor has to issue an edict of repentance, begging God to forgive him. He can’t leave the imperial city more than a few times a year. If he goes out more often, he will be scolded for wasting money and manpower. He has to be on guard against this and that every day, for fear that someone will covet the chair under his butt. He can’t even eat too much of his favorite things…”
Responsible for the rise and fall of a country, every decision concerns the lives of countless people, this, this, this… How can a person live like this!!Ye Shuo shuddered just thinking about it.
These are just the things on the surface. Ye Shuo didn’t mention that being an emperor also requires one to work hard to have children. The infant mortality rate was high in ancient times. If the emperor had few children, the country would be unstable. He also had to face the clan ministers who formed a group to urge him to have children.
There are indeed many loyal concubines in the harem, but there are also many who are not sincere, and the emperor has to play the role of a seed drill from time to time.
Also, when you reach old age, your body becomes weak. It would be fine if all the children you raise are good, but if there are a few who are too ambitious, you will not have a stable life when you are old.
From the moment you sit on the throne, you can never stop in this life, and all struggles can only be ended by death.
It is indeed beautiful, but it is also very miserable.
Ye Shuo looked at his cousin: “I’ve thought about it, but I really can’t think of any reason. What do you think, cousin?”
Only fools would do a business that is only losing money with no profit.
As for Wei Wen who was standing aside, he was now dumbfounded.
This was the first time in his life that he had heard someone say such a thing.
Who in the world doesn’t know that it’s good to be an emperor?
This has almost become an iron rule that is taken for granted, and even Wei Wen is no exception.
When Wei Wen heard Ye Shuo say this, he thought, “I don’t want to,” and subconsciously opened his mouth to refute.
As a result…Wei Wen couldn’t find any reason to refute at all.
The only thing that can decide a person’s life or death at will is only for tyrants, and it also requires daily hard work.
There is no such thing as a free lunch in this world. Not to mention those with evil intentions, everyone else must assume the responsibilities that belong to their position.
Taking all factors into consideration, it does seem more cost-effective to be a prince.
As long as you are born well, it will be almost the least worrying thing.
He had power, second only to the emperor, and as long as he was not compared with the emperor, even the emperor’s son had to show him respect.
Wei Wen held his breath for a long time before finally saying, “Don’t you have any ambition at all?”
Power and beauty are what almost everyone pursues throughout their life, and as soon as my little cousin was born, the position of the emperor was within his reach. Who in the world can resist such temptation?
If you give up easily, you will be wasting this opportunity given by God.
Ye Shuo remembered that his father had asked him the same question in his previous life.
Ambition, ambition, people spend their whole lives paying for their ambitions.
As long as you give up your ambition, everything will become easy.
It’s not that Ye Shuo can’t see through it. On the contrary, it’s because he sees too clearly that he feels it’s not worth it.
That position wasn’t worth exchanging so many things for.
“I am a narrow-minded person and cannot tolerate so many things. I just hope that the people around me can be safe, healthy and happy.”
Fate can be very cruel sometimes, so Ye Shuo never dared to expect too much. If you are too greedy, you will have to pay the price.
Wei Wen was silent for a moment, but soon he couldn’t help asking again, “Can you tolerate someone always putting pressure on you? You set too low a standard for yourself, and it’s too simple.”
“What are you talking about?” Ye Shuo was speechless: “There are so many people in the world who are better than me. If I compare them one by one, won’t I tire myself to death?”
It is not that difficult to accept your own limitations. You don’t need to be strong all the time or to be the best in every situation. The most important thing is to figure out what your goal is.
Life is a process of constantly challenging oneself. No matter who others are, they are just passers-by in life.
What Ye Shuo wants to do now is to force these people who are destined to be passers-by to stay. It is equivalent to going against the will of heaven. How can it be easy? He thinks he is super awesome.
It’s like a person who is destined to die, but you use all means to keep him/her for another two years, so that he/she can live a free and comfortable life for another two years. Even if this person dies in the end, at least you broke the predetermined fate with your own hands. Isn’t it worth being proud of?
Wei Wen was completely speechless. Looking at his little cousin’s determined eyes, he seemed to… understand a little bit.
“So, that’s why you’re planning for the little princess’ future so early?”
“Of course.” Ye Shuo nodded.
“It would be fine if nothing happened, but if my mother is destined to suffer the pain of separation in the future, I hope I can avoid such a terrible fate through my own hands.”
Even in his previous life, he had failed once.
Wei Wen was truly shocked by his little cousin’s words.
This time it was Ye Shuo’s turn to ask: “What about you? Do you want to lead the Zhen Mansion to a different ending?”
With his cheap father’s defence, the uncertainty of the next emperor, and the three generations that were almost destined to decline, should he go with the flow and put all his hopes on luck, or should he start to change secretly within the safety line?
Ye Shuo’s plan was never to take the initiative to attack, and the risk would be reduced a lot in an instant.
Besides, if he really wants to stand against his stepfather, given the current situation of his grandfather’s family, the military power in his hands has basically been divided up. There might have been some hope when he was just born, but if he wants to take action now, he is basically seeking death.
What Ye Shuo has to do is just to provide a backup for the little princess and his grandfather’s family. It would be best if it is not used. In case it is used, there will be no room for resistance.
In case my stepfather and the next emperor have any ideas, at least there will be people in the court to persuade them, so that the public opinion will not be one-sided.
For those who don’t care about the life and death of the Duke of Zhen’s family, since the life and death of the Duke of Zhen’s family has nothing to do with them, why should he try to save them?
If it does not concern you, you will just ignore it.
If this is not enough, the worst that can happen is that he will be demoted to the bottom and become a complete commoner from a descendant of the Duke’s Mansion. However, as long as there is one younger generation who is somewhat capable of achieving something, there is still hope of making a comeback based on the foundation prepared in advance in the court.
The flame is out, but the fire is still there, so it’s not like there is no chance at all.
“Another ending…” Wei Wen murmured, then smiled bitterly.
“It’s not that easy. There are always risks involved.”
Ye Shuo did not deny it: “This is natural.”
There are risks no matter what you do. The difference lies in whether you buy futures, stocks, funds or make fixed deposits.
If you just deposit it in a fixed deposit, unless you are extremely unlucky, there is nothing to say.
Wei Wen didn’t answer yes or no, he just asked: “Can the things you said really be realised?”
“Well, basically no problem, I have prepared everything.” Ye Shuo pointed to the pile of handwritten textbooks.
Basic mathematics, basic physics, basic chemistry… Although there is not much content in it, it is the crystallisation of the wisdom of giants in various fields. In ancient times when mirages were called miracles, it was a complete dimensionality reduction attack.
After that, there are advanced mathematics, advanced physics, advanced chemistry, as well as advanced mathematics, advanced physics, and advanced chemistry. Most people in modern times will never understand these things in their lifetime, and the same was true in ancient times. They are enough for a person to learn for a lifetime.
Wei Wen picked up a book and flipped through it. He thought he was knowledgeable enough, but after reading it, he found that he could not understand what was written on it at all.
It’s something I’ve never heard of or seen before.
But because he had read a lot of books, Wei Wen could vaguely judge that these things were not written randomly.
Wei Wen resisted the dizziness and said, “…Are you sure that ordinary people can learn it?”
“That’s not necessarily true. It does require selection.” After all, poor students still make up the majority, and truly talented people are rare.
Technical talents are always in demand wherever they go, whether in ancient times or modern times.
“But if we’re talking about selecting people, is there any problem on your end?”
Wei Wen did not deny this.
It is not without reason that His Majesty is so wary of the Duke’s Mansion. A lean camel is bigger than a horse. Even now, the Duke’s Mansion is still a behemoth in comparison.
As the saying goes, imperial power does not extend below the county level. In ancient times when transportation and communications were not so developed, the emperor’s control over various regions was far less strong than it is today.
What’s more, the old Duke Zhen has been rooted in the border for so many years that it is not an exaggeration to say that he is the local emperor.
After all, there is only one eldest prince, and the other manpower arranged by the emperor with the help of the eldest prince is ultimately limited.
Although most of the border areas are no longer controlled by the old Duke of Zhen, a small part of the old Duke of Zhen still has deep roots.
For example, in the southwest, it still depends on General Xu, who was brought up by the old Duke Zhen, to guard it.
The closer to the border, the more merchants there are trading, and the more complicated the personnel are. Throughout the Zhou Dynasty, there are people from all regions, and all kinds of chaos are particularly serious.
Because of the war, everyone was living a life of today without worrying about tomorrow, so they didn’t care about so many things. Whether they were women or men, they often slept with one today and another tomorrow, and the children they gave birth to ran around everywhere and no one cared.
Especially businessmen, they have loose belts and are promiscuous, and in the end they don’t even know whose child it is after it is born.
There are also young soldiers in the military camp who basically cannot go home for one or two or two or three years, so they simply marry wives locally.
Local women do not have to be chaste like women in other places. If they like a man, they can just sleep with him. If their husband dies, they can just find another one.
Therefore, there are still many unattended children at the border. When the old Duke was in power, he felt sorry for these children and used his own money to set up a charity to provide food for those unattended children. When they reached working age, he would expel them.
This custom remained unchanged until Wei Wen’s aunts took charge of the family, and they still sent silver every year.
Selecting people is not a problem. With General Xu here, it should be foolproof.
I guess my little cousin guessed this, so he came to me.
The combination of the two is definitely the best choice.
As for my little cousin’s brain, he can come up with so many things, which proves that it must be good.
The younger cousin didn’t want to fight for that position. After weighing the pros and cons, Wei Wen felt that what he said was not a lie and he should be safe.
As for Ye Shuo, since his grandfather was confident in his eldest cousin, Ye Shuo had nothing to worry about his own eldest cousin.
I believe that there is no problem with the most basic things such as knowing and selecting people. Every noble family has a set of methods for training death squads, and I believe that my cousin should know it.
Although the selection of people is not that exaggerated, the necessary means are still needed.
Just one point, whether one is good at dancing or not is not important, what is important is whether the person is pure.
Ye Shuo, who is good at handling things, didn’t dare to accept it because the risk was much higher than that of others.
It would be even better if the other party is a fanatic of science and technology. You don’t need to use any tricks. As long as you have fresh knowledge that he has not learned before, the other party will follow you obediently.
After all, since we are looking for technical talents, technology should naturally be the most important. It doesn’t matter if the emotional intelligence is a little low, as long as it is above the passing line, there is no problem.
Given my cheap dad’s character, he will definitely not mistreat capable people.
For a wise ruler, it is basic practice to be eager to seek talented people, not to mention that Ye Shuo hit the pain points of Emperor Jingwen every time.
Flood control, salt making, smelting… Which of these cheap things could my father refuse?
Similarly, Wei Wen could not refuse the road that lay before him.
After a while, he finally nodded.
“I agree.”
“Okay, I’ll leave the rest to you.”
At that time, Wei Wen still didn’t know what his cousin’s words meant.
Just like that, three days passed in a flash. After handing the things to Wei Wen, Ye Shuo set out on his return journey.
The old Duke Zhen didn’t care what the two had discussed behind his back. He only knew that he was finally free.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Good People
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
There are four types of people in Zhen Mansion, and these four types of people have different reactions to Ye Shuo’s departure.
It’s just like the old Duke Zhen, who was on guard every day against his grandson suddenly attacking him. Now that the time has come and his grandson is finally leaving, the old Duke Zhen actually subconsciously breathed a sigh of relief. You know, this is the grandson he has been waiting for for so long!
The old Duke of Zhen finally understood why the emperor felt overwhelmed. The child was too naughty and it was really tiring.
Looking at Mrs. Wei and several aunts were reluctant to let him leave.
Madam Wei returned from the palace two days ago. Although the emperor had agreed, she still wanted to avoid gossip from others. Madam Wei didn’t stay in the palace for long. She suppressed her reluctance to leave her daughter and granddaughter, and returned after only ten days.
When Mrs. Wei first saw her grandson, she loved him very much.
In the eyes of Madam Wei and several aunts, Ye Shuo is a good-looking, sweet-spoken, caring and sensible child. Who would reject such a lovely child?
The most important thing is that he is very good at chatting with people. No matter what the topic is, whether it is family matters or matters related to store management, he will not be impatient like his uncles and cousins.
As a result, over the past few days, Mrs. Wei and his aunts became more and more dissatisfied with their husbands and children.They are both men, why is there such a big difference?
Others are considerate in every way, but my own man can never get to the point, and gets angry and looks silly when he talks.
As for Ye Shuo’s uncles and cousins, they felt that their nephew/little cousin had been here for so many days but had learned nothing. They thought that their father/grandfather was really something. There should be a limit to spoiling a child. As a result, such a good opportunity was wasted.
But they really couldn’t resist and were afraid of being beaten, so they didn’t dare to say a word from beginning to end. When their nephew/cousin was about to leave, they finally reacted and were quickly overwhelmed by guilt.
If only they had been braver.
Especially Wei Zhao and Wei Ping, they clearly knew that their little cousin was stupid, but instead of helping him, they just stood by and watched.
Next time, next time I will never do this again!
“Little cousin, I stole this from my grandfather’s room. Take it to the palace.” While no one was paying attention, Wei Zhao secretly stuffed a book into Ye Shuo’s arms.
Ye Shuo took a quick glance and thought it should be something like a boxing manual.
Afraid of being noticed by his grandfather, Wei Zhao lowered his voice: “Remember to practise hard after you get to the palace!”
Although this boxing manual may not be of much use to my little cousin’s brain, at least it can prevent him from falling down with just one push the next time he encounters a situation like that of Zheng.
These cousins ​​of Ye Shuo may not be smart enough and often cause trouble for the family, but they are really simple and kind, and they will treat their family members well in their own way.
This is probably the reason why Wei Wen can never let go of these younger brothers.
“Thank you, fifth cousin.” Ye Shuo did not refuse, but looked at him with excitement and moved eyes.
Sure enough, Wei Zhao felt extremely satisfied in his heart all of a sudden.
However, Wei Zhao didn’t feel happy for long before he was pulled out by his eldest brother and thrown aside.
Wei Zhao wanted to resist, but as soon as his eyes met his eldest brother’s cold face, his whole body immediately became limp.
Under the pressure of Wei Wen’s eyes, Wei Zhao left in disappointment.
“…You’ve almost done that.” Perhaps they had reached a preliminary consensus that everyone was in an equal cooperative relationship, and since they were relatives, Wei Wen no longer called him “Your Highness” all the time.
Looking at his little cousin who was playing tricks on his father, uncles and cousins, Wei Wen couldn’t help but grit his teeth.
This group of people… He didn’t know what to say. Didn’t they know why his wife/mother suddenly disliked him these days? ?
But Wei Wen didn’t come here to talk about these things. He had something serious to ask Ye Shuo. He had to ask clearly in advance, otherwise, when his little cousin entered the palace, he didn’t know when he would be able to come out.
Wei Wen made a long story short: “The plan you mentioned to go to sea is probably not going to work.”
If you want to go out to sea and travel across the ocean, you must first build a large ship that can withstand the wind and waves. It’s not that the Duke’s Mansion cannot build such a large ship, but the cost is too high and the noise is too loud, which will inevitably attract the attention of others.
It would be bad if His Majesty knew about this.
Wei Wen considered for a long time and decided to reject him.
But in fact, Ye Shuo knew it in his heart and didn’t hold out much hope. Since the plan of going out to sea to dig potatoes was not feasible for the time being, he could only think of other ways.
“Then you should try to find such a place.” The place that Ye Shuo was referring to was naturally Champa in his previous life.
Even if there are no potatoes with a short growth cycle and high yield, Champa rice that can be harvested twice a year will do.
If there is Champa in this world, if there is no Champa, then we can only try our luck in places with similar climates, but it may take a long time.
“This is a matter of great importance. The people you send out must be reliable.” Even if they succeed in finding it, they cannot just transport it back. After all, food will be their biggest trump card.
The people sent out may not come back in a short period of time, and they will most likely have to stay there, so Ye Shuo said the words “must be reliable”.
“It doesn’t need to be a lot, about seven or eight people will be enough. They don’t need to do much, as long as they can keep in touch at any time. Too many people will make things worse.” If there are too many people, there will be more concerns. If there are too few people, nothing can be accomplished and no trouble will arise.
Seeing his little cousin speaking with such certainty, as if he had seen it with his own eyes, Wei Wen couldn’t help but feel curious about where he knew so much.
However, Wei Wen was a smart man and naturally knew what to ask and what not to ask.
How did my cousin know this? As long as it is useful, it’s fine.
Seeing this scene, Wei Wen couldn’t help but want to make a joke: “You leave all the things to me, aren’t you afraid that I might have problems?”
This is just the beginning, just some basic things. Since Ye Shuo dares to take it out, there is no need to worry that he will take it for himself.
Just the teaching materials written by Ye Shuo are modern things after all. Even a genius cannot understand them just by reading them once. A lot of problems in the future will still need to be solved by Ye Shuo. Otherwise, even if the things are given out, they will just be waste paper.
Even one formula in it may represent the life of a great man. It would be extremely difficult to verify it yourself without the guidance of someone who knows it and without taking shortcuts.
Although Ye Shuo will not show up directly, he still serves as a teacher.
It would be fine if it were applied to modern times, but if it were applied to ancient times, the phrase “respecting teachers and honouring learning” was not just empty talk.
Even if Wei Wen really has that ability, Ye Shuo is not worried.
Whatever he gave out, he had the ability to take back.
So Ye Shuo just said: “You can give it a try.”
Seeing that his little cousin really didn’t seem to care, Wei Wen immediately understood that this might be just the tip of the iceberg.
There is more hidden behind him that he doesn’t know about.
Wei Wen’s expression couldn’t help but change slightly.
Just like that, Ye Shuo got on the carriage amid Wei Wen’s doubtful expression and returned to the palace.
There was also a small episode outside the palace that Ye Shuo didn’t know about, and that was the granddaughter of the Grand Tutor, Liang Wenyin.
Liang Wenyin had been thinking about contacting the Ninth Prince last year, but unfortunately the Imperial Concubine suddenly became pregnant, so the Ninth Prince stayed in the palace for nearly a year before returning.
After waiting for a long time for him to leave the palace, Liang Wenyin finally received the news, but by then Ye Shuo had already gone to the Duke’s mansion.
I don’t know when he will come out next time.
She is already seventeen years old this year, and her marriage can be postponed until she is eighteen at most. As the days go by, Liang Wenyin has gradually gotten rid of the idea of ​​relying on others, from being restless at the beginning and hoping that the Ninth Prince can give her an accurate answer.
Liang Wenyin suddenly realised that no one could help her make decisions for her whole life, not even the Ninth Prince.
You are the only one who can decide your own life.
Soon, Liang Wenyin made a decision in her heart.
The other side.
Seeing the prosperous scenes in Shangjing City getting farther and farther away, Ye Shuo felt so reluctant to leave that it was beyond words.
Alas, happy days are always so short.
The first thing Ye Shuo wanted to do when he returned to the palace was to go back to Qiuwu Palace to find his mother. He missed her so much after not seeing her for half a month.
result…
As soon as Ye Shuo started to take a step, he was stopped by the eunuch: “Ninth Prince, the emperor sent a servant here to ask you to come over.”
Well, my cheap dad is here to check the results.
It turns out that the King of Volumes’ thinking is not good. No matter what you do, you must gain something.
But Ye Shuo was not weak either. After all, he was really studying seriously this time. This time, Ye Shuo was not weak at all.
When Ye Shuo arrived, Emperor Jingwen had a rare moment of free time and had done nothing serious. He was playing chess and chatting with the Crown Prince and Prime Minister He.
You see, this is the only fun in being an emperor every day.
As expected, the moment Emperor Jingwen saw Ye Shuo, he asked, “How do you feel about staying at your grandfather’s house for so long?”
“In reply to your Majesty, I think it’s great.” Ye Shuo looked like he had discovered a new world.
“My grandmother and aunts are very kind to me. They bring me food and fun things every day. My grandfather also practises martial arts with me and teaches me moves. Also, my uncles and cousins ​​will not bully me, especially my eldest cousin. He is also very kind to me. Whenever I encounter difficulties, he will help me from time to time…”
With his cousin around, Ye Shuo didn’t know how much less to worry about. Thinking of this, his cousin was really a very good person!
“This son suddenly realised that the generals were not as rude as he imagined. Although my grandfather’s hands were a little strong, he was very patient with me.”
The more he spoke, the more excited he became, and the more he talked about the advantages of the Duke of Zhen’s family, it seemed that Ye Shuo didn’t notice the changes in Prime Minister He and the Prince’s expressions at all.
Prime Minister He was almost stunned by the Ninth Prince’s words.
He…this…oh, forget it.
After hearing this, the prince couldn’t help but start winking at his brother.
The prince believed that his father sent Xiaojiu to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion in order to ease the relationship between Xiaojiu and the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, but now… is it a bit too much?
Ye Shuo said whatever he wanted to say. It was his first time at his grandfather’s house and it was definitely better than he had imagined.
Now that he’s well, why can’t I praise him?
“Father, I really, really like my grandfather. I think he’s a really good man.”
…over.
Hearing these words, Prime Minister He and the Crown Prince almost closed their eyes at the same time.
This time, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help himself and slowly put down the chess piece in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Discussion
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Although Emperor Jingwen could still remain calm at the beginning, he could no longer control himself when he heard the last sentence.
He sent his son to the Duke of Zhen’s mansion because he was afraid that the son would become ungrateful to his relatives and eventually disregard even blood ties.
But it’s only been a few days? It’s become like this in just a few days.
Isn’t it true that children’s personalities change too quickly?
Or did the old Duke Zhen give him some kind of magic potion?
Emperor Jingwen suddenly became depressed.
But he was the emperor after all, so he wouldn’t be so impatient. The more unhappy he was in his heart, the less he showed it on his face.
This is what is called moodiness.
Looking at his son who was so excited and boastful, Emperor Jingwen narrowed his eyes subconsciously and said, “Then tell me, what have you learned in the Duke’s Mansion? What did the old Duke tell you?”At that moment, Emperor Jingwen felt that he should not have underestimated the old Duke, as he had been acting honestly in the past two years and the people he had arranged for were becoming more and more influential. The Duke’s family could not cause any trouble, so he withdrew the surveillance personnel.
As expected, I cannot be careless for even a moment when it comes to the old Duke of Zhen.
Ye Shuo didn’t even think about it: “No problem!”
It’s just a performance. Whose kid wouldn’t want to perform talents after returning from school?
Ye Shuo had already made preparations, so he turned to look at Wang Ziquan who was standing beside him: “Eunuch Wang, can you find me some bricks… or tiles?”
Thinking about the fact that the gold bricks in the palace were all large and hard in texture, Ye Shuo changed his words decisively for the sake of his hands.
What did he want the tiles for?
Although Wang Ziquan was a little confused, since it was the Ninth Prince who asked, he naturally hurried to ask someone to find them.
Soon, a dozen tiles were taken to the Qinzheng Hall by people from the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
This time, not to mention Eunuch Wang, even the Crown Prince and Prime Minister He couldn’t help but frown.
He propped up three of the pieces, thought for a while, and felt that the three pieces stacked together were too thick, so Ye Shuo decisively took down another piece.
Ye Shuo concentrated and calmed himself, took a deep breath, and then chopped down fiercely under the gaze of the three people.
“ha!”
Emperor Jingwen and his men first heard a loud roar, followed by the sound of tiles breaking.
After a moment, looking at the two tiles that broke in half, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but get excited: “How is it?”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Prince: “…”
He Xiang: “…”
The prince hesitated for a moment: “…Xiaojiu?”
Emperor Jingwen rubbed his temples and vaguely understood something: “You have been in the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion for so many days, and this is all you have learned?”
He is really good at splitting tiles with his hands.
“Isn’t this amazing enough?” Ye Shuo was stunned.
He didn’t use any internal strength or any special skills. He just relied on the power of his palm to split the two tiles. He used the palm technique passed down from his grandfather.
Isn’t it enough to learn this much in ten days?
But in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen and others, this is no different from street acrobatics, and street acrobatics are even more entertaining.
“Apart from this, is there nothing else?” Emperor Jingwen didn’t believe that the old Duke of Zhen had only taught him this after so long.
Or was it that the Zhen taught that little bastard to play dumb with him…
Just as this thought came to Emperor Jingwen’s mind, he heard Ye Shuo speak in a slightly embarrassed tone.
“Yes, there is, but… it’s not suitable to be displayed.”
Emperor Jingwen was stunned for a moment, then his expression relaxed and the mist in his eyes gradually dissipated: “It’s okay, there are no outsiders here, just go ahead and demonstrate.”
Was it the old Duke Zhen’s special skill? Or something else? Something that could make his son so cautious must not be an ordinary thing.
The little bastard never acted like this before.
Emperor Jingwen gradually became interested. He suddenly remembered that he had not exercised for a long time. Today he was relatively free and happened to be tired of drinking tea and playing chess. It was a rare opportunity, so it would be okay to play with his son.
So Emperor Jingwen asked, “How about I accompany you for a few moves?”
This will also help to improve the old Duke’s impression of his son.
It is true that the old Duke Zhen is a skilled martial artist, but Emperor Jingwen himself is not weak either.
Emperor Jingwen thought that the child was just a few years old and had only learned martial arts for a few days, so no matter how powerful he was, he didn’t think too much about it.
Ye Shuo was horrified when he heard this, and waved his hands repeatedly, saying: “No, no, I won’t fight with you.”
If he beats his adopted father to death again, wouldn’t his mother’s life be ruined for the rest of her life?
There are so many concubines in the harem, he can’t do such a sin.
“Father, the moves this son has learned are really not suitable for you, so let’s just forget it…”
It’s not that Ye Shuo is very confident in himself, but the main reason is that the parts he aims at are too fragile and can be easily damaged if you are not careful.
However, in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, Ye Shuo’s earnest advice was just evidence that his son looked down on him.
The little bastard is not young, but his tone is quite arrogant. It seems that the things that the old Duke Zhen taught him made him so proud that he began to lose his mind.
No prince had ever dared to speak to him like this, and he could not tolerate any prince who dared to speak like this. Emperor Jingwen did not bother with him just because the little bastard was young and ignorant, otherwise, house arrest and beatings would have been the lightest punishment.
The more this happened, the more Emperor Jingwen wanted to dampen his enthusiasm.
Emperor Jingwen almost laughed out of anger: “Someone, change my clothes for me!”
He must teach this rebellious son a lesson today!
“Father, this really won’t work, Father.”
“Father, please think about it again, Father!”
Ye Shuo had a bitter face and followed Emperor Jingwen almost wherever he went, trying to make his adoptive father give up this crazy idea.
Finally, Emperor Jingwen went to the room at the back of the hall and started to take off his dragon robe, but Ye Shuo still refused to leave.
In the end, it was Wang Ziquan and a group of young eunuchs who dragged him away.
The Crown Prince and Prime Minister He outside looked at each other in bewilderment.
After Ye Shuo was ruthlessly driven out by Emperor Jingwen, the prince thought about it and finally reminded him: “Xiao Jiu…you’d better not say that…”
The prince was terrified after hearing what his brother had just said.
“Since father has spoken, you can compete with him.” If you say more, be careful not to make more mistakes.
Ye Shuo grinned, feeling extremely embarrassed: “But, I’m afraid of hurting my father…”
When the prince heard this, he shuddered all over.
As for He Xiang, he has already started pretending that he doesn’t exist.
“Okay, okay, today I want to see how capable you are!” Emperor Jingwen came out after changing his clothes, and immediately heard such a sentence. If Emperor Jingwen still had some joking thoughts at the beginning, he was now completely angry.
Grabbing the little bastard’s collar, Emperor Jingwen dragged him to the open space outside without saying a word, with a sullen face.
“Come on, if you can’t satisfy me today, then you won’t leave today and you’ll just have to stand here!”
If an ordinary child heard these words, coupled with his father’s gloomy face, he would probably be frightened to the point of being unable to move.
But Ye Shuo is not a child after all.
Just now, his cheap father grabbed his collar and almost made him roll his eyes. Ye Shuo quickly straightened his hemp-like clothes and said, “Um… I have to make it clear in advance that the moves I learned from my grandfather are relatively powerful. If you are really hurt, you can’t blame me.”
The prince closed his eyes subconsciously, and at this moment he really wanted to go up and cover his brother’s mouth.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said, “Fists and feet have no eyes. I won’t bother with you.”
“Similarly, if I hurt you, you are not allowed to cry or scream.”
“Okay then…” Ye Shuo responded reluctantly and looked at the guards, eunuchs and palace maids beside him.
“Father, can you please ask them to go down first…”
The little bastard talks a lot.
Emperor Jingwen completely lost his patience. He tucked his robe into his belt and reached out to grab his shoulders.
The sound stopped abruptly and Ye Shuo hurried to hide.
Seeing that he dodged very flexibly, Emperor Jingwen was stunned at first, then felt that the little bastard had slipped through his armpits and came behind him, and then he reacted.
The two of them really started fighting outside the Qinzheng Hall.
Emperor Jingwen was over forty years old, but he was still as charming and elegant as ever, and everyone was dazzled by him.
As for the Ninth Prince… he was dodging here and there, what was his plan?
Emperor Jingwen felt something was wrong as he was fighting. He felt that the little bastard’s attack was particularly subtle.
After blocking his two fingers for the third time, Emperor Jingwen realised that it was not an illusion.
This bastard has been aiming at my eyes and lower body!!
Emperor Jingwen had never seen such a gangster style of fighting in his life. In the past, when he sparred with others, everyone behaved according to the rules and won by hard power. There was no one like his son who even used dirty tricks at the beginning.
Although Emperor Jingwen himself was quite skilled in martial arts, he still found it very difficult to deal with such a shameless person.
The little bastard is as slippery as a loach and once he gets caught, it’s hard to get rid of him. But he is young, small and agile, so it’s hard for an adult to catch him.
Emperor Jingwen tried several times to distance himself from him, but after a short while he stuck to him again like a dog-skin plaster, which made him both infuriating and helpless.
Ye Shuo’s foot almost brushed against Emperor Jingwen’s thigh, causing the emperor to break out in a cold sweat.
Emperor Jingwen finally had to take real action against him.
When Ye Shuo kicked him again, Emperor Jingwen seized the opportunity and attacked with lightning speed, then grabbed Ye Shuo’s ankle tightly to control his movements.
Ye Shuo was shocked and almost instinctively followed the force and climbed onto his cheap father’s back.
He just stretched out his hands, but soon both of them were grabbed.
Emperor Jingwen thought that he should behave himself this time, but…
His hands and feet were controlled and he couldn’t move at all. Looking at his cheap father’s ears swaying in front of his eyes, Ye Shuo got excited and opened his mouth, revealing a row of white teeth, and bit it without thinking.
The smug look on his face had not yet solidified. The next moment, Emperor Jingwen felt a pain in his ears. Almost instinctively, he took a breath of cold air: “Hiss——”
Looking at the two people who were fighting each other, both the prince who had practised martial arts and He Xiang who had not practised martial arts were silent at this moment.
After realising what was happening, the two men hurried down the stairs to separate the fight.
“Your Highness, hurry up and let go!”
“Xiao Jiu!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Vomiting Blood
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Let go, let go quickly!”
Is this child born in the year of the dog? Why is he biting?
Even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t hold back after his ear was bitten.
“Mmm no hum… hum hum hum hum! (I won’t let go… unless you admit defeat!)” Ye Shuo is not the kind of person who would give in easily.
But obviously, Emperor Jingwen was not either.
It can be said that Emperor Jingwen lived half his life and never knew how to write the word “surrender”.
The severe pain made Emperor Jingwen’s breathing a little unstable. He almost bit his cheek to pieces. “If you don’t let go, don’t blame me for being rude.”
“Hehehe.” If you don’t loosen, then don’t loosen.
Just like that, the father and son, who were both strong-willed by nature, held his son’s wrists and ankles tightly with such force that they tried to force him to let go first.The other one was biting his own father’s ear, looking like he was trying to see who could outlast the other.
He really did use force, and it really hurt.
The expressions of both the father and the son were distorted to varying degrees.
He Xiang felt a little regretful. He should have left when the Ninth Prince showed up. Why didn’t he learn his lesson?
The prince was at a loss as to what to do, and was walking around anxiously.
Tell me, what are these two trying to do?
How could they be having a good discussion but end up fighting?
“Father, Xiaojiu is still young…please be more considerate of him…”
The prince had no choice but to persuade the older one who could understand what people said.
Emperor Jingwen gritted his teeth and said: “Why should I let him?” How embarrassing it would be if the emperor gave in first.
Even if that person is your own son.
The prince choked, and then could only look at his younger brother: “Xiaojiu, don’t be so stubborn…” Although he is his biological father, he is also the emperor after all. He can’t take it seriously, right?
Xiaojiu is a little too honest.
If the emperor’s dragon body is damaged, it will be a serious crime!
“Please stop making trouble…” Sometimes the prince really wanted to pry open his brother’s brain to see what was inside.
“Hmm—”
Ye Shuo just made a sound, and then he felt something was wrong, so he hesitated for a moment.
Emperor Jingwen seemed to have noticed his relaxation, so he subconsciously slapped him with his palm, trying to peel off the dog-skin plaster.
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo was too difficult to deal with just now, coupled with the pain in his ear, that Emperor Jingwen attacked him a little too harshly.
Emperor Jingwen thought that with the little bastard’s agility, he would be able to at least land safely, if not dodge it.
In the end, for some reason, he just stood there without moving.
Then Emperor Jingwen watched his son fly away like a kite with a broken string.
Ye Shuo drew a graceful arc in the air, and then with a “bang”, he fell heavily to the ground.
“Xiaojiu!” The prince was shocked and hurried to check on his condition.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but be stunned.
Although he was a little worried in his heart, he felt a little embarrassed because of what happened just now, so Emperor Jingwen abruptly retracted his foot that he had stretched out at some point, and his tone was a little stiff.
“Prince, don’t worry about him.” How could he not know the temper of the little bastard?
“He must be pretending.”
Emperor Jingwen was very confident at first, until the little bastard forced himself to look up and then spat out a mouthful of blood in front of him.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen froze in place all of a sudden.
The prince was so frightened that he hurried to help his brother: “Xiaojiu, how are you? Xiaojiu, don’t scare me!”
Seeing that the others were still in a daze, unable to react to what had happened, the prince almost shouted at the top of his voice: “Why are you still standing there?! Someone come! Call the imperial physician!”
“Xiaojiu, Xiaojiu?!”
“Third, Third Brother…” Stop shouting Third Brother. It’s too close and the sound is too loud to hurt my ears.
Ye Shuo was already a little choked, and felt even more uncomfortable when the prince shouted at him. As a result, as soon as he opened his mouth to explain, he was caught off guard and burst into a series of coughs.
“Cough, cough, cough, cough.”
Along with the coughing, there were mouthfuls of blood.
The Ninth Prince was spitting out blood, and soon all the bricks and stones around him were dyed red. It was a heart-wrenching scene.
Everyone, including He Xiang, was dumbfounded.
How come someone suddenly gets killed while they are arguing with each other?
His Majesty… killed his own son with his own hands…
Such a thought suddenly flashed through his mind, and he felt a chill down his spine. He secretly groaned in my heart, wondering why he had to choose today to come here?
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously looked at his hands, and his brain went blank for a moment.
The next moment, Emperor Jingwen’s fingers suddenly tightened.
The prince wanted to say something else, but he saw a familiar figure passing by him and picking up his brother who was lying on the ground and unable to get up.
Sending someone to invite him and then waiting for the imperial physician to come would take too long, so Emperor Jingwen planned to take him directly to the Imperial Hospital.
“Someone, come and get ready!”
Ye Shuo turned upside down like this, and under the influence of gravity, the blood that was originally going to be spit onto the ground flowed out from the corners of his mouth, and soon his face was covered with blood.
Ye Shuo subconsciously grabbed his stepfather’s sleeve: “Father, I…”
“Don’t talk.” Ye Shuo then noticed that his stepfather’s cheeks had been tensed up at some point, and even the blue veins on his forehead were popping out.
“I won’t let anything happen to you, let alone let you die.”
He was just a kid, why was I competing with him?
It would have been fine if I had just competed with him, but I had hit him so hard.
Emperor Jingwen’s expression was unusually annoyed, but he finally said that sentence –
“This is my fault.”
For a man like Emperor Jingwen to say such a thing, it is obvious that he really regretted it.
For a moment, Ye Shuo didn’t know whether he should tell him the truth, or wait until his adoptive father lost all his face before letting the imperial physician tell him.
No, no, I’m going out soon. It will be too late if you don’t say it now.
By then, everyone in the palace will know about it, and with my stepfather’s self-esteem, he will be furious and ashamed.
So Ye Shuo quickly seized the last moment and quickly finished what he had just said.
“Don’t worry, Father! I’m fine!”
Emperor Jingwen stopped and lowered his head subconsciously.
Then he saw his son spit out two teeth with two “puff” sounds.
Noticing his cheap father’s gaze, Ye Shuo said with a bloody face, a little embarrassed: “Um… I accidentally broke my teeth when I bit your ear just now.”
Ye Shuo hadn’t been a child for a long time, and he had even forgotten that eight or nine years old is the time when children start to change their teeth.
Normally, the upper and lower teeth should fall out when the child is six or seven years old, but they have not fallen out until now. Ye Shuo almost forgot that tooth loss exists.
But my cheap dad has already said it, there is nothing I can do…
It was not known whether he was angry or ashamed, but in an instant, Emperor Jingwen felt anger rising up and his face turned red.
…
Half an hour later, in the Qinzheng Palace—
Emperor Jingwen sat down with a gloomy face and said coldly to his son beside him: “Open your mouth.”
Ye Shuo knew that he was on the verge of exploding, but he didn’t dare to provoke him again, so he opened his mouth obediently.
“ah–“
Just facing the two dark holes between his son’s upper and lower teeth, Emperor Jingwen’s mouth and eyelids twitched slightly.
Because Ye Shuo’s two teeth were not lost normally, the amount of bleeding was quite heavy, so they were all over the place.
When the imperial physician arrived, he was shocked to see such a tragic scene. He thought something big had happened.
It turned out that the Ninth Prince bit the emperor’s ear, and ended up breaking his own upper and lower deciduous teeth.
“You deserve it.” In response, Emperor Jingwen uttered these two words lightly, but his hands did not stop moving, wiping his gums clean bit by bit with a soft cloth.
Seeing that the bleeding had stopped, Emperor Jingwen threw the fine cloth aside.
Hey, hey, hey, if you use so much force your teeth will grow crooked!
However, Ye Shuo could only think about this in his heart and dared not say it out loud. He could only sit there obediently and did not dare to resist at all.
After the blood on his face was cleaned, Ye Shuo spoke carefully: “Father, your ears…” How about asking the imperial physician to take a look…
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously touched his ear. His ear was not broken, but the tooth marks on it would not disappear for a while, and it was now burning hot.
The little bastard really dared to do that.
For a moment, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know whether to praise him for his bravery or scold him for his stupidity.
Ye Shuo had something to say about this: “Father, you said it yourself. You won’t be angry and won’t argue with your son.”
“Whatever I say, you believe it?”
“Ah.” Ye Shuo nodded: “What else?”
“Father, are you going to lie to me again?”
Emperor Jingwen nodded subconsciously with his hand on his knee, but he said nothing.
After a long while, he asked, “Is this all you learned at the Duke’s Mansion?”
“Yes, what do you think?” Hearing this, Ye Shuo suddenly became energetic.
“Isn’t it extremely useful and powerful?”
How dare he speak!
Emperor Jingwen finally couldn’t hold back and started to curse: “Asshole! Look at what tricks you are using!”
“Poke eyes, bite ears, and kick…kick crotch. Don’t forget, you are a prince, a prince!”
When Emperor Jingwen thought about his son’s conflict with others in the future and that scene, he had an urge to faint on the spot.
Shameful!
It’s so embarrassing!
But in fact, the real killing technique is to attack people’s eyes, temples, lower body and other parts.
The most important thing is to be able to defeat the enemy with one move. If your life is about to be lost, who cares about whether it is decent or not?
Besides, it wouldn’t necessarily be indecent once one becomes really proficient in it. It’s just that Ye Shuo is a beginner, so he looks a little vulgar.
“But, these moves are really practical…” They are painful and deadly. Ordinary people can’t withstand them at once. Even masters can’t practice these positions.
So whether it is a master or an ordinary person, they can break it with one move. Isn’t it practical enough?
But obviously, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t accept it.
Emperor Jingwen could never have imagined that the Duke of Zhen’s family all took a bold and open approach, and it was with this in mind that Emperor Jingwen sent him there.
As a result, even in this seemingly sure situation, his son still brought about a result that he had never imagined.
It’s really hard to guard against.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly thought of a question.
“Who taught you these moves?”
“My grandfather, of course.”
“It’s a lie.” No matter what, the Duke of Zhen would never take the initiative to teach him this.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said, “If you don’t tell the truth, I will call the guards over.”
“No, no, no, I’ll tell you, okay…it was indeed me who forced my grandfather to do it…”
really……
Emperor Jingwen asked again: “Who gave you the moves before?”
Ye Shuo scratched his chin awkwardly: “Also… also my grandfather…”
Now, Emperor Jingwen finally understood what he meant when he said “My grandfather is a good man.”
Indeed, the old Duke Zhen is indeed a good man.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Scared to tears
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Emperor Jingwen realised belatedly that the good person in his son’s eyes was not necessarily a real good person, but a good person in his opinion.
And this good person is often quite different from what others think.
Isn’t it good that the Duke of Zhen accompanies him in practising even this kind of thing?
“So what did your grandfather tell you to do…?”
“He said that I am a good grandson, but he said he should not come again next time.”
Ye Shuo scratched his head in annoyance: “But I really practised seriously this time!”
Indeed, Emperor Jingwen was not so shortsighted. The angle his son chose when he made his move just now was indeed tricky. Even an experienced person could easily fall into the trap if one was not careful.
It can be seen that he has indeed practised hard and put in a lot of effort.
But it is precisely because of this that it makes things even more troublesome. Isn’t the old Duke of Zhen unwilling to have him come to his house?What if one fails to defend himself and gets hit, wouldn’t he be crippled?
Looking at his own son, he was able to master it after only practising for a dozen days. It was obvious that he had tasted the sweetness and was determined to go all the way. Emperor Jingwen could only stop him in time before he was completely defeated: “In the future, you are not allowed to use this kind of inferior trick in front of others. Do you hear me!”
How can a prince bite someone’s ear during a fight?
Emperor Jingwen felt very bad when he thought about the fact that so many people had seen the scene just now.
I should have listened to him earlier and let the guards and palace maids go down first. Now, with so many eyes on us, it would be difficult to enforce the gag order.
Ye Shuo was stunned by the suddenness. Subconsciously, he stood up and asked, “Why? Why?”
“No reason or basis, I just said no!”
“Dad, how could you do this? I worked so hard to learn this!”
“Now, forget it all, forget it all!”
Looking at the two people who were arguing again for no apparent reason, the prince suddenly felt so tired that he was too lazy to care.
Forget it, let them be.
As for He Xiang, after experiencing the shock just now, he now just wants to leave quickly.
In the future, whenever he encounters the Ninth Prince, he will definitely run as far away as possible. After all, this is a fierce man who dares to bite the emperor’s ear. Is there anything he dare not do?
In the past, he only thought that the group of generals including the Duke of Zhen were reckless men. Now, Prime Minister He finally knows what a real reckless man looks like.
After all, Ye Shuo was still a child, and Emperor Jingwen was an emperor. He could not prevail against the emperor. Later, Emperor Jingwen said, “If you do this again, I will fine your mother’s salary,” which made Ye Shuo give up immediately.
