No, no, no, no matter what I do, I must not implicate my mother.
Ye Shuo thought about it and decided to endure it.
What his cheap dad said was that he couldn’t show it in front of others, but he didn’t say that he couldn’t practise it secretly behind others’ backs. At worst, he could just practise it secretly behind others’ backs.
Seeing his son behaved well, Emperor Jingwen was not happy at all. Instead, he felt awkward and panicked.
Obviously, he also knew that using the imperial concubine to threaten his son was somewhat unfair and unmanly.
This is the reason why Emperor Jingwen did not like to involve the imperial concubine in the affairs between father and son in the past. Emperor Jingwen once said that he would never beat his children, but now he still beats them with a rattan stick three times a day.
So, this son was born to break his bottom line.
Emperor Jingwen once again felt that raising this one child was more tiring than raising a group of children.
After the atmosphere calmed down a little, He Xiang immediately resigned without thinking.
“Xiaojiu is back now. My dear minister, don’t forget to come and teach him when the time comes.” Upon hearing this, He Xiang’s leaving steps immediately staggered.
Upon seeing this, Emperor Jingwen felt relieved.
Emperor Jingwen’s ears are in this condition now, so he naturally cannot see anyone.
In the afternoon, Emperor Jingwen continued to play chess with the prince. Ye Shuo wanted to leave, but Emperor Jingwen refused to let him go until the teeth marks on his ear disappeared.
Ye Shuo couldn’t resist and had to compromise.
Emperor Jingwen knew that he was impatient to watch him and the prince play chess, and this was exactly the effect Emperor Jingwen wanted.
Emperor Jingwen was still waiting to see him running around in the palace in a panic, but who knew…
Who knew that this little bastard would not put himself in a difficult position at all, since it was the height of summer, he simply took off their shoes, lay down on their feet, and then fell asleep.
Ye Shuo curled up at the two men’s feet, not minding the shabbiness, and slept soundly.
On the contrary, Emperor Jingwen and the Crown Prince were stunned for a long time after watching his actions.
Emperor Jingwen and the Crown Prince had never seen a prince as undisciplined as Xiaojiu before. Even the Prince of Jin, who was known to be the most undisciplined, had to give way to him.
Finally, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t bear it anymore, so he waved to Wang Ziquan beside him and asked him to bring over a quilt.
Otherwise, if you sleep like this, you might catch a cold.
In addition to the cool quilt, Emperor Jingwen also personally went downstairs, picked up his sleeping son, put him in the innermost part, covered him with the quilt, and then sat down next to the chessboard again.
With such a son, Emperor Jingwen could not help but worry about him, and his various actions became more and more smooth.
The prince has become numb by now.
He imagined if it were him, if his son was like this, would he be able to be so cruel as to not care about it.
The answer is yes and no.
It’s really not good to ignore him.
Therefore, the prince could only pretend that he didn’t see it.
Ye Shuo woke up from a nap and found that the two of them were still playing chess. The chessboard was almost full of chess pieces but the winner had not yet been decided. So he yawned and tiptoed down from the side.
Then Ye Shuo began to move his body.
He did the high-leg stretch as usual, and when the exercises were almost finished, Ye Shuo simply started to do the horse stance.
Anyway, my cheap dad’s palace is big, so it’s no problem to do somersaults and run in it, let alone such a little trick.
The activities were almost over, and there were still snacks specially provided by the imperial kitchen and top-quality tea tribute from all over the country. This life was so comfortable that Ye Shuo didn’t want to leave.
He felt very comfortable here, as if this was not the Qinzheng Hall but his own Qiuwu Palace, which made Wang Ziquan, who was always trembling with fear on the side, twitch his eyelids.
This may be the difference…
In the end, it was Emperor Jingwen who took the initiative to stand up.
He could never concentrate when the kid was around.
Not to mention Emperor Jingwen, the same was true for the crown prince. The crown prince just couldn’t understand why it tasted particularly delicious when he saw his brother eating it, even though it was obviously the same thing, and he looked so decadent and dissolute.
“Don’t you want to see your mother? Come on, let’s go to Qiuwu Palace together.”
When Ye Shuo heard this, he immediately stood up and wiped off the snack crumbs on his hands.
Seeing this, Wang Ziquan hurriedly handed over a clean handkerchief.
Who would have thought that the Ninth Prince didn’t even use the handkerchief to wipe his hands, but instead carefully wrapped something up.
Emperor Jingwen took a look and felt his scalp tingling: “Why do you still have those two teeth?”
It turned out that what Ye Shuo had wrapped was nothing else but his upper and lower front teeth.
“Of course I have to keep it.” Ye Shuo thought about it.
“I have to throw one onto the roof and the other into the water. Otherwise, what if the new tooth doesn’t grow out?”
What, what kind of statement is this? Emperor Jingwen and the Crown Prince had never heard of it before.
It seems that this world does not have this custom.
Although this thing has no scientific basis at all, Ye Shuo still wants to seek psychological comfort. After all, this is ancient times and there are no special dental beauty projects. If the teeth fail to grow out or grow crooked, he will have nowhere to repair them.
Therefore, he not only had to throw it, but also had to pray devoutly before throwing it.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t care about anything else, he just had one sentence –
“You are not allowed to throw it on the roofs of my Chengming Hall, Qinzheng Hall, Xuanzheng Hall, and Taihe Hall.”
Emperor Jingwen might not specifically explain other people’s affairs, but he was really worried about his own son.
Guarding against him is like guarding against a thief.
Ye Shuo curled his lips and said reluctantly: “…Okay, then I’ll throw it on my own roof.”
Emperor Jingwen was relieved.
The prince tactfully took his leave, and Emperor Jingwen then took him towards Qiuwu Palace.
When passing by the Lotus Heart Pond, Ye Shuo picked out his upper teeth and threw them in time. Emperor Jingwen was silent for a long time, and finally pretended not to see it.
It was almost evening when the two, one big and one small, returned to Qiuwu Palace. At that time, Concubine Rong had people spread a few mats at the door and put the little princess on them to play.
“Mother!!!” The moment Ye Shuo saw his mother, he rushed out.
Hearing the familiar voice, the imperial concubine was startled at first, and then subconsciously opened her arms.
As expected, not long after, there was a burning hot stove in my arms.
Emperor Jingwen, who was watching this scene from behind, couldn’t help feeling a little jealous.
The little bastard had never been so close to me before.
“I miss you so much, mother!” He missed him so much after not seeing him for more than ten days.
Ye Shuo raised his head, tears in his eyes.
The imperial concubine also missed him. She found that he was not tanned at all, and then she breathed a sigh of relief. “Shuo’er seems to have lost some weight. I guess practising martial arts must be very hard for him.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
He’s suffering as hell!
“Of course.” Ye Shuo nodded hurriedly.
The imperial concubine couldn’t help feeling distressed: “Father is really something. He knows you are still young, but he doesn’t restrain himself.” The imperial concubine knew how her father trained his brothers when they were young, and subconsciously thought that her father would do the same to his grandson.
“By the way, is your grandfather treating you well?”
Ye Shuo said without hesitation: “Grandfather is very good to this son!”
Yes, the old Duke of Zhen was good to him, but he was not good to the old Duke of Zhen.
Emperor Jingwen, who was standing next to him, couldn’t bear to watch it any longer and promptly interrupted the imperial concubine’s thoughts which had obviously been led astray.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t bear to see the old Duke Zhen being wronged, so he planned to reveal the true face of his son.
Speaking of which, my cheap dad is so stingy that he even complained to his mom.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath, and seeing that he really couldn’t get a word in, he squatted down and looked at the pointy little princess on the mat.
After not seeing her for a few days, the little princess’s complexion looks much healthier. It must be that she has been out playing a lot in this hot summer.
Seeing the wet nurse next to him seeming to want to say something but hesitant, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but stretch out his arms and lift her up.
Maybe because she still remembered him, the little princess didn’t feel scared, but instead felt a sense of closeness.
Suddenly thinking of something, Ye Shuo had a bad idea in mind, and when his sister came closer to look, he suddenly grinned.
Just like that, the two black gaps between the upper and lower front teeth suddenly came into view.
Caught off guard, the little princess burst into tears.
Oh no… she is scared and crying…
Ye Shuo’s heart skipped a beat.
Emperor Jingwen had barely finished speaking when, in the blink of an eye, his son and daughter were thrown into chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Tiredness
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
I even forgot how the little bastard treated his sister before.
The little bastard didn’t even spare his own sister.
In addition, the imperial concubine has always valued this son. For example, now, the imperial concubine’s first reaction is –
“Oh my god, Shuo’er, your teeth!”
It’s not that the imperial concubine ignored the princess, it’s mainly because the two gaps above and below Ye Shuo are too eye-catching.
Well… there is an inexplicable sense of joy.
You see, you can no longer count on the imperial concubine.
In the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, the Qiuwu Palace is now like a mountain, and his son is the biggest bandit inside. The rest of the palace servants have to submit to the bandit’s order, and the little princess is the poor little thing who was abducted by the bandit and has no power to resist and can only allow him to bully her.
It’s really pitiful.Therefore, Emperor Jingwen picked up the little princess without much hesitation.
Feeling his hands were empty, Ye Shuo was about to speak when he met his stepfather’s condemning gaze.
“What did you do to scare her?”
Ye Shuo complained: “Dad, I said I didn’t mean it, do you believe me…?”
Emperor Jingwen was too lazy to pay attention to him.
As for the imperial concubine, she had only heard that the emperor held the little princess in his arms before, but she didn’t know how he did it. Now, she finally saw it with her own eyes.
It doesn’t seem like a bad thing.
The imperial concubine originally wanted to take care of it, but after seeing this scene, she completely gave up.
Although the imperial concubine was a little slow to change her mind on other things, she knew that it would only do good and no harm for the emperor to be closer to the little princess.
Jianjian is a child with a good personality. She stopped crying after being held and coaxed for a while.
Only then did Emperor Jingwen remember to hand the child over to the nanny next to him.
“As a brother, can’t you be more considerate of your sister?” During dinner, when everything had calmed down, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but give some earnest advice.
The Sixth Prince standing by was not surprised at all and wondered what Xiaojiu had done to the little princess again.
The Sixth Prince didn’t understand. It was fine if Xiaojiu provoked others, but why didn’t he even let the little princess go?
At this moment, the Sixth Prince’s thoughts strangely overlapped with Emperor Jingwen’s.
In Ye Shuo’s opinion, parents like his stepfather are the most annoying type in modern times. Look at his mother, she would never say such things.
“Why must the older one give way to the younger one?” Ye Shuo didn’t understand. They were both children, but just because the one in front was born earlier, he was destined to give way all the time. Isn’t this too unfair?
“If that’s the case, who would want to be the older one? Wouldn’t it be better for everyone to be the younger one?”
Emperor Jingwen thought without hesitation: “You are Jianjian’s brother.” So it was all natural.
Ye Shuo pondered for a long time. After a while, he said, “In that case, I will call you Sister Jian Jian from now on.” It’s just a name and it won’t hurt to lose weight.
The moment he finished speaking, the Sixth Prince almost choked to death on the soup in his mouth.
Concubine Rong looked at her five-month-old daughter and then at her eight-year-old son with a look of shock.
Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he couldn’t even speak clearly.
As if that wasn’t enough, Ye Shuo started shouting at the innocent little baby girl next to him, causing Emperor Jingwen’s blood to boil.
“Sister Jianjian, Sister Jianjian, from today on, you call me brother and I call you sister, how about that?”
Jianjian, who was in the arms of her nanny, had no idea what her brother was talking about. She thought he was playing with her. She blinked her eyes and looked confused. She was so cute.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help himself and slammed the bowl on the table: “Ridiculous! You are absolutely ridiculous!”
How could there be such a ridiculous child in this world!
Wang Ziquan, who was standing by, silently put his hands behind his back, ready to pass the cane over at any time.
“Father, I have finished my meal. I will take my leave now.” It’s not that the Sixth Prince is disloyal, but his voice is too low to get a word in.
It’s not like I haven’t tried it before, it just never worked.
Seeing that a war was about to break out, the Sixth Prince decisively slipped away.
Ye Shuo seemed not to notice it, and continued to talk to himself: “That’s right, if it was you, would you be happy?”
Emperor Jingwen opened his mouth and wanted to say that he was happy to do so, but somehow, he suddenly remembered something that happened many, many years ago.
At that time, the late emperor was still alive. Although Emperor Jingwen was not the eldest son, he was ranked very high. In addition, he was also the crown prince, so he was often forced by the late emperor to give up things that should have belonged to him.
Today it is the child of Concubine Zhao, the favourite of the late emperor, and tomorrow it will be the son of Concubine Wang, the favourite of the late emperor.
He was even almost forced to give up his position as crown prince.
Emperor Jingwen was suddenly speechless.
Ye Shuo knew that children in ancient times would definitely not be able to escape this test, but it was a little strange. His stepfather had already experienced it, so why did he still follow this so-called “unspoken rule”?
Giving actively and giving passively were two completely different things.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t say anything else after that, but just warned him to eat quickly.
Silence means consent, so Ye Shuo didn’t argue and just ate his meal obediently.
Wang Ziquan finally put down his hand that was touching the cane.
After dinner in the evening, Ye Shuo thought about his hard work over the past ten days. His hands were almost broken from writing with charcoal pencils. The more he thought about it, the more unbalanced he felt. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ravage the little princess.
The little thing has no idea how much risk he has taken and how much effort he has endured for her future. I’m so worried about her.
Seeing the little pointed face constantly changing in his hands, Ye Shuo felt a little comforted.
“…That’s enough.” Emperor Jingwen suspected that he had just said those words just to continue bullying his sister without any psychological burden.
Ye Shuo’s actions were so touching that Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but speak.
The scope of my cheap dad’s responsibilities is getting wider and wider now.
Withdrawing his hand angrily, Ye Shuo returned to the side hall with a sigh.
After throwing his lower tooth onto the roof, Ye Shuo calmly thought that it was still early, so he took out his charcoal pencil and began to continue writing and drawing on the place where he had not finished last time.
As for Xiao Luzi, although he felt that the Ninth Prince’s recent behaviour was very mysterious, he had a vague feeling that this did not seem to be a trivial matter, and Ye Shuo hardly avoided him.
But because Xiao Luzi couldn’t understand what Ye Shuo wrote at all, he could only guess and couldn’t think that much.
Anyway, ever since the day he was assigned to the Ninth Prince by the Imperial Concubine, he, a servant, had no choice but to go down this path to the end.
Fortunately, although the Ninth Prince is not very reliable, he is very kind to his servants. They don’t have to be beaten or scolded, nor do they have to worry about being pushed out to take the blame at any time. The most important thing is that they have warm quilts to sleep in, during winter. To find such a master, Xiao Luzi feels that he must have burned incense in his previous life, so he is naturally loyal.
Around the hour of Hai, which was around nine or ten o’clock, Ye Shuo stopped writing in time, closed the half-written book, and went to bed.
Xiao Luzi didn’t ask any questions. He just considerately put the book away, making sure it wouldn’t be seen by the palace maids who were cleaning the house. Then he fell asleep on the footstool under Ye Shuo.
The other side.
Compared to Ye Shuo’s leisure, Wei Wen is much busier. Although the most critical problem has been solved, the rest is all physical work.
Wei Wen had to be on guard against Emperor Jingwen and find a way to contact General Xu. Most importantly, having students was not enough, there had to be a teacher, right?
Where could he find a teacher?
As the saying goes, a good teacher produces good students. Without a good teacher, no matter how smart the students are, it is useless. If they can’t even get started, how can they talk about their future?
Therefore, this teacher must not only be good, but also top-notch. It would be best if he could be like Taifu and Lord Cen.
But how easy is it to find such a famous teacher?
Wei Wen thought about it and finally thought of a great man named Zeng Mohuai, who was also very good at teaching and educating people. He had countless disciples, and his disciples were spread across three countries. He was not inferior to the Grand Tutor and Lord Cen at all, and was even better than the two in teaching.
This person is truly a leading figure in today’s education industry. Most importantly, he has made great achievements in government affairs, which couldn’t be more in line with the current situation.
The other party’s reputation was so great that the monarchs of the three countries treated him with courtesy. Even though he had never been loyal to anyone, including Emperor Jingwen, no one made things difficult for him.
What’s more, Mr. Zeng Mohuai had served as an official in three countries, and Emperor Jingwen had personally invited him when he first ascended the throne.
Wei Wen was already old enough to remember things by that time, so he naturally remembered this incident.
Although Mr. Zeng came, he did not stay for long, only about half a year. He was really not used to the environment in the officialdom, so he left again.
He is a freedom-loving person by nature, and he is extremely fanatical about the things he likes, especially mathematics.
The reason why Zeng Mohuai is so popular among the three monarchs is because of his strong personal abilities, and some of the little gadgets he makes can sometimes be of great use.
The three monarchs were all very open-minded. Although Mr. Zeng himself never defected to anyone, the same could not be said for his disciples.
When the disciples grow up and reach the age of becoming masters, they can’t always stay by the teacher’s side, right? At that time, everyone will fight for the position based on their own ability.
Therefore, Mr. Zeng is also a big supplier of talents to the courts of the three countries. Isn’t he respected?
If he can be invited, the current problems can be solved almost instantly.
There is indeed such a person in this world, but the problem is how to invite him.
The emperor went to invite him personally, and Mr. Zeng only stayed in Shangjing City for less than half a year. Wei Wen thought he did not have the ability to keep him, but he was very envious. So when his grandmother sent someone to deliver something to the palace, he specifically asked his little cousin to see if he had any solution.
When Ye Shuo learned the news, he thought in his heart that this was a simple matter.
The other party seems to be studying engineering. Isn’t this a good match for their majors?
Not to mention that he is a good seedling, maybe this big shot can find a way to poach him.
So after listening to it, Ye Shuo didn’t say much. He just asked someone to tell his cousin to find the person and show the thing to him. Since the other party had real ability, he might understand it immediately, and it would save a lot of trouble.
Wei Wen didn’t quite believe it at first, but seeing that his little cousin was so confident, he had no choice but to listen to him and give it a try.
But it was not easy for Wei Wen to leave Shangjing City after all. He was afraid of alarming Emperor Jingwen, so he did not dare to make any big moves.
Therefore, after Wei Wen managed to find out Mr. Zeng’s current residence, he asked someone to deliver the things over.
Wei Wen prayed in his heart that Mr. Zeng would not think he was being presumptuous.
He really didn’t have much hope at the time, but what Wei Wen never expected was that he received a reply in less than half a month.
What’s more, Zeng Mohuai, who is over 60 years old, plans to come to the capital in person to meet Wei Wen in person.
Wei Wen was stunned for a moment.
He realised belatedly that perhaps his cousin’s books were even more powerful than he had imagined…

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Serving
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
A month ago, in a small border town.
An unkempt, sloppy-looking old man was fiddling with the objects at hand as usual. Various kinds of wood were scattered on the ground at his feet, making the place look very messy.
But the strange thing is that there were so many people around the old man, but no one tried to help him tidy up. Some even tiptoed past him, as if they were afraid of disturbing anything.
Perhaps it was because the old man looked too ordinary. He had lived in this small town for almost a year. The people in the town and even the county magistrate did not know that the old man was the famous Mr. Zeng Mohuai. They just thought he was an ordinary carpenter. Seeing that he had good skills, they often brought some broken farm tools here to be repaired.
The group of apprentices led by the old man had good skills. It was basically not the old man’s turn to repair the farm tools, but they were all repaired by his apprentices.
Perhaps because they are good at different things and have different inclinations, Zeng Mohuai’s students are not like the students of the Grand Tutor and Lord Cen, who wear long Confucian robes. Instead, they are dressed in shorts. In addition, they follow their teacher around all year round, so their skin is tanned and a little rough and dark. At first glance, they look more like ordinary apprentices.
The old man kept moving his hands, and soon those wooden lumps of various shapes fit together and gradually became a whole, forming the shape of a bird.
After the pieces were put together, the old man didn’t know where he touched, and the bird’s wings flapped a few times, and it flew up as if it came alive.
Seeing this, the students in the yard subconsciously put down the work at hand and looked over here.“It’s done!”
I don’t know who shouted this excitedly, but before he finished speaking or the voice fell, the wooden bird seemed to have run out of power and could no longer continue.
First, a small piece of wood at the tail fell apart, and then the feet, belly, feathers… After about three or four breaths, the wooden bird fell apart in the air.
Wood fell and flew everywhere. Everyone’s expressions froze at the same time and the whole yard suddenly became silent.
“It’s still a long way to go, how can it be accomplished?” The old man couldn’t help but look at the student who had been shouting just now, and said unhappily.
The man didn’t dare to say a word and his expression became embarrassed.
When the old man’s eldest disciple came back, he saw the mess on the ground and immediately understood what had just happened.
Seeing the teacher looking over, the eldest disciple’s heart trembled, and he subconsciously said: “Teacher, someone asked someone to give this to me, and said it was for you.”
After all, the old man’s reputation is there, and there are constant stream of people sending gifts to him every month or even every day.
Among them are the old man’s former students as well as other people, but all of them are of extraordinary status and well-informed. Otherwise, ordinary people would never be able to find this place.
The old man was so annoyed that he thought it was another noble family or even the royal family. He was going to ignore it, but he found out that the other party was sending him some books.
If it was something else, it would be fine, but it is really hard for the old man to refuse something like a book.
He just experienced a failure and needed to calm down, so he said, “Bring it to me.”
The eldest disciple handed the book over subconsciously.
It didn’t matter that the old man just took a quick look at it, he was soon attracted by the contents of the book.
These things…
The other side.
After receiving the reply, Wei Wen stopped it without thinking.
If Mr. Zeng really came, His Majesty would definitely discover the secret activities that he and his little cousin were doing.
There was no way out, Wei Wen could only suppress his anxiety and reject him.
I thought Mr. Zeng would be angry this time, but who would have thought that he, who is known for his bad temper, would still be in a good mood.
Wei Wen gritted his teeth and took the opportunity to propose that Mr. Zeng go to the southwestern border to teach.
This time, it took a full month for the other party to reply.
Seeing that the other party still had no objection, Wei Wen held the letter in his hand, feeling as if he were in a dream.
What Wei Wen didn’t know was that Zeng Mohuai’s disciples had already been in an uproar a month ago.
They had never seen such rude people, and they were filled with indignation.
“This guy named Wei Wen really doesn’t know what’s good for him!” He was the one who gave the book, but he refused it. Is he trying to play a trick on me?
What’s more, this matter doesn’t sound simple.
“Teacher, I always feel that there must be something wrong here.” The eldest disciple asked his fellow disciples to find out. It seems that Wei Wen is the grandson of the Duke of Zhen from the Great Zhou.
The Duke of Zhen now seems to be suspected by Emperor Jingwen in court.
With such a sensitive identity, there must be a lot of connections behind it. If they are not careful, even they will fall into this vortex.
So the eldest disciple’s first reaction was to refuse.
The eldest disciple had followed his teacher to the courts of various countries for a period of time, so he naturally knew how much trouble there was.
The eldest disciple originally thought that with his teacher’s love of freedom, he would definitely not get involved in such muddy water. However, after reading the reply, his teacher went to pack his luggage without saying a word.
In just one night, Zeng Mohuai packed up all his important books, tools, etc., and looked like he was ready to set off at any time.
“Teacher, you…”
Faced with his students’ doubts, Zeng Mohuai shook his head and said nothing.
Although he is only obsessed with making various inventions, he is not completely ignorant of what is happening in the court. Can’t he see that there is a trap here?
It’s just that the things written in those books are too shocking. Zeng Mohuai has a hunch that if he can understand them all, it will definitely be a very extraordinary thing.
Moreover, the contents of the book seemed to be more than just these. Zeng Mohuai was extremely anxious and couldn’t wait to know the contents below. For someone like him who was devoted to research, nothing else mattered, and the most important thing was to keep exploring.
What country, what party, what court… he doesn’t care about any of it.
Sometimes, for something, some people will jump in without hesitation even if they know there is a trap ahead.
Zeng Mohuai saw it clearly and danced happily, but…
Zeng Mohuai couldn’t help but turn his head and look at his disciples: “If you don’t want to, I won’t force you.”
Although Zeng Mohuai is their teacher, he does not intend to force them in this capacity.
If Zeng Mohuai’s disciples cared about these things, they would not have stayed with him forever. They would have gone to the three countries to serve as officials or make a living, just like their other fellow disciples.
Finally, the group bid farewell to the small border town where they had lived for a year and a half.
Their original plan was to live here for three to five years, but now they had to leave before half the time was even over.
Of course, it was not like Zeng Mohuai did not have ‘no requirements’. His requirement was that if he encountered any problems that he did not understand, he hoped that Wei Wen could give him an answer.
Wei Wen had no idea what this was, so he could only convey it truthfully to his little cousin.
The other party’s attitude is so positive, it’s obvious at first glance that he is a fanatic. If he really starts asking questions, it will be endless, and even he may not be able to withstand it.
So Ye Shuo thought about it and said, “You can ask questions, but you can only ask once a month, and only three questions each time. If you ask more than that, I will not answer any more questions.”
Even so, it takes a lot of effort to explain just one of them clearly, and Ye Shuo will have to put in a lot of effort to answer all three questions.
After hearing the messenger repeat his cousin’s words, Wei Wen couldn’t help but feel that his cousin was too cautious.
As a result…Mr. Zeng was not angry at all, but very happy instead.
Even if others don’t know, how could he not know how precious the opportunity to have questions answered one-on-one is?
Mr. Zeng has been to all three countries, so he knows very well that there is only one person in the world who can produce these books.
One is willing to fight, the other is willing to be beaten, and both are eager to be beaten. Wei Wen is almost unable to understand the current situation.
Soon, Mr. Zeng followed the agreement and settled down at the border of Da Zhou with his students.
Not long after, Emperor Jingwen also received the news that Zeng Mohuai had brought a large number of disciples to the Great Zhou from a neighbouring country.
Zeng Mohuai had done this many times before, here today, there tomorrow, so Emperor Jingwen did not suspect anything else, and was even a little happy that this man finally came to the Great Zhou.
As the saying goes, those who are close to the water get the moon first. There are many smart people in the court, and many people who know how to manage, but there is a lack of people who can personally take charge and direct how things should be done.
After all, if a person himself does not understand this thing, no matter how good he is at managing others, he will not be able to accurately arrange every useful person in his place.
There are some rules to follow when deciding which one to do first or which one to do later.
However, there were many people studying for imperial examinations throughout the Great Zhou, but few knew how to build canals and dams. This was the reason why Mr. Zeng had such a transcendent status among the three countries.
This old man knows how to do it, and the students he brings up also know how to do it, so they are very popular in the eyes of the monarch, right?
Emperor Jingwen is just waiting to get the ready-made benefits.
Sitting in the special seat prepared for him in the Qinzheng Hall, Ye Shuo was so happy when he heard this.
Isn’t this exactly what they want?
My cousin is really reliable. He found such a great and powerful teacher right away.
Ye Shuo has been kept in the deep palace and doesn’t know much about what’s happening outside. If this matter is handed over to him, he doesn’t know how much effort it will take.
After that, apart from answering questions online on time once a month, Ye Shuo basically didn’t need to worry about anything anymore. The rest of the operations were handled by Wei Wen. Apart from this, his life was no different from usual.
He didn’t know if it was an illusion, but Wei Wen always felt that he was being left alone. But when he thought about it carefully, if it weren’t for his little cousin’s book, this matter really wouldn’t have been so smooth.
I just always feel like something is weird…
Compared to his elder cousin who became more and more haggard day by day, Ye Shuo’s life became more and more comfortable. In addition, the little princess Jianjian grew up day by day. She could walk when she was about one year and three months old. Ye Shuo soon had a “little slave” by his side, and he didn’t even have to do it himself to get things.
Just like now——
“My lovely little Jianjian, I’m so tired, can you bring me some snacks?”
The one-year-old little princess was naive to death. When she saw her brother lying there like a pile of mud, she didn’t think much about it and ran into the house to get him some snacks.
Ye Shuo thought of something and couldn’t help but raise his voice.
“Also, remember to wash your hands before you take the snacks. If you have dirty hands, brother won’t eat it.”
Emperor Jingwen, who was standing next to him, failed to control his strength and nearly crushed the book in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Fragile
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Jianjian originally wanted to run and play in the yard, but after being interrupted by Ye Shuo, she suddenly forgot what she was going to do, and her mind was full of thoughts about her brother asking for snacks.
“Don’t you have hands? Can’t you take it yourself? Even if you are too lazy to take it, aren’t there servants like Xiao Luzi around?” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t understand why he insisted that his sister help him take it.
The little princess’s little arms and legs are so busy that she doesn’t even have time to rest. He has the nerve to do that.
Ye Shuo lay on the hammock, looking lazy: “I don’t want to do this either, Dad, but there is no other way, Jian Jian is willing to do this.”
Such a young child, who can’t do anything, finally meets someone who will bother her. Wouldn’t she feel needed?
This is probably the sense of accomplishment that children have.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and felt angry when he saw his despicable look.
But the little princess didn’t think so. No matter how many times Emperor Jingwen told his daughter not to bother him or pay attention to him, and to tell him to get what he wanted, it still didn’t work.
The next time his son spoke, his daughter completely forgot his advice and still went to help him get things. Emperor Jingwen was so depressed by seeing this.Now, in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, the little princess is just a foolish child who is cheated every day, sold and still counts money for others.
Emperor Jingwen decided that he would keep a closer eye on her in the future, otherwise she might be kidnapped at any time.
Ye Shuo didn’t care what his cheap father was thinking. Anyway, it was impossible for his cheap father to stay in Qiuwu Palace for 12 hours. Jianjian had been with him for a long time, so naturally she would be closer to him.
As for the imperial concubine standing by, she just watched, occasionally picking up needle and thread to embroider some grass, flowers and the like to pass the time. Apart from this, she had nothing else to do.
Before, the Imperial Concubine would always go outside to quarrel with the Concubine Shu and the others. Now that she has these two children, she is not so interested in competing with the Concubine Shu and the Queen. She has become much calmer. Of course, the premise is that the other party does not provoke her.
What’s more, the imperial concubine doesn’t care about Emperor Jingwen as much as before. With Xiaojiu and Jianjian around every day, her life is already very fulfilling. Now the imperial concubine prefers to play mahjong with Zhao Chongrong and others, and almost no longer participates in the affairs of the harem.
The imperial concubine suddenly became interested in embroidery and the like. She would never touch such things before.
As for the results… forget it, it’s enough to kill time.
After a while, Xiao Jianjian ran out again with stumbling steps.
Her staggering appearance made the wet nurses behind her extremely nervous. They put their hands on the sides, fearing that she would fall. Emperor Jingwen’s gaze also involuntarily followed her.
But Ye Shuo was like a blind man, completely unaware of the little princess’s hard work, and even shamelessly picked on her: “Jianjian, stretch out your hand for me to see, so I can see if your hand is clean and fragrant.”
Emperor Jingwen narrowed his eyes subconsciously, and decided that no matter what the little princess’s hands looked like, or whether she had washed them, if Xiaojiu dared to say anything disliked him, he would let the guards stuff the cake into his mouth!
Jianjian didn’t think so much, since her brother had spoken, she stretched out her hand to show him.
“Well, not bad, Jianjian is really well behaved.” Ye Shuo turned his sister’s paws over and over to examine them carefully, then nodded with satisfaction.
“Being a good kid means washing your hands frequently, you know?”
As the saying goes, diseases come from the mouth. This concept did not exist in ancient times. Ye Shuo had to find a way to help her develop a habit.
When Jianjian heard him praising her, she was very happy and her little face turned red.
Just when Emperor Jingwen thought that this was finally all that was needed, he saw his son lying back, paralyzed in bed, unable to move.
“Jianjian is the best. Since you have brought the snacks, you can feed them to your brother as well.”
“ah–“
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Concubine Rong: “…”
Both of their hands stopped at the same time.
As a child, when we were little, we loved playing house, giving injections to dolls, feeding dolls, but what should we do if we don’t have dolls now?
Here is a ready-made one that can even talk.
Therefore, Jianjian did not feel bored, but very excited.
“Yes, just do it this way, slowly and gently, breaking it into small pieces little by little for brother to eat.”
“Brother, brother…” If it was Emperor Jingwen, he would have slapped him in the face and told him to eat it or not. But looking at the little princess, she really broke the snacks in hand into small pieces as requested, and not only fed them to him, but also called him brother.
Even after all this, she still calls him brother? ?
Emperor Jingwen’s expression was somewhat distorted.
The little princess stood on tiptoe, holding the cake, and worked very hard, while the little bastard was so lazy that he didn’t even turn his head.
After finally finishing the meal, the little princess was exhausted.
His sister was still young, and he was afraid of scalding her if he served her tea. So after finishing his meal, Ye Shuo thought for a moment and said, “Brother can’t eat alone. Go, bring some for Daddy as well.”
Seeing my cheap dad standing next to me, he was so greedy that his eyes turned red.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t hold it in any longer: “Can’t you stop bullying your sister? Can’t you——”
Before he could finish his words, he saw a small hand appear in front of him.
“Father…eat…”
The one-year-old little princess has fair skin and big eyes. She is as cute as can be. When she stares at people, she seems to be melting hearts.
Emperor Jingwen really couldn’t say no, and after a moment, he could only reach out to take it.
Of course, Emperor Jingwen was definitely not as shameless as Ye Shuo, who let his daughter feed him. Emperor Jingwen naturally ate the food himself.
“Good girl, Jianjian.” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but reach out and touch his daughter’s head.
However, even so, Ye Shuo still did not let the little princess go. After giving her this, he continued to nag her.
“And mother, she hasn’t eaten yet either, go get her another one.”
Will he ever be done?
This time, not to mention Emperor Jingwen, even Concubine Rong began to glare at her son.
“You could clearly let her take two at once, why did you ask her to take them one by one!” Emperor Jingwen gritted his teeth and tried to suppress his anger.
Ye Shuo waved his hand nonchalantly: “What’s the big deal? Children should exercise more.”
Does this brother have a heart?
The little princess ran back and forth. With her height, she had to climb for a long time to cross the threshold. It was heartbreaking.
After the imperial concubine received the snacks, she refused to let her daughter run away again no matter what.
However, at this time, Jianjian had already started rubbing her eyes.
Ye Shuo looked up at the sky not far away. The sun was about to set and it felt like it was about time.
Sure enough, after dinner, Jianjian could no longer bear it. She was so tired that she didn’t even have the energy to cry. She was held in the arms of the wet nurse and fell into a deep sleep.
Because of the habit she developed since childhood, she probably won’t wake up until dawn.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t think too much about it and just moved in Qiuwu Palace directly. Even he didn’t pay attention to the fact that he was staying in Qiuwu Palace more and more often.
I have a son and a daughter. Although the son is absurd, playing with cats and dogs all day instead of doing anything serious and making people angry, he will be fine after he gets over the anger.
When it came to Xiaojiu, Emperor Jingwen could say whatever he wanted and scold whatever he wanted without worrying about which words would make him think too much. Anyway, the child was thick-skinned and big-hearted, which inevitably made Emperor Jingwen feel more at ease.
Although his daughter was still young, she was well-behaved and sensible, and the imperial concubine herself did not have so many twists and turns, so Emperor Jingwen also experienced the simple and warm life between ordinary couples in the palace.
Just like today, I was reading a book while listening to the brother and sister playing and fighting, and the whole afternoon passed by.
Managing such a large country sometimes made Emperor Jingwen feel tired, so he inevitably yearned for a moment of peace and quiet.
Emperor Jingwen was satisfied, but the others in the harem were not.
Especially the Queen. Before, the Emperor would come to her palace to sit on the first and fifteenth days of every month, but now he doesn’t even come anymore.
His Majesty has visited the little prince only a handful of times, even less frequently than the Ninth Prince. What makes the Queen even more exhausted is that the little prince still cannot walk and speaks incoherently, while the little princess, who is younger than the little prince, can now run around.
Of course, what made the queen most desperate was that for some unknown reason, the emperor’s attitude towards their Zheng family had gradually become colder, which made the queen even more panicked.
All of the above, no matter which one it is, urgently needs something to change it.
There was no other way, the queen could only force her son to learn to walk and talk, and she must make the little prince stand up in a short period of time to change everything.
In just over a year, the little prince would be sent to school. Before that, the queen would make sure he became a normal prince no matter what.
She couldn’t beat him, but scolding him was fine. Thinking that the one-year-old boy was already able to understand what she said, the queen subconsciously began to stimulate her son with words.
Seeing that the little prince seemed to react more strongly to sharp sounds, the queen was delighted, and her attitude became increasingly harsh, causing the little prince to tremble all over when he heard it.
But even though he was trembling, he didn’t have enough strength to stand up, which only made him, who was already weak, even more timid.
His horrible appearance made the Queen even angrier. At this time, the Queen couldn’t help but think of the little princess who was about his age.
The little princess is just a princess, but she can still please his majesty. She was given a name when she was three months old. Now, she is often held in his arms. The difference between them is huge.
It would be great if my son could please the emperor more.
Since the Queen had thought of this in her mind, she couldn’t help but bring some of this out in her words. At first, she just wanted to stimulate the little prince to stand up, but later on, things gradually changed.
It was under such circumstances that the little prince finally stood up with difficulty by holding on to a chair when he was almost two years old.
The queen was startled, and then she was overjoyed. Meanwhile, the little princess was also growing up under Ye Shuo’s oppression.
The little princess discovered that this man she called brother was really fragile. Whenever she walked away from him while strolling in the garden, he would lose his way. He would have to wait for her to turn back and hold his hand before he could barely keep up with her.
You have to keep a close eye on him at all times, otherwise this person you call brother will get lost if you are not careful.
Oh, it’s so fragile.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: School
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Brother, brother, this…” After a while, as they were walking, they found that the person who was called brother was gone again. The little princess, who couldn’t control her excitement and ran a long way away, panicked and quickly turned back to look for him.
As expected, my brother was mesmerised by the flowers and plants on the roadside for the umpteenth time.
“Jianjian, look, is this flower beautiful?” Ye Shuo squatted there, pointing at the green Yangchun in the grass and said.
The light green chrysanthemums are now in full bloom, and they are still graceful even in the autumn wind.
One of them in particular was exceptionally lush and beautiful.
“Yeah, yeah.” Jianjian took a look and found that the flower was exactly the same as the other green chrysanthemums. She really didn’t know what this person called brother was so happy about.
Jianjian nodded perfunctorily like a little adult, but held Ye Shuo’s hand with one of her little hands, deciding in her heart that she would not let him out of her sight no matter what.
“Brother, brother…let’s go…”
Thinking that Empress Zhao and the others might be waiting impatiently, Jianjian couldn’t speak clearly and could only express his meaning vaguely and anxiously.Ye Shuo then stood up with great difficulty.
But the devil is a devil after all, how can that be enough?
Children, when they are happy, cannot control themselves easily, and they run so fast that the palace servants behind them cannot keep up, and they can easily fall if they are not careful.
So Ye Shuo said that as long as he ran faster than her, she would slow down herself.
“Jianjian, look, what is that!”
Jianjian had just been quiet for a while when she heard these words.
Then the man called brother successfully escaped from his hands.
Looking at the empty little hands, Jianjian was stunned.
Then such a scene appeared in the Imperial Garden——
The Ninth Prince was running in front, and the little princess was chasing him with her short legs. As she chased, she shouted, “Brother, brother, slow down…”
The prince who was passing by saw this scene and fell silent on the spot.
The fifth prince has now set up a residence outside and has also been assigned an assignment in the court. This time he came to pay his respects to his mother, but as luck would have it, he came across such a scene.
The fifth prince turned his head and said, “Am I seeing things right? Is there something wrong with my eyes, or is there something wrong with my ninth brother’s brain?”
The Fifth Prince had laughed at Ye Shuo before, saying that after his sister was born, he stayed in Qiuwu Palace every day taking care of the child, and did not behave like a prince at all.
So this is how he raises his children?
Isn’t this the child taking care of him?
But Ye Shuo didn’t care about that. He finally caught up with his brother. Xiao Jianjian was panting and grabbed his hand. This time, she refused to let go.
Jianjian panted and advised: “No, you can’t… run…”
My mother said that we are not allowed to run around in the palace.
Ye Shuo was embarrassed when he heard this: “But, brother just saw Jian Jian running too.”
Jianjian said without thinking: “Jianjian…don’t run, brother…don’t run.”
Ye Shuo pretended to think, and finally said reluctantly: “Okay then.”
Afterwards, in order to keep an eye on her brother, Jian Jian stopped rushing forward. Holding Ye Shuo’s hand, she walked slowly and firmly towards Empress Zhao’s palace.
Ye Shuo saw a pool of water in the middle. Before he could say anything, Jian Jian got anxious and took the initiative to speak: “No, no!”
Don’t think that she doesn’t know what this guy called brother wants to do. He must want to play in the water!
This happened in the summer when he wanted to jump into the lotus pond and nearly drowned.
That incident really frightened Jianjian. She would not allow him to get close to the water no matter what. She would even ask him to take a detour when he saw a well. Even when he was taking a bath, Jianjian would check from time to time to see if he was still alive.
“Cold…sick…”
Ye Shuo: “…”
No matter what, he wouldn’t jump into the water in the middle of autumn.
Maybe Jianjian was scared during the summer.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to go down to see if there were any lotus roots in the lotus pond. It seemed that digging two sections of fresh lotus roots to eat would be good, but he misjudged the thickness of the mud in the pond and his two feet sank into it and couldn’t be pulled out. He looked like he was almost drowned in the mud.
Because of this incident, Jianjian had a deep psychological trauma towards water. He didn’t know whether it was good or bad, but at least it was good now.
Jianjian saw that he was still staring at the pool and was terrified. She was afraid that he would think badly and jump in again, so she was anxious.
Seeing that she was about to cry, Ye Shuo quickly retracted his gaze.
Jianjian didn’t hesitate and hurriedly took him away from this troubled place.
The little princess did not notice the slightly distorted expressions of Su Yue and the others behind her.
It wasn’t actually too far from Qiuwu Palace to Empress Zhao’s Palace, but even so, it still took the two of them almost half an hour to walk.
More than an hour was wasted on the road.
By the time they got there, Jianjian was almost exhausted.
Seeing the miserable appearance of the little princess and looking at the spirited Ninth Prince beside her, Zhao Chongrong and the others immediately knew that the Ninth Prince must have done something again.
The Ninth Prince is really something. The little princess is still young, but he is not afraid of tiring her out.
Children exercise a lot and eat a lot. Looking at the little princess’s chubby face, Zhao Chongrong and the other two finally swallowed their words of advice.
In fact, if the little princess is healthy, this is also good…
It was Ye Shuo’s idea to have lunch at Zhao Chongrong’s place. The main reason was that there were not many entertainment activities in the palace and Jianjian was still young. If she was not allowed to do something, she would just make trouble every day.
Coming to Zhao Chongrong’s place at noon every day, she treats it as a mission. When she hears the word “mission”, Jianjian works very hard.
No matter how obedient and sensible a child is, there will always be bad times. During this time, the mother can feel more relaxed when the two children are not around.
Every day, Ye Shuo and the other two come over to eat, so Zhao Chongrong and the others don’t feel lonely anymore. It’s good for all three parties.
Except that Jianjian feels a little tired, there is no other problem.
After a long time of struggling, they finally finished lunch. Jianjian felt sleepy and was about to make trouble. Zhao Chongrong and the other two were ready to coax the child, but…
Before the three of them could speak, Ye Shuo spoke first.
“Jianjian, it’s time to coax brother to take a nap.”
Zhao Chongrong and the other two: “…”
“Coming, coming.” Habit became nature, Jianjian ran over without thinking.
While rubbing her eyes, she reached out to pat her brother’s chest. The force should not be too strong or too weak. If it was too strong, he would feel the shock, and if it was too weak, he would not feel anything.
After Ye Shuo closed his eyes, Jian Jian could hardly stand.
The wet nurse was so heartbroken that she quickly picked up the little princess and put her on the small bed that Zhao Chongrong had prepared long ago.
Only at this time of day can the little princess take a rest. The rest of the time, she is either being assigned work by the Ninth Prince or on her way to do work assigned by the Ninth Prince.
Zhao Chongrong had imagined countless times what her daughter would look like when she was born. Although her little princess was not born successfully, she was sure that she would never be like this!
At noon, Jianjian woke up on time and played with the three ladies for a while. When the time was almost up, Jianjian went to call her brother to get up, and then dragged her brother back to Qiuwu Palace.
“Goodbye, Madam Zhao, Madam Li, and Madam Xu.”
Alas, such a polite child, how come she has such a brother?
Of course, the little princess is not always a little angel, she also has her temper sometimes.
For example, in winter, Jianjian ran back and forth in the palace. She complained that her clothes were too thick and it was difficult for her to move, so she refused to let the imperial concubine give her a cotton coat.
There is a kind of cold that makes mom feel you are cold.
It just so happened that Ye Shuo didn’t like wearing cotton pants either. Seeing his sister like this, he decisively said, “Okay, then I won’t wear them either.”
Jianjian was stunned.
After much thought, Jianjian finally put on the cotton coat.
“…How can you be so lacking in persistence?” Even after walking quite a distance away, Ye Shuo could still be heard complaining.
Jianjian didn’t want to do that, but——
“Brother, you’re so thin.” Jianjian looked at her own chubby hands with dimples, then looked at her brother’s skinny hands with protruding joints, and couldn’t help shaking her head.
Ye Shuo looked down at his well-proportioned and slender fingers, but didn’t find anything wrong. Why was Jian Jian looking at him like that?
Afraid that the man called brother would freeze to death, Jianjian decided to put on a cotton coat.
When he was over two years old, Jianjian couldn’t stand the man she called brother, always picking up dishes she didn’t like for her. He didn’t understand even when she told him that he was so stupid.
Seeing that they really couldn’t communicate, one day, Jianjian pushed her brother’s hand away in anger and went to find chopsticks by herself.
Although she was extremely unskilled in using chopsticks as it was her first time and the chopsticks fell back into the bowl at least eight times out of ten, at least she didn’t have to accept food she didn’t like.
You can pick up whatever you want and eat whatever you want. It’s so free.
After experiencing this kind of happiness once, Jianjian never let Ye Shuo feed her again, and she became more and more proficient in using chopsticks, from being unfamiliar at the beginning.
In less than a month, Jianjian could eat whatever she wanted.
Emperor Jingwen, who was standing by, couldn’t help but hold his forehead when he saw this scene.
Silly daughter, doesn’t she know that besides her brother, she can also let the maids, eunuchs or wet nurses feed her?
If she wants to eat something, she can just move her mouth, why bother to do it herself?
Until now, she still hasn’t figured out why her brother always sends the maids, eunuchs and wet nurses out every time she eats?
Xiaojiu is really something. He even lied to his own sister.
The next day, after his stepfather left, Ye Shuo suddenly remembered something and went to tell his mother.
After hearing this, Concubine Rong looked incredulous.
“Are you going to ask your sister to go to school???”
“Yes.” Ye Shuo said without thinking, as if it was a matter of course.
“She’s almost three years old now, so she should start learning calligraphy and reading.”
Putting aside the question of whether to invite the princess to the study room, based on his previous actions, he shouldn’t have thought of this.
When Shuo’er was three years old, he refused to go to the study room. Now it’s Jianjian’s turn, but he looks like he’s determined to send her in no matter what. I really don’t know what’s going on in his little head.
As if he had seen through his mother’s doubts, Ye Shuo cleared his throat and said seriously, “I’m just thinking, there must be someone in our family who can study, right?”
“It’s not like you can’t even come up with the last one, right?”
Concubine Rong was stunned for a moment, and suddenly felt that her son’s words seemed to make sense…

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Etiquette
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Indeed, it is impossible for a family to have no one who can read, right?
“But if that’s the case, won’t Jianjian be too tired?” The other princesses didn’t have to do so many things. When they reached a certain age, they could read, but there were no strict requirements. It was up to the individual whether to read or not.
If you want to study, there will be special female officials to teach you. If you don’t want to study, you won’t be forced.
As a princess, it’s fine for her to get married when she reaches a certain age.
In the past, princesses basically all lived this way.
The imperial concubine had never experienced the modern era, so naturally she didn’t know that women could receive the same education as men, so she could only see the hardships her daughter was going through.
If you study, you will naturally suffer, and studying itself is an extremely hard thing.
But if it is not bitter now, it will be very bitter in the future.
Dying consciously or living in confusion, Ye Shuo didn’t know which option was better for Jianjian. Jianjian couldn’t make a choice now, so Ye Shuo could only act according to his own ideas.This book is definitely a must read.
However, Ye Shuo did not say it directly, but smiled and said: “You have to learn to read after all. Jianjian is young and has a good memory. It is not easy to forget if you learn it early.”
Concubine Rong thought about it and agreed. Jianjian needed to be enlightened no matter what.
But there’s no need to go to the study room, right?
“When the time comes, mother can just find a female official to teach her.”
“Mother, there’s no need to be so troublesome.” Due to the rules of the palace, no matter how talented the female official was, she had to teach the princess “Female Training”, “Female Rules” and “Female Admonitions”. Ye Shuo didn’t want Jianjian to be exposed to these things too early.
Although the original intention of these books has not been distorted so much nowadays, they only teach women how to behave, and the methods seem gentle, but think about it carefully, why there are no corresponding “Men’s Training”, “Men’s Rules”, and “Men’s Admonitions”. When the corresponding books are published, Ye Shuo will admit that this is a good thing.
Everyone in the world advises women to be kind, gentle and obedient. It is indeed not a bad thing to have compassion for the weak, but sometimes women can live better by being a little cruel.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo said, “Isn’t there a ready-made teacher right now?”
Don’t forget that he is now giving one-on-one private lessons, so it doesn’t matter if there is one more or one less person.
The imperial concubine was stunned: “You mean——”
“Don’t we still have the tutor? Third brother is already this old and has already graduated. It would be such a waste for the tutor to only take me with him. I don’t want to learn, so when the time comes, I can just take Jianjian with me.”
With a new student, the tutor must be very happy.
Since the tutor was assigned by his adoptive father to be the prince’s teacher, there must be no problem with his professional level. He is also an acquaintance, so Ye Shuo is relieved.
The most important thing is that you can use the tip to block gunshots, what a great thing!
At the same time, at the Taifu’s house, the Taifu suddenly felt a chill on his back and couldn’t help sneezing.
It was the first time that the imperial concubine had seen someone speak so confidently about not liking to study. However, when she thought about herself, she felt that she was not much better, so she could not bring herself to curse.
Forget it, since Shuo’er is like me, there is probably nothing I can do. I should think more about Jianjian. Jianjian is still young and she still has hope.
The imperial concubine also knew that the Grand Tutor was indeed a good person.
But……
“Will the Master agree?”
That’s the prince’s teacher, a top official of the dynasty! Would this… anger him?
Ye Shuo wasn’t worried at all: “Mom, don’t worry, I have a way to get the old man, the tutor, to agree.”
Well, Shuo’er has even found a teacher for Jianjian, and the teacher is so respected and virtuous, now all he has to do is wait for Jianjian to go to class.
It is so difficult to find a good teacher. Even a royal concubine would not be willing to miss such an opportunity.
So without further thought, the imperial concubine nodded decisively: “Okay.”
The imperial concubine made the final decision, thus determining Jianjian’s “fate”.
Poor Jianjian is still sleeping soundly, and has no idea that her mother would sell her out so easily.
The two maids next to them didn’t even say a word. After all, it wasn’t the first time.
Since the decision had been made, Ye Shuo had already started making preparations.
The Sixth Prince, who was also in Qiuwu Palace, soon learned about this matter. He was also very confused at first, wondering why the usually lazy Xiaojiu would be so persistent in the little princess’s studies.
Doesn’t he understand the principle of not doing to others what you don’t want others to do to you?
However, Ye Shuo stopped the Sixth Prince with one sentence: “It’s okay for me not to count on her, but my mother and I will count on you.”
“In such a large Qiuwu Palace, there must be someone we can rely on, right?”
If the Sixth Prince could use the power of the Imperial Concubine and the Duke of Zhen, he would definitely be happy to do so, but this is obviously not the case at the moment. Xiaojiu’s intention is to find someone to support him.
He felt that he was not capable enough and was ready to rely on his sister.
The Sixth Prince was almost exhausted from studying seriously every day, so how could he have the leisure to follow his brother to fight in the arena?
The Sixth Prince couldn’t help but twitch his lips slightly: “I think you are much more reliable to rely on yourself than on Jianjian.”
It should be said that as expected of someone who has read so many books, he hit the point in one sentence.
Indeed, instead of placing your hopes on children, it is better to do it yourself.
But, Ye Shuo is obviously not interested in this now.
“But I just want to see what others can do if they try hard.” Ye Shuo’s expression now was as if he couldn’t even fly to the sky, and he was looking for an egg in his parents’ nest, hoping that the egg would fly.
Even though the Sixth Prince didn’t know this routine so clearly, he was still very angry.
“Not striving for progress, not striving for advancement, and willing to degenerate!”
After saying these twelve harsh words, the Sixth Prince was once again driven away in anger.
Ye Shuo touched his chin, wondering if it was really that serious, and didn’t notice that Xing Yucheng next to him was reading even faster.
Not taking the Sixth Prince’s words to heart at all, Ye Shuo looked like a hopeless case and continued to act as he always did.
In this way, Jianjian soon noticed that for several months, her brother came home sighing every day.
Jianjian took a lot of effort to figure out that it was her brother who was reading and was scolded by the teacher.
So, what is reading and why does it make my brother so sad?
Jianjian now still cannot understand what reading means, so she can only piece together a little bit of truth from Ye Shuo’s words.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about that. He just hugged his sister and cried, “Wuwuwuwuwu Jianjian, brother is so stupid. Why can’t brother learn?”
Indeed, her brother was really stupid. He was the dumbest person she had ever met.
At first Jian Jian even nodded in agreement, but when Ye Shuo started crying, she immediately panicked and didn’t care about anything else: “Don’t cry, don’t cry… Brother, don’t cry…”
Ye Shuo seemed not to hear and cried even louder: “If only brother could be as smart as Jianjian, if brother could be as smart as Jianjian, he would definitely be able to learn it right away.”
No matter how ignorant Jianjian was, she knew what the word “smart” meant.
The imperial concubine often praised her, saying that she could speak when she was less than one year old, could walk when she was one year and three months old, could eat by herself when she was over two years old, and could wash her face by herself when she was three years old. After listening to her for a long time, Jianjian gradually came to realise that she was very smart.
What Jianjian didn’t know was that her imperial concubine thought her brother was well-behaved, sensible and obedient…
“Then, then Jianjian… share her intelligence with… my brother…” Jianjian used her sleeves to wipe the tears of her stupid brother.
Alas, although these words sound nice, they are not what Ye Shuo wants.
Seeing that the foreshadowing was almost complete, Ye Shuo gradually began to show his true colors: “Brother, isn’t so clever. Brother wants Jianjian to help me get revenge, okay?”
“But…but…the person that my brother can’t beat, Jianjian can’t beat either…” The little princess was finally not completely confused and still knew her own weight.
But how could such a simple girl escape the trap set by her brother?
“There is no need for Jianjian to help her brother fight. Jianjian only needs to use her smart brain.”
The little princess couldn’t resist her brother’s deception and agreed without thinking.
For a period of time afterwards, Ye Shuo would remind her every day for fear that she would forget. Later on, Jian Jian herself became more anxious.
“There are still ten days left, Jianjian, are you ready?”
“There are still seven days left, Jianjian. I believe you can do it.”
“Five more days…”
“Three days…”
“Jianjian, you will be able to see the master tomorrow morning. I’ll leave my brother’s affairs to you then.”
[1] Using ‘my’ for himself or oneself
“No problem!”
At that time, Jianjian answered in the affirmative, but when the thing really happened, as a child, she could not help but back down.
Children change their expressions very quickly, and it’s hard to deal with them when they start crying.
So Ye Shuo decided not to give her any chance to regret.
The next morning, Ye Shuo knocked on his mother’s door and carried his sleeping sister on his back.
Although it is already May, the weather is still quite cold in the morning, so Ye Shuo specially found a cloak for Jianjian to put on.
Ye Shuo’s steps were extremely steady as he moved forward step by step.
After the Grand Tutor left the court, Ye Shuo had almost arrived at the Eastern Palace.
Although it was true that Emperor Jingwen had a special seat set up for Ye Shuo, he did not have to report there every day. Ye Shuo had specifically asked about it yesterday, and the Grand Tutor said that he would meet the Crown Prince today and teach him to read in the East Palace.
To be honest, more than three years have passed, and the Grand Tutor had given up on the Ninth Prince a long time ago. Now, apart from the Emperor’s orders, the only thing that supports him is his sense of responsibility as a teacher.
Nowadays, the Grand Tutor at least scolds him, but it won’t be long before the Grand Tutor doesn’t even bother to scold him.
When the Grand Tutor and the Crown Prince came together, they happened to run into Ye Shuo.
Why did he come so early today?
The same thought came to their minds at the same time.
Soon, the prince discovered something was wrong. Why did Xiaojiu have such a big bump on his back?
As if sensing the prince’s doubts, Ye Shuo turned sideways, revealing Jianjian’s sleeping face.
Didn’t the Ninth Prince come to class today? Why did he bring the princess with him?
After seeing the little princess, for some reason, the Grand Tutor suddenly had a bad feeling in his heart.
Soon, the preceptor’s premonition came true.
“Teacher, Jianjian is already over three years old. It’s time for her to start learning. Could you take the trouble to teach her how to read and write?”
What on earth did the Ninth Prince think of him?!
How could it be possible to ask him to teach a princess?
The master did not hesitate and blurted out, “No!”
Ye Shuo seemed a little helpless when he heard this: “Okay, then I’ll go find the Master’s wife to teach her.”
After all, the teacher’s wife is well-read, so there is no problem for her to help Jianjian with his education.
“I’m really sorry, Third Brother, Teacher, I won’t bother you anymore.”
Without waiting for the two to react, Ye Shuo turned around and left without any reluctance.
Because of her granddaughter’s marriage, Mrs. Zhen had been unkind to her husband in recent years. When the Grand Tutor thought of what happened the last time he visited her house, he shuddered.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Measurement
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Turning around, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but count silently in his heart.
“three.”
“two.”
“one……”
“Wait a minute!” Before Ye Shuo finished counting the last word, he heard the tutor calling him back decisively.
Based on the Grand Tutor’s understanding of the Ninth Prince, he is definitely capable of doing such a thing.
The Taifu has to attend court every day, teach the prince to read, and give him advice, which is tiring enough in itself. If he cannot have peace at home, then he really has no way to survive.
The Grand Tutor also understood that the Ninth Prince did it on purpose, but for the sake of family harmony and for himself to sleep peacefully, the Grand Tutor finally lowered his head.
Even teaching this to a princess is not polite.He is a man and also the prince’s teacher. How can this be allowed?
But the Grand Tutor seemed to have accepted his fate. After all, since he had become involved with the Ninth Prince, he could not escape no matter what.
Not only could he not escape, but now he had to teach his sister to read. This made the Taifu regret countless times. He should not have offended Lord Cen and then been dragged into this trouble by him.
The prince was watching from the side, and he really didn’t dare to speak. The prince was sure that if he dared to say one more word, Xiaojiu would throw the burden on him.
So, I’m sorry, teacher…
The Master sighed, feeling a deep sense of powerlessness: “I promise you.”
As long as the Ninth Prince doesn’t go looking for his wife, it doesn’t matter if it’s against the rules, everything else can be discussed.
The Grand Tutor suddenly realised that since he met the Ninth Prince, he seemed to have done many things that he would never do before, and he didn’t even know how many times he had broken the established rules.
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo immediately carried his sister on his back and followed the two of them.
Once again lamenting the speed at which the Ninth Prince changed his expression, as he walked into the East Palace, the Imperial Tutor couldn’t help but ask, “Aren’t there clearly female officials in the palace? Why did you come to me? The princess is a woman, wouldn’t it be more convenient for her to find a female official?”
Because you guys control everything the female officer teaches…
Although he was complaining in his heart, Ye Shuo looked very serious: “My sister, I definitely want to give her the best.”
Taifu = Prince’s teacher = the best.
After quickly understanding what the Ninth Prince meant, even the Grand Tutor couldn’t help but feel relieved, finally not feeling so aggrieved.
As the saying goes, flattery never wears out, no matter how many holes there are. Everyone likes to hear nice words, not to mention the Taifu, even the emperor is the same, it mainly depends on how the nice words are said.
If it is too straightforward, they will feel that their intelligence is being insulted, which is why simple flattery will not make them happy but will make them angry.
It’s like this, a casual sentence, it’s best to think about it and figure out its meaning.
Anyway, the Grand Tutor is feeling quite comfortable right now.
However, the Grand Tutor was not fooled by Ye Shuo’s short words. It was fine if he did not explain it in advance this time. If the Imperial Concubine gave birth to another prince or princess in the future, he would not be the one to teach them, right?
If he did not refuse in advance, his life would be in vain.
Therefore, the Grand Tutor decisively said: “This is just the first and last time, it won’t happen again.”
“No problem.” Let’s not talk about whether his mother will have another child in the future. Even if she does, it will be several years later. Let’s finish the current things first and think about the future later.
When Ye Shuo was walking inside with Jian Jian on his back, he faintly heard the voice of a child in the distance. He knew without thinking that it must be the prince’s other children.
In the few years since Jian Jian was born, the Eastern Palace has added a lot of people, both boys and girls, but they were all born to concubines and other women. Ye Shuo did not know the details. After all, he was only familiar with the Crown Princess and the little grandson of the emperor. Apart from the Crown Princess and the little grandson of the emperor, Ye Shuo naturally would not pay attention to others.
And now the little grandson was still taking classes in the study room, so Ye Shuo had even less interest.
With his younger brother/the Ninth Prince around, the Crown Prince and the Grand Tutor naturally wouldn’t bring up overly confidential topics. They only talked about the things happening in the court. As Ye Shuo listened, he couldn’t bear it anymore and lay down on the table.
Soon, Ye Shuo and the little princess were sleeping soundly, each one more than the other.
The Grand Tutor and the Crown Prince were already accustomed to this scene, and the Little Nine/Ninth Prince was also like this in the Qinzheng Palace.
In the end, the little princess woke up first. Seeing the unfamiliar environment and the strange old man, she became flustered and subconsciously called Ye Shuo.
“Brother…Brother…” Where on earth is this place?
Jianjian still remembers that she was sleeping in her mother’s room.
As if he didn’t see that the little princess was about to cry, Ye Shuo pointed upwards: “Third brother, you should know this, right?”
The prince held his forehead with his hand, smiled at the little princess very friendly, and called her “Jianjian”.
After careful identification, Jianjian breathed a sigh of relief.
“Here, this is the Master Taifu I mentioned to you before. He is my brother’s teacher and will be your teacher from now on.”
The Grand Tutor was stunned when he heard this. Wait a minute, didn’t he say that it was just the beginning of the study? Why did he call for a teacher?
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo’s description before was too terrifying, which made Jian Jian think that the man called Taifu must look ferocious and particularly vicious. But now, it seems that he is not so bad.
Jianjian gradually let down her guard and her hands, which were tightly holding onto the corner of Ye Shuo’s clothes, gradually loosened.
But after all, he was a stranger, so Jianjian just called out timidly, “Master Taifu.”
Taifu himself had two daughters. Although his wife was in charge of raising his daughters, he at least held them in his arms when they were young.
As for the granddaughter, she grew up day by day under the supervision of the Grand Tutor.
When the Grand Tutor saw the little princess, he couldn’t help but think of his daughter and granddaughter when they were young. His expression subconsciously softened, no longer as stiff as it was when he was facing Ye Shuo.
“I pay my respects to the little princess.”
“No, no need. Please stand up, Master.” Jianjian was flustered for a moment when she saw this, but she was a princess after all, so she quickly calmed down.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Ye Shuo, who was like a lazy dog, leaned close to his sister’s ear and whispered, “This is the man who calls me stupid every day. Jianjian, you must help me get revenge. I am counting on you!”
The movement of the Grand Tutor standing up suddenly froze, and the look in his eyes when he looked at the Ninth Prince changed.
Whenever the Grand Tutor thought the Ninth Prince was shameless enough, he would often do something even more shameless.
How could he think of telling a complaint to the little princess who is only three years old!
“Brother…” To be honest, Jianjian was just a little kid after all, and she was quite nervous and scared. But when she turned around and saw that her brother was more nervous and scared than her, and that her brother had always been stupid and couldn’t do anything well, the young Jianjian suddenly felt a surge of courage in her heart.
In the end, Jianjian gritted her teeth and looked into the Master’s eyes.
“Well, then…”
The Crown Prince was watching with great interest, and was even in no hurry to deal with state affairs. The Grand Tutor suddenly had the urge to curse.
In this way, Jianjian started the first day of study in a daze.
