Zeng Mohuai’s actions may seem absurd, but he is actually acting according to the actual situation.
Appearances are not important to him, what matters is the results.
In order to curb the current flooding of the source river, different analyses should be conducted based on different situations. Some require strengthening of embankments, while others require adjustment of flood diversion channels. If the river is silted up, the river channel needs to be narrowed, etc. Dredging and blocking require specific analyses of specific situations. People without a basic understanding simply cannot do this job.
Besides, if it really doesn’t work, isn’t there someone who can give me guidance remotely?
This was that person’s idea. He asked me to bring my students to help, so he naturally had to help finish it. Besides, with his ability, it shouldn’t be difficult for him to provide some effective suggestions.
Thinking of this, Zeng Mohuai no longer felt worried.
No matter how precocious the boys and girls in ancient times were, they were only in their teens after all. When such an important task was handed to them, they would naturally feel panic-stricken and at a loss.
Even if a genius is selected from thousands of people, before he has gone through the hardships, he is nothing more than a useless bud.
But when Master Zeng mentioned the person who would deliver news to them on time every month, the people’s originally tense hearts suddenly became less panicked.
Yes, if all else fails, they can seek help from that mysterious and powerful teacher.
Because there are many orphans who are unattended at the southwestern border, and there are many people watching, the news might leak out. Until now, only Zeng Mohuai knows that the person who has been sending the message is the ninth prince of the current dynasty.
For other people, including this group of students, the situation is what it appears to be to outsiders.
Even this group of new students thought that Zeng Mohuai stopped teaching when he passed by here during his travels through the Three Kingdoms period.
Zeng Mohuai only cared about the knowledge given by the Ninth Prince, and did not care about the Ninth Prince’s age and purpose. As long as there was new knowledge, Zeng Mohuai didn’t care about that.
Perhaps in the near future, only after all these more than a thousand people have been screened out, Zeng Mohuai will tell them the identity of the other teacher.
We should proceed step by step. Now it is time to allow them to contact the people of the eldest son of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion individually.
Over the past three years, no matter how tricky the questions they asked, they were never stumped by the mysterious teacher. As time went on, the impression Ye Shuo left on them became more and more profound.
Sometimes, problems that even Master Zeng could not solve were explained clearly by him in just a few words. The eight students in front of him already regarded the owners of those letters as gods.
When Master Zeng mentioned that the man would cover for them, the eight people in front of them were not so worried at all.
In these few days, they have seen so many disaster victims that even a heart of stone would be moved. Young boys and girls are at the age of great ambition, so how could they not want to save the people from the disaster?
It’s just that the cost of failure is too heavy that makes them dare not speak out easily.
But in fact, no matter how old you are, everyone has gone through this, and after getting familiar with it, you will gradually become proficient.
Zeng Mohuai did not hesitate for long and immediately assigned them.
At this juncture, Emperor Jingwen didn’t want to offend Zeng Mohuai, so he didn’t stop him. He just wanted people to really listen to the eight of them. In Emperor Jingwen’s opinion, forget it!
Zeng Mohuai wanted to use this to train his disciples, but Emperor Jingwen was unwilling to play with so many people’s lives.
Emperor Jingwen’s meaning was very clear, but soon, the imperial envoy who served as his eyes and ears also brought news that although these people were still young, they still had some abilities, and more than half of the eight were actually better than the local officials.
Emperor Jingwen was stunned.
After pondering for a long time, Emperor Jingwen suddenly changed his expression, and when he asked someone to deliver a message to the imperial envoy, he used a different tone.
“Keep an eye on them. If any of them stand out, report to me once this matter is resolved.”
It would be difficult to get Zeng Mohuai to pledge allegiance, but his students have great potential.
Young people who are only in their teens!
If they are like this now, what will happen in the years to come?
After confirming that they had real ability, Emperor Jingwen’s heart suddenly became hot.
Meanwhile, on the other side.
Ever since his younger cousin sent a letter asking Zeng Mohuai to come out of retirement, the number of letters coming to him suddenly began to increase dramatically.
Fortunately, Wei Wen had ordered someone to leave the letter at a remote farm outside the city early in the morning. Otherwise, with pigeons flying several times a day, it would be strange if the emperor did not become suspicious.
After all, Wei Wen was a special messenger, so he naturally had the right to read these letters.
I opened one at random, and as expected, all of them were asking my little cousin how to deal with floods. There were all kinds of situations, each more tricky than the other.
After all, if it is a simple situation, a few students can handle it on their own, and there is no need to spend so much effort to come and ask.
Wei Wen was silent for a moment. He knew that time was running out, so after receiving the message, he immediately tried to find a way to send it to the palace.
About half an hour later, Ye Shuo received a thick stack of letters.
Among the eight students, the mysterious and powerful one, but in fact, Ye Shuo is only a few months away from turning eleven: “………………”
Help, help…

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Test
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Sure enough, this kind of task is not so easy to take.
But since the letters for help were already in front of him, what else could he do? Ye Shuo could only help read them one by one.
I opened one of the letters casually. After all, we were all engineers, so there was no nonsense and we got straight to the point.
It turned out that the girl named Zou Wu came to ask him how to close the dragon gate. The so-called dragon gate is the last opening left after blocking the gap, so it is called the dragon mouth.
Whether the breach control can be successful depends entirely on closing the dragon’s mouth. If it is successful, the gap can be blocked smoothly. If it is unsuccessful, the flood will continue to spread.
The girl named Zou Wu was assigned to a large tributary in the lower reaches of the Yuan River. Now the dam of the tributary is about to be destroyed. The river is nearly 50 meters wide and the water is rushing, so the gap has been blocked many times but has not been successfully blocked.
The water flow is fast and the water pressure is high. There is no crane now, so the things that can be lifted by manpower are extremely limited. The wood and stones are not heavy enough, and the objects being suppressed will soon be washed away.
The river channel is nearly fifty meters long and it is impossible to seal it. There was really no other way, so Zou Wu wrote to ask for help.
Ye Shuo quickly searched to see if there were any similar experiences. After a moment, he picked up a pen and wrote down his suggestions.Xiao Luzi, who was standing by, only knew that his master seemed to be extremely busy, and had no idea what kind of big thing he was doing.
It took Ye Shuo two full days to process this batch of letters.
Every great disaster will be followed by a great epidemic. Ye Shuo finally wrote down some modern epidemic prevention experiences, such as the fact that the water from the current Yuan River cannot be drunk, and that well water must be boiled before drinking.
After explaining all these things, Ye Shuo was already exhausted.
However, saving a life is like putting out a fire. Ye Shuo did not dare to delay at all. He immediately asked Xiao Luzi to quickly deliver the reply letter to his cousin.
Looking at the thick pile in front of him, my cousin was so shocked that he couldn’t recover for a long time.
He can actually answer them one by one…
His eldest cousin asked someone to send these letters out of Shangjing City almost overnight.
Two days later, a group of fifteen people, including Mr. Zeng Mohuai and his eldest disciple, all received reply letters.
Although Zeng Mohuai was familiar with flood control, the breach of the Yuan River this time was unusual, and even he found it difficult. Therefore, Ye Shuo’s reply could also provide him with more ideas.
However, Ye Shuo was far away in Shangjing after all, and did not see the real situation with his own eyes. He could only give answers based on their written descriptions. As for whether it should be used or not, it would ultimately depend on them.
But even these are enough.
Zeng Mohuai’s expression changed after reading the sentence in the letter: “Source rivers are prone to siltation, bursting and moving. I listened to your advice, sir. Now the north side of the source river is higher than the south side. There is a risk of bursting and changing course in the south. I hope you will carefully judge.”
Then he counted the days and found that it had indeed been nearly a hundred years since the last time the source river burst its banks.
There is a saying that the Yuan River “bursts its banks twice every three years and changes its course once every hundred years”, so the Ninth Prince’s guess is not groundless.
Although the Great Zhou lacks talents in flood control, it is not that there are no talents to be found. It’s just that there are too few people and not enough manpower.
Zeng Mohuai quickly informed the two adults who were working with him to control the flood about this matter.
The two adults were startled, and the three of them quickly led everyone around and began to carefully observe the direction of the river.
The three of them were suddenly shocked when they discovered that the river bank dozens of miles away was indeed disappearing and collapsing.
Then Zeng Mohuai made a decision that shocked everyone –
Rush to harvest and abandon the city.
Of course, the so-called abandoned city does not refer to this place, but the risky places downstream. According to Zeng Mohuai’s estimation, there are about three cities that are at extremely high risk of being affected.
If we rush to harvest in large quantities, this year’s grain output may not be optimistic.
But if we don’t rush to harvest, if the source river really changes its course or floods to the south, it will not just be a matter of reduced grain production, the foundation of the entire Great Zhou will inevitably be shaken.
The diversion of a source river has always been no trivial matter, and if the situation becomes serious, even the change of dynasties is possible.
Therefore, the decision to do it or not was soon handed over to Emperor Jingwen.
Emperor Jingwen was not an indecisive person. He would rather have a false alarm than take this gamble.
Soon, Emperor Jingwen made a decision.
He even dispatched secret guards to inform the governors of various places at full speed, asking them to harvest the crops within five days and then abandon the city if the source river was diverted.
The rest of the secret guards notified the neighboring cities and asked them to build temporary shelters as quickly as possible to accommodate these people.
The number of people in the three cities is neither too few nor too many, and if they are divided up, they can still be accommodated.
As for the ideological work of the people, it is not so easy to do.
After all, most people were not happy about being suddenly notified to move from their homes, and they didn’t understand when they were told that the source river was being diverted.
And the grain in the fields is not so easy to harvest.
If this happened in modern times, it would definitely be difficult to do, but you have to know that this is a feudal society, so it is actually easier to do.
Emperor Jingwen directly implemented a high-pressure policy and notified the three prefects that if the people did not obey, the soldiers guarding the city would be allowed to directly collect the grain. The grain would then be taken over by the local government and distributed uniformly when they arrived at the new city.
In this situation, the people will definitely not agree. If they collect the food themselves now, it will be a little less, but it is better than handing it over directly to the government, right?
Seeing that the soldiers defending the city were serious about their attack, after this happened once or twice, the rest of the people had no choice but to rush to harvest, suppressing their heartache and cutting down the crops even before they were fully ripe.
Wherever there is food, there are people.
After five days, Emperor Jingwen had successfully dispatched soldiers from other places temporarily. Then, under the “escort” of these soldiers, the people marched towards the nearby cities in batches.
Of course, there were many who refused to leave even at the cost of their lives, including ordinary people and wealthy families. There was really no way to deal with this small group of people. The secret guards killed several of them on the spot but they still showed no sign of compromise, so the local prefect had no choice but to give up.
Life and death are determined by fate. Personal choices are different and cannot be forced.
The thatched cottages and tiled houses had now become sheds that could barely keep out the wind and rain. Just as the people in the three places were filled with resentment, they suddenly heard a report from afar –
My hometown was flooded.
Overnight yesterday, the source river seemed to carry the power of destruction, and countless streams of water rushed over like an overwhelming force. In just over two hours, one of the three cities was flooded so deeply that even the city tower could not be seen.
The remaining two were not much better, with more than half of the buildings and houses gone.
Standing on a high ground, looking at the floodwaters dozens of miles away, the people in the three places were speechless for a long time. The resentment in their hearts was swept away and turned into gratitude.
They were grateful that the government issued the notice in time, and the people in areas that were not flooded were also grateful, but they were grateful that the flood did not pass through their area.
The other side.
Perhaps it was because several students and Zeng Mohuai communicated with each other too frequently, and Ye Shuo’s reply was not conspicuous among them, so it did not attract the attention of others.
After receiving Ye Shuo’s reply, Zou Wu thought for a moment and felt that this method was feasible.
The fifty-meter river channel is too wide, but it can be divided into several parts. In this way, although there are more breaches, the water flow will be smaller. Then they can be blocked one by one. Although the project is large, it is very likely to solve the current dilemma.
Zou Wu immediately conveyed her meaning as soon as she said it. However, what she did not expect was that her proposal was soon opposed by the local prefect.
The other party even felt that Zou Wu was harming people.
“Do you know that doing this may very well cause the dam to burst?”
Zou Wu was stunned, and naturally knew that the real test was coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Being a Thief
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Zou Wu was young but not stupid. It was impossible for her not to see that the people around her seemed to respect her but were actually neglecting and disdainful of her.
If it had happened before, it would have been fine. Zou Wu would have chosen to turn a blind eye when she didn’t know how to deal with it.
But now that she has found the method, and it is estimated to be feasible, Zou Wu is determined to give it a try no matter what.
The prefect on the other side continued: “It is not easy to divide the original dam pier into three parts. If so, wouldn’t all the previous efforts be in vain?”
This is the first time I heard that a gap was smashed into three, and it is also the first time I heard that the gaps became more and more blocked.
Originally we were just going to block one, but now the dam pier is divided into three, doesn’t that mean we need to block three?
Wouldn’t the prefect think that the girl in front of him was fooling around?
But in fact, ordinary wood and stone are powerless to deal with a 50-metre-wide river. Dividing it into three parts and treating each part as a whole is equivalent to dividing the water flow into three parts.
If there is only one portion, the water flow is too large to be blocked. Is it possible that one third cannot be blocked?Taking risks is inevitable, but if this continues, it is only a matter of time before the dam collapses completely.
After her thoughts were opened, Zou Wu’s mind became clearer and clearer, and she could not help but argue with the prefect.
But unfortunately, no one had ever done this before, and the prefect relied on past experience and refused to give in no matter what.
Seeing that time was dragging on, the already broken dam was becoming more and more shaky and could collapse completely at any time. Zou Wu became anxious.
Most people won’t cry until they see the coffin. They would rather deceive themselves and let it rot than eliminate the stubborn disease by self-mutilation.
Although the dam was rotten at the moment, it was still effective. What if the other two gaps were opened and it was completely ruined?
Zou Wu was finally forced to send a letter to the imperial envoy directly by carrier pigeon, bypassing the prefect.
Today’s imperial envoy is the eyes and ears of Emperor Jingwen, and like Emperor Jingwen, he is a man of swift and decisive actions. In addition, the flood is an urgent matter. After careful consideration, he is sure that it will not be able to be stopped by traditional methods, so he makes a prompt decision and decides to take a risk.
After the reply came, if I tried to stop it, I would have to bear the consequences myself. But if the imperial envoy agreed, then if there was any problem, it would be the imperial envoy who would bear the consequences myself.
After seeing the reply, the prefect knew that his official hat was saved, so he stopped making things difficult for Zou Wu.
Zou Wu gave an order, and the others began to move.
In this way, under Zou Wu’s command, the first gap was successfully blocked, and then the second, and when it came to the third, everyone’s heart was in their throat. After all, whether the flood could be successfully stopped here depended entirely on this last one.
It did take a little more effort to plug the last gap than the first two, but it was finally successful.
It actually worked!
Standing on the shore, faintly listening to the cheers of the river workers in the distance, the prefect couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
It’s amazing…
Surrounded by everyone in the centre, ignoring the unanimous voices of admiration and compliments around her, she stared blankly at the river that was no longer spreading. At this moment, the teacher whom she had never met before was like a god in Zou Wu’s eyes.
In the next two days, the weather was cloudy and rainy, and when it rained, the riverbed continued to rise.
Even though the dam had been successfully blocked, everyone couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat when they saw this scene.
If the water level rises again, it will inevitably cause a second dam breach. At that time, this method may not be effective.
Everyone, including Zou Wu, prayed madly in their hearts day and night.
Finally, on the third day, the sky cleared up, and the intermittent rainfall that had lasted for more than half a month finally came to an end.
And the flood was finally stopped here successfully by them.
Such a feat is truly shocking.
After the storm, the eight people seemed to be reborn. Their will became stronger and stronger. The childish innocence on their faces gradually disappeared, and finally a hidden determination was revealed.
Even the imperial envoy couldn’t help but sigh when seeing this scene, saying that the young are to be feared.
Thinking of the emperor’s previous instructions, the imperial envoy pondered for a moment, and finally compiled his own observations and the voices of his subordinates, and then sent them to Shangjing along with the disaster situation at full speed.
Despite the tireless work day and night, the imperial envoy’s letter was delivered to Emperor Jingwen’s desk in just a day and a half.
After seeing the three cities being flooded, now Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, I caught up in the end.
Because of advance preparations, the losses caused by this incident were not great, far from being serious. In addition, Emperor Jingwen had been in power for so many years, and the national treasury was still relatively full. It would take a period of recuperation for the country to recover.
But if you don’t prepare in advance, the outcome will be unpredictable.
But the more this happened, the more complicated Emperor Jingwen’s mood became. When he saw that the first person to bring up this matter was Zeng Mohuai, Emperor Jingwen suddenly became very conflicted.
How can’t we use such good talent for our own benefit?
The more he thought about it, the more uncomfortable he felt. Emperor Jingwen quickly looked at the next letter. However, he couldn’t help but read it. When he saw Zou Wu and the other eight, he stood up suddenly.
“God bless my Great Zhou!”
Although the flood caused a lot of losses to the imperial court, it is comforting that these young heroes emerged.
Except for Zou Wu, the performances of the others were also quite impressive, which was a blessing in disguise, so much so that Emperor Jingwen felt sincerely surprised.
Especially at this critical juncture, the envoys will arrive in a few days. The flood was successfully contained on the eve of the envoys’ arrival. Doesn’t it just prove that God does not want to destroy the Great Zhou?
“The flood receded in time. This is a sign of great prosperity, a sign of great prosperity!”
When a dynasty prospers, many heroes emerge. If I remember correctly, the oldest of these eight people was only sixteen or seventeen years old, and the youngest was only twelve or thirteen years old.
They were all young talents, the likes of which could not be produced even by an ordinary emperor during his many years in office. There were even fewer historical records about them. Zou Wu and the others happened to all be from the Great Zhou. It was hard for Emperor Jingwen not to wonder whether this was a reward from God for his diligent governance of the country over the years.
All in all, this is not a bad thing.
After so many days, His Majesty finally smiled. Prime Minister He and the others were also very happy: “Congratulations, Your Majesty! Congratulations, Your Majesty!”
“God bless the Great Zhou, long live our emperor!”
Emperor Jingwen looked at the ministers kneeling on the ground and breathed a sigh of relief. At the same time, he was thinking in his heart that although these eight people were still young, their significance was extraordinary.
Especially since the envoys from Beiting are about to arrive and the flood has just passed, the Great Zhou cannot afford to show any weakness.
Talent is also a way to demonstrate a country’s strength and prove that a country has successors.
Especially since these eight people are so young, they are even more different from ordinary people.
As he thought about this, an idea flashed through Emperor Jingwen’s mind, and then he said, “Pass on my order to summon these eight people to the capital.”
In addition to showing Zou Wu and others to Beiting, Emperor Jingwen also planned to strike first to avoid delaying for too long and letting others reap the benefits.
He Xiang and the others quickly understood what Emperor Jingwen meant. While they were amazed, they also agreed with it very much.
Zeng Mohuai’s disciples have rarely been those who play power games. As long as they are not in competition with them, the more such talents there are, the better. The more the better, and the Great Zhou will become more prosperous.
So that was settled.
When they received the news, Zou Wu and the others were in disbelief for a moment.
You have to know that three years ago, they were still orphans wandering around the border. In just over three years, they have come into the emperor’s sight.
But at the same time, they were also very clear that most of the credit for being appreciated by the emperor was due to their two teachers.
Under the guidance of Master Zeng and the deliberate selection of Wei Wen, Zou Wu and others were influenced by them and actually did not have much desire for power.
They still prefer the atmosphere of discussing academics with seniors and teachers. The sense of accomplishment when they work together and successfully verify a certain formula is incomparable to anything else.
Zeng Mohuai is devoted to research, and the students he teaches are naturally no less capable.
Therefore, Zou Wu and others were only slightly excited, and after calming down, they felt that it was nothing.
They even worried about what would happen if they could never come back. Before they came out, the formula at hand was only half proved, and the other half had not been verified yet. They didn’t know how long it would take to go back and forth.
In fact, Zeng Mohuai was reluctant to part with these eight people. They were such good assistants and much smarter than his eldest disciples.
But think about it, these people are not his real students, but are sent to him by others for foster care. Even if Zeng Mohuai is reluctant in his heart, he can’t go against the one in the capital.
Seeing that the eight people seemed somewhat reluctant, Zeng Mohuai changed their attitude instantly with just one sentence –
“The other teacher you have been talking about is now in Shangjing City.”
Zou Wu and the others opened their eyes wide almost instantly.
Doesn’t this mean that as long as they arrive in Shangjing City, they will be able to see the mysterious and powerful teacher they have always been thinking about? ?
Zou Wu and the others were immediately as if they had been injected with chicken blood, and they became excited at a speed visible to the naked eye.
However, what Zeng Mohuai did not say was that their so-called teachers were actually younger than them.
I just hope they won’t be too surprised by then…
The other side.
During these days, Ye Shuo’s one hand was almost worn out from writing. From the disaster area to here, he received an average of ten letters a day, and Ye Shuo had answered at least dozens of questions.
Now that he finally heard the news that the flood had receded, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
It’s finally over…
Finally I can take a break.
At this moment, the brain waves of the father and son strangely overlapped.
Even the strongest person could not stand such high-intensity work, so Emperor Jingwen thought about it and finally decided to give himself half a day off to come and relax with the imperial concubine.
When Emperor Jingwen arrived, Ye Shuo was just about to go out, and the father and son almost bumped into each other.
Wang Ziquan subconsciously stood in front of Emperor Jingwen. After reacting, Wang Ziquan was stunned: “Ninth Prince?”
“Your servant greets His Majesty the Ninth Prince.”
Emperor Jingwen also noticed the huge dark circles under his son’s eyes. Subconsciously, he frowned and blurted out: “How did you become like this? Did you become a thief?”
Ye Shuo was exhausted from doing homework continuously. He finally had some free time to go to the Imperial Garden for some fresh air, but he was caught red-handed and was mistaken for a thief: “…………”

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Conflict
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Emperor Jingwen had just solved such a big problem, and he felt relaxed and energetic.
Looking at Ye Shuo again, he looked like an eggplant hit by frost, very wrinkled. The images of the father and son were completely reversed. On the other hand, the Ninth Prince looked like the one who was always worried about the disaster ahead.
Similarly, Ye Shuo was also shocked when he saw his stepfather.
Didn’t my cheap father say that he had been busy for half a month? He hadn’t even returned to his own bedroom in the past half a month. He had been staying in the Qinzheng Palace, meeting ministers every day. How could he still be so energetic?
He recovered in less than half a day. Are all emperors so resistant to pressure?
Think about the eldest prince who stayed at the border for ten years, think about the crown prince who had to suppress all his younger brothers at a young age, and then look at the second prince, the fourth prince, the fifth prince, and the sixth prince… Ye Shuo suddenly felt that the people in the royal family were so resistant.
Unlike him, he was already exhausted after just a short while.
After seeing his adoptive father, Ye Shuo suddenly had a better understanding of his own abilities.
It turns out that the job of emperor is not something that a normal human being can do.On the other hand, when Emperor Jingwen saw his son’s slightly dull look, he was thinking the same thing.
Look at Zeng Mohuai’s eight students and then look at his own son. They are completely different. The gap is really obvious.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but ask, “Why haven’t you been sleeping at night lately? What have you been doing?” The Grand Tutor and Lord Cen have been too busy to take care of him recently, so he must have been having too much fun.
“…”
Ye Shuo pulled the corner of his mouth: “…Well, I really haven’t done anything.”
“Then you…oh, forget it.” Emperor Jingwen was too lazy to ask in detail, and even felt that it was pretty good to be able to do this.
At least the little bastard didn’t cause him any trouble when he was in a state of panic, nor did he add fuel to the fire, so let him have fun. Emperor Jingwen was already very satisfied.
“From the looks of you, it seems like you’re going out, right?”
“In that case, play outside for a while longer. Don’t rush back.”
Emperor Jingwen came to the imperial concubine’s place to relax. He really didn’t want to bring Ye Shuo, the little bastard, with him today. When Ye Shuo was leaving, Emperor Jingwen even threw the little princess to him.
Without the disturbance of children, Qiuwu Palace was indeed much quieter.
The imperial concubine felt sorry for him, so she did not stop him. During this rare leisure time, after Wang Ziquan and the others had left, Emperor Jingwen laid his head on the imperial concubine’s lap and gradually relaxed.
“Let’s not talk about anything else today. I have a headache. Please massage my head for me.”
The imperial concubine smiled, placed her finger on Emperor Jingwen’s temple, and said softly, “Your Majesty has worked hard these days.”
Emperor Jingwen was greatly pleased by the rare gentleness of the imperial concubine, and the atmosphere between the two of them was as sweet and tender as when they first met.
Compared to their stepfather and imperial concubine who suddenly became disgusting, Ye Shuo and Jian Jian, who were thrown out without mercy, stood at the gate of Qiuwu Palace, staring at each other.
Jianjian couldn’t help but pursed her lips: “Brother, Jianjian is sleepy.” Usually at this time, it was her time to take a nap, but obviously she couldn’t sleep today.
Ye Shuo reached out and patted her head: “Why are you so sleepy? The sun is finally out. Come on, I’ll take you to the Imperial Garden to play!”
My cheap dad is really something. He is not ashamed even at his old age.
Although he felt disgusted in his heart, Ye Shuo couldn’t wait to go to the Imperial Garden to relax and breathe some fresh air.
Seeing that her brother’s old illness had recurred, Jianjian trotted after him.
“Brother, brother…slow down…”
Sure enough, after staying with Ye Shuo for a while, Jian Jian was no longer sleepy. Instead, she was very energetic, as if she was afraid of losing him.
After holding it in for so long, Ye Shuo finally came out. His steps were naturally very cheerful, and the word “happy” was almost written on his face.
The result of such reckless behaviour is that excessive joy will lead to tragedy.
As soon as he turned a corner, Ye Shuo bumped into someone again. What happened today? Why are people walking close to the wall?
It was his cheap dad before, this time let him see who he bumped into again.
It felt like this must be a very important person, after all, Ye Shuo was knocked away in an instant, and after staggering two steps, he sat down directly on the ground.
“I’m sorry, I’m sorry.” Ye Shuo apologised repeatedly. When he looked up, he found that the person he bumped into was none other than the eldest prince.
But the eldest prince doesn’t look very happy right now.
Ye Shuo thought that the other person’s bad face was because of him. Indeed, no one would be unhappy if they were bumped into like this out of nowhere.
So Ye Shuo quickly patted his butt and stood up, and bowed with a slightly awkward look: “I’m sorry, brother, I was in a hurry just now and didn’t notice you were here.”
But in fact, the eldest prince’s anger was not directed at Ye Shuo, and he was walking faster than Ye Shuo just now, but Ye Shuo couldn’t see it from his angle.
The reason why the eldest prince was so angry was because of the unlucky second prince.
The eldest prince originally thought that after his return, the first one to get restless would be the crown prince, but he didn’t expect that the first one to jump out would be the second prince.
The Second Prince probably couldn’t stand the two of them just sitting there like turtles, so he tried every way to muddy the waters and try to fish in troubled waters.
The second prince knew that his elder brother was not the type to cooperate with others, so he had no intention of putting any effort into it. He just wanted to make the situation more chaotic.
The second prince didn’t do anything big, he just disgusted the eldest prince openly and secretly.
The eldest prince had just returned when a flood occurred. It was really unlucky, so the second prince’s people hinted in the court that it was because the evil spirit in the eldest prince was too strong and he returned before he had completely dispelled it.
People didn’t attack him directly, but kept persuading him to go to the royal temple to worship, which made the eldest prince very angry.
This second brother has been very sinister since he was young. I didn’t expect that after not seeing him for so many years, his skills have not only not diminished, but have become even better than before.
The eldest prince feels unlucky, so shouldn’t he show some of that when he walks around?
And Ye Shuo just happened to run into his trap.
According to the eldest prince, none of his younger brothers are easy to deal with, especially since he hasn’t been here for so long. The eldest prince also learned from his mother that the ninth prince has a close relationship with the crown prince and they were taught by the same teacher. Naturally, the eldest prince conceived that his ninth younger brother is the crown prince’s man.
The impression I had of him when I first met him suddenly plummeted to the bottom.
Seeing him bump into him, the eldest prince narrowed his eyes subconsciously: “I’m afraid that the ninth prince is so domineering in the palace that he has forgotten the rules of the palace.”
After all, he was the crown prince’s man, so the eldest prince had no intention of giving him any face. Besides, the eldest prince’s current status was entirely due to his military exploits, so naturally he looked down on princes like Ye Shuo who relied on acting like a spoiled child to win the favour of Emperor Jingwen.
They are nothing but a bunch of scumbags.
Wow, is the eldest prince in a bad mood today?
Ye Shuo was not a fool after all, and he reacted quickly. With the eldest prince’s skills, how could he be easily hit by him?
“I also find it strange. Why do I feel that big brother seems absent-minded today? Could it be that something happened to make big brother unhappy? Why don’t you tell me about it? I may be able to help my big brother think of a solution.”
I swear to God, Ye Shuo really just wanted to ease the atmosphere and made that joke.
After all, the eldest prince had such a bold personality, he couldn’t be angry just because the two of them bumped into each other, right?
As a result, when these words fell into the ears of the eldest prince, it was completely different.
In his eyes, his brothers were more treacherous and cunning than the others. How could he not know about such a big commotion in the court? What a joke! He was just making fun of himself.
Obviously, the eldest prince had just returned to the palace and did not have a clear understanding of Ye Shuo’s character of not worrying as long as he could.
Thus the misunderstanding was born.
“Ninth brother is good at talking.”
Ye Shuo: “???”
Wait, did he say anything?
What happened? ? Even the imperial palace, which was known for its subtle ways of speaking, wouldn’t be so exaggerated, right?
The eldest prince was thinking, the second son and the crown prince would be fine, but now this little brat wanted to step on him.
“Compared to me, your impetuous personality should go to the temple to calm down.”
as well as…
“I just don’t know if my ninth brother’s courage is as powerful as your mouth.”
The eldest prince couldn’t help but take a step forward.
Perhaps the eldest prince’s expression was too terrifying, which frightened Jianjian, who had finally caught up with him.
The eldest prince was eight feet tall and had a strong build. When he stood there, Ye Shuo looked like a skinny chick.
The eldest prince originally just wanted to scare him. After all, his father did dote on his younger brother, and he didn’t want to go too far. But in Jianjian’s eyes, it seemed that the eldest brother clenched his fists and wanted to beat her brother.
Even though Jianjian was still young, she knew that her eldest brother could kill her own brother with just one punch.
Her heart tightened, Jian Jian rushed forward with a cry, and stood in front of Ye Shuo: “Don’t you dare bully my brother!”
Although the little princess is young, she is very brave and much stronger than the queen’s legitimate son.
But the eldest prince still wanted to embarrass his younger brother who was laughing at him, so he gave him a sharp look.
The princes raised in the imperial city are just flowers that have never experienced the wind and rain. Why should the eldest prince do it himself?
The eldest prince has been fighting on the border for ten years and has scared away countless enemies with just a glance. This is certainly not something a child can endure.
Jianjian was really scared and couldn’t help but burst into tears.
Then her crying directly annoyed Ye Shuo.
Looking at the little princess crying loudly standing in front of him, Ye Shuo’s eyes changed slightly.
But Ye Shuo was not stupid. In terms of martial arts, he was definitely no match for the eldest prince. If he wanted to defeat the eldest prince, he would still have to practise for a few more years even if his grandfather taught him all his unique skills.
If the direct approach doesn’t work, then we can only use the covert approach.
“Ye Liancheng, just wait for me!”
Ye Shuo was so angry that he even called out the eldest prince’s real name.
The eldest prince was stunned. How come his younger brother wasn’t just bluffing?
The eldest prince thought that children who were spoiled like this would usually be bullies at home.
However, by the time the eldest prince reacted, Ye Shuo had already left with his sister.
However, the eldest prince did not think much about it. After all, it was just a child. Even if he was angry, could he hurt himself?
So when he saw Concubine De, he told her about the second prince, and he also told her about the episode on the way.
The eldest prince had been away from the palace for a long time. Even if someone sent him messages from time to time telling him the news in the palace, he still didn’t understand because he hadn’t experienced it personally.
But just because the eldest prince didn’t understand didn’t mean that Concubine De didn’t understand. After listening to what her eldest son said, Concubine De’s heart suddenly skipped a beat.
It’s over. This time I’ve stirred up a hornet’s nest.
The eldest prince thought about it over and over again, but he couldn’t think of any way the prince could hurt him. He couldn’t let the Duke of Zhen report him, right?
Father mustn’t listen to the words of the Duke of Zhen.
No matter how noisy he was, his father would not touch him.
Therefore, the eldest prince still didn’t care: “It’s just a child’s joke, mother, don’t take it to heart.”
The eldest prince also didn’t believe that a child of that age would dare to do anything.
Until his younger brother, the eighth prince, came back crying.
Just as the eldest prince was stunned, Concubine De’s anger suddenly rose.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Resolving Worries
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
When the eldest prince heard his younger brother say that it was the Ninth Prince who did it, his first reaction was: Really beat him up…
The eldest prince thought that he was just uttering some harsh words.
On the other side, Concubine De obviously couldn’t help herself and started to curse: “Come on, why did you provoke him? The Ninth Prince has always been a scoundrel, you know that!”
Based on Defei’s many years of experience, it was clear that the Ninth Prince was a person who would not listen. No matter how much she condemned him, it would be in vain. Defei was too lazy to waste her breath on him, so she could only choose to restrain her son who was a normal person.
What’s more, this time it was his own son who took the lead.
Who in this palace doesn’t know to stay away from the Ninth Prince? I had clearly said this when my eldest son came back, but it was all in vain. In the end, my eldest son still offended the Ninth Prince.
When Concubine De thought of the Ninth Prince’s past deeds, she was so angry that she wanted to punch her eldest son twice.
Seeing his brother’s miserable state and his mother’s furious expression, the eldest prince knew he was in the wrong and lowered his posture: “I see he is so arrogant, I think he wouldn’t dare…”
“How could he not dare?” Concubine De raised her voice: “He even dared not listen to your father’s words, how could he be afraid of you?”No matter how powerful the eldest prince is, he can’t surpass the emperor, right?
This is the first time the eldest prince has dealt with his younger brother, and he was shocked for a moment.
He started to act as soon as he said he would, without any ambiguity, which was rare even for the eldest prince in the army.
“But my son has already offended someone, what else can I do?” It’s not necessary to ask him to lose face and apologise to such a young child, right?
Upon hearing this, Concubine De couldn’t help but choke. Indeed, it was really embarrassing for the eldest brother to apologise to the ninth brother.
But if he don’t apologise, I’m afraid this matter will never end.
The eldest prince couldn’t help but look at the eighth prince beside him and said, “Why are you crying? Aren’t you ashamed?”
The Eighth Prince doesn’t want to do that either!
He was having a good time in the study room today, feeling very happy, but when school was over, he was blocked by Xiaojiu.
Xiaojiu didn’t give him any time to explain and started beating him up, while apologising to him, saying “I’m really sorry, brother. The more I think about it, the angrier I get. I really can’t swallow this anger. You know me, I can’t stand seeing others happy when I’m unhappy. If you want to blame someone, blame big brother”, and “I feel the pain from the beating. I believe big brother will soon understand how I felt at that time.”
The Eighth Prince was three years older than Ye Shuo. It was fine that he couldn’t beat his younger brother, but the reason he got beaten was because of him. He was also the one who was implicated. This was the so-called sudden disaster from heaven. How could the Eighth Prince not cry?
The Eighth Prince couldn’t help but retort: ​​”If it wasn’t for my elder brother to provoke Xiao Jiu, my younger brother wouldn’t have to suffer this beating.”
It was a painful spot, and the Eighth Prince’s eyes became more resentful as he felt the pain.
The eldest prince is now almost unable to understand his mother and brother’s thoughts.
“It was the Ninth Prince who beat you. Why don’t you blame him but blame me?”
Yes, the eldest prince admitted that he was also wrong in this matter, but it was too unreasonable for the ninth prince to do this.
Looking at his mother and younger brother, it seemed that neither of them was targeting the Ninth Prince.
What the eldest prince didn’t know was that over the years, Concubine De and the eighth prince had already become accustomed to Ye Shuo’s style of doing things. It’s like when you know someone has problems but you still go and poke him, don’t you deserve to be bitten?
Between a psychopath and a normal person, the normal person will naturally be more likely to condemn him.
The eldest prince’s mistake was that it was too normal.
Unexpectedly, the Ninth Prince would use such a trick on him. The eldest prince was a little annoyed now: “You too, you don’t pay more attention to martial arts and archery on weekdays.”
The fourteen-year-old, who was about to leave the palace to build his own residence, was beaten by an eleven-year-old who hadn’t even fully grown his hair. The eldest prince felt a little embarrassed.
“What’s the point of you saying this now?” Besides, it’s enough that the youngest son is good at studying. It’s normal that he can’t compare with the ninth prince who runs around every day.
Concubine De couldn’t help but glared at her eldest son: “Think about what to do!”
The eldest prince frowned slightly and said, “What can I do? The Ninth Prince has already beaten him, so it’s time for him to calm down.”
As soon as the words fell, the atmosphere instantly became solemn.
Concubine De: “I’m afraid it’s not as simple as you think.”
The Eighth Prince: “Brother, you think Xiaojiu is too easy to fool.”
The eldest prince: “…”
The eldest prince held his breath and said, “Why? Do you really want me to apologise to him?”
Ye Shuo has a stubborn temper, and the eldest prince is even more stubborn than him.
“Just go out there and do what you need to do as usual. I don’t believe he would dare to do anything to you!”
Hearing this, the current Eighth Prince was even more horrified: “Brother, don’t say it, he really dares.”
The most important thing is that this matter has nothing to do with me. Isn’t it too unfair for me to suffer this unexpected disaster?
The eldest prince couldn’t help but slap the table and said, “Why, in such a huge palace, no one can control him, right? He is simply lawless!”
No, they are just angry with each other, what does it have to do with me?
You have to know that it was him who got beaten, not his elder brother.
The eighth prince had a bitter face. Seeing that the eldest prince was angry, he really didn’t dare to persuade him any more.
Of course, the eldest prince is the eighth prince’s elder brother after all. Although he is angry, he would not really sacrifice his younger brother.
And so, the eldest prince returned home with a lot of anger.
The eldest prince sat down on the chair, and he also became angrier the more he thought about it. If he really wanted to fight with a child, he didn’t have the face to do so. But if he just let it go, he really couldn’t swallow this anger.
At this time, several sons of the eldest prince came over. After hearing what happened, they patted their chests and said, “Father, don’t worry. Just leave this matter to your sons.”
“As long as my son is here, my Eighth Uncle will be safe.”
The eldest prince left the capital soon after his marriage. The eldest prince’s wife and two concubines took the trouble to follow the eldest prince to the border, so the eldest prince’s children were basically born at the border.
The eldest prince is seventeen years older than Ye Shuo. He has several sons who are about the same age as Ye Shuo, some are eight, nine, and ten years old, all younger than Ye Shuo. Besides, the Ninth Prince is still their uncle. Even if the Ninth Prince is unruly, he would not fight with his own nephews, right?
If Ye Xun knew what his uncle was thinking at this time, he would definitely give a heartfelt advice, don’t disbelieve it, the Ninth Prince is really brave.
Children’s problems should be solved using children’s methods.
No one can find fault with it.
Compared to their “weak” Eighth Uncle, these sons of theirs who grew up at the border have not fallen behind in martial arts.
Almost instantly, the eldest prince’s brows relaxed, and he thought he had found a way to restrain his ninth brother, so he agreed to their request.
Seeing that they finally had the chance to share their father’s worries, Ye Yan and the other three were naturally extremely excited. They were ready to go, just waiting for tomorrow to come.
The other side.
After shedding two crocodile tears for the innocent Eighth Prince, Ye Shuo finally felt a little better.
On the other hand, the pointed little princess at the side had stopped crying and was now trying to persuade him: “Brother, brother, the eighth brother is innocent…”
When Jianjian saw his own brother blocking the eighth prince there and then beating him up without saying a word, she was so shocked that she even forgot to cry.
“Obviously… it has nothing to do with my eighth brother…”
This is the truth, but…
Ye Shuo touched his chin and said innocently: “But brother doesn’t care about that. Brother has no morals. It’s okay as long as I can vent my anger.”
He is the only one who can talk about being a scoundrel so confidently.
Jianjian’s young mind was greatly shocked at this moment.
Ye Shuo had no intention of repenting. Seeing that it was already evening and it was almost time for dinner, he decided to take his sister back to Qiuwu Palace: “Let’s go, we should go home for dinner.”
When they arrived at the gate of Qiuwu Palace, Ye Shuo suddenly thought of something and could not help but whisper to Jian Jian: “By the way, you must not tell father what happened today.”
You see, Ye Shuo clearly knew in his heart whether what he was doing was right or not.
I believe that the eldest prince and the eighth prince would be too embarrassed to publicise it. As long as both sides don’t say anything, no one will know. Don’t be too perfect.
Anyway, he is not the one who suffers.
After forcing Jianjian to nod with difficulty, Ye Shuo swaggered into Qiuwu Palace.
I don’t know if it’s an illusion, but Emperor Jingwen always feels that the palace is too quiet today.
Especially since the son took the daughter out to play for most of the day, nothing happened.
While eating, Emperor Jingwen asked casually: “Where did you go this afternoon? Did anything happen?”
Jianjian is still an honest child and has not learned to lie yet. Subconsciously, she lowered her head and grabbed the food on the plate, like a student who was afraid of being called by the teacher.
Looking at Ye Shuo again, he was an old hand after all, and he answered with ease: “I first strolled around the garden, and on the way I met my elder brother, and chatted with him for a while. At 3 p.m., I met my elder brother, who was very enthusiastic. My son couldn’t bear to disappoint him, so he had a cordial and friendly exchange with him.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Those words were all good, why do they sound so awkward?
After leaving Qiuwu Palace, Emperor Jingwen thought about it and still felt that being too quiet was not in line with the character of the little bastard. Halfway through the journey, Emperor Jingwen finally called Wang Ziquan over and said, “Go and ask if anything happened this afternoon.”
At first, Wang Ziquan wondered if the emperor was being too cautious with the Ninth Prince. After finding out what had happened, Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but sigh that the emperor was indeed foresighted.
Then Emperor Jingwen found out that the eldest prince scared Jian Jian and made her cry, and then Ye Shuo blocked the eighth prince on his way home from school and beat him up.
So this is what is meant by cordial and friendly communication.
The eldest prince suffered such a great loss, no wonder the little bastard didn’t complain to him.
Emperor Jingwen regretted it and felt that he should not have asked about it.
He even dared to offend his elder brother, he is really something.
But this is just a small matter, and it’s not necessary to summon the boss to the palace and scold him in the middle of the night. Forget it, let’s talk about it tomorrow.
As for the Crown Prince and the Second Prince, they felt the same way.
I thought I would be the first to confront the eldest prince, but I didn’t expect Xiaojiu to be much more agile than them.
The most important thing is that this child is really brave.
Upon hearing the news, the Crown Prince and the Grand Tutor, who were discussing something, suddenly fell silent.
“This Xiaojiu…” The prince had a terrible headache.
While the Grand Tutor was gritting his teeth, he was already prepared in his heart to report to the Crown Prince.
The night passed in a flash, and he didn’t care what others were thinking. The next morning, before dawn, when Ye Shuo was still sleeping soundly, Ye Yan and others had already come to the palace under the pretext of visiting his grandmother.
The four of them were ready to go, determined to perform well and help their father solve his problems.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Threat
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Although Ye Yan and his brothers are young, they are very strong.
The four children, each stronger than the other, stood guard at the door of the upper study room like an iron tower. When Ye Xun saw them, he subconsciously asked the eunuch beside him to pass the message to the Ninth Uncle.
Obviously Ye Xun also heard about what happened yesterday.
Although Ye Xun didn’t quite understand how the Great Uncle could compete with the Ninth Uncle, as there was obviously such a huge gap between the two, but when he thought about the Ninth Uncle’s ability to get into trouble, Ye Xun suddenly didn’t find it strange anymore.
As the Ninth Prince, it’s not surprising that he would have conflicts with anyone.
The other side.
At the hour of Chen, Ye Shuo slowly woke up from his sleep, washed up and finished his meal, and then at the urging of Princess Jianjian, Ye Shuo reluctantly prepared to go find Lord Cen.
Well, the Grand Tutor has been worrying a lot about flood control lately, and his body is a little exhausted. He needs to take a break before he can continue to endure teaching the Ninth Prince.
As it happened that it was soon to be Lord Cen’s turn, Lord Cen simply asked the Ninth Prince to report to him two days in advance.These two people who had been fighting for most of their lives actually began to sympathise with each other because of Ye Shuo.
Now, the ones who are most afraid of something happening to each other are the Grand Tutor and Lord Cen, because if one of them falls ill, the Ninth Prince’s studies will be completely placed on the shoulders of the other person.
Therefore, when the two meet now, they are no longer sarcastic to each other, but are caring about each other and worrying about each other’s health every day.
The Ninth Prince will graduate in four years. If he persists a little longer, he will be free in four more years.
In this case, Lord Cen will naturally take better care of the grand tutor.
While teaching the Ninth Prince, other princes also cannot slack off on their studies. In this case, Ye Shuo will definitely have to run to the upper study.
For fear of affecting the mentality of other princes, Ye Shuo usually stayed in Lord Cen’s tea room.
Xing Yucheng never thought that the Ninth Prince would get into such trouble just because he hadn’t been here for a short time due to the holiday.
The eldest prince has now returned to the court and is in the limelight. How can the ninth prince go against him directly?
Xing Yucheng suddenly felt that his decision to take part in this year’s imperial examination was so wise.
Ye Shuo was furious when he heard the news.
“What? You’re going to take the imperial examination? Why don’t you wait until I go to court and then I’ll arrange a position for you? Don’t you trust me?”
Xing Yucheng choked, and that weird expression almost made him say “Can I trust you?”
If I rely on the arrangements made by the Ninth Prince, I guess I will have no future in this life.
Xing Yucheng will be seventeen this year, and he is still neither high nor low. It is impossible for him not to be anxious.
But in order to take care of the Ninth Prince’s self-esteem, Xing Yucheng naturally could not say it clearly. He just said: “In reply to Your Highness, I have studied for so many years, and I also want to see how good my level is.”
It is said that his mother has good taste. The study partner she chose is so motivated. Ye Shuo almost forgot that when he was young, his mother wanted to give him the best of everything.
My own affairs don’t seem to be very important.
Xing Yucheng reacted and said, “Ninth Prince, why don’t you tell us about yourself…”
Xing Yucheng has been with Ye Shuo for so many years, so he said directly if he had anything to say: “Forgive my frankness, but it is really inappropriate for you to conflict with the eldest prince right now.”
“What’s appropriate or inappropriate about this?” Apart from the fact that Jianjian crying made him very angry, Ye Shuo didn’t take this matter as a big deal at all.
Now that his revenge has been taken, doesn’t Ye Shuo feel relieved?
To be honest, even though these brothers are not easy to deal with, they are not so intolerant that they cannot tolerate others.
Of course, the main reason is that it is not cost-effective to make enemies through small fights. As long as their core interests are not really touched, generally there will be no problems.
To put it bluntly, as long as it does not involve party disputes, the rest are just matters between brothers.
It is true that Ye Shuo’s goal is to live, but he also wants to live freely and happily. If he has to endure and give in to such a small thing, then what’s the point of living?
It would be better to kill himself than to let him try to please these brothers.
“Don’t worry, nothing will happen. Maybe my eldest brother has already forgotten about it.” Ye Shuo vowed.
result……
Before Ye Shuo took a few steps, he was stopped by the young eunuch beside his nephew.
Then Ye Shuo learned that the Eighth Prince had four more bodyguards.
…This is what the Ninth Prince said, nothing will happen.
The Ninth Prince is indeed unreliable.
Xing Yucheng twitched his lips, feeling that it was as he expected. Just as Xing Yucheng was thinking about how to ease the situation, Ye Shuo suddenly became interested.
Big brother is on guard against himself!
The eldest prince is only two years older than the crown prince. When Ye Shuo was in the palace before, he had never seen the eldest prince’s children, let alone heard of them. This means that the eldest prince’s eldest children were all born at the border.
If you calculate it this way, the oldest one is only ten years old, a little younger than me.
Ye Shuo understood that the eldest prince was planning to “bully the strong with the weak”.
Did he think that as an uncle, he wouldn’t do anything?
“Brother, brother…” Jianjian couldn’t help but tug at his brother’s clothes after hearing this.
The next moment, the Ninth Prince made the decision, “Let’s go, I’ll take you to meet these nephews!”
Seeing the Ninth Prince so excited, Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but feel dizzy.
Finished.
Xing Yucheng looked very familiar with this performance.
But there was no way. Xing Yucheng and the others couldn’t stop him at all. Even the little princess, who had the highest status and the most influence, tried her best to stop him, but still couldn’t stop Ye Shuo.
The little princess almost hugged his thigh.
The little princess was about to cry.
Just like that, under the desperate gaze of Xing Yucheng and Xiao Luzi, Ye Shuo came to the upper study.
It was after school hours and the second class in the upper study was about to end. Since the Sixth Prince left, the Seventh Prince also left the palace to build his own residence. Now the only people in the upper study that Ye Shuo was familiar with were the Eighth Prince and the little grandson Ye Xun.
Ye Shuo was not very familiar with the rest, like the tenth prince, the eleventh prince, the twelfth prince, and even the queen’s sons.
Normally at this time, Ye Shuo would usually walk around and then go to the tea room for fear of hurting their young hearts, but today, because the eldest prince’s sons were there, Ye Shuo just swaggered over.
When he saw his figure, Ye Xun’s eyes widened.
Wait, didn’t he send someone to inform the Ninth Prince? Why did the Ninth Prince come anyway?
Didn’t receive it, or…
Ye Xun was not stupid. Seeing the bitter look on the face of the eunuch behind Ye Shuo, he quickly realised that his actions might have had the opposite effect.
Ye Xun could not help but take a breath.
From a distance, Ye Shuo saw Ye Yan and the other three who were as strong as calves. Looking at their facial features similar to those of the eldest prince, he immediately realised that these were his other good nephews.
Not bad, not bad. This physique looks very healthy.
It just so happened that Jianjian was about to start practising martial arts, and he was in need of a few sparring partners. These four men were obviously martial artists, and they were worthy of being the sons of the cheap eldest brother, and they looked to be quite tough.
Ye Shuo was afraid that if he practised for an ordinary person, it would not produce any effect. These four nephews came at the right time.
For some reason, Ye Yan suddenly felt a chill on his back when being stared at by the Ninth Prince.
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo’s eyes were too explicit, the other party’s eyes kept scanning him as if he was selecting goods. Ye Yan couldn’t hold it back any longer, and said, “We brothers are here today, we won’t let you bully your eighth uncle!”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at the Eighth Prince standing beside him.
Seeing this, the Eighth Prince waved his hands repeatedly: “Xiaojiu, you know this is not my idea.”
Ye Yan was stunned. Eighth Uncle, this was their real uncle, their father’s brother, how could he surrender so quickly?
The Eighth Prince didn’t want to do this, but he felt this was the best way.
However, the four nephews were kind-hearted after all, and the Eighth Prince could not bear to see them being entangled by Xiao Jiu, so he hurriedly said, “Don’t talk nonsense!”
Then the Eighth Prince turned his head again and said sincerely: “Xiao Jiu, since they are still young and can’t stand the tossing, please let them go.”
“I want to, too, but look at them yourself, they themselves are unhappy about it.”
Ye Shuo blinked, then imitated the eldest prince yesterday and took a step forward.
Ye Yan thought he was going to attack, and the kids panicked and immediately surrounded Ye Shuo.
Of course, Ye Yan and the other three knew what was right and wrong. They knew that Ye Shuo was their uncle and did not dare to really take action. So they thought of using their bodies to stop him outside.
Just as Ye Yan and the others thought, Ye Shuo was indeed embarrassed to fight with his nephew.
But there are always more effective solutions than taking action.
When the Eighth Prince fell into Ye Shuo’s hands again, he suddenly had an urge to vomit blood.
Perhaps what my elder brother said was right. I should indeed strengthen my practice in martial arts and horse riding and archery.
Otherwise, no matter how good his temper is, he won’t be able to bear being treated as a hostage all the time.
Ye Shuo cleared his throat, then his face became serious: “Everyone stand still, if anyone dares to disobey, don’t blame me for being rude.”
Ye Shuo just didn’t believe that they could watch their own uncle get beaten.
Before Ye Yan and the others could react, they watched Uncle Eight being arrested. Then they heard these words and for a moment they didn’t know how to react.
The youngest of the four was the smartest. When he saw Ye Shuo holding the eighth prince hostage, he followed suit and rushed forward, also holding hostage the little princess who was still overwhelmed by what was happening before her.
Ye Shuo was startled at first, but then he thought of something and felt relieved.
In war, the key is to capture the leader first. As long as the key person is in your hands, you have the bargaining power.
As if he saw what the other person was thinking, Ye Shuo almost laughed out loud.
“By the way, have you forgotten something?”
“cough……”
“Well, I dare to hit my brother, do you dare to hit your aunt?”
Even though Jianjian is young, she is still the aunt of several people.
Jianjian finally reacted and pursed her lips. A layer of mist quickly filled her eyes and tears kept rolling in her eye sockets, as if she was about to cry in the next second.
When Ye Yan saw this, he was immediately dumbfounded.
“Now because of your disobedience, I have decided to let your Eighth Uncle take the blame for you.” Ye Shuo’s eyes turned cold, and then he punched the Eighth Prince in the stomach without hesitation.
What does this have to do with me!?
The Eighth Prince was about to curse, but then he realised that it didn’t seem to hurt.
The Eighth Prince turned his head subconsciously and met Ye Shuo’s eyes.
“Real fight or fake fight, you choose one.”
The Eighth Prince: “…”
What choice does he have?!
The Eighth Prince is indeed a smart man. After he understood what he meant, his expression immediately twisted, and then he covered his stomach and cried out “ouch ouch ouch”.
“Let me make it clear first, you can’t tell this to your elder brother.”
If my eldest brother knew that I sold my nephews out of fear of physical pain, je would break his legs.
Ye Shuo patted his chest, meaning that you can trust me to do the job.
The eighth prince weighed the issue for a long time, and finally “reluctantly” sold out his nephews.
It was the eldest brother who originally caused the trouble. It is only natural that the son should pay for the father’s debts. He had already taken a beating for his eldest brother before, so he couldn’t just be the only one to be beaten, right?
Seeing this scene, Ye Yan and the others dared not resist at all.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but reveal a mysterious smile.
The other side.
After the morning court session ended, Emperor Jingwen seemed to be hesitant to speak, and finally called the eldest son alone, and briefly mentioned what happened yesterday afternoon.
The eldest prince was stunned, and then seemed a little unbelievable.
My father actually cares so much about his ninth younger brother!
“It’s not what you think.” Emperor Jingwen was such a smart man that he immediately realised that his eldest son had misunderstood.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but sigh: “I’m just afraid that you will be entangled by Xiaojiu.”
Emperor Jingwen knew how powerful his son was. If he was targeted by him, there would be no escape.
“You still have time to say a few soft words now.”
Emperor Jingwen made this suggestion with good intentions.
However, no matter how wonderful Emperor Jingwen’s words were, they were all biased in the eyes of the eldest prince.
He used to favour the crown prince, and now the ninth prince. How could my father do this?
Just when the eldest prince’s heart was surging with grief and indignation, and he could not control his emotions for a moment, Wang Ziquan suddenly came over from outside. As he walked, Wang Ziquan shouted, “Your Majesty, eldest prince, it’s bad, the ninth prince and the emperor’s grandson, they–“
For a moment, Wang Ziquan really couldn’t find the right words to describe the scene.
However, Emperor Jingwen and the eldest prince misunderstood.
The eldest prince: “Yan’er and the others beat up the ninth prince?”
Emperor Jingwen: “Shuo’er used his tricks again?”
Oops, things seem to be more serious than I thought.
“Hurry, hurry up!” After all, those are the royal blood!
Before Wang Ziquan could finish his words, the two fathers had already hurried to the scene of the incident.
When Emperor Jingwen and the eldest prince arrived, they saw Ye Shuo supervising several imperial grandchildren jogging with great interest.
It would be fine if I lost in a one-on-one fight, but the key is that I haven’t even started to fight yet and I have to listen to him in everything. If I don’t listen, he will beat my own uncle.
The more they thought about it, the more aggrieved they felt. Ye Yan and the others couldn’t stop crying, and their tears kept pouring out.
Emperor Jingwen was silent for a moment, then couldn’t help but look at his eldest son.
Tell me why you provoked him. Now look what happened, several of your sons have been lost.
As for the eldest prince, he was obviously unable to react when he saw his sons running and wiping their tears.
“Ninth brother, please don’t go too far!” Perhaps because he was too angry, the eldest prince lost his composure.
Seeing his cheap elder brother pulling the Eighth Prince aside and then standing in front of him, Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, then he was a little bit unbelievable: “Brother, are you threatening me?”
The eldest prince did not say anything. He just stared at him with a fierce look. The throbbing veins on the back of his hands showed that he was not at peace.
“It’s indeed a threat.” Ye Shuo understood.
“Just wait for me!”
The eldest prince felt that these words sounded particularly familiar, but before he could react, he saw Ye Shuo suddenly running in front of Emperor Jingwen.
Just when the eldest prince thought that the ninth prince was going to exaggerate and make the first move to complain, he heard him say this –
“Father, it has been a month since my nephews came back. It was fine before because of the flood, but now that the flood has stopped, shouldn’t my nephews go to the upper study to study?”
“No matter what happens, we can’t delay our children’s studies.”
When they go to the upper study and stay in the palace every day, won’t they be at his mercy?
Ye Shuo thought so in his heart, and his face showed that he was very worried about his nephew’s future, as if he cared more about him than the eldest prince, his biological father.
How could the eldest prince not understand his plan? As soon as he finished speaking, his expression froze.
If the emperor nodded, wouldn’t that mean… from one hostage at the beginning, it suddenly became five? ? ?
The eldest prince’s heart suddenly stagnated.

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Arrival
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo never mentioned any conflict and only talked about the studies of his four older nephews.
Emperor Jingwen was helpless. He looked at his eldest son beside him and asked him what to say in the current situation.
The little bastard was very cunning and hit the nail on the head. No matter how angry he was, the little princes still had to study, right?
Unless the eldest prince could find a better teacher, Master Cen in the upper study was destined to be the fate of the little princes.
But it was obvious that there were not many teachers or great scholars in the entire Great Zhou who were better than Lord Cen and his companions, so Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to agree to Ye Shuo’s reasonable request.
Now even the eldest prince could not say that his father was partial.
And the eldest prince finally understood why his mother and father reacted that way after they heard about the conflict between him and his ninth younger brother.
Once this child sticks to you, it’s hard to get rid of him easily.
In fact, Ye Shuo’s idea is very simple. If he can’t deal with his cheap elder brother, how can he not deal with his cheap elder brother’s younger brother and son?I have seen many shameless people, but I have never seen someone so shameless and scoundrel.
Other brothers, like the crown prince and the second prince, at least have some dignity, but this one is different. He has no dignity at all.
The current situation is that he {YS} can’t deal with him {YL}, but no one else around him {YL} can deal with him {YS}.
Holding your breath, it’s really too suffocating!
The eldest prince also understood why his sons, who had always been strong, were wiping tears while running.
The eldest prince was trying to suppress him with his momentum, but as soon as he looked over, Ye Shuo glared back at him, unwilling to be outdone. He looked even more ferocious than him.
The eldest prince: “…”
The eldest brother is really something. He is so old but still behaves like a child. Emperor Jingwen next to him frowned, completely forgetting that he had just argued with his son in the same way a few years ago.
While the two men were exchanging glances, Ye Yan and the other three could no longer sit still and surrounded them, panting.
“Father, I don’t want to come to the study.”
“Grandpa Emperor, I don’t want to…”
“Father…”
The four children shouted in unison. They were not stupid. If the Ninth Prince threatened them with the Eighth Prince every day, wouldn’t they have to listen to the Ninth Prince every day?
Obviously, Ye Yan and the others knew that the Eighth Prince was their uncle, and they couldn’t just sit back and watch.
So once you enter the palace, you’re doomed.
However, before Emperor Jingwen could even say anything, the eldest prince shouted, “Shut up!”
“Starting tomorrow, all of you, come here and study!”
There is no other way. It is not enough to just know kung fu. You must also read books.
The eldest prince, whose lifeline of education was strangled, turned pale.
They didn’t expect their father to suddenly get angry, and Ye Yan and his four brothers were dumbfounded.
As for Ye Shuo standing aside, he made a victory gesture.
So what’s the point of fighting for that position? Because of this, you will be controlled by others in every way and you won’t be able to speak or do things with confidence.
Seeing the little bastard openly provoking his eldest son, Emperor Jingwen felt a terrible headache. Emperor Jingwen really wanted to ask him how confident he was to feel that he could withstand a punch from his eldest brother.
After the eldest prince finished scolding his son, he almost gritted his teeth and said, “Well done, Ninth Brother.”
The eldest prince didn’t know what was wrong. He couldn’t control his temper when he saw his younger brother.
Oh my god, he’s coming again? The cheap elder brother is indeed extraordinary. People who have led soldiers are more stubborn than others.
Ye Shuo stretched out a finger and said, “Once.”
The eldest prince narrowed his eyes: “What do you mean?”
“You’ve threatened me again.” Ye Shuo said seriously, “That’s three times in total. Don’t blame me for randomly picking one of your sons.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
The eldest prince: “…”
“Asshole, you—”
Ye Shuo didn’t even blink, and decisively raised another finger: “Twice.”
The eldest prince was so angry when he realised what was going on.
It’s already this time, the little bastard should stop adding fuel to the fire, okay?
Emperor Jingwen didn’t dare to let the two of them stay together anymore. If his eldest son really didn’t care and hung up on the little bastard and beat him up, he might not be able to stop him.
“Someone! Send the Ninth Prince back to Qiuwu Palace!”
At Emperor Jingwen’s order, Ye Shuo was almost dragged away by the guards. Before leaving, he glared at several of his nephews.
“My dear nephew, see you tomorrow.”
Ye Yan and the others couldn’t control themselves and shivered.
“Well, calm down too.” After a while, facing the mess left by his youngest son, Emperor Jingwen had to clean up the mess for him. Fortunately, Emperor Jingwen had done a lot of this over the years and had long been accustomed to it.
“Your brother is still young, don’t bother with him.”
The eldest prince curled his lips, but what he was thinking in his heart was that although his younger brother was young, he seemed more annoying than the crown prince.
But since Emperor Jingwen has spoken, the eldest prince certainly cannot go against him.
The eldest prince finally regained his senses and lowered his head: “Father is right, it was I who was reckless and started a quarrel with my ninth brother.”
“…There’s no need to say that.” Emperor Jingwen paused strangely, obviously knowing the little bastard’s ability to irritate people.
“Xiaojiu is also wrong in this matter.”
The eldest prince was stunned. In the past, his father doted on the prince, but he never said such words…
The eldest prince felt a little comforted and was not so angry anymore.
As he walked along the road, Emperor Jingwen could not help but slowly recount his experiences over the years: “Your ninth brother broke my pair of jade unicorns when he was born. When he was one or two years old, he teased me. When he was three, four, five years old…”
The more Emperor Jingwen talked, the more silent the eldest prince beside him became. He suddenly began to wonder how his father had survived all these years.
It’s infuriating enough if it happens once or twice, but if it happens every day every year, no one can stand it.
If this was his own son, the eldest prince would definitely beat him three times a day until he became obedient.
As if he had read his mind, Emperor Jingwen sighed, “I have beaten and scolded him, but your ninth brother is just a piece of tough meat. I really have no choice.”
“Fortunately, he is not a bad person by nature, and I have no intention of entrusting him with important tasks, so I indulge him a little.”
What are the other sons? They are the future pillars of the Great Zhou.
As for the little bastard, Emperor Jingwen will be thankful if he doesn’t commit crimes and bring harm to the people in the future.
A thousand words could not outweigh the words of Emperor Jingwen. Although the eldest prince had some guesses in his heart, he was still surprised when he heard Emperor Jingwen admit it himself.
A prince who is not valued by his father is useless.
Even if we are glorious and glorious at this moment, we are ultimately just a rootless duckweed, a flash in the pan.
Why should I bother with such a brother?
