As long as the Great Zhou cannot stand up in its bones and people are filled with fear, no matter how sharp the weapons are, they will become weak.
Thinking of this, Huyan Jue felt a little relieved.
The other side.
Huyan Jue’s reaction just now really pleased Ye Shuo, and Ye Shuo’s good mood immediately showed on his face.
Especially after kneeling for a long time, people would inevitably feel tired. Ye Shuo himself was not a very particular person, so he inevitably relaxed a little.
However, when Emperor Jingwen saw this scene, he felt something was wrong.
Seeing his son holding his chin with one hand, the corner of his lips slightly raised, and the index finger of the other hand circling the edge of the teacup, coupled with that immature but already handsome face, he looked at the dancer in the middle of the field without blinking, and when he was excited, his index finger moved little by little, as if following the beat. This…isn’t this the image of a playboy?
Thinking of his own Zhou-Zhua Ceremony, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but frown.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Conflict
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
He is already like this at such a young age, what will he be like when he grows up?
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel worried on such an important occasion.
At first, the queen thought that Emperor Jingwen had taken a fancy to one of the dancers, but it turned out not to be the case.
Following Emperor Jingwen’s line of sight, the Queen only saw the Ninth Prince.
…Damn it, why is it the Ninth Prince again!
The Queen couldn’t help but say, “The Ninth Prince is interested.”
First he quarreled with the envoy, and now he seems obsessed with singing and dancing. Isn’t he interested?
The queen couldn’t understand why the emperor liked such a superficial son.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen just hummed and didn’t even look away, his perfunctory attitude no longer so obvious.The queen suddenly became extremely embarrassed.
After the dance, Ye Shuo looked away with a lingering look.
He was told that the ancient songs and dances were truly unique. Modern dance was unrestrained, while ancient dance was implicit, combining strength and tenderness. They each had their own merits. Moreover, this was a state banquet, so one could imagine how high the level was.
Another thing is that my cheap dad does have a high level of aesthetic taste. Even if the dancers’ looks don’t conform to current trends, they are still beautiful.
And beautiful things always make people stop and look.
Ye Shuo was enjoying the feast for his eyes, but when he turned around, he saw that his stepfather looked weird.
Well, he must have been pissed off by the envoy.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo left Luanqing Palace and returned to Qiuwu Palace, where he fell asleep without any psychological burden.
Soon Emperor Jingwen was forced to give up thinking about this matter. After all, his son was still young, and the matter of sending envoys was imminent.
Emperor Jingwen thought that once the Shenbi crossbow was unveiled, the envoy from Beiting would have some thoughts in mind, which would save him and his ministers from having to worry about it.
This was indeed the case at the beginning. Huyan Jue was indeed very afraid and he did not make any more provocative remarks during the meal. He did not even eat a few bites of the food in front of him.
But after returning to the inn, Huyan Jue thought more and more that this was not the case.
Hu Yanjue is now in his forties, the same age as Emperor Jingwen. He came to the Great Zhou when he was young, when the previous emperor was still in power. The attitude of the people in the Great Zhou at that time left a very deep impression on Hu Yanjue.
Soft, especially soft. At that time, the Great Zhou was extremely weak from top to bottom.
Even if they won the battle, it was the same. They had to marry princesses, pay indemnities, and cede land. Huyan Jue still remembered that they had no food in Beiting at that time, so they marched south to massacre seven cities of Da Zhou. At that time, Da Zhou’s first reaction was not anger or hatred, but weakness and fear.
The soldiers of Beiting are tall and mighty. One of them is almost as good as two of Da Zhou. Every man in Beiting is brave and cruel by nature. How could Da Zhou possibly win under such circumstances?
Therefore, the late emperor was already three points weaker before he even started the battle.
In the eyes of the late emperor, the lives of the people were not as important as his own safety. As long as he could keep things peaceful, it didn’t matter even if he had to sacrifice some things.
And the most shameful thing back then was not this, what was the order to allow Beiting to bring swords into the palace? The late emperor even asked his own daughter, a princess, to dance in public when the envoys came, in order to please the brutal Beiting people.
The princess did not return home that night, and committed suicide after returning from the inn the next day.
As to whether she really committed suicide or was forced to do so, no one knows now.
Because the princess died in an inglorious way, the late emperor directly removed her name from the imperial genealogy. Until now, the princess doesn’t even have a name.
At that time, Huyan Jue was still young, even less than 20 years old. He experienced all of this personally and was extremely shocked at the time.
It turns out that a country can be so weak.
Later, the Duke of Zhen rose to power and took back the seven cities, and Beiting gradually became less presumptuous.
But once an impression is left, it is difficult to erase. No wonder that after so many years, when Beiting was short of food again, the first thing that came to mind was the Great Zhou.
Emperor Jingwen was only the crown prince at that time. Unlike the crown prince today, his situation was much more difficult than that of his son.
The late emperor preferred the sons of his favorite concubines and did not like Emperor Jingwen. However, because Emperor Jingwen had been designated as the crown prince since the day he was born and because of opposition from court officials, the late emperor did not touch him.
One can imagine what kind of life Emperor Jingwen, who was less than twenty years old, led. He was not much better than the princess. He was just a toy that was manipulated at will.
Therefore, even though Emperor Jingwen has a tough attitude now, Huyan Jue is still thinking about the Crown Prince who was forced to drink at the banquet and could not resist, and had to force a smile and could not show it even when he was drunk.
Huyan Jue was still young at the time and was at the end of the team. In addition, he was not very conspicuous, so Emperor Jingwen did not recognize him this time.
Huyan Jue knew his limits and didn’t dare to mention this matter.
After all, other things he did were just tests at most. If he dared to expose the shortcomings of the current emperor in public and point out the most unspeakable pain of the emperor, then the fight would not stop until his death.
Huyan Jue came here with a mission, not to seek death.
For the above reasons, Huyan Jue still did not believe that the Great Zhou would really dare to take action.
“It’s just bluffing.” Huyan Jue made this judgement after calming down.
How strong can a country be if it has no backbone?
Soon, Huyan Jue’s fear of the magic arm crossbow gradually dissipated. As long as Da Zhou did not really take action, he would not be able to restrain his contempt for him.
“There are still six days left. Let’s wait and see.”
The incident of the envoy from Beiting was a secret in the palace, and Ye Shuo had no idea about it. He even thought that he had already displayed his weapons and everything was stable. But…
When Xing Yucheng came on the fourth day, he was so full of complaints that he couldn’t control himself at all.
It must be no small matter to make this person so angry, so Ye Shuo subconsciously asked a few questions.
You won’t know the result until you ask. Once you ask, Ye Shuo almost gets angry to death.
“What? Those people haven’t stopped yet?”
“Not only has it not stopped, it has simply intensified. At first, they were just picking on people in the post house, but later on, they started to harass the people. Taking people’s things without paying has become the norm.”
During the exam preparation period, Xing Yucheng came out one day, thinking of joining in the fun, but he ended up seeing such a scene, and he almost got pissed off to death.
“…They didn’t get beaten even after this?” Ye Shuo looked incredulous when he heard this.
No way, no way, this is the Great Zhou, our own territory, how can we be bullied by people from other countries? ?
“I wanted to call.” Xing Yucheng lifted up his clothes, looking depressed.
“I really can’t beat him.”
Beiting was sent to the Great Zhou, a long journey. They were afraid of encountering danger at such a long distance, so they must have chosen some masters. How could ordinary people be the opponents of that group of people?
Xing Yucheng was weak, so he could only be beaten?
Looking at the scars on Xing Yucheng’s body, Ye Shuo, who was already very angry, became even more angry.
Xing Yucheng hesitated for a while, and finally whispered: “Your cousins ​​wanted to take action, but they were quickly stopped…”
Among all the nobles in the entire Shangjing City, in terms of numbers and physique, only my grandfather’s family could defeat the other side.
But the problem is that the other party is an envoy. If Beiting takes the opportunity to send troops, the current Zhen Mansion cannot bear the crime.
Ye Shuo knew what was going on, so he remained silent.
“…No, this is too fucking cowardly! I really can’t stand it!” Not only were the common people bullied, but his study partner was also beaten. After thinking about it over and over again, Ye Shuo really couldn’t swallow this. He tossed and turned, and the more he thought about it, the angrier he got. He sat up from the recliner with a jerk.
Xing Yucheng came here to curse people and to vent his anger. After all, his father and mother at home had always told him not to cause trouble. Xing Yucheng couldn’t hold it in any longer, so he had to come to the palace to complain to the Ninth Prince. Unexpectedly, the Ninth Prince actually planned to settle the score with them in person.
Xing Yucheng was caught off guard by his action.
After realizing what was happening, Xing Yucheng hurried to catch up.
He also didn’t expect that the usually lazy Ninth Prince would be so impulsive. If the Ninth Prince really had a conflict with the group of envoys because of his words, Xing Yucheng would probably blame himself to death.
“Your Highness, calm down! Calm down!”
“Don’t be so impatient. This matter should be considered carefully.”
Xing Yucheng was just like everyone else, with too many concerns and too many things to consider, but the problem was that people had bullied him right at his doorstep, and it was clear that they had no intention of saving any face for Da Zhou.
Long-term planning, long-term planning, bullshit!
Damn, we should fight now!
Ye Shuo took a deep breath, his eyes heavy: “If we win the battle and it’s like this, I dare not think about it, what will happen if we lose.”
Will it be oppression, slaughter, or even massacre?
“The blood of the soldiers was truly shed in vain at that time.”
What good is it for a country to be powerful without backbone? A country that is not a country is nothing but a joke.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Departure
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Xing Yucheng opened his mouth: “But, but…”
“Are you going or not? If you are going, shut up and stop talking so much.”
Perhaps Xing Yucheng’s chattering annoyed Ye Shuo, so Ye Shuo said this.
Xing Yucheng subconsciously closed his mouth.
After standing there hesitating for a while, seeing Ye Shuo walking further and further away, Xing Yucheng finally gritted his teeth and followed him.
Just go, there’s nothing to be afraid of!
The worst that can happen is that I’ll be scolded by my father and mother when I get back.
At this moment, Xing Yucheng suddenly forgot his parents’ instructions.
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo made too much noise, and before long even the imperial concubine in the room heard about it.Su Yue was a little anxious when she heard this: “My queen, please go and persuade His Highness the Ninth Prince!”
The Ninth Prince has always been naughty, so now is the time for him to listen to Concubine Rong.
Concubine Rong paused holding the snacks, and then, to the great surprise of Su Yue and the others, Concubine Rong actually said something like this:
“My son has done nothing wrong, why should I stop him?”
After her father won the battle, he was forced to apologize to Beiting. This kind of humiliation was fine for her family once, but it must not be endured a second time!
“Shuo’er is like my son this way.”
Moreover, Concubine Rong also believed in her own judgment of men. The emperor was not the late emperor, and he would never let his son suffer any injustice.
But this alone was not enough. Concubine Rong thought about it, turned back to the room, took out the badge from the drawer, and handed it to Su Yue.
“Go there in person and tell my father about this.”
The imperial concubine is planning to move out the old Duke of Zhen.
Su Yue was totally surprised by this development.
The other side.
The first people Ye Shuo met after going out were the Second Prince and the Fifth Prince.
The two seemed to be arguing about something in the corridor. The Second Prince had a calm expression, while the Fifth Prince, who was now eighteen years old, had a flushed face.
“Second brother, are we really going to let them do whatever they want—”
“Ninth brother, why are you here?” Without waiting for his younger brother to finish speaking, the second prince spoke suddenly as if he had seen something.
Seeing that Ye Shuo’s expression seemed a little strange, the Second Prince was a little surprised: “Ninth brother, you seem to be in a bad mood. Can I ask who made you so angry?”
The Fifth Prince then noticed that Xiaojiu had come to his side at some point.
Ye Shuo didn’t intend to waste time, and casually said: “Apart from that group of envoys, who else could it be?”
“Forget it. I won’t say any more to you. I have to go see what the situation is outside.”
After saying this, without noticing the changes in the two men’s expressions, Ye Shuo hurriedly left with his attendants and companions.
Ye Shuo walked in a hurry, so he didn’t hear what the Fifth Prince seemed to say.
“Don’t be anxious, Xiaojiu, wait for me——”
What Ye Shuo didn’t know was that the two of them had just quarreled because of this matter. After hearing what Ye Shuo said, the Fifth Prince’s eyes immediately lit up.
However, just as he was about to chase after them, the Second Prince stopped him without hesitation: “Now that everyone has come forward, why are you so anxious?”
In the second prince’s opinion, the eldest prince and the crown prince have not made any move yet, so it is not their turn to intervene in this matter.
Now, the eldest prince and the crown prince did not move, but the ninth prince moved first, so there is no need for them to get involved in this mess.
This is a thankless job. If it is handled well, it will be fine, at most you will get a few words of praise. But if it is not handled well and it causes conflict between the two countries, you will become a sinner in an instant.
After weighing the pros and cons, the second prince felt that it was not worth it, so he just pretended not to see it.
“But I’m afraid that Xiaojiu—”
“Don’t worry, with Xiaojiu’s personality, he won’t suffer any loss.” On the contrary, he is the most suitable person to take the lead, both in terms of identity and age.
The second prince’s eyes flickered.
The fifth prince still felt uneasy and wanted to take action, but before he could even lift his foot, he heard the second prince’s slightly warning voice.
“Fifth brother.”
The Fifth Prince’s movements suddenly stopped and he met his brother’s eyes. After a long while, he was finally forced to stop.
The second person Ye Shuo met was Ye Xun.
The little prince kicked pebbles as he walked, looking very unhappy.
Perhaps the things happening outside have affected the palace, making everyone quite restless. These two people who are usually not seen have now appeared.
After seeing his dear Ninth Uncle, Ye Xun casually asked him what he was planning to do in such a hurry.
Ye Xun thought that the Ninth Prince had suffered another of his old illness and was planning to go outside to listen to books and music. He was about to remind him that things were not peaceful outside recently, but when he heard him say that he was going to settle accounts with the envoy from Beiting, Ye Xun suddenly perked up.
“Take me with you, Uncle Nine!”
As the legitimate son of the Crown Prince, Ye Xun was taught every day that he was the most noble person in the world, and that no one was more noble than him except his grandfather the Emperor and his father.
But when the envoys from Beiting arrived, Ye Xun found that this was not the case. At least when he was helping to deal with diplomatic affairs, those people were quite rude to him.
This made Ye Xun wonder, is Da Zhou really as powerful as others say?
But Ye Xun didn’t dare to ask such a question, and kept it in his heart. It would be strange if he was happy after a long time.
So when Ye Xun heard Ye Shuo say this, he couldn’t help it immediately.
He also wanted to let those envoys see how powerful their Great Zhou was.
Ye Shuo didn’t want to take him with him at first, and he didn’t even try to hide the contempt in his eyes. What can a seven-year-old kid do? He completely forgot that he was also a kid in the eyes of others.
However, Ye Xun kept pestering him, Ninth Uncle first and Ninth Uncle second, and Ye Shuo had no choice but to nod: “…Okay then.”
Actually, Ye Xun still has some good points. After all, he is the prince’s legitimate son, and the two attendants around him are also good in martial arts, so it is not a loss to accept him.
And wherever Ye Xun is, there must be Ye Yan and the others.
The prince’s son has such ambition, so they, as their father’s sons, should not lag behind, right?
As uncles, they can’t be partial to one and neglect the other.
Just like that, when Ye Shuo arrived at the gate of the imperial palace, there was already a large group of people following him.
Seeing this scene, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth.
For a moment, he wondered if he had come here to take care of the child.
Because of the arrival of the envoys, there were so many envoys in public, but no one knew how many there were in private. The imperial palace itself was under martial law recently, and the commander-in-chief was alarmed in a short while.
But Ye Shuo not only showed no sign of repentance, but asked the commander-in-chief for guards.
Since they came to our house, how can we do it without thugs?
The commander-in-chief: “…”
He really is worthy of being the Ninth Prince. I was really stupid just now. I actually expected him to be obedient and turn back.
The commander-in-chief looked at him, and Ye Shuo looked back without giving in. The four looked into each other’s eyes, and neither of them was willing to give in.
In the end, it was the commander-in-chief who looked away first.
The commander-in-chief transferred thirty guards over. Although the number was not large, each of them was an expert.
The commander-in-chief can only give this much. Thirty guards are enough to protect the prince and the emperor’s grandson. Any more would be a pure declaration of war.
“Thank you.” Ye Shuo casually bowed to the commander-in-chief, thinking that this man was really nice. He thought a dozen would be enough, but he didn’t expect him to be so generous and give to so many people at once.
Looking at the Ninth Prince’s back, the commander-in-chief smiled bitterly.
In his opinion, the Ninth Prince was the most considerate one.
This group of people have to worry about so much, but in the end they have to rely on an eleven-year-old prince. It is simply the biggest joke in the world.
Compared to them, Emperor Jingwen could be said to be the first one to receive the news.
Emperor Jingwen made a prompt decision and shouted to the empty space in front of him: “Wu Yi.”
“The servant is here.”
“You go, follow them.” Looking into the eyes of the secret guard, Emperor Jingwen spoke each word with emphasis: “Make sure that those people don’t harm my son in the slightest.”
“yes!”
After Wu Yi left, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said sternly: “Come here, inform the Jingzhao Yin to lead the people to prepare. If the Beiting envoy dares to fight back, immediately send people to capture him!”
Emperor Jingwen has finally endured enough.
This Beiting is really going too far!
He had no idea that his small action would cause so many people to follow suit. After Ye Shuo left the palace with a group of little followers, he began to search for the envoys.
However, he didn’t know whether he was unlucky or just missed it. After searching for a long time, he didn’t even see the shadow of a person.
In addition, Ye Shuo came out today wearing the clothes of a prince, and the common people would retreat away from him, so how could they rush to approach him? It was difficult for him to even ask for information.
But Ye Shuo was unwilling to give up just like that.
After touring the entire Shangjing City, Ye Shuo thought about it and finally decided to go to the post station.
What if? What if we find something at the posthouse?
Ye Shuo calmed down and led his men towards the inn again.
And this time, Ye Shuo actually saw with his own eyes the envoy attacking the people.
Although the location was an inn, this inn was also the territory of the Great Zhou. Even if it was really the people of the Great Zhou who made the mistake first, it was not their turn to teach them a lesson. Naturally, there would be punishment according to the law.
Besides, the real situation may not be what it is.
Seeing that the woman in coarse cloth was about to be knocked to the ground by several Beiting people, Ye Shuo said without thinking, “Stop!”
When the Beiting people heard the language of the Great Zhou, they were stunned at first. However, even when they saw that Ye Shuo, the leader, was wearing the clothes of a prince, they still did not take him seriously. They just carried on as usual.
Ye Shuo’s eyes suddenly turned cold: “How dare these foreigners look down on the royal family? Come on, take them down!”
“yes!”
There were only two people from Beiting who took action, while Ye Shuo had a full thirty guards. In a short while, the two Beiting men were pinned to the ground, and even their rough faces were soon rubbed to bloody marks by the gravel on the ground.
He didn’t know if it was because he also had a deep resentment towards this group of people, but Ye Shuo always felt that these guards had done a heavy job.
But Ye Shuo was too lazy to care, and he hoped that they would be ruthless. Ye Shuo just stepped forward and helped the woman who fell to the ground and was covered with scars: “I will take you to find a clinic now.”
At this moment, Ye Shuo didn’t think too much about it. He just thought that the other party had offended this group of people, so he was beaten innocently.
But the next moment, the woman seemed to collapse and cried out, “Don’t worry about me, don’t worry about me, go, go and save my daughter!”
Ye Shuo’s heart skipped a beat. After he came to his senses, he turned around abruptly and looked at the inn that was shining and magnificent in the sun, but now it seemed like an abyss.
The vermilion wall, shining under the midday sun, seemed to be weeping blood.
Ye Shuo’s expression suddenly became extremely terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Punishment
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Perhaps because she was too devastated, the woman could only repeat this sentence.
The emperor’s grandchildren felt a chill in their hearts. Ye Xun was the first to step forward and said hurriedly, “Madam, this is my ninth uncle. My father is the current crown prince. If you have any grievances, just speak up. We will definitely make a decision for you!”
Ye Xun’s words were powerful and resounding, but strangely, the woman did not feel happy after hearing them. Instead, she became even more desperate, and the only light left in her eyes went out.
Obviously, even the common people in Shangjing City have gradually realized something.
“There is no one left. Is there no one left……”
After understanding what the woman meant, Ye Shuo felt a sharp pain in his heart.
Because there was no one left in the Great Zhou, it couldn’t even protect its own people.
“Raise your head!” After taking a deep breath, Ye Shuo turned around and kicked one of the Beiting guards.
The guard felt pain and reacted instinctively.“Let me ask you, did you capture a girl?”
Feeling the blood slowly flowing down the corner of his lips, the guard who was pinned to the ground did not beg for mercy. Instead, he chuckled and said, “I, I don’t understand…what are you…saying…”
The other party is trying to use the language barrier to confuse people.
This is an inn, and it is also where the envoys from Beiting stay. As long as they insist on not admitting it, what can they do even if they are the princes of the Great Zhou?
However, what the guard never expected was that when he denied it, the little prince in front of him was not angry at all, but shouted loudly: “My people from the Great Zhou are missing, and someone reported that they are here. Please cooperate.”
Then Ye Shuo’s eyes turned cold: “Someone, search for me!”
“You can’t search, you can’t search…” Upon hearing the noise, the Minister of Rites hurried over, sweating profusely.
Looking around and seeing the woman begging, how could the Minister of Rites not guess what was happening here?
Two days ago, they were just bullying the market, but now they are directly robbing people.
The Minister of Rites was shocked and angry, but…
“Please calm down, Ninth Prince. This matter is of great importance and you must not act rashly!” Breaking into the post station without permission is an act of provocation. If not handled properly, it may lead to a war!
However, Ye Shuo didn’t even look at him and walked in.
“Even if this post house is a dangerous place, I will definitely break into it!”
The moment he finished speaking, Ye Shuo was immediately surrounded by the Beiting guards who had rushed over after hearing the news.
Ye Shuo noticed that Huyan Jue did not seem to be among them. He must have gone to the palace. After all, Beiting only stayed in Shangjing for seven days in total, and they had no idea why they lost those three cities this time.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t care whether Huyan Jue was there or not.
Seeing that he seemed to be trying to force his way in, the guards of Beiting were not as cautious as those of the Great Zhou. They immediately drew the scimitars from their waists, and the tip of the scimitars was pointed at the nose of Ye Shuo, the prince of the Great Zhou.
Seeing this scene, the thirty guards following Ye Shuo and the little emperor’s grandson also drew their weapons.
“Your Highness, let me ask you again, where is the woman you captured now?” If he could get the answer, it would be fine. If he couldn’t… Ye Shuo’s eyes turned cold.
But obviously, these Beiting people would definitely not say it.
The only option now was for Ye Shuo to force his way in.
Ye Shuo walked towards the first room of the inn without any hesitation.
“Ninth Prince, please stay!”
One of the Beiting people shouted, his eyes full of anger and his tone full of threats: “Do you want to provoke a war between Beiting and Dazhou?”
“You were the ones who were rampant first. If we were to declare war, it should be you!”
When Ye Shuo kicked open the door of the first room, the guards finally met Beiting’s guards.
The courtyard of the inn was suddenly filled with the flashing of swords and the shadow of sabers.
The commander-in-chief was really considerate. He guessed their intentions and was afraid that they would suffer losses, so he gave them the best of the best among the Black Armor Guards.
“I’ll search this side, and you search that side. Be quick.” It’s not known whether there are any reinforcements from his stepfather’s side. They only brought thirty guards in total, plus a few of the emperor’s grandson’s attendants, a total of only forty people. Compared with the envoy’s team of nearly two hundred people, there is still a big gap.
Fortunately, Huyan Jue was not there. When he went out, he probably took more than half of the people with him. Otherwise, the situation would have been one-sided.
But despite this, the group of guards could not hold out for long, at most a quarter of an hour, so they had to fight quickly and decisively.
Seeing Ye Xun still trying to exchange a few moves with the guards, Ye Shuo immediately pulled him away.
But forget it, with his small arms and legs, he would have been useless in the past.
As for Ye Yan and his companions, although they are young, they are heavy and have been taught by the eldest prince himself, so it is not difficult for them to tie them together and beat up anyone.
As Ye Xun turned around, Ye Shuo saw that one of the guards was about to chop the guard with his round knife. Subconsciously, he brushed the flowers next to him and threw out a few green leaves in his hand.
A few blood lines suddenly appeared on the back of the Beiting guard’s hand.
While the other party was in pain, the guard seized the opportunity and immediately started fighting with him.
After a quick glance, he found that there was no one in the first room. Ye Shuo pulled Ye Xun and quickly kicked the door of the second room.
Then the third, fourth, fifth…
Seeing that Beiting’s encirclement was getting tighter and tighter, the guards were finding it increasingly difficult to fight. Ye Shuo and Ye Yan were on the left and right and were about to meet up.
After checking the entire circle, there are only two rooms left. In other words, if the woman’s daughter is there, she must be in these two rooms.
Ye Shuo vaguely heard a noise, so he quickly stepped forward and subconsciously pushed the door. However, the moment the door opened, he clearly heard the rustling sound of clothes.
Oh no, there’s an ambush!
Ye Shuo’s eyes blurred and he immediately saw the man’s bright and rough face.
Seeing the opponent’s hand coming towards him, if this palm hit him, even he would be in trouble. In a flash, Ye Shuo didn’t care about hiding, pushed Ye Xun to a safe place beside him, and immediately raised his palm to attack.
Before he could make a move, another figure, much faster than him, floated over like a ghost, pulled him back by his clothes, and replaced him to fight the man face to face.
The man, who was originally full of anger, flew backwards almost instantly.
Looking at the figure standing in front of him, this familiar inverted triangle figure, this seemingly cold and fierce but actually honest look, and this chin…
Ye Shuo almost blurted out: “Master!”
If the person who came wasn’t the unlucky guy from before, who else could it be?
Wu Yi was startled at first, then he subconsciously reached for his mask.
For a moment, Wu Yi wondered if his mask had been accidentally blown off by the wind on his way here.
It wasn’t until his fingers touched the cold metal covering his face that Wu Yi calmed down instantly. So, how did he recognize him?
And this Master…
Completely unaware of Wu Yi’s complicated thoughts at the moment, Ye Shuo became immediately energized after seeing him.
When Wu Yi, the number one killer under his cheap father, appeared, Ye Shuo suddenly felt that the Beiting guards in the yard were nothing.
Out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of a woman’s figure faintly on the wooden bed. Without thinking, Ye Shuo pulled Wu Yi inside, and then quickly locked everyone outside, including Ye Xun.
Wu Yi is a secret guard, he would definitely not say anything nonsense, and the man just now was still in the house. Ye Shuo was afraid of being ambushed, so he simply brought Wu Yi in with him.
When Ye Shuo walked towards the bed, another figure rushed towards him.
This time, Ye Shuo didn’t even move, and Wu Yi knocked the man down cleanly and neatly again.
When he opened the curtains, he breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that the woman’s shirt was just a little messy, but her belt was still there.
Fortunately, fortunately I made it in time.
Even though the two beasts failed to succeed, it was still a great insult to women of that time.
The woman’s eyes were filled with grief, anger and shame. Taking advantage of this opportunity, she pulled out the hairpin and was about to stab it into her neck.
However, the next moment, a hand quickly grasped the tip of the hairpin.
“Hey, hey, hey, what does this have to do with you? What did you do wrong? Both of them are alive, why do you want to die?”
And then there is——
“If you die, what will you ask your mother to do?”
The woman was stunned, and then couldn’t help crying.
Only then did Ye Shuo notice that the other person seemed to be a mute girl who could not make any sound. No wonder they didn’t hear any sound of struggling or asking for help when they came in just now.
These two bastards, even a mute girl could do that to them, they are worse than beasts!
Ye Shuo was almost biting his teeth.
“Here is fifty taels of silver. Take it with you and leave Shangjing with your mother.” Ye Shuo knew the horror of rumours, especially in ancient times.
“Don’t worry, I’m the only one who saw your face. If you live somewhere else, no one will recognize you.”
The mute girl stared at him blankly, as if asking, is this really the case? Can the days ahead really return to peace?
Ye Shuo looked straight into her eyes and nodded affirmatively: “Of course, the premise is that you must become strong yourself.”
Ye Shuo suddenly thought of a place where there were no requirements for women’s chastity.
“How about I send you to the border to study?”
The mute girl was silent for a while, and seemed to quiet down little by little with this voice.
Finally, the mute girl knelt down on the bed and kowtowed three times to Ye Shuo, tears falling like rain.
Wu Yi had been staring at the two people and didn’t notice what they said.
About half a quarter of an hour later, the two men flew out and landed right in the center of the courtyard.
The force was so great that it even broke one of the doors.
Apart from Huyan Jue, these two people can be said to have the highest status in the envoy team.
Seeing this, the other guards had no choice but to stop.
“Major General, are you okay?”
“Get lost!”
The man who was called the Major General and the first to attack Ye Shuo, struggled to sit up from the ground. He was panting and staring at Ye Shuo, who was obviously the leader: “Asshole! How dare you… ruin my good deeds…”
“This prince also wants to ask, who gave you the courage to rape a woman in the streets of Shangjing City?” Ye Shuo’s eyes were sharp.
Hearing this, the man couldn’t help but burst into laughter: “Ha…haha…”
“So… what if I robbed him?”
Probably because of the injury, the man was a little out of breath, but it did not affect his arrogance at all: “Could it be that… you can still… punish me, kill me…?”
Ye Shuo also smiled, and thinking back to the scene just now, his eyes gradually turned colder.
Just when the man thought that the matter was over, he heard him slowly speak –
“As you said, why not?”
Seeing the other party behaving like this, Ye Shuo had already developed the intention to kill him.

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Killed
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Hearing this, the man, Qiu Linyuan, instead of feeling afraid, laughed even louder: “Ha…hahaha…hahahahaha…”
“Even you… the Emperor dare not touch… me…”
“What… thing are you…”
Qiu Linyuan didn’t believe what the little brat said at all, and he didn’t believe that the little brat would be so brave.
“I will remember this vengeance…”
Although he didn’t know the identity of the masked man in black who suddenly appeared, it didn’t stop Qiu Linyuan from putting the blame on Da Zhou.
Qiu Linyuan stared at Wu Yi, as if he wanted to remember him in his heart.
Damn, you dare to threaten others even when you are about to die.
Ye Shuo on the side was too lazy to talk nonsense with him. Without saying a word, he turned around and pulled out his sword from the waist of the nearest guard.With a “clang” sound, everyone only felt a flash before their eyes, and the next moment, they saw the Ninth Prince/Ninth Uncle pointing the tip of his sword at the two men lying on the ground like dead dogs.
Seeing this scene, everyone had different looks and expressions.
Needless to say, the Minister of Rites was naturally worried and anxious, while the four brothers Ye Yan opened their eyes wide, as if they were meeting their uncle for the first time.
As for Ye Xun, he seemed to want to say something but hesitated, not knowing what he should say.
This sword is quite heavy… It was his first time touching the real thing, and Ye Shuo couldn’t help but grin in his heart.
Ignoring the gazes of the group of people, Ye Shuo took a deep breath and then spoke loudly: “Who can tell me, according to the laws of the Great Zhou, what is the crime of robbing a woman in the street?”
The guards were stunned by the Ninth Prince in front of them for a moment, and there was silence for a moment.
Xing Yucheng looked at this, then looked at that, finally gritted his teeth and took a step forward: “Your Highness, robbing a woman in the street is a heinous crime, and he should be executed according to the law!”
After saying this, Xing Yucheng’s heart was beating wildly, but for some reason, he suddenly felt no longer afraid, and instead felt a surge of heroic spirit.
This is the way the world should be. This is how it should be.
“Okay!” Ye Shuo licked his lower lip: “No matter from the perspective of law or human feelings, you two are dead now. Do you have anything to say now?”
“If you’re still a man, don’t deny what you’ve done now!”
Qiu Linyuan didn’t think so much at all: “This young general is not like you Great Zhou people. I have never denied anything I have done!”
“So what if I captured that girl? It’s her good fortune that this young general likes her…”
After hearing these words, Ye Shuo no longer had any concerns in his heart.
However, Ye Shuo had just taken two steps forward when a voice called him.
Compared to other people, Wu Yi didn’t think about whether to send troops or not. He just knew that now that he was standing here, he couldn’t let the Ninth Prince get his hands dirty.
So he said, “I am willing to do it for you.”
As he said this, he pulled out a dagger from somewhere and was about to attack.
Ye Shuo was horrified: “Stop!”
Qiu Linyuan was startled, and then laughed even more wildly.
“You have nothing to do here, go back!” For a moment, Ye Shuo really wanted to knock open his head to see what was inside.
Wu Yi didn’t even look at the fact that he was the ninth prince of the dynasty and the grandson of the Duke of Zhen.
So now that things have come to this, he has no choice but to do it himself.
Ye Xun, Ye Yan and the others are qualified, but the problem is that they are just a bunch of children. Forget it, just do it yourself.
“This prince will do it himself, you just watch from the side and don’t let anyone disturb me.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but wave his hands.
Wu Yi had no choice but to give up, and turned around, staring at the Beiting guards with a fierce look.
There were some guards who dared to charge forward, but with Wu Yi around, how could they charge forward? In a short while, a large number of them were knocked down.
Ye Shuo held the sword and slowly approached Qiu Linyuan.
Qiu Linyuan just glanced at him indifferently, then curled his lips in disdain, like a tender melon.
Qiu Linyuan dared to guarantee that the prince had never killed anyone before, and it was not certain whether he had ever killed a chicken. Looking at his nervous expression, it was simply ridiculous.
Nonsense, Ye Shuo is neither a pervert nor a sociopath, and he has always lived in a society ruled by law in his previous life. It would be impossible for him to have killed anyone.
Ye Shuo knew all the weaknesses and fatal points of human beings, and dissection was no problem for him, but this was a living person, so the feeling was different.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but tighten the hilt of the sword in his hand, and reminded them naggingly: “Ye Xun, Ye Yan, you better turn your heads away, otherwise I won’t be responsible if you get covered in blood later.”
Ye Xun was visibly nervous. He felt relieved and decided to give him a way out: “Uncle Nine, if it doesn’t work, then let’s just—”
Before Ye Xun could finish his words, a stream of blood splattered more than two meters high.
Ye Xun, Ye Yan and others couldn’t help but be stunned.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but yell, “…Fuck!”
For the first time in my life, the tattoo was indeed crooked.
It was true that the tip of the sword in Ye Shuo’s hand had pierced into Qiu Linyuan’s aorta, but it was not a fatal blow, and blood was splattered everywhere.
Ye Shuo’s already trembling hands shook even more violently.
However, this scene, which seemed extremely funny before, suddenly became terrifying now.
Qiu Linyuan covered his neck tightly, and after he came to his senses, he finally began to back away desperately.
“Don’t be afraid, don’t be afraid. Next time, next time I will definitely give you a quick death.”
Maybe he accidentally poked his trachea, Qiu Linyuan was like a broken bellows, and the sound he made was full of noise: “I am a major general… but… General Qiu’s, son…”
“You dare to kill me… My father will not… will not let you go…”
At the same time, Jingzhao Yin finally arrived with his men.
Seeing this scene, Jingzhao Yin subconsciously said: “Your Highness, spare his life!”
The other guards would be fine, but the identities of these two are extraordinary. Killing them would really cause big trouble.
Jingzhao Yin became anxious and moved faster.
However, Ye Shuo was like a possessed deaf man. Since he said he wanted to kill, there was no such thing as going back on his word.
So the Jingzhao Yin watched helplessly as the sword in the Ninth Prince’s hand fell from high up. This time Ye Shuo aimed carefully before stabbing, and he also fulfilled his promise. This time, Qiu Linyuan just thrashed twice before he was completely silent.
Jingzhao Yin staggered and almost fell to the ground.
Then he looked at the other person. The one just now was in trouble, so this one had to be protected at all costs.
Before Jingzhao Yin could even finish his words, Ye Shuo swiftly and efficiently stabbed the second man’s neck.
I’ve already killed them all, so why would I care whether I killed one or two?
It was the feeling of killing someone that was really not pleasant. When no one was paying attention, Ye Shuo’s figure swayed for a moment, and returned to normal after two breaths.
By the time Jingzhao Yin arrived in front of the two men, the flowers were already cold. The two men were deadlier than dead.
The emperor only told him to protect the Ninth Prince, and if the people from Beiting dared to take action, he should take them all away. However, he did not say what to do if the envoy was killed by the Ninth Prince.
Looking at the Ninth Prince who had now turned into a bloody man, Jingzhao Yin was stunned.
The entire courtyard of the posthouse fell into deathly silence.
“Ninth, Ninth Uncle…”
Ye Yan swallowed his saliva: “Now, what should I do now?”
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate and said casually: “What else can we do? Go to the palace.”
He has already killed the people, it’s time to find his cheap dad to clean up the mess.
As he spoke, Ye Shuo threw the blood-stained sword to the ground.
The other side.
Huyan Jue was still bargaining with Emperor Jingwen, hoping to exchange a batch of gold, silver and jewelry for the three cities lost in Beiting.
After hearing this condition, Emperor Jingwen almost laughed out of anger. How much is the gold and silver, and how much is the land worth?
In the end, they still have to be taught a lesson, so that they will know that the Great Zhou is not easy to bully.
Just when the discussion was getting intense, the commander-in-chief suddenly walked in hurriedly.
Emperor Jingwen had a vague idea of ​​what was going on. He also knew that the commander-in-chief had let his son go when he led his men out of the palace.
I thought it was just a fight between kids, maybe some heavy punches, but what’s the problem? It was a good opportunity to teach Bei Ting a lesson.
However, what Emperor Jingwen never expected was that his son not only used too much force, but actually killed the two offenders.
“…Are you serious?” Emperor Jingwen almost lost his words for a moment.
After seeing the commander-in-chief nod in affirmation, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but have a thought in his mind: Really kill him…
Emperor Jingwen was an emperor, but he didn’t know what to say.
When the guards from Beiting sent a message, Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to believe it.
When Huyan Jue saw the guards in such a miserable state, his mind exploded.
“How dare you! How dare you! As the saying goes, when two countries are at war, envoys are not killed. How dare you kill my Beiting envoy? How absurd! How absurd!”
After the shock, Huyan Jue was so angry that he was shaking all over.
However, at this moment, a child’s voice suddenly came from outside the hall –
“They are just two beasts, just kill them.”
“If you dare to talk nonsense again, I will kill you too!”
Of course, Ye Shuo’s last words were just angry words, but now he looked like this, who would dare to take it as angry words? Hu Yanjue’s anger subsided a little, and cold sweat suddenly broke out. They, the Beiting people, are brave, but they are not fearless.
Emperor Jingwen looked at his son, who was covered in blood, even on his face, and could no longer bear it, and stood up with a “whoosh”.
The moment the words fell, another voice came from outside, but this time it was more hearty and deeper than before.
“Hahahaha, the Ninth Prince said it well!”
“They are just two envoys. Kill them if you want. But do you want my brother, the prince of the Great Zhou, to pay with his life?”
Ye Shuo thought that the first person to come would be his grandfather, but he didn’t expect that the first person to come would be his stepbrother…

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Cake
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Let alone Ye Shuo, even the eldest prince did not expect that he would be the first one who could not help but take action.
He went where he was told to go and killed where he was told to kill. From the time he received the news to the time he led his men out of the palace, it took him less than an hour in total. Compared to other princes, he was really brave.
The eldest prince immediately understood why his father doted on him so much. Although his younger brother was a bit annoying, he was not completely without merit.
At the very least, he is much better than the Second Prince and other people who only know how to hide in the dark and do some devilish tricks.
Ye Shuo’s decisiveness and efficiency immediately suited the eldest prince’s taste.
And this child even dared to kill the envoy, let alone himself. The eldest prince suddenly felt much more balanced.
He is just like that. He treats everyone the same and doesn’t target me specifically.
The eldest prince was dressed in royal robes and walked with the gait of a dragon and a tiger. In the blink of an eye, he arrived in front of Huyan Jue.
The eldest prince was born tall, and he had an aura that came from his experience at the border. The oppressive feeling made Huyan Jue want to retreat.In just a moment, Huyan Jue stopped walking.
The eldest prince originally wanted to pay his respects to Emperor Jingwen, but when he saw his brother’s current appearance, he couldn’t help but be stunned. How did he become like this?
After being called up by Emperor Jingwen, the eldest prince looked at Huyan Jue again.
Hu Yanjue took a deep breath and managed to calm down: “Does the eldest prince intend to go to war with my Beiting?”
The eldest prince laughed loudly, and then his eyes were like torches, and his aura was like a mountain pressing down on him: “So what if we start a war? It will only mean that I will have to endure the wind and sand at the border for another ten years.”
Hu Yanjue didn’t really believe it. How could there be such a selfless prince in this world?
“Emperor Zhou, Prince Ding, don’t forget that our Beiting soldiers are all brave and good at fighting.”
Hu Yanjue pointed out the identities of the two people killed by Ye Shuo in a slow voice: “The ones who died at the hands of the Ninth Prince were the sons of General Qiu and General Long. Emperor Zhou, if this news reaches the ears of the two generals, they will definitely be furious. I admit that the eldest prince is indeed young and strong, but I’m afraid that a first prince will not be able to do it by then, right?”
“If you don’t want the people of the Great Zhou to suffer, it wouldn’t be wronged to wrong the Ninth Prince.”
It was a naked threat, not even disguised.
Good! Beiting is really good, even the prince dares to ask for it!
This is simply too much!
Emperor Jingwen and the eldest prince were furious, but before they could speak, they heard another voice coming from outside the hall –
“If the eldest prince alone is not enough, what about adding me?”
“As for my sons, although they are not very capable, they are still enough for us.”
It turned out that after the Duke of Zhen received the news about his daughter, he thought about the actions of the envoys in the past few days. After much thought, he decided to bring his sons with him when he entered the palace this time.
Look, it’s just in time to come in handy now.
Although Ye Shuo’s uncles have not been to the battlefield for many years, they have always maintained their peak condition due to daily training. It should not be difficult for them to lead the troops here. After a little adaptation, they can continue to go to the battlefield.
But now, General Lanruo, the most powerful general in Beiting, was beheaded by the eldest prince, and his head was cut off and sent to Emperor Jingwen as a gift.
In this comparison, Beiting is actually at a disadvantage.
Perhaps the Duke of Zhen had left too deep an impression on him during the time of the previous emperor, and he also knew clearly what kind of people those officials were. In order to prevent the past from happening again and to avoid being upset, the Duke of Zhen simply claimed to be ill and did not come to the banquet on the day of the banquet, and Huyan Jue did not see him either.
He thought that after so many years, the Duke of Zhen would have become very old, but when he saw him today, Huyan Jue found that it was not the case at all.
The Duke of Zhen is a little older than before, but he is still in good health, and his energy and spirit are no less than when he was young.
Compared with the nightmare that Beiting left on Da Zhou, the shadow left by the Duke of Zhen on Beiting was equally significant.
The Duke of Zhen went against the order of the late emperor and killed 100,000 of their soldiers without blinking an eye. Such a character and such means are truly frightening.
Not to mention that the Duke of Zhen’s sons were also quite famous on the battlefield back then.
When Huyan Jue saw the Duke of Zhen appearing in a suit of armor, he knew that his plan to make the Ninth Prince bow his head would fail.
Ye Shuo noticed that Hu Yanjue was short of breath, and his momentum suddenly became stronger: “Today my father, my elder brother, and my grandfather are standing here, let’s see what you can do to me!”
Emperor Jingwen felt relieved when he saw that his son put him at the first place.
Seeing the child in front of him being so aggressive, Hu Yanjue was angry and hateful, and couldn’t help but grit his teeth and said: “Ninth Prince, you killed my Beiting envoy, you have to give an explanation!?”
Ye Shuo did have reasons, and they were quite legitimate.
But why did Ye Shuo tell him this?
“If I want to kill them, just kill them. Why do I need so many reasons? Do I need to explain myself?”
Emperor Jingwen, the eldest prince, and the Duke of Zhen were originally planning to listen, wondering what could have made him so angry that he would kill someone directly. However, they were caught off guard and heard such words. Even the eldest prince could not help but feel genuinely shocked at his younger brother’s courage.
This is too arrogant. The Duke of Zhen couldn’t help but sweat profusely. He had never been like this when he was young…
If Huyan Jue hadn’t been here, Emperor Jingwen would really have wanted to give him a look and ask him to restrain himself.
However, Ye Shuo has now found a backer, and the backer is so reliable. It would be strange if Ye Shuo could restrain himself.
Compared with Emperor Jingwen and his two men, Ye Shuo’s six uncles were very considerate. Not only did they not think there was anything wrong, they also thought that what he said was good and that he was worthy of being their nephew.
Looking at Ye Xun and the others who had been eavesdropping outside, his blood boiled even more.
“That’s awesome!” Ye Yan and a few others who had actually faced the Beiting people at the border were even more excited.
Ye Yan really couldn’t help it and jumped out on his own initiative.
“Grandfather! It was them, the envoys from Beiting, who first kidnapped the women of our Great Zhou and tried to commit indecent acts! These envoys from Beiting are shameless!”
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen’s originally calm expression suddenly turned gloomy.
For a moment, the memory that he had deliberately forgotten flashed before his eyes again.
Emperor Jingwen was once again reminded of the unbearable past of more than 20 years ago.
After the New Year’s Eve banquet, Emperor Jingwen, who was forced to toast the envoy from Beiting, was drunk for three days. Whether it was because he was drunk or because he was discouraged, he lay in bed for three days before he could barely get up. When he woke up, he heard the news that Princess Daiyuan had hanged herself two days ago.
Emperor Jingwen did not dare to investigate further, but how could he not know what had happened?
Once or twice, even a saint would go crazy.
“Huyan Jue, you Beiting people are really going too far!” Emperor Jingwen said this almost with gritted teeth.
When Huyan Jue heard the Emperor of the Great Zhou bring up this matter on his own initiative, his heart immediately skipped a beat.
Huyan Jue was not stupid, and he naturally knew that when someone took the initiative to reveal his scars, it was either a complete peace agreement or the beginning of revenge.
As expected, the next moment, Hu Yanjue heard Emperor Jingwen speak from above –
“Come here, kill all the Beiting guards in the inn today, don’t leave any alive.”
Emperor Jingwen has now completely broken off relations with Huyan Jue.
Good man, how come my cheap dad is even angrier than me after hearing this?
Ye Shuo was stunned.
Hu Yanjue was horrified: “Emperor Zhou!”
Hu Yanjue wanted to say something else, but he saw Emperor Jingwen looking back at him. What kind of look was that…
Almost instantly, all the hairs on Huyan Jue’s body stood up.
Emperor Jingwen spoke each word with emphasis: “Go back and tell your Wolf King that my Great Zhou does not intend to return those three cities. I do not intend to apologize to the Wolf King for what happened today, and I will not let my son admit his mistakes. If the Wolf King is dissatisfied, I will not hesitate to fight with Beiting!”
The Emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty was going to take real action!
When Emperor Jingwen gave the order, all parties responded so quickly that the commander-in-chief returned in just half an hour.
All the Beiting guards in the posthouse were killed, and no one survived.
Huyan Jue’s feet seemed to be nailed to the ground and suddenly he was unable to move.
He never imagined that when they came in the past, even the noble princess had to be toyed with by them, but now, it was just a little mute girl, nameless and without a surname, but she attracted such a thunder.
When Emperor Jingwen’s eyes fell on Huyan Jue, Huyan Jue immediately broke out in a sweat.
Huyan Jue almost fled from the palace.
After so many years, Emperor Jingwen finally avenged himself and Princess Daiyuan.
But although she was still alive, Princess Daiyuan would never know these things again.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t tell what he was feeling. It was a complicated feeling, but at the same time, he felt relieved as if a huge stone had been lifted off his shoulders.
Ye Shuo tightened his fingers, took a deep breath, and took the opportunity to speak: “Father, why don’t we knock Bei Ting down in one go.”
Or maybe…
“How about simply incorporating the territory of Beiting into our Great Zhou?”
This was the first time that Ye Shuo expressed an ambition that was inconsistent with his usual image.
No one knew how nervous he was at this moment.
Ye Shuo knew that the conflicts among his brothers could not be reconciled and their ambitions could not be eliminated.
The cake is so small, what should we do if there is not enough to share? If we make the cake bigger, maybe there is still hope.
Ye Shuo said quickly: “There is also the State of Chen. Doesn’t the emperor want to unify the State of Chen and Beiting together? By then, the world will only have our Great Zhou family, and there will be no need to fight anymore.”
Emperor Jingwen, who had already sat down again, did not notice the urgency in his son’s eyes. After hearing this, he immediately laughed: “The Great Zhou, Chen and Beiting have been like this since ancient times. How easy is it to unify them?”
It’s not that no one had tried before, but the price they paid was so great that in the end they were unable to do so and even their own dynasties were overthrown.
Many people tried, but none of them succeeded. As time went by, no one tried this idea anymore.
Perhaps it was God’s will that this land was naturally meant to be three countries.
Just like in modern times, if someone says they want to unify the world, they will definitely be regarded as a joke by all mankind.
Only after the entire Blue Star is unified will this joke no longer be a joke.
Before this is done, no one knows that this method is feasible.
Emperor Jingwen was born and raised here, so it was extremely difficult for him to think about unifying the Three Kingdoms.
When Ye Shuo heard this, his heart suddenly turned cold.
But at this time, Ye Shuo still refused to give up: “What if? What if it works?”
“Alright!” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but raise his tone, feeling a little annoyed by his own son’s pestering.
“It’s okay to say such naive words once, but don’t mention them again in the future, or you’ll make a fool of yourself.”
Ye Shuo opened his mouth, but suddenly couldn’t speak.
Seeing this, the eldest prince raised his eyebrows and joked, “Ninth brother is quite ambitious. He has just killed two insignificant pawns, and he already wants to unify the world.”
The eldest prince didn’t mean anything else, he just felt that his thinking was moving too fast. At this rate, he would probably go to the sky to pick the sun tomorrow.
The eldest prince really kept bringing up things that were not relevant to the topic. Ye Shuo had finally forgotten about this matter, but when he brought it up, his nose suddenly started working again. Especially since he was covered in blood, he couldn’t ignore it even if he wanted to.
Even if those two people are nothing, this is still the blood of living people…
Ye Shuo’s face suddenly turned pale, and he didn’t care where he was. He bent down in front of Emperor Jingwen and the eldest prince and said, “Ugh—”
Caught off guard, the eldest prince’s expression froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Opening
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo suddenly started vomiting violently. After a while, his entire stomach was emptied. And there was a tendency for vomiting to continue. It looked like he would not stop until he vomited out all the bile.
By the time Emperor Jingwen and the eldest prince reacted, Ye Shuo was only left with one breath.
Seeing their son/brother suddenly half-dead and like a dead dog, Emperor Jingwen and the eldest prince were obviously a little panicked.
Why did he vomit like this out of nowhere?
It took a while for the two to get their questions answered.
“Take me quickly… to take a shower…” Only when you experience it yourself, will you know how strong the smell of blood is, and how it makes people dizzy.
Ye Shuo almost grabbed the eldest prince’s arm and said this.
After realizing what was happening, the eldest prince and Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but laugh and cry.
“It’s just two lives, is it that serious?” The eldest prince had killed so many people that he couldn’t even count them. He really couldn’t understand Ye Shuo’s feelings.“You don’t understand…” If Ye Shuo was just a naive child, maybe it would be okay, but the problem is that Ye Shuo is not.
For him, killing someone is something that completely overturns his decades of cognition, and the impact can be imagined.
The eldest prince originally wanted to laugh at him, but when he saw how weak he looked, he felt too embarrassed to laugh at him.
Emperor Jingwen did not take this matter seriously. After Huyan Jue left, he still had a lot of things to deal with.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but look at his eldest son: “Liancheng, why don’t you send Xiaojiu back?”
The eldest prince: “…”
The eldest prince opened his mouth, but finally nodded with great difficulty.
The eldest prince never thought that he would have such a harmonious relationship with his brothers other than his biological brother in his life.
The Duke of Zhen saw that he had nothing to do here and was about to leave, but the next moment, he heard the voice of Emperor Jingwen trying to keep him.
The Duke of Zhen was stunned.
The other side.
Ye Shuo’s eyes were lifeless, and he lay on the eldest prince’s back like a dead dog, his mind full of scenes from the posthouse.
The eldest prince couldn’t help himself and said, “Women are more brave than you.”
The eldest prince’s wife and the two concubines did not react as strongly as he did when they first started killing people.
“You just faced Huyan Jue with such momentum, show it!” The eldest prince’s heroic evaluation of him suddenly fell to the bottom again.
Ye Shuo did not refute, whatever he said was what it was.
The eldest prince felt uncomfortable with his younger brother’s sudden docility.
The palace servants who saw this scene along the way almost popped their eyes out of their heads.
First it was the crown prince, then the emperor, and now he has been carried by the eldest prince. He is probably the only ninth prince in the world who can have this privilege.
I don’t know how the Ninth Prince did it.
It was not until they were almost at Qiuwu Palace that Ye Shuo came to his senses. It was rare for him to get along so harmoniously with his cheap brother. Then, inexplicably, he recalled something.
“By the way, big brother, when you saw me before, you told me to go to the temple to calm my mind. What did you mean?”
It was the time when Ye Shuo had a conflict with the eldest prince. After Ye Shuo went back, he thought about it and couldn’t understand why he suddenly said such a thing.
Ye Shuo has a good memory and wants to figure it out after such a long time.
The eldest prince thought for a long time before he figured out what he was saying.
The two of them had a grudge because of this, but he didn’t even know about it?
“Didn’t you hear what the court said at the time?”
“Ah?” Ye Shuo was also confused: “This…should I know?”
The eldest prince was stunned.
The first reaction of the eldest prince was that he was talking nonsense. As a prince, how could he say that he didn’t care about the affairs of the court? It was simply the biggest joke in the world.
But then the eldest prince felt that there was really no need for Ye Shuo to lie to him.
He even dared to kill the envoy, how could he dare not admit it?
Besides, the fight between the two sides has already ended, and everyone who should be offended has been offended. Even if he wants to find an excuse, it is too late.
Combined with his sons’ observations over the past few days, a thought suddenly flashed through the eldest prince’s mind: Perhaps he really didn’t know that someone in the court was hinting that he was a jinx.
If this is true, then this is too much of a loss! ?
This fight was really unfair.
The eldest prince was silent for a moment, then asked, “Didn’t the crown prince mention this to you?”
“…Why would Third Brother tell me this?” Ye Shuo was even more puzzled: “How old am I?”
Isn’t this something that the prince will only consider after he turns 15 and goes to court? Are these people so anxious?
However, based on the eldest prince’s understanding of the crown prince, if he really wanted to train the ninth prince to be his right-hand man, not to mention that he is only eleven years old, he would have told him everything he should have told him when the two became fellow disciples.
The crown prince never mentioned it, which can only mean one thing, that the prince does not intend to include Xiaojiu, or in other words… the prince has excluded this younger brother from the fight from the beginning.
Indeed, with his personality, he is not really suitable for power struggles.
Since the Crown Prince had this intention, and the First Prince did not want to have any more people competing with him, family affection was already weak in the royal family, so one less rival was a good thing. The First Prince thought for a moment and then crossed out Ye Shuo’s name from the list.
To some extent, this should be the tacit understanding between the two rivals, the eldest prince and the crown prince.
Afterwards, no matter how Ye Shuo asked, the eldest prince refused to continue talking. He was really annoyed by the questions, so he just started to laugh it off.
Even though Ye Shuo had such good patience, he became a little angry when he was halfway through his words.
“If you want to say something, just say it completely. What’s the point of saying only half of it?” Especially for something like this that obviously had a hidden story, Ye Shuo wanted to find out more.
However, the eldest prince refused to say anything.
If the Ninth Prince could always remain like this, it would be a good thing.
“Hey, we’ve arrived at Qiuwu Palace.”
Just as Ye Shuo raised his head, the eldest prince cleared his throat, then picked him up from behind, threw him to the door of Qiuwu Palace and left without looking back.
Ye Shuo was left jumping up and down in the same place. Listening to the shouts coming from behind him, the eldest prince’s mood inexplicably improved a lot.
“…What is this?” Ye Shuo gritted his teeth. He had vomited so hard that he had no strength left. Finally, he had to give up and returned to Qiuwu Palace with the help of Xiao Luzi.
The first thing Ye Shuo did when he returned to his room was to ask for hot water.
He was ready to wash himself thoroughly from inside to outside.
When Ye Shuo tried to take off his clothes, he discovered that, probably because the blood was too thick and had been stuck together for a long time, Ye Shuo’s face was almost as white as paper.
After holding it in for a while, he finally stopped vomiting.
Ye Shuo’s hair was soaked with blood. It took him a long time to wash it clean until the water started to get cold.
Maybe it was because the impact was too great or because he had been soaking in water for too long, but that night, Ye Shuo successfully developed a fever.
Eight or nine years had passed since his last fever. When he touched his burning forehead, even Ye Shuo began to doubt whether he was really that fragile.
This does seem a bit too useless…
But there is no other way. Even if it is embarrassing, you still have to call the imperial physician.
Not long after, Emperor Jingwen and the eldest prince also got the news. For a moment, they both didn’t know whether their son/brother was being cowardly or arrogant.
You can say he was weak, but he killed the two envoys without saying a word. But you can say he was arrogant, because he scared himself after killing them.
People who heard the news were inevitably confused.
The next day, the little princess woke up from her sleep and saw how weak her brother was. Her impression of his “inability” became even deeper.
Jianjian thought that the little rabbits she raised were stronger than the man she called brother.
But it doesn’t matter. She has already started learning martial arts. When she finishes her training, with her help, he won’t be bullied anymore.
Yes, bullying.
Since Jianjian was still young, the imperial concubine did not tell him about Ye Shuo’s murder. She just said that her brother went out to fight with others, so he became like this.
Ye Shuo was so sick, didn’t Jian Jian think he was being bullied?
After feeding her brother water, Jian Jian waved her fists in the yard even harder.
After class in the study, Ye Xun’s first reaction was to visit the Ninth Uncle.
Coincidentally, Ye Yan and the other three thought the same.
And so, although they did not take the same route, the two sides finally met at the gate of Qiuwu Palace.
Ye Yan’s first reaction when he saw Ye Xun was to grin.
But then he thought about how the other party had performed well in the inn, and how he didn’t show any fear or retreat amid the swordplay, and felt that he was still quite courageous. Ye Yan’s impression of him was better than before.
Ye Xun also felt that the four people were courageous.
The four brothers Ye Yan and Ye Xun ignored each other at the door, but after they walked in, they had a tacit understanding with each other, like real cousins.
The other side.
Huyan Jue didn’t dare to stay in Shangjing City for long. He was like a guard guarding the posthouse one moment and who knew if he would be the one to be killed the next.
Huyan Jue fled Shangjing overnight with the remaining two or three men.
As expected, there was an uproar in the court the next day.
Some people were scolding the Ninth Prince for slaughtering the envoys, while others were trying their best to shift the blame for the Ninth Prince onto others.
As long as they refuse to admit it and insist that the two men were not killed by the Ninth Prince but by an unknown person, and then push that unknown person out and hand him over to Beiting to vent their anger, this crisis can be safely overcome.
Emperor Jingwen felt sad when he saw them arguing.
He observed for a long time and found that there were many people who showed weakness, but very few who advocated a tough stance.
Since when did the court only have spineless people?
Or was it because the late emperor and himself were too weak, causing the people below to follow suit and become complete wimps?
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt a chill running down his spine.
When he heard that they were discussing and even planning to hand over the Ninth Prince, Emperor Jingwen could no longer bear it.
“Xiao Jiu has only killed two people. The rest were all ordered by me. According to what you said, I am afraid you want to hand me over as well.”
Emperor Jingwen looked around with a cold gaze.
This is a serious matter.
All the ministers knelt down one after another and said, “Your Majesty, please calm down. We are guilty.”
“You should apologize.” Emperor Jingwen looked at them one by one and said, “If I hear these words again, watch out for your heads!”
When Emperor Jingwen first ascended the throne, he also killed many ministers.
Suddenly recalling the past, everyone shuddered.
The emperor’s tough attitude proves that there is really no room for maneuver in this matter.
A group of ministers have already made preparations for the Beiting army to invade.
Emperor Jingwen thought the same way, so he appointed officials to the Ministry of War and the Ministry of Works, according to their expertise.
In such a special period, the lowest of the eight was a seventh-rank assistant professor at the Imperial College, and the highest was a sixth-rank deputy director of the Secretariat, so their starting point was quite high.
On the other hand, Emperor Jingwen dispatched troops and horses and was on high alert at the border.
Even the eldest prince was ready to go on an expedition here.
However, what Emperor Jingwen and his ministers never expected was that, instead of getting angry, Beiting did not even mention the killing of the two generals’ sons and so many guards. What’s more, Beiting even sent a princess to marry, which was truly the first time in history.
According to the spies, the princess’s team is already on the way.
It was the State of Chen that suffered great misfortune and became the fat meat in the eyes of Beiting.
Anyone showing any sign of cowardice at this time will be chosen and become a target prey.
Such a change made everyone in the court excited.
It turns out that even someone as tough as Beiting has to give in sometimes.
Some ministers suddenly realized that in today’s world, perhaps they needed a crown prince with equally strong skills and attitude as the future emperor, so that Beiting could not be easily bullied.
The strategy of appeasement does not seem to be of much use to this group of barbarians. Their politeness will only be regarded by Beiting as weakness.
The prince watched this scene in the court. After returning to the East Palace, he couldn’t help himself and slowly closed his eyes.
Then, there was news that the Sixth Prince wanted to marry Prime Minister He.
The thing that Ye Shuo was most worried about finally happened.
His brothers were too smart. Once they saw an opportunity, they would not give him time to find a solution to the problem.
Before he could move, they had already moved.

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Like
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo had a fever for several days in a row, and when he finally recovered, he was still asking people here about what the prince had not told him in the court, but a series of explosive news came one after another.
First, Zou Wu and others were given official titles, then Beiting sent a princess to marry, and then the Sixth Prince wanted to marry Prime Minister He’s daughter.
The first two were fine, but when it came to the news about the Sixth Prince, Ye Shuo almost instinctively smelled something wrong.
Especially since the Sixth Prince is only five years older than him, and now he has just turned sixteen. The Crown Prince waited until he was eighteen years old to marry the Crown Princess.
Although people in ancient times got married early, it was not so early. The Sixth Prince’s action seemed like he was preparing for something.
For a feudal country, the issue of succession is also an important assessment for the crown prince.
For example, when Ye Shuo was born, the prince had not yet married or had children, so his birth would affect the prince’s status.
By the time the Queen’s legitimate son was born, the Crown Prince had already married and had successfully given birth to a legitimate son with the Crown Princess. In addition, as he grew older and his status became more secure, even if the Queen gave birth to a legitimate son, it had almost no impact on the Crown Prince.
That’s the difference.If the Sixth Prince wants to get involved, unless he has extraordinary means, a child will save him a lot of effort.
For a prince like him with little capital, it is a huge profit.
If you want to have a child, you have to get married first, right?
That’s why Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly tightened when he heard the news.
Especially since the person the other party was looking for was He Xiang, no one would believe him if he said he didn’t have any ideas.
When Ye Shuo heard the news that the Sixth Prince was going to come to his house tomorrow, his eyes went dark.
Considering the Sixth Prince’s temperament, since the news has already leaked out, it is basically a done deal. Such a cautious person would not make such a move unless he is absolutely sure.
As for why He Xiang agreed, Ye Shuo was not surprised at all.
The Sixth Prince was a ruthless man who dared to scratch his own face with a stone when he was five years old. With a small trick, not only did he let the Fifth Prince take the blame, but he was also successfully adopted by his mother into the Qiuwu Palace. Now that so many years have passed, he must have evolved a long time ago. Prime Minister He is not blind. How could such a cunning person not see the potential in the Sixth Prince?
With such a big change happening in the palace, Ye Shuo could easily find out what happened if he paid a little attention. It was not something so confidential that could not be known to others.
All of this was caused by the arrival and departure of the envoys, as well as the subsequent decisions of Beiting.
The ministers in the court finally tasted the sweetness and now know how to deal with Beiting. Only by fighting violence with violence can they make the other side feel fear and dread.
To fight violence with violence requires extremely strong measures.
The Crown Prince’s attitude was not that he was not tough, but that he had no say. The eldest prince’s toughness was the real toughness. He had the ability to make the envoy retreat, but could the Crown Prince? The Crown Prince’s words were just empty words.
Under such a comparison, the balance in everyone’s hearts would naturally tip towards the eldest prince.
As one grows stronger, the other weakens, and disputes are bound to arise between the two.
If a person does not move, it is fine. But once a person moves, even a saint will reveal his flaws.
Ye Shuo guessed that the Sixth Prince acted so quickly because he anticipated that if this continued, the two would inevitably make mistakes.
As for Prime Minister He, he is not stupid. If the Sixth Prince can see it, then he can too.
The position of the crown prince is shaken, and it is not certain who will ascend the throne in the future. As the saying goes, a new emperor appoints new ministers. He Xiang’s term of office has come to an end with Emperor Jingwen, and when the next emperor comes, unless the succession is a normal one, the next emperor will also have his own team during the entire process. It is like when Emperor Jingwen ascended the throne, almost all the people in the court were replaced.
If He Xiang does not want to be replaced, or wants to continue to maintain the glory of his family, he can only start choosing sides.
He Xiang has worked hard to climb to his current position, so how can he allow his family and descendants to fall into depravity?
