So Prime Minister He and the Sixth Prince hit it off right away.
Although the eldest prince is in the limelight now, he already has a principal wife and a concubine. How can the daughter of the prime minister be his concubine?
In addition, He Xiang felt that the Sixth Prince, who could see through the key at a glance, might not be a bad person.
For a moment, Ye Shuo felt a splitting headache.
He was just ill for a while, but how come his group of brothers suddenly gave him a blowout attack?
Ye Shuo was terrified, still fearing that the Crown Prince would be forced to take action because of this incident, but the Sixth Prince had already arrived.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to listen to what the Sixth Prince had to say first.
But what can the Sixth Prince say?
Although he had already made an agreement with He Xiang in private, he certainly couldn’t say that in public.
The Sixth Prince’s biological mother died early, and he was not very close to his stepmother, the Queen.
The fact that Concubine Rong and the Queen don’t get along is known to everyone in the palace, and the Sixth Prince doesn’t intend to please both sides, so naturally he won’t go to the Queen.
Having lived in Qiuwu Palace for so many years, the Sixth Prince naturally hoped that Concubine Rong would make the decision for him.
Matters between men and women are decided by their parents and the matchmaker’s words. Even if you are a prince, you cannot go beyond the rules of etiquette.
So the Sixth Prince planned to reveal this matter to the Imperial Concubine and ask her to speak for him.
The next day, the Sixth Prince came to visit. After hearing his purpose, Concubine Rong was so shocked that she didn’t even care about the tea in her hand.
How come the child has found someone so soon after leaving the house?
The Sixth Prince’s brain was not kicked by a donkey. All the above were inferred by Ye Shuo based on his understanding of him.
Ye Shuo knew clearly that the Sixth Prince was not an emotional person. It was harder than climbing to the sky to make him fall in love with someone, but others, not even Emperor Jingwen, did not know.
So in the eyes of outsiders, this is a romantic love story of a young man and woman falling in love at first sight.
Seeing Concubine Rong’s constant questioning, the Sixth Prince blushed quickly: “That day, I was also following my fourth brother to do some work, and I happened to meet the Sixth Miss on the way to the temple to burn incense, so…”
Wow, this guy even found witnesses.
The Fourth Prince, who is just a tool, probably doesn’t even know he’s being used by others.
Ye Shuo, who was standing by, almost choked to death on the pastry in his mouth.
The Sixth Prince continued, “I am the sixth among all the brothers, and Miss Six is ​​also the sixth. I feel that we are destined to be together, but it is not good to offend each other, so I thought of asking the concubine to help me ask.”
Listen and see, what a well-educated and polite man, even if he is a prince, he still sticks to etiquette and does not overstep the line.
Coincidentally, the imperial concubine loves to hear this, she loves to hear romantic love stories of young people.
The imperial concubine listened with great interest. After she finished her tea and the story, she didn’t think much about it and said, “Well, since you have this intention, I will ask someone to ask for you.”
Although the imperial concubine was excited, she knew her limits and did not take on too much.
Ye Shuo had basically anticipated the result. The Sixth Miss of the Prime Minister’s Mansion would not have a second answer. Naturally, she would say that she was willing, just like the Sixth Prince.
Ye Shuo sat there, looking at the person who had lived with him for ten years. His face was now filled with a rosy color that seemed real. For a moment, even he couldn’t tell whether it was real or fake.
After getting a positive answer, the Sixth Prince felt relieved. He sat with the imperial concubine for a while, chatting about family matters before leaving.
The moment he walked out of Qiuwu Palace, the redness on his face that was caused by the ridicule gradually faded away.
At this moment, the Sixth Prince suddenly heard a voice behind him –
“Xiao Ming, can you tell me, do you really like that Sixth Miss?”
The voice was very familiar, and the Sixth Prince knew who it was without turning around.
That’s the only person who can call him that.
The Sixth Prince thought this question was a little funny. In the whole palace, only Xiaojiu could ask such a question. Whether they liked it or not, whether it was sincere or not, it was not important to them at all.
Only a naive person would take a matter of feelings as the criterion for choosing a wife.
However, when he heard this question, the Sixth Prince’s eyes could not help but flash before the pretty face of the Sixth Miss of the Prime Minister’s Mansion.
The Sixth Prince didn’t know what love between men and women was, he only knew that he didn’t hate the other person.
So, I guess I like it.
So the Sixth Prince said, “Of course I like it.”
Seeing him turn his head and look into the other person’s still calm eyes, Ye Shuo was suddenly speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Acquaintance
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
For a moment, Ye Shuo really wanted to persuade him to stop fighting. Wouldn’t it be good to live happily?
But at the same time, Ye Shuo also knows that everyone has their own aspirations.
Although he didn’t want to see such a scene, he had no right to stop it.
Everyone in this world has the right to accuse the Sixth Prince of his evil ambitions. A mere bastard even dares to attempt to replace the legitimate son and get involved in the Great Zhou dynasty. But Ye Shuo is the only one who cannot do that.
Unlike modern monogamy, the Sixth Prince’s biological mother, no matter how low her status was, was recorded as the woman of Emperor Jingwen, and the prince she gave birth to was also listed in the royal jade book.
All men are born equal, and when one feels injustice, one should fight for it. As the saying goes, “Are kings, princes, generals, and ministers different in kind?” This slogan was shouted by the ancients more than 2,000 years ago, and it is impossible for Ye Shuo, a modern person, to forget it.
If farmers give birth to farmers, they will be farmers all their lives, and if merchants give birth to small merchants, they will be merchants all their lives, then where is the equality?
People cannot choose their birth, but it is too sad to let people be trapped by their birth all their lives.
Is it wrong for the Sixth Prince to want to go one step further?Ye Shuo couldn’t say anything to persuade him.
Ye Shuo could only watch him leave.
Compared to her son’s inexplicable depression, Concubine Rong was quite happy. Although the Sixth Prince was far less important than her own children, she had raised him for more than ten years after all. Now that the child had grown up and had a girl he liked, Concubine Rong was naturally happy to help arrange things.
“Look at how early your sixth brother has become wise. When you turn sixteen, your mother will definitely choose a prince consort for you.”
While discussing what to do with the two maids, the imperial concubine said this casually.
However, just this one sentence frightened Ye Shuo so much that he almost dropped the bowl in his hand.
“Don’t!” Damn it, arranged marriages are feudal dregs, don’t do that!
Sixteen is the age to go to middle school, Ye Shuo is not such a beast, he won’t do anything to a minor.
Fearing that his mother would arrange a marriage for him early, Ye Shuo had to give a warning: “My future wife must be someone I like.”
“You are young, what do you know? Your mother is an experienced person and can definitely help you pick a good one.” Concubine Rong was full of confidence about this matter.
Ye Shuo: “…”
To be honest, his mother in this life is not as good as his mother in the previous life. Can Ye Shuo trust her?
Besides, although he is a prince now, he will not achieve much in the future. Ambitious girls and their families may not be interested in him. How can he choose girls on the street?
His mother’s idea was a bit too naive.
Ye Shuo finally used his trump card and started rolling on the ground: “No, no, I don’t want it. I want what I like! I won’t get up unless you agree to it, Mom!”
Looking at her brother who was struggling there, the little princess holding a brush couldn’t help but shake her head.
Alas, I’m used to it, but I don’t know when my brother will be able to be as steady as her.
I hope my brother can get rid of this bad habit before he gets married.
Concubine Rong didn’t expect his reaction to be so intense, and couldn’t help but feel unhappy: “Marriage is always decided by parents and matchmakers—”
“But my son just wants to find someone he likes, what’s wrong with that?” Ye Shuo knew that his mother would only respond to soft tactics and not hard ones, so he put his head on his mother’s knees and looked at her eagerly.
“Don’t you want your son to be happy in the future?”
Concubine Rong couldn’t stand it, but she didn’t want to surrender, so she stretched out her finger and tapped her son’s forehead: “How do you know that if you choose the wife you will definitely live a happy life?”
“Maybe my son won’t be able to stay with his wife smoothly until old age, or they may get tired of each other along the way, but at least he won’t regret it.” It is very rare for two people to love each other, and they won’t feel regretful even if they can’t be together until the end.
Ye Shuo is a very free and easy person. If they get along, they will get together. If they don’t, they will separate. There are no twists and turns.
The imperial concubine had never heard such words before and was really shocked for a moment.
After she realised what was going on, she said unhappily, “What if the girl you like is a merchant’s daughter, an ordinary citizen, or a maid in the palace? Wouldn’t this palace have to obey you? What kind of talk is that?”
[1] This palace = she is referring to her title as imperial concubine rong, as the owner of the palace allotted to her
The imperial concubine finally got the point.
Ye Shuo thought about it and finally decided to tell his mother the truth in advance. If he didn’t make it clear in advance, it would be troublesome in the future: “If this is really the case, my son is willing to marry the other party.”
Shocking!
Almost at the moment the words fell, the entire Qiuwu Palace fell silent.
The imperial concubine opened her mouth for a long while, and then her mind suddenly exploded.
“You are trying to piss me off to death!” Perhaps she was really annoyed, she even forgot to call herself Imperial Concubine.
For the first time in her life, the imperial concubine had the urge to teach him a lesson herself.
When Emperor Jingwen arrived, what he saw was the imperial concubine chasing her son around the yard with a rattan stick.
Emperor Jingwen was confused for a moment. In the past, he was the one who took action, and the imperial concubine was always the one who protected him. Why did the situation suddenly turn around today?
The moment he saw his cheap father, Ye Shuo quickly hid behind him.
How could the imperial concubine dare to show her weapon against the emperor? She gritted her teeth and threw away the cane helplessly.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief when he saw this.
Emperor Jingwen raised his eyebrows, looked at the mother and son in a panic, and asked curiously, “What happened? Tell me so that I can hear it too.”
Then Emperor Jingwen soon learned about Ye Shuo’s recent bold words.
Now, even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t laugh anymore.
But Emperor Jingwen quickly realised that this was a good thing.
In the past, Emperor Jingwen was worried that his son would become addicted to women in the future. If he really thought so, at least he wouldn’t have to worry about this for a long time.
As for his words that he would only marry someone he loved and would never marry someone he didn’t like, Emperor Jingwen just listened to them.
Emperor Jingwen himself was a man, so he naturally understood the bad qualities of men. When he reached a certain age, he would choose a good-looking, well-educated, and considerate woman as his wife. After spending time with her day by day, it was hard to believe that he could still endure it.
However, what Emperor Jingwen didn’t know was that Ye Shuo did have physical impulses, and in fact he was a person with very strong desires in his previous life. This was normal, and there was nothing to be embarrassed about admitting.
But the biggest difference between humans and animals is that humans can control their lower body. Ye Shuo doesn’t care what others do. Ye Shuo has his own principles.
He lived like a widower until he was almost thirty in his last life, so it wouldn’t be a big deal to be widowed again in this life, although it would be a bit tragic…
Emperor Jingwen didn’t take his childish son’s words to heart at all.
Seeing that the emperor did not scold him angrily, the imperial concubine was so shocked that it was beyond words.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief when he saw this.
Soon, Emperor Jingwen shifted his attention to the little princess. Seeing that the little princess could concentrate on practising calligraphy in such a noisy environment, Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt relieved.
At least there is someone reliable in Qiuwu Palace.
The father and daughter looked at each other, and the emotions in their eyes were exactly the same.
The imperial concubine only knew a few words, so she naturally couldn’t teach Jianjian. As for her own son, let alone his poor handwriting.
Jianjian didn’t even have anyone who could teach her calligraphy, so she could only practise blindly by herself.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t bear to watch this, so he rolled up his sleeves and taught Jianjian to write a few words just like he had taught Ye Shuo.
And Jianjian gave him much more feedback than Ye Shuo did back then.
Only then did Emperor Jingwen finally find some sense of accomplishment.
Half an hour later, Jianjian put down the brush on time, played with his brother for a while as usual, and then started practising boxing in the yard very consciously.
She is so self-disciplined that she doesn’t look like a child at all.
As Emperor Jingwen watched, he realised that this set of boxing was the one that the eldest prince practised. He thought it was just a play between children, but he didn’t expect the effect to be quite good.
It’s a pity for the emperor’s grandchildren.
After Ye Yan and his brothers got out of school in the afternoon, they were as tired as dead dogs but still had to come to Qiuwu Palace to practise with their aunt.
And the Ninth Prince, clearly, seldom went to school, but he was unwilling to even go to the upper study room to look for them!
Ye Xun was a little embarrassed at first, but as time went by, he gradually integrated into the group. After all, he was the first to arrive, so why should he give in to Ye Yan and the others!
Thinking of this, Ye Xun suddenly felt more justified.
A group of children started competing with each other, and each one of them practised harder than the other. Jianjian felt that as their aunt, it would be embarrassing for her to fall behind, right?
Surrounded by his daughter and grandson, how could Emperor Jingwen, who was a very face-conscious and repressed emperor, resist showing off his talents in front of his children?
When the eldest prince first started practising Kung Fu, he was the one who taught him step by step.
Emperor Jingwen’s boxing skills were very impressive and he immediately earned the admiration of a group of little kids.
“Father, father, you are so awesome!” The little princess Jianjian learned this from her brother and said whatever she wanted to say. Although Ye Yan and Ye Xun were not so explicit, their eyes were also full of stars.
The corners of Emperor Jingwen’s mouth suddenly raised a slight arc.
Emperor Jingwen cleared his throat and began his customary lecture: “Practise hard, and you will be able to do it in the future.”
He saw his son still doing the horse stance slowly, and Emperor Jingwen said, “Don’t be like your brother, and your uncle. Remember that?”
“Remember!”
Ye Shuo: “…”
How come this matter can be linked to him?
Ye Shuo was forced to slowly open his eyes.
Soon Ye Shuo was stunned.
Jianjian and the others were still young and didn’t notice it, but Ye Shuo noticed that his cheap father was slightly out of breath after the set of punches.
Ye Shuo still remembered that three or four years ago, when he bit his cheap father’s ear, he didn’t behave like this.
Once people are over 40, their body functions will begin to decline drastically. My cheap dad, who is already 47 years old this year and will soon be 50, is really not young anymore.
However, all the princes have gradually grown up.
Quickly putting this thought behind his mind, Ye Shuo took out a sandbag and weighed it in his hand.
“Come on, let’s play with sandbags together. It’s just right with so many people, and it will be more fun to play.”
Ha, who wants to play with him?!
Ye Xun and Ye Yan looked at each other almost subconsciously, and the disgust in their hearts was almost overflowing.
However, once you start playing with sandbags, you can’t stop.
Ye Shuo would not give in to them just because they were children.
Looking at the white lime marks on his clothes, Ye Xun’s hands were shaking. For a moment, he even forgot that Emperor Jingwen was there: “Ninth Uncle! You wait!”
Ye Xun almost gritted his teeth as he said this.
However, Ye Shuo’s hands and feet were so nimble that he couldn’t be hit easily by him.
Soon, Ye Yan and his brothers on the side were in trouble.
After a short while, several people started fighting in a group, with sandbags clanging and it felt like stones were being thrown.
Jianjian, who was only four years old, thought about it and decisively withdrew from the battlefield.
Emperor Jingwen and Concubine Rong watched while drinking tea and couldn’t help laughing.
When it got dark at night, the group of people dispersed reluctantly, each of them was covered in a mess that was simply unbearable to look at.
When the four brothers returned, the eldest prince almost spit out the tea in his mouth when he saw their horrible appearance: “Where have you been???”
Ye Yan then felt scared. He curled his lips and gritted his teeth to confess the matter of playing with the sandbags.
The eldest prince smacked his lips and asked only one question: “Did you win or lose?”
“Of course I won!” Is there any need to ask? Ye Xun is only one person, but they have four!
Ye Yan couldn’t help but straighten his chest.
The eldest prince was immediately satisfied.
Compared to them, Ye Xun was not doing so well, after all, he was alone. Frightened, he returned to the East Palace. He wanted to sneak back to his room to change clothes without being noticed, but he ran into his father by chance.
Ye Xun was startled by the figure standing in the dark. When the other person slowly walked into the light and shadow, and he found out that it was none other than his own father, Ye Xun’s heart suddenly rose to his throat.
It’s over, it’s over, it’s all Uncle Ninth’s fault!
Just play with sandbags, why do you have to dip them in white lime!
Looking at his son in tattered clothes, the prince couldn’t help but frown slightly: “What happened? Did you have a fight with someone?”
Ye Xun hurriedly shook his head and tremblingly told the story of how he and Ye Yan and the others smashed sandbags.
Ye Xun thought his father would be angry, but he didn’t expect that after the prince heard it, he said nothing, waved at him, and let him go to take a shower and change clothes.
“Hurry up, dinner will be served soon, and your mother is still waiting.”
Huh? I didn’t get scolded…
As the legitimate son of the Crown Prince, Ye Xun naturally knew the recent situation in the Eastern Palace, so Ye Xun subconsciously felt that his father would not be happy about him playing with his uncle’s son.
But he didn’t seem to care much.
Ye Xun couldn’t help but look back again. For some reason, he always felt that his father’s figure standing in the courtyard seemed a little thin.
But my father is the prince, how could he be weak?
Ye Xun shook his head and quickly put this thought behind him.
In the blink of an eye, another five or six days passed.
Fearing that someone might gossip, the imperial concubine waited for a few more days before summoning the young lady of the prime minister’s residence to the palace for a chat.
The Sixth Miss is the daughter of the Young Madam, and the granddaughter of Prime Minister He. The Imperial Concubine has instructed the Young Madam to bring the Sixth Miss along as well. Anyone with a discerning eye can tell what is going on.
The imperial concubine’s actions this time were not very volatile, and only a few people knew about it.
Ye Shuo is only eleven years old now. Although boys and girls are not allowed to sit at the same table as each other at the age of seven, it is not necessary to be shy about it. So, when the young lady of the prime minister’s mansion came in, Ye Shuo saw the girl following behind at a glance.
After seeing the other person’s face clearly, Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment.
The Sixth Miss suddenly came to the palace. She didn’t want to talk much today. Besides, she herself was not a talkative person. As a result…
Miss Six has a good memory. Even though she hasn’t seen him for many years, she can still vaguely recognize Ye Shuo.
Perhaps because she was too surprised, Miss Six almost blurted out: “Little beggar?”

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Engagement
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The young lady did not expect her daughter, who had always been steady, to say such a thing to the Ninth Prince. She inevitably felt nervous, so she could not help but say, “Tan’er, don’t be rude.”
He Wutan knew that she was being rude, so she quickly bowed to Ye Shuo and said, “I am sorry for my rudeness, Ninth Prince, please forgive me.”
I was really out of my mind. I actually mistook the prince for a little beggar whom I had only met once.
The reason why He Wutan had such a deep impression of the little beggar was not only because she had a good memory, but also because he was the most polite little beggar she had ever seen.
Ye Shuo had recognized the other person at first sight, but he didn’t expect it to be such a coincidence that Xiao Ming fell in love with her.
After many twists and turns, the two will eventually become a family.
Seeing that the Sixth Miss of He family seemed a little embarrassed, Ye Shuo hurriedly said, “It’s me, you didn’t recognize the wrong person.”
Now it was He Wutan’s turn to be stunned: “How could it be…”
The young lady standing by and the imperial concubine who came out after hearing the noise were both confused.How come these two people seem to know each other?
Ye Shuo cleared his cough and waited until everyone came into the house before describing the whole story of how he disguised himself as a beggar to test Mr. Cao.
Hearing that the girl in front of her not only bought buns for her son, but also wanted to take him to the prime minister’s residence and make him a servant, the imperial concubine couldn’t help but laugh and cry, and immediately she had a better impression of He Wutan.
She was so young, but she still had compassion for a little beggar, so I guess she must be a good person.
When He Wutan saw the imperial concubine’s smile, her face turned red.
The young lady was also surprised and could not help but glance at the Ninth Prince next to her. Normally, the young lady had only heard her father-in-law mention the name of the Ninth Prince, and now she finally saw how unorthodox he was.
But because Ye Shuo was doing good things, if it weren’t for him, the granddaughter of the Grand Tutor would have jumped into the fire pit, so the young lady did not have any bad impression of Ye Shuo.
As Ye Shuo talked more and more, the relationship between the Imperial Concubine and the Young Madam gradually became warmer. They were completely different from the others who were very reserved when they first met.
“It seems like we are destined to be together.” The imperial concubine couldn’t help but sigh.
The imperial concubine had previously asked someone to inquire about the basic situation of the sixth young lady in the prime minister’s mansion. At first, the imperial concubine was a little dissatisfied because the other party was older than the sixth prince, probably two or three years older.
This was a little hard for the imperial concubine to accept, as she believed that in a marriage, the man should be older than the woman. However, since the Sixth Prince had clearly expressed his love for her, the imperial concubine could not refuse him, so she thought about meeting her in person.
Fortunately, I saw it with my own eyes. This Sixth Young Miss is indeed quite good. She is well-educated, quiet and yet generous. It is obvious that she is being trained according to the standards of a mistress of the house in the Prime Minister’s Mansion. Although she is still a little short of becoming an imperial concubine, there is still time for her to learn.
From this perspective, the fact that the other party is a few years older doesn’t mean much.
The imperial concubine asked a few more general questions, and the Sixth Miss answered them all fluently. From the imperial concubine’s point of view, this girl was better than herself in many aspects, so the imperial concubine was naturally very satisfied.
Seeing that the imperial concubine was not angry because of her knowledge, He Wutan also breathed a sigh of relief.
Even though the Sixth Prince was not registered under the name of the Imperial Concubine, she had raised him for many years after all. If she and the Sixth Prince really got married in the future, she would have to treat the Imperial Concubine as his mother-in-law.
The imperial concubine seemed to be a generous person, and she was not as arrogant and domineering as rumoured, and she wouldn’t not allow others to be ahead of her.
When the imperial concubine asked He Wutan what books she read, she first carefully mentioned “The Book of Songs”, “The Analects of Confucius” and “The Great Learning”. She thought the imperial concubine would be unhappy. On the one hand, it was because the imperial concubine did not like reading, and He Wutan thought she also did not like other women reading. On the other hand, ordinary people believe that a woman’s virtue lies in her lack of talent, and if she wanted to marry a prince, it was natural that she had to be gentle and obedient.
However, what He Wutan didn’t expect was that the imperial concubine didn’t show any dissatisfaction at all. Instead, she smiled and said, “That’s just right. I like scholars.”
Maybe she thinks what she lacks is good. Anyway, the imperial concubine has always envied those women who have read a lot, such as Concubine De, who is even more enviable.
The most important thing is that the Sixth Prince also likes reading, and the two of them happen to have a common language. Otherwise, the relationship between husband and wife will not last long.
Of course, it was impossible for the imperial concubine to mention the Sixth Prince at this time. Everyone knew it, and mentioning it so bluntly would only make people embarrassed.
Ye Shuo who was standing by still remembered that when they met in front of Baoyu Pavilion, this Sixth Miss was already a young girl. Now, five or six years have passed, and she should be older than Xiao Ming.
Ye Shuo listened in and found that it was indeed true. He Wutan was indeed older than the Sixth Prince.
Moreover, she had cancelled a marriage before, so it had been delayed until now.
There were other young ladies younger than her in the prime minister’s mansion, but Xiao Ming just fell for her.
Inadvertently, Ye Shuo suddenly remembered what he had said to Xiao Ming when he was reading medical books in the garden when his mother was pregnant.
Ye Shuo once told the Sixth Prince in person that the best childbearing age for women is between 23 and 30 years old. They cannot be too young, otherwise there will be great risks during childbirth.
Ye Shuo didn’t know whether the other party took these words to heart and found the Sixth Miss. He also didn’t know whether he was considering the mother or the future child. In such an ancient environment, he chose He Wutan, who was three years older than him.
But at least he didn’t attack a child of thirteen or fourteen years old, so he didn’t commit a serious sin.
Although the Sixth Young Miss of the Prime Minister’s Mansion is only nineteen and not yet twenty years old, she is safer after all.
After asking He Wutan, what remained was the communication between the two elders, the Imperial Concubine and the Young Madam.
It happened that the little Princess Jianjian woke up and saw a stranger in the room. Instead of feeling scared, she looked curious.
Jianjian has been trained by Ye Shuo now, and she has become very outgoing. She is not shy at all and even dares to take the initiative to hold He Wutan’s hand and let He Wutan take her to the yard to play.
Apart from the imperial concubine and concubine Zhao, Jianjian played with a group of boys every day. It was natural that she was quite excited when she finally met a young girl.
The imperial concubine took advantage of the situation and drove the group of children out.
Jianjian is not stupid and she soon figured out He Wutan’s identity. But as a child, she has no sense of propriety when it comes to words and says whatever she thinks.
“Are you my sixth brother’s future wife?”
Hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but hold his forehead: “Jianjian.”
The news hasn’t even been revealed yet. If it gets out, it will damage Sixth Miss’s reputation.
“Don’t talk nonsense.”
Jianjian looked at He Wutan’s slightly embarrassed face again, and immediately realised that she had said the wrong thing. But she was really curious, so she shook off all the Sixth Prince in one breath.
“My sixth brother said he likes you, do you like him?”
Ye Shuo didn’t say anything this time. To be honest, he also wanted to know this question.
He Wutan was stunned at first, then smiled and said nothing.
She and the Sixth Prince were only together because of the family’s intention. Besides, the cancellation of the engagement was not a pleasant thing at the time. Since she was deeply loved by the Sixth Prince, he was now her best choice.
He Wutan had nothing to be dissatisfied with.
When Ye Shuo saw her smile, he immediately understood.
Logically speaking, since Xiao Ming was not really moved, it would be a good thing for the Sixth Miss not to be moved either. However, for some reason, Ye Shuo felt a little sad.
He may never be able to adapt to the royal marriage life.
Jianjian didn’t insist on not getting an answer, and she quickly started talking about other things with her future sister-in-law.
He Wutan immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
The little princess’s question almost made her unable to cope.
It was not until Jianjian started talking about other things that He Wutan was surprised to find that although the little princess was young, she had read a lot of books. From time to time, she would utter a few idioms and familiar articles. He Wutan was finally convinced that what the imperial concubine said just now was not just polite talk.
Being able to let the princess go to school and study like a boy, I think her life will be good.
The last bit of repulsion in He Wutan’s heart dissipated in an instant.
As expected, almost the next day after He Wutan returned to the Prime Minister’s Residence, an imperial edict came from the palace.
According to the calculations of the Sitian Monitoring Bureau, the wedding date of He Wutan and the Sixth Prince was set for half a year later.
Soon, the Sixth Prince heard the news that Xiaojiu was familiar with his future wife.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Princess
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
When the Sixth Prince heard the news, his first reaction was, how did Xiao Jiu know the Sixth Miss?
How could he know her?
Thinking about it later, considering Xiaojiu’s personality of being able to chat with anyone, it didn’t seem like a particularly strange thing.
The engagement was finally settled, and the Sixth Prince felt relieved.
He was going to get married in half a year, so the Sixth Prince should have been nervous, but he only had a slight emotional fluctuation when the news came, and he quickly calmed down.
But the Sixth Prince still pretended to be excited.
As a result, when the Fourth Prince saw him the next day, he couldn’t help but tease him, and finally made the Sixth Prince blush, and then he let him go.
After the Fourth Prince left, the embarrassment in the Sixth Prince’s eyes in the room instantly disappeared.
There is still half a year left. I hope nothing goes wrong during this period.As for the choice of the prince’s wife, in fact, the Sixth Miss is not the best choice. The saying that they are both sixth in the family means that they are destined to be together is nonsense. It is just a nice thing to say.
Originally, the Sixth Prince’s plan was to marry several other young ladies who were not engaged. However, when he was discussing it with Prime Minister He, what Xiao Jiu had said inadvertently flashed through his mind.
If the woman is too young, the risks are extremely high for both the mother and the child.
The child was just making up stories, and the Sixth Prince did not believe it at first. However, his goal was to have a healthy child after all, so he finally investigated it with the attitude of believing it was true rather than not.
It is found to be true, for example, for women who get married and have children at the age of thirteen or fourteen, the probability of both the child and the mother surviving at the same time is much lower than that of women over the age of seventeen or eighteen.
And such an important matter had never been discovered before.
The Sixth Prince finally chose the Sixth Miss who had been broken off from engagement in the Prime Minister’s Mansion.
He couldn’t give up his obsession to climb up, so he could only choose the best one within the range of options.
As for whether to cancel the engagement or not, the Sixth Prince doesn’t care.
As the days passed, there was no change in the life of the Sixth Prince. Every day he went to court, returned to the six ministries, and returned to the Prince’s Mansion. Every once in a while, he would come to the palace to visit the Imperial Concubine. At night, he would read for an hour as usual before going to bed.
The Sixth Prince’s day is packed with activities, and he even studies harder than when he was studying. When Ye Shuo found out about this, he didn’t know what to say.
Since he is planning to have a child, he is still so busy and doesn’t have enough time to rest. With his physical condition, there is no way he can have a child.
Some people always think that having a child is a woman’s business alone, but they don’t know that if the father of the child is not good, no matter how hard they try, it will be in vain.
The quality of the child’s father is the key factor in whether the child is healthy or not.
Not only women, but men also have an optimal childbearing age.
Miss Six has a ruddy complexion, a steady and long breath, a well-proportioned body, and strong and clean teeth. She is obviously in good health, so the only difficulty lies with Xiao Ming himself.
But the problem is that Xiao Ming himself doesn’t think so. He still feels that he is in good health, it’s just that his martial arts skills are not as good as those of the eldest prince. He has no self-awareness at all.
That’s right, let alone in ancient times, even if this happens in modern times, few men think that being unable to have children is their own problem.
In this situation, the only one who would suffer is Miss Six.
However, the Sixth Prince’s purpose of getting married was not simple, and for a moment Ye Shuo didn’t know whether he should tell him about this matter.
Just when Ye Shuo was struggling, the princess sent by Beiting for marriage finally arrived.
The princess is now only in her twenties, and is in the prime of her beauty, just like a blooming flower. She has a wild beauty that the women of the Great Zhou do not have. Her skin is not as fair as those of the women of the Great Zhou, but a very healthy honey color.
As soon as the other party showed up, she swept across a large area of ​​the harem with her unique energy alone.
After all, Concubine Rong is not a saint. Even though she is a concubine, she can’t help but feel a slight sense of crisis in her heart.
It would be fine under normal circumstances, but the key point is that this princess doesn’t look like a peaceful person. Her big eyes keep roaming around Emperor Jingwen at the top of the table, which makes the imperial concubine feel chest tightness and shortness of breath.
The other person is young and beautiful, wouldn’t the imperial concubine be jealous?
However, that would have been the end of it. When Princess Huyan’s gaze fell on Ye Shuo, the imperial concubine realised what it meant to be truly horrified.
The previous jealousy suddenly disappeared, and the imperial concubine’s vigilance was aroused in an instant.
She would rather the other party had her eyes on Emperor Jingwen than have her set her sights on Shuo’er.
Forget it, becoming a concubine is much better than becoming my own daughter-in-law.
This kind of good thing should be left for His Majesty to enjoy slowly.
Ye Shuo also noticed the princess’s abnormality. When he saw the hint of temptation in her eyes, Ye Shuo was completely stunned.
I am still a child!
This beast!
At first, Ye Shuo wondered if he was too narcissistic and had seen it wrong, but after observing for a while, he found that it was indeed not his illusion.
But at the same time, Ye Shuo didn’t think that the other party really liked him. To be honest, he was born with a good face in his life, all thanks to his parents’ good genes, but the problem was that he was young. How could a primary school student have any charm?
It was just a hint from Beiting.
It seems that these guys are still determined to cause trouble in the Great Zhou. Even in this situation, they refuse to give up.
Emperor Jingwen also noticed that Princess Huyan glanced at his son from time to time, which frightened the usually active little bastard so much that he hid behind him like a quail, and no longer dared to talk nonstop as usual.
Emperor Jingwen thought it was a little funny at first, but after he realised what was going on, he couldn’t help feeling angry.
Of course, this anger was not directed at Ye Shuo, but at Bei Ting being shameless.
His son is so young now. If he was really seduced by Princess Huyan of Beiting, he would have lost his virginity at an early age, and his life would be ruined.
The people of Beiting really have the heart to kill!
Emperor Jingwen then looked at his other sons, including the eldest prince. Anyone who was caught in his sight could not help but become very nervous.
Although beautiful women are beautiful, they are not lucky enough to enjoy them.
Keeping her in the backyard is unsafe, and marrying her as the principal wife would mean cutting off their path to further advancement. It is not cost-effective no matter how you think about it, so it is better to leave this good thing to my father.
Emperor Jingwen read this meaning from the looks of his sons: “…”
For the first time in his life, Emperor Jingwen experienced the pain of forcing women into his harem.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to finally decide to take the princess into the harem.
After all, she was a princess who symbolised the diplomatic relations between the two countries. In the end, Emperor Jingwen conferred her the title of Ronghua, a fourth-rank official, which was neither too high nor too low, and gave an explanation to Beiting without being particularly formal.
If nothing unexpected happens, Princess Huyan will have to stay in Ronghua’s position for the rest of her life.
It would be fine if she could live a peaceful life. The palace does not need her. Her status is there, and Emperor Jingwen will not treat her unfairly.
But if she is restless, that’s another story.
The Queen, on the other hand, could not help but feel a pity in her heart. She was thinking that it would be better if the princess asked to marry the Ninth Prince.
The Ninth Prince is now eleven years old, and the princess is already twenty years old. The nine-year age difference between them is actually nothing. If Beiting insists, if it succeeds, the Ninth Prince will be crippled.
Based on what the Ninth Prince had done before, Beiting would definitely find ways to avenge him, and destroying the Ninth Prince would be a piece of cake by then.
Unfortunately, Emperor Jingwen loved his son very much. Beiting had just been shocked and did not dare to provoke Da Zhou again. Princess Huyan was very prudent and did not dare to mention it at all.
In Princess Huyan’s mind, even if she became a concubine, what would it matter? This additional identity would not hinder her actions.
After all, Princess Huyan was married to a foreign prince, and the Beiting envoy had done such a thing in Shangjing City before. The Sitianjian didn’t even give her a good day, but just randomly picked a day, and then Princess Huyan was carried from the post house to the palace in a sedan chair.
The Beiting envoys who escorted the princess to the capital had never suffered such an insult, but because of what happened before, they dared not say anything.
When the people in the capital saw this scene, they felt extremely happy.
Seeing this group of people, the brave ones even dared to throw rotten eggs and rotten vegetable leaves at them in the street.
The emperor’s attitude determines the attitude of the court to a certain extent, and the attitude of the court determines the courage of the people.
Last time, the emperor said to kill the guards of the post station, and he killed them all in one breath. Rotten eggs and rotten vegetable leaves were really not a big deal, so the Jingzhao Yin only took symbolic care of it and turned a blind eye to it.
After so many years, the people in Shangjing City finally got their revenge.
The people know clearly what foundation all this is built on.
Because they won the battle, and why did they win the battle? The answer is self-evident.
When the eldest prince returned with his troops, his majestic and vigorous appearance as he sat on horseback was seen by most of the people in the capital.
The envoys from Beiting were upset but helpless. Finally, after sending the princess to the palace, they left in disgrace.
On the other hand, after Princess Huyan entered the palace, the Queen treated her very well at first, and it would not be an exaggeration to even describe her as friendly.
The queen completely ignored the identity of the enemy princess and believed that the Ninth Prince killed their Major General, so Beiting must be resentful. It was also because of the Ninth Prince that Emperor Jingwen ordered the killing of so many of their guards, and it was also because of the Ninth Prince that Beiting suffered such a great humiliation.
The enemy of my enemy should be my friend.
However, what the Queen did not know was that although Beiting hated the Ninth Prince and would kill him if given the chance, Beiting’s target had never been a single person, but the entire Great Zhou.
The more chaotic the Great Zhou and the Chen Kingdom are, the more beneficial it will be to Beiting.
Princess Huyan noticed the Queen’s thoughts in time, so she went with the flow and pretended to be at odds with the Ninth Prince, taking the opportunity to get close to the Queen.
What the queen didn’t know was that the ally she thought she had, one day, by chance, saw the little prince playing there alone.
Princess Huyan’s mind moved, and she slowly squatted down in front of the little prince.

chapters.title: Chapter 151: Approaching
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
A long time has passed since the last time the little prince fell ill after being caught in the rain.
The little prince had been weak to begin with, and had been ill intermittently, with no signs of recovery. Now that he had finally recovered, the queen was finally willing to let him out.
The little prince has long been accustomed to being alone. He has never had any friends of the same age around him. There are only palace maids, nannies and young eunuchs around him.
It seemed like the eldest prince and other adult princes didn’t take him seriously at all, and even ignored him when they met. Every time the little prince saw the contemptuous looks from the eldest prince and the others, he couldn’t help but shudder.
In their eyes, I am like garbage, and I feel redundant even when they look at me.
The eldest prince has always disdained to flatter the queen, so naturally he is too lazy to pay much attention to her children.
As for the Second Prince and the Crown Prince, they showed more sympathy and pity for the little prince than for others, which made the little prince feel suffocated.
As for the Tenth and Eleventh Princes, who were not much older than him, because of their low birth, every time the Queen saw her son hanging out with the two princes who were destined to be abandoned, she could not help but get furious, thinking that her son was a loser who only knew how to play with trash.
Those who are with trash are destined to be trash themselves.As for the few grandchildren of the emperor? The queen was afraid that these people would harm her son, so she did not allow them to have any contact with each other. As time went by, the little prince was left alone.
Since he was born, the little prince has never played with toys or had any friends. He is surrounded by a group of palace maids and eunuchs all day long, as if he is in a cage. He is scolded by the queen many times, so he is inevitably very silent.
And ever since he was frightened by General Lanruo’s head last time, no one comforted him in time, so now the little prince is not only weak, but also surrounded by a gloomy aura.
Physical condition is closely related to mental condition. If you cannot relieve your emotions in time, it will be a double torture.
From beginning to end, no one taught the little prince how to be happy. What’s more, he didn’t even know what happiness was.
Even Princess Huyan was startled the moment the little prince raised his head.
What kind of look is that!
He looked lifeless and didn’t look like a child of only four or five years old at all.
Princess Huyan’s heart beat twice, and then she quickly smiled: “Who are you? Why are you here alone?”
It stands to reason that the Queen Mother would not leave the little prince alone, but the little prince is a living person after all, not a machine. He naturally has his own ideas, so now and then he will deliberately shake off the palace maids and eunuchs who follow him, and buy himself a chance to catch his breath.
The little prince didn’t know why he did this, he just knew that if no one followed him, he would feel much happier.
Only at this time did he have a rare chance to catch his breath.
Now, seeing a stranger for the first time, the little prince was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously looked towards the rockery cave not far away.
Princess Huyan reacted quickly and thought that he must have been hiding in the cave, thus avoiding the sight of the palace people.
Faced with Princess Huyan’s question, the little prince remained silent.
Seeing that the child opposite her had her mouth tightly shut and didn’t even look at her, as if trying to avoid looking at her, Princess Huyan changed her mind and pretended to be angry, then threatened: “If you don’t speak again, I will call for help.”
Having said that, she was about to stand up.
And this trick really worked. The little prince in front of him panicked and subconsciously tried to grab the corner of her clothes.
Princess Huyan’s movements were not very big to begin with, so he naturally caught her in the act. With the corners of her lips slightly raised, Princess Huyan smiled and said, “Now, can you finally tell me who you are?”
But in fact, Princess Huyan already knew about the little prince’s identity. When she was in the Queen’s Palace, she had met him several times by chance.
So when she saw the other person, she stopped subconsciously.
The Queen of the Great Zhou was not without desires; on the contrary, she was an extremely ambitious woman.
Princess Huyan, who was equally ambitious, smelled the scent of her own kind almost as soon as she saw the other person, so Princess Huyan acted submissive in front of the queen.
Princess Huyan is not afraid of ambitious people. The more ambitious they are, the happier she is. She is only afraid of meeting those who are timid and content with the status quo. She really has no idea where to start with such people.
The little prince had not communicated with anyone for a long time, and he spoke haltingly. After holding back for a long time, he finally said, “I am… the thirteenth prince…”
“Well, what’s your name?” asked Princess Huyan.
“My name is Hu Yanjin.”
Faced with the stranger’s sudden enthusiasm, the little prince couldn’t help but stammer: “Ye, Ye Wuji…”
The little prince’s name was chosen by the queen herself. He was born unhealthy and had illness, so naturally she hoped that he would be as healthy as the other princes.
The two-character name just happens to be in line with the eldest prince and the crown prince.
“What are you playing? I know a really fun game. Why don’t I teach you?” Since Princess Huyan was planning to get close to the little prince, she naturally didn’t care about his timidity.
The little prince subconsciously wanted to refuse, but Princess Huyan took his hand without any explanation.
Since the little prince was born, no one had ever been so gentle to him. The little prince, who was only four or five years old, could not tell the truth from the false and was subconsciously stunned.
So, so warm…
While the child was distracted, Princess Huyan taught him several small games that were popular in Beiting.
Gradually, the little prince became addicted to Princess Huyan’s gentle and compassionate gaze.
Completely different from other people, when she looked at him, it seemed as if there was only room for him. This made the little prince subconsciously open his eyes wide, feeling very incredible.
How could someone like me…
However, happy times are always short-lived. After a while, the little prince caught a glimpse of palace maids and eunuchs rushing towards him from the corner of his eye.
“The little prince is here, the little prince is here!”
The little prince was startled and immediately broke free from the illusion, subconsciously pushing Princess Huyan.
Princess Huyan grew up on the grasslands of Beiting. Since she had the blood of the Wolf King flowing in her veins, she was naturally as sensitive as a wolf. She noticed the movement in the distance long before the little prince.
Just when the little prince thought that this time would be like the past, he would be discovered by his mother and the matter would end hastily.
The little prince was ready to be scolded and humiliated, but at this moment, he suddenly heard a voice in his ear –
“Remember the pattern I just taught you, little prince. I’ll play with you next time.”
Almost at the moment the words fell, Princess Huyan disappeared.
Then, the palace maids and eunuchs arrived breathlessly. They came late, so naturally they didn’t meet Princess Huyan.
Every time the little prince escaped, it was these palace servants who were punished. At the very least, they would be slapped in the face, while at the worst, they would be beaten with a stick. Over time, even the palace servants would feel resentful.
They blamed the queen for being unkind and the little prince for being disobedient.
Even though the palace maids didn’t dare to say it out loud, how could the little prince, who was so sensitive, not feel it?
He seemed to be born to be disliked.
If it had happened before, the little prince would naturally feel extremely painful, but this time, for some reason, when he thought about the next time the princess would come to see him again, the little prince suddenly felt less uncomfortable.
What’s more, he even felt a faint sense of anticipation in his heart.
For the first time, he began to look forward to the coming day.
The little prince left here reluctantly as his wet nurse suppressed her impatience and resentment. Before leaving, he subconsciously glanced at the rockery cave, and a trace of worry suddenly crossed his mind.
After about a moment, Princess Huyan came out from the corner, feeling extremely satisfied.
Although the queen’s legitimate son is young, being young has its advantages. He is easier to control and is less vigilant.
Princess Huyan originally wanted to work hard on other princes, but now it seems that there is no need.
Soon, Princess Huyan left with satisfaction.
In the blink of an eye, another five or six days passed.
Ye Shuo took Jian Jian to Zhao Chongrong’s palace to have a meal as usual. Then he found that Xu Chongyi, who had always been very happy to see them, was unusually absent-minded this time.
Even if Jianjian was trying to act funny and make Xu Chongyi laugh, Xu Chongyi’s smile was extremely forced.
But if Ye Shuo remembered correctly, Xu Chongyi seemed to be the niece of the Empress Dowager? She had no children, but her status was not low, so she should not have any worries.
After all, Ye Shuo and Empress Zhao and the others have known each other for seven or eight years since the mahjong game, so it’s inevitable that Ye Shuo would show some concern.
Xu Chongyi hesitated for a moment before slowly explaining the whole story.
Only then did Ye Shuo realize that it was an old cat that Xu Chongyi had kept in her palace that was missing.
Zhao Chongrong and Li Chongyuan had never kept a pet, so they didn’t know the significance of a pet to its owner and didn’t take the matter seriously. They thought the cat might have run away because it was playing, and it might find itself back in a couple of days, so they spoke to comfort the cat.
But Ye Shuo had raised both dogs and cats in his previous life, and he knew in his heart that after raising cats and dogs for nearly ten years, they were no longer just pets. No wonder Xu Chongyi was so worried.
What’s more, before he and Jianjian appeared, this cat had always been with Xu Chongyi.
So Ye Shuo wiped his mouth without saying anything and said, “It just so happens that I’m tired of playing sandbags with Ye Xun, Ye Yan and the others recently, and I’m just about to change to a new game. Today, when they get out of school, I might as well help Madam Xu find the cat.”
Xu Chongyi was stunned. How could a small person like her have such a big face when asking the prince and grandson to find a cat…
However, Ye Shuo patted his chest and said, “Don’t worry, I’ll take care of it.”
Seeing Ye Shuo so persistent and not even bothering to do it, Xu Chongyi was both touched and happy.
“well……”

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Half a Year
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Xu Chongyi’s cat’s name is Tuan Tuan, and she adopted it from the Beast Taming House in the Ministry of Internal Affairs ten years ago.
Xu Chongyi has raised Tuantuan for ten years, but Tuantuan is not just ten years old. Tuantuan was already an adult cat when she brought him home.
Its previous owner was a concubine in the palace. The concubine died of illness, and she couldn’t bear to see Tuantuan become a wild cat, so she returned it to the Beast Taming House. Then, because of Tuantuan’s good personality, it was adopted by Xu Chongyi after many twists and turns.
And now Tuantuan has disappeared without a trace, how can Xu Chongyi not be anxious?
“We haven’t seen it like this normally, so the people around us were a little careless and let it run away without paying attention.” Cats and dogs like to run outside, and Xu Chongyi was particularly careful at first, but as time went on, there were always omissions. When talking about this, Xu Chongyi couldn’t help feeling annoyed.
Ye Shuo hurriedly comforted him, “Don’t worry, don’t worry, maybe he got lost. I’ll take people to look for him later.”
When the time was almost up, Ye Shuo took Jian Jian straight to the study.
At the time of Shen, Ye Xun, Ye Yan and others came out of the study. The moment they saw Ye Shuo, the five of them were stunned at first, and then became excited.
Today the sun rose from the west, and today the Ninth Prince actually came to pick them up from school!However, after they understood what he wanted to do with them, Ye Xun and Ye Yan immediately felt that it was just as they expected.
The Ninth Prince was indeed not the kind of uncle who would love his nephews. It turned out that he wanted to ask them to do hard labor.
“How can a grandson of the emperor go to look for an old cat?” Ye Yan shouted in dissatisfaction.
No one noticed that when the little prince passing by heard the word “cat”, his whole body became stiff.
Before Ye Shuo looked over, the little prince quickly buried his head.
Although the three of them did not get along well with the Queen, the little prince was innocent after all, and the child was quite pitiful. Ye Shuo had never seen him smile.
Ye Shuo is also a human being, and sometimes he has the same hypocritical problem as others. When hostile people do not threaten him, he is willing to show his kindness.
So when he saw the little prince, Ye Shuo greeted him casually.
However, the little prince did not feel happy, but his eyes were full of fear.
Ye Shuo thought he had scared him, so he quickly took two steps back.
The little prince almost fled away from here.
The other party’s cowering look made Ye Yan and the others look down upon him even more. Just like this, is he still a legitimate son? Huh.
“Okay, don’t be dissatisfied. Come and help us. It will be dark soon.” Ye Shuo patted their heads one by one.
The Ninth Prince is so rude. Please, they are the emperor’s grandsons. Their fathers are a prince and a crown prince respectively. Even though he doesn’t need to be too cautious as an uncle, he still has to observe basic etiquette, right?
It’s a shame to order them around like this every day.
However, Ye Xun and Ye Yan are just like this. It’s nothing more than simplicity and freedom.
Only when they are with the Ninth Prince can they do whatever they want and say whatever they want.
Therefore, although Ye Xun and Ye Yan were cursing, their actions were not slow and no one knew what they were trying to do.
“Okay, including Jianjian, whoever finds Tuan Tuan first will be the winner today.” Ye Shuo doesn’t make special arrangements, he always treats everyone equally. As for himself, who has ever seen a referee leave the court with a contestant?
“Humph! Uncle Nine, you are so boring.” Who would work hard for something like this!
The four Ye Yan brothers said these things, but their actions were completely different.
Children have more energy and are no less efficient than adults.
Besides, Tuan Tuan was an old cat and he couldn’t run far, so the group started from Xu Chongyi’s palace and then spread out to the surrounding areas.
Cats are different from dogs. Dogs will make marks along the way, but cats are timid and easily frightened by passers-by, so they panic and lose their way, and in the end they don’t even know where they are going.
Now that three whole days had passed, Tuantuan must have been extremely hungry. Ye Shuo took the meat jerky that Xu Chongyi had given him, which was Tuantuan’s favorite, and called Tuantuan’s name.
But what was surprising was that after so many people had been searching for almost an hour, they still couldn’t find any trace of Tuantuan.
However, many other wild cats were found.
There was boredom in the palace, and many people kept cats and dogs. Sometimes they were not abandoned intentionally, but because the owners of the cats and dogs had an accident, or were demoted, or were sent to the cold palace, or died of illness, and they could not take care of the cats and dogs when they could not take care of themselves.
Cats and dogs reproduce quickly, and even though the palace guards would kill a batch every year, the rest would still remain.
In addition, cats can catch mice, so as long as they are not rampant, no one usually cares.
Just like that, Brother Ye Yan rushed over with a hawksbill turtle in his hand, shouting, “Uncle Nine, look, is this the one?”
Ye Shuo curled his lips: “…Although this tortoiseshell cat is also very cute, but, Tuantuan is a white Persian cat.”
Ye Shuo had clearly explained Tuan Tuan’s characteristics before, but Ye Yan and his brothers were so excited that they simply forgot about it.
“What about this?” Soon, Ye Xun also came back with the cat he found.
This time the look was right, but…
Ye Shuo said weakly: “But Tuantuan has two mandarin duck eyes.”
So it’s neither of these two.
It would be a shame to let these two napping cats make a wasted trip, especially with Ye Yan’s method of catching the cats. It hurt Ye Shuo so much just watching it.
He quickly asked the two groups of people to put the cats down. Ye Shuo fed the two cats some dried meat and then let them go.
In the next half hour, a few people found other cats and dogs, but none of them matched Tuantuan.
“…I’m so tired.” Ye Xun had the least physical strength and was the first to give up, so he sat down.
When he said this, he looked around and found that Ye Yan and the others were not there, so he was so presumptuous.
Ye Shuo took Jianjian and Xiaoluzi with them to continue searching.
Soon Jianjian couldn’t bear it anymore. She didn’t care about her image anymore and picked up a stone and sat down.
Ye Shuo didn’t think there was anything wrong. While Jian Jian was holding the bamboo tube to drink water, Ye Shuo said casually, “Xiao Luzi, you guys help keep an eye on her first. I’ll look for Tuantuan nearby.”
As he said that, Ye Shuo went to check some nearby corners where cats and dogs liked to hide.
There happened to be a rockery here, and Ye Shuo planned to go inside the rockery to take a look.
Climbing to the top of the rockery, Ye Shuo lowered his head and looked down. There was nothing here, nothing here, and nothing here.
Just when he was about to give up, he accidentally saw a dark place that looked like a cave.
These are the places the cats and dogs in the palace love the most.
Ye Shuo jumped down from the rockery and stood outside to listen. When he heard no movement inside, he leaned over and went in without any precautions.
Then, Ye Shuo smelled a faint smell of decay.
Ye Shuo’s heart paused and he almost subconsciously took out a fire starter.
Then Ye Shuo saw the mess in the dog hole.
There were dead mice and a cat that was very dirty but had vaguely discernible white fur.
Ye Shuo’s pupils suddenly shrank, and all the sounds were blocked in his throat.
Just at this moment, there was a noise outside –
“Uncle Nine has been in there for so long and hasn’t come out yet. Could Tuan Tuan be in there?”
“Let’s go around and take a look.”
Almost at the moment he heard footsteps at the door of the dog hole, Ye Shuo subconsciously extinguished the fire, turned around, and blocked the dog hole in front of him tightly.
Jianjian was stunned when he saw this: “Hey, brother? Tuantuan is not here?”
Ye Shuo shook his head gently: “No, let’s look for another one.”
The children did not suspect anything and soon went to other places under Ye Shuo’s leadership.
After such a long search, naturally nothing was found.
As night fell, Ye Xun, Ye Yan and the others left with tired steps, saying that it was too tiring to look for a cat and they never wanted to help find a cat again, don’t even think about it!
Ye Shuo smiled and watched them leave.
As for Jianjian, she was so tired that she fell asleep in her wet nurse’s arms.
After signaling the wet nurse to send Jianjian back, Ye Shuo hurriedly brought Xiao Luzi back to the dog hole in the rockery.
Xiao Luzi was a little confused at first, but after seeing the situation inside the dog hole, Xiao Luzi was immediately shocked by the scene in front of him.
“This is… Tuan Tuan!?”
Ye Shuo didn’t know the answer to this question, so he could only wrap up the white cat and give it to Xu Chongyi.
Xu Chongyi was full of expectations at first, but after seeing this scene, she almost fainted.
“How, how could this happen?!” Looking at the scarred white cat, Xu Chongyi couldn’t help but widen her eyes. She was careless just this time, and there was no chance to make amends.
Ye Shuo remained silent.
Life in this palace is really too depressing. If it is suppressed for too long, dark things will grow wildly.
Compared with normal people, there are more abnormal people in the palace.
The only thing Ye Shuo could say to comfort Xu Chongyi was: “Judging from the wound, Tuantuan must have been treated like this after he died.”
Although it was still extremely cruel, at least Tuantuan did not suffer too much during his lifetime.
As for why Ye Shuo knew that the wounds presented by being abused while alive and being abused after death were different, it was a blessing in disguise.
“I remember Madam Xu, you said before that Tuantuan suddenly became restless some time ago. I suspect that Tuantuan knew that he didn’t have much time left, so he ran away this time.” Cats are creatures that generally don’t choose to die at home. When their lifespan is about to end, they will look for a secluded corner outside and close their eyes completely.
Tuantuan should be more than ten years old, the possibility is very high.
In ancient times, cats did not have sterilisation surgery or special medicines, so their lifespan was generally short.
“Concubine Xu, you don’t have to blame yourself too much. This matter has nothing to do with you.” Even if it is prevented this time, it will not be prevented next time. Cats are such strange and stubborn creatures.
Despite what Ye Shuo said, Xu Chongyi’s expression was still extremely forced.
Ye Shuo also knew that this kind of thing still had to be digested by Xu Chongyi himself, and no matter how much he said, it would be useless.
Ye Shuo bowed to Xu Chongyi in silence, then left.
While walking on the road, although Xiao Luzi felt unlucky, he was just angry. Ye Shuo, on the other hand, although he said it lightly, he did not feel relaxed at all in his heart.
First there were insects, rats and ants, then dead cats, gradually increasing in number. This was not a good sign.
Today is dead, tomorrow is alive, today is a mouse, an insect, and a cat, what will it be tomorrow?
Ye Shuo seemed to see an anti-social being slowly growing up not far from him.
No matter who the other party is, it is difficult for Ye Shuo to feel at ease because the imperial concubine and Jian Jian, as well as the crown prince and crown princess, Ye Xun, and Empress Zhao all live in the palace.
So the next morning, Ye Shuo specifically asked Xiao Luzi to find out who had passed by there in the past few days.
But it was obvious that there were so many people in the palace, including the concubines in each palace and the palace servants and eunuchs as numerous as stars, so asking like this would be like looking for a needle in a haystack.
Among the results that Xiaoluzi found out, there were palace maids, guards, imperial doctors, and even concubines from various palaces and princes and princesses. It was really difficult to tell who did it.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but rub his temples.
Ye Shuo even waited outside the dog hole by himself for a long time, but the dog hole seemed to be abandoned and no one went there anymore.
After a long time, Ye Shuo had no choice but to give up.
On the other side, Princess Huyan met the little prince again.
Princess Huyan was probably the first person who could break through the encirclement and walk to his side.
Therefore, the moment he saw her, the little prince subconsciously smiled.
Princess Huyan couldn’t help feeling proud when she saw this.
Princess Huyan was so intent on getting closer to the little prince that her attention was not on the small wooden stick in his hand. Naturally, she did not notice that the bottom of the stick was covered with dead ants.
Of course, the harem is not Princess Huyan’s playground, and Princess Huyan naturally knows her limits.
She did not meet the little prince very often, only once or twice a month, and each time lasted only about an incense stick’s time, so it was difficult for anyone to notice.
What’s more, Princess Huyan discovered that after she became close to the queen, more than half of the people following her in secret suddenly disappeared.
No matter what, the Queen is the legal wife of the Emperor of the Great Zhou. If she sees something she shouldn’t see, the person who sees it will be guilty.
What’s more, this is the harem, with so many concubines here, it is always inconvenient and it is inevitable that there will be omissions.
Although it was not an easy thing to disappear for a moment or two, it was not difficult for Princess Huyan.
And in such an environment, time passed day by day, and in the blink of an eye, it was the day of the Sixth Prince’s wedding.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Picking up the bride
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The wedding ceremony is also called the evening ceremony. In ancient times, it was held in the evening, which means the gradual alternation of yin and yang.
By the afternoon, Ye Shuo had already changed into festive clothes.
In fact, Ye Shuo didn’t want to be so active, mainly because he would have to have brothers to help pick up the bride on the wedding day, right?
It is known that the eldest prince thinks he is noble, so he will definitely not go. The second prince… The second prince is not familiar with Xiao Ming, so he will probably not go either. The third prince is the crown prince, so how can the crown prince go to pick up his younger brother?
The fourth prince is close to Xiao Ming, so he is one of them. The fifth prince and the sixth prince have had a grudge since they were a few years old. It is lucky that they don’t fight when they meet. Forget about picking up the bride.
The Seventh Prince followed the Fifth Prince, and if the Fifth Prince did not go, the Seventh Prince could not go either. The Eighth Prince could try to get it, but Xiao Ming was the type of person who wanted to keep everything to himself and suffocate himself to death, so it was extremely difficult to get him to talk back.
The remaining brothers are either too young or not familiar to him at all. After counting them all, Xiao Ming can only rely on himself.
On this happy day, no matter what Xiao Ming’s purpose is, Ye Shuo will never embarrass him because of their friendship over the years.
Therefore, Ye Shuo had no choice but to fill in the number.After changing his clothes in a hurry and letting Xiao Luzi put a hair crown on him, Ye Shuo could not help but stand up and looked at his attendant and his companion with raised eyebrows: “How do you feel?”
It must be said that the Ninth Prince was born with a good appearance. With such a face, naturally, he looks good in anything he wears.
Even though Xing Yucheng didn’t want to admit it, he could only nod to Xiao Luzi now.
“By the way, how did you do in the exam?” Ye Shuo is indeed a devil, as he asked such a sharp question right from the start.
Xing Yucheng was quite relaxed at first, but now he couldn’t laugh at all.
“…On such a happy day, why did Your Highness the Ninth Prince bother to mention my pain?”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but roll his eyes at him. Come on, he had seen many people like Xing Yucheng. What they said was not good might not necessarily mean it was really not good.
“After the results are announced, I’ll be waiting to drink at your wedding.”
While Xing Yucheng was stunned, Ye Shuo pushed open the door of the room, and was immediately seen by Concubine Rong and maids including Su Yue.
A hint of surprise flashed across the imperial concubine’s eyes.
Afterwards, the imperial concubine couldn’t help feeling a little proud, looking at her two children, each one more handsome than the other.
Su Yue and the maids couldn’t help but sigh in their hearts that the Ninth Prince has indeed grown up now. Look at his tall and straight figure, and his handsome and even beautiful eyes and eyebrows!
In the entire Qiuwu Palace, perhaps Princess Jianjian was the only one whose expression did not change at all.
She admitted that her brother was indeed good-looking, and she could still feel his good looks when they saw each other every day, but the problem was that his face was exchanged for his personality and brains!
Jianjian seriously suspected that her brother had used all his brains to exchange for this face when he was reincarnated, so he was so stupid, fragile and pretentious.
Hearing that he was going to ride a horse to pick up the bride later, Jianjian habitually warned: “Brother, be careful.”
If she wasn’t so small, Jianjian would have wanted to go with him.
The little princess Jianjian had no idea that her brother had been able to ride horses with Ye Xun long before she was born, and that so many guards were unable to catch up with him.
Holding back his smile, Ye Shuo nodded seriously: “Yes, brother will be obedient. When the brother is not at home, Jianjian will also help take care of the mother.”
“Yeah!” Jianjian nodded as a matter of course.
The imperial concubine couldn’t help but give her son a cold look.
Ye Shuo left the palace quickly, and now the large army was already waiting there. It was still nearly half an hour before the wedding procession set out.
The wedding procession started from the Imperial Palace, then went to the Prime Minister’s Residence, and took the bride to the Prince’s Residence. Only then was the whole process completed.
The Fourth Prince is now talking to the Sixth Prince.
The moment they saw Ye Shuo, they were both startled.
“So early?” The Sixth Prince subconsciously looked at the sky, then looked at Xiaojiu, and then couldn’t help but begin to wonder if the Xiaojiu in front of him was someone else pretending to be him.
Ye Shuo’s mouth twitched involuntarily: “…Is it that serious?”
Didn’t he finally arrive early once? He was still much later than them, so was he really that shocked?
But you have to know that when the eldest prince returned victoriously, he was almost late.
Arriving early is simply impossible for Xiaojiu.
Even the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but feel a little moved, completely forgetting that the Fourth Prince next to him had arrived a long time ago and was not much different from him.
Ye Shuo was completely speechless.
The Fourth Prince was much older than Ye Shuo. When Ye Shuo arrived at the Upper Study, the Fourth Prince had already left the palace to build his own residence. He had not returned and could only see Ye Shuo during the New Year and other festivals. Therefore, the Fourth Prince was relatively unfamiliar to Ye Shuo.
Later, based on Ye Shuo’s close observation, he found that the Fourth Prince was a polite gentleman, and… very fond of preaching.
In just a stick of incense, Ye Shuo heard that he had shared all his experiences when he got married, and from time to time, he would pull him out to talk about them again.
Ye Shuo still remembered that he had this problem when he saw him more than ten years ago when he was just one month old.
He used to be in charge of the Fifth Prince, but the Fifth Prince was so rebellious that he probably wouldn’t be happy to be under his control. As they grew older, Ye Shuo never saw the two of them hanging out together again.
What could Ye Shuo do when he was lectured by the uncontrollable Fourth Prince? He just listened. After all, he was still his brother in this life.
After waiting for a long time, the time came and Ye Shuo almost breathed a sigh of relief at the same time as the Sixth Prince.
Well, the Fourth Prince is good in every way, but it would be even better if he could talk less…
If he were not a prince, becoming a teacher would have been a good choice.
When the guards reminded them, the three of them jumped on their horses almost at the same time.
Although Ye Shuo is young, he is not far behind others.
In this way, a group of people took to the streets with the wedding procession.
The people of Shangjing City had already known the news that the prince of the imperial city was getting married to the daughter of the prime minister’s mansion today. Naturally, they were waiting on both sides of the road to see such a lively scene since early morning.
Emperor Jingwen did not issue an order to clear the streets, so the area from the imperial city to the prime minister’s residence was extremely lively at this moment.
Unlike the Fourth Prince, Ye Shuo did not feel embarrassed at all. Instead, he enthusiastically asked the guards for wedding candies and distributed them to the people along the street.
In those days, candy was a rare and precious thing. Ordinary people could not even eat it once a year. Candy came in small pieces, wrapped in oil paper, and looked quite real.
But there are not many candies after all, and not everyone can get one.
Many people just join in the fun and don’t think that such a good thing can really happen to them.
Among them were an old beggar squatting on the street corner, a child, a woman, and an old man. Who would have thought that while they were thinking about this, small pieces of candy suddenly fell in front of them.
Hearing a “ding-ling” sound from the broken bowl, the old beggar subconsciously reached out to cover it, but when he saw that no one was paying attention, he slowly opened his hand.
When they looked up again, only the back of the little prince was left.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Getting Married
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Half an incense stick later, the wedding procession arrived at the gate of the Prime Minister’s residence.
At this time, the Prime Minister’s residence was decorated with lanterns and was bustling with activity. Officials were constantly coming and going, some of whom were familiar with Prime Minister He, and some of whom were his subordinates. Faintly, one could also see the figures of familiar people such as the Grand Tutor.
After all, all of them had worked with Prime Minister He for many years, and this time the Prime Minister’s Mansion was getting married to the Royal Family, so naturally everyone had to take time out to have a drink at the wedding and present gifts.
And now, Prime Minister He was standing at the door, greeting the gentlemen.
