Welcoming guests should have been the job of the son and daughter-in-law, but the guests were of high status, so in order to avoid being impolite, Prime Minister He went to the door to greet the guests himself.
“The Sixth Prince has arrived—”
Hearing the voice of the eunuch in charge of ceremonies, Prime Minister He looked up subconsciously.
Even though the Sixth Prince is not yet seventeen years old, he is a member of the palace after all, so his manners and bearing are naturally impeccable.
Even though the Sixth Prince looked a little thin, he was still elegant and handsome. Moreover, He Xiang had chosen him as his grandson-in-law, so how could He Xiang not like him?However, before He Xiang could relax his brows, he accidentally saw Ye Shuo behind the Sixth Prince, and his expression froze.
Why did this devil come here?
Moreover, he seemed to be coming with the Sixth Prince to pick up the bride.
Ever since the envoy incident, He Xiang and others had raised the danger level of the Ninth Prince by more than one level. If he was just not fond of studying and disobedient before, he was now directly equated with a dangerous person.
It’s not that the envoy shouldn’t have been killed, but right after he killed the envoy, the emperor immediately massacred the entire post station. It’s hard not to wonder if the emperor had some element of protecting his own people in doing this.
Considering how much His Majesty dotes on the Ninth Prince, people like them would probably be beaten in vain.
Nowadays, the first and second rank officials in the capital would rather offend the eldest prince, the second prince, and the crown prince than offend the ninth prince. The former are at least reasonable and will be considerate for the sake of their official positions, but if the latter gets angry, even the emperor may not be able to help him, and that would be so embarrassing.
Besides, there was really no need to offend the Ninth Prince, so everyone was particularly friendly when facing Ye Shuo.
Noticing the change in He Xiang’s expression, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch his chin, wondering, is it that serious?
Seeing that the Ninth Prince seemed to have discovered something, Prime Minister He’s heart suddenly tightened.
“Why are you so nervous? I don’t eat people.” Ye Shuo snorted as the Sixth Prince got off his horse and came in front of the other party.
Hearing this voice, He Xiang complained bitterly, but he still had to be fully prepared to deal with it.
“The Ninth Prince is joking.”
However, the more he said this, the more Ye Shuo couldn’t help but have evil thoughts: “Since my sixth brother is married to the sixth young lady of the mansion, then if you count it this way, He Xiang and I are also related. Just based on the relationship between me and my sixth brother, we are now much closer.”
He Xiang was stunned. He had even forgotten to consider this before.
If he had known this, he would…
As expected, some things have gains and losses.
“…Xiaojiu.” The fourth prince at the side couldn’t bear to watch it any longer and couldn’t help but give a reminder.
After Ye Shuo cleared his cough, he went up to the Grand Tutor and started to harass him.
Only then did He Xiang feel relieved.
The moment the Grand Tutor saw his student, his temples began to ache involuntarily.
It was fine when he was in the palace, but why didn’t this bastard let him go outside the palace?
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t expect was that when he accidentally glanced away, he actually saw the figures of Zou Wu and others here.
It’s not Zou Wu herself. To be honest, although Zou Wu is the most capable one among this group of students, because she is a girl, she is naturally inferior to her fellow brothers.
The world is in this state today, and it cannot be changed by one person alone. Only by passing it down from generation to generation can such secular concepts be broken one day.
Considering the current official positions of those two young men, they are probably not qualified to sit here, unless… Prime Minister He has a liking for their talents.
The fact is indeed as Ye Shuo expected. Although He Xiang is the prime minister, he is not alone. He has many friends and followers. Every few years, he naturally needs some fresh blood to ensure his longevity.
Therefore, the more He Xiang looked at these two young men with real potential, the more he liked them.
Although the two of them have a teacher, Zeng Mohuai has never been a person who likes to meddle in other people’s affairs. In addition, Zeng Mohuai is extremely picky and has memorised and filtered everything in advance. When it comes to him, isn’t it just a matter of taking advantage?
He Xiang took decisive action to take advantage of these two good seedlings before others could react.
He Xiang’s thoughts were not much different from Emperor Jingwen’s. It was difficult for both of them to control their feelings. Little did they know that the person they liked had already been programmed when they left the factory. If the power-on password was wrong, all their efforts would be in vain.
In addition to the good nature of these people, Ye Shuo’s almost 100% monopoly on knowledge is also a very critical factor.
Without them, there will be the next batch. They are not irreplaceable, so no matter where they are, they can only depend on Ye Shuo in the end.
There is no such thing as a free lunch in this world.
The moment they saw Ye Shuo, the two teenagers instinctively became conflicted. Just as they were thinking about what they should do, Ye Shuo’s gaze did not linger on them for too long and quickly shifted to the other side.
After the two young men understood what he meant, they immediately had the answer in their minds when faced with He Xiang’s recruitment.
When Ye Shuo was driven away by the tutor who was really fed up with his annoyance, the Sixth Prince finally took the Sixth Miss out of her boudoir.
When the Sixth Miss came out, she was carried out by her brother. From a distance, one could see the Young Madam shedding tears.
It is natural for a mother to be reluctant to let her daughter marry off.
This is the case for a woman who marries into the capital. If she were to marry someone from a foreign country, I’m afraid she would cry her heart out.
Looking at the Sixth Miss’ sisters, they now had all kinds of expressions. Although they were standing in an inconspicuous place, they were still seen thoroughly by Ye Shuo.
I guess it’s not peaceful in the prime minister’s mansion, or rather, in this world, as long as there are people, it will never be peaceful.
He Wutan was also feeling uncomfortable. Ye Shuo looked at the Sixth Prince, who was usually smart but now acted like a piece of wood. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a headache.
It’s already this late, isn’t Xiao Ming going to say anything?
Since he didn’t say it, Ye Shuo could only speak for him.
Ye Shuo bowed to the young lady and the Sixth Miss’s father and said, “Don’t worry, you two. If the Sixth Miss is bullied by him after marrying my Sixth Brother, just tell my mother the truth. My mother will definitely take care of the Sixth Miss.”
As parents, don’t we just want our children to live a happy life?
Even though the Ninth Prince has a bad reputation, he never fails when it comes to matters like this.
After the Sixth Prince reacted, he said, “Ninth brother is right, please rest assured, father-in-law and mother-in-law.”
The young lady felt relieved immediately.
This time, the Sixth Miss finally got into the sedan chair smoothly, and the atmosphere was not so sad anymore.
The Sixth Prince, the Fourth Prince and Ye Shuo walked at the front of the procession, paving the way for the big red sedan behind them. Suonas were played along the way. After the first carry-out of dowry from the Prime Minister’s Residence was carried into the gate of the Prince’s Residence, the last carry-out of dowry had not even come out of the Prime Minister’s Residence.
After all, it was a marriage to the royal family, so it was not an exaggeration to say that it was a ten-mile red wedding.
After the Sixth Prince and the Sixth Miss landed on the ground, the Eldest Prince and the Crown Prince finally arrived here one after another.
When the Sixth Prince left the palace to build his mansion, he spent a total of only 200,000 taels of silver. Whether in terms of scale or reputation, the Sixth Prince’s mansion was far inferior to those of his other brothers.
The eldest prince didn’t care at all, and the crown prince didn’t even bother with the somewhat simple layout around him.
Sometimes having more brothers means more disadvantages, and the chances of them causing trouble at the wedding ceremony are greater.
While the Sixth Prince and the Sixth Miss were getting married, Ye Shuo was guarding there like a door god.
Seeing this scene, the eldest prince couldn’t help but sneer, but after thinking about it, he was too lazy to care and simply pretended not to see it.
The prince acted gentle, but he couldn’t help but feel amused in his heart.
“Bow to Heaven and Earth——”
“Bow to your parents twice—”
“The couple bows to each other—”
“Send it to the bridal chamber—”
“The ceremony is over——!”
Emperor Jingwen did not attend the wedding of the second prince before, and he never came after the crown prince’s wedding, so he did not even show up tonight.
When the Sixth Prince started to toast everyone one by one, some people could no longer hold back.
It’s easy to tell that the first one to jump out would definitely be the fifth prince.
On such a happy day, even the Sixth Prince did not want to have a conflict with others. He had just drank two cups of wine and as he was not able to handle the alcohol, he could not control his violent coughing.
The Fifth Prince was just about to laugh out loud when he saw Ye Shuo glaring at him.
I have tolerated you for a long time, that’s enough!
The Fifth Prince’s smile suddenly stopped.
The Sixth Prince wanted to raise his glass again, but then someone held his arm.
Just as the Fifth Prince was about to speak, he saw Ye Shuo holding up three fingers. Don’t forget, he still owed his three favours.
Xiaojiu is sick, why is he still protecting someone like Laoliu?!
The fifth prince gritted his teeth but could do nothing, and then subconsciously looked at the second prince.
The second prince decisively turned his gaze to the eldest prince: “Brother, as the eldest son, now that my sixth brother is getting married, don’t you want to toast him with two glasses of wine to celebrate?”
Even at this time, he still didn’t forget to stir up trouble. The eldest prince glared at the second prince fiercely.
He has already fought against the ninth brother once, and he would never fight against him a second time.
The eldest prince passed the ball to the crown prince: “Second brother, you are confused. His Royal Highness the Crown Prince hasn’t spoken yet, so how can you and I talk?”
The second prince did not expect that the usually tough eldest prince would give in so quickly. Looking at the crown prince again, the folding fan in his hand suddenly stopped.
The prince remained calm: “I have not been feeling well lately and should not drink.”
Well, it seems that no one wants to deal with a tough guy like Xiaojiu. With Xiaojiu’s protection today, everything will naturally go smoothly for the Sixth Prince.
Seeing that the older brothers were all gone, there was no need to mention the other seven princes and the eighth prince.
So when the time came, he was only slightly tipsy.
“Go back to your parents’ home after three days of marriage, don’t forget.”
“Also, exercise more and have a baby soon.”
Ye Shuo finally reminded him, but he didn’t know whether the Sixth Prince paid attention to it or not.
Ye Shuo, who had accomplished his mission, patted him on the shoulder, then jumped off the chair and left with everyone else.
The Sixth Prince looked at Xiaojiu’s relaxed and carefree back. The tipsy look in his eyes gradually faded away and he remained silent for a long time.
When the butler came to urge him, the Sixth Prince just said “hmm”, then got up and went back to his room, leaving the maids and servants to clean up the mess.
As soon as Ye Shuo walked out of the gate of the Prince’s Mansion, he heard the Fifth Prince say, “You are protecting him so much, he should appreciate it.”
It was probably intuition, but the Fifth Prince felt that the Sixth Prince was not a good person.
Ye Shuo spread his hands: “Otherwise, we are brothers, and we have been friends for so many years.”
Only he thinks that brothers in the royal family are brothers.
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo acted too matter-of-factly that the Fifth Prince was suddenly speechless. After a long while, he muttered in a low voice: “He is a very evil person. Be careful, he will stab you sooner or later.”
Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows and didn’t care.
Having lived in the same palace with the Sixth Prince for ten years, Ye Shuo naturally understood him better than anyone else.
“Forget it. I don’t want to waste my time talking to you. Your Highness will go first.”
As he spoke, the fifth prince got on the carriage, followed by the eldest prince, the second prince and others.
The Crown Prince was going back to the East Palace, and Ye Shuo shamelessly got on board his luxurious carriage. The remaining Eighth Prince was not so shameless, so he followed behind in his own carriage.
Soon, several carriages drove off in different directions.
Although the Crown Prince and the Eldest Prince did not show anything at the Sixth Prince’s wedding banquet, in fact, the two of them had already been enemies for a long time, and all they lacked was the finishing touch.
This day seemed like a watershed, as the eldest prince finally confronted the crown prince.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Found
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+, now 260+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Before, the eldest prince and the crown prince were still testing and finding out about each other, but now they have seriously put their thoughts on the surface.
This can be seen from the fact that the faces of Ye Xun and Ye Yan brothers changed immediately after they walked out of the gate of Qiuwu Palace.
In the past, their incompatibility with each other was not so obvious, but now they are too lazy to even pretend, and now they tend to be sarcastic to each other whenever they meet.
Ye Shuo just felt his ears hurt. Once he saw them quarreling so much, he couldn’t help but warn them: “I don’t care what you do outside, but you can’t quarrel here. Whoever quarrels, get out!”
“Children should stay out of the way of adults!”
They are so small, and it seems like they can do something powerful.
“You are so young and you are thinking so much. It’s not too late when you grow up. You will have something to worry about when you grow up.”
Ye Xun, Ye Yan and the others opened their mouths, but when Ye Shuo looked over, they all closed their mouths.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo was satisfied.“Okay, stop standing there. Today we’re going to play sandbags, kick a ball, or hide and seek. Choose one of the three.”
They were tired of playing with sandbags, and Jianjian was unwilling to play hide-and-seek, so Ye Shuo said quickly, “I’ll count to ten, and whoever says it first will do the talking. Ready, ten…one!”
Jianjian now knows her brother very well. She had long guessed that he was not a normal person, so she was always on guard. Sure enough, when he shouted “one”, she blurted out: “Cuju!”
Ye Shuo nodded: “Well, that’s fine, let’s play Cuju today.”
Ye Xun: “…”
Ye Yan and the other three: “…”
Wait, they haven’t reacted yet!
“Uncle Nine, didn’t we agree on 10 to 1?” What about the 9, 8, 7 in the middle? ?
Ye Shuo blinked at them: “Yes, it’s 10 to 1, that’s right.”
…Damn it! He fooled me again!
As if noticing the resentment in their eyes, Ye Shuo smiled and said, “Be careful next time.”
In front was the little princess with pointy hair, happily holding the football, while behind her were a few dejected looking grandchildren.
When they arrived at the venue, everyone drew lots to form groups. As luck would have it, Ye Xun and Ye Yan were assigned to the same group.
Several people had distorted faces, as if they had eaten something unclean.
Ye Shuo almost laughed out loud.
“Hmm… maybe this is fate.”
Let me make it clear in advance that this was not Ye Shuo’s doing. He knew it was impossible for them to really love each other, and it would be easy to make things worse if he was not careful, so it was really God’s will.
Ye Xun, Ye Yan and the others pinched their noses and stood with Dudu with the mood of visiting a grave.
In addition to Jian Jian, Ye Shuo also found Xiao Luzi and other young eunuchs who knew some martial arts to fight against Ye Xun and others.
The young eunuchs have gotten used to it by now, and there is no such thing as letting the players win. On the contrary, Ye Xun and Ye Yan are good players if taken individually, but because there is no communication and cooperation, they keep conceding goals to Ye Shuo, the main player of the enemy team.
Looking at the smug expression of the Ninth Prince, the brothers who were so angry about losing finally decided to ignore the issue of their positions for the time being. Gradually, they developed a tacit understanding and the situation became a little better.
Why! Why is the Ninth Prince so accurate?
Compared with the group of children who automatically opposed each other, the eldest prince, who was involved, did not take these trivial matters to heart.
No matter what happens between him and the crown prince, it has nothing to do with their respective children. Within a controllable range, the eldest prince also hopes that his children can have a carefree childhood.
I believe the prince is the same.
As for what happens in the future, let’s talk about it after the winner is decided.
So the eldest prince just listened to it and put the matter behind him.
Seeing that the eldest prince seemed to be unconcerned, the people below him tactfully stopped talking about it. The aides under the eldest prince quickly started talking about something else: “Except for the diehards like the Grand Tutor, the voices in the court that support the orthodoxy are getting smaller and smaller, and there are more and more people who can distinguish the important from the unimportant. If this continues, I’m afraid it won’t be long before the prince will be able to decide the winner with the crown prince.”
There was no way. The eldest prince’s victory came at just the right time. He almost used his life to fight for a future for his originally destined fate.
“Beiting led his army westward to launch a surprise attack on the State of Chen. They even found a way to break the poisonous miasma that the State of Chen had set up around them. The State of Chen suffered heavy losses. I’m afraid that this news will be reported back to Shangjing soon. By then, the prince’s reputation will surely rise to a higher level.”
As the saying goes, the death of a rabbit makes the fox mourn. If the Great Zhou had not handled this well, who would have been slaughtered and suffered heavy losses? In the current Great Zhou, only the eldest prince can be compared with the Duke of Zhen.
Thinking about the glory of the Duke of Zhen in the past, the staff couldn’t help but feel excited.
Then the aide paused and looked at the eldest prince.
The always arrogant eldest prince shook his head: “Don’t be complacent, and don’t underestimate the prince.”
If the prince could be brought down so easily, he would not have been able to stay in that position safely until now.
Now that the eldest prince dares to confront the crown prince head-on, he has naturally made full preparations. The more difficult the time, the more he cannot take it lightly.
Now that luck is on his side, as long as he doesn’t make any mistakes, he will be able to take advantage of the situation and rise sooner or later.
“I will warn my subordinates later. During this special period, I want them to be more alert.”
The aide was a little stunned. In his opinion, with the prince’s current power, it would be more than enough to deal with a prince who had never set foot out of the capital. However, since the prince was so careful this time, the aide naturally would not spoil his fun.
On the other side, the East Palace——
The prince couldn’t help but look at the tutor and a few other people beside him. They all sighed and shook their heads helplessly.
It’s not that they don’t want to, but this time the eldest prince came well prepared. He kept restraining his men and was cautious everywhere, not giving them any chance to find any flaws.
The eldest prince can now rise up by taking advantage of the situation, so why would he do anything extra?
The only one who can fight against the eldest prince, the Duke of Zhen, has already registered his name with the emperor, so he cannot be touched at all.
Besides, he has his own grandson, so why would he join the Crown Prince?
If the Ninth Prince could be won over, there might still be hope.
The Grand Tutor was probably the most stable person among all the people. He advised: “Don’t panic, Your Highness. Even if public opinion is boiling, it will not be able to overcome the will of the emperor.”
From ancient times to the present, although the people’s will has always been emphasised, but throughout history, how many crown princes were deposed because of public opinion?
Therefore, no matter how popular the eldest prince is among the people, in the eyes of the Grand Tutor, he is nothing more than a flower in the mirror and a moon in the water.
The prince did not say anything. Instead, he waited until everyone else left and showed the tutor what he had found out.
After the Master looked through it carefully, his expression changed slightly.
There were so many people in the court, especially so many military generals, who secretly defected to the eldest prince!
The prince lowered his eyes and said, “Teacher, now it is not just the will of the people.”
The Grand Tutor was somewhat speechless, and the two of them looked at each other in silence.
After a while, the Grand Tutor brought up the old matter again: “Perhaps, Xiaojiu…”
The prince shook his head: “The Duke of Zhen can’t protect himself, so there’s no need to mention it again, teacher.”
Since the child is clean, let him remain clean.
What the prince didn’t say was that what he showed to the tutor was only a part of it. As for the rest, even the prince was unsure.
Therefore, for now, no matter what, the prince must find a way to take action.
Soon, Ye Shuo clearly felt that the prince was distancing himself from him.
At the beginning, Ye Shuo just went to the East Palace several times in a row but didn’t see the prince. He knew that the prince was busy, but when Ye Shuo met him on the road, he just greeted him quickly and left. This made Ye Shuo alert all of a sudden.
Something is wrong.
Then Ye Shuo deliberately chose a day when the prince was present, but still did not see the prince himself, only the prince’s wife. Ye Shuo was almost certain that he was avoiding him.
Plus, the eldest prince has been pressing on…
Ye Shuo shuddered suddenly.
Shit!
The prince wasn’t going to do anything stupid, was he? ?
Now, Ye Shuo had to go see him no matter what.
The prince hid here and there, but one day when he was leaving the court, he was finally blocked in a corner of the imperial garden by the quick-eyed and quick-handed Ye Shuo, leaving him no chance to escape.
“Tell me the truth, what have you been doing recently?”
The prince did not want to involve his younger brother in these matters, so he tried every means to avoid him. He did not expect that he would be so stubborn and would not give up until he found him.
After being rejected a few times, any sensible person would not keep pestering the matter, but he did not do that.
Especially, he asked such a question as soon as they met.
The prince couldn’t help but be shocked by his sharpness.
The prince looked relaxed: “Ninth brother, you are joking. I have been in this palace all the time. What can I do?”
“My father has told me that I have things to do. Ninth brother, I wil take myl leave now.”
Having said that, the prince turned around and was about to leave.
“Third brother, you used to call me Xiaojiu.” Ye Shuo said in a faint voice.
The prince was stunned for a moment. Ye Shuo took a deep breath and quickly chased after him. After observing that there was no one else around, Ye Shuo spoke: “No matter what, no matter what the situation is, Third Brother, you must, you must believe in Father.”
Looking at his brother’s expression, which was completely different from usual and was serious to the point of being solemn, the prince wanted to dismiss him with a few words, but found that he couldn’t open his mouth no matter what.
After a long silence, the prince lost his usual gentle smile: “What if I say that even my father can’t do anything this time?”
The prince’s voice was so soft that it could not be heard if one was not paying attention.
Ye Shuo’s pupils suddenly shrank.
If even my cheap father can’t stop me, then the eldest prince…
Wait, that’s not right.
Given my cheap dad’s character, there’s no way he didn’t know.
Given my cheap dad’s personality, he has probably already made arrangements for everyone in his mind.
What’s more, he had already given hints.
——King Ding.
Taking all factors into consideration, Ye Shuo still prefers his cheap father.
But… the prince couldn’t be aimless, he must know something!
Ye Shuo didn’t know the specific situation, but the prince alienated him first, and saved his life first, even Ye Shuo couldn’t be completely indifferent.
Even though Ye Shuo had already decided not to interfere in these matters, he still couldn’t help but remind him: “Third brother! No matter what the situation is, it won’t be wrong to listen to father.”
Having said this, Ye Shuo has already reached his limit.
The prince had never seen his brother like this before, and meeting his brother’s slightly anxious eyes, the prince finally shook his head.
Sometimes, people in high positions are not as free as they imagine.
“Xiaojiu, I’m not you. I can’t remain indifferent.”
The smarter a person is, the more he trusts his own judgement. The smarter a person is, the less likely he is to pin all his hopes on others, even if that person is his biological father.
In the prince’s view, his younger brother could rely on their father wholeheartedly, but he really couldn’t do it.
There is nothing more dangerous in this world than tying your entire fortune on the pity of others. Once the person holding the delicate thread turns against you, you will no longer have a chance to resist.
But what the prince didn’t know was that Ye Shuo was the same.
So in the end, the two of them just ended up in the same place.
How could Ye Shuo persuade the prince if he couldn’t even do it himself?
In this palace, there is no one who is not suspicious every day.
“Xiaojiu, since you have said this yourself, I will also remind you that since you have no intention of fighting, remember to stay away from these things in the future.”
“Otherwise, sooner or later, there will be a day when it will no longer be up to you.”
The prince was not stupid. He could clearly see whether he had this idea or not, and whether it was real or fake.
In the end, Ye Shuo watched the other person leave.
At this moment, Ye Shuo felt extremely powerless.
Everyone understands it, but no one can escape it. There is nothing more torturous than this.
After all, he couldn’t change anything.
Make the cake bigger? Ye Shuo has tried countless times in his life, but no one would listen to him. Everyone thought he was daydreaming.
Without anyone under his command and no one to support him, what can Ye Shuo use to unify the country?
Kick out the eldest prince and the crown prince and take the throne himself? How could he have such ability! It was no problem for his eight brothers to eat him up.
In the end, the tragedy could not be prevented, and he ended up sacrificing himself.
No matter how you count, it’s a dead end on all sides.
Ye Shuo returned to Qiuwu Palace dejectedly. He hugged his mother and Jianjian for most of the day, and the pain was slightly relieved.
Ye Shuo sat in the middle, with the imperial concubine on his left and Jian Jian on his right. The two of them had to sit close to him and hug him. They couldn’t be any further away.
Jianjian has long been accustomed to her brother’s occasional tantrums. He probably just suffered some kind of blow again.
Oh, what a fragile brother…
Noticing that her brother’s grip on her clothes was getting tighter and tighter, Jianjian hummed a song and patted his back with her little hands in an imitative manner.
The days passed one by one, and about a year went by, but there was still no movement from the Sixth Prince, who had been married for a whole year.
The Sixth Prince couldn’t help but feel anxious.
He tried many methods, but none of them seemed to work. The imperial physician who took the princess’ pulse said that there was nothing wrong with her.
The Sixth Prince suddenly remembered what Xiao Jiu had said before –
“Exercise more and have a baby soon.”
There is really no connection between exercise and having a baby early, and it is really incongruous to put the two sentences together.
With the attitude of preferring to believe it to be true than not, the Sixth Prince inadvertently brought up the matter when he brought his wife to the palace to pay his respects to the Imperial Concubine.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Fuck!
Could this group of people not be so perceptive?
If these people were just a little dumber, they wouldn’t be…
Things have come to this point, Ye Shuo weighed it for a long time and finally decided not to continue hiding it.
So he said: “With your body, if you don’t exercise more, it would be strange if you can give birth to a child.”
At first, the Sixth Prince thought that this was just another way of saying that he was weak. It would be strange for a man to not get angry when being insulted like this.
The Sixth Prince was a little angry at first, but when he calmed down, he couldn’t help but think, could it really be his problem?
The Sixth Prince’s desire to have a child eventually overcame his male pride.
For the first time ever, the Sixth Prince did not take a carriage to travel between the six ministries, but walked between the six ministries and the Prince’s Mansion every day.
While the Sixth Prince was trying his best to get a child, his eldest cousin who had always tried his best to avoid contact with Ye Shuo suddenly sent him news.
After many years, without a map, the people sent by my cousin finally found the Champa rice that could be harvested twice a year on their own feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: After Years
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+, now 260+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
But Champa in this life is not called Champa, but Lucheng, so the so-called Champa rice should be called Lucheng rice in this life.
When he heard the news from his men, even Wei Wen was so excited that he was incoherent.
There actually is such a place in the world, where rice is everywhere, and some of it even rots on the ground but no one harvests it. What a waste!
Just by reading the text, Wei Wen felt as if his heart was being cut by a knife, and he wished he could collect it for the people there.
If there really are gods and fairylands in this world, Lucheng should be like this.
How happy and joyful it would be if everyone had enough to eat.
But how did the Ninth Prince know all these things?
Such a thought flashed through his mind uncontrollably, and then Wei Wen threw it aside fiercely. No matter how he knew it, as long as he could save people, Wei Wen didn’t care how he knew it.
Smart people always know what to ask and what not to ask. Wei Wen only cares about the results, not the process.Champa rice can be harvested as soon as it is planted, regardless of whether the soil is fertile or barren, and can be harvested up to three times a year. The same is true for Lucheng rice. People nowadays have never seen this thing before, so they are naturally shocked.
But actually this is nothing. If Wei Wen were asked to go to South America in his previous life, it would be a real shock.
In tropical areas such as South America, any seed you sow can grow, and there is edible food everywhere.
The matter was of great importance, so Ye Shuo made a special trip to meet with his eldest cousin.
He seldom mentioned his grandfather’s family and visited them less than twice a year, so a visit after such a long time would not arouse suspicion.
My eldest cousin is worthy of being the only hope of the whole family. He is really reliable in doing things and there will hardly be any mistakes in anything that goes through his hands.
If it weren’t for his adoptive father’s suspicion, his achievements would have been far more than this. Thinking of this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel regretful.
The conditions in ancient times were not as good as those of modern times. After several years of traveling back and forth, most of the first dozen people died on the road, and the rest have been replaced by two batches. Now there are only five or six old people left in the team.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but fall silent.
Then Ye Shuo took out a few silver notes from his purse and said, “Please distribute this money to their families.”
“No need.” Wei Wen shook his head: “I have already given it to them before.”
Those who can take on such a job naturally don’t come from very good families. If they are given too much at once, it would be troublesome if they cannot protect the children.
“I will have messengers send money there every year until their children reach adulthood, which will be better.”
Very good, Wei Wen has learned how to distribute pensions without any guidance.
Ye Shuo finally kept the banknote.
Although the Lucheng rice has been found, it is of no use as long as my grandfather has no intention of rebelling. Even if he has the intention of rebelling now, it is too late. Except for my grandfather himself, people like my uncle and cousin can hardly be the opponents of the eldest prince and his generals.
Therefore, Lucheng rice is not a good thing for the Duke Zhen’s Mansion, but will become a death warrant.
This thing can only be used at critical moments, so it is better to keep it in Lucheng for the time being.
Apart from the Yellow River’s change of course two years ago, the grain harvests in the past two years have been pretty good. Anyway, I haven’t heard my cheap dad worry about it, so there must be enough to eat and it won’t be of any use for the time being.
After finding out the situation, Ye Shuo didn’t want to worry about it anymore, but then he changed his mind and realised that the eldest prince and the crown prince were now fighting like a pair of black chicken eyes, and the other brothers would join the battle sooner or later. It was true that when gods fight, mortals suffer. It would be fine if Ye Shuo didn’t have the ability, but if he did, he would naturally think about taking precautions.
It is not enough to just find a place. Ye Shuo is thinking about whether he can find a way to expand his power. It would be a waste if the rice in Lucheng rots in Lucheng.
However, after hearing his words, Wei Wen shook his head: “It is already extremely difficult to find Lucheng, how easy is it to establish a force?”
This is no longer just a matter of whether those dozen people have the ability, it also requires a lot of financial support.
Although the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion is rich, it is still very difficult to support such a team.
The most important thing is that most of the money in the mansion is earned by grandma and aunts. Although grandma and aunts are unlikely to ask, how can’t Wei Wen feel embarrassed to spend such a large amount of money every year?
Ye Shuo laughed: “Now that we have food, are you still worried about not having money?”
The most important thing is that if those people can lay some foundations in Lu City, it will be a way out for them if they really reach the end of their rope.
Yes, they do.
Even if his mother has feelings for his adoptive father, they are not as deep as those for his grandparents. Ye Shuo couldn’t bear to see his mother sad, so naturally he would go wherever his mother went. In addition to the remaining foundation of his grandfather, and when Ye Shuo has thoroughly understood the skills of the secret guards, the secret guards will no longer be a threat. If it really doesn’t work, and they really can’t make it in Shangjing, they can still run away, right?
Of course, this was just a helpless choice. Even if there was a glimmer of hope, my grandfather probably would not leave here.
Ye Shuo thought about it, then asked his eldest cousin for a charcoal pencil and started writing on the spot.
After a while, the method of making distilled liquor was developed.
Since we have grain, making wine is an excellent choice.
Distilled liquor is definitely a far cry from today’s low-alcohol liquors that are full of impurities. It’s a dimensionality reduction attack.
Wei Wen had never thought that his younger cousin could also make wine. After a quick glance, he said, “If it really has such an effect, it would be nice to sell it to dignitaries.”
“…Drinking alcohol harms the liver, why would you harm your own people?” No matter what kind of wine it is, no matter how precious it is, it will ultimately do more harm than good.
Ye Shuo finally discovered that among all the people he knew, very few of them looked outside.
“Such a good thing should naturally be left for the people of Beiting to enjoy.” Beiting is located in the north, where the winter is extremely cold and people need alcohol the most to warm themselves up. Therefore, almost everyone in the north loves and is good at drinking. It would be a pity not to take advantage of such a good market and such a good opportunity to make money.
Ye Shuo’s heart is very small and can only accommodate people from his own country, not people from other countries.
The prices of grain and wine are high, and only princes and nobles can drink them to their heart’s content. Ordinary people of Beiting cannot be cheated, and at the same time, Beiting’s combat power can be weakened. Why not do it?
After hearing what his little cousin said, Wei Wen also felt that it made sense.
“Anyway, let’s try this recipe first and see how effective it is.” It’s not that Wei Wen doesn’t believe him. After going through so many things, Wei Wen no longer has any doubts in his heart. It’s just that he always has to get the finished product, which will make him more convincing.
If you just make it at home, the equipment is very simple. The only difficulty is the cooling equipment. However, the temperature of well water is enough. If that doesn’t work, saltpeter can also make ice.
Ye Shuo nodded, and talked to his grandparents for a while. When it was evening, he left after saying “Ask me if you have any questions.”
Although Wei Wen was a clumsy person, he estimated that he and the servants around him should be able to do the job.
He accidentally saw his eldest grandson fiddling with something in the kitchen, and he was fussing with half a bag of rice. The Duke Zhen, who had come all the way to see him, was heartbroken.
As an old general who had fought in the battlefield, what he hated most was people wasting food.
Doesn’t he know how many soldiers could be saved by this small half bag of rice?
If it weren’t for the past, the Duke of Zhen would have taken action long ago.
Half a month later, the rice had disappeared, and was replaced by a jar of wine.
“Is this what you have made these days?” Wei Wen let the brewed wine settle for a few days and now felt that the time was about right. As a result, just as he opened the seal, he suddenly heard such a voice coming from behind him, and was immediately startled.
“grandfather?!”
“Okay, stop talking so much, pour me a bowl and let me try it.” The Duke of Zhen was not polite at all and sat down on the bench beside him.
Wei Wen had no choice but to pour him a bowl.
When the wine bowl was brought in front of him, the Duke of Zhen immediately smelled an extremely strong aroma of wine. The aroma of the wine was extremely mellow, and just by smelling it, he felt drunk.
Looking at the wine soup again, it is not turbid in color, and there are not even many impurities. It is clear and transparent, just like well water.
The Duke of Zhen immediately understood that this must be a good thing.
No wonder the two people, one big and one small, are so troubled.
The Duke of Zhen’s mouth was watering and he picked up the bowl without hesitation.
The wine first passed through the mouth, then the throat, and then the stomach. Wherever it went, it felt like fire. Almost instantly, sweat broke out on Duke Zhen’s forehead.
“Good wine!” The Duke of Zhenguo couldn’t help but his eyes lit up.
Wei Wen didn’t use much rice, only a little over a pound in total. The wine that came out later was not as strong as at the beginning, so he stopped immediately according to the instructions on the recipe.
The grandchildren will not be able to enjoy this pound of wine, but it should be enough if I just share it with my sons.
Hearing him say this, Wei Wen couldn’t help but remind him: “Think carefully, this is just one jar of wine. Once you drink it, it will be gone.”
“Just brew more after you finish drinking it.” The old Duke didn’t care. Now that he has a mountain of gold, is he still worried about not having money to spend?
But the next moment, Wei Wen shook his head and said, “I knew you would say this once. When my cousin was leaving, he specifically told me to only do this once and not again.”
When Ye Shuo came here before, he knew how much his grandfather, uncle, and cousins ​​could drink, one jar after another. But the problem is that alcohol is really not a good thing. For the sake of their health, it is better to forget about drinking this kind of strong liquor with an alcohol content of 40 or 50 degrees.
The Duke of Zhen’s expression froze in an instant.
When he heard that they were going to provide such good things to the people of Beiting, the Duke of Zhen flew into a rage on the spot.
“You two are really betraying each other!”
“Unfilial sons, two unfilial sons!”
Wei Wen withstood the pressure and asked, “Grandfather, based on your understanding of the Beiting people, do you think this is feasible?” After all, Wei Wen had never really dealt with the Beiting people, so he was inevitably a little nervous.
Upon hearing this, the Duke of Zhen sneered: “Let’s put it this way, if there is really a chronic poison in here, do you believe that they can drink themselves to death?”
The winter in Beiting is extremely cold, and people can freeze to death if they are not careful. This strong liquor is not only a pastime for them, but also their lifeblood. How could anyone refuse it?
Wei Wen immediately felt relieved.
The Duke of Zhen looked at his eldest grandson eagerly, feeling deeply regretful. If he had known, he should have taken a closer look when his eldest grandson was processing the batch of rice. Now, he couldn’t even remember how his eldest grandson did it.
Wei Wen remained unmoved.
The eldest grandson is so hard-hearted that the Duke of Zhen is helpless and can only see if his youngest grandson can think of a solution.
As for distributing the only jar of wine to his sons? Forget it!
The Duke of Zhen planned to put the jar in the room, next to the bed, and drink it slowly.
However, the Duke of Zhen made a sad discovery that after tasting this wine, he could no longer drink any other wine.
Those things are as light as water, and have a sour taste. Is that something people drink? It’s almost like horse urine.
After more than one pound of distilled liquor was consumed and it was time for dinner, the Duke of Zhen suddenly lost interest.
Ye Shuo’s uncles were surprised to find that their father didn’t drink anymore!
“This is good wine that Zhao’er spent a lot of effort trying to get from outside. Father, are you sure you don’t want to try it?” Could the old man be sick?
His uncle spoke tentatively.
However, the Duke of Zhen just sniffed it and immediately lost interest.
The taste of this wine is extremely mixed, not even a fraction as good as the wine brewed by my grandson. It is really tasteless.
“No, you can drink it by yourselves.” The Duke of Zhenguo flatly refused.
Ye Shuo’s uncles soon started drinking heavily.
It is indeed a good wine, the taste is really extraordinary. I have to drink it sparingly and not guzzle it like usual.
Seeing how excited they were, the Duke of Zhen shook his head.
What a bunch of ignorant people, this is all they can achieve in their life.
Alas, the people of Beiting are so lucky…
Gradually, the Duke of Zhen even quit drinking.
About five months later, Wei Wen sent silver to Lucheng several times in advance. The dozen people set up stalls and produced a batch of finished products. Then a caravan set out from General Xu and came to Lucheng, then bypassed the State of Chen and entered Beiting with this batch of distilled liquor.
Since it was being sold to the people of Beiting, there was really no need to be polite. Ye Shuo just ripped them off, and the profit increased dozens of times. Even Wei Wen, a scholar who had little contact with the business in the mansion, had the urge to smack his lips in amazement.
This is too dark…
However, there is no way around it, the monopoly industry is so profitable.
Not long after, the best distilled liquor brought by these merchants was brought to the Wolf King.
Then, there was news that the Sixth Imperial Concubine was pregnant.
Nine months later, the Sixth Princess gave birth to a boy with great difficulty, and the Sixth Prince finally got his wish.
Another year and a half passed, and the Sixth Prince’s son, Ye Jin, finally learned to walk.
It was an extremely sunny day. When Jianjian, who was already eight years old, came back from the study room with Master Cen, she heard the sounds of “creaking” and “creaking”.
Then there is a familiar hammock.
The young man on the hammock has his eyes closed, his limbs are slender, and the corners of his lips are half-curled. The afternoon sun shines on his face, which is as beautiful as a painting.
There was an uncontrollable flash of surprise in those sharp eyes.
Then, the boy who looked like a god slowly opened his eyes.
In an instant, the fog was thicker than before.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Building a Mansion
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+, now 260+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Well…you’re back…”
The boy who just woke up is not fully awake yet. The hoarseness mixed with the boy’s unique clear voice creates a strange feeling, which makes people can’t help but shudder, and even their hearts are trembling.
The maid following behind Jianjian couldn’t control herself and her cheeks flushed slightly.
Ye Shuo leaned there, yawned lazily, and asked, “What homework did Master Cen assign today? Is it too much? If not, you can just help me write it.”
With a “crack”, something broke.
Jianjian woke up immediately.
Damn it! I was deceived by his face again!
He does this every day, but I still get deceived every time. Why can’t I learn my lesson?
Why did God put this face on his head!“Do your own things! Do your own homework!”
Jianjian, who is now eight years old, is no longer as gullible as she was before. She deeply suspects that her brother did it on purpose and wanted to use this face to confuse her and achieve his ulterior motives.
so……
“Don’t even think about it!”
Seeing her intense reaction, Ye Shuo did not force her. He sighed in his heart that his sister was not as cute as before, and said, “Then call Xing Yucheng into the palace and let Xing Yucheng help write it.”
Poor Xing Yucheng, he made one wrong step after another. Ever since he received the five taels of silver as a child, he has never lived a peaceful life.
What’s more, in the year when he became the top scorer in high school, Ye Shuo generously gave him a house, and Xing Yucheng couldn’t even refuse.
Over the years, the silver Xing Yucheng had saved had become a considerable sum. If he was discovered, according to the laws of the Great Zhou, beheading would be the least severe punishment.
Perhaps the previous lesson was too painful, Xing Yucheng is now probably the most honest official in the entire Shangjing City, and he is now showing signs of PTSD.
Xing Yucheng himself had good abilities and had made remarkable achievements in the three years he was in office, so he was soon transferred back by Emperor Jingwen. In addition, due to his honest and upright character, his career was naturally smooth sailing.
Although Xing Yucheng may not be so willing to come back…
“…Brother, please spare Lord Xing.” Ever since learning about this, Jianjian suddenly felt infinite sympathy for Lord Xing.
He was a well-known genius before, and he won the top spot in the imperial examination. Now he is a fifth-rank official in Beijing, but he still cannot escape the fate of doing homework.
“We still have to give Lord Xing some face.”
Ye Shuo spread his hands: “Either he helps me write, or you help me write, you choose one.”
“…Then let Lord Xing write it for you.” Jianjian has learned her lesson after being fooled twice. She now understands the essence of “It is better to let my friend die than to let me die.”
“Look, you…A-choo!” Ye Shuo wanted to say something, but he felt an itchy nose and sneezed as soon as he opened his mouth.
“You deserve it! Who told you to sleep in the yard in May? It’s fine if you just slept, but you didn’t even cover yourself with a blanket.”
Despite complaining like this, Jianjian still pulled out her handkerchief, her eyes full of hidden worry, fearing that he would get sick again if he wasn’t careful.
When the Imperial Concubine and the Sixth Princess came back from touring the garden, what they saw was the Seventh Princess teaching the Ninth Prince a lesson.
This scene can only be seen in Qiuwu Palace. Other princes don’t have the patience to fight and play with the princess all day long.
“Hey, Jin’er is here.”
“Let Uncle Nine take a look to see if our Jin’er has gained weight again.”
When Ye Shuo saw the little kid in the Sixth Princess’s hand, his eyes lit up.
Before the little kid could react, he felt his feet were off the ground the next moment.
Ye Shuo is now sixteen years old. He is already over 1.8 meters tall and has a tendency to continue growing taller. In addition, he inherited good genes from his grandfather, so his body is extremely strong.
Although it doesn’t look much from the outside, the explosive power contained in his body is far beyond what ordinary people can compare to.
The old Duke of Zhen once estimated that, in terms of strength alone, he is no worse than he was in his twenties, but his grandson is only sixteen years old and has not yet reached his peak.
In this situation, it was naturally easy for Ye Shuo to lift a mere child.
At first, the precocious little kid was still tense, but in the end he couldn’t help it anymore and started to scream.
The Sixth Princess was already used to all this. She was a little nervous when he did this for the first time, but after doing it many times she no longer thought it was a big deal.
“That’s right. You’re still so young, why do you always learn from your father?” Keeping any emotions in your heart for a long time can easily harm your body, which is why some bad guys live longer.
Because of Xiao Ming, the child’s health is not very good. If he becomes like his father again, it will be disastrous.
Realising that he was now so high from the ground, the little kid subconsciously hugged Ye Shuo’s neck tightly.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but burst out laughing.
“Let’s go, Uncle Nine will take you to find your father.”
Looking at her brother-in-law with skillful movements and standard postures, the Sixth Princess couldn’t help but sigh that if only her husband could be half as good as him, no, even one-tenth of him.
It’s not that the Sixth Prince is inconsiderate. After all, he is so smart, and the way he speaks and does things will not make people feel uncomfortable. If he were just a husband, the Sixth Princess would have no dissatisfaction.
But his attitude towards his son was far less intimate than that of the Ninth Prince.
Maybe it’s because he is the only son and my husband has high hopes for him, so he is not as tolerant to his child as other fathers.
In the entire Great Zhou, people like the Ninth Prince are actually a minority.
The Sixth Imperial Concubine subconsciously asked about her brother-in-law’s marriage: “Has Mother Rong arranged a marriage for my brother-in-law?”
Concubine Rong also wanted to do this, but the problem was that her son didn’t have this idea at all, and the concubine was very worried now.
But Shuo’er refused to give in, and there was nothing she could do.
“Maybe he hasn’t met enough girls now. Maybe he will get the idea after he goes out and builds his own house.” Ye Shuo has received too many preventive measures in recent years, so the imperial concubine’s attitude has gradually softened. She is no longer as picky as before.
Speaking of building a mansion, according to palace rules, he should have moved out as early as last year.
But the imperial concubine was reluctant to do so, and the emperor was also reluctant to let him go, so the matter was postponed for another year.
Regarding the Ninth Prince’s residence, the Ministry of Internal Affairs spent nearly 700,000 taels of silver, the Imperial Concubine and the Duke of Zhen contributed 300,000 taels, and the Emperor allocated 300,000 tales from his own private treasury, totaling 1.3 million taels of silver. Even in the capital city of Shangjing, where every inch of land is valuable, the area occupied by the Ninth Prince’s residence is extremely impressive.
Compared with the Sixth Prince’s two hundred thousand taels, it is like heaven and earth.
Even the eldest prince’s mansion, plus the expansion after he was conferred the title of prince, cost less than one million taels in total. It is no exaggeration to call the Ninth Prince’s mansion luxurious.
Since the cost of building this mansion is so high, the workload is naturally much larger. Four years have passed since Ye Shuo was twelve years old, and it is only now completed.
This time, the imperial concubine and Emperor Jingwen really could not find any reason to keep their son.
The Ninth Prince’s Palace was completed about a month ago. The Imperial Observatory gave a good date in June, so at most there were only about ten days left.
The imperial concubine couldn’t help but sigh, feeling very reluctant.
Of course, this was not what made her most angry. What made her most angry was that when this little bastard mentioned moving out of the palace, he was not sad at all. Instead, he was full of anticipation and looked impatient, which made the imperial concubine really want to give him a beating.
“He is such a heartless person. I gave birth to him in vain!”
The brother-in-law was really straightforward. He didn’t even try to hide such a thing. The Sixth Princess found it both ridiculous and funny.
The other side.
Ye Shuo held the little kid in his arms easily, thinking to himself, these royal children are so easy to raise, each one is more obedient than the other. If it were an ordinary one and a half year old child, he would be so annoying when he makes trouble, but the children here are self-taught and are more well-behaved than babies.
But behind this understanding, there is a price to pay.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask: “Jin’er, Uncle Nine wants to ask you, have you listened to Uncle Nine’s advice recently and exercised more?”
The little kid had just started learning to speak, and right after that he started learning to recite poems. I really don’t know what Xiao Ming was thinking.
The only consolation is that since Xiao Ming discovered that exercise helps with having a baby, his physical fitness has finally improved.
He changed his career late and the results were average, so the little Jin’er had to start from childhood.
The little bean nodded obediently: “Yes…Uncle…”
“That’ll do.” It was too intense for him to bear right now. What Ye Shuo taught was nothing else but the second set of elementary school students’ radio gymnastics – Young Eagle Takes Off.
The little kid takes after his father, his hands and feet are uncoordinated, and the picture of him flapping his arms and legs like a duckling is so funny.
But Ye Shuo didn’t dare to laugh. Once he laughed, the little guy, who was just as concerned about his reputation as his father, would have to give up.
“Jin’er is awesome!”
Ye Shuo was not stingy with his praise.
The little boy’s face quickly turned red.
When Ye Shuo brought him to the gate of Qinzheng Palace, they had just caught up with the Sixth Prince and his men when they finished their business.
I guess they are discussing some national affairs today, and a group of people will be gathered soon.
The eldest prince, the second prince, the crown prince… all the way to the seventh prince are all here. As for the eighth prince, he has not yet become powerful enough, so he is usually not included in meetings like this.
Seeing Xiaojiu coming over with the child from afar, the eldest prince and the crown prince, who had just been on the verge of a showdown, felt that the scene was weird.
Why does he always like to deal with women and children? What kind of hobby is this?
As for the Sixth Prince, he watched helplessly as his son, who looked so lovely when he was singled out, suddenly became much more mediocre in the contrast with his younger brother, and the corners of his mouth could not help but twitch slightly.
Even though the princes don’t care much about their appearance, they don’t like to stand with their younger brother anymore.
Due to the limitations of ancient conditions, there were very few tall people. But in terms of height, only the eldest prince could compete with Ye Shuo. In this case, how could others like him to get close?
But God has always been fair. He gave him a good face and an excellent mother family, and he would make up for it in other ways.
Thinking about what the emperor had just said, that Xiaojiu would be leaving the palace soon, and that he would be assigned to the Ministry of Works and would only be given a nominal position, everyone subconsciously breathed a sigh of relief.
It seems that the emperor is very sensible and what he said is true. Although he doted on Xiaojiu, he also completely deprived him of the qualification to move forward.
If you pamper someone but don’t give him power, everything will be like a castle in the air or a bubble in the water, which will shatter at the slightest touch.
Looking at it this way, the eldest prince and his companions suddenly felt that everything else was nothing, just some petty profits.
Poor Xiaojiu, he still doesn’t know what he has lost.
This child has never grown up carefully since he was young, and it’s the same now.
Since he was not a competitor, and Xiaojiu himself was not annoying, the eldest prince and the others turned a blind eye and did not bother to bother with him.
“?”
Noticing the sympathy that flashed in the Fifth Prince’s eyes, Ye Shuo was a little puzzled. What was going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Leaving the Palace
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {240+, now 260+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Xiaojiu, since you are about to leave the palace, remember to come to Big Brother’s house often.”
Before leaving, the eldest prince reached out and patted him on the shoulder to comfort him.
Then came the second prince. Even though he was the second prince, he was not reluctant to show goodwill to people with whom he had no direct conflict of interest.
Finally, there are the fourth prince and the fifth prince.
As for the Seventh Prince, he was merely a vassal of the Fifth Prince and naturally had no right to sympathise with Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo couldn’t free his hands because he was holding the child, and one of his shoulders was hurt by the patting.
Looking at the backs of several people, Ye Shuo was confused.
Then Ye Shuo looked at the Sixth Prince beside him: “What’s going on?”
The Sixth Prince was silent for a moment, then said, “Go ask your father.”Ye Shuo originally wanted to hand the child to him, but then he changed his mind and thought that since he had brought little Ye Jin here, he should go and pay his respects to his stepfather, so he said, “Then you wait outside. I’ll go in and ask Father if he wants to come to Qiuwu Palace to have dinner with us tonight.”
What can the Sixth Prince do? He can only wait.
Ye Shuo went in holding the child.
Emperor Jingwen was writing something at that time. When he heard the announcement, he looked up subconsciously and saw his unmarried son taking care of the child.
Emperor Jingwen felt a headache every time he saw this skillful posture.
Ye Shuo first greeted his adopted father with the nervous little Ye Jin, then walked closer and asked, “By the way, Dad, what did you just say to my eldest brother and the others? Why did they look at me like that just now?”
Emperor Jingwen sighed.
When will the little bastard change his temper of saying whatever he wants? Stop being so blunt all the time.
Some things should be treated as if they were not seen even if they were discovered.
Although he thought so in his heart, Emperor Jingwen said: “I just mentioned to your brothers that you left the palace to build a mansion.”
Oh my god!
Is he finally going to be free?! He is not being ungrateful. After all, his mother and Jianjian are still in the palace. Filial piety and staying in the palace and with his mother every day are two completely different things.
It is a very natural thing for people to grow up and then go out on their own. When animals grow up, they have to leave their mother’s arms and go out on their own to explore the world.
After so many years, Ye Shuo also wanted to breathe the air outside the palace.
A hint of anticipation and surprise subconsciously flashed in his eyes, but then Ye Shuo thought of something and immediately restrained himself.
Ye Shuo still remembered that when his cheap father asked this question last year, he just smiled and his cheap father was so angry that he immediately locked him up for another year and couldn’t stop scolding him for being heartless. Ye Shuo couldn’t make the same mistake again.
Just like that, Emperor Jingwen watched the little bastard with a distorted expression as if he wanted to laugh but didn’t dare to, pretending to be in pain, but in fact he didn’t even notice that his white teeth were exposed.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen was immediately angered by this unfilial son.
“You bastard, you can’t even pretend!” Emperor Jingwen was angry that he dared to treat him so perfunctorily.
Ye Shuo felt that his stepfather was really hard to please. In his heart, he liked him for being like this, but in his words, he disliked him for being like this.
“Oh, Dad, don’t be angry, don’t be angry. You’ll get sick from being angry.” Besides, he won’t change if you get angry, so it’s useless.
“Oh, by the way, father, it’s been such a long time, and I haven’t been to my own prince’s palace to see it. Have you bought all the furniture and ornaments inside?”
Speaking of which, his son is really something. He asked for leave twice before, saying that he wanted to go and see the progress of the construction of his mansion. If Emperor Jingwen had not been careful and asked the secret guards to follow him, he would have been fooled by him.
What the hell did he do to go and check the progress of the construction? As soon as he stepped out of the imperial city gate, he disappeared in a flash and didn’t come back until it was dark in the evening.
From then on, this excuse was completely invalid for Emperor Jingwen.
Compared to Ye Shuo, who was a hands-off boss, Emperor Jingwen, as an emperor, at least went to see him several times.
Emperor Jingwen was not the kind of emperor who was lazy and ignorant. He naturally knew how serious the situation was in the Imperial Household Department, where they deceived their superiors and bullied the weak. But that was human nature and he could not do anything about it, so Emperor Jingwen had to go there in person to alert them.
Just because of the renovation of the Ninth Prince’s Palace, the servants of the Imperial Household Department had to deal with two batches of people, and finally stopped the servants from having the idea of ​​​massive corruption.
Therefore, Ye Shuo’s prince’s mansion was built to be both large and luxurious, which was considered as compensation from Emperor Jingwen to him.
As for what the compensation is, the answer is self-evident.
“Almost everything has been prepared.” Emperor Jingwen answered himself without even needing Wang Ziquan’s reminder.
Sometimes the difference between caring about someone and not caring about him is so huge, especially for an emperor who has so many sons and cannot devote so much energy to the harem. A child who wins his heart is like a treasure, while a child who dislikes him is just a weed.
In addition to the 300,000 taels, Emperor Jingwen also picked out a lot of good things from his private treasury, and now they are all placed in his son’s house.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even mention it to anyone.
“After you leave the palace, remember to report to the Ministry of Works every day.” The Ministry of Personnel, the Ministry of Revenue, the Ministry of Rites, the Ministry of War, the Ministry of Justice, and the Ministry of Works, with the Ministry of Works being the last. At this point, Emperor Jingwen could not help but pause.
This decision had been made before, but when it was actually spoken, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but wonder if this would be too harsh on Xiaojiu.
Cutting off his path to power was too cruel for a prince.
But if we don’t do this, the eldest prince and the others probably won’t agree. As time goes by, Xiaojiu will eventually get hurt.
However, Ye Shuo’s first reaction after hearing this was – Isn’t this completely liberating?
You have to know that Xing Yucheng’s father is now the Minister of Industry, the highest official in the entire Ministry of Industry. Knowing that Xing Yucheng is his companion, rounding it off, the Minister of Industry is also considered one of his own. Apart from anything else, there is no problem in helping to punch in and sign in.
After all…Xing Yucheng has taken over the house.
The five taels of silver given at the time was really a huge profit.
Zou Wu has now been promoted to the fifth rank of the Ministry of Works with her skills. She is below the vice minister of the Ministry of Works. Once the vice minister retires, she will be able to take over immediately. In this case, Ye Shuo can go if he wants to, or not go if he doesn’t want to?
Ye Shuo almost laughed out loud.
“Thank you for your consideration, Father!”
This time, he even called out his father.
For a moment, Emperor Jingwen suddenly didn’t know what to say.
His younger brother, the Prince of Jin, knew that he did not have the ability, so he gradually gave up the idea. But his own son, who was born not to love power, tried desperately to run away, as if power was more poisonous than poison. This was the first time that Emperor Jingwen had seen such a thing.
In the past, Emperor Jingwen could say that it was because he was young and did not understand these things. But now that he is already sixteen years old and is about to leave the palace to set up his own palace, this reason can no longer convince Emperor Jingwen.
After a moment, Emperor Jingwen sighed.
It’s better this way. After all, there is a son with me who has nothing to do with imperial power, only the father-son relationship.
“Okay, okay, I’ve finished speaking, you can go out first.” Emperor Jingwen waved his hand.
Ye Shuo was about to leave with little Ye Jin in his arms, and then he thought of something and asked casually, “By the way, my sixth brother and the Sixth Royal Concubine are here tonight, Dad, do you want to come back for dinner?”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t think much about it and nodded casually.
After so many years, he has almost gotten used to it.
When Ye Shuo walked out of the gate of the Qinzheng Palace, the Sixth Prince’s feet were sore and painful.
The Sixth Prince was already very tired after standing for a whole afternoon, and he didn’t expect that he would have to wait again. He was even more tired.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo could only say: “You deserve it.”
“You said you were not feeling well, why don’t you just ask Eunuch Wang to move a chair for you?”
The Sixth Prince really wanted to beat up this brother who was ignorant of the sufferings of the world. Now, like the eldest prince, the more he looked at his younger brother, the angrier he became.
“If the prince doesn’t sit down, how can we sit down first?”
Ye Shuo: “…”
“Then tell the prince!” If you can’t save face, just tell the prince. The prince won’t be unwilling to cooperate with such a small matter.
Ye Shuo has always wondered what the purpose of their mouths is. Is there any problem that cannot be solved through communication?
The Sixth Prince was stuck. No matter what, he couldn’t say it.
No wonder Ye Shuo felt that most of the time they were just asking for trouble.
“And the same goes for Jin’er. He’s still so young. Don’t push him all the time.”
The Sixth Prince was powerless to do anything about this matter. He knew that his son was weak and only learned to walk at the age of one and a half. But the Sixth Prince could not do anything. He only had this one son, and he could not have as many sons as the Eldest Prince and the Crown Prince. This was the only way he could do it.
His son must be smarter than all the other imperial grandchildren so that he won’t fall behind.
Fortunately, even though the Sixth Prince was anxious, he did not go too extreme and always controlled the situation carefully.
However, little Ye Jin seemed to have sensed his father’s expectations and learned self-discipline without any instruction.
Ye Shuo wanted to persuade him, but didn’t know how.
The two looked at each other in silence and walked along the way.
In a blink of an eye, more than ten days passed, and Ye Shuo finally waited for the day to leave the palace. The imperial concubine felt a pang in her heart, and she wanted to cry, but when she heard her son laughing so loudly, the imperial concubine thought for several times and really couldn’t cry.
All the sadness in her heart turned into anger, and the imperial concubine almost took action.
When Emperor Jingwen arrived, Ye Shuo immediately stopped acting rashly.
I have already performed ninety-nine bows, and this one shudder is all that’s left. I can’t let anything go wrong.
However, Emperor Jingwen felt unhappy when he saw his grown-up son.
Emperor Jingwen is now old, and he would recall the past from time to time.
I still remember that when I first saw the little bastard, he was only that big, staggering and unable to walk steadily. But now, more than ten years have passed in the blink of an eye, and he has grown taller than me.
A complex emotion flashed across his eyes, and Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but give him a lot of instructions.
Ye Shuo was only concerned with imagining his wonderful future life and didn’t notice the implicit meaning of his words, which told him to remember to visit the palace more often when he had time.
But Emperor Jingwen was a man who cared a lot about his reputation. He would never say much, let alone speak directly. His words could usually only be understood by listening in a roundabout way. When he met someone like Ye Shuo, it was really useless.
It’s not that Ye Shuo really didn’t understand, he was just too lazy to guess.
Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he almost died when he saw his son saying “hmm” and “ah” so much.
How could I have given birth to such a thing? !
“Get out, get out of here!”
“Go away and never come back!”
Everything was fine at the beginning, but now he started scolding again. After so many years, Wang Ziquan had become accustomed to it.
Ye Shuo pretended to be reluctant and said goodbye to his mother, stepfather and Jian Jian in tears.
Seeing his tears, Emperor Jingwen was instinctively startled, but before he could see clearly, he saw Ye Shuo had turned around.
In the end, all that was left of Emperor Jingwen and the imperial concubine was a back view.
It has always been like this between parents and children. Although they are the closest people, they cannot accompany each other forever.
Wang Zisheng was the emperor’s close attendant, and at this moment he subconsciously wanted to comfort him. The prince’s leaving the palace to build a mansion proved that the prince had grown up, which was a good thing. But when he looked up inadvertently, he saw that the emperor’s eyes were slightly red…

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Luxury
chapters.content:
One can imagine the shock in Wang Ziquan’s heart.
This is the emperor who suffered so much back then without blinking an eye…
Although Emperor Jingwen had recovered as normal when they returned to Qiuwu Palace, as if the scene just now was just Wang Ziquan’s hallucination, Wang Ziquan still remembered it deeply in his heart.
The other side.
Ye Shuo was still a little sad at first. After all, after so many years, he had long been accustomed to being his mother’s little baby. It was really hard for him to leave suddenly.
But soon, he adjusted his mentality.
They were almost at the palace gate, and Ye Shuo became happy again.
This scene happened to be seen by the commander-in-chief who was on patrol.
As a close minister to the emperor, the commander-in-chief was naturally very good at guessing the emperor’s intentions, and he knew that the emperor had never been willing to let the ninth prince leave his side.
The emperor loves his son so much that he even made an exception and kept the ninth prince for another year. However, the ninth prince did not seem to share the emperor’s wishes…Looking at the overjoyed Ninth Prince, the commander-in-chief was silent for a moment, hesitating whether to report the matter to the emperor.
Finally, the commander-in-chief sighed and decided to let it go so as not to add more trouble to the emperor.
Having no idea what the commander-in-chief was thinking, Ye Shuo habitually greeted him when he passed by.
“Thank you for your hard work, Commander-in-Chief. Come on, Commander!”
Although he didn’t know what the so-called “come on” meant, the commander-in-chief could guess it from the Ninth Prince’s performance.
For some reason, the commander-in-chief suddenly felt a subtle sense of blockage in his heart.
Before he could lead others to pay their respects, only the back of the Ninth Prince was left.
When Ye Shuo walked out of the gate of the imperial city, he felt like a fish entering water, and he became a completely different person.
Seeing him walking towards the small stalls in front of the Imperial City, Xiao Luzi subconsciously asked, “Your Highness, didn’t you say you were going to the Prince’s Palace…?”
Why did it stop now?
“Why are you in such a hurry so early in the morning?”
Ye Shuo also asked for a bowl of noodle tea for Xiao Luzi, and while cleaning the chopsticks carefully, he said, “That house won’t run away again.”
Xiao Luzi opened his mouth, but suddenly couldn’t say anything to refute.
To be honest, this noodle tea is quite delicious, and Xiao Luzi gradually shut his mouth.
After eating the noodle tea, Ye Shuo felt even fuller. He didn’t take the carriage today specifically because he wanted to have some fun.
As usual, Ye Shuo found a teahouse and sat down.
It would be fine if Ye Shuo didn’t come here often, but now that he has moved out, he will naturally be a frequent visitor here in the future. In ancient times, there was a lack of entertainment, and few people were literate, so most of the compiled storybooks were not to Ye Shuo’s taste.
It’s okay to listen to it occasionally, but Ye Shuo can’t stand it for a long time.
Ye Shuo had money. Over the past few years, he had taken advantage of Bei Ting. Apart from sharing the profits with his eldest cousin and his men, Ye Shuo had already accumulated a huge amount of wealth.
Not to mention comparing it with the national treasury, one person certainly cannot compare with a country, but he is definitely much richer than his cheap father. Money makes money in Lu City, and even if Ye Shuo tries his best to squander it, he can never keep up with the speed of making money.
In this case, Ye Shuo will naturally never lack money to spend.
The people of Beiting are not stupid. They have noticed this over the years, but there is nothing they can do. The imperial court cannot prohibit it at all.
Once the hole is opened, it will be difficult to close it again.
Even though they added new laws, many people would still take a sip every winter, even at the risk of having their hands chopped off.
Compared to the extreme cold, the pain is still bearable.
Faced with repeated bans, Beiting had thought about directly killing the people who produced distilled liquor, but unfortunately, the people who produced this kind of liquor were not in Beiting’s territory. The production place of distilled liquor was in Lucheng, and there was the Chen State in between, so Beiting was really out of reach.
All they could kill were innocent merchants who brought goods to sell.
But Beiting wanted to trade with Chen and Da Zhou, and merchants were really indispensable. If too many were killed, other merchants would be unwilling to come, and Beiting would be the one who would suffer in the end.
Then, Beiting adopted the method of self-production. After all, distilled liquor was not a very confidential thing, and it was not surprising that the method of making distilled liquor was leaked. But unfortunately, Beiting simply did not have that much grain to consume.
Food and recipes are indispensable. Nowadays, none of the three countries can sustain such consumption, so Beiting can only watch helplessly.
The power of Lucheng is being nurtured with Beiting’s money, and it is growing stronger and stronger. Now, unless there is a large-scale invasion, a small force going to spy will have no way back.
Soon, small-scale invasions will no longer be a concern.
Not to mention that my grandfather has very mature methods of training soldiers, the modern military training methods that Ye Shuo brought out are definitely a dimensionality reduction attack at the moment.
With food, money and land, the soldiers trained in this way will naturally be much stronger than those of Beiting, Chen State and Da Zhou. On the contrary, the number of people gathered in the force is less, and the number of people has now become a burden.
When Ye Shuo brought out the method of training special forces, for a moment, the cousin seriously suspected that he was going to rebel.
After all, if we continue to expand at this rate, it may not be impossible to achieve success in a few years or even decades.
Didn’t you say you should leave yourself a way out? This road is too wide and too smooth!
Self-protection is self-protection. Killing those who want to hurt them is also called self-protection.
It’s like lurking. As long as all the enemies are killed, wouldn’t it be considered a success?
