What the cousin didn’t know was that until now, Ye Shuo still hadn’t done everything.
This is just the beginning, it’s just distilled liquor, he hasn’t yet brought out his other killer weapon.
——Tobacco, a highly profitable industry whose annual tax revenue can support the annual military expenditure and still make a fortune.
If this thing was brought out and placed in ancient times, Ye Shuo didn’t know what would happen.
The packaging is small and convenient for transportation. No matter whether you are a commoner or a noble, you can have some after dinner. The one who can make money is really good.
But Ye Shuo really has no shortage of money now, and smoking is harmful to health, so he thinks about it and decides to give up.
In this case, it would be easy for Ye Shuo to listen to a book that suits his taste.
Anyway, he didn’t feel bad about spending Beiting’s money. He just regarded it as a contribution to the GDP of Dazhou and a relief for the working people.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo took out a silver note from his purse.
Ye Shuo had been here a few times before. When the owner of the teahouse saw his demeanor, he knew that this young man must be rich or noble, but he didn’t expect that he would be so generous.
The owner of the teahouse subconsciously took a look and was shocked to find that they were all large-denomination silver notes, with a total of at least seventeen or eighteen notes of one thousand and five hundred taels. The smallest denomination among them was the one hundred taels note in his hand.
The shopkeeper almost bent over to take it.
Ye Shuo didn’t say much, just said: “Find a few people who are good at writing stories. I’ve been bored lately, I want to ask them to write a few books for me.”
Ye Shuo was too lazy to follow the crowd, so he planned to spend money to get a customised version.
Since it is custom-made, Ye Shuo will definitely make it according to his own taste.
As the saying goes, a man of courage will always be rewarded with a large sum of money. Moreover, the storybooks themselves are meant to entertain the public. It doesn’t matter who you write for.
“Twenty tales per copy. Four copies first. If you can satisfy me, the remaining twenty tales will be your reward.” Judging from the shopkeeper’s attitude, he must be sensible and would not dare to default on his debt. Therefore, Ye Shuo did not hesitate and gave him the hundred taels of silver without even getting a written agreement.
…This money is so easy to make!
The teahouse owner accepted it happily without much hesitation.
Xiao Luzi on the side wanted to stop it, but it was too late.
Oh my God, His Highness, is he crazy?
He had only been out of the palace for half an hour, and one hundred taels of silver, which is almost 40% of his monthly allowance, had already been spent. At this rate, even with the subsidy from the imperial concubine, it would still be far from enough for His Highness to spend.
It’s over. If this continues, the Ninth Prince’s Mansion will be ruined by his own master sooner or later.
Xiao Luzi is about to cry.
However, Ye Shuo seemed not to notice and explained his request in detail to the shopkeeper.
The literati in ancient times were extremely talented, and their creative works were also quite rich. Not to mention the four great classics, but also works like Strange Stories from a Chinese Studio, White Snake and Green Snake, Three Words and Two Pats, etc., which one is not a classic among classics, and they were all written by the ancients.
Of course, if it is just the fantasy of a poor scholar, then it will definitely not work.
The more money Ye Shuo gave, the more demands he naturally made.
The shopkeeper carefully asked him what he was talking about. Ye Shuo did not hide anything and casually told him one or two stories. The more the shopkeeper listened, the brighter his eyes became.
Since he runs a teahouse, the owner naturally has some vision and can tell the value of the stories he tells.
only……
“If you want a book of the same standard, I’m afraid this silver is not enough.”
The shopkeeper looked a little embarrassed.
Xiao Luzi was a little shocked when he heard this.
Twenty tales of silver was enough for an ordinary family to use for a year, so how come it couldn’t buy a book? Back then, he was sold to the palace by his parents for only six taels of silver.
Twenty taels is enough to buy three of himself and he still has plenty!
This shopkeeper, is he trying to trick His Highness because he is young?
However, Ye Shuo knew that classics are priceless. If someone could really write a classic like Strange Stories from a Chinese Studio, its value would certainly not be measured by mere money.
Therefore, Ye Shuo felt that the shopkeeper’s request was very reasonable: “If it is written according to my requirements, it would be this price. If it can really be compared with the ones I just mentioned, it will naturally be a different price.”
Since the other party is willing to take this job, he must be in financial difficulty at home. The only thing Ye Shuo can give is financial compensation.
The shopkeeper was naturally delighted to see that the young man was so reasonable.
“Since this gentleman is so generous, I won’t be stingy. Here is a pot of tea for you. Please enjoy it slowly.”
The shopkeeper was happy, but Ye Shuo’s remarks, which seemed like he was being taken advantage of, made Xiao Luzi extremely agitated.
“You see, this is the benefit of learning and knowledge. As long as you read more, money is just a trivial benefit.”
The Ninth Prince himself does not like reading, but he always encourages people around him to read.
After Xiao Luzi calmed down, he could no longer hold back and asked, “Your Highness… In this case, then you see, I can…”
Xiao Luzi admitted that he was moved.
As long as he could write it, Ye Shuo would certainly not object.
After coming out of the teahouse in the afternoon, Ye Shuo went to the most famous opera troupe in Shangjing City. Seeing that there were no seats left, he directly booked a whole theatre. He was half lying on a recliner, swaying, feeling very comfortable.
Before leaving, Ye Shuo repeated his previous action – spending money.
Although Ye Shuo has not listened to all the songs that are popular nowadays and those that were popular many years ago, since he has come out, he will definitely listen to all of them sooner or later. If we don’t let them create songs early, what if he gets tired of listening to them and can’t catch up? How can that work?
In the evening, when they went to Zuixinglou for dinner, Ye Shuo still did the same old thing.
Spend money and ask the chef here to research new recipes.
Dim sum, snacks, cold dishes, hot dishes, meat or vegetarian are all fine; Ye Shuo just wants to try something he has never tried before.
Who wouldn’t want the research funds that fell from the sky? In order to get the money, the chef’s eldest apprentice immediately packed his bags and prepared to find new ingredients for him.
When he returned home in the evening, Ye Shuo made another detour and got a few musicians to stay in his house.
Now that he has just opened his mansion, it is naturally very deserted. It is a good opportunity for him to listen to some music to warm up the atmosphere.
There are also horses. They should be raised as soon as possible so that they can go fishing and hunting everywhere in the future. How can they do without a decent means of transportation?
After all, the Ninth Prince is also a prince. In addition, Emperor Jingwen intends to let the Ninth Prince cultivate brotherly feelings with his other sons, so basically several princes live on the same street. Even if they are not on the same street, they are not far away.
When the eldest prince finally came back after traveling day and night to appease his men, he saw his younger brother being surrounded by several musicians when he returned with heavy steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Entering the Mansion
chapters.content:
“Are these… all going to be brought into the palace?” He had no recollection of any musicians assigned to him by his father, so the eldest prince could not help but point at the group of musicians holding zithers and pipa and ask.
Ye Shuo nodded, as if it was a matter of course: “Of course.”
There are no mobile phones or speakers these days. If you want to listen to some music, don’t you have to rely on manual labour?
The eldest prince paused and said, “Ninth brother, as princes, you and I should set an example for the people and not be so arrogant and extravagant.”
…This sentence always sounds familiar.
Ye Shuo pondered for a moment, then turned his head and said in confusion: “Brother, are you jealous?”
Thinking back to the time when my stepfather and the prince were just like this, they were exactly the same.
“Huh? Am I jealous of you, my ninth brother?” The eldest prince retorted almost instantly.
He, a prince, commands a large army, while Xiaojiu is just an oligarch prince.
So there is nothing to be jealous of.Ye Shuo couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows when he heard that. That look made the eldest prince feel uncomfortable.
“Forget it, let’s not talk about this.” Ye Shuo was worried about not being able to find a good horse, and now a good horse is delivered to his door.
“Brother, do you have any extra horses? Can you give me one?” Ye Shuo scratched his chin and looked at him expectantly.
As everyone knows, the eldest prince is a military officer, so the horses in his camp will naturally not be bad.
The eldest prince: “…”
This brother is so shameless.
The eldest prince, who had never been asked for anything so directly, didn’t react for a long time.
But this is really not a big deal. Horses are extremely expensive to ordinary people, but they are nothing to the eldest prince.
But the eldest prince didn’t know what he wanted the horse for, so he asked.
Ye Shuo said without hesitation: “Of course, to go out and play!”
He has already moved out, so staying in Beijing won’t be enough to keep him there.
Ye Shuo had specifically asked his grandfather before, and the old Duke Zhen admitted it himself, that with his current skills, he could run anywhere without any problem.
As long as it is not the enemy’s base camp, he can go anywhere.
So Ye Shuo didn’t even need guards, he could just leave whenever he wanted.
“I plan to ride horses to climb mountains, go fishing, and then travel to several nearby cities…” It would definitely be boring to stay in one place all the time. Ye Shuo counted on his fingers one by one, but planned in his mind where to go first.
Ye Shuo thought he had plenty of time, so he didn’t plan to be in a hurry. He would stop and go as he pleased, staying in an inn for ten days or half a month in each place he arrived at. If the local scenery was good and the people were friendly, then staying there for a year or two would not be a problem.
At this rate, he would be able to travel to all the famous cities in the Great Zhou within ten years.
This is the kind of life Ye Shuo has always wanted to live.
The eldest prince was very worried when he heard this. How could he be so relaxed when he was also a prince?
“Didn’t the emperor assign you a job?” Even if it was an honorary position, it didn’t matter whether you went or not. Generally speaking, everyone would go.
Otherwise, if there was a commotion during court, it would be embarrassing.
Then the eldest prince suddenly remembered that his younger brother was very shameless.
“Of course I have my own way.” Ye Shuo cleared his throat and then blinked: “To tell you the truth, brother, my study partner is Xing Yucheng, do you know him?”
“His father is the current Minister of Industry, so…”
There is no need to investigate this matter. If you ask more, you will know. There is no point in Ye Shuo hiding it, so it is better to say it directly.
The eldest prince: “………………”
The eldest prince’s eyes changed again and again. This should be the first time he saw his younger brother take the initiative to confess his power.
But the Minister of Works is a shitty power. Although he is one of the six ministers, he is far from comparable to the other ministers. Only he thinks this is a good thing.
Although it is indeed a good thing for him.
Didn’t you see that his brother was so happy that he almost flew up in the air?
“Brother, I see you must be tired after coming back so late. This is the musician I hired at a high price. Why don’t you just come to my house and have a seat?” Ye Shuo pointed to the Ninth Prince’s house not far away, with a polite and enthusiastic attitude.
However, the eldest prince was so upset that he was in no mood to argue with him any more.
“No need. You should keep this extravagant thing to yourself!”
After saying this, the eldest prince flicked his sleeves and left.
As he walked, the eldest prince suddenly thought of a question. If he achieved great things in the future, would he still have to support him?
This was the son of the imperial concubine, and he had a noble status. As long as he hadn’t made a big mistake, no one could treat him badly.
A rare brother who has no ulterior motives.
But when you think about it, it’s really infuriating.
Thinking of this, the eldest prince suddenly became even angrier.
The eldest prince secretly swore that if such a day really came, he would never spoil him like his father did.
As long as we cut off his subsidies, we will see how he can live freely!
Thinking of this, the eldest prince suddenly felt much more relieved.
Tsk, these people are so stingy.
Ye Shuo waved to the musicians, signalling them to follow.
Ye Shuo quickly arrived at the gate of the Ninth Prince’s Mansion, where a group of maids and servants had been waiting for a long time.
The news from the palace said that he would come out in the morning, but now it was dark and the Ninth Prince had not come yet. Just when everyone thought that the Ninth Prince would not come today, he was suddenly seen outside the door.
“Greetings to the Ninth Prince.” The butler was the first to react and then saluted.
Others followed closely behind.
“Greetings to His Majesty the Ninth Prince.”
“No need to be polite, everyone please stand up.”
“By the way, you’re the housekeeper, right? Have someone settle these people first, and then go shopping with me.”
Speaking of which, Ye Shuo hasn’t seen what his new home looks like yet.
When the butler saw the musicians, he was stunned at first, and then he immediately asked someone to arrange them. It was so efficient that it was obvious that they were carefully selected.
Although the light at night is not very good, under the reflection of lanterns and moonlight, one can still vaguely see the appearance of the entire mansion.
Every house, corridor, pavilion, tower, brick and tile were all carefully selected. Even the bricks and stones inside the mansion were exceptionally smooth. They were all chiselled from the mountains and transported here piece by piece.
The decoration of any room is extremely exquisite, grand but not vulgar.
Especially the crane screen in Ye Shuo’s room was extremely delicate. At first, Ye Shuo thought it was the work of some famous artist, but when he walked closer, he found out it was embroidery.
The total length is over three metres. It is so big and there is not a single mistake. The embroiderer must have put a lot of effort into it.
Ye Shuo’s bed was covered with a brand new ivory mat, which Ye Shuo had previously left for Jian Jian to sleep on. Emperor Jingwen then took out the one that the late emperor had rewarded him with from his private treasury and gave it to his son.
Look at the paintings hanging on the wall. They are all works by famous artists throughout the ages. They are all authentic. Even one painting alone is priceless.
Emperor Jingwen was of an elegant nature and was fond of calligraphy and painting, so he naturally collected quite a few works, and now most of them had arrived at Ye Shuo’s house.
What’s more, Ye Shuo’s entire bed is made of golden nanmu wood, which is extremely luxurious.
Even Ye Shuo couldn’t help but take a deep breath at the generosity of his stepfather.
The other rooms, though inferior, were also extraordinary.
There are nearly twenty such rooms in the entire prince’s mansion.
Further back is a vast garden with a martial arts field and a mountain. There is a small pavilion on the mountain, and in the courtyard at the foot of the mountain is the hot spring water that was specially brought in.
As soon as he got close, a faint smell of sulphur rushed into Ye Shuo’s nostrils.
After finishing the tour and returning, Ye Shuo took a bath on the first night and only came out after soaking until his whole body was warm.
The wet robe was a little loose and stuck to Ye Shuo’s body. Wearing wooden clogs, Ye Shuo walked through the corridor and returned to his room.
The mattresses had been dried in the sun in advance and were full of the smell of sunshine. Ye Shuo didn’t choose any bed and fell asleep after lying on it for a while.
The first night at the prince’s mansion passed quickly.
The next morning, the eldest prince and his entourage came out of the prince’s mansion one after another and rushed to attend the morning court. When they passed by here, they couldn’t help but pause.
I saw that the door of Xiaojiu’s house was closed. Not only the door, but even the two lanterns at the door were not lit. It was obvious that he was not going to get up any time soon.
Now Ye Shuo doesn’t even have to do homework or read books, so naturally he is more indulgent than before.
As expected, Ye Shuo didn’t go to court at all.
Emperor Jingwen was sitting at the top. He looked down and couldn’t help but take a deep breath. He was not surprised at all.
The censor standing by quickly noticed the absence of the Ninth Prince and subconsciously began to criticise him.
However, not to mention Emperor Jingwen, even the eldest prince and others had to speak for him.
It’s better to be lazy than to suddenly fall in love with power without realising it.
No matter how powerful the censor is, he will find it difficult to achieve anything if he is besieged by so many people.
The Minister of Works, who had received the notice in advance, was in tears. His son had taken a house from the Ninth Prince, and now he, as his father, was also implicated.
So why did his son accept the house given by the Ninth Prince? !
The Minister of Industry couldn’t figure it out no matter how hard he tried.
When the eldest prince and his companions left court, it was almost time for Ye Shuo to get up.
After slowly washing and getting dressed, Ye Shuo faced the rising sun, leisurely walked down the street with Xiao Luzi, and started a new round of play.
When the eldest prince and other ministers came out of the imperial city hungry, they happened to run into the ninth prince, who was eating a bowl of fried liver at a small stall at the foot of the imperial city with a gusto.
The smile on the second prince’s face froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Recapture
chapters.content:
Wow, what a large group of migrant workers… No, they are the pillars of the country…
“You haven’t eaten yet?”
Seeing that his brothers looked strange, Ye Shuo asked tentatively: “Can we have some together?”
Now that he has seen it, Ye Shuo wouldn’t want to eat alone, right?
In order to prevent improper conduct in front of the palace, ministers and princes usually did not eat during the morning court session, so as to avoid wanting to go to the toilet after staying there for too long, or eating the wrong food. They would generally eat after returning home.
The eldest prince and the others snorted in their hearts at the same time. Who would want to eat something so shameful?
The eldest prince and the others were about to refuse when they heard him say, “I’ll treat you.”
The eldest prince and others paused for a moment.
It’s not that they are short of money for this meal. How much does a bowl of fried liver cost?
The main reason is that the emperor gave them too much money, and they felt uncomfortable. Even if the emperor only gave them a minor job, they still felt uncomfortable.Xiaojiu finally showed his generosity, so how could he not take advantage of it?
The eldest prince and the others finally sat down next to Ye Shuo in silence.
The Taifu, who also came out with the crowd, took the opportunity to get on the carriage, but was afraid of being discovered and caught by him, so he left without looking back.
The man selling fried liver nearby was so happy when he saw this that he farted with joy. He watched as several nobles in dragon robes walked out of the palace gate, chatted with the young man at the stall, and then went straight to his stall.
Oh my God, even the princes and the nobles came to eat the food I made!
My ancestors had done good deeds. They really had done good deeds.
The hawker placed several servings of fried liver in front of the distinguished guests with an extremely pious attitude.
After only one glance, the Fifth Prince subconsciously became picky: “This color… is it for human consumption?”
Ye Shuo rolled his eyes at him and said nothing, but just picked up the bowl and took a sip.
The eldest prince ignored him and took a sip.
Although this thing is not as exquisite as the ones made by the imperial chef in the palace, it tastes good and is enough to fill the stomach.
“You don’t need the chef in the prince’s mansion, but come out to eat this?” The eldest prince didn’t quite understand what his younger brother was thinking.
Ye Shuo shook his head: “You don’t understand.”
No matter how delicious something is, there will come a day when you get tired of it. Changing the taste frequently can keep it fresh and last longer.
Besides, is it a question of what to eat? Rather than eating, getting up in the morning and breathing fresh air is the most important thing.
“Brother, you guys are really boring.”
They have no interest?!
The eldest prince and the others were almost laughing in anger, but what they were thinking was, Xiaojiu, you can be proud for now, wait for the order from the emperor, and see how long you can be proud!
Several people, including the sixth prince, kept cursing.
The fifth prince almost finished the entire meal while complaining.
The Fifth Prince complained that the fried liver was not clean nor tasty, but he ate half a bowl of it in one breath. Ye Shuo had no idea what he was doing.
Seeing that the time was almost up, the brothers stood up.
Xiao Luzi paid the money almost under the gaze of several princes.
They had no idea how much their younger brother was worth now. Looking at the copper coins that Xiao Luzi took out, they suddenly felt even happier than when they had eaten the fried liver just now.
Then the few of them separated at the street corner.
The eldest prince was heading to the military camp, the second prince and others were heading to the six ministries, and as for Ye Shuo, it went without saying that he was heading to the teahouse.
After listening to the book, Ye Shuo planned to go to the medical clinic in the capital and hire two apprentices who were proficient in acupoint massage, and have them come to his home regularly every day to massage him and relax his muscles.
Seeing this, the eldest and second princes stopped in their tracks and asked, “Aren’t you going to report to the Ministry of Works?”
Ye Shuo didn’t even think about it: “I have already asked someone to send a message to the Minister of Works.”
The Minister of Works knew = he had punched in. Besides, his position was just an honorary one, it didn’t matter whether he went or not. If there was any problem, Zou Wu would tell him directly, there was no need for Ye Shuo to go to work every day.
Just like that, the eldest prince and his entourage watched their younger brother walk into the teahouse in front of them.
The eldest prince snorted coldly, flicked his sleeves and left.
After the Second Prince and the Fifth Prince had walked for some distance, the Fifth Prince could not help but sighed, “I really envy my Ninth Brother…”
Among so many princes, only the Fifth Prince told the truth.
The second prince paused and said, “What is there to envy? Everything he has now is nothing but flowers in the mirror and the moon in the water. Sooner or later, he will pay the price for his temporary enjoyment.”
“Ah? Will he really pay the price?” Looking at Xiaojiu’s personality, and with the Imperial Concubine and the Duke of Zhen behind him, it doesn’t seem like he will pay a price.
The fifth prince wanted to say more: “Second brother…”
Second Prince: “Shut up!”
“…oh.”
The other side.
Just like yesterday, Ye Shuo ate and drank his fill today, then went home in the dark.
With money paving the way, the teahouse owner is very efficient. Of course, it may also be that there are more poor intellectuals. This afternoon, the teahouse owner handed him a stack of bills.
If I finish writing everything and show it to him, and if he is not satisfied, the article will be discarded. It is better to let those people write the beginning first. If the boy is satisfied, then let them continue writing. If not, then forget it.
In this way, Ye Shuo actually discovered several articles with great potential.
It certainly can’t be compared with the classics, but it’s also quite interesting.
“This, this, and this. Tell them to hurry up and write. If they write well and quickly, they will be rewarded handsomely.”
As soon as Ye Shuo said this, the teahouse owner became even more excited.
Then we went to the opera troupe and the clinic. We strolled around here and there, and the day passed quickly. I didn’t feel bored at all, but rather very fulfilled.
After all, spending money is a very interesting thing in itself.
As expected, Ye Shuo ran into the same person at the same time and place again.
But this time, the eldest prince had an extra black horse in his hands. The black horse had shiny fur and strong limbs. It was obviously a good horse that was carefully raised.
When the eldest prince stroked the horse, there was even a hint of pity in his eyes: “This is the offspring of my warhorse, named Qingfeng. I am giving it to you now. Xiaojiu, you must treat it well in the future.”
The eldest prince originally used Qingfeng as a spare horse, but now he is back, right? He really can’t use it, and it’s really pitiful for this horse to stay in the barracks every day, so it’s better to give it to Xiaojiu, at least he can go out and have some fresh air often.
Feeling the great prince’s attention, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but become serious: “Of course.”
As everyone knows, the fodder in Beiting is the best and the horses raised there are the strongest. Ye Shuo happens to have several caravans in Beiting, so it should not be difficult to ask them to transport the fodder back.
So Ye Shuo asked: “Does your horse eat the grass in Beiting?”
The eldest prince was stunned for a moment.
After realising what he meant, the eldest prince couldn’t help but sweat: “…That’s not necessary.”
Although the eldest prince had been taken care of carefully before, it was not to this extent.
How much money would it cost to feed it with grass from Beiting every day?
However, for Ye Shuo, money was really nothing. Besides, the caravan was his own, so the cost alone was much less. How much money would it cost to cut some grass in Beiting’s fields?
“Don’t worry, brother. I know what’s going on.”
The eldest prince: “…”
The eldest prince suddenly began to sympathise with the imperial concubine, the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, and…his father.
How much money does one have to put in to support such a wasteful thing?
Just at this moment, Ye Yan and his brothers, who had just finished their homework, heard a noise outside. When the servant said it was the Ninth Prince, Ye Yan and his brothers rushed out without much hesitation.
It just so happened that Ye Shuo had just got a new horse and was worried about where to go. When he saw them, he asked casually, “I’m going to the enclosure to hunt tomorrow. Do you want to come?”
Knowing that his cheap father doesn’t like entertainment, he hasn’t been to the enclosure for two or three years, and the other princes are the same. Now the various free-range animals in the royal hunting grounds are giving birth one after another, and the grass is almost eaten bald. Every year, guards have to be sent to clean up a batch to maintain balance. Ye Shuo thought, since he is idle anyway, why not let himself help digest it, otherwise it will be in vain to spend so much money on maintenance every year?
Ye Yan and the others were excited and subconsciously wanted to agree, but when he looked up, he saw his father’s eyes.
Ye Yan and others suddenly woke up.
They forgot that they have to report to the study room tomorrow.
The study room only gives a few days of leave a year: New Year, birthday, and Tianchang Festival, and that’s it. No leave is allowed at other times without special circumstances.
However, these are not a big deal in Ye Shuo’s eyes.
“I’ll ask someone to tell Lord Cen tomorrow.”
Ye Yan and the others looked at their father expectantly. The eldest prince did not hesitate and shook his head decisively, saying, “Don’t even think about it!”
Then the eldest prince looked at his younger brother and warned him, “Don’t lead Yan’er and the others astray!”
OK then…
Ye Shuo shrugged his shoulders, gave them a helpless look, then took Qingfeng’s hand and went back home.
Ye Yan and his brothers were almost crying.
Ye Shuo kept his word and rode his horse to the royal hunting ground on the outskirts of the city the next day.
It is called a hunting ground, but it is actually very large. You can’t even see the end of it at a glance.
Not many people hunt in this hunting ground, so naturally no one wants the hunting dogs that are raised all year round.
Ye Shuo was very interested in the group of hunting dogs, especially those fine dogs with long limbs and bright eyes. It was obvious that they were good hunters.
Ye Shuo waved at them. The hounds were slow to react at first, but after being reminded by the trainer, they came over with their tails wagging.
Adult dogs have already recognized their trainers as their masters after a long time, which is probably enough, but the puppies are just born now, so Ye Shuo had an idea and decided to raise a few of them at home.
The house is indeed a little quieter now.
The trainer naturally would not refuse. He was already worried because this group of hunting dogs gave birth to another litter two months ago, and all the dogs that could be donated from nearby areas had been sent here. If no one wanted this litter, they would have to be given to the nearby villagers.
After all, following the villagers is not as good as following the princes and nobles to enjoy life. If possible, the animal trainer would like to let them live a wealthy life.
“There are six in this litter. Apart from this one, I’ve seen all the other little ones. They all have good qualifications.”
Looking at the five strong puppies and one obviously weak one, Ye Shuo didn’t care if there was one more or one less, so he said, “Leave these six to me, I’ll take them away at night.”
The trainer was immediately delighted.
Xiao Luzi was so excited at the sight of the prey that he couldn’t help but reach out and touch it.
In this way, Ye Shuo, with a group of hunting dogs and several guards, spent a whole day in the enclosure.
When he left, in addition to the six weaned puppies, he also took away two hares and a deer.
After returning to the mansion, the dusty Ye Shuo handed the hare and deer to the kitchen, asking them to help cut them and then marinate them with spices. He planned to have a barbecue in the pavilion on the mountain in the evening.
By the way, Ye Shuo sent the servants in his mansion to knock on every door. He couldn’t finish all the food by himself, so he asked them to ask his brothers if they were interested in having a barbecue together.
However, the eldest prince and his men had worked all day and were exhausted. At night, they had to sleep in the rooms of the princes’ wives and concubines. How could they have the leisure time to eat barbecue?
Ye Yan and the others wanted to go, but they haven’t finished memorising their books yet!
When Ye Shuo came out of the hot spring wearing a robe, he heard the news that he was rejected.
Forget it, if they don’t want to eat it, just eat it yourself.
So Ye Shuo brought musicians and a few storybooks with him. They listened to the music, read the storybooks, and grilled meat at the same time. After a short while, the deer legs on the grill were sizzling and oozing with oil.
Although the mountain behind the Ninth Prince’s Mansion is not very high, only about a hundred metres, it is high enough for people around to see clearly.
Especially the hanging lanterns swaying in the wind and the distant sound of the piano made the Sixth Prince’s hand that was turning the pages of the book suddenly pause, and the Sixth Prince almost opened his mouth with gritted teeth.
“Someone! Close the window!”
The Sixth Prince was fine, but the people in the First Prince’s mansion, which was the closest to the palace, were suffering.
The barbecue itself is not attractive, what is attractive is the leisurely feeling.
Smelling the aroma of meat wafting in the air, Ye Yan and the others were drooling in their dreams that night.
Ye Shuo did what he said, and now he is like a bird out of a cage, wandering and flying everywhere.
But human nature is inherently mean. The more he behaved like this, the more the eldest prince and the others wanted to know what he did every day, and then they could not help but ask him about it.
Then, Ye Shuo’s itinerary slowly unfolded before everyone’s eyes——
On the first day, we ate fried liver, went to a teahouse to drink tea and listen to storytelling, and listened to opera in the afternoon.
The next day, we went hunting.
On the third day, they went fishing, relaxing and having a picnic in the wild, and they ran into Prince Su. In the end, Xiaojiu returned with a full load. The Ninth Prince’s Mansion had a fish banquet that night, but as for Prince Su… as expected, there was no feast.
On the fourth day, Xiaojiu went hiking and stayed overnight in a temple on the mountain. He had a vegetarian meal in the morning and then came back.
The fifth day, the sixth day, the seventh day…the eldest prince and others gradually became numb.
In just over a month, Ye Shuo’s goal was no longer limited to Shangjing City. He began to ride his horse directly and headed towards several other cities.
The nearest city was about two days’ journey from Shangjing, so it was impossible for Ye Shuo to return on the same day, and he stayed there for nearly half a month.
It can be seen that Xiaojiu’s itinerary is gradually expanding. If this continues, it won’t be long before he can no longer be found.
Half a month later, Ye Shuo came back. When he passed by the enclosure on the outskirts of the city, he couldn’t help but go there again.
This time, he gained more than just the six puppies.
What Ye Shuo didn’t expect was that he actually encountered a little tiger that had albinism, was abandoned in the wild, and was now dying.
This tiger is about the same size as a three-month-old puppy.
Ye Shuo thought about it, and finally picked it up and took it back.
It’s not that he felt pity or anything, it’s mainly because this thing looked so cute that he really couldn’t help himself.
At worst, we can wait until it grows up and send it back to the wild.
It is illegal to keep this thing in modern times, but nowadays, you can do whatever you want with it.
After Ye Shuo returned home, he specifically asked the kitchen for goat milk. It took him a lot of effort to feed the goat milk to the little white tiger.
The arrival of the little tiger made Ye Yan and others unable to sit still anymore. They stopped reciting books and the first thing they did after school every day was to come and see this little thing.
In addition to the little tiger, there were also six puppies, barbecued meat and fish to eat, and hot springs to soak in. Oh my god, is this a fairyland? !
The eldest prince almost watched helplessly as his sons, who he had high hopes for, became less hardworking than before.
This is simply outrageous!
The eldest prince eventually had an unprecedentedly violent quarrel with Ye Yan and his brothers.
The eldest prince was so angry that he seemed a little frustrated: “Why are you guys competing with him? Why don’t you compete with Ye Xun more!”
“Your Ninth Uncle has no ambitions. Do you want to be like that, too?”
In fact, Ye Yan and his team aren’t not working hard, they are just not working as hard as before.
The most important thing is that they also feel that such days seem to be quite good.
Thinking of this, Ye Yan said: “But, I don’t have to do anything. I just need to go out and play every day. It’s really happy…”
As for Ye Yan’s three younger brothers, they couldn’t help nodding when they heard this.
When the eldest prince heard this, his eyes went dark.
It’s over. My sons have been led astray by Xiaojiu.
After sending Ye Yan and the others to the study room to kneel as punishment, the eldest prince took a deep breath and decided that he could not go on like this.
Coincidentally, other people thought so too.
Xiaojiu has only been here for a few days, and their house is already in turmoil!
On the other side.
In the first five days, Emperor Jingwen was able to keep his composure and resisted the urge to check what his son was doing.
On the tenth day, Emperor Jingwen began to frown.
On the fifteenth day, Emperor Jingwen finally couldn’t help it and started cursing.
“Ignorant wolf! I really raised an ungrateful wolf!”
It’s quite blatant.
“I am still healthy, but he is like this. Wang Ziquan, tell me, can I still count on him in the future?!”
Wang Ziquan didn’t dare to speak, thinking, Your Majesty, you can’t count on the Ninth Prince anyway…
In the end, Emperor Jingwen failed to fulfil the promise he had made in his heart.
Emperor Jingwen initially thought that the little bastard had grown up and it was time to let him go. It was pointless to keep holding on to him.
As a result, now…
Bullshit, let him go!
He shouldn’t have let him leave the palace in the first place!
Freedom? That little bastard doesn’t deserve this word.
This thought reached its peak after he asked the secret guards to investigate what he had been doing recently.
Every day outside the palace, he either listened to operas or storytelling, or went fishing and hunting. He even went to the capital city and stayed there for half a month before returning.
When Emperor Jingwen received the news from the commander-in-chief, he was in disbelief for a moment.
“Are you sure he went out alone?”
After receiving the affirmative answer from the commander-in-chief, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but take a breath.
“Then why are you still standing there? Why don’t you bring him back to me?!”
Xiaojiu has never travelled far since he was a child. The only time he went far was to the temporary palace, he was with so many people. Could he know the way?
If he didn’t know the way, what if he accidentally went into the deep mountains and forests and couldn’t find his way back?
Although the official road was relatively safe, it was not without its problems. If he really encountered danger, would he want to bite the enemy’s ear to escape? He had grown up so much, why was he still so ignorant!
Emperor Jingwen was almost furious.
However, it was too late for the commander-in-chief to chase him. Qingfeng was the eldest prince’s precious warhorse. How could ordinary horses catch up with him when he really ran?
By the evening of the third day, Emperor Jingwen received news that his son was staying at an inn in Yuancheng near Shangjing.
And the following half month, when he spent lavishly in Yuancheng.
If Emperor Jingwen didn’t realise that the little bastard was enjoying himself here, then his reign would have been in vain.
It seems that after the little bastard was left alone outside, he had completely forgotten about his father, the emperor, and his mother.
He doesn’t want to come back at all!!!
Emperor Jingwen waited and waited, and finally Ye Shuo came back. He thought that he would finally come back to the palace this time, right?
As a result, a little tiger cub once again held him back.
Just when Emperor Jingwen was planning to capture him regardless of the consequences, the eldest prince, the second prince and the fourth prince, who had children and whose children were old enough to remember, came almost together. What’s more, Prince Su and Prince Jin were also among them.
How could Prince Su not come? There were only so many good places for fishing in the suburbs of Beijing, and he and his nephew would bump into them almost every time. Prince Su was busy helping Emperor Jingwen with his work on weekdays, and he could not stand being deprived of such a hobby.
As for Prince Jin, before Ye Shuo came out, he was the most comfortable person in the capital. But… Ye Shuo spent a lot of money, and all the good things came to him first. The storyteller that Prince Jin was used to listening to would always tell stories that his nephew would like to hear every time he went to the teahouse.
The Prince of Jin is not inferior to him, but the key is that the Prince of Jin has no money!
The shop under the name of King Jin is certainly profitable compared to that of ordinary people, but it is far from enough compared to Ye Shuo.
The more I thought about it, the angrier I got. Wasn’t Prince Jin coming to the palace to complain?
Soon, several people started to complain to each other in the Qinzheng Hall.
Soon Emperor Jingwen understood the demands of the eldest prince and his two brothers.
No matter what method, we must get Xiaojiu back!
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
The little bastard is really capable of angering so many people at the same time.
Emperor Jingwen was very angry at first, but now he is not angry at all. Instead, he is worried that his son will be eaten by his brothers and uncles.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to clear his throat and quickly call the secret guards over.
About an incense stick later, Ye Shuo was lying comfortably on a recliner, enjoying the apprentice’s massage service while stroking his little white tiger and listening to songs. When he saw his cheap master Wu Yi, Ye Shuo was stunned.
Why is he here?
What happened?
Before Ye Shuo could react, Wu Yi spoke: “Your Highness, I am sorry for your wrongdoing.”
Then, Ye Shuo was taken back to the palace.
Wow!

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Decision
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo and Wu Yi exchanged two moves, and Ye Shuo was controlled by Wu Yi.
Although Ye Shuo didn’t use his full strength, it was obvious that Wu Yi didn’t do that either, so there was still a certain gap between the two.
“It hurts, it hurts, Master, please spare my life!”
The captured Ye Shuo felt a sharp pain in his shoulder and couldn’t help but scream.
Wu Yi was stunned for a moment and subconsciously let go.
“Your Highness, the Emperor has ordered that you please follow me.”
Ye Shuo had no choice but to be forced to obey.
Along the way, Ye Shuo tried to find out what had happened. Suddenly, his cheap father called him back and sent his cheap master over.
But Wu Yi was a secret guard after all, and he kept his mouth shut. He didn’t reveal any information at all. Ye Shuo had no choice but to give up.Ye Shuo thought that he had behaved well recently and had not committed any crime. In the palace, his mother Concubine, Jianjian, and his grandfather’s family were doing well. So when Ye Shuo saw the brothers and uncles in the palace, his first reaction was –
“Hey, it’s so lively today, are you planning to have some kind of party?”
Ye Shuo quickly filtered through all the important dates, and then froze, OK, it seems there isn’t one…
Emperor Jingwen felt a headache when he saw his son who was totally unaware that he had offended the public.
Then, Emperor Jingwen spoke in front of the expectant eyes of the eldest prince, Prince Su, and Prince Jin: “From now on, you should not go out again. Stay in the palace.”
“When your stubborn nature is worn away, I will let you leave the palace.”
Caught off guard, Ye Shuo: “Ah?”
*
“So, why is this happening…”
Ye Shuo racked his brains but couldn’t figure out the reason. He just felt that he was extremely innocent.
Ye Shuo, who had only played for two months before being forced to return to Qiuwu Palace, looked completely depressed. He lay on the table, feeling weak and wanting to cry but unable to.
Jian Jian, who was practising calligraphy nearby, could not help but sneer when she heard this: “You deserve it!”
Bad brother, stinky brother, he went out to play for so long and didn’t even call her!
After listening to the whole process, Jianjian didn’t feel pity for him at all. He was simply hateful. She would not be fooled by his pitiful face.
For the first time ever, the imperial concubine held the same attitude as her daughter and was also critical of her son. After all, Ye Shuo had been away for two months and had not thought about coming back, so the imperial concubine was naturally unhappy.
After being caught and scolded by two people, one big and one small, Ye Shuo could only run away in fear.
“I don’t want to do that either! But it’s really fun outside.”
“I’ve lived for sixteen years and have only been out a few times. It’s understandable that I couldn’t control my emotions for a while…”
This palace looks big, but no matter how big a place is, you will get bored if you stay there for too long.
When Ye Shuo was in modern times, he would fly here or there every day, whether it was domestic or foreign. He would drive away when he felt like it. It was quite good that he could be patient for so long without going crazy. He was quite restrained, okay?
“Mom, my son is so uncomfortable, wuwuwuwuwu.”
The more he thought about it, the more aggrieved he felt. Ye Shuo lay on the imperial concubine’s lap and began to sob: “They don’t play by themselves, and they don’t let their son play either. They are too much!”
It was not that Ye Shuo was careless. He was so happy that he forgot about his trip. On the other hand, Ye Shuo would never have thought that he could continue to live in the palace after he became an adult.
Apart from the prince, who else could have such treatment? No wonder Ye Shuo indulged himself a little.
Well now, the impossible has come true.
It turns out that he can’t predict every situation.
Ye Shuo became more and more sad.
Even though she knew he was pretending and wasn’t really crying, the imperial concubine still couldn’t help feeling a little distressed.
Indeed, staying in this square palace is not as free as being outside.
Before the imperial concubine married Emperor Jingwen, she was the daughter of a duke. Coming from a military family, she did not have so many concerns. She often played polo, climbed mountains, and had parties with a group of young sisters. Naturally, she knew how happy the outside world was.
The imperial concubine could still understand her son’s current mood.
But she couldn’t do anything about it, it was all the emperor’s will.
“Shuo’er, don’t cry, Shuo’er, don’t cry, just bear with it a little longer, alas…”
“The eldest prince and his brothers are such fools. How could they do this?” The imperial concubine suddenly felt that the eldest prince and his brothers were going too far. They were bullying him by relying on his age.
Jianjian: “…”
Seeing her mother’s attitude change so quickly, Jianjian was stunned.
Put yourself in her shoes. If your brother was hunting, fishing, or listening to books while you were studying, you would also be angry. But your eldest brother and his brothers have good tempers and didn’t even beat him up.
“Mother, please don’t spoil my brother too much.” Jianjian couldn’t help but say.
But obviously, the current imperial concubine won’t listen.
As expected, my brother’s current state is closely related to my father and mother.
At the beginning, Jianjian’s attitude was very firm. Just because Ye Shuo didn’t come back to see her and her mother for two months, Jianjian would not easily forgive him.
But soon, the little white tiger cub and six puppies were sent to the palace.
How could Jianjian resist the attacks of the animal cubs?
Especially the little white tiger, with its cute appearance, big paw pads, and fierce roar, almost no one can refuse it.
“Call me brother, and I’ll let you touch it.”
Seeing Ye Shuo holding the little tiger by the scruff of the neck, Jian Jian could no longer sit still.
Jianjian, who didn’t know the habits of cats, subconsciously felt that the little tiger must be in pain when she saw this scene.
This is not Ye Shuo’s first time, he is already considered a veteran.
Jianjian almost pounced on the little white tiger and snatched it back from his brother’s clutches.
The brother and sister were playing and fighting. When it was time for dinner, Emperor Jingwen came almost on time. When he saw the little white tiger, he couldn’t help but frown: “You have been so busy recently that you can’t even go to the teahouse. Is it because of this little thing?”
“Of course.” Tigers are not easy to raise, especially a dying little tiger like this. In modern times, it would take professionals to rescue it. As a non-professional, you can imagine how much effort Ye Shuo would have to put in to revive it.
Emperor Jingwen listened to what he was chattering on and on, but he didn’t take it seriously. After all, Emperor Jingwen had only hunted tigers in his life and had never raised tigers, and he had no interest in such furry things.
Emperor Jingwen simply reminded him, “Just raise it for a few months, and when it grows up a bit, put it back in the hunting grounds.”
A tiger is a tiger after all, and even a cub of a few months old is already capable of hurting people.
“Be careful with its claws, or it will scratch you and hurt you.” Emperor Jingwen said with a hint of warning in his tone.
Perhaps it was the instinct of a wild animal, the little white tiger sensed something, and then huddled in a corner and began to sniff at people. The more he looked at this thing, the more dangerous it seemed. Emperor Jingwen frowned more and more: “If you really want to keep it, you can simply let the trainers in the palace train you for a few months, and then have them send it back to you when the time comes.”
They have forgotten that they are now members of the ruling class of the evil feudal society.
“How do animal trainers train?” Cats are different from canines, especially wolves and dogs. No matter how much they are trained, their obedience is not high. In ancient times, there were not all kinds of methods to train big cats, right?
Just when Ye Shuo was puzzled, he heard Emperor Jingwen say, “Of course, grind off the claws and teeth of the little thing.”
Without teeth and claws, no matter how big it is, it can’t hurt people. He can keep it as long as he wants.
Ye Shuo immediately shook his head upon hearing this: “Forget it then.”
He really couldn’t do this.
As he said that, Ye Shuo picked up the little white tiger again, and then he didn’t know how he did it, but after a few seconds, the little white tiger miraculously calmed down.
When Emperor Jingwen saw the scabbed scratches on his son’s hands, a “川” character appeared between his brows.
“Dad, you scared it.” Seeing that the little tiger he had coaxed with great difficulty was struggling again, Ye Shuo spoke helplessly.
Emperor Jingwen was furious: “I kindly reminded you, but you still…” He still didn’t appreciate it!
Seeing that his cheap father was about to lose his temper, Ye Shuo quickly changed the subject: “By the way, father, why didn’t you protect your son when you were in the Qinzheng Palace this afternoon?”
Thinking of how he had been scolded by so many people, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look resentful.
“You even sent someone to bring this son back from the mansion.” Please, he has only been out for a short time, do you still have any humanity?
“How dare you say that.” Emperor Jingwen was almost amused by his shamelessness.
“Don’t you think about what you have done outside? Can your elder brother and others feel comfortable?” Not to mention the eldest prince and others, Emperor Jingwen didn’t feel happy at all.
The emperor is the supreme ruler and should be the freest person in the world, but he ends up living worse than his own son every day.
For a moment, Emperor Jingwen even felt that their roles were reversed.
“It would be fine if it was just your eldest brother, but you actually led your nephews astray, asking Yan’er and the others every day if they want to eat barbecue, or asking them to go fishing. This is just now, if it was before your eldest brother, he would have lost his temper long ago.”
“Do you think everyone has as much free time as you?”
Ye Shuo curled the corner of his mouth: “…Aren’t I kind-hearted?” If a child is locked up at home every day, he will probably get suffocated after a long time.
“Let’s not talk about this.” This time the tiger was no match for the wolves, so Ye Shuo accepted it.
“Dad, when are you going to let me out? I’m an adult prince, and I’m living in the palace all day. It’s ridiculous. The censors will gossip about me.”
Emperor Jingwen realised that if he was released, he would really not want to go home at all.
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen did not give a direct answer, but only asked: “Don’t you want to spend more time with your father, your mother, and Jianjian in this palace?”
Under normal circumstances, almost everyone would answer “yes”.
But the problem is that Ye Shuo dared to bet that as long as he said that word, his stepfather would definitely go with the flow and would definitely not let him leave.
So Ye Shuo thought about it, and despite his mother’s sharp, murderous gaze, he shook his head firmly: “No.”
“Since you want to, then you should be more… huh?” Emperor Jingwen was stunned.
Four people, including Wang Ziquan, looked over almost immediately.
Ye Shuo spoke the truth: “I’m sorry, Dad, Mom and Jian Jian. Now I want to go out of the palace and have fun.”
Emperor Jingwen was stunned at first, and then he became furious.
After that, Ye Shuo couldn’t get out at all.
If he wants to get out again, he will probably have to wait until next life.
In addition, he even had to continue studying with Lord Cen and the Grand Tutor. This time, Emperor Jingwen insisted that he learn what “filial piety” meant.
This was probably the first prince since the founding of the Great Zhou who left the palace to set up his own residence and then was sent back to go back to school.
After hearing the news and what he had said to his father, the eldest prince and others fell silent.
If he had said a few nice words, things wouldn’t have turned out like this.
When his not guilty sentence turned into life imprisonment, Ye Shuo felt that it was time for him to escape from prison, no, to run away completely.
There is no way, who told the people here, they can’t play!

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Changes
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
These days, people are not allowed to tell the truth.
Ye Shuo was walking on the road, kicking pebbles for fun. The peach blossoms around him fell down and fluttered in front of his eyes, which made his eyebrows and eyes look stunning. I don’t know how many people were stunned by him.
But what Ye Shuo was thinking about at the moment was the desperate expression on Lord Cen’s face when he saw him just now.
I thought that after the Ninth Prince left the palace, I would finally be able to get rid of him. If I wasn’t afraid of the emperor’s anger, I would have wanted to buy two strings of firecrackers to set off.
But he was not happy for long. The Ninth Prince came back after a walk. From what the Emperor said, he would not be able to get out for a while. Lord Cen felt that the road ahead was bleak and he wished he could resign on the spot, so that he could live two more years.
As he thought about it, Ye Shuo’s thoughts gradually shifted.
Just when he was thinking about whether to run away, he saw a familiar figure walking hurriedly not far away.
That person was none other than the always low-key Seventh Prince.
The Seventh Prince looked extremely anxious, and was accompanied by the imperial physician. If it were anyone else, they would definitely not be willing to meddle in such trivial matters, but Ye Shuo was famous for being there wherever there was excitement, and no matter who it was, he would go up and ask questions whenever he saw them.Just when the Seventh Prince was getting anxious, he suddenly heard a voice: “Seventh Brother.”
The Seventh Prince turned around and saw Ye Shuo walking towards him.
“What happened?” Seeing the Seventh Prince open his mouth, Ye Shuo said, “Let’s talk while we walk.”
Perhaps it was because his attitude was too natural, and the Seventh Prince was now somewhat confused, so he subconsciously agreed.
After walking for a long time, he gradually reacted.
Then Ye Shuo learned that the seventh prince’s biological mother, Xu Guirong, was ill.
Ye Shuo frowned upon hearing this: “Is it serious? Do you need any medicine?”
If Ye Shuo has a situation where he can help with something that is easy to do, like this one, he will generally help.
But his subconscious reaction made the Seventh Prince stunned.
Although his mother had been living in Concubine Shu’s palace and he had been serving the Fifth Prince at all times, Concubine Shu did not even care as much about his mother’s illness as his ninth brother did.
It’s really funny.
The Seventh Prince calmed himself down and did not show off. He just said, “If there is any need, I will ask my Ninth Brother for help.”
Ye Shuo nodded: “Okay, let’s go see concubine Guirong first.”
This was probably Ye Shuo’s second time coming to Concubine Shu’s palace. It could be said that he had a connection with Concubine Shu, as Ye Shuo saw her as soon as he came in.
“Greetings to the Concubine Shu.”
Concubine Shu first looked at him, then looked at the Seventh Prince and the imperial physician behind him, and she had a rough idea in her mind.
This seventh prince is so capable that she doesn’t know when he got in touch with the son of the woman in Qiuwu Palace.
Concubine Shu didn’t say much, and Ye Shuo didn’t delay any longer. He followed the Seventh Prince into Xu Guirong’s room in the side hall.
Ye Shuo took a look from a distance through the gap in the screen and was then startled.
Ye Shuo remembered when he was just one month old. At that time, Xu Guirong was still young and a low-key person like the Seventh Prince. Even when he was punished, he kept his head down and remained silent.
But now, perhaps because of her illness, Xu Guirong has become extremely thin and there is no trace of her former beauty.
About half an incense stick of time later, the imperial physician and the seventh prince came out together. Both of them looked bad, and the situation was not optimistic.
The imperial physician sighed: “Gui Rong’s illness has been delayed for too long, at least a month, I’m afraid…”
The Seventh Prince subconsciously tightened his grip upon hearing this. When he entered the palace more than a month ago, he noticed that something seemed wrong with his mother’s complexion, but he did not take it to heart at the time. Now thinking about it, he really regretted it.
“What’s more, Empress Guirong’s foundation was damaged when she was young. If she uses good ginseng to replenish her vitality, it would be better.”
When Ye Shuo heard the first half of the sentence, his heart couldn’t help but pause slightly.
When the imperial physician finished speaking, the Seventh Prince looked over and Ye Shuo nodded: “No problem, my mother has some wild ginseng, I’ll have someone bring it to you later.”
Ginseng is something that is extremely difficult to pick and grow. One or two stalks are fine, but if you want to use them for a long time, it is indeed difficult given the Seventh Prince’s current financial situation.
But in fact, although Ye Shuo said so, his mother didn’t have much stock left. The only option now was to buy it outside. This was not a difficult task for Ye Shuo, so he didn’t mention it.
The Seventh Prince heaved a sigh of relief upon hearing this, and couldn’t help but feel grateful: “Thank you, Ninth Brother.”
The Seventh Prince said this sincerely.
After all this ordeal, the Seventh Prince’s forehead and body were covered in sweat. Ye Shuo noticed that his lips were a little pale, presumably because of his deep affection for Xu Guirong.
It was the same back then. As soon as Xu Guirong knelt down, the Seventh Prince couldn’t control his tears and burst into tears. Although it was partly because the Seventh Prince was still young, it was also because of the bond between mother and son.
And Xu Guirong didn’t tell the Seventh Prince even though she was so ill. She hired an imperial physician and got medicine prescribed for her, but it didn’t work. She couldn’t hide it any longer, so the Seventh Prince found out.
This made Ye Shuo think of his mother. While the imperial physician was writing the prescription, he softened his heart and advised, “Seventh brother, don’t worry. Concubine Guirong will get better.”
The Seventh Prince was a very smart man and could naturally understand the meaning of this. Similarly, he finally noticed his own embarrassment at the moment.
The Seventh Prince pulled the corner of his mouth and forced a smile, saying, “Thank you for your good words, Ninth Brother.”
“You don’t know, Ninth Brother, I have been dependent on my mother since I was born. I am not afraid of being laughed at by you if I tell you this. If something bad happened to my mother, I really don’t know what I would do.”
It can be seen that the Seventh Prince was very flustered and said things that he would never say under normal circumstances.
Ye Shuo couldn’t do anything else but pat his hands and comfort him: “It will be fine, everything will be fine.”
Gradually, the Seventh Prince became less nervous.
After Ye Shuo returned, he asked someone to deliver the ginseng shortly afterwards.
A few days later, Ye Shuo accidentally met the Fifth Prince, but the Fifth Prince at this time acted as if nothing had happened and even asked him if he had seen the Seventh Prince.
“Really? This Old Seven has been gone for so many days. I don’t even know if he has finished the task I asked him to do for me.”
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, then asked: “You still don’t know what the seventh brother’s situation is now?”
The Fifth Prince: “What could possibly happen to him?”
Hmm? That shouldn’t be the case. Given the relationship between the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince, it’s impossible for him not to know that Xu Guirong was seriously ill.
While Ye Shuo was stunned, the Fifth Prince suddenly thought of something: “Oh…you mean Xu Guirong’s illness? But what does Xu Guirong’s illness have to do with him? There are so many palace servants, and he can’t help much. There are still so many things to do in the Ministry of Revenue. No matter what, it can’t affect the work, right?”
“I came here today just for this matter. Forget it, I won’t talk to you anymore. I have to go find him.”
Looking at the Fifth Prince’s hurried back, Ye Shuo’s heart skipped a beat.
Perhaps because he had known the Fifth Prince for so long, Ye Shuo almost forgot that the Fifth Prince always treated people differently based on their social status and he was not always friendly to everyone.
The Fifth Prince was arrogant from the beginning, but Ye Shuo was even more arrogant than him, which forced him to restrain himself when facing Ye Shuo.
The Fifth Prince had one face when dealing with Ye Shuo, and another attitude when dealing with the Seventh Prince.
The Seventh Prince has followed the Fifth Prince since he was a child. The Seventh Prince’s mother is a person in the Palace of Concubine Shu. The identities of both mother and son are suppressed by Concubine Shu and the Fifth Prince. Over time, the Fifth Prince naturally regards the Seventh Prince as a slave, and slaves cannot have their own thoughts.
After so many years, the Fifth Prince has long been accustomed to it.
It would be fine if such a balance was not broken, but once it was broken, it would probably lead to a disaster.
Ye Shuo instantly recalled that when he was in the study, he saw that the Seventh Prince had clearly started writing a poem, and he wrote two whole lines before changing to something else. This proved that he actually wanted to express himself in his heart.
The reason why the Seventh Prince was constrained in every way and forced to listen to the Fifth Prince was that his status was low, and also…Xu Guirong was in the hands of Concubine Shu, so the Seventh Prince had to obey.
There are not so many masochists in this world. What there are are only people who have to compromise.
In order to let his mother live a good life, the Seventh Prince was willing to bury his intelligence and talent, be driven by Concubine Shu’s son, and become a transparent person among the princes.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo shuddered immediately.
Then, rare medicinal herbs began to be sent to Concubine Shu’s palace as if they were free.
In Ye Shuo’s opinion, if this matter can be solved with money, then it is not a problem. If not…
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, thirty-seven days later, Xu Guirong died.
Despite being kept alive by so many precious medicinal herbs, Xu Guirong eventually died.
Ye Shuo’s mind went blank at first, and he suddenly remembered what the imperial physician had said before –
“What’s more, Empress Guirong’s foundation was damaged when she was young. If she uses good ginseng to replenish her vitality, it would be better.”
She was injured when she was young…
Since the Fifth Prince treats the Seventh Prince in this way, Concubine Shu must not be much better to Xu Guirong.
Ye Shuo hurriedly asked Xiao Luzi to find out how Concubine Shu had treated Xu Guirong over the years.
As expected, Xu Guirong’s injury was indeed related to Concubine Shu.
Xu Guirong was originally a maid in Concubine Shu’s palace, but she was favoured by her stepfather. Concubine Shu was naturally unhappy, but who could be happy?
Soon after Xu Guirong was favoured, Concubine Shu made excuses to make things difficult for her, and that was when Xu Guirong fell ill. As a result, she didn’t recover well, and the birth of the Seventh Prince made her even more injured, and even damaged her foundation.
An emperor would never care so much. He would just favour whoever he liked. He didn’t know or care whether a little palace maid would suffer a catastrophic disaster because of his small action.
Emperor Jingwen had the same problems as all other emperors, and he was never lazy.
After Xu Guirong’s death, Concubine Shu thought it was unlucky and refused to allow anyone to set up a mourning hall in her palace. Even after so many years, Concubine Shu had no feelings for Xu Guirong, so Xu Guirong was hastily buried according to the palace rules.
The Second Prince didn’t care much about his younger brother. After all, the Seventh Prince had been mediocre since childhood. Besides, how capable could a prince be if he could even be controlled the Fifth Prince?
When Ye Shuo heard that the Seventh Prince not only did not make a fuss, but was even calmer than before, it seemed that he knew it was useless and that Xu Guirong would not come back no matter what, so he gave up struggling.
Then, only three days after Xu Guirong was buried, not even the seventh day had passed, the Seventh Prince went to the Ministry of Revenue to do his work as usual.
Calm, too calm, which was totally different from the anxious look on the Seventh Prince’s face when he first heard that his mother was ill.
Ye Shuo just felt that something was wrong.
Ye Shuo thought that this was bad enough, but he didn’t expect that even worse news was waiting for him.
A few days later, probably less than a month at most, the Crown Prince had a big fight with his tutor.
Considering how much the Grand Tutor values ​​the Crown Prince, the fact that he was so furious must mean something serious.
The Taifu is old-fashioned and stubborn, and it is difficult for him to change his mind once he has made up his mind. Under other circumstances, these would all be shortcomings, but his stubborn temper also means that he cannot tolerate any flaws.
He won’t change when he’s young, and even less so when he’s old.
In addition, Ye Shuo had expressed concerns before, so he thought that the crime the prince had committed this time must be serious.
The more he cared about it, the angrier he became, to the point that the Grand Tutor didn’t even care about his manners.
There are so many details in front of us that it is difficult to ignore them.
Looking at the familiar palace wall, Ye Shuo suddenly felt a little breathless.
Noticing the sadness on his face, the imperial concubine was startled at first, then slowly walked behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Escape
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“If you really can’t stay here any longer, just leave if you want.”
Concubine Rong didn’t know what her son was thinking at the moment. She just thought that Ye Shuo was bored of staying in this palace.
Since it was so painful, why not leave?
Shuo’er was different from me. As a concubine, I could never leave.
He could be free, so why trap him here?
Although the imperial concubine was worried and concerned, she also knew the pain of losing freedom.
Rather than making herself happy, the imperial concubine hopes that her two children will live happily.
If her own happiness is built on the suffering of her children, the imperial concubine really would not bother to do it.
Ye Shuo was startled when he heard this, and spoke subconsciously: “Mom…”Ye Shuo’s mind was in a mess. He had actually wanted to run away before, and now after these two things happened he wanted to run away even more.
Ye Shuo is not a saint. If things go on like this, he is afraid that he will not be able to remain indifferent.
Sometimes there are things that you know you can’t do, but you still can’t help but want to try.
But sometimes these attempts often result in death.
As the saying goes, those involved in the matter are often confused, while those who are not involved can see things clearly. Even the smartest people will inevitably fall into this vicious circle. After Ye Shuo joined the game, as a person in the game, it was impossible for him to be as rational as he is now.
Failure to maintain absolute rationality is the beginning of downfall.
People who drown are usually people who know how to swim. Ye Shuo couldn’t guarantee that he would be the exception.
Ye Shuo believed that he was no better than his brothers in playing political games. In terms of playing political games, his brothers were naturally gifted.
But in the current situation, Ye Shuo really didn’t dare to leave. After all, his mother and Jian Jian were still in this palace. If they were accidentally injured, it would be too late for him to regret.
However, the imperial concubine could not understand why her son wanted to run away but refused. This was really unlike him.
“Don’t give me excuses like you don’t really want to go out or anything like that. How can I not understand you?”
Ye Shuo was just about to make up an excuse to get away with it, but the imperial concubine didn’t give him a chance and exposed him right away.
The imperial concubine is very slow in some aspects, but terrifyingly sharp in other aspects.
Under the repeated pressure from the imperial concubine, Ye Shuo had no choice but to tell the truth.
“If I leave, what will happen to you and Jianjian?”
“What do you mean? Jianjian and I can’t live without you, right?” I thought it was something else. When the imperial concubine heard this, she couldn’t help but roll her eyes at him, feeling both angry and amused.
“My father is the Duke of Zhen, and I am the imperial concubine appointed by the emperor himself. Who dares to touch me?”
From beginning to end, Concubine Rong was proud of her family, father and brother.
Concubine Rong knew even more that if anything happened to her, her parents and brothers would definitely not abandon her.
Even after entering the palace for so many years, the imperial concubine has never doubted this.
“To tell you the truth, I personally agreed to your entry into the palace. If I hadn’t agreed, I don’t know what would have happened.”
Then the imperial concubine snorted: “So, take care of yourself first.”
That’s true.
A lean camel is bigger than a horse. As long as my grandfather is alive, it is unlikely that anyone will set their sights on his mother. If my grandfather gets angry, most people will not be able to handle it.
His mother is a royal concubine, and now he is even more loved by his stepfather. Although his stepfather can be truly ruthless when he can, when he cares about someone, he can still be considered reliable.
After a long pause, Ye Shuo said, “If that’s the case, then I’ll really leave.”
When the imperial concubine first saw her son’s nagging manner, she felt a little uncomfortable.
“Just go, really.”
The imperial concubine was not a weak person from beginning to end.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a little relieved.
*
Although Ye Shuo had made up his mind, it was impossible for him to be completely unprepared.
The first person Ye Shuo found was his eldest cousin, who had been wronged, and asked him to take care of his mother and Jian Jian more.
Ye Shuo still has great confidence in his cousin’s abilities.
“Especially the Queen, you must be careful.”
Wei Wen agreed without much hesitation.
The second group of people that Ye Shuo came to visit were his students.
Over the past few years, Ye Shuo has had more and more students in the court. There are no longer just Zou Wu and his friends. There are also some in local areas. Ye Shuo didn’t pay much attention to them before. He basically let them roam free and occasionally gave them some guidance.
You don’t know until you see it, and you’ll be shocked. This group of people are quite capable.
Putting it all together, even if the teacher was Zeng Mohuai, it would still arouse suspicion. As for why my cheap father didn’t find out, it was because the population at the border was mixed, from all over the country, and as long as they were dispersed and then assigned back to their hometowns, they would not be so conspicuous.
It is normal for a few young talents to emerge in local areas every year.
Since it is so normal, no one would think of conducting such an in-depth investigation, and concealing the truth would be a piece of cake.
After all, who would doubt a person who has risen step by step from the bottom?
Then, Zou Wu and others received orders to protect the imperial concubine and the princess.
Zou Wu and others: “…”
They spent the whole day speculating on the teacher’s purpose. Some of them were even ready to sacrifice their lives for him in their fanatical worship. But… this is it?
Suddenly, they felt that the image of the teacher as the wisest person was not so unattainable.
Still feeling unsafe, Ye Shuo called Xing Yucheng into the palace again.
“Of all the people I know, you are the most capable and the smartest, so I’ll leave this matter to you.”
Xing Yucheng had become numb to it. Ever since he met the Ninth Prince, he had to help him deal with all those little troubles every day.
I used to help him with his homework, and now I help him take care of his mother and sister. I have never done any serious work.
But Xing Yucheng really couldn’t refuse, after all, there was no one else around him except himself!
Xing Yucheng had no choice but to agree.
This is what happened openly. As for the harem, Ye Shuo then found Zhao Chongrong and the others.
Although Zhao Chongrong and the others are not as high-ranking as his mother, they are old ladies after all. They have been in the palace for so long, so no matter who they are, they must be capable.
“Madam Zhao, Madam Xu, Madam Li, I am really worried about my mother, so could you please take care of my mother and Jianjian after I leave?”
Ye Shuo didn’t force anyone, as long as someone could give him a reminder at the critical moment.
Zhao Chongrong and the other two loved the brother and sister the most, and naturally responded to all their requests.
I can’t guarantee anything else, but if you pay a little attention to the movements of each palace, there will be no problem.
Concubines of high status have their own way of living.
After settling his mother and Jian Jian, Ye Shuo started to think about the little white tiger and the six small dogs.
A little white tiger is fine, but a tiger that is a few months old is no longer something that ordinary people can deal with.
Although six Chinese greyhounds together are ferocious enough, the worst thing to be afraid of is when they are separated.
Ye Shuo still remembers Xu Chongyi’s Persian cat.
So many years have passed, and I don’t know what happened to the person who did such a thing.
For fear of hurting his mother and Jianjian, Ye Shuo planned to take the little tiger away and leave the six small dogs behind. Therefore, Ye Shuo specifically instructed Su Yue to pay more attention to the six dogs.
After hearing what happened with Xu Chongy, Su Yue couldn’t help but shudder: “This method is really cruel…”
Since this was mentioned, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask a few more questions: “Has anything similar happened in the palace in recent years?”
Although Ye Shuo had asked around, he didn’t find anything. It’s possible that Su Yue knew more.
Then Su Yue shook her head: “It seems… not.”
Let him think about it. Over the years, except for the Queen Mother, no one else in the palace seemed to have any obvious hostility towards his mother, so the harem was relatively peaceful.
Apart from the rivalry in the harem, not counting his mother, there was one person who had a grudge against Ye Shuo——
The Princess Beiting who came to the Great Zhou to marry.
Unfortunately, after becoming a concubine, the other party still seemed to be restless. She ran to the Queen’s palace every few days. Not long after, just one or two months, the princess became more and more excessive. Finally, her stepfather couldn’t stand it anymore, so he found a random reason to imprison her, and she has not been released yet.
Because of this incident, the Queen Mother was severely reprimanded. Logically speaking, she should not be able to cause any trouble.
Even if she had some ability, with the people in her cousin’s hands, as well as Empress Zhao and the increasingly clever girl Su Yue, they could not reach into the Qiuwu Palace.
It felt like it was about right, but to be on the safe side, Ye Shuo personally took a brush and wrote a few letters before leaving, and asked someone to send them out.
Everything is ready, except running away.
Ye Shuo would definitely not be able to escape by himself. He would be stopped before he even reached the palace gate.
After many years, Ye Shuo got into the Taifu’s carriage again.
The Grand Tutor was now exhausted both physically and mentally, and was just feeling worried when he heard a slight sound coming from under his butt.
This movement seems familiar…
The Master suddenly dreamt of ten years ago.
Then, as expected, Ye Shuo once again climbed out of the box in the Taifu’s carriage.
