“Teacher, I didn’t expect that after so many years, you still haven’t changed your old habits.”
As if he didn’t notice the crack in Taifu’s expression, Ye Shuo planned to run away without thinking, but then he thought of something and turned back.
The Taifu subconsciously thought that he was going to ask him about the quarrel between him and the Crown Prince. Over the past few days, many people had asked him about it openly or secretly, and the Taifu was tired of making up excuses.
Just as the Grand Tutor subconsciously put his full attention, the next moment, he heard him ask, “Teacher, I remember you once said that you have many students, all over the Great Zhou?”
The Master was stunned, not knowing what he meant.
“In that case, does our sect have any tokens or something? Give me one.”
Grand Master: “…”
Wait, Ye Shuo suddenly remembered that the tutor seemed to have a ruler that he had used for many years to punish students.
Ye Shuo had noticed when he was beaten before that the ruler was worn out and had a patina on it, so it looked like it was quite old.
Ye Shuo was beaten almost every day before, so the tutor gradually developed the habit of carrying it with him.
“Let me think, it seems to be here…”
When Ye Shuo opened the third drawer, he saw what he was looking for at a glance.
“That’s it.”
Before the tutor could figure out what he wanted this thing for, the next moment, Ye Shuo gave him a big bear hug.
“Teacher, take care!”
With the character of the Grand Tutor, how could he be so close to others in his life?
The old man was embraced and a little embarrassed. He was about to scold him for being a bookworm in a rage, but then he heard this sentence.
Then, the Taifu watched Ye Shuo put the ruler into his arms, jumped off the carriage, and ran away like a dog.
By the time the Grand Tutor reacted, Ye Shuo had already rushed into the Prince’s Mansion.
Maybe Ye Shuo was unlucky, because when he came out he happened to run into the eldest prince who finally had half a day off.
“Hey, brother, you’re back so early today?”
The eldest prince couldn’t help but frown when he saw this: “What are you doing?”
Ye Shuo shrugged casually: “I have nothing to do, so I plan to go out for a walk.”
The eldest prince looked suspicious.
I always feel like something is wrong, but I can’t put my finger on it.
After a while, the eldest prince finally reacted.
Wait, didn’t the emperor forbid him to leave the palace? How could he get out?
It happened that the eldest prince had just come out of the military camp, also riding a horse. After noticing that Ye Shuo was heading in the wrong direction, he immediately chased after him.
The two men were running one after the other at lightning speed. The wind around them was like a knife cutting on Ye Shuo’s face, and in a short while his hair was messed up.
Seeing him getting closer and closer to the city gate, the eldest prince couldn’t help but yell, “Stop him!”
Ye Shuo’s heart tightened and he immediately sped up.
Almost at the last moment before the city gate closed, Ye Shuo successfully “squeezed” out through the gap in the door.
“Thank you for the Qingfeng, big brother. I don’t need words to express my gratitude for your kindness. I will go ahead!”
The eldest prince: “…”
Hearing Ye Shuo’s voice from afar, the eldest prince’s teeth were about to break.
He never thought that his brother would run away so blatantly! He even rode the horse he had given him!
Not long after that, the eldest prince received a letter.
It said that during the time he was away from home, he was asked to help take care of the imperial concubine and the princess.
You don’t have to think about who it is.
Along with the eldest prince, the second prince, the crown prince, the fourth prince, the fifth prince, the sixth prince, the seventh prince and the eighth prince all received the same content.
Since he was so sensible, these people wouldn’t be so shameless, right?
“This Xiaojiu…” The second prince saw it but didn’t say anything.
The other side.
Since Ye Shuo has been too mysterious in recent days, Emperor Jingwen wants to see what he plans to do.
As a result… the man just rode away on horseback.
Judging from the situation, he is planning to run far away this time and won’t be able to come back in a short time.
Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he almost died, but what made him even angrier was that the imperial concubine and the others knew about it in advance but did not try to stop it.
Just as Emperor Jingwen was about to open his mouth to curse, he heard the imperial concubine and Zhao Chongrong kneel down in unison and say in unison, “Please forgive me, Your Majesty.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen looked at the imperial concubine. He was reluctant to give up something he loved so much.
Then he looked at Zhao Chongrong and the others. They were all elderly people living in the palace and had no children. Besides, they were always low-key and tactful, so they had to be given some respect.
In the end, Emperor Jingwen turned away and left.
“A loving mother often spoils her son. Just spoil him!”
“When he gets into big trouble, you will regret it sooner or later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Liangzhou
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ten miles away from Shangjing, Ye Shuo met up with Xiao Luzi, who had smuggled out under the pretext of shopping. Leading Xiao Luzi and Little White Tiger, they headed south, stopping from time to time, until they reached Liangzhou.
Perhaps it was because of the little tiger following him, Ye Shuo and his group attracted a lot of attention along the way.
Unlike the Ninth Prince who had been pampered since childhood, Xiao Luzi became alert almost subconsciously.
He originally thought that His Highness’s ostentatiousness would surely attract someone with ulterior motives, so he was very careful in every aspect. However, he found that, hmm, there didn’t seem to be anyone so foolish as to target them.
But what Xiao Luzi didn’t know was that it wasn’t that no one had bad intentions, but that Ye Shuo solved it secretly.
Just like when they were staying at the inn on the first night, because the next city was still some distance away, they had to settle for the next best thing and choose to complain to the small inn in the town. Then, just after midnight, Ye Shuo clearly heard the sound of a lock being pried open outside.
However, with the little white tiger around, the five senses of wild animals are much more sensitive than humans. When Ye Shuo heard the little white tiger’s growl, he woke up immediately.
He picked up the chopsticks and threw them out. After that, the people outside fell silent. It was obvious that they understood that this young man was not easy to mess with and they had met a tough guy.
When Ye Shuo opened the door, apart from the chopstick stuck in the opposite wall, there were only messy footprints.Whether it was Ye Shuo himself, the little white tiger, or the fat and strong Qingfeng with shiny fur, they all made people very greedy.
Along the way, Ye Shuo basically encountered all kinds of situations.
There were people stealing horses, tigers, and even people, and all kinds of methods were used in an endless stream.
After all, Ye Shuo was not omnipotent, and sometimes he would fall into the trap, but fortunately he reacted in time and was not tricked. It was just that he would be in a very embarrassing situation occasionally. Ye Shuo had smelled the drug twice. If the little white tiger had not reminded him in time, he would probably have fallen asleep.
Later on, Ye Shuo had evolved to the point where he would stare at the chef cooking, and would not touch the food or water on the table even if he left for a short while.
In ancient times, living in peace without anyone to protect you was indeed much more difficult than it is today.
And along the way, Ye Shuo was also growing rapidly.
He has a strong learning ability and his previous disadvantages were due to his lack of experience. Now that he has seen it, he has gradually become proficient.
When passing by a certain city, it happened to be the solar term and the city was extremely lively. Ye Shuo had just entered the city. The black horse, the white tiger, and the dazzlingly handsome young man, this combination was extremely eye-catching.
In addition, they were both obviously strangers, so they would naturally be noticed by those who were interested.
To be able to raise horses so well, and with this young man’s demeanour and bearing, he must have been born into a wealthy family.
The young man is so ignorant of the ways of the world that he doesn’t even know how to restrain himself. He parades around like this, it’s almost as if the word “fat sheep” was written all over his face.
As if he didn’t notice the unusual things around him, Ye Shuo kept comforting the somewhat restless little white tiger.
Although the little white tiger has always been hanging out with people, this is the first time it has seen such a lively environment. Due to its nature as a wild beast, it must have subconsciously wanted to be on guard, and its aggressiveness was stronger than usual.
Fortunately, it is only five months old. If it had grown a little bigger, Ye Shuo would not have dared to take it out again, at least not to a crowded place.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, a man with ordinary appearance passed by Ye Shuo.
Xiao Luzi watched helplessly as the other party tried to steal the purse of His Highness the Ninth Prince but failed, and his own purse from his waist was touched by His Highness instead.
Oh my God, if His Majesty saw this scene, he would probably faint.
This, this, this, Your Highness has only been out for a short time and he has already learned bad things!
Ye Shuo had been robbed once before, but fortunately the thief didn’t know kung fu, so he caught up with him and beat him up before he got his money bag back. How could Ye Shuo make the same mistake again?
He used force to intimidate the other party, and he actually learned something from it.
Now, it comes in handy.
The man walked a long way before he realised something was wrong. He felt like something was missing around his waist. He subconsciously touched it, but as expected, he found nothing.
When I looked back again, I saw the young man holding his purse and smiling at me.
The man immediately realised that he had fallen into trouble. Just as he was about to slander the other party as usual, Ye Shuo had already taken the lead and opened the purse in his hand.
Maybe because he left in a hurry and didn’t have time to deal with it, the purse was only covered with another layer on the outside and another layer inside.
Judging from the fabric used for the inner layer, it is obviously not something for men.
Then Ye Shuo asked, “Whose purse is it? Who lost it?”
Upon hearing this, the people around immediately started checking their pockets. The man knew that he could not do anything, so he quickly slipped away in shame.
Then, Ye Shuo met the first owner who came to claim the lost item.
The man thought Ye Shuo would give it to him immediately because he saw that he was young and dressed like a nobleman. However, he actually asked him what was inside and how much money was in it.
The young man’s expression immediately became awkward.
“Okay, you move aside first. Come on, next one!”
In this way, Ye Shuo finally returned the purse to its real owner as he wished.
Looking at the Ninth Prince who was already feeling very comfortable in his situation, Xiao Luzi’s mood was extremely complicated.
The two of them hurried along like this, and after almost a month, they finally arrived in Liangzhou.
When he first arrived in Liangzhou, Ye Shuo clearly felt that the humidity of the surrounding air was different from that of Shangjing. It was fine and moist, with water surrounding it. Ye Shuo led the horse and looked at the small bridge and flowing water in front of him. Compared with Shangjing, it was less solemn and more tender and gentle.
Although Liangzhou is not as noble as Shangjing, it is extremely rich. There are many merchants here and the economic level is relatively high, so the safety is naturally better than other places passed by.
Ye Shuo immediately decided to stay here.
If you want to settle down here, how can you not have a place to stay?
When Xiao Luzi saw that Ye Shuo spent tens of thousands of taels of silver to buy an old house in Liangzhou City without blinking an eye, Xiao Luzi was heartbroken.
Although Xiao Luzi didn’t know how much silver the prince had brought out, he knew that if he lived off his savings, he would eventually become penniless.
This place is not like the capital. Without the subsidies from the emperor’s concubine and the old Duke Zhen, Xiao Luzi has even imagined the scene of himself and his master sleeping on the streets.
Although Ye Shuo would not go hungry because of these mere tens of thousands of taels of silver, after all, Beiting was sending him silver continuously, but he would not really do nothing.
As a person, you have to find something to do, otherwise you will be useless, right?
Especially along the way, Ye Shuo saw so many businessmen in fancy clothes, such fat sheep, it would be a pity not to slaughter them.
Gradually, several thoughts flashed through Ye Shuo’s mind.
The other side.
Emperor Jingwen initially thought that his son had never suffered much since he was a child, so how could he get along so easily outside? He probably thought that he would cry and shout to come back soon.
Emperor Jingwen had even decided that he must teach him a lesson when the time comes.
However, he waited for a month.
Emperor Jingwen soon received news that his son had settled in Liangzhou.
The little bastard really went alone with one horse, and at most a little eunuch who was of no use other than serving, and they travelled through mountains and rivers and finally reached Liangzhou in the south.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know what to say for a moment.
If he had put a bit of this energy into serious matters, he probably wouldn’t be in this state now.
Emperor Jingwen originally wanted to find out what the little bastard was going to do next, but not long after, Emperor Jingwen no longer cared about him.
About half a year later, Emperor Jingwen received a secret memorial.
It’s about the prince.
After reading all the content above, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but look pale.
Emperor Jingwen could never have imagined that his most beloved son would do such a thing.
“Selling official positions and titles, exploiting the people, and forming cliques for personal gain.” Each and every one of them is shocking.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly thought of the quarrel between the crown prince and his teacher more than half a year ago. He didn’t think much of it at the time, but now thinking about it, it seems that it was a foreshadowing.
Emperor Jingwen was not unaware of the open and covert struggles between his eldest son and the crown prince, he just couldn’t believe that the crown prince had no confidence in his father.
It is really disappointing that you can’t keep your cool.
For a ruler, judgement is particularly important. He must know what is feasible and what is not.
It is really stupid to insist on doing it even though you know it is a dead end!
Emperor Jingwen’s hands were shaking with anger.
However, this was his most beloved son, the crown prince whom he had placed high hopes on since he was young. Emperor Jingwen naturally wanted him to turn back in time before a disaster occurred.
So at the morning court session the next day, Emperor Jingwen scolded the prince mercilessly in front of all the civil and military officials in the court.
Since the day he was appointed as the crown prince, the prince has never been as embarrassed as he is today.

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Adventure
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Emperor Jingwen thought that if he did this, the crown prince would change, but he didn’t know that this would only make the crown prince, who was already in a precarious situation, even more panicked. After all, for so many years, Emperor Jingwen’s favour was only on the crown prince. In the final analysis, the crown prince was just a title.
He can be appointed as the crown prince today, and someone else can be appointed as the crown prince tomorrow.
The position of crown prince seems to be extremely glorious, but it is ultimately subject to the fate of the monkeys scattering when the tree falls.
Now that the destiny is with the eldest prince, and everything goes smoothly for the eldest prince, the crown prince will inevitably become suspicious over time and try desperately to grab something.
He could not and dared not trust Emperor Jingwen. Even if his father really only cared about him, even if he really succeeded to the throne smoothly in the future, with the eldest prince’s current power, he could easily overthrow him.
So many soldiers are loyal to the eldest prince. They have been at the border for ten years and have lived and died together. How can this be changed by ordinary people? Otherwise, why would my father be so afraid of the Duke of Zhen?
The prince was unwilling to watch himself being dethroned, and even more unwilling to be an emperor in name only in the future.
My father had an eldest prince back then, what does he have now?
Everyone wants to have the initiative in their own hands, and no one wants to sit and wait for death.The emperor’s attitude is ambiguous, the eldest prince is aggressive, and his younger brother is ambitious. Even though he knows it is a poison to quench thirst, the prince has to take an extreme approach.
But for Emperor Jingwen, it was impossible for him to tell the Crown Prince everything.
As for military affairs, there was no way he would fall in the same place twice.
Emperor Jingwen believed that his attitude was extremely clear and his original intention had never changed from beginning to end.
It was precisely because Emperor Jingwen had suffered in the past that he knew what it was like to be a crown prince and walk on thin ice, so he did not want his son to go through all of this.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to give birth to the eldest and second princes. His position as crown prince was unstable at the time, and he needed sons to consolidate his position.
But after the birth of his legitimate son, the crown prince, Emperor Jingwen waited for a full five years before the fourth son of the Eastern Palace was born. Such an attitude can be said to be firm.
Later, Emperor Jingwen appointed a crown prince at an early age when he was in his prime, which put an end to everyone’s thoughts. When Xiaojiu was born that year, he was worried that the concubine’s son would threaten the crown prince’s position, so he tried to kill him.
Later, even though he gradually doted on Xiaojiu, when Xiaojiu was sixteen years old, he still restrained himself and did not give him any special honours. He almost fed the prince every mouthful of food.
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen could not figure out where the prince’s doubts came from.
The more a person lacks in his childhood, the more he will want to make up for it when he grows up, and compensate in a vengeful way. The emperor is also a human being, and the emperor is the same.
Based on Emperor Jingwen’s own experience alone, he would not let the prince suffer the same fate as himself.
Rather than saying that Emperor Jingwen was doting on the crown prince, it would be more accurate to say that he was looking at his former self through the crown prince.
However, the prince disappointed him in the end.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t understand why the crown prince still felt like he was in prison even though he had done so much.
The Crown Prince did not understand. His father had obviously always favoured him, so why didn’t he protect him to the end and instead imposed restrictions on the eldest prince? Such an ambiguous attitude was really suspicious.
But unfortunately, neither of them is the kind of person who speaks their mind freely, and as they each have their own concerns, they naturally drift apart.
Unlike Ye Shuo, the prince could not stand losing face in public, especially in front of his brothers.
And what about Emperor Jingwen? He didn’t know how to educate his children from the beginning.
It is difficult for a person who has never been loved by his father to know how to love a child and what love really is.
The more harsh Emperor Jingwen was, the more the prince became obsessed with power politics.
About half a year passed like this. Emperor Jingwen was heartbroken and disappointed. When the prince’s power expanded to a critical point, he could not help but take action and secretly dealt with a very key figure under the prince. At this point, the prince’s fear reached its peak.
…discovered!
The more well-behaved and obedient a child is, the more ashamed he is to admit his mistakes, and the more he wants to cover them up.
Therefore, the prince’s first reaction was not to confess, but fear, shame, and anger.
Seeing that the crown prince not only did not repent but became even more crazy, the friction between Emperor Jingwen and the crown prince intensified, and the relationship between the father and son took a sharp turn for the worse and reached freezing point.
Looking at the prince who was gradually indulging in sensual pleasures, at this moment, Emperor Jingwen could hardly remember how handsome and bright he looked when he was in his twenties.
The other side.
Half a year after Ye Shuo came to Liangzhou City, after he had almost figured out the inside story of Liangzhou City, he decided to open a black shop… no, a restaurant.
This restaurant only accepts extremely treacherous and evil people. Only those who have committed extremely heinous crimes are allowed to enter.
Anyone who enters the restaurant is classified according to the level of crime. Primary criminals are paid one thousand taels of silver a day, mid-level criminals are paid two thousand taels of silver a day, senior criminals are paid three thousand taels of silver a day, and special-level criminals are given special treatment, with the pay ranging from five thousand taels to ten thousand taels, depending on Ye Shuo’s mood.
There was a reason why he dared to ask for such a high price. Anyone who entered his restaurant, no matter what crime he had committed, even if the person was guilty of a heinous crime, Ye Shuo could protect him from death until he had spent all his money.
Of course, treason is an exception, and Ye Shuo doesn’t want to rebel against his adopted father.
After hearing what the Ninth Prince said, Xiao Luzi’s first reaction was that he was crazy.
“Young Master, are you trying to kill yourself?” He was shielding a criminal. Even his status as a prince could not protect him.
“I beg you, sir, please don’t be confused!”
Xiao Luzi was about to cry.
However, Ye Shuo was not too worried: “Although this idea is absurd, I have to give it a try. What if it works?”
Many criminals would not reveal the whereabouts of the dirty silver if they knew they would not survive, but what if there was a chance to survive?
For a dying person, one more hour would be good.
When the time comes, the money will be returned to the victim’s family. Even if someone is dead, at least they can get some compensation, which is better than losing both.
I just don’t know whether the government will agree.
But the key to this matter is communication. What if it works? It will also be of great benefit to the government.
Ye Shuo quickly took out the ruler he had snatched from the tutor.
Ye Shuo is a man of great integrity. Since he has escaped from the palace, he does not intend to use the title of prince anymore.
It doesn’t matter. Doesn’t he still have the identity of the Taifu’s student?
After relying on your father, you can still rely on your teacher. Why should you work hard when you can rely on others?
If…the teacher is not bragging.
The Taifu has been an official in the court for so many years, and the students he had taught before have already become local tyrants or famous figures. If they did not make it, they would naturally be just like everyone else.
After asking around, Ye Shuo actually found out.
The Taifu said that he had many students all over the world, and it turned out that he was not exaggerating.
Even after so many years, students still feel scared when they see the familiar ruler.
Wu Weiyong, who was considered one of the most powerful men in Liangzhou City, couldn’t help but shudder when he saw the thing in Ye Shuo’s hand.
It’s true.
“You said you were the teacher’s student. Do you have any other evidence?” Perhaps because time has passed, the filter has become thicker, and Wu Weiyong was really reminded of the past.
“If you don’t believe me, you can write a letter to the teacher.” Ye Shuo is as real as gold and is not afraid of fire. He is not false at all.
About ten days later, Wu Weiyong actually received a reply and had a strange expression on his face.
Wu Weiyong knew his teacher’s personality, so he could not have imagined that the teacher could be so concerned about a student that he actually asked him to take care of the boy in the letter.
Wu Weiyong thought about it and finally made a connection with Ye Shuo and the prefect of Liangzhou.
Liangzhou’s economy is already developed, so the officials here are naturally more flexible. The other party was originally a little hesitant, but as soon as Ye Shuo said that he would be responsible for everything, the governor of Liangzhou no longer had any worries.
If it works, it is his political achievement. If it doesn’t, it is his youth’s problem. He won’t lose anyway, so there is no harm in giving it a try.
Then, Ye Shuo’s Ping’an Restaurant opened.
There is no shortage of desperate people in this world. If they have lost their lives, what do they need money for?
When they are desperate, even if it seems ridiculous, people will still come to them.
It didn’t take long for Ye Shuo to make his first business deal.
If there is a first, there will be a second. If the first deal is successful, how long will the second and third be?
After people discovered that they would not be arrested by the government as long as they stayed in the Ping’an Restaurant, the Ping’an Restaurant quickly became famous.
There are naturally many people who spend a lot of money in this situation. Later, they found that the owner of this restaurant was really ruthless. He only gave them 1,000 taels of silver to eat this for a day?
It was worse than the ordinary restaurants outside.
However, Ye Shuo felt that this kind of food was a bargain for them. After all, they had done evil things, so how could they deserve to eat good food?
These people protested, but Ye Shuo still did what he had to do. He looked like he was saying “come if you want, get out if you don’t want to.” He was as arrogant as he could be, which made people wonder who was the evil one.
Of course, since he is such a vicious criminal, with Ye Shuo’s attitude, some people would occasionally want to kill him out of anger. But Ye Shuo is not a pushover after all. If he spends Beiting’s silver, naturally there will be masters following him.
Over time, not only the wanted criminals of the government, but even the gangsters would come here to seek refuge.
As long as there is money to be paid, unless it is an extreme situation, people who come to seek revenge will not mind waiting a few more days. Naturally, they will give Ye Shuo some face and agree with each other not to fight in the restaurant.
The people hiding in the restaurant knew clearly in their hearts that they were just being taken advantage of, but they had no choice. When a person is extremely thirsty, even if he knows that the water in front of him is poisoned, he still has to drink it. This is what is meant by drinking poison to quench thirst.
In just over half a year, Ye Shuo’s nickname changed from the Ninth Young Master to the current Chief Boss.
His Highness is about to make a name for himself in this world…
The path is very messy.
But what Xiao Luzi didn’t understand was, what good would this do to His Highness? He himself didn’t make much money.
However, Xiao Luzi didn’t know that fame and fortune are inseparable. If a person has fame, money will naturally come to him. It just depends on whether you want to do it or not.
Not long after, Ye Shuo applied to the governor of Liangzhou for permission to open a gambling house.
It is called a gambling house, but in fact it is a place for the wealthy in the city to discuss business and relax. It is similar to the model of a casino, but Ye Shuo does not cheat ordinary people. Capital must be verified before entering.
In order to prevent someone from losing everything they had, when only 30% of the money the gentry brought was left, someone in the gambling house would remind them and force them to log off.
However, not many people bought into this model at the beginning. After all, the gentry were not fools. They verified capital and imposed this and that restrictions. Did they think they were made of clay?
But they had no choice, because Qinglufan had a good environment, good service, and most importantly, many things, many of which were new and novel things they had never heard of before. Even though there were many problems, it seemed that they could not be completely intolerable.
[1] Qinglufan = gambling house
As time went by, and with the influence of Ye Shuo’s reputation, Qinglufang’s business really became booming.
Then there is intra-city express delivery. Kung Fu exists in this world, and people who know Kung Fu can run errands much faster than modern delivery guys.
As for the official teaching houses in Liangzhou, there were obviously better ways to make money. Most of them were the wives of officials, who were proficient in music, chess, calligraphy and painting. Why would they be greedy for the money from selling their bodies?
In addition, in addition to women, men could also sell their bodies. There were many women doing business in Liangzhou.
When it comes to marketing, the ancients were still far behind.
After the magistrate of Liangzhou tried to make some changes, he found that it was true. When the people inside were not asked to sell their bodies, the wealthy people in Liangzhou City were more willing to invest money in it. No one knew why.
In the past, Liangzhou’s economy was developed, but there was not much entertainment, and money was not circulated, so it was just for show.
Now that so many new and interesting gadgets have suddenly appeared, everyone’s money naturally has a place to go.
In just one year, seeing the promising growth in tax revenue, the governor of Liangzhou was so excited that he immediately made Ye Shuo his close friend.
Looking at the two people who were talking about brothers all the time, Xiao Luzi could only pray for the prefect, hoping that he would never know the truth.
In a blink of an eye, two years passed. The exhausted Emperor Jingwen finally decided to tour the south and personally eradicate those cancers one by one.
It just so happens that when I pass by Liangzhou, I can stop by to see how the little bastard is doing recently.
As the relationship between him and the Crown Prince became strained and the other princes were fighting openly and secretly, Emperor Jingwen now felt relieved only when he mentioned his youngest son.
References
↑1Qinglufan = gambling house

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Development
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Although Emperor Jingwen’s goal was to clean up the officialdom in the south, he did not say it explicitly out of consideration for the Crown Prince’s face. On the surface, Emperor Jingwen only said that the Ninth Prince had been away from home for two years and he wanted to see how he was doing and to take a look at the latest customs and practices in the south.
The emperor has been doting on the Ninth Prince for a long time. There have been even more exaggerated cases in the past. More than two years ago, the emperor wanted to keep the Ninth Prince in the palace and raise him for the rest of his life. Now he just went to see him. What’s so hard to understand?
Hearing this news, everyone felt that the emperor seemed to be too doting on the Ninth Prince, to a level far beyond the ordinary.
The Ninth Prince’s favour has not diminished in the two years since he left the palace. The Emperor still cares about him all the time. Such an honour is rare in ancient and modern times.
Only the prince knew that his father’s move to look for Xiaojiu was fake, but his intention to take action against him was real.
My father took it seriously and showed no mercy at all.
The prince looked up, with a look of dejection.
A few days later, Emperor Jingwen drew up a list of names for the southern tour. Except for the crown prince, he did not bring any powerful princes with him. He only brought his fourth, fifth, seventh and eighth sons. He left the eldest prince, the second prince and the sixth prince in Shangjing City.
After all, my father treats the prince differently.Upon hearing the news, the eldest prince couldn’t help but sneer, but there was a hint of anger and sadness in his eyes.
Even though the prince has behaved so absurdly, his father still refuses to give up. He still holds out hope for the prince and tries to bring him back on the right track.
If I had done what the prince did, I would have died countless times!
Children who have never received the love of their parents will never feel complete, no matter how old they are. There will always be something missing, and there will always be regrets.
In the eyes of the eldest prince, Emperor Jingwen went to such great lengths to cut off the prince’s escape route in order to save him. After all, after eliminating all the dirty and smelly people, after a few years, Emperor Jingwen would assign the prince some decent tasks, and the prince would become the innocent prince he once was.
My father really put a lot of thought into this.
But in the eyes of the prince, although his father took him with him on the southern tour, he kept him under house arrest in a room on the ship, not allowing him to go out or see anyone, and making him watch helplessly as his own empire was about to collapse. This was really too cruel.
The prince didn’t know when the sword hanging over his head would fall, and he was in fear every day. As time went by, he couldn’t help but feel resentful.
When the ship arrived at Bingzhou, Emperor Jingwen ordered people to place the prince there and sent someone to guard him.
Before parting, Emperor Jingwen said: “After this matter is over, I hope you can learn some lessons.”
The reason why Emperor Jingwen brought the prince here was to make him remember his mistake so that he would not make the same mistake again next time.
Emperor Jingwen originally wanted him to see with his own eyes what those people had done and how tragic their end was, but in the end, Emperor Jingwen really couldn’t bear to do it, so he let the prince get off the boat early.
“Just stay here and reflect on yourself!”
Concealing the complexity and sigh in his heart, Emperor Jingwen waved his sleeves and left.
The strong wind from the river bank blew the prince’s robe, making a rustling sound. The prince lowered his head under the scorching sun, making it impossible to tell his expression at the moment.
The usually brave Fifth Prince stood on the boat and watched this scene. He couldn’t help swallowing his saliva and didn’t dare to make a sound along the way.
After the prince left, no one dared to act rashly. The huge ship was eerily quiet.
Everyone was very cautious, fearing that they might make a mistake and become a victim of the game between the emperor and the prince.
The prince and the emperor no longer look like father and son.
The big ship went downstream, and in such an atmosphere, it gradually approached Liangzhou.
The other side.
He had no idea that the large army was gradually approaching him. After all, Ye Shuo only cared about his mother and Jian Jian. He was too lazy to ask about other things, nor did he dare to ask, because the answer he might get would definitely be unsatisfactory, so it was better not to know.
Although escape is shameful, it is very useful.
Ye Shuo waved to Xiao Luzi as usual and asked Xiao Luzi for his schedule for today.
After two years, Ye Shuo’s life in Liangzhou had gradually returned to normal. Every day he only needed to inspect the places under his name and collect rent to make a living.
Although Ye Shuo made a lot of money, he also spent a lot of money, especially for the construction of Liangzhou City. He was very generous in investing, spending a lot of money every day. As a result, the governor of Liangzhou could not help but have the illusion that the young man in front of him cared more about the development of Liangzhou than himself…
The Ninth Young Master is building Liangzhou as if it were his own home.
No prefect would dislike a person who is willing to spend money without expecting anything in return.
Even though the magistrate of Liangzhou was more than ten years older than Ye Shuo, and was in his thirties and almost forty, when he looked at Ye Shuo now, it was no different from looking at his own brother. No, that’s not right. He looked closer than a brother.
Where can you find such a good person? This is the best pie in the sky.
In just two years, the roads in Liangzhou City were more than doubled. The roads became wider and smoother, making it more convenient for merchants to travel.
It is not easy to change the old city area of ​​Liangzhou, but we can still develop new urban areas. Isn’t this what urban expansion works like?
Large tracts of vacant land in Liangzhou City were utilised. More neatly arranged and uniform houses, better road planning, wider roads, and a more beautiful living environment all attracted the attention of wealthy merchants.
Especially the sewage and drainage in the new urban area and various infrastructure in the old urban area are completely incomparable.
Needless to say, Ye Shuo must have participated in the construction of the new urban area, especially the commercial street in the new urban area, which was designed by Ye Shuo himself and built with his own money.
Among them, shops and government offices accounted for 40%, and Ye Shuo accounted for 60%. At first, the magistrate of Liangzhou thought that his brother was really kind. Not only did he help them build houses for free, but he also gave up nearly half of the profits in one go. However, after the first quarter’s turnover came out, the magistrate realised that he was too happy too early.
Even if it was only 60%, he would have made a fortune! As expected, there is no business without fraud, so how could a businessman let himself suffer a loss?
After the optimization of Liangzhou’s infrastructure, whether it was the environment or other aspects, it was abruptly raised a lot. In this case, the wealthy businessmen from other cities would naturally gradually flow to Liangzhou.
Who doesn’t want to enjoy better resources at the same cost?
The streets in Liangzhou were wide and smooth, and it was more convenient for them to use horse-drawn carriages to travel when doing business than in other places.
In the past, Liangzhou was rich, but only relatively speaking. Compared with Shengzhou and Yeling and other places, it was still far behind. But now Liangzhou has gradually caught up.
The more wealthy merchants came, the more money Ye Shuo earned. The previous initial investment was nothing, and his business became more and more prosperous. It was a virtuous cycle.
Since Liangzhou has become wealthy, tax revenue will naturally rise. With more tax revenue, the resettlement of poor people has been put on the agenda. Coupled with Ye Shuo’s generous donation, resettlement houses have been built in large numbers in the west of the city.
Before, Ye Shuo was short of manpower, so he specifically asked Zeng Mohuai to send a few students over. With these students leading the teams, the construction teams under Ye Shuo’s command were fast and good, not to mention the quality of the projects. With Ye Shuo personally supervising it, there was really nothing to complain about.
In their spare time, even people from other cities would invite these construction teams over, and Ye Shuo behind the scenes naturally made a fortune.
In addition to this, Ye Shuo also took a lot of money and set up several special awards, which, needless to say, were naturally related to innovation.
No matter what kind of innovation it is, Ye Shuo will accept it all.
After all, Ye Shuo is only one person, and the development of Da Zhou requires the joint efforts of everyone. It is not advisable to force things to happen. We should mobilise the enthusiasm of everyone and make progress together.
With such a huge reward, Liangzhou City naturally became a place where flowers blossomed.
The advancement of science and technology can often promote the development of agriculture.
The magistrate of Liangzhou always felt that if he continued to develop like this for a few more years, his path to promotion would be just around the corner, and by then being granted a title of nobility or appointed as prime minister would no longer be a dream.
Perhaps it was because Liangzhou was developing too rapidly that other cities around it could no longer sit still. The governors of various places racked their brains and frantically thought of countermeasures. After all, Liangzhou was so outstanding that if they didn’t think of a solution, they would soon be outdone!
This governor of Liangzhou was really hateful. He was so eye-catching that they had no choice but to move.
If one party wants to keep up with others, others have to follow suit. The life of officials becomes difficult, while the lives of the people below are getting better and better. So, it’s okay for them to sacrifice.
Sacrificing one prefect to save millions of families is truly the virtue of a saint and is worthy of praise.
Ye Shuo seemed not to notice that so many people were involved because of him. As the centre of the storm, Ye Shuo felt quite at ease.
Ping An Restaurant hasn’t had much business recently, but Ye Shuo doesn’t mind. After all, a decrease in the number of criminals is a good thing.
Ye Shuo took the booklet handed over by Xiao Luzi and flipped through it. He found that he had to go to a shop in the east of the city to collect rent today. So he changed his clothes and walked out of the house under the protection of two martial arts masters.
Now in Liangzhou City, who would not call him “Chief Boss” when seeing him? Even the prefect always used this title to make fun of him.
Not to mention, Ye Shuo really felt like a mountain king in Liangzhou. It was really quite impressive and exciting.
After greeting the people he interacted with, Ye Shuo successfully collected this month’s rent from the high-end cloth shop in front of him, and then walked into Qinglufang with the more than one hundred taels of silver.
Since he had nothing to do, he just came in and played a few games. It just so happened that he felt like playing today.
The moment they saw Ye Shuo, the guests in Qinglufang were stunned at first, and then cheered.
“The Ninth Young Master is here, the Ninth Young Master is here.”
Wow, the owner of Qinglufang is here, which makes those who lost to him before suddenly excited.
“Old rules, who will go first?” Ye Shuo rolled up his sleeves, put one foot on the stool, looked around and asked.
“Me! Me!”
Soon, Qinglufang became lively.
The other side.
Emperor Jingwen thought for a long time and finally decided to give the little bastard a surprise, so after he got off the boat, he only brought a few guards and the fourth, fifth, seventh and eighth prince with him.
However, as soon as he entered the city and saw the scenes before him, Emperor Jingwen was immediately stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Gambling House
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
There is no other reason, the changes in Liangzhou today are really too great.
The new and wide street, I don’t know what it is paved with, but at first glance, it is extremely flat without any undulations.
Coupled with the neatly arranged houses around, and the orange vests coming and going on the street, stopping when waved, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help feeling a little confused. He didn’t even remember that there was such a place under his rule.
Or maybe it was because I hadn’t left Beijing for a long time, so I didn’t know the situation outside was like this.
Then Emperor Jingwen shook his head and said, “No, that’s not right. When he passed through Bingzhou and other places before, he didn’t see such scenes, and he didn’t hear any reports from his subordinates. It must be unique to Liangzhou and it only appeared recently.”
After observing for a while, I found that the people here all walked with smiles on their faces, and they looked very prosperous. I guess this is because they are extremely looking forward to and yearning for their future life.
Emperor Jingwen had an idea, and then called over a man in an orange vest and asked, “Excuse me, young man, what is the meaning of wearing this?”
In addition to delivering things to customers, the Orange Vests also do various odd jobs part-time. They can stop at any time and as long as they know and can do it, there is no problem.
Not to mention introducing the current situation in Liangzhou to others.These people used to be beggars in Liangzhou City, and there were also refugees who poured in from other places. Ye Shuo arranged some resettlement houses for them, and then had them registered by the prefect. They also received concentrated training before taking up their posts to improve their professional capabilities. Now they do odd jobs every day. Although they are not rich, they have no problem with eating every day.
Beggars and refugees were gathered together, making them easier to manage, and the crime rate in Liangzhou City was reduced a lot.
A low crime rate and good public security will attract more people to settle here. The prefect wanted to hug Ye Shuo, who came up with this idea, and give him a big kiss.
This was not the first time that Orange Vest had encountered this situation. He had long been accustomed to it. Anyone who first came to Liangzhou had to go through this experience.
“A few guests, they must be from other places, right?”
Hearing this, the princes became nervous for a moment. After all, they did not bring many people with them today. If their identities were discovered, they would be in danger.
However, the orange vest seemed to have seen through their thoughts and waved his hands, saying, “Don’t be nervous, my guests. I’m not trying to find out your identities, but I’ve encountered this kind of situation quite a lot. If you don’t believe me, look over there.”
Following the line of sight of the man in the orange vest, the Fourth Prince and his companions realised that they were not the only ones there. There were many other people in gorgeous clothes at the city gate who were acting the same way as them.
“Those are all businessmen from other places. Judging from the way you are dressed, you are also here to do business in Liangzhou, right?” Forgive the orange vest. Although he has received training, with his vision, he can only see this much.
Emperor Jingwen nodded calmly, “That’s right. We are new to your place and are a little confused. I wonder if this young man could take us around Liangzhou City?”
“No problem. Please follow me.” The orange vest was responsible for this job. When he heard the man in front of him say this, he naturally responded.
Emperor Jingwen immediately forgot about his son and the only thing on his mind was the situation in Liangzhou.
“This is Longxing Street, the most famous commercial street in Liangzhou…”
“This is Apricot Rain Road. If you had come a few months earlier, you would have seen the apricot blossoms on both sides of the river. Now the apricot blossoms have withered, which is a pity. However, if you wait a little longer, you might be been able to eat apricots produced in Liangzhou City…”
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously looked towards both sides of the river bank, and indeed saw the green apricots on the branches that were almost integrated with the leaves.
“And here, this is Dingxi Bridge. Legend has it that the immortals from heaven once stayed here.”
“And here, this is the most famous Ping An Restaurant in Liangzhou. This is our boss’s territory!”
Orange Vest is now Ye Shuo’s employee. He has a job provided by Ye Shuo, so when he mentions Ye Shuo, he naturally speaks with enthusiasm.
The chief scoop…
If Emperor Jingwen remembered correctly, it should be underworld slang, referring to the head of an organisation or force.
When can such power be brought to the surface? Doesn’t the governor of this place care?
Seeing the orange vest praising him so much, Emperor Jingwen frowned slightly: “Chief Boss?”
The man in the orange vest did not notice Emperor Jingwen’s displeasure. Whenever outsiders asked him about it, he would subconsciously start talking endlessly.
Seeing the orange vest praising the other party to the sky, with an expression of extreme admiration and the desire to worship him, Emperor Jingwen frowned even more.
From what the other party said, it seems that the other party has some connection with the government. In this case, isn’t this a real collusion between officials and businessmen? What’s more, there is also a dispute between underworld forces.
This Liangzhou City seems to be much more complicated than I imagined…
“Thank you, young man.” After spending most of the day and almost understanding the situation in Liangzhou City, Emperor Jingwen said with a smile.
“Thanks for your hard work.”
Upon seeing this, the Fourth Prince took out a piece of loose silver and placed it in the hand of the man in the orange vest.
Orange Vest never thought that he would get so much reward money just for taking people to tour Liangzhou City for a whole morning. It was as much as one or two taels of silver, enough for him to eat for a month.
But think about it, the luckiest people in the same industry as mine had earned as much as five taels of silver, so this one tael of silver was nothing.
Thanks to Liangzhou, thanks to the chief leader!
The orange vest left happily.
Looking at the other person’s back, the Fourth Prince and others couldn’t help but look at Emperor Jingwen: “Dad, should we go find Xiaojiu next, or…”
When walking outside, the Fourth Prince and his entourage now address Emperor Jingwen by the common people’s name.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen shook his head and said, “Don’t ask about Xiaojiu’s location first, go see the governor here first.”
In addition to what the Orange Vest said, Emperor Jingwen also wanted to find out whether the other party had any connection with the Crown Prince.
After saying this, Emperor Jingwen walked towards the prefectural government office.
The Fourth Prince and others hurriedly followed.
Liangzhou magistrate Zhao Jinchuan was out patrolling most of the day today and only returned in the afternoon.
When he came back in the sedan chair, he accidentally glanced to the side, and this one glance scared him to death.
Zhao Jinchuan had met the emperor once a few years ago. The atmosphere in the Xuan Zheng Hall was solemn and dignified. Due to the rules, one could not look directly at the emperor’s face, so Zhao Jinchuan just looked up when he entered the Xuan Zheng Hall.
With just one glance, the emperor at the top seemed to be branded in his heart, and he dared not forget it at any time.
And now, he actually saw a similar person at the gate of the government office, which made Zhao Jinchuan break out in cold sweat.
If it was a mistake, it would be embarrassing at best, but if it was not, who knew what the consequences would be?
Almost instantly, Zhao Jinchuan asked someone to stop the sedan.
Seeing a stranger lingering at the main entrance of the government office, and the prefect just returning, the runner subconsciously wanted to shout to drive him away.
However, before they could speak, they saw the prefect almost jogging over.
The yamen runner was stunned, and then, under the pressure of Zhao Jinchuan’s eyes, he retreated.
Zhao Jinchuan took a deep breath, then pretended to be relaxed and bowed: “Sir, may I ask your names, gentlemen?”
Emperor Jingwen raised his eyebrows slightly and uttered the word “Ye”.
The surname Ye is the royal surname, so my guess must be correct.
Zhao Jinchuan hurriedly ordered people to welcome the distinguished guests into the government office.
But Zhao Jinchuan didn’t dare to believe the other party’s one-sided statement. After a pot of good tea, Zhao Jinchuan boldly asked, “This is a serious matter. Apart from these, do you have any other evidence?”
“Bold!” The fifth prince jumped up immediately.
Emperor Jingwen was not angry. Instead, he was very satisfied with the prudence of the Liangzhou prefect. He just hoped that the other party would not let him down in the end.
When Zhao Jinchuan saw the token in Emperor Jingwen’s hand, he no longer had any doubts. He immediately knelt down and shouted “Long live the Emperor” three times.
“I have been negligent, and I beg Your Majesty to forgive me.”
Emperor Jingwen sat at the head of the table and did not call out, but simply asked, “Where does this chief of Liangzhou City come from?”
Here it comes!
Hearing this, Zhao Jinchuan immediately became extremely alert.
Zhao Jinchuan did not dare to hide anything, but told everything he knew.
A young man? White Tiger? Two years ago? The Ninth master?
Upon catching these keywords, Emperor Jingwen was stunned.
This combination sounds very familiar…
Emperor Jingwen paused and asked, “Since he only arrived in Liangzhou two years ago, how can you be sure that the other party has no ill intentions?”
“You know, your actions are really bold now!”
After all, the other party has helped him so much. In this situation, Zhao Jinchuan naturally has to help the other party to refute a few words, so as to prevent the emperor from misunderstanding that he is a person with ulterior motives and then killing him.
After thinking about it, Zhao Jinchuan hurriedly said: “Your Majesty, the young man named Gu Shao really has no ill intentions. Your Majesty does not know that he is the student of the Grand Tutor. He is knowledgeable and talented, and has good character. Since he came, Liangzhou has developed so much. I hope Your Majesty will understand!”
When Emperor Jingwen heard the words “Taifu’s student”, he was basically certain that it was his son.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t expect that the little bastard actually had such ability. It seemed that he had grown a lot after being out for two years.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt relieved.
Sure enough, the little bastard was just slow in coming to his senses, he wasn’t really hopeless.
How could his son be mediocre?
Emperor Jingwen did not explain anything at the moment, but just said: “In this case, call the man over and let me see him.”
Zhao Jinchuan naturally didn’t dare to refuse, and quickly sent the people around him to invite him.
result……
Half an incense stick later, the yamen runner was sweating profusely: “My Lord, the Ninth Young Master is currently in Qinglufang, busy. He said…he said he would not come…”
Ye Shuo had done this before, and since he was now the God of Wealth of Liangzhou, Zhao Jinchuan was used to turning a blind eye to it.
They are our brothers, who would care so much?
But this time the situation is clearly different.
Zhao Jinchuan couldn’t help but look at the yamen runner.
‘Didn’t you say we had a distinguished guest?!’
The yamen runner felt extremely wronged, and he must have said it. The other party’s attitude was also very firm. He was busy and had no time, and unless his father came, he could wait until he was done with his work before talking about anything.
Zhao Jinchuan didn’t even dare to look at the emperor and the princes.
Emperor Jingwen was actually interested: “Qinglufang? What a nice name. What does it do?”
Zhao Jinchuan: “…”
Finally, under pressure, Zhao Jinchuan had to answer: “Your Majesty, it is a gambling house.”
Caught off guard, Emperor Jingwen was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Cancer
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Is this what you call erudite and well-behaved?” When Emperor Jingwen heard the prefect’s compliments just now, he was very happy, thinking that his son had made progress.
It turns out that they were all deliberately exaggerated.
“…Your Majesty, please forgive me!” Zhao Jinchuan had never expected that his virtuous brother would make such a big mistake at such a critical moment. He couldn’t help but wipe the sweat from his forehead.
“Apart from some minor flaws, he’s a pretty good person…”
Emperor Jingwen did not comment.
Zhao Jinchuan felt a sudden increase in pressure, so he looked at the yamen runner beside him and said, “The noble is here, why don’t you go and call him again!”
“Just say it’s the prefect’s order, go now!”
Zhao Jinchuan was so angry at this yamen runner that he almost died. How could this be a normal situation? If he didn’t come back, he would be tied back even if he had to be tied up!
Zhao Jinchuan winked at the yamen runner, indicating that he should bring more people this time.The yamen runner was about to take action when he heard Emperor Jingwen say, “Wait.”
Then Emperor Jingwen came down from his seat at the head of the table and said, “I will go with you.”
Four, Five, Seven, and Eight princes were shocked when they heard this. They also wanted to see what Xiao Jiu looked like now.
The fifth prince laughed the most happily.
“This…” Isn’t this bad?
Although Zhao Jinchuan didn’t dare to let the emperor and the prince enter such a smoky and foul place, he didn’t dare to refute it after all.
“Your Majesty, Your Highness, this way please.”
The other side.
Ye Shuo originally thought of leaving after losing the hundred or so taels of silver today, but he didn’t expect that he was so lucky today that up to now, not only has his capital not decreased, but his chips have been increasing. A rough estimate is that the pile of silver in front of him must add up to several thousand taels.
I don’t even know how many waves of people have just gone down.
Ye Shuo did a good job in preventing addiction. These wealthy merchants from Liangzhou City now only regarded Qinglufang as a den of money. It was a place for them to relax and have fun after returning from business trips or completing a big deal. Therefore, they did not bring much silver every time they came here. They did not expect Ye Shuo to come today. If they had known this, they would have brought more silver.
Qinglufang is Ye Shuo’s territory. Out of the principle of keeping things within the family, Ye Shuo comes here to play several times a month. This is one of Qinglufang’s ways of attracting customers. Over time, he naturally became familiar with this group of wealthy businessmen.
It’s quite strange to say that this Ninth Young Master is so young, but he has made such a big plate. The key is that most of them are still alive. Such means are really amazing.
The most important thing is that he is good at gambling and can basically do anything. No wonder he became the boss at such a young age.
Wu Weiyong initially felt sorry for the downfall of his fellow disciple, but as time went by, he actually became a frequent visitor to Qinglufang.
Seeing another person defeated, Wu Weiyong, who was well prepared, immediately took over.
“Junior brother, this is a gambling master specially invited by my senior brother, you’d better be careful.” After losing to Ye Shuo last time, Wu Weiyong felt uncomfortable no matter how he thought about it, tossing and turning, which led to today’s scene.
Ye Shuo was not afraid when he heard this: “Come on!”
Perhaps because Ye Shuo made the loudest noise, many people didn’t even care about playing and rushed over.
When Emperor Jingwen arrived, what he saw was his son sitting in front of the gambling table, rolling up his sleeves, standing on a stool and shouting.
Several princes, including the fourth, fifth, seventh and eighth, were also deeply shocked by this scene.
As princes, when have they ever been to such a dirty place? On the other hand, Xiaojiu is so skilled that he feels more comfortable than at home.
Ye Shuo replaced the poker in his hand with a dice cup and started shaking it almost at the same time as the other party.
The dice cups jingled and clanged, dazzling the onlookers. Seeing his son so excited, Emperor Jingwen’s face turned pale.
With a “dong” sound, the dice cups fell onto the table at the same time.
The bet between the two was simple, just comparing the size. Ye Shuo did not hesitate and was the first to unveil his dice cup.
“The five qi converge to the origin, I accept your approval.”
The moment the dice cup was opened, the five dice with six points on them looked like blooming flowers, making people dizzy.
Ye Shuo looked at the opposite side with a hint of amusement. If he had heard correctly, the opponent should also have five sixes, so this was a draw.
Obviously, the other party did not expect that the owner of Qinglufang was also a master. This time he had met his match.
It seems that some special means are needed.
Seeing that the two men wanted to start the next round after failing to win the first round, Emperor Jingwen could no longer sit still.
Zhao Jinchuan took a deep breath and hurried forward: “Gu Shao!”
Ye Shuo turned his head subconsciously, and then his eyes widened.
Why do those figures look so familiar? I’m afraid I’m just hallucinating because I rolled the dice too much.
He saw Emperor Jingwen standing there with a dark face, and the Fourth Prince, the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince, the four of them stood there like door gods, especially the Fourth Prince, who was looking at him with disapproval on his face.
Zhao Jinchuan was totally unaware and was still hinting with his eyes: “What are you still standing there for? Come over here quickly. The nobles want… Hmm? Why are you running? Stop right there!”
Without waiting for his adoptive father to speak, Ye Shuo flicked the dice cup in his hand and ran away.
Zhao Jinchuan was so frightened that he almost died.
Emperor Jingwen made a prompt decision: “Come here, capture him!”
Ye Shuo was almost about to push open the window and jump out, but when he was about to succeed, someone grabbed his foot at the last moment.
Turning around, it turned out to be the Fourth Prince.
“Fourth brother, please forgive me for once!”
Seeing the pleading in his brother’s eyes, the Fourth Prince shook his head firmly. The monk can run away but the temple cannot. The sooner he dies, the sooner he will be reborn.
Zhao Jinchuan had not expected that he would be so bold, and hurriedly advised: “Your Majesty, to be honest, this man is my sworn brother whom I just recognized a few days ago. He is not like this on weekdays. Please understand, Your Majesty!”
Zhao Jinchuan is quite loyal and would not just abandon Ye Shuo and run away if nothing goes wrong.
Although he is now ready to sacrifice his own relatives for the sake of justice.
There were many people in Qinglufang, and Zhao Jinchuan lowered his voice deliberately for fear of accidentally exposing Emperor Jingwen’s identity. However, the fifth, seventh, and eighth princes next to him still heard everything clearly.
…Xiaojiu actually recognized a brother randomly outside so easily.
Aren’t there enough brothers in the family?
The five, seven, and eight princes all moved at the same time.
At the side, seeing the chief leader being captured, Ye Shuo, who had hired two martial arts masters at a large price, subconsciously drew the sword at his waist.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo was immediately shocked: “No, no, no, we are on the same side, don’t do anything.”
Ye Shuo had no choice but to come before Emperor Jingwen and kneel down with a plop.
“father.”
The two martial arts masters were stunned. After they reacted, they put away their swords and bowed their heads to admit their mistake: “Old master.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen almost choked back the words that were about to come out of his throat.
As for Zhao Jinchuan standing aside, he finally couldn’t keep his calm expression anymore.
If Gu Shao is the prince, then wouldn’t I be…
“Who was the man who just gambled with you? Why did he seem to call you his junior brother?” How many relatives did the little bastard recognize in the outside world?
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo hurriedly explained, “That man’s name is Wu Weiyong, and he is the teacher’s student.”
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt pity for Taifu. He was afraid that the Taifu would never have thought that the bad student he taught was actually leading the good students astray.
“You even want to borrow the influence of the Grand Tutor. You are really something.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help shrinking his head: “The old man, the Grand Tutor, has many students all over the world. It would be a waste if we don’t use him. Isn’t this…”
Seeing so many people looking over here, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but take a deep breath and said, “Let’s talk outside.”
Emperor Jingwen did not want to be a monkey for people to see.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to follow. Before leaving, he signalled to the shopkeeper with his eyes to take back the money he won, otherwise it would be gone later.
After walking out of Qinglufang, Ye Shuo lowered his head obediently, ready to listen to the lecture.
Emperor Jingwen also thought that it would be quiet outside, but who knew that it would be even worse outside than inside.
“He’s a great boss.”
“The chief.”
“The group of people from Jiangcheng Sect are causing trouble in our area again. Chief, when do you think we can gather our brothers and fight back?”
In the past, Ye Shuo didn’t think there was anything wrong with these titles, but now that his cheap father and the others were here, Ye Shuo suddenly felt ashamed.
Of course, compared to him, Emperor Jingwen and the Fourth Prince would only be more embarrassed.
Xiaojiu is making a mess outside, what is he doing?
Seeing that the other party was completely unaware and was still urging him, Ye Shuo pulled the corner of his mouth and said, “For the time being… I guess I can’t go?”
The man was stunned: “Ah? Why?”
Ye Shuo pointed at Emperor Jingwen and said, “Well, my father is here.”
That’s indeed not good.
His face became serious and he quickly called out “Hello, old man”, and then several people left quickly.
Emperor Jingwen thought that the matter was about to end there, but who knew that something even more powerful was waiting for him.
When Ye Shuo saw Shopkeeper You and his men coming to inspect the shop downstairs, he instinctively felt something was wrong. However, before he could say anything, Shopkeeper You saw him and immediately came forward to greet him.
“Hey, isn’t this the Ninth Young Master?”
Shopkeeper You is now in his early thirties, still at the age of charm, with a rosy face and extremely beautiful appearance.
However, Emperor Jingwen on the side frowned subconsciously. For some reason, he always felt that there was something wrong with the way the other person looked at his son.
Soon, Emperor Jingwen’s premonition came true.
“Ninth young master, what do you think of what I told you last time?”
Because Ye Shuo had been to the Music Academy several times before, Manager You thought he was new. With such a stunning appearance, it was hard for Manager You not to be attracted.
Although the misunderstanding was later clarified, Manager You still couldn’t stop thinking about him.
Shopkeeper You dares to guarantee that this young man must be better than he imagined. Shopkeeper You does not ask for eternity, but a brief encounter with him would be good enough.
What Manager You was talking about was nothing else but a one-night stand.
Ye Shuo felt numb all over.
In the past, Zhao Jinchuan always teased him about these romantic affairs, but now it was too late to regret.
Emperor Jingwen was almost laughing out of anger: “Have you ever been to that kind of place?”
Hearing this voice, Shopkeeper You finally succeeded in noticing the strangers around Ye Shuo: “They are…”
Ye Shuo hurriedly said: “My father, my fourth brother, fifth brother, seventh brother, and eighth brother.”
Shopkeeper You immediately returned to his serious demeanour and said, “Since your father is here, I won’t bother you for now.”
Even Shopkeeper You felt embarrassed at this moment.
“Tell me, what else are you hiding from me?”
After Manager You left, it was not known whether Emperor Jingwen was furious or not, but he calmed down instead.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to bring his stepfather and the others to Ping’an Restaurant.
The fifth prince didn’t think anything of it at first, but when he went up to the second floor and saw the prices of the vegetables above, he couldn’t help but let out a strange cry.
“You’re asking forty taels for one fish, are you running a shady business?!”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Sorry, he runs a black shop.
And now the way Emperor Jingwen looks at him is no different from the way he looks at the cancer of society.

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Confiscated
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Even if the Fifth Prince was ignorant of the sufferings of the world, he knew that forty taels of silver for a fish was definitely not normal.
It was so blatant and arrogant, and it further proved that his involvement with the prefect was deeper than imagined.
Emperor Jingwen came this time to deal with the Crown Prince’s affairs, but unexpectedly, he caught Xiaojiu first.
Emperor Jingwen looked at his son and for a moment he didn’t know whether he should continue the investigation.
Ye Shuo suddenly remembered something and quickly changed the subject: “By the way, Dad, Brother Four, Brother Five, Brother Seven, Brother Eight, why are you here? Why didn’t you let someone know in advance?”
If he sent someone to notify them in advance, he would never let his stepfather and the others see that kind of scene.
“Isn’t it because of you?” The fifth prince said unhappily, “You haven’t been back to the capital for two years. Father is worried about you, so he wanted to stop by and see you during his southern tour.”
Ye Shuo’s first reaction when he heard this was, bullshit!
This was pure nonsense. No matter what his cheap father did, he would never go so far just to see him.Ye Shuo subconsciously wanted to refute, but then he changed his mind and thought, why should he refute? Since they said so, then so be it. It would not do him any good to expose them.
“real?!”
Seeing his brother first startled, and then with a mixture of excitement, disbelief and shock in his eyes, the Fifth Prince choked.
Wait, did he really believe it?
I was just saying it casually.
“Fourth brother, fifth brother, seventh brother, eighth brother, I thought you were still angry with me…”
“Also, Dad, I haven’t seen you for more than two years, how come you have white hair?” Ye Shuo actually noticed this from the beginning. Compared to two years ago, his stepfather’s condition was obviously not as good as before.
Although his majesty has increased with age, the traces of time on his face cannot be concealed no matter how hard he takes care of himself.
I guess the fighting in the palace is more intense than I imagined.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help feeling sad.
During the two years that Xiaojiu was away, he became more and more unruly.
The moment the words fell, the Fifth Prince and the others were horrified.
You know, as an emperor, the most taboo thing is for others to say he is old.
The same was true for Emperor Jingwen. His sons were in their prime, but he was ageing day by day, like the setting sun. Whenever Emperor Jingwen looked in the mirror, he would feel powerless and angry.
When Emperor Jingwen heard this, his first reaction was anger. His expression suddenly became a little bad. But just as he was about to speak, he saw the undisguised concern in Ye Shuo’s eyes.
“Dad, how are you feeling lately?”
No matter who they are, including his closest friend Wang Ziquan, they are all very secretive about his ageing and dare not mention it at all. Whenever they mention it, these people will try every possible means to praise his youth and say that he is more energetic than before.
But old is old, that is the fate of man, even if you are the emperor you can do nothing about it.
Emperor Jingwen was a little uncomfortable with the sudden appearance of someone who spoke the truth.
After a while, Emperor Jingwen said, “It is a little older than before.”
“Then Father, please be less angry and less prone to rage. Being angry can easily harm your health.”
Looking at the father and son arguing with each other, Zhao Jinchuan’s eyes almost popped out.
It turns out that there is such a scene in royal family.
Zhao Jinchuan quickly lowered his head and drank tea to hide his shock.
But his sudden change was still seen by the Fourth Prince and the others, and they all said in their hearts at the same time, “No, they are not like this normally.”
At the very least, they would not dare to mention the fact that their father has white hair even if they were beaten to death.
It was getting dark, and Emperor Jingwen and his entourage were originally going to have dinner in this restaurant, but Ye Shuo didn’t dare to do that. Judging from the chef’s cooking skills in this Ping’an Restaurant, he could only say that the food would not starve him to death. If his cheap father ate this kind of food, he would probably be killed on the spot by the guards.
“This is my house in Liangzhou. Although it can’t compare to the one you gave me, it’s still good enough.”
About half an hour later, Ye Shuo brought them to his current residence.
The old house that was abandoned two years ago has now been renovated into a new one. As Ye Shuo’s wallet has gradually become fatter, he has expanded the house several times and the area of ​​the house has been expanded again and again.
The so-called richest man in Liangzhou is not just talk.
Looking around, the Fourth Prince and the others seriously doubted whether his words “not as good as going to the capital” were just modesty.
It can be seen with the naked eye that this house is larger than the Ninth Prince’s Mansion in the capital.
Emperor Jingwen wanted him to quit Qinglufang at first. After all, it would be embarrassing for a prince to run a casino. It would be embarrassing for the old ministers and the noble families to know about it.
But after arriving at the house, Emperor Jingwen suddenly hesitated.
This casino seems to be more profitable than I thought.
“Do you have an account book? Bring it here for me to see.”
Hearing this, Ye Shuo subconsciously became alert. What a familiar tone. It was so similar to the tone his friends’ parents used when they were giving out New Year’s money when they were children in his previous life.
Emperor Jingwen noticed the vigilance in his son’s eyes and was both angry and amused: “What’s with that expression? Can I still covet your little money?”
Finished, more like it.
However, the emperor’s order was hard to disobey, and Ye Shuo had no choice but to ask the accountant in the mansion to fetch the account book of Qinglufang.
Emperor Jingwen sat there and flipped through the book. Then he couldn’t help but be a little surprised: “So many?”
Coming, coming, coming.
The next moment, Emperor Jingwen said, “What about the others? Bring them up as well.”
“…It’s okay for me to show it to you.” Ye Shuo tried to struggle desperately: “But Dad, you have to promise not to covet your son’s money.”
Emperor Jingwen said nothing, but just looked at him with a smile.
What happened to your promise not to be greedy for money? ! How can you, my cheap father, go back on his word! Ye Shuo gave the order with a sad face.
After reading it, Emperor Jingwen was very satisfied.
Think about the daily turnover of a modern casino, and then think about the backward productivity in ancient times. It is no wonder that even the emperor would be tempted and would sacrifice his face to snatch his son’s things.
“Okay, the treasury is short of money, so I’ll keep these account books with you for now.”
No way? It’s so dark?!
Ye Shuo initially thought that his cheap father would only take 40% to 50% of it, but he didn’t expect that he would not leave any for himself.
“Dad! You can’t do this!” When Ye Shuo thought about how so many things no longer belonged to him, he couldn’t hold back his grief and anger, and cried loudly while hugging Emperor Jingwen’s legs.
“You are the emperor. How can you take your son’s things? Wouldn’t that damage your image as a wise emperor?”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t buy his words at all: “Since you are my son, everything you have should belong to me.”
It turns out that parents in feudal society are unreasonable.
Patriarchy and imperial power oppress people!
Ye Shuo cried even more sadly.
Although in most cases he didn’t need to do it himself, and he spent a lot of money to have others do it for him, it was still his hard work after all, two whole years! Who wouldn’t cry!
Seeing that he was throwing tantrums like he did when he was a child when they disagreed, Emperor Jingwen almost laughed out loud: “Why are you crying? I didn’t take it for nothing.”
The little bastard is almost twenty years old now, and according to the rules, it is time for him to be promoted to a higher title.
First the prince of a county and then the prince, if he wants to be crowned the prince, there must be a reason, something to show for it, right? Otherwise, his brothers would be unhappy.
What’s more, in the current situation, it’s better for the little bastard not to have any extra things in his hands, so as not to attract people’s attention. He doesn’t have the ability to protect them, so he won’t get into trouble later.
When Ye Shuo heard this, he asked, “Then what are you going to exchange for?”
Since the things are about to be lost, it would be nice to get some compensation.
Emperor Jingwen paused and said, “How about a prince’s position?”
Two years of hard work in exchange for a prince title, it’s a huge profit!
Ye Shuo was immediately fine.
“Dad, you are so kind. I know that you love your son the most.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen felt that the little bastard changed his expression faster than turning the pages of a book, and he didn’t even try to hide it.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know what to say about him.
Then, Ye Shuo asked a question that made Emperor Jingwen’s smile freeze instantly.
“By the way, where is my third brother? Didn’t my fourth brother and the others just say that he was here too? Why can’t I see him?”
Anyone who has a little knowledge of the court’s developments would not ask this question. The fact that he asked this question proves that he really knows nothing about it.
Seeing that the confusion in his youngest son’s eyes did not seem fake, Emperor Jingwen’s anger only lasted for a moment. Then he sighed, feeling worried about the little bastard’s frankness and stupidity.
