It would be fine if he were like this to his biological father, but with his temper, he would suffer a great loss sooner or later if his brother took the throne in the future.
Emperor Jingwen did not say it directly, but only vaguely said: “When your third brother was in Bingzhou, I let him get off the ship in advance.”
Ye Shuo always felt that his cheap father’s expression seemed a little stiff when he mentioned the crown prince. There must be something fishy going on, so he asked, “Then did you tell my third brother the specific reason for not bringing him along?”
Ye Shuo didn’t know what happened between them, but his idea was very simple. From the child’s point of view, the father took a group of children out to play, but left one of them alone. How could the one who was left alone not think too much?
Emperor Jingwen did not care. Even if he was the crown prince, it was impossible for him to explain everything clearly.
Seeing that his youngest son kept harping on such trivial matters, Emperor Jingwen became a little annoyed after a long time.
“Since you care so much about your third brother, why don’t you go to Bingzhou to accompany him!”
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help feeling angry because he had taken so much trouble to help him plan, but his mind was completely on his brother. Even Xiaojiu went against him.
hiss…
My cheap dad himself was angry.
After not seeing my stepfather for two years, his temper has become even weirder.
Ye Shuo hurriedly said: “I am not speaking for Third Brother, I am speaking for you, right?”
Emperor Jingwen sneered at him, wondering what nonsense he could come up with.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo was very helpless: “The son that Dad values ​​most is Third Brother. Dad, you don’t think your son can’t see it, right? Since you value him so much, how can your son bear to see you sad?”
“If it can be avoided, why not avoid it?”
“If you really feel embarrassed and can’t save your face, then let your son convey your message.”
“Someone, bring paper and pen!”
Without giving Emperor Jingwen any chance to refute, Ye Shuo had already spread out the paper and held the pen in his hand.
Then Ye Shuo raised his head and said seriously, “Okay, Dad, start talking.”

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Tampering
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo’s movements were smooth and flowing, and when Emperor Jingwen reacted, he only saw his son’s eyes full of expectation.
However, Emperor Jingwen’s attitude was very firm. He would not say it.
Ye Shuo didn’t mind: “If you don’t want to say it, then I’ll say it for you.”
After saying this, Ye Shuo wrote the first line of words.
“I wish to inherit your throne…”
When he heard the first few words, the veins on Emperor Jingwen’s head began to throb wildly.
Ye Shuo seemed not to notice and continued: “I haven’t seen you for a few days. I miss you so much.”
“…Stop!” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t bear it any longer and gritted his teeth to call for a stop.
“What the hell did you write?!”“A family letter, isn’t that how a family letter should be written?” Ye Shuo said as if it was a matter of course.
Who writes a letter like this? The words used are so artificial and… disgusting.
Emperor Jingwen’s face turned green, as if he had eaten something indigestible.
Seeing that he was about to continue, Emperor Jingwen made a prompt decision: “Give me the pen.”
Ye Shuo looked embarrassed: “Ah? Dad, this is not good, right?”
Emperor Jingwen stood up and said, “Bring it here!”
When Emperor Jingwen sat there instead of Ye Shuo, he realised that the paper was empty and there was clearly nothing written on it.
Looking at the mockery in his youngest son’s eyes, what else could Emperor Jingwen not understand?
Ye Shuo took a piece of dessert and put it in his mouth, he said slowly: “Since you care, why don’t you say it clearly?” Guessing all the time will only hurt others and yourself.
Emperor Jingwen tightened his grip on the brush, his face was serious and looked exceptionally handsome.
People who care about their reputation are generally like this, which shows that being too shameful is not a good thing.
Seeing that he was about to get angry again, Ye Shuo didn’t dare to provoke him again and quickly stepped aside.
“You keep busy, keep busy. I suddenly remembered that I have something else to do. I’m leaving now. See you tomorrow, Dad!”
After saying this, Ye Shuo immediately ran away.
As an emperor, Emperor Jingwen would never bow his head first. The crown prince could not guess what he was thinking, so he was naturally anxious.
But in fact, the difference between father and son is just a step. The problem is that no one is willing to give them this step.
Everyone knows it, but no one wants to.
After a whole stick of incense had passed, Emperor Jingwen finally made his first move.
“I wish to inherit your throne…”
“…I have a lot of thoughts about the trip to Liangzhou. I will personally remove all the officials in the southern bureaucracy. After this incident, I hope my son will think carefully in the future and not believe in the slander of villains. People with high status can be feared but not relied upon. Those who can be feared should be upright and behave themselves. If you fail to follow the teachings of the past, your crime will be greater than that of others. As the crown prince, you must be even more cautious. You should remember this lesson and never make the same mistake again.”
After half an hour, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath, put down the pen, waited for the ink to dry, put it in an envelope, and handed it to the person next to him.
“Go and deliver this letter to Bingzhou and give it to His Royal Highness the Crown Prince.”
The man was startled at first, then said, “Yes!”
I just hope that the crown prince can listen to me.
Looking at the sky that had already turned dark, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but sigh.
At night, before going to bed, Ye Shuo heard the sound of horse hooves and immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
It’s better to talk about it out loud. Only by talking about it out loud can the problem be solved fundamentally. Otherwise, it will just be scratching the surface.
In a blink of an eye, a few more days passed.
Ever since the people of Liangzhou City knew that they were the Ninth Prince’s brothers, the attention paid to the fourth, fifth, seventh and eighth princes when they were active in the city suddenly increased greatly. At the same time, they also saw how comfortable their younger brothers’ lives were outside.
No wonder he was so unwilling to go back, he is really cool.
In Liangzhou City, the prefect was his sworn brother, the people in the underworld recognized him as their leader, the businessmen and wealthy people greeted him with smiles, and even the women who came and went frequently flirted with him.
There’s no way, not only men like women, women in the world also like men. Although they cannot express their preferences openly due to etiquette, the frequent glances back cannot deceive people.
I don’t want to take this kind of beauty home, but it would be nice to be able to take a few more glances at her on the street.
It wasn’t so obvious in the past when they were in Shangjing. The noble ladies in Shangjing City, firstly, seldom went out, and secondly, they knew clearly his identity. They thought that marrying a prince who only doted on them but had no ability would not be of any benefit to the family.
However, despite this, many people were still tempted. After all, even though the Ninth Prince was notoriously arrogant and debauched, just looking at his face would make people feel much better even if they just put it at home.
Unfortunately, before the noble ladies had a chance to act, Ye Shuo was summoned back to the palace by the emperor, and then he disappeared. It was really a pity.
The fourth, fifth, seventh, and eighth princes only heard about this after Ye Shuo left. For a whole month after Ye Shuo left, he was the only topic of conversation in the capital. Upon inquiry, they found that most of the information was spread by women. Then the fourth, fifth, seventh, and eighth princes realised that their ninth brother was so popular.
Then the Fourth Prince couldn’t help but start worrying about his marriage.
“If I remember correctly, you will be twenty soon, right? How come you haven’t met the girl you like yet?”
“…Oops.” Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo was stunned and slammed the fan in his hand.
“I had forgotten about it.”
Ye Shuo had lived such a comfortable life in the past two years that he completely forgot to pay attention to other things.
Seeing this, the fifth prince couldn’t help but say something sarcastic: “Be careful, father will just point someone to you when the time comes.”
Ye Shuo paused: “No, not really…”
Although he said this, Ye Shuo was unsure in his heart. Let alone, this could really be possible.
Sometimes, the more you fear something, the more likely it is to happen.
After several days of investigation, Emperor Jingwen finally breathed a sigh of relief after carefully browsing through the things presented by his subordinates.
Although his son was indeed involved with the prefect of Liangzhou, it was not what he thought.
Most of the money his son earned was invested in the construction of Liangzhou. He used the construction of Liangzhou to drive his business. The two circulated and complemented each other, so he naturally made a fortune.
Emperor Jingwen was unable to judge for a moment whether his son was capable or simply good at spending money, because his son did not do much by himself. He basically spent huge sums of money and then asked others to do the work.
Such extravagance made Emperor Jingwen feel ashamed of himself.
An idea like the Ping An Hotel is not something a normal person can come up with. It is extremely dangerous. It only proves that he is brave and lucky, but nothing else.
The only contribution he made was the cement used to pave the roads in Liangzhou City, which he made himself.
The little bastard has loved playing in the mud since he was a child, and now he has really become famous for it.
Emperor Jingwen wanted to praise him, but the problem was that various gambling methods and rules in his Qinglufang were emerging one after another. Qinglufang would launch a new gambling method every once in a while, such as mahjong and poker. Emperor Jingwen had checked and found that they were also invented by him. Compared with them, cement was nothing.
The little bastard is not stupid, on the contrary he is very smart, but he doesn’t use his intelligence in the right way.
In addition, when they went to Qinglufang to capture him before, Ye Shuo left such a deep impression on Emperor Jingwen that Emperor Jingwen really couldn’t believe that he really had any great abilities.
He often goes in and out of gambling houses, and occasionally goes to the music school to hang out with the girls there. He goes hunting, fishing and flower viewing every three to five days. Xiaojiu is still the same Xiaojiu.
These things that were investigated cannot be called secrets. They can be completely regarded as the little bastard’s daily leisurely life. Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel relieved while sighing.
Similarly, Emperor Jingwen also discovered a problem. Until now, his son had not become smart. Although he would occasionally go to the music school, he had never asked the women there to serve him. Usually, except for Xiao Luzi, he was surrounded by burly men.
In other words, his son still hadn’t lost his virginity until now, which made Emperor Jingwen wonder if there was something wrong with him.
This discovery made Emperor Jingwen extremely worried.
This kind of thing would be inconvenient even for a biological mother to ask, as it concerned the offspring of his youngest son. Emperor Jingwen hesitated for a long time, and finally, suppressing his embarrassment, summoned Xiao Luzi and asked him a few questions.
But Xiao Luzi’s answer made Emperor Jingwen feel even more depressed.
Even Xiao Luzi said that there has never been a woman around him, which proves that there really has never been a woman around him.
Emperor Jingwen put his son’s marriage on the agenda without hesitation. Even he began to get anxious.
The first person Emperor Jingwen visited was Zhao Jinchuan.
The prefect is also an important official. Under normal circumstances, his status would not be worthy of that of a prince, but in the current situation, it is just right.
When Zhao Jinchuan heard the emperor asking him if he had any unmarried daughters at home, he was stunned. Obviously, he also understood that there must be a deep meaning behind the emperor’s question. In addition, the ninth prince had not yet married, so the answer was very clear.
But unfortunately, it is a little late to bring up this matter now.
After a fierce struggle in his heart, Zhao Jinchuan finally shook his head helplessly: “I do have a daughter, who is now eighteen years old, but… my daughter is already engaged and will be married on the eighth day of the tenth month this autumn.”
You can’t break off the engagement at this critical moment, right? That would be too embarrassing.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to give up.
There is no suitable one on Zhao Jinchuan’s side. There is no one in Liangzhou City who is of sufficient status to be a match for the prince.
We can’t really let Xiaojiu marry the daughter of a merchant, what a disgrace that would be!
Ye Shuo was extremely delighted to hear the news.
Ye Shuo thought that the matter was over, so when Emperor Jingwen decided to set off, he followed him.
“What are you doing here?” Emperor Jingwen frowned.
Ye Shuo was stunned: “Why can’t I come?”
Isn’t it about the Southern Tour? In Ye Shuo’s eyes, Southern Tour = Inspection = Travel, and he also wanted to see what the ancient emperors’ Southern Tour looked like.
“Dad, you have confiscated all my shops. What am I still doing staying in Liangzhou City?” It would be too cruel for him to watch the change of ownership of Qinglufang with his own eyes.
“you–“
Before Emperor Jingwen could finish his words, Ye Shuo squeezed forward.
Normally he wouldn’t come when he was called, but now he came even when he was not called. Emperor Jingwen felt a headache looking at his little son who was always so rebellious.
But since he was already on the boat, Emperor Jingwen would not chase him off, but only reminded him: “You can follow along, but remember not to cause trouble.”
What does “making trouble” mean? When has he ever failed to keep his promise?
And what’s with the cheap dad’s coaxing tone?
Although he was complaining in his heart, Ye Shuo nodded hurriedly.
Looking at their naive younger brother, several princes couldn’t help but shake their heads.
At the same time, on the other side, Emperor Jingwen’s letter finally arrived in Bingzhou after many twists and turns.
When the prince heard the news outside, he was startled and subconsciously took the letter.
Then, the inky black words above came into view——
“I have given a lot of thought to the Liangzhou trip. I will personally remove all the officials in the southern bureaucracy one by one. As the crown prince, you have violated the teachings of your ancestors, and your crime is greater than that of others. I hope you will think carefully.”
‘As the crown prince, you have violated the teachings of your ancestors, and your crime is greater than that of others.’
If he wasn’t extremely disappointed, my father would not have used such words. And the purpose of my father’s trip was indeed me.
If the crown prince still had a glimmer of hope before, now he can no longer deceive himself.
After repeatedly confirming that it was undoubtedly Emperor Jingwen’s handwriting, the prince’s face turned pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Ambush
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Your Highness…”
Mo Shu, who was standing by, was horrified upon seeing this and subconsciously looked at his master.
At this moment, the crown prince was already in a state of confusion. It took him a long while to find his voice again.
The other side.
Two days later, Ye Shuo gradually realised that he was on a pirate ship.
Although he vaguely felt that his stepfather’s trip to the South was definitely not to see him as he said, and he must have other things to do, Ye Shuo did not expect that this matter would be so complicated.
It didn’t seem like an ordinary patrol at all. It seemed more like they had a target in mind and that’s why they came here on purpose.
As the group walked further away, the atmosphere on the ship became more and more solemn.
Except for Ye Shuo, no one dared to say anything. Ye Shuo was almost suffocating himself.While the ship was docked, people were coming and going in my cheap father’s room. None of them were people Ye Shuo recognized. Some of them were wearing official robes, some were wearing white clothes, and some were wearing… that should be the clothes of military commanders, right?
The crowds were coming and going, and Ye Shuo was dazzled.
As if he had noticed his brother’s confusion, the Fourth Prince happened to be free, so he stood aside and explained casually: “That’s the governor of Shanzhou, the one dressed as a military commander is the garrison commander of Shanzhou, and that…that…”
“Stop, stop, stop.” Ye Shuo couldn’t stand it after listening for a while, “Why are there so many people? There are too many people.”
“That’s just the beginning.” The Fourth Prince laughed. As a prince, he should remember some important people clearly.
“Ninth brother, you have to learn.”
Ye Shuo didn’t care. Why would he learn this? He didn’t plan to work in officialdom.
Ye Shuo just didn’t understand what his cheap father was going to investigate. Why was he going through so much trouble?
Ye Shuo was confused, but he couldn’t quite figure out the direction. After thinking it over, he finally took advantage of no one’s attention and pulled the least trouble-making and most low-key Seventh Prince into a corner.
“Can you tell me what exactly did Father come here for?”
The more Ye Shuo looked, the more uneasy he felt. He had a vague feeling that something big was about to happen.
Being caught off guard by Ye Shuo’s arm, the Seventh Prince was silent as he looked at his brother’s face so close to him. He said, “Didn’t I say before that I would visit you in Liangzhou while on my southern tour?”
Ye Shuo: “…”
“Forget it, just pretend I didn’t ask.”
Ye Shuo turned around and was about to leave, but the next moment, he heard the Seventh Prince add another sentence behind him.
“Of course, that’s what it looks like on the surface. That’s what Father told us at the time.”
Ye Shuo paused, then turned around and saw the Seventh Prince silently mouthing words to him. To prevent the guards around from overhearing, he didn’t even make a sound in the middle –
‘Crown Prince’.
When Ye Shuo saw these two words, his heart immediately tightened.
Although he guessed that the palace would not be as peaceful as before in the next two years, he did not expect that things would have come to this point.
Having come to this point, Ye Shuo did not ask any further questions.
From now on, it is no longer something he can interfere with.
Not long after Ye Shuo asked this question, the first official, the prefect of Shengzhou, was dismissed.
Emperor Jingwen acted drastically and executed him on the spot after obtaining the evidence.
Ye Shuo did not go to see the governor of Shengzhou on the day he was being questioned. About half a day later, Ye Shuo heard the news of the governor’s death.
Then, when my cheap dad walked in, he could not hide the smell of blood.
Although Emperor Jingwen is no longer young, he has not lost his ambition at all. He killed all the people without blinking an eye.
The Fourth Prince, the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince followed Emperor Jingwen respectfully. Only Ye Shuo seemed so out of place at this moment.
When he saw those people, Ye Shuo suddenly thought of something.
The Fourth Prince knew all about the people summoned by his step-father before. Perhaps he had an idea of ​​it in his mind from the beginning.
There were also the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince. Even the most arrogant Fifth Prince was not the least bit surprised when they saw what was happening before their eyes, nor did they have any questions at all. They were totally unlike Ye Shuo, who asked questions everywhere.
Everyone knew that this southern tour was fake and that the purpose of investigating the crown prince was real, and everyone was cooperating silently.
This made Ye Shuo wonder whether they were the same in the court.
Everyone is looking forward to and pushing the crown prince step by step towards the abyss.
Among them is not only the eldest prince, but also the second prince, the fifth prince, the sixth prince, the seventh prince, the eighth prince, and even the fourth prince who seems the most indifferent may not be without that idea.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have made such thorough preparations in advance.
Ye Shuo had said before that the crown prince was like a piece of delicious fat meat, and the others were jackals. When these jackals grew up, once the fat meat fell to the ground, it would be torn into pieces in an instant.
After figuring out the key, Ye Shuo realized that this time the prince must be dug out completely.
What we see now is just the beginning.
Just as Ye Shuo thought, as the ship went downstream, the number of officials being punished continued to increase.
There are about two days left in the voyage and the ship will arrive at Yeling.
That night, for some reason, Ye Shuo tossed and turned, feeling a little uneasy.
He didn’t have any seasickness problem, so it had nothing to do with seasickness. Unable to sleep, Ye Shuo put on a coat and went outside.
At that time, the silver moon was like a hook, the river was sparkling, and both banks were pitch black. Only the sound of cicadas was extremely noisy.
When Ye Shuo walked to the bow of the boat, he discovered that his cheap father couldn’t sleep either and was also outside getting some fresh air.
Ye Shuo tiptoed up behind his cheap father and quickly covered his eyes with lightning speed.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen’s thoughts were instantly disrupted.
The next moment, he heard the person behind him speak in a rough voice: “Guess who I am.”
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said, “Xiaojiu, if you don’t let me go, don’t blame me for being rude!”
Who else could it be? Did he think his brothers were as boring as him? Others didn’t have the guts to do that.
There is no one else in the world who can do such a thing.
“Tsk, Dad, this is boring.” Ye Shuo didn’t want to do it either. The main reason was that when he saw someone with their back to him, he couldn’t help it and his hands became particularly itchy. It might be a problem brought by the modern times and he couldn’t get rid of it after all this time.
As he said that, Ye Shuo sat down on the deck, and the word “dirty” that Emperor Jingwen said was stuck in his throat.
It was hot and humid in the summer, even though there was water all around. Ye Shuo waved the folding fan in his hand and said, “Dad, why aren’t you sleeping so late?”
“Didn’t you sleep either?” Emperor Jingwen asked the guards to move a chair and then had someone wipe it clean carefully before he sat down.
One has noble manners, and the other is a playboy. The contrast between the father and son is too obvious.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t stand it any longer, so he scolded, “You don’t stand properly, you don’t sit properly, look at you, you don’t look like a prince at all.”
Ye Shuo didn’t ask him what was bothering him, because the anger had already burned on him.
Ye Shuo stood up reluctantly. Just as he was about to say something, he accidentally saw an iron hook flying straight towards his cheap father.
“Be careful!” Ye Shuo subconsciously stepped forward and pulled his stepfather aside.
Then came the sound of breaking air.
Although the hook missed this time, it still managed to hook onto the edge of the ship.
The guards beside him swung their swords and hastily cut it off. However, even though one was cut off, the next one flew over.
Immediately afterwards, iron hooks came like raindrops, almost covering the entire edge of the boat.
Then, countless black shadows flew out from the water, holding hidden weapons, aiming directly at Emperor Jingwen!

chapters.title: Chapter 173: Assassination
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Protect the Emperor!!”
With a roar, almost all the guards rushed over.
Then came the fourth, fifth, seventh and eighth princes.
Ye Shuo closed the folding fan in his hand and was about to move when he saw Emperor Jingwen subconsciously pulling him behind him.
“Don’t make trouble.”
Although so many years have passed, perhaps because he is too out of touch, Emperor Jingwen still habitually treats him as a child.
Ye Shuo: “…”
While Ye Shuo was stunned, the fourth, fifth, seventh and eighth princes had already arrived in front of them. What’s worse, the seventh and eighth princes had not even put on their clothes yet, but they rushed out immediately when they heard the noise.
Several princes held swords in one hand and escorted Emperor Jingwen to a safe place together with the guards.Almost at the same time as the first wave of attack occurred, a dozen secret guards emerged from an unknown corner.
Ye Shuo glanced at the ground and saw that the dart-type hidden weapon had left a slightly whitish mark on the deck because it was soaked in water.
After Ye Shuo realised what was happening, he quickly said, “Be careful, the hidden weapon is poisonous!”
Upon hearing this, a dozen or so secret guards frowned and became more brutal in their actions. They did not care about leaving any survivors and killed them on the spot.
Ye Shuo made a special observation and found that Master Wu Yi was not there. He guessed that his adoptive father had left him in Beijing to monitor the movements of all parties.
When the emperor left the capital, the capital city without the emperor naturally attracted more attention than the place where the emperor was.
Ye Shuo’s heart sank.
Although the ships built for the emperor’s southern tour were of considerable size, inland river transportation was not as good as sea transportation. Limited by the river channel, no matter how big they were, they could not be much bigger. Even if the guards and secret guards tried their best to stop them, there would still be some fish that slipped through the net and rushed here on the narrow and long deck.
Fortunately, the few ships leading the way in front and the escorting ships in the back have noticed something is wrong and are hoisting sails and rushing over here.
Seeing this, several princes also followed suit.
Although it has been said before that there are few princes with great martial arts skills, that is only relative. If they are picked out alone, they are still capable of fighting.
Emperor Jingwen and Ye Shuo were protected by the crowd in the centre. Emperor Jingwen had a gloomy face and didn’t seem to be very worried.
That’s right, it’s impossible for my cheap dad to come here rashly without any preparation.
I just don’t know who sent these people, and who has such courage!
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, he saw from his peripheral vision that the assassin who was fighting with the Fourth Prince was using a dagger to block the Fourth Prince’s attack while reaching his other hand to his waist.
Ye Shuo didn’t even think about it. He turned his wrist and a nail flew out from his sleeve.
During these two years outside, Ye Shuo has grown a lot and basically carries small gadgets like hidden weapons with him.
This flying nail was none other than the one used by the secret guards in the palace. Ye Shuo had seen it before at his cheap master’s place, and after he came out, he specially ordered someone to make an identical one, without any difference at all. In such a chaotic situation, everyone thought it was the secret guards who did it, and even the throwing technique was exactly the same.
A flower of blood exploded from the assassin’s wrist almost instantly, and the Fourth Prince took the opportunity to kill him with a sword.
At first Ye Shuo thought that with these dozen secret guards, although their abilities were not as good as Master Wu Yi’s, they were specially trained after all, and they would surely be able to quell the turmoil soon.
However, what Ye Shuo did not expect was that after just one stick of incense had passed, the number of assassins not only did not decrease, but increased instead.
Looking at the escort ships in front and behind, the sails of the ships were set on fire at some point, and the raging fire illuminated half of the sky.
The timing chosen by the other party was very clever. The river where they were located was much narrower than before. The escort ships on both sides could not sail side by side and could only follow in front or behind. In this way, the distance was immediately widened a lot, and rescue could not be so timely.
Ye Shuo was almost certain that the other party had planned this in advance and had been lying in ambush here early in the morning.
These assassins are wearing diving suits made of fish skin and shark skin. There are so many of them that ordinary people cannot afford to do so.
Diving suits made of fish skin and shark skin are simply a great help to people who can swim. No wonder the other party was so close but no one noticed.
So who is it?
After about a quarter and a half hours, more than half of the dozen secret guards were dead, and the group of assassins were not much better off. They were covered in blood, and their shark skin had long since become tattered.
Seeing that victory was imminent, they unexpectedly found that before their reinforcements arrived, the enemy’s reinforcements arrived first.
There were more people in the second wave than in the first wave, and they were even more crowded. They were also covered in shark skin, but the quality was even better.
In less than three rounds, one of the secret guards was defeated and killed by the opponent with one blow.
The leader of the first wave of assassins was stunned at first, then he thought of something and started to cooperate with the other side.
Blood spurted out like a fountain, splashing less than two metres away from Ye Shuo. At this moment, Ye Shuo’s eyes were also a little red.
Emperor Jingwen felt a little depressed, and without waiting for the guard next to him to speak, he took the initiative to draw the sword of the dead guard.
Ye Shuo had used up all the flying nails he carried with him just now. Since no one’s attention was on him, Ye Shuo quickly flicked his hand over the assassin’s body, and a large wave of flying nails came in.
Emperor Jingwen and the Fourth Prince retreated step by step and did not notice that the people hiding in the dark and planning a sneak attack fell one after another.
Between life and death, Ye Shuo no longer cared to hold back. His targets had long been the opponent’s wrists, legs, temples, throat, heart and other fatal parts.
Ye Shuo was not very good at using a sword, and had hardly ever used it. After all, neither his cheap master nor his grandfather taught him. His swordsmanship was far inferior to that of hidden weapons. It was enough for normal times, but now the number of opponents was too large. No matter how fast the hidden weapons were, they could only deal with a part of them.
One of the assassins quietly went around to the back, and before he could make a move, a flying nail shot into his eye.
The assassin screamed and was immediately killed by Emperor Jingwen, who was with Ye Shuo.
Unfortunately, the eyesight of Emperor Jingwen, who was in his fifties, was no longer as good as it used to be.
The old man refused to tell anyone about his presbyopia and pretended to be serious every day, but he was eventually exposed by accident.
“Don’t be distracted at a time like this.” Emperor Jingwen knew that his son was incapable of killing anyone.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Emperor Jingwen was not young after all, and he had to take care of a son, so he gradually felt a little overwhelmed.
While Emperor Jingwen was fighting with one of the assassins, the other assassin was already ready to strike.
Ye Shuo had just rescued one of the guards when he turned around and saw that the assassin had come behind his cheap father.
As for Ye Shuo, you can ask him to help, but you can’t ask him to risk his life to help.
Unless the other party fights for him first.
Either it’s his mother, his father, or his closest relatives, otherwise forget it.
Call him a cheap dad. He doted on him before, but this doting was mixed with too many other things. Ye Shuo himself was unwilling, but who told him to protect himself just now?
Ye Shuo subconsciously touched his sleeve, only to find that the flying nails had been used up long ago.
If the opponent’s palm hits him firmly, my cheap dad may not survive…
In a flash, Ye Shuo pushed his cheap father away, and when he wanted to retreat, it was too late.
The other party’s palm finally hit him.
Emperor Jingwen staggered, and then he saw his son spit out a large mouthful of blood with a “wow” sound.
Emperor Jingwen’s pupils suddenly shrank, and the hand holding the sword trembled.
…damn!
Who is this guy? So powerful?!
Ye Shuo thought that he had been practising martial arts for nearly 18 years, but it was still a virgin martial art. It shouldn’t be so weak, right?
Ye Shuo thought that he could block it, but he didn’t expect that he couldn’t. For a moment, Ye Shuo seriously doubted whether his grandfather was lying when he said that he could walk alone and was not afraid of ordinary people.
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that the person opposite him was even more frightened than he was.
How come he is not dead? Could it be that his skills have regressed?
The palm strike just now actually made him feel as if he had slapped the man in black that he had met before.
Then, the assassin felt a pain in his lower body, and within two breaths, he was completely silent.
“Dad, I told you, this trick of mine works… cough cough cough…”
However, at this moment, Emperor Jingwen had no time to care about what moves he had just used, and hurried over to check on him: “Shuo’er, Shuo’er, are you okay?”
Ye Shuo wanted to say that he was fine, but he couldn’t stop coughing as soon as he opened his mouth, and all he coughed out was blood foam.
“Dad, you say…. I’m not going to die, right?”
Feeling severe pain in his chest and blacking out in front of his eyes, Ye Shuo was completely panicked.
It’s over, it’s over. My internal organs must be broken.
When Emperor Jingwen heard him say this, tears were about to fall from his eyes, and his voice was a little choked: “No, you won’t die, believe me, I won’t let you die!”
At the same time, on the other side, seeing their leader fall, the other assassins immediately lost their composure.
Seeing that the emperor’s reinforcements were about to arrive, one of them gritted his teeth and shouted, “Burn the boat! Burn the boat quickly!”
No matter what, Emperor Jingwen must die here today!
All the cooking oil and wine in the cabin were smashed, and soon the smell of fire came from the ship. In addition, when the assassin was at the bottom of the water at the beginning, he had already chiselled more than a dozen large holes in the bottom of the ship. Now the time was almost up, and when everyone came to their senses, they found that the ship was tilting to one side.
Suddenly, without Ye Shuo’s support from behind, the Fourth Prince and his men felt a surge of pressure. They had been able to remain uninjured before, but now it was no longer possible. After a short while, several of them were covered in bruises.
Then, Ye Shuo saw someone holding a sword and stabbing his cheap father. He barely got up and pushed the sword away, but he lost control and fell into the river.
In the end, what Ye Shuo saw were his stepfather’s eyes filled with shock and anger, and his frantic roars.
Emperor Jingwen ultimately failed to maintain his noble image as an emperor.
Ye Shuo thought, this should be the end of the matter, right?
He knows how to swim, so it shouldn’t be a big problem.
As a result… After a short while, his stepfather and his group of brothers fell down like dumplings. This scene made Ye Shuo dumbfounded.
But in the water, those wearing shark skin have a lot of advantages over them.
After trying his best to kill a few more underwater, Ye Shuo felt relieved when he saw that no one was biting him anymore. He was completely exhausted and held on to a piece of wood tightly. He struggled for a few times and then lost consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Rescued
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The big ship sank, causing a huge wave, and for a while the rescue ship could not get close.
After waiting for a long time for the wind and waves to subside, they saw that the entire river was filled with corpses, including assassins and guards. The scene was in chaos and for a moment, no one could tell who was who.
The key point is that the emperor is still on that ship! The commander who was responsible for ensuring the safety of the emperor and the princes during the southern tour was so frightened that he jumped into the water without caring about anything else, calling on everyone to join in the salvage.
“Quick, go find His Majesty and the other princes!”
However, at this time, due to the previous capsizing of the boat, huge waves were created, forming a whirlpool. Some people were caught in the whirlpool and died on the spot, while others had already been pushed away. It was extremely difficult to find them now.
Ye Shuo killed and saved people at the same time, but he didn’t know how many people he had killed, let alone how many people he had saved.
Anyway, who he saw was his own, he helped him, and now he was exhausted, so he fainted.
It was unknown how much time had passed. Ye Shuo was awakened by the cold. When he opened his eyes, his hand slipped due to weakness and he fell off the wooden board into the water, almost choking him to death.
Ye Shuo swam to the shore with almost all his might. His chest felt burning with pain, but his internal organs should not be broken, otherwise he would not be alive today.Fortunately, fortunately…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel relieved.
He looked up at the sky and found that it was already bright. Judging from the speed of the river, he should have drifted quite far. He had not seen the surrounding scenery and Ye Shuo could not tell where he was.
There are mountains all around, so it would be difficult to get out.
However, before he could catch his breath, he saw a person floating down from upstream.
The color of this dress…
Ye Shuo was startled and hurriedly looked for something to fish it out. If it was too late, he would not be able to catch up.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo found a branch in time and stopped the man.
Ye Shuo waded into the water again, gritted his teeth, and fished the man out.
As expected, he is indeed his cheap dad.
Ye Shuo remembered that not long after he fell into the water, his stepfather also fell down, and then it was the Fourth Prince and the others.
I guess they saw that the ship was about to sink and there were too many assassins on board, so they had no choice but to jump down.
Ye Shuo also killed many assassins underwater. As long as they are not too unlucky, the Fourth Prince and the others should still be alive.
I just don’t know where it’s drifting to, and whether everyone is on the same route.
After pulling the man out of the water, Ye Shuo quickly checked his cheap father’s breath and found that although his cheap father’s breath was weak, it was still there. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
If his stepfather was gone, there would be chaos in the capital, as his mother and Jianjian are still in the palace.
By that time, Ye Shuo couldn’t guarantee that he could protect the safety of his mother and Jian Jian in such a chaotic environment.
Carefully avoiding the wounds on his cheap father’s body, Ye Shuo quickly performed chest compressions on him.
If this were in modern times, Ye Shuo would probably have to give his cheap father artificial respiration. Although artificial respiration is for saving lives, it is still difficult to do it.
Fortunately, this is ancient times, and there is such a thing like internal strength.
Ye Shuo moved like a swimming dragon, quickly tapping on several acupuncture points on his cheap father’s body. Soon the water in his cheap father’s trachea and lungs slowly drained out.
After a while, probably because Ye Shuo made a lot of noise, Emperor Jingwen finally opened his eyes with difficulty, and subconsciously, he was about to take action.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo hurriedly stopped him: “No, no, no, father it is me.”
My cheap dad’s physical fitness is really good. He can hit people as soon as he opens his eyes.
“Xiaojiu…?” Emperor Jingwen’s voice was a little hoarse. Just as he was about to move, he was immediately held down by Ye Shuo.
“Don’t move, don’t move. Don’t bother the wound. I’ll help you to the shore.” Ye Shuo himself was still a wounded man. The distance was only about ten metres. During the whole process, Ye Shuo grinned uncontrollably.
In modern times, except for the last few years of illness, he had never suffered such suffering.
Seeing him like this, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know whether to say that he was young and healthy, or to scold him for being weak.
The most basic requirement for a real man is to remain calm when attacked by swords. No one is like him. He burst into tears when he was injured. He doesn’t have the demeanour of a prince at all.
After finally helping his stepfather to lean against a big tree, Ye Shuo saw that his wound was still bleeding, and even his lips were white, but he didn’t say a word. Ye Shuo was shocked: “Dad, don’t you feel the pain?”
Forget it. He is just like that. He probably won’t be able to let go of his imperial airs in his lifetime.
Ye Shuo took out his flint and lit a bonfire. After making sure he wouldn’t freeze, he took two deep breaths and said, “Dad, wait here. I’ll go get you some herbs.”
If this blood continues to flow like this, it will eventually run dry.
Ye Shuo pulled open Emperor Jingwen’s clothes and saw a huge bloody hole. Ye Shuo did not dare to delay.
Seeing his son’s actions, Emperor Jingwen was stunned for a moment: “This flint…”
“I’ve suffered losses before, so I’m specially prepared.” Ye Shuo has learned a lot in the past two years.
Without waiting for his stepfather to speak, Ye Shuo put the flint in his pocket, broke a stick, pushed aside the grass, and went up the mountain.
Looking at his back, Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt that he had grown up a lot.
These two years spent outside were not in vain.
About half an hour later, Ye Shuo emerged from the bushes again.
In ancient times, the forests were too dangerous in the summer. No one came to develop them, and there were not even any roads. If one had a poor memory, once they walked in, they would probably not be able to get out.
Emperor Jingwen was awakened almost instantly, and became alert.
He was relieved to see it was him.
At first, Emperor Jingwen was somewhat pleased with his son’s growth, but when Ye Shuo mashed a handful of green leaves into a paste and lifted up his clothes to paste it on his wound, Emperor Jingwen immediately came to his senses.
“What, what is this?”
Ye Shuo said as a matter of course: “It’s the herbal mud that stops bleeding and reduces inflammation.”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know when he learned the medical skills.
After hearing this, Ye Shuo immediately said, “Dad, you forgot, when my mother was pregnant with Jianjian, I went to see the doctor for a while.”
I can’t say that I can cure diseases, but I have no problem identifying medicinal herbs.
But how could Emperor Jingwen trust him?
After careful recollection, Emperor Jingwen found that it was more than ten years ago. The most important thing was that he did not learn anything at all!
Emperor Jingwen immediately broke out in a cold sweat.
“Stop! I warn you! Don’t come over here! And don’t use—”
At this point, Ye Shuo couldn’t listen to him. Taking advantage of his cheap father’s inability to resist, he applied the medicinal mud directly without blinking an eye.
You know what, some Chinese herbal medicines are really magical. The bleeding stopped in just a short while.
Although the bleeding was stopped, Emperor Jingwen never wanted his son to treat him in his lifetime if possible.
Then Ye Shuo took out a bunch of wild fruits from his arms. They were all found with great difficulty. There were wax gourds and wild cherries, which were only available in this season.
Emperor Jingwen ate two wild cherries with doubt, and his teeth almost became sour.
Normally he would turn his nose up at these things, but now he had no choice at all.
Emperor Jingwen was puzzled as to who could have such great power.
However, at this moment, the son who was pinching his nose and eating cherries suddenly stood up.
Emperor Jingwen was startled and looked over. Before he could react, Ye Shuo had already picked up the branch skillfully.
The one who fished out this time was the seventh prince.
The Seventh Prince’s injuries were also serious, even worse than those of his stepfather. Fortunately, Ye Shuo still had some herbs that he had picked for Emperor Jingwen, so he quickly used them on him.
After all this trouble, Ye Shuo was almost exhausted.
However, Ye Shuo was thinking that this was not a solution.
Although the injuries of the two people have been temporarily treated, these few herbs alone are far from enough. In addition, they have been soaking in the water for such a long time. It is summer now, and it is hot and humid, so there is no guarantee that inflammation will not occur.
In short, we must hurry up and leave here, find a village or a family to settle down as soon as possible.
Besides, the deep mountains and old forests are not safe either. Ye Shuo just discovered traces of wild beasts when he was picking herbs. He was not afraid, but the key was his stepfather and his seventh brother.
In their current condition, they would not be able to survive even if a few wild boars came.
Ye Shuo is alone, and even if he could try his best to hold on, he couldn’t take the two of them away.
Just when Ye Shuo was in a dilemma, he suddenly heard an eagle’s cry from the sky above his head.
Thinking they were being pursued, the three of them immediately felt nervous.
Looking up suddenly, Ye Shuo saw that the eagle was circling above their heads, as if observing something.
Ye Shuo subconsciously wanted to bring the eagle down, otherwise their position would be exposed.
However, the eagle was flying too high. Ye Shuo threw several stones but it was of no use. When the stones flew to a certain height, they no longer had that much force and were easily avoided by the eagle.
Seeing the other party’s dodging movements so skillfully, Ye Shuo’s heart sank again and again.
There is no doubt that this eagle was specially trained by someone.
Just as they guessed, someone soon heard the noise and came over.
Ye Shuo hurriedly lay down and pretended to be seriously injured, so that if he met a strong enemy, he could at least catch the opponent by surprise.
However, what Ye Shuo, Emperor Jingwen and the Seventh Prince did not expect was that the person who came was actually an old man.
The old man was about seventy years old and was dressed like a woodcutter. If you didn’t know him, you would think he came to the mountains to chop wood.
But if you look closely, you can see that he is different from an ordinary woodcutter. His breathing is long and powerful, and you can tell at first glance that he is a martial artist, and he doesn’t feel any worse than his Master Wu Yi.
Ye Shuo, who had lost confidence due to the previous battle, didn’t think he could beat him.
This valley has not been visited by outsiders for many years. When the old man heard Zixiao’s call and came to check today, he thought he was some extraordinary person.
It turned out that they were just three people who had walked in by mistake.
Looking at the uninvited guests in front of him, the old man initially had no intention of paying any attention to them, let alone saving them.
There are so many dying people in this world, how can he save them all?
The old man was heartless, and after making sure the three people were not a danger, he planned to leave them here to fend for themselves.
As a result, at this moment, a gust of wind blew from the riverside, and the hair blocking Ye Shuo’s eyes was blown away.
“…Hmm?” When he saw this scene, the old man couldn’t help but snort.
What a handsome face…
Just when Ye Shuo was hesitating whether to ask for help, he saw the old man suddenly stop, turn around, and squat in front of him.
However, even at such a close distance, the old man still couldn’t find any flaws on his face.
Having lived to such an old age, this must be the most beautiful person the old man has ever seen in his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Forced
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Not knowing what the other party was going to do, Ye Shuo tried his best to remain calm.
There was silence all around for about half a cup of tea. Just when Ye Shuo thought the other party had left, he suddenly heard the old man’s voice above his head.
“Boy, I know you are awake. Open your eyes, I have something to ask you.”
Ye Shuo’s heart tightened, and he was forced to open his eyes helplessly: “Senior.”
Ye Shuo was already quite stunning when he closed his eyes. The injured young man leaned against a big tree. The tree canopy was shady and mottled shadows fell on his face and body. Even though he was dirty, it couldn’t hide his nobleness, but added a sense of abject beauty. That scene was really like a god descending to the earth.
No wonder the old man was immediately interested.
This was the first time the old man used the word “beautiful” to describe a man. He had never known before that beauty could also be used to describe a man.
Thinking about how Concubine Rong was so stunning and famous in the capital, there is no need to say more. He inherited the beauty of both Concubine Rong and Emperor Jingwen, plus his own performance. Not to mention anything else, just Ye Shuo’s appearance is so good that it would be hard to find a second person in the world who can compare with him.
The old man was just thinking that such a face should only be used for appreciation. It would be a pity if is a vulgar person from inside.It’s like a beautiful jade with a flaw, it’s suddenly no longer beautiful.
After Ye Shuo opened his eyes, the old man discovered that this man’s eyes were also so beautiful.
The young man was born with a pair of phoenix eyes with slightly upturned corners, which made him look extremely elegant and noble. His gaze was as clear as water, and for a moment, the old man felt that he was the vulgar man.
Or maybe compared to him, everyone seems tacky.
Quickly suppressing the thought in his mind, the old man stared into his eyes and asked, “Boy, let me ask you, are you married?”
When asking this question, the old man didn’t have much hope at first. After all, there were very few young men and women in the world who were still unmarried at this age.
The old man asked this question out of exception because he was so handsome.
Ye Shuo was stunned when he heard this: “Ah?”
What the hell is this question?
Thinking about the old man’s intention in his heart, Ye Shuo shook his head and said, “No.”
“Then… do you have any concubines, maids, or any lovers outside?” The old man had a sharp eye. He knew from the way he was dressed that he was not from an ordinary family, so he asked this question. The old man was already prepared. If he mentioned any, he would immediately turn around and leave.
Even though he is good-looking, you can’t accept him even if you already have someone in your heart.
Ye Shuo vaguely heard something, but at this time, he could only tell the truth: “…To reply to your question, no.”
“Impossible!” The old man denied it without even thinking.
“Unless there is something wrong with your body.” Either he is a liar, or else how could such a man have never had a woman?
The old man had also been young, how could he not understand the bad roots of men in the world? It is useless for a man to be good-looking, it is all just a show, the inner qualities are also very important.
After saying this, without giving Ye Shuo any chance to resist, the old man stretched out his hand like lightning and was about to touch his pulse.
How could Ye Shuo just surrender like that? His stepfather and the Seventh Prince were both in a coma, so Ye Shuo fought without reservation.
His move made the old man a little frightened. What a profound internal skill!
He didn’t even notice it just now. If he had attacked me when I was bending over to check, I don’t think I would have gotten away with it.
I’ve been in the mountains for too long and I’ve lost my vigilance.
That’s the trick…why does it become more and more obscene the more I look at it?
“Stop, stop, stop. I don’t want to fight with you anymore.” If they continue fighting like this, it will be difficult to determine the winner for a while.
The key is that I have the advantage now, so there is no need to fight him to death.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief when he heard that. He had suffered internal injuries. After a night of sleep, although he had recovered some strength, his chest still hurt terribly.
If possible, he didn’t want to fight to the death.
Noticing that he seemed to have an injury on his chest, and then looking at the other two seriously injured and dying people on the ground, the old man said: “Whether you have a physical problem or are lying, we will know the truth in a few days.”
Those people in the valley are not vegetarians either.
“I just ask you, are you willing to go with me?”
Regarding this issue, Ye Shuo was definitely willing, but it was obvious that the other party did not seem to be so kind.
“Senior, what do you want from me?”
The brain is still quite flexible.
The old man was satisfied and asked, “What do you have?”
Ye Shuo paused and said, “Money? Power? Or…”
“I don’t want any of these.” Before Ye Shuo could finish, the old man interrupted him impatiently: “I only want you.”
Sounds weird…
Ye Shuo shuddered on the spot, his vigilance instantly increased, and he was also prepared to perish together with the old man in front of him.
“A gentleman can be killed but not humiliated! I don’t agree!”
Hearing this, the old man was stunned at first, and then jumped up on the spot: “What are you thinking!”
The old man also felt humiliated.
As the mighty Hou Tian Yi, how could he be such a dirty and disgusting person!
If it weren’t for his face, the old man would have taken action long ago if he had had the same temper as before.
After taking a deep breath, the old man managed to suppress his anger: “It’s not me, it’s my disciple. She is 23 years old and still unmarried.”
Even if you are a man of the world, with a dignified sword, and claim to be free and easy, it is still difficult for you to break away from the current mainstream thinking.
In the ancient times, when it was common for teenagers to get married, the old man’s apprentice was now 23 years old. How could he not be anxious?
Not only was he anxious, but everyone in the Medicine Valley was anxious.
The old man is already seventy years old this year. How many years can he live? He was worried when he thought about leaving his disciple alone in this world.
But the problem is that ever since that incident, his disciple has refused to give in, which has made the old man and his group very anxious.
Well, there is no other way, the old man can only try other methods.
Ye Shuo’s arrival rekindled hope in the old man’s long-silent heart.
The old man didn’t believe that his disciple would not be tempted if he brought such a “beauty” back.
Doesn’t the young man in front of him look much better than his apprentice’s senior brother who is not even remotely related to her? If this young man is the moon in the sky, then her senior brother is the firefly on the ground, and how can the light of a firefly compete with the brightness of the bright moon?
But the problem is that even if she is the old man’s apprentice, Ye Shuo cannot agree.
“Marriage is about mutual affection between two people. How can it be forced?”
However, the old man still didn’t care: “Who said this is a forced sale?” If his disciple looks down on him, the worst that could happen is that he will just return the goods.
“My disciple can buy it, but you can’t.”
The old man had never thought that the young man in front of him would refuse, and he never gave him a chance to refuse.
The worst that could happen is they can just kidnap him. Even though his Kung Fu is a little tricky, it’s not a problem for them.
It was just that the situation had not yet come to that point, so the old man was willing to talk to him a few more words instead of forcing him to do anything.
Ye Shuo never imagined that he would actually meet someone in ancient times who would just twist the melon off without caring whether it was sweet or not.
“Senior, this really can’t be done…”
“Stop talking nonsense.” The old man glanced at the two people on the ground.
“If you agree, I will rescue them. If you don’t agree, then the three of you will stay in this deep forest.”
“But I have to remind you that within this 100-mile radius, there is only one family in this Valley. If you want to find someone to help, you have to go at least another 100 miles west. You can do it yourself.”
It is already afternoon and it will be dark soon. The temperature in the mountains will drop sharply after dark, and wild beasts will roam around at night. It is not certain that his cheap father and his seventh brother will be able to survive until tomorrow morning.
Should he watch them die or be forced to compromise? Such a dilemma was immediately placed in front of Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo used to have infinite dreams for his marriage, but he never expected to encounter such an accident.
Ye Shuo tried to struggle desperately: “Senior, can you please show some leniency for the sake of being a fellow martial artist?”
The old man was not a soft-hearted person when he was out there. If he had not raised his apprentice by accident, he probably would never have known what the word “emotion” was in his life.
Want him to show kindness to a stranger? How is that possible?
Hearing this, the old man turned and left.
Anyway, Zixiao is guarding here. Once these two people are dead and the young man’s physical strength is almost exhausted, it won’t be too late to force him back.
If it was someone he knew well, Ye Shuo could still find the other person’s weakness. However, if he suddenly met a stranger, no matter how capable he was, it would be useless without the third eye.
Finally, when the old man’s figure was about to disappear, Ye Shuo finally spoke.
“…Senior, please stay.”
Ye Shuo was helpless: “I promise you.”
On the bright side, this old man’s apprentice may not necessarily think highly of him, so there might be hope for the situation to turn around.
In this world, not all women have to get married. This old man’s disciple has been able to fight against the secular world for so long, so she will surely not compromise so easily.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo felt certain.
The old man turned and looked at him, as if trying to determine the truth of his words: “Are you serious?”
What else can Ye Shuo do now that things have come to this?
“A gentleman’s word is his bond.”
So, the matter is settled.
According to the old man, unless his disciple doesn’t want him first, Ye Shuo can only belong to his disciple.
For his stepfather and the seventh prince, Ye Shuo sacrificed too much.
Maybe he heard the conversation between the two while he was unconscious, but Emperor Jingwen’s brows subconsciously raised and his eyeballs kept moving, as if he was preparing to struggle to wake up.
But he had no choice. He had lost too much blood and did not have the strength to do so. After tossing and turning for a while, he could not resist his body’s reaction and fell into a deep sleep.
Ye Shuo carried his adoptive father on his back, while the old man carried the seventh prince on his back.
It was only then that the old man realized that the person on his back seemed to be quite good-looking, better than his apprentice’s senior brother, but because Ye Shuo had set such a good example before him, the old man didn’t even notice him the whole time.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo was about to sell out the Seventh Prince, but then he suddenly remembered that the Seventh Prince had already been married and had a lot of concubines in his house, which did not even meet the threshold required by the old man.
Ye Shuo could only give up in disappointment.
When they got on the road, the old man asked Ye Shuo a lot of questions, such as his age, height, weight, etc. The old man asked everything.
When he heard that he was only twenty years old, three years younger than his apprentice, the old man frowned subconsciously.
But soon, the old man put the matter aside.
He’s only three years younger than his apprentice, so it doesn’t matter.
Ye Shuo thought about it and thought that he couldn’t sell himself at a big loss, so when he was halfway there, Ye Shuo said: “Master, you see, since we are now a family, my fourth brother, fifth brother, and eighth brother are still missing. I don’t know where they were washed away by the water. Could you please help find them?”
Caught off guard, the old man stopped abruptly.
“Huh….?”
“What did you just call me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Ruthless Man
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Master, what’s wrong?”
Ye Shuo acted as if it was a matter of course, which made the old man start to wonder.
This change of words is a bit too quick…
The old man has been in the underworld for many years and claims to have seen all kinds of people, but this is the first time he has seen someone like Ye Shuo.
The old man thought that he would make trouble for a while, and even made some preparations.
Seeing that the other party had not spoken, Ye Shuo could not help but urge: “Master, why don’t you speak?”
“Master, please respond.”
Judging from what happened just now, this old man’s eagle is much more reliable than human eyes. If an eagle can be used to find people, it will surely be much more efficient.
The old man’s expression changed several times, and finally, he said: “…You don’t have to change your words so early.”There must be something wrong when something is abnormal. Seeing that he was so obedient, the old man became alert.
“My disciple may not be able to like you. When she comes back, it won’t be too late for you to change your mind.”
Oh, it turns out that person is not here.
What is Ye Shuo worried about?
He will take advantage of it first.
“But since I promised the Master, from now on, I belong to the Valley Master.”
The old man narrowed his eyes when he heard this: “Let me make it clear to you, don’t think you can get away with this. I won’t buy it.”
After all, the old man is a man who has experienced many ups and downs, and he is not so easily fooled.
“Since the Master has chosen me, based on the Master’s understanding of his apprentice, I believe that she must like me.”
“In that case, if we really fall in love with each other in the future, Master, if you don’t save me now, wouldn’t it hurt the relationship between me and the young apprentice?”
It’s not hard to guess what parents are thinking. They want to consider every aspect of their children.
In modern times, there are countless parents who know that some of the school rules are unreasonable, but still dare not resist. Isn’t it because they are worried about their children going to school?
After the words fell, the old man couldn’t help but snorted: “You dare!”
It’s hard to say whether one would dare to do it or not.
Just like he said, what if they really fall in love? Although he forced the person to come with his words, the old man also hoped that the two of them could live in harmony.
Ye Shuo looked back with innocent eyes, and their eyes met. Finally, the old man was defeated.
Poor parents in the world…
The old man blew a whistle, and the eagle seemed to have received some instructions. It circled at a low altitude and landed on the old man’s shoulder.
Then the old man seemed to give some instructions, and the eagle, having received the order, quickly flapped its wings and flew away.
In addition to it, there are three other eagles lurking nearby. With these eagles serving as the eyes of Medicine Valley, it is extremely safe.
“So, since you have promised me, don’t even think about running away.” The old man couldn’t help but “remind” him from the side.
Ye Shuo had no intention of running away. With his father and the Seventh Prince injured, where could he run?
“Thank you, Master.” Ye Shuo even expressed his gratitude.
Old man: “…”
“snort!”
About half an hour later, the two arrived outside the Medicine Valley.
Standing halfway up the mountain and looking down, the entire Medicine Valley is surrounded by water on three sides. It looks like a very beautiful place.
“It’s so beautiful…”
Ye Shuo turned around and said, “Master, is this where we are going to live from now on?”
The old man choked and was too lazy to pay attention to him. He just carried the seventh prince on his back and walked downstairs.
Ye Shuo didn’t mind seeing this, and was even in the mood to appreciate the scenery along the way.
After all, the old man saved him for his body and didn’t want his life. As long as he didn’t kill anyone, everything could be negotiated. There was always a way to solve the problem.
After entering the Medicine Valley, Ye Shuo discovered that there were almost no people inside. There were only a few stone houses, which looked deserted.
Hearing the noise, someone came out quickly.
“I said Huo Tianyi, you——”
The person who came was also an old man. Although he looked a little younger than the one Ye Shuo had met before, he was also in his sixties.
Seeing a stranger appear in the valley, Mei Yingzhuo frowned subconsciously.
However, at this moment, the old man, Huo Tianyi, said: “It’s just right, I was just about to look for you, I just saw a few patients here, come and take a look.”
Having said that, without giving Mei Yingzhuo any chance to object, Huo Tianyi put the Seventh Prince on the bed used to treat patients in Mei Yingzhuo’s home.
Ye Shuo noticed that there were two people tied up on the other two beds in the room, looking in pain and wailing. Ye Shuo’s heart immediately tightened.
I always feel that this place doesn’t seem to be a place where hermits and masters live…
It looks more like a den of thieves.
Medicine Man Valley, Medicine Man Valley, Medicine Man Valley…
Ye Shuo had been in the underworld for two years after all. He carefully recalled the rumours he had heard and finally found a few words in a corner.
Then Ye Shuo found that he seemed to have really entered a den of thieves. Rather than calling it the Medicine Man Valley, it was more like the Evil Man Valley.
Anyway, according to the version Ye Shuo heard, the people living here seemed to be evil monsters who kill people without blinking an eye. No wonder he always felt something was weird.
When Huo Tian saw that his eyes widened when he saw the two people next to him, he finally felt relieved.
“How about it, are you scared?”
“Yes, a little.” Ye Shuo said honestly: “I was a little scared when I first saw them, but after hearing what Master said, I am not afraid anymore.”
After the words fell, Mei Yingzhuo, who was checking the injuries of Emperor Jingwen and the Seventh Prince, was stunned: “Master?”
Mei Yingzhuo was confused: “Don’t we only have Zhi’er as our apprentice?”
When did this old man accept another disciple outside?
When Mei Yingzhuo looked at Huo Tianyi again, his eyes immediately became wrong.
Huo Tianyi couldn’t help but glared at Ye Shuo fiercely: “Don’t listen to this kid’s nonsense, the thing is…”
Soon, Huo Tianyi repeated what happened before: “I thought this boy was very good-looking, so I brought him here. What do you think? Is he much better than Zhi’er’s shitty senior brother?”
When Mei Yingzhuo first saw Ye Shuo, he thought this boy was too handsome. Then, after hearing Huo Tianyi’s plan, he thought about it and felt that this might really work.
Zhier is already grown up, why is she still dragging her feet and refusing to get married?
“…This kid is quite sensible.” Obviously, Mei Yingzhuo also felt that the attitude of the young man in front of him was too nice and he didn’t seem like a good person.
But it doesn’t matter. No matter how evil this kid is, how can he be worse than them? There is always a way to deal with him.
Since the two lying there were hostages, Mei Yingzhuo’s attitude towards Emperor Jingwen and the Seventh Prince would naturally be slightly better than before.
None of those who can be regarded as big demons are good people. After a few silver needles were applied, the fever of Emperor Jingwen and the seventh prince was immediately improved.
Soon, Mei Yingzhuo stretched out his hand towards Ye Shuo: “Boy, I heard that you are also injured? Give your hand here, let me take a look.”
Ye Shuo did not resist and stretched out his wrist in front of him.
As the saying goes, observation, listening, questioning and palpation are all important. When Mei Yingzhuo probed Ye Shuo’s dantian, his face changed immediately.
Then he looked up at Huo Tianyi. This kid had such a deep inner strength, but Huo Tianyi was not afraid that he would put it into himself in the end?
Don’t let him fail to force it and end up putting himself in it.
Huo Tianyi was not too worried. Although the young man was strong, he was young after all. Besides, he had his father and brother around, so Huo Tianyi was not afraid that he would disobey.
After a moment of silence, Mei Yingzhuo said, “You are seriously injured, and you have been on the road for such a long time. I am afraid you will need to rest for a while.”
Ye Shuo naturally agreed to everything the doctor said.
Soon Mei Yingzhuo began to prescribe medicine and then went to get the medicine.
Not long after, looking at the bowl of black medicine in front of him, Ye Shuo fell into deep thought.
Then he looked up and asked in confusion, “Masters, I think I have been obedient enough. Is there something I haven’t done well enough that you two treat me like this and even tamper with this medicine?”
Huo Tianyi felt extremely uncomfortable with his accusing look and was a little annoyed: “What are you talking about!?”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at Mei Yingzhuo standing beside him.
Mei Yingzhuo was silent for a moment, then asked, “Do you know medicine?”
Ye Shuo nodded: “I know a thing or two.”
Mei Yingzhuo couldn’t help feeling a little embarrassed when he heard this.
“Hey… I’ll go make you another bowl right away.”
After Mei Yingzhuo left, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh, looking disappointed: “It was a fair trade, but it’s not fair at all.”
No matter how unreasonable Huo Tianyi was, he would never resort to such despicable means. This time he was implicated by the old poisonous man Mei Yingzhuo.
Huo Tianyi suddenly became less tough and couldn’t help but curse the other party in his heart.
What a waste of time! Can this kid still turn the tables in Medicine Man Valley?
And Ye Shuo continued: “Master is like this, I am sure that the disciple is not much better. It’s a pity that I have a clean name, but in the end I have to fall into the hands of a witch…”
“You’re talking nonsense!” Now, more than 20 years have passed, Huo Tianyi doesn’t care what people say about him, but he absolutely cannot accept someone pointing out his apprentice.
“If it weren’t for Zhi’er’s request, do you think you could still stay here now?”
According to Huo Tianyi’s own personality, if the young man in front of him didn’t want to, he would just kidnap him directly. Why would he say so much to him? And he also treated the injuries of his father and brother.
When his father and brother died, and he was injured and couldn’t leave, wouldn’t he still have to compromise? Why would he have to go to so much trouble?
“Also, you are not allowed to call Zhi’er a witch!”
“If you say one more word, be careful or I will chop you to death!”
If these six people were outside, everyone would hate them. But they ended up raising a kind-hearted female apprentice who likes to stand up for the weak.
In this case, Huo Tian and his friends didn’t want her to be tainted by mud because of them.
Ye Shuo heard this and thought: “So, the young apprentice is a good person.”
Ye Shuo pointed at the two people lying on the bed and said, “If the Young apprentice is a good person, how could these two be so miserable? I’m afraid you are not the only one who thinks she is good?”
Seeing the young man in front of him looking suspicious, as if he didn’t believe what he said at all, Huo Tianyi couldn’t help himself.
I believe that when encountering such a thing, there are very few parents in this world who can bear it.
“What do you know? One of them is a rapist who has raped countless girls, and the other is a notorious bandit who has killed countless people. They deserve this fate.”
This old man is overbearing and cold by nature. He can explain so much, so I guess it must be true.
Ye Shuo had a rough idea in his mind.
“Yes, yes, Master is right. It was I who misunderstood.”
Huo Tianyi was satisfied, this was good enough.
When it came to the second bowl of medicine, Mei Yingzhuo didn’t tamper with it after all.
After all, Ye Shuo said he understood a little, but he didn’t know how much he understood. There was a long time to go, so he could just observe and see. It was only the first day, so there was no need to rush.
By the time everything was arranged, it was already early morning.
Huo Tianyi originally wanted to find a place for him to sleep, but Ye Shuo’s words, “I am a married man now. If I don’t get enough rest, it will affect my reputation. What if I offend the young apprentice?” made Huo Tianyi hesitate.
He actually looked down on men who were so delicate, but when he thought about it, his face was indeed important at the moment.
It’s just a room.
Ye Shuo finally got the single room he wished for, and was provided with a set of clean bedding.
“Master, please find a way to buy me a few servants tomorrow.” This house has not been lived in for a long time, and many places need to be cleaned up. Ye Shuo is too lazy to do it, so it would be more convenient to hire someone.
“Since Young apprentice is kind-hearted, that servant cannot be abducted. I just need someone to support me because my family can’t afford food.” Although the silver on Ye Shuo’s body was washed away by the flood, he believed that the old man in front of him should have some.
He really thinks he’s somebody!
Huo Tianyi was about to get angry when he heard Ye Shuo say, “If we don’t clean up this house, Young apprentice won’t be able to look after it when she comes back.”
Huo Tianyi: “…”
What he said seemed to make some sense.
“You’re sensible.” Huo Tianyi was very satisfied with his knowledge and taste, and was even more satisfied that he had already started doing what a husband does before even meeting his disciple.
Huo Tianyi tried to find fault with it, but couldn’t find any, so he left in disappointment.
After he left, Ye Shuo blew out the light, lay down with peace of mind, and had a good night’s sleep.
The next morning, the Seventh Prince woke up first, and Emperor Jingwen did not wake up until the afternoon.
When Emperor Jingwen saw the scene around him, his first reaction was that he must have been rescued, and he was still thanking this family in his heart.
Seeing this, the Seventh Prince couldn’t help but remain silent, thinking that it was too early for his father to be happy.
The Seventh Prince immediately closed his eyes and pretended to be asleep, pretending he knew nothing.
Upon hearing the news that his cheap father had woken up, Ye Shuo, who was busy cutting new clothes, immediately stopped and walked in.
“Dad, you’re finally awake.”
Emperor Jingwen was lying there. After his mind became a little clearer, he was thinking about how to reward the people here after he recovered.
But Ye Shuo shook his head after hearing his words: “No need, Dad. I have already pledged myself to them. You can live here peacefully. Your son has everything.”
“What?!”
After realising what his son meant, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but almost jumped out of bed.
Emperor Jingwen’s originally relaxed mood suddenly became cloudy.
The second reaction was that this group of people dared to threaten the prince. When he felt better, he would definitely notify the secret guards to kill all of these troublemakers, leaving no one alive!

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Beauty
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Emperor Jingwen had a gloomy face and was extremely angry, but now he was helpless and could only put up with him for the time being.
Emperor Jingwen also knew that this kind of thing was a great humiliation for a man, so he immediately tried to comfort them, “I’m sorry for wronging you. In a few days, I will make sure they die a miserable death!”
In the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, being able to save him and the other princes was a great blessing. These people actually dared to ask for rewards, which was really ungrateful.
Even if the other party does not know that his son is the heir to the throne, he still deserves the death penalty.
The slight feeling of gratitude disappeared in an instant, and only anger remained in Emperor Jingwen’s heart.
Emperor Jingwen thought he would see his son’s humiliated face, but when he looked up, he found that it was not the case at all.
The youngest son did not seem as indignant as he had imagined.
At this moment, Huo Tianyi came in cursing, “Hey, kid, you still haven’t said whether you want Fu Guang Duan or Su Jin!”
He was just measuring the size, but he just ran away as soon as he said so, which made Huo Tianyi very angry.However, after seeing the other party, Emperor Jingwen also became angry.
How dare you speak to the prince in such a tone? How presumptuous!
Fu Guangduan is graceful and Su Jin is elegant, each has its own merits. Ye Shuo thought for a moment and said, “I want both.”
“…”
Huo Tianyi took a deep breath: “I warn you, don’t push your luck!”
Medicine Valley is not short of money. After all, the most untouchable people in the world are doctors. Mei Yingzhuo alone is enough to run the entire Medicine Valley. Apart from Mei Yingzhuo, the others also have their own means. They stay in this valley all year round and basically have nothing to spend, so they don’t value money much.
It is one thing to just not take it seriously, but it is another to be taken advantage of.
