However, Ye Shuo was somewhat helpless: “When I was at home, I also had a luxurious life. You have seen what I wore before. Which one of them is not better than Fu Guang Duan and Su Jin? My request is not too much, right?”
“Young apprentice and I haven’t even gotten married yet, and you’re treating me so harshly. If you’re so stingy about the money, why bother trying to steal a groom for the apprentice?”
“You are all famous seniors, and the young apprentice is a young hero. You shouldn’t be so unreasonable, right?”
Although Huo Tianyi had lived in seclusion here for decades, he still had his old eyesight and knew that what he said was true. His clothes were indeed very expensive.
Huo Tianyi really had nothing to say.
Ye Shuo changed the subject and sighed, “But there is a saying that goes, if you marry a chicken, you follow the chicken; if you marry a dog, you follow the dog. Since the young valley master is so poor, I will have no choice but to live with her like this…”
Huo Tianyi was a man of reputation and didn’t want his disciple to be accused of being stingy.
After a while, Huo Tianyi gritted his teeth and said, “…just wait!”
It’s just two sets of clothes, what’s the difficulty?
Ye Shuo heard this and looked at his cheap father and his seventh brother. Huo Tianyi felt bad at that time.
As expected, the next moment, he said, “Filial piety is the most important virtue. As a son, how can I enjoy it alone?”
Huo Tianyi understood immediately.
To be honest, Huo Tianyi himself is not that great, but he wants to find a husband for his apprentice who is good in every way.
At the very least, this person cannot be a heartless and ruthless person.
Huo Tianyi’s expression changed several times, and finally he turned and left without saying a word.
Without objection, Ye Shuo took it as his agreement.
When Ye Shuo turned his head again, he saw that his cheap father was gasping for breath with his face flushed red.
Ye Shuo hurried to support him, and only breathed a sigh of relief after making sure that his wound had not opened.
Ye Shuo was about to withdraw his hand, but unexpectedly his cheap father grabbed it tightly, with emotions surging in his eyes. However, before he could speak, Ye Shuo could not help but remind him: “Dad, Fourth Brother and the others haven’t been found yet.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…………”
Not sure if it was an illusion, but Emperor Jingwen just felt a tightness in his chest. After holding it in for a long time, he finally managed to utter a few words: “…I’m sorry for wronging you.”
Actually it’s not that bad.
So far, Ye Shuo hasn’t felt any discomfort.
As for the deal proposed by Huo Tianyi, since he wanted to ask for help, he naturally had to pay a price.
“I’ll go get you and Brother Seven something to eat.”
After Ye Shuo came out, he ran into Mei Yingzhuo soon after.
“Fourth Master.” Ye Shuo greeted the other party very enthusiastically.
For a moment, Mei Yingzhuo wondered whether this was the Medicine Man Valley where he had lived for decades, or the home of the young man opposite.
There are a total of six people living in the Medicine Valley. Mei Yingzhuo doesn’t know martial arts, but he is good at poison techniques, so he barely ranks fourth, so Ye Shuo calls him the fourth master.
Mei Yingzhuo was silent for a moment, then asked coldly, “What’s the matter?”
“There’s nothing else, I just want to ask Fourth Master, how are my father and seventh brother doing?” Ye Shuo was very concerned about their health.
Mei Yingzhuo thought for a moment, then spoke without any emotion: “The younger one is young and strong, there is no big problem, just rest for a while.”
“As for the old one…”
Seeing the other party pause, Ye Shuo hurriedly asked: “How is my father?”
“Although your father was only hit by one sword, the opponent was angry and stabbed him in the wrong place, almost injuring his heart. Plus, he is not young anymore, so his recovery is a little slow. In the future, remember not to let him get too angry or too sad, and maybe the problem will be solved.” Mei Yingzhuo is an extremely skilled doctor. If he had been replaced by a slightly worse doctor this time, with the amount of blood Emperor Jingwen had lost, he might not have been able to be saved.
When Ye Shuo heard this, his expression changed slightly.
He thought that everything would be fine as long as the person was saved, but he forgot that there was such a thing as hidden injury.
“Thank you, Master Four. I will remember it.”
Ye Shuo knew that a doctor’s dedication and his inattention were two completely different situations. In this situation, Ye Shuo had no choice but to rely on the other party.
“Thank you for your concern, Master Four.”
Seeing the pleading look in the young man’s eyes, Mei Yingzhuo was somewhat surprised and felt that he seemed to have underestimated the young man’s character.
But in the end, Mei Yingzhuo didn’t say any words of promise, he just nodded and said “hmm”, indicating that he understood. As for whether to do it or not, that was another matter. Ye Shuo couldn’t force him.
Then, Ye Shuo came to the kitchen of Yaoren Valley.
[1] Yaoren = Medical
It’s already afternoon, even the big devil still needs to eat.
Now there is no servant here, and Ye Shuo can’t rely on anyone else, so he can only do it himself.
Fortunately, he was not a lazy person who did not know the difference between grains and vegetables. Even though he had been pampered for so long in ancient times, let alone being a top chef, he should have no problem lighting a fire and cooking a meal.
Now that Ye Shuo needs help from others, his attitude is naturally very proper.
You have to ask when you need it, and you have to work when you need to.
In addition to his stepfather, Seventh Brother’s share, Ye Shuo also made some extra, and several other masters also had shares.
The demons in the Medicine Valley are also human beings, and as human beings they need to eat.
There are both men and women in the Medicine Valley, including two old men, the first master and the fourth master, a charming woman in her forties, a disfigured woman, a man who looks like a boy but is already fifty years old, and a monster who is neither male nor female and is not tolerated by the world.
As usual, several people came to the small kitchen.
None of them were good at cooking and they were too lazy to take care of things. The only purpose of food for them was to fill their stomachs.
But today, something seems a little different.
Ye Shuo was carrying a lunch box and ran into a few people head-on.
Ye Shuo greeted everyone skillfully: “Second Master, Third Master, Fifth Master.”
Although they had only met once in the morning, as the saying goes, the first time is strange, the second time is familiar. We would be dealing with each other frequently in the future. Aren’t these people familiar with Ye Shuo?
While my cheap father and the others are recovering from their injuries, they will have to rely on these people for help.
“I left some food on the stove. If you don’t mind, just use it.”
Several people were silent and no one spoke.
Ye Shuo’s gaze stayed on his second master, the beautiful woman, for a moment. Don’t get me wrong, he didn’t have any other intentions, he just felt that the other person looked vaguely familiar, but when Ye Shuo thought about it carefully, he couldn’t remember what she was.
Soon, Ye Shuo put this episode behind him.
Seeing that they ignored him, Ye Shuo didn’t feel embarrassed. He said hello to them and left.
After he left, they came to the stove and the beautiful woman was the first to open the lid there, and then the aroma of food wafted out.
“…Go and call Lao Si over to see if there is any poison in here.”
The answer is obvious. Ye Shuo is not so stupid as to show off his little tricks in front of Mei Yingzhuo, a professional.
Everyone sat down around the table and looked at the food in front of them quietly. No one spoke or picked up their chopsticks.
In the past, the disfigured woman, that is, the Sixth Master, would usually come over after everyone else had left.
Today seemed a little special. When everyone came to their senses, they saw a woman wrapped tightly, leaning against the door frame.
Although she had not left the house during the past two days, she heard everything that happened outside clearly.
“Boss has brought back an incredible person this time.”
The beautiful woman paused and said, “I’m afraid Huo Tianyi may have done something bad with good intentions this time.”
The boy-like man was puzzled, and the androgynous Third Master next to him said, “We can’t let Zhi’er see him.”
The fifth master finally asked, “Why?”
Although Master Five is old, he has been a child all his life after all. He has never experienced love affairs between men and women, so naturally he does not know how serious it is.
The three of them looked at each other, obviously thinking the same thing.
Although this young man has a top-notch appearance, he is not fatal alone. If his personality and the way he does things are taken into account, their apprentice will not be able to beat him.
If we really meet and get married, my heart will be devoted to him sooner or later.
Add to that the handsomeness of the young man, where had the young girl seen anything like this? How could she resist such a great temptation?
Just now, the scene of the young man washing his hands to make soup and standing under the sunset with a smile was enough to make the beautiful woman’s heart beat faster, not to mention the young disciple.
As expected of an old hand, the beautiful woman saw through Ye Shuo’s true nature at a glance.
This kid is definitely not a good person.
Just because the two old guys don’t understand doesn’t mean they don’t understand.
So, the next day, when Huo Tianyi finally came back with two servants and a pile of clothes, he heard the news that the beautiful women demanded that Ye Shuo and his party be driven out of the valley.
“Why?!”
When Huo Tian heard this, he immediately became angry.
“I worked so hard to get him back, why are you letting him go just like that?!”

↑1Yaoren = Medical

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Discovery
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
He definitely couldn’t agree with Huo Tianyi’s busy schedule.
“You two are so good at talking!”
Huo Tianyi’s attitude was extremely firm. If he said he disagreed, he meant he disagreed.
The beautiful woman at the side could not help but snort coldly: “Then you will lose both your apprentice and your army!”
Huo Tianyi didn’t care. In his opinion, it didn’t matter if Ye Shuo and his party were born rich. Even if they were officials, since they came to Yaoren Valley, they could only be the meat and he would be the butcher.
That young man is disobedient, so I naturally have plenty of ways to make him obedient.
“Although this kid is good at martial arts, our Zhi’er is no pushover either.” Huo Tianyi was naturally very confident in the disciple he had taught personally.
“Although Zhi’er is only 23 years old this year, she is even better than her teacher.”
The thing that Huo Tianyi was most proud of in his life was that he had taught such a talented apprentice and passed on all his martial arts to her. Seeing how outstanding the other party was, Huo Tianyi was filled with satisfaction.But how could the beautiful woman explain this to him?
Being good at martial arts didn’t mean you would have the upper hand. Was he treating it like a fight? Whoever had the stronger fist would be the winner?
He is too naive.
Huo Tianyi has always been stubborn. Unless the beautiful woman fights with him and wins, Huo Tianyi will naturally not say anything more.
But the problem is that it is difficult for the beautiful woman to win under normal circumstances, otherwise she would not be just the second master. In addition, Mei Yingzhuo stands with him this time, making it even more difficult for the beautiful woman to win.
Seeing that she really couldn’t convince him, Master Six couldn’t bear it any longer, so she turned around and left without saying a word.
The beautiful woman also warned: “Just wait, Huo Tianyi, sooner or later you will regret it, and by then I’m afraid you won’t even have time to cry!”
Huo Tianyi snorted and laughed.
Soon, the crowd dispersed.
When Huo Tianyi arrived at the medicine house with two servants and a bunch of clothes, Ye Shuo had just finished feeding his stepfather.
Since his stepfather was in poor health and could hardly get out of bed, Ye Shuo could only feed him slowly, one spoonful at a time.
Emperor Jingwen had been served by countless palace servants in his life, and there were many who were more dedicated than Ye Shuo, but they were not his sons after all, so the feeling was completely different.
Emperor Jingwen did not expect that the little bastard, who seemed to be out of touch on weekdays, could be so reliable at the critical moment.
Emperor Jingwen drank the porridge smoothly without choking or burning his mouth.
This inevitably moved Emperor Jingwen.
However, what he didn’t know was that Ye Shuo had acquired this skill when he was with Mr. Gu.
Mr. Gu was bedridden for a long time and finally couldn’t get up. Ye Shuo fed him one spoonful at a time every day.
So sometimes, the most ruthless things are the most touching.
The little bastard has sacrificed too much this time, and Emperor Jingwen has decided that when he returns, he will directly skip the title of Duke and confer the title of Prince on him.
With this in mind, I think his group of brothers should have no objection.
“I’m sorry for wronging you.”
While Ye Shuo was clearing the dishes, he said, “It will only take two days. When the master returns with his servants, they will serve you.”
Ye Shuo always says what he thinks and rarely tries to be sentimental.
Emperor Jingwen’s emotion did not last long before he choked.
Bastard! He didn’t even bother to pretend. If it were someone else, I’m afraid they would want to show him their loyalty. They would show ten out of ten loyalty.
However, it was precisely because of this that Emperor Jingwen felt at ease.
“Dad, if you need anything, I’ll go talk to the master.” When Ye Shuo said this, his expression was very natural.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt very uncomfortable.
“…You don’t have to act so deliberately in front of Dad.”
Heaven and earth are all sincere, what Ye Shuo said was all true, how could he say it deliberately?
Seeing the little bastard in a daze, Emperor Jingwen immediately had a bad premonition in his heart: “Xiao Jiu, you are not really planning to marry this woman, are you?”
“What else? I have already promised them.” Ye Shuo is not so tasteless as to use sweet words when he needs someone and kick them away when he doesn’t need them anymore.
Since Ye Shuo has spoken, he will naturally keep his promise.
Regardless of Ye Shuo’s own wishes, exchanging two lives for a marriage is considered quite fair.
“Unless the woman doesn’t want this son first, then I will have no choice but to accept her as my wife.”
Emperor Jingwen almost fainted. At this moment, Huo Tianyi outside finally couldn’t help but said, “Okay!”
When he looked at Ye Shuo again, his eyes were filled with satisfaction.
“It’s good that you have such awareness.” Huo Tianyi was very satisfied with the other party’s tact, and he didn’t take the words of the beautiful woman and others to heart.
Emperor Jingwen felt relieved when he saw him.
The little bastard said that just now. He must have discovered that the other party was eavesdropping outside, so he must have said it on purpose for the other party to hear.
In this way, Emperor Jingwen suppressed his uneasiness.
Emperor Jingwen and Huo Tianyi looked at each other, both of them with anger in their eyes.
Emperor Jingwen thought to himself that when his health got a little better, he would make sure that everyone here died a miserable death and would have them torn into pieces by five horses.
Huo Tianyi was thinking that this young man was obedient, but he, as his father, was a restless person. After his disciple got married to the young man, if he dared to act like a evil father-in-law, he would definitely teach him a lesson.
One is the supreme ruler, the other is a swordsman. They dislike each other so much.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about them. There was no way they could fight anyway, so he carried the food box and came to the side of the Seventh Prince who was pretending to be dead.
“Okay stop pretending, I know you’re awake.”
Hearing his brother’s voice, the Seventh Prince looked embarrassed and slowly opened his eyes.
It really wasn’t that he pretended to be unconscious on purpose, it was just that he didn’t dare to speak just now.
The Seventh Prince knew very well how important he was in his father’s eyes. If he didn’t get what he wanted, the father and son would have a big argument and then take the blame on him.
Ye Shuo took out the food and asked, “Do you want me to feed you or do you want to eat it yourself?”
The Seventh Prince was not so shameless: “I will eat it myself, I will eat it myself.”
Enduring the pain, the Seventh Prince sat up and slowly scooped up the porridge in front of him and drank it.
About an incense stick later, Ye Shuo closed the door and walked out with Huo Tianyi.
“Here, this is the servant you wanted, and these are your clothes.” Silk was expensive, and even Huo Tianyi felt the pain.
“Thank you, Master.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but thank you upon hearing that, being very polite and courteous.
“Master, can you arrange a separate room for my father and my seventh brother? The two people in the other two beds are so noisy that they can’t sleep at night.”
Ye Shuo confirmed that those two people were indeed thieves.
Considering that he was so knowledgeable and tactful just now, Huo Tianyi naturally didn’t care about these trivial matters.
Huo Tianyi was in a good mood. Two rooms and two beds, what did that matter?
“And my fourth brother and the others, Master, please pay more attention to them.”
“As long as you are obedient, we are a family. I will naturally do my best to help you find your fourth brother and others.”
Huo Tianyi thought about it and decided to send out the eagles at night.
By daybreak, it would be the third day since the shipwreck. If the Fourth Prince and his companions could not be found, they would be in great danger.
Now that Huo Tianyi is satisfied, he will naturally pay more attention to it than before.
Later, Ye Shuo discovered that compared to Huo Tianyi, other masters who had never had conflicts with him were more hostile towards him.
Ye Shuo had clearly cooked for them, so why was this happening?
Especially the beautiful woman, who directly told him where the exit of Medicine Valley was and asked him to run away quickly.
On the surface, it seemed to be for his own good, and she even promised to help send his father and brother away.
Ye Shuo was very happy at first, after all, it was the other party who gave in voluntarily. But after thinking carefully, his adopted father was in such a state now, and he might not be able to get good medical treatment if he was sent away. There were still so many assassins outside, and if they came back again, Ye Shuo could not guarantee that he and his father could escape again this time.
After much thought, he decided that it would be safer to stay in the Medicine Valley, especially with the ghost doctor here, it would be difficult for my cheap dad to die.
Ye Shuo weighed the issue and decisively refused.
“Second Master, my father’s injuries are quite serious and he can’t be moved easily. It will take a day and a night to go back and forth from here. If something goes wrong along the way, do you have any plans to deal with it?”
“Or, will the Fourth Master follow us throughout the entire process?”
The beautiful woman’s expression froze when she heard this. She was not very well versed in medicine. She could treat minor injuries, but if an injury to the heart meridian really broke out, the patient would just have to wait for death.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo knew that it was unreliable, so his attitude became more resolute.
Seeing that he was not fooled, the beautiful woman gradually became anxious.
From sweet words at the beginning to coercion and inducement in the end.
Seeing that the other party was determined not to give up until he was driven out, Ye Shuo had no choice but to turn to Huo Tianyi for help.
When Huo Tianyi saw that there was such a thing, he immediately became angry.
“This kid is a member of Medicine Valley in life and a ghost of Medicine Valley in death. I wonder who dares to drive him out!”
Ye Shuo also nodded repeatedly: “I will stay in this Yaoren Valley and wait for the young valley apprentice to come back. I will not go anywhere else.”
Beautiful woman: “…”
The beautiful woman was so angry that she almost died of anger at him.
“It’s a pity that this old man has so much strength. It’s really infuriating!”
The beautiful woman then looked at Ye Shuo again. He used these seductive tricks before Zhi’er came back. If Zhi’er came back one day, she would be tortured to death by him sooner or later.
After glaring at the two men fiercely, the beautiful woman left in a rage.
Just when the Second Master, the Third Master, and the Sixth Master were trying their best and racking their brains to get rid of the person, the Fourth Prince and his men finally got the news.
Facts have proved that Ye Shuo’s choice was right. When human power was beyond their reach, several eagles worked day and night, as tired as dead dogs, patrolling everywhere within a radius of 100 miles without stopping for a moment. Finally, they found traces of the two people more than 30 miles away.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to go there in person, but firstly, his internal injuries had not healed yet. He could still go about his daily life, but he couldn’t be too tired. Secondly, although what he said sounded good, what if he ran away during the journey?
After much deliberation, Huo Tianyi finally decided to go there in person.
Huo Tianyi personally brought back the Fourth Prince and the Eighth Prince. As for the Fifth Prince, no trace of him was found within a hundred miles. It was estimated that he was either dead or ran away.
Ye Shuo is more inclined to the latter. After all, even if a person dies, there must be a corpse, right?
After a few days, it should be able to float in the water.
When Mei Yingzhuo came out with a tired face, Ye Shuo hurriedly went to greet him: “Fourth Master, how are my fourth brother and eighth brother?”
“The little one just fainted from exhaustion and hunger. He just needs to be nursed back to health for a while. As for the big one…”
It was another familiar pause, but this time the situation was even more grim than last time.
“The older one hit a rock when he was washed down by the water, and his right leg is probably broken.”
After he finished speaking, Ye Shuo was stunned.
Mei Yingzhuo had no feelings for them, so he naturally didn’t care what they thought, and he didn’t deliberately control the volume.
When the Fourth Prince in the room heard this, his hands gripping the quilt silently tightened and his thoughts instantly became confused.

chapters.title: Chapter 179: Master
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The Fourth Prince only appears to be non-competitive on the surface, but he is not really non-competitive.
Concubine Xian only gave birth to one son, so how could she not have high hopes for him?
It was just that compared to the other princes, concubine Xian and the Fourth Prince were not so aggressive.
The emperor is in his prime, and the position of the crown prince is shaken. It is still unknown who will take the throne in the future. The first bird to stick its head out gets shot. It is better to slow down for the time being, and perhaps you will reap miraculous results.
Being born in a royal family, sometimes, not fighting is fighting.
But no one expected such a mistake to happen along the way.
Whether for his future or for his own face, the Fourth Prince would not allow himself to become a cripple.
Not to mention the civil and military ministers, the Fourth Prince could not accept even the gazes from his brothers.
Even though the Fourth Prince looked harmless on weekdays, he was a member of the Ye family after all, and had the same paranoia as the other members of the Ye family.Ye Shuo hadn’t figured out what to say yet, but when he looked up, he saw the Fourth Prince struggling to get up from the bed, and walking to the door while enduring the severe pain.
“Fourth brother!” Ye Shuo hurried to help him.
However, the Fourth Prince’s mind was in a mess, and he was in no mood to pay attention to him. He just stared at Mei Yingzhuo and asked, “Is there any way to cure me?”
He would rather die than be a cripple for the rest of his life.
However, Mei Yingzhuo was too lazy to pay attention to him. After all, it was the another young man who was going to marry into their Medicine Valley, not him.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to help him ask again.
If it could be cured, that would be great. After all, too many lice wouldn’t itch, and too many debts wouldn’t worry. Since the wound had already been opened, it would be better to just eat this bowl of soft rice to the end, instead of being hesitant and ending up losing both sides.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at Mei Yingzhuo.
Mei Yingzhuo: “…”
Not only him, but his whole family. It is rare to be so thick-skinned.
But the problem is that since Mei Yingzhuo has already taken action, if he regrets now, would all his previous efforts be in vain?
With such a huge sacrifice on my side, Medicine Valley will soon become Saving People Valley. If this kid dares to treat Zhi’er badly, Mei Yingzhuo swears to heaven that he will poison his entire family!
Taking a deep breath, Mei Yingzhuo’s tone was unprecedentedly cold: “He can be saved.”
Hearing these words, the Fourth Prince’s eyes suddenly lit up, and infinite hope suddenly surged in his heart.
“But it’s very dangerous.” The next moment, Mei Yingzhuo shattered his hopes with his own hands.
“It would be better to just amputate the right leg, and save your life.”
Extraordinary circumstances call for extraordinary measures. Unlike ordinary doctors, Mei Yingzhuo is best at using poison to treat poison. Many people have been saved by him, but many have also been killed by his treatments. That’s why Mei Yingzhuo is not tolerated by the secular world and has stayed in these deep mountains and forests for so many years.
Normally, when encountering such a difficult patient, Mei Yingzhuo would definitely want to encourage the other party to treat the patient. As for whether the patient was cured or killed, that was the other party’s problem, and he didn’t care about that.
It was only for the sake of his apprentice’s future husband that Mei Yingzhuo wanted to be cautious and save his life, but he didn’t expect that the other party would not appreciate it at all.
Almost the moment the words fell, the Fourth Prince made a decision: “I want to save my legs.”
“You have no say in this matter.” Mei Yingzhuo rejected him mercilessly.
The Fourth Prince had no choice but to look at Ye Shuo beside him, his eyes full of pleading.
This made Ye Shuo suddenly feel troubled. If it were him, he would definitely save his life rather than his leg. Even if he lost his leg, as long as he was still alive, there was still infinite hope. What was the point of saving the leg but losing the body?
But the key is that the Fourth Prince is not him, and the Fourth Prince simply cannot accept his own imperfections.
As a prince, he should be perfect.
Ye Shuo could only advise: “Fourth Brother, since Fourth Master said so, it must be very dangerous. Otherwise… you should think about it again? It’s not too late to make a decision after you think it through.”
“No need.” The fourth prince shook his head: “If I can’t save my right leg, then I would rather die.”
Now that things have come to this, what else can Ye Shuo say?
The two stood there in silent confrontation. The Fourth Prince’s face turned pale, and he was shaky, but he didn’t even take a step back. Ye Shuo really had no choice but to look at Mei Yingzhuo on the side.
“Please, Master Fourth, help me and save my fourth brother.”
Mei Yingzhuo frowned, obviously he didn’t understand why the young man’s brother was so stubborn, but since the other party had spoken, he was happy to study his broken leg.
After getting a positive answer, the Fourth Prince felt relieved and fell down all of a sudden.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo was quick-witted and prevented him from falling to the ground. In the end, he carried him to the bed.
The fourth prince was the most seriously injured, so Mei Yingzhuo naturally focused on him.
Since it was an unconventional method, the whole process was naturally extremely painful. However, it was not known whether it was because of the presence of his stepfather or the presence of the Seventh and Eighth Princes, but in any case, the Fourth Prince did not utter a word during the entire process.
The sheets and quilt covers were torn by him, and several towels were bitten to pieces by him, but the Fourth Prince never cried out in pain.
Such a performance surprised Mei Yingzhuo.
Ye Shuo really couldn’t bear to look at it, so he only stayed in the medicine house for two days and never came back again.
Now, the favour he owed became even bigger.
As he, his adoptive father, the Fourth Prince, the Seventh Prince, and the Eighth Prince were walking on the road, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh.
It looks like I have to sell myself to pay off my debts.
“Xiaojiu.” When passing by the Seventh Prince’s residence, Ye Shuo suddenly heard the other party calling him.
The Seventh Prince did not keep the secret and simply asked, “Fifth Brother…should have been rescued, right?”
Ye Shuo knew about the conflicts between the Seventh Prince, the Fifth Prince, and Concubine Shu, and he also knew that his purpose in asking this question must be not simple.
Ye Shuo opened his mouth, wanting to persuade, but he didn’t know how.
The facts were there and he couldn’t deny it even if he wanted to.
Ye Shuo could only avoid giving a direct answer: “Master found no trace of Fifth Brother.”
Even the eagles with such good eyesight didn’t notice it, and there wasn’t even a corpse. It was almost certain that the fifth brother was lucky.
As to whether it was just luck or someone was helping him, it’s hard to say.
The seventh prince’s eyes flickered slightly, and when he raised his head again, he had returned to normal.
“Ninth brother, thank you again this time.”
The Seventh Prince meant what he said. If it weren’t for him, he would have been washed away by the water long ago. The Seventh Prince didn’t think he could have the same luck as the Fifth Prince.
Ye Shuo waved his hands to show that he didn’t care.
Except for Ye Shuo who was still able to move freely, everyone else was injured or lying down, and no one could run or jump.
Ye Shuo was really bored being alone, and the Medicine Valley in front of him was too simple. When he was in Liangzhou, Ye Shuo had worked in design and decoration. Due to limited conditions, he couldn’t make any big moves, but there was no problem with a small renovation.
It just so happened that although the fifth master was small in stature, he was extremely good at carpentry, the third master had a good aesthetic sense and could draw, and with Ye Shuo as the adviser and the increasing number of servants, it was not difficult to renovate several houses.
The second master just glanced away and found that the third master, who had originally stood with her, had betrayed her.
The Second Master could not help questioning the other party, and the Third Master finally woke up from his dream and told the truth: “I have been in the valley for so many years, and he is the only one who appreciates me.”
The others used to fight and kill, going through wind and rain, and each one was more arrogant than the other, and most of them mocked and ridiculed each other.
They all just said that her paintings were shit, and that even shit was better than this. Only Ye Shuo would praise her and say that her paintings… The Third Master recalled carefully and then remembered that what the other party was talking about seemed to be abstract art.
Although the Third Master did not know what abstract art was, she was sure that this was not a phrase that the young man had made up to fool her.
“So I couldn’t help myself, just…”
The third master lowered her head slightly in shame.
Seeing this, the beautiful woman became even more wary of Ye Shuo.
The young man can praise such ugly things under the third master, he is really a tough guy.
In addition to these, Ye Shuo also has the responsibility of cooking every day. There is no other way. The cooking skills of the several masters are really too poor.
My cheap father and the others can’t get out of bed now. Even if they get out of bed, it will be useless. They can’t be relied on.
No matter how you look at it, Ye Shuo is the only one who can take the leading responsibility.
After eating the food he cooked for a few days, even the beautiful woman couldn’t help but have a thought in her mind –
It would be nice if my disciple could find such a good match.
It’s just a pity that a man like this is destined to not be able to stay with a woman for his entire life.
The beautiful woman had seen too many people like him. He would devote himself to her when he needed her, and discard her like a piece of trash when she wasn’t needed.
Most men in the world are unfaithful, it’s just a matter of time.
The beautiful woman soon came to her senses.
In addition to three meals a day, Ye Shuo would go out fishing, picking mushrooms, catching rabbits, etc. in his spare time. He lived a carefree life.
At first Huo Tianyi was worried that he would run away, but later he found out that he would not even go away if you chased him with a stick, let alone run away.
Huo Tianzhi only knew that there was such a woman in the world, but he didn’t know that there was such a man in the world.
Laugh, laugh, sooner or later you will cry!
The beautiful woman at the side couldn’t help but sneer when she saw this.
Fishing, catching rabbits and shrimps, and researching new menus, while Ye Shuo was busy in the valley, he didn’t know that a few days ago, a group of people came here dozens of miles away from him, but they didn’t stay long and left, so even the eagle didn’t notice them.
When the fifth prince woke up, he found himself on a large carved wooden bed. His second brother was sitting beside him. He seemed to be afraid that he would be too hot, so he fanned him intermittently.
Seeing him wake up, the second prince also regained consciousness.
Without caring about anything else, the Fifth Prince hurriedly got up and said, “Go and save Father and Xiaojiu and the others!”
The second prince paused while holding the folding fan, and then returned to normal in an instant: “I have already given the order.”
After thinking for a while, the second prince added: “That’s why I came here this time.”
No wonder my second brother, who should have been in Beijing, is here.
The fifth prince couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
The Fifth Prince was injured after all, and after he felt relaxed, he soon fell into a deep sleep again. Therefore, the Fifth Prince didn’t know about it. Soon someone came in and reported what happened today.
Although the Second Prince looked worried, he said, “Since there is no harvest today, it must be because the people under us did not search carefully enough. Let them search these two places again carefully.”
Although these two places are the most likely, since we can’t find them, we can’t keep wandering around here, right?
The visitor was about to speak, but he noticed the look in the eyes of the second prince looking back at him, and his objections immediately dissipated.
After this person left, the room soon returned to peace.
In this way, after a few days, fortunately, the eighth prince, who was the least injured, was finally able to get out of bed and walk.
At the same time, a fiery red figure appeared in front of the Medicine Valley.
The fiery red figure was none other than Yao Zhi, who had been travelling outside and had not returned home for a long time.
Yao Zhi didn’t really want to go back. As she grew older, every time she came back she would be urged to get married by the master and his people. Yao Zhi was simply fed up with it.
But there was no way. She had been away for nearly half a year. If she didn’t come back, the master and the others would definitely be angry.
Also, Yao Zhi missed them too.
No matter how good the outside world is, it is not as good as being in front of the master and his people. Yao Zhi just hopes that the master and his people can nag her less this time, and then she will be thankful.
Thinking of this, the woman raised her foot and walked towards Medicine Valley.
Then, as soon as she stepped into the Medicine Valley, the woman saw the young man with his back to her.
The young man seemed to sense something strange behind him and turned around. Yao Zhi was immediately frightened by his appearance and ignored the young man’s current condition.
Her steps suddenly stopped, and then Yao Zhi heard the other party calling out –
“My Lord.”
The young people’s voices are clear and pure, pure and elegant.
The word “lord” can refer to the ruler of a country or the head of a family.
Caught off guard, after realising what the other party was calling her, Yao Zhi, who was usually cool and knowledgeable outside, immediately blushed.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: Guilt
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
At that time, Ye Shuo was processing the fish that had just been caught from the river. He was afraid that his clothes would get dirty when killing the fish. After all, Yao Ren Valley did not look very wealthy, so Ye Shuo specially changed into a set of coarse cloth clothes.
Ye Shuo had soaked in the water for a night, and many things on his body were washed away by the river. His clothes were deformed by the water and could no longer be worn. The fine jade hairpin on his head had now turned into a branch picked from any tree.
But even so, it did not detract from his appearance at all, especially his pair of phoenix eyes, which were slightly smiling and watery, like waves on the river or the sea, so beautiful that staring at his eyes for a long time would give one a thrilling feeling, which would make one’s heart tremble violently.
The straw hairpin and plain clothes make the young man look even more handsome.
As the saying goes, Lang Yan is unique and there is no one like him in the world. This is the case.
A young man of similar age appeared in her home and called her master. Even the knowledgeable Yao Zhi had never seen such a scene before. She suddenly stumbled when she spoke: “Who are you?”
“Why are you in my house?”
“I…” Ye Shuo just opened his mouth and before he could say anything, Huo Tianyi and others who heard the noise came out of the house one after another.
After seeing the disciple he had personally brought up, even Huo Tianyi, who was naturally cold-hearted, couldn’t help but relax his brows.“Hmph, you still remember to come back.” But Huo Tianyi has never been good at expressing himself. Even though he misses her in his heart, he still speaks subconsciously with sarcasm.
Fortunately, Yao Zhi has gotten used to it over the years. She also felt aggrieved in the past, but later she gradually discovered that the master actually loved her very much. Over the time, Yao Zhi gradually learned to ignore those bad words.
Ye Shuo who was standing by knew that these master and disciples had not seen each other for a long time and must have a lot to talk about. It was not convenient for an outsider like him to participate in them, so he whispered, “Young apprentice and the masters, please chat slowly. I will go to prepare dinner for you.” After that, he did not say much and sat back on the stool quietly.
Yao Zhi’s attention was immediately drawn to it.
For some reason, Yao Zhi felt that the young man was lonely and pitiful, and almost ignored what the masters were saying.
The beautiful woman noticed this detail, and when she saw that her disciple’s gaze subconsciously followed him, her expression froze.
Didn’t they just meet?
If I had known that Zhi’er would come back today, I would have locked this young man in the room and not let him out!
But if Zhi’er knew about that, I’m afraid she would pity him even more.
The beautiful woman was so angry that when she turned around and saw Huo Tianyi standing there completely unaware of anything, she became even angrier.
Looking at Huo Tianyi again, he didn’t feel any sense of crisis at this moment. He was still looking his apprentice up and down. Seeing that his apprentice was not injured, Huo Tianyi immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
While talking about something, several people came to the yard where Huo Tianyi lived.
At the last moment, Yao Zhi’s gaze was still on the young man with his head lowered, processing the fish and shrimp in his hands.
About half a minute later, Yao Zhi could no longer hold back, and while the masters were asking questions, she quickly asked, “Who is that young man at the door just now?”
At this moment, even the most silent Master Six could not drink the tea in her hand anymore. She just felt very upset.
Huo Tianyi heard this, not only did he not feel ashamed, but he was very proud: “This is something that I found outside the valley with great difficulty, and I specially found a way to get him into the valley to be your husband. How about it, isn’t he much better than your senior brother?”
“If you are satisfied, the Master will choose an auspicious day for you two to get married.”
Yao Zhi had a vague premonition from the beginning. Based on her understanding of the masters, they would not easily let strangers in. Now, after listening to the whole process, Yao Zhi felt a surge of anger rushing to her forehead.
In the past, the masters only forced people with words, but now they directly lure people into the Medicine Valley!
No wonder, no wonder the young man looked like that, now it all makes sense.
Yao Zhi was furious: “Master, didn’t you promise me that you wouldn’t do bad things again?”
Huo Tianyi didn’t care when he heard this: “We both agree, how can it be considered a bad thing?”
In Huo Tianyi’s opinion, it is fair for the young man to marry his apprentice and for him to rescue his father and brother. How can it be considered a bad thing?
Indeed, to be honest, Huo Tianyi’s behaviour cannot be said to be bad, but he is definitely taking advantage of someone in distress.
“Besides, he himself agreed to it.”
As for how Ye Shuo himself felt, Huo Tianyi didn’t care.
This is probably what Yao Zhi cannot understand. Even if the master does not save her, she will not say anything. It is her own business if she wants to save him. Even Yao Zhi cannot force the master to have a chivalrous heart.
But forcing people to sell their bodies… How is this different from being a bully?
A choice with options is a choice, and a choice without options is not a choice at all.
There is only one path in front of you, and it is a joke for others to tell you that it is your own choice.
This can only be a sacrifice that is forced upon us.
“…I’ll send him out of the valley right now.” This young man was indeed born with a good-looking appearance, and Yao Zhi was indeed bewitched by him just now, but she still couldn’t accept it.
Yao Zhi stood up and was about to leave.
Then, Huo Tianyi said behind her: “It’s useless. His father and brothers are still here. Even if you chase him away now, he won’t leave.”
Upon hearing this, Yao Zhi paused, bit her lower lip, and finally wanted to listen to what the young man himself had to say.
The beautiful woman was worried about the two of them being alone together, so she followed them immediately.
Looking at the old man who looked so calm and composed, sitting there leisurely drinking tea as if he had everything under control, the beautiful woman really wanted to eat him alive.
When Yao Zhi went out again, she found that Ye Shuo, who had been there just now, had disappeared at some point, while smoke was rising from the kitchen not far away.
Yao Zhi walked into the kitchen at a very clever time, just in time to catch Ye Shuo putting the fish into the pot.
With a “sizzle” sound, as soon as the fish in Ye Shuo’s hand was put into the pot, the big black pot in front of him immediately began to emit billowing smoke.
Ancient stoves were like this, good in every way except that the smoke from oil and firewood could not be controlled. Ye Shuo would be choked every time. In addition, his internal injuries had not healed yet, so when he coughed, it would inevitably affect his injuries.
After a while, a thin layer of sweat appeared on the tip of Ye Shuo’s nose.
Ye Shuo took after his mother, with naturally fair skin. When he coughed and frowned, he looked even weaker and more pitiable.
When the beautiful woman saw this scene, her teeth were about to break.
Sure enough, my premonition was right, this young man was indeed a demon!
I had never seen him so delicate before, but when my apprentice came back, he immediately became delicate.
The beautiful woman hurried to see her disciple, and as expected, all of her disciple’s attention was now attracted by him.
Yao Zhi didn’t think much about it and immediately tried to snatch the spatula from Ye Shuo’s hand.
However, Ye Shuo seemed to have sensed it already. After dodging, he gently pushed her aside with one hand.
“Young apprentice, there is a lot of fumes in the kitchen, which is not good for a girl’s skin. Young apprentice, please wait outside. The food will be ready soon.”
Ye Shuo is a grown man, so naturally he is not worried about this.
Since Huo Tianyi had found his fourth brother and eighth brother one after another, and Mei Yingzhuo had tried his best to treat his fourth brother’s leg every day, Ye Shuo returned the favor. Seeing that the disciple that several people had talked about had returned, he specially spent some extra effort and prepared a big meal.
In summer, clothes were thin, and Yao Zhi only felt a slight heat on her back before he pushed her away.
Yao Zhi saw that the Second Master was staring at this place non-stop. Yao Zhi had just returned and was unsure of the Second Master’s attitude for a moment. After thinking for a while, Yao Zhi finally whispered: “Come here, I want to tell you something.”
“Wait a moment.” Ye Shuo took some boiling water from a stove next to him and stewed the two fish. He then picked up the towel next to him and wiped his hands before walking to Yao Zhi’s side.
It was obviously a cheap coarse cloth, but in his hands, it seemed like expensive silk. His every move revealed an indescribable pride.
“Young apprentice, what do you want me to do?” When Ye Shuo came closer, Yao Zhi suddenly realised that he was much taller than her.
Especially since the kitchen was dim, Yao Zhi felt as if she was completely enveloped by this young man.
The next moment, a refreshing breath like pine and cypress, which was unique to young people, came. When Yao Zhi looked up again, she met his eyes.
His pair of auspicious phoenix eyes seemed to be able to speak, revealing a hint of doubt in them.
The distance was so close that Yao Zhi could even see his tall nose, flawless skin like jade, and two slightly parted lips…
If this happened to any other girl, she would probably lose her composure on the spot.
Even though Yao Zhi had been in the underworld for many years, she could still feel the heat constantly rising to her face.
Yao Zhi controlled herself and did not retreat, and managed to maintain her composure on the surface.
Subconsciously looking away and not daring to look any further, Yao Zhi whispered, “Do you want to go out? I can take you out.”
Ye Shuo was slightly surprised when he heard this, but then he shook his head: “I can’t leave, my father and my brothers are still here.”
Yao Zhi couldn’t help feeling a little worried when she heard this.
This young man doesn’t plan to leave, what should she do?
Just when Yao Zhi was a little confused, she heard him say, “Young apprentice Master, can you help Shuo’er?”
Yao Zhi was stunned for a moment: “What help?”
“Grand Master and the others value the Young apprentice very much, and Shuo’er must now depend on the Young apprentice. If the Young apprentice is unwilling, then for GrandMaster and the others, Shuo’er will have no value in existence.” In short, the woman in front of him is the key to everything.
“So Shuo’er would like to ask the young valley apprentice to stay in this Medicine Man Valley for a while longer.”
Yao Zhi watched the young man in front of her and it seemed that she found it difficult to speak when he said this. Her eyelashes trembled slightly at first, and then quickly drooped.
Yao Zhi immediately got excited and said, “No problem!”
Realising that her voice seemed a little loud, Yao Zhi quickly lowered her voice and said, “Don’t worry.”
Even if the young man didn’t mention it, Yao Zhi couldn’t just leave without resolving his problem.
The beautiful woman watched the whole process. Although she did not hear what the two people discussed, her heart sank to the bottom.
In addition to the two fish, Ye Shuo also cooked shrimps, grilled mushrooms, roasted lamb, etc., and soon filled the table.
In addition, to express his gratitude, Ye Shuo specially steamed the yam, mashed it into a paste, poured wild honey and jam on it, and made a special dessert for Yao Zhi.
No one else, including several female masters, has this position, only Yao Zhi has it.
“Young apprentice, Masters, I’m going to deliver food to my father and fourth brother.”
Soon, Ye Shuo left with the food box.
Looking at the other person’s back, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel soft-hearted.
Such a filial and gentle young man was forcibly abducted by his master. The master was too much this time!
The beautiful woman and the disfigured woman looked at each other, and a few words emerged in their minds at the same time –
Big, momentum, already, gone.
The other side.
After handing the other separately packed meals to several servants and asking them to deliver them to his four brothers respectively, Ye Shuo lifted his clothes and came to his stepfather alone.
After so many days of recuperation, my cheap dad was finally able to sit up. I guess he will be able to get out of bed in two days.
While eating, Emperor Jingwen thought of something and asked casually, “What happened today? Why is it so lively outside?”
Ye Shuo paused, cleared his throat, and said, “My future wife is back.”
Unexpectedly, a deafening coughing sound suddenly broke out in the room.
Then, as expected, Ye Shuo was almost beaten out by his stepfather with a stick.
Picking up the wooden bowl on the ground and putting it back into the food box, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but imagine the image of the young apprentice in fiery red clothes.
I have to say, this girl is quite cute when she blushes.
After a moment, Ye Shuo chuckled.
When Ye Shuo returned to the kitchen, there was no one there. Only a few servants were dealing with the leftovers. After handing the food box to them, Ye Shuo left quickly.
It was getting dark, and Ye Shuo went back to his room to sleep. As luck would have it, he ran into Yao Zhi at the door.
Seeing the lock of the main house in the yard being opened, Ye Shuo was startled, and then a look of understanding flashed in his eyes.
Yao Zhi had never expected that the master would arrange for this young man to live in the side room of her courtyard before she came back!
Ye Shuo’s originally pale face gradually turned a little red, and he looked embarrassed, as if he wanted to say something but didn’t know what to say.
Yao Zhi’s brain exploded with a buzzing sound. At the same time, Yao Zhi’s sense of guilt instantly reached its peak.
Because just now, Yao Zhi, who always claimed to be chivalrous, actually had evil thoughts towards this powerless young man in front of her…

chapters.title: Chapter 181: It is over
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Yao Zhi was immediately frightened by the thought that flashed through her mind.
For a moment, Yao Zhi actually felt that it would be a good idea to let him stay.
Having been out there for so many years, Yao Zhi had seen countless despicable people, but this was the first time she had experienced such a thing.
Everyone has bad habits. Yao Zhi had never come into contact with the dark side deep in her heart before, so it was normal that she couldn’t accept it for a while.
She didn’t dare to stay any longer and just ran away after saying “I’m tired, I’m going to rest.”
Looking at the other person’s slightly flustered back, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh silently.
Before, Ye Shuo was a little worried about what he would do when the Young apprentice came back, but he didn’t expect that the Young Valley apprentice would be such an interesting person.
It was especially interesting when the girl’s cheeks were red and she was trying to maintain her composure.
Ye Shuo couldn’t control his evil thoughts any more.After returning to the room, closing the door and calming down, Yao Zhi suddenly felt annoyed. She felt that she had been in the underworld for so many years and had been a fool. She shouldn’t have panicked over such a small matter.
Fortunately, the young man was gentle and simple, and did not notice it, otherwise Yao Zhi would really have been unable to live as a human being.
Yao Zhi was making the bed while thinking about something randomly.
When she finished her work, she found the young man still in the yard, apparently sorting out the clothes he had washed during the day. Under the moonlight, the young man’s figure was tall and slender, like a pine or bamboo, tough and beautiful.
Seeing that the other party seemed to be about to turn around, Yao Zhi got excited and quickly blew out the candle on the table.
The main room in the yard suddenly became dark.
When Yao Zhi came to her senses, she was shocked to realise what she had done.
Really, there was a window between them and he wouldn’t know that I was looking at him through the gap. After realising this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel a little annoyed.
Ye Shuo in the yard seemed not to notice that the candle not far away suddenly went out. He took the dried clothes into the house. Ye Shuo quickly fetched two basins of water from the water tank in the yard.
It is September now, the height of summer. Even though it is relatively cool in the mountains, it is inevitable to sweat a lot throughout the day.
Due to limited conditions, Ye Shuo could not take a hot bath, so he usually filled two basins of water and wiped his body at night.
Usually, Ye Shuo is the only one in the yard, and he basically does everything in the yard.
But isn’t Yao Zhi here right now? After all, she’s a girl, so Ye Shuo can’t go out shirtless.
But the problem is, sometimes the more you cover up, the more alluring you are. Half-covering your face is actually more tempting than being naked.
Especially when looking from the dark to the light, under the reflection of candlelight, Ye Shuo’s every move was cast on the paper-pasted window.
He first took off the mosquito repellent sachet from his waist and placed it on the table, then took off his coat. Then Yao Zhi saw every move he made clearly.
When he seemed to be starting to take off his innermost underwear, Yao Zhi immediately lay down, not daring to continue watching.
Lying on the familiar bed, Yao Zhi tossed and turned, unable to sleep, her mind filled with the silhouette on the window.
After about an incense stick of time, she heard the sound of a door opening in the side room.
There was a “squeak”, followed by the sound of splashing water. It seemed that his evening wash was over.
By the time Yao Zhi fell asleep again, it was already the second half of the night.
Compared to her, Ye Shuo slept soundly.
I don’t know if it was because she had something on her mind or if the shock she received that day was too great, but poor Yao Zhi had dreamt all night. The dream was full of strange things and everything. In the end, Yao Zhi woke up half an hour earlier than before.
It was still dark, and after Yao Zhi opened her eyes she couldn’t fall asleep.
There was no choice but for Yao Zhi to get up. At this time, as expected, Ye Shuo’s room door was still closed.
Unlike Yao Zhi and other standard martial artists, although Ye Shuo also practises martial arts, he still has to sleep until dawn before getting up.
After all, this yard belongs to Yao Zhi. In the past, Yao Zhi was used to putting her toiletries in the side room. Some things needed for martial arts practice, such as sandbags, were also placed in the side room. However, now another person has moved into the side room. Yao Zhi feels a little regretful. If she had known earlier, she should have taken out those things she needed last night.
Yao Zhi felt inexplicably awkward, as if she was not the owner of this courtyard, but Ye Shuo was.
Yao Zhi hesitated at the door for a long time. Just when she was about to give up and endure for a day, she suddenly heard the voice of a young man coming from inside the house.
“Who is it…?”
Perhaps because he had just woken up, his voice was a little hoarse, but still very pleasant to hear.
Yao Zhi subconsciously stopped: “Yes…it’s me.”
What was she doing here so early?
Ye Shuo didn’t think too much about it and asked.
When he learned that she was here to get something, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say, “Come in…”
Only then did Yao Zhi realise that he didn’t even lock the door when he slept.
Was he too unguarded towards others? No wonder he was easily lured back by the master.
Yao Zhi was about to remind him, but when she turned around, she saw that the young man was so sleepy that he could not open his eyes. His soft undergarment made of fine cotton was loose. If he made any big movement at this moment, the undergarment would probably no longer be able to cover it.
The young man was about to wake up, looking drowsy. From his defenceless posture, one could tell that he must have lived in an extremely stable and wealthy environment since he was a child.
Yao Zhi quickly gathered what she needed and left without even looking back.
Ye Shuo opened his eyes a little, but soon he could no longer resist the sleepiness and fell into a deep sleep again.
After Yao Zhi finished practising martial arts in the open space outside, she ran around the valley several times and even finished her breakfast, but Ye Shuo was still not awake.
Could something have happened?
On the way, Yao Zhi even ran into the Eighth Prince, and thought that Ye Shuo was just like his brother, with almost the same schedule. In addition, there were not many entertainment activities in ancient times, so everyone went to bed early and naturally got up early.
It’s rare to find someone as sleepy as Ye Shuo.
Seeing that her disciple seemed inattentive and looked into her garden from time to time, the beautiful woman could hardly maintain her expression.
Because Huo Tianyi brought many servants during this period, although these servants could not cook as well as Ye Shuo, they had no problem making porridge in the morning. Ye Shuo did not have to get up early and even had to prepare breakfast himself.
Huo Tianyi and his friends finished eating quickly, and Mei Yingzhuo subconsciously ordered the servants to clean up the kitchen. However, just as he finished speaking, Yao Zhi next to him said, “Wait!”
Yao Zhi pointed at the steamed buns and porridge and said, “Don’t you need to leave some for… for Mr. Gu?”
Everyone has eaten, but the young man seems to have not eaten yet?
The beautiful woman, the Sixth Master, and the Third Master put down their bowls and chopsticks almost at the same time, and then all looked at Huo Tianyi, who was in the lead.
For some reason, even Huo Tianyi, who never cared about these little things, felt something inexplicably uncomfortable in his heart.
But he didn’t know why he was so uncomfortable, and his tone became a little bad: “Who asked him to get up so late? We are not his servants, why should we leave food for him?”
Yao Zhi was stunned for a moment, then reacted: “So, he didn’t have breakfast before I came back?”
That being said, Huo Tianyi always felt something was odd.
When Yao Zhi looked at the master again, there was a hint of condemnation in her eyes.
Forcing people to make such a choice and abducting them is one thing, but not only not giving them enough food, but also asking them to help cook for everyone. The master is really too harsh.
However, all this was done for herself. Anyone could say that the master was not good, except Yao Zhi.
Yao Zhi could only tell him that what he did was wrong, but she could not force him to do what he thought was right.
Yao Zhi was unable to change the master’s attitude towards Ye Shuo, but she could secretly save a portion of her own rations for Ye Shuo.
The beautiful woman noticed this scene and her teeth were about to break.
Seeing that the flowers she had raised for so many years would soon belong to someone else, the beautiful woman thought about it and felt that she couldn’t go on like this.
The beautiful woman made a prompt decision and decided to have a talk with her apprentice, and to tell her how sinister the men like the young man were.
The beautiful woman only hated that when she let her apprentice go out to explore the world, the man only mentioned how he would use sweet words to deceive the woman, what means he would use to force the woman to obey him, and how unfaithful the man would be, what kind of words he would say and what kind of things he would do, but forgot to tell her that there were such means.
Not to mention Yao Zhi, it was the first time for the beautiful woman to see Ye Shuo like this.
However, the young man’s methods were much more advanced than those of other men.
Feeling pity is a taboo for women. Women are born with soft hearts. If she feels pity for a man, she is not far from falling.
Why didn’t I think of this?
The beautiful woman stopped Yao Zhi just as she walked into the yard. However, before she could say anything, she heard the young man’s voice coming from the side room.
“Young apprentice, can you give Shuo’er a favour?”
Seeing that his door was open, Yao Zhi was hesitating whether to give him the buns and porridge in her hand, but unexpectedly he spoke first.
Yao Zhi immediately stopped caring about her second master.
“What’s the matter?”
“Can you help me get another branch from outside? I accidentally broke the branch I used to tie my hair this morning because I used too much force.”
The sound came from far away and Ye Shuo walked out with his hair loose and a look of slight distress on his face.
“Look.” As he said this, he spread out his hand, and on the palm of the young man’s hand, there was a branch that had been broken into two.
Perhaps a branch broke and scratched his hand, and suddenly a striking red mark appeared on his wrist. The red mark was particularly eye-catching under the sun and hurt people’s eyes.
The beautiful woman took a breath of cold air almost instantly, her heart felt cold, and she no longer had any hope.
Finished.
It’s all over now.

chapters.title: Chapter 182: You Deserve It
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
It was just a branch. There were many of them everywhere in the mountain. Yao Zhi quickly picked one for him.
But when Yao Zhi gave him the branch, she quickly regretted it.
The branch that was picked at random was too sloppy, and it really didn’t match him. It was fine when viewed alone, but when the branch was inserted into his hair, it didn’t match at all.
She didn’t even pick all the buds off the branches, and the creases were very rough. She should have shaved them smoother.
Yao Zhi was used to hanging around in the underworld, and she no longer had the carefulness and gentleness of an ordinary girl. In addition, Yao Zhi’s temperament was also rough, so why would she care about this?
But now, Yao Zhi’s mind kept flashing back to the hairpin that the young man used to tie his hair. She always felt that everything about it was not good, and she always felt that she should give him something better.
At least, it can’t be like it is now.
It’s a bit too shabby.
“…Zhi’er? Zhi’er?”Just when Yao Zhi was distracted, she suddenly heard Huo Tianyi calling her.
Yao Zhi suddenly woke up.
Huo Tianyi was also a little puzzled. When he taught this child swordsmanship in the past, she was the most focused. Why did she seem a little absent-minded today?
“Are you feeling uncomfortable somewhere?”
Suddenly, Yao Zhi made a decision in her heart.
“Master, I suddenly remembered that I have something else to do. I’m leaving now!”
After much thought, Yao Zhi finally couldn’t bear it anymore.
Looking at his disciple’s hurried back, Huo Tianyi thought that she had made another breakthrough in swordsmanship and was busy gaining insights, and he was immediately relieved.
In the entire Medicine Valley, Master Five’s carpentry skills were the best, and Yao Zhi naturally learned some skills from him as well.
I can’t say about big jobs, but making some small things is no problem at all.
When Yao Zhi came to her senses, there was already a piece of peach wood in her hand.
The other side.
Looking at Ye Shuo who was leisurely eating buns and drinking porridge, the beautiful woman inhaled and exhaled, and after repeating this several times, she forced herself not to attack him.
But she was not so polite when she spoke. Even though she was always charming, she couldn’t help but sneer when she treated Ye Shuo: “You have someone to serve you food, you are living a comfortable life.”
Ye Shuo didn’t take it seriously, he smiled and said shyly: “Since I am already the young valley apprentice’s man, it’s just a meal, I think it’s still okay.”
Ever since Zhi’er came back yesterday, this young man has become a different person, revealing the coquettish aura of a vixen everywhere. What’s more, he is handsome and his pretentious attitude is very seductive.
But after Zhi’er left, he changed into a completely different person, which was really infuriating.
If I had even a third of his ability back then, I wouldn’t have ended up like this…
Suppressing her anger, the beautiful woman couldn’t help but sneer: “If I tell you that the food you are eating now was taken from Zhi’er’s share, would you still feel at ease eating it?”
Ye Shuo was stunned. Obviously, he didn’t expect that this was what Yao Zhi saved for him.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a slight warmth in his heart.
This girl is cute and a little honest.
The beautiful woman thought that the young man in front of her would be moved after hearing this, but she didn’t expect that after she finished speaking, he not only did not stop, but ate even faster.
“Since the young valley apprentice specially left it for me, I should eat more.” If I waste it, I will be letting down the other party’s kindness.
“you–!”
The young man was shameless and the beautiful woman had no way to deal with him. In the end, she walked out angrily with a cold face.
Soon, Ye Shuo ate up all the porridge and buns in the lunch box.
As usual, after visiting his cheap father and the others, Ye Shuo prepared to go to the mountains to collect some wild honey.
A few days ago, he discovered traces of bees in the forest, but the sudden arrival of the Fourth Prince and the Eighth Prince interrupted his search. Now that they have settled down, it is time to look for the beehive.
Ye Shuo went up the mountain carrying a long knife.
“Master, I’ll be back before lunch.”
Looking at the young man who knocked on the door, walked in, picked up the long sword in his collection and left, Huo Tianyi couldn’t help but twitch his mouth slightly.
Isn’t he too much of an outsider?
Ye Shuo’s attitude was very natural. When Huo Tianyi nodded, he didn’t even bother to be polite to him.
About an hour later, sitting alone in the corner of the valley, looking at the peach wood hairpin in her hand, Yao Zhi felt extremely satisfied.
The red mark on Ye Shuo’s wrist unconsciously emerged in her mind, and Yao Zhi polished the edges of the wooden hairpin to make it smoother.
Yao Zhi used all her skills to carve this peach wood hairpin into a delicate and beautiful shape, especially the cloud pattern on it, which is both elegant and noble.
In addition to this peach wood hairpin, she also made a peach wood hair crown for Ye Shuo.
When Yao Zhi handed the branch to him, she noticed that the young man only had a piece of cloth tied on his head, which looked too shabby.
Yao Zhi brushed off the sawdust on her body, rubbed her numb calves, and when she stood up, she put the two things into her arms.
Although Yao Zhi was a girl who lived in the underworld, she knew that things like hairpins and purses could not be given away easily, so she had no intention of giving them to him in her own name from the beginning, so she specifically found a corner where no one was.
Yao Zhi happened to meet the master on the way. After thinking it over, she decided to ask the master to pass it on.
The master is the most tight-lipped and the most aloof. He is the one who is least likely to gossip in the Medicine Valley.
When Huo Tianyi saw the hairpin and the crown, his eyes widened.
The carvings on these hairpins and crowns are extremely exquisite. The smell of tung oil has not yet dissipated, and you can tell at a glance that they were freshly carved.
Huo Tianyi watched Yao Zhi grow up. For so many years, his disciple had never carved a hairpin for him!
Huo Tianyi was so excited that he actually said what he was thinking.
Yao Zhi was stunned for a moment, and couldn’t help but look at the master’s hair, which was also a tattered piece of cloth, but…
“Master, you never mentioned it to me…”
If Ye Shuo hadn’t taken the initiative to ask her for the branch, given Yao Zhi’s personality, she would definitely not have thought of these things.
Huo Tianyi was originally reluctant to give up his old face, but after thinking about it, he felt really depressed, so after a while, Huo Tianyi finally spoke up: “Then you also carve one for me.”
“No problem, Master.” Yao Zhi was very good-tempered and nodded immediately.
It was just a hairpin, and it didn’t take much effort for her.
One is a handsome young man, the other is an old man in his seventies with a face full of wrinkles. One is gentle and tactful, the other opens his mouth directly to ask for it. Such a contrast is really tragic.
Fortunately, Yao Zhi didn’t mind. If it were someone else, he would probably have cursed.
How can an old man compare with a young man in his prime? It’s good enough to have a piece of cloth.
After handing the hairpin and crown to the master, Yao Zhi looked around, but did not see Ye Shuo. She subconsciously asked, “Where is Master Gu?”
Huo Tianyi was happy for just a moment before the anger returned and he felt even more uncomfortable.
“Go up the mountain!”
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but frown when she heard this. The mountain was full of wild animals and it was so dangerous, what was he doing there?
Ignoring the master’s anger, Yao Zhi asked with a little concern: “Did he say where he was going? When will he be back?”
Huo Tianyi: “…”
Huo Tianyi spoke almost word by word: “Dig wild honey, and be back at noon.”
Yao Zhi stood up in an instant.
Judging from the way Ye Shuo and his companions were dressed and behaved, they must have come from a wealthy family. How could a young man from a wealthy family know the dangers of the mountains? If he wasn’t careful, he might be eaten by the tigers and wolves in the mountains.
He had just arrived and didn’t know the dangers. She even forgot to inform him in advance, not to mention that his injuries hadn’t healed yet. Yao Zhi felt a little annoyed.
“Master, why didn’t you stop him?”
“Forget it.” This was not part of the master’s job.
Yao Zhi walked outside without thinking, intending to go look for him herself: “Zixiao! Come on, take me to find him!”
Watching his disciple’s actions, Huo Tianyi couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
In Huo Tianyi’s opinion, before his apprentice came back, the boy was running around the mountains and fields freely, so how could he be so pampered?
How come in the eyes of his apprentice, that boy is like a porcelain doll, who can’t be touched here or there?
I can only say that Huo Tianyi doesn’t know what a male demon is. You have seduced his soul away, so what the other party says is what it is?
When the beautiful woman next door heard the noise and came out, she saw Huo Tianyi sitting there stupidly. The beautiful woman sneered on the spot.
“You deserve it.”
Just when Huo Tianyi was full of confusion, Yao Zhi quickly found Ye Shuo’s trace under the guidance of several eagles.
Ye Shuo had been here for some time and was no longer unfamiliar with the movements of eagles. When he heard the eagle’s cry above his head, he didn’t even raise his head.
He carefully cut off the beehive and put it into a box. In ancient times, there were no professional protective tools like those in modern times. Although Ye Shuo had covered himself tightly in advance, he was still stung by the bees several times.
Fortunately, these are just ordinary bees. They are not poisonous at all. They just hurt, but there is nothing else to worry about.
By the time Yao Zhi arrived, Ye Shuo had already finished his work.
He didn’t expect the other party to come over at this time. Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, then quickly put the gauze dress wrapped around himself on her, and without waiting for the bee to react, he pulled her hand and ran away.
Yao Zhi only felt her vision being blocked by the gauze dress, and then her hand fell into his hand.
The young man’s hands were big and hot, with distinct joints. Yao Zhi almost forgot that she knew martial arts.
When the two of them ran all the way to the river at the foot of the mountain, Yao Zhi looked at the young man who was panting with his hands on his hips, and the sweat on his forehead kept dripping onto the stones under his feet. She didn’t know if it was because of tiredness or something else, but her heart was beating so fast that she could not hear any other sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Sober
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
In the end, Ye Shuo was the first to speak.
Leaning over and gently lifting the gauze covering her body, Ye Shuo asked, “Are you okay?”
“No, it’s okay…” Yao Zhi dodged and didn’t dare to look the young man in the eye. She had none of the heroic spirit she had outside.
After she calmed down a little, Yao Zhi quickly realized that something was wrong.
“Ah! Your neck!” Yao Zhi noticed two bee stings on his neck. When she thought of the gauze dress he had just given her, she immediately became anxious.
But in fact, the bees had already found Ye Shuo before she came, and it had nothing to do with her.
Ye Shuo told the truth, but Yao Zhi didn’t believe it at all. She just thought he said it on purpose to make herself feel better.
The timing of her passing was so unfortunate. Yao Zhi didn’t know when she became so reckless, messing up even the smallest things.
Yao Zhi felt extremely guilty.But now is not the time to talk about this. Yao Zhi said quickly: “Don’t touch these two places. Wait here. I will find some herbs for you.”
Yao Zhi is still very intimidating when she is serious.
Ye Shuo thought about it and finally sat down obediently.
About an incense stick of time later, Yao Zhi brought back a huge pile of herbs. The number was so large that even Ye Shuo was shocked.
Perhaps because she walked too fast, Yao Zhi was sweating and her peach-like face turned red.
Ye Shuo was about to speak, but he saw her raise her chin without saying a word, and then took out a few needles from her waist.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo immediately shut his mouth.
Carefully picking out the two bee stings, Yao Zhi crushed the dandelion leaves and applied them to the two places that were covered by the bees. After everything was done, she breathed a sigh of relief: “I hope it doesn’t cause heat poisoning.”
Ye Shuo blinked.
Yao Zhi then noticed how close the two of them were. The young man looked at her with pure kindness in his eyes. She looked at her hand again, which was now placed on his chin. As the young man swallowed, his Adam’s apple rolled up and down…
Yao Zhi felt as if she was scalded and quickly retracted her hand.
Ye Shuo smacked his lips, and actually felt a little moved.
Then Ye Shuo cleared his cough, and Yao Zhi immediately woke up.
“The wild honey has been collected, and it’s time for you to return.”
“But…” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but raise his hand.
“I haven’t finished preparing the food for today yet.”
The valley was too far away from the outside world. It would take Huo Tianyi a whole day to go back and forth using his lightness skills, so there was naturally no way for him to get fresh fruits and vegetables.
Fortunately, Master Five is very good at making traps, and the surrounding natural resources are extremely abundant, so the people in the entire Medicine Valley can meet their daily needs by relying on these mountains and rivers.
Nowadays, Ye Shuo is basically in charge of the food ingredients in Yaoren Valley.
“I plan to catch some fish and pick some mushrooms and wild vegetables…”
Before Ye Shuo finished speaking, he saw Yao Zhi picking up a few stones from the ground. She noticed some movement in the water not far away and immediately threw one of the stones out.
Then, a fish floated up with its belly turned upside down.
Yao Zhi has lived in the Medicine Valley for more than 20 years. She knows everything here very well, and is especially familiar with how to hunt.
Ye Shuo had only been outside for two years, so he was naturally far inferior to her in this regard.
This move by the opponent made Ye Shuo’s eyes light up immediately, and he did not hide his curiosity and amazement: “How did you do it?”
“Young apprentice, can you teach me?”
This is actually a very simple skill, but in the eyes of the young man, it seems like something extraordinary.
Although Ye Shuo thought it was indeed amazing, if it were placed in modern times, it would be a unique skill and one would have no problem making a living from it.
For some reason, under such gazes, Yao Zhi suddenly felt a little overwhelmed.
When Yao Zhi woke up, there were six fish, a pile of wild vegetables and mushrooms, and a little wild boar lying at her feet.
Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi took great pains and moved all the things back in three trips.
Previously, in order to treat Ye Shuo’s bee sting, Yao Zhi collected too many herbs. She had no place to process them, and it would be a waste to throw them away, so in the end she gave them all to Mei Yingzhuo.
Mei Yingzhuo looked at these herbs that were picked in a rather rough manner and couldn’t help but feel puzzled. Didn’t he teach his apprentice medical skills a long time ago, and even taught her how to prepare medicinal materials? Why did she forget them after growing up?
