Ye Shuo lit the fire skillfully. While he was cooking, Huo Tianyi walked in and threw something into Ye Shuo’s arms.
Ye Shuo hurriedly caught it and it almost fell to the ground.
Ye Shuo took a closer look and found that it was actually a hairpin and a hair crown. Although both were made of peach wood, they were extremely delicate, especially the cloud pattern on them, which showed the ingenuity of the person who made these two things.
Huo Tianyi didn’t want to give it at first, but there were only so many people in Yaoren Valley. If he didn’t give it, his disciples would soon know about it.
Putting the things into Ye Shuo’s hands, Huo Tianyi couldn’t help but said angrily: “Here, these two things are for you.”
After all, it was his disciple’s good intention, Huo Tianyi felt uneasy, and emphasised: “Protect it well, if it is damaged or broken, I will hold you accountable!”
Ye Shuo didn’t expect that the girl would specially make these two things just because of his words.
As for why Ye Shuo knew that these two items were from Yao Zhi, he had just finished talking about the hairpin when he got up in the morning, and the hairpin was in his hand at noon. Who else could it be if not her?
The master didn’t have the leisure to do that.
Ye Shuo pondered for a moment and temporarily handed the work at hand to the servant beside him. Then, under the gaze of Huo Tianyi, he untied his hair that he had tied up with great difficulty and put on the peach wood hair crown and peach wood hairpin.
“Thank you, Master. I have received your kindness.”
Huo Tianyi always felt weird when he heard this.
“Just take it, why are you talking so intimately?!”
Ye Shuo smiled but did not answer.
Seeing her disciple suddenly becoming uneasy, the beautiful woman’s hands under the table creaked.
When his adoptive father and the others were around, Ye Shuo usually didn’t eat with the people in Yaoren Valley. The Eighth Prince was able to move freely now, and his injuries were almost healed, so Ye Shuo was not as careful with him as he was with his adoptive father.
“Look at this crown and hairpin on my head. What do you think?”
The Eighth Prince was caught off guard and was stunned. After he realised what was happening, he didn’t know whether to laugh or cry: “Xiao Jiu, it seems that you have been doing well these days.”
None of his other brothers, including his father, lived as freely as he did.
Even in these deep mountains and forests, Xiaojiu feels like a fish in water.
At first, the Eighth Prince was a little worried that carrying such a heavy burden on him would make him depressed, but now he is relieved. However, the Eighth Prince still has to remind him what needs to be reminded.
“Okay Xiaojiu, stop playing.”
The Eighth Prince and others were not used to dealing with these people from the underworld, so they basically just stayed at the other end of the Medicine Valley.
But even so, it doesn’t mean that the Eighth Prince knows nothing about what’s happening outside.
“Be careful not to overdo it, or you’ll lose yourself.”
Hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frown: “Who said I was playing?” Ye Shuo is not like this to everyone, and not everyone is worth his attention.
The Eighth Prince laughed: “Otherwise, can you really marry that girl into our family?”
This Medicine Valley might be very impressive in the eyes of the people in the martial arts world, but it is nothing in the eyes of the royal family. Any team can annihilate them all here.
And how could a mere chivalrous woman be a match for the prince?
A woman like Yao Zhi could be played with outside, but how could she be brought home? Wouldn’t that make people laugh?
“Play is play, but don’t make it too ugly. It’s best not to have children, otherwise it will be very troublesome.” The eighth prince rarely reminded someone like this, and this was considered earnest advice.
In an instant, the dream was shattered.
Ye Shuo returned to reality almost instantly.
Perhaps to My cheap dad and the others, everything that happened in the Medicine Valley was just a dream, and they might even regard it as a shame.
Ye Shuo alone may never be able to change their minds.
Ye Shuo said word by word: “Eight bearers in a grand sedan chair, with a formal matchmaker, what’s wrong with that?”
“Xiaojiu!”
“Ye Chen!”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said, “If you say this, you only say it once, and I only listen to it once.”
Over the years, except for the time with the diplomatic corps, the Eighth Prince had never seen him really get angry with anyone.
At first the Eighth Prince thought he was playing tricks again and wanted to laugh, but he unexpectedly met his eyes. There was not a trace of frivolity in those Ruifeng eyes which were always bright and cunning, but a terrifying depth.
The Eighth Prince couldn’t help but widen his eyes: “Are you crazy!?”
If he really married a woman from the underworld as his principal wife, he would basically have no chance of becoming the emperor, and there might even be other punishments.
Only a madman in this world would cut off his own path so easily.
“Xiao Jiu, don’t be willful. Father won’t agree!”
As for this, there is always a way.
Seeing this signal in his brother’s eyes, the Eighth Prince couldn’t help but gasp.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo didn’t say much and left quickly.
Yao Zhi soon found out that Ye Shuo was showing off his hair crown and hairpins everywhere. For a moment, Yao Zhi really wanted to give him the best things in the world.
Yao Zhi felt a little regretful. If she had known this would happen, she would have been more careful when travelling around to see if there were any good jade materials.
After all, peach wood is not as precious as jade.
In addition, all the work that originally belonged to Ye Shuo was taken over by Yao Zhi, such as going up the mountain to hunt and going to the river to catch fish every day. These were no problem at all.
Ye Shuo was a late riser, and sometimes Yao Zhi had already prepared food for the next two days by the time he got up.
When Emperor Jingwen was able to move around normally again, what he saw was a girl in a bright red dress piling all kinds of things in front of her son as if they were free.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Regret
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Today Yao Zhi brought back a basket of crabs.
September is the season for eating crabs. Seeing that the weather was getting cooler, Ye Shuo mentioned it inadvertently. As a result, when Yao Zhi left the valley this time, she bought a basket of crabs.
In the deep mountains and forests here, the crabs are basically wild and rarely artificially raised, so the sizes vary greatly.
Some crabs looked to weigh less than one or two pounds, while others were more than half the size of a palm. In addition to hairy crabs, there were also some blue crabs mixed in. All of them were lively and looked particularly pleasing to the eye.
Crabs don’t need any special seasonings or complicated cooking methods. Simply steaming them is delicious enough.
About a quarter of an hour later, the lid of the big iron pot was opened, and the rich aroma of crabs immediately spread out.
Yao Zhi didn’t hesitate much and gave the largest ones from her share to Ye Shuo. The masters who saw this scene couldn’t help but feel a little heartbroken.
Ye Shuo was still dividing and packing crabs, but when he looked up, he saw his cheap father standing not far away, looking at him from afar.
Obviously, Emperor Jingwen also saw Yao Zhi’s actions just now.How could he have the nerve to ask a girl to accommodate him?
However, Ye Shuo was not only embarrassed, but also extremely shameless: “Dad, I just happened to be looking for you. Since you came by yourself, why don’t we have something to eat together?”
Although Huo Tianyi and others were also prominent figures, people in the martial arts world were not that particular after all. Just as Emperor Jingwen was about to refuse, Ye Shuo pulled him to the table without any explanation.
Then, a big hot crab was stuffed into his hand.
After asking the Fourth Master, he was told that it was okay to eat one or two less, so Ye Shuo felt relieved.
Yao Zhi looked at the young man’s father curiously. Although Emperor Jingwen was already in his fifties, he was an emperor after all. He had an aura of majesty without even getting angry, which was really out of place in this countryside.
Huo Tianyi, who was standing by, couldn’t help but feel a little frightened. When the young man’s father was injured before, he didn’t pay much attention to him at all. All his attention was on Ye Shuo. In addition, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t get out of bed before, so Huo Tianyi hardly saw him.
Now looking at it, it is not so ordinary.
Huo Tian had seen many dignitaries while travelling around the world, but none of them could be compared with the middle-aged man in front of him.
Huo Tianyi finally began to guess the identities of this group of people.
Not knowing what the old man in front of him was thinking, Emperor Jingwen paused, said “sorry for bothering you”, and finally lifted up his clothes and sat down.
Then, Emperor Jingwen began to search around.
Everyone was confused and didn’t know what he was looking for, but Ye Shuo reacted and leaned close to his cheap father’s ear and said, “Dad, the conditions are simple right now, and we don’t have the crab meat, so you have to make do with this.”
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help glaring at him. How could he eat without the crab meat? What would it look like if it was all over his hands and body?
Ye Shuo almost forgot that his cheap father was a mysophobe.
But since he has already stopped the person, he naturally has to take responsibility to the end.
“It’s okay, Dad. You don’t have to get involved. I’ll peel it for you.”
As he said that, Ye Shuo took the initiative to open a crab.
The young man’s hands were extremely deft. He easily shaved out the crab roe and a few crab legs with just one chopstick. As for the crab body, Emperor Jingwen would not eat much of the rest except for the part at the thigh root.
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate and ate the rest of the crab body.
Emperor Jingwen always felt that the little bastard was too obedient, which made him feel uncomfortable. But after all, in front of so many outsiders, he couldn’t ask directly, so he could only ask with his eyes.
‘What did you do?’
Ye Shuo looked back innocently.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and turned to look at the girl who was sitting face to face with his son.
To be honest, although this girl is not stunningly beautiful, she is very smart and pretty, the kind of smart and pretty that has never been seen in the palace, without any impurities. No wonder the little bastard fell in love with her.
However, such a woman could be favoured, but was far from qualified to become the prince’s consort. Emperor Jingwen still hoped that his son could find a well-educated and well-mannered lady from a noble family.
Emperor Jingwen was the emperor after all, and not showing his emotions on his face was a basic skill, so no one noticed what he was thinking at the moment.
During the meal, Emperor Jingwen’s every move revealed an indescribable nobleness, which made Huo Tianyi and the others feel uncomfortable.
Ye Shuo on the side couldn’t help but hold his forehead. Even at this time, his stepfather still couldn’t let go of his pride. Ye Shuo finally gave up completely.
After Emperor Jingwen left, Ye Shuo wanted to get some crabs, but found that there was only a mess on the table. Where were the crabs? Although the young man in front of him was the son of the man just now, for some reason, it was extremely easy to get along with him.
Huo Tianyi couldn’t help feeling a little proud when he saw this. He was so slow and still wanted to eat crabs? He must be dreaming.
Don’t leave him any!
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, then looked at Yao Zhi who was standing beside him.
This was something Yao Zhi bought specially for him from the market outside, but he ended up only eating the crab bodies that his cheap father wouldn’t eat. No matter how he thought about it, he felt like he had lost out.
“My Lord…”
As soon as these two words came out, Huo Tianyi immediately jumped up from his seat, and several other masters also looked over.
Only Yao Zhi’s face was as red as an apple.
Huo Tianyi was so angry that he yelled, “What are you yelling about?!”
Ye Shuo was stunned: “Didn’t you say that I should marry the young apprentice?” Why did this old man go back on his word?
“We have already agreed, you can’t go back on your word at the last minute!”
Ye Shuo suddenly became alert.
“It is true that I want you to marry my disciple, but——” But he did not ask the young man to shout like that!
Huo Tianyi is a man after all, and he naturally knows how humiliating it is to force another man to marry his disciple.
Huo Tianyi did leave some room for himself out of fear that there would be hidden dangers a hundred years later.
But this young man in front of me never mentioned the matter of marrying into the wife’s family from beginning to end, but he called me “Master” first. His intention was so sinister!
However, Ye Shuo really didn’t care what he was called. After all, he no longer needed to rely on titles to declare his status.
“In short, you are not allowed to scream anymore!” Huo Tianyi finally reacted.
Unfortunately, it’s too late.
“I am warning you, do not use these seductive tricks on Zhi’er in the future, otherwise -“
Before Huo Tianyi could finish his words, Yao Zhi had already brought over a plate of crabs. This was something Yao Zhi had secretly left for him when she saw that the situation was not good.
“Master, second master, third master, fourth master, fifth master, sixth master, you are such a fool, why do you waste food?”
Yao Zhi felt helpless. It was obvious that the masters couldn’t eat any more and would rather waste the food than leave any for him.
If Yao Zhi hadn’t discovered it in time, the last few crabs would have been spoiled by them.
Really, why did it come to this?
Six people ganged up to bully him. What would happen if Yao Zhi didn’t help?
The beautiful woman immediately realised that the more they acted like this, the more pitiful this young man looked. But what else could she do? Just watch?
Ye Shuo didn’t care what they were thinking and started eating happily.
He opened the crab shell, picked up the crab roe with chopsticks and put it in his mouth. The delicious taste made Ye Shuo forget everything else.
In Yao Zhi’s opinion, the young man in front of her was too easy to feed. A little bit of delicious food could make him so happy.
Yao Zhi unconsciously focused all her attention on him. She just watched Ye Shuo for as long as he ate. She didn’t even notice that several masters had left one after another.
But even though he liked it, Ye Shuo was not the kind of person who would make a fuss for no reason. It was fine if crabs could be bought at the market, but he could forget about other more rare things.
In particular, Ye Shuo discovered that in the past two days, she had been staying in the mountains for longer and longer periods of time.
In the past, Yao Zhi would basically come back when he got up, but now, she would not come back until noon, and when she came back, she would even bring back some fresh wild fruits.
You know, it’s already the end of September, and it’s almost October. Autumn is here, where can we get so many fresh wild fruits?
The first day was fine, but the second day was still like this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel suspicious.
Then when it was night, he couldn’t help but stop Yao Zhi.
“Have you gone deeper into the mountains in the past two days?”
Yao Zhi was stunned. How did he know?
Under Ye Shuo’s gaze, Yao Zhi nodded gently: “…Yes.”
“Is it because of those fruits?” Ye Shuo asked again.
For some reason, Yao Zhi felt a little embarrassed when he looked at her. She originally wanted to just get away with it, but when she met his eyes, she suddenly couldn’t say anything.
Seeing this, what else did Ye Shuo not understand?
“Is it… for me?”
Yao Zhi opened her mouth and said, “I saw that you liked to eat it, so…”
It turned out to be because of me. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a little annoyed.
This girl is silly, isn’t this what happened?
“Well, actually… I don’t really like eating that fruit that much.”
“Liar!” When Yao Zhi heard this, she subconsciously refuted it.
The look in his eyes is clearly different when he treats things he likes and things he dislikes.
Ye Shuo didn’t know that Yao Zhi had seen through his lie yet, so he continued: “So, can you please not go into the deep mountains to pick fruits for me?”
“OK?”
Yao Zhi wanted to refute at first, but when the last word “OK” came out, she couldn’t resist anymore.
Although Yao Zhi agreed, Ye Shuo still felt uneasy and suddenly had trouble sleeping.
The next day, Ye Shuo got up early for the first time and secretly followed Yao Zhi up the mountain. If Emperor Jingwen saw this scene, his eyes would probably pop out.
Yao Zhi is a trustworthy person. Since she promised Ye Shuo not to go deeper into the mountains, she naturally won’t go there again.
But unexpectedly, today, she actually found traces of wild fruits on the outskirts of the mountain.
However, the location of the fruit tree was not very good. It did not grow vertically but horizontally, sticking out from the middle of the mountain.
Although the location of the fruit trees is relatively steep, it is nothing for Yao Zhi, who has been growing freely in the mountains for more than 20 years.
In addition, Yao Zhi’s lightness skills were outstanding, so she was able to succeed easily.
So she didn’t think too much about it and immediately flipped over and jumped onto the fruit tree.
When she jumped down again, she saw the young man’s angry eyes.
Of course, Ye Shuo was not angry with her, but with himself. He ignored the impact that his words would have on the silly girl in front of him.
Despite this, Yao Zhi was still very panicked.
Ye Shuo tried his best to restrain himself, but he didn’t know that the slight abnormality still caught Yao Zhi’s eyes.
Ye Shuo was still the same, and Huo Tianyi and his group didn’t notice anything different.
Mei Yingzhuo noticed that his disciple was absent-minded, and asked, “Zhi’er, what’s wrong with you? Why do you look so unhappy?”
Yao Zhi didn’t know what to say and her heart was in a mess.
“Master Four, I, I don’t know either…”
But Yao Zhi soon organised her words: “It’s just that I can’t control myself when I’m with Master Gu. My heart beats very fast. Today he got angry, and I felt uneasy for no reason. I’m a little… scared? I’m afraid he will ignore me in the future…”
Yao Zhi kept on talking: “What’s going on, Fourth Master? Am I sick?”
Yao Zhi had studied medicine with Mei Yingzhuo for so many years, but had not found the corresponding symptoms, so she could only turn to her master for help.
However, as soon as Yao Zhi said this, Mei Yingzhuo’s yard instantly became quiet.
Looking at his disciple’s furrowed brow and slightly distressed expression, Huo Tianyi finally understood at this moment what it meant to regret something.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Senior Brother
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Huo Tianyi never thought that things would turn out like this.
According to his expectation, the young man was under his control and should be completely dominated by him. He held his father and brothers in his hands, and he would not dare to go west if he was told to go east.
But the current situation is completely reversed. How come he ended up losing his own apprentice?
Huo Tianyi couldn’t figure it out no matter how hard he tried.
Meanwhile, Yao Zhi kept asking questions, and with every question she asked, the beautiful woman and the others became uglier.
Feeling something vaguely, Yao Zhi walked away dejectedly.
It was she who said she would let him go at the beginning, and now she is the one who goes back on her word. Yao Zhi feels that she is really despicable.
After the yard returned to silence, the beautiful woman could no longer hold back.
“Huo Tianyi! Look at what you have done!”Let alone them, Huo Tianyi is also very annoyed now: “How could I know that things would turn out like this!”
It’s only been a few days and I can’t eat or sleep because of him.
But the beautiful woman knew that with the young man’s tricks, it would be strange for Zhier not to be tempted.
The Sixth Master at the side said coldly: “That’s why you shouldn’t pick up a man who lives in the mountains. He might be a vixen.”
But there is no way, things have come to this point, it is too late to regret.
Huo Tianyi would rather suffer a loss than not want to drive Ye Shuo and the others out, but the problem is that they have to be willing to leave.
Huo Tianyi took a deep breath: “So what should we do now?”
Now Huo Tianyi finally became humble.
The six people thought about it, and finally a person emerged in their minds——
My disciple’s bastard senior brother Lin Zhan.
If Lin Zhan showed up, he might be able to compete with this young man.
But then the six of them gave up the idea.
Forget it, they would rather have this male demon than their apprentice’s senior brother.
Although neither of them is a good person, there are differences in severity. So far, apart from the fact that the young man has bewitched Zhi’er, he is pretty good in other aspects.
The six masters did not plan to inform Yao Zhi’s senior brother, but they did not know that Yao Zhi’s senior brother was already on the way and heading towards Yaoren Valley.
After all, Yao Zhi came back without saying hello to him, and Lin Zhan really couldn’t bear to give up his swordsmanship learned from Huo Tianyi, Meng Chunhan’s disguise skills, Lu Fanqing’s hidden weapons, Mei Yingzhuo’s medical and poison skills, as well as Zhuang Wuhen and Han Xiangyu’s Qimen Dunjia and Gu Yushu.
These are all good things. Marrying Yao Zhi is equivalent to possessing all the unique skills of the six people. How can Lin Zhan give up?
I should have known that I shouldn’t have made her angry. But it doesn’t matter. Women can be coaxed and they will be fine.
Walking on the road, Lin Zhan didn’t care at all about his junior sister who was particularly naive when it came to matters between men and women. Lin Zhan was an old hand at this and naturally didn’t worry about failing.
And the other side.
After Ye Shuo calmed down, he was hesitating about how to tell her. He told her not to go to such a dangerous place, it was not worth it, and the fruit was really not that important.
As a result, Ye Shuo waited and waited, until dark, but she didn’t come back.
She was much later today than before.
When it was almost midnight, Ye Shuo could no longer hold it in and was about to walk out of the house.
As luck would have it, he ran into Yao Zhi who had just returned.
Yao Zhi didn’t expect that she had been wandering outside for so long just to avoid him, but ended up running into him.
According to his usual habit, he should have finished washing up and was ready for bed.
Yao Zhi had practised martial arts before, so her footsteps were as light as a feather, so it was difficult for Ye Shuo to find her. Yao Zhi’s thoughts were also rather confused, so the two of them accidentally bumped into each other.
“careful!”
Yao Zhi was about to steady herself, but Ye Shuo got there first and grabbed her arm. Ye Shuo wanted to speak, but his eyes accidentally met hers.
What kind of look does she have now?
Panic, confusion and a little bit of trepidation.
Ye Shuo was stunned, and then the two of them spoke almost at the same time.
“I’m sorry, I…”
“Are you still angry?”
She knew he was angry!
Ye Shuo was inevitably shocked. He had concealed it very well, and no one else had noticed. How could she…
Then Ye Shuo knew why she was so nervous.
“I kind of want to… hug you, okay?” Ye Shuo inevitably said this, and then he remembered that the ancient feudal ethics were so strict, I’m afraid…
However, before he could react, he fell into a warm embrace.
At this moment, Yao Zhi was as fiery and hot as her clothes. Ye Shuo vaguely felt that he was about to be burned by her heat.
But soon, the two separated.
For Yao Zhi, it was unbelievable that she could do such an outrageous thing, but at the same time, she felt extremely guilty.
It was pitiful that he was taken captive to the valley, but he actually…
Yao Zhi felt extremely guilty.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but explain: “Those fruits are really nothing to me.”
It is no exaggeration to say that it is within easy reach.
But Ye Shuo was still worried and expressed his concerns very seriously.
I don’t know why, but Yao Zhi not only didn’t feel like she was being disciplined, but instead felt very sweet inside. It was really strange.
Seeing that the two people not only had no bad impact after their quarrel, but became even closer, Huo Tianyi and others felt so uncomfortable in their hearts, don’t even mention it.
It’s bad enough that the flowers you grow are picked, but the pots they grow are also taken away. That’s probably how it feels.
But there is no way, you can only bear the consequences of your own sins.
However, Huo Tianyi was not completely deceived. He still remembered his doubts about the identity of the young man’s family when he saw the young man’s father.
Huo Tianyi thought about it and finally decided to find out the identities of these people.
The other side.
A month has passed since the emperor disappeared, and the capital city is now in chaos.
Wu Yi’s original order was to stay in Shangjing and monitor the movements of all parties, but now a month has passed and the emperor has not returned yet, and Wu Yi can no longer sit still.
Compared with the current chaos, the safety of the emperor is more important to the secret guards.
They didn’t care about the rise and fall of the Great Zhou, they only ensured that the emperor was alive. Once Emperor Jingwen died, this group of secret guards would be buried with him.
After waiting for another two days, there was still no news from the front. Wu Yi immediately put down all the tasks at hand, led all the secret guards, left Shangjing, and headed towards the place where Emperor Jingwen fell into the water.
The secretly trained secret guards left one by one, causing turmoil in the entire Shangjing.
Now that the secret guards have come out in full force, I’m afraid something bad has happened to His Majesty…
For a time, all the nobles in Shangjing were in a state of panic. Everyone felt threatened and was fully prepared to face the great changes that were about to happen.
The second prince, who was far away, had ordered people to expand the search area three days before the secret guards set out.
Such a long time has passed, if something happened to my father and his entourage, there should have been a result long ago.
If not… then I can only say that my father is blessed by God and this is God’s will.
The Second Prince was such a smart man, how could he be caught by others?
When the time was almost up, he immediately started to act.
Just when the second prince had vaguely grasped the clue, he received news that the secret guards in Shangjing City had come out in full force, and the second prince immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, I took action in advance, otherwise I would have been caught and criticised.
The second prince quickened his pace, trying to find the trace of Emperor Jingwen and his entourage before the secret guards arrived.
Medicine Man Valley——
Knowing that Yao Zhi’s birthday was coming soon, and considering that she had given him a hair crown and hairpin before, Ye Shuo also wanted to make one for her himself.
Ye Shuo had no problem with design, as he was used to seeing all kinds of novelty tricks in modern times, but when it came to putting his hands on it, Ye Shuo immediately ran into trouble.
He had never done this kind of handicraft before, so no matter how good his brain was, it was useless as his hands simply couldn’t keep up.
Master Wu took a look as he passed by and couldn’t help but sneer.
A novice dares to do such complicated things. It seems that he lacks the most basic understanding of himself.
Ye Shuo was not the kind of person who couldn’t open his mouth. He begged Master Wu to teach him, but the problem was that Master Wu was lucky enough not to beat him up when he saw him. How could he be so kind?
In this way, Ye Shuo scraped several pieces of material and didn’t even make a fart. Master Wu, who was standing by, was so happy.
But soon, Master Five could no longer laugh.
When two wooden splinters stuck in Ye Shuo’s hand, Yao Zhi discovered it and refused to let him do it again.
Such a person should be well taken care of and should not be asked to do such rough work. Besides, she is not without hairpins to use.
Seeing the young man looking like he was dying just because he had two thorns stuck in his body, Master Wu, who often did carpentry work and treated bumps and bruises as commonplace, was so angry that he jumped to his feet.
“What kind of man is like him!” What’s even more infuriating is that his disciple just fell for it!
Master Wu had never had much contact with women in his life, so he naturally didn’t know that a girl like Yao Zhi, who was so powerful outside, liked someone like Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo failed in his challenge of the high difficulty and could only settle for the next best option and choose the simple one.
After sharpening the peach wood, grinding it flat, and applying tung oil, a simple hairpin was ready. After much thought, he finally carved a mark that belonged to him in a very secret corner of the hairpin.
Ye Shuo carefully wrapped up the best wooden hairpin, intending to keep it and give it to her on her birthday.
After such a period of contact, Ye Shuo gradually discovered that she knew more than he thought.
She is good at medicine and poison, the art of Qimen Dunjia, etc. Among them, her best skill is the swordsmanship which she completely inherited from Huo Tianyi.
After truly seeing her, Ye Shuo finally realised how talented she was in martial arts. No wonder Huo Tianyi and the others regarded her as a treasure. He also understood why the arrogant Huo Tianyi treated the little orphan girl differently and even raised her together with other people.
Ye Shuo just casually mentioned that his swordsmanship was so poor that he always suffered losses when fighting against people with weapons. Then Yao Zhi thought about it and immediately handed him an iron sword that she used to practise martial arts when she was a child.
Under the white oak tree, the sword lights all over the sky set off the woman’s sharp eyebrows and eyes, which made Ye Shuo stunned on the spot.
The half-green and half-yellow leaves fell down rustlingly, and a gust of wind blew, as if it was scattering fluttering rain of flowers.
Before Ye Shuo’s heart could start beating wildly, Yao Zhi had already spoken.
“Wrong.”
“Ah?” While Ye Shuo was stunned, Yao Zhi took the initiative to put her hand on Ye Shuo’s wrist.
“That’s the right amount of force.”
Once Yao Zhi gets serious, she easily ignores other things around her.
Ye Shuo, on the other hand, felt a little nervous when she approached him so actively.
What he did before, he didn’t expect to be retaliated so quickly…
But after all, Ye Shuo was a very thick-skinned man. He suppressed the throbbing in his heart and quickly entangled with him: “I don’t know this move either. Young Valley apprentice, please teach me this one.”
Yao Zhi just hugged him from behind, and when she came to her senses and met the young man’s eyes, she felt her face getting hot and immediately let go of her hands.
“Practise well!”
Otherwise, with his current state, what would he do if he faced a strong opponent next time?
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but worry about him.
Afraid of angering her, Ye Shuo quickly stopped while he was ahead.
Just like that, Yao Zhi quickly practised the Tianyi sword technique taught to her by Huo Tianyi. The scene was extremely dazzling and murderous. Looking at Ye Shuo again, he was still repeating the basic movements of chopping, cutting, and picking.
The seventh and eighth princes took a look when they passed by. When they saw their younger brother learning something from a woman, they felt ashamed.
Ye Shuo didn’t blush or feel nervous, but the Seventh and Eighth Princes were terribly embarrassed.
As for Huo Tianyi, there is no need to mention him. Fortunately, his disciple had some sense and only laid the foundation for him, and did not teach him the Tianyi swordsmanship, otherwise Huo Tianyi would be so angry that he would die.
Just as Ye Shuo was gradually immersed in the quiet and peaceful life in the mountains, the Second Prince, Wu Yi and others were gradually approaching here.
After thousands of people searched day and night, someone soon found the path leading to the Medicine Valley.
However, compared to them, the other person was much faster.
The next morning, when Ye Shuo was about to go to the mountains, he arrived at the gate of Yaoren Valley and coincidentally ran into an uninvited guest.
Then, Ye Shuo saw the jade ring hanging around the young man’s waist.
Ye Shuo was obviously stunned for a moment.
This thing seems familiar…
At the same time, Lin Zhan couldn’t help but look up and down at the strange young man in front of him. When he saw his face, Lin Zhan immediately felt a sense of crisis.
How could there be a strange man in this Medicine Valley that has never seen outsiders for many years?

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Looks Familiar
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Although Lin Zhan is not from Yao Ren Valley, Yao Zhi still has to call him senior brother. It has nothing to do with Yao Ren Valley, but because the other party is the son of her biological father’s senior brother.
More than 20 years ago, before her death, Yao Zhi’s mother entrusted her newborn daughter to a beautiful woman, Meng Chunhan.
Yao Zhi’s mother and Meng Chunhan are close friends. They have been friends since they can remember. Yao Zhi’s mother watched her good friend go from being full of vigour and vitality at the beginning to meeting the wrong person and becoming hated by everyone in the end.
Even though Meng Chunhan was not tolerated by the world, Yao Zhi’s mother did not cut off contact with her. Yao Zhi’s mother believed in her own eyes, the handkerchief friend she grew up with, rather than the rumours outside.
In this situation, even though the beautiful woman had become disheartened by the cold eyes of everyone, she still accepted the entrustment of Yao Zhi’s mother, and even promised Yao Zhi’s mother that she would raise her friend’s daughter to adulthood and ensure her lifelong peace.
At that time, Yao Zhi’s mother was already at the end of her strength. Not long after receiving the beautiful woman’s affirmative answer, she passed away. Before her death, Yao Zhi did not leave much to her daughter, only a few things, among which was the jade pendant with double spirit fish.
Because the beautiful woman had been out of touch with worldly affairs for a long time and lived in a daze all day, she did not know the current situation of Yao Zhi’s mother, nor did she know when she got married. She only knew that the jade pendant belonged to Yao Zhi’s father.
At first, the beautiful woman thought that her best friend was just like her, having met a scumbag who was not even by her side when her wife gave birth.
After investigation, it was discovered that Yao Zhi’s father did not deliberately abandon her and her daughter. A few months ago, when he learned that his wife was pregnant, Yao Zhi’s father picked up a sword and died together with his enemies. In this way, Yao Zhi’s mother could live a peaceful life for the next few months.However, what Yao Zhi’s father didn’t know was that his death had caused his wife great grief. After desperately giving birth to a daughter, she also followed him, and so Yao Zhi became an orphan.
Although Yao Zhi’s mother was unable to raise Yao Zhi herself and was unable to take full responsibility for her, in the end, she did find a reliable master for her.
Although her disciple’s father was not very capable, he was still a man, so the beautiful woman did not have much prejudice against him, and she was not so averse to the disciple’s father’s school.
In addition, as she was the only child who had stayed in the Medicine Valley, she was bound to feel lonely after a long time. So when Yao Zhi grew up a little, the beautiful woman took her to recognize her father and mother’s home.
It was not a big deal to go there, but after knowing what happened afterwards, the beautiful woman regretted it so much that her intestines turned green.
At first the beautiful woman thought that she and her brother were of similar age, so they could play together and practise martial arts together. It would always make her less lonely to have someone to keep her company.
Who knew that bastard looked like a decent person, but in fact he had all sorts of tricks in his mind. When Zhi’er was beginning to fall in love, the beautiful woman even wanted to bring them together, but in the end…
As a result, this bastard kept wavering between Zhi’er and his junior sister, and was never willing to give a definite answer. After a while, the beautiful woman realised something was wrong.
Well, it turns out that this young man looks decent, but he is actually a dishonest person!
The beautiful woman immediately gave up the idea of ​​marrying her to him, but Zhi’er and him grew up together, so they had feelings for each other.
Lin Zhan has not married yet, and Yao Zhi has no intention of getting married either. However, Yao Zhi did not show any rejection of her senior brother. Over time, the beautiful woman and the others misunderstood and thought that Yao Zhi had been waiting for him.
Although Ye Shuo didn’t know the hidden truth, he had a photographic memory after all. Basically, he would not forget anything he had seen.
Especially, the pair of jade pendants with spirit fish had a very unique shape, and Ye Shuo naturally remembered them clearly.
He remembered that when he was seven years old and went out of the palace to be a beggar, he was rescued by a little girl and picked up an identical piece.
In addition, Ye Shuo felt that the beautiful woman’s figure was somewhat familiar from the beginning, and the little girl back then loved to wear red clothes, and now Yao Zhi also likes to wear red clothes, and the ages of the two seem to match…
Could Yao Zhi be the little girl who “saved” him in the dark alley that year?
If this is true, then the young man who has a jade pendant with the same pattern as Yao Zhi must have a very deep connection with her.
The fact that the two people do not have any common genetic characteristics means that the possibility of their blood relationship is low.
Young men and women of similar age who are not related by blood…
Ye Shuo immediately became displeased with the young man in front of him.
However, before Ye Shuo could say anything, Lin Zhan spoke first: “Who are you and why are you here?”
Listening to the tone, those who didn’t know would think that Yaoren Valley was the young man’s home!
“I was just about to ask you, what is your relationship with Yao Zhi?” When facing Lin Zhan, Ye Shuo had a completely different face.
Ye Shuo’s tone was much more natural than Lin Zhan’s. Plus, Ye Shuo was born tall, nine feet tall, almost 1.9 meters tall. Although he didn’t show any bad expression, for some reason, Lin Zhan still felt angry when he was looked at by him.
Lin Zhan was not actually close to Ye Shuo, he was also eight feet tall, a full 1.8 metres, and if he stood outside he could be said to be able to kill anyone in seconds, but if he stood face to face with Ye Shuo, he was not even close enough.
Just as the two were sizing each other up, Yao Zhi vaguely heard some noise outside. She heard that Ye Shuo seemed to be talking to someone, so she subconsciously walked out.
When she saw Lin Zhan, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but be a little surprised: “Brother Lin?”
“Why are you here?”
Senior Brother Lin? Lin Zhan?
Did he run into that young man?
Now, even Huo Tianyi didn’t bother to wipe the sword in his hand. The six masters almost pricked up their ears in the garden at the same time.
Emperor Jingwen was silent for a moment, then quietly opened the window a crack.
The moment he saw Yao Zhi, Lin Zhan quickly smiled, as if he was bathed in spring breeze and was a gentleman.
“Junior Sister Zhi’er.”
Lin Zhan pulled something out of his sleeve and said, “It’s Junior Sister’s birthday, and I specially ordered someone to make this for her. I came all the way here to give it to her. I hope she won’t dislike it.”
This shape…could it also be a hairpin?
Yao Zhi opened it subconsciously, and inside was indeed a jewel hairpin.
Ye Shuo’s expression suddenly fell, and he said in a dark tone: “Hairpins are women’s personal belongings, and cannot be given away easily.”
Yao Zhi naturally knew this truth, but before she could speak, Lin Zhan said, “Junior Sister Zhi’er and I have been childhood sweethearts, so we are not considered outsiders.”
Green, plum, bamboo, and horse.
These four words flashed through his mind, and Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh at himself: “Brother Lin is right, the friendship between childhood sweethearts is naturally incomparable to others. Compared with Brother Lin, Shuo’er, who just met Yao Zhi, is naturally an outsider…”
The latter sentence was spoken in a very light voice, but for some reason, it made Yao Zhi’s heart suddenly tighten.
“You two can chat slowly. Shuo’er has something else to do, so I won’t bother you any more.”
Seeing that he was about to leave, Lin Zhan didn’t have time to feel proud before he saw him first look at Junior Sister Yao steadily, and then turn around and leave.
Yao Zhi was immediately flustered by the various emotions in the young man’s eyes.
Yao Zhi made her choice without hesitation: “…I’m sorry, Senior Brother Lin, please find a place to sit first. I’ll talk to him and I’ll be back soon.”
Yao Zhi said this, but she never came back.
Lin Zhan kept waiting and waiting, but in the end, he only got a few servants. Although the servants had a good attitude and served very attentively, they quickly found a room for Lin Zhan and brought him lunch. However, these were not what Lin Zhan wanted.
Lin Zhan’s nose was almost crooked with anger.
This one-sided situation was really boring, and the six masters soon felt bored.
As for Emperor Jingwen, he always felt that his son’s behaviour looked familiar…

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Thats it
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Just pay attention to him, why do you care about me?”
When Ye Shuo returned to the room, he deliberately closed the door a little late. Yao Zhi was so quick-eyed and quick-handed that she immediately seized the opportunity and blocked the door with her hands.
Then Yao Zhi heard these words.
Perhaps the jealousy on Ye Shuo’s face was too obvious, even Yao Zhi could sense it. For some reason, seeing him like this, Yao Zhi felt inexplicably happy.
After all, in this world, who doesn’t want to be extremely important in front of the person they like?
Therefore, Yao Zhi subconsciously explained: “Listen to me, there is really nothing between me and Senior Brother Lin. Senior Brother Lin likes Junior Sister Yue. He and Junior Sister Yue are a perfect match.”
If Senior Brother Lin didn’t have someone in his heart, and they were the same age, Yao Zhi wouldn’t be able to communicate with him so naturally.
But the behaviour of the other senior brother didn’t seem like he only had feelings for the Junior Sister Yue she mentioned.
Ye Shuo did not doubt Yao Zhi’s words, but since he could see it, Senior Brother Lin must have been very obvious in his expression.He is clearly committed to his lifelong love with his junior sister, but he wants to give Yao Zhi a hairpin. The most likely possibility is that this senior brother is playing two-timing.
Well, this kind of scum is also worthy of competing with me for someone? !
Ye Shuo sneered in his heart, but said on the surface: “But he is obviously interested in you too!”
“Impossible!” Yao Zhi refuted without thinking.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t give her this chance at all: “Just now when you were not here, he asked me why someone like me was here.”
“He also gave you a hairpin.”
“He also told me that he was your childhood sweetheart.”
With every word Ye Shuo spoke, Yao Zhi’s doubts grew deeper. In the end, Yao Zhi herself was not sure.
But what finally made Yao Zhi waver was Ye Shuo’s next words.
“If you don’t believe me, go ask your masters and see what they say!”
Ye Shuo understood it in an instant. If this senior brother was really a good person, Huo Tianyi would not be so anxious to pick up people randomly on the street.
So Ye Shuo did not panic at all.
Yao Zhi followed his words and soon realised that Second Master seemed to have said that Senior Brother Lin was not a good person, but she did not pay attention to it at the time, so Second Master did not say it again.
Ye Shuo continued: “Think about it carefully. When he was alone with you, did he really not do anything out of line?”
Indeed, whenever Junior Sister Yue was not around, Senior Brother Lin would become much more casual, his behaviour would not be so particular, he would deliberately become gentle when speaking, and his words of concern would be much more than usual…
In the past, Yao Zhi just thought it was her illusion, but now that Ye Shuo had pointed it out, Yao Zhi gradually realised that something was wrong.
When so many coincidences come together, they are no longer coincidences.
Seeing that the situation was getting heated, Ye Shuo immediately raised his voice: “Since you two love each other, why bother to provoke me!”
The young man’s brows were filled with pain, and for a moment he looked a little miserable.
However, before Yao Zhi could take a closer look, Ye Shuo quickly drove her out.
“I was planning to give you this hairpin on your birthday, but now that you have something better, I guess you don’t need it anymore. So, just throw it away.”
He actually made a hairpin for himself!
Yao Zhi was excited, and then a parabola passed by. Without thinking, Yao Zhi immediately raised her hand to take it.
With Yao Zhi’s skills, it was no problem for her to catch a hidden weapon with her bare hands, so catching a small wooden hairpin was naturally a piece of cake for her.
Although the peach wood hairpin in his hand was simple in style, it was polished to be extremely smooth and flat, without a single burr on it. One could tell at a glance that it was carefully made.
Looking at the closed door in front of her, Yao Zhi’s heart immediately became empty.
After pacing for a while, Yao Zhi first clenched the wooden hairpin which still had residual warmth in her hand, then placed it solemnly in her arms, and finally Yao Zhi walked towards the second master’s yard.
It was obvious that she had made up her mind at this moment and wanted to ask the second master for clarification.
The beautiful woman soon learned the purpose of her visit, and almost instantly, she had a deeper understanding of the young man’s methods.
How long has it been? Less than an hour? The young man has already started to sow discord between her apprentice and her senior brother.
But what could the beautiful woman do? She wished her disciple could see the true face of her shitty senior brother as soon as possible. With the idea of ​​killing as many people as possible, the beautiful woman had no choice but to follow Ye Shuo’s wishes and told her disciple everything she had seen and heard over the years.
No matter what, the masters would definitely not harm her. After the second master’s analysis and Yao Zhi’s own thinking, Yao Zhi gradually discovered that Senior Brother Lin seemed to be…trying to have his feet on both sides?
No wonder he was so angry. If it were me, I would definitely not be able to tolerate such a thing.
The beautiful woman was almost worried to death when she saw this. Although Lin Zhan had been found to be a scumbag, the other one didn’t seem to be much better than him…
What is this called, both out of the dragon’s den and into the tiger’s den?
The other side.
Just when Ye Shuo was hesitating whether to add fuel to the fire and drive that man out of the valley completely, the Seventh Prince suddenly knocked on the door of his room.
At first Ye Shuo thought it was Yao Zhi who had returned, and immediately said, “If you don’t settle your two affairs, don’t even think about coming to see me again!”
The moment the words fell, there was a sudden silence outside the door.
Just when Ye Shuo was wondering if he had gone too far, the person outside finally spoke: “… Ninth brother, it’s me.”
Oh.
It turned out to be the seventh brother.
Only then did Ye Shuo open the door.
“Why are you looking for me?” Ye Shuo looked suspicious.
The Seventh Prince couldn’t understand how he could remain calm after saying such shameful words.
This younger brother always surprises and shocks him.
The Seventh Prince had a strange look in his eyes, as if he wanted to say something but hesitated, and yet wanted to say something but was still reluctant.
Then, he pointed to the yard not far away and said, “It’s not me, it’s our father who’s looking for you.”
Emperor Jingwen had never taken the current petty quarrel seriously, but now he really couldn’t hold it in any longer.
Thinking of his father’s expression just now, the Seventh Prince couldn’t help but kindly remind him: “Be careful.”
“No problem, watch me.” Ye Shuo made an OK gesture, then walked in under the Seventh Prince’s admiring gaze.
The moment the door closed, Emperor Jingwen could be heard gritting his teeth: “What the hell are you doing?!”
Before Emperor Jingwen finished speaking, he heard his son crying out, “Dad! You have to make the decision for me!”
“Those people teamed up to bully this son!”
Ye Shuo was crying and looked so miserable.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Jingwen swallowed the words that were about to come out of his mouth.
Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he laughed: “They bullied you?”
Emperor Jingwen was not blind. Look at those masters he always called “masters”. After such a long time, look at how angry they were all because of him.
Not only did he lose money, he also lost things, and he almost lost himself.
If you think about it carefully, those people didn’t actually gain anything.
Ye Shuo paused and said, “And Yao Zhi, she also bullied your son!”
This is even more nonsense.
During these days, Emperor Jingwen watched helplessly how his son had bewitched the girl. He served her with delicious food and drinks every day, and tried every means to get some new and interesting toys for his son. The girl almost took out her heart to show him.
Whenever her son turned his face away, the girl would be flustered for a long time. In this situation, it was unclear where the bullying came from.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and suddenly calmed down a bit: “Get up first and talk later.”
Seeing his stepfather’s firm attitude, Ye Shuo had to stand up reluctantly.
This time Emperor Jingwen called him over not for anything else but to ask him where he learned this act. The Imperial Concubine had an extremely hot temper and was rarely gentle and scheming, so it could be basically concluded that it was not the Imperial Concubine’s fault.
Ye Shuo said without hesitation: “Of course I learned it from the ladies in the palace. Your son has been in the palace for so long, he can’t just stay there for nothing, right?”
“I saw that you were quite fond of this trick, so I thought I would try it myself. But you don’t know, Dad, this trick is so effective!”
Seeing his son’s excited face, Emperor Jingwen felt his temples throbbing.
No wonder it looks so familiar.
There are so many good things in the palace, but he doesn’t learn them, and he doesn’t memorise books, but just learns these messy things, right?
“Have you ever seen a man like this in the whole world?” For a moment, Emperor Jingwen thought he had raised a princess, but the problem was that even Jianjian didn’t behave like this.
When Ye Shuo heard this, he felt innocent: “But this son has never chased a girl, how can he know how to chase a girl?”
Suddenly, Ye Shuo had an idea: “Why don’t you teach your son a lesson? When we were at home, my mother and the other ladies loved you very much. Dad is so powerful, he must have a way.”
Indeed, with so many women in the harem, which one of them didn’t try to please him?
If my son continues to be like this for a long time, it will not be a big deal. Fortunately, it was discovered in time. If it was discovered later, the embarrassment would have been brought to my family.
Emperor Jingwen thought about it, and then spoke: “For men, the words bravery and courage are the most important. Men need to rely on their own abilities, not on the pity of women, let alone these inferior means.”
Emperor Jingwen said a lot, and Ye Shuo listened very carefully.
About a quarter of an hour later, Ye Shuo stood up.
“Thank you, Dad. I understand. Now that I have the right method, I will never be the same again.”
Ye Shuo spoke seriously, and Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel relieved to see that he was so obedient.
After Ye Shuo left, Emperor Jingwen took a while to figure out what was going on.
I always feel like something is wrong…
But before Emperor Jingwen could investigate further, Ye Shuo seemed to have become a different person, and his whole aura suddenly changed.
Compared with him, Lin Zhan himself could not compete with him. Now Ye Shuo’s noble aura suddenly appeared, which made Lin Zhan look even more unbearable.
Lin Zhan’s demeanour was almost crushed to pieces under Ye Shuo’s half-smile.
If the young man picked up from the riverside is the phoenix in the sky, then Lin Zhan is not even a chicken on the ground.
Seeing the two people coming almost at the same time, the beautiful woman and others couldn’t help but wonder why they had regarded Lin Zhan as a major concern in the first place?

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Arrival
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Lin Zhan is not stupid, so he can see it. He also wants to work hard, but the final result is in vain.
After all, the hardware conditions are there, and Lin Zhan cannot do it alone.
There is no need to say much about his height and figure. Ye Shuo is almost half a head taller than him, which immediately pulls down Lin Zhan’s momentum.
Ye Shuo was born into a noble family in both of his lives. Although he was a casual person, his manners would definitely be good if he wanted to.
Even if he relied on money and power, Ye Shuo had already built up his foundation. His every move and gesture was filled with confidence and composure that ordinary people did not have.
If Lin Zhan deliberately dressed himself up, then Ye Shuo was born that way.
People like him don’t need to follow any rules. Whatever he does is the rule itself.
Whether standing, sitting, or even walking, he was completely different from Lin Zhan.
The beautiful woman and others suddenly discovered that Lin Zhan, who used to be so handsome, had such short legs.Ye Shuo was only half a head taller than him, but the difference in the position of their belts was more than just that.
Although Lin Zhan also practises martial arts, even if he is not as good as Yao Zhi, he is also one of the most talented young people in the martial arts world. But why is his waist so asymmetrical? It is not as thin and flexible as Ye Shuo’s.
Ye Shuo’s waist is so tight that you can see it even through his clothes. His waistline is very obvious, and you can faintly see the outline of his waist and abdomen.
In comparison, maybe it’s because he used too much force, but the lines of Lin Zhan’s waist are not that smooth.
Although Lin Zhan’s waist is much rounder than Ye Shuo’s, his back is narrower than Ye Shuo’s. I don’t know how he can hook up with so many girls.
As for appearance… forget it, there’s no need to mention it.
Ye Shuo has deep facial features and clear lines. If the two of them were compared to a painting, then God must have used thick ink when he drew the picture. The Ye Shuo in the painting is sharp and extremely aggressive, which makes people feel thrilled when they see it.
Looking at Lin Zhan again, his was painted bland and tasteless.
Thanks to the good genes from his stepfather and his royal mother, Ye Shuo didn’t get a single acne during his entire adolescence. His skin was as smooth as ice, without a single pore on his face, and even if you looked closely, you couldn’t find the slightest flaw.
The few small moles not only did not detract from his appearance, but instead made him more mysterious and alluring.
But Lin Zhan doesn’t have such capital. To be honest, his skin is not bad, but there is no way to deal with acne marks, acne pits, pores and blackheads.
When the two of them came together, Ye Shuo was almost glowing under the sun. Looking at Lin Zhan again, he suddenly seemed so ordinary.
Even someone like Huo Tianyi, who didn’t pay much attention to other people’s appearance, subconsciously turned his eyes to Ye Shuo, and suddenly had a clearer understanding of Ye Shuo’s good looks.
Lin Zhan’s face turned green when he noticed the strange atmosphere.
Ye Shuo was very satisfied when he saw this. It was worth it that he specially changed into a set of clothes made of floating light forging today.
Well… no matter how good-looking a person is, sometimes he needs something to set him off, right?
With the floating light forging reflecting the sunlight, Ye Shuo looked as if he was illuminated, and he was radiant.
Ye Shuo has lived for so many years and rarely bullies others by taking advantage of his power, but now that the situation is special and needs special treatment, he doesn’t mind attacking the other party from all sides.
After the two sat down, in order to ease the awkwardness, Lin Zhan subconsciously took a fruit from the table.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo also picked one up.
The skin of the fruit bought from outside was a little rough and slightly red. When it fell into Ye Shuo’s hands, it immediately made his fingers look even whiter and longer.
Looking at Lin Zhan again, his hands were perfectly integrated with the rough fruit.
As if he had thought of something funny, Ye Shuo sneered softly.
Although he didn’t say anything and didn’t even look at him, it was more powerful than if he had said or looked at him.
Lin Zhan’s face immediately turned from blue to red.
If it wasn’t for the wrong timing, the beautiful woman would almost laugh out loud.
In the past, she only knew that women would make such comparisons, but now she finds that the competition between men is even more interesting.
Thinking that it has been almost two days since I arrived here, and Junior Sister Zhi’er has not said a single word to me, if this continues, the cooked duck will fly away.
Lin Zhan had already regarded Yao Zhi’s unique skills as his own, so how could he allow others to interfere?
“This young man, it seems that he is also a martial artist?” For a man, what’s the use of being good-looking? You must have real kung fu.
Once Junior Sister Zhi’er sees his useless side, she will naturally change her mind.
How could Ye Shuo not understand his thoughts? But Ye Shuo could be afraid of anyone but him.
“nature.”
Lin Zhan was obviously very confident in his kung fu. Seeing that he actually responded, he was immediately delighted: “Since Mr. Gu is so confident, I think his kung fu is not bad. It’s a good time to be free in the mountains. Why don’t we practise together? Then we can ask a few seniors to take a look and give us some pointers.”
Lin Zhan not only wanted to embarrass Ye Shuo, but also wanted to embarrass him in front of Yao Zhi’s masters.
“Can.”
Ye Shuo agreed very readily, but Yao Zhi became anxious.
“No way!”
Yao Zhi looked at Ye Shuo: “Your injury is not healed yet!”
Ye Shuo then remembered that he seemed to have been slapped by the assassin before and suffered internal injuries.
Almost a month has passed, and the pain in his chest has gone away in the past few days. But Ye Shuo is afraid of having any sequels. He has always attached great importance to his health since he was a child, so he still takes care of himself as before. Yao Zhi thought that his injury had not healed yet.
Lin Zhan thought his plan was going to fail and his face looked a little ugly.
Unexpectedly, the young man had no intention of shirking his responsibility at all.
“It doesn’t matter. It won’t affect my fight with Senior Brother Lin.” The subtext is that he doesn’t take this guy seriously.
This really pissed off Lin Zhan. He had wanted to say something polite, but now it seemed unnecessary.
Huo Tianyi and others looked at each other and shook their heads.
This young man’s internal strength is comparable to Zhi’er’s. Although his moves are slightly lacking, Lin Zhan will not be his opponent.
Soon Ye Shuo went to bring lunch to Emperor Jingwen, and then Emperor Jingwen learned that his son was going to fight with others for a woman.
“Dad, what do you think of my learning? Am I brave enough?”
As a result, when Emperor Jingwen heard this, he couldn’t eat anymore.
Which prince would fight to snatch women? Only people of low status would do that.
You are not an uncivilised barbarian who needs to show off your fists to win a woman’s heart.
Emperor Jingwen was about to curse, but then he changed his mind and thought that even using fists would be better than using tricks on the concubines in the harem.
Ignoring his cheap father’s extremely depressed look, Ye Shuo walked out with the lunch box in a good mood.
Almost immediately after he left, Emperor Jingwen called the Seventh and Eighth Princes over and said, “Go and keep an eye on him. Don’t let anything happen to him.”
The Seventh Prince: “…”
The Eighth Prince: “…”
Forget it, since it is the order from their father, they naturally dare not disobey.
In the afternoon, seeing that Ye Shuo did not have a sword in his hand, Lin Zhan also threw away his sword.
In a situation like the current one, if Ye Shuo wants to win beautifully, he certainly can’t just attack the opponent’s lower body, as he thinks it’s dirty.
But it doesn’t matter. Without those special moves, doesn’t he still have the boxing and palm techniques he learned from his grandfather?
The Seventh and Eighth Princes were not surprised at all that their younger brother could use these moves. After all, the old Duke Zhenguo had to teach his grandson some decent things to rely on, right?
Ye Shuo had already prepared for a tough battle, but he didn’t expect that Lin Zhan would be so vulnerable. After two palms, he could hardly hold on.
Ye Shuo suddenly felt confused as to whether his kung fu was too high or too low.
Why is it so strenuous at times and so easy at other times? Or is Lin Zhan just a show-off?
But in fact, Lin Zhan’s kung fu is not bad, and he is considered a leader in the martial arts world. However, he is completely incomparable to a one-in-a-million genius like Yao Zhi, and naturally he is not Ye Shuo’s opponent.
Just when Lin Zhan was retreating step by step, he accidentally saw Huo Tianyi and others. Although Huo Tianyi and others did not show any mockery, their eyes were extremely indifferent.
From the very beginning they didn’t take Lin Zhan seriously. If he wasn’t Zhier’s senior brother, they wouldn’t even look at him.
This made Lin Zhan, who was trying hard to show off in front of several people, suddenly feel angry and embarrassed.
Seeing that Lin Zhan was about to be defeated, his expression suddenly changed, and then all his ordinary moves turned into killing moves.
Lin Zhan actually… had the will to kill!
Yao Zhi grew up with him, how could she not tell whether he was fighting or killing?
Yao Zhi’s face changed immediately, and before Ye Shuo could fight with him, Yao Zhi jumped down from a big rock nearby, and rushed towards Lin Zhan with sword lights all over the sky.
Before the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince had time to admire their brother’s excellent palm skills, they saw him being rescued by the woman again.
“Lin Zhan, what are you doing?!” Yao Zhi protected Ye Shuo behind her, her eyes as sharp as knives.
It was clearly me who had just received two palm strikes from him, and my junior sister didn’t say anything at that time. But now, before I even touched the corner of his clothes, my junior sister couldn’t sit still.
Lin Zhan’s chest was already aching, and now he wanted to spit out blood.
Seeing that the other party was protecting the man outside like this, Lin Zhan suddenly felt like he was wearing a cuckold and felt that Yao Zhi had betrayed him.
After finally waiting for Huo Tianyi and the others to leave, Lin Zhan could no longer bear it and pulled Yao Zhi aside. The pain and humiliation made Lin Zhan blurt out his true feelings: “Junior sister, can you wake up a little! Do you know what you are doing now?!”
It was obviously him who started it first!
Yao Zhi was about to retort, but she heard Lin Zhan say, “Who do you think you are?”
“Junior sister, you are already 23 years old. Do you know what this age means to a woman? You are not that pretty. Do you think a normal man would marry you? Do you think the man in front of you really likes you?”
“He’s lying to you, he’s lying to you, do you know that?”
Lin Zhan is probably such a person. He judges others by himself. In his mind, Ye Shuo is also trying to steal the unique skills of Medicine Valley.
“I’m telling you the truth. There is no man in this world who would allow a woman to be stronger than him. You are better at martial arts than him, but do you think he really likes staying under your protection? Once he’s done using you, he’ll just throw you away.”
“Junior sister, you don’t expect that a person like this will stay with you forever, right? Don’t dream!”
Yao Zhi was confused by the other party’s series of words: “Impossible!”
Lin Zhan smiled: “Otherwise, tell me, why do you make him like you? From childhood to adulthood, besides me, have there been other men who have liked you?”
Yao Zhi suddenly clenched the sword in her hand.
Lin Zhan took a deep breath, and his tone gradually softened: “Junior sister, listen to me, don’t expect things that don’t belong to you.”
“You are not gentle, you have no interest, you don’t understand men’s minds, and you hang out with men all day. Junior sister, in this world, no one will want you except me.”
Lin Zhan had a good idea. He wanted to marry Yao Zhi first, and then after two or three years, find a way to take Junior Sister Yue as his concubine.
From the very beginning, as their senior brother, Lin Zhan had the intention of enjoying the benefits of having two women, and he even regarded them as his forbidden delicacies.
And Lin Zhan really did as he said, and he believed from the bottom of his heart that a girl like Yao Zhi, who was already over the age of marriage, would not be attracted to any other man.
Lin Zhan had been pretending to be a gentleman for so many years, and when his true face was suddenly exposed, Yao Zhi was a little confused.
When Yao Zhi reacted and was about to strike him with a sword in anger, she suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves coming from outside the valley.
This movement…
There are so many people!
Huo Tianyi and others’ faces suddenly changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Greetings
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
At that time, Ye Shuo was talking to the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince. Both of them had a teasing look on their faces, vaguely wanting to laugh at him.
Although Ye Shuo was chatting with them, his thoughts had long since flown away.
I don’t know what that bastard senior brother Yao Zhi is talking to her. They haven’t finished talking even after such a long time.
“It’s over, it’s over. It looks like Xiaojiu is really screwed this time. He can’t leave that girl even for a moment.”
Hearing this, Ye Shuo was about to speak when he heard the sound of horse hooves like thunder.
The three of them changed their expressions, no longer caring about joking, and immediately turned their heads to look over.
As for Emperor Jingwen in the yard, he also raised his head after hearing the noise.
Looking at Huo Tianyi and the others, they all picked up their weapons and suddenly became alert.
With so many people here and if they come with bad intentions, this small valley may not be able to bear it.“Huh!” The second prince received news this morning that there was a family here. He immediately set off in the afternoon, trying to find his father’s whereabouts before everyone else.
Looking at the rows of houses in front of him that looked like a peaceful mountain village, the second prince’s heart paused. When he approached, he ignored the stone with the words “Medicine Man Valley” carved on it. He thought for a moment, then dismounted and walked forward.
“Excuse me, is there anyone here?”
After seeing the other party dismount, the group of people following him also rolled down in unison, their movements were so uniform that the faces of everyone in Yaoren Valley changed.
Suppressing her vigilance, the beautiful woman smiled and greeted him: “Excuse me, sir, what brings you to this little Medicine Man Valley?”
“I wonder if you have ever seen a middle-aged man with extraordinary bearing and several young men?” A month has passed. If the younger brothers could have escaped, they should have done so long ago. No bodies have been salvaged from downstream, so the second prince judged that the men were most likely together.
The second prince was polite and had the demeanour of a noble young man.
Middle-aged man…young man…
I’m afraid the other party wasn’t talking about Gu Shuo and his group.
Just when the beautiful woman was feeling confused and uncertain, Ye Shuo heard a familiar voice and immediately wanted to go over.
However, the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince on the side were quick to react. The Seventh Prince covered his mouth with his hand, while the Eighth Prince shook his head slightly at him.
I think these two people also know the Second Prince’s style. It is not certain whether the Second Prince came before everyone else for a good or bad thing.
The ninth brother has not been to the capital for a long time, so naturally he doesn’t know what has happened in the capital over the past two years. It is not a good thing that he trusts every one of his brothers so much.
The Eighth Prince and the Seventh Prince looked at each other and immediately saw the same emotion in each other’s eyes.
However, Ye Shuo was not too worried. There were so many people here, and all of them were masters. It would be extremely difficult to ensure their complete annihilation. If any of the Second Prince ran away, there would be a risk of being exposed. The Second Prince had always been cautious and would not do anything so straightforward.
Just as the Seventh and Eighth Princes were preparing to observe how the situation developed, the beautiful woman quickly figured it out in her mind.
If the other party has good intentions, then it won’t be a problem if you lie, as the other party will naturally know that you are doing good for the young people.
If it was malicious, then this lie could save their lives.
In a flash, the beautiful woman immediately came up with an idea in her mind: “What young man? There are no outsiders here.”
“lie!”
The second prince had just looked from a high place and saw that there were clothes and quilts drying in each of these courtyards, but only a few of them came out. There must be something fishy going on.
The second prince made a prompt decision: “Someone, come here! Check every room for me!”
Seeing that the other party was coming with such a fierce momentum, Lin Zhan thought that the other party was coming to seek revenge.
After all, he had been here for a day and had figured out that these people were injured and that was why they ended up here.
Coupled with the beautiful woman’s concealing attitude, Lin Zhan immediately misunderstood.
Although Huo Tianyi and his men are strong, they are old after all, and are no longer as notorious as the Tianyi Sword in the past. If a real conflict breaks out between the two sides, it is still unknown who will win and who will lose. Lin Zhan does not want to be implicated by Yao Zhi’s mistress.
If I can’t do it, then the two of them can’t do it either!
Seeing Yao Zhi’s incredible expression, Lin Zhan immediately jumped out: “Sir, the person you are looking for is here!”
Caught off guard, Ye Shuo and the other two exposed their position in an instant.
When the Second Prince looked in the direction of the voice, he saw the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince, one covering his mouth and the other pressing someone.
Although he had some guesses in his mind before coming, when he saw that several people were full of life, the second prince couldn’t help feeling disappointed.
It’s not that I have any problem with these three people, but as long as they are alive, the probability of anything happening to my father is not high.
When Lin Zhan said this, the Seventh and Eighth Princes could no longer hide their anger. They immediately started to hate Lin Zhan. Afterwards, the two of them were no longer embarrassed. They stood up and bowed to the Second Prince: “Second Brother.”
The second prince knew why the two of them came here, and said with a half-smile: “I haven’t seen you for a month, and I didn’t know when you two brothers turned into mice.”
Ye Shuo also got up from the ground, cleared his throat, and called out, “Second Brother.”
Anyway, he doesn’t care about anything, so compared to others, the second prince naturally likes him much more.
The second prince’s expression softened slightly: “Ninth brother, long time no see, how are you these days?”
Ye Shuo thought for a moment and said, “It’s not bad. It’s freer than at home, but I have to worry about many things myself.”
“You are very honest.” The second prince laughed.
Seeing the two of them chatting like this, Lin Zhan on the side was immediately dumbfounded.
How could he, the two of them, be brothers?!
Yao Zhi heaved a sigh of relief upon seeing this, and when she looked at her senior brother who had grown up with her, in addition to disappointment, there was also undisguised disgust in her eyes.
She had never known before that Senior Brother Lin was such a person.
The second prince only spoke a few words to the three people and quickly got straight to the point: “Where is father now?”
“I’ll take you there right away.”
Ye Shuo and the other two led the way. When they arrived at the courtyard where Emperor Jingwen was, the door was not even opened yet, but the Second Prince knelt down with a thud.
“I am late in coming to your rescue, please forgive me, father.”
The Seventh Prince paused when he saw this, but then quickly returned to normal.
Although the other party called him father, the words like “rescue” are worthy of people’s deep thought.
Huo Tianyi suddenly thought of the news he had heard in the past few days, which said that the current emperor was attacked on his way to the south and his whereabouts are unknown.
No normal person would have thought that the person they pulled out of the water was the emperor, and the same goes for Huo Tianyi.
Huo Tianyi didn’t know the list of people on the emperor’s southern tour. He was still guessing whether it would be the officials accompanying him. The result…
The door opened with a creaky sound. Before Emperor Jingwen could open his mouth, a loud whistle was heard in the valley at the same time.
It turned out that when Wu Yi and his men arrived near Ye Ling, they heard from people outside that the Second Prince had brought the local elite troops to rescue people.
Wu Yi didn’t dare to delay at all and followed him over.
The secret guard was very skilled, and with a few quick jumps, he was moving quickly towards Yaoren Valley. A group of black dots were seen from a distance, and in a short while, they were already in front of him.
What’s more, Wu Yi and his two men were each holding a struggling and miserable eagle. The eagle’s claws and wings were tied tightly with ropes, and its mouth was entangled with something. Ye Shuo then realised that it was no wonder that Zixiao did not return to the valley to report the news today. It turned out that he was captured by his cheap master.
Only after seeing Wu Yi and the others did Emperor Jingwen feel completely relieved.
When he saw Emperor Jingwen, Wu Yi knelt on one knee without hesitation and said, “I am late in coming to your rescue, Your Majesty, I hope you will forgive me.”
Emperor Jingwen called for people to get up without much hesitation.
Emperor Jingwen originally wanted to ask what was going on outside, but when he turned around, he saw his son standing there stupidly. Looking at Yao Zhi and Lin Zhan again, Emperor Jingwen suddenly remembered the martial arts competition between the two.
Judging from the time, the two people should have finished their fight.
To be honest, Emperor Jingwen had little confidence in his son’s abilities, so naturally he thought that he had lost.
It was one thing that Emperor Jingwen looked down on Yao Zhi, but it was another thing entirely if the girl his son liked was snatched away by someone else.
Emperor Jingwen thought for a moment, then waved at Wu Yi and whispered something to him.
The Second Prince’s heart tightened suddenly upon seeing this. He thought that his father was so mysterious and must have something important to tell Wu Yi. The Second Prince almost instantly became extremely alert.
However, he didn’t expect that when his father finished speaking, he saw Wu Yi coming straight to the ninth prince.
Ye Shuo: “?”
Ye Shuo was confused, and then he saw his cheap master kneeling on one knee like he had just done to his cheap father, shouting, “Greetings to the Ninth Prince.”
As Wu Yi moved, the other secret guards followed suit, and in the blink of an eye, a large group of them knelt in front of him.
“Your servant pays respects to the Ninth Prince.”
Ye Shuo: “………………”
Help, help!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Decision
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo’s mind went blank for a moment. After he realised what had happened, he looked at the huge group of people in front of him and half of his body went numb.
I really want to pretend I never existed…
Ye Shuo felt that he should not have believed his words in the first place. His cheap father’s words sounded nice, but if he thought about it carefully, how could he, an emperor, know how to chase girls?
Almost in an instant, everyone’s eyes were focused on Ye Shuo.
The second prince was wondering why his father suddenly asked this group of secret guards to pay their respects to his ninth brother.
As for the Seventh and Eighth Princes, after a rough thought, they roughly knew the reason, so they watched the fun from the sidelines.
However, things have come to this point, Ye Shuo has no choice but to bite the bullet and raise his hand pretending to be calm: “Well, everyone get up.”
