Wu Yi then stood up with a group of secret guards.
The moment Wu Yi stood up, Huo Tianyi and others almost subconsciously stared at him.Although Wu didn’t reveal any of his aura, a thought flashed through Huo Tianyi’s mind quickly –
Unfathomable.
Similarly, Wu Yi also noticed Huo Tianyi, who was old and introverted but had an extraordinary feeling, and… the woman in fiery red clothes not far away.
Out of instinct, Wu Yi almost instantly locked onto these two targets in his mind.
When Emperor Jingwen was present, Wu Yi was only at the disposal of Emperor Jingwen, so naturally all the attention was on him.
Seeing so many strangers around, who seemed to be people from the martial arts world, Wu Yi couldn’t help but look at Emperor Jingwen, asking his master with his eyes how to deal with these people.
Emperor Jingwen obviously understood what he meant. As he was hesitating, he saw his youngest son looking at him pleadingly.
Emperor Jingwen’s brows suddenly frowned, and after considering for a moment, he finally shook his head slightly at Wu Yi.
Forget it, considering that they are still diligent later, I will forgive their previous offence.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
They had no idea that in just a few breaths, they had been to the gates of hell. Now Huo Tianyi and others have not yet reacted to the change of these people’s identities.
As for Lin Zhan who was standing aside, his eyes widened.
He never imagined that the young man in front of him who was posing coquettishly would actually be the prince!
“This is impossible!” Lin Zhan almost shouted out.
However, almost instantly, he closed his mouth, lowered his head, and tried his best to reduce his presence.
Lin Zhan was flustered, and all kinds of emotions flashed through his mind.
In the eyes of the Second Prince and others, Lin Zhan was just a small character after all, so no one paid attention to this place for a while.
Now that Emperor Jingwen has been found, the secret guards will naturally escort Emperor Jingwen and others back to the capital.
Soon, the Medicine Valley became the territory of Emperor Jingwen and several princes.
The secret guards were well-trained, with a guard every five steps and a sentry every ten steps. Any one of them was as good as anyone except Huo Tianyi in terms of kung fu. If they started fighting, without any special means, they would be wiped out in less than half an incense stick of time.
They claim to be masters in the martial arts world, but it turns out they are just so-so.
No wonder the word “jianghu” has existed for so many years, but no force has been able to gain popularity. It turns out that the root cause lies here.
During his lifetime, Huo Tianyi had a good understanding of the royal majesty.
“You have really good taste.” The beautiful woman couldn’t help but tease when no one was around.
Huo Tianyi smiled bitterly, feeling that God was playing a trick on him. How could he have imagined that the person he picked up casually by the river would be a prince!
No wonder this young man is so handsome, ordinary families can’t raise such a guy.
Even though these people are from the underworld and are evildoers that everyone wants to kill, they are not fools after all, and they will not rush to seek death for no reason, so they naturally remain silent when facing so many secret guards.
The beautiful woman didn’t know whether she should be happy or sad at this moment: “It seems that his marriage with Zhi’er will not be successful.” It was a blessing in disguise.
The beautiful woman was not stupid. Given the young man’s identity, it was absolutely impossible for him to marry a woman from the underworld.
Huo Tianyi felt very complicated when he heard this: “It won’t work out, it won’t work out…”
As for the agreement, the six of them were very tactful and never mentioned it again.
Including Mei Yingzhuo, they just thought that their hard work was wasted, which was better than being targeted by the royal family.
Since Huo Tianyi and others would think so, Lin Zhan would naturally think so too.
Although he was very unwilling and jealous of Prince Ye Shuo’s identity, when Lin Zhan reacted, he couldn’t help but feel happy.
If you think about it carefully, this is actually a good thing. Given the young man’s identity, he will definitely not marry her, so he still has a chance.
While no one was paying attention to him, Lin Zhan quickly made another small move.
Yao Zhi’s mind was in a mess because of this sudden news. She didn’t care about being angry with Lin Zhan at all. When she finally noticed someone in front of her, she heard Lin Zhan say, “How is Junior Sister? Was what Senior Brother said before true?”
It was impossible for the young man to marry her before, and it was even more impossible for him to do so now.
“Do you think that for someone like him, he will miss his days here after he gets out? No, he won’t. He will only feel humiliated.” It must be said that Lin Zhan had a very accurate grasp of the psychology of Emperor Jingwen and several princes. Emperor Jingwen did think of killing them after he got out.
“Think about it, a prince has to live in the hands of a woman. Can he be really happy?”
“Junior sister, you should know yourself and not aim too high.”
If he were a prince, with mountains of gold and silver, and endless beauties to enjoy, how could he really be attracted to a country woman?
He was just forced by the situation and endured it for a while.
Although Lin Zhan had never witnessed the extravagant scenes of the royal family with his own eyes, he had seen high-ranking officials taking concubines. Lin Zhan had once taken a look at the concubine and found her so beautiful.
If this is the case even for officials’ backyards, let alone the royal family.
Lin Zhan felt drooling just thinking about it, so he was certain in his heart that the young man would definitely not admit it.
I just don’t know if these two people who are so close have ever had sex. Thinking of this, Lin Zhan’s expression couldn’t help but freeze, but for the good things about Yao Zhi, Lin Zhan finally decided to hold his nose and endure it.
The worst that could happen is that after he has coaxed those things into his hands, he will kick her out. An unclean woman is naturally not worthy of him, so Lin Zhan feels at ease.
However, just as Lin Zhan finished speaking, he heard the sound of gnashing teeth not far away.
“Well, I knew you had bad intentions!”
Ye Shuo had vaguely felt that Yao Zhi was not in a good state before, and guessed that this person probably didn’t say anything nice, so he was deliberately on guard.
This time, Lin Zhan was caught red-handed by Ye Shuo.
When Lin Zhan heard the young man’s voice behind him, he was immediately startled. Before he could react, Ye Shuo waved to the people brought by the second prince.
“Someone, take him down for me!”
He couldn’t control the secret guards, but the people brought by the second prince were always obedient.
Lin Zhan wanted to resist, but Wu Yi, who was always paying attention to the surrounding movements, shot him in the leg with a stone.
Lin Zhan’s right leg went numb and his knee went weak. Seeing this, the people next to him immediately grabbed him.
“Who told you that I’m unhappy? She treats me well, and I’m so happy.”
Ye Shuo squatted down, and under the other party’s incredulous gaze, he gritted his teeth and said: “Also, I’m telling you clearly, don’t use your standards to measure others. This prince likes her like this, and this prince wants to marry her, three letters and six ceremonies, and eight sedan chairs, nothing is missing!”
The moment the words fell, almost everyone was shocked, and the Second Prince finally understood what had just happened.
Huo Tianyi and others were all in disbelief. When the news reached Emperor Jingwen’s ears soon, he suddenly stopped.
Bastard, how dare you say anything!
But after knowing what Lin Zhan said to Yao Zhi, Emperor Jingwen thought, no wonder the little bastard couldn’t help it.
Lin Zhanzhe’s eyes widened immediately: “Impossible! You are lying!”
“As a prince, how could you possibly be interested in a girl from the martial arts world?” What’s more, this girl is already 23 years old!
In his eyes, what exactly did he think of Yao Zhi? Ye Shuo was so angry.
“First of all, she is good at Kung Fu. How many people in this world have better Kung Fu than her?”
“Secondly, she is kind.” Kindness itself is an extremely precious quality, which not everyone possesses. Kindness with strength is simply a powerful weapon.
“Besides, she is very clear about right and wrong, and she doesn’t bully others even if she has the ability. She is also very careful and considerate, and she knows so many things that others don’t know…”
The more he counted, the more Ye Shuo looked at Lin Zhan as if he was looking at a bedbug.
“Look at yourself again, how can you compare to her? You have the nerve to belittle her. Who do you think you are?”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and pulled Yao Zhi’s hand: “Let’s not waste time talking to this kind of person, let’s go!”
Looking at the backs of the two people, Huo Tianyi was stunned.
The beautiful woman was also shocked: “…Wait, he’s not really going to marry Zhi’er, is he?”
If he really asked, I think his disciple would not refuse.
Thinking of this, the six masters were not happy at all. Instead, their hearts sank and their eyes went dark.
After walking a long way, they arrived under a familiar big tree. Looking at the angry Ye Shuo, for some reason, Yao Zhi, the person involved, was not so angry anymore and even laughed.
“He scolded me, not you. Why are you so angry?”
“I just can’t bear to see others mistreat you…” I didn’t expect that Lin Zhan, who looks like a decent person, is actually such a person behind the scenes. It’s really hateful.
“No, I just forgot to ask someone to beat him up. I have to go back again.”
However, if Yao Zhi doesn’t let go, Ye Shuo will definitely not be able to go back.
“By the way…are you really a prince?”
What is supposed to come will eventually come.
For some reason, Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly trembled. He didn’t dare to look her in the eye. Ye Shuo pretended not to care and sat down on the big rock next to him: “Ah…”
“It’s been like this since I was born.”
From the outside, you couldn’t tell at all. Even now, Yao Zhi still felt like she was dreaming.
The atmosphere suddenly became quiet.
Ye Shuo couldn’t bear it. After a while, he couldn’t help but ask: “So…will you come with me?”
If it were a normal time, Ye Shuo wouldn’t mind staying with her, but after leaving the valley, his stepfather would definitely investigate the assassination. The eldest prince didn’t come, the crown prince didn’t come, but the second prince was so active in running. This gave Ye Shuo a very bad premonition, and he didn’t know who he would investigate in the end.
There is also my cheap father’s body, and my mother and Jianjian in the palace…
Once you get out of the valley, it’s two completely different worlds.
Ye Shuo looked at Yao Zhi hopefully. Yao Zhi was silent for a long time, and then she just let go of his hand.
The answer she gave at this moment was very obvious.
The chivalrous women in the martial arts world are like birds flying in the sky. Even if they indulge themselves for a while, they are still unwilling to be canaries in a cage.
Although she liked him, she didn’t want to break her wings because of him.
After a fierce struggle, the girl in red finally decided to give up.
Yao Zhi opened her mouth and was about to say something, but when she looked up, she saw the young man in front of her, his eyes turning red.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Style
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Even so, Yao Zhi still had no intention of wavering.
When she likes someone, she will naturally be like a moth to a flame and treat that person with all her heart, but when she has made a decision in her heart, she will act decisively without any hesitation.
“Life in a large mansion may not be suitable for me.” After all, Yao Zhi is not a child anymore. She can afford an ordinary man, but if it is a prince, it is really beyond her ability.
Yao Zhi simply couldn’t imagine what it would be like for her to become one of the women in the harem begging for her husband’s mercy. The thought was terrifying.
This is not good, so forget it. It would be nice if this relationship could stay at its best moment.
Just think of it as a beautiful dream.
At this moment, Ye Shuo still had a glimmer of hope in his heart: “Is it because of what Lin Zhan said?”
“I can assure you that there will be no backyard. Although I am a prince, I am not the kind of prince you imagine. Until now, I have no wives or concubines in my family, nor have I had other girls. If you don’t believe me, you can ask my seventh and eighth brothers.” Ye Shuo didn’t care much when he first met her, but now, he suddenly wanted to fight for himself.
How could it be because of Lin Zhan?Yao Zhi wanted to refute, but after hearing his next words, she was stunned.
“Never had a girl before…” How is this possible?
At first, Yao Zhi instinctively felt a flash of anger in her heart, and suddenly she felt a little cold, thinking that the other men outside that he and Second Master had talked about were no different, they were all lies.
But after seeing the sincerity and seriousness in Ye Shuo’s eyes, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel shaken.
Even if he was lying, he wouldn’t tell such a low-level lie, so it seems more like the truth.
But what does this have to do with her? Perhaps the word “prince” is extremely noble to others, but it is troublesome to Yao Zhi.
Yao Zhi was used to being free, and the birds flying in the sky could not behave like house sparrows.
Honestly, he was a good person, but not good enough for her to make her give upon her freedom.
Seeing that Yao Zhi was still shaking her head, for a moment, Ye Shuo suddenly had the urge to force her to stay by his side.
Ye Shuo is also a human being, and he also has his own bad qualities. He never considers himself a saint, so when he is forced into a corner, he also wants to control and manipulate others.
But in the end, looking at the girl in red who was unaware of anything in front of him, Ye Shuo still endured it.
After waiting until the turbulent emotions in his heart gradually calmed down, Ye Shuo half-compromised, half-pleaded: “If that’s the case, then you can stay with me for the last two months, just two months, okay?”
Before Yao Zhi could refuse, he continued, “My fourth brother’s leg injury has not healed yet. It takes a hundred days for a broken bone to heal. It’s only the first month now, and there are still two months left. The Fourth Master used some unconventional methods before. Father estimates that he will let Fourth Master accompany him for a while before letting him go. Fourth Master is old, and it’s not good to ask him to travel back and forth.”
It has to be said that Ye Shuo really understands his adoptive father, and Emperor Jingwen really thinks so.
Since it concerns the Fourth Prince’s leg, Emperor Jingwen doesn’t care whether Mei Yingzhuo agrees or refuses. He always finds a way to make him nod.
Most of the imperial physicians in the palace were from aristocratic families and had a fairly complete inheritance of medical skills. Their abilities were no worse than Mei Yingzhuo’s. After all, there was a saying that went, “Learn both civil and martial arts, and serve the emperor.” The top talents in the entire Great Zhou were concentrated in the royal family.
But skills are skills alone, and most of the doctors in the palace prefer the golden mean. If something happens to the noble, the whole family will die, so they are not as brave as Mei Yingzhuo. In this case, if you want to cure the fourth prince’s injured leg, you still need Mei Yingzhuo’s help. But in fact, Yao Zhi, who inherited Mei Yingzhuo’s medical skills, can also do the job.
Now that the Fourth Prince’s leg has been almost healed, all that’s left is for it to slowly recover. There’s actually no need to put in any more effort later on, so the two months that Ye Shuo mentioned really just meant that he wanted Yao Zhi to stay with him for the last two months.
Even if Ye Shuo didn’t say it, Yao Zhiyi would not let her elderly master work so hard.
And this excuse of his was much better than Emperor Jingwen directly giving orders and forcing him to do so.
Yao Zhi didn’t know the twists and turns. After thinking about it, she didn’t give a direct answer, but just said, “If your father really said so, then let’s talk about it.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief when he heard this.
Based on Ye Shuo’s understanding of his stepfather, he estimated that there was a high probability that something like this would happen.
Sure enough, when everything was ready, Emperor Jingwen quickly gave an order that Mei Yingzhuo must accompany him throughout the journey, leaving no room for Mei Yingzhuo to refuse.
Just when Mei Yingzhuo was about to grit his teeth and admit it, Yao Zhi stepped forward in time and resolved a possible conflict.
“Your Majesty, my teacher is old and it is not suitable for him to travel far. I beg Your Majesty to allow me to accompany him.” Emperor Jingwen looked at her for a long time, and seeing his son clinging to her, he finally turned a blind eye, raised his hand, and let Mei Yingzhuo go.
Mei Yingzhuo felt very complicated when he saw this.
As the saying goes, serving the emperor is like serving a tiger. It was the past, but now Mei Yingzhuo is very worried about his disciple following the emperor and a group of princes.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo assured him: “Don’t worry, Fourth Master, I am here to protect her.”
Mei Yingzhuo was silent for a moment, then said, “…It’s hard for you to still call me Fourth Master.”
Hearing the call of “Fourth Master”, Mei Yingzhuo gradually felt at ease.
Wu Yi, who was standing by, had sharp ears and eyes. When he heard the word “Fourth Master”, his brows beneath the mask couldn’t help but frown slightly.
result……
Soon Wu Yi discovered that the Ninth Prince now had not only the Fourth Master, but also the First Master, the Second Master, the Third Master, the Fifth Master, and the Sixth Master.
For some reason, the secret guards on the side always felt that their leader seemed a little unhappy, but after a closer look, it seemed like a simple illusion.
How strange.
The other side.
When she learned that her disciple had rejected the young man’s invitation, even the beautiful woman was shocked.
She thought that as long as the young man opened his mouth, her disciple would nod without hesitation. After all, her disciple’s obsessed look these days did not seem fake.
“Don’t you like him anymore?” The beautiful woman couldn’t help but ask while her disciple was packing his luggage.
Yao Zhi paused as she sorted out her clothes.
“like.”
How could I not like him? I believe no one would reject such a person, and the same goes for Yao Zhi.
Even now, when Yao Zhi looked at him, she would still feel her face blushing and her heart beating uncontrollably.
“But I know better what I want most.”
“If he were just an ordinary man, I would definitely treat him like a treasure. I would give him whatever he wants and give him a pair of children.”
“Unfortunately, he is not.”
Yao Zhi was a little dazed, but soon returned to normal.
Hearing these words, the beautiful woman seemed to have re-recognized the child she had raised.
After a while, the beautiful woman smiled bitterly: “Master is not as good as you.”
If she had made this decision back then, she wouldn’t have ended up like this.
The secret guards around urged her to do her job, and after about an incense stick of time, Yao Zhi had finished packing.
After a month of treatment, the Fourth Prince’s complexion looked much better than before, and his injured right leg could gradually move, but he could not use any strength, so he could no longer ride a horse and could only take a carriage.
When it was time to say goodbye, Ye Shuo, sitting on the horse, couldn’t help but wave to the masters.
“Don’t worry, I will come back to visit you when I have time!”
Huo Tianyi: “…”
Huo Tianyi’s old face immediately fell, and his expression almost said the words “You’d better not come”.
Huo Tianyi didn’t expect that he had picked up a piece of toffee and couldn’t get rid of it. For a moment, he even thought of moving to another valley.
Or maybe we should just stop staying here?
Ignoring Huo Tianyi’s depressed look, Ye Shuo had to tighten the reins after his cheap father gave him the order: “Go!”
Compared to Ye Shuo who kept looking back with a look of nostalgia, Yao Zhi was even better. After all, she had been travelling frequently for so many years and had gotten used to it. If someone didn’t know, they would think this was Ye Shuo’s home.
From that time on, Emperor Jingwen only knew that the princess was extroverted, but he didn’t know that the prince was also like that.
Emperor Jingwen endured for a while before he barely managed to suppress the urge to scold him.
Of course, Ye Shuo did not forget to beat Lin Zhan up before leaving. It was a bargain for this bastard to be beaten up.
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that after he left, the group of people following him did not leave with him.
Under Lin Zhan’s horrified gaze, the leader drew his sword and, without even frowning, ended his life without hesitation.
Until his death, Lin Zhan never figured out why he suddenly suffered such a misfortune.
Obviously, the Ninth Prince had already said that he would let him go, right?
Before Lin Zhan could figure out the problem, he lost consciousness forever in just a few breaths.
What Lin Zhan didn’t know was that he was already doomed when he made the sound and exposed the locations of the Seventh and Eighth Princes.
The reason why he was not killed in public was that the Seventh and Eighth Princes left Lin Zhan behind for the sake of their younger brother.
As the saying goes, the majesty of heaven is such that if you are not careful, you will suffer a catastrophic disaster.
“I’m really sorry for dirtying a few of you guys’ places.”
Thinking of the Ninth Prince, the leaders were naturally polite to Huo Tianyi and the others, but their actions were not as gentle as they said.
After confirming that Lin Zhan was no longer breathing and could not be deader, several people casually threw him into the woods.
They didn’t care at all whether they would provoke revenge from Lin Zhan’s family. After completing the task, they quickly rode away.
Dust rolled up, and in a short while, the figures of several people disappeared from sight.
Even Huo Tianyi and his gang, who were considered big villains by the people in the martial arts world, felt horrified when they saw the other party behaving like this.
After spending a long time with Ye Shuo, Huo Tianyi and the others began to develop illusions that they shouldn’t have.
At this moment, they finally understood what it meant that the royal family was ruthless.

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Numbness
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Around dusk, the group left the valley, and the main force was already waiting outside.
The moment they saw Emperor Jingwen, they immediately knelt on the ground and shouted “Long live the Emperor” three times, especially the commander who was responsible for the safety of the ship, who was now trembling with fear.
Fortunately, he was the emperor’s man, otherwise he would have been killed by the second prince long ago.
Now that Emperor Jingwen has escaped from trouble, it is time for his final judgement.
“I am incompetent and failed to detect the assassin’s arrival in time, causing damage to the emperor’s body. Please forgive me, Your Majesty!”
To be honest, the assassins came so fiercely and silently that it was understandable that the commander failed to notice them in time.
But there was no way, the result was like this. Since he was given the task in the first place, he had to do it well, no matter whether it was beyond his ability or not.
Therefore, Emperor Jingwen did not hesitate and immediately dismissed him from his official position and replaced him with another person.
This is the best outcome for the commander.The emperor was injured, several princes were injured, and he was lucky enough to be able to save his family. The rest of his life was saved for nothing.
The commander straightened his back and kowtowed three times to Emperor Jingwen, his eyes full of gratitude: “Thank you for your grace.”
Except for the commander, no one else in charge of this area could escape.
They all knelt in front of Emperor Jingwen, waiting for his decision with anxiety or nervousness.
Yao Zhi, who was in the team, was immediately frightened when she saw such a scene.
When she was in Yaoren Valley before, she only knew that the young man’s father was extraordinary and not like an ordinary person. Now she has truly seen his side as an emperor.
The same was true for the others. Almost the moment they left the valley, they stopped all their ease and joking and suddenly became cautious and tense.
These are referring to the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince.
Yao Zhi instinctively looked at the young man beside her and saw that he was still the same. For some reason, she felt inexplicably relieved.
As if he could see her emotions, Ye Shuo whispered to comfort her: “Don’t be nervous.”
Yao Zhi was used to storms after all, so she nodded quickly.
It just so happened that the secret guards were all here. Seeing his cheap father whispering a few words to Wu Yi, and then seven or eight secret guards disappeared into the crowd one by one, he vaguely felt that these people should be going to investigate the assassin. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say, “Stay with me more in the next few days. If you have any problems, tell me. I will accompany you then.”
Yao Zhi opened her mouth and after a moment she uttered a soft “hmm”.
The fourth prince in the carriage nearby: “…”
They can talk, but can they not say it in front of me?
After reorganising the team, Emperor Jingwen and his entourage quickly set off again.
Having learned from the last lesson, this time, in addition to the people brought on the southern tour and the secret guards, the newly appointed prefect of Shengzhou heard that the emperor was now in his territory and immediately sent garrison troops over.
When Emperor Jingwen came, he was only accompanied by a thousand men, but when he returned, he was accompanied by a large group of four or five thousand men.
Looking at the young man in the team, Yao Zhi had previously thought that he did not come from a good background, so he could so casually say that he wanted to marry her.
But two days later, from the information revealed by people around, it seems that this is not the case at all.
The son of the imperial concubine, the emperor’s favourite son, the grandson of the Duke of Zhen…
He was the former richest man in Liangzhou, and also the chief leader who has become famous in the underworld in the past two years.
Apart from the Crown Prince, the Ninth Prince is the most noble one…
In the entire team, everyone was respectful to him, including the other princes, who were all polite to him.
Yao Zhi gradually gained a better understanding of his identity, but when she was with him, she couldn’t tell at all.
“Why are you looking at me like that? It makes me feel embarrassed and I can’t even talk to people properly.” Her eyes were too focused and Ye Shuo was a very perceptive person. After a while, he felt his back starting to get hot.
Unexpectedly, Ye Shuo’s charming face came closer, making Yao Zhi blush.
“Ninth Prince, please respect yourself!”
She pretended to be calm, but the red tips of the girl’s ears still betrayed her.
“There is no relationship between the two of us now!”
“What’s the big deal? There’s no outsider here.” Ye Shuo is not the kind of person who doesn’t know his limits. He is definitely not like this when he is outside.
The fourth prince at the side couldn’t help but cough heavily: “Cough cough!”
When the two looked over, the fourth prince was somewhat helpless: “I’m still here.”
The Fourth Prince’s desire to stand up again became stronger and stronger. Otherwise, if he met these two people, he would not be able to escape and would be forced to listen to their sour words.
Ever since Yao Zhi took over the job of treating Mei Yingzhuo’s injuries, Ninth Brother has been visiting her more frequently.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo did not seem panicked at all: “What’s the big deal? Fourth brother, you are not an outsider.”
None of the brothers like to gossip outside, and each one of them is more strict than the other, so Ye Shuo is more outrageous.
The Fourth Prince said that he would definitely not tell anyone, but the problem was that even if that was the case, he was too confident in himself.
The Fourth Prince was speechless and could only make arrangements later, asking the people around him to pay more attention to the movements around them when the Ninth Prince came, in order to avoid being noticed by someone with ulterior motives without his knowledge.
Today is already the third day since leaving the valley. According to the cycle, it is time to give acupuncture to the Fourth Prince, but the problem is that the Fourth Prince’s injury is in his right leg. As a girl, Yao Zhi naturally cannot do it herself.
But this is not a difficult thing. It’s just acupuncture. Any doctor with some skills can do it. It’s not a big problem.
“Let me do it.”
Ye Shuo on the side suddenly spoke up, looking eager to try. Apart from anything else, Ye Shuo was absolutely great at identifying acupoints.
However, just these three short words made the Fourth Prince’s hair stand on end.
If I let the Ninth Prince take action, will I still have a chance to survive?
However, Ye Shuo’s subsequent words made the Fourth Prince even more desperate.
“But you have to teach me how to give acupuncture first.”
The fourth prince lost all his composure and shouted without even thinking: “I don’t want you to come!”
“Where is the imperial physician in the team? Send him over!”
The fourth prince was ready to crawl out even if he had to.
Perhaps because he screamed too miserably, the imperial physician rushed over soon.
After Yao Zhi explained the acupuncture points, sequence and strength, the imperial physician quickly had an idea.
“Fourth brother, can’t you trust your brother just once?” Ye Shuo looked disappointed.
The Fourth Prince was so afraid that he would attack directly if he was late that he wished his neck would be broken.
“Oh well……”
Seeing that the young man was in a low mood, Yao Zhi hesitated for a while, but finally spoke.
“Come here, I’ll teach you.”
It’s just acupuncture techniques, some basic stuff, so Yao Zhi didn’t care that much about it.
In the past, when encountering something like this, Yao Zhi would usually teach him step by step, but now it is different. She just gave guidance from the side and didn’t even touch him.
Xiaojiu also has this day.
The Fourth Prince smiled unconsciously, but his expression soon twisted because of the sudden pain in his leg.
Compared with Ye Shuo and the Fourth Prince, the atmosphere on Emperor Jingwen’s side was much more tense.
Emperor Jingwen would be unable to sleep or eat well if he could not find the source of such a large number of assassins.
By now the main force had already arrived in Shengzhou. Two days later, news came from Bingzhou that the crown prince had learned that they had escaped and was determined to come no matter what.
Seeing that the crown prince was no longer as lifeless as before, Emperor Jingwen’s mood finally improved a little.
At this time, Emperor Jingwen also remembered the letter he had sent to the prince when he was in Liangzhou. He believed that after reading the letter, the prince would not be the same as before.
When the Second Prince saw this, his eyes suddenly darkened.
On the surface, my father seems to favour my ninth brother the most, but this favour is ultimately just superficial. In the end, the one he values ​​most is only the crown prince.
For so many years, the Second Prince could not figure out why the Crown Prince was so good when they were both his father’s sons. The only thing that made the other party better than them was that they could be reborn into the Empress’ belly.
It’s a waste that the emperor loves him so much. I’m afraid the prince will disappoint the emperor this time.
The second prince lowered his head, hiding the resentment and unwillingness that had emerged in his eyes, and raised his lips in a sarcastic smile.
Emperor Jingwen’s good mood was eventually halted by the news coming from the secret guards.
After reviewing the evidence presented by the secret guards, Emperor Jingwen’s expression suddenly changed.
He never imagined that his legitimate son, whom he had always placed high hopes on, would actually do such a thing as killing his father and brother.
The so-called father-son relationship is nothing but a joke.
Emperor Jingwen felt a tightness in his chest and had difficulty breathing.
“What? Third brother is coming?” After hearing about this, Ye Shuo sat up from the bed at once.
He hasn’t seen the prince for almost three years, and he misses him a lot.
The next morning, hearing the noise outside, Ye Shuo got up early on purpose.
The moment he saw the prince, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but be stunned: “Why have you lost so much weight?”
In Ye Shuo’s impression, the prince has always been a gentleman, gentle as jade, but now he has lost his charm and looks emaciated, almost unrecognisable.
For a moment, Ye Shuo almost couldn’t recognize it.
Seeing that it was him, the prince subconsciously smiled: “Xiao Jiu.”
For some reason, these two short words almost made Ye Shuo cry.
“That’s good, that’s good…” Seeing that his brother was healthy and seemed to have no serious health problems, the prince couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
After observing for a while, the prince couldn’t help but say, “Xiaojiu seems to have grown a lot taller.”
The prince remembered that when he left the palace, he was only about the same height as himself, but now he is almost half a head taller than him.
“Third brother is now completely incomparable to you.”
There’s no way. If you play outside every day and get a lot of exercise, you’ll grow fast.
Feeling somewhat embarrassed by the other party’s teasing gaze, Ye Shuo was about to say something when he heard a voice of notification coming from not far away –
“The Emperor has arrived——”
“Greetings to the Emperor, long live the Emperor.”
The prince knelt down subconsciously, but he didn’t know that when Emperor Jingwen looked at him again, his eyes were first filled with anger, then resentment, and the Buddhist beads in his hand kept tightening. His expression was extremely unfamiliar, as if he had just met him for the first time.
“I was extremely worried when I heard that my father was in danger. I wonder if he is doing well now…”
The prince was silent for a moment when he saw that there was no sound from above for a long time, and then he spoke. However, before he finished speaking, Emperor Jingwen was already extremely angry.
When he heard the word “An”, Emperor Jingwen could no longer restrain himself and kicked him.
“You bastard!”
The prince only felt a sharp pain in his shoulder. As he fell to the ground gasping for breath, the last glimmer of light in his eyes finally turned into complete numbness.
This day finally arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Abandoned
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
From the scolding and scolding in the beginning, to the surveillance later, every word was heart-wrenching. Now, the emperor started to beat him in public as soon as they met, treating his reputation as nothing and stomping on him hard to the ground.
What happened next? What happened next? I’m afraid the crown prince will be deposed soon.
It was not known whether it was pain or despair, but veins bulge on the back of the prince’s hands. All the panic and helplessness he felt when he learned that Emperor Jingwen had been assassinated disappeared, leaving only a blank expression.
No one expected that the emperor would suddenly become furious. Everyone around was stunned at first, and then they all knelt down.
As for Ye Shuo, he was completely dumbfounded.
What’s going on? What happened? Why are you so desperate the moment you meet?
After all, my stepfather is the emperor. Thunder, lightning, rain and dew are all grace from the emperor and cannot be resisted.
Seeing that he was about to attack again, Ye Shuo on the side gritted his teeth, protected the prince behind him, and took the blow for him.
Shit! This hurts so much!How could the prince endure this anymore?
Ye Shuo’s back felt burning and he felt like his shoulder blades were about to be broken by the kick.
“Father! Why do we have to use force if we want to talk?” With so many people here, how could the prince bear it!
Emperor Jingwen was already furious after seeing the crown prince, and now seeing his youngest son grimacing in pain and about to cough out his lungs, Emperor Jingwen subconsciously hesitated.
Ye Shuo took this opportunity, completely disregarding his face, and immediately hugged his stepfather’s legs to prevent him from kicking anyone again.
“Dad, calm down Dad!”
Emperor Jingwen was now completely helpless.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said coldly: “Let go!”
Ye Shuo said with a bitter face: “Dad, please don’t do it again. Look at my third brother’s body now. How can he withstand this?”
Emperor Jingwen then noticed that the prince now seemed extremely haggard. He was hunched over with the spine on his back protruding.
Emperor Jingwen failed to kick the second time.
Ye Shuo hurriedly said, “We are all family, why can’t we talk it out?” Communicate! Ye Shuo was almost tired of saying this.
However, it would have been better if Ye Shuo had not said it. As soon as he said this, especially the word “family”, Emperor Jingwen felt like someone had stabbed his lungs and became even angrier.
And within this anger, there is also a hint of unspoken sorrow.
“You treat him as your own brother. Ask him if he treats you as his own brother?” Has he ever been a real son to this emperor?
“Chengzuo, Chengzuo, ask yourself, are you worthy of your brother risking his life to protect you?”
“Xiao Jiu, take a look at what your brother, the prince, has done!”
As he spoke, Emperor Jingwen took a stack of papers from the secret guard and threw them in front of the two men without saying anything.
Ye Shuo didn’t know what was written on it, but since it concerned the crown prince, he definitely couldn’t let anyone else know.
Therefore, Ye Shuo quickly picked up all the papers before anyone else looked over. Soon, he was attracted by the contents on them.
The assassination was arranged by the governors of Yeling and Xianghu, and the governors of Yeling and Xianghu were the prince’s men…
“This is impossible!” Ye Shuo’s first reaction was disbelief.
“Father, there must be something wrong here!”
Ye Shuo believed that the prince might make a wrong choice because of his younger brothers who were eyeing him covetously, but he absolutely did not believe that the prince would kill his father and brothers.
Emperor Jingwen did not believe it at first, but now all the clues pointed to the prince and he had no choice but to believe it.
None of the other princes made any unusual moves, and who else could have such great power except the crown prince?
How could the governor of Shan Yeling Xianghu have such ability!
When Emperor Jingwen toured the south, the troops he brought were enough to deal with most situations, but in the end he still failed to prevent it. How could two governors, without more support behind them, turn the world upside down?
The more expectations Emperor Jingwen had before, the more disappointed he is now.
“Prince, now that the evidence is irrefutable, do you have anything else to say?”
The prince remained motionless and silent.
Ye Shuo suddenly became anxious: “Third brother! Say something!”
If my father has doubts in his heart, what difference does it make whether he says it or not?
In the past two years, the prince has said too much, he is really tired of it. Every time he explains, he gets no response, and gradually, the prince no longer has any extra expectations in his heart.
The emperor’s suspicion has reached this point, and the prince really has nothing to say.
However, just when the prince was about to give up completely, he heard Ye Shuo next to him shout again: “Third brother!”
“…Please!”
Suddenly meeting his brother’s pleading eyes, the prince’s already numb heart couldn’t help but tremble.
“Now, I believe everything Third Brother says, so this must not have been done by Third Brother, right?”
After these words were spoken, the atmosphere suddenly became quiet.
Just when Ye Shuo thought that the prince would not speak, he saw him shaking his head slightly and imperceptibly.
Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly came back to life, and he hurriedly looked at his adoptive father: “Father, did you see it? It really wasn’t done by my third brother. Father, please, check again!”
Emperor Jingwen was silent for a while, and finally waved to the person next to him.
“The prince is not feeling well. Someone, help him down to rest.”
This means that he will be put under house arrest again.
Without waiting for others to approach, the prince stood up first.
Ye Shuo looked at this, then looked at that, and without much hesitation, he stepped forward to support the prince.
If it was anyone else, the prince would definitely not want them to see him in such a state of embarrassment, but if it was Xiao Jiu…
In the end, the prince did not refuse.
Following the instructions to the gate of the courtyard, Ye Shuo saw that the atmosphere was too depressing, so he pretended to be relaxed and said, “Third brother, don’t worry too much. With the secret guards here, you will be cleared of all charges sooner or later.”
But in fact, innocent or not is no longer important to the prince today.
The prince had already become disheartened.
“Xiao Jiu, you still believe in me, but my father doesn’t. It’s really boring for me to be the crown prince.”
“Third brother…”
Before he could finish, the prince walked in.
With a creaky sound, the door closed, completely isolating the prince.
Ye Shuo watched helplessly, but felt powerless.
Yao Zhi watched this scene from afar, unable to tell what she felt.
Before today, she thought that the princes were as glamorous and proud as they appeared on the surface, but it turned out that they also had hardships that others never knew about.
It was hard because he was smiling all the time before, which made Yao Zhi mistakenly believe that he was always as carefree as he appeared to be.
Ye Shuo also saw her, and their eyes met. After hesitating for a while, Yao Zhi finally walked over.
When Ye Shuo returned to his yard, before he could say anything, Yao Zhi said, “Lift up your shirt and let me see your injury.”
“This is not good…” The injury was on the back, and it seemed a little strange for a girl to see it.
Seeing that he became reserved at this time, Yao Zhi pursed her lips and pulled his collar off without saying anything.
Ye Shuo almost cried out in pain.
The back of the young man’s neck was very delicate and smooth, just as beautiful as his face, except that his shoulder blades were now dark blue, making him look particularly scary.
Yao Zhi stretched out her hand to check and breathed a sigh of relief when she saw that no bones were injured.
“It’s not serious, but once today is over, I’m afraid it will be swollen by tomorrow, which may affect the movement of this arm. Don’t touch it or scratch it, it will be healed in a few days.”
Ye Shuo nodded obediently.
Compared to Ye Shuo, the Second Prince was extremely angry after learning about this.
Even at this time, the emperor was still tolerant. Even though the prince had committed such a heinous mistake, the emperor only put him under house arrest.
Time and again, the second prince felt heartbroken.
Father was so tolerant of the Crown Prince, but had he ever shown any mercy to his sons?
Even Ye Shuo, who had pleaded for the Crown Prince, was now hated by the Second Prince.
But the Second Prince has more methods than just these. Now that he has appeared here, the Second Prince has made all the preparations, and this time he must bring down the Crown Prince.
Others may not know, but the second prince knows a shocking secret. Even though the eldest prince is now in the limelight, no matter how powerful he is, it is useless because his father will never choose him as the heir.
My father has already suffered once as the Duke of Zhen, so how could he let himself repeat the same mistake?
If the eldest prince can be quiet and stay as the Prince Ding for the rest of his life, it will be fine. But if he dares to show any sign of disloyalty, my father will definitely take drastic measures.
It’s ridiculous that the eldest prince is still kept in the dark until now, and is still dreaming of ascending to the throne!
Without the crown prince and the eldest prince, he, the second in command, naturally would be counted among the last.
Otherwise, with the two of them in front and behind, when will the Second Prince be able to make a breakthrough? His younger brothers are growing up one by one, and if he doesn’t take action now, it might be too late.
That’s why the second prince acted decisively this time.
So, the second prince came before Emperor Jingwen with what he had found out.
“Your Majesty, I have something to report.”
The secret guards moved quickly, but the second prince was not slow either. The secret guards had only been here for a short time, but the second prince had arrived half a month earlier than them.
Emperor Jingwen ordered his men to present what the second prince had prepared.
Emperor Jingwen looked at it while the second prince spoke below him.
“Since this concerns the Crown Prince, I shouldn’t have said much, but this is a matter of great importance, so I have to speak.”
“My son learned that half a year ago, in the spring, a small locust plague occurred in Yeling and Xianghu. Natural disasters are not serious, and they should be reported to the higher authorities truthfully. However, for some reason, the two prefects seemed to be bewitched, or they were afraid of losing their official positions, so they kept the disaster secret.”
“My son has been to Yeling. The people in the two places had no harvest in the spring and had to rely on old grain to survive. In addition, the two prefects did nothing. Now people have started to die in Yeling and Xianghu, father!”
The crown prince’s subordinates had made such a big mistake. No matter how much Emperor Jingwen favoured the crown prince, he could not protect him.
It was not until this point that the Second Prince dealt the Crown Prince the fatal blow.
In this case, even the Ninth Prince would not be able to help him.
As it turned out, the second prince guessed correctly. Even Ye Shuo had no way to plead for the prince.
The prince had never imagined that his indulgence would lead to such a horrific disaster.
“As the crown prince, you have violated the teachings of your ancestors. Your crime is greater than that of others.”
Perhaps my father is right, and I, as the crown prince, am the culprit.
How can I have the dignity to continue being the crown prince?
In the autumn of the 25th year of Jingwen’s reign, Crown Prince Ye Chengzuo angered the emperor because of treason and corruption. On October 3, the emperor issued an edict to demote Crown Prince Ye Chengzuo to a commoner.
On October 7, a wealthy businessman named Hu in the Zhou Dynasty donated 200,000 dan of grain, and a wealthy businessman named Gu donated 100,000 dan of grain to help the victims.
On October 10, the deposed Crown Prince Ye Chengzuo committed suicide in Qingfeng Courtyard. The emperor was deeply saddened and did not implicate him afterwards, retaining the title of his legitimate son.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Gentleman
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
How could things turn out like this?
In the early morning, Ye Shuo looked at the prince lying there quietly, his mind was blank, he didn’t even know how all this happened.
Ever since the Second Prince reported the Crown Prince for forming a clique and engaging in private activities ten days ago, and his officials kept the locust plague a secret in order to protect their positions, causing the people in Yeling and Xianghu to be starving and living in misery, Ye Shuo has been busy ever since.
Just as the Second Prince thought, after something like this happened, Ye Shuo naturally could not continue to protect the Crown Prince. Otherwise, where would he put those suffering people?
Ye Shuo couldn’t do such a thing. The only thing he could do was to help the prince to remedy the situation.
Ye Shuo went to great lengths to order his men to transport grain from Lucheng at full speed, regardless of cost, to relieve the urgent needs of Yeling and Xianghu.
The businessmen surnamed Hu and Gu were naturally Ye Shuo’s subordinates.
Ye Shuo has been selling so much liquor to Beiting for many years, so he naturally has a lot of caravans under him. The merchants named Hu and Gu are two of them.
Fearing that the target would arouse suspicion if it was too large, Ye Shuo went through a lot of trouble to get these 300,000 dan of grain over. This was enough to feed the disaster-stricken people in Yeling and Xianghu for two months. With these two months, the grain from the imperial court would naturally be delivered, and the crisis in the two places would be resolved smoothly.Since October 3rd, the day the crown prince was deposed, Ye Shuo has been trying to contact people and has come to see the crown prince every day.
At that time, the prince’s condition was already very wrong. Ye Shuo saw it and was anxious. He kept persuading him to wait a little longer. Maybe things would turn around?
Ye Shuo just thought that after making up for the mistakes, everything would be fine. He never thought that the prince would take such a step.
Ye Shuo still remembered that when he came last night, the prince was still fine. How come he was gone when he woke up this morning?
What Ye Shuo didn’t know was that the reason why the prince was so calm was not because the crises in Yeling and Xianghu were resolved, but because he had already made up his mind to die.
A dying person’s heart is naturally extremely calm, and nothing can stir up waves in his heart anymore.
Even after eating the last barbecue with Ye Shuo, when Ye Shuo was leaving, the prince specifically reminded him: “It’s getting cold, remember to put on more clothes.”
Who would have thought that our meeting yesterday would be our final farewell.
Ye Shuo raised his trembling hands and tried to check the prince’s breathing.
No.
No.
Still no.
Ye Shuo only felt a bone-chilling chill rising from the soles of his feet. For a moment, he froze there, unable to move, his mind filled with the scene of the first time he saw the prince.
The boy was as gentle as jade at that time. Ye Shuo still remembered how helpless he looked when he hugged him.
“Third brother, please don’t do this…”
When the imperial physician and Yao Zhi heard the noise and rushed over, they also gasped when they saw this scene.
When Yao Zhi’s gaze met Ye Shuo’s panic-stricken eyes, her heart trembled.
After seeing her, Ye Shuo almost didn’t hesitate and spoke instinctively: “Please, save him.”
At this moment, Ye Shuo seemed to have grasped the last straw.
Yao Zhi naturally didn’t want to disappoint him, but… but the prince had been dead for a long time, his body was cold, and even if a great immortal came, he would be powerless.
Wrapped in his expectant eyes, Yao Zhi felt powerless: “I’m sorry…”
The string that was tense in Ye Shuo’s heart finally broke.
But he couldn’t fall down now. Ye Shuo’s body swayed slightly, and the next moment, he grabbed the bedpost next to him in time. When the slight dizziness in front of his eyes subsided, he gritted his teeth and let go.
There is still the level of cheap dad that I haven’t passed yet.
Although my stepfather demoted the prince to a commoner, besides being disappointed, he was also worried that this incident had caused too much trouble. If he didn’t do this, he would not be able to stop the people from gossiping about it.
That’s why we say that the Second Prince’s move was truly amazing, making it impossible for Emperor Jingwen to be partial to him.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think of what Mei Yingzhuo had said before. The last time the assassin came for his cheap father, the assassins kept coming and finally stabbed his cheap father in the lower part of his heart and successfully injured his heart meridian.
Although the external injuries have healed now, I still cannot be too sad or angry, otherwise it will hurt my body.
If he knew…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at Yao Zhi who was standing beside him: “Do you still have the Heart Protection Pill?”
This matter is already unavoidable, Ye Shuo can only make preparations in advance.
Upon hearing this, Yao Zhi hurriedly took out two pills from her sleeves.
This medicine was brought out by Yao Zhi from the valley. Afraid that she would be implicated if something bad happened, Ye Shuo opened the box. After the imperial physician checked it, he took the imperial physician to his stepfather’s residence.
On the way, Ye Shuo’s mind was in a mess and he really didn’t know how to talk to his cheap father.
Just as he was about to step into the courtyard where Emperor Jingwen was, the prince’s attendant, Mo Shu, who had been silent all this time, suddenly stopped him and handed him a letter in his arms.
“This is what His Royal Highness the Crown Prince left for you, the Ninth Prince.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but stop.
He quickly opened the letter, and then the prince’s handwriting came into view. Ye Shuo had no idea how many times he had seen it when he was in the East Palace. The Grand Tutor always compared his handwriting with the prince’s. But now the prince’s handwriting was just like him, no longer vigorous and green, but full of gloom.
This majestic palace is indeed the most murderous place.
“My ninth brother, I am writing to you personally: As for the matter of Xiang Hu & Ye Ling, I know that I have committed a grave sin. I am ashamed to face the world. I feel ashamed of the teachings of the Grand Tutor and the grace of the Emperor. The only way I can thank the world is to die.”
What if the two merchants Hu and Gu later donated grain to make up for the shortfall? Could the dead people be resurrected?
The prince had never thought that his small action could cause such a big storm. What he had done in the past few years, every time he thought about it at night, even he felt disgusted.
I’m afraid that in the eyes of others, he has long been filthy, covered in mud and can’t be washed clean. Where is the attitude of the crown prince?
But despite this, he still couldn’t keep his position as the crown prince. I’m afraid that in the eyes of others, he, the crown prince, has long been a joke. What’s the difference between his behaviour and that of a clown?
From the glorious crown prince to the useless person now, the crown prince is really unbearable. Just thinking about it makes him feel disgusted.
In addition, at this point, the prince felt that he had no hope of turning things around, and only death could protect the many children and concubines in the Eastern Palace.
The crown prince knew that he was no longer able to resist, and his father extremely disliked him. The prince had no choice but to risk his life to win the last bit of sympathy from Emperor Jingwen.
Perhaps only by taking this life can I reawaken the remaining kindness in my father’s heart.
To this day, the prince no longer has any bargaining chips in his hands. No matter from which perspective, only when he dies can everyone live comfortably.
Forced by circumstances, the prince had to die.
“Yes, the child is innocent.” Before the prince died, he was particularly reluctant to let go of the Crown Princess of the Eastern Palace, who also had several children. Daughters would be fine, and no one would make things difficult for the princesses, but the same could not be said for the emperor’s grandsons.
Everyone is eyeing the Eastern Palace, and the Crown Prince has no one to trust, so before he dies he can only leave his orphan to Ye Shuo.
“I hope that my ninth brother will help me take care of Ye Xun for the sake of our brotherhood.”
What the prince is most worried about is his own legitimate son.
Ye Xun has just turned sixteen. The situation of the Eastern Palace has been bad in the past two years, and Ye Xun’s marriage has not been decided yet. But the prince will never see that day.
With a “plop” sound, a drop of water finally fell on the letter paper.
“…You really know how to cause trouble for others!” You can’t let people rest in peace even after death!
Touching his face randomly, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but curse.
After folding the letter and putting it back in his arms, Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said, “I received the letter. There is no need for him to remind me. I will protect Ye Xun after returning to Shangjing.”
After all, Ye Xun was raised by Ye Shuo, so naturally he would not let him be bullied.
After hearing the Ninth Prince’s assurance, Mo Shu couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Although the Ninth Prince behaves in an absurd manner, he is the one whose words count the most among all the princes.
“I, the servant, would like to thank the Ninth Prince on behalf of my master.”
“No need.”
Ye Shuo paused for a moment and asked again: “Besides this, Third Brother…did he say anything else before?”
This… naturally exists.
Mo Shu lowered his eyes: “The master said that he was sorry for you, for letting you see his unbearable side.”
Among the people in the world that the prince was ashamed to face, one was Ye Shuo.
The prince felt a little sorry that he knew all this.
Ye Shuo tried hard to hold back his tears: “What else?”
Mo Shu added: “Also, the master said that he once wanted to be a gentleman.”
But it is difficult to be a gentleman. In the end, he took the wrong path and ended up like this.
Mo Shu will never forget the sad and resentful expression on His Highness’s face under the bleak moonlight.
The prince was unwilling to accept his fate, but no matter how unwilling he was, it had now disappeared with his death.
The moment the words fell, the atmosphere around them suddenly became quiet.
Mo Shu had to remind him, “Your Highness, the Emperor is about to get up, and I should leave. I have said everything I need to say, and I will take my leave.”
Ye Shuo opened his mouth and asked out of the blue: “Can I not leave?”
Ye Shuo added: “Ye Xun hasn’t grown up yet.”
It was Mo Shu who suddenly spoke that year, causing the red pill in the midwife’s hand to fall by accident. After so many years, Ye Shuo still remembers it vividly.
The other person’s face was exactly the same calm as the prince’s last night. What else did Ye Shuo not understand?
“As long as you want, I will guarantee your innocence.”
Mo Shu was stunned for a moment, then he shook his head and said, “The little grandson of the emperor has his own servants.” And he was just a servant of His Royal Highness the Crown Prince.
“Thank you, Ninth Prince, for your consideration.”
Because of his relationship with His Royal Highness the Crown Prince, Mo Shu kowtowed three times and bowed nine times.
Then, Ye Shuo watched him leave.
Although twenty years have passed, Ye Shuo can still vaguely see the other person’s appearance back then.
After a while, Ye Shuo walked into the courtyard where Emperor Jingwen was, waiting to face his next fate.
But obviously, because of his subordinates, Emperor Jingwen had already received the news before Ye Shuo could speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Reserved
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Emperor Jingwen felt a headache when he woke up early in the morning. He was inexplicably irritated and everything he saw was unpleasant to the eye.
Therefore, when he heard the noise outside, Emperor Jingwen immediately got angry.
“What’s going on outside? Why is it so noisy?”
The servant next to him was frightened when he saw the emperor getting angry: “I’ll go ask right away…”
A moment later, when the servant came back, his face was pale.
Seeing his pale face, Emperor Jingwen felt even worse and said coldly, “Speak!”
The servant finally couldn’t bear it anymore and fell to his knees with a plop.
“Your Majesty, the deposed crown prince…he committed suicide by swallowing gold last night…”
With a “bang”, the teacup in Emperor Jingwen’s hand fell to the ground and broke into countless pieces.For a moment, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t even react to what the people in front of him were saying.
That was the prince, how could he die? And in such an undignified way as swallowing gold.
“How dare you!” Emperor Jingwen stood up suddenly.
“Even if the crown prince is deposed, he is still my son. How dare you maliciously curse my son? Come, drag him away and beat him to death!”
No matter who you are at this moment, you will inevitably be implicated.
The servant was horrified and said, “Your Majesty, please spare my life. Everything I said is true. Please spare my life, Your Majesty!”
However, the more he did this, the more he had to die.
When Ye Shuo heard such noise when he entered the room, his heart couldn’t help but tremble. Without thinking too much, he knew that his stepfather must have known the news of the prince’s suicide.
When he saw Ye Shuo, Emperor Jingwen was filled with anger and had nowhere to vent. He cursed Ye Shuo fiercely for the first time: “Xiao Jiu, you came at the right time. These bastards saw that the prince had lost his power and treated him so badly. These cunning slaves are really hateful!”
“Xiaojiu, weren’t you eating meat and drinking wine with the prince in the courtyard last night? Go tell those people that the prince is still alive and well, and tell them to watch their heads!”
Although the crown prince had been deposed, this statement showed that Emperor Jingwen was still paying attention to him and even knew that he ate meat and drank wine with others.
Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly felt very blocked.
Under the expectant gaze of Emperor Jingwen, Ye Shuo gritted his teeth, lifted his clothes, and knelt down.
Silence is better than words at this time. Only when the death is announced will the visitors kneel as soon as they see them.
Emperor Jingwen’s head buzzed and he was even a little unsteady for a moment.
Ye Shuo knelt silently, almost choking with sobs, and finished what he wanted to say: “My third brother committed suicide in Qingfeng Courtyard last night. I hope that Father… will mourn for him.”
Then, Ye Shuo only felt the sound of wind passing by his ears, and when he turned around again, he only saw a dark figure.
Not caring that his adoptive father hadn’t called him yet, Ye Shuo hurriedly followed.
Emperor Jingwen walked very fast. The wound on his chest was very stuffy and uncomfortable. Ignoring the suffocating feeling from his heart, Emperor Jingwen arrived at the gate of Qingfeng Courtyard in a short while.
However, when they really arrived at the place, Emperor Jingwen began to hesitate.
Until now, he still didn’t think the prince would do such a thing.
How could a proud prince choose to leave in such a way?
However, Emperor Jingwen did not know that the prouder a person is, the less likely he is to allow others to see his miserable appearance, even his own father.
That’s why the prince avoided other methods such as hanging and committing suicide, and finally chose the most painful and least noticeable way to commit suicide.
Even though his intestines were pierced and he was in excruciating pain, he didn’t even blink.
So when Emperor Jingwen saw the prince’s body, he just saw him lying there with a calm expression, as if he was just asleep.
Emperor Jingwen breathed heavily and reached out with trembling hands to check the prince’s breathing.
Ye Shuo had just done something like this once, so the answer Emperor Jingwen came up with could only be the same as Ye Shuo’s.
The prince is dead and his body is cold.
When touching the prince’s cold body, the emperor, who was over fifty years old, felt his legs go weak for a moment.
Losing one’s father in childhood, losing one’s wife in middle age, and losing one’s son in old age, from ancient times to the present, these three great sorrows in life are the most painful for anyone, even for an emperor.
After all, the emperor is also a human being, and as a human being, he has a heart and emotions. How could Emperor Jingwen not feel pain when he watched his most beloved son die in front of him, under his nose?
But for Emperor Jingwen, the extreme pain was hatred and anger.
As an emperor, he could not allow things beyond his control to happen, and the prince’s suicide meant he had lost control of the situation.
According to Emperor Jingwen’s idea, the prince should take a brighter and smoother path than his own. He should be appointed as the crown prince in his childhood, and when he is old, he should inherit his position smoothly. Even if there are occasional setbacks in the process, it doesn’t matter, as they are all insignificant trifles.
But now the prince’s ending is even more miserable than his own.
He managed to survive those dark and difficult years and finally ascended the throne, but his son, whom he had high hopes for, died early.
The prince has really let me down a lot.
The prince is only thirty-five years old this year! He is still young.
Emperor Jingwen hated him for giving up on him so easily, and was even more annoyed that he had been the crown prince for so many years, but was still so vulnerable.
Seeing his adoptive father staring at the prince’s body for a long time without saying a word, Ye Shuo, who was standing by, subconsciously reached for the small box in his arms.
Ye Shuo thought his stepfather would collapse like this, but unexpectedly, instead of crying, he laughed softly. Ye Shuo’s heart tightened immediately.
At first, Emperor Jingwen’s voice was not loud, but later he actually laughed out of pain and laughed out loud.
“Hahahahahaha, hahahahaha, good death, good death!”
“When he was the crown prince, he colluded with his clique, which was disloyalty. As a son, he didn’t know that his body and hair were given by his parents, and he easily harmed them, which was unfilial. How can such an unfaithful and unfilial person be worthy of being my son!”
“Come here, burn the body of the deposed crown prince and this house for me, come here, come—”
When Ye Shuo heard the first few words, he was shocked. When he was anxiously thinking about how to respond, he saw his stepfather’s hand pointing at the prince stiffen, he took a few quick breaths, and then fell down holding his chest.
Ye Shuo was quick-witted and quick-handed, pulling his cheap father up before he fell to the ground.
At this moment, Emperor Jingwen’s face was ashen, his teeth were clenched, and his lips were slightly purple. Ye Shuo acted quickly, and hurriedly pried open his cheap father’s teeth with his hands, and then fed him the Heart Protecting Pill.
Then Ye Shuo carried his stepfather on his back and ran to his stepfather’s residence.
As for those who stayed behind, they were now in trouble, and then they heard the Ninth Prince speak.
“Until Father wakes up, none of you are allowed to move. Do you hear me?!”
However, His Majesty had just said something. If he didn’t follow His Majesty’s instructions, I’m afraid…
The leader was about to speak when he met Ye Shuo’s eyes. The sharpness in his eyes was like a knife, causing his heartbeat to accelerate.
As expected of a prince, even though the Ninth Prince is a playboy, he still has great aura.
Seeing that the other party was shocked, Ye Shuo disappeared without waiting for the other party to answer.
Ye Shuo put his stepfather on his bed as quickly as possible, not caring that he was sweating profusely, and hurried to call Yao Zhi and the imperial physician beside him.
“Come and see how father is doing now!”
At this time, the other princes in the team also heard the news of the crown prince’s suicide. The fourth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince were immediately shocked.
The death of the prince is a big deal. Once the news comes out, it will probably cause a shock.
As for the second prince, his eyes were full of disbelief.
The second prince didn’t believe that the crown prince died so easily. He was the crown prince!
The eldest son of the empress, who had been like a mountain pressing down on his brothers since childhood, couldn’t be so weak…
For some reason, the Second Prince felt inexplicably panicked, as if something beyond his control was about to happen.
The second prince took a deep breath, and when his panic calmed down, he didn’t care about anything else. He immediately stood up, put on a robe, and walked towards the courtyard where Emperor Jingwen was staying.
After they realised what was happening, the other princes also started to move. Even the Fourth Prince, who was recovering from his injuries, asked people to carry his sedan chair here.
The other side.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo fed the emperor the heart-protecting pill in time, and with the help of the imperial physician and Yao Zhi, Emperor Jingwen woke up after a short while.
The first thing Emperor Jingwen did when he opened his eyes was to look at the bed curtain above his head. He spoke in a hoarse voice, word by word, “Come here, draft an edict and convey my decree to depose the Crown Prince for being disobedient and unfilial. From today on, his name will be removed from the Imperial Book of Documents. The Crown Princess, the Crown Princesses, and all the Emperor’s grandchildren will also be removed…”
Since the prince doesn’t even care about his own wives, concubines and children, then let these people follow him.
There is no room for them in the royal family or the imperial palace anymore.
Ye Shuo had never expected his adopted father to be so impulsive and heartless. He was going to punish everyone involved!
The prince probably never expected that his suicide would not only fail to arouse the Emperor Jingwen’s sympathy, but instead make him hate him to the core.
However, before Emperor Jingwen could finish, Ye Shuo hurriedly interrupted him: “No, Dad!”
“This was all my third brother wanted before he died. Although my third brother was wrong, the Crown Princess and the others did not deserve this, Dad!”
“Obligations are forgiven when one dies. If Third Brother knew that his actions would implicate his wife and children, he would probably not be able to rest in peace in the underworld. After so many years, Third Brother has become so exhausted. If you really did this, how could father and son meet again a hundred years later?”
Ye Shuo actually doesn’t really believe in reincarnation, but since the ancients believed in it, he can only say this.
“Could it be that, Dad, you really want Third Brother to become a lonely ghost? Is this really what you want?”
“How outrageous!” Emperor Jingwen was indeed furious.
Hearing a roar from inside, the Second Prince and his men outside suddenly stopped and thought carefully, and decided that it would be better to wait until the storm subsided before going.
Emperor Jingwen would vent his anger on others, and naturally he would also vent his anger on his youngest son.
“Are you going to disobey me too?”
“Dad, son…”
However, before Ye Shuo could finish his words, Emperor Jingwen’s fists and feet had already landed.
Under normal circumstances, Ye Shuo would have run away long ago, but there was no way now. His stepfather was angry, so Ye Shuo could only wait until he calmed down.
Now Ye Shuo can’t retreat at all.
Seeing his youngest son kneeling there without saying a word, Emperor Jingwen became even angrier.
Finally, Ye Shuo couldn’t bear it anymore, his face turned pale, he groaned, and fell down. His back and shoulders were in so much pain that Ye Shuo curled up like a shrimp.
Emperor Jingwen froze, and looking at his little son who was gasping for breath, he finally couldn’t hold back his tears.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo knew that no matter what, the Crown Princess and the others were saved.
As for the prince’s body…it is estimated that it cannot be entered into the imperial mausoleum, and it is not realistic to open a separate tomb for him. The prince can only be wronged and live in the place prepared for him first.
Ye Shuo had been working hard in recent days and was already exhausted physically and mentally. He was shocked by the prince in the morning and then became the target of Emperor Jingwen’s venting in anger. When everything calmed down, Ye Shuo could no longer hold on as soon as he walked out of the yard.
As if she saw that he was having trouble going on, Yao Zhi walked forward silently, finally put her arms around his waist, rested her shoulders against his armpits, and gently lifted him up.
Then, there was news that Emperor Jingwen issued an edict to retain Ye Xun’s title.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Investigation
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Although the prince is dead now, the stigma on him cannot be let go.
Whether it is clear or turbid, you will only know after checking.
The one who is supposed to be the prince cannot escape, and Ye Shuo will not cover up for him. The one who is not supposed to be the prince cannot have everything good or bad thrown on him.
Ye Shuo has some roots in Liangzhou after all, so it shouldn’t be difficult for him to find out the specific situation of Xiang Hu and Ye Ling.
While Ye Shuo was lost in thought, Yao Zhi had already taken off his shirt.
The young man’s originally smooth and beautiful skin was now covered with blue-black scars, which looked extremely scary. The shoulder blade on his back had not yet healed fully, and now it was even more injured. It was almost swollen higher than a steamed bun. Yao Zhi felt a pang in her heart, and her eyes couldn’t help but feel hot.
She couldn’t imagine that this always cheerful and active young man would now have to endure this.
When her eyes met the tiredness on his face, Yao Zhi felt mixed emotions and it was quite complicated.
In Yao Zhi’s opinion, he should have lived happily forever. But his life was not as happy as he imagined.He basically hasn’t laughed since he left the Medicine Valley. This grand palace is not as comfortable as being in a remote valley. He lives in fear all day long. If Yao Zhi hadn’t seen it with her own eyes, she would never have believed it.
Fortunately, Yao Zhi still had some bruises and sprains medicine that she used when traveling around the world, and now she could use them for him.
When the ointment was applied to his body, Ye Shuo’s back muscles began to tremble violently and uncontrollably.
hiss–
It hurts so much!!!
Ye Shuo, who had lived a life of luxury and had basically never suffered any hardship in his two lifetimes, was sweating profusely on his forehead.
Only then did Yao Zhi realize that the young man in front of her seemed to be particularly afraid of pain and could not stand even the slightest pain. Even in this situation, he not only had to face the death of his brother, but also had to take care of his father who had lost his son in middle age, become the object of his father’s venting, and take care of the prince’s funeral.
Does he have pain in his heart that others don’t know about?
He tried hard not to shout out. After Yao Zhi applied the medicine to him, Ye Shuo rested for about an incense stick of time. After he had recovered a little, he quickly got up from the chair.
“What are you going to do?” The moment the words came out of her mouth, Yao Zhi realized that she seemed to be meddling too much.
I promised to draw a clear line with him, but I kept breaking my promise. When did I become the kind of person who doesn’t keep her word?
However, Ye Shuo’s attitude was very natural. He walked out with a grin and didn’t forget to explain to her: “I have to quickly notify someone to get ice.”
Although it is already autumn, the prince’s body cannot be exposed to the air for a long time, as it will easily breed a foul smell over time.
My cheap father is in that state now. He is angry and I can’t rely on him. I dare not mention the prince in front of him. What if my cheap father gets angry and yells that he wants to burn the prince?
As for the second prince and others… the prince is a time bomb now. There is no benefit in helping him. It may even implicate then. I guess no one wants to get involved.
Not to mention the people under my cheap father, they all follow orders. What if they fall down without orders?
After thinking about it, I can only lend a hand.
Upon hearing this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but fall silent for a while, but when he walked out, she finally followed him.
When they returned to Qingfeng Courtyard, Ye Shuo gave an order. In addition, the emperor did not mention the use of fire after waking up, so the people in charge of guarding immediately notified everyone to go to the ice storage places in Shengzhou to get ice.
Then, before the prince was put into the coffin, Ye Shuo personally helped the prince change into new clothes from head to toe.
But despite this, the moment the coffin was closed, Ye Shuo still felt his heart tremble violently.
Just like his father in his previous life, after this separation, he will never see him again.
The voices, smiles and appearances of the dead are all lost in the dust of time.
Ye Shuo was obviously very tired, but after lying down, the prince’s every word and action flashed before his eyes uncontrollably.
“Please stay with me.” Yao Zhi turned around and was about to leave, but suddenly heard these words coming from behind her.
Yao Zhi thought about it, and finally moved a chair and sat at the head of his bed.
Ye Shuo tossed and turned due to fatigue in his heart and pain in his body. Yao Zhi couldn’t bear to see it anymore, so she decisively pressed a few acupoints on him. Ye Shuo felt relieved and gradually fell asleep.
It was two days later when Emperor Jingwen managed to escape from his frenzy.
Emperor Jingwen still had hatred in his heart, so it was naturally impossible for him to take the initiative to ask about the prince’s affairs after his death. However, deep in his heart, he did have other emotions.
Emperor Jingwen was stunned when he learned later that all matters had been taken care of by his youngest son.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly remembered the scene when he went crazy two days ago. As the person involved, Emperor Jingwen naturally knew how hard he had hit his son. According to his original expectation, his youngest son would probably be unable to get out of bed for several days, but he did not expect that he had not stopped for a moment in the past two days.
Emperor Jingwen had always hoped that his youngest son would grow up and become sensible, but he never expected that it would end up like this.
