What’s more, even the prince’s clothes were changed by the youngest son himself.
Hearing this, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but ask, “Didn’t the Second Prince and the others think of lending a hand?”
The secret guard paused, and Emperor Jingwen immediately understood something.
The prince has just lost his power, and these brothers are just standing by and watching. They are truly a bunch of heartless people!
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt a chill in his heart.
Emperor Jingwen was angry with the Second Prince and others, but that didn’t mean that Emperor Jingwen was not angry with Ye Shuo.
Emperor Jingwen is now in a very complicated mood. He refuses to admit that he still has feelings for the prince and hates that the prince abandoned him so easily, but he will not tolerate others humiliating the prince.
After experiencing the pain of losing his son, Emperor Jingwen’s temper became more and more strange. On the one hand, he felt comforted by his youngest son’s affection, but on the other hand, he felt that his youngest son had betrayed him, so he was very angry.
You know, although the prince is no longer with us, the suspicion of treason has not yet been cleared from him.
It was just a coincidence that Ye Shuo came at the wrong time and happened to run into the muzzle of the gun.
Upon seeing his figure, Emperor Jingwen immediately lost his temper, and even his eyes became fierce. “Since you care so much about your third brother, and you want to bury him in your own tomb, why don’t you go and keep him company?”
Ever since the death of the crown prince, my stepfather’s temper has become more extreme.
His stepfather wouldn’t sentence him to death outright. If he was just going to guard the mausoleum, Ye Shuo wasn’t too worried. It didn’t matter where he stayed.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh: “Dad, don’t say these angry words. Even if I hear them too much, I will take them seriously.”
Ye Shuo can now understand his stepfather’s feelings at the moment, but some things would hurt feelings if said too much.
Seeing that he had the courage to threaten him, Emperor Jingwen immediately became angry, and his eyes became even more vicious.
However, before Emperor Jingwen could speak, Ye Shuo opened the food box in his hand and placed the food on the table one by one. Ye Shuo said, “You haven’t eaten properly for two days. If you continue like this, you will be hurt. These are all cooked by me. They are all appetizing and easy to digest. Dad, please consider it as a favor and use some of them.”
Seeing that he was still ignoring his anger, Emperor Jingwen was just about to overturn the table and the dishes together, but he slowly raised his head after he finished speaking.
“Dad, I feel so tired these past few days…”
Ye Shuo’s tired voice was not fake. After such a busy schedule, he was almost exhausted.
Emperor Jingwen then noticed the dark circles under his eyes and the visible haggardness, and he could no longer lower his raised hand.
Ye Shuo moved a stool for him.
Emperor Jingwen looked at him for a long time with a serious look.
Ye Shuo seemed completely unaware. He tested the food in front of him for poison one by one before carefully placing the bowl and chopsticks in front of Emperor Jingwen.
“Please, Father, please open your mouth and have some food.”
As a son, he could do this, so even the current Emperor Jingwen could not find any fault with him.
Emperor Jingwen finally sat down.
During the entire lunch time, neither the father nor the son spoke. Although they didn’t speak, the atmosphere was much better than before.
Perhaps he finally realized how sad his youngest son was, and Emperor Jingwen stopped venting his anger on him or finding fault with him. However, his appetite was still poor. He barely ate half a bowl of porridge and took two chopsticks of the refreshing side dishes, and then he couldn’t eat any more.
“That’s fine…” It’s better than not eating anything.
Hearing his youngest son mumbling there, Emperor Jingwen remained silent and did not say anything.
It was not until Ye Shuo was carrying his lunch box and preparing to leave that he suddenly said, “I’ll ask Han Ji to come find you later.”
Han Ji is the commander-in-chief who was just promoted by his stepfather.
What did his cheap father mean by saying this for no reason? What could Han Ji do by coming to him?
After thinking about it for a while, Ye Shuo realized that his cheap father couldn’t save face and saw that he was too tired to directly ask for help, so he beat around the bush and did this.
Ye Shuo added casually: “Okay, I’ll come over in the evening. Cold cabbage and chicken leg pine mushroom porridge, right? This son remembers it.”
The cold cabbage and chicken leg and matsutake porridge were the only two things that Emperor Jingwen had picked up his chopsticks just now.
Before Emperor Jingwen could open his mouth, as if he wanted to say something, but in the end he just moved his lips but didn’t say anything.
Ye Shuo was already used to this and didn’t care and left soon.
Ye Shuo did not hide anything when he investigated the assassination later. He wanted to investigate the prince’s affairs, but he could not hide it from his adoptive father no matter what, not to mention there was no need to do so.
Seeing this, Yao Zhi at the side couldn’t help but say: “Maybe I can help with this matter.”
Yao Zhi has been in the underworld for so long, so naturally she has two or three close friends. It would be no problem for her to help him get some information.
However, in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, the actions of the two people were no different from playing house. What could they find out with the help of those people?
Emperor Jingwen thought about it and finally summoned Wu Yi.
The reason why the prince was deposed was not because of the regicide, but because the locust plague was exposed later, forcing Emperor Jingwen to give an explanation to the people of the world.
The crown prince had already been deposed, the matter was a foregone conclusion and could no longer be reversed. There was no need to pursue the issue of whether it was regicide or not, and Emperor Jingwen was also afraid of getting a bad answer.
Now that the prince is dead, the situation is completely different.
If the assassination was really done by the prince, then it would be fine. But if it wasn’t done by the prince…
Suddenly, Emperor Jingwen slowly closed his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Raising
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Around the fourth day, Ye Xun received the news and rushed over on horseback, with the news that Mo Shu had died for his master.
Ye Shuo had no way of giving Mo Shu the same treatment, so he could only have him burned, collect his remains, put them in a jar, and have someone place it next to the prince’s coffin.
This was what Ye Shuo had promised him, and Mo Shu was very satisfied with this plan.
At first, Mo Shu thought that he would follow the prince to death, but he didn’t expect that he would be buried in the tomb with the prince. It was really a great surprise.
From this perspective, the master’s end was not so miserable.
At least… the Ninth Prince saw him off for the last time.
Ye Shuo had just gotten up. When he heard the news of Mo Shu’s suicide, he sat there quietly for a while, then waved his hand and asked someone to handle it according to the previous agreement.
As early as a day ago, Xiao Luzi also came back. Because he had to stay in Liangzhou to handle the handover matters, Ye Shuo did not take him on board. Xiao Luzi was very lucky to miss the assassination.
Then came the news that Ye Shuo and his group were stabbed and disappeared.Now, more than a month has passed, and everything has changed.
When Xiao Luzi hurried over from Liangzhou, he was heartbroken when he saw the current Ninth Prince.
Mo Shu treated the crown prince like this, so why not Xiao Luzi?
After helping Ye Shuo wash and dress like before, he heard the announcement from the front, put down the half-eaten breakfast, wiped his mouth, and went to meet people.
It’s been more than two years, almost three years since I last saw him. Ye Xun has grown into a handsome young man. Looking closely, he actually looks a bit like the prince back then.
Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly skipped a beat.
But Ye Xun was only sixteen years old, still a little immature. It goes without saying that he was completely panicked when he heard such bad news. If he hadn’t been influenced by the palace for so many years, he would not have been able to stay calm like he is now. However, the confusion in his eyes after losing his father’s protection could not be concealed no matter what…
The incident happened suddenly. As the eldest son, his brothers were young, and it was impossible for him to have servants follow him as usual. He could only come here alone on a fast horse.
Children who have not yet grown up have to face the storms early.
Perhaps because of the long journey, Ye Xun was exhausted and felt helpless as to what to do.
When he saw Ye Shuo appear, Ye Xun felt inexplicably relieved.
It stands to reason that when the grandson of the emperor comes, he should go to see Emperor Jingwen as soon as possible, but in this situation, how can Ye Shuo let his nephew go to see his stepfather?
With the nephew’s current appearance, if he goes, it will only make his stepfather’s already unstable emotions even more out of control.
So Ye Shuo said: “Don’t rush to see your grandfather, come and meet your father first.”
Ye Xun remained silent, nodded, and then followed his ninth uncle in a daze.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo had already taken care of everything before he came, otherwise he would not be able to count on the little grandson of the emperor.
Four days had passed since the prince committed suicide. Even though Ye Shuo had people add more ice every day, it still couldn’t last long. It was only enough for Ye Xun to see the prince for one last time.
“You stay here with your father for a while. The coffin will probably be completely sealed by evening.” Ye Shuo knew how much Ye Xun admired his father. Thinking of this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help feeling distressed.
The father and son must have a lot to say, and Ye Xun has been like everyone else since he was a child, he likes to keep everything to himself. At this time, Ye Shuo really didn’t have the heart to tease him, and he rarely left space for the two of them.
He was just worried that something might happen to Ye Xun, so Ye Shuo didn’t actually go too far.
Ye Shuo had just walked out of the yard when he heard the suppressed crying of a young man behind him…
Hearing this noise, Ye Shuo’s heart also felt sad. Ye Shuo quickly looked up at the sky, thinking in his heart, Third brother, third brother, your death will be the end of everything, but how will your wife and children cope with their lives?
The other side.
Emperor Jingwen also learned that Ye Xun had travelled thousands of miles from Shangjing to come here to attend the prince’s funeral.
After secretly glancing at His Majesty, the people below asked cautiously, “Your Majesty, do you want to summon the Emperor’s grandson to see you?”
After a while, Emperor Jingwen shook his head: “No need.”
What’s the use of seeing him? It will only cause you sorrow.
On the eighth day, the group finally returned to Shangjing. As for the prince’s coffin, it parted ways with the main group a few dozen miles away and went to the mausoleum prepared for Ye Shuo by the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
The emperor’s words were his bond and he would not take them back, so the prince was still deposed and his burial was naturally extremely shabby.
Compared with Ye Xun who was panicked and helpless, Ye Shuo had sent someone to inform the Crown Princess in advance a day ago.
The Crown Princess and the Crown Prince have been married for many years and they are deeply in love. She must be allowed to meet the Crown Prince again, otherwise she will feel regret every time she thinks of it in the future.
The Crown Princess is in good spirits at the moment. Although she looks a little haggard, she does not seem as heartbroken and unable to control herself as imagined.
Although the Crown Princess is weak, she is also flexible. Now that the Crown Prince is gone, she naturally has to help take care of this large family. Except for a few people, the rest still depend on her for their livelihood.
But at the same time, the Crown Princess certainly could not stay in Shangjing any longer. It was no secret that Emperor Jingwen had even wanted to bury them all with the Crown Prince. If they continued to stay in Shangjing, it would be a disaster for them if they displeased Emperor Jingwen one day.
Because of the incident with the crown prince, his father would probably no longer be the Grand Tutor soon. But his previous foundation was there, so it would not be too bad. Except that life would be much more difficult than in the Eastern Palace, there would still be a way out.
What’s more, the atmosphere in the East Palace in recent years is actually not much better than the outside world.
“At least I have some reputation in Liangzhou. My previous house is still empty. How about I send my third sister-in-law to Liangzhou?” Ye Shuo had some roots in Liangzhou, which was better than other places.
The Crown Princess was not very worried about her situation. As she was just a woman, even if there were party struggles in the future, she would not be affected.
Everything would be fine if the Crown Princess took people to other places, but what about Xun’er?
Xun’er had inherited the title in advance, so he had to stay in Shangjing. If he didn’t stay, his descendants would be forever excluded from the upper circle.
The Crown Princess actually didn’t care that much, but she had no choice. With Xun’er’s personality, he would definitely not be willing to do so.
The Crown Princess wanted to use her mother’s status to force him to submit. She only wanted him to be safe, and nothing else. But think about it, how can she control her child’s life like this?
Since Ye Shuo had spoken, he would naturally help him to the end.
No matter if it was the prince’s life-saving grace or the friendship between Ye Xun and him growing up together, Ye Shuo would not sit idly by.
The reason why he ran away in the first place was because he couldn’t stand seeing these things. Now that he saw them, he naturally couldn’t run away.
“If Xun’er doesn’t mind, I will take him to my house until he can stand on his own feet.”
With Ye Shuo watching nearby, no one could get their hands on the Ninth Prince’s Mansion.
The Crown Princess never imagined that the one who would stand up in the end would be this brother-in-law who was always considered out of touch by others.
The affairs concerning the crown prince’s death, the placement of his relatives, and finding his son… In the entire royal family, he is the only one who truly regards the crown prince as his own brother.
They often laugh and joke every day, as if they don’t care about the people and things around them, but they are the most affectionate.
But people like him are probably the hardest hit.
The Crown Princess was silent for a while, and then, in front of everyone, she couldn’t help but bow deeply to Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo was shocked and subconsciously wanted to help her up, but as expected, he was rejected by the Crown Princess.
“Uncle Jiu is kind and righteous, so you should accept this gift. This gift is not what I want, and I am performing it on behalf of the deposed crown prince.”
Ye Shuo had no choice but to sit there on pins and needles and endure it.
When it was time to say goodbye, Ye Shuo walked fast on purpose to leave space for them. Then the Crown Princess looked at her son, her eyes changed several times, from loving and compassionate at the beginning to firmness in the end.
“Xun’er, from now on your mother won’t be around, and everything will depend on you.”
And then there is…
“When you go to the capital, remember to listen to your Ninth Uncle and never forget the great kindness he has shown you today.”
A good family was shattered in an instant, and Ye Xun couldn’t help but choke up.
But in the end, he listened carefully to the end, and then nodded solemnly: “Of course, my son will definitely listen to the Ninth Uncle. If there is a chance in the future, I will definitely repay this favour.”
After so many years, Ye Xun is no longer the little kid who would only scream when frightened.
Just as the Crown Princess was packing up her things as quickly as possible and planning to leave the East Palace overnight, Ye Shuo also returned to the palace and walked towards the familiar Qiuwu Palace.
More than two years have passed, and Qiuwu Palace is still the same, without any change at all.
As soon as Ye Shuo approached, he heard a series of dog barking. Ye Shuo then remembered that when he left, he asked Jian Jian to take care of a few small dogs.
It has been almost three years now, and the six Chinese Greyhound puppies have now grown into adults.
Jianjian took good care of them, and they were all in high spirits. If the palace servants hadn’t stopped them, these dogs would have rushed out long ago.
Judging from the arrogant attitude of these dogs, his mother must still be the most favoured person in the harem, and no one can ever let her suffer any injustice.
When the palace servants saw Ye Shuo and Xiao Luzi, they were startled at first, and then they subconsciously shouted: “The Ninth Prince is back, the Ninth Prince is back!”
It didn’t matter that she shouted like that. The imperial concubine inside soon heard the noise and came out.
The moment she saw Ye Shuo, she subconsciously pinched her waist and said, “You bastard, you still remember to come back!”
Ye Shuo: “…”
When did his mother learn to take advantage of his father?
What could Ye Shuo do? He could only smile along.
Her son hadn’t come back for more than two years, and there was no news at all. Concubine Rong was so angry that she was about to die. She originally wanted to scold him, but when her eyes fell on the young man’s now haggard eyebrows, somehow, the concubine’s eyes suddenly turned red.
By this time, the news that the prince had died on his way to the southern tour had already spread.
After dragging Ye Shuo into the house, the handkerchief in the imperial concubine’s hand was almost twisted to pieces. After struggling for a long time, she couldn’t help but ask, “Does it hurt?”
By now, Ye Shuo couldn’t hold it in any longer: “It hurts, mother. It hurts so much for my son.”
The imperial concubine’s tears suddenly fell.

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Encounter on the Road
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
For the imperial concubine, the life or death of the prince had nothing to do with her, and she was not that close to the prince.
But the imperial concubine knew that her son had a particularly deep affection for the prince, and after hearing these words, she couldn’t stand it.
This child is usually careless and seems to care about nothing, but his mind is more delicate than others.
If it wasn’t so painful, he wouldn’t have shouted out like that.
In a short while, the imperial concubine shed all the tears that Ye Shuo had not had time to shed in the past few days.
“Don’t worry, don’t worry, mom is here.”
Regardless of the fact that Su Yue and the others were still there, the imperial concubine hugged him in her arms like she did when they were little, and patted his back continuously.
Only the familiar scent of the imperial concubine made Ye Shuo feel at ease.
After a short while, a large area of ​​the imperial concubine’s shoulders was wet.When Jianjian came back from the study, what she saw was the scene of mother and son hugging each other and crying.
To Jianjian, her brother was too weak to be a prince. In her life, she had never seen a prince like him who could cry at any time. He was not worth anything at all.
I don’t know why, Jianjian looked disgusted on the surface, but she felt sour and uncomfortable in her heart.
“Jianjian…”
After not seeing her for more than two years, Jianjian has grown much taller than before. The twelve and a half year old girl has already begun to show her beautiful appearance.
Princess Jianjian’s eyebrows and eyes are bright, not as gentle as those of ordinary girls. In addition, she habitually has a cold face, which gives people a feeling of coldness and arrogance that is difficult to approach.
Jianjian was quite favoured by Emperor Jingwen in the palace. She was the only one among the princesses. Therefore, her aura and her cold eyes made people dare not look directly at her after looking at her for a long time.
Looking at Ye Shuo and the imperial concubine again, their eyes were as red as rabbits, which made Princess Jianjian look even more majestic.
I didn’t notice it at normal times, but now it seems that the brother and sister were born with the wrong gender.
As Jianjian grew up, her temperament became increasingly cold, hard and resolute. She hated seeing other people crying the most. But now her brother was looking at her from afar with his red eyes as if he had just cried. When she heard him calling her, his voice was hoarse and he looked as if he had suffered a great injustice, Jianjian’s expression suddenly froze and her heart began to weaken uncontrollably. She could hardly maintain her cold face.
Seeing her attitude softening, without waiting for Jianjian to put down her pencil case and the book in her hand, Ye Shuo still felt it was not enough, and turned around and hugged his sister and cried.
Ye Shuo cried bitterly and said, “Jianjian, I feel bad.”
The news of the prince’s death was no longer a secret, but because Jianjian was young before, she could not remember many things. In addition, there had been constant disputes in the court in recent years. Since Ye Shuo left, Jianjian seldom went to the East Palace. Therefore, although Jianjian was very sad, she was far from being heartbroken.
Jianjian has reached puberty and doesn’t like to be close to people. When she saw Ye Shuo approaching, she instinctively wanted to push him away, but when she heard him crying, she really couldn’t do it.
Jianjian just stood there stiffly, letting his tears and snot rub all over her body.
“…Can you calm down! Look at yourself, you don’t even look like a prince anymore.”
Jianjian took out a handkerchief and wiped his tears as usual, like she did when they were children, with a look of disgust on her face.
It is said that women are made of water, but now it seems that her brother is more likely to be made of water.
It was not until the evening that Ye Shuo’s emotions gradually calmed down.
“It’s been such a long time since we last met. Jianjian seems to have grown a lot taller…” Ye Shuo hiccuped and sobbed as he looked at his graceful sister in front of him, gesturing with his hands.
“It was only this small before, but now it’s this tall.”
Jian Jian had almost finished the homework that Master Cen had assigned her. When she heard this, she couldn’t help but roll her eyes: “You just saw it?”
“That’s right. You’ve been living a carefree life outside, and I’m afraid you’ve completely forgotten about me and my mother. It’s already very rare that you know I’m taller than before.”
After not seeing her for two years, the little girl has become even more talkative.
Looking up inadvertently, Jianjian saw that Ye Shuo’s eyes, which had finally calmed down, began to turn red again, and Jianjian’s smiling expression instantly froze.
Oops, she’s pissed him off again.
Jianjian hurriedly stumbled as she tried to change the subject, no longer daring to use her usual tactics to deal with her brother.
That’s about right.
Ye Shuo quickly sucked back his tears.
Ye Shuo hasn’t been back for a long time. Today, the small kitchen cooked all his favourite dishes, and Jianjian had no objection to this.
As long as her brother doesn’t cry, she can do anything. It’s just a few dishes, it’s really a small matter that can’t be any smaller.
What’s more, after finishing dinner, Jianjian kept accompanying Ye Shuo to the palace gate. When Ye Shuo’s figure gradually disappeared, a trace of worry flashed across Jianjian’s eyes.
Jianjian is a very intelligent girl. Although she doesn’t know what exactly happened in the court, she can vaguely feel that a storm is coming.
Now the third brother is gone, and he is crying like this. If something happens to someone else, how will his brothers be able to bear it?
Jianjian now only regrets that she was born too late and that she is a princess. Even though she has the will, she is powerless.
The other side.
Compared to the gloom and sadness in Qiuwu Palace, the Queen could not contain herself and started to feel happy as early as the day when the news of the Crown Prince’s death came.
Once the crown prince dies, won’t her son be the only legitimate son? He will naturally have more followers.
“Wu Ji, after so many years, the good days for us mother and son are finally coming.”
The Thirteenth Prince is now thirteen years old and has gradually become like a teenager. He has already learned to obey, and no matter how the Queen treats him, he will no longer resist.
Although the Thirteenth Prince looks like a teenager, he is not as energetic as the other princes, and there is a hint of gloom between his brows.
Seeing her son so obedient, the queen was naturally very happy, but soon, thinking of her son’s academic problems, the queen’s face immediately fell again.
There was no other reason. Although his son was now a legitimate son, his intelligence was not satisfactory. He was not even as good as the little girl in Qiuwu Palace.
In fact, the Thirteenth Prince’s performance in the study was not bad, but because he was not the best, he was useless in the eyes of the Queen.
How could he not be like the previous prince, who was excellent in every way? Why couldn’t such a smart child be born in her belly? Even if it meant losing her body, the queen was willing.
When the time came, the queen drank a bowl of bitter medicine as usual. Bitterness and pain are two things that people will never get used to even after a long time.
Today, the Queen’s tongue is numb from all the medicine she takes, and she falls ill every few days. She cannot taste the original flavour of anything she eats, not even candied fruits covered with molasses.
After eating seven or eight candied fruits, the bitter taste of the medicine could no longer be suppressed. Looking at her son’s submissive and cowardly appearance, the queen was no longer happy and suddenly became very angry.
“Useless thing, it’s a waste of my hard work to cultivate you for so many years.”
She scolded him a few more times and waited until it was completely dark outside before letting him go back. She also gave some instructions to the palace maids around the Thirteenth Prince.
“Change him into that lake blue outfit tomorrow. I don’t know how you guys are serving him. This cyan outfit doesn’t suit him at all. Didn’t all of you notice that?”
But… the Thirteenth Prince likes cyan the best and hates blue the most.
The palace maid hesitated for a moment and said this, but the queen didn’t care at all. She just thought that the Thirteenth Prince was only thirteen years old and he didn’t understand anything, so what he said naturally didn’t count.
Seeing this, the palace maids dared not mention it anymore.
The other side.
When Ye Shuo arrived at the palace gate, Ye Xun was already waiting there.
In just one day, the Crown Princess had ordered people to pack the luggage and find a carriage. Half an hour ago, she left the palace and left Shangjing.
Sighing in his heart, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but pat Ye Xun on the shoulder: “Don’t be dejected, there are still many days to come, cheer up.”
Ye Xun pulled the corners of his mouth and forced a smile.
As luck would have it, when the two of them were walking side by side towards the Ninth Prince’s Mansion, they once again ran into the First Prince who was returning from work at the door.
When the eldest prince saw Ye Xun, a complex emotion flashed across his eyes.
The eldest prince could never have imagined that the once glorious prince would die like this. It felt like a dream.
The eldest prince thought that he would be ecstatic after learning the news of the death of his greatest rival, but in fact, he was not. Instead, he felt bored and uninterested.
It’s really boring.
In comparison, Ye Xun was still young. The moment he saw his great uncle, although he did not show anything on his face, his hands were secretly clenched under his sleeves.
Compared to the crown prince, his son is too young.
With a sneer in his heart, the eldest prince did not take the young man seriously at all. He just set his sights on Ye Shuo: “Ninth brother has been very busy these days.”
In the past, his younger brother never cared much about things, so the eldest prince didn’t bother to bother with him. But now that he brought the prince’s son to his house, the eldest prince couldn’t help but wonder if the prince had other thoughts, and he couldn’t help but want to get involved.
If he really had any ulterior motives, the eldest prince would no longer be able to treat him as a brother.
Seeing that the Great Uncle had a dangerous look in his eyes, Ye Xun immediately became alert.
Ye Shuo was not panicked at all: “No matter what, Ye Xun is my nephew, I can’t just sit there and watch. Big brother, don’t put on such an expression, my brother is no longer the same as before, you can’t afford to offend me now.”
The eldest prince was stunned.
I haven’t seen him for more than two years. How come this guy has become so arrogant? Is this still him?
The eldest prince almost didn’t react. In a short moment, the eldest prince thought a lot. When he came to his senses, he was furious: “Since you said so, then I have to see what you can do.”
…Hiss, things have gotten out of hand.
Ye Shuo hurriedly began to shout: “Miss Yao! Miss Yao, help me!”
As early as in the morning, Yao Zhi was arranged by Ye Shuo to live in his house. At that time, his stepfather did not say much, and others did not dare to gossip about her.
And with the Fourth Prince been taken care of by her, no one dared to say anything.
Yao Zhi, who was doing nothing in the yard, heard the young man’s shout. She didn’t even have time to go through the main gate. She just jumped lightly and jumped onto the wall.
The bright red dress was like a raging fire, lighting up half of the alley.
The eldest prince: “?”
Ignoring the slightly confused expression of the other party, after Yao Zhi came over, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask in a low voice: “What do you think of this person in front of you?” If it really doesn’t work, it should be okay to add him, right?
Yao Zhi looked the eldest prince up and down, then nodded: “Okay.”
“He can’t beat me without help.” After so many years in the underworld, Yao Zhi still has this kind of vision.
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
He has been waiting for this day for so many years!
Then Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows and looked over: “How is it, big brother?”
The eldest prince: “…”
At the same time, the Sixth Prince also returned exhausted.
Originally, the Sixth Prince wanted to walk to the other side, but unexpectedly he heard a noise not far away. The Sixth Prince did not want to pay attention to it, but after careful listening, he found that it was the voice of his ninth brother whom he had not seen for a long time, and… the figure of the eldest prince.
The Sixth Prince thought about it and finally changed direction.
There were lanterns hanging in a row on the street, and under the light of the candles, the figure of the Sixth Prince gradually became clear.
The moment he saw the other person, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but shout, “Xiao Ming!”
The Sixth Prince could hardly maintain his expression.
Looking at the eldest prince again…Huh? Why did the eldest brother’s expression become so ugly?

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Ambition
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
This embarrassment is not directed at him, but… the Sixth Prince across from him?
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment.
The Sixth Prince paused, then bowed to the First Prince: “Big Brother.”
Seeing this, the eldest prince could not help but sneer: “I don’t deserve your courtesy.”
The Sixth Prince said calmly, “Big Brother, you are too kind. I am really scared.”
The eldest prince: “Humph!”
He kept saying he was terrified, but in his heart he was thinking about how to kill himself!
Then the eldest prince looked at Ye Shuo who was standing beside him: “The imperial concubine has found a good brother for you.” Hearing that he and Xiao Jiu were in trouble, he came over.
He is loyal.Ye Shuo: “?”
I just don’t know if the Sixth Prince had the ability he has now when he was with the Imperial Concubine.
Just as Ye Shuo was stunned, the eldest prince flicked his sleeves and left.
After a while, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but turn his head and ask, “What does he mean?”
Also, Xiao Ming is now quite capable. He dares to challenge the eldest prince openly, which is totally different from his previous style.
Under Ye Shuo’s surprised eyes, the Sixth Prince couldn’t hold it in any longer and couldn’t help but clear his cough.
Then, Ye Shuo understood why the eldest prince was deeply resentful of the sixth prince but did not take any unnecessary action.
During the month when his stepfather was missing, the eldest prince had his own army and was in a position of power, so it was naturally impossible for him to just sit there and wait.
It was fine in the first few days after the news came, but later on, the eldest prince’s small actions became more frequent, and the atmosphere in Shangjing City became even more subtle. The eldest prince wanted to take advantage of this opportunity to control Shangjing and ascend to that position.
The Sixth Prince who stayed behind naturally saw this, and joined forces with He Xiang and other civil officials to resist the attack of the First Prince.
Almost all the civil officials united together, and even the eldest prince did not dare to face his edge, so there is peace now. When the eldest prince sees him again, how can he not be annoyed? How can he not hate him?
In short, the Sixth Prince has made great progress.
If it hadn’t been for this incident, the eldest prince wouldn’t have known that his younger brother was hiding so deeply.
After hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t come back to his senses for a long time. When he looked up again, the look he gave the Sixth Prince could not be described as pure surprise, but rather shock.
Is this still the poor little Xiao Ming he knows?
The Sixth Prince was such a calm person, but he felt a little embarrassed when he was looked at by him.
Ye Shuo touched his chin unconsciously and said, “Doesn’t this mean… that I can walk around freely in Shangjing City in the future?”
From now on you can’t call him Xiao Ming anymore. I guess you have to call him Sixth Brother.
The Sixth Prince was speechless when he heard this. It was as if he could not walk around the capital city without him.
It was just that Xiaojiu was happy for himself sincerely without any impurities, which made the Sixth Prince feel comforted.
Over the years, there is a reason why my father would choose to go to Qiuwu Palace whenever he was tired.
After so many years, the Sixth Prince finally became as high-spirited and vigorous as the other princes.
When they were about to part, the Sixth Prince’s eyes inadvertently passed over Yao Zhi, and he couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
Xiaojiu…is probably the most casual one among all the brothers. He is really out of tune.
It’s better this way. After all, Xiaojiu and I will never be completely opposed to each other like I and my other brothers.
Similarly, Ye Shuo was also very moved that the Sixth Prince came to “rescue” him after hearing the sound.
As for whether there are other factors behind it… I can only say that people can’t live too clearly. Sometimes it’s enough to be almost clear. It’s not a bad thing to be a little confused.
Soon, Ye Shuo separated from the Sixth Prince.
Ye Shuo arranged for Ye Xun to live in the yard next to his own.
“Just live here peacefully. If you have any problems, just come to me or the housekeeper.”
The boy who had just lost his father was the most vulnerable and needed guidance from others. Ye Shuo patiently gave him advice.
Under the warm orange light, the young man’s eyebrows were unusually gentle at the moment. How could anyone who witnessed this scene not be moved?
Yao Zhi’s eyes were confused, and she didn’t dare to stay any longer, and left almost as if she was escaping.
The next morning, Ye Shuo went into the palace without much hesitation.
He returned in a hurry yesterday and only visited his mother and Jianjian. He hasn’t been back for more than two years, so he must go and see Zhao Chongrong and the others, and by the way, thank the three of them for taking care of Qiuwu Palace.
When Xu Chongyi saw Ye Shuo, dhe immediately shouted in surprise: “Ah!”
“Why did you come back? When did you come back? Come in, come in.”
After examining it carefully, Xu Chongyi couldn’t help but say, “It’s thinner than before.”
“Maybe it’s because I have a lot of things to worry about recently, so I’ve lost some weight.” Ye Shuo paused, then answered vaguely.
Soon Li Chongyuan also came over after hearing the news. The two of them observed Ye Shuo over and over again. They entered the palace much earlier than Concubine Rong, and their age was similar to that of Emperor Jingwen. They were not as young as they were before, so naturally they became more talkative.
Ye Shuo was sandwiched between the two people, like a puppet that was powerless to resist.
After finally breaking free, Ye Shuo looked around, but did not see Zhao Chongrong, so he subconsciously asked, “Where is Empress Zhao? Why can’t I see her?”
The moment the words fell, Xu Chongyi and Li Chongyuan suddenly became quiet.
Ye Shuo suddenly had a bad feeling in his heart.
Under the urging of the young man’s eyes, Xu Chongyi couldn’t help but sigh: “Sister Zhao has been ill since the beginning of autumn, and she hasn’t recovered until now.”
Being healthy and successful is extremely rare. Birth, ageing, sickness and death are the norm in life. When you reach a certain age, all kinds of illnesses will follow and it is difficult to avoid them.
Besides, Zhao Chongren herself was not a very open-minded person. If she had not had these two children by her side to accompany her and ease the depression a little, the problems hidden in her heart would have erupted long ago and would not have waited until today.
Ye Shuo’s heart tightened, and he stood up immediately: “I’ll go see Empress Zhao.”
Xu Chongyi thought about it and finally nodded.
When Ye Shuo knocked on the door of Shulanzhai and entered the main hall of Shulanzhai, the person who came into his sight was Zhao Chongrong, who looked sick.
Zhao Chongrong’s face was pale. She leaned on the edge of the bed and forced herself to drink the medicine brought by the palace maid. The originally pretty and pleasant woman was no longer as beautiful as she used to be, and looked a little withered and dying.
Sometimes, time can be really cruel.
Seeing this scene, Ye Shuo couldn’t help feeling a little sad.
Noticing the movement at the door, Zhao Chongrong initially thought it was two good friends. At this time, Jianjian was still studying in the study room, and she had no contact with other concubines, so they were the only ones who could come here.
“Didn’t I say to stop coming here to avoid getting sick? Ahem.”
Zhao Chongrong couldn’t help coughing twice, and when she looked up, she saw a tall and graceful figure.
Over the past two years, Ye Shuo had gradually lost his original immaturity. For a moment, Zhao Chongrong almost didn’t recognize him.
When she recognized it was him, Zhao Chongrong suddenly became happy: “When did you come back?”
After reacting, Zhao Chongrong waved his hands hurriedly: “Quick, quick, quick, get out, what if the disease is passed?”
She was very happy that Ye Shuo came to see her for the first time after he came back.
“Don’t worry, I’m in good health.” After saying this, he sat down without caring about Zhao Chongrong’s refusal.
Zhao Chongrong couldn’t help but look at Xu Chongyi and Li Chongyuan, only to find that they were in the same situation, chatting with her as usual.
If I can find a few people like this, my life in this palace will be worthwhile.
There were tears in Zhao Chongrong’s eyes, but she was afraid that they would worry, so she pretended to lower her head to eat candied fruit while no one was paying attention, and quickly wiped her tears with her sleeve.
But how could Ye Shuo and the others not see it? They just pretended not to know.
Around noon, Jianjian also came over. Jianjian first habitually glanced at the flowerpot next to her and saw that there was no medicine soup in it. Then she heard that Empress Xu and the others saw Empress Zhao drink the medicine with their own eyes, and only then did she feel relieved.
Zhao Chongrong felt a little embarrassed as she was already old and had to be taken care of by a little kid.
Jian Jian said, “So what if you are old? Won’t you still act like a child?”
It turned out that Zhao Chongrong felt that these decoctions were useless. She hadn’t seen any improvement after drinking so many of them. Plus, the medicine was bitter, so she poured the whole bowl into the flowerpot in a fit of anger.
After Jianjian found out, this is what happened.
Zhao Chongrong couldn’t help but argue: “It was only that one time.”
But it didn’t work this time.
Jianjian couldn’t help but sigh: “You have to take the medicine on time, then the disease can be cured.”
Zhao Chongrong had no hope at first. Over the years, she had seen too many people in the palace, many of whom died of a cold. Zhao Chongrong didn’t think she would be the lucky one, but…
Looking at the undisguised worry in so many people’s eyes, Zhao Chongrong gradually felt a sense of energy in her heart.
When Ye Shuo and others left, Zhao Chongrong was obviously in much better spirits than before.
Ye Shuo specifically asked Jian Jian and found out that Empress Zhao had caught a cold in the early autumn, which caused evil wind to enter her body. In addition, she had accidentally lost her daughter that year, which injured her body, so it took so long for her to recover.
Ye Shuo was anxious here but couldn’t do anything. He could only try his best to help find some precious medicinal herbs and spend more time with her.
After what happened, Ye Shuo’s mood was naturally not very good.
Even though he has lived two lives and knows that with the passage of time, people will gradually begin to lose things after reaching a certain age, but he still prays that this day will come later and later.
After returning home, before Ye Shuo could calm down, he heard that the matter he had been investigating for so many days had finally made some progress.
The assassination was indeed not instigated by the crown prince. Rather, the prefects of Yeling and Xianghu saw that Emperor Jingwen was coming with great force and was killing and beheading people wherever he went. They knew that when the emperor arrived, it would be their own death. Even the crown prince could not save them, so the two prefects were desperate and actually came up with the idea of ​​treason.
Since there is no doubt that I will die, I might as well give it a try. There might be a chance of a turning point.
There is no other reason, and it is not instructed by others. The answer is that simple.
But what Ye Shuo didn’t understand was, when his step-father was well prepared, how could the two prefects have such great abilities and how did they collude with such a large group of assassins.
It is precisely because the number and quality of the assassins are completely beyond the ability of a mere prefect that he suspects the crown prince’s involvement.
Now it has been confirmed that it was not done by the crown prince. When the crown prince was in Bingzhou, he did not move at all, so who else could it be?
However, before Ye Shuo could think about it carefully, during the morning court session the next day, another piece of news that shocked countless people came –
In front of all the civil and military officials, the Seventh Prince revealed how the Second Prince had someone conceal the truth and replaced a letter.
No, it’s not a swap, but the order of the words in the original letter was changed, so that two different meanings are presented.
“I hope your Majesty will understand.”
As he spoke, the Seventh Prince lowered his head and respectfully raised above his head the thing he had obtained with all his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Taking Action
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
When the Second Prince received the news of the Crown Prince’s death, he felt extremely uneasy.
Others didn’t know how the emperor felt about the prince, but he and the eldest prince, who were about the same age as the prince, knew it best. Even though the emperor had reprimanded the prince in the past two years, as the saying goes, the deeper the love, the more severe the criticism. The emperor had never been so harsh on him, the eldest prince, and the other princes.
Because I value you, I feel very sorry for you.
It was precisely because he saw it so clearly that the Second Prince felt even more desperate, and so he wanted to get rid of the Crown Prince even more. And things went smoothly as he expected.
But the second prince never expected that the crown prince would commit suicide in despair.
When a person dies, all things are gone. Even if the prince had many faults in the past, as time goes by, all the emperor can think of is his good side.
What the second prince had not expected was that the assassination was not arranged by the crown prince.
When the second prince learned the result, he broke out in a cold sweat.
How is it possible? With such a big scene, who else could have done it if not the crown prince?If the prince was not dead, and if he was the one who ordered the assassination, then the letter would no longer be important. By then, the prince would have no way of making a defense, and he would be able to conceal the truth easily.
Unfortunately, the development of the two events went against his inference.
When the second prince learned the results of the investigation into the assassination, his heart suddenly skipped a beat and he knew that something bad had happened.
But the Second Prince could never have imagined that it would be the Seventh Prince who would finally expose this matter, and it happened so quickly and so unexpectedly.
How could it be him!
— A Seventh Prince who had been following the Fifth Prince since he was a child and whose presence was not even as strong as that of the servants around him!
The second prince stared at the letter in the seventh prince’s hand as if he wanted to make a hole in the letter. His heart was instantly filled with turbulent waves.
How could it be! How could he have this letter in his hand!
I had clearly found a way to destroy it after the death of the deposed crown prince!
The Second Prince had always been cautious and naturally would not make such a mistake, so the Seventh Prince simply asked someone to find out what method could be used to produce exactly the same handwriting, and then used the same method to make another letter.
As long as the second prince really did such a thing, even if the letter was not true, it would eventually become true.
It’s like if the prince really attempted assassination, it doesn’t matter whether you believe it or not. As long as he did it, he would be guilty of patricide and treason.
The process is not important, what is important is the result.
It’s not that the Seventh Prince didn’t have other options. He ultimately choose the Second Prince’s own method to send the Second Prince to hell completely. It can be seen from this how ruthless his methods were and how vicious his intentions were.
The only difficulty in this matter is how to put all the words on the letter together.
Although the seventh prince was not favoured, it was not difficult for him to get the authentic work of Emperor Jingwen. With the authentic work, he could use a special method to soak it in water and peel it off, so that every word on it could be arranged and combined at will.
Because it was written by Emperor Jingwen himself, the prince was unable to recognize it at first.
The Seventh Prince does not have the ability to produce conclusive evidence, and the Second Prince is unlikely to leave such an obvious flaw. But it doesn’t matter. As long as we can guess what methods the Second Prince used, I believe that my father will investigate every detail clearly.
The Seventh Prince has been patient for so many years, waiting for this day.
The Second Prince’s eyes were red with anger as he watched Emperor Jingwen finish reading the letter.
Emperor Jingwen remembered that what he had written originally was clearly to tell the prince to admit his mistakes and correct them and not to make the same mistake again, but this letter turned out to be a heart-piercing reprimand.
Even Emperor Jingwen himself could not tell whether these words were real or fake, so how could the prince know clearly?
If the prince had seen such content at the beginning, Emperor Jingwen could not imagine what the prince felt at that time.
The death of the crown prince was closely related to the interference of some people with ulterior motives.
This is what we see openly. How much more are there that we cannot see behind the scenes?
These people will do anything to get that position, and they can even think of such a sinister method.
The prince was lax in governing his subordinates, which resulted in countless deaths and injuries among the people in Yeling and Xianghu. It was not unfair for him to commit suicide to apologize. The prince sold official positions and exploited the people, which deserved death. The prefects of Yeling and Xianghu plotted treason, and the prince, as their backer, was also guilty. These were all the crimes the prince deserved. All of the above could not be cleansed up no matter what, and it could even be considered a mercy that only the prince died.
There is just one thing, the prince can die, but he cannot die due to a misunderstanding with Emperor Jingwen.
The prince and Emperor Jingwen, father and son, harboured resentment until their death. Even at the last moment, the prince did not even know that he was not rejected by his biological father.
The second prince who did this act caught the attention of Emperor Jingwen, and suddenly gave Emperor Jingwen a place to vent his resentment.
The Second Prince watched as Emperor Jingwen’s eyes gradually turned cold and disgusted.
The second prince immediately broke out in a cold sweat.
Emperor Jingwen was in a state of anxiety, and in the end he could only squeeze out one word from between his teeth: “Investigate!”
Whenever the secret guards under my father’s command take action, no matter how covert they are, they will be thoroughly investigated in the end. Over the years, there have been very few exceptions.
No matter how the Second Prince tried to remain calm, his slightly pale face could not be misled, and there was a thin layer of sweat on his forehead, slowly rolling down to his temples.
The Seventh Prince suddenly felt relieved.
When the Second Prince finally waited until the court session was over, he saw the Seventh Prince also coming out of the palace. He couldn’t help but say, “Seventh brother, you are really good at this. I usually underestimated you.”
It’s true that the barking dog bites.
The Second Prince was obviously confused, otherwise, how could he have ever stopped someone in public like this before?
The Seventh Prince used to be afraid of his mother Xu Guirong’s safety, so he naturally didn’t dare to confront the Second Prince and the Fifth Prince. But now his mother Xu Guirong is gone, and the Seventh Prince is all alone. What is there to be afraid of?
Therefore, the Seventh Prince didn’t even move his eyelids, but just said: “Second brother, you are too kind.”
Xu Guirong was just a maid beside Concubine Shu back then, but later she became the emperor’s woman like Concubine Shu herself. It was natural that Concubine Shu was unhappy, and it was understandable that she repeatedly made things difficult for her.
But what does this have to do with the Seventh Prince? The Seventh Prince is not so magnanimous. He is narrow-minded and naturally cannot learn to think from others’ perspective.
The seventh prince only knew that his only warmth in the palace, his mother who cared about his food and clothing, who would compromise for him and even worry about him when she was sick, was gone.
Now that his mother was gone, he had nothing to worry about.
It doesn’t matter anymore.
However, the second prince did not understand why he was the one among him, his mother, and the fifth prince.
To be honest, the Second Prince was a smooth person and seldom offended anyone. Even if he looked down on the Seventh Prince and did not take him seriously, he would not bully him openly. This was completely different from the Fifth Prince who bullied him everywhere. After all, the Second Prince at least gave him some face. Even if he wanted to go crazy, he should target his fifth brother.
In response to the Second Prince’s question, the Seventh Prince’s answer was also very simple. At this point, it seemed that there was nothing he couldn’t say: “You are so amazing. You are the most amazing among the three.”
Regardless of whether it is conspiracy or overt conspiracy, or big or small ways, it is undeniable that the second prince has this ability.
As long as the second prince is eliminated, neither the remaining concubine Shu nor the fifth prince will be a match for the seventh prince.
Die together with these people? No, the Seventh Prince would not do such a stupid thing. Even if he wanted revenge, he would not sacrifice himself. Besides, it was too easy for them to deal with three people at once.
The Seventh Prince had been the Fifth Prince’s little follower for so many years, so he naturally knew that Concubine Shu’s greatest wish in life was to watch her son sit on the supreme throne.
If you want to take revenge on someone, the best way is not to let him die, but to take away all his hope bit by bit.
Whatever the other party wants, you must destroy it.
What’s more, the Seventh Prince will not touch the Fifth Prince. He will only leave Concubine Shu with a glimmer of hope while giving her endless despair.
With the Second Prince around, they might be able to turn the tide in time. Without the Second Prince, with the Fifth Prince’s temperament and intelligence, he would have to be slaughtered like a chicken or a pig by the Seventh Prince for the rest of his life.
The Seventh Prince has been the Fifth Prince’s dog for more than twenty years. It is time for the Fifth Prince to be his dog.
After understanding the hidden meaning behind his words, even the Second Prince felt a chill.
What a madman!
The second prince quickly reacted: “Don’t forget, if you overthrow us, you won’t get any good either!”
No matter what happens between the three of them, in the eyes of outsiders, the three of them are tied together.
Although the Seventh Prince was capable, he had been suppressed by the Second Prince and the Fifth Prince for so many years. How could he still compete with those brothers?
Without the Second Prince and the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince was nothing because of his low status. Even if he wanted to build up his own power, it was too late now.
The second prince suppressed his anger and said softly, “If you stop now, I swear that I will not hold it against you later.”
Not to mention that the Second Prince was not trustworthy, the Seventh Prince had no idea if there was still a chance and how much chance there was. Just the matter of Xu Guirong was something that the Seventh Prince would never be able to let go of in his life. Even if he hurt a thousand enemies and lost eight hundred of his own, he would not let the Second Prince die!
“My brother has something else to do, so I’ll take my leave now.”
Looking at the seventh prince’s back, the second prince could no longer conceal the hatred in his heart.
“I treated you like a brother, but you actually betrayed me!”
Compared to the Second Prince, the Fifth Prince had a much more irritable temper. The moment he saw the Seventh Prince, he immediately raised his hand and punched him.
Just like in all the years before, he didn’t care about the Seventh Prince’s face at all.
“Brothers?” Upon hearing this, the Seventh Prince could not help but sneer.
“Would you hit your brother, or anyone else? In your eyes, I am just a dog.”
But if a dog acts like this for too long, it will bite people.
Where have we come to now?
Since the Seventh Prince was planning to kill the Second Prince, how could he only have such a small amount of things in his hands?
A few days later, the secret guards found out that the Second Prince had indeed planted people around the Crown Prince, and he was also the one who swapped the family letter.
Emperor Jingwen’s chest heaved violently.
Seeing that the time was almost right, the Seventh Prince once again stood up in front of everyone.
“Your Majesty, I have something to report to you.”
When he heard this voice, the Second Prince, who was already frightened, felt even more nervous.
Emperor Jingwen took a breath and said, “Announce!”
The Seventh Prince lowered his head and took out another memorial: “I want to report my second brother for forming a clique for personal gain, privately giving and receiving things, and selling official positions and titles.”
Just as the Second Prince overthrew the Crown Prince, the Seventh Prince is now trying to overthrow the Second Prince.
The crown prince was not clean, so was the second prince clean? Except for Xiaojiu, none of his brothers could withstand the investigation.
As for the exaggerated part, is it important? The Seventh Prince saw clearly that his father now lacked an excuse to vent, so the Seventh Prince gave him such an excuse.

chapters.title: Chapter 201: Provocation
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The Second Prince himself is not clean, so the scene where he sued the Crown Prince suddenly seemed funny and ridiculous, and the Second Prince’s face looked even more hateful.
When the Second Prince sued the Crown Prince, it was out of righteousness, but now it has suddenly become a deliberate frame-up.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t tolerate the crown prince back then, so how could he tolerate him now? Even if the second prince had committed less than half of what the crown prince had done before.
“Second brother, what else do you have to say now?”
With a “bang”, Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he could no longer bear it and threw the memorial in his hand to the ground.
The second prince originally wanted to argue, but when he saw the name list on the memorial, he knew that it was meaningless to refute or not.
It was written very clearly above, with the names, number of people, official positions, and the amount of money that had been exchanged…
It’s not that the Second Prince is greedy. No matter what, he is not so short-sighted. What he wants is not just money. But they are not gods and cannot expect to live on wind and dew. Even if they do that, the people below them still have to live. When they manage things, there will naturally be money circulating, but the amount is not high. If it were in the past, it would be just a small matter. Now, because of the crown prince, it has been magnified all of a sudden.
The memorial was written in great detail. It was obvious that the person who wrote it knew that hiding things would do no good and that they would be discovered sooner or later. If the emperor could accept it, then that was fine. If not, then the Second Prince would naturally have no way to defend himself and it would be useless to say anything.But it was obvious that Emperor Jingwen could not accept it at the moment. Not only did he not accept it, he was extremely angry.
The second prince is usually eloquent, but now he can’t utter a word.
The second prince knew clearly that there was no benefit in resisting now. If it was discovered later that what he said was untrue, the consequences would be even more serious. He could only obey as much as possible, hoping to win a little sympathy from his father.
This memorial was obviously wrong in every way, but no one could find out what was wrong. One could only say that the Seventh Prince had a very accurate grasp of Emperor Jingwen’s current mood and knew what to do in order to evoke the greatest pain in Emperor Jingwen’s heart.
What did Emperor Jingwen not understand when he saw this scene?
“Come here, fetch my whip!” Emperor Jingwen had never beaten his son except when he was facing Ye Shuo. Moreover, the Second Prince’s current situation was very different from Ye Shuo’s.
For a moment, all the civil and military officials in the court didn’t know how to react.
Strictly speaking, the emperor’s educating his children can only be regarded as a family affair. Moreover, most of the civil servants are in the same faction as Prime Minister He and the Minister of the Chancellery. Behind Prime Minister He is the Sixth Prince. Unless the Sixth Prince gives the order, they are happy to pretend not to see it and are unwilling to get involved.
As for the military officer, the eldest prince didn’t like the second prince’s behavior. He was so happy to see him in trouble that he didn’t have time to plead for him.
Soon, Wang Ziquan brought the whip. Wang Ziquan followed orders and naturally presented the whip immediately.
Even though he knew that the Seventh Prince did it on purpose and that this was the result he wanted, the Second Prince felt that the deposed Crown Prince was too fragile. If it were him, he would definitely climb back to a higher position, even if he had to crawl, and make those who laughed at him die one by one!
But for some things, you only realise how difficult they are when they happen to you.
The crown prince cares about his face, but does the second prince really not care about his face?
Especially in public, in front of civil and military officials, even if he ascended to the throne in the future, he would probably not be able to face them without any grudges.
What’s more, so many brothers are watching him!
Even the second prince couldn’t control himself: “Father, please forgive me this time!”
This was the first time in his life that the Second Prince begged for mercy. After all, he was his own son, so Emperor Jingwen naturally could not remain calm.
But soon, the hesitation in Emperor Jingwen’s heart was replaced by raging anger.
You know, the crown prince at that time didn’t even have the chance to beg for mercy.
How cruel was the Second Prince when he had someone steal the letter?
It would be better not to have such a mean and vicious son.
Seeing Emperor Jingwen hesitate, the Second Prince couldn’t help but feel hopeful. However, before he could be happy, he heard the whistling sound of a whip.
The whip was just about to hit the second prince’s face.
You know, it is better not to hit someone in the face, especially for the princes. Emperor Jingwen’s action was undoubtedly full of hatred. If the whip really fell on the second prince’s face, the second prince would be disfigured, and a disfigured prince would not be able to become emperor.
Before the second prince could react, the whip in Emperor Jingwen’s hand fell on him with a “swish”.
“This whip is to punish you for deceiving your superiors and subordinates.”
“This whip is for your disrespect for your brother.”
“This whip is for you to tamper with my will and commit treason!”
Today he altered his family letter to the crown prince. Will he tamper with the imperial edict tomorrow?
“Swish, swish, swish”, “Swish, swish, swish”, the sound of the whip whistling was endless. In a short while, the second prince’s body was torn into pieces.
The second prince wanted to scream to gain Emperor Jingwen’s pity, but he was helpless. He couldn’t do such a thing in front of so many people.
The familiar dull pain in his chest finally forced Emperor Jingwen to stop. He gasped and looked at his second son in front of him.
The second prince thought that his punishment was over, but he didn’t know that in Emperor Jingwen’s heart, he had already made a decision in just half an incense stick of time.
Emperor Jingwen naturally knew why he did such a thing, and precisely because he knew this, he did not want him to succeed even more.
Since he also wants that position, I might as well stop him from thinking about it completely.
Under the horrified gaze of the Second Prince, Emperor Jingwen’s voice was extremely cold and cruel.
“I have issued my decree. The Second Prince is unfilial and unfraternal. He has framed the Crown Prince and privately tampered with my will. I am afraid he has the intention of treason and is narrow-minded and vicious. He is really not fit for important tasks. From today on, his status as a prince is revoked and he is demoted to a commoner. Within three days, he will be expelled from the capital and will never be allowed to set foot in Shangjing again. His name will also be removed from the imperial jade book.”
Emperor Jingwen paused, then became firm again.
“I will just pretend that I don’t have a son like him!”
Just like the crown prince in the past, the second prince is the same now, except that the second prince is scolded even more harshly. Emperor Jingwen even said that he would not allow the second prince to be his son.
The second prince’s face turned completely pale.
However, this was not the end. Emperor Jingwen continued, “Concubine Shu has no way of educating her son and has indulged her son. She will be demoted to Xiaoyi immediately.”
If there were not the Fifth Prince, even being demoted to Xiaoyi would not be enough, and Emperor Jingwen would have definitely demoted her to the lowest position.
The fact that there was such an ending was already thanks to Emperor Jingwen’s consideration for Concubine Shu’s many years of service.
Now that the Crown Princess has taken the Crown Prince’s many children and concubines to Liangzhou, how can the Second Prince’s wives, concubines and children continue to stay here?
Then, Emperor Jingwen said something that even the Seventh Prince was shocked.
“Also, the Second Prince’s title of second eldest son will be revoked, and all his wives, concubines, and children will be expelled from the capital!”
If this were true, not only the Second Prince, but also his descendants would forever become commoners and be forever expelled from the power centre of the Great Zhou.
For the Second Prince, this was even more painful than killing him directly.
Even a tiger couldn’t bear to attack its own children, so even the Second Prince had a loving and caring heart towards his own children.
It was not until this moment that the Second Prince finally understood how ruthless his father was.
The Second Prince had long known about his father’s deep affection for the Crown Prince. What he could not accept at this moment was that he was so insignificant.
All we can say is that the crown prince died at the best age, and Emperor Jingwen was not yet completely disappointed in him.
When the second prince saw the emotionless eyes of Emperor Jingwen, his heart suddenly turned cold.
The second prince had no choice but to shamelessly plead for his son: “Father, it doesn’t matter how you punish me, but Lang’er and the others are innocent, Father!”
Emperor Jingwen treated the crown prince in the same way, but Ye Shuo pleaded for him at the time, and finally Emperor Jingwen rescinded his order. What does the second prince have now? Even if his brother, the fifth prince, broke his head, it would be useless.
The more the Second Prince behaved like this, the more the emotions in Emperor Jingwen’s heart surged: “You are so good to your son, why couldn’t you think more about me when you attacked the Crown Prince?”
He would feel pain if he lost his child, but wouldn’t he feel pain if he lost his own child?
If the Second Prince hadn’t interfered, the Crown Prince might not have ended up like this.
That’s the prince on whom I pin all my hopes!
I have also put a lot of effort into planning for him.
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen felt heartbroken, and his heart gradually hardened: “Come here, drag Ye Hezhi out!”
When the guards lifted up the Second Prince, he could no longer restrain himself and asked, “Father, have you ever considered us as your own sons? Have you ever cared about us in the slightest?”
Now that things have come to this, the Seventh Prince’s wish has finally been fulfilled, and the Second Prince no longer has any concerns.
Without the identity and title of a prince, life or death is no longer that important.
“Even if he is the Ninth Prince, how sincere are you to him? Is it even one tenth of what you have for the Crown Prince? I want to know, if the Ninth Prince knew, would he feel sad about the favouritism of the Emperor?”
The old Duke Zhen, who was pretending to be dead, paused for a moment when he heard this.
The second prince looked at the eldest prince and said, “Brother, you can still be so proud. Do you think your fate will be any better than mine? I am waiting for the day when you will be as miserable as I am!”
The Second Prince only reminded him of and was unwilling to say more.
The second prince could not become emperor himself, so he would not want to see anyone else become emperor, especially the eldest prince.
Fight, fight, the harder you fight in the end, the better!
The eldest prince suddenly raised his head with a look of surprise and doubt, but the second prince, seeing this, burst into laughter for no reason, with a look of triumph in his eyes.
The eldest prince’s face suddenly turned pale.
Even at this point, the second brother still refused to behave himself and continued to stir up trouble everywhere.
But the eldest prince also knew that the second prince would not be so aimless, he must know something.
The expression of Emperor Jingwen on the side kept changing. He had never expected that his second son would know so much.
The Second Prince’s sudden outburst caught Emperor Jingwen off guard. Emperor Jingwen had no intention of taking the Second Prince’s life. Even though he was very angry, he had never thought of taking the Second Prince’s life.
After all, there are only a few emperors who are willing to take action against their grown-up sons.
But the Second Prince’s current attitude seems like he is seeking death.
And the fact is indeed so. The Second Prince knew that after being driven out of Shangjing, the Seventh Prince would not give him a chance to live. It would be better for him to die at the hands of Emperor Jingwen than to die at the hands of the Seventh Prince.
The second prince wanted to force Emperor Jingwen to kill his son with his own hands.
Even if their lives are cheap and not as valuable as the crown prince’s, at most they can use their lives to fill the gap, which should be enough, right?
I just don’t know how many sons my father still has to kill.

chapters.title: Chapter 202: Love
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Brother, brother, what’s the difference between you and me?” Or maybe, the eldest prince is not even as good as himself.
The second prince was quickly taken away by the guards, but the words he had just said and the meaningful look in his eyes made the eldest prince feel very uneasy.
“Regarding the matter concerning the Second Prince, do you have any objections?”
Compared to him, Emperor Jingwen was much calmer.
The second prince had no military power and was not a legitimate son, so he did not have that much influence and naturally, there were few people who spoke for him.
This was the first time in the Fifth Prince’s life that he felt despair. The faces and brothers before him were all terrifyingly indifferent.
No matter how the Second Prince treated others, he was very kind to his brother, who was born to the same mother. On the day when everyone fell into the water, they had to rescue the Fifth Prince from the water even at the risk of being discovered.
Everyone else could be rude to the Second Prince, or even look down on him, but not the Fifth Prince.
However, the more painful the Fifth Prince was, the happier the Seventh Prince was. I’m sure Concubine Shu, no, now Lu Xiaoyi, felt it even more deeply.What the three of them, mother and sons, owed me over the years must eventually be repaid.
Seeing the Seventh Prince not far away looking relaxed, the Fifth Prince was filled with hatred, wishing to kill him as soon as possible. Emperor Jingwen seemed to have been reminded and also looked in the direction of the Fifth Prince.
As I said, the Second Prince is certainly not clean, but is his other son really so selfless and without any selfish motives?
Those who pursue personal gain under the banner of justice are also despicable.
For so many years, the Seventh Prince had been hanging out with the Second Prince and the Fifth Prince, and the three of them grew up together. Now, he suddenly stabbed the Second Prince, and Emperor Jingwen’s impression of him also plummeted.
A person of Emperor Jingwen’s status was most wary of any quarrel between brothers.
The Seventh Prince’s heart tightened, but he did not back down in the end.
Even if he followed the Second Prince and the Fifth Prince, he would never be able to make a breakthrough. It would be the same result. Why not be more decisive?
The Seventh Prince only hated himself for not being decisive enough. He naively thought that as long as he was tolerant and obedient, he could let his mother live a good life.
But the reality is that the more cautious you are, the less others will take you seriously. Who would care about a pig or dog that doesn’t bite people?
Look at them now, they are all starting to get scared, aren’t they?
Apart from his father’s annoyance, at this moment, the Seventh Prince felt extremely happy.
This is nothing, there are still many days to come. Without the Second Prince, the remaining two, mother and son, the Seventh Princes will definitely prevent them from causing any trouble in his hands!
“Resign.”
After taking a steady look at his sons, Emperor Jingwen slowly closed his eyes.
The ministers filed out, and when they got outside, they saw the Sixth Prince passing by. The Seventh Prince paused, and finally said in a low voice: “Thank you.”
The Sixth Prince seemed not to have heard it and did not stop walking.
Sometimes, people not only need strength, but also the means.
The Sixth Prince never did anything to hurt others, he just went with the flow. He just found out a few people who were disloyal to his father, and as for the list being leaked, what does it have to do with him?
Seeing that the other party didn’t seem to have any intention of dealing with him further, the Seventh Prince was startled, and then after he understood, he smiled bitterly in his heart.
I’m afraid that after today, my reputation will be ruined.
After a long while, the Seventh Prince regained his composure and walked into the harem alone.
Now that so much time has passed, I believe Lu Xiaoyi has heard about this matter and has received the imperial edict.
The Seventh Prince was still waiting to see Lu Xiaoyi make a fool of herself.
When the Seventh Prince arrived, he happened to meet Eunuch Wang who came to deliver the imperial edict.
After all, she was one of the three concubines, so Wang Ziquan had to be present in person.
Upon hearing the sad news, Concubine Shu, who was casually applying nail polish, suddenly stood up.
“How could this happen? Eunuch Wang, did you convey the wrong order?”
However, the imperial edict was right before our eyes and could not be faked.
The first-rank Shufei is the master of a palace, while the fifth-rank Xiaoyi is just an inconspicuous woman in the harem and naturally cannot live in such a magnificent palace.
Wang Ziquan hardened his heart and said, “Madam, please go in.”
Concubine Shu then reacted: “Where is the Second Prince? Where is he now? I want to see him!”
However, the Second Prince is now disliked by the Emperor and has even been demoted to a commoner. Who would have the courage to do this?
Wang Ziquan sighed: “My queen, you know the rules of the palace, please don’t embarrass me anymore.”
Three days later, the Second Prince and his wives and concubines will be driven out of the capital, never to return. Unless something unexpected happens, Concubine Shu… will never see the Second Prince again in this life.
The mother and son had been together for thirty-six years, but one day something unexpected happened and they were separated.
When Concubine Shu saw the culprit, the Seventh Prince, standing there, she went crazy.
“I will kill you!”
But how could Concubine Shu be a match for the Seventh Prince who was in his prime?
The seventh prince turned slightly and dodged easily.
It hurts, it hurts. After his mother passed away, Concubine Shu did not allow the body to be kept in her palace, so he did the same when his mother was hastily buried.
Things change over time, and Concubine Shu deserves this!
After appreciating enough, the Seventh Prince left with satisfaction.
The other side.
The second prince thought that after he returned home, Emperor Jingwen would soon send someone to give him poisoned wine, a white silk dagger and other items.
However, he waited and waited, until he was forcibly expelled from Shangjing, and still those people did not arrive.
If you want to say something, go ahead and say it. If you want to sue, go ahead and sue. Does he think he can turn the tables?
What ismore terrifying than partiality is indifference and indifference.
The emperor, his father, even disdained to order his own death. How could the second prince not go crazy?
They and the Crown Prince are all the Emperor’s sons! Why is this happening? The Emperor is so unfair!!!
The Second Prince couldn’t even take action without the Seventh Prince taking action.
After the court session, Emperor Jingwen wandered around aimlessly. When he came to his senses, what appeared before him was the Prince’s Eastern Palace.
The prince lived in this palace for thirty-five years, and he himself lived in it for thirty years. Most of the memories of both father and son were left here.
“This was Chengzuo’s favourite place to stay in the past.” When the prince was young, he would even take a brush dipped in water at night and draw the shadows of bamboo and trees on the wall.
“This small pond is also the prince’s favourite.”
What’s more, the fish inside were all picked by Emperor Jingwen himself when the prince was named crown prince at the age of ten.
The fish in the Eastern Palace and the fish in the pond outside his bedroom were even from the same batch of tribute.
These fish have now reproduced several times over and over again, but there is no one left to feed them from time to time when they are free.
