The East Palace, which was once bustling with people, is now deserted, with only desolation in sight.
In a trance, Emperor Jingwen seemed to see the crown prince standing in the sun, looking here quietly. Emperor Jingwen could not help but take two quick steps, but when he got closer, he realised it was just an illusion.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t understand why the relationship between father and son had come to this point.
Emperor Jingwen was in his fifties and no longer young, but he had never felt so overwhelmed as he did now.
Maybe I really am old.
The eunuchs and palace maids standing by were so frightened when they saw the emperor covering his chest that they wanted to call for the imperial physician immediately, but in the end Emperor Jingwen just waved at them and recovered after a long time.
When the people around you just leave, it may not be so obvious, but as time goes by, you will find that air is leaking all around your body.
Emperor Jingwen sat on the stone bench in the courtyard of the East Palace until dark before leaving. Afterwards, he ordered the palace to be completely sealed off.
No matter how many times he comes or how long he waits, the prince will never come back.
At the Ninth Prince’s Mansion——
When Ye Shuo heard that the letter was indeed altered by the Second Prince, he felt as if struck by lightning and fell to the ground exhausted.
“how so……”
He clearly had good intentions at the time, thinking that it would be fine if his adoptive father and the prince could talk it out. However, he never expected that his suggestion would be the last straw that broke the camel’s back.
Ye Shuo slowly closed his eyes.
“It was my fault.”
Yao Zhi on the side wanted to comfort him, but didn’t know where to start. She wanted to say that this matter had nothing to do with him, but she knew in her heart that he was also involved.
All Yao Zhi could do was give him a hug when he was in pain.
“This matter… is more about your second brother’s problem.” Yao Zhi couldn’t help but say this.
Ye Shuo did not deny it.
If we divide the responsibility for the crown prince’s death, he accounts for two, the crown prince accounts for two, the second prince accounts for three, and the stepfather accounts for three. Each and every one of them is responsible.
Ye Shuo never imagined that the letter could be replaced in the middle of delivery.
Just when Ye Shuo was in agony, the next piece of news cheered him up. It was none other than the second prince’s last question, asking whether his stepfather had ever been sincere to him.
The intention to sow discord is obvious.
If this question had been asked more than ten years ago, Ye Shuo would have chosen zero without hesitation. His cheap dad has no feelings for him at all.
But now…Ye Shuo felt that it would be better for him to ask clearly to avoid trouble.
The second prince’s words not only made the eldest prince confused, but also made the relationship between Ye Shuo and Emperor Jingwen suddenly awkward.
Everyone knows that these words should not be taken to heart, but no one can avoid taking them to heart.
Ye Shuo was soon summoned to the palace by Emperor Jingwen. No matter what his adoptive father meant, this move was exactly what Ye Shuo wanted.
Ye Shuo knew that the prince’s suicide was related to him, and Emperor Jingwen always thought of his youngest son’s proposal.
Emperor Jingwen knew that he had good intentions, and he was also aware of his youngest son’s feelings for the crown prince. After learning about this, it was very painful, but Emperor Jingwen could not help but think about it.
But after losing the crown prince, the other princes were in that state, and Emperor Jingwen inexplicably developed a strange emotion.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know that this was called fear.
Emperor Jingwen could not help but wonder how his youngest son viewed his second brother’s words, whether he also felt that he was biased like the second prince said, and whether he would feel resentful because of this and eventually become like the second prince.
Under the impact of various emotions, Emperor Jingwen’s mind was in a mess, and even his expression changed from hot to cold, which was a bit scary upon closer inspection.
Just when Emperor Jingwen was hesitating about how to test the waters, Ye Shuo had already asked the question directly and crisply.
“Dad, if love is divided into ten points, how much do you give to your son?”

chapters.title: Chapter 203: Three Points
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Emperor Jingwen opened his mouth, as if he was about to speak, and Ye Shuo hurriedly said, “Dad, I’m serious, don’t fool me.”
Under Ye Shuo’s gaze, Emperor Jingwen soon became annoyed: “You are a prince, and you keep talking about love all day long. How can you be so immature!”
Doesn’t he feel ashamed?
Emperor Jingwen was somewhat angry and humiliated.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo felt more confident. He took this opportunity to press on: “Dad, no matter what, you have to give your son an explanation today.”
Although Emperor Jingwen was not the rare emperor who could only be seen once in a few hundred or a thousand years, he could still be ranked among the top emperors in history. He had experience in this aspect, but in terms of feelings, ten Emperor Jingwens could not compare to one Ye Shuo.
Cheap dad doesn’t know how to be a father to others, but Ye Shuo knows very well how to be a son to others.
But how could Emperor Jingwen say the word “love” so easily?
The ancients were very reserved, especially the emperor. In his entire life, he never mentioned this word to anyone, not even to Empress Yuan.Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt itchy and wanted to slap him on the spot to make him shut up, so that he wouldn’t have to face such an embarrassing scene.
“You disrespectful bastard!” He was just a prince, how dare he ask his father for an explanation?
Talking about the word love was like asking for his stepfather’s life, and his stepfather refused to say it no matter what. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say: “But I heard that my second brother…” Ye Shuo finally said it.
“Three points, three points! Stop asking!”
Hearing the word “Second Brother”, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but say through gritted teeth.
Compared with ten points, three points is not even the basics. Ye Shuo was not angry when he heard this, but instead felt relieved.
Based on his understanding of his stepfather, sometimes he has to listen to his words in reverse. If he says 70%, then he can only believe 30%. If he only says 30%, then he can believe 70%.
It may be a habit he has developed since childhood, or it may be that the emperor is always on guard. My cheap dad… is used to hiding himself no matter what the matter is. He hates others seeing through him the most, and he hates showing his unguarded side to others even more.
Even when facing the crown prince, he was still like this. Subconsciously, he erected a high wall in his heart.
He was the only one inside the city wall, and no one else could get in.
After getting the answer, Ye Shuo stopped pestering and quickly changed the subject: “By the way, Dad, why did you summon me to the palace today?”
He didn’t mention it, but Emperor Jingwen was in a trance and felt very uncomfortable.
He had only said three-tenths of the answer, but there was no reaction from his side. Emperor Jingwen didn’t know why, but instead of feeling happy, he suddenly became angry.
The dark cloud in Emperor Jingwen’s heart due to the family letter gradually dissipated without him even noticing.
In fact, Emperor Jingwen felt a little regretful the moment he said this. He should have said more so that he could not let him pry into his heart and at the same time express his love appropriately.
Five points, I should have said five points just now.
This way, he wouldn’t be too close to the number in his mind, nor would he be too disappointed. He wouldn’t be too arrogant, but he wouldn’t be so restrained as his brothers.
But in fact, no one knew that after hearing his youngest son ask that question, the answer that automatically popped up in Emperor Jingwen’s mind shocked himself.
If the little bastard hadn’t asked, Emperor Jingwen might never have discovered in his lifetime that his feelings for his youngest son seemed to be deeper than he had imagined.
But unfortunately, the opportunity had already been missed. Someone like Emperor Jingwen would never take the initiative to bring up such a topic, so once it was missed, it would never come back.
Ye Shuo seemed not to notice his cheap father’s dilemma and asked again why he was called here. He was clearly asking a question even though he knew the answer.
Emperor Jingwen had no choice but to suppress what happened in his heart, but he was really anxious, so he couldn’t help but become sarcastic: “Why, is it so difficult to ask you to come back for a meal? Do you take me seriously?”
But in fact, it was not like that at all. Emperor Jingwen was mainly worried that his naive younger son would believe what his second son said, and then people around him would exaggerate the situation, causing the father and son to become estranged.
The younger son was too easy to fool and had no brains, so Emperor Jingwen had to be on guard.
But the result was that the younger son was too naive and actually questioned him so directly, which made Emperor Jingwen extremely embarrassed.
Sure enough, even the emperor has menopause. My cheap dad’s condition can’t be considered menopause. He is in his fifties, but his temper is getting more and more weird.
Now that his stepfather was not in good health, Ye Shuo did not dare to provoke him again. After accompanying him for lunch, Ye Shuo wanted to find his mother.
Looking at his youngest son who was sitting there with a thorn on his butt and looking around from time to time, Emperor Jingwen sighed and did not keep him any longer. He waved his hand and told him to get out.
I will be reviewing memorials later and wanted to ask him to read a book or something nearby, but seeing his behaviour, I decided not to do it.
The younger son is not cut out for this at all.
Ye Shuo didn’t even bother to be polite to his cheap father, and ran away in a flash. It would be suffocating to stay in the Qinzheng Palace for an entire afternoon, so Ye Shuo would rather wander around outside, help Jianjian walk the dog, wash the dog’s feet, anything else would be better than this.
To be honest, picking my toes is more fun than being here.
“He is twenty years old, but still the same.” Since he was one year old, the little bastard hasn’t changed at all. He still likes to play, doesn’t like to work, and doesn’t like to study.
Emperor Jingwen was so worried that he was about to die.
Although he had a group of doctors in the Imperial Medical Bureau to help him regulate his body, Emperor Jingwen could still feel that his health was not as good as before.
In the past, he could still hide the white hair on his head, but now, no matter how skillful Wang Ziquan’s hands are, he can no longer hide those clumps of white hair.
Especially since the death of the crown prince, in just one or two months, Emperor Jingwen’s hair turned almost half white.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but worry about the little bastard’s future, but he didn’t know how long he could protect him.
Emperor Jingwen held the brush and gradually began to lose his focus.
The other side.
When the imperial concubine learned about what happened in the Qinzheng Palace, she was furious.
How could such a good son of hers be worth only three points in the eyes of the emperor?
The imperial concubine never thought that the emperor would lie about this matter. In her opinion, she, a concubine, would not deny such a small matter. As an emperor, how could Emperor Jingwen not dare to admit it directly?
“It’s okay, Shuo’er. You will always be a perfect score in your mother’s eyes.” If the full score is ten, the imperial concubine could even give it twelve points.
Unlike Emperor Jingwen, the imperial concubine was always straightforward. To her, if she liked something, she liked it, and if she didn’t like something, she would feel annoyed at first glance.
Sure enough, his mother is the best.
Jianjian, who was standing aside, watched the mother and son start to be affectionate with each other again, saying things like “good baby” and “good boy”, and the veins on her forehead couldn’t help but throb wildly.
In the past, my brother was just fragile, and Jianjian thought that he would be fine after he became an adult. But… instead of getting better, he got worse! Now he even learned to act like a spoiled child.
Is he really a prince?
Jianjian sighed deeply, feeling that the burden on her shoulders was getting heavier.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask, “Do you want to come over too?”
Jianjian shook her head firmly, indicating that she would never associate with the two of them.
The young girl doesn’t know yet that the more she experiences in the future, the more she will realise how good her mother’s arms are.
The news that Ye Shuo went directly to the Qinzheng Hall to question Emperor Jingwen about how much he loved him soon reached the ears of other princes.
Xiaojiu… is still as reckless and straightforward as ever. He can’t hide things in his heart, and sometimes they are not always bad. The Second Prince’s plan is likely to fail.
The eldest prince was particularly impressed. He imagined what it would be like if he ran over to ask his father such a question. Just thinking about it made him feel a chill.
This is too scary…
The most important thing is that my father may not buy into this.
The eldest prince couldn’t help but take a bronze mirror to look at himself. The man in the mirror was about thirty years old, with bronze skin and a resolute face.
The eldest prince decisively put down the bronze mirror and gave up the idea.
All the princes were very puzzled as to how their younger brother had done it and why he had to be so thick-skinned.
But when they heard their father’s answer, that it was only three points, all the princes could not help but remain silent.
Xiaojiu was really nothing. After all, it was only the crown prince who took the lead. Whether alive or dead, he was the number one among all the brothers.
Xiaojiu must be sad to suddenly learn such a cruel fact.
Just as the eldest prince and others were feeling sympathy, the next morning, when the court session was about to end and everyone thought that everything was fine, Wang Ziquan stepped forward and took out an imperial edict.
“The Emperor, in compliance with the Will of Heaven, proclaims: Ye Shuo, the ninth son of the Emperor, is of pure nature and dignified conduct. He made contributions to the construction of Liangzhou and later saved the Emperor. He is hereby conferred the title of Prince and given the name ‘Rui’. I decree this!”
Wang Ziquan looked around and, as expected, the Ninth Prince had not come. Wang Ziquan planned to deliver the imperial edict to the Ninth Prince’s home after the court session.
Not to mention Emperor Jingwen, after so many years, even Wang Ziquan knew that he was lazy and was used to taking care of the Ninth Prince more.
The moment the words fell, not only the civil and military officials in the court, but even the princes were stunned.
Didn’t we agree on… three points?

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Toss and Turn
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Rui means auspiciousness, and Emperor Jingwen’s attitude is very clear. He hopes that the Ninth Prince will be able to have everything he wants and live in peace and safety until his old age.
In addition to the position of a prince, no matter who inherits the throne in the future, as long as the ninth prince does not make a big mistake, no one will touch him because of Emperor Jingwen’s reputation.
Although there were the Liangzhou and rescue incidents before, and Xiaojiu was the son of the imperial concubine and the grandson of the Duke of Zhen, based on his background and his age now, he should indeed be given a higher title, but for some reason, the princes always felt that something was wrong.
After thinking about it carefully, I realised that my father has been in a bad mood since the death of the crown prince. Everyone is afraid of being implicated by saying something wrong or doing something wrong, so they have been behaving themselves to the exclusion of others.
Even the court, which had been filled with endless arguments, became unusually quiet.
Let’s look at the fate of the second prince. After it was discovered that he had attacked the crown prince, his entire family suffered misfortune. As a result, in such a situation, Xiaojiu was not only not implicated, but instead went against the tide and was granted the title of prince, which really shocked everyone.
The only thing that the eldest prince and the others care about is whether their father is compensating or lying.
If it is because he feels that he does not have that much affection for Xiaojiu and needs to appease the Imperial Concubine and the Duke of Zhen, this makes sense.
But it would be the same if my father said three points but actually didn’t think so at all in his heart.The eldest prince and the others wanted to find some clues from Emperor Jingwen’s expression and eyes, but unfortunately, how could they guess what Emperor Jingwen was thinking?
The emperor’s thoughts were a mixture of true and false, false and true, as if covered by a layer of mist, making it difficult to see clearly.
After a while, everyone gave up trying to figure out Emperor Jingwen’s thoughts.
Anyway, no matter what the situation is, the emperor has no intention of letting him take power. Although the emperor is old now, he is not confused. Even if he dotes on him, he will not confuse state affairs with his love for him.
As long as their father doesn’t delegate power to Xiaojiu, they won’t have to worry about having another competitor.
Now that everyone has their own team and due to his father’s health, even if Xiaojiu wants to develop his own power now, it is too late.
So just pamper him.
There was just one thing that felt like a thorn in the throat of the eldest prince and the others.
The word “Rui” was obviously carefully chosen. Although all of them were conferred the title of prince one after another when they reached a certain age, none of their titles were particularly outstanding. It was obvious that they were drafted by others rather than chosen by the emperor himself.
Also, kind-hearted? Upright? Was he really talking about Xiaojiu? That arrogant, domineering, playboy-like younger brother?
If the Fifth, Seventh, and Eighth Princes had not personally visited Liangzhou, they would have really believed what the imperial edict said.
Since when did opening a casino, a black shop, and colluding with the local governor count as building Liangzhou…
The rescue of the emperor did exist. After all, Xiaojiu did sell himself because of his face, and now the creditors are still in the Ninth Prince’s mansion.
The beautification in this imperial edict is a bit too serious.
The court officials wanted to object at first. After all, it was against the rules to directly confer the title of prince without going through the process of appointing a duke. But they had no choice but to do so as the matter of saving the emperor was still there.
Everyone has only heard of being crowned a prince based on ability or political achievements, but this is the first time they have heard of someone being crowned a prince based on money or face.
But what others didn’t know was that Emperor Jingwen had both the idea of ​​compensation and the idea of ​​lying in his mind.
As soon as the word “three points” came out of his mouth, Emperor Jingwen felt a little regretful, but he couldn’t bring up the topic again after it was revealed. Now he named him a prince in the hope that his youngest son would understand that he didn’t really think that way in his heart at that time.
Compared to being subtle, Emperor Jingwen was extremely tactful.
Even if he had such thoughts, he would never say them out loud.
A 20-year-old prince! Even the eldest prince had to guard the border for ten years before he could get the title of prince!
If we only compare the titles without comparing the actual power, the difference is obvious.
In addition to the imperial edict conferring the title of king, Emperor Jingwen also specially bestowed some things on Ye Shuo. After the morning court session, the imperial edict and rewards flowed into Ye Shuo’s palace like water.
As expected, we can’t just look at the surface of what my cheap dad said, we have to combine many aspects to make it work…
“Thank you, Father. May you live long and long.”
Ye Shuo knelt down to express his gratitude, and after a while, Wang Ziquan personally helped him stand up.
Sometimes Wang Ziquan’s attitude is enough to reflect Emperor Jingwen’s attitude.
Looking at the Ninth Prince who had grown up in front of him, Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but smile: “Congratulations, Prince Rui. Congratulations, Prince Rui.”
Ye Shuo also smiled.
After Wang Ziquan left, Ye Xun beside him couldn’t help but say, “Congratulations, Ninth Uncle.”
After such an incident, Ye Xun has changed a lot. How could the boy call him Ninth Uncle so politely in the past?
Ye Xun’s eyes, which were bright and had flickering flames, are gone.
Ye Xun is now polite, cautious and quiet. Ye Xun was already precocious, and now that the crown prince is dead, the only childishness on his face has been taken off.
Ye Shuo knew that it would take time to recover, so he was not in a hurry. He would just change little by little. So he just said, “Since the family is so happy, I will ask the cook to make two more vegetarian dishes today.”
Since Ye Xun was in mourning, he was not allowed to eat meat according to the rules of the Great Zhou. Ye Shuo, who basically ate the same food with him, naturally seldom ate meat.
Ye Xun naturally knew that although the Ninth Uncle did not say it, he was taking care of him in every way. He loved listening to music so much that he had kept the mansion for three years. He even sent away the musicians who he was reluctant to move when he left. As for his hobbies of listening to books and drinking tea in restaurants, he had given them up.
Ye Xun was not allowed to leave the house during the mourning period, and Ye Shuo also seldom went out to avoid him being lonely in the house.
The crown prince was just his elder brother, so he shouldn’t be that strict. But Ye Shuo was afraid that Ye Xun would feel uncomfortable, so he took the initiative to change out of his brightly coloured clothes and put on plain clothes. He also asked the housekeeper to replace all the festive red lanterns in the mansion.
When the Eastern Palace was sealed, Ye Xun had no place to place his father’s spirit tablet, so Ye Shuo had someone clean up a room for worship. He burned three incense sticks a day without interruption. Even if Ye Shuo got up late, he would go to check before breakfast. Occasionally, he would chat with Ye Xun in front of the prince’s spirit tablet.
Even though Ye Shuo is only four years younger than Ye Xun in this life, he has gradually taken over his father’s role, so that, Ye Xun has a support even when his parents are not around, and he doesn’t collapse all of a sudden.
After accompanying Ye Xun to finish lunch, and waiting until his nephew, who was exhausted by the continuous news and had nightmares at night, fell asleep, Ye Shuo yawned and walked out of his yard.
As he paid close attention, he soon ran into Yao Zhi who was also in the mansion.
“It just so happens that the emperor has rewarded us with new tea today. How about we go to the pavilion to drink tea together?” Ye Shuo took the initiative to invite.
Today was the big day when he was conferred the title of prince, so Yao Zhi naturally couldn’t bear to spoil his fun.
The young man’s life had been hard enough recently, so Yao Zhi subconsciously wanted to go along with him. As they spent more time together, Yao Zhi felt that he was a very gentle person, and gentle people were the easiest to get hurt.
Love and pity, for women, love and pity are always inseparable.
Love breeds pity, pity breeds love, and gradually she will want to help him share his burdens. It is precisely because Yao Zhi has been through some things with him during this period that she can see clearly that behind his glory of being crowned as a king, there are also pains that others cannot know.
After two cups of hot tea, just when Yao Zhi was about to add more tea to him, she looked up inadvertently and found that he had fallen asleep on the rattan chair without knowing when.
Although early winter is not as cold as midwinter, it is still very easy to catch a cold. Fortunately, the six corners of the pavilion are wrapped tightly to keep it out, and there is a stove burning next to it, so it is not too bad.
Occasionally, a cold wind blew, and the servants passing by could vaguely see two figures in the pavilion.
A few more days passed like this. Three months had passed since he fell into the water, and the Fourth Prince’s leg was finally almost healed. Today was the first day he tried to get out of bed. When Ye Shuo heard Yao Zhi talk about this, he went over to see him, or rather, to visit him.
Rehabilitation is not necessarily easier than healing an injury, and the patient’s will is particularly important in this matter.
The Fourth Prince is now like a toddler. He has to start all over again. The pain he feels can be imagined.
But Ye Shuo’s brothers lacked everything except the spirit of hard work and progress. Each one was more patient than the other. Ye Shuo felt pain just watching them, but the Fourth Prince didn’t say a word during the whole process.
After the Fourth Prince finished today’s work, sweating profusely, he saw his brother grimacing, as if he was the one who was hurt.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but give him a thumbs up: “Awesome.”
The fourth prince: “…”
His brother was too emotional. He was one of the few who would burst into tears just because of a scratch. The fourth prince couldn’t help but feel helpless.
After observation, Yao Zhi quickly came up with two solutions. One was a quick fix, but it would be very painful and usually required acupuncture and medication. The other was a slow recuperation, but it would take a little longer, about half a year to a year, before normal use could be fully restored.
Ye Shuo could almost guess which one the Fourth Prince would choose with his eyes closed, and the fact was exactly as he expected. Before Yao Zhi could finish explaining the latter method, the Fourth Prince had already made his choice decisively.
They are a group of people who can accomplish great things. Ye Shuo always admires them for their willpower.
Another month passed, and Ye Shuo watched the Fourth Prince change from staggering at the beginning to walking briskly now. It was so fast that even though Ye Shuo was not a professional medical student, he knew that being so impatient for success was not a good thing, so he secretly asked Yao Zhi if there would be any sequel.
Yao Zhi paused at that moment. Her lack of an answer was the best answer. How could such a high-intensity activity not leave sequelae?
According to Yao Zhi’s estimation, the disadvantages of not taking good care of oneself would gradually become apparent in at most ten years, even before one’s old age.
But the reality is, it’s not that the Fourth Prince doesn’t take his right leg seriously, but the current situation does not allow him to wait any longer.
The sudden injury of Emperor Jingwen disrupted the Fourth Prince’s plan, forcing him to take action.
The method of not fighting is only applicable when his father is in good health. The Fourth Prince can naturally wait if he has time. But now, if he does not want to be completely left behind by the First Prince, the Sixth Prince and others, the Fourth Prince can only fight back.
Sometimes, man’s plans are not as good as God’s plans. It really is a matter of time and fate.
Fortunately, the Fourth Prince entered the Six Ministries earlier than the Sixth Prince, and with the help of Concubine Xian behind the scenes, the Fourth Prince also has a strong foundation. When he really starts to take action, he should not be underestimated either.
After the aftereffects of the crown prince’s death faded, the situation in the court soon began to change again.
Peace is only temporary, fighting is the norm.
While Ye Shuo was living quietly with Yao Zhi and Ye Xun in his mansion, Emperor Jingwen was still unable to sleep at night. He often thought of the crown prince’s appearance when he was alive and could not calm down.
Then, news came that Emperor Jingwen wanted to go to the royal temple, Zilu Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Going up the Mountain
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The emperor had such an idea, and the people below naturally had to follow him.
There had already been chaos when Emperor Jingwen and his companions disappeared, so he naturally did not want to repeat the same mistake. Therefore, the list of people accompanying him this time was particularly complete. Emperor Jingwen basically brought everyone he could, including the empress, as well as the noble concubines, virtuous concubines and virtuous concubines.
Ye Shuo, as the ninth prince, now the Prince of Rui, was also among them. Even Jian Jian, who was only twelve and a half years old, was on the list of accompanying people.
It was not uncommon for emperors before the Great Zhou Dynasty to bring their entire families to worship Buddha, but the reason for mobilising so many troops this time was because of the deceased crown prince, so everyone was not happy about it.
Emperor Jingwen even gave the task of guarding to the eldest prince. There was no other way because the commander-in-chief of the Black Armor Guard fell ill a few days ago.
Emperor Jingwen is now over fifty, and the commander-in-chief is no longer young. In addition, it is very normal for him to suffer from occasional illness after years of military life.
Since Yao Zhi had entered the country and was living in the Ninth Prince’s mansion, as long as she was there, no one else could harm Ye Xun, so Ye Shuo was very relieved.
“The Fourth Prince’s legs and feet are now fully recovered. I will leave when you come back this time.” After hesitating for a long time, Yao Zhi finally said it.
She was afraid that if she stayed any longer, she would be completely reluctant to leave.Even though he knew he couldn’t keep her, Ye Shuo couldn’t help feeling a little disappointed when he actually heard these words.
Seeing the young man hanging his head, Yao Zhi couldn’t help feeling a little bit reluctant, but in the end, she still forced herself to harden her heart.
When the time came, Ye Shuo had no choice but to get on the carriage to leave Beijing.
Zilu Peak is not far from Shangjing, fifty miles away from the outskirts of Beijing. It is a place where the royal family worships Buddha, so it was much more magnificent than ordinary temples when it was built. After expansion by several generations of emperors, the temple now occupies almost half of the mountain.
To show their sincerity, even when Emperor Jingwen came, he did not ride in a sedan chair, and the others were even more so. Fortunately, the mountain was not very high, so it was okay.
Because the distance was relatively short, the group set out in the morning and arrived almost at noon.
Emperor Jingwen led the way, walking in the front, and the other concubines and princes followed closely behind him.
“Are you tired, mother? Do you want your son to carry you?” Ye Shuo was afraid that his mother would be tired, so he asked secretly.
If you are not allowed to ride in a sedan chair, can you at least let someone carry you on your back?
However, Concubine Rong couldn’t help but roll her eyes at him when she heard this. How could she be so embarrassed with so many people watching?
Besides, it was just a short distance, and her son was underestimating her. After all, Concubine Rong was born into a military family.
Although the imperial concubine refused verbally, she was extremely proud in her heart and couldn’t help but glance at the virtuous and virtuous concubines beside her.
Although his son is not as capable as the others sons, he is the most considerate.
Seeing this, Concubine Xian and Concubine De laughed, but they couldn’t help but feel a little envious. As for the Queen, she felt that Concubine Rong was deliberately showing off her son’s health to her, which immediately touched the Queen’s heart.
The Thirteenth Prince is weak and lacks the Emperor’s favour, which is the Queen’s greatest pain.
Without noticing this, Ye Shuo looked at Jianjian again.
Jianjian moved away from him almost instantly. A young girl in adolescence couldn’t afford to lose face like that.
“If you really have a lot of energy but nowhere to use it, why not go find your Sixth Brother?” Perhaps because Ye Shuo had said it too much, Jian Jian gradually felt that the Sixth Prince was not as strong as his other brothers.
Especially during the month when Ye Shuo and the others disappeared, the Sixth Prince ran around everywhere to unite everyone to resist the First Prince. After such a long period of hard work, the Sixth Prince naturally couldn’t hold on any longer.
Fortunately, Emperor Jingwen returned in time, and the Sixth Prince finally felt relieved.
Speaking of the Sixth Prince, Ye Shuo subconsciously looked back, only to find that the Sixth Prince had fallen behind at some point.
Of course, the reason why the Sixth Prince fell behind was not because of himself. With the Sixth Prince’s temperament, even if he could not keep up with the team, he gritted his teeth and forced himself to speed up.
The main reason is that the Sixth Prince is now bringing his own son. Little Ye Jin is only five or six years old now. How can he walk such a long mountain road in one breath?
“Xiao Ming, why did you bring Ye Jin with you?” After not seeing him for a few years, this child is exactly like his father. They are indeed father and son. Even their expressions are exactly the same when they stand together.
Unexpectedly, Xiao Jiu would come back to look for him. The Sixth Prince was stunned for a moment before answering, “He is not in good health, so I thought of taking this opportunity to bring him to the temple to pray for blessings.”
If the father’s penis is of poor quality, the child born will inevitably be weaker.
As a father, the Sixth Prince naturally hopes that his children can be healthy.
Oh, I forgot to mention that not long after Ye Shuo left, the Sixth Prince’s concubine gave birth to another son for him, but this time it was a daughter.
The little princess was only two or three years old, and it was not appropriate for her to leave the house, so the Sixth Prince did not take her with him.
In addition to Ye Jin, the Sixth Prince also plans to offer a perpetual lamp to his daughter later.
As the Sixth Prince was a prince, he naturally favoured sons over daughters. However, he had difficulty in having children, so he only had two children, so they naturally seemed precious to him.
Ye Shuo looked at Ye Jin’s face which had turned pale from walking too much, and without much hesitation, he carried him on his back.
Although the child is young, he still weighs a considerable amount, and most people cannot carry him to the top of the mountain in one breath.
Upon seeing this, the Sixth Prince subconsciously wanted to stop him. In his opinion, although his son was physically weak, his will must not be weak. What others could do, he should also be able to do.
However, Ye Shuo felt that children should be taught, but there was no need to be overly harsh on them. It should be done step by step. You can’t eat hot tofu in a hurry.
“Ye Jin is still young, it’s not time for that. You as his father are still here, and I as his uncle are still here. The mountain road is difficult to travel on, and we are still making things difficult for such a young child. Doesn’t it prove that we are incompetent?” Besides, Ye Jin has already walked so far, no matter what, it is enough.
The Sixth Prince has been extremely strict with himself since he was young. Having grown up this way, it was inevitable that he would apply the same standards to his son.
After a while, the Sixth Prince said helplessly: “This is just the first time, it won’t happen again.”
He was afraid that his son would become slack after getting used to enjoying himself.
After hearing this, Ye Jin stopped struggling.
Three years had passed, and the children’s memory was not that good. Ye Jin had long forgotten his uncle Ye Shuo, and naturally he had also forgotten what he had promised him when they parted.
Ye Jin only had a vague impression, and felt that this uncle was very kind.
The child, who had never had such close contact with others, naturally felt awkward when he suddenly landed on the back of a relative stranger. Just when Ye Jin was a little confused and at a loss, he heard the person under him say, “Hold on tight.”
“?”
While Ye Jin was stunned, Ye Shuo took a deep breath, exerted force on his feet, and then rushed out as if he had been injected with chicken blood.
First came the princes, then the imperial concubine and others, and then Emperor Jingwen.
When climbing a mountain, whoever reaches the top first wins.
Seeing his youngest son disappearing in a flash without a trace, Emperor Jingwen suddenly stopped in his tracks.
The Sixth Prince: “…”
The Sixth Prince regretted that he should not have handed his son over to him!
The Sixth Prince almost forgot how his younger brother had tormented Ye Xun.
Emperor Jingwen was also very familiar with this scene. Past memories came flooding back. He sighed and waved to everyone: “Don’t worry about him. Let’s continue.”
My son has not made any progress in other serious matters over the years, let alone this.
If the little bastard could have refrained from causing trouble along the way, he wouldn’t be himself.
The other side.
Ye Jin only felt that all the scenes in front of his eyes flashed by quickly. In fear, he subconsciously hugged Ye Shuo’s neck tightly.
Ye Shuo walked very fast and could climb three or four steps with one lift.
But Ye Jin now is much calmer than Ye Xun back then. Even though he was scared, he just kept silent and waited until he reached the top of the mountain, only then did he feel better.
“First!”
Ye Shuo, who once again won first place, felt refreshed. Ye Jin couldn’t hold it in any longer and said tremblingly: “Ninth, Ninth Uncle, can you put me down?”
Only then did Ye Shuo remember to let go.
When the monks in the temple, especially the abbot, saw the two people, they couldn’t help but look at the sundial in front of the temple. It was obvious that Ye Shuo had come too early.
When Emperor Jingwen and his party came up, Ye Shuo and Ye Jin had been waiting in the dining hall for quite some time.
Because he had walked for such a long time on the mountain road, Emperor Jingwen’s clothes were soaked with sweat, so he went to change his clothes before coming here.
Concubine Rong and Jianjian were fine, especially Jianjian. Because she had practised martial arts for many years, this mountain road was nothing to her. It was just that she was not as lively as Ye Shuo, so she was not very conspicuous.
Although Concubine Xian and Concubine De were a little tired, they were still within the normal range. Only the Queen was sweating profusely.
Looking at the princes again, the eldest prince goes without saying, the fifth prince, the seventh prince and the eighth prince are all calm and not out of breath, the sixth prince is slightly sweating and panting, as for the fourth prince, he just walked such a long way with a leg injury and it is inevitable that he cannot bear it, he almost climbed up with gritted teeth, and now his right leg is trembling, seeing someone looking at him, the fourth prince hurriedly sat down, then pulled down the hem of his clothes to cover it up.
There is also the Thirteenth Prince, the current Queen’s son, who is not much better than the Queen. His panting can still be heard from such a long distance away.
Upon seeing this, the queen immediately glared at him fiercely.
The Thirteenth Prince quickly stopped panting, his face quickly turned red, and then he began to cough violently.
When Ye Shuo saw this scene, he hesitated for a moment and finally did not step forward.
Bailu Temple is worthy of being a royal temple. The vegetarian meals there are more exquisite than those elsewhere. The vegetarian food here is truly unique.
That afternoon, Emperor Jingwen took a bath, burned incense, and went to the abbot for advice.
Ye Shuo had nothing to do, Jian Jian was now too impatient to play with him, and his mother would not play with him as long as Concubine De, Concubine Xian and the Queen were present, so he soon set his sights on little Ye Jin.
Entertainment is prohibited in Buddhist sacred areas, so there is nothing else to do. It’s okay to play with children, right?
Guessing his brother’s thoughts in an instant, the Sixth Prince pulled his son behind him without hesitation.
“Don’t even think about it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Play
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Hey, Xiao Ming, don’t be so stingy. It’s not a big deal if you lend me your son to play with.” Ye Shuo would definitely be impatient to take care of an ordinary child, who would cry and make noise. Even Ye Shuo would subconsciously want to stay away from him when he saw the child.
But the children of the royal family are different. Each one is more obedient and sensible than the other. They don’t cry or make a fuss. Even if they are bullied, they will just hold back tears and try their best to hold back their tears. Aren’t they more interesting than toys?
However, when the Sixth Prince heard this, he almost laughed out of anger.
Look at what he said. Can children just play around with that?
“If you want to play, go give birth to one yourself!” The Sixth Prince’s voice was crisp and decisive.
The moment the words fell, Ye Shuo’s expression suddenly fell.
The Sixth Prince then remembered that his younger brother had already reached adulthood, but he didn’t even have a maid to serve him.
Without women, there would naturally be no children.
The Sixth Prince subconsciously protected his son more closely.Thinking that Yao Zhi would leave after returning this time, Ye Shuo felt so hurt that he became furious and wanted to steal the Sixth Prince’s son while he was not paying attention.
The Sixth Prince was well prepared and followed suit immediately.
The young Ye Jin could only see the two people interacting with each other above his head, and he couldn’t help but feel dazzled.
His father had taught him a lot, but he never taught him what to do if something like this happened. Just when Ye Jin was at a loss, the next moment, he felt his feet were off the ground.
After all, the Sixth Prince was not good at fighting, so how could he be a match for Ye Shuo?
The moment Ye Shuo succeeded, he quickly picked up the child and put him on his shoulders, letting the child ride on his neck.
Ye Jin subconsciously hugged his head tightly.
Ye Shuo grabbed Xiao Ye Jin’s feet, and in the Sixth Prince’s angry eyes, he jumped three feet away: “Don’t worry, I will return it to you in the evening.”
Fire could almost be spewing from the Sixth Prince’s eyes.
He never thought that strength and agility were such important things. The Sixth Prince could only watch his younger brother take his son away leisurely.
“Come on, Uncle nine will take you for a stroll around this mountain.”
Compared to his strict and well-behaved father, the Ninth Prince in front of him was obviously much more lively and not so serious.
This was the first time Ye Jin had come into contact with such a person and he was very uncomfortable with him, but how should he put it, he seemed… not annoying.
It is the nature of children to love playing, and they need to rely on this nature to constantly explore the world. But unfortunately, the royal family’s upbringing always suppresses this nature of children.
If the repression is too severe, the child will no longer be like a child.
As Ye Shuo continued to move forward, Ye Jin passed by the Sutra Library, Dharma Hall, Main Hall, Heavenly King Hall… these quiet places of Buddhism, and Ye Shuo and Ye Jin subconsciously kept silent.
Then there are the bell tower and drum tower, as well as the places where male and female guests live respectively in the back mountain.
In the past, Ye Jin had always been standing on the ground. He was short and when he looked at everyone, he naturally felt that they were insurmountable and unattainable. But now that he had changed his perspective, he felt that the view in front of him had suddenly become much wider.
It turns out that this is how the world looks like in the eyes of adults.
It just so happened that Ye Shuo was tall, and Ye Jin felt that even the air he breathed was much fresher.
Watching the Sixth Prince’s son passing by and looking down at him, the eldest prince felt the veins on his forehead throbbing.
Only Xiaojiu could let a child ride on his neck.
However, the so-called condescending attitude was actually the eldest prince’s overthinking. Ye Jin just glanced at him.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Ye Shuo quickly slipped away quietly.
After a while, Jianjian also saw his brother who was doing nothing and wandering around with his little nephew.
Jianjian felt that if he was not a prince, he would have been regarded as a gangster by the people.
Jianjian took a deep breath and finally resisted the urge to call him and ask him to be serious.
Walking further back, passing the dining hall, you will see a large vegetable garden. I think the monks in the temple rely on this large vegetable garden to be self-sufficient on this mountain. The vegetarian food they had for lunch today should be taken from here.
Ye Shuo grabbed his nephew’s ankle and watched with great interest.
At first Ye Jin thought it was boring, but as time went by, he became fascinated by watching the monks picking cabbages.
After the fresh cabbage was picked, it was sent to the back kitchen. The monks first washed the cabbage with mountain spring water, then drained the water, added coarse salt and rubbed it…
Under the gaze of Ye Shuo and Ye Jin, the monk, who performed the same movements thousands of times every day, gradually became stiff.
Although the monks of Bailu Temple are monks, they are also practitioners. If they can really achieve the state of having no desires and no demands, they will no longer be monks, but will become Buddhas.
After all, they could not completely escape from the realm of laymen. How could the monks not be nervous when being stared at by two nobles?
Fortunately, Ye Shuo’s attention was quickly diverted. Seeing that several monks beside him had finished picking cabbages and were carrying baskets, as if they were going out, Ye Shuo casually asked, “What are you doing?”
“Amitabha, in reply to His Royal Highness Prince Rui, I and my companions would like to go to the mountains to pick some fresh mushrooms and bamboo shoots.”
The monk put his hands together and bowed respectfully.
When Ye Shuo heard this, he immediately became excited and asked the monk for a bamboo basket.
The monk was confused by his actions, and when he came to his senses, Ye Shuo had already joined their team.
Ye Jin also moved from Ye Shuo’s shoulders into the bamboo basket. The bamboo basket was neither too big nor too small, just enough to hold a child like him.
Although winter mushrooms and bamboo shoots are delicious and juicy, there are not many of them. Ye Jin was a little reserved at first, but soon he also started picking up mushrooms.
Compared to studying at home, studying in the mountains seems to be a different kind of fun.
But the pity was that Ye Jin had been spoiled since childhood, how could he know so many mountain products? He saw the Ninth Prince next to him putting the mushrooms he picked into the bamboo basket from time to time, and thought that all kinds of mushrooms could be put in it.
Children particularly like brightly coloured things, and they found the target in a short while.
“Ninth Uncle, look!”
When Ye Jin came back with a bunch of mushrooms, he saw the young man in front of him blinking rapidly.
Ye Jin was such a smart kid, he subconsciously asked, “Ninth Uncle, what’s wrong?”
“Nothing, it’s just that Uncle Nine forgot to tell you that the brighter the mushrooms, the more likely they are to be poisonous.”
Poison? ? ?
Ye Jin threw the mushroom in his hand to the ground almost instantly.
When he looked up again, Ye Jin looked at him in disbelief.
Why didn’t the Ninth Prince tell us such an important thing just now!
As if he didn’t see the accusing look in the child’s eyes, Ye Shuo touched his chin and said, “It’s not a big deal. We have a lot of people. Even if you put all the fruits you picked into the pot, it would only make people feel numb. They will recover after three to five days of rest. It won’t kill anyone.”
As Ye Shuo spoke more and more, Ye Jin’s eyes gradually became filled with fear.
Isn’t this scary enough? If Grandpa emperor eats it…
Ye Jin couldn’t help but shiver.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t hold it in anymore and burst into laughter.
Even though Ye Jin was such a good-tempered kid, he was almost pissed to death by him.
“Ninth Uncle!”
“Okay, okay, at worst Uncle Nine will teach you how to distinguish poisonous mushrooms from normal mushrooms.”
Looking at his angry little nephew, Ye Shuo rubbed his head.
However, as the saying goes, every failure makes you wiser, so Ye Jin was not easily fooled by him again.
Because of the previous incident, Ye Jin suffered from a lack of common sense, so he studied very hard when Ye Shuo taught him to identify the various plants around him.
This alone was not enough, Ye Jin had to verify with the monks around him from time to time. He was so cautious at such a young age, worthy of being taught by Xiao Ming.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a little emotional.
It was not until the evening that Ye Shuo brought Ye Jin out of the mountain.
No matter how careful he was, after all, he had to climb up and down, pick mushrooms from wood and mud, and wield a hoe to dig bamboo shoots. Ye Jin was already in a mess.
When Ye Jin was immersed in happiness at first, he didn’t think anything was wrong. He even thought that the Ninth Prince was not as uneducated as the rumours said. There were so many things and plants in the mountains, and he knew them all. He was obviously a very smart person.
But soon, as the distance between him and his father got closer and closer and his father’s face became visibly ugly, Ye Jin woke up instantly.
Ye Jin felt that no matter what, the Ninth Prince, as the culprit, would always say a few good words for him, but…
After letting Ye Jin out of the bamboo basket, Ye Shuo ran away without hesitation, leaving him behind.
The child was left alone and dumbfounded.
Looking at his son who looked like he was dug out of the ground, covered in mud, with dull eyes like a beggar, the Sixth Prince’s head instantly heated up.
The other side.
The eldest prince soon received news from the foot of the mountain that a young man was standing in front of the eldest prince’s door. As the servant at the door informed him, the eldest prince saw him for a short while.
The eldest prince was not unfamiliar with this face. The young man was a subordinate of General Xu. Because he was nimble and reliable, General Xu often asked him to deliver messages back and forth.
As for General Xu, he is a fierce general under the command of the eldest prince. He has been through life and death with the eldest prince for many years. When they attacked Beiting and captured three cities in a row, General Xu also made an indispensable contribution. He can be said to be one of the most trusted people of the eldest prince.
This time when they came to Zilu Peak, the eldest prince brought him along without thinking twice.
In addition to General Xu, there is another general who is in charge of the guard work and is also the eldest prince’s confidant.
Seeing the young man suddenly coming up the mountain, the eldest prince was stunned for a moment, and then asked him what happened at the foot of the mountain.
“It’s not a big deal, but General Xu’s men seem to have discovered traces of outsiders at the foot of the mountain, and General Xu asked if we should go check it out.” The young man looked respectful and didn’t dare to hide anything.
Although this is a royal temple, villagers often appear around it, and…
Suddenly remembering what the second prince said, the eldest prince said in an uncanny way: “No need.”
“Then I will go and reply to General Xu’s words right away.”
The young man didn’t think much about it and quickly went back to report.
A moment later, news came from the front that Emperor Jingwen had come out from the host.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Assassination
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
In the following days, Ye Shuo would take Ye Jin for a stroll every day, and then send him back when they were tired of playing. This way, Ye Shuo didn’t have to clean up, and he wouldn’t be so bored, which was simply killing two birds with one stone.
The only bad thing was that the Sixth Prince’s life was harder. He had to help his son clean up almost every day. At most, he had to wash him two or three times a day.
Even though there were palace servants around him and the Sixth Prince didn’t need to do it himself, he was still very worried. The clothes that Xiao Ye Jin brought with him every day would soon be insufficient.
At first, Ye Jin and the Sixth Prince slept in separate rooms, but later, in order to protect his son from his younger brother, the Sixth Prince simply slept with his son himself.
However, the more the Sixth Prince acted like this, the more Ye Shuo became more outrageous.
Life in the temple is really boring. It is also kind of fun to compete with the Sixth Prince in wits and courage from time to time.
Often, the Sixth Prince would be talking to someone, and in the blink of an eye, his son would disappear. Looking at the figure running away not far away, who else could it be but his younger brother?
Xiaojiu seemed to treat his son as a trophy, and stealing him would be considered a success.
The Sixth Prince just felt that his younger brother was extremely childish and had made no progress at all over the years.Ye Jin was terrified at the beginning, then became trembling with fear, and finally became numb and cold now.
Oh, I’m used to it.
Now, suddenly a pair of hands came from behind, picked him up and ran away. Little Ye Jin felt no emotion at all.
“Ninth Uncle, we have to go back early today. I still have to study.” Seeing that he could not resist, Ye Jin took the initiative to propose conditions and negotiate with him.
Ye Shuo felt that the children of the royal family were really miserable. They finally had a vacation, but they couldn’t escape the fate of studying.
It’s not that studying is bad, reading is definitely a good thing. You should study when you should study and play when you should play. It would be too tiring to think about studying when you can’t play.
This child doesn’t seem to have a childhood…
Fortunately, there was a small porcelain kiln behind the temple, which was usually used to make some simple ceramic utensils, such as pottery jars, bowls and plates. Basically, it was self-sufficient. Seeing an idle windlass, Ye Shuo took him to make a few small bowls by hand.
In the meantime, Ye Shuo took Ye Jin to the mountain to pick up some firewood.
It is extremely cold in the mountains in winter, but fortunately, once you start exercising your body will gradually start to heat up, so after walking back and forth, it won’t be so cold anymore.
Then, Ye Shuo taught Ye Jin how to make charcoal step by step.
Ye Jin was stunned. He felt that the Ninth Prince knew so many things that he could even burn charcoal.
Then he told this to the Sixth Prince. The Sixth Prince looked at his son’s eyes, which were slightly surprised, and was silent for a moment before saying, “…Except for studying, your Ninth Prince knows everything.”
Especially when it comes to having fun, it reaches the pinnacle.
The Sixth Prince had a headache. He never thought that his son would find it interesting to pick up branches to make a fire, even though it was just some simple chores.
But that’s how children are. When they make something with their own hands, the participation they get in it is incomparable to anything else.
Just when Ye Shuo and Ye Jin were looking forward to opening the kiln, the next day, news came that the Queen was celebrating the Thousand Years Festival.
Calculating the time, the Queen’s birthday is around these few days.
When she was in the palace before, it was basically just a routine matter. In the first few years, she would entertain ministers at banquets. But after the Thirteenth Prince was born, there were no more such banquets. Basically, they were just held in the backyard, and Ye Shuo didn’t keep track of it.
The Queen is the mother of a country, but now Emperor Jingwen seemed to have just remembered it and hurriedly had a family banquet set up in Bailu Temple.
The emperor was busy grieving for the deceased prince, so how could he remember anything else? How could the queen not be angry?
In fact, on the day of the queen’s birthday, Emperor Jingwen was still mourning the prince with the abbot, and only came out of the meditation room when the family banquet was about to start in the evening.
No matter who it is, I guess no one would be happy celebrating their birthday under such circumstances.
Seeing that the atmosphere was not very good, Ye Shuo was very tactful and did not show up. He took the cleaned Ye Jin and quietly walked around behind the crowd and came to the table.
Now that Ye Shuo has grown up, he naturally can no longer sit with the imperial concubine and Jian Jian. Instead, he sits on the left with the other princes, while the imperial concubine, Jian Jian, the virtuous concubine, and the concubines sit in the row on the right.
Buddhism is a quiet place, so naturally there is no sound of decadent music. Fortunately, there are some martial monks in Bailu Temple, so the banquet was not boring.
Of course, not boring is only from Ye Shuo’s perspective. He likes these things and is interested in the boxing and stick techniques in the temple, so naturally he would not be unhappy.
But looking at the Queen, her expression is almost unable to be maintained.
The Queen was filled with hatred and felt that the Emperor was too heartless. Even though he was angry at her for acting on her own, so many years had passed, and wasn’t it enough that he had punished and humiliated her like this?
The crown prince was dead, the previous empress’s legitimate son was dead! Yet, he still refused to even look at herself and her son.
For a moment, the queen felt disheartened, and the last bit of concern for Emperor Jingwen in her heart disappeared.
However, compared to the empress, Emperor Jingwen’s spirit and complexion were better than before. The abbot of Bailu Temple was indeed an accomplished monk. After some persuasion, Emperor Jingwen seemed to relax a little.
As the monks were coming and going, the eldest prince, who was sitting at the front, was originally doing nothing. Soon, his attendant came in from outside, and while everyone’s attention was on the group of monks, the attendant quickly whispered a few words to the eldest prince.
“Your Highness, General Xu sent a message saying that in the evening, on the back of Zilu Peak, there were traces of trampled grass and trees on a small path. There were also some fresh footprints beside the stream. It is estimated that someone came up the mountain. General Xu asked if we need to send troops up immediately?”
This is a temple after all, and most of the soldiers are only stationed at the foot of the mountain.
They are not ordinary villagers!
The eldest prince was shocked when he heard this, and his eyes changed slightly. The fourth prince beside him looked over subconsciously, and the eldest prince returned to normal almost instantly.
“There are many wolves at night, remember to tell General Xu to be alert.”
Although he said this, the eldest prince shook his head slightly at his servant.
The attendant had followed the eldest prince for many years, so how could he not know what his every move meant?
“Yes.” The attendant went out again without much hesitation. If nothing unexpected happened, he should have gone to pass on the message to General Xu.
The eldest prince did not notice that Emperor Jingwen, who was at the top, glanced over here.
Even though he was the eldest prince, he felt his heart pounding at this moment, and he felt inexplicably irritated.
Zilu Peak has been sealed off, and there are so many people guarding the foot of the mountain, with the imperial carriage prominently among them. Now an outsider is going up the mountain in the dark, he must have bad intentions.
The eldest prince was almost certain that this wave of assassins was targeting his father. At the same time, the words that the second prince said in the Xuanzheng Hall that day once again emerged in the eldest prince’s mind.
Ever since that day, the eldest prince has been feeling uneasy. He wanted to ask someone, but the seriously ill second prince refused to speak and just looked at the people he sent with a gloomy expression. This made the eldest prince angry and resentful, but he could do nothing about it. The seeds of doubt in his heart gradually sprouted.
Of course, this is not the most unsettling thing for the eldest prince. What makes him most uneasy is the actions he took in Shangjing City during the period when his father was missing.
At the moment, my father is immersed in the pain of losing the crown prince and has no intention to investigate. Once my father recovers from the pain and knows that I am leading troops to control Shangjing…
The eldest prince didn’t dare to imagine what would happen to him, his wives, concubines and children.
Now, taking advantage of this opportunity, the eldest prince had to make a choice. It would be too late if he delayed any further!
General Xu and General Fang at the foot of the mountain were both his confidants who had followed him in battle for many years. This was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and the eldest prince could not help but be tempted.
The commander-in-chief of the Black Armor Guards happens to be ill right now. Isn’t this God creating an opportunity for him?
But the eldest prince really couldn’t kill his father and brothers with his own hands, so these assassins came at the right time.
Looking at the familiar faces before him, the eldest prince had a fierce struggle in his heart and soon hot sweat appeared on his forehead.
Ye Shuo, who was standing by, was completely unaware of this and was eating the vegetarian food in front of him with great relish. When the sound of breaking through the air was heard, Ye Shuo was even stunned for a moment.
“There’s an assassin! Protect the king!”
Wang Ziquan standing by subconsciously stood in front of Emperor Jingwen, and his already shrill voice became even more piercing.
Among the princes, the thirteenth prince sat the lowest, because Emperor Jingwen had never acknowledged his status as the legitimate son, so he could only sit according to seniority.
The assassins rushed in from the main gate, and the Thirteenth Prince was naturally the first to encounter them.
The Thirteenth Prince was a coward to begin with. When he first saw this scene, he naturally rolled over and crawled in fear, “Help! Someone come and save me!”
“Someone, come quickly!”
Except for the eldest prince, Ye Shuo had the fastest reaction among almost everyone.
Hearing the Thirteenth Prince’s cry for help, Ye Shuo paused suddenly, but then he rushed towards the imperial concubine and Jian Jian opposite without hesitation.
When did the defence around my cheap dad become so lax?
The assassinations they have encountered in recent times are more than those in the previous 19 years combined. The last incident just happened, and now…
Wait, the last incident is not over yet!
They only found out that it was the two prefects who did it, but the two prefects obviously didn’t have that much power, so there must be another force behind it.
After Ye Shuo reacted, he looked up at Emperor Jingwen.
Seeing that his cheap father didn’t seem surprised after seeing the assassin, as if he had expected it, Ye Shuo suddenly thought of a possibility.
Could it be that my cheap dad is… fishing? ? ?
He is not sad because of the death of the crown prince, but he is really trying to lure the snake out of its hole!
In fact, my cheap father had already found out who was behind this, and he kept it a secret until today!
But Ye Shuo didn’t understand. With my cheap father’s personality, if this was really done by one of his brothers or someone else, my cheap father wouldn’t have gone to such great lengths to put on such a show.
Ever since my grandfather fell into poverty, no one in the entire Great Zhou could threaten him anymore.
Unless the person behind this is from outside.
Following his adoptive father’s gaze, Ye Shuo only saw the Queen Mother.
The Queen Mother had long lost her favour, and considering his stepfather’s previous attitude, Ye Shuo didn’t believe that there was love between the two of them.
But at this time, the first person his stepfather looked at was the Queen, which made Ye Shuo a little confused.
Then Ye Shuo suddenly remembered that he was once scolded by his adoptive father because the queen had too close contact with the princess from Beiting who was married to the princess.
No way…
This is the Empress of the Central Palace! The other master of the Great Zhou Dynasty!
Just when Ye Shuo was shocked, he saw the panic and fear on the Empress’s face. It was so real that it didn’t seem fake.
Ye Shuo hesitated for a moment, wondering if he had made a wrong judgement. Not to mention Ye Shuo, even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but frown.
But if it wasn’t the queen, who else could it be?
At the same time, the fourth prince also came to the side of the thirteenth prince.
Ye Shuo was originally the closest to the Thirteenth Prince, but he ran away. The only one left was the Eighth Prince. The Eighth Prince wanted to rescue him, but was dragged to his side by the First Prince.
As for the Seventh Prince and the Fifth Prince, one lost his mother and the other lost his brother. Now their hearts are colder than each other and they don’t bother to care about such things at all.
The two of them only care about their own life and don’t care about the death of others.
Look at the Sixth Prince. He is already busy protecting his own son, so how can he spare any extra energy?
The Fourth Prince hesitated for a long time, but in the end he couldn’t bear to watch his brother die at the hands of the assassin, so he rescued the Thirteenth Prince before the assassin’s sword pierced him.
“Follow me, don’t mess around—”
Before the Fourth Prince could finish his words, a dagger pierced his chest.
Then, the dagger stabbed out.

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Tools
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The first one.
I thought it would be the Ninth Prince who would came to save me, as he was the closest to me. But I didn’t expect that he just hesitated for a moment and then ran to the other side very quickly.
It seems that the Ninth Prince is not as harmless and enthusiastic as he appears to be, and is also selfish at heart.
Similar scenes had been simulated thousands of times in his dreams. The Thirteenth Prince did not feel strange at all. Instead, he felt a strange sense of excitement. Without blinking, the Thirteenth Prince pulled out the dagger in his hand.
What had been envisioned countless times has finally become a reality.
This knife was sharp and decisive, hitting the vital point directly!
During the whole process, the Thirteenth Prince did not hesitate at all. No matter who came, no matter how strong their kung fu was, as long as they were not prepared against him beforehand, they would not be able to avoid the knife.
The Fourth Prince only felt a pain in his chest, and when he saw the tip of the knife sticking out of his heart, his eyes and face were full of disbelief.
In the last moment of his consciousness, the Fourth Prince thought, perhaps he should not have fought, or perhaps the last time he broke his leg was a warning from God.If I had chosen to give up last time, if I had not been so eager for quick success this time and had chosen to slowly maintain it, I would not have been able to climb the mountain and naturally would not have made this move.
People who are too greedy will be punished…
It really proves the saying, what is destined to be yours will eventually come to you, and what is not destined to be yours should not be forced.
I just can’t bear to die like this…
In the end, the Fourth Prince collapsed completely exhausted, and he was unable to close his eyes until his death.
Without the cover of the Fourth Prince, the true appearance of the Thirteenth Prince behind him gradually revealed.
Ye Shuo, who was not far away, was afraid that he would never forget this face that still had a childish look for the rest of his life.
How could the Thirteenth Prince still have a panic expression on his face at this moment? Although his hands were not stained with blood, it still made people feel terrified.
Everyone’s impression of the Thirteenth Prince was still that he was young and cowardly. The incident happened so suddenly that they were unable to react at all.
He is only thirteen years old now.
Even an adult prince couldn’t do it so straightforwardly, so who could have thought that a thirteen-year-old child could kill his own brother without blinking an eye?
The kindness of the Fourth Prince has now become a death warrant for him.
However, in the eyes of the Thirteenth Prince, these people were never his brothers. If they were really brothers, then where were they when he was suffering?
Coming to save him now would be nothing but hypocrisy.
The Thirteenth Prince didn’t care who they were. He had made a plan from the beginning. He would kill anyone who came to save him. Anyway, all the people in front of him were going to die, so he would kill as many as he could.
If you want to blame someone, you can only blame the Fourth Prince for his disgusting and ridiculous kindness.
The queen at the top was the first person to scream when she saw this scene.
“Wu Ji, are you crazy!?”
The queen knew clearly what the crime of killing a prince was. Even if her own son was also a prince, he would not escape severe punishment if he killed his own brother in public.
Not only he himself, but also her position as queen and her maternal family behind her will be in trouble.
Doesn’t her own son know that he and those above him will rise and fall together?
However, what the Queen did not know was that this was actually what the Thirteenth Prince also wanted.
In the eyes of the Thirteenth Prince, if his biological mother was the mastermind, then everyone else was an accomplice. If he was unable or failed, then they would all die together.
The Thirteenth Prince was very surprised when he heard this: “Didn’t you ask your son to fight for that position, mother?”
“You usually despise your son for being cowardly, but now that he has killed the fourth brother with his own hands, shouldn’t you be happy, mother?”
Strange, it’s really strange.
Upon hearing this, the queen almost vomited blood.
The queen had never thought that her son was so naive. How could such a thing succeed?
Noticing that Emperor Jingwen was shocked and angry, and looked at her as if he was looking at a dead person, the queen felt her whole body tremble.
“Who on earth is it? Who on earth has bewitched you?”
Fortunately, the queen was not too stupid. She knew that in the current situation, she could only find ways to shift the blame.
The Thirteenth Prince avoided answering and just said, “Mother, don’t worry, you will be the Queen Mother soon.”
Doesn’t he realise that the emperor comes well prepared?
Seeing the people around her secretly on guard, as if the servants would decisively take action as long as she made any unusual moves, what else did the queen not understand?
Although Ye Shuo was worried about the fourth prince, there were many assassins at the moment, and his mother and Jian Jian were still here. He could not leave them for a moment, because he really could not afford the loss.
Along with the sounds of fighting and sharp movements, the assassins around Ye Shuo fell one after another.
The virtuous concubine next to him had been screaming heart-wrenchingly since the Fourth Prince fell down. She ignored the attempts of the maids beside her to stop her and tried her best to get to the Fourth Prince’s side.
Ye Shuo gritted his teeth and tried his best to help Concubine Xian eliminate the assassins who threatened her.
In the end, even the Fifth Prince couldn’t stand it anymore. The Thirteenth Prince was feeling proud when the Fifth Prince, with a cold face, kicked him in the heart.
“What a crazy bastard!”
Look at how many brothers he has. Who does he think he is?
The Thirteenth Prince had been specially trained in the technique of stabbing with a dagger, but he himself had no martial arts skills and was naturally unable to resist the Fifth Prince’s angry attack.
The Thirteenth Prince immediately flew out like a kite with a broken string, and after landing he vomited two mouthfuls of blood.
Seeing that he had temporarily lost the ability to move, the Fifth Prince lowered his head to check on the Fourth Prince’s current condition, only to discover that the Fourth Prince had already stopped breathing.
The Fifth Prince suddenly stopped moving.
Afterwards, when Concubine Xian came over, the Fifth Prince let go and discovered that the blood flowing from the Fourth Prince’s wound was jet black.
The fifth prince reacted quickly: “You bastard, how dare you poison him!”
In addition to the assassination technique of killing with one strike, the Thirteenth Prince also poisoned the dagger. Even if the Fourth Prince did not die on the spot, the poison would enter his internal organs and even gods would be unable to save him.
From the very beginning, he was aiming to take people’s lives!
The veins on the arms of Emperor Jingwen above him were bulging.
It is true that Emperor Jingwen set a trap, and he knew that the mastermind behind it was Beiting.
Beiting seemed to know the current trends in the court, and he knew that the princes were ready to make a move, so he wanted to kill him and plunge the Great Zhou into civil strife. That was why he spared no effort in these two assassinations.
However, no matter how capable the other party is, it is impossible for him to control his movements all the time.
Unless… there is an insider around me, and his status is not low.
Then Emperor Jingwen traced the blame to the Empress.
Emperor Jingwen knew that the Queen was resentful towards him because of the matter of his legitimate son. Moreover, the Queen once had dealings with Princess Beiting in the palace, and she was the only one who knew his itinerary so well. Therefore, Emperor Jingwen almost believed that it was the Queen.
Even if Emperor Jingwen disliked the Empress, she was still the Empress and the Queen Mother of the Zhou Dynasty. She could not be easily deposed without solid evidence, so this trip to Zilu Peak was planned.
However, what Emperor Jingwen never expected was that the person truly hiding behind the scenes was not the queen whom he hated to death, but his own son who seemed timid and incompetent and hid under the queen’s wings.
The Thirteenth Prince… is only thirteen years old, just a half-grown child.
Who would have thought it was him?
Whether it was killing his brother with his own hands, attempting to kill his father, or colluding with Beiting, it all made Emperor Jingwen want to kill him.
“Do you know that the princess of Beiting is using you? Even if she supports you to be the emperor, you will only be a puppet by then.”
From the fact that he didn’t care who saved him and just killed someone randomly, Emperor Jingwen knew that his purpose was not that simple. He wanted to kill everyone present, so he didn’t care who he killed first.
Such a mentality is truly vicious and cruel.
Emperor Jingwen’s chest heaved.
Upon hearing this, the Thirteenth Prince subconsciously retorted: “Impossible! The princess promised me!”
Moreover, what about being a puppet? Being a puppet now does not necessarily mean it will remain a puppet in the future.
“The princess wouldn’t lie to me!”
Seeing that he was very emotional, he knew that he was deeply obsessed with it. Emperor Jingwen did not want to say anything more. Now that the situation was completely clear, there was no need to continue.
“Take them all down!”
Following an order from Emperor Jingwen, several more secret guards rushed out, and the originally evenly matched situation immediately changed.
No matter how vicious the Thirteenth Prince’s character is, he does not have enough experience and cannot be truly as still as a mountain.
Seeing this scene, he couldn’t help but feel panic in his heart.
Damn it, how come he had been in the temple for such a long time and hadn’t noticed so many secret guards hiding in the dark!
Not to mention him, even Ye Shuo, who was wandering around all day, couldn’t find any trace of the secret guards.
But soon, the Thirteenth Prince forced himself to calm down again.
It doesn’t matter, it doesn’t matter. Zilu Peak is far away in the suburbs, not in Shangjing, so if the cost is not considered, the princess can mobilise a lot of people.
Also, even if Zilu Peak is defended, what can it do?
When the princess’s troops kill all of Shangjing and occupy it, my father will be powerless to save the situation.
In order to plan this matter, they could be said to have made perfect preparations. No wonder the Thirteenth Prince dared to act so blatantly.
“Be patient, reinforcements will be here soon.”
Under the protection of the assassins, the Thirteenth Prince retreated step by step with them. Just when the Thirteenth Prince was getting extremely nervous, there were sudden sounds of dense footsteps coming from outside.
There were so many of them that just when the Thirteenth Prince thought that his reinforcements had arrived, his excited expression did not last long, and soon the smile on his face froze.
The people who came were not what he had expected. The two faces in the lead were General Xu and General Fang. Who else could they be?
After killing the last assassin, General Xu and General Fang knelt on one knee without thinking: “Your Majesty, please forgive us for being late to save you!”
The eldest prince clearly remembered that he had not had time to pass the message down, so why did they bring people up?
Could it be that the two of them betrayed him?
