Perhaps because she had seen too many men like her father and brother, the imperial concubine couldn’t stand seeing men like this, even if the man was her own son.
The imperial concubine’s eyes changed when she looked at her son again.
Even Jianjian couldn’t hold back any longer and slowly put down the book in her hand.
Being stared at like this by three people, Ye Shuo suddenly felt unhappy: “But I am a prince! Isn’t it normal for me to be a little pampered?”
Listen, listen, is this human language? !
How did I raise such a thing?
The imperial concubine gritted her teeth and said, “Except for this status, how can you compare to others?”
The girl is good at kung fu, medicine, considerate and has a good temper. Then look at your son. Wait, what advantages does your son have?
Apart from being a spoiled brat and annoying people, he seems to be incapable of anything else…
The Imperial Concubine was suddenly stunned. Stepping out of her identity as a mother and looking at things from a purely woman’s perspective, she realised that the above were not advantages at all, but rather huge disadvantages.
Think about it, if you find out after marriage that your husband is not capable of handling things at all, and that he always relies on you for everything, even if the sky falls, you have to bear it all by yourself, God, is this still a life for people?
The Imperial Noble Consort and Emperor Jingwen were feudal, but it was not without its benefits. At the very least, they would not think that it was natural for Yao Zhi, a girl, to do these things.
This girl must have a very good temper to tolerate him like this…
The Imperial Noble Consort was so angry when she saw that her son was still acting as if it was a matter of course and had no remorse at all, that she started to curse him.
Looking at his son who would occasionally refute and constantly emphasise his own strengths, Emperor Jingwen shook his head. This child might be hopeless.
Judging from the situation, ordinary women really cannot satisfy him, and he is definitely not the ideal husband for the daughter of an official family. If he really finds a woman who follows the rules, the two of them will probably become a pair of resentful lovers sooner or later, and will probably have no peace for the rest of their lives.
If she is from a big family, it would be even worse. After I leave, his in-laws will skin him alive when they see how he treats their daughter, right?
Therefore, small families are not completely without merit.
In the past, Emperor Jingwen had a lot of time and only cared about the reputation of the royal family. Now that he doesn’t have so much time, he has become more open-minded about some things.
In the end, Ye Shuo was almost kicked out by Concubine Rong.
Although her son didn’t have much ability, he had a powerful mouth and could often leave people speechless. The imperial concubine couldn’t win an argument with him, so she simply drove him away, out of sight and out of mind.
“Mother! Mother! I am your son, you can’t treat me like this!” Caught off guard, Ye Shuo banged on the door in front of him and shouted.
“Go away, I don’t want to see you now!”
About half an incense stick later, there was no more noise outside and there were only three people left in the room. Seeing this, Jianjian also left very tactfully.
When the room quieted down, the imperial concubine drank two cups of cold tea in one breath, and her anger finally subsided a little, but her face was still uncontrollably filled with worry: “What should I do in the future if he is like this?”
Emperor Jingwen was also worried. His youngest son had not made much progress over the years and he was afraid that it would be difficult for him in the future.
In this way, the emperor and the imperial concubine discussed the issue of children’s education for most of the night before they reluctantly fell asleep.
The rain stopped the next day, but Emperor Jingwen still had no intention of ordering his son to leave immediately.
Ye Shuo also didn’t make a fuss for the first time. After all, his cheap father didn’t have much time left…
Ye Shuo wouldn’t go against him at this time.
When the ministers of the previous dynasty learned about this, they must have reacted strongly. After all, the Ninth Prince was already over 20 years old, and now he stayed in the palace for a long time. What kind of thing was this? The emperor’s favour for him was too much.
But in the end these voices were suppressed. Emperor Jingwen knew that he did not have much time left, so he did not care about everything as much as before.
Since the emperor doesn’t care anymore, how can the ministers have the qualifications to worry about the affairs of the harem for him?
It was just that it was really boring in the palace. Ever since Zhao Chongrong caught a cold last time, her health had been in and out of control. Apart from visiting her every day, Ye Shuo had no place to spend the rest of his time.
The Fifth Prince and the Sixth Prince could see their younger brother strolling in the Imperial Garden almost every day. He looked so comfortable.
Especially the indolence on his face, which made people feel angry.
For a moment, the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince even wanted to give up.
Anyway, the emperor has already chosen the sixth prince, and I heard that the will has been written. They are still working so hard every day, and I don’t know what they are arguing about.
However, in just a short moment, several people woke up.
The fifth prince’s mother has now been demoted to Xiaoyi, a fifth-rank official. The second prince’s life or death is unknown outside. If he doesn’t fight back, his mother will really have no way to survive.
The same goes for the Eighth Prince. As for the Seventh Prince, right now it’s just a rumour that my father favours the Sixth Prince, and there’s no conclusion yet. What if, what if things turn around in the end?
They couldn’t be as carefree as the Ninth Prince, so even if there was only a glimmer of hope, they would fight hard for it.
Seeing that the expressions of several people were not right, Ye Shuo quickly left to avoid being an eyesore and making them feel uncomfortable.
They felt unhappy and thought that if they gave up, their honour as princes would be reduced, which was really not worth it.
The war with Beiting is at a critical moment. If they don’t do it, who will?
Finally, Ye Shuo thought about it and felt that this was not going to work and he had to find something useful to do, so he asked someone from the Ministry of Internal Affairs to carve a set of mahjong for him.
People cannot stay idle like this all the time. If they are idle for too long, their brains will become dull.
“…Is this the serious matter you mentioned?” Seeing him so serious at first, Emperor Jingwen thought it was a big deal, but…it was just this? ? ?
Looking at the hundred or so mahjong tiles in front of him, Emperor Jingwen felt that they looked familiar. He remembered that he had seen them in his Qinglufang when he was in Liangzhou.
Isn’t this a gambling tool?
“So Dad, are you coming? We are short of one.”
Ye Shuo pointed and there were just four of them: himself, his mother, Jian Jian, and his stepfather.
The twelve-year-old girl Jianjian who was dragged in to fill in the numbers: “…”
I have never seen a brother who would drag his sister to gamble like this.
“I still have to memorise my lessons.” Jianjian couldn’t help but say.
“Hey, you can recite the book anytime, come and keep your brother company.”
Afterwards, Ye Shuo pushed his cheap father to the card table and told him that his cheap father had been too extravagant in his life. He still had to review memorials until now. Although he was an emperor, he had never relaxed or had fun in his life.
But can this small set of mahjong tiles really make people relax?
Caught off guard, Emperor Jingwen sat on the stool, listening to the “clattering” sound in front of him. After struggling for a while, he finally rolled up his sleeves.
Since he has spoken, his daughter and the imperial concubine are also waiting. It just so happens that he is relatively free recently, so he may as well play a few games with them.
But… I’ve lost too much, haven’t I?
Emperor Jingwen initially just wanted to play with his wife and daughter, but after losing the first game, his attitude suddenly changed.
Looking at his son happily counting money, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and said, “… Come again.”
Jianjian couldn’t help but frown. She was just one step away from winning.
However, what they don’t know is that gambling is like this: the more you want to turn the tables, the harder it is to do so; the more anxious you are, the more likely you are to lose.
An hour later, Ye Shuo was the only winner among the four people. Ye Shuo defeated the three of them alone, and he did not even show mercy to the Imperial Concubine.
“Hahaha, thanks, thanks!”
Jianjian and the Imperial Concubine stared at their brother/son who was happily counting golden beans with murderous eyes.
Watching the last golden bean in his hand fall into his hands, Emperor Jingwen was silent for a while, and finally slowly covered his heart.
With a “ding” sound, the golden beans in Ye Shuo’s hand fell into the plate, making a crisp sound.
No, not really?
Could it be that my cheap dad got mad and had a fit? When did my cheap dad become so fragile?
The eunuch Wang beside him screamed: “Your Majesty!”
Ye Shuo stood up subconsciously, but just as he approached and was about to ask, he saw that Emperor Jingwen immediately returned to normal.
Seeing that he acted as if nothing had happened, how could Ye Shuo not know that he had been cheated?
“…”
My cheap dad is really something. He starts acting when he gets angry about losing. He really can’t afford to play this game.
Not to mention him, even the eunuch Wang standing beside him was stunned.
“Dad, if you continue like this I won’t play with you anymore.” Ye Shuo took his hand back with a sad tone.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but cough lightly when he saw this.
At that moment, the worry in his youngest son’s eyes did not seem fake. Seeing that he seemed to be really angry, he did not speak a word all the way when he sent him back to the bedroom. When they arrived at the door of the bedroom, Emperor Jingwen thought for a moment and said suddenly: “If you really like that girl named Yao, how about I help you?”
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment.
Oh my god, is there such a good thing? Is this something that my cheap dad can say?
But the progress is a bit too fast. Yao Zhi may not agree.
Just as Ye Shuo was struggling over whether he should agree or not, how he should tell Yao Zhi, and what he should do if he was rejected, Ye Shuo felt distracted for two whole days and couldn’t sleep.
However, before he could come up with an answer, he ran into the Sixth Prince.
Because of the war, the Sixth Prince has been very busy recently and only sleeps for two or three hours a day. He was dazzled by the scorching sun outside. If Ye Shuo had not been quick-eyed and quick-handed, the Sixth Prince would have nearly fallen down the stairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Getting Angry
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Xiao Ming, are you okay?” Ye Shuo suddenly woke up from his confusion and saw that his face was a little pale, so he asked hurriedly.
“…Call me Sixth Brother.”
Even at this time, the Sixth Prince still subconsciously corrected his address.
After a while, with the help of his arm, the dizziness in front of his eyes disappeared a little. The Sixth Prince wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said, “Fortunately, it’s nothing serious.”
Even in this state, you still say it’s nothing serious? ? ?
Noticing that his breathing rhythm is much faster than that of ordinary people, Ye Shuo hurriedly said: “I’ll go find a doctor for you.”
However, just as Ye Shuo turned around, he saw the Sixth Prince blocking his way.
“Don’t go.”
Ye Shuo: “?”Seeing his brother’s puzzled look, the Sixth Prince sighed inwardly, thinking that he was too naive.
After hesitating for a while, the Sixth Prince finally said, “If the imperial physician comes, it may be bad for me.”
I have only been working for a few days and I have already collapsed from exhaustion. If the court officials knew about this, they would inevitably wonder whether I am qualified to sit in that position with such poor health.
Whether the heir is in good health is also a criterion for court officials to measure. Otherwise, frequent changes of kings may be even more terrifying than the king’s mediocre ability.
So no matter what, you can’t let others know.
Ye Shuo was shocked: “But you can’t just keep putting it off like this, right?” In Ye Shuo’s opinion, seeing a doctor when one is sick is the most natural thing to do.
“What if something goes wrong?”
The Sixth Prince felt fine: “I know my own body well, I just need a little rest.”
Ye Shuo paused and said, “If it really doesn’t work, tell our father to stop and take a rest.”
It’s just a break, no one will die.
However, the Sixth Prince still shook his head after hearing this.
Now is the critical moment, he can’t stop, and he didn’t dare to stop. After so many years of painstaking planning, if it fails because of such a small matter, the Sixth Prince will regret it too late.
It has to be said that the current situation is exactly the same as what Emperor Jingwen had guessed, and even worse.
The Sixth Prince is smarter than Emperor Jingwen thought.
The Sixth Prince had long guessed that everything before his eyes was just a test given to him by his father. If he could get through it, everything would go smoothly and his dream would come true. If he couldn’t, all his hard work and efforts over the years would be in vain.
How could the Sixth Prince allow himself to fall before dawn?
The Crown Prince was so glorious in the past, but he still fell at any time, didn’t he? The lesson from the past is there, and the Sixth Prince will never let himself follow the Crown Prince’s footsteps.
The Sixth Prince watched helplessly as the Crown Prince was brought down from his throne. Moreover, he was also one of the participants in the incident. Now, he was just like the Crown Prince back then. If he made the slightest mistake, he would be doomed.
His father is watching, his brothers are watching, and the court officials are watching even more, so no matter what, the Sixth Prince will not reveal even the slightest flaw.
The Sixth Prince lost his mother when he was born. His mother was just a little palace maid. Ever since he could remember, the Sixth Prince had experienced the ups and downs of the palace. If the Imperial Noble Consort had not taken him to Qiuwu Palace, he would probably have been tortured to death by the palace maids around him within a few years.
So at that time the Sixth Prince swore that he would never live that kind of life again in his life.
He said it and did it.
The Sixth Prince knew that he did not have the capital and backing of his other brothers, nor was he a very smart man. In terms of studying, he was not as good as the Eighth Prince, and in terms of family background, he was not as good as the Ninth Prince. After much thought, the Sixth Prince found that the only thing he had to show off was his diligence.
He has to work several times harder than others to reach the same height as others.
Fortunately, he was about to succeed. His hard work was not in vain and God was kind to him.
I have already done ninety-nine bows, only this one shiver is left. Except for Xiaojiu, anyone else would have to try his best.
The Sixth Prince knew that people needed to walk more, rest more, and not overwork. Ever since the issue of offspring, the Sixth Prince knew better than anyone that Ye Shuo was right and he did not lie to him. But the Sixth Prince had no choice. There were so many eyes watching him, he had no choice but to keep going until he successfully sat in that position.
The fight for succession is a one-way street from beginning to end. Once you start, there is no turning back.
The Sixth Prince knew that he couldn’t go on like this, but he had no other choice.
So, wait a while, wait a little longer, just hold on.
Once you get through this stage, things will be easy in the future.
The Sixth Prince couldn’t help but comfort himself in this way.
Ye Shuo opened his mouth, but couldn’t say anything. He wanted to persuade him again, but found that he couldn’t persuade him at all.
Xiao Ming knows everything, but he still chose this path. How can I change him?
None of his brothers are stupid, they just have different aspirations and you can’t force them.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help scratching his head: “Then what are you going to do? Let me tell you, if you collapse now, you will really lose everything.”
Upon hearing this, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but look up at him.
Ye Shuo inexplicably felt that the look in the other person’s eyes made him feel uneasy.
“W-What do you mean? What do you want to do?”
The Sixth Prince was silent for a moment, then said, “Xiao Jiu is indeed smart.”
However, his praise of himself instantly gave Ye Shuo goosebumps, and he almost jumped three feet high. His eyes instantly became alert: “I’m warning you, don’t do anything reckless.”
The Sixth Prince’s subsequent words further confirmed Ye Shuo’s guess.
“I remember that Miss Yao is still living in your house.” This was the only solution. As he said, if he collapsed now, he would really lose everything.
Ye Shuo: “…”
As expected, he really had Yao Zhi on his mind!
The Sixth Prince still trusted Yao Zhi’s medical skills. She could cure the Fourth Prince’s leg injury, let alone himself.
“You are the only one I can trust now.”
As for the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince, there was no way the Sixth Prince would trust them.
There are no true brothers in the royal family, and there are very few people who can be trusted.
When saying this, the Sixth Prince’s brows showed weakness and fatigue that could not be concealed.
Ye Shuo couldn’t tell for a moment whether he was real or pretending. After all, he was a ruthless person who knew how to use any means to achieve his goals at the age of four or five. This guy was no worse than him in acting.
But he had no choice. The current situation of the Sixth Prince was indeed miserable. Ye Shuo hesitated for a while, but finally nodded: “…Okay.”
“But I have to tell you in advance that I am only taking you there. It is up to Miss Yao to decide whether to help you or not.”
The Sixth Prince: “…”
My younger brother is too low in status.
The Sixth Prince originally wanted to tell him that he couldn’t do that, but thinking about his brother’s temper, he decided to give up. It would be bad if he accidentally offended him.
Ye Shuo originally planned to carry him on his back, which would be faster, but he knew with his toes that the Sixth Prince would not agree.
In the end, Ye Shuo pretended to chat with him, but actually served as his crutch, supporting him all the way, and they got on the carriage.
The carriage slowly drove out of the palace. On the way, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but ask, “What have you been doing with my father these days? My father doesn’t even approve memorials.”
As for who is reviewing the memorials now, isn’t the answer obvious?
However, this sudden reliance made the Sixth Prince a little flustered. He felt uneasy and was afraid that there was a trap waiting for him.
But in fact, it’s not that complicated.
Ye Shuo didn’t take it seriously at all, and said casually: “Oh, you mean that, I was playing mahjong with my mother and Jian Jian, and we were short of one person, so I thought of asking my father to come over.”
The Sixth Prince: “…”
The Sixth Prince never expected this to happen.
“Eh? Sixth brother, why do you look so ugly all of a sudden?”
So while I was working so hard, they were playing cards in Qiuwu Palace, right?
The Sixth Prince opened his mouth and finally uttered two words: “Haha.”
Then the Sixth Prince refused to speak again.
After about half an hour, the carriage arrived at the gate of Prince Rui’s Palace.
As luck would have it, the Sixth Prince happened to run into Ye Xun who was returning from burning incense for the Crown Prince, and the uncle and nephew were inevitably a little awkward for a moment.
Ever since the death of the crown prince, Ye Xun has not left his house and has basically never had any dealings with his uncles again.
As for the Sixth Prince, he was also one of the driving forces behind the Crown Prince’s suicide. When facing the Crown Prince’s legitimate son, he inevitably felt a little uncomfortable.
But the Sixth Prince had experienced a lot of ups and downs, so he would not show it at all.
Neither of them intended to say much, they just greeted each other briefly and left.
When he reached the corner, looking at his back, Ye Xun subconsciously thought, what is the Sixth Uncle doing here? And his face seemed to be a little pale…
Before Ye Xun could think about it, the Sixth Prince walked into Ye Shuo’s yard.
After a while, Yao Zhi also came here.
Even though Ye Shuo said that Yao Zhi might not necessarily help, it was Ye Shuo who asked after all, so how could Yao Zhi refuse?
It’s not a big deal after all.
However, after Yao Zhi asked about the Sixth Prince’s symptoms and took his pulse, her brows subconsciously frowned.
She remembered that the man in front of her was only a few years older than Ye Shuo, right? He was in his prime, but his body was quite weak.
It seems to be caused by long-term fatigue, excessive thinking and lack of rest.
But fortunately, he is still young. If he takes good care of himself for two or three years, he should be able to make up for most of it.
Yao Zhi thought so and said so.
However, what the Sixth Prince lacks now is just these two or three years. He couldn’t help but look at his younger brother.
What else could Ye Shuo do? He couldn’t force the Sixth Prince to sleep. If he did that, the Sixth Prince would not only not be grateful to him, but would probably hate him to death.
That is Xiao Ming’s lifelong desire and dream…
Ye Shuo pulled the corner of his mouth and asked in a low voice: “Um… can you find a way to replenish him on the basis of maintaining the current situation?”
Maintaining the status quo means… doesn’t it mean that we have to endure like we are now? ?
The Fourth Prince was like this in the beginning, and the Sixth Prince is still like this now.
Yao Zhi was stunned for a moment, then she reacted and her anger suddenly rose.

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Exposed
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
No matter which doctor it is, wouldn’t he get angry when he meets such a patient?
Seeing this, Ye Shuo knew that he had said the wrong thing, but there was nothing he could do, he had to bite the bullet and continue talking.
“Miss Yao…”
“Okay, stop talking. Tell him to talk to me.”
Yao Zhi turned around and looked at the Sixth Prince standing beside her: “If you keep going like this, you’ll end up killing yourself sooner or later, don’t you know?”
As a doctor, Yao Zhi has an obligation to tell patients the truth.
“Even if that’s the case, it doesn’t matter?”
If an ordinary imperial physician dared to speak to him like this, the Sixth Prince would definitely not be so nice.
But there is no choice, who can blame the girl in front of him for her special identity?The Sixth Prince couldn’t afford to argue with the girl his younger brother liked.
What’s more, now I am the one who needs help from others.
For some reason, under the gaze of the girl in front of him, the Sixth Prince suddenly felt a lot of pressure.
The Sixth Prince sweated, but finally, he nodded.
Now, what else could Yao Zhi do? Faced with such a situation, no matter how skilled she was in medicine, she would be helpless.
All Yao Zhi could do was to try her best under limited conditions.
I just hope that the Sixth Prince can turn back in time, maybe there is still room for manoeuvre. Maybe when he sits on the throne one day, maybe the situation will get better…
In the end, Yao Zhi prescribed two prescriptions for him.
“Once at 7 pm, once at 9 pm, remember to take it on time.” Since he refused to go to bed on time, he wouldn’t forget to take the medicine, right?
Upon hearing this, the Sixth Prince heaved a sigh of relief and naturally did not respond.
After he left, Yao Zhi closed the door, then looked at Ye Shuo beside her, took a deep breath, and said stiffly: “This is just the first time, it won’t happen again.”
She didn’t want to treat these disobedient brothers around him anymore! It was simply a torture.
Ye Shuo nodded without hesitation, like a chick pecking at rice.
“I’ll do whatever you say.”
Yao Zhi originally wanted to keep a stern face so that he wouldn’t forget his lesson. However, seeing that he was so obedient, she couldn’t help but burst out laughing.
“You are a good coaxer.”
He said nice things, but he turned back to his true form after a while. Yao Zhi now saw through him.
But Yao Zhi didn’t hate it at all. Instead, she felt happy.
No matter what he does, he is always cuter than others.
“By the way, I don’t care what other people do, but you can’t learn from them.”
Yao Zhi didn’t want to see him become like this.
No matter what, he has to be fine.
“Of course!” Ye Shuo said without even thinking about it.
“I’m different from them. I like to play and I don’t have any special abilities. The burden of our family will never be entrusted to me.”
In this situation, Ye Shuo can do whatever he wants and however he wants, so why would he tire himself out? He just needs to get enough sleep every day.
“In my lifetime, I will just be a rich and idle king.”
When the young man said this, his expression was full of carefreeness.
Yao Zhi has recently seen too many of the royal descendants’ endless ambitions, but he is the only one who is always so clear and refreshing.
Who wouldn’t be moved by such a person?
Being looked at by her like this, Ye Shuo felt inexplicably hot on the face for some reason.
Then, he once again remembered what his cheap father had said before.
If you really like it, he will fulfil your wish.
Ye Shuo had imagined countless times what his future partner would look like, and now, he finally had an accurate answer.
It’s not a matter of being passionate or lasting until death. It’s enough that she can trust him and he can trust her.
Ye Shuo’s mind got heated, and he blurted out: “Are you willing to spend your whole life with me like this?”
When Yao Zhi’s eyes met the young man in front of her, her heart couldn’t help but beat twice.
With a loud “bang”, Yao Zhi’s head exploded.
“Are you willing to spend your whole life with me?”
lifetime……
Lifetime…
Lifetime……
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and tried to suppress the nervousness in his heart: “If you are willing, I will treat you well for the rest of my life.”
Hey, wait.
It seems like every scumbag has said this.
Just as Ye Shuo was about to make amends, he heard Yao Zhi hesitantly speak: “Do you… want to marry me?”
Seeing that the girl in red seemed a little flustered, he was afraid of scaring her, or scaring her away again if he did it too suddenly, so he hummed softly: “Hmm…”
“right!”
“So…are you willing?”
Facing the young man’s sincere eyes, Yao Zhi also suppressed her embarrassment and helplessness, and said stutteringly: “Please let me think about it…”
“Okay, okay…”
“You must, must, think carefully!”
Later on, Yao Zhi couldn’t even hear what he was saying. After Ye Shuo left his yard, looking back every few steps, the red-dressed girl’s face suddenly turned redder than her clothes.
In the past, Yao Zhi was always carefree. When she had no idea what love was, she felt that the world was so big that she could roam freely.
Now I even have the urge to confine myself to a prison.
However, despite being impulsive, by the time Yao Zhi came to her senses, she still couldn’t stop feeling uneasy.
She subconsciously took out something and told herself a fortune.
This usually happens when she doesn’t know what to do. Most of her problems can be answered by the hexagrams.
But this time she was confused, so the hexagram naturally became scattered and couldn’t be put together.
In the end, Yao Zhi picked up the scattered copper coins again.
Yao Zhi sat down on the ground, her knees against her chest, her hands around her legs, looking extremely distressed.
Obviously, Yao Zhi didn’t know what to do. It would have been great if the masters were here at this time.
Yao Zhi’s mind was a mess. She was happy, worried, and even more anxious about gains and losses.
What makes me happy is that the young man also has feelings for me and wants to spend his whole life with me.
My worry is that after getting married, I’m afraid I won’t be as free as before.
What I am worried about is whether he will remain consistent in the next few decades as he is today.
But, I really like him, I really like him, I really like him…
As we spend more time together, all kinds of little things accumulate and I like him more and more.
He was gentle and good-tempered, not only towards himself, but also towards others, even the servants in his house. He would never lose his temper easily, and would never beat or scold them. He was very different from the powerful people in her memory who seemed to need to torture their subordinates to show off their status.
He is gentle but not weak. If his servants make mistakes, he will use thunderous methods and never show mercy.
He values ​​friendship, whether it is to his father, brother, or nephew.
He has a strong sense of responsibility. Although he looks like a dandy and carefree person on weekdays, he is more reliable than anyone else at critical moments.
But youth also has a vulnerable side.
Yao Zhi will probably never forget the way the light in the prince’s eyes suddenly shattered when he committed suicide.
Whenever she thought of it, Yao Zhi felt so heartbroken that she wished she could remove all the suffering from him.
Now, even if the young man said nothing and just stood there, Yao Zhi’s heart trembled and she became more reluctant to let go.
As she thought about it, suddenly, Yao Zhi felt a surge of courage to risk everything.
If it’s him, then I’m willing to take this gamble.
Bet he won’t let me down.
Just like that, Yao Zhi relied on this momentum, stood up, and walked quickly towards Ye Shuo’s yard.
The flaming red skirt drew a dazzling arc in the air, like a rolling wave, ready to burn everything in sight.
Compared to her at that time, Ye Shuo was not much better.
In his two lifetimes combined, this was the first time he proposed to a woman.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but start pacing on the spot, turning around and around in the room, until he even made the small paths around him dizzy.
Ye Shuo’s infectiousness was so strong that Xiao Luzi’s heartstrings tensed up for some unknown reason.
Xiao Luzi couldn’t help but comfort him, “Your Highness, don’t worry. With your status, Miss Yao will definitely agree.”
“…It would be great if that were the case.” Ye Shuo smiled bitterly.
If this was true, Yao Zhi would not have kept her distance from him when she learned that he was a prince.
This identity is not a help to him, but a constraint.
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, he suddenly heard some noise outside.
The moment he saw Yao Zhi, Xiao Luzi next to him tactfully went out. In addition, he also stopped the servants who were about to come in outside the door.
Are you kidding? Whether the palace can have a young mistress depends on this one time. How can I let this group of people destroy it?
Yao Zhi hesitated for a moment, but finally stepped over the threshold.
Seeing the young man’s slightly tense expression, Yao Zhi’s originally wandering gaze suddenly fixed.
This is a different time, and she must not let go of such a good man no matter what! He is so good, no one else in the world can compare to him. If she misses him, she will never meet another one in her life.
so…
“I do.” Yao Zhi heard herself say this.
Then, Yao Zhi fell into the young man’s arms.
Yao Zhi’s face was pressed against Ye Shuo’s chest. At this angle, she could not see the young man’s expression at all and could only hear his voice.
“If that’s the case, then you can’t escape.”
“I have to tell you, since you promised me, you can’t go back on your word.”
And Ye Shuo would not give her a chance to regret.
The moment the words came out of his mouth, Yao Zhi’s nervousness about marrying him disappeared, but she became even more panicked.
Because Yao Zhi found that she couldn’t break away from him!!!
His eyes changed several times, and Ye Shuo couldn’t help but bend down and whispered in her ear: “Oh, I forgot to tell you, although I am close to my third brother, I am not my third brother after all.”
“I have never been a gentleman.”

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Meeting
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
The prince is dignified and reserved, while Ye Shuo is arrogant, reckless and unrestrained.
Yao Zhi was obviously panicking.
“What do you mean?”
“Cough, nothing.” After a clear cough, Ye Shuo returned to normal almost instantly.
After all, she had just nodded. It would be bad if I wasn’t careful and scared her away again.
Quickly suppressing the uncontrollable possessive desire that was emerging in his heart, Ye Shuo closed his eyes and slowly loosened his hand.
When Yao Zhi saw his face again, Ye Shuo had that familiar, harmless look again.
Since Ye Shuo was born as a human being, he would naturally have human reactions. When he was excited, he could not control his emotions for a while.
Especially since Yao Zhi’s heartbeat was accelerating and her cheeks were red, Ye Shuo wanted to bully her, as well as her plump lips with teeth marks…But not now, it would scare her.
Yao Zhi, who was standing by, watched his eyes change from dark to light, and finally to a familiar smile. She was terrified.
I always feel like he has become a different person just now.
However, before Yao Zhi could think about it, Ye Shuo said, “I will go and tell my father to start preparing for it.”
After saying that, Ye Shuo ran out happily, and it was too late for Yao Zhi to stop him.
After a moment, Yao Zhi couldn’t help it and stomped her feet hard.
“What are you in such a hurry for?”
But in the end, Yao Zhi laughed uncontrollably.
Yao Zhi is not a person who likes to drag things out. Since she has promised him, she will not go back on her word.
Although she was still feeling a little embarrassed and shy, Yao Zhi still walked out confidently in front of everyone.
When Ye Shuo returned to the palace, he found Emperor Jingwen fishing in the imperial garden.
In the past, at this time he was either reviewing memorials or meeting with ministers, but now he has basically left those tasks to others.
My cheap dad has changed a lot compared to before.
Perhaps because he knew that he did not have much time left, after experiencing a struggle of pain and despair, Emperor Jingwen gradually became calmer than ever before.
However, just as the fish was hooked and he hadn’t even pulled it up, someone grabbed his arm. Then he heard the familiar voice of his youngest son.
He seemed particularly excited today.
“Dad! Tell the people in the Ministry of Internal Affairs to prepare a wedding ceremony for me right away!”
Emperor Jingwen’s hand trembled, and the fish on the hook broke free instantly, then shook its tail and disappeared completely.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
This was the first fish he caught today.
Emperor Jingwen resisted the urge to curse, put down the fishing rod in his hand, and then turned to look at him: “You didn’t answer me at that time, I thought you were unhappy.”
“Yes, yes. How could I not be willing? But this is such a big deal, shouldn’t I think about it carefully?”
The main thing is that Yao Zhi might not agree at that time…
Emperor Jingwen always felt that it was not what he said, but he did not care and just asked: “Have you thought it through now?”
Ye Shuo nodded affirmatively: “Of course.”
“So Dad, please inform them as soon as possible.”
Perhaps it was because of the nephew’s reluctance to marry that people found it surprising. Prince Su at the side couldn’t help but put down the fishing rod in his hand and looked at the father and son with interest.
At this moment, Emperor Jingwen felt that his old face was about to be completely lost by his youngest son.
“Why are you in such a hurry? Can’t you see that your uncle and I are fishing here? It won’t be too late until the evening.”
As a man, how could he be so impatient?
Ye Shuo was thinking, what’s so good about catching these goldfish in the imperial garden? They have been fed silly by people every day, and they can’t wait to eat a handful of fish so that they jump onto the shore one by one.
These fish will not run away, but the girls in his palace may not be so lucky.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t dare to refute his cheap father at this time, otherwise, what if he changed his mind?
Ye Shuo had no choice but to move a stool and sit aside to watch the two of them fishing.
It is true that a son is no longer under the control of his father.
Unable to bear the pitiful look in his son’s eyes, Emperor Jingwen sighed. Prince Su was there too. After thinking for a while, Emperor Jingwen said, “I remember that there are many sons but few daughters in your palace. You always hoped to have a princess with Princess Su, but Iyouhave not been able to do so for so many years.”
Prince Su and Emperor Jingwen had been brothers for so many years, how could he not understand what he meant?
Although Prince Su’s mansion had no legitimate daughter, it had many concubine born daughters, so how could it lack daughters?
It was true that the emperor agreed to his nephew marrying a woman from the underworld, but he still had to raise her status a little, otherwise he would not be able to explain to the royal family.
It’s just one more daughter, it doesn’t matter.
So Prince Su said, “Even if my Royal Brother doesn’t want to talk about it, I will still mention it. The girl who saved my Royal Brother’s and several of my nephews’ lives must be a person of good character. I have discussed this with the Princess and wanted to adopt her as my adopted daughter. What do you think, my Royal Brother?”
Prince Su has become more and more reasonable in recent years.
This was exactly what Emperor Jingwen had in mind, so he naturally would not refuse. By the way, on the pretext of saving his life, Emperor Jingwen also conferred the title of county lord on Yao Zhi.
With such an identity, I believe those people should be able to shut up.
Yaoren Valley is too far away, and it is not good to ask a girl to marry from such a far place. Emperor Jingwen even specially granted a house so that when Huo Tianyi and his people came, they would have a place to live.
Emperor Jingwen took almost every aspect into consideration for Ye Shuo.
He didn’t have anything to do now anyway, so naturally he spent more time on this.
Back then, even the Crown Prince didn’t go through so much trouble to marry a Crown Princess. It seems that my brother is afraid that his son will suffer any injustice.
Prince Su, who had never seen this side of his brother before, couldn’t help but smack his lips.
This was indeed the case. Emperor Jingwen was not stupid. How could he not know that his youngest son would be slandered and ridiculed by many people after marrying a woman from the underworld? Only when he personally took charge would those people not dare to talk about them behind their backs.
It’s all the youngest son’s fault, he’s determined to marry that girl.
He is young and doesn’t know the seriousness of the matter, so I have to worry more about him.
Although Emperor Jingwen did not even help to draft the wedding ceremony, he asked Wang Ziquan to help oversee it, which was almost the same as if he were supervising it personally.
My royal brother has finally shown a kind fatherly heart.
Looking at his nephew who kept calling him “Dad” left and right, Prince Su laughed.
This child is not good at anything except sweet talk. Now that the crown prince is gone, it is a blessing to have a ninth prince to accompany his brother.
This kid is very brave and dares to say anything. They can never do or say what he does. Fortunately, my brother is not alone.
By the evening, Emperor Jingwen felt tired, and Ye Shuo hurriedly reached out to support him and led him back to his bedroom to rest.
The setting sun cast a layer of afterglow on the clouds, and the entire gravel road was dyed with a layer of warm colour by the setting sun, stretching the backs of the father and son very long. For a moment, time seemed to freeze.
But in the end, it is just an illusion. No matter what people do, they cannot keep time.
About half an incense stick later, the two figures disappeared, and Prince Su looked at the attendant beside him.
“Pack up, it’s time for us to go back.”
It is one idea to have Prince Su as the brother of Emperor Jingwen, but it is naturally another idea to have the Sixth Prince and others as his sons.
Although they have long been accustomed to their father’s preference for Xiaojiu over the years, every time something happens, their father can still enhance their understanding.
Even in an ordinary family, there is no father who would take care of everything for his son, no matter how big or small, right?
If Xiaojiu gave birth to a child, he would have to take the child to the palace to raise him. After all, in his father’s eyes, how could Xiaojiu raise a child?
But if you think about it carefully, it is indeed true. With his way of raising a child, it would be fine for a child of a few years old, but if it was only a baby of a few months old, he would probably kill it.
But while they were envious, the brothers couldn’t help but completely let down their guard against him.
Marrying a chivalrous woman sounded inappropriate. The Fifth Prince and his companions had never even thought about it. However, Xiao Jiu not only thought about it, he also did it.
Did he really have no desire for that position?
There was actually such a weirdo among the princes.
The fifth prince felt that he might never understand what was going on in his brother’s head. The most important thing was that his father actually agreed.
For a moment, the Fifth Prince and his brothers could not tell whether their father wanted him to get better or not.
But even if the emperor agrees, the imperial concubine won’t be happy, right?
The Imperial Concubine’s temperament might be similar to that of the girl surnamed Yao, but their backgrounds were too different. The Imperial Concubine used to look down on everyone. She even looked down on the Queen. How could she really like a Jianghu girl?
With the Imperial Concubine’s temperament, she would probably make a scene.
Let’s see if Xiaojiu can still relax this time.
Just as the Fifth Prince and the other brothers thought, after learning the news, the Imperial Concubine quickly summoned Yao Zhi into the palace.
Seeing that the matter was about to be settled, how could the imperial concubine not meet her in advance?
After the nanny who delivered the message left, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel a little nervous.
She didn’t think she was inferior to Ye Shuo. It was just that since she liked Ye Shuo, it was natural for her to hope that Ye Shuo’s mother would like her.
The next day, the Sixth Prince thought about it and finally asked his princess consort to go to Qiuwu Palace to take a look under the pretext of paying respects. In case a conflict really occurred, the princess consort could be there to mediate.
When the Imperial Concubine saw Yao Zhi, her first words stunned the Sixth Prince’s wife.
I only heard the Imperial Concubine ask: “Can you tell me why you like my son?”
Huh? This tone doesn’t sound like dissatisfaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Anger
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo has so many good qualities that I don’t know where to start.
Yao Zhi spoke without hesitation: “He is kind, loyal, and responsible…”
Yao Zhi listed a string of advantages rapidly, which stunned the imperial concubine beside her.
Then, Yao Zhi’s expression became a little embarrassed, not knowing what she thought of: “Also, he looks good…”
So among the advantages, the Imperial Concubine probably identified most deeply with the last one. After all, he was her own son, who inherited the advantages of both her and the Emperor, so naturally he looked good.
But he is kind, loyal, and responsible…
Is she talking about her own son who would rather sit than stand, would rather lie down than sit, and would always want others to take care of everything for him whenever he encounters any problem? ?
This girl was indeed deceived by Xiaojiu.
The imperial concubine’s heart suddenly skipped a beat.The imperial concubine held it in for a while, but couldn’t hold it in any longer, so she asked tentatively: “Don’t you think he’s a troublesome person?”
Only because I am his biological mother and he is the child I gave birth to after ten months of pregnancy, I am so patient. If it were someone else, it would be strange that they would spoil him like this.
Yao Zhi was stunned when she heard this: “No, why would he cause trouble? He has such a good temper.”
“Prince Rui is a very gentle person.” Gentle and good-tempered. Thinking of this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but blush.
So, good temper.
A very gentle person.
Even if the Imperial Concubine was going against her conscience, she couldn’t say that her son had a good temper. After all, everyone in the palace knew that the Ninth Prince was born with a bad temper. He had never listened to the Emperor since he was a child, and his temper couldn’t be worse.
Speaking of gentleness…
If his brothers heard this, they would probably roll their eyes at him. He bullied this one and provoked that one every day. How could he be gentle?
Now that the Sixth Prince’s wife was present, the Imperial Concubine felt even more uncomfortable when she heard this.
Normally, she could praise herself as much as she wanted behind closed doors, but if she was outside… the Imperial Concubine would always have some sense of shame.
“Don’t be shy, come sit inside the palace.” The Imperial Concubine couldn’t stand it any longer, so she called her into the house and signalled Su Yue with her eyes to send away all the palace maids around her to avoid being laughed at by others.
However, to outsiders, this scene seemed like the Imperial Noble Consort was having a very pleasant conversation with the future Princess Rui, and she even took the initiative to hold the hand of the future Princess Rui, looking very intimate.
The scene that everyone expected did not seem to happen.
The Imperial Concubine is not a two-faced person. If she really has something on her mind, she will express it on the spot. She would not be like this now, unless she is really satisfied with the future Princess Rui.
The Sixth Prince’s wife next to her was startled, and then burst into laughter. It seemed that she had made a wasted trip today.
“My dear mother, I remember that today is the day for checking the accounts at our residence, so I will take my leave now.”
Presumably, the Imperial Mother still had many things to explain. After paying her respects, the Sixth Prince’s wife did not stay long and prepared to leave by making an excuse.
The Imperial Concubine did not try to persuade her to stay, as she had a lot of questions to ask.
As early as just now, when she came in, Yao Zhi discovered that Ye Shuo’s mother was also a stunning beauty. Although she was a little older, she still had unparalleled beauty. What’s more, because she was not as young as she was before, she had added a touch of charm that was unique to women and that only time could give her.
The Imperial Concubine is like a peony, extremely beautiful and gorgeous, and unparalleled in wealth and honour.
When she took her hand, Yao Zhi realised that the imperial concubine’s hands were extremely soft, like the finest mutton fat. Compared with her own, Yao Zhi felt ashamed.
How come they all look so good? Even the details like fingers and hair are beautiful.
The Imperial Concubine also felt the calluses on Yao Zhi’s palms caused by years of sword practice. The Imperial Concubine had seen her father and brother practising martial arts at home, and Jian Jian also practised martial arts, so the Imperial Concubine naturally knew the hardships involved.
It is not easy for women to surpass men in this regard, let alone reach the top level in the world.
In the end, such a girl ended up in the royal family.
The imperial concubine couldn’t help but curse her son in her heart, what a sin!
To be honest, the girl in front of her was not the most beautiful, but she was very smart. When she thought that her brilliance would be dimmed because of her identity as a princess, the imperial concubine couldn’t help but feel regretful.
It turns out that all men in the world are the same. They like to catch birds in the sky and put them in cages, but they don’t care about those that are already in cages.
What a bastard!
This made the imperial concubine think of herself.
The Imperial Concubine felt more and more guilty. After Yao Zhi sat down, she hurriedly asked, “My dear girl, I heard that my bastard son often loses his temper with you. Does he make you angry?”
Yao Zhi was stunned: “How could it be?”
“King Rui… treats me very well.”
If she hadn’t known about it before, the Imperial Noble Consort might have really believed it. But this was said by Emperor Jingwen.
Emperor Jingwen said that he had seen with his own eyes that his son had given the girl the cold shoulder for no apparent reason, and the girl had to try to coax him in return, which was really aggrieved.
The Imperial Concubine then said, “Don’t lie to me. I know everything.”
Yao Zhi then remembered that this was the case.
But how could she let herself be angry? On the contrary, seeing him jealous, Yao Zhi felt as sweet as if her heart was filled with honey.
Recalling the young man’s face full of resentment, his pair of beautiful phoenix eyes staring at her, and cursing her non-stop, Yao Zhi’s face suddenly tingled and even steam came out of her face.
“I, I like him like that…”
Yao Zhi was quite anxious, but the Imperial Concubine next to her was very disappointed.
It’s over, it’s all true.
The last bit of hope in the imperial concubine’s heart disappeared.
My son has been completely spoiled by me.
“Why do you like him? If he gets angry at you, just scold him!” Putting herself in the imperial concubine’s shoes, the anger in her heart suddenly emerged.
“If it doesn’t work, don’t you know Kung Fu? Go ahead and hit him. He can’t beat you.”
“How, how can this be possible?” Yao Zhi hurriedly shook her head.
“He’s afraid of  pain. What if I hurt him? I can’t do it.”
Besides, being in such an environment and having to go through so many things, he was already pitiful enough, how could Yao Zhi bear it?
The moment the voice fell, noticing the pity in Yao Zhi’s eyes, when the imperial concubine looked at the girl in front of her again, she suddenly felt a little disappointed.
“But if you don’t straighten him out in time, you’ll be the one who suffers when you get married in the future!”
To be honest, as a mother, she naturally hopes that her daughter-in-law will be obedient and devoted to her son.
But there is a connection between these two. The imperial concubine also hopes that her son can grow up to be a truly responsible man.
His own son is bullying the girl too much!
Yao Zhi was a little confused when she heard this: “How can it be hard to be with him?”
Yao Zhi thought about it and found that apart from her status, she didn’t find any grievance.
But her birth was not something she could decide, and she had tried very hard not to make herself feel embarrassed.
Yao Zhi is not a fool. She is clean and tidy, and no one gossips about her. The servants in the palace treat her respectfully. How could she not know why?
The imperial noble concubine was shocked: “He asked you to climb up the cliffs to pick fruits and go to the river to catch fish. If he thinks you are not doing well enough, he will scold you. Isn’t this hard work?”
“He didn’t scold me.” Yao Zhi always felt that something was wrong, but she really couldn’t put her finger on it.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but correct him: “He’s just angry with himself.”
After thinking for a while, Yao Zhi added: “And the reason why he did this is also for my own good.”
After hearing this, the imperial concubine almost fainted.
“Silly girl, what a silly girl.”
“If he really wants you to protect him, would he let you protect him? It should be him who protects you!”
“Could it be that you can protect him like this for the rest of your life?”
If it were him, and if he never changed his mind, it wouldn’t be impossible for him to do it for his whole life.
What’s more, it seems that I haven’t done anything.
Yao Zhi has always played the role of a protector in the martial arts world, so these things are really commonplace for her.
As for the Imperial Noble Consort, except when she married the Emperor, she was the one being protected the rest of the time, so she could not understand it no matter what.
How could he have the heart to deceive a girl into this state?
This child has grown completely crooked!
Jian Jian, who was standing by, had been listening for a long time, but now she couldn’t bear to listen any longer: “You must have been deceived by my brother.”
The Imperial Concubine took a deep breath and suddenly looked at Su Yue who was standing beside her: “Where is the Ninth Prince? Tell him to come over here!”
He didn’t even accompany Miss Yao on such a big occasion as her first visit to the palace. This is simply outrageous!
Su Yue pulled the corner of her mouth, was silent for a moment, and said: “To answer your Majesty, the Ninth Prince… is now fishing with His Majesty.”
The Imperial Concubine was already angry, and this stirred up a hornet’s nest.
“Go and invite him now, right now!”
It’s over, it’s over. The Imperial Concubine is completely furious this time. I hope the Ninth Prince will just take care of himself.
Su Yue hurriedly bowed and said, “I’ll go right away.”
The other side.
Looking at his calm little son, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel confused: “Isn’t today the day when Miss Yao enters the palace? Why don’t you go and take a look?”
Ye Shuo yawned and said lazily, “What’s there to see? Don’t worry, Dad. Mother and the others can handle any problem themselves.”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
At the beginning, I was still there for him, but in the end, my youngest son is not even as good as me.
After a while, Emperor Jingwen saw the maidservant beside the Imperial Noble Concubine coming over with some people.
Seeing that His Majesty was also there, Su Yue hurriedly paid her respects. After being called by Emperor Jingwen, Su Yue looked at the Ninth Prince who was standing beside her and said, “Your Highness, the Queen is calling you.”
Emperor Jingwen knew immediately that his son would probably get into trouble this time.
Emperor Jingwen originally wanted to go and take a look, but thinking about the possibility of being injured by mistake, he decided not to do so.
Ye Shuo touched his chin and put down the fishing rod.
“Let’s go.”
Sure enough, as soon as Ye Shuo stepped into the gate of Qiuwu Palace, a teacup lid flew towards him.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to hide, but when he saw Yao Zhi next to him move, he did not move.
Yao Zhi almost subconsciously stopped the cup that was thrown at him.
Ye Shuo blinked and looked at his mother, seemingly innocent: “Mom, what did your son do wrong? Why did you hit me?”
Seeing the young man’s aggrieved face, Yao Zhi subconsciously shouted, “My Lady!”
The imperial concubine’s breath was suddenly stuck in her throat, unable to breathe out or swallow.
He still has the nerve to complain. How can he have the nerve to do that?
“Get over here!”
After all, the Imperial Concubine is Ye Shuo’s biological mother, and Ye Shuo dare not disobey her. So under Yao Zhi’s nervous gaze, Ye Shuo came to his mother.
The son who used to be so caring to me now seemed so unbearable to me.
The Imperial Concubine looked at the worried Yao Zhi, took a deep breath, grabbed her son’s ear, and said with almost gritted teeth: “I don’t care what happened in the past, but if you bully her again in the future, watch out for your skin!”
God have mercy on her, how could there be such a pitiful and silly girl!
Did his mother… agree?
Seeing that Ye Shuo was in a daze, the Imperial Concubine thought that he was unwilling, so she used more force on her hands, and Ye Shuo screamed in pain.
“Son knows, son knows, son will treat her well, mother, please let me go!”
Only after the Imperial Concubine had vented her anger did she let him go.
In this way, their marriage was settled.
The Imperial Concubine’s unexpected reaction, even the fact that she gave a lecture to her own son whom she protected like the apple of her eye because of that chivalrous woman, shocked everyone in the harem.
Because of the attitudes of the Emperor and the Imperial Concubine, no one dared to say anything this time.
The messenger travelled day and night, and within a few days, it brought the news to the Medicine Valley.
After obtaining the “consent” of everyone in Yao Ren Valley, the Ministry of Internal Affairs began to prepare for the marriage of His Royal Highness Prince Rui.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Dowry
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
When a prince gets married, he must go through all the three ceremonies and six betrothal gifts.
But due to the recent tense war situation and the lack of funds in the national treasury, it is estimated that it cannot be done according to Ye Shuo’s usual standards.
When the Ninth Prince left the palace to build his mansion, it cost millions, not including some of the decorations. If the wedding ceremony also follows such standards, it will probably cause dissatisfaction among the soldiers on the border.
When the Sixth Prince wrote this letter, he broke out in a cold sweat. After all, his father doted on Xiaojiu so much, and he naturally hoped that Xiaojiu’s wedding ceremony could be more grand.
But there are some things the Sixth Prince can give in to, and some things he cannot give in to.
Even for the sake of that position, the Sixth Prince could not simply obey.
However, what the Sixth Prince did not know was that when Emperor Jingwen saw this, instead of being dissatisfied, he nodded in his heart.
Between state affairs and his youngest son’s marriage, the former is naturally more important. What he wants is an heir to the Great Zhou, not a yes-man who only knows how to please.
Under such circumstances, the Sixth Prince still insisted on his own ideas. He was…very good.Seeing that Emperor Jingwen just glanced at him and nodded, with no intention of making things difficult for him, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Then it was the Imperial Noble Consort and Xiaojiu.
The Duke of Zhen was a military commander himself, and the Imperial Concubine naturally knew how hard it was to fight in a war. When the war was intense, the soldiers outside didn’t even have food to eat. So although she also wanted to make her son’s wedding a grand one, she thought it was better to give up at this juncture.
At worst, I can just give more subsidies on my side.
Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had no objections at all. National affairs came first, and that was the way it should be.
It’s just that the wedding was to be kept simple, but the betrothal gift could not be reduced. This was a once-in-two-lifetime event, and Ye Shuo didn’t want to let her down.
In addition to the items purchased by the Ministry of Internal Affairs and various purchases by his mother and stepfather, Ye Shuo also added a lot of his own.
Everyone knew that he made a fortune in Liangzhou during those two years, so no one suspected anything.
So the result was that when the list of betrothal gifts was brought out, everyone was shocked.
Whether someone takes it to heart or not, whether they care or not, can probably be seen from these things. Now, those who were still having doubts in their hearts completely shut up.
I just don’t know whether this woman from the martial arts world can accept such a valuable gift from the royal family.
In the entire Great Zhou Dynasty, although no one could match the royal family, they couldn’t be too far behind, right? Otherwise, wouldn’t it be a joke?
Although the Ninth Prince didn’t have a good reputation and was destined not to sit in that position, he was a real prince after all, one of the most powerful people in the entire Great Zhou Dynasty. Just because of his identity and status, countless powerful families wanted to marry their daughters to him as a principal wife.
Even if he couldn’t reach the top, so what? He would still have the same benefits. The splendour of a superclass prince was enough for most officials to enjoy endlessly.
But in the past, everyone wanted to bet on the most promising person, but they were also afraid that they would be implicated because of the Duke of Zhen’s family. As a result, after just a moment of hesitation, the Ninth Prince, who was of marriageable age, fled from Shangjing City overnight.
Who knew that after all the twists and turns, the Duke of Zhen’s family, who they thought were doomed, did not fall, but the Queen’s family fell first.
When the Ninth Prince came back, he was already twenty years old, and he also brought back a girl he liked, which made everyone’s new idea come to nothing again.
The Ninth Prince’s action was truly heretical. Of course, despite this, many people still held on to a glimmer of hope, thinking that a woman from the martial arts world would never be able to enter the royal family’s gate, and her status was not even high enough to be a concubine. No matter how much the Ninth Prince insisted, it would be the best that the Emperor could give her the position of a concubine.
She’s just a concubine, so just give it to her. As long as the position of the principal wife is vacant, their daughter still has hope.
Who would have thought that man proposes, God disposes. The emperor suffered a series of blows and his health was not as good as before. Suddenly, he became more open-minded about everything. Now he only has the heart of a loving father. Then, after being coaxed by the Ninth Prince, he actually agreed to such an absurd request.
A woman of humble origin actually became the princess of a noble prince.
It was at this time that everyone suddenly realised that the Ninth Prince, who was known for his playboy status, was the most suitable marriage candidate.
Although the Ninth Prince has little ambition, his status is very high. Even if a new emperor ascends the throne in the future, his glory will not be diminished in the slightest.
If the Sixth Prince can really ascend the throne smoothly in the future, relying on the friendship nurtured by the Imperial Noble Consort for many years, the Sixth Prince and the Ninth Prince lived under the same roof for a full ten years. Such an experience is unmatched by other princes.
Looking at the Ninth Prince’s backyard again, everyone only now realised that from beginning to end, there had not been a single woman in the Ninth Prince’s backyard. It could be said that it was as clean as it could not be.
Not to mention the prince, even if it is an ordinary man, how many of them would argue for the girl they love when they know it is impossible, and insist on having her even if it will make their father and mother dissatisfied?
This kind of thought alone is enough to make women all over the world envious.
The dude in everyone’s eyes turned out to be such a devoted person.
All the men in the world were laughing at him for wasting his status as a prince. If it were them, they would definitely have beautiful wives and concubines and spend every night having fun.
Women all over the world are envious. If there is a man who treats them like this, let alone if he is a prince, even if he is a commoner, they will be willing.
It’s just that most men in the world are fickle. Even if a woman is a bachelorette, they will not be satisfied with one woman.
Therefore, very few people, regardless of gender, age or status, are optimistic about the Ninth Prince and his wife.
Given that they are not a good match and have such a huge disparity in status, it is inevitable that the two will become enemies; it is just a matter of time.
The Ninth Prince’s backyard was only temporarily clean. Some families with a good family tradition did not have concubines before marrying a wife. After marrying a wife, within two years, the backyard would be full.
Since their marriage has now been settled, Yao Zhi naturally can no longer live in Ye Shuo’s house.
Princess Su quickly sent someone to pick her up.
It’s hard to say whether she’s happy or not, but it’s a task entrusted by the Emperor, and Princess Su just needs to do her best.
At the beginning, Princess Su thought that Yao Zhi, as a woman from the martial arts world, must be vulgar, or perhaps it was because of this that she was able to catch the eye of the Ninth Prince.
Unexpectedly, after a few days of contact, Princess Su found that the girl in front of her was not as crude as she had imagined. Yao Zhi, who grew up in a wild way, was definitely not proficient in etiquette, but she was generous and natural in dealing with people.
She is a very confident girl, confident but not arrogant. She will not belittle herself because of her status, nor will she be timid because of the eyes of others.
It can be seen that this is a very determined person.
Yao Zhi is no longer a child, and has seen many ups and downs in the martial arts world. She knows how to advance and retreat better than ordinary women.
She would respond with the same politeness to those who were polite to her, and she would never tolerate those who spoke harshly to her.
The fact that she has her own principles alone is enough to make her superior to most people.
Sometimes, a weak character is more terrifying than a humble origin. People who can be shaken by just a few words from others will not only live a tiring life themselves, but also make the people around them live a tiring life.
Having judgement is not a skill that everyone possesses.
Princess Su had a favourable impression of the girl in front of her, but…
Seeing her look full of anticipation for her upcoming wedding in a few months, Princess Su couldn’t help but sigh deeply.
No matter how determined a girl is, she still cannot escape the word love!
Princess Su was also young once. When she was young, she also dreamed of being together for the rest of her life, but in the end, all she got was sadness.
Prince Su treated her very well, respected his wife, and never embarrassed her in front of the concubines, but in the end, he couldn’t have only her.
The Ninth Prince is an impatient and playful person. How long can he hold on?
When the girl asked about her purpose of coming, Princess Su did not tell her that several groups of officials were secretly and openly trying to find out whether they wanted to give their daughter to the Ninth Prince as a concubine. She just smiled and explained various matters to her.
Yao Zhi was not an ungrateful girl. She could feel Ye Shuo’s dedication, so even though she didn’t like the cumbersome royal etiquette, she patiently followed Princess Su to learn it.
Finally, as if she remembered something, Princess Su asked hesitantly, “Regarding your dowry…”
This was not something that Princess Su was supposed to ask, but since the girl in front of her seemed to be to her liking, she wanted to give her some advice.
“Speaking of this, I was just about to tell the princess.” Yao Zhi, like Ye Shuo, is a person who asks questions when she doesn’t understand something and never feels ashamed of her ignorance.
“This is the list I made these days. Princess, could you help me take a look and see if there is anything taboo on it?”
Princess Su was appointed by Ye Shuo’s father, so Yao Zhi naturally trusted her.
“Show it to me.”
It would be bad if ordinary things appeared at the wedding ceremony, as it would damage the reputation of the future Princess Rui.
But she probably couldn’t afford the expensive dowry, and Princess Su herself didn’t have much hope. She took the gift list and glanced at it roughly.
Then, Princess Su was stunned.
“These…”
The family background of the girl in red in front of her was far beyond her expectations.
As if she remembered something happy, Yao Zhi laughed subconsciously: “These are just some worthless things, but they are a token of my good friend’s love. I’m sorry to make you laugh, Princess.”
The gift list included gold, silver, jade, coral, and even extremely valuable antique calligraphy and paintings, as well as some rare medicinal materials that were rare in the palace, and even furniture made of huanghuali wood.
Since Miss Yao was going to get married, and her husband was a member of the royal family, how could they, the people of Jianghu who had received her favour, not express their gratitude?
In short, they would not let others look down on her.
Outside Shangjing City, a group of gangsters looked at the towering imperial city in front of them, finally laughed and left together.

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Children
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
When Ye Shuo was hesitating whether to secretly find Yao Zhi to ask about it, he found out that she had already prepared her dowry.
As early as the day they received the news from the secret guards, Huo Tianyi and his friends sold almost all of their valuables and spent all their savings to raise the dowry for their apprentice’s marriage.
Many of the things had been prepared early in the morning, including a full set of huanghuali wood furniture. However, the family background of the disciple’s future husband was too prominent, so Huo Tianyi and the others had to buy several times more than before, and it was barely acceptable.
Huo Tianyi once thought that his disciple would eventually look for a chivalrous young man, but who would have thought that his disciple’s vision was much sharper than they imagined, and she actually fell in love with a prince at first sight.
Although this prince doesn’t look like a prince at all, the identities of the two people seem incompatible no matter how you look at it.
Ye Shuo naturally knew that the reason they did this was that they didn’t want Yao Zhi to be looked down upon. If he really did that, it would be bad. After thinking about it, he finally gave up.
In the past, when Yao Zhi lived in his own house, Ye Shuo didn’t feel it, but now that she was taken away by Princess Su, Ye Shuo felt that the Prince’s Mansion in front of him suddenly became much emptier.
It wasn’t that hard to bear, just… a little lonely.
Whenever passing by Yao Zhi’s yard, Ye Shuo would always take a look subconsciously, and it would take a while for him to react.I don’t know who came up with the rule of not allowing them to meet before the wedding. Ye Shuo really wants to ‘thank him.’
The ancient wedding ceremony was already complicated, with adoption, asking for the name, accepting the marriage proposal, paying the betrothal gift, asking for the date, and welcoming the bride. It would take more than half a year to complete the whole process.
We have only just come to the stage of asking for the name, and there are still four months and thirteen days left.
“Oh.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh.
Jianjian, who was standing by, couldn’t help but grit her teeth.
Just play cards, why sigh? The most hateful thing is that while he was sighing, he won all her gold beans.
If he hadn’t been distracted frequently while playing cards, Jianjian would have thought he did it on purpose.
Even though Jianjian was a princess and received a subsidy from the imperial concubine every month, she could not withstand such a loss. Now, half a month had passed, and the little pocket money she had left had been completely taken away by him.
Then, she needs to prepare the money for him as a gift, and that money cannot be touched.
Jianjian, who was only twelve years old, tasted poverty for the first time in her life.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t stand it any more. He bullied Jianjian when he was happy and bullied Jianjian when he was unhappy. He couldn’t be the only one happy, right?
“It just so happens that I’m a little tired of playing cards these days. Why don’t you accompany me for a walk outside?”
Although playing mahjong is fun, you will inevitably feel uncomfortable if you sit for a long time.
The “outside” that Emperor Jingwen was referring to was not the Imperial Garden, but the area outside the Imperial City. Emperor Jingwen had not seen the common people outside for a long time.
Of course Ye Shuo would not refuse after hearing this.
Then Ye Shuo looked at Jian Jian beside him and asked, “Are you going?”
Originally Jianjian wanted to go, but unfortunately her pockets were empty, so she thought about it and decided to give up.
Jianjian looked at the culprit in front of her with resentment, wondering how he had the nerve to ask her that.
Ye Shuo acted as if he knew nothing, then looked at his mother again, which made Jian Jian even more angry.
A glimmer of longing flashed in the imperial concubine’s eyes, but in the end she shook her head.
It’s just a few hours outside, there’s really no point, so I decided to give up.
Ye Shuo was stunned, but didn’t say anything.
The last two people to leave the palace were Ye Shuo and Emperor Jingwen.
“What do you usually do when you are outside?” Emperor Jingwen is now free and has much more leisure time than before.
The streets in front of me are bustling with people. The war with Beiting does not seem to have affected this place. The people of Shangjing City still live and work in peace and tranquillity.
Even because of the war, there were more unfamiliar faces coming and going in the capital city than before.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help feeling comforted when he saw this scene.
At the beginning, he took over a mess from the previous emperor. Now, more than 20 years have passed, and the Great Zhou has swept away the decline and decadence of the past, and there is even a day when it can challenge the Beiting. It seems like a dream.
The previous humiliation seems to be still vivid in my mind.
Emperor Jingwen was probably really old. In recent days, he always liked to dream about the past. New grudges and old hatreds made him more and more dissatisfied with Beiting.
If he could hear the news of the great defeat of Beiting before he died, he would die without regrets. In the future underworld, he would have the face to face the ancestors of the Ye family. Even when facing the great ancestor who founded the Great Zhou Dynasty for a hundred years, he would have the qualification to say that as a descendant of the Ye family, he would not lose the reputation of the Ye family.
Apart from the Great Zhou, there are not many emperors who can compete with Beiting.
Even Emperor Gaozu, when the Zhou Dynasty was first established, had sent a princess to Beiting for marriage. But he had been in power for more than 20 years, but he had never sent a daughter or a sister away.
His years of hard work were worth it, and Emperor Jingwen should naturally be proud of it.
Completely unaware of what his cheap father was thinking at the moment, Ye Shuo blurted out without much thought: “Listen to storytelling, eat snacks, listen to operas and music, and try the new dishes in the restaurant…”
He had so many tricks that no one had the patience to listen to him finish, so Emperor Jingwen spoke up: “In that case, you should lead the way.”
Emperor Jingwen now also wants to experience the happiness of his son.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch his chin when he heard this: “Uh… Dad, are you sure?”
Emperor Jingwen nodded, as if to say, “Stop talking nonsense.”
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate: “Okay then, just stay with your son and talk less, so as not to scare others.”
…Is this the tone a son uses when talking to his father?
Emperor Jingwen was almost so angry that he laughed, but in the end, he resisted the urge to teach him a lesson and agreed reluctantly.
Near noon, Ye Shuo brought Emperor Jingwen to Zuixinglou. As soon as the owner of Zuixinglou saw him, he immediately came forward to greet him.
Because Ye Shuo often hung out outside and was generous, his identity was no longer a secret. Even though three years had passed, the shopkeepers still remembered him clearly.
Isn’t this the God of Wealth?
Ye Shuo didn’t waste any words and said, “Boss, what new dishes are there recently? Pick two or three of the chef’s best dishes and serve them up. I want to treat a guest today.”
Ye Shuo pointed at Emperor Jingwen next to him.
Perhaps it was because his attitude was so natural that the shopkeeper did not suspect anything else for a moment.
“Okay, both of you please come in.”
It was still the third floor, still the familiar box, with the best position and the best view, just enough to take in all the life going on downstairs.
The shouts of the small vendors downstairs could be heard faintly.
The food in Zuixinglou is not the best and is much worse than the imperial chef in the palace. But when paired with such scenery, it has a unique flavour.
Emperor Jingwen hadn’t been so relaxed for a long time.
In the afternoon, Ye Shuo brought his stepfather to the teahouse to listen to storytelling. As the money from the Rui Palace had never been cut off, the storybooks written by the scholar had accumulated a large pile in the past two years, including stories about cultivation, the supernatural, love, and all kinds of things.
When Ye Shuo saw so much inventory, his eyes suddenly lit up.
During the time of waiting for marriage, he finally didn’t have to worry about being bored. He could watch it himself in the evening, and if he liked it, he would send it to his mother, Jianjian and Yao Zhi.
Only Xiaojiu would like this kind of useless miscellaneous book.
Emperor Jingwen’s old problem came back again. He frowned subconsciously, then picked up a book and flipped through it.
Then, the first sentence of the book stunned him.
“After I was killed, I became a ghost.”
The perspectives of the storybooks that Emperor Jingwen had seen were all human, and this was the first time he saw a protagonist who was a ghost.
Driven by curiosity, Emperor Jingwen continued reading.
But in fact, this is a story about a man who turns into a ghost, and then encounters various situations on the way to finding the real murderer who killed him, and then resolves them one by one.
Ye Shuo glanced at the signature on the storybook. Hmm, it was very familiar. He remembered that this person was very good at melodramatic stories. His writing skills were not very good, but what he wrote was inexplicably attractive.
Sure enough, Emperor Jingwen read almost the entire book with a frown on his brow.
Several times he wanted to put it down, but after a while, Emperor Jingwen picked it up again. After repeating this several times, Emperor Jingwen finally couldn’t help but cursed: “What the hell, bullshit!”
