Not only is the handwriting awful, but the word order of some sentences is also incorrect. How can this be worth so much money?
However, Ye Shuo clearly noticed that his cheap father had already turned to the last page…
Then Emperor Jingwen turned around and asked, “Do you usually read this kind of stuff?” No wonder he hasn’t made any progress in all these years!
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment: “Actually… Dad, the one you have in your hand is pretty good.”
Even though it’s illogical, at least the plot isn’t too outrageous. It’s just a little bit curious.
“Can it be worse?” Emperor Jingwen didn’t believe it.
After that, Emperor Jingwen experienced a series of stories, including a love triangle, a bloody and abusive love, a love between a human and a demon, and the hard struggle of a poor boy, and finally he trampled all those who bullied him under his feet.
Perhaps because they feel that he is not around, these storybook writers are becoming more and more free.
How to say it, legends are after all very rare, and even those with great abilities would not write stories for them.
This was the first time Emperor Jingwen had come into contact with this kind of thing. For some reason, he felt extremely disgusted in his heart, but he inexplicably wanted to continue watching.
He wanted to see what else these people could write.
Facts have proved that the imagination of these sour Confucian scholars far exceeded Emperor Jingwen’s expectations. For a while, Emperor Jingwen was in a dilemma whether to scold them or not.
“Dad, don’t get too excited. Just treat it as a joke.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but advise.
That being said, Emperor Jingwen had been serious for most of his life, and this was his first time coming into contact with such an informal book, so naturally he needed some time to digest it.
When the two came out of the teahouse, Emperor Jingwen was still thinking in his heart, why didn’t the characters in the storybook who had a conflict with him wait until the characters were killed before venting their anger?
“If there really was someone who spoke like the person in the storybook, he would have been executed long ago. How could he be appreciated by the noble?”
Of course, but the problem is that he is not the protagonist.
While his cheap father was chattering, Ye Shuo made an excuse to buy some pastries and took the opportunity to slip away.
Phew, my ears are finally quiet.
Ye Shuo had just breathed a sigh of relief when a child of five or six years old bumped into him.
I don’t know if it’s an illusion, but Ye Shuo always feels that this child is somewhat similar to himself in his previous life.
Ye Shuo immediately became interested.

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Scene
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
“Kid, why are you alone? Where are your family members?” Looking around and not noticing anyone who looked like a parent, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but squat down and ask.
Under normal circumstances, Ye Shuo probably wouldn’t be so kind. Even if he met a lost child, he would at most hand the child over to the guards beside him.
But isn’t this guy in front of him 30% similar to him? It just so happens that Ye Shuo is relatively free at the moment, so it’s okay to chat with him for a while.
Ye Shuo just found it interesting at the moment and didn’t think too much about it. There was also a hint of nostalgia in his eyes.
Although the child was lost, he did not seem to panic. He even looked at the young man who suddenly appeared in front of him with some curiosity.
Ye Shuo felt that although this child looked a bit like him, he was much dumber than he was when he was young.
After a while, the child realised that there was no one around him without him noticing.
“Dad, Dad…”
The child began to look around, but there was no familiar face around.The child couldn’t help but start to panic.
“Hey, hey, hey, don’t worry.” It was evening now, and there were a lot of people coming and going. He was afraid that he would get lost again if he wasn’t careful. It would be bad if he met human traffickers or something.
The material of the clothes the child was wearing was just ordinary cloth, so he must be a child from an ordinary family. If he was spotted by human traffickers and abducted, his parents would probably have no place to cry.
Ye Shuo took out a small piece of cake from the packed cake and gave it to him, and said to him in a soothing tone: “How about this, you eat a piece of cake to calm your nerves first, and I’ll help you find your father later, okay?”
The child had just come here following the aroma of freshly baked cakes, and when he saw Ye Shuo taking out a piece of hot and steaming date paste cake, his attention was gradually drawn to him.
Ye Shuo felt that he was wrong. How could there be such a stupid child like him in ordinary people’s families? He didn’t know what kind of parents could give birth to such a child. He was too easy to be deceived.
What a waste of this clever face.
Ye Shuo laughed, and seeing that he was concentrating on eating the date paste cake in his hand, he picked him up easily.
Feeling his feet were off the ground, the child subconsciously wanted to shout, but just as he made a sound, Ye Shuo shook the oil paper bag in his hand and said, “If you behave yourself, these snacks are all yours,” and the child immediately became obedient.
When Emperor Jingwen was getting impatient waiting at the stall nearby, he saw his son holding a child and walking towards him against the flow of people.
The youngest son was tall and good-looking, which made him eye-catching. Now that he was holding a child, he was even more conspicuous. Most of the people on the street, especially the women, couldn’t help but look over here.
Emperor Jingwen: “?”
There was a flash of doubt in his eyes. Where did he get such a strange child in just a short time?
The next moment, Emperor Jingwen’s doubts were answered.
“I just found him at the door of the pastry shop. I guess he was brought out by his father, and then he got lost, so I brought him here.” Ye Shuo had checked and found that he was just an ordinary child and there was no danger.
Ye Shuo sat down.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but twitch his lips.
“What’s wrong with you?” He has so many nephews that it’s not enough for him to play with, right? Now he has started to kidnap and play with young children on the street.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t understand why he was so interested in children.
When the child was eating happily, Ye Shuo put his hands under his armpits and brought him close to his cheap father, saying, “Dad, don’t you think this child is pretty?”
‘Look, he looks so much like me’
Ye Shuo almost blurted it out, but he realised instantly that this child looked like him in his previous life, and had basically nothing to do with him in this life.
When Emperor Jingwen heard his youngest son say this, he reluctantly looked at the child.
“It’s OK.”
Emperor Jingwen himself was extremely handsome, and his children were all equally good-looking, so he did not think there was anything unusual about this child.
Ye Shuo felt that his cheap father’s standards were too high.
Look at this child, how cute he is.
Emperor Jingwen thought that since the child was lost, he could just hand him over to the guards. Unexpectedly, his own son insisted on taking him with him, and kept saying that it was time for dinner anyway and the child would not need much food.
Emperor Jingwen wondered if he was going to get married soon, as he was so patient even with strange children.
The child in front of me is a little silly, but he is relatively easy to take care of. Plus, at the age of five or six, he is able to understand what adults are saying and won’t cry at every turn.
He asked one of the guards to stand guard at the door of the pastry shop to see whose child was lost. Then Ye Shuo took his adoptive father to the gate of the imperial city to eat fried liver.
Emperor Jingwen found that it was not so rare for his youngest son to bring him food, drinks and toys throughout the day, as these were all available in the palace, and were even much better than those outside. The most rare thing was this leisurely mood.
I don’t have to think about anything for the whole day, and I feel like my whole body has relaxed.
No wonder the youngest son likes this kind of life.
Unfortunately, he was the emperor, and he was destined to never feel at ease until he closed his eyes.
In just a moment, Emperor Jingwen broke free from the emotions that suddenly arose.
The sky gradually darkened and the lights came on. It was still far from curfew. Lanterns were hung high on both sides of the moat. Under the moonlight, the surface of the river was shimmering with silver light.
Ye Shuo bought two green-faced, fang-toothed monster masks, put one on himself and gave the other to the child next to him.
Because the mask is too big, even with a rope tied on it, it would fall off the child’s face from time to time, and the child would have to reach out to hold it up from time to time. But despite this, he still had a lot of fun playing with it.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to buy one for his stepfather, but unfortunately, Emperor Jingwen refused to accept it, thinking that wearing the same mask as a child would undermine his dignity.
How can a prince be so close to an ordinary child?
Ye Shuo was already used to his stepfather’s embarrassing behaviour, so he was not surprised at all. He thought it was quite interesting.
By the time of guarding, Emperor Jingwen felt a little tired.
Noticing the flash of fatigue on his cheap father’s face, Ye Shuo took the initiative to ask for it back.
“I don’t know if the child’s father has come to find him.” For such an irresponsible parent, it must have been enough for him to bear after more than an hour.
Let’s see if that person dares to be so careless next time.
Ye Shuo held the child in one hand and supported his cheap father with the other, and slowly walked towards the pastry shop.
At this time, there were already few people in front of the pastry shop. From a distance, Ye Shuo saw two people standing there. One was the guard that Ye Shuo had specially left behind, and the other one should be the child’s father.
Faintly, one could hear the child’s father anxiously explaining something.
“Sir, can you tell me where my son is now?”
After waiting for so long, the man was almost getting anxious, but the person in front of him just said that he knew the whereabouts of his son, but refused to tell him where he was. As time went by, the man couldn’t help but feel uneasy.
The guard was unmoved when he heard this: “Don’t worry, your son is fine now.”
He was even lucky enough to catch the eye of Prince Rui. Even the guards had to sigh that he was so lucky.
But for a man, he doesn’t care whether he is a prince or not, his son is the most important thing.
“It’s all my fault. It’s all my fault. I didn’t take good care of him.”
The man was naturally no match for the guards, but he didn’t dare to offend them, so he could only hit his head in frustration.
As he got closer, Ye Shuo saw an oil-paper bag dropped at the man’s feet. Now the bag was torn, and the scattered cakes inside were scattered all over the ground.
It doesn’t take much to tell who these pastries are for.
The child’s father did not seem as irresponsible as he had imagined. The material of his clothes was even inferior to that of the child. Although the child was wearing cloth, it was fine cloth. On the other hand, the child’s father was wearing coarse cloth.
Even though the man was squatting there with his back to him, Ye Shuo felt somewhat familiar with him for some reason.
While Ye Shuo was in a daze, the child in his arms didn’t have so many scruples and shouted, “Dad!”
Hearing the familiar voice, the man was startled at first, then he raised his head instantly.
“Li’er!”
When the man saw his son, he no longer cared about anything else and rushed over here subconsciously.
When he saw the man’s appearance, Ye Shuo couldn’t control himself and his pupils shrank suddenly.
How could he forget, how could he forget, this child is somewhat similar to himself in his previous life, so the child’s father must be –
The white and fat man in front of me looks almost exactly like Mr. Gu when he was young.
Ye Shuo never expected to see such a face here at this time.
Seeing him rushing towards him, Ye Shuo subconsciously took a step forward. Just as he was about to move, he saw the man take the child from his arms without hesitation.
Ye Shuo felt his arms go empty, and then he saw the father and son hugging each other in front of him.
At this moment, Ye Shuo was just glad that he had just bought a mask.
Just when the man was getting excited, he heard a deep voice from above his head: “Are you the father of this child?”
Emperor Jingwen looked at the two, one big and one small, and felt that they really did not look like father and son.
One has a handsome appearance, and the other looks like a white steamed bun. Given the contrast, this scene of a loving father and a filial son seems inexplicably funny.
The man finally reacted and bowed hurriedly, “Thank you, my lords. Thank you, my lords.”
“No need to thank me.” Emperor Jingwen did not have the leisure time to do that. If he met a strange child on the road, he would not take him out to play for most of the day.
“If you want to thank someone, then thank my son.”
It turns out that the two people in front of him are also a father and son.
The man hurriedly thanked him: “Thank you, young master. Otherwise, I would not know what to do if I lost this child.”
Since his wife passed away, this only son has been his lifeblood. He may not care about anything else but this child.
Noticing the other party’s face full of ecstasy and gratitude for having recovered what he had lost, Ye Shuo opened his mouth and tried several times, but no sound came out.
Emperor Jingwen then noticed that his usually talkative youngest son had not said a word since he saw the man.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but turn his head and look over.
Ye Shuo turned his head away almost instantly.
A strange feeling suddenly arose in Emperor Jingwen’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Click
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo quickly realised that he was wearing a mask, and turned his head again.
“…Next time, don’t be so careless.”
Especially since the child is so stupid, what if he gets kidnapped?
“And you, don’t eat anything given to you by strangers when you are outside in the future.”
Under the gaze of Emperor Jingwen, Ye Shuo calmly instructed the two of them, calmly accepted the thanks from the man in front of him who looked like his father, and calmly watched them leave after the other party thanked him.
From a distance, one could still hear the conversation between the father and son——
“I’m sorry, Li’er. Daddy was too anxious just now and the cake fell to the ground.”
“It’s okay, Dad. The big brother just gave me some to eat. There were jujube paste cakes, osmanthus cakes, and jade bean cakes…”
Once upon a time, his father also held his hand like this and walked him home from outside.Before Emperor Jingwen could say anything, Ye Shuo had already firmly supported Emperor Jingwen’s arm. His voice was normal, without any sign of abnormality.
“Dad, the palace will be locked soon, so we should go back.”
Two pairs of father and son, heading in opposite directions.
One goes east and the other goes west.
When he arrived here, Emperor Jingwen had already dispelled the strange feeling that had inexplicably arisen in his heart, thinking that he might have been wrong, and that the reason his youngest son tilted his head might really just be a coincidence.
But Emperor Jingwen should never have turned his head back at the moment the palace gate closed.
Ye Shuo was worried about the father and son, so he naturally didn’t plan to stay in the palace today.
He made up an excuse, sent his cheap father home, and left.
Ye Shuo’s steps were very fast, as if he wanted to grab something.
Fearing that he would be too late, he simply ran.
Now all his attention was on the man just now, so naturally he didn’t notice that Emperor Jingwen, who never looked back, actually looked back today for the first time.
Emperor Jingwen was a little worried in his heart, but he ended up seeing this scene.
The pastry shop is located on the central axis of the entire Shangjing City, and is considered to be the best shop in the entire Shangjing. After Ye Shuo ran for a while breathlessly, he looked far away and found that the father and son had disappeared.
It should be turning.
“…Damn it!”
Ye Shuo cursed inwardly, but felt powerless.
For a moment, he even forgot to use his internal energy. The night wind rushed into his lungs, causing him to choke and cough.
Ye Shuo took off the mask on his face and leaned against the wall of a shop next to him which had already closed.
The young man raised his hand and wiped his face hard with the back of his hand.
Is he…crying?
Emperor Jingwen didn’t know, but he still stopped subconsciously.
The guard beside him was hesitating whether to speak, but he saw Emperor Jingwen quickly raise his hand.
Then Emperor Jingwen watched his son leave in dismay dozens of feet away.
Emperor Jingwen spent the whole night thinking about his youngest son’s last image.
What does it look like? Lonely and sad.
Emperor Jingwen was obviously very tired, but he couldn’t fall asleep no matter what. Finally, Emperor Jingwen sat up, and then summoned the secret guard to his side.
“Go and check the details of the father and son.”
Emperor Jingwen inexplicably cared about the father and son.
At the same time, on the other side, in the Rui Palace——
Ye Shuo and Emperor Jingwen made almost the same decision: “Xiao Luzi, go and help me check this person.”
Ye Shuo took out a piece of paper and quickly drew a man’s figure with a charcoal pencil.
Ye Shuo will never forget every strand of Mr. Gu’s appearance.
When Xiao Luzi took the piece of paper, he found that the man on it was very ordinary. The only characteristic was that he was white and fat and looked very blessed.
But what did the master want such a person for?
Xiao Luzi was confused, but he didn’t ask. As a servant, he only needed to do what the master ordered.
“yes.”
After Xiao Luzi left, Ye Shuo drove everyone else out, and then he instantly submerged himself in the water.
A feeling of suffocation came over him, and many scenes flashed before Ye Shuo’s eyes, all of which were related to his past life.
There are scenes of his parents taking him to the amusement park, scenes of his father making his first fortune with the help of his mother and the whole family going to a restaurant to celebrate, and scenes of when his mother passed away in his previous life and Mr. Gu hiding in the room and crying until he fainted.
It is Ye Shuo’s most precious, most precious thing.
Now that another person who looks exactly like Mr. Gu has appeared, Ye Shuo’s heart is out of control and is in turmoil.
Mr. Gu should be the biggest knot in Ye Shuo’s two lifetimes.
But now a person who looks exactly like old Mr. Gu has reappeared, and the child beside him makes Ye Shuo feel uncomfortable.
At the most important moment, Ye Shuo noticed that although the man and the child were not wearing good clothes, their hands were smooth and without calluses like those of ordinary people. No one else knew about Mr. Gu’s affairs, not even his mother, so they were definitely not sent by someone with ulterior motives.
Ye Shuo guessed that something unexpected had happened at home, which made him a little worried.
Ye Shuo’s mind was in a mess and he didn’t fall asleep until dawn.
Xiao Luzi had been smart since he was young, and with the money Ye Shuo gave him, Xiao Luzi figured out the details of the father and son in about a day.
The man who looks exactly like Mr. Gu is not named Gu now. His surname is Xiang and his given name is Xiang Hong. The child is his son, named Xiang Li, which means dawn, which means the first day of the day.
Although the two men were not ordinary people, they were not that wealthy either. Xiang Hong used to be a small businessman, but because the world was in chaos recently, the batch of goods he had was robbed on the road. Xiang Hong suffered heavy losses and almost sold all his property. The maids and servants in the family were either sold or sent away. Now Xiang Hong is the only one left to take care of the child, so Xiang Li was accidentally lost.
The reason why the father and son came to Shangjing was mainly because the war was about to spread to their hometown. For the sake of his safety, Xiang Hong simply gritted his teeth and came to Shangjing to seek refuge with his distant cousin.
No matter how powerful Beiting is, it will not be able to reach Shangjing in a short time.
This made Ye Shuo think of himself. In his previous life, his mother also died at about the same time. Like Mr. Gu, Xiang Hong also chose to do business.
Ye Shuo was out of control and stayed with the father and son for almost the entire day.
Nowadays, Xiang Hong has not only sold all his property, but also lives under someone else’s roof. Naturally, life is not easy for both father and son.
Ye Shuo stood at the entrance of the alley, watching him being scolded for no reason by his own uncle but he did not dare to talk back. Instead, he had to put on a smile and apologise to him in various ways.
When Xiang Li came out, he had to pretend nothing had happened and try to make his son happy.
Little Xiang Li is probably still young, and the incident happened suddenly, so he has not yet adjusted to the identity of a young master and still has some of the temper of a young master.
He didn’t know how to hide his feelings at all, and he didn’t know that he couldn’t be like before. He had to learn to keep his head down. When playing with his cousin’s grandson, he wouldn’t give in to him, and soon made the child cry loudly.
Xiang Hong’s uncle was already unhappy about the sudden addition of two mouths to feed in the family, which made the already poor family even worse off. When he saw this scene, he became even more angry.
However, considering that they were from the same clan, the other party did not say anything unpleasant in front of Xiang Hong. Instead, he turned around and started to make indirect accusations together with his wife.
“Some people still think they are rich businessmen and masters, but they are just poor beggars.”
“You’re so old, but you can’t even learn Beijing dialect. It’s so embarrassing.”
The couple spoke one after another, and Xiang Hong couldn’t help but show a little embarrassment and awkwardness on his face, but he also knew that he was now asking for help from others, even though this cousin’s family had received favours from his father in the past and his family had supported them financially, but he had no choice but to bow his head when he was under someone’s roof.
In the end, Xiang Hong pretended that he heard nothing and quietly continued with the work in his hands.
Not the same, not at all.
Although the man in front of him had the same face as his father in his previous life, his behaviour habits, some small movements, and even his temper and personality were completely different from his father.
The person in front of him…is not his father.
The secret hope in Ye Shuo’s heart was suddenly dashed.
What’s more, even if the man in front of him is his father, so what? Just like himself, he should have a new family and a new life.
That child was not as clever as he was back then, nor as smart as him, but he was the biological son of the man in front of him after all. Even if a smarter and better child appeared, he would choose his son without hesitation.
Ye Shuo should have known that the moment his father closed his eyes in his previous life, their relationship as father and son had ended.
His father might be like him, going to an unknown world, an unknown place, and becoming a completely new person.
Just like him now, he is no longer a handsome rich second generation in modern society, but has become a prince of a feudal dynasty called Da Zhou.
And this identity will never change until he closes his eyes in this life.
Looking at the father and son not far away, after a while, Ye Shuo whispered something towards the small path next to him.
Xiao Luzi was stunned, thinking that his master was too attentive to the two people in front of him. He took the younger one out to play for most of the day yesterday, and today he arranged work for the older one and even paid him a monthly salary out of his own pocket…
Although the person in front of him was not his father, he looked so much like his father that Ye Shuo couldn’t bear to see him suffer.
The robbery of his goods was an accident. If he had real ability and I helped him in time, I believe he would be able to make a comeback soon and wouldn’t have to depend on others for his life.
From beginning to end, Ye Shuo never showed his face.
When Xiang Hong learned that there was a grocery store outside that was willing to hire him as their accountant, he couldn’t help but feel ecstatic.
The money given by that family was not much, but it provided food and accommodation, which solved Xiang Hong’s urgent needs immediately.
Don’t worry if the money is not much. When you get off work, you can buy some small things that both girls and boys like, and sell them with a carrying pole. I believe you can make some money.
Xiang Hong made his fortune by working as a peddler, and now he is just starting over.
“Li’er, just wait and see. In less than three years, Dad will definitely let you live a good life.”
“Yeah! I believe in Daddy!”
Seeing Xiang Hong so excited that he kissed and hugged his son, Ye Shuo was stunned, smiled, and then left.
After exiting the alley, Ye Shuo let out a long breath. He looked up at the sky, his eyes filled with melancholy and enlightenment.
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that all his hard work was soon discovered by the secret guards.
Seeing that his son not only gave money but also found ways to arrange for the man to be the accountant, most importantly, he also painted a portrait of the man with his own hands.
After looking at the paper in front of him for a long time, Emperor Jingwen learned that Ye Shuo was entering the palace today. Without thinking twice, he had someone summon him to the Qinzheng Palace.
Ye Shuo was originally wondering what his stepfather wanted to talk to him about.
Before he could think about it, he heard Emperor Jingwen ask, “What is your relationship with that man?”
When Ye Shuo saw the sketch, his heart skipped a beat.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Killing Intent
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Ye Shuo’s first reaction when he heard this was, when was he exposed?
His second reaction was, his cheap father was a little too sensitive.
The only thing is that the reason why his cheap dad reacted so strongly was that he probably was trying to trick him, not because he really guessed something.
How could it be so easy to guess what happened in the past and present lives?
Regarding this matter, I definitely cannot tell the truth. If I mention any word about Mr. Gu, both Xiang Hong and his son will die.
Ye Shuo also didn’t want to implicate them because of himself.
So Ye Shuo thought about it and asked tentatively: “If my son said that he simply had a good impression of the father and son, would you believe it, Dad?”
Emperor Jingwen almost laughed out of anger.
“What do you think?”Does he think of himself as a fool?
Emperor Jingwen admitted that his health was not very good, but he was not yet senile and confused.
Ye Shuo thought about it and felt that this reason was indeed not very convincing. It felt like an insult to his cheap father’s brain.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh: “Well, let me make it clear in advance that you can’t be angry if I tell you the truth.”
Emperor Jingwen rarely nodded beforehand, but simply said, “Tell me about it.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
My cheap dad is getting harder to fool as he gets older.
Ye Shuo’s plan was dashed, and he could only say, “This is what happened. My son had a dream a while ago. He dreamed that he came to a very magical world.”
“In that world, big birds made of iron can fly in the clouds, and four-wheeled things called cars made of iron can run on the ground without being pulled by horses. There is also something called a high-speed train that can travel a thousand miles a day. My son roughly calculated that it would take at most two or three hours to get from Liangzhou to here…”
Listening to his youngest son chattering away, Emperor Jingwen’s first reaction was to sneer.
How could something made of iron be so heavy and fly in the sky?
Emperor Jingwen was a little angry, thinking that his son was fooling him, even in such a ridiculous way.
But gradually, as he listened, he realised something was wrong.
Because his youngest son’s description of these things was extremely detailed, Emperor Jingwen knew very well that if they were fabricated out of thin air, it would be impossible to describe all the details of these things clearly.
Later, Emperor Jingwen himself began to become undecided.
Emperor Jingwen thought for a while, then asked a few details. Ye Shuo answered fluently, and Emperor Jingwen became more and more confused.
The younger son’s logic was even self-consistent, and it didn’t seem like he was lying.
The younger son is not a fool. On the contrary, he is very smart and would not fool himself with something that can be easily exposed.
Seeing that the time was almost right, Ye Shuo changed the subject and said, “Then son also dreamed that he gave birth to a son in that world.”
I’m sorry to my father in my previous life, but there is no other way. I can only ask him to bear with it.
Mr. Gu is so kind, I’m sure he won’t mind.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo completely got rid of the last bit of guilt in his heart.
“And that son is the man we met before. The reason why the son likes that child so much is because he looks very similar to his son’s son, that is, your grandson.”
“I didn’t think too much about it at the time, but when his father came out, this son couldn’t hold it back any longer.”
Ye Shuo’s words were very clever, a mixture of true and false, false and true, making it difficult to tell what was true and what was false.
In Ye Shuo’s words, he became the father and Mr. Gu became the son, and the roles of the two were suddenly reversed.
Suddenly there is an extra father, and the cheap father can’t tolerate it.
Suddenly there are more sons, and the cheap father won’t cause trouble for others, right? “Although this is just a dream, after meeting that man, the son can’t bear to watch them continue to live such a hard life.”
Just when Ye Shuo felt that this method was perfect, he heard Emperor Jingwen speak out of the blue.
“roll.”
Ye Shuo was stunned.
Seeing his reaction, Emperor Jingwen repeated: “Get out of here.”
Why did his cheap father get angry when all was well?
Ye Shuo was puzzled when he was kicked out by a group of guards. He reviewed the situation in his mind and felt that he had said nothing wrong.
And the fact is indeed so. Emperor Jingwen did not catch the loophole in Ye Shuo’s words, because except for Mr. Gu and his father-son identity, everything else Ye Shuo said was true.
But besides being an emperor, Emperor Jingwen was also a father.
With his father’s keen intuition, Emperor Jingwen could vaguely sense that he was lying. And the purpose of lying was not for anything else, but to protect the father and son.
Because of two outsiders, the youngest son actually chose to deceive himself. It can be seen that these two people are very important in his heart.
He chose those two people and gave up himself.
Just as Wang Ziquan was desperately trying to figure out what the Ninth Prince said was wrong, he heard Emperor Jingwen speak up: “How dare he lie to me and say that man is his son? Is there anyone who would serve his son so well and even lie to the emperor?”
If he was really his son, why would he be so secretive in front of him?
Emperor Jingwen felt that he was not his son, but more like his father!
Wait, if that’s true, then it all makes sense.
In an instant, Emperor Jingwen suddenly understood.
Then he thought of how he desperately chased after him that night, and how dejected he looked when he found that he was gone after arriving at the place, as if he had lost a precious treasure. What’s more… he even cried at that time.
It’s just a dream. What if it’s true?
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but tear the sketch in front of him to pieces. Not feeling satisfied with tearing up the sketch, Emperor Jingwen smashed everything he could see.
In a short while, the entire Qinzheng Hall was in a mess.
“What a bastard! What a bastard!”
Wang Ziquan had never seen Emperor Jingwen get so angry since he started serving him. Even when he was facing Beiting, or the Crown Prince, the Emperor would endure it as much as possible and rarely showed such emotions.
Moreover, the emperor was in poor health and could not afford to get angry. Wang Ziquan immediately knelt down and said, “Your Majesty’s health is the most important thing. Please take care of yourself!”
In Wang Ziquan’s view, they were just two common people. Given the emperor’s previous temper, he would just find a reason to kill them. Who could say anything?
Seeing that Emperor Jingwen’s chest was rising and falling violently and his hands were shaking, Wang Ziquan thought without hesitation: “How dare these two lowly people make His Majesty unhappy? I will go and bring people to kill them right now!”
Compared with the Ninth Prince’s attitude, His Majesty’s mood is naturally more important.
However, what Wang Ziquan never expected was that just when he was about to take his men out of the palace with a sign, he heard Emperor Jingwen behind him struggling to speak at the last moment, not knowing what he thought of.
“…No need.”
Having just experienced a fit of rage, Emperor Jingwen’s voice was still a little hoarse. After a long while, he said, “They are just two lowly people. Don’t bother with them.”
His Majesty… actually chose to let them go!
Wang Ziquan turned around in shock, only to find that Emperor Jingwen had already turned around without him noticing.
*
The Ninth Prince has fallen out of favour.
Such news spread quickly throughout the harem as if it had wings.
However, this time no one cared at all, and no one was gloating behind the scenes. After all, they had seen too many things like this over the years. Everyone was excited at first, but now there was no ripple in their hearts.
Anyway, they will have to reconcile in the end. There is no overnight hatred between father and son. If they really believe it, they will become clowns.
In short, no one took it seriously. Even the Sixth Prince just gave him a quick reminder, asking him to be more sensible and not to always make his father angry. Seeing this, Ye Shuo agreed on the surface, but he was smiling bitterly in his heart.
He wanted to come, but this time the matter was unusual. If his stepfather really guessed something, he would probably not forgive him easily.
After all, his stepfather himself is not a generous person, not to mention that this involves his dignity as an emperor and a father. How can he let it go easily this time?
Who would like their child to have two fathers?
Because his cheap father was very angry at the moment, Ye Shuo went to the palace more frequently than usual. Originally, he was thinking of finding an opportunity to reconcile with his cheap father, but who would have thought that his cheap father’s face would change immediately when he saw him. Ever since that time, Ye Shuo started to avoid him.
At this critical juncture, Ye Shuo didn’t dare to go forward and offend his stepfather.
On the contrary, it was Jianjian who keenly noticed the abnormality.
“What happened between you and Father?”
This matter is difficult to explain in a few words. Ye Shuo scratched his head and didn’t know where to start for a moment.
Seeing the distressed look on the young man’s face, Jian Jian couldn’t help but sigh deeply: “When the evening comes and the emperor comes, I will try to find a way to help you.”
We can’t let the two of them stay awkward like this forever, right?
“Don’t!” Ye Shuo was horrified.
“Don’t interfere in this matter.” Otherwise the situation would probably become more chaotic.
Upon hearing this, Jianjian couldn’t help but frown.
Ye Shuo was afraid that she would ask too many questions, so he picked up a basket of fruit next to him and said hurriedly, “I heard that Empress Zhao is sick again. I’ll go see her.”
After saying that, Ye Shuo disappeared in a flash, leaving Jian Jian, who was left behind, stamping her feet in anger.
When Ye Shuo opened the door of Shulanzhai, he saw that Zhao Chongrong, who was not in good health to begin with, had become even thinner and looked much older. After the last cold incident, Zhao Chongrong recovered, but her health was still getting worse day by day. Now, she would get sick from time to time.
Thinking of the imperial physician’s previous diagnosis, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a pang in his heart.
Although Zhao Chongrong was sick, she was not completely confused. She also knew that she didn’t have much time left.
Even Zhao Chongrong had never thought that she could live so long after losing her daughter. Nearly twenty years have passed, and she has no regrets.
Zhao Chongrong herself is almost sixty years old. Her father and mother passed away long ago. Her brothers, sisters, nephews, and nieces have also long since disappeared and are no longer in the capital.
Thinking of the recent rumours, Zhao Chongrong is now alone and dying, so there is really nothing to be afraid of.
The only thing she couldn’t let go of was the remaining siblings Ye Shuo and Jian Jian.
The emperor had always been ruthless and cold-blooded, and Zhao Chongrong remembered how cold he was in the past. After thinking for a long time, she finally spoke out the secret that she had hidden in her heart for more than 20 years.
Because she was afraid that if she didn’t say it, no one would ever know about it again.
After so many years in the palace, Zhao Chongrong only learned one thing: not to develop any real feelings for the emperor, otherwise it would hurt both herself and others.
At the same time, Emperor Jingwen also received the news.
Emperor Jingwen never imagined that Zhao Chongrong would be so bold, and he never thought that Zhao Chongrong would be an insider of the incident.
After hearing what the secret guard said, Emperor Jingwen panicked for a moment, and he didn’t even bother to wipe the water in the cup that spilled on him. He stood up from the dragon chair, and his first reaction was –
kill!
Kill her!

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Reincarnation
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Although Emperor Jingwen thought so in his heart, he was afraid that it was too late now.
Emperor Jingwen did not expect that he had only heard the news that the Ninth Prince had entered the palace and asked the secret guards to secretly monitor his movements, but he accidentally discovered such a scene.
Zhao Chongrong was just a little girl, how dare she do that! He was at a loss for a moment, and when he came to his senses, Emperor Jingwen almost gritted his teeth and spoke.
“Come here, prepare our carriage!”
On the other side, in Shulanzhai——
Ye Shuo watched Zhao Chongrong take out a palm-sized wooden box from under his closet. After opening the box, a tiny pill was found inside.
I don’t know what medicinal ingredients the pills are made of, but even after so many years, they haven’t faded at all and are still so bright, which actually seems a bit weird.
Seeing this scene, Ye Shuo was so shocked that he almost jumped up.
Obviously, he had not expected that the small pill dropped by the midwife would be picked up by Zhao Chongrong, the owner of Shu Lan Zhai, and it had been kept secret for twenty years.The incident happened suddenly, and Ye Shuo had no time to stop it, nor did he have any precautions in advance. When the wooden box was opened, Ye Shuo obviously noticed some movement outside. He estimated that it was most likely that the secret guard noticed something and went to report to his stepfather.
Looking at the thing in front of him again, Zhao Chongrong was unaware of it and continued: “You must be very curious about what this is.”
Zhao Chongrong was initially still hesitant as to whether or not to speak of this matter. To be honest, the emperor had treated the Ninth Prince quite well over the years. If she rashly took out this thing, it might be seen as an attempt to sow discord.
Zhao Chongrong originally planned to keep this matter as a secret and bury it deep in his heart forever.
If the Ninth Prince never knew about it in his life, perhaps it would be better for him.
Also, Zhao Chongrong was not a saint after all. Although she had feelings for the Ninth Prince and Princess Jianjian, she was not so noble and upright as to do so. She also had a family of her own, and her every word and action in the palace would implicate them. Zhao Chongrong knew very well that if she spoke out about this matter and it was exposed, she and her family would surely be killed.
She didn’t have any attachment to the palace, but her family did.
Zhao Chongrong has endured until now, until now, when some of her family members have passed away, some have been separated, and now she finally has the courage.
Especially recently, Emperor Jingwen’s attitude made her feel dangerous. Even now, His Majesty still turned against him at any time, and the Ninth Prince was not on guard at all. How could Zhao Chongrong be at ease? Investing in the emperor was really the most dangerous thing.
Zhao Chongrong’s original intention was just to prevent the child in front of him from being sad because of the emperor’s ambivalence. The emperor and father are the emperor and father, the emperor comes first and the father comes second. If the order is wrong, she is afraid that he will suffer.
So Zhao Chongrong continued, “This is what I found in my room after your mother took you away. It’s such a small thing, I guess he didn’t expect that I would find it…”
When talking about the latter part, Zhao Chongrong couldn’t help but laugh at herself.
The matter was of great importance, and Zhao Chongrong was prepared for fear that he would not trust her.
She subconsciously wanted to open the rabbit cage next to her and prepare to demonstrate it to him, but as soon as she raised her arm, she was stopped by the young man in front of her.
Feeling that his arm stopped in mid-air, Zhao Chongrong couldn’t help but look up.
The next moment, he heard him say, “Madam Zhao, that’s not necessary.”
“But……”
Just as Zhao Chongrong was about to say something, she heard him say, “I knew about this matter from the beginning.”
Now it was Zhao Chongrong’s turn to look at him in shock.
“How is it possible? How could you…” Even the Imperial Concubine didn’t know about this.
The reason why Zhao Chongrong was so sure was because she now understood the temperament of the Imperial Noble Consort. The Imperial Noble Consort was impatient and could not keep things to herself. Considering how much she cared about the Ninth Prince, if she knew, she would definitely not be able to get along with His Majesty without any grudges like she does now, and would have caused a quarrel long ago.
Then the question is, if it wasn’t the Imperial Concubine who said it, and he was just a little baby back then, how did he know it?
Ye Shuo didn’t answer this question directly, he just lowered his eyes and said, “It was that midwife who slipped this little pill from her sleeve when I was just born while no one was paying attention…”
“If it weren’t for the prince’s attendant Mo Shu who suddenly spoke up, I would be dead by now.”
He was just born at the time. Even if he noticed it, how much resistance would he have?
“Don’t worry, Madam Zhao. I know. I know everything.”
Zhao Chongrong couldn’t imagine how he had managed to get through all these years with such a thing on his mind.
As an insider, Zhao Chongrong felt a lot of pressure when he saw Ye Shuo and Jian Jian every day, let alone him as an eyewitness.
My own biological father wanted to kill me from the very beginning. No matter who it is, who can remain indifferent to such a thing?
As an unwanted child, how sad it must be to face your father every day.
As if seeing the knot and pity in Zhao Chongrong’s heart, Ye Shuo shrugged and said with a smile: “So for all these years, I haven’t made it easy for my father either.”
All his royal brothers combined don’t worry about him as much as his cheap father does.
This is probably how the term “debt collector” came about.
After hearing what he said, the big stone that was pressing on Zhao Chongrong’s heart finally fell to the ground, and she couldn’t help but laugh.
“Since you know what’s going on, I feel relieved.”
In this way, there would be nothing in the palace that could make her anxious.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said, “So, Madam Zhao, I will help you destroy this thing. There is really no need to keep it.”
“I’m afraid the secret guards probably already know about it.”
Zhao Chongrong was shocked when she heard this, but she was unusually not nervous. Perhaps it was because at this point, she really had nothing to be afraid of.
Being able to discover the existence of the secret guard in time meant that the child in front of him was not as dissolute as he had imagined, and Zhao Chongrong felt more relieved.
Put the red pill on the ground and crush it with your feet. After a while, this little thing, which had always been bright and colourful, merged with the dust on the ground and lost its luster.
I thought it was something really awesome, but it turns out to be just this good.
Later on, Zhao Chongrong was really exhausted, and seeing this, Ye Shuo offered to resign.
Before leaving, Zhao Chongrong couldn’t help but ask, “What do you think of His Majesty…”
Ye Shuo paused, and finally said, “Let it go.”
It’s not about forgiveness or not caring, but about letting go.
“Why bother so much about some things? It’s rare to be ignorant in life.” If he had to take revenge on every single thing, he probably wouldn’t have the energy to do so.
It’s rare to be confused, it’s really rare to be confused…
If I had thought this way back then, things would probably have been very different.
Zhao Chongrong finally fell into a deep sleep.
When Ye Shuo walked out of Shu Lan Zhai, he happened to run into Emperor Jingwen who was rushing over.
In just a short while, Emperor Jingwen came here from the Qinzheng Hall. It took only an incense stick of time.
Emperor Jingwen originally planned to order the execution of Zhao Chongrong, who instigated discord. However, when the situation really came to this, he hesitated and was even afraid to step forward.
The last time this happened was when the prince committed suicide. His legs felt as if they were filled with lead, just like now, and he couldn’t move at all.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help thinking that if Zhao Chongrong really told him that he had ordered the midwife to secretly execute his youngest son, there would be no way back for the father and son.
If he had so many sons in the past, Emperor Jingwen would not care about one or two of them at all. Even now, he has quite a few sons.
So what if we are discovered?
Emperor Jingwen thought so in his heart, but his hands were out of control, and the hand holding the beads was slightly twisted.
Just as Emperor Jingwen’s expression changed several times, Ye Shuo walked out of Shu Lan Zhai.
Emperor Jingwen almost subconsciously looked into his son’s eyes, trying to discern what emotion was in them. For a moment, he suddenly didn’t dare to ask what Zhao Chongrong had just said to him.
Ye Shuo was not surprised by his appearance. Besides, he didn’t think he could get away with it by playing dumb.
Given my stepfather’s usual temper, I’m afraid they won’t be able to be father and son in the future.
My stepfather is very wary and cannot tolerate a prince who has a grudge against him.
What’s more, after so many years, Ye Shuo also felt a little tired.
When their eyes met, the atmosphere became a little awkward for a moment.
In the end, it was Ye Shuo who spoke first: “Empress Zhao has just fallen asleep, father, please don’t let anyone disturb her.”
Not knowing what he said at all, Emperor Jingwen nodded subconsciously.
My cheap father is a man who keeps his promises. Since he said so, he should not do anything to Zhao Chongrong. Ye Shuo scratched his head and saw that there was nothing for him to do here, so he said, “Thank you, father.”
“In this case, I will take my leave first.”
Seeing him turn around and leave, his tone was unprecedentedly distant, and Emperor Jingwen’s heart suddenly tightened.
“Wait a minute!”
Ye Shuo had to stop and ask: “Father, do you have any other instructions?”
Emperor Jingwen opened his mouth, and after repeating this several times, he asked tentatively: “Your birthday is coming soon. I have asked the imperial kitchen to prepare a banquet for you in advance. It will be the day after tomorrow, and I will be there then. Do you… still want to go back to Qiuwu Palace?” There was a cautiousness in his tone that he himself did not even notice.
Even someone as noble as an emperor has things he is afraid of losing. Without him, he would end up being alone.
Apart from his identity as Emperor Jingwen, just as a father, when he grows old, there will be a day when his status with his children will be reversed.
Emperor Jingwen was so proud in the past that he kept his word with his children, but now he has to pay it back one by one.
Sometimes, the relationship between parents and children seems like a reincarnation.
In all these years, Ye Shuo had never seen his cheap father say such words.
However, Ye Shuo’s daze caused Emperor Jingwen to misunderstand.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Heart Trembling
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
This… let’s just forget it.
If he could be more sensible now, he could at least maintain some respect between him and his stepfather. As father and son, Ye Shuo didn’t want to make things too embarrassing at the end.
It’s really meaningless to be on guard against and suspicious of my cheap father at this point.
So Ye Shuo thought for a moment and said, “Father is very busy, and the war situation at the border has been tense recently, so why not… not celebrate my birthday…”
Looking at his youngest son’s back, Emperor Jingwen had only one thought in his mind –
“He is blaming me, he hates me…”
That’s right. Who wouldn’t blame and hate him when he found out that his biological father never wanted him to live since he was born?
However, if Emperor Jingwen were allowed to choose again, he would still do the same.
So after the crown prince and other princes, he finally lost another son.Soon, everyone in the palace discovered that instead of reconciling, the emperor and the ninth prince’s relationship became increasingly strained.
Whenever the Ninth Prince entered the palace, he would deliberately choose a time when Emperor Jingwen was not around or was busy. Even if the two of them bumped into each other in the palace, the Ninth Prince would avoid them as far as possible in advance.
Ye Shuo is a very knowledgeable and interesting person. He knows exactly when to advance and when to retreat. Most importantly, he is very smart. When he wants to stay away from someone, he almost never fails.
As a result, Emperor Jingwen had several occasions where he received the news in advance but still came up empty-handed.
The atmosphere between the two was so weird that even the Imperial Concubine noticed it, and she couldn’t help but ask what had happened.
But how could Ye Shuo tell his mother? It had happened so many years ago, and telling it now would only cause trouble.
So Ye Shuo just said: “Mom, don’t ask.”
Then the Imperial Concubine really stopped asking. Although she was worried in her heart, she would not force her son if he didn’t say anything.
Jianjian, who was standing by, saw this and felt anxious. One was her father and the other was her brother, so she naturally hoped that both of them were doing well.
Seeing that she couldn’t get anything out of her brother, Jianjian had no choice but to go to Emperor Jingwen.
However, the only way Emperor Jingwen could answer her was silence.
How could he say that he was killing his own children?
“It’s all… my fault…”
The moment the words fell, everyone, including Jianjian, widened their eyes.
Wang Ziquan almost dropped the teacup in his hand. Although he steadied his hand in time, some of the tea still spilled out. This was totally impossible for a eunuch who had served the emperor for decades.
It’s just as incredible as the emperor admitting his mistakes.
In all these years, when has Wang Ziquan ever seen this side of His Majesty?
After Jianjian left in a daze, Emperor Jingwen also got up and went back to his bedroom to rest.
In recent days, Emperor Jingwen has become more and more silent. The imperial palace has become even more deserted. Even if he puts on more clothes, he still can’t resist the chill that seeps out from his bones.
Ever since Emperor Jingwen became ill, Prince Jin and Prince Su would visit him in the palace from time to time. The two of them grew up with Emperor Jingwen. Although Emperor Jingwen’s status was very different after he became emperor, they still had a brotherly relationship.
On this day, Prince Su came to accompany Emperor Jingwen to fish in the Imperial Garden as usual. At this time, a whole month had passed since Ye Shuo came out of Zhao Chongrong’s Shu Lan Zhai.
Just when Prince Su was racking his brains to try to make Emperor Jingwen happy, he heard Emperor Jingwen say something out of the blue.
“Royal brother, tell me, is all this retribution?”
Seeing his brother’s hair getting whiter and whiter, Prince Su’s heart trembled inexplicably. Subconsciously, Prince Su pretended to be relaxed and said, “How could it be?”
“Everyone in this world knows that my brother is a wise ruler.”
Apart from Emperor Gaozu who founded the Great Zhou, his royal brother was the most outstanding person in the entire Ye family.
“He is a wise monarch, but not a good father.” First it was the crown prince, then Xiaojiu, and eventually his own sons would leave him one after another.
Shaking his head in self-mockery, Emperor Jingwen left in silence with his hands behind his back.
It was not until this moment that Prince Su realised that his brother, who used to be cold-hearted and fearless, was now just an ordinary person.
There is always a shortage of palace servants around the emperor, but the dark dragon robe he wears separates him from those people far away. No matter how many people are around him, from a distance he looks like a lone figure.
The young man who used to support him is gone. Everything has changed. No one can get close to him anymore.
After Emperor Jingwen left, Prince Su thought about it and finally decided to visit his nephew’s house in person.
At that time, Ye Shuo was enjoying the breeze in the pavilion on the hill in his back garden. The hanging chair he had tied with his own hands was swaying, and he seemed a little absent-minded.
About half an hour later, Ye Shuo heard some noise not far away and woke up from his complicated thoughts, then subconsciously looked over.
Then he saw Prince Su, supported by his attendants, climbing the last step breathlessly.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo hurriedly got down from the hanging chair.
“Huh… I’m so old, and my legs and feet are not very useful anymore.” Prince Su, Prince Jin, and Emperor Jingwen are only one or two years older, or two or three years younger than each other, so they are actually about the same age.
In the past, Prince Su could ride his horse to hunt and could go through most of the day without even taking a breath. But now, he even finds it difficult to climb a small hill.
Ye Shuo helped him sit on the stone bench next to him, and couldn’t help but frown and said, “Why did the emperor uncle come up here by himself? He didn’t even ask the housekeeper to inform me so that I could go down to greet you.”
Prince Su didn’t care. “It has nothing to do with the housekeeper. I didn’t tell the people below me to report it. I just happened to have some free time, so I can stretch my muscles.”
Although Prince Su said so, he was his uncle. No one would come to see him for no reason. Ye Shuo could almost guess the purpose of Prince Su’s visit.
It was estimated that Prince Su came back this time to persuade him to reconcile with his adoptive father, and Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh.
But some things cannot be explained in a few words. Rather than making the ending worse, it is better to stop here.
Prince Su did not go straight to the point, but told Ye Shuo a story. The protagonist of the story was none other than Emperor Jingwen himself.
As the brother of Emperor Jingwen, Prince Su watched him walk along the way and naturally knew how difficult it was for this imperial brother.
“Like being forced by the late emperor to accompany the Beiting people to drink, these are still minor matters. Back then, the late emperor saw that your father was outstanding, which made him look even more unbearable. He wanted to kill your father many times. Because of this, your father took good care of the prince after he was born and treated him with special favour.”
“He thought that this way he could avoid those tragedies, and that as long as his attitude was firm enough, everything would be fine.”
Several years ago, the late emperor wanted to kill his own son. Several years later, the emperor brother also wanted to kill his own son. It went on and on, as if it was a cycle of fate.
“He tried so hard to avoid tragedy, but ended up in another tragedy. If you think about it carefully, it’s really ridiculous.”
Emperor Jingwen failed to keep the ones he wanted to keep, and he also failed to keep the ones he didn’t want to keep at first but changed his mind in the end. One has to feel that it was really fate that played tricks on him.
Sometimes, only after becoming a parent do you realise that no matter what you do, there will always be regrets between your children.
Even if you are careful in everything, there will always be omissions. Sometimes it is an inappropriate word, and sometimes it is just a look.
Ye Shuo was silent for a while after hearing this, but still didn’t say anything.
His cheap father has his own difficulties, and he himself has his own difficulties as well. He cannot just forgive his cheap father because of his difficulties.
Who doesn’t have times when they are forced to do things against their will in life? Ye Shuo couldn’t always think about others in everything he did.
Seeing that his nephew was still unmoved, Prince Su couldn’t help but sigh. If other princes encountered such a thing, they would quickly back down after hearing what he said. Who could really be angry with the emperor?
Only he was so stubborn.
He doesn’t care about power but only about love. Perhaps it is because of this that the emperor can’t let go.
Knowing that his nephew would only respond to soft words and not to hard ones, if he were to use force, he would only push him further away. Prince Su could not help but say, “Uncle Royal said this not to force you to forgive your father, but… considering your father’s poor health, could you please visit him more often? Don’t avoid him anymore. There are some things that he can’t always bear even though he is the emperor.”
Prince Su spoke earnestly. After a long while, Ye Shuo finally spoke: “Now that father and son are suspicious of each other, how can we go back? There is nothing wrong with the current situation.”
Prince Su discovered the root of the problem almost immediately.
His nephew seemed to believe that his father would have a grudge against him because of this incident. If it was in the past, it was indeed the case, but now…
The emperor brother was indeed cruel and heartless in the past, but as his nephew, how could he not underestimate the emperor’s feelings for him?
“My nephew, you are joking. The emperor may be like this to everyone, but he treats you differently.”
Without waiting for Ye Shuo to refute, Prince Su said, “Whether it is true or not, you can find out by yourself when you go to the palace.”
Ye Shuo was sceptical.
“That’s all I have to say as an uncle. I want to remind you that for some things, don’t wait until you lose them before you regret it.”
Prince Su finally left.
Ye Shuo stood there in a daze for a while, and finally decided to trust him once.
If what Prince Su said is true, then…
The next morning, when Emperor Jingwen learned that his youngest son wanted to see him, he was stunned for a moment, and didn’t even realise that the pen in his hand had slipped down. When he came to his senses, he spoke almost subconsciously.
“Hurry up and announce it!”
For a moment, he forgot all about Xiang Hong and Zhao Chongrong.
There were some things that Emperor Jingwen suddenly didn’t want to think about.
When Ye Shuo got closer, he found that in just a month, his stepfather seemed to have lost a lot of weight.
However, before he could say anything, the secret guard appeared before him and brought news that caught both of them off guard.
Just now, Zhao Chongrong…died. Ye Shuo’s eyes widened almost instantly.
The emperor, the secret guards, the former concubines… everything was so suspicious that they were already angry about this matter.
Emperor Jingwen panicked and almost blurted out, “It wasn’t me.”
He reacted almost instantly, and Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly felt a pang of pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Reversal
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
This matter was obviously not done by my stepfather. If it was really done by him, he would not have waited until now.
Outside, both Xiang Hong and Xiang Li, father and son, are fine. It doesn’t make sense for the stepfather to attack only Zhao Chongrong. Ye Shuo still has some judgement in this regard.
What’s more, Zhao Chongrong’s health was not good to begin with, and even the imperial physician had mentioned this matter.
It is enough for him to say this and do this.
Finally, under the somewhat tense gaze of Emperor Jingwen, Ye Shuo nodded: “I know.”
“…dad.”
Upon hearing these long-lost words, Emperor Jingwen froze.
When he was young, whenever he called him like that, Emperor Jingwen would subconsciously correct him. But now he is reluctant to do so. It really is a different time now.
However, Ye Shuo did not stay here for a long time. Compared with his stepfather, Zhao Chongrong’s matter was more important at the moment.So Ye Shuo opened his mouth and said, “Son has to go to Shu Lan Zhai, so he has to leave first.”
After thinking for a while, he added: “I will go back to Qiuwu Palace at night.”
Only then did Emperor Jingwen feel relieved.
After his youngest son left, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t calm down no matter what, so he simply put down the brush in his hand. Anyway, most of the things were handled by the Sixth Prince now, so it didn’t matter if he reviewed less memorials for a day or two.
After a while, Emperor Jingwen arrived at Qiuwu Palace.
When Ye Shuo arrived at Shu Lan Zhai, he heard crying before he even entered the door.
Ye Shuo paused, took a deep breath, and then walked in.
When Jianjian arrived, Zhao Chongrong was on her deathbed. Jianjian, who was in the study, had already received the news. She happened to see Zhao Chongrong for the last time and talked to her for a long time. It can be said that Jianjian watched Zhao Chongrong leave with her own eyes.
At first, Xu Chongyi and Li Chongyuan wanted to drive her out because she was young, but the little princess was very determined and insisted on staying.
Because Zhao Chongrong was also pregnant with a daughter that year, she would naturally be more caring towards Jianjian on weekdays. Jianjian felt that at this time, she should see Empress Zhao off for the last time.
This was the first time that Jianjian faced death head-on. The Crown Prince and the Fourth Prince had all died outside, so the impact on her was not as great as it was now.
Jianjian has been pampered by the Imperial Concubine and Emperor Jingwen for many years. So far, the biggest obstacle she has encountered is her brother who causes her trouble. Apart from that, she has never experienced any other storms.
It was not until now that Jianjian suddenly realised that people could be so fragile. Empress Zhao was fine before, and even half a month ago she was talking and laughing with him in the yard, but now she has closed her eyes forever.
What is death? Death is when the people you are close to no longer run, jump, or respond to you.
Jianjian was already precocious, and now she felt even more deeply. She couldn’t help but wonder if her mother would be like Empress Zhao after a few years, just sleeping and never waking up again, and then her father, and then her brother…
No matter how serious she is, Jianjian is just a child now.
When Ye Shuo came in, he saw that Jianjian’s eyes were red, and it was obvious that she had just cried. The little girl pretended to be strong but couldn’t hide her confusion, which was really heartbreaking.
Birth, ageing, sickness and death are the norm in life, but every time we face them, we still cannot control ourselves.
Ye Shuo sighed, then held Jian Jian in his arms and whispered to comfort her: “Don’t cry, don’t cry, brother is here.”
It would have been better if Ye Shuo didn’t say anything. After he said that, Jian Jian completely lost control of herself and burst into tears like she did when she was a child.
“Don’t die, brother, don’t die!”
Jianjian grabbed the corner of Ye Shuo’s clothes tightly, as if this could change anything.
Ye Shuo was not surprised that she would suddenly say such words. Children are like this. Even though they don’t know the meaning of death yet, their brains are one step ahead of her and begin to be filled with fear. Then they can’t stop imagining that the people around them will move away from them one by one.
Although Jianjian felt that her brother was extremely troublesome, had no ability and was extremely fragile, a very, very troublesome troublemaker, she couldn’t help feeling afraid when she thought that one day he would leave her like Empress Zhao did.
Ye Shuo also went through that age. After his mother passed away in his previous life, there was a period of time when he was particularly afraid that Mr. Gu would suddenly leave him, so Ye Shuo understood what Jian Jian was thinking at the moment.
“No, no, even if I really have to die, I will die after Jianjian. I will never leave Jianjian alone. How about that?”
“Don’t you dare lie to me!”
“Brother promises you.”
After receiving a positive answer, Jianjian, who had been crying uncontrollably, reluctantly let go of his hand.
After Jianjian was tired of crying, Xu Chongyi and Li Chongyuan brought the palace maids from Shulanzhai to change clothes for Zhao Chongrong.
Only then did Ye Shuo see the dead Zhao Chongrong.
Zhao Chongrong was relatively peaceful in the last moments of her life.
Although her illnesses made her feel extremely miserable, at least she had two good friends and the little princess by her side. Her ending was much better than most people in the palace. The only regret was that she did not live past the age of 60, which was not considered a long life, but Zhao Chongrong did not care.
During these last moments, although Zhao Chongrong aged very quickly, her face was extremely peaceful when she closed her eyes.
Being able to leave without regrets, she is already much better than others.
For the sake of Prince Rui and the princess, the people in charge of Zhao Chongrong’s funeral naturally did not dare to neglect the arrangements, and the Ministry of Internal Affairs also did not dare to be harsh in the slightest.
After the initial panic, order was quickly restored in Shu Lan Zhai.
By the time everything was done, it was already dark.
According to the rules, Zhao Chongrong’s children or nephews should keep vigil for the first three days, but unfortunately, Zhao Chongrong has no children, and no one knows where her nephews and nieces are now. Zhao Chongrong at least watched Ye Shuo grow up, and helped him and his mother a lot. He only needs to keep vigil for three days, and he doesn’t even have to worry about the rest. It is natural for Ye Shuo to do the duty.
Some things may have been destined.
Twenty years ago, Ye Shuo was born in Shulanzhai, and twenty years later he saw Zhao Chongrong off in Shulanzhai.
As it was still light now and he had already made arrangements with his stepfather during the day, Ye Shuo planned to go back to Qiuwu Palace to have dinner before coming here.
As for Jianjian, after she was tired of crying, she fell asleep leaning against Xu Chongyi without knowing when.
There were still tears hanging on her long pointed eyelashes, her brows were furrowed all the time, and she slept very uneasily.
Taking it from Xu Chongyi, Ye Shuo carried Jianjian on his back and told Xu Chongyi and Li Chongyuan to go back to their palace to rest. Ye Shuo said, “Don’t worry, I’ll be back in a while.”
The two nodded at the same time and did not force themselves to stay here.
After Ye Shuo left, Xu Chongyi looked at the coffin in the main hall and couldn’t help but sigh: “We are lucky to meet this child.”
Li Chongyuan seemed to sigh: “Yes…”
The other side.
As long as Ye Shuo was there, she suddenly felt safe. She didn’t know if it was because she felt safe, but in her sleep, her pointed brows finally relaxed.
After putting her in the room, Ye Shuo came to the main hall and found that his mother and stepfather had been waiting there.
“Mom, Dad, why aren’t you eating?” Ye Shuo took a look and found that the food was not even hot enough.
The Imperial Noble Consort was also wondering why the Emperor didn’t start eating in advance today.
Only after Ye Shuo sat down did Wang Ziquan start to help serve the dishes, which made the Imperial Concubine have an illusion: Could it be that the Emperor was waiting for Xiao Jiu?
But then the imperial concubine shook her head and dispelled the thought.
How is it possible…
Seeing him sit down at the table as usual and start shovelling food into his mouth, Emperor Jingwen felt inexplicably relieved.
Later, when the Imperial Noble Consort learned that her youngest son was going to keep vigil for Zhao Chongrong for three days, she didn’t think it was a big deal, but she was worried that he might hurt himself, so she couldn’t help but remind him not to force himself and to do what he could.
But in fact, Ye Shuo would not stay there for 12 hours. There were palace servants from Shu Lan Zhai there during the day, so it was actually okay.
After hearing what he said, the Imperial Noble Consort finally felt relieved.
Emperor Jingwen, who was standing aside, couldn’t help but frown, but since his youngest son had said so, he couldn’t say anything else.
After dinner, when he came out of Qiuwu Palace, Emperor Jingwen looked at Wang Ziquan standing beside him.
“Have someone watch carefully, and ask the people in the Ministry of Internal Affairs to persuade Prince Rui to rest more, and not to be so rigid about those empty formalities.”
Wang Ziquan was not surprised. He knew very well that after this incident, His Royal Highness Prince Rui’s favour would be even greater than before, so he responded without hesitation.
Although his youngest son had deep feelings for Zhao Chongrong, this did not mean that Emperor Jingwen had a good impression of her.
Just talking about the fact that Zhao Chongrong instigated discord before her death, Emperor Jingwen wanted to cut her into pieces. The only reason he was able to keep it secret was for the sake of his youngest son’s face.
If he hadn’t been concerned about her, Emperor Jingwen would have taken action long ago. How could he have kept Zhao Chongrong until now?
Now that Xiaojiu was finally no longer avoiding him, Emperor Jingwen naturally didn’t want to cause any more trouble.
After returning to his bedroom and pondering for a long time, Emperor Jingwen finally picked up his pen and raised Zhao Chongrong’s status by a whole level, posthumously conferring her the title of Ru Fei and burying her with the rites of a first-rank concubine.
Ye Shuo soon learned the news and immediately understood the reason.
It turned out that what Prince Su said was true. My stepfather did not become suspicious and defensive because of the revelation of what happened that year. In addition, in my stepfather’s heart, my importance seemed to be even more important than he imagined.
Zhao Chongrong, no, the concubine’s body was kept in the palace for seven days before being buried in the concubine’s tomb, guarded by the Black Armor Guards throughout the process.
On the day when Concubine Ru was buried in the Concubine’s tomb, Ye Shuo accompanied her throughout the whole process. Until the moment the tomb was closed, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel dazed.
I have sent another one away…
Finally, he turned around to take a look at the huge mausoleum in front of him. After a while, Ye Shuo rode away.
Then, the news that the Ninth Prince and the Emperor had reconciled their past grudges spread once again, and this time it was even more different than before.
The emperor and the ninth prince seemed to be completely turned upside down…

chapters.title: Chapter 228: March
chapters.content:
(T/L NOTE: Everyone thank the buyers of {330+} chapters, that you got to read these bonus chapters!)
Everyone has long been accustomed to such news. After all, it happens every once in a while, and no matter who it is, there will be no waves in their hearts.
At first, there were people in the harem who gloated over the misfortune, but now they are too lazy to even inquire about it. After inquiring about it, they only make themselves angry.
As usual, the Sixth Prince came to report to Emperor Jingwen on the recent work of the court.
Although Emperor Jingwen seemed to be less involved in affairs nowadays and had entrusted him with such important tasks as mobilising grain and grass, the more this was the case, the more the Sixth Prince dared not slack off.
The Sixth Prince knew very well that his father had been the emperor for so many years and had a very strong foundation. His father’s position was far from being as simple as it seemed. If he made even the slightest mistake, all his previous efforts would be in vain. Naturally, the Sixth Prince was extremely alert.
What the Sixth Prince did not expect was that when he arrived at the Qinzheng Palace, he found that his father was not there at all. The Sixth Prince was stunned.
He remembered that this was exactly the time his father had mentioned the day before.
Seeing this, the eunuch beside him hurriedly said, “The emperor is in the imperial garden now.”
However, the young eunuch didn’t know the exact location, and even if he knew, he wouldn’t dare to tell you.The Sixth Prince knew the rules, so he had no choice but to look for the emperor all over the Imperial Garden.
Fortunately, whenever Emperor Jingwen went out, there was always a large crowd and he could be easily discovered.
When the Sixth Prince heard the noise and came to the garden, Ye Shuo was fighting crickets with his adoptive father.
Neither of them was a professional player, and the crickets were just randomly found, but despite this, the two of them still had a lot of fun playing.
“Hurry up, hurry up, hurry up!” Ye Shuo shouted while holding a piece of cow grass.
Emperor Jingwen next to him remained silent, but from his expression one could tell that he was also working hard.
How could the competitive Emperor Jingwen allow himself to lose, even in a cricket fight?
The Sixth Prince paused for a moment.
After a moment’s silence, he came over.
“Your Majesty, the Sixth Prince is here.” Wang Ziquan, who was standing by, hurriedly reminded him when he saw this.
While his cheap father was distracted, Ye Shuo quickly poked his cricket, making it more and more agitated. Then he pounced on another cricket and killed it.
Wang Ziquan: “…”
Wang Ziquan took a step back silently.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath, then raised his head. When he saw the Sixth Prince, he suddenly remembered what he had said two days ago.
I’m really old and my memory is not that good. I even forgot such an important thing.
Ye Shuo had no interest in what was happening in the court, so he didn’t pay attention to what they were talking about. He only vaguely heard words like “the war is fierce” and “the treasury doesn’t have enough money”.
Ye Shuo believed that with his brothers’ abilities, it should not be difficult to handle these things.
By the time the Sixth Prince had finished discussing with Emperor Jingwen, it was almost noon. Ye Shuo was bored and was playing with rings and bracelets made of cow grass.
It happened that the Sixth Prince had to rush back to the Six Ministries in the afternoon. If he took a detour to go to his own residence, he might be too late. So the Sixth Prince simply went back to Qiuwu Palace with Ye Shuo and the others to have lunch.
It was only March now, and the weather was still chilly. When Ye Shuo was on the road, he noticed that it seemed to be windy, so he said casually, “It’s windy, Dad, put on more clothes.”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t think there was anything wrong at all. He was not so bad that he couldn’t stand even this little breeze.
Seeing his refusal, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frown.
His stepfather’s health was already poor enough, and now he wasn’t being taken care of. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel a bit of a headache.
“How can this be possible? What if I get caught in the wind?”
Seeing his youngest son frowning, Emperor Jingwen finally put on the thin cloak. After all, it was just a piece of clothing and not a big deal. There was no need to make him angry.
What’s more, Xiaojiu is concerned about himself.
The Sixth Prince standing aside was stunned. You know, what his father hated most was being controlled by others, and anyone who tried to control him always ended up badly.
It wasn’t even the Empress dowager’s place to let the Emperor call her Mother, but didn’t she still get implicated?
Now the emperor was not only not angry, but happy instead. The Sixth Prince was naturally surprised.
In addition, during lunch, the Sixth Prince saw his father move his chopsticks twice towards one of the spicy dishes. The third time, he wanted Wang Ziquan, who was standing next to him, to take some, but was stopped by his Ninth Prince.
My cheap dad is getting old now, and his sense of taste is not as sensitive as when he was young. Instead, he likes food with strong flavours. Although spicy, salty and fresh taste good, it is not good for his body and will increase the burden on his cardiovascular system.
Ye Shuo could only remind him helplessly.
