If it were in the past, Emperor Jingwen would have lost his temper. As an emperor, he could eat whatever he wanted. Why should he care about other things? Who would have the guts to control him?
But now…
Seeing the disapproval in his youngest son’s eyes, Emperor Jingwen thought about it and finally put down his chopsticks.
The Sixth Prince walked out of Qiuwu Palace in an almost daze.
He felt that he might need to write something, or deal with some important matters piled up in the six volumes, and calm down.
After Zhao Chongrong passed away, Ye Shuo and Emperor Jingwen never mentioned the matter of the pill again, especially Ye Shuo. It would have been fine if he had questioned him loudly, but he did it silently, which made Emperor Jingwen feel uneasy.
Now it seems that everything has been turned over, but Emperor Jingwen still feels aggrieved in his heart.
Especially because of this incident, the youngest son did not have a good birthday this year, let alone a banquet. However, because of Zhao Chongrong’s matter, the youngest son has not been in a good mood recently, so Emperor Jingwen did not mention it.
Now that Zhao Chongrong had been buried, Emperor Jingwen began to find various excuses to reward his youngest son.
There are some things that Emperor Jingwen may never be able to say in front of Ye Shuo. Besides, he has no experience in apologising, so he just stuffs all the good stuff into Ye Shuo’s arms.
The storeroom in Prince Ye Shuo’s mansion was almost full, and the housekeeper was hesitating whether to knock down the wall of the adjacent room and build another storeroom.
Seeing that his cheap father wanted to give him a precious tree that had just been sent as tribute from the local area, Ye Shuo hastily refused: “No, no, no, this thing is clumsy and heavy, and it doesn’t look good. I have to take care of it carefully every day, and it can easily break if I’m not careful. I don’t want it.”
The jade branches of the precious tree were thin and brittle, more precious than itself, but Ye Shuo could not afford to serve them.
You have to know that being gifted by the emperor is a great honour. Ordinary noble families would build a special ancestral hall to worship one if they could get it, and they might even keep it as a family heirloom. But when it came to Ye Shuo, he didn’t choose it.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t take it seriously when he heard this: “It’s broken, so what’s the big deal?”
He had plenty of such things in his private vault, and Emperor Jingwen would never punish his own son for such trivial matters.
Emperor Jingwen is now very open-minded. It doesn’t matter if some insignificant little toys are broken by his youngest son while playing with them.
Once upon a time, Emperor Jingwen was so distressed that he even spent a long time smashing his two emerald unicorns when Ye Shuo was just born.
In addition to these things that happened in public, Emperor Jingwen also secretly ordered his secret guards to carry the things in his private vault to Ye Shuo’s palace box by box without telling anyone.
Emperor Jingwen knew that he could not hand over the Ye family’s kingdom to him, but his personal property would not be a problem because it would have to be divided in the end anyway.
Emperor Jingwen was extremely secretive, fearing that Ye Shuo would spread the news everywhere. Emperor Jingwen also specifically reminded Ye Shuo several times, telling him not to let the news leak out, especially to his brothers, who must not be mentioned under any circumstances.
Of course, Emperor Jingwen did leave nothing for the Fifth Prince and other princes, but as for the quantity and quality…this kind of thing, after all, is just a father’s intention, and they themselves do not lack these material possessions.
What’s more, the five princes all have real positions, but the youngest son has nothing. It’s generally fair that one gains while the other loses.
In addition to his youngest son, Emperor Jingwen also left some for his youngest daughter, but the Princess’s Palace had not yet been built, so there was really no place to put those things, so they could only be temporarily placed in the youngest son’s palace. When Emperor Jingwen got the list compiled by his subordinates, he also specifically asked them to classify them, so that it was clear which one was for his son and which one was for his daughter.
“Jianjian is a girl, she will feel confident only if she has something in her hands. When she gets married, you must remember to give it to her as a dowry.”
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo naturally agreed.
Emperor Jingwen finally felt relieved.
Since these were just casual chats between father and son, Emperor Jingwen did not particularly avoid others, so his words “If it’s broken, it’s broken, what’s the big deal” quickly spread.
There were more and more things that needed the Sixth Prince to do. He paused, then put down his pen and looked at the few antique vases in the study that were given to him by his father. He couldn’t help but wonder what would happen if he broke the vase.
But after all, this was a gift from Emperor Jingwen when he got married, so the Sixth Prince finally gave it up.
It’s really not worth it for such a small matter.
He has more important things to do, so he naturally doesn’t care about these trivial things.
As for the Fifth Prince and Concubine De, they couldn’t help but think that their father/the emperor was still alive. If one day their father/the emperor was gone, how long would he be able to be proud?
The days passed one by one, and from time to time Ye Shuo would follow Emperor Jingwen out of the imperial city to play in Shangjing City, either fishing or playing pitch pots, cricket fighting, mahjong, sunbathing, etc.
At first, the imperial concubine didn’t want to follow them around. After all, she only went out occasionally, and when she came back, life in the palace would only seem more boring.
Now that the Queen is gone, Concubine Shu has been demoted to Xiaoyi, Concubine Xian has lost her only son, and Concubine De has been implicated in the affairs of the eldest prince. Add to that the fact that Emperor Jingwen hasn’t held a beauty contest for several years, it would be strange if the Imperial Noble Concubine’s life could be interesting.
But Ye Shuo insisted on taking her along, and finally, the Imperial Concubine accepted it.
Sometimes, the Imperial Concubine was shopping there, and Ye Shuo and Emperor Jingwen were waiting for her. Sometimes, Ye Shuo and Emperor Jingwen saw some interesting stalls or novel things, and the Imperial Concubine would wait for them.
All in all, Emperor Jingwen lived a very comfortable and happy life during these few months.
Three months passed in a flash, and in the blink of an eye it was the day for Ye Shuo’s wedding that had been set by the Imperial Observatory.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Welcoming the Bride
chapters.content:
On that day, Ye Shuo got up early without waiting for Xiao Luzi to remind him.
No, that’s not right. It should be said that he didn’t sleep all night.
He was actually going to get married. For some reason, Ye Shuo suddenly felt something was unreal, as if he was dreaming.
Along with this came a little nervousness and uneasiness.
Ye Shuo thought that he was a man who had experienced many ups and downs, and he should be extremely calm even when getting married. But when this day really came, he found that it was not the case at all.
In his excitement, Ye Shuo almost wore the wrong clothes. If Xiao Luzi hadn’t reminded him in time, Ye Shuo would have made a fool of himself.
“…Forget it, let you guys do it.” In the end, Ye Shuo gave up on putting on his clothes, which was an extremely simple task in daily life.
When Ye Shuo put on the red wedding gown, everyone’s eyes lit up. His Royal Highness Prince Rui was already tall and straight, and now in red, he was truly unique and stunning.
Especially those Ruifeng eyes, which were even brighter and more dazzling today than before, as if they were filled with the stars in the sky. In addition, His Royal Highness Prince Rui was also extremely handsome, so anyone who was stared at by those eyes would be moved.
Ignoring the stunned people in the room, Ye Shuo noticed the movement behind him. He didn’t even turn around, but just asked, “How is it?”Ye Xun also got up early, intending to come and congratulate him on his wedding, but as soon as he entered the door, he heard these words.
“…”
Seeing the Ninth Prince now looking like a peacock with its screen spread out, Ye Xun was silent for a moment and nodded helplessly: “It looks good.”
Only then did Ye Shuo feel satisfied.
Immediately afterwards, Ye Shuo went to the ancestral hall in the mansion again.
Ye Shuo would burn incense to the prince almost every morning when he got up, and today was no exception. In fact, it was because today was a special day that he had to go even more.
“I had thought of asking my third brother to be my witness when I got married, but I didn’t expect it to be a little late.”
Just think about it, the crown prince is helping to preside over the whole process. He is the future emperor, it would be such an honour for him to tell others about it.
It’s a pity that the prince didn’t live to see this day.
The prince’s tablet was placed there, motionless, neither sad nor happy, except for the prince’s name on it which was still as bright and clean as new, as if the prince was quietly watching everything in front of him.
Ye Shuo inserted the incense in his hand into the incense burner, and when the auspicious time was over, he walked out of the ancestral hall and climbed onto the horse.
Ye Xun is still in mourning, so he naturally cannot go out. Thinking back to what the Ninth Prince said just now, Ye Xun stayed in the ancestral hall for a long, long time…
Just as the Ninth Uncle said, he is married now, but his father will never see him again.
The other side.
As soon as Ye Shuo left the house, he saw the Sixth Prince and the Seventh Prince already waiting outside.
When getting married, one naturally has to go and pick up the bride. Because the Sixth Prince had previously written a letter proposing to reduce all expenses on Ye Shuo’s wedding to avoid extravagance and waste, Ye Shuo’s wedding was therefore much simpler than expected, and the money spent was instantly cut by more than half. Feeling guilty, the Sixth Prince naturally agreed to the task of picking up the bride.
What’s more, when he got married, it was Xiaojiu who helped to pick him up. Today, the Sixth Prince specially took time off from the six ministries to make this trip.
What’s more, he is also the witness today.
Nowadays, the Sixth Prince is extremely busy, and it seems harder than climbing to the sky to see him. Even Ye Shuo feels flattered.
“I suddenly felt that I was too honoured.”
Upon hearing this, the Sixth Prince’s mouth twitched slightly. If his expression had been more sincere when he said this, the Sixth Prince might have actually believed it.
The Sixth Prince inexplicably felt that he was making fun of him.
Even if it wasn’t a joke, today he was getting married, and even his father was the master of ceremonies, so what was he?
When the eldest prince and the crown prince got married, even his father didn’t do this. I’m afraid he was the only one who had such an honour.
“Don’t do anything weird and waste time.” The Sixth Prince couldn’t help but remind.
He didn’t know if it was an illusion, but Ye Shuo always felt that the Sixth Prince had started to control him now. He didn’t know if it was because he had been in the Sixth Ministry for too long and was accustomed to giving orders.
No way, my cheap dad just loosened his control over him.
Seeing the Sixth Prince frowning, Ye Shuo quickly straightened his back.
After a series of busy work, the wedding procession finally set off on time in the evening.
The Ninth Prince was now the most beloved of the emperor, so the people below were naturally very alert when it came to matters concerning him. The Imperial Astronomical Bureau had almost read through the almanac, and had been paying close attention to the changes in the sky in recent days, fearing that if it rained or was windy, the entire Imperial Astronomical Bureau would be punished. So when the wedding day really came, under the control of many parties, today’s weather was as good as it could be, and even the sunset was much more gorgeous than usual.
Facing the fiery clouds in the sky, Ye Shuo rode on Qingfeng and slowly walked through the streets. The afterglow of the setting sun fell on his face, adding a bit of warm and good colour to him. Wherever he went, the people were all shocked.
More than 20 years ago, when the Imperial Noble Consort was travelling in a carriage, the wind accidentally blew open the curtain of the carriage. In the breeze, just half of her face had already made her famous throughout the entire Shangjing. Now, more than 20 years have passed, and in the sunset, the Ninth Prince, who has perfectly inherited the Imperial Noble Consort’s peerless beauty, is even more stunning.
As the saying goes, “Young men should only see the painting, but I alone know the essence of it. When I paint to the end of the sky and the water, I am definitely not a mortal.” This is probably the case.
It was a pity that the day they met was the day he got married. For a moment, countless women were heartbroken and regretful.
“If I had known this, I would have asked my father for help.”
In the past, everyone only knew that the Ninth Prince was born with a good appearance, but his reputation was not very good. So the noble ladies subconsciously thought that the Ninth Prince was a useless idiot, a typical dandy.
Now it seems that even if he is a straw bag, so what? He is so handsome, it is natural that he is a little spoiled.
Unfortunately, however, it is too late now.
For a moment, the noble ladies on the second floors on both sides of the street who came to watch the ceremony sighed almost at the same time.
About half an hour later, Ye Shuo arrived at the gate of Prince Su’s Mansion.
Prince Su’s mansion is just like him, solemn and dignified, and looks particularly cold. Now it is hung with red silk and red lanterns everywhere, making it look much more festive.
Ye Shuo dismounted, tidied his clothes, and then stepped in under the attention of everyone.
It was not the first time that the young ladies and young masters in Prince Su’s Mansion had seen their cousin. They had seen him from afar before, whether at family banquets or sacrificial ceremonies, but Ye Shuo was still young at that time. Now that he has reached adulthood, the feeling when seeing him up close is naturally very different.
She performed the greetings in a proper manner with Prince Su and Princess Su. Now Prince Su was Yao Zhi’s adoptive father. Although this marriage was promised by Emperor Jingwen, the rules still had to be followed.
Prince Su started asking him several questions. According to the rules, he could not go to see the bride if he could not answer them.
But at the same time, Prince Su knew his nephew’s abilities and was afraid that he would not be able to find a wife, so he racked his brains overnight to think of a few questions that he could answer.
Getting married, Ye Shuo wouldn’t be a drag at this time.
However, before he could open his mouth, the Sixth Prince and the Seventh Prince beside him took the initiative to answer for him.
Prince Su asked about the contents of the only two articles that Ye Shuo had been able to recite over the years. However, so many years had passed, and Xiao Jiu probably had forgotten them long ago. Fearing that he would embarrass himself, the Sixth Prince and the Seventh Prince spoke subconsciously.
The Sixth Prince and the Seventh Prince were stunned when they heard each other’s voices almost at the same time. But after thinking about it, they still went ahead and continued talking.
Prince Su: “…”
This child is hopeless.
However, being able to get the Sixth Prince to speak for him, from another perspective, this was also a skill. After a moment, Prince Su finally let him go.
In the courtyard, Yao Zhi had been a little nervous since she woke up in the morning. Like Ye Shuo, both of them overestimated themselves.
But besides feeling nervous, Yao Zhi also felt a little excited.
Since the marriage was decided, Yao Zhi hasn’t seen Ye Shuo for nearly half a year. Although Ye Shuo came to see her secretly during this period, he was discovered by Prince Su in time, and then Prince Su threw him out without mercy. Since then, Ye Shuo never had a chance to come in again.
I heard that he had some unpleasantness with his father in the middle, but fortunately everything was fine in the end. Only then did Yao Zhi feel relieved.
I just don’t know how the young man is doing recently.
Just when Yao Zhi was thinking about something, she suddenly heard the voice outsi6. Yao Zhi was about to take action, but the next moment, she saw a slender hand with distinct joints reaching under her big red veil.
Seeing her in a daze, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh. Without giving her a chance to refuse, Ye Shuo took her hand.
Perhaps because she was equally excited, Yao Zhi could feel that his hands were particularly hot.
“Follow me.”
As the two moved, the tassels on her veil fluttered constantly. Through the veil, Yao Zhi could not make out what was in front of her, but she could vaguely feel that he was leading her out of the courtyard, down the steps, through the garden, and all the way to the gate of the palace.
During this process, Yao Zhi could even hear the faint gasps from the people around her.
The Ninth Prince could not hide his excitement on his face. Perhaps his emotions were too exposed, which infected the people around him. Coupled with the dazzling red colour on the two of them, the two people who were originally not a good match in the eyes of others actually looked a bit more stunning.
Yao Zhi was already impatient and wanted to see what he looked like now.
The young man was already good-looking, and he would be even more stunning in a wedding gown.
When Yao Zhi sat in the sedan chair, the noise outside was immediately blocked out. When Ye Shuo let go of her hand, Yao Zhi felt as if something was stuffed in her palm.
When the door curtain fell again, Yao Zhi looked down and found that they were two pieces of crispy biscuits wrapped in oil paper. They must have been specially prepared because he was worried that she had not eaten much since morning and was afraid that she would be hungry.
The two biscuits still had the residual warmth of his body on them. Suddenly, Yao Zhi felt that all the hard work in the past six months was nothing.
After saying goodbye to Prince Su and Princess Su, and waiting for Ye Shuo to climb over the mountain and mount his horse again, she heard Xiao Luzi beside him shouting loudly: “Lift the sedan chair——”
At the same time, in the palace, Emperor Jingwen had already thrown aside the memorial in front of him. Anyway, the Sixth Prince would handle the matters above. As it was such a happy day, Emperor Jingwen was in no mood to continue reading it.
When Wang Ziquan beside him reminded him that the time was almost up, Emperor Jingwen stood up.
As he stepped onto the imperial carriage, Emperor Jingwen gradually regained consciousness on the way.
My youngest son has finally grown up now…
It was getting dark, and Emperor Jingwen arrived at Prince Rui’s Mansion before the wedding procession arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: The Ceremony is Over
chapters.content:
The ministers were not surprised by the appearance of Emperor Jingwen. They would have been surprised if the emperor had not come today.
After Emperor Jingwen walked into the hall, Huo Tianyi and others arrived soon after.
Since the wedding date was set, Huo Tianyi and others did not leave Shangjing for nearly half a year. The moment the emperor saw the beautiful woman and her friends, everyone present frowned subconsciously.
Emperor Jingwen knew without hesitation that this must have been arranged by his youngest son. Moreover, since it was a marriage, both sets of parents naturally had to be present.
Yao Zhi’s parents were no longer around, so it was only natural that the beautiful woman should sit at the head of the table as the elder. The younger son had good intentions, but he was not thoughtful enough, so Emperor Jingwen had to help him make up for it.
After Emperor Jingwen sat down, he naturally gestured to the beautiful woman to sit down as well.
Seeing that the emperor didn’t say anything, the others simply spoke out, so they naturally didn’t dare to have any more opinions.
After about an incense stick of time, the sound of ritual music could be heard outside the palace.
Emperor Jingwen’s expression became more and more solemn.
After Ye Shuo came in, Emperor Jingwen’s eyes lit up. He was indeed his son. The wedding gown he was wearing was truly priceless.This is more like his own son.
Emperor Jingwen naturally had special feelings for the child he raised with his own hands. Seeing this scene, he was naturally even happier, and it would not be an exaggeration to say that he was relieved.
Now, in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, no matter what the youngest son does, it is good.
Seeing his youngest son’s unconcealed joy, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but smile as well.
It’s just that we should remind you now.
“The auspicious time is about to pass, let’s start quickly.” Emperor Jingwen said.
Wang Ziquan never thought that there would be a day in his lifetime when he would preside over the wedding ceremony for the prince.
The Ninth Prince had lived in the palace since he was a child, and Wang Ziquan had watched him grow up. Although he was naughty by nature, he did not like to torture servants like them. On the contrary, such a prince was particularly lively. Wang Ziquan naturally liked him in his heart. Wang Ziquan could not help but laugh, and then shouted loudly: “The auspicious time has arrived, the newlyweds are worshipping——”
“Bow to Heaven and Earth——”
Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi first bowed to the sky and then to the earth.
“Bow to your parents twice—”
Then Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi first bowed to Emperor Jingwen, and then bowed to the beautiful woman sitting above.
The beautiful woman looked at this scene and subconsciously tightened her grip on the armrest of the chair.
“The couple bows to each other—”
Through the veil, Yao Zhi vaguely saw the young man opposite bending down towards her, and she couldn’t help feeling dazed.
“Send it to the bridal chamber—”
“The ceremony is over——”
Perhaps when hier disciple was soft-hearted and chose to follow this young man for two months, she and others should have thought that this day would come.
In the end, her disciple still couldn’t escape the trap set by the young man in front of her.
Although the young man did as he said, with three matchmakers and six betrothals, and eight sedan chairs to welcome her as his legal wife, how could things be so simple? This was only the first step, and there were still ninety-nine steps waiting for them in the future.
From year to year, if something went wrong, it would be all over.
Betting on a man’s sincerity will only result in an even greater loss.
Beneath the beautiful woman’s smile, there was a deep sorrow.
“Go to the room and wait for me. I’ll be there soon.”
After hearing this, Yao Zhi said “hmm” softly, and then went to Ye Shuo’s room under the guidance of the maid.
Since they are husband and wife, it is natural for them to be together. Ye Shuo did not specially ask anyone to prepare the so-called princess’ courtyard. As for whether this is in accordance with the rules, it is not the first day that he has been breaking the rules. In the entire King Rui Mansion, his words are final.
Knowing that he was there, the people below would definitely not be able to relax. Emperor Jingwen also did not want the wedding ceremony to be ruined because of him, so after the ceremony, he left early.
Before leaving, Emperor Jingwen subconsciously reminded Xiao Luzi, telling him not to forget to ask his master to go to the palace to pay respects to the Imperial noble Concubine tomorrow morning.
As for what time to go, Emperor Jingwen knew that his youngest son liked to sleep in. Besides, the empress dowager in the palace was just a decoration, and the rest were all family members, so it was not so particular. It would be fine as long as he went there before lunch.
Naturally, I wrote down all the little tricks one by one.
After Emperor Jingwen left, Huo Tianyi and the others did not stay long.
The high officials present didn’t look down on these gangsters, so how could they know that these gangsters would look down on them? Therefore, it was best for them to keep out of each other’s way and live in peace.
Only then did the entire Prince Rui’s Mansion begin to become lively.
You won’t know until you see it. You will be shocked when you see it. When Ye Shuo got married, even Prime Minister He was present. Not only Prime Minister He, but also Shangshu Ling and others. It can be said that all the ministers who had taught Ye Shuo were invited by him.
Time flies so fast. I didn’t expect that the unreliable prince back then is now old enough to get married.
Prime Minister He, the Shangshu Ling and others had already taken sides and were now serving different masters. Today at Prince Rui’s mansion, they had put aside all the unpleasantness in the court and sighed at the same time.
They only had one thought at the moment, which was to hope that the Ninth Prince would quickly become stable after his marriage.
But when they thought about the identity of the woman he had married, He Xiang and the others felt that they were simply dreaming.
If the Ninth Prince had really grown up and become reliable, it wouldn’t be like this. Instead, they thought that the Ninth Prince was even more rebellious than before.
In the past, the Ninth Prince could do very limited things due to his young age. Now that he has grown up, no one can control him.
Lord Cen sighed and only hoped that the Ninth Prince could have the baby later. He had a vague premonition that no matter what the Ninth Prince gave birth to, it would eventually have to be left to them to teach, just like the Seventh Princess had done back then.
It would be fine if the child’s temperament was like the Seventh Princess, but if it was like the Ninth Prince… Oh my God, I don’t even dare to think about it.
Anyway, ever since the Ninth Prince reached school age, they have basically had no free time.
Noticing the distress on Lord Cen’s face and vaguely guessing what he was thinking, the former Prince’s tutor beside him smiled and said, “Lord Cen, it has come to this.”
Seeing him gloating over other people’s misfortunes, Lord Cen immediately became furious: “Now that you have resigned from your post and are free from stress, you are here to make sarcastic remarks.”
Ever since the incident with the Crown Prince, the Grand Tutor felt ashamed to face the Emperor and unworthy of the Emperor’s trust, so he resigned and went home. Now Ye Shuo invited him to watch the ceremony in the name of his student.
After this experience, the Taifu’s temperament has become much calmer. Now he has opened a school in his mansion and teaches every day, just like an ordinary old man.
From then on, the affairs of the court had nothing to do with him anymore.
After all these years, how could Lord Cen not understand him?
Lord Cen couldn’t help but sneered, “I advise you not to be happy too soon. Do you think you can just quit your job and that’s it? With the Ninth Prince’s temper, will he let you go?”
“Since he called you a teacher, you will be his teacher for the rest of your life, not only to himself, but also to his children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren…”
The former prince’s tutor’s expression suddenly froze.
For a moment, the former Grand Tutor suddenly wanted to give up his house in the capital and move back to his hometown.
At this moment, a voice suddenly came from behind the two of them.
“Teachers, what are you talking about?”
The Grand Tutor in front of Lord Cen was immediately startled.
“No, nothing…”
Ye Shuo looked suspicious, but thinking that Yao Zhi was still waiting for him in the room, he hesitated for a moment and decisively let the two of them go.
Then came He Xiang and the others.
The former Grand Tutor of Lord Cen did not dare to provoke Ye Shuo, but would He Xiang and the others dare to do so? The prince in front of him had been a tough guy since he was a child. Once he got involved, there was no way to tear him apart. Besides, what good would it be to conflict with him? Therefore, even though they knew that Ye Shuo had little power, everyone was still polite to him.
The Sixth Prince watched as Prime Minister He, who always frowned in front of him, actually smiled for the first time. He smiled and said, “Your Highness Prince Rui, congratulations.”
The Sixth Prince: “…”
The Sixth Prince couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
Then there was the old Duke of Zhen. Ye Shuo was the grandson of the old Duke of Zhen. Now that he was getting married, how could the old Duke of Zhen not come?
In addition to him, Wei Wen also came.
The moment he saw his cousin, Ye Shuo’s eyes lit up, making Wei Wen almost turn around and run away.
After all, so many years have passed, and Wei Wen has long since come to his senses. Whenever he comes looking for me, it’s definitely not good.
The key point is that he just helps to run errands, but all the benefits go to him, while I am the one who does the hard work.
My younger cousin is married now, but I am still alone.
Previously, it was because the family was in danger and they didn’t want to implicate the girl. Now, there are too many secrets and it has become even more dangerous.
Wei Wen gritted his teeth and toasted Ye Shuo a glass of wine: “Congratulations, cousin.”
“You too, you’ve worked hard, cousin.”
Saying words that only the two of them could understand, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but drink the wine in the glass.
Then there is Ye Shuo’s former study partner, now the Minister of Public Administration, Xing Yucheng.
Just as Xing Yucheng was toasting Ye Shuo half happily and half stiffly, a voice suddenly came from the side.
“Your Highness, Prince Rui, I offer you a toast.”
It turned out that he was the newly appointed Salt Transport Commissioner Si Yuntong, who came to the capital to express gratitude after being promoted by the emperor. He happened to arrive in time for the wedding of the emperor’s most beloved ninth prince, so he was invited to come.
The face in front of him was particularly unfamiliar. Ye Shuo was just wondering, but he accidentally saw a flash of excitement in the other person’s eyes. He lowered his head and saw the jade pendant with a lily flower carved on it worn on his waist.
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, then he understood.
“Congratulations, everyone.”
And then there is…
“Well done.”
Ye Shuo complimented the young man in front of him in a voice that only the two of them could hear, and it made the young man in front of him excited.
To receive praise from the teacher is the greatest pursuit for these students.
Now I have finally got what I wanted.
After just a glance and a glass of drinks, the two passed each other.
After taking a deep breath, the newly appointed Salt Transport Commissioner Si Yuntong finally calmed down.
He couldn’t help feeling a little proud when he noticed that his fellow students who were scattered at other tables were looking at him with envy.
Apart from the ministers, the rest were the Fifth Prince, the Eighth Prince and others. As for the Tenth Prince, the Eleventh Prince and the Twelfth Prince, although they had now left the palace to set up their own residences and were present today, Ye Shuo was not familiar with them after all, so he just greeted them briefly.
The Fifth Prince was in a bad mood and wanted to make a fuss, but was once again forced back by Ye Shuo’s three conditions.
“The same trick again. Can you use this to control me forever?” The fifth prince almost vomited blood.
Ye Shuo didn’t care: “It’s not a new trick, as long as it works.”
As long as the Fifth Prince is not too embarrassed to deny his debt, this method will work.
The Sixth Prince and the Seventh Prince came specially to pick up the bride for him, which might not be without the intention of blocking the wine for him, but looking at the current situation, it seems that they are not needed at all.
Even He Lin’s attitude towards Xiaojiu is “I’ll do it, you can do whatever you want”, “Your Highness can do whatever you want”, “As long as Your Highness is happy”, so where is the use of their abilities?
At Ye Shuo’s wedding, everyone present was asked to be as obedient as possible.
Finally, Ye Shuo patted Ye Yan and his brothers on the shoulders, watched them leave, and without waiting for the servants to clean up the leftovers in the yard, he quickly walked towards his room.
Nearly an hour and a half had passed since Yao Zhi was sent to the bridal chamber, so she must have been getting impatient.
The steward of Prince Rui’s Mansion couldn’t help but laugh upon seeing this, but at the same time, he was even more afraid to neglect the princess.
Just when Yao Zhi was feeling bored, she suddenly heard someone greeting her, followed by the intoxicating aroma of wine.
The faint aroma of wine mixed with the fresh fragrance of the young man like pine and cypress, and Yao Zhi’s cheeks immediately began to heat up uncontrollably.
When the veil in front of her was gently lifted by the weighing rod, she looked at the young man’s eyes which had become a little misty due to his tipsiness, and the faint redness under his eyes. Perhaps it was because of the wine on his lips, but now they were exceptionally red, like a flower that was almost rotten and eager to be picked… Yao Zhi almost instinctively held her breath, for fear of disturbing him.
Yao Zhi rarely put on makeup today, and the maids in Prince Su’s mansion carefully applied lip balm on her lips. Her breath smelled sweet as an orchid.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch her face and murmured, “It’s so beautiful.”
Feeling the heat in the young man’s palm, for a moment, Yao Zhi really wanted to drown in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Bridal Chamber
chapters.content:
Not to mention the bride, even the maid beside her blushed. This scene was so touching that it made people feel warm in their hearts.
Both the prince and the princess are extremely good-looking, and the combination of the two is so stunning that one cannot take their eyes away.
It is no exaggeration to say that today’s wedding is the dream of all women in the world. If you take a closer look, you will find that His Royal Highness Prince Rui has such a patient and gentle side. His every move is fascinating.
And the princess, when the prince is not around, is always generous and heroic, but as soon as the prince appears, her eyes change unconsciously.
“cough.”
In the end, the matchmaker couldn’t help it anymore and coughed lightly, interrupting the two people’s eye contact.
It has been a long time since the bridesmaid presided over weddings for the nobles in the capital city, but it is rare to see her being so indulgent. Most of them are very restrained.
The nobles have been of extraordinary status since birth and have been accustomed to restraining their emotions since childhood. Not showing their likes and dislikes is just the most basic thing. There is almost no one like Prince Rui who has a smile in his eyes and eyebrows.
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo’s expression was too obvious, even the smile on the face of the bridesmaid, who was used to all the joys and sorrows in the capital, became more sincere.
Look at how sweet this couple is, it’s so sweet that it’ll make your teeth fall in love with them.What a wonderful story! The man is in love and the woman is willing. No matter what the future holds, at least now there seems to be no room for a third person to come between them.
Hearing the cough, Ye Shuo came back to his senses almost instantly.
Seeing that there were so many people watching in the room, Ye Shuo was lucky that he had always been thick-skinned, otherwise he would not be able to bear it.
Yao Zhi originally wanted to remain calm, but after trying several times, she ultimately failed.
Yao Zhi’s cheeks were like peach blossoms in full bloom in March, and the light pink colour was particularly attractive. Taking advantage of this opportunity, the bridesmaid quickly signalled with her eyes and asked someone to bring a bowl of dumplings over.
After all, this was Yao Zhi’s first marriage. Princess Su had only told her some necessary things, and the rest was something Yao Zhi had to experience on her own. Princess Su didn’t want to ruin the fun of her future niece-in-law’s wedding day, so she deliberately kept it a secret.
So when the dumpling fell into her mouth, Yao Zhi subconsciously shouted: “Ah, why is it raw?”
“It’s good to give birth, it’s good to give birth, it’s good to give birth! Did everyone hear that, our Princess Rui said she wants to give birth.”
The bridesmaid’s smile deepened: “Congratulations to His Royal Highness Prince Rui, congratulations to His Royal Highness Prince Rui, I wish His Royal Highness Prince Rui and Princess Rui every year, every year has this day, may they have a son soon, may they have children soon.”
Yao Zhi was not a stupid person. After she realised what was happening, her face suddenly turned red.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but look at Ye Shuo beside her, only to see that the young man laughed out loud as if he had expected it.
Have you ever seen a pig run before you’ve eaten pork? It turns out that the TV shows he saw in his previous life were actually real. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel like he had suddenly fallen from a dream into reality.
Seeing that she seemed to be annoyed, Ye Shuo quickly regained his composure.
Although he was not in a hurry to have a child, and even felt that it didn’t matter whether he had a child or not, in comparison, Ye Shuo still preferred to be alone with Yao Zhi and didn’t want to suddenly have a child.
Ye Shuo did not have such a strong desire to continue the family line, nor did he have the idea of ​​continuing the glory of his own line. It was up to Yao Zhi to decide whether to have one or how many she wanted, and everything would be left to fate.
But on such a happy day, Ye Shuo did not say it outright to ruin the atmosphere. He hurriedly said, “I would like to borrow this aunt’s good wishes.”
“Come here, give her a reward!”
Soon Xiao Luzi came in with the wedding money that had been prepared long ago.
In the past, bridesmaids only knew that Prince Rui was wealthy, but she didn’t know that Prince Rui’s Mansion was so rich. A casual reward was a silver note of one hundred taels, which was more than what she had received from three or four other people combined.
The bridesmaid was immediately overjoyed, and she kept saying nice things to Yao Zhi. In the end, she used up almost all her life’s skills, and made Yao Zhi almost burn with anger.
When lovers are deeply in love, it is the most heart-warming.
Just for this reason, his reward was not given in vain.
Seeing that the night outside was getting darker, after all the procedures were completed, the matchmaker left very tactfully, and the remaining maids were quickly taken away by Xiao Luzi.
The door closed with a creak, and Yao Zhi’s heart jumped.
Just when she was at a loss, she saw Ye Shuo turned around with a bowl of hot noodle soup in his hand. He must have brought it when the door closed.
“I heard from the maids that you haven’t eaten much all day. You must be starving. Eat something while it’s hot.”
In the middle, Ye Shuo handed her two cakes, but that was just enough to fill her stomach, how could it fill her up?
Like Yao Zhi, Ye Shuo had been busy all day and didn’t eat much, but fortunately, he had moved his chopsticks a few times when he was toasting people just now, so he wasn’t very hungry now.
Upon hearing this, Yao Zhi subconsciously touched her stomach and felt something uncomfortable in her stomach. She didn’t act shy and took the chopsticks from Ye Shuo.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sit next to her, propping up his chin with one hand, and just looked at her. Under the dim candlelight, the young man was too beautiful.
Yao Zhi’s heartbeat was a little fast, so she began to talk nonsense: “Today is over, I am so exhausted.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but hum, expressing his deep agreement: “Just this once, there won’t be a next time.”
Hmm–
Not bad, not bad.
I was very hungry during the day, so it would be inappropriate to eat too much at night. Therefore, Yao Zhi only ate half a bowl and stopped.
Feeling something strange on her lips, she was about to find a handkerchief to wipe it, but Ye Shuo got there before her and wiped off the soup stain that had accidentally splashed on her lips.
I couldn’t help but suddenly recall what my second master had told me a few days ago. Besides, Yao Zhi herself was studying medicine, so how could she not know about the things between men and women?
However, it is precisely because we know everything that it is easier to let our imagination run wild. Only those who really know nothing will not have such wrong thoughts.
Feeling the young man’s breath coming towards her, Yao Zhi froze.
Just when Yao Zhi thought he would take advantage of this opportunity to do something, she saw him immediately withdraw.
The intoxicating smell disappeared. For some reason, Yao Zhi suddenly felt a sense of loss and almost looked for it subconsciously.
“It’s getting late, go to bed early.”
No matter how shy Yao Zhi is, she still needs to rest at night.
Yao Zhi is now wearing the ceremonial clothes of a prince’s princess, and the hairpins on her head are extremely cumbersome. Her neck is sore after a day of work. This is because she is in good health. I wonder how those young ladies who are kept in seclusion can bear it.
Yao Zhi had just taken off two of them when the remaining hairpins got tangled with her hair.
But before she could open her mouth, Ye Shuo had already walked behind her and helped to untie her clothes very naturally.
The young man’s hands were extremely beautiful, just like him, especially when reflected in the bronze mirror, they looked even more hazy and slender. From time to time, his fingertip brushed against Yao Zhi’s ears, the back of her neck, the base of her ears, and the sides of her neck.
These were all extremely vital parts, and every time the young man touched them, Yao Zhi would shudder. But seeing the young man’s serious and focused expression, his concentration made her feel something was wrong. Yao Zhi endured it for a few seconds, but in the end she didn’t have the heart to interrupt him.
“alright.”
When Ye Shuo took off the last earring, the pink on Yao Zhi’s face had spread all the way to the base of her neck. Hearing these two words, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Yao Zhi suddenly felt thirsty, which was strange because she had just drank some water.
As if he didn’t notice Yao Zhi subconsciously fanning herself at the side, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but put his hand on his waist belt.
When Yao Zhi turned around again, the bright red royal robe had fallen to the ground. The young man was wearing only his innerwear, and the bright colour had immediately faded away. He suddenly became elegant, like a nobleman who was ignorant of the world.
Yao Zhi watched him walk towards the carved wooden bed, lift the quilt, lie down on the inside very obediently, and close his eyes.
The young man’s long eyelashes trembled and trembled, and the trembling reached people’s hearts.
When the candle went out, Yao Zhi’s mind was filled with the scene just now.
Ye Shuo was extremely honest. He just lay there without moving, looking gentle and good-tempered, ready to be bullied.
At first, Yao Zhi was a little resistant to what was going to happen on her wedding night. After all, she had been alone for many years and was not used to other people getting close to her. But after all this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but start to have wild thoughts.
Especially when they were so close, the aroma of wine mixed with the scent of pine and cypress from the young man beside her kept drilling into her nose, and it was difficult for Yao Zhi to ignore it even if she wanted to.
In the end, it was Yao Zhi who made the first move, but she had no idea why the young man took the initiative and how things developed like this.
The young man shouted and called out, “Sister, sister,” as if to make people’s hearts and livers burst out. No wonder they say lust is like a knife above one’s head. Now he is about to kill himself. When Yao Zhi came back to her senses, it was already the Yin hour.
Yao Zhi was exhausted and fell into a deep sleep.
…Forget it, let’s stop here for today.
Ye Shuo sighed and reached out to wipe away the tears from the corners of her eyes.
After waiting and waiting, it was almost dawn and Xiao Luzi could faintly hear the voice of his master calling for water.
The originally drowsy Xiao Luzi suddenly started to shudder.
Ye Shuo is quite thick-skinned, but Yao Zhi probably isn’t. And her current appearance is indeed not suitable for others to see, not even the maid.
Therefore, Ye Shuo only asked Xiao Luzi to bring in the water and did not call anyone. After getting the hot water, Ye Shuo asked Xiao Luzi and the others to go and rest.
As for the follow-up matters, Ye Shuo naturally helped to deal with them.
Perhaps because she was extremely tired, Yao Zhi slept until noon, and then she opened her eyes in a daze.
Yao Zhi opened her mouth and tried to speak, but found that her voice had become hoarse without her knowing when, and her legs were so weak that she could hardly stand up.
If she hadn’t been helped by him in time, he would have almost fallen.
Just at this moment, Ye Shuo pushed the door and walked in.
Their eyes met, and Yao Zhi regained her senses. The look in her eyes when she looked at him suddenly changed.
Ye Shuo’s heart skipped a beat and he knew something bad was going to happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Entering the Palace
chapters.content:
In the past, Yao Zhi had no idea that the young man had such a side. She only thought that he had always been extremely docile.
Now that the lovemaking had stopped, Ye Shuo had once again returned to his usual docile and harmless self, but when Yao Zhi saw his face again, she couldn’t help but feel a tingling sensation on her scalp and a sharp pain in her waist.
Ye Shuo also vaguely realised that he had frightened her because of his lack of tact last night, and subconsciously began to think about how to make amends later.
Even Ye Shuo is more or less controlled by his body at this age. It was fine before he didn’t eat meat, but now that he can eat meat, even he can’t control himself all the time.
As if he didn’t notice her defense, Ye Shuo put the food box in his hand on the table next to him: “I remember that you like the food I make the most. I made these in the kitchen myself. Come and try them?”
Ye Shuo had eaten only half full last night, and was so full that he got up earlier than Yao Zhi for the first time in his life.
Yao Zhi’s face turned blue and red for a long time. After she recovered some strength, she finally got out of bed.
The clothes around can be put away, the bed can be rearranged, but the existing marks cannot be erased. When she accidentally saw her wrist, her memory completely came back. For a moment, Yao Zhi really wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl into.
Oh my God, how could he be so shameless!
However, the young man now looked as if he knew he was wrong, and looked at her pitifully, making her want to scold him but unable to.The most important thing is that the whole process was quite enjoyable, but it was really tiring, and I felt like I was about to fall apart.
In short, in order to live a few more years, it is better to be moderate in this kind of thing.
So Yao Zhi pretended to be angry and ignored him. After a while, the young man even drooped his head.
“It’s okay for you to be mad at me, but you can’t not eat…”
“If you think my cooking is not tasty enough, I can ask the chef in your house to cook it for you again…”
In this situation, how could Yao Zhi hold back?
“No need.” Just two words made the young man’s beautiful eyes light up immediately, and Yao Zhi’s heart couldn’t help but tremble.
“This is honey-fruit glutinous rice porridge, this is egg roll pancake, and this is pickled radish…”
Although they were all home-cooked dishes, they were still quite exquisite. In case she had no appetite, they specially prepared some appetising pickled radish. It was obvious that the cook had put a lot of effort into the preparation.
Between being angry and calming down, Yao Zhi couldn’t hold on to the end.
“You too… sit down and eat something with me.”
Ye Shuo was about to say that he had already eaten, but after thinking about it, he finally sat down.
After a meal, Yao Zhi’s anger had almost subsided. Strike while the iron was hot, Ye Shuo stood up, and under Yao Zhi’s puzzled gaze, he walked to the head of the bed and pulled out a wooden box from the wall side of the bed.
“What are you doing? What is this?” Yao Zhi couldn’t help but ask.
While she was stunned, Ye Shuo hurriedly opened the wooden box in front of him. Then, stacks of large banknotes came into Yao Zhi’s sight.
There were so many banknotes and the amounts were so large that even someone like Yao Zhi, who didn’t value money very much, was shocked.
“Where did you get so much money?” Yao Zhi was not stupid. She had been in the Prince Su’s Mansion for so long, how could she not know how the expenses of the Prince Su’s Mansion were?
Even if the Emperor and the Imperial Concubine subsidised him, they couldn’t subsidise so much!
Yao Zhi suddenly lost the mood to pay attention to anything else.
Ye Shuo didn’t tell everything, but he didn’t hide it either. He just said, “A few years ago, my eldest cousin from my maternal grandfather’s family and I started a business together without telling my father and mother.”
He didn’t say that this business was about selling distilled liquor, nor did he say that everyone in Beiting, from top to bottom, could no longer do without this thing.
Yao Zhi immediately understood that the emperor must not be informed of these banknotes.
Being in the royal family is like this, many things have to be hidden, such as his kung fu and the huge amount of silver bills in front of him.
It didn’t matter whether there were banknotes or not, what mattered was this secret. He told her something that even his father, the emperor, didn’t know so easily. With such trust, how could Yao Zhi not be moved?
His life in the royal family was already hard, and if doing these things could make him happy, it wouldn’t be that hard to accept. Of course, it couldn’t last that long, and Yao Zhi insisted on this.
One hour is fine, how can it last until almost dawn…
Seeing that Yao Zhi seemed to be getting softer, Ye Shuo quickly took advantage of the situation and said, “Sister Azhi, I really couldn’t control myself last night. I, I didn’t want to do that. Please forgive me…”
But in fact, how could Ye Shuo be as innocent as he said?
But Yao Zhi didn’t know. It was only after being reminded by the word “sister” that Yao Zhi realised that he was still young, having just turned twenty. Most young people don’t know their limits, so it was understandable that he went a little too far.
On the contrary, I was the one who, even though I was already 23 years old, still followed him in making trouble. This was really wrong.
What we need to do is to ask him to exercise proper self-control and gradually guide him back to the right path.
As Yao Zhi thought about this, she suddenly became certain in her heart. Then she realised that she still had to go to the palace to pay her respects to the Imperial Concubine today. But looking at the sky outside, it might have already passed the noon hour.
…Oh no!
“What are you still standing there for? Why don’t you clean up quickly?”
Ye Shuo heaved a sigh of relief and couldn’t help but said, “Don’t worry, my father said yesterday that it won’t be too late to go there at noon.”
Oh my God, he actually took it seriously. My husband is too honest.
Yao Zhi endured the discomfort and quickly asked the maid to help her dress. After all this busy work, Yao Zhi’s waist and legs became more and more sore.
Fortunately, she had practised martial arts before, so she could barely hold on.
Just as Yao Zhi was about to walk out of the room, she saw Ye Shuo walk up behind her and pick her up.
Since her current situation was caused by Ye Shuo, Ye Shuo should naturally take the responsibility.
When the maids and servants sweeping the floor saw this scene, their faces turned red and they turned their eyes away, not daring to look anymore.
Yao Zhi also blushed a little, and couldn’t help struggling: “What are you doing, so many people are watching!”
“What’s the big deal?” What’s wrong with being intimate between husband and wife? They are now legal.
Ye Shuo didn’t care. He smiled and carried Yao Zhi all the way to the carriage that had been prepared long ago. During the whole process, she didn’t even touch the ground.
About a quarter of an hour later, the carriage slowly drove into the imperial city. When Ye Shuo helped her get out of the carriage, Yao Zhi suddenly thought of something.
How could the Imperial Concubine hear my voice? As soon as I opened my mouth, I would be exposed.
Yao Zhi suddenly wanted to hit him again.
“It’s okay, my mother won’t care.” Even if she noticed, she would probably just scold him at most.
Yes, scold him.
After all, it was obvious that he was the one who did the bad thing, and his mother would not blame the girl.
As if he saw her worry, Ye Shuo hurriedly comforted her. However, despite what Ye Shuo said, Yao Zhi was still so angry that she wanted to scratch him.
At three quarters past noon, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi arrived at the gate of Qiuwu Palace together.
“Let me make this clear first. When we go in later, you have to speak for me.” Yao Zhi decided that in order not to embarrass herself, she would speak as little as possible.
Ye Shuo knew that he was in the wrong, so naturally he did not object.
The Imperial Concubine had some understanding of her son, so she didn’t expect him to come so early.
So the Imperial Concubine got up slowly, dressed slowly, had breakfast slowly, and went outside to digest the food as usual. Only then did she hear the eunuch’s report from outside.
“Prince Rui and Princess Rui are here——”
It is indeed so.
The Imperial Concubine looked up at the sky, and remembered the attitude of the girl named Yao when she talked about her son, and couldn’t help but sigh.
At first, she had thought that when her son reached marriageable age, she would definitely find someone strong to take care of him. But now, it seemed that this girl was being completely dominated by him, so she guessed that it would not work.

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Social Death
chapters.content:
Although Ye Shuo had told her in advance, today was Yao Zhi’s first time entering the palace after her wedding. She had never spent much time with the Imperial Noble Consort and didn’t know her well enough, so she inevitably felt a little nervous.
However, after the two of them finished their greetings, the Imperial Concubine acted as if she was used to it, and even said, “You got up early today. I thought it was good that you came before lunch. At least you didn’t make a fool of yourself.”
There was even a hint of praise in his words.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but be stunned.
Seeing Yao Zhi’s surprised expression, the Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but explain: “He has been like this since he was a child, so everyone doesn’t think it’s strange.”
If the Ninth Prince was not late one day, others would be surprised.
No wonder he didn’t feel anxious at all when he was in the palace…
Yao Zhi had a vague understanding in her heart.
Ye Shuo did not refute when he heard this, but just said: “We are all family, why should we be so polite?” Rules are dead, but people are alive. If we follow the rules everywhere, it would be too tiring.
It didn’t matter that he came late. The Imperial Concubine had long been too lazy to say anything to him, but he acted as if it was a matter of course, which made the Imperial Concubine angry.Didn’t he know that today was the day his wife would go to the palace to pay respects to him after her wedding? Even if he didn’t consider himself, he should at least consider Princess Rui, right?
Fortunately, I know what kind of person he is, otherwise Princess Rui would have suffered so much. This child, why is he so careless!
The Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but glared at him fiercely. When she turned her head and looked at Yao Zhi again, she couldn’t help but comfort her: “Following him, you have suffered.”
They had just gotten married, and the Imperial Concubine didn’t dare to imagine how much hardship this girl would have to endure in the future.
I don’t know how the young man offended the imperial concubine, causing her to say so. Yao Zhi subconsciously said, “I’m not wronged.”
He gave me all his fortune the day before, so how could I feel wronged?
The Imperial Concubine immediately sensed something was wrong: “Huh? What’s wrong with your voice?”
Yao Zhi froze immediately, and then she couldn’t help but look at Ye Shuo beside her.
Ye Shuo remained calm and said, “Maybe I was too tired yesterday and got angry.”
“Did I ask you a question? Why are you answering without thinking?” Yao Zhi’s action of looking back just now caused the Imperial Concubine to misunderstand. She thought that she had to consider her son’s mood even for such a small matter.
No matter how much the imperial concubine dotes on her son, she doesn’t want him to become the kind of man who only knows how to show off in front of women. Such men are the most despicable.
Ye Shuo opened his mouth to retort, but heard the Imperial Concubine say, “Since the ceremony has been completed and tea has been served, you should go outside first. I have something to say to the Princess.”
Yao Zhi’s eyes widened immediately.
This wouldn’t work. If she exposed herself later, she would need him to help her cover up.
Yao Zhi subconsciously grabbed Ye Shuo’s sleeve, and the imperial concubine’s eyes narrowed immediately.
Just when Ye Shuo was in a dilemma, he suddenly heard the voice of Eunuch Wang outside, saying that his stepfather was calling him over.
The Imperial Concubine had something to say to her daughter-in-law, and Emperor Jingwen also had something to say to his youngest son. The two of them were in perfect sync with each other.
Since the emperor had given the order, the imperial concubine simply kicked him out.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to give Yao Zhi a helpless look. Although he knew that his mother would not do anything to Yao Zhi, just in case, Ye Shuo still left Xiao Luzi behind after he went out.
The Imperial Concubine, who had given birth to two children in a row, was no longer the same as before. She was much more independent than when she first entered the palace. In addition, she had been influenced by Jianjian and had read many books and classics. She waited until her son’s back disappeared before she said, “As women, we cannot just focus on our husbands.”
The Imperial Concubine was so obsessed with and dependent on Emperor Jingwen, but what happened? In fact, looking back over the years, it was just like that.
Yao Zhi never expected the Imperial Concubine to say such a thing. She subconsciously wanted to shake her head: “I didn’t…”
broken.
The Imperial Concubine has been in this palace for a long time. What kind of situations have she not seen? The most terrifying thing is that she is deeply trapped but does not know it.
The Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but ask again: “Do you think… Shuo’er treats you well?”
“Of course.” Yao Zhi nodded.
When Jianjian came back from boxing practice, he heard this conversation.
“Sister-in-law.” Jianjian bowed to Yao Zhi, and Yao Zhi also bowed in return.
Everyone was still peaceful at this point, but as luck would have it, when Jianjian was taking off the wristband, she didn’t put it in the right place and it fell off the tray.
Yao Zhi reached out her hand almost subconsciously and caught the iron wristband steadily.
Jianjian immediately saw the purple marks on Yao Zhi’s wrist.
Didn’t my sister-in-law just get married to my brother yesterday? And she had been living in Prince Su’s mansion before, so how could she be injured?
Could it be that the uncle and aunt bullied her?
Thinking of this, Jianjian asked, “Sister-in-law, are you hurt?”
Yao Zhi was stunned for a moment, then shook her head: “No.”
“Really?”
“Really not.”
That’s too weird.
Or maybe she was hiding it on purpose, how could that be possible? If she was really wronged, she, her brother, and her mother would take care of it for her.
Jianjian thought so and worriedly said a few words to her personal maid beside her.
Yao Zhi was concentrating on answering the Imperial Concubine’s question at the moment and did not notice this.
Jianjian knew that her sister-in-law was very good at kung fu, so she didn’t throw the kettle to the ground. Instead, she pretended to be careless and was about to throw it at herself.
How could Yao Zhi allow such a thing to happen?
But what she didn’t expect was that she did catch the pot, but the water inside spilled all over her.
“Hey, sister-in-law, are you okay?”
“Li Shuang, hurry up and help my sister-in-law go to my mother’s room to change clothes.”
“No…” Yao Zhi was just about to say that it was just a little water and it would dry up after covering it for a while, but then she realised that this was the imperial palace and it would be indecent if she kept wearing wet clothes.
So Yao Zhi swallowed the second half of the sentence.
When Yao Zhi came to the inner room alone and took off half of her clothes, she suddenly woke up.
No.
Something seems wrong.
It was also because this was Qiuwu Palace, where the Imperial Concubine lived, and the one who had just made the move was Ye Shuo’s own sister, so Yao Zhi was not on guard for a moment.
When she saw the clothes that were prepared to fit her perfectly, Yao Zhi suddenly realised that she had fallen into a trap. The pot of water just now was meant for her, and as for the purpose…
Yao Zhi almost subconsciously tightened her clothes, but it was too late.
After all, this was her family’s business. Worried that someone might spread gossip, Jianjian sent everyone else away and only brought the imperial concubine in.
“Look, mother, I didn’t lie. It was indeed the people from Prince Su’s Mansion who bullied my sister-in-law!”
Jianjian is smart, but she is still young after all, and there are some things she doesn’t understand at all. Jianjian doesn’t understand, but it doesn’t mean that the imperial concubine doesn’t understand.
As an experienced person, how could the Imperial Concubine not know where the spots and marks on her daughter-in-law’s back came from? Even her wrists were not spared.
Shuo’er is a little too crazy.
Isn’t this pure bullying of a girl? No matter what, you can’t go so far!
In addition, thinking of Yao Zhi’s constant praise of how good her son was, the imperial concubine’s anger rose in her heart.
Yao Zhi was a little embarrassed when she first realised that the Imperial Concubine and the Princess had seen her upper back, but she soon stopped worrying about it because the Imperial Concubine gritted her teeth and said, “Good girl, don’t worry, your mother will take care of it for you,” and then she pulled out a cane from the vase with ease…
At the same time, on the other side, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sneeze.
Ye Shuo didn’t take it to heart. Under the guidance of Wang Ziquan, Ye Shuo stepped into the Qinzheng Hall.
Then, Ye Shuo saw the Sixth Prince sitting at his desk reviewing memorials. He remembered that many years ago, the Crown Prince was also like this, sitting there and writing down his comments word by word.
As if he had noticed his brother’s gaze, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but look up.
Seeing the dark circles under the Sixth Prince’s eyes, Ye Shuo was startled, and then blurted out: “Don’t tell me that you worked overtime again after picking up the bride yesterday.”
Given the Sixth Prince’s temperament, this is definitely something he can do.
And the fact was just as Ye Shuo said, after the Sixth Prince returned, he dealt with the accumulated matters of the day before going to bed. Then, early in the morning, before dawn, he set out from his mansion to attend court in Xuan Zheng Hall.
It was Xiaojiu who had the wedding night yesterday, so why was he so energetic?
Looking at his brother’s spirited face, the Sixth Prince was stunned.
Not to mention him, even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but frown.
Emperor Jingwen was initially worried that his youngest son would lose control after suddenly getting the girl he loved, and would act too recklessly and hurt his body. But now he is worried that he may have some hidden illness.
But Emperor Jingwen would never say such things directly. Suddenly, he thought of something and said calmly, “The imperial physician will come to check my pulse later. Since you are here, I will check your pulse as well.”
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, and then he was dumbfounded when he reacted. The Sixth Prince beside him couldn’t help laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Daily Life
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo originally wanted to resist, but was ruthlessly suppressed by Emperor Jingwen. As for the result of the imperial physician’s pulse diagnosis, it was naturally that the Ninth Prince was in good health and had no problems at all.
So he doesn’t understand at all…
Emperor Jingwen had never thought that as an emperor, he would have to worry about these things. How could he feel comfortable doing this?
But Emperor Jingwen really couldn’t help but worry about it, so after thinking about it, Emperor Jingwen’s eyes couldn’t help but fall on the Sixth Prince.
The Sixth Prince grew up with Xiaojiu since childhood. If there are things that are inconvenient for him to do in person, it is the same to ask the Sixth Prince to do it.
The Sixth Prince understood what his father meant almost immediately, and his smile froze.
No, what does this have to do with him? He, he can’t ask!
For a moment, the originally serious atmosphere in the Qinzheng Hall suddenly changed. In the end, it was Ye Shuo who spoke first to break the weird atmosphere.
“By the way, Dad, you called your son here, is there something you want to tell him?”
Ye Shuo spoke very casually, as if he was talking about daily life, but this seemingly ordinary thing was something the Sixth Prince could never do.It’s not that the Sixth Prince couldn’t get over it, but being cautious and polite would never be wrong, while being casual might lead to being convicted. Reward and punishment were just a matter of his father’s decision.
Emperor Jingwen had already gotten used to it by now and didn’t think it was a big deal, so he put aside his doubts for the time being. It just so happened that Emperor Jingwen had been sitting for a long time and felt a little tired, so he took this opportunity to walk outside and told him something.
“You stay and review these memorials. Your brother and I will go for a walk in the Imperial Garden.” Emperor Jingwen said this as he stood up.
Watching the two people leave, the Sixth Prince looked at the pile of memorials in front of him. While feeling happy, he couldn’t help but feel a little complicated.
well…
What else can I do?
It was near noon, and the sun was shining brightly outside, making people feel warm all over. Emperor Jingwen kept on giving instructions as he walked.
“Now that you are married and an adult, you must learn to be more stable and not act like a fool like before.”
“You have to know how to get along well with the princess. When you have nothing to do, don’t just think about playing. Go to your brothers’ homes more often, especially your sixth brother’s.” Being in the royal family, the relationship between brothers and sisters is not deep. If they don’t keep in touch frequently, I’m afraid that soon even the last trace of friendship will be gone.
Ye Shuo is free every day and can come to the house at any time. Moreover, the families live close to each other, basically on the same street, but the problem is that his brothers may not be happy with it…
In this regard, Ye Shuo was quite self-aware and really didn’t dare to offend Xiao Ming, especially since he only had that one son. Since the trip to Zilu Peak, he had been guarding against him like a thief. How could he dare to let him get close?
Seeing his youngest son’s face hesitant to speak, Emperor Jingwen, who also thought of this, couldn’t help but be silent. After a while, Emperor Jingwen said: “If it doesn’t work, you can pick up the job of the Ministry of Works again-“
Before Emperor Jingwen finished speaking, Ye Shuo’s head was shaking like a rattle. He had to report on time every day and go to court before dawn. Who could stand this?
Ye Shuo has been idle for so many years. Isn’t it like asking him to go to work all of a sudden?
“Dad, my brothers are all so capable. Having one less son won’t affect the family affairs at all.”
This child is too simple-minded. He has never thought about the future. He has never thought about what he will do after he is gone!
Seeing that his youngest son was still so heartless, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but sigh. Then he couldn’t help but suddenly said, “Have you ever thought about what you will do after I am gone?”
This was the first time that Emperor Jingwen raised this issue directly without any reservations.
Ye Shuo didn’t think too much about it, and subconsciously said: “Wouldn’t it be better if Dad didn’t leave?”
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
This damn kid, can he control this matter? If there is a choice, can he just let it go when he wants to? He still wants to stay on the throne as everyone in the world says, long live the emperor!
My youngest son’s mind is so simple and scary.
Emperor Jingwen should have been angry at his youngest son’s somewhat silly answer, but he really couldn’t get angry.
Besides, what he said was right. The best solution to this problem was for me to live longer. As long as I lived one more day, I could protect him for one more day.
This child is really worrying.
I am already in my fifties, and I still have to think of ways to clean up his mess every day. It is not worry-free at all. Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but feel annoyed again.
But the matter was not over yet. After enduring with great difficulty, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and continued to ask, “If the weather is not good, what if this day really comes? Have you thought about how to arrange it?”
It’s good to have a cheap dad in power, but if there is really no other way, then we can only…
“Then son can only look for the Sixth Brother.”
Dad is gone, so I can only look for my brother. This was something Ye Shuo had thought of from the beginning. Although the brother he mentioned before was the crown prince and now became the sixth prince, it didn’t make any difference overall.
The moment he finished speaking, seeing his youngest son’s matter-of-fact look, Emperor Jingwen could no longer hold back.
“You have no ambition, get out of here, get out of here!”
At this moment, Emperor Jingwen was really annoyed even if he looked at him any longer.
Why is my cheap dad getting angry again? And he was the one who asked the question first…
Ye Shuo was almost driven away by Emperor Jingwen.
“Dad, you can lose your temper, but please don’t let it get you in trouble!”
Seeing his youngest son looking back every few steps, Emperor Jingwen gritted his teeth and said, “Get away!”
The emperor clearly knew that the Ninth Prince was a hopeless case, but he still couldn’t control his anger. Wang Ziquan, who was standing by, had already gotten used to it.
After Ye Shuo’s figure completely disappeared, after a while, feeling a discomfort in his heart, Emperor Jingwen took out a heart-protecting pill and swallowed it with ease.
In recent days, His Majesty’s heart attacks have become more frequent. Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but feel a little worried: “Your Majesty…”
“Don’t worry… I’m fine…” How could Emperor Jingwen rest assured when his youngest son was in this state?
Moreover, he had just married and had no children. How could Emperor Jingwen dare to die like this?
He didn’t need to worry about the affairs of the court now, but he couldn’t rest assured until his youngest son could establish himself.
“I have to hold on…”
Before he knew it, beads of sweat covered Emperor Jingwen’s forehead. When the pain in his heart was no longer so intense, he wiped the sweat off his forehead.
Then, Emperor Jingwen said, “Don’t tell the Sixth Prince about this. If I find out who leaked the news, watch out for his head!”
The attendants, who were originally very nervous, felt their hearts tighten immediately when they heard this.
“yes.”
The other side.
When Ye Shuo walked back, a layer of worry appeared in his eyes.
My father’s health is getting worse. A few months ago, he could still walk around most of Beijing, but now he is out of breath after walking a few steps. It’s like a dam corroded by ants, and it will collapse completely at any time…
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, as soon as he entered the room, he saw that the three people in the room had unusual expressions on their faces.
Yao Zhi’s face turned red and she looked extremely embarrassed, Jianjian was confused and at a loss, and as for his mother… his mother’s eyes seemed to be spitting fire.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but blink.
Seeing that she still looked innocent, the Imperial Concubine took a deep breath and said, “Come in with your mother.”
After all, this is a matter between a young couple, shouldn’t the Imperial Concubine keep it behind closed doors?
Ye Shuo instinctively felt that it was not good, so he subconsciously looked at Yao Zhi who was standing beside him. Without waiting for Yao Zhi to help plead for mercy, the Imperial Concubine took him into the palace without saying anything.
With a “dong” sound, not only the maids and palace servants, but even Jian Jian and Yao Zhi were locked outside the door.
When there was no one around, the imperial concubine dropped the cane in her hand on Ye Shuo’s calf. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but scream.
“Mom, what are you doing!”
“What are you saying about me!”
After glaring at the little bastard fiercely, the imperial concubine took a deep breath, lowered her voice, and said, “You are courting death! You have just got married, and you are so reckless! A girl, with a delicate body, how can she bear such torment from you.”
Perhaps it was because her son was too energetic, and the Imperial Concubine couldn’t bear to think of ruining his health.
In an instant, Ye Shuo understood what happened and subconsciously said, “Mom, listen to my explanation!”
“Okay, you explain.” The Imperial Concubine was not completely unreasonable, but there must be a legitimate reason, right?
Yes, Ye Shuo suddenly remembered, how should this matter be explained?
Seeing this, the Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but sigh: “Since you are sincere in asking for marriage, I won’t say anything, but you don’t treat her well after marrying her. What do you want to do?”
As a mother, she may not care about the background of her son’s wife, but she cannot watch him continue to act like this.
“Mom just wants to ask you, do you really like me?”
“Of course!”
The Imperial Concubine thought that there was something wrong with her education, but she didn’t know if it was too late to remedy the situation now.
“Since you really like her, you should learn to consider her. Even though this girl is bewitched by you now, as a person who has experienced this, I have to remind you here. Don’t think that you are a prince or a king and you can squander the sincerity of the girl you like. If you do too much, I am afraid that you will regret it, too late.”
A woman’s sincerity is limited. The imperial concubine was afraid that he was too young to understand the importance of it, and would regret it when he lost her, ending up with a miserable old age.
He was young and proud, and his parents spoiled him too much, so it was inevitable that he didn’t know how to cherish things and didn’t know that he needed peace in the family, which was the only way for him to live a comfortable life.
Over the years, the Imperial Concubine has seen so much in the palace.
“Mom, I know what I am doing.” Ye Shuo also knew that his mother was doing this for his own good, but the situation here was difficult to explain clearly, so misunderstandings were inevitable.
The more his mother acted like this, the more at ease Ye Shuo felt. Looking at the current situation, he didn’t have to worry about his princess and his mother not getting along.
The Imperial Concubine was still a little worried after hearing this: “Do you really know your limits?”
Ye Shuo swore: “Of course!”
The Imperial Concubine stared at him for a long time. Seeing that his expression was not fake, she reluctantly put down the cane in her hand: “…Okay, I will trust you again.”
“I knew that mother is the best to me! No matter what, it’s all for the good of her son!” Ye Shuo quickly threw the cane onto the wardrobe that his mother couldn’t reach, and couldn’t help but hug her arms.
“You’re already so old, but you’re still so annoying…”
Although the Imperial Concubine complained, she had a smile on her face.
Yao Zhi waited outside for a long time with a troubled look on her face. Only when the door was reopened and the young man was still alive and kicking did she breathe a sigh of relief.
At first Ye Shuo was quite normal, but after lunch, when the two of them were getting ready to leave the palace in the carriage, Ye Shuo’s true colours were immediately revealed.
“Sister Azhi, my mother just beat me with a cane, it hurt so much!”
Looking at the red marks on the young man’s calf, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel distressed, but she couldn’t blame the Imperial Concubine. No matter what the Imperial Concubine was thinking, Yao Zhi was already content that she could do this.
Yao Zhi has heard a lot about these things over the years.
“You deserve it. Let’s see if you dare to mess around again in the future.”
Back at Prince Rui’s mansion, Yao Zhi complained while applying medicine to him.
Lying in Yao Zhi’s arms, hugging her waist, and feeling the faint medicinal fragrance coming from Yao Zhi’s body, at this moment, Ye Shuo felt that he was about to die of happiness.
All he wanted in his two lifetimes was just such an easy and happy life.
Putting his robe back down, Ye Shuo said, “Come, I’ll help you rub your waist too.”
“Don’t!” How could Yao Zhi dare to let him touch her? She immediately hid eight feet away.
“It won’t work in the next two days. Let’s wait and see…”
Ye Shuo swore to heaven that he was not thinking nonsense just now!
After playing for a while, Yao Zhi was also tired, so the two of them slept in the room for most of the day and didn’t wake up until the evening. Then they got up to eat.
Knowing that His Royal Highness Prince Rui likes to eat, the kitchen always has various things prepared.
