Three days passed in a flash. When Ye Shuo returned home three days later, he could almost feel the undisguised disgust of Huo Tianyi and others. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at Yao Zhi who was standing beside him.
“Sister Azhi…”
Huo Tianyi and others: “…”
This boy is so shameless! He doesn’t look like a prince at all!
But Yao Zhi was not so stupid after all, and she would not do anything to go against her master for Ye Shuo. It was just that Huo Tianyi and others saw her in trouble, and they really couldn’t bear it, so they could only accept it.
Just as Ye Shuo was arguing with the other masters, the second master sighed, then pulled her disciple aside and asked in a low voice: “Do you still find it hard to manage the affairs of the palace?”
Seeing her disciple in a daze, the second master thought that Ye Shuo had not handed over the power of housekeeper to her, and her heart sank.
However, what the Second Master didn’t know was that it was not the case at all.
Yao Zhi was born in the countryside and had been in the underworld for so many years that she knew the prices of goods at the bottom very well. She knew exactly whether the accounts in the palace matched or not, so there was basically no possibility of fooling around.
Since Yao Zhi was particularly knowledgeable about money, she controlled the financial power of the palace, which was equivalent to controlling the lifeline of the people below. Naturally, no one dared to make trouble for her.
Of course, there were some cases of lip service and double-crossing in the palace, but Ye Shuo had already said that the matter was entirely up to the princess, and some troublemakers felt that the princess’ status was not high enough and wanted to break the law themselves, forgetting that although Yao Zhi had a chivalrous heart, she was not a soft-hearted person.
On the contrary, it is precisely because she has seen so many things that she knows better what to let go and what not to let go.
In Yao Zhi’s opinion, they receive such a high monthly salary but are still so unsatisfied. If the water is too clear, there will be no fish. It would be fine if they just take a little bit of oil as a subsidy, but it is really hateful that they are so greedy!
After Yao Zhi dealt with several people quickly and efficiently, no one dared to do the same again.
They thought the prince would no longer care about the matter, so they could finally take advantage of the situation. However, it turned out that the new princess was also very powerful, so everyone gave up all thoughts.
The staff structure of the palace is simple, with only three masters in total. Basically, they only need to spend two or three hours every month to check the accounts. In this case, wouldn’t Yao Zhi, who regards eating and sleeping in the open air as normal, feel relaxed?
Yao Zhi didn’t think so before, but now that the second master reminded her, she suddenly woke up.
“Thank you for your reminder, Second Master. We really can’t go on like this.”
Beautiful woman: “?”
Yao Zhi said so, and she did so. After returning to the mansion, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but ask: “On a daily basis, as the prince, what do you need me to do as the princess?”
You can’t say that you have nothing to do, right?
“You’re talking about this…” Ye Shuo scratched his head.
“Then we have a lot to do. Let me think about it…”
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but become serious.
Ye Shuo began to count on his fingers, “My father is not in good health right now. I have to go to the palace to see him at least half of the time in a month, accompany him fishing, playing chess, or just go shopping with him.”
“As for the rest of the time… in the morning, I go out to eat snacks and listen to storytelling. At noon, I go to Zuixinglou to try new dishes. In the afternoon, I listen to opera. When I get tired, I get a back massage. In the evening, I soak in hot springs and eat barbecue. Or I go hunting in the suburbs…”
So many things happened to Yao Zhi during the two months she lived in the mansion that she had no idea what Ye Shuo’s daily life was like. Now, after listening to him talk about it one by one, she found that it was completely different from what Princess Su had taught her.
Now it was Yao Zhi’s turn to be stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Im Sick
chapters.content:
Although the young man said a lot, it can be summed up in one word – play.
“Don’t you need to go to court or something?” When Yao Zhi was in Prince Su’s mansion, Prince Su had to get up before dawn every day and then take a carriage to the imperial city. Yao Zhi thought he was the same, but only had a few days of free time because he had just gotten married.
Besides, Princess Su once said that every prince had to attend court when he was fifteen or sixteen years old.
“Ah? No need.” Ye Shuo shook his head immediately after hearing that.
Yao Zhi was stunned for a moment: “Then…what about the tea party, poetry party, and flower party?”
Princess Su would go out from time to time, and she took her out a few times, so Yao Zhi made a special trip to learn. She was not the best at poetry competitions, which was not embarrassing, but she was very good at pitching pots, so overall she was not weak.
As for the young men, ladies, princesses and princes inside, although not all of them are very friendly, at most they just compete with words, which is better than those who always resort to knives and guns.
These princes and nobles were extremely reserved in their words, and they were well aware of the principle of leaving a way out for future encounters. Therefore, unless it was a life-and-death feud, it was extremely rare for them to openly praise someone and secretly criticize him, or even humiliate him to death. Yao Zhi had only heard of it, but had never actually encountered it.
Yao Zhi had almost figured out the tricks after going there twice, but he suddenly told her today that it was totally unnecessary?
“Not that it’s unnecessary.” Ye Shuo scratched his head.“The main reason is that I don’t really like those kinds of occasions. I always feel uncomfortable.”
There were quite a few invitations sent to Prince Rui’s Palace, and there were piles of them at the housekeeper’s place, but Ye Shuo had never been there once.
“But if you like, you can go and have fun.”
Ye Shuo was not afraid of her being bullied. First, Yao Zhi’s personality was there. Second, he was now a core figure in the first echelon of the Great Zhou nobles, and his princess was also included in the group. So even if there were really people who didn’t like them, they could only flatter them. At worst, they would just ignore it. Who would be so stupid as to offend them?
Hearing this, Yao Zhi was a little surprised: “But the aunt said that this would help the uncle…”
This is indeed the case.
“No way, who asked the uncle to help the father do the work?” It’s easier to get things done if there’s someone in the court. The same applies to the princes with real power. How can he carry out his work without cooperation? In addition, the transmission of various messages is a tacit understanding in the core circle. Otherwise, how can some things and responsibilities be avoided so easily? This is a tacit understanding among everyone.
But the key point is that Ye Shuo doesn’t need to do anything, so whether they cooperate or not has nothing to do with him? No matter how stubborn these people are, can they be more stubborn than their cheap father and Xiao Ming?
As long as they stand high enough, it doesn’t matter whether they go or not.
Another reason is that if you stay at home for too long, you will inevitably feel stuffy. These gatherings also give women a reason to go out and play, but Ye Shuo will not restrict his wife. She can leave the house at any time, so it doesn’t matter whether there are gatherings or not.
Now, there is one less thing Yao Zhi needs to do.
Yao Zhi thought for a moment and said, “I see there are many shops under the name of the palace.” When Ye Shuo left the palace to build a mansion, both the imperial concubine and the emperor provided him with a lot of subsidies, and there were a lot of farms, shops and fields.
Princess Su also reminded her of this at the time, and Yao Zhi learned a lot from her.
But for Ye Shuo, his energy is limited after all, and he cannot manage the operation of the shop one by one, so he just needs to know how to use people.
He couldn’t manage so many things, so why not find a few people to manage them separately? As long as he controlled these people, it would be like controlling all the industries in his hands.
In feudal society, as a prince, it was extremely easy for him to investigate someone.
An assessment is conducted every three months, or once a quarter, to compare the profitability of the shop in the hands of several people. Those who deserve rewards will be rewarded, and those who deserve punishments will be punished. That’s about it.
Since there are competitors among them, Ye Shuo is not afraid that they will collude and undermine him.
So basically, Ye Shuo only needs to inspect the place every once in a while, look at the account book, and then wait to collect the money. They will find ways to make more money themselves.
After listening to this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but fall into deep thought.
In other words, apart from the identity of princess, there doesn’t seem to be much change in other aspects.
Ye Shuo’s last sentence completely reassured Yao Zhi.
“As our mother and father’s favourite son and daughter-in-law, we don’t have to worry about anything else. We just need to think about how to make them happy.”
Looking at the young man lazily lying there, Yao Zhi vaguely felt that life after marrying the prince was a little different from what she had imagined.
At the same time, she finally understood why Princess Su had such a strange expression when she said so much to her, as if she wanted to say something but didn’t say it.
But it’s better this way. Since he doesn’t fight or compete, I don’t have to worry about whether I can single-handedly rescue him from Shangjing City when something happens to him.
“Come on, come on, don’t just stand there. I just hired a female doctor who has great skills. Come and try it out.”
As he spoke, Ye Shuo pulled Yao Zhi to the chaise longue next to him.
I have to say that as long as you are willing to spend money, the quality of the doctor will be high. Just looking at the technique of pressing acupoints, you will know that he is much better than ordinary doctors.
When Ye Xun came out of the ancestral hall and passed by here, this was the scene he saw.
Ye Xun’s breathing stagnated and his footsteps also paused.
Seeing the Ninth Prince looking at him, Ye Xun instinctively felt that something was wrong, but before he could escape, he was caught by Ye Shuo.
Massage and bone correction should not be considered as entertainment activities…
What’s more, the child has been in a bad mood recently. I believe that his third brother in heaven would be able to understand.
Ye Shuo didn’t say anything and had someone bring over a chaise longue.
About half an incense stick later, the number of people in the yard increased from one to three.
The three of them stood in a row, Ye Shuo lay in the middle, letting the afternoon breeze blow across his cheeks. This scene couldn’t be more comfortable.
Perhaps they were infected by him, and eventually, Yao Zhi and Ye Xun also gradually relaxed.
What’s more, Ye Xun didn’t even know when he fell asleep, and in the end it was Ye Shuo who asked someone to send him back.
This kind of life is good, but after a long time, Yao Zhi always felt uneasy, so she only enjoyed it with Ye Shuo for four or five days, and then returned to her usual routine, getting up before dawn every day to practise sword.
Looking at her husband who was still sleeping soundly in the bed, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but laugh.
But such days did not last long. When Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had been married for about three or four months, just as autumn began, Emperor Jingwen fell ill.
It was night when he got the news. Without caring about anything else, Ye Shuo just put on some clothes and entered the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Treatment
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo’s movements were extremely slight. He had not intended to wake Yao Zhi up, but Yao Zhi’s hearing was extremely sensitive, and due to her habit of wandering outside for many years, she woke up when Xiao Luzi knocked on the door.
So Ye Shuo just put on a cloak and came out. Before he reached the gate of the palace, Yao Zhi had changed her clothes and caught up with him.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say: “Just continue sleeping, there’s no need to…”
Yao Zhi shook her head: “I’ll go with you.”
My father’s health has not been good to begin with. If this time… Yao Zhi suddenly didn’t dare to think about it anymore.
So when Qingfeng appeared, Yao Zhi jumped on the horse without saying a word.
Qingfeng was a gift from the eldest prince. It was an extremely fierce horse, but now this fierce horse was particularly docile under Yao Zhi’s crotch.
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate after hearing that. He took a deep breath and sat on the horse as well. Then he pulled the reins hard and his eyes changed instantly: “Gee—”
The situation was urgent and it was too late to take a carriage.
Qingfeng rushed out like an arrow. After curfew, the sound of horse hooves in the empty street was like thunder that pierced the sky. Two figures flashed by like lightning and disappeared completely in a short while.In less than half an incense stick of time, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi arrived at the gate of the imperial city.
“Who is it?”
Watching from afar, the commander-in-chief of the Black Armor Guards instinctively became alert, but when his hawk-like eyes saw the familiar face behind him, he was startled and immediately relieved.
Then he took a deep breath and said, “Open the door.”
Obviously, the commander-in-chief also knew what was happening in the palace at the moment.
A “creaky” sound was heard. Looking at the open gate of the imperial city in front of him, Ye Shuo didn’t even raise his head, and without any pause, he rode his horse and rushed in.
The black-armoured guards guarding the imperial city nearby broke out in cold sweats upon seeing this.
“Commander-in-chief, this is against the rules…”
Riding a horse within the palace walls is a capital crime. Not only will Prince Rui and Princess Rui be punished, but they will also have to suffer the consequences.
His Royal Highness Prince Rui is a little too bold.
However, the commander-in-chief was not worried. Extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures. What’s more…how could the emperor blame His Royal Highness Prince Rui for such a small matter?
“Don’t worry about it. The emperor will make the decision.”
Seeing that the commander-in-chief didn’t care, the black-armoured guards next to him naturally didn’t dare to say anything more.
In front of Chengming Palace, when he heard the loud sound of horse hooves, for a moment Wang Ziquan thought there was something wrong with his ears. But when he saw the Ninth Prince, he suddenly didn’t find it strange anymore.
This really seems like something the Ninth Prince would do.
“Whoa–” Ye Shuo turned over and got off the horse. He did not stay for long. He threw the whip to the eunuch beside him who opened his mouth wide and wished his chin would drop to the ground. Ye Shuo stepped over the threshold and walked straight into the hall.
As he walked, he asked, “How is Father doing now?”
Wang Ziquan regained his consciousness, but remained silent after hearing this. After a moment, he said, “Your Highness, you will know if you go and take a look.”
As soon as Ye Shuo walked into Chengming Hall, he saw a group of concubines and underage princesses kneeling there. As for the princes, they had probably just received the news and had not had time to arrive yet. Ye Shuo could be said to be the first to arrive.
Not seeing his mother, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask, “Where are my mother and Jian Jian?”
Wang Ziquan said: “To reply to Your Highness, the Imperial Noble Consort and the Seventh Princess are both inside now.”
Only then did Ye Shuo feel relieved.
Looking at the mess in front of him, as he was about to step into the inner hall, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at Yao Zhi beside him. After hesitating for a while, he opened his mouth and said in a voice that only the two of them could hear: “Can you please help keep an eye on it later?”
Ye Shuo didn’t want to suspect anyone, but… the situation was urgent after all, so Ye Shuo had to be a little cautious and put safety first in everything.
When Yao Zhi heard this, she turned her head away almost instantly.
What he meant by this was… Could it be that someone else dared to murder the emperor?
Although Yao Zhi had been far away from the martial arts world before, he had still heard of the name of Emperor Jingwen. Compared with the previous emperor, he was really an emperor who was very diligent. Under such circumstances, the people below him naturally would not want him to die. Even if they wanted to rebel, they could not do so at all.
So the only person who might want to kill him is…
Yao Zhi nodded calmly, indicating that she understood and would be more careful later.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and then pushed open the tightly closed door of the inner hall.
Then, he saw the Imperial Concubine and Jianjian, both with worried faces.
After all, they have been together for many years. Although the Imperial Noble Concubine has become more open-minded than before, she still has feelings for Emperor Jingwen and cannot completely turn a blind eye to him.
Not to mention Jianjian. Ever since she could remember, Emperor Jingwen had always been an excellent father in her heart. Coupled with the natural closeness of children to their parents, her feelings for Emperor Jingwen were even deeper.
If Jianjian really wasn’t moved at all, then that would be a real problem.
Ye Shuo subconsciously looked in the direction of the dragon bed and found that his cheap father had a fever and his face was red. He also had convulsions from time to time. It was really serious.
Ye Shuo’s expression couldn’t help but change slightly.
Just at this moment, Emperor Jingwen’s body twitched again. The young eunuchs and palace maids were afraid of hurting the emperor’s body, so they didn’t dare to move at all. The imperial concubine was not strong enough. Jian Jian was strong enough, but she was still young after all, and had never studied medicine. How could she know what to do?
Ye Shuo was an adult after all, so he looked at the imperial physician beside him. The imperial physician spoke hurriedly and according to the instructions, Ye Shuo deftly stuffed a clean soft cloth into Emperor Jingwen’s mouth to prevent him from biting his tongue, and then controlled his limbs in time. After a long while, Ye Shuo’s body stiffened, and Emperor Jingwen gradually calmed down.
“What’s going on?” He slowly tried to let go, and seeing that his cheap father stopped struggling, Ye Shuo finally had time to wipe the sweat off his forehead. Then, he looked at the palace servants standing by.
“How did it become like this?”
The last words were naturally Wang Ziquan’s: “Reporting to His Majesty Prince Rui, this afternoon, His Majesty was strolling in the garden when he accidentally got caught in the rain, and by the evening, he became like this now.”
The current Emperor Jingwen is like a willow catkin in the wind or a candle in the rain. He cannot withstand the slightest storm. The slightest mishap may cost him his life.
Ye Shuo then remembered that there was indeed a slight drizzle of rain in the afternoon, but it stopped after a cup of tea. Ye Shuo did not take it seriously at the time, but he never thought that his stepfather would become like this.
But despite this, in Yao Zhi’s opinion, it was still somewhat abnormal for an adult to be burned like this.
High fever accompanied by convulsions is something that only happens in childhood. Even though Emperor Jingwen was in such poor health, it shouldn’t have been so serious.
Yao Zhi thought about it, then sat down on the edge of the bed under everyone’s gaze, and then she took the pulse and examined him. Then she picked up the medicine bowl next to her and sniffed it carefully.
After a moment, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but frown.
“Where’s the recipe? Can you let me take a look?”
The imperial physician hesitated for a moment, then handed over several prescriptions he had written previously.
Yao Zhi was a little sceptical at first, but now after reading the prescription, she is more certain: “Why is the prescription like this? Why don’t they use these two herbs?”
Yao Zhi skillfully called out the names of two medicines, and the imperial physician’s expression immediately became embarrassing.
Ye Shuo understood it almost instantly. It was all due to his conservatism. Especially since his adoptive father’s health was getting worse, the imperial doctors naturally did not dare to act rashly.
It’s not that the imperial physician’s medical skills are bad, but under the oppression of imperial power, he can only display 50% of his full ability.
But at this time, delaying the emperor’s treatment would be a serious crime.
But this imperial physician is my stepfather’s man, and Ye Shuo has no right to deal with him. When my stepfather wakes up, he will settle accounts with him.
We can’t keep dragging it out like this. If it keeps burning, my cheap dad will really be burned to death. Ye Shuo took a deep breath and asked, “If it were you, how would you treat it?”
Yao Zhi thought about it, then picked up the paper and pen that the imperial physician had just used and wrote down her own prescription.
“If it were me, I would use the medicine this way.”
The imperial physician looked at them one by one and was shocked: “Absolutely not!”
“The drug is so powerful, and His Majesty’s body is so weak, how can this be done?”
The imperial physician had been in the palace for decades and was used to mediocrity, so it was inevitable that he found it difficult to accept for a while.
Although Yao Zhi was Mei Yingzhuo’s apprentice, she was not as evil as Mei Yingzhuo. Normally, she would not act like this, but…
“Extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures. Time has dragged on for too long. Ordinary medicines are no longer effective on Father. Only drastic measures can give him a glimmer of hope.”
Ye Shuo: “How sure are you?”
Yao Zhi thought for a moment and said, “Three points.”
Ye Shuo’s grip tightened immediately.
If my cheap father were awake now, we could discuss the matter with him. But now that he is no longer mentally stable, only they can make the decision.
Just at this moment, the Sixth Prince and his entourage finally arrived in a carriage.
The fifth prince, the sixth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince all had their own thoughts, but their faces showed worry and nervousness. As for how much of this worry and nervousness was true and how much was false, only they themselves knew it.
After hearing the current situation, the Fifth Prince and the others fell silent almost instantly.
To be honest, they didn’t want to make this choice at all. In their hearts, they even felt a little resentful of Yao Zhi for exposing the imperial physician. If they didn’t know, wouldn’t it be better to just let it go in confusion?
After all, if a bad choice led to the death of the emperor, how would the world view them if the news got out? Filial piety comes first, and the world would criticise them. Who could bear such a big accusation?
Ye Shuo noticed the changes in their eyes and naturally guessed what they were thinking.
However, what the Fifth Prince and the others did not know was that Ye Shuo had no intention of forcing them, nor did he intend to force them, and Ye Shuo was even more unwilling to tie them up.
What does reputation matter? Living is the most important thing.
In ancient times, there was neither the Internet nor cameras, so even most of the people in the capital did not recognize him, let alone people in more distant places.
His stepfather’s current condition could not be delayed any longer, so Ye Shuo did not hesitate and pulled the Sixth Prince aside.
Xiao Jiu didn’t look for anyone else but him. At this moment, the Sixth Prince felt his scalp tingling. Just as he was thinking about how to shirk this matter, he heard him say, “Since this was my idea, the consequences will naturally be borne by me.”
“But Sixth Brother, if something really happens, can you only punish me? Don’t implicate my mother Jianjian, especially Azhi. Just treat it as your brother begging you.”
This was the first time that Ye Shuo properly called the Sixth Prince “brother”.
The Sixth Prince never expected him to say this. He was stunned, and then he suddenly couldn’t say anything he had in mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Fever Subsides
chapters.content:
To be honest, Xiaojiu’s behavior was really tactless, but at the same time, it also made people feel at ease.
Who wouldn’t want someone to choose them without considering anything else when they are lying in bed unable to move?
Perhaps the royal family lacks true love, so people like him are even more precious. His father’s love for him was not in vain.
Looking into his eyes, the deep resentment hidden in the Sixth Prince’s heart suddenly dissipated a lot.
To be honest, if the Sixth Prince were allowed to choose, he would definitely not be able to do it.
Now that the most critical moment has come, the Sixth Prince did not attack his father, not because he had deep feelings for Emperor Jingwen. There was affection, but it was just a child’s natural admiration for his father. Compared with the position so close, it was really not worth mentioning.
The reason why the Sixth Prince did not take any action was that he was worried that his father would have a backup plan and that people would say that he did not come to the throne legitimately.
The Sixth Prince not only wants that position, he also wants to be legitimate and popular.
The emperor’s health has not been good to begin with, and it will only last for one or two years at most. The Sixth Prince has waited for so many years, so a little more time will not be a problem. As long as he lives a peaceful and honest life, the throne will almost certainly fall on his head. There is really no need for him to do anything unnecessary and cause trouble.
The Sixth Prince is much more patient than the Crown Prince at the time. He has been taking every step carefully for more than 20 years without making any mistakes. His endurance is far beyond that of ordinary people. Even Ye Shuo cannot compare to him.Now that Xiaojiu had spoken like this, the Sixth Prince thought about it and decided not to play dumb anymore.
“If there is something wrong, I will do my best to plead with you and the Imperial Concubine. As for the rest, please don’t say anything nonsense.”
Especially whether to punish or not, what kind of status can punish a prince? My father is still alive.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about the loopholes in the words at all. It was just a mere topic of conversation. If Xiao Ming liked him, he wouldn’t care at all. If Xiao Ming didn’t like him, then no matter how careful he was, it would be useless.
Although the Sixth Prince is not a gentleman who keeps his word, his words are basically trustworthy.
After receiving a positive answer, Ye Shuo turned around and handed the prescription to the imperial physician beside him.
“Since what the princess said is true, then you should prescribe the medicine as directed. If anything goes wrong, I will take full responsibility.”
This, this is absolutely not allowed!
When the imperial physician heard this, he broke out in a cold sweat. He really didn’t dare to agree. The imperial physicians hurriedly looked at the other princes.
The Fifth Prince was the first one to stand up. To be honest, the Fifth Prince still believed in his younger brother. The one he did not trust was the Sixth Prince.
The two of them were whispering to each other just now and no one knew what they were talking about. It would be bad if the younger brother was deceived by the Sixth Prince who was sinister by nature.
Now if something happens to my father, with the Sixth Prince’s current momentum, the throne will have to fall on his head. It’s too risky, it’s safer to listen to the imperial physician.
So the Fifth Prince said, “No, I don’t agree!”
Although the Seventh Prince did not speak, he rarely went against the Fifth Prince, which made his attitude clear.
The Eighth Prince followed closely behind: “Xiaojiu, you can’t take responsibility for your father’s life. You don’t have the final say on such matters.”
Or maybe, this will be an opportunity.
The Sixth Prince’s rise after the Crown Prince is unstoppable. If they continue like this, they will never be able to turn things around. Now, perhaps they can make a fuss about their father’s affairs and maybe bring him down. If they can shift the blame onto the Sixth Prince, they might still have a chance to turn the tables.
As for how to proceed, I have to think about it carefully…
Almost in an instant, this thought came into the mind of the Eighth Prince.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t care what they were thinking or planning at this moment. Ye Shuo only knew that time waits for no one. How could he have the time to talk nonsense with them?
“If you want to stay, then shut up. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude.” Since they were unwilling to make a choice and unwilling to bear the blame, Ye Shuo respected their opinions, but at the same time, they had no reason to get in the way here anymore.
Ye Shuo even used force to deter others.
The eyes of the Fifth Prince and the others widened almost instantly. They never expected that their younger brother would say such words.
The fifth prince looked incredulous: “You are a prince, and we are also princes. We are of the same rank, and we are the elders. Why do you want to kick us out?”
The Eighth Prince followed closely behind: “Don’t forget, your good Sixth Brother is not the Crown Prince yet!”
Upon hearing this, the Sixth Prince’s face tensed up, and he vaguely knew what they were planning.
Yao Zhi on the side thought about it and stood up without much hesitation. After all, she was a gangster and had no family background. She could run away at any time with her master, so she didn’t care so much.
It didn’t take Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi long at all to throw the Fifth Prince and his men out.
The most important thing was that Yao Zhi was the one who took action, especially the one who wanted to harm Ye Shuo, she was the most ruthless.
How could the Fifth Prince and his men be a match for Yao Zhi? They were almost beaten to a pulp.
The door was closed with a “bang”, and it was finally quiet. Ye Shuo then looked at the group of imperial doctors standing beside him with a glare as sharp as a knife.
“Now I have taken all the blame for you. You must do your best and don’t hide anything. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude!”
Wherever Ye Shuo’s eyes went, the imperial doctors’ backs could not help but sweat. Under the intimidation of Ye Shuo, the imperial doctors finally took action.
This was the first time Jianjian saw her brother look so serious. He seemed quite imposing…
Jianjian was a little stunned.
Although Ye Shuo could still live well without the skin of a prince, no one wanted to give away something they had already obtained for no reason. Therefore, when Ye Shuo sat next to his adoptive father again, he couldn’t help but sigh deeply.
“Dad, you must show some courage this time, otherwise your son will really have to run away this time.”
Not long after, the imperial physician brought over a bowl of medicine. Seeing this, Ye Shuo quickly made way.
Because everyone’s attention was on Emperor Jingwen’s face at this moment, no one noticed that his fingers under the quilt moved violently a few times, as if he was struggling to wake up, but unfortunately, his body could not continue at this moment. After a while, Emperor Jingwen was forced to calm down.
After drinking several bowls of medicine, Ye Shuo felt it was too bitter.
Since it concerned the safety of her husband’s father and himself, Yao Zhi naturally tried her best, almost using up all her medical skills. She did everything she should do, especially when Yao Zhi was giving acupuncture. The hearts of the imperial doctors beside her almost broke several times.
Princess Rui and Prince Rui are truly a couple; each one is bolder than the other and they dare to challenge His Majesty no matter what.
By the second half of the night, Yao Zhi had done almost everything she could, and she was so tense that even she couldn’t help feeling sleepy.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at Wang Ziquan standing beside him.
Wang Ziquan understood and said hurriedly, “Thank you for your hard work, Princess. Please go to the side hall with me to rest.”
Logically speaking, the emperor was seriously ill, and Yao Zhi should have stayed here all night, but she had already done so much, and it was enough.
Anyway, he had already done enough wrong things tonight, so one or two more wouldn’t make a difference. Ye Shuo ignored everyone’s gazes and let Yao Zhi go to rest.
Yao Zhi was unwilling at first, but in the end she was unable to persuade Ye Shuo.
Hearing the sound of the door opening, the Fifth Prince and others who had been waiting outside looked over almost instantly. However, Yao Zhi’s expression remained unchanged, and she walked out almost under their gaze.
I really can’t take care of her now. The most important thing is how my father is doing.
Now that the medicine has been used and the acupuncture has been performed, the rest depends on my cheap dad himself. If he can successfully reduce the fever before dawn, there is still hope. If not, I’m afraid all hope is over.
“Sixth Brother and I will be the ones to guard here. You and Jianjian should go and have a rest first, so as not to tire yourself out.”
Not only Yao Zhi, Ye Shuo also drove his mother and Jian Jian to the side hall to rest. As soon as the Imperial Concubine and Jian Jian walked out of the room, the Fifth Prince and his men swarmed in.
But it was too late for them to come in now. Looking at the empty medicine bowls and his brother lying on the table, ready to take a nap, how could they not know what had happened?
The fifth prince gritted his teeth and said, “Xiaojiu, you are so brave!”
“Yes, yes, you are all right.” Anyway, the medicine has been fed to the emperor, and they can’t just pull the medicine out of their cheap father’s throat.
Ye Shuo was so tired that he really didn’t have the energy to argue with them.
After saying this perfunctorily, Ye Shuo closed his eyes decisively. For a moment, he didn’t know whether to fight or not fight the Fifth Prince.
The Eighth Prince also spoke up: “If I find out what you did in there, you two just wait and see!”
If there was really something wrong, the cheap master hiding in the dark would have come out long ago. But now the cheap master hasn’t moved at all, which is enough to explain the problem.
The secret guards didn’t make any move, so what they said naturally didn’t count.
In just half a cup of tea, Ye Shuo fell into a deep sleep.
When the Fifth Prince saw this, he was so angry that he almost died.
The Sixth Prince was also very sleepy, but he couldn’t do whatever he wanted like his younger brother, so he just found a chair to sit down and rest for a while.
Now that things have come to this, there is no point in saying more. Let’s just wait for the results.
The Fifth Prince and the others took a deep breath, and soon found their seats.
However, as the saying goes, “Good fortune never comes alone, and misfortune never comes singly.” As if it weren’t for the rain, the next morning, before Emperor Jingwen had made any move, an urgent message came from the border of the Great Zhou Dynasty, saying that the situation on the battlefield had undergone new changes.
There is no way. Emperor Jingwen is definitely unable to take charge now, so the Sixth Prince can only help deal with it.
The Sixth Prince had just closed his eyes, and before he even had time to greet others, he was forced to rush to discuss with He Xiang and the others. The noise was so loud that even Ye Shuo was woken up.
Just at this moment, Wang Ziquan, who had been guarding beside Emperor Jingwen without resting for even a moment, seemed to have discovered something and suddenly shouted loudly –
“The fever has subsided, Your Majesty, the fever has subsided!”
I actually made the right bet…
This time, almost everyone was alarmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Stunned
chapters.content:
Sometimes, some things are not entirely due to luck.
“Father, are you okay? How do you feel?” Seeing Emperor Jingwen open his eyes, the Fifth Prince and others rushed over.
Although Emperor Jingwen’s fever had subsided and he had opened his eyes, he was too weak to speak. Only his eyeballs could move, and he couldn’t even lift his arms.
Ignoring the five princes, Emperor Jingwen’s gaze passed through them and fell directly on his youngest son.
While Ye Shuo felt relieved, he saw that his brothers were making too much noise, so he pushed them all aside without saying anything.
“Come on, come on, make way, keep your voices down, or else don’t blame me for being rude.”
Ye Shuo has now completely let go.
Anyway, the offence has already been committed. It is an offence if you offend once, and it is an offence if you offend several times. So let it be.
Ye Shuo doesn’t like to get used to others, it’s always others who get used to him.
Caught off guard, the Fifth Prince and others staggered to and fro. After the Fifth Prince stood firm, he looked at him with eyes that seemed to be filled with anger.Ye Shuo didn’t take it to heart at all. He sat down on the bedside of his stepfather, reached out and touched his forehead. He found that it was indeed not as hot as before, so he stretched out a finger and asked, “Dad, don’t be stunned. Look here. Can you tell your son, what number is this?”
The Fifth Prince, who was full of complaints and wanted to say something, shut his mouth instantly when he saw this.
Forget it, why bother with him!
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Seeing that his cheap father remained silent for a long time and looked at him like a wooden stick, Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly skipped a beat: “It’s bad, he’s burned stupid.”
Ye Shuo hurriedly began to shout: “Azhi, Azhi, come over quickly——”
Emperor Jingwen used up almost all his strength to grab his arm.
“Stop…shouting…!”
My youngest son is good in every way except for this erratic habit. I don’t know when he will be able to change.
As soon as he woke up, Emperor Jingwen’s eyelids began to twitch.
Fearing that he would be embarrassed again, Emperor Jingwen, who did not want to answer such an insulting question, controlled himself and said with great difficulty: “Yes, yes.”
Only then did Ye Shuo breathe a sigh of relief.
“I…I’m fine now, all of you…all go out…”
It would be fine if he had no choice, but if he had a choice, Emperor Jingwen would not want to show his weak side in front of others, even if the other person was his own son.
After staying up all night, Ye Shuo was already very sleepy. Now that his adoptive father had woken up, there were naturally imperial physicians to take care of him, and there were so many palace servants, so he was not needed at all. So Ye Shuo nodded subconsciously.
However, the Fifth Prince and others had just the opposite opinion. They thought that when their father was unconscious, he could neither hear nor see anything they did, so what was the point? But things were different after he woke up.
then……
“Yes, Dad. Son will go to rest now.” This is Ye Shuo.
“Father is not feeling well right now. Your sons and I are willing to wait here.” These are the Fifth Prince and his entourage.
Several people spoke almost at the same time, and after hearing what the other party said, they all widened their eyes at the same time.
At this moment, whether it was Ye Shuo or the five princes, they all felt that their brother/brother was sick.
Ye Shuo was thinking, it’s already this time, why are you still pretending.
The fifth prince was thinking, why didn’t he pretend at this time, wouldn’t all his previous efforts be in vain?
Ye Shuo didn’t care what they were thinking, he was going to sleep anyway. After paying his respects to his adopted father, Ye Shuo hurried to the side hall.
Those whom he wanted to stay ran away, but those whom he didn’t want to stay, stayed. The “you” that Emperor Jingwen just mentioned did not include his youngest son at all.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even have time to try to persuade him to stay before Ye Shuo disappeared.
The Ninth Prince is really a man of true character. Wang Ziquan couldn’t help but wipe the cold sweat from his forehead when he saw this.
After the Fifth Prince and his companions left, Wang Ziquan could no longer hold back and whispered, “Your Majesty, the Ninth Prince was actually very dedicated during your coma, and it was not what you saw.”
Over the years, when has Wang Ziquan ever spoken for any of the masters in the palace? Now he just couldn’t stand it anymore.
However, what Wang Ziquan did not expect was that the next sentence he heard was Emperor Jingwen say, “Hmm.”
Your Majesty, he…he actually knew!
Noticing the shock in Wang Ziquan’s eyes, Emperor Jingwen closed his eyes slightly and said nothing.
From beginning to end, Emperor Jingwen knew what was happening outside. Although he was asleep, due to his nature, he would never completely let his guard down at any time, so he could vaguely sense what was happening outside.
Everyone thought that Emperor Jingwen had lost consciousness, but in fact he hadn’t, so when he heard his youngest son’s words, he had such a big reaction, but he couldn’t break free no matter what.
Emperor Jingwen listened and became anxious. He knew very well that if he really couldn’t wake up this time, his youngest son would be in danger.
No matter what, he cannot be allowed to carry such a stigma for the rest of his life.
It was Yao Zhi’s medical skills and Emperor Jingwen’s strong desire to survive, not just luck, that enabled Emperor Jingwen to survive this ordeal.
As for the Fifth Prince and the others… forget it, let’s not talk about them.
In this situation, how could Emperor Jingwen not be moved?
Among all his sons, only Xiaojiu would make such a choice, so all his sons combined were not as good as him.
Later, Emperor Jingwen found out that his youngest son had done much more than that.
After receiving the news, he even rushed into the imperial city on horseback. Emperor Jingwen felt that it was a blessing from God to have such a son in his life.
The other side.
Ye Shuo slept until the afternoon and then he woke up. Then he learned the news from the front line.
No wonder the Sixth Prince left in such a hurry at that time. It turned out that the State of Chen saw that the battle between Da Zhou and Beiting was in full swing, and they could not hold back any longer, so they joined the battlefield and launched a surprise attack. The two countries, which were originally enemies, now joined hands.
A lot of troops were urgently transferred to the border of Chen State, and the pressure on the eldest prince who stayed there suddenly increased.
The eldest prince knew that he would be dragged to death sooner or later if he continued like this, so he led his troops in a surprise attack, hoping to tear a hole in Beiting’s army. However, he accidentally fell into the enemy’s trap. Now three days have passed, and the eldest prince’s life or death is no longer known.
Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly began to lift.
As for the eldest prince, Ye Shuo’s feelings for him cannot be said to be very deep, but it is definitely not without any feelings. In addition, nephews have always been good friends with Jian Jian, and he has watched them grow up. If possible, Ye Shuo also hopes that he can be alive.
Then there is the cheap dad’s side.
Although my cheap dad has woken up now, according to Azhi, his physical condition has become worse, and it is still unclear whether he will be able to get out of bed in the future.
Ye Shuo knew that he could never give his cheap father his complete trust. The only thing he could do, within a limited scope, was to allow his cheap father to spend a relatively stable ten thousand years and not let him end up with a miserable old age.
Ye Shuo couldn’t guarantee anything else.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo did just that.
The Great Zhou was sandwiched between the Chen Kingdom and Beiting. Just when the Sixth Prince was at his wits’ end and didn’t know what to do, he suddenly heard a message from his subordinates saying that two merchants named Hu and Gu had been collecting food and grass from the people since the beginning of the war. Now, nearly a year has passed, and the amount of food and grass stockpiled by the two men is already considerable. They now want to donate it all to the court in exchange for the status of imperial merchants.
If the Sixth Prince remembered correctly, the money and grain donated by these two people were also donated by the Crown Prince, but the amount was insufficient, so he only gave him a plaque and a reward.
It seems that the two of them are unwilling to give up, so they put in so much effort this time.
If they had the title of imperial merchants, the two of them would be able to trade completely unimpeded within the Great Zhou. In addition, they had made such a great contribution, so even officials from all over the country would have to give them some face in the future. So overall, they did not lose out.
As a true businessman, he will never do business without capital.
The Sixth Prince agreed without much hesitation.
When winter comes, food in Beiting will become increasingly scarce. It is a critical time. Whether it will succeed depends on winter. The two of them came at the right time.
Then it was the Ministry of Works, which quickly came up with weapons to deal with the State of Chen. Their efficiency was astonishingly high.
The Sixth Prince only felt the pressure greatly reduced for a moment.
Soon, Ye Shuo contacted his eldest cousin again, and almost on the same day, many pigeons were released in the suburbs of the city.
The other side.
Compared to the Great Zhou, Beiting’s days were not easy either. A year ago, since they started fighting with the Great Zhou, a team came out of nowhere, with only one or two thousand people in total, which was not a large number. At first, Beiting didn’t take them seriously at all, thinking that some small country around it was taking the opportunity to cause trouble. However, as time went on, they were harassed by the enemy on the other side of the battlefield and they were miserable.
This group of people were elusive and had great skills. Sometimes, when the Beiting army was walking on the road, they would suddenly appear from nowhere and catch them off guard. By the time they could react, this group of people had already dispersed again and fled.
At first, Beiting wanted to chase them, but the more they chased, the worse things got, and more people died.
When it comes to guerrilla warfare, how can Beiting’s army compare to the special forces trained with modern methods? Beiting can only stick together to avoid too much loss.
Now, a year has passed, and the enemy’s troops have become stronger and stronger. They have taken away everything that could be robbed and burned, especially food and fodder. No matter how much food is transported, it is not enough for this group of people to rob. They are even more annoying than the army of the Great Zhou.
However, what was strange to Beiting was that there was no trace of the other party in recent days, and when this group of people appeared again, it was five days later.
After receiving the order from above, the leader of the troops from Lucheng spent a full five days rushing here from the other side, gathering information everywhere before finding the mission target.
However, it took too long to send messages back and forth, and they were still a step late.
As early as half a day ago, the army led by the eldest prince was discovered by the Beiting people. A total of 5,000 people have been slaughtered, with not a single one left.
It was the other party who cut off General Lanruo’s head. Now the situation has changed and it is his turn.
Just as General Lan Feng was about to take action, a sharp arrow flew through the air.
With a “ding” sound, the scimitar in Lan Feng’s hand was almost knocked to the ground, but despite this, a very obvious dent appeared on his scimitar.
This is one of the best weapons in the world, bestowed upon us by the Wolf King!
This sound, this sign…
“It’s the locusts, the locusts are coming!”
Someone shouted, but the Beiting soldiers, who already knew the other party’s reputation, immediately became agitated. Lan Feng wanted to continue, but he saw the leader in the distance suddenly pointed the crossbow in his hand at him.
Lan Feng’s heart immediately tightened.
“Retreat! Retreat quickly!”
No one knew where this group of people came from, but the crossbows in their hands were silent, powerful, and accurate, making them the nemesis of the cavalry.
Lan Feng didn’t care about anything else and immediately led his men to evacuate the place.
Half an incense stick later, the leader of the Lucheng troops felt a tightness in his heart when he saw the corpses all over the ground. He found the eldest prince based on his clothes and portrait. Looking at the man who was stabbed several times and even had one leg chopped off, the leader felt a tingling sensation on his scalp.
Oops, I’m late. How am I going to explain this to my boss?
However, no matter what, even if the target of the mission is dead, they have to bring back the other party’s body.
Just when everyone was preparing to find a way to bring this person back, as soon as they made a move, they saw that the other party seemed to move.
“Alive! Chief, this man is still alive!”
The leader was stunned for a moment, and then was overjoyed.
Then, everyone took off their backpacks and began emergency rescue.
In the blink of an eye, another five days passed. When Emperor Jingwen learned that the State of Chen had joined, he couldn’t help but worry, but he didn’t expect that the turning point would come so quickly.
Then the eldest prince led his troops in a surprise attack and was nearly beheaded. Although he has been rescued now, he has lost his right leg.
This time, the eldest prince is completely ruined.
Upon hearing the news, Emperor Jingwen was silent for a while, and finally gave an order that after he recovered from his injuries, he would be taken back to the capital to retain his title as prince.
After all, he was the first son he raised, so in the end, Emperor Jingwen finally softened his heart. As for the eldest prince’s rebellious intentions, it was just passed.
The eldest prince used to be so glorious, but after he lost a leg and became disabled, he became so miserable.
If they were to say, the eldest brother was really pitiful. He fought with the prince all the time, but in the end, someone else got the advantage.
Just as the Fifth Prince and others were sighing, the second imperial edict of Emperor Jingwen also came down.
“The Emperor, by the Mandate of Heaven, proclaims: When I was ill, my fifth, seventh, and eighth sons failed to take good care of me. This is extremely unfilial. From today on, they will be demoted from their titles of prince to county prince. I decree this.”
Father actually… took away the positions of three princes in a row!
When this imperial decree came out, not to mention the Fifth Prince and his friends, even Ye Shuo was dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Return
chapters.content:
Even if my father is ill and the choices made by the Fifth Prince and his men are not to my liking, they would not even take away their princely positions…
If it were just this, it wouldn’t have happened. Emperor Jingwen would have been heartbroken, but he wouldn’t have resorted to such a big war.
The main thing is the attitude of the Fifth Prince towards the Sixth Prince. As princes, they all have the same background. No one is willing to watch his brother sit in that position so close to him, so it is normal for them to go against the Sixth Prince.
But the present is different from the past. It’s fine if they are causing trouble to the Sixth Prince now, and the Sixth Prince can’t do anything to them, but what about a few years later? After I die, how can the Sixth Prince let them go easily? Sooner or later, they will end up killing each other.
Enough of his sons have died, and Emperor Jingwen didn’t want this to happen again. It would be better to use this as an excuse to completely end their thoughts, at least they could still keep their lives.
Also, when he was seriously ill, the fifth prince said, “We are both princes.”
Xiaojiu’s actions have really offended his brothers. If he doesn’t do something, his brothers will definitely not let him go when he really goes to hell one day.
Now the Fifth Prince and his companions have been demoted to the rank of Duke. The rank of Duke is a whole level lower than that of Prince, which is a gap that is difficult to cross. In this way, the Fifth Prince and his companions are no longer a threat to Xiaojiu.
After much consideration, Emperor Jingwen issued this imperial edict.
Emperor Jingwen had more or less considered his sons. As for whether the Fifth Prince and others would appreciate it, the answer was naturally self-evident.At this moment, the hatred of the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince, and the Eighth Prince towards Emperor Jingwen instantly reached its peak.
No matter what, they have been serving their father every day in recent days and trying their best to make up for it. But their father turned out to be so cruel and heartless. How could the five princes not be angry?
The fifth prince could no longer hold back, and rushed into Chengming Palace almost immediately after receiving the imperial edict.
At that time, Ye Shuo was dozing off out of boredom, while the imperial physician beside him was trembling with fear as he checked the pulse of Emperor Jingwen. Just at this moment, there was a noise outside the door. Ye Shuo looked in the direction of the sound and saw the Fifth Prince rushing in despite the guards’ obstruction, and then… he knelt heavily in front of Emperor Jingwen’s bed with a thump.
Emperor Jingwen, who had anticipated this, did not even blink an eye.
The fifth prince became even more sad and angry when he saw this scene.
“Father, don’t you have any sons in your heart?” The father did not have the slightest fatherly love for them. Instead, he required them to be obedient and filial at all times and in all things. If they were not careful, he would reprimand and scold them. Even a person with a gentle temper could not tolerate this.
At this moment, the Fifth Prince only thought that Emperor Jingwen did this for Ye Shuo, and never considered that Emperor Jingwen was also thinking about them.
The Fifth Prince was overwhelmed by the news and suddenly started to speak without thinking.
“Father, is my ninth brother your only son? If so, why did you give birth to us?”
With a “crash”, the medicine bowl in Emperor Jingwen’s hand fell heavily to the ground.
Meeting the gloomy and cruel eyes of Emperor Jingwen, the Fifth Prince was startled immediately, and then he realised what he had just said, and broke out in a cold sweat.
“I was impolite for a moment, please forgive me, father!”
“roll.”
“Get out.”
Even though Emperor Jingwen is seriously ill now, the Fifth Prince still does not have the courage to act unruly in front of him. The princes’ fear of Emperor Jingwen is almost ingrained in their bones.
After such a fuss that started off well but ended badly, the fifth prince finally left.
Before leaving, he couldn’t help but give his younger brother a vicious look.
Obviously, the fifth prince was completely resentful of him this time.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Wait, what does this have to do with him? No, that’s not right. It seems to be somewhat related.
However, Ye Shuo did not admit that they hated him because he chose to save his stepfather.
The next moment, Ye Shuo was interrupted by his cheap father’s cough.
“Cough, cough, cough, cough…”
Ye Shuo came back to his senses immediately and sat down beside the bed to pat his cough.
No matter what, the Fifth Prince is still the son of Emperor Jingwen. Emperor Jingwen naturally could not remain completely indifferent. In the end, he was still angry with the Fifth Prince.
When his consciousness was a little fuzzy, looking at his youngest son who seemed casual and calm in front of him, Emperor Jingwen thought in his heart that he did not want to be partial, but his youngest son was too considerate. Looking at the fifth prince and the others, they would only make things more troublesome for him.
After a while, Emperor Jingwen became short of breath and fell into a deep sleep.
The other side.
Upon learning that the Fifth Prince had made such a fuss but got no results and was scolded by his father instead, the Seventh and Eighth Princes had no choice but to give up the idea for the time being.
It has been a long time since the night when Emperor Jingwen had a high fever, and his condition has gradually stabilised. He can be said to have been saved again.
The Sixth Prince could neither say he was happy nor unhappy about this matter. As of now, he had just taken over all the affairs of the former Crown Prince for a year. The time was still short and his foundation was not deep enough. He needed more time to consolidate his position, otherwise, when he succeeded to the throne, there might be trouble again.
What’s more, my father is no longer able to take care of things now, so whether he is here or not doesn’t have that much impact.
The Sixth Prince had no dissatisfaction with Xiaojiu, but it was the Fifth Prince’s words that made him frown.
Judging from the temperaments of the Fifth Prince and the others, they would probably hold a grudge against Xiaojiu. Xiaojiu probably didn’t expect that he just wanted to save his father’s life, but ended up implicating himself.
He had never considered these things beforehand, which led to his current embarrassing situation.
Xiaojiu is always like this. He always likes to act impulsively and is never thoughtful in anything he does. He is already twenty-one years old and married, but he still acts like a child.
In the past, he had the crown prince to protect him. After the crown prince was gone, it was his father who protected him. Now if his father was also gone, who could he rely on in the future?
In addition, he was already at odds with the fifth prince, so the sixth prince couldn’t help but think of this problem.
Although Xiaojiu has a reckless personality, he doesn’t have any bad intentions after all… He will be nice to whoever is nice to him, which is particularly valuable.
After a while, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but sigh.
After about two or three days, the matter of the eldest prince spread throughout the court. The ministers were silent about Emperor Jingwen’s arrangement, but they didn’t say anything in the end.
Another month passed, and the eldest prince returned with injuries and is now on the way.
In the end, as it was natural, it was Ye Shuo who went to pick it up.
When they saw him, Ye Yan and others couldn’t help but widen their eyes.
I thought that given the current situation of Prince Ding’s Mansion, no one would come today, but I didn’t expect that the Ninth Prince would actually come…
Ye Shuo noticed the astonishment on the faces of several people and couldn’t help but say, “Don’t just stand there. There’s news from the posthouse that people are coming soon.”
Knowing that now was not the time to talk about this, Ye Yan and his brothers quickly came back to their senses.
Perhaps because he knew that the eldest prince had committed a crime, his return this time was far less grand than the last time he returned victoriously. He only had a carriage and two or three guards, and from a distance he looked particularly shabby and destitute.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but recall the time when the eldest prince came back with the army, riding on horseback with high spirits. Now that time has passed, it feels like a lifetime ago.
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, then ordered the soldiers guarding the city to open the city gates.
The soldier was stunned. Logically speaking, the eldest prince was a criminal, so how could he be treated like this?
But after all, it was His Royal Highness Prince Rui who spoke in person, so the soldier had to obey.
Ye Shuo didn’t know what kind of thoughts had occurred to the eldest prince at the time, but since things had passed, the mistakes made at the time should be offset no matter how serious they were.
The eldest prince lived at the border for ten years and really didn’t deserve to end up like this.
Although Ye Shuo had known about the eldest prince’s current situation in advance, he had only read about it in letters before. Now, seeing the eldest prince’s appearance, Ye Shuo’s heart couldn’t help but tremble.
It was seen that the eldest prince’s entire right leg from the knee down was gone. Now his trouser leg was empty, with a cloth strip wrapped on it. And some yellowish unknown liquid was obviously oozing out of the cloth strip. When Ye Shuo saw this scene, his face changed.
Although it is already late autumn, the wound will still become inflamed and fester if not handled properly. By then, not only will your leg be damaged, but your life may also be lost.
And the eldest prince really doesn’t look like he wants to live.
Falling from a great height into an abyss, the prouder a person is, the less he will allow himself to be imperfect.
Ye Shuo clearly felt that the eldest prince was lying there, his eyes covered with a layer of deathly gray, and his whole body seemed to have been drained of all his energy and spirit, without any life at all.
In this case, it would be strange if those medicines could work for him.
No matter how good a doctor is, he still needs the cooperation of his patients.
Ever since they could remember, in the impression of Ye Yan and others, their father was always a tall and mighty figure. He was even more powerful in Beiting in the past. But now, the thin and decadent middle-aged man in front of them was very different from the father in their impression.
If you count carefully, the eldest prince is already 38 years old this year, almost 40.
Noticing the eldest prince’s premature gray hair and the fine wrinkles caused by the wind and sand at the border, Ye Shuo took advantage of the time when Ye Yan and the other children were stunned to get off the horse and get into the carriage.
“Brother.”
Hearing the noise nearby, the eldest prince only moved his eyes, but in the end, he finally calmed down.
Along the way, Ye Shuo kept trying to talk to him, but the eldest prince rarely responded.
That’s right, a loser, now a cripple, how can he have the extra energy to chat and laugh with others?
After sending the eldest prince to Prince Ding’s mansion, the eighth prince also came to visit his brother, but unfortunately, the eldest prince still didn’t speak.
Ye Shuo and the Eighth Prince finally had no choice but to leave.
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that after leaving Prince Ding’s Mansion, the Eighth Prince turned around and went to Concubine De’s Palace.
Along the way, the Eighth Prince’s mind was full of his eldest brother’s current appearance. The Eighth Prince knew very well that his eldest brother, who had lost one of his calves, had completely lost hope of seizing the throne. In this case, it would be better for him to transfer the power in his hands to himself, so that the two brothers would still have a glimmer of hope.
Rather than giving it to a cheap outsider, it is better to give it to your own brother.
The Eighth Prince couldn’t hold back any longer after receiving the imperial decree that demoted him to a prince.
With his back to the wall, the Eighth Prince decided to go to Concubine De for advice.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Medication
chapters.content:
About half an hour later, when Concubine De learned the purpose of the Eighth Prince’s visit, she was incredulous for a moment.
Her eldest son was seriously injured and dying, and even lost a leg, but the first reaction of the youngest son was to take over the things of the eldest son. How could Concubine De not be shocked?
The youngest son was smart and knew how to use everything he could to increase his advantage, but his mentality was too cold.
At this moment, Concubine De felt that she might have spoiled her youngest son over the years, and spoiled him to the point that he had lost his heart and was only filled with selfish desires.
To be honest, over the years, the eldest son has been very kind to the younger son. If the eldest son had not fought hard at the border, how could they and their mother be where they are today, and how could she have taken the position of Concubine De?
The palms and backs of the hands are all made of flesh, so Defei’s first reaction was to oppose.
“Get down on your knees, you bastard!”
Concubine De had a gentle temperament and seldom spoke in such a harsh tone. For a moment, even the Eighth Prince was frightened.
Not daring to disobey, the Eighth Prince knelt down with a plop.
Concubine De asked again: “If it weren’t for your elder brother, do you think that mother and son would have been able to live so peacefully in the palace for so many years?”The Eighth Prince also knew this, but…
“Son really has no other choice. If the situation continues like this, and if the Sixth Brother succeeds to the throne someday, how will my eldest brother and I survive?”
The Eighth Prince is now forced into a desperate situation. He has already done so many things and has also secretly made things difficult for the Sixth Prince. He is very scared.
The Sixth Prince has never been a broad-minded person since he was a child. He is petty and vindictive, and he is ruthless. Almost every time he strikes, he hits the target. The Eighth Prince is afraid that the other party will retaliate against him after he succeeds to the throne. The Eighth Prince is now in a dilemma. It is impossible for him to give up halfway, so he can only close his eyes and bite the bullet and go all the way to the end.
Even if it means a life-and-death struggle, we still have to fight.
“Mother, please have pity on your son. Your son’s legitimate son has only been born for two years. You have seen the child before. He has just learned to walk and called your son father. How can your son bear to watch him being implicated by you?”
As the Eighth Prince spoke, the image of her chubby little grandson flashed through Concubine De’s mind.
But at the same time, Concubine De also knew that what her younger son said was not true. From the fact that his first reaction was to come to her, Concubine De knew what he was planning. He just wanted her to speak up and persuade her eldest son.
I am the eldest prince’s biological mother, and my eldest son must listen to me no matter what.
Concubine De was an extremely smart person. She could see things clearly, but precisely because she saw things so clearly, she also knew that not everything her youngest son said was a lie.
The reason why Concubine De opposed it was that she was only concerned about her eldest son’s feelings, not the transfer of her eldest son’s power to her younger son.
The Eighth Prince grew up with Concubine De since he was a child. How could he not know what Concubine De was worried about at the moment and why she was so furious.
Seeing that Concubine De seemed to be wavering, the Eighth Prince hurriedly took advantage of the situation and pursued her.
“Mother, I promise you that if I ever get the throne, I will never forget your kindness. I will take good care of you and ensure that my nephews will live a life of wealth and prosperity.”
Sometimes, even if the meat is rotten, it should be kept in your own pot rather than being given to outsiders.
To be honest, the Eighth Prince’s words were so earnest that Concubine De couldn’t help but be shaken at this moment, but in the end, she still shook her head in the slightly desperate look of the Eighth Prince.
“No matter how much you say, I will not intervene in this matter.” What’s the difference between such words and the intention to kill the eldest son?
The eldest son has been away for so many years, but the younger son has been raised by her side. It’s a lie for Concubine De to say that she is not partial, but she is not a confused person after all. It’s okay to let the eldest son give in on small matters, but Concubine De can’t do that on big matters. Everyone in this world is not worried about the lack of wealth but the inequality. Once the gap is opened, I’m afraid there will be endless troubles.
But at the same time, Concubine De would not stop her younger son.
“If you have the ability to get what your elder brother has, then do it. I will not say no. If you don’t have the ability, then you have to accept your fate.” With such a good opportunity in front of him, if he doesn’t even have the ability to win people’s hearts, how can Concubine De believe that he can get that position?
“Your elder brother can’t stand the slightest provocation now. You can do whatever you want, but you can’t let him know.”
If the eldest son didn’t know, then this matter would not implicate him.
The eldest son had had a hard enough life in the first half of his life, and Concubine De didn’t want to implicate him because of the younger son at this time.
This is probably the greatest fairness that Defei, as a mother, can ensure between her two children within her ability.
The Eighth Prince was inevitably disappointed upon seeing this, but when he wanted to persuade her again, he saw that Concubine De had already forced herself to harden her heart.
“I am a little tired. Someone, send the Eighth Prince out.”
Knowing that if he stayed here any longer, he would be scolded sooner or later, so Defei immediately ordered people to drive him out.
After the Eighth Prince left, Concubine De couldn’t help but sit down dejectedly.
Now the eldest son is seriously injured and dying, and the youngest son is like this. For a moment, Concubine De felt pain and resentment in her heart, but she didn’t know who to blame.
The Eighth Prince hit a snag with Concubine De, but at the same time, he also received a reminder from Concubine De.
The fact that the eldest brother had our father’s people in his hands was originally a hidden danger. When the Eighth Prince came, he was still thinking about how to identify these people one by one. Now, he already has an idea in his mind.
I would be afraid of the Sixth Prince ascending the throne. Similarly, those who truly followed my eldest brother would also be worried because my eldest brother suddenly became disabled.
Since they had sided with the eldest brother in the first place, they had been drawn into the vortex of the fight for the throne. Now that the eldest brother has no hope of winning the throne, they must be extremely panicked.
This kind of thing is not something you can withdraw from just because you want to. When the new emperor ascends the throne, they will most likely not have a good ending. They wanted to use this to get promoted, but now they have to pay the corresponding price.
If I could stand out at this time, given that I and my eldest brother share the same mother, it would be the best choice, and I would naturally be able to gather them together.
Thinking of this, the Eighth Prince was immediately certain.
The other side.
Just as the Eighth Prince was walking around, Ye Shuo came to the First Prince’s mansion again the next day.
After a whole night, the image of the eldest prince lying in the simple carriage, looking lifeless, kept lingering in Ye Shuo’s mind. Since he was worried, Ye Shuo went to him without much hesitation.
Anyway, they both lived close to each other, and Ye Shuo always ran into his cheap elder brother when he went in and out. It only took him two steps to get there, and it wasn’t much trouble.
It’s really worrying that there are two patients in the family one after another, and both of them are so seriously ill.
When Ye Shuo arrived, he saw Princess Ding and several concubines standing beside the eldest prince’s bed with anxious faces. The women were so anxious that tears were about to fall, but the eldest prince refused to move at all, with his teeth clenched and his eyes not even opening.
Seeing the broken bowls and spoons on the ground and the stains on the princess and the concubines, how could Ye Shuo not understand what happened? It was just that his cheap elder brother wanted to die and didn’t want to drink the medicine.
As you get closer, you can still hear the princess’ pleading voice.
“My Lord, please drink a little!”
The eldest prince was born brave, and his whole family went to the border. After so many years of sharing life and death, the friendship between the princess consort, the concubines, and Prince Ding himself has long been extraordinary. It is difficult to explain the intrigues among them. There is no doubt that they are all on his side, and the eldest prince also has them in his heart, otherwise he would not have voluntarily asked to go to the border to protect his wife and children, and would not return until he died.
But no matter how much he cared, the eldest prince could not survive for them.
Princess Ding wanted to say something else, but when she saw her brother-in-law, she was startled at first, and then she subconsciously wiped away her tears.
“Why is His Royal Highness Prince Rui here? The palace is busy with many things, and I was unable to greet you in person. I am sorry to have embarrassed His Royal Highness Prince Rui.”
“Sister-in-law, you are too kind. I just came to see my brother when I had nothing to do.”
Without waiting for Princess Ding to speak again, Ye Shuo sat down next to the eldest prince. The next moment, Ye Shuo could clearly feel his adopted brother’s body tense up for a moment.
Huh? From this point of view, he didn’t seem to have any other emotions in his heart. Compared with when he just came back yesterday, he seemed to be a little stronger. At least after returning to the familiar environment, he was able to react to things in the outside world.
Ye Shuo turned his head and asked suddenly, “Do you have any more medicine? Please, sister-in-law, bring me another bowl.”
Princess Ding was stunned for a moment, then asked someone to get it.
About half an incense stick of time later, the new medicine soup was brought up by the person below.
Looking at the four big idiots standing there, anxiously doing nothing, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say, “What are you still standing there for? Why don’t you come over here quickly? Don’t look to the side, I’m talking about you.”
It took Ye Yan and the others a while to react before they realised that the Ninth Prince was calling them.
After Ye Yan and the other boys came closer, Ye Shuo said again: “Come on, one by one, grab his hands and feet for me.”
Ye Yan and the other three: “!”
Ye Yan was the first to react, and said tremblingly: “Uncle Jiu, I, we dare not…”
The eldest prince’s majesty is deeply rooted in people’s hearts. It’s like asking the fifth prince and others to fight with Emperor Jingwen. Who would dare to do that?
“You are so useless. You have grown so big for nothing. Each one is stronger than the other. It turns out they are all weak.” Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo’s face showed undisguised disgust.
“He’s already like this, what are you afraid of?”
It is estimated that the current eldest prince cannot even defeat the youngest of Ye Yan’s four brothers.
Ye Shuo added: “It’s going to be a death sentence anyway, how can we know if we don’t try it? What if it works?”
However, it was these words that touched several people.
They didn’t want their father to die. If their father died, they would really become fatherless children.
Ye Yan got excited and took the lead to hug the eldest prince’s only remaining foot, and then two people each grabbed one of his arms.
In the past, the eldest prince had four hands and feet, and Ye Yan and his brothers also had four. Now the eldest prince is missing a foot, so now they have one more.
Before the eldest prince could even react, he was already firmly controlled by his own son.
The eldest prince was forced to open his eyes.
The eldest prince was just about to speak, telling him to get lost and stop interfering, saying that he didn’t need his pity or his false kindness, but he saw the young man in front of him rolling up his sleeves and grinning.
“I’ve wanted to do this for a long time, and now I’ve finally waited for this day.”
“Someone, bring me the bowl of freshly cooked medicine!”
Ye Yan’s eyes widened immediately, and then he asked what the eldest prince was thinking: “No, Uncle Jiu, it will burn people to death!”
“How could that be?” Ye Shuo said as if it was a matter of course.
“Don’t forget, your father was once known as the God of War. What’s a mere bowl of water? Don’t worry, he can handle it.”
Ye Shuo approached step by step, holding the medicine bowl.
“Come on, open your mouth, ah——”

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Miracle
chapters.content:
The eldest prince has simply lost the will to live. He has not become stupid, nor has his five senses been closed. Psychologically, he doesn’t want to care about anything, but his body can’t really turn a blind eye to everything around him.
Just when the eldest prince was hesitating whether to resist, the remaining of his four sons, the one with cold sweat, hugged Ye Shuo.
“Uncle Jiu! Please, show mercy!”
Perhaps it was because Ye Shuo was too eccentric on a daily basis, and for a moment, everyone couldn’t tell whether he was joking or serious.
What if he really got excited and made his father drink such a bowl of boiling hot medicine, then… Ye Yan and others couldn’t help but shiver.
“Don’t worry, it’s nothing.”
“Uncle Jiu, this really won’t work!”
The two of them pulled each other for a long time. If Ye Shuo didn’t take action, he really wouldn’t be able to break free for a while. After a long while, Ye Shuo had no choice but to say helplessly: “Okay, I’ll wait a little longer.” There was regret in his words.
Ye Yan and the others breathed a sigh of relief almost instantly, and even the eldest prince felt inexplicably relieved.
Princess Ding and a group of concubines standing by were hesitant to speak, thinking that their brother-in-law was too unreliable. But they had no choice. After all, he was a prince. Unless the prince spoke personally, who would dare to drive him out?Life at home is already difficult enough, if we offend this person again, what will happen?
Princess Ding twisted her handkerchief so much that it was deformed.
After waiting for a long time until the bowl of medicine in his hand was no longer so hot, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at his nephew.
When the boy met his gaze, he quickly let go.
“Hold tight, or it will spill.”
Following Ye Shuo’s order, Ye Yan and others exerted all their might, and for a moment the eldest prince felt he could not breathe.
He didn’t know why his sons listened to him so much, and he didn’t know whether they were his sons or his sons.
