Just when the eldest prince was thinking about something, Ye Shuo had already taken out the soup spoon from the bowl, pried open his teeth without saying a word, and poured the whole bowl of medicine into him.
The eldest prince struggled desperately, but he had not eaten or drunk much in the past month and had no strength left. How could he be a match for a few young men?
The eldest prince then clenched his teeth again, but no matter how good his teeth were, could they be better than porcelain?
After swallowing a bowl of medicine, the eldest prince started to cry and had a snot.
Ye Shuo acted as if he didn’t see it and was very satisfied with his results.
“Not bad.” Although it was his first time doing this job, only a little bit of the medicine spilled out of the bowl. It was simply perfect.
Staring at this scene in a daze, Princess Ding and the concubines suddenly understood something.
While putting down the empty bowl, Ye Shuo casually said: “See? This is how it has to be. Anyway, he can’t resist you now.”
If soft means don’t work, then use hard means. What’s the point of just begging him? It’s okay to force him.
Given the relationship between Princess Ding and his adopted elder brother, and the fact that Ye Yan is their eldest son, the eldest prince can’t really do anything to her.
Princess Ding pursed her lips and said nothing.
The eldest prince at the side was about to cough up his lungs.
After all this tossing and turning, the eldest prince felt dizzy and had almost no strength left. It was extremely difficult for him to even turn over. Lying on the bed, panting, the eldest prince pulled the corners of his mouth and forced a cold smile: “No matter what you do… I will not do as you wish… In the end… you are just wasting your time.”
However, before he could finish, he was interrupted by Ye Shuo.
“Whether you live or die has nothing to do with me.”
Ye Shuo said as if it was a matter of course: “I only do what I want to do, as long as I am happy. Even if you can’t be saved in the end, it’s your problem. What does it have to do with me?”
When everyone heard this, they felt that something was strange, but they could not find any words to refute it for a moment.
No one expected him to say such a thing, even the eldest prince felt ripples in his heart.
The next moment, the young man yawned blatantly.
“It’s done. The medicine has been given. It’s time for my brother to go to the palace to visit father.” Ye Shuo was very busy taking care of the two patients.
Princess Ding was stunned for a moment after seeing this, and then hurriedly said, “I’ll go see the prince off.”
She still has many things she wants to ask.
The eldest prince watched his princess go out with his brother. He could faintly hear their voices, one asking a question and the other answering it, so smoothly.
Princess Ding was not someone who didn’t know how to adapt. It was just that for a moment, she couldn’t get over the hurdle in her heart. After leaving the house, she couldn’t help but feel a little conflicted: “His Highness the nineth Prince, tell me, isn’t this…not good for the prince?”
“What’s wrong with that?” Ye Shuo didn’t care.
“As long as you understand what you want, it doesn’t matter what other methods you use.”
What Princess Ding and the others wanted was naturally that their husbands/fathers were alive. As long as people were alive, there was hope.
Princess Ding suddenly said in her heart: “Thank you, his highness the ninth Prince. I understand.”
Well, the girl is teachable. As expected of a woman who has stayed at the border for so many years, she is decisive.
Ye Shuo left quickly.
What he didn’t know was that after he left, Princess Ding immediately ordered the cook in the mansion to cook rice, chicken, shrimp, fish and other ingredients into a bowl of porridge, and then crush everything inside.
Since the prince is so unwilling to eat properly, just mash it into a paste and feed it to him bit by bit.
In just half an hour, when the eldest prince saw his princess coming in with a bowl of something that he couldn’t make out clearly, he instinctively felt that something was wrong.
Sure enough, the eldest prince soon experienced the same thing for the second time.
“Yan’er, go and hold down your father’s hands and feet.”
After all, they were husband and wife, and Princess Ding’s method was not as rough as Ye Shuo’s. She was very patient and fed him the bowl of porridge in her hand bit by bit. However, the eldest prince’s discomfort was no less than when Ye Shuo was here just now.
He felt that his dignity as the head of the family was seriously challenged.
“You…how dare you…” Is this still the gentle and docile princess?
Looking at the concubines standing by, none of them came to help him. Some even helped to pry open his mouth when he was struggling.
Princess Ding was unmoved: “Since the prince is unwilling to eat well, then I will come to help the prince.”
“Our family has survived ten years of life at the border. Now that we have finally had a better life, no one should be left behind, especially the prince. Even if he has to die, he can only die after us.”
“Besides, Yan’er and the others are still young and still need the prince. Before they can establish themselves, I will never let anything happen to the prince.”
As she spoke, Princess Ding even very gently wiped the porridge stains on the eldest prince’s lips with a handkerchief. It was obviously a very gentle action, but for some reason, the eldest prince shuddered.
The Ninth Prince is right. The children in the mansion have all grown up. How could they be afraid of him?
Princess Ding couldn’t help but let out a long breath.
Of course, who is the eldest prince? How could he allow a little girl, especially his own wife or concubine, to ride on his head?
But unfortunately, everyone in the palace now listens to the princess. The princess found a reason to send away the few confidants around the eldest prince, so that they would not make trouble at this critical moment.
Ye Shuo was just a leader, but Princess Ding learned everything on her own and made the eldest prince live a life of semi-confinement.
Don’t want to take medicine? Just pour it into your mouth.
Refuse to drink water? Refuse to eat? Then break it up into small pieces and feed it to him.
This kind of life reached its peak when it was discovered that the eldest prince was trying to commit suicide.
In the middle of the night, they felt something was wrong. When the princess and her men broke in, the eldest prince was holding a fruit peeling dagger, and the dagger was now against his neck.
When the princess saw this, her legs went limp.
Seeing his wife fall to the ground, unknown whether she was dead or alive, the eldest prince froze for a moment. Taking this opportunity, Ye Yan snatched the dagger away.
Seeing that the eldest prince had nothing in his hand, Princess Ding climbed up from the ground. Her eyes were grim, and there was no sign of weakness at all.
“Since the prince is determined to abandon us, don’t blame me for being rude.”
Then, the eldest prince was kidnapped.
Originally, the eldest prince could move freely, but now he can only eat, drink, defecate and urinate in bed.
When Ye Shuo came the next day, he saw that the eldest prince’s hands and feet were tied with soft cloth, which would not hurt him but could also restrict his movements.
At first, Princess Ding was a little nervous. After all, although they were husband and wife, the eldest prince was still a prince, and it would be a serious crime for her to do this.
Unexpectedly, the young man in front of me first blinked, and then laughed out loud on the spot.
“Ye Liancheng, ah Ye Liancheng, you have come to this day.”
Princess Ding couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Looking at his brother’s smiling face, the eldest prince felt genuinely humiliated at this moment.
Sometimes, the healing of wounds is also related to the patient’s will, but Princess Ding served him with such good food and drink, and the best doctors from the Imperial Hospital came to treat him and change his dressings every day. Even though the eldest prince was reluctant, he gradually got better.
Looking at the gradually fuller cheeks in the mirror, deep despair suddenly welled up in the eldest prince’s heart.
What the eldest prince could not tolerate the most was that his younger brother laughed so happily every time, as if he was enjoying the fun. However, his wives, concubines and children were not angry at all. Instead, they obeyed his orders and served him with all kinds of delicious food and drinks.
Ye Yan’s brothers have listened to him since they were young, and now they are even worse. For a moment, the eldest prince felt that this was not his own Dingwang Palace, but a branch of Ruiwang Palace.
The eldest prince lay on the bed, feeling as if he had been abandoned by the whole world.
He couldn’t even die if he wanted to. The eldest prince had never felt so powerless in his life.
Now no one in the whole palace listens to him, and his brothers are unreliable. Gradually, a figure emerged in the eldest prince’s mind.
If it was my father, he would definitely not…
However, before the eldest prince could finish his words, he was interrupted by Ye Shuo who was standing beside him: “Don’t think about it. With me here, will Dad listen to you?”
“Where do you think my sister-in-law got such confidence?”
With a “puff”, the eldest prince’s fantasy was completely shattered. At this moment, all the eldest prince’s roads were blocked.
No one can be relied upon, and the only way to turn things around is to save yourself.
If he didn’t want to be trapped in this bed for the rest of his life, he could only…
When Princess Ding brought him another bowl of porridge, the eldest prince finally spoke in a hoarse voice.
“Untie the rope, and I will eat it myself.”
Caught off guard, Princess Ding nearly dropped the porcelain bowl in her hand. She hurriedly grabbed it, but her eyes were a little red.
The prince is willing to eat on his own initiative, which is simply great news.
Princess Ding moved in a hurry, but as soon as her hands touched the strips of cloth tied to the bed, her brother-in-law’s words suddenly flashed through her mind.
Even if Prince Ding showed weakness, he could not be so soft-hearted.
Princess Ding thought about it, and then solemnly asked the eldest prince for a lot of guarantees, promising to eat well, take medicine well, never commit suicide, and so on.
Princess Ding not only wanted him to make a verbal promise, but also asked him to write it down. If he broke the promise, the contents of the letter of promise would be made known to everyone in the world.
The eldest prince: “…”
There’s no need to think about it, it must have been that bad idea that came from my idiot brother.
Resisting the urge to curse, the eldest prince said with a stiff face, “Look, my hands are still tied, how can I write so many words? Why don’t you untie me first, and I will write to you, how about that?”
The eldest prince, who was once upright, has now become petty under pressure.
However, Princess Ding’s gaze fell on the eldest prince’s lips.
The eldest prince’s bad premonition immediately reached its peak.
However, half an hour later, Princess Ding finally got what she wanted.
“Pooh, pooh, pooh!” The eldest prince wiped the corners of his mouth frantically and cursed his younger brother in his heart.
The eldest prince decided that he would avenge himself no matter what.
So when Ye Shuo came again the next day, he saw the eldest prince sitting on the edge of the bed waiting for him.
The cloth strips binding his hands and feet were gone, which meant… Ye Shuo reacted instantly and turned around and ran away without hesitation.
The eldest prince, leaning on a crutch that he had asked the craftsmen in the palace to make overnight, chased after him desperately.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Afterimage
chapters.content:
A whole month of house arrest!
Eating, drinking, defecating and urinating all on the same bed, one can imagine what kind of life the eldest prince leads. He is not like a human being at all, but a pig or dog kept in a cage, with no dignity at all. And the young man in front of him is the culprit of all this.
The eldest prince’s expression was completely out of control and he laughed hideously.
“Stop, stop right there!”
There was no way Ye Shuo would listen to him, he ran faster than a rabbit.
“If you don’t want to stop, then don’t stop. If you have the guts, come and chase me.”
The eldest prince was almost pissed to death by him.
However, Ye Shuo did what he said and did not give in to his adopted elder brother at all just because he was a disabled person. He even wandered around ten feet away from the eldest prince when he was gasping for breath.
The eldest prince’s broken right leg subconsciously scratched in the air and tried to push off the ground. After he came to his senses, his face turned ashen.
Seeing that the time was almost up, especially since the eldest prince was almost out of breath, Ye Shuo ignored everything and patted his butt to leave, as if he was just about to leave after admiring the miserable state of the eldest prince.“Big brother, you should take good care of your injuries. I will go to the palace first.”
After saying this, Ye Shuo left leisurely.
Staring at his back, the eldest prince swore that sooner or later he would pin him to the ground and beat him.
He really couldn’t die for the time being, with so many eyes watching him. His princess even ordered all the sharp weapons in the mansion to be hidden. The only way for the eldest prince to take revenge was to eat hard, exercise hard, and return to normal.
Absolutely, absolutely not let him laugh at himself again!
When I return to my former self, I will see who in this mansion dares to ride on my head and shit!
On the other side.
After Ye Shuo left Prince Ding’s Mansion, he saw Yao Zhi with her arms folded and looking at him.
For a moment, Yao Zhi couldn’t even figure out whether he wanted the eldest prince to get better or was simply teasing him, because the smile on his face was too real.
It would be strange if the eldest prince could understand something that even Yao Zhi couldn’t see.
Yao Zhi thought about it carefully and felt that he had good intentions at first, but later on, as the eldest prince’s injuries healed day by day, this kindness gradually changed…
After Ye Shuo entered the palace, he told this matter to his stepfather. After all, the eldest prince was his stepfather’s son, and he should be relieved that the eldest prince could recover his vitality.
After learning that the eldest prince was now able to get out of bed, Emperor Jingwen was indeed relieved, but then he felt as if something was wrong.
It seems that I don’t like to drink herbal medicine these days…
Two months had passed since the high fever. Every day, Emperor Jingwen took more medicine than he ate food. As time went on, it was inevitable that Emperor Jingwen felt annoyed.
He kept taking medicine but his body didn’t get better. Now he was just relying on these medicines to hang on to his life. Emperor Jingwen was naturally negative. Now that he heard about the plight of the eldest prince, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but think, would the youngest son treat him like this?
Thinking about it, it seems that this is really possible.
He had done so many outrageous things that even his status as an emperor might not be enough to subdue him. The most important thing was that Emperor Jingwen was reluctant to punish him for such a reason, and given his youngest son’s arrogant nature, it should not be difficult for him to see that.
Just when Emperor Jingwen was thinking about something, he saw Ye Shuo just happened to take the bowl of medicine handed to him by the imperial physician.
“Come on, Dad, it’s time to take the medicine.”
Emperor Jingwen thought about it and decided not to go against him today. He simply drank the bowl of medicine in front of him.
Huh? Why is my cheap dad so obedient today?
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, then he reacted and found it a little funny.
Emperor Jingwen is now very tired and spends half a day sleeping. In the remaining time, Ye Shuo basically has to take out half an hour every day to accompany him for a walk, and then have lunch with him, his mother and Jian Jian, and that’s it.
In the afternoon, Ye Shuo returned to his mansion in a carriage.
Thinking about how awkward the eldest prince looked this morning leaning on a cane, and that he had nothing to do all day, Ye Shuo thought about it and then casually drew a pair of crutches.
The craftsmen in the Eldest Prince’s Palace made a so-called walking stick, but it was actually a cane used by the elderly. It did not have much support, and could hardly support the eldest Prince, who had lost half a leg, in walking. It was far less convenient than an armpit crutch.
After finishing the drawing, Ye Shuo asked people to get wood and tools. He was very excited and ready to show his skills.
When seeing this scene, Yao Zhi felt that it looked familiar for some reason.
I remember that he was so confident before and wanted to make the best hairpin in the world for himself, but the result was…
“Oh shit, it’s broken!”
Fortunately, Ye Shuo did not use any precious wood, but just ordinary willow, pine, elm and the like, so he would not feel bad even if he failed.
In the yard, Yao Zhi was practising swordplay, while Ye Shuo was planing wood. After about half an hour, Yao Zhi couldn’t stand it any longer, so she put down her sword, wiped the sweat off her forehead, and said, “That’s not how it should be done. It should be like this, like this, and like this.”
Yao Zhi’s fourth master was best at carpentry, so she learned a lot from him. Making furniture was no problem for her, let alone a pair of crutches.
So, under Yao Zhi’s guidance, Ye Shuo created… What is this thing? ? ?
Ye Shuo tried it under his armpit, and then said: “Although it is a bit ugly, it is not useless. Let’s leave it like this.”
Ye Shuo lost interest and his hands were a little tired, so he was too lazy to do it. Even the final application of tung oil was done by Xiao Luzi.
Yao Zhi, who was standing by, couldn’t imagine what it would be like to give this thing to the eldest prince.
This crutch is really too ugly, it’s hard to show it off…
“…How about I make another one for you?” As a member of the palace, Yao Zhi felt a little embarrassed.
Ye Shuo didn’t care: “I made this myself, it’s good enough to have it, what else can big brother be dissatisfied with?”
Yao Zhi opened her mouth, thinking that her husband was a little too confident…
The next morning, Ye Shuo came again with his gift.
Princess Ding and Ye Yan were now full of gratitude towards Ye Shuo. They didn’t care what he gave them as a gift and started praising him nonsensically.
The eldest prince who was eating at the side frowned and asked suddenly: “What is this?”
“Give it to you!” Ye Shuo took it in front of his cheap brother.
“It’s specially given to you. Do you like it?”
You want to give this thing to me? Can you call this a walking stick? The tree branches that beggars on the street are smoother than this thing!
The eldest prince was about to sneer, but he saw that his princess had already frowned, with a threatening look in her eyes.
“…”
After a moment of silence and weighing the pros and cons in his mind, the eldest prince swallowed back the sarcastic words that were about to come out of his mouth. With a stiff face, he almost forced himself to praise: “Thank you, Xiaojiu, I… like you very much…”
“As long as you like it, remember to use it.”
Ye Shuo put the crutches aside, and then he realised that the eldest prince was actually eating. Although it was just some porridge and side dishes, he was slowly returning to a normal diet.
“Ah… I thought you could hold on for a few more days.” Especially seeing the cheap brother tied to the bed, helpless and furious, it was estimated that he would not be able to see it anymore.
Glancing at the disappointment in his brother’s eyes, the eldest prince’s eyelids started twitching suddenly. He didn’t say anything, but he wielded his chopsticks more and more skillfully.
But speaking of which, he is so close now, it seems like an opportunity…
The eldest prince acted as fast as lightning and grabbed forward without hesitation.
However, what he didn’t expect was that Ye Shuo, who seemed relaxed, jumped three feet high like a rabbit.
Although Ye Shuo seemed careless, he had actually been on guard against this trick for a long time. How could he succeed so easily?
“Brother, brother, you can’t do this. You need to practise more.”
Ye Shuo had a sighing look on his face, which made the eldest prince very angry. However, this was not enough. Before leaving, Ye Shuo snatched away several buns in front of the eldest prince and patted him on the shoulder in a particularly provocative manner.
“Brother, keep working hard!”
The eldest prince almost broke his chopsticks as he watched the young man leave.
It’s so infuriating. It’s really so infuriating!
When his back disappeared, the eldest prince’s gaze inevitably fell on the armpit crutches beside him.
This thing has a strange shape and is made very crudely. I have never seen it before and have no idea how to use it.
The eldest prince fiddled with it for a long time and finally got the hang of it. Then he found that although this thing was a bit ugly, it seemed to be much more useful than the crutches made by the craftsmen in the palace.
My younger brother really underestimates me. He actually dares to take out such a thing. He really doesn’t take me seriously.
The eldest prince was holding back his anger. No matter what, he had to catch him, otherwise he would not be able to rest in peace even after his death!
The eldest prince remained silent. When Ye Shuo was not around, he used two crutches to walk around the yard. Even though calluses appeared on his armpits and hands, he was unwilling to stop.
But when Ye Shuo appeared, the eldest prince acted as if nothing had happened, and even pretended to be weak occasionally. He was waiting for the day when Ye Shuo completely let down his guard. The eldest prince swore that he would make him taste the feeling of being tied to the bed and having his mouth pried open to be fed!
As the days passed, the eldest prince’s arms became stronger and stronger, and he swung his armpit crutches so fast that soon even his afterimages could be seen.
Everything was originally developing in a good direction. While Ye Yan and his brothers breathed a sigh of relief, they were especially grateful to Ye Shuo.
Until one day, Ye Yan saw his father’s deputy general walking out from the back door of his uncle’s palace…

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Background
chapters.content:
At first Ye Yan didn’t take this matter to heart, but when he walked back, the more Ye Yan thought about it, the more he felt something was wrong.
Why did Vice Admiral Lin come out of the Eighth Prince’s house?
It would be fine if he came out from the front door, but he saw two people coming out from the back door. Why can’t they show it openly to others? It’s really suspicious to be so secretive.
Ye Yan told Princess Ding about this without much hesitation.
After hearing this, Princess Ding paused what she was doing.
Ten years have passed since their family returned from the border. Princess Ding has always had a good impression of her younger brother-in-law.
The Eighth Prince was very cute when he was young, and he became smart and clever when he grew up. Every time she met him in his mother’s palace, he would make her and his mother laugh. Over time, Princess Ding began to treat him as her own brother, and every time they encountered something, Princess Ding would inevitably protect him in front of the eldest prince.
However, this scene was so subtle, and at this critical moment, it was hard for Princess Ding not to think too much.
“Besides you, was there anyone else present at the time? Was your eighth uncle able to discover it?” Princess Ding couldn’t help but ask.
Ye Yan shook his head. After all, he was not a fool, so he subconsciously kept silent.Ye Yan had been practising martial arts since he was young. He walked very lightly and was particularly good at hiding himself, so the Eighth Prince naturally could not discover him in time.
“That’s good.”
Princess Ding heaved a sigh of relief upon hearing this. After thinking for a while, she warned, “Your father has just recovered and cannot stand any stimulation. Please don’t make this public and don’t tell anyone else.”
Ye Yan nodded without much hesitation: “I will listen to my mother.”
Just when Princess Ding was hesitating whether or not to tell the eldest prince and exactly how to say it, what Princess Ding did not expect was that the eldest prince actually took the initiative to bring up this matter.
It was an extremely ordinary evening. Three months had passed since the eldest prince was injured. Under the ravages of the cruel reality, the eldest prince gradually realised that no matter how hard he struggled, his right leg that was chopped off by those people from Beiting would never come back.
After experiencing madness, decadence, and despair, the eldest prince finally accepted reality.
Besides, he had already written a letter of guarantee and put his lip print under the princess’s coercion. The eldest prince had never been an erratic person, and now he was too embarrassed to do the suicidal thing he had done before.
Since there was no way he could commit suicide anymore, the eldest prince would inevitably start thinking about the future.
Although some of those who followed him were his father’s men, the eldest prince still had many die-hard followers around him. Now he could see that it was impossible, and with so many people, the eldest prince had to find a way out for them.
Now he only has a few brothers left, the fifth, sixth and seventh brothers. Unless the eldest prince has been kicked in the head by a donkey, he would not give away so many good things to outsiders.
As for the Eighth Brother and the Ninth Brother… the eldest prince would definitely choose the Eighth Brother without hesitation, as he was his own brother from the same mother. Even though the Ninth Brother came to visit him every day, the eldest prince still did not give it too much thought. He already had the answer in his mind, but in his heart, he couldn’t help but say sorry to the Ninth Brother.
As for the prince behind Xiaojiu… the eldest prince didn’t even think about it and just passed by.
Who are those people? A bunch of half-grown boys who haven’t even grown all their hair yet, are they qualified to be on the same level as them? No matter what, that position will never be theirs.
However, just as the eldest prince finished speaking to Princess Ding, he noticed that there was something wrong with Princess Ding’s expression.
The eldest prince thought Princess Ding had considered Ye Yan and the others, and subconsciously explained: “It’s not that I don’t want to leave those things to Yan’er and the others, but even if I give them to them, Yan’er and the others may not be able to convince them.”
Ye Yan and his younger generation are not of high enough status to handle this.
“What’s more, this kind of thing has always been a double-edged sword. For Yan’er and the others, it would be better if it didn’t happen.”
It would be fine if his sons were gifted, and the eldest prince would fight for them even at the cost of his life. However, as Ye Yan and the others grew up, the eldest prince knew in his heart that although Ye Yan and his brothers were indeed excellent, they were far from being able to change their fate.
So let’s just forget it.
But what was Princess Ding thinking?
After a few hesitations, Princess Ding finally told Ye Yan what had happened that day.
The first reaction of the eldest prince upon hearing this was—
“This is impossible!”
The eldest prince almost blurted out.
Because the eldest prince is thirteen or fourteen years older than the eighth prince, the eldest prince’s impression of his younger brother is still that of the smart and clever child he once was.
When the eldest prince left home, the eighth prince was only two or three years old, and he was the most attached to his elder brother.
At that time, the Eighth Prince was full of admiration. Ever since he learned to walk, he followed him wherever he went. When he learned that he was leaving, his younger brother cried bitterly in his mother’s palace, holding his hand and insisting on leaving with him.
The mother was left with no choice but to have the Eighth Prince sent to his residence. On the day the eldest prince was leaving, she was afraid that he would make a fuss again, so she got up early before dawn and left with her family.
As expected, after waking up, the eighth prince found that his brother was missing. He cried for several days. Later, his mother used many methods to gradually divert his attention.
Then, a full ten years passed.
I still remember that when I just came back from the border, the Eighth Prince was only twelve or thirteen years old. When he saw me, there was joy, admiration and nervousness in his eyes. He wanted to get close to me but didn’t dare to. In the end, it was my mother who meditated with a smile, and the two of them gradually became familiar with each other.
All along, the eldest prince felt that there was still a brotherhood between the two of them, and that they would not end up in the same situation as others.
But what his wife and son say cannot be false either.
Thinking of this, the eldest prince quickly calmed down: “When the eighth master comes tomorrow, I will ask him what’s going on.”
The Eighth Prince has to attend court every day, so he is far less free than Ye Shuo. Naturally, he comes less frequently than Ye Shuo, probably only once every four or five days. Counting the days, tomorrow will be about the same.
Seeing that the eldest prince had his own ideas, Princess Ding didn’t say anything else.
The eldest prince is very sentimental, but he is not a heartless person. When encountering such a thing, he can’t help but have doubts in his heart.
After tossing and turning in bed for most of the night, the eldest prince finally fell into a deep sleep near dawn.
The next day, the Eighth Prince was completely unaware and came to visit as usual.
Seeing his elder brother getting better and better day by day, the Eighth Prince couldn’t help but feel complicated, feeling happy but also a little regretful.
The eldest prince had something on his mind, and he didn’t try to hide it, so after a few words, the eighth prince vaguely realised that something was wrong.
Some things have been done and they are done, no matter how well you hide them, there will still be flaws.
The Eighth Prince never imagined that even though his elder brother was in such a state, he was still so well-informed. He was slightly shocked, but it was only for a short moment, and then the Eighth Prince knelt down with a thud.
Looking at his younger brother, what else did the eldest prince not understand?
The eighth prince knew that he could not think of shirking responsibility at this time, so he simply admitted his mistake.
However, no matter how good his attitude was, the eldest prince’s words made him completely lose his temper.
“I don’t care about anything else. I just want to ask you, when did you start to have this idea?”
The eldest prince has been running the army for many years, and although he is now in decline, he is still far from ordinary. He will not be deceived by the sweet words in front of him, and his words hit the nail on the head.
If it was just a recent thought, it would be fine, but if it happened in the past… the eldest prince would inevitably weigh in his mind the value of the brotherhood between the two of them.
The Eighth Prince was startled, and immediately realised how big a flaw he had revealed when his heart was overwhelmed.
In a flash, beads of cold sweat covered the back of the Eighth Prince. The Eighth Prince knew that if his answer could not satisfy his eldest brother, he would not be able to pass this test.
However, just as the Eighth Prince was frantically thinking of a countermeasure, the First Prince seemed to see through his thoughts and slowly spoke: “Don’t fool me, this kind of thing is not difficult to investigate.”
It’s over… Hearing these words, the Eighth Prince felt utterly disappointed.
The eldest prince could never have imagined that he had already visited his mother’s palace on the day he returned to Beijing, not a few days ago, not this month, nor last month.
What a great Eighth Prince! What a brother from the same mother!
Now, he actually used his clever mind on himself.
“Good, very good!” The eldest prince’s chest heaved violently, and he lost control and broke the teacup in his hand with a bang, which showed how excited he was at the moment.
The eldest prince practised the armpit crutches very hard, originally intending to use them to deal with Xiaojiu, but he did not expect that he would end up using them on his own brother.
In the end, the eldest prince beat him almost from his own courtyard to the gate of the palace in one breath.
The Eighth Prince tried to resist, but was beaten by the storm-like afterimages of the cane and fled away. Finally, the Eighth Prince became anxious and said, “Brother, I am your biological brother!”
“Brother, I know I was wrong, so what if you just forgive me this time?”
What the Eighth Prince didn’t know was that before today, the First Prince sincerely wanted to teach him what he had.
And it was precisely because of this that the eldest prince could not accept it. If the eighth prince had not been so impatient, if he had waited a little longer, everything would have been very different.
Also, there are some things that the eldest prince can give voluntarily, but others cannot ask for them, cannot snatch them, and certainly cannot covet them.
The Eighth Prince not only took it all, but also took it sneakily. How could the First Prince tolerate him?
In the past, the First Prince only thought that Little Nine was hateful, but now, in comparison, even Little Nine has become much cuter.
At the very least, Xiaojiu simply wanted to watch himself having fun, while the rest of them just wanted to drain him completely in one breath.
“I was blind in the past to see such a heartless person!” The eldest prince returned to his yard angrily with two crutches. He couldn’t help but curse on the spot.
This happened again and again, and the eldest prince felt that there was something wrong with his way of judging people.
“Since he is so unkind, don’t blame me for being unjust. I will just feed those things to the dogs–” Forget it, it would be a pity to feed them to the dogs.
The eldest prince paused for a moment, then immediately changed his words: “I would rather give it to Xiaojiu than to him!”
Hey, wait, where’s Xiaojiu?
After sitting there panting for a long time, the eldest prince finally realised that he hadn’t seen his younger brother for several days.
The eldest prince turned around and couldn’t help but ask, “Where’s Xiaojiu?”

chapters.title: Chapter 244: Terror
chapters.content:
At the same time, in Prince Rui’s Mansion, Ye Shuo, who was nestling in Yao Zhi’s arms, couldn’t help but sneeze.
“A-choo!”
Seeing this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel a little worried: “Did you catch a cold?”
Ye Shuo was about to say that he was not that fragile, but when he noticed her look, he thought about it and shook his head: “I don’t know…”
Then he added: “I do feel a little cold.”
Winter is coming and the weather is getting colder. Even at noon it is not as warm as before.
Yao Zhi subconsciously hugged him tighter, then realised that she might have been deceived.
But after catching the cunning in his eyes, Yao Zhi hesitated for a moment, and ultimately did not expose him.
Yao Zhi was reading a book in her hand while rubbing his earlobe from time to time. After a while, Ye Shuo closed his eyes comfortably.
As Yao Zhi watched, she couldn’t help but ask, “Why haven’t you visited big brother in the past few days?” In the past, he used to visit big brother very frequently.Ye Shuo sighed when he heard this: “I’m too lazy to go. It’s boring.”
The eldest prince is now like a chicken with blood pumped up. He runs around the palace on crutches all day long. He swings his crutches with great vigour, and the muscles on his arms are even more obvious than before. Ye Shuo weighed the matter for a long time and felt that it was not cost-effective. What if one day he is not paying attention and is pounced on and bitten by him? Wouldn’t that be a big loss for him?
So he really went to see the eldest prince make a fool of himself before…
Yao Zhi paused while rubbing his earlobe, but didn’t say anything. If he didn’t want to go, then he didn’t have to go. What was the big deal?
On the other hand, Ye Yan was surprised for a moment when he didn’t expect his father to ask about his ninth uncle at this time. He said, “Uncle Nine may be busy recently…”
Seeing the eldest prince frowning, Ye Yan hurriedly said, “Son will go to Uncle Jiu’s house and take a look!”
Having said that, Ye Yan disappeared in a flash.
Ye Yan and Ye Shuo grew up together, so the housekeeper did not stop him when he saw him. Xiao Luzi wanted to remind him, but before he could say anything, Ye Yan didn’t think too much and just walked in.
Then, Ye Yan saw the scene of his uncle leaning in the arms of his aunt.
Ye Yan was completely dumbfounded.
In a flash, Yao Zhi pushed the young man away. Ye Shuo cleared his throat, not blushing at all, and even reminded him, “Remember to knock on the door next time.”
Ye Yanmu nodded dumbly, but what he was thinking was, it turns out that the uncle and aunt are actually like this in private…
So the question is, how should I tell this to the Ninth Prince?
Finally, Ye Yan thought about it and said, “Uncle Jiu, my father wants to see you.”
Ye Shuo was stunned for a moment, and without much thought, he said: “If that’s the case, let him come over. I happen to be free.”
Ye Shuo’s logic was very simple. Since the eldest prince had something to do, he would definitely come to him on his own initiative. It seemed that he had never thought about whether the eldest prince could go out now that he was missing a leg.
Ye Yan couldn’t help sweating when he heard this: “Uncle Jiu, my father is not very convenient now…”
“What’s the inconvenience? I think you guys are just pampering him too much. It’s just a few steps away, he can’t stay at home all his life, right?” People always try to take the first step, and now is a good opportunity.
Hearing this, Ye Yan could no longer hold back and could not help but remind him: “Uncle Jiu, this is really not a great thing.” Even he himself felt jealous.
But helplessly, Ye Yan also knew his own capabilities. If he could take advantage of the situation, there would be no problem at all. But in this situation, Ye Yan could not see the way forward at all.
Ye Shuo thought about it, but couldn’t find what he was missing, so…
“Either he comes here in person, or you ask clearly before coming.”
Ye Yan: “…”
Ye Yan took a deep breath, turned around and left.
Not to mention him, even the eldest prince was stunned, with an incredible look on his face: “You didn’t tell him, is it a good thing?”
Ye Yan looked aggrieved: “I said it.” But the Ninth Prince refused to come no matter what. What else could he do?
The eldest prince sat there, unable to come back to his senses for a long time.
Since he doesn’t want it, then I’m not willing to give it to him!
The eldest prince was furious, but he changed his mind and thought that if the matter was left at that, Xiaojiu might never know what he had missed, so he had to say it.
After telling him, let him beg me in return…
The eldest prince’s brows were sometimes furrowed and sometimes relaxed, and he was not tangled at all. Finally, the eldest prince said, “Go and secretly spread the news and tell him about what happened to your eighth uncle today.”
In this case, anyone with a bit of common sense would know that he wants to delegate power.
Ye Yan was suddenly a little confused. Why make it so complicated? After guessing for so long, he might as well just tell Uncle Jiu.
However, Princess Ding on the side noticed something and realised that her husband was trying to get back at his brother-in-law.
The eldest prince had already thought of several ways to make things difficult for him when the time came, and he suddenly felt relieved.
Seeing his son still standing there like a log, the eldest prince immediately frowned and said, “What are you still standing there for? Hurry up and go!”
Ye Yan was startled and moved quickly.
About half an hour later, Ye Yan returned here with a strange expression.
The eldest prince cleared his throat, picked up a new teacup, and asked slowly, “Why, what did your uncle say?”
“Well…”
Ye Yan scratched his head, stuttering and stumbling: “My ninth uncle told you not to be sad. It was indeed Uncle Eighth who was wrong. He said you fought well and he expressed his deep sympathy for you.”
After waiting for a long time without any follow-up, the first prince, who was calm and composed at first, could not help but be dumbfounded: “Just… just this?”
Ye Yan nodded: “Yeah, that’s all.”
Ye Yan didn’t even dare to say that at first Uncle Jiu looked very interested, as if he was listening to a story. Only after he finished listening did he become serious.
The eldest prince’s mouth twitched slightly.
How can there be such a useless person in this world? He can’t even understand the voice-over of others! ?
With the Zhen Mansion, the soldiers in his hands, his father’s favour and his own status, Xiaojiu may not be powerless to fight against Laoliu (little eight). Even if God chases him and feeds him, he can’t get anything in his mouth. How can someone be so useless?
The eldest prince could no longer hold back, so he stood up and said, “I’ll go there myself.”
Under Ye Yan’s dull gaze, the eldest prince walked out of Prince Ding’s Mansion angrily, leaning on a pair of crutches.
After walking out of the gate of Prince Ding’s Mansion and looking at the people coming and going on the street, the eldest prince calmed down almost instantly, and his hands holding the crutches became a little stiff.
But now that he has already come out, he will naturally not retreat.
Along the way, the eldest prince always felt that everyone here was looking at him, laughing at him, pointing at him, and felt in his heart that he was a useless person. Suddenly, the eldest prince felt like he was stripped naked in the street, and his heart was filled with shame.
As luck would have it, the Seventh Prince happened to pass by, noticed the movement not far away, and subconsciously looked over.
When he saw the familiar figure, the Seventh Prince couldn’t help but be stunned, as if he didn’t expect that the Eldest Prince would recover so quickly.
However, the eldest prince misunderstood, thinking that the seventh prince deliberately stopped to laugh at him, and immediately glared back at him fiercely.
It’s all my useless brother’s fault!
Without waiting for the Seventh Prince to react, the First Prince took two quick steps, then turned around and went into the Prince Rui’s Palace next door.
Only after the gate of Prince Rui’s Palace was closed again did the eldest prince breathe a sigh of relief.
Under the guidance of the butler, the eldest prince came to Ye Shuo’s courtyard.
Not long after, after hearing everything and his own plan, the eldest prince was fully convinced that Xiaojiu would finally give in this time. However, what the eldest prince did not expect was that within just a few breaths, deep fear began to overflow from his eyes bit by bit.
Caught off guard, the eldest prince was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Serious Illness
chapters.content:
How could Ye Shuo not be terrified?
The cheap big brother actually had such an idea in mind. No wonder Ye Yan was hesitating just now, looking like he wanted to say something but couldn’t. For something like this, Ye Shuo never thought about himself at all.
Then, Ye Shuo rushed forward without hesitation and covered the eldest prince’s mouth with his hands.
“Brother, just treat it as your brother begging you to stop talking nonsense, okay?”
At first Ye Shuo thought that the eldest prince was so anxious to come and beat him up, but now it seems that he might as well get beaten up.
Ye Shuo subconsciously looked around, and when he found that they were the only two in the room, he breathed a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, fortunately, the cheap brother is not so tactless. He had already sent the servants away when he was talking just now. Otherwise, if this got to Xiao Ming’s ears, it would be a disaster!
Even so, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but jump up and down: “Brother, it’s true that I just watched you having fun for a few days, but it’s not a crime. Why do you repay kindness with hatred!”
“Repaying kindness with enmity? You actually said that I repay kindness with enmity?!” The pride in his heart shattered in an instant, and the eldest prince pushed his hand away with an incredible look on his face.
“Did you understand what I just said?” The eldest prince wanted to get angry at first, but thinking about his younger brother’s brain, he barely suppressed his anger, then broke it down and explained it to him again.But what he didn’t know was that it was because he understood what he was saying that Ye Shuo was so frightened, okay?
Just ask who wouldn’t be scared if this happened to them!
After a while, Ye Shuo’s head was shaking like a rattle.
“I don’t care. I don’t want it. You can find whoever you want, but don’t find me.”
Ye Shuo has been the prince for so many years, and he is finally going to retire. If he is asked to get involved at this time, wouldn’t that be like asking him to die? He would be crazy to agree to work for 007 while living such a stable and comfortable life now.
The eldest prince was also shocked: “You know, your eighth brother tried his best to take this list!”
However, the other brother was so resistant that for a moment, the eldest prince felt completely insulted.
Ye Shuo did not hesitate and said, “Since Big Brother wants it, then just give it to Big Brother.”
“Don’t you think that I don’t want it? If it can be given, will it be your turn?” What the eldest prince said was absolutely true. If it can be left to one’s own people, no one would give such a good thing to others.
But the eldest prince now clearly sees in his heart that his own brother… is not a person worthy of trust. No matter how much he talks now, it can’t change his profit-seeking nature.
If something like this happens once, it will definitely happen a second time.
Ye Shuo thought about it and felt that it was true, so he said, “Then you should just give it to Xiao Ming. You can also earn some favours, which is a good thing.”
After hearing this, the eldest prince’s head suddenly became filled with blood.
It was already humiliating enough that he had failed to seize the throne and was overtaken by others. Now he had to surrender to the Sixth Prince like a dog, taking away all his years of hard work. How could the eldest prince tolerate this?
The eldest prince had not forgotten that the Sixth Prince had used him as a stepping stone to get into his father’s sight.
“I would rather feed them to a dog than give it to him!” the eldest prince blurted out in rage.
Ye Shuo: “…”
How come even at this point, the cheap brother  still can’t let it go…
In this case, there is only one last solution left.
Ye Shuo said: “Since this and that don’t work, just keep them in your hands.” Anyway, his cheap brother has completely lost hope. Even if he has more things in his hands, it won’t be a big deal. Those people at most won’t be able to get promoted, and their lives should not be in danger.
Rather than following the wrong person, it is better to maintain the status quo.
Seeing that he refused to agree after all he said, the eldest prince became anxious: “Don’t you want to sit in that position?”
The eldest prince had never seen a prince who did not have this kind of thoughts, especially the kind of prince who had a great chance but remained motionless.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo shook his head very honestly: “No.”
The eldest prince was stunned.
After reacting, the eldest prince who had successfully created a misunderstanding could not help but grit his teeth and say, “What kind of magic potion did the Sixth Prince give you that makes you so afraid of him?” He did not even have the slightest thought of resisting.
I’m not really afraid, but I’m definitely worried.
If Xiao Ming was gone, what if the Great Zhou Dynasty was destroyed by someone? At that time, there would be turmoil both internally and externally, and not only would the common people suffer, but he, the prince, would also suffer.
So this should also be considered a disguised form of fear? Thinking about it carefully, what the eldest prince said is not wrong.
Ye Shuo nodded hurriedly: “Afraid.”
Seeing that his younger brother spoke without hesitation, with a sincere and serious look on his face, as if he was saying something that was the most natural thing, the eldest prince’s head buzzed, and the string called reason was completely broken.
The eldest prince stood up in an instant, leaning on his crutches, and cursed at him: “Idiot, coward, waste! You are such a useless person!”
Caught off guard and sprayed in the face, Ye Shuo didn’t take it seriously and even laughed: “Since big brother knows, don’t embarrass your younger brother.”
Ye Shuo doesn’t care about face or not. He wishes all his brothers would think he is a waste.
The eldest prince’s hands suddenly began to move.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo suddenly became alert and subconsciously took several steps back.
“I’m telling you, don’t do anything. You can’t beat me now, and I won’t be polite.”
Hearing the noise, Yao Zhi thought something had happened and hurried in.
Seeing that the two were about to draw their swords, Yao Zhi frowned and subconsciously blocked the young man with her sword. Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but cast a smug look at his cheap brother.
It can be seen that he is not only afraid of the Sixth Prince, but also likes to live off women.
How could their Ye family produce such a weirdo? It’s really amazing.
The eldest prince’s eyelids twitched violently a few times.
In the end, the eldest prince looked at him carefully, said “Don’t regret it”, and left angrily.
Only then did Yao Zhi look at her young husband.
“What’s wrong?” she asked casually.
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate and told her what happened just now. At the end, he couldn’t help but feel indignant: “Isn’t this pure deception? If I had known this, I would have ignored him!”
Yao Zhi: “…”
Although she also didn’t want him to be dragged into the vortex of the fight for the throne, at this moment, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel a little sympathy for him.
I guess the eldest prince must have felt very aggrieved just now…
After a while, Ye Yan and Princess Ding thought that their father/prince would calm down soon, but unexpectedly, after a trip to Prince Rui’s mansion, he became even angrier when he came back.
His father/prince was so angry that he kept cursing all the way and knocking his cane loudly.
No need to think about it, it definitely didn’t work.
Ye Yan and Princess Ding were also extremely surprised. The mother and son looked at each other and saw a hint of amazement in each other’s eyes.
The other side.
The Seventh Prince only knew that his eldest brother went to Prince Rui’s Palace, but there was no movement after that. After paying attention for a long time, he did not see any subsequent actions from the two, so he gave up.
Perhaps the commotion was so loud that even the Sixth Prince heard about it. So when he met his younger brother in the palace, he casually asked a few questions.
“What happened on that day that made Big Brother so angry?”
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but scratch his head, looking embarrassed.
It felt like it wasn’t a good idea to say this out loud, but lying to him would be even worse, so Ye Shuo thought about it and said, “Can I… not tell you?”
The Sixth Prince never thought that he would actually say such a thing to him. After all, usually when the brothers encountered something they didn’t want to tell others, they would either talk about it or just laugh it off. This was the first time that the Sixth Prince heard such an answer.
But in fact, Ye Shuo didn’t want to do that, but there was no way, none of his brothers were fools, and instead of lying and being caught, which would make everyone embarrassed, it would be better to be honest.
Those who treat others as fools and like to be clever are the real fools.
The Sixth Prince was silent for a while, and asked for the first time: “What if I really want to listen?”
Normally, the Sixth Prince was a very tactful person, so why was he different when he met him?
Ye Shuo sighed in his heart, looked around, and found that there was no one else, so he pulled him aside and said in a voice that only the two of them could hear: “I can tell you, but you have to keep it a secret.”
The Sixth Prince nodded.
Then, he found out that the eldest prince wanted to force the things that the eighth prince wanted on Xiaojiu.
“…”
He never expected that he would actually tell this matter out loud. The Sixth Prince was speechless for a long time.
“Okay, I’ve finished. Do you have anything else to add? If not, I’m leaving.” Ye Shuo pointed to Chengming Palace not far away.
Since he had already asked, it would be rude not to reciprocate, so the Sixth Prince reluctantly gave his opinion.
“The Eighth Prince has too bad a character, so he is not the best choice. As for you… I am afraid you cannot convince the people, so you are not the best candidate either.” As for himself, the Sixth Prince had never considered him at all. With the eldest prince’s temper, he would rather feed the dog than leave it for himself.
I have to say, the Sixth Prince’s guess was really accurate.
“It’s best to let go of those who are determined to climb up. If they are not, it’s fine to keep them in Big Brother’s hand.”
“Isn’t that right?” Ye Shuo agreed deeply.
“That’s what I told my eldest brother, but he still scolded me. He really doesn’t know how to appreciate a good person!”
“Okay, I won’t talk to you anymore. I guess Dad is getting impatient waiting for me. I’m leaving first. You…you should do your best. Bye!”
Looking at Xiaojiu’s back, the Sixth Prince opened his mouth. After a long while, he sighed deeply, with a look of helplessness on his face.
There’s no way, I just can’t get angry…
In the end, just as the Sixth Prince had expected, the Eighth Prince’s eyes became red, the First Prince held those people and refused to give them to him, and the First Prince tried his best to stuff them into Xiaojiu’s hands, but Xiaojiu seemed to have encountered a flood and a beast, and in the end he simply avoided him. It must be said that this scene was really funny.
The days passed one by one, and in the blink of an eye the whole winter was over.
On New Year’s Eve, the eldest prince hesitated for a while, but finally came to the palace on crutches to attend the family dinner.
At the family dinner, the eldest prince was like a firecracker. He couldn’t help but suspect that others were talking about him when they were whispering below, so he simply armed himself, and when he saw someone looking in his direction, he immediately put on a murderous expression.
Now that the eldest prince has lost a leg, his temper has become even more violent. But if you think about it, it is understandable. If it were me, I guess I wouldn’t be much better.
When the eldest prince met Emperor Jingwen, they were both silent for a while, and then turned their heads away at the same time.
Emperor Jingwen was thinking, if he remembered correctly, the eldest brother is almost forty years old this year, and he doesn’t look as proud as before.
The eldest prince was thinking in his heart that the old man was really old. He could not even stand steadily and needed someone to help him walk.
Emperor Jingwen distributed New Year’s money to his sons, daughters, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren as usual. On the surface, Ye Shuo received the same amount as everyone else, but in fact, his stepfather had secretly given a big red envelope to him, Jian Jian and Yao Zhi before the dinner started.
However, after just half an hour, Emperor Jingwen could no longer sit still. Seeing this, Ye Shuo stood up and helped him back to Chengming Hall.
It’s no use. I’m really old and I’m afraid I don’t have many days left.
After just a few steps, Emperor Jingwen was a little out of breath. He knew in his heart that he might not have much time left, and the imperial doctors who looked more and more frightened when they saw him also confirmed this.
Looking sideways at his youngest son, who was still very young, Emperor Jingwen could not help but think as his consciousness blurred, “Just hold on a little longer, hold on a little longer. At least, I can hold on until his birthday…”
After a while, Emperor Jingwen fell into a deep sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Death
chapters.content:
The further time went by, the more Emperor Jingwen needed someone to be by his side. Finally, Ye Shuo thought about it and decided to move into the palace with Yao Zhi.
Anyway, this wasn’t the first time he broke the rules, so everyone turned a blind eye and no one said anything.
Now, more than a year has passed since his youngest son got married. Emperor Jingwen thought that given how much they loved each other, Princess Rui should have been pregnant a long time ago. However, he waited and waited, but after such a long time, there was no result.
Finally, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but ask, but the answer he got almost made him die of anger.
This bastard doesn’t even think about having a child now!
“You turned a deaf ear to everything I said to you!” I hinted at him in both obvious and covert ways, and he just pretended not to know, right?
Emperor Jingwen was almost pissed off by him.
However, having a child is a very serious matter. I can’t just give birth to one with Yao Zhi because of my cheap father’s expectations, right? This is too irresponsible.
What’s more, he and Yao Zhi are not ready yet.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help scratching his chin: “Well… my son wants to play for a few more years.”Play, play, play, he only knows how to play!
If Emperor Jingwen was not unable to get out of bed, he would have to give him a good beating.
Seeing that his forceful approach was not going to work, Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath and began to appeal to his emotions and reason: “My health is getting worse and worse, can’t you just listen to me? Just this once, is that all that’s not going to work?”
Although my cheap dad’s behaviour is quite soft-hearted, there are some things that cannot be confused at all. This is the principle.
So Ye Shuo hesitated for a long time, and finally shook his head: “Dad, why don’t you change your request? This… is really not possible.”
Although Ye Shuo was extremely sincere, as an emperor, what did Emperor Jingwen want? What else did he need? Everything he had now, which one was not given by himself?
Emperor Jingwen wanted to have a grandson, or at least a granddaughter, as long as it was his child, but it was obvious that it was too late.
Emperor Jingwen felt more and more depressed: “Get out, Wang Ziquan, go and drive him out for me!”
Wang Ziquan had no choice but to silently say “I’m sorry”, then beat Ye Shuo out with a rattan stick.
“…What happened again?” As soon as the Sixth Prince stepped into Chengming Palace, he saw Xiaojiu in such an embarrassing state and couldn’t help but feel puzzled.
Ye Shuo shrugged, his tone extremely helpless: “What else can I do? I made my father angry.”
The Sixth Prince was speechless. It was already this time and his younger brother didn’t even bother to obey their father.
But considering his personality, it would be strange if he really became obedient.
“Forget it. I won’t talk to you anymore. I’m going back to Qiuwu Palace for dinner. See you later!”
Looking at his brother’s hurried back, the Sixth Prince laughed, and then when he turned around, he couldn’t help but become respectful and cautious again.
Since Ye Shuo was already being pushed forward by Emperor Jingwen, how could Yao Zhi be left behind? Even the Imperial Concubine had mentioned it several times, both openly and covertly, but was blocked by Ye Shuo.
The Imperial Concubine was almost pissed off by her unruly son.
“Wait wait wait wait, how many years do you want me to wait?”
Defei and her family will soon have grandchildren who will start giving birth one after another. How can the Imperial Noble Concubine not be anxious?
But there was nothing she could do despite her anxiety. Ye Shuo continued to do what he wanted. Anyway, he was used to being willful. In the end, Emperor Jingwen and the Imperial Concubine had no choice but to compromise.
While Yao Zhi felt relieved, she also felt a little distressed.
Since the two of them have already gotten married, the issue of offspring has become a matter for both of them. Now that he has to shoulder the entire responsibility alone, Yao Zhi can’t help feeling a little guilty.
But she really wasn’t ready to be a mother, so there was nothing she could do except to be nice to him and compensate him.
Once Ye Shuo can no longer hold on, he will choose to transfer his firepower to the innocent Jian Jian, since she is free anyway.
It just so happens that Jianjian is already fourteen years old, which is the right age to discuss marriage.
“Mother, you only care about me, why don’t you care about my sister? If you don’t pay attention to the young talents in the capital, I’m afraid they will be picked up by others by then.”
Feeling her mother’s gaze, Jianjian’s heart immediately tightened.
At this moment, Jianjian really wanted to eat her brother alive, bones and all.
Jianjian acted decisively and refused decisively.
In her opinion, having a brother was troublesome enough, and she could barely handle it herself. She really didn’t need an outsider to come and cause more trouble.
This son and daughter, one only knows how to play and refuses to have children, while the other regards engagement as a disaster, which makes the Imperial Concubine worried to death.
Really, no one is worry-free.
After hearing all this, Emperor Jingwen was also very worried. He didn’t dare to give up so easily.
But helpless, sometimes, there are things that he can’t decide.
Although Emperor Jingwen has been very cooperative with the imperial physician and takes medicine every day, his health is still getting worse day by day. At this moment, Emperor Jingwen’s body is like a funnel, and the sand in the funnel has now reached the bottom. No matter what, he can’t delay it any longer.
Spring soon arrived. On Ye Shuo’s birthday, Emperor Jingwen, who had been somewhat listless for nearly half a month, suddenly perked up for the first time. He was not drowsy as usual, but opened his eyes early in the morning.
When Wang Ziquan came in the morning, he found that Emperor Jingwen had gotten down from the ground by himself, and the basin of water in his hand immediately began to ripple.
In just a moment, Wang Ziquan recovered as usual, and even laughed: “Your Majesty got up really early today, and I didn’t even have time to call you. It shows that the medicine prescribed by Doctor Meng is really effective. I see that your complexion has improved a lot.”
Emperor Jingwen smiled and said nothing.
When Ye Shuo arrived, Emperor Jingwen, who was also not dressed properly, was startled, but then he had a bad premonition in his mind.
Suppressing the uneasiness in his heart, Ye Shuo pretended to be puzzled and asked, “Dad, you got up early today, but what do you want to do?”
Seeing that he hadn’t reacted yet, Emperor Jingwen said unhappily, “Isn’t today your birthday?”
Ye Shuo just remembered that this was the case. There were too many things going on recently, which made him feel depressed. Ye Shuo completely forgot what day it was today.
Seeing his youngest son in a daze, Emperor Jingwen did not hesitate to speak again: “It is still early in the morning, so you can accompany me to stroll in the Imperial Garden.”
Ye Shuo naturally agreed.
Maybe he had a premonition of something, but Emperor Jingwen said a lot while they were strolling around the garden. Most of it was about the future. He told Ye Shuo to stop being so willful and to control his temper.
In the end, Ye Shuo could hardly maintain the expression on his face.
Under the gaze of Emperor Jingwen, he nodded silently: “Son, I understand.”
Emperor Jingwen was relieved.
At noon, Emperor Jingwen specially asked the imperial kitchen to prepare a large copper pot. For some reason, he suddenly wanted to eat something tasty today. After taking medicine every day for such a long time, Emperor Jingwen’s tongue was numb. Today, he finally tasted the salty, fresh and spicy taste.
There was no one else in the entire Chengming Hall except Emperor Jingwen, Ye Shuo, Imperial Noble Consort Jian Jian, and Yao Zhi.
When she first came in and saw the expression on Emperor Jingwen’s face, Yao Zhi’s expression could not help but change slightly. She had been practising medicine for so many years, how could she not know that her father was…
But Yao Zhi did not show it and quietly accompanied Emperor Jingwen to finish the lunch.
During the dinner, Emperor Jingwen also gave her many instructions. It was obvious that they were just telling her to live in harmony with her husband and wife and to avoid any grudges in the future.
Although Yao Zhi had not known Emperor Jingwen for a long time, her heart was still in knots when she saw this scene.
If she was like this, how would he, her husband, behave?
After leaving the gate of Chengming Palace, just when Yao Zhi was hesitating about how to start the conversation, the next moment, she saw the young man’s hand coming up to hold hers.
Only then did Yao Zhi realise that his hands were so cold at this moment.
“Don’t talk, Dad is still watching.”
When turning the corner, Yao Zhi discovered from the corner of her eye that Emperor Jingwen was standing at the window, looking at this side from afar.
“That’s great…”
When the figures disappeared, Wang Ziquan vaguely heard the emperor mutter these words.
It’s a pity that I may never see such a beautiful scene again…
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even know whether he would remember today if he, as a father, was not there on his youngest son’s birthday next year.
I just hope that they won’t be too sad then.
As night fell and midnight passed, Chengming Palace was suddenly in chaos. Prince Su and Prince Jin were still asleep, but when they received the notice, they rushed to the palace overnight.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: The Emperor Collapses
chapters.content:
“I will trouble you with the rest.”
Looking at their brother who had changed drastically, Prince Jin and Prince Su finally nodded with tears in their eyes.
When Prince Su and Prince Jin came out, Ye Shuo, who was kneeling outside, was about to move, but saw Prince Su shook his head and looked at the Sixth Prince beside him.
“My brother is calling you in.”
The Sixth Prince was stunned for a moment when he heard this, and then he acted quickly.
The fifth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince stared at his back as if they wanted to stare a hole in his back, but they felt extremely powerless in their hearts.
After entering the inner room, the Sixth Prince did not dare to look at anything more. Until now, he still looked cautious and respectful.
In other words, the more it is at this time, the more the Sixth Prince dares not to be careless.
“Father, what do you want?”
Looking at the future successor of the Great Zhou before him, Emperor Jingwen could not say that he liked him very much, but he did not hate him either. Although he had originally favoured the crown prince, after two years, Emperor Jingwen had to admit that he was more suitable for the position than the crown prince.His son never acts on emotion, and every decision he makes is based on interests, which is good. But at the same time, this child has been able to endure since he was young. His character is somewhat similar to his own when he was young, but he is more ruthless than himself. For a moment, Emperor Jingwen didn’t know what his future would be like.
Of course, the Sixth Prince was not without flaws. For example, he had few children. After so many years of marriage with the princess, he only had one son. But this was not a big deal. He had few wives and concubines in the palace. There were only four people in total, including the princess, concubines, and other concubines. When he ascended the throne and started the selection, everything would gradually get better.
Emperor Jingwen was an emperor and a man, so he naturally didn’t think there would be anything wrong with his son.
However, what he didn’t know was that even this matter was within the Sixth Prince’s budget.
It’s not that the Sixth Prince only wanted to find four women, but he had to do so in order to cover up such a big flaw.
Now it seems that it is extremely successful. Even Prime Minister He feels that the Sixth Prince is a man who keeps his promises. After marrying his granddaughter, he rarely touches other women.
How could such a meticulous and thorough Sixth Prince fail?
Looking at the Sixth Prince kneeling below, Emperor Jingwen took two breaths and said, “You have done a good job in Beiting and Chen State.”
Although it was the first time to deal with such an important matter, under his arrangement, the Great Zhou Dynasty was able to withstand the attack from the two countries. Emperor Jingwen was particularly satisfied with this.
“It’s only been two years. War itself is a matter that consumes a lot of national and civilian power. Recently, I have seen that the two countries seem to be retreating. There is also news from the secret guards that Beiting can no longer hold on. In this case, you should find an opportunity to negotiate peace with them.”
Although the Great Zhou still has some strength left, if something goes wrong in the middle, it may cause big problems, so the safest thing to do is to stop here.
Over the years, the three countries have always been like this, fighting and resting, fighting again and resting again, and everyone, including Emperor Jingwen and the Sixth Prince, have long been accustomed to it. The most fundamental purpose this time is just to tell Beiting that their Great Zhou is not so easy to bully, and if they dare to make small moves, they must be prepared for war.
The ascension of a new emperor is basically a time of turmoil. If internal and external troubles come at this time, the Sixth Prince will really not know what to do.
Now that Emperor Jingwen had spoken, the Sixth Prince couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
“I will follow my father’s orders.”
Emperor Jingwen looked at his son who had never been favoured by him since childhood, and finally said, “You… are very good.”
He climbed to this position step by step from nothing. Even Emperor Jingwen could not guarantee that he could do better than him.
“I will hand this kingdom over to you. I hope you will not bring disgrace upon the reputation of the Ye family in the future.”
The Sixth Prince was already past the age of craving for father’s love, and no longer took these matters to heart, but when he heard these words, he still felt a tremor in his heart.
The part that was originally missing in my heart was finally made up.
Although this recognition came too late, it finally came.
The Sixth Prince thought he didn’t care at all, but when that day really came, his eyes became red uncontrollably.
“As your son, I will live up to your father’s trust and will not let him down.”
Finally, the Sixth Prince bowed respectfully and seriously to Emperor Jingwen who was lying on the bed before leaving.
Finally, Emperor Jingwen called Ye Shuo in.
After finishing all other matters, Emperor Jingwen now seemed like a real father.
“In the future, you must listen more to your sixth brother and don’t go against him. I know this will wrong you, but there is nothing I can do about it.” In the future, the sixth prince will be the king and the youngest son will be the minister. As time goes by, this gap will become more and more obvious.
Emperor Jingwen himself was an emperor, and he also had brothers. How could he not understand these things?
“Remember, remember, don’t treat your sixth brother like you treat me.” After I left, the Sixth Prince would never protect his youngest son like I did. Father and son are different from brothers.
Emperor Jingwen had already told him this once yesterday. Perhaps because he was afraid that his youngest son had forgotten, he told him again in a nagging manner.
Holding back tears, Ye Shuo nodded: “Son understands.”
“Also, I have left an imperial decree for you and Jianjian. After I leave, you must not act recklessly because of this imperial decree. Be careful that your sixth brother will punish you.”
“You are an adult now. Don’t be so willful as before. Don’t make your mother angry like before. And you and the princess should pay more attention to Jianjian’s marriage.”
“It’s fine if you and the princess don’t want to have children now, but when you two give birth to a child in the future, regardless of whether it’s a boy or a girl, remember to burn incense for me in the Hall of Supreme Harmony. You must remember, don’t forget.”
Emperor Jingwen actually didn’t know what would happen after death, but he couldn’t help thinking that it would be nice if he could know everything about the world even after death.
And then there is…
“After one month, everything will be over. I will leave you another thing, another thing, thirty miles southwest of the city…”
As he spoke, Emperor Jingwen felt more and more breathless. Seeing this, Ye Shuo could no longer control himself and tears rolled down his face. After a short while, the quilt covering Emperor Jingwen was wet.
Seeing his youngest son crying so hard, Emperor Jingwen felt a pang in his heart and began to tighten his grip on his hand.
“Don’t cry, don’t cry…”
“If…if people could really live forever, …”
How could Emperor Jingwen let go of such a situation?
“Leaving you, you two children behind… I… I really…”
“Also, don’t… don’t blame me…”
Don’t blame me for not being able to leave all the best things for you.
For a moment, Ye Shuo wanted to tell him everything and tell him not to worry, but in the end, Ye Shuo did not say a word.
From beginning to end, even until death, due to their respective identities, neither the father nor the son ever truly opened their hearts to each other.
In the end, Emperor Jingwen left with a heart full of worry and reluctance.
Ye Shuo watched him close his eyes like this, and finally, he couldn’t help but shouted, “Dad!”
Emperor Jingwen seemed to have heard the cry and wanted to respond, but his right hand finally dropped weakly.
In the last moment of his consciousness, numerous scenes flashed before Emperor Jingwen’s eyes, from the time he could remember till now, to this moment.
Among them are the cautiousness and prudence in his youth, the forbearance and humiliation in his youth, the coldness and cruelty after he ascended the throne, and the estrangement between father and son later…
Human life is so short, and there are only a few things that can be remembered.
But in the end, God was kind to him. Although he lost several sons in a row, he was not left completely alone. In the later period of his reign, there was no turmoil in the court. Everything was calm. He did not have to worry about being pushed off the chair by others, especially his own son, when he was sick.
Although his life was somewhat rough in his youth, it gradually got better later on, especially in his later years, when his life was relatively smooth. Compared with other emperors, he was much better off.
He had been working diligently and conscientiously in handling various matters for so many years, and had not dared to slack off for even a single day. After ascending the throne, he had pulled the Great Zhou, which had been nearly collapsed by the previous emperor, back from the brink of decline. With such an achievement, it would not be difficult for him to be remembered in history.
Such a glorious achievement will be remembered by future generations. How many emperors can achieve this?
In terms of political affairs, he was good at both civil and military affairs. Even in the last years, he successfully resisted the encirclement of two countries. In terms of family affairs, he was also extremely happy in the end. What else could he not be satisfied with? If he was lucky, he might even become an emperor of all ages!
His lifelong wish was finally fulfilled.
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen’s frown gradually relaxed.
Ye Shuo stayed with his father for a long time, until he was completely out of breath and his body was cold, then he stood up.
The same thing happened twice, but the pain was not reduced at all.
No matter how smart he is, if he can’t keep something, he still can’t keep it.
At first, the imperial physician said that Emperor Jingwen had only half a year to a year to live. However, he was worried and held on for two whole years. Today, he finally couldn’t hold on any longer.
In the twenty-seventh year of Emperor Jingwen’s reign, Emperor Jingwen…died.
·
·
·
Three days passed in a flash, and the wake was over. Prince Su quickly took out the imperial edict that Emperor Jingwen had prepared long ago.
Although the Sixth Prince already knew the answer when his father summoned him, when that day finally arrived, he still felt ecstatic from the bottom of his heart. However, he could not show it because of the recent death of Emperor Jingwen and so many eyes watching him.
Just when the Sixth Prince was trying hard to control his emotions, he saw Prince Su take out the second will.
The second edict was none other than what Emperor Jingwen left for Ye Shuo and Jian Jian, the two siblings. The content was also very simple, stating that Prince Rui’s life would not be harmed unless he committed the serious crime of treason, and Jian Jian’s marriage would never be allowed.
Emperor Jingwen finally made an exception and agreed to what he had failed to do with Ye Shuo.
But at the same time, Emperor Jingwen knew the Sixth Prince’s temper better. Blindly suppressing him would only make him rebellious. How could Emperor Jingwen not know that what an emperor hated most was being forced by others, even if that person was his own biological father.
Even with a will, it would be easy for the emperor to take someone’s life.
Therefore, in addition to the will, Emperor Jingwen also specially gave the Sixth Prince a rattan stick. The will clearly stated that if Prince Rui did anything wrong, there was no need to show mercy and the prince could act on his father’s behalf and punish him.
You can beat but not kill, you can punish but not kill.
Emperor Jingwen was already almost tolerant. After all this, unless Ye Shuo really committed a heinous crime, the Sixth Prince would beat him, but there was really no reason to take his life.
This was probably the most comprehensive method that Emperor Jingwen, as a father, could think of.
Since he likes freedom, let him be free forever.
