Subconsciously looking at the coffin not far away, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but burst into tears in front of everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Burial
chapters.content:
After Emperor Jingwen’s last will was announced to the world, the Sixth Prince Ye Ming was confirmed to be the next emperor, and the Ministry of Rites also began to work on various matters related to the new emperor’s enthronement.
The world has always been like this. It will continue to operate as usual without anyone, even if that person is the emperor.
Whoever is missing will be quickly replaced.
Ye Shuo, together with others, knelt in front of Emperor Jingwen’s coffin for three whole days. Regardless of whether the people around them were being sincere or not, they all looked very sad.
The Imperial Concubine cried and fainted several times, and her pointed eyes were swollen like walnuts. Seeing this scene, Prince Su couldn’t help but feel a pang of bitterness in his heart. He suppressed his anger and said in a deep voice, “Prince Rui, why don’t you accept the order?”
“Son…I accept your order.”
When he stood up, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel dazed for a moment. It was Yao Zhi who helped him up from behind, and Ye Shuo finally came back to his senses.
In the end, the emperor still cared about him.
When the Sixth Prince saw the imperial edict made of brocade, he couldn’t help but sigh in his heart, but there was not much surprise on his face.
The ninth brother got what he wanted, and he also got what he wanted. As for the other brothers… seeing that the fifth prince and the eighth prince seemed to be resentful on their faces, the sixth prince did not take them to heart at all.They were not my opponents in the past, and they are even less likely to be in the future.
The next task is to escort Emperor Jingwen to the imperial mausoleum. All the royal relatives, including the eldest prince and a number of married princesses, will accompany him to see him off for the last time.
I still remember how his father was always serious and solemn, but time passed quickly and everything turned out to be in vain in the end.
Those walking in the front were naturally the eldest prince, the sixth prince and Ye Shuo. The eldest prince was the eldest, the sixth prince was the heir appointed by Emperor Jingwen, and Ye Shuo was the most beloved son of Emperor Jingwen during his lifetime. Only the three of them could stand here.
This was a national mourning, and the entire streets of Shangjing were cleared out. The procession composed of royal relatives stretched for more than two miles. Paper money flying in the sky was like heavy snow, and under the strong wind, it was almost blinding to people’s eyes.
As he walked, he realised something was wrong. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at the Sixth Prince beside him and asked, “Why did you bring him here too?”
The person Ye Shuo was talking about was none other than Ye Jin.
Counting the days, Ye Jin is only about seven or eight years old now.
It would have been fine if he had brought it with him, but he didn’t even leave anyone to help him.
When Ye Shuo was in the mourning hall before, he was in no mood to pay attention to anything else. Now, after thinking about it a little, Ye Shuo realized that Ye Jin seemed to have stayed in the Hall of Supreme Harmony for three whole days.
For three whole days, apart from a little food, he didn’t even drink water. Ye Jin was born weak, and this was going to cost him his life!
No wonder the kid looked so bad. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frown: “Why don’t you ask the guards to carry him?”
The Sixth Prince naturally felt sorry for his only son, but there was nothing he could do.
“My father has just passed away. As the future crown prince, Jin’er should be here to see him off for the last time.” As for why he didn’t let anyone carry him, it was naturally because he was afraid that other royal relatives would laugh at him.
“But this place is dozens of miles away from the imperial mausoleum.”
The Sixth Prince’s gaze remained unchanged: “It’s only a few dozen miles, it should be no problem.”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and couldn’t help but said, “You are such a cruel father.”
This was the first time that Ye Shuo confronted the Sixth Prince, and this was after the Sixth Prince made it clear that he would succeed the new emperor.
The Sixth Prince was silent and said nothing.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about that and picked the child up from the ground.
Just when Ye Jin felt dizzy and didn’t know whether he should speak, suddenly, he felt his feet lifted off the ground and fell into someone’s arms.
This smell, this familiar movement…
Ye Jin raised his head suddenly: “Ninth Uncle?”
After realising what was happening, Ye Jin immediately started struggling: “Ninth Uncle, put me down! Don’t let anyone see me!”
As Ye Jin spoke, he subconsciously looked at his father, while the Sixth Prince looked at the Eldest Prince beside him. Just as the Eldest Prince frowned, he saw Ye Shuo also looking at him.
The eldest prince: “…”
The eldest prince opened his mouth and tried to hold it in for a while, but he couldn’t help it and uttered: “What do you mean?”
“Why are you looking at me? Can I still argue with a child?”
The eldest prince didn’t even take a brat seriously. This kid really didn’t look that good. When Yan’er and the others were this age, they could train with other soldiers on the parade ground. But he was nothing like this. He felt like a strong wind could blow him away.
It is true that like father, like son. The Sixth Prince is not good himself, and his sons are not good either, far inferior to his own sons. The eldest prince felt much more balanced in his heart.
After hearing this, the Sixth Prince nodded towards Ye Jin.
Ye Jin immediately calmed down.
At this moment, Ye Shuo felt really tired for his brothers who lived in the eyes of others.
Prince Su and Prince Jin at the back couldn’t help but look at each other upon seeing this, and inexplicably breathed a sigh of relief.
Perhaps, my brother’s worries are unnecessary.
Although he knelt in the Hall of Supreme Harmony for so long, Ye Shuo was in good health after all. He recovered a lot after taking a nap for more than an hour before the funeral. Now he didn’t feel anything even though there was a child on his body.
As for the Sixth Prince, Ye Shuo was worried about his son at first, but as time went by, Ye Shuo soon began to worry about him.
“…Are you okay?”
It would be fine for Ye Shuo to hold a child in his arms, but it would be too much for him to carry an adult on his back. Besides, the Sixth Prince would never do that.
Unable to hold on to his brother’s arm, the Sixth Prince calmly wiped away the sweat that kept dripping from his temples, then shook his head gently.
The eldest prince, who was leaning on crutches, couldn’t help but sneer.
Feeling that the Sixth Prince’s hand holding his arm suddenly tightened, Ye Shuo had no choice but to glare at him.
I really don’t know what the cheap brother is trying to do at this time. Be careful or Xiao Ming will pull his pants off after he takes over.
The Sixth Prince is now such a treasure that not a single word can be said about him.
The eldest prince couldn’t help but roll his eyes at his younger brother.
They set out in a mighty procession before dawn in the morning, and it was almost noon when they finally arrived at the imperial mausoleum which had already been built.
When everyone stopped, the Sixth Prince opened his mouth and said in a voice that only the two of them could hear: “Thank you.”
Ye Shuo put the child in his arms down without saying anything, thinking it was just a piece of cake.
Then, accompanied by a loud “fall”, even the body of Emperor Jingwen was completely buried underground.
From then on, no matter alive or dead, we will never see him again.
Another hour passed, and after all the procedures were completed, everyone was finally able to take a break here for a while. Otherwise, except for a very few people, everyone else would have collapsed from exhaustion.
The Ye family had its own tomb keepers since Emperor Gaozu, and after several generations, it has now become a village. However, the village is small, with only a few houses. As expected, only a few people are qualified to rest in the houses.
Carefully wiping off the dust that had accidentally stained the tablet of Emperor Jingwen, he turned around and saw little Ye Jin sitting there, looking at him with his big eyes. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but reach out and rubbed his head.
No matter what, he is the crown prince for sure, and it is really inappropriate for him to do this.
However, the Sixth Prince on the side thought about it but said nothing.
Ye Jin instinctively wanted to struggle. Ye Jin was not used to this kind of intimacy because it was too close… But when he thought about how good the Ninth Prince was to him and how he had just hugged him all the way, Ye Jin was too embarrassed to refuse him.
The Ninth Prince is good in every way, except that it would be better if we could keep a little distance from him.
Don’t be so… near…
Although the child’s hair was a little yellow, it was unexpectedly quite soft. Ye Shuo accidentally played with his nephew’s head for a long time. Ye Jin finally couldn’t bear it anymore and pushed him away, then protected her head tightly.
“Ninth Uncle, can you please be serious?”
It was almost time for lunch, and Ye Jin was frantically thinking about telling him that there were still many things to do later.
Ye Jin was thinking about how to refuse him, but just when he was about to open his mouth, he saw the Ninth Prince seemed to have seen something and then stood up.
Then, the Ninth Prince withdrew his hand and walked out.
Through the door, Ye Jin noticed that it was a young man who looked familiar, but because Ye Jin was still young when the incident with the prince happened three years ago, he didn’t remember much and he rarely went out due to health reasons, so he didn’t know the identity of this young man.
Ye Jin had a vague impression, but he just couldn’t remember it.
The Ninth Prince walked up to the other person very naturally, said something to the young man, and then the two of them left hand in hand.
Faintly, one could hear the young man calling him “Ninth Uncle”.
With the same name, the identity of the young man is self-evident, it is Ye Xun.
Emperor Jingwen was Ye Xun’s grandfather after all. Now that Emperor Jingwen has passed away, Ye Xun should come here to see him off and burn some incense.
It was just because of the matter of the former crown prince that Ye Xun dared not speak out, and just now he just followed far behind the team. Ye Shuo knew what he was worried about, so he said, “Come with me.”
After hearing this, Ye Xun followed.
Ye Jin suddenly remembered that besides himself, the Ninth Uncle had many nephews.
Although my father has only one son, he has many cousins.
The eldest prince on the side seemed to see what the future prince was thinking and couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows. Instead of comforting him, the eldest prince added fuel to the fire.
“There’s not much age difference between your Ninth Uncle and Ye Xun, and they’ve been playing together since they were young.” Ye Shuo has known Ye Xun for many years earlier than Ye Jin.
Ye Jin suddenly felt that the rice in the bowl no longer tastes good, and a slight sense of loss suddenly arose in his heart.
The Sixth Prince, who was standing by, saw this scene and for some reason, felt that it was somewhat familiar…

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Ascension to the throne
chapters.content:
The Sixth Prince couldn’t help but think of the past, when he had nothing and watched Xiaojiu go to the East Palace to play with the former crown prince every day. Now that he has gained power, his son still has to watch Xiaojiu go to the former crown prince’s son to play, just like he did back then.
People like them have never been able to compare with the former prince’s family.
Although he felt a little uncomfortable, thinking about it the other way around, it also showed that Xiaojiu had not changed all these years. Even the change of power did not make him change his mind. After the former prince was deposed, who else would have the courage to take in the former prince’s son?
They were not favoured by him because they were not lucky.
Knowing it is one thing, but having others tell it out loud is another matter altogether.
The Sixth Prince couldn’t help but glance at the First Prince, then said calmly: “In this world, not everything remains unchanged.”
No matter what, the former crown prince is just a thing of the past.
The eldest prince was stunned when he heard such a thing. What does that mean? The sixth prince wants to argue about this?
The next moment, the eldest prince’s premonition came true.
The Sixth Prince said, “Your father once taught you that if you want something, you have to fight for it yourself.”When Ye Jin heard this, his eyes lit up immediately: “Yes, father!”
The Sixth Prince has not yet held his succession ceremony, so he is still called the Prince for the time being.
Ye Shuo didn’t come back until the break was over. Looking at the dirt on his clothes and the mud on the soles of his shoes, one could tell that he had just taken Ye Xun back to the imperial mausoleum again.
It was a bit late at this time. The team was about to set off. It was too late to eat. So many people could not wait for him. The eldest prince watched the child in front of him hand over the pancake that he had prepared early in the morning, and said in a very scheming way: “It has been in the box all along. It is still warm.”
As expected, Ye Shuo immediately showed an expression of being moved.
Ye Jin was still young after all. No matter what his childhood experiences were, they were still better than those of the Sixth Prince back then. Naturally, he was not as patient as the Sixth Prince. He could not help but glance at the young man next to him with pride.
Ye Xun was stunned for a moment, and after he reacted, he couldn’t help but laugh.
The Sixth Prince was like this, when he was a child, with the former Crown Prince. Wasn’t it the same with Ye Xun and Ye Yan when he was a child? How could he not understand this child’s mind?
Or maybe it was especially children who had the strongest possessiveness.
Then, Ye Shuo gave one of the two pancakes in his hand to Ye Xun.
The eldest prince standing by couldn’t help laughing. If today wasn’t the day Emperor Jingwen was to be buried, he would have almost laughed out loud.
The eldest prince’s face couldn’t help but twist.
Just when Ye Shuo was puzzled, he lowered his head and saw that Ye Jin’s face had turned red with anger.
Feeling moisture spreading in his eyes, Ye Jin was afraid that others would laugh at him, so he quickly lowered his head, stomped his feet hard, turned around and ran away.
Just ran away…
Ran away…
…
Seeing this scene, the Sixth Prince narrowed his eyes unconsciously.
This was the first time since the child was born that he actively expressed his emotions, but the result was a complete failure.
Ye Shuo was confused: “What’s going on?” Why does it feel weird?
“What happened?” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at the eldest prince beside him.
How could the eldest prince tell him? As long as he didn’t say it, given the temperament of the Sixth Prince and his son, they would definitely not tell it on their own initiative, and the eldest prince would be more than happy to do so.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to look at the Sixth Prince again.
The Sixth Prince said nothing, but just said: “We are about to set off, it’s time to go.”
Ye Xun did guess something, but he didn’t say anything either. Ye Xun pretended not to know and quietly retreated with the pancake.
No one said anything. Ye Shuo had no idea that the eldest prince would be so bored that he would actually “sow discord” on a child.
Ye Shuo thought that what he gave out was a cake, but that cake was more than just a cake.
Although the Ninth Prince was not very reliable and liked to play tricks on people, Ye Jin inexplicably couldn’t hate him in his heart. He even liked him a little. No, it should be said that he liked him more than just a little. Among all his uncles, he liked the Ninth Prince the most.
But what Ye Jin didn’t expect was that his favourite uncle’s favourite nephew was not him.
“Damn it!” Why is this happening?
Ye Jin rarely felt frustrated.
When he returned, Ye Shuo found that his nephew refused to let him hold him in his arms no matter what. His face started to turn pale as he walked, and he didn’t say a word.
Although Ye Shuo didn’t know what he was angry about, he knew that if he didn’t pay any attention, this kid would tire himself to death.
I thought Xiao Ming was a stubborn boy when he was young, but I didn’t expect that the son he gave birth to was even more stubborn than him. They are indeed father and son, and it’s really amazing.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to pull him up from the ground by force.
Just as Ye Jin was about to turn away, he heard the Ninth Uncle in front of him speak helplessly: “It doesn’t matter if you are angry with the Imperial Uncle, you should at least let the Imperial Uncle know the reason, right? Otherwise, the Imperial Uncle would be too innocent.”
Ye Jin opened his mouth, but couldn’t say anything no matter what. If he said it, the Ninth Prince would definitely laugh at him for making a fuss out of nothing.
Ye Jin also felt that he was being unreasonable, but for some reason, he was very angry.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo pretended to sigh: “Alas, you are unwilling to tell Uncle Nine even such a small matter. Uncle Nine really loves you in vain.”
The moment the words fell, Ye Jin could no longer bear it.
“How can you love me? You gave the biscuits I prepared for you to others!”
Ye Shuo understood instantly, so this is what was going on.
That pancake didn’t seem to be a simple pancake. For example, when he was a child, he would be so angry that his lungs would explode when he saw his mother holding other children, even if the children were babies that couldn’t speak.
It happened so many years ago, but Ye Shuo still remembers it until now, which shows how angry he was at that time.
But these situations only occur for very close elders. I didn’t expect that my little nephew was so close to me.
Ye Shuo thought so in his heart, and said: “It’s Uncle Nine’s fault. It’s Uncle Nine’s fault. If Uncle Nine knew, he would definitely not give it to him.”
Ye Shuo didn’t say that Ye Xun was also his cousin, and that a piece of cake was nothing. This made Ye Jin, who couldn’t control himself and was feeling annoyed and frustrated, stunned.
“Ninth, Ninth Uncle, you’re not angry?” Ye Jin asked stutteringly.
“You don’t think I’m making a big deal out of nothing?”
Forgive Xiao Ye Jin. He has never been respected like this before, not even by his father and mother.
Not to mention him, even the eldest prince looked shocked.
Looking at his younger brother talking so much to a child, the eldest prince suddenly understood why even his own son liked him and why he was so patient with a child. If it were him, he would never be able to do it.
In the eyes of the eldest prince, it is enough for a father to always maintain his dignity.
Ye Shuo heard this and said, “How could that be? It’s normal that you don’t want me to share the things you gave me with others, but you should tell me next time. Otherwise, if you keep it in your heart, who will know?”
But only the Ninth Prince would care about such things.
Perhaps the young man at the moment was too deceptive, Ye Jin couldn’t help but suddenly asked what was in his heart: “Ninth Uncle, do you like cousin Ye Xun more, or do you like me more?”
The eldest prince and the sixth prince looked over immediately.
“Uh…” This question…
This question really stumped Ye Shuo.
But Ye Shuo really didn’t want to lie to a child, so he cleared his throat and said, “Ye Xun.”
The eldest prince: “…”
Hiss!
This is the future crown prince!
The Sixth Prince: “…”
As expected, Xiaojiu was as honest as ever and answered whatever was asked.
Suddenly hearing the affirmative answer, Ye Jin became uncontrollably sour, but he really couldn’t be angry with him, so he could only choose to keep silent.
Ye Shuo was really helpless this time. He could only sigh and touch his head.
When they returned to Shangjing, Ye Jin saw from afar that the Ninth Prince and Ye Xun got on the same carriage and went back to the same place.
Although he was not the Ninth Prince’s favourite nephew, for some reason, Ye Jin liked him more.
It’s my cousin who is really an eyesore.
“I have a feeling that the future little prince is going to hate me to death.” Ye Xun couldn’t help but joke as he lowered the curtain.
Ye Shuo sighed: “I can’t help it, who told your Uncle Jiu to be so popular?”
“Oh, by the way, Ye Yan and the others just called me. I might have to go to your uncle’s house later.”
Now, it was Ye Xun’s turn to have a stiff expression.
In a blink of an eye, nearly another month has passed.
As the saying goes, a country cannot be without a king for a day. Although the Sixth Prince was still in mourning, he had a special status after all. After waiting for twenty-seven days, he took off his mourning clothes and welcomed the coronation ceremony.
The day of the coronation ceremony was exceptionally lively and joyful, with no trace of the desolate national mourning that had occurred a month earlier when Emperor Jingwen passed away.
Early in the morning, Ye Shuo changed into the royal robe, and Yao Zhi also changed into the dress belonging to the princess.
“As I remember, we only wore this thing once, at our wedding?” The royal uniform was already thick and heavy, and Ye Shuo began to sweat after a while.
Like Ye Shuo, Yao Zhi was also a little uncomfortable with suddenly dressing so formally.
If she hadn’t participated in this important palace ceremony, Yao Zhi would have even forgotten that she was married and was a princess.
Being with him, Yao Zhike became much more lazy than when she was wandering around the world before.
After everything was cleaned up, Ye Shuo took the initiative to hold Yao Zhi’s arm.
Yao Zhi blushed a little and couldn’t help but whispered, “Be careful, if others see it, they will probably laugh at you.” Although… she was very happy.
Ye Shuo didn’t care: “What’s the big deal? Let them talk if they want to.”
As expected, when the eldest prince, the fifth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince all froze in expression when they saw the couple behaving like this at the palace gate.
Pretending not to notice their constipated expressions, Ye Shuo walked in leisurely with Yao Zhi.
Then came the sounds of ritual music.
Finally, I have waited for this day.
The miserable life in his early childhood, the cautiousness in his childhood, the hard work in studying in his youth, the careful planning in his youth… all passed by before his eyes one by one. The Sixth Prince did not look away, but took one step at a time, and finally reached the top.
Then, under the gazes of court officials, royal family members, and everyone else, the Sixth Prince slowly sat down in that position.
Then, in front of the Xuanzheng Hall, the Sixth Prince swept his eyes around, and everyone present, without exception, knelt on the ground.
“Welcome to our Emperor.”
“Long live the emperor. Long live the emperor. Long live the emperor.”
In the 27th year of Jingwen’s reign, Emperor Jingwen died and was posthumously named Emperor Zhaochengwen.
In April of the same year, the sixth prince Ming ascended the throne and changed the reign title from Jingwen to Taicheng, and was named Emperor Taicheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Heartache
chapters.content:
After Emperor Taicheng ascended the throne, the first thing he did was to replace the current leader of the Black Armor Guard.
The Black Armor Guards are all elite soldiers, and they are also responsible for protecting the capital. Now that everyone is staying in Shangjing, as long as the Black Armor Guards are under control, no matter what happens later, they will not be too passive. In this way, there will be more time to slowly take back the military power.
Emperor Taicheng was neither anxious nor slow, and had everything under control. He acted skillfully, without any sign of the unfamiliarity or nervousness that comes with having just ascended the throne.
When He Xiang saw this, he knew that he had not misjudged the person.
The leader of the Black Armor Guard was promoted when Emperor Jingwen ascended the throne. Now he has reached the age and it is time for him to retire.
The commander-in-chief had always been a man of insight and interest. He knew that his career had come to an end. After realising the new emperor’s intentions, he did not argue any further and simply resigned.
Otherwise, if you are too tactless, you might lose your last bit of dignity.
Emperor Taicheng was very pleased with his tact and immediately rewarded him with many things, including naturally giving his wife and children titles.
The commander-in-chief was grateful for his kindness, and after performing the grand ceremony, he left respectfully.
As the saying goes, a new emperor appoints his own ministers. With the passing of the previous emperor, his era has also passed.Looking at the beautiful spring scenery and sunshine outside, after a while, the commander-in-chief took off the official hat of a first-rank military officer on his head, and walked out of the palace that he had guarded for decades, little by little and step by step.
The resignation of the commander-in-chief did not have much impact. As for his successor, Emperor Taicheng already had a candidate in mind.
He was a deputy general under the commander-in-chief named Li Yuheng.
Like the previous commander-in-chief, this person is also extremely smart, knows how to read people’s expressions, and is very capable. What is even more rare is that while he is smart, he also has a heart of loyalty, filial piety, benevolence and righteousness.
Emperor Taicheng remembered that when he first met him, he was just a minor official of the fifth rank, and he caught his eye because he did his job well.
Emperor Taicheng watched this man grow up and provided him with a lot of help on his way to growth, so Emperor Taicheng did not doubt his loyalty.
But the matter of guarding the imperial palace is of great importance, and we must be extremely careful.
The only thing that Emperor Taicheng cared about was that the other party’s wife used to be a personal maid to the Imperial Concubine. In this way, the other party could not be considered a complete lone minister.
Fortunately, Emperor Taicheng has now taken over the secret guards that belong only to the emperor. Although the previous wave had been buried with the late emperor, and the newly appointed batch are all newcomers, these people have not fallen behind in the training of secret guards, and their abilities are also quite strong. Naturally, it is no problem for them to investigate a mere deputy general.
Therefore, Emperor Taicheng soon found out that although Li Yuheng had married the imperial concubine’s personal maid, she had hardly had any contact with Qiuwu Palace since her marriage, and in recent years, they had completely stopped communicating.
That’s right, she’s just a maid, who would care?
Given the Imperial Concubine’s temperament over the years, I’m afraid she has forgotten about it a long time ago.
Emperor Taicheng gradually felt relieved.
But even though he knew it, Emperor Taicheng had to test the other party.
Soon, Li Yuheng was summoned into the palace.
Li Yuheng is a very smart man. Ever since he heard the news of the commander-in-chief’s retirement a day ago, he knew in his heart that a new commander would be elected soon.
And based on Emperor Taicheng’s attitude towards him in the past, this task would most likely fall on him. Thinking of this, Li Yuheng’s heartbeat began to accelerate uncontrollably.
The commander of the Black Armor Guard is a first-rank official, a high-ranking official of the current dynasty. He is considered the pinnacle of being a minister, and his name will be recorded in history as a matter of course. No matter who it is, it is impossible for anyone to remain calm in such a situation.
Similarly, Emperor Taicheng also knew that he could understand what he meant, but it was precisely because of this that he made the test today.
Soon, Li Yuheng heard these words——
“Since I summoned you here at this critical moment, I’m sure you understand what I mean. I won’t keep you in suspense and will just speak directly.”
“I have my eyes on you as the new commander of the Black Armor Guards, but you also have to understand that your family is not suitable for this position. It’s ok to be the son of a merchant, but I heard that your wife was once a personal maidservant of the Imperial Concubine?”
Now that everything is clear, the next step is to start making choices.
“Now, I will give you two choices. One, demote your wife to a concubine, or divorce her. Two…” Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but look at a small porcelain bottle that had been prepared on the side.
“I don’t need to teach you what’s next, right?”
Almost instantly, Li Yuheng lowered his head.
Emperor Taicheng thought that he was frightened, but he didn’t know that Li Yuheng felt that this scene was too familiar. The Ninth Prince of the previous emperor had also used this trick to test him…
It was the same trick, but Li Yuheng couldn’t get nervous at all.
Compared to a person who can kill his partner for profit and official position, the emperor must want a loyal subordinate who will not be moved by profit.
After a long time, Li Yuheng finally spoke: “Your Majesty, I married Su Xin with three matchmakers, six engagements and eight sedan chairs. She and I have been married for many years without any mistakes. How can I demote her to a concubine? How can this be allowed!”
As for directly poisoning someone to death, that is even more ridiculous.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Taicheng was satisfied in his heart, but frowned: “Even if you are only a deputy general for your whole life, are you willing?”
“I… I am unwilling, but Su Xin married me when she was still a nobody, and she gave birth to two sons and two daughters for me. I, I really can’t bear it…”
As if he didn’t see the struggle on Li Yuheng’s face, Emperor Taicheng said nothing, waved his hand and told him to leave.
Emperor Taicheng’s behaviour made Li Yuheng nervous.
But there is no choice, the words have already been said, so I can only take a gamble.
Fortunately, Li Yuheng won the bet.
When he received the imperial decree appointing him as the new commander, Li Yuheng breathed a sigh of relief, yet he almost collapsed.
“Thank you, Lord. Long live the emperor.”
At this point, he had completely entered the centre of power in the Great Zhou.
Who would have thought that the son of a merchant back then would be able to achieve what he has today?
Thinking back to the beginning, Li Yuheng couldn’t help but feel dazed.
Now that he has really taken this position, Li Yuheng’s feelings towards Prince Rui have become more complicated. With Prince Rui’s kindness to him, he should repay him, but whenever Prince Rui makes a request, it is really difficult for Li Yuheng to refuse.
However, to Li Yuheng’s surprise, Prince Rui seemed to have forgotten about him a long time ago, and never took the initiative to look for him…
The other side.
Early in the morning, Yao Zhi followed Ye Shuo out of the city. Others thought that the two were going to a temple outside to burn incense and eat vegetarian food, but Yao Zhi knew from the beginning that this was not the case.
The two of them came to look for the relics left by the late emperor.
Counting the days, today is exactly one month.
“Thirty miles southwest of the city… should be here, right?”
Looking around, Ye Shuo found that the surroundings were desolate. Not to mention people, there was not even a ghost. Fortunately, Yao Zhi came with him. Otherwise, he would be alone and would feel a little uneasy.
The two of them searched for a long time but couldn’t find anything special. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel suspicious.
“Could it be that Dad had someone dig a cave and buried all the gold, silver and treasures in his private vault?”
If this was true, Ye Shuo didn’t dare to imagine the expression on Xiao Ming’s face, who had now entered the palace.
But after a careful observation, Ye Shuo felt that it was not the case. After all, the land in front of him showed no signs of having been turned over recently.
But if it is not gold, silver and treasures, what else could it be?
While Ye Shuo was lost in thought, Yao Zhi next to him keenly noticed something unusual.
“Who is it, who is there!”
Yao Zhi shouted loudly, and at the same time, the soft sword at her waist popped out.
Even though Yao Zhi had been eating, drinking and having fun with Ye Shuo in the palace for more than a year and had become lazy as a result, her basic skills were still there and she could react in an instant.
This movement, this performance, could it be…
The moment the soft sword stabbed out, an incredible thought immediately popped up in Ye Shuo’s mind.
Under the sword shadows as dense as raindrops, the man in black was forced to show his face.
The moment the other person’s figure appeared, Ye Shuo recognized him at the first moment even though he was still wearing a mask.
Ye Shuo almost blurted out: “Master!”
If the man in black is not Wu Yi, who else could it be?
The number of secret guards is not large. The rule that secret guards must be buried with the emperor after his death was set during the reign of Emperor Gaozu. The control is extremely strict. No one can escape the layers of inspection. It is harder than ascending to heaven to hide the truth. Even if it is Emperor Jingwen, after all the twists and turns, he can only keep Wu Yi.
Fortunately, this one can be worth an entire team.
Wu Yi’s kung fu is the best among all of them, and he is also the one who has been with Emperor Jingwen the longest. He knows many secrets. He is not afraid even if the Sixth Prince really turns against him one day. With Wu Yi’s ability, it will not be a problem for him to save his youngest son’s life.
In addition to the will, Emperor Jingwen made two preparations, one overt and one covert. He only hoped that these things would never be needed.
In an instant Ye Shuo understood his father’s intention. How could he hold back his tears?
“Besides this, does Dad have any other instructions?”
“there is none left.”
Wu Yi shook his head, looked at his new master, hesitated for a moment, and said: “The emperor only asked you to take good care of yourself in the future, saying that he can no longer protect you in the future. This is… the last time.”
A month later, at this moment, Ye Shuo’s heart still aches uncontrollably.

chapters.title: Chapter 251: Being Tricked
chapters.content:
Yao Zhi looked over with some concern.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath, and forced himself to suppress the bitterness in his heart.
Strictly speaking, Wu Yi is no longer a secret guard now, and can walk openly under the sun.
However, the moment the mask was taken off, Wu Yi felt as if he had been stripped naked and felt uncomfortable all over.
“Master, what do you want me to do for you?” Not daring to look at the two of them, Wu lowered his head subconsciously.
He has never changed this habit over the years.
That’s right, who can expect a person who has been trained as a killing machine since he was a few years old to have his own thoughts?
Wu Yi’s personal will had long been destroyed in the day-to-day training.
No matter how many times Ye Shuo told him not to call him master, it was of no use, Wu Yi remained the same.
“Your Majesty’s last words, I dare not forget them.”Ye Shuo was completely at his wit’s end.
Although his stepfather meant well, the Rui Palace was crowded with people and not a good place to stay. For a while, Ye Shuo couldn’t find a good excuse to put him there.
After all, many of Xiao Ming’s secret guards were trained by Wu Yi. Although they wore masks during training and no one knew each other’s appearance, they could be recognized by others.
But if Ye Shuo were to leave Wu Yi alone outside, he really couldn’t bear it.
When Ye Shuo met Wu Yi, he was only in his twenties. Now he is in his forties, which in ancient times would be the age for enjoying the company of grandchildren. However, Wu Yi is still alone, without even a single close relative. Ye Shuo doesn’t even know if there was any close relationship with him among the secret guards who were buried alive with him. Even if there was, they are all gone now.
Ye Shuo was really worried, and after thinking about it, he suddenly thought of a good place to go.
“You said that since Master and Wu Yi are both martial artists, they should have more in common, right?”
Also, the Fourth Master is here too. Wu Yi has been a secret guard for so many years, he must have a lot of hidden injuries on his body. It would be a good thing if he could take this opportunity to recuperate.
Yao Zhi thought about it and felt that there should be no problem. After all, the courtyard given by the emperor was big enough, and they could have a competition in their spare time. Isn’t it wonderful?
Seeing that Yao Zhi had no objection, Ye Shuo looked at his cheap master and asked, “What do you think?”
When Wu Yi heard the word “Master”, he frowned subconsciously.
I don’t want to deal with the Ninth Prince’s masters who suddenly appeared…
A flash of resistance passed through his eyes, but in the end, he didn’t want to disappoint him, so Wu Yi’s expression remained unchanged and he nodded gently: “Thank you, Master.”
Ye Shuo pulled the corner of his mouth uncontrollably and subconsciously wanted to speak, but in the end he just sighed: “Forget it…”
A few days later, a strange man came to Princess Rui’s mansion, but no one took it seriously.
Everyone knows that Princess Rui came from the underworld, and most of the people she associates with are from the underworld, so no one is surprised.
Ye Shuo’s plan was a good one, but what he didn’t know was that on the first day he entered the mansion, Wu Yi and Huo Tianyi started fighting…
The other side.
Just a few days after the coronation ceremony, the empress-crowned ceremony arrived as scheduled.
Looking at the thin man in front of her with a faint smile, the former Sixth Prince’s wife, now the Queen, couldn’t help but have a hint of complexity in her eyes.
To be honest, Emperor Taicheng treated me well, but after so many years of marriage, I still haven’t entered his heart.
It’s not that I feel sad, the queen just feels a little regretful. Everyone wants to have the best of both worlds, but it’s impossible to have the best of both worlds.
Perhaps, this is the norm between ordinary couples.
After all, people like Prince Rui and Princess Rui are only a minority.
Looking at the two people watching the ceremony with the same expression, the queen couldn’t help but sigh in her heart that the behaviour habits of these two people were becoming more and more similar.
However, what the Queen didn’t know was that Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had almost the same idea in mind –
“This hair crown and clothes look too heavy.”
“Yeah yeah……”
When they reached the last two steps, Emperor Taicheng took the initiative to stand up from the dragon throne and came forward, which was a manifestation of his utmost love and respect.
Since the emperor gave her such a face, the queen naturally returned the favour and quickly drew up a list of contestants.
It was all based on folk sayings, and those selected were girls who looked like they were good at giving birth.
Looking at the list in front of him, Emperor Taicheng paused, then asked casually: “How did the queen perform at that time? Were you dissatisfied?”
Upon hearing this, the newly appointed eunuch in charge of the Imperial Household Department couldn’t help but shake his head.
“Your Majesty, the Queen has no complaints.”
After that, Emperor Taicheng said nothing more.
In the afternoon, Emperor Taicheng drafted the imperial edict to appoint Ye Jin as the crown prince.
Upon hearing the news, the queen couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Although the previous prince’s example was there, who would really not want it to belong to his own son? As for the fact that the emperor also made Concubine Sun’s daughter the eldest princess, it was nothing.
In addition to the position of crown prince, there is also the selection of empress dowager.
Some court officials proposed to make the Imperial Concubine the Empress Dowager, saying that although the Imperial Concubine was not his biological mother, she had raised him for so many years and they were actually mother and son, so it should be so. Otherwise, he would be heartless and unfilial.
I don’t know if the person who said this was the Fifth Prince’s man, the Seventh Prince, or the Eighth Prince, but Emperor Taicheng was furious after hearing this.
The person who said this had an extremely sinister mind. If he agreed, Xiaojiu, the empress dowager’s own son, would be used as a gun by them sooner or later. But if he disagreed, he was afraid that he would create a rift with the Imperial Concubine Dowager.
Upon learning that Xiaojiu was also in the palace, Emperor Taicheng thought about it and decided to go to Qiuwu Palace.
If possible, Emperor Taicheng did not want to become estranged from the Imperial Noble Consort and Xiaojiu…
Looking at everything familiar in front of him, the hem of Emperor Taicheng’s robe passed through the air, he raised his foot and stepped in.
At the same time, Jianjian was desperately winking at her brother, indicating that his mother was in a bad mood and asked him to be more careful.
Ever since Emperor Jingwen passed away, the Imperial Concubine Dowager has been a little listless.
After all, they have been together for so many years. Now that Emperor Jingwen is gone, how can the Imperial Concubine not be sad? The Imperial Concubine is also not young anymore. I don’t know if it’s because she’s old or what. Recently, she often thinks of Emperor Jingwen’s appearance and his every move and every word.
It was here that Emperor Jingwen read a book while she embroidered and watched her two children playing in the yard.
Emperor Jingwen laughed at her for being clumsy and her embroidery was ugly, saying that she was not right for the job, and told her to give up. But he turned around and hung the purse she had embroidered around his waist, and only replaced it when it became old.
However, she had only embroidered on a whim at the time, and had rarely touched needle and thread since then. She had always been careless, so she didn’t pay much attention to it.
Thinking about it now, I feel a little regretful.
Countless details were magnified, and the Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but murmur: “If I had known earlier, I would have embroidered one more for him…”
Ye Shuo really couldn’t bear to see his mother go on like this. There would definitely be problems over time. No matter what, he couldn’t let her stay like this for a long time.
Ye Shuo’s mind got heated, and he couldn’t help but ask, “Mom, do you want to leave the palace? How about your son taking you out of the palace?”
“Forget it, there’s nothing interesting outside…” The Imperial Concubine Dowager had been out before, so she couldn’t help but feel a little uninterested.
However, what Ye Shuo said this time was different from the previous petty quarrels.
He came forward and lowered his voice: “Son means to go to a farther place, north or south, east or west, anywhere is fine as long as it is within the Great Zhou.”
With a “click”, the pastry in Jianjian’s hand fell onto the table.
He, he, he…does he know what he is talking about?!
Seeing Jianjian’s shocked face, Ye Shuo asked casually: “Are you going?”
At this moment, Jianjian’s heart was shamefully moved. She met her brother’s eyes and saw that his expression did not seem fake. Her heart could not help but start beating wildly.
Looking at the Imperial Concubine Dowager, she was also dumbfounded.
“this……”
However, before the Imperial Concubine could answer, she heard a notification from outside the door –
“The Emperor has arrived!”
Emperor Taicheng knew that the Imperial Noble Consort had lived in Qiuwu Palace for more than twenty years, almost thirty years, and that she had decorated Qiuwu Palace herself. Therefore, he did not let her move to another palace like other concubines, but made an exception and asked her to continue living here.
What was Xiao Ming’s intention in coming so suddenly? He was so busy now, he couldn’t have come to pay respects to his mother, right?
This was the first time that Emperor Taicheng had met his younger brother in private since he ascended the throne. Just as Emperor Taicheng was thinking, if he was still as casual and rude as before, should he point it out directly or keep silent?
If he pointed it out directly, he was afraid that he would be unhappy, but if he kept silent, he was afraid that he would do the same in the future, which was a bit inappropriate.
Just when Emperor Taicheng was hesitant, he saw the young man in front of him kneel down with a plop without saying a word, and then bowed deeply to him.
“Welcome to His Majesty! Long live the Emperor!”
Emperor Taicheng was stunned as he had not expected this to happen.
Although this is the best possible outcome, for some reason, when this scene really happened, Emperor Taicheng felt even more uncomfortable.
We were once brothers, but now we are just strangers.
Could it be that, even he is going to become estranged from me?
His heart sank to the bottom of the valley with a thump. Emperor Taicheng gathered his fingers under his sleeves and said after a moment, “That’s not necessary.”
“Just call me Sixth Brother, like before.”
besides……
“There is no need to perform such a grand ceremony in private.”
However, the young man still knelt on the ground, and his voice became hesitant: “But, but you are the emperor now, this, this is probably against the rules…”
“Rules are dead, but people are alive. If I say it’s okay, then it’s okay. Who else dares to comment?”
This is what Ye Shuo was waiting for.
“Hmm.”
“Why didn’t you say so earlier?”
Ye Shuo jumped up from the ground without any trace of fear on his face.
Emperor Taicheng was stunned, then he realised that he had been tricked.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Wait
chapters.content:
When Emperor Taicheng saw this, he squeezed something with one hand and it made a crackling sound.
He regretted it. How could he have forgotten what kind of person his brother was?
As the saying goes, it is difficult to change one’s nature, how could he suddenly learn well?
Seeing that his face was not right, Ye Shuo hurriedly said: “You said it yourself, it has nothing to do with me.”
Emperor Taicheng took a deep breath, and Ye Shuo hurriedly changed the subject: “By the way, Sixth Brother, why are you here today…?”
Emperor Taicheng endured it for a while, but in the end he didn’t bother with him.
Seeing the Imperial Concubine Dowager, Emperor Taicheng’s expression softened involuntarily.
After pondering for a moment, Emperor Taicheng said, “During the morning court session today, the court officials mentioned my biological mother, which immediately aroused my longing for her. The Imperial Concubine has been in the palace for a long time, could you… tell me something about my mother?”
Why did Xiao Ming mention his mother out of nowhere?
Ye Shuo had never paid attention to the affairs of the court, so he didn’t know that the voices that wanted to make his mother the queen mother had emerged again.As for the Imperial Concubine Dowager and Princess Jianjian, one has lived in the deep palace for a long time and the other is still young, so there is even less way to know.
Since the new emperor asked, the Imperial Noble Consort recalled carefully for a long time, but it turned out that she had no idea what Emperor Taicheng’s biological mother looked like or her name.
After hesitating for a moment, the Imperial Concubine Dowager said, “When I entered the palace, your biological mother had passed away for more than a year. Perhaps… Concubine Xu and the others know about it. Why not call Concubine Xu and the others over and ask them?”
The Imperial Concubine Dowager answered Emperor Taicheng’s question seriously.
Emperor Taicheng paused with his hand holding the teacup, and when he looked up again, he saw three slightly confused faces.
Emperor Taicheng’s expression froze. How could he have forgotten that the euphemisms he usually used with court officials might not be understood by them?
Emperor Taicheng sighed, and finally chose to speak frankly: “Some court officials have mentioned that they want to make you the Queen Mother. I wonder what the Royal Concubine… thinks?”
This time the Royal Concubine finally understood.
It would have been good if Emperor Taicheng had arrived earlier. Now her son had just said that he would take her outside the Shangjing City. The Imperial Concubine Dowager had always longed to go outside the palace. In her life, she had only been outside when she was young, with her father and brothers. After so many years, she had long forgotten what that felt like. She only remembered that she was very happy and excited at that time.
If you become a queen mother, you will never be able to go out and will be trapped in this world for the rest of your life.
Thinking of this, the Imperial Concubine Dowager showed some reluctance.
Emperor Taicheng was stunned, and then he heard her say, “When I was the Imperial Noble Consort, I didn’t have to take care of so many things. If I were to become the Empress Dowager, I’m afraid I would have to worry about everything. I can’t stand it.”
If her son was the emperor, it would be fine, and the Imperial Concubine Dowager would have tolerated it reluctantly. But he was not her own son, and she would be annoyed to see him every day. Besides, she had seen what happened to the previous empress dowager. It was a thankless task.
You are the only one who is dear to you, no matter how nice other people say to you.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but let out a long sigh when he heard that. Fortunately, his mother didn’t agree.
Looking at Jianjian again, although she is young, she can vaguely sense the pros and cons of it. She also doesn’t think it would be a good thing for her mother to become the queen mother. ȐА𐌽𝔬𝐛Еs̩
Seeing that everyone had a look of resistance, for a moment, Emperor Taicheng even doubted whether the position of Queen Mother was really that bad.
Emperor Taicheng felt relieved, but at the same time he couldn’t help feeling a little guilty.
After all, the Imperial Concubine had raised him for ten whole years, and she even gave him her private money when he left the palace to build a mansion. The more he thought about it, the more he felt that the Imperial Concubine was kind. Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but look at Ye Shuo standing aside.
“Xiao Jiu doesn’t seem to like the job in the Ministry of Works. There happens to be a vacancy in the Ministry of Rites. How about Xiao Jiu going there?”
He couldn’t do other big jobs, but it should be okay to organise a celebration banquet or something?
However, Ye Shuo felt his scalp tingling after hearing this. Why do his brothers always like to force things they think are good on people? Not everyone will like it.
Ye Shuo waved his hands hurriedly: “Don’t, don’t, don’t look for me.”
If Xiao Ming really feels bad, then he can…
Suddenly thinking of something, Ye Shuo calmly asked: “Sixth brother, if you really want to send it, I won’t stop you. I just want to exchange it for something else. I don’t know if it will work.”
Emperor Taicheng nodded: “You say.”
Ye Shuo looked at the Imperial Concubine beside him, and her heart was pounding wildly.
This child, could it be that he wants to –
The next moment, the Imperial Concubine’s premonition came true.
“I’ve noticed that my mother has been absent-minded recently, so I want to bring her to my house to stay for a few days, and take her for a walk outside Shangjing. What do you think, Sixth Brother?”
Jianjian had to say that her brother was really bold. If the emperor knew where the “outside of the capital” he mentioned was, the scene would be so shocking! She simply couldn’t imagine it.
However, thinking this in her heart, Jianjian couldn’t help but secretly pull Ye Shuo’s sleeve.
Ye Shuo seemed to remember something and added, “Oh, and Jian Jian, let her go with us.”
Jianjian seriously suspected that he did it on purpose.
This was not a big deal, so Emperor Taicheng did not doubt anything else and nodded immediately.
“good.”
“If you need anything, just tell me.”
Ye Shuo was not polite: “Since we are travelling, we need a horse. My brother’s family only has one horse, Qingfeng. Sixth brother, what do you think…”
Emperor Taicheng is now the emperor, and he is many times more generous than before. He immediately made an approval and brought six horses from the parade ground as a reward to His Royal Highness Prince Rui.
“Oh my god! Sixth brother, you are so nice, you are simply the best sixth brother in the world!”
When Emperor Taicheng was about to leave Qiuwu Palace, he could still hear the voice of his younger brother. Emperor Taicheng hated flattery the most in his life, but because the young man was too enthusiastic and explicit, even a calm Emperor Taicheng could not resist.
Emperor Taicheng tried to control himself a few times, but ultimately failed to do so and slightly raised the corners of his lips.
However, what Emperor Taicheng didn’t know was that after he left, the Imperial Noble Consort pulled her son to her and said, “You are courting death! You even dared to lie to your brother!”
“How did I lie? Didn’t I tell you that I was going outside the capital? As for how far away or when I would be back, Sixth Brother didn’t ask.” Ye Shuo looked innocent.
The Imperial Concubine pulled the corner of her mouth and said, “You are probably so bold because of the will your father left you. But your mother has to remind you that you can escape the death penalty, but you can’t escape the living crime. Do you think your Sixth Brother will let you go in the end?”
It has to be said that Emperor Jingwen’s initial concerns were absolutely correct.
Except for treason, he really dares to do anything else.
However, Ye Shuo was not afraid: “Who cares? Let’s go first!”
“So mom, are you going to leave or not?”
This was probably one of the most difficult choices the Imperial Concubine Dowager had ever felt. The last time she was so conflicted was whether or not to marry into the palace.
But in the end, the yearning for a place outside of Beijing finally overcame everything else.
After the Imperial Concubine made the decision, she couldn’t help but ask, “Will this cause trouble for my father and brothers?”
“No, don’t worry, the Sixth Brother is not that petty.”
“Then, what about you? Will your Sixth Brother beat you to death when you come back?”
“I don’t think he’ll beat me to death. At most, he’ll use a cane to whip me. With son’s physique, he will definitely be able to withstand this beating.”
About half an hour later, looking at the imperial city gradually disappearing behind her, the imperial concubine felt both uneasy and full of anticipation and excitement.
“It’s crazy. It’s absolutely crazy.”
Jianjian kept chattering beside him, but his eyes were brighter than ever before.
This was probably the craziest thing she had ever done since she was born, but surprisingly she didn’t find it disgusting. Jianjian then realised that the heart in her body was actually so restless.
However, it is not an easy task to escape with the imperial concubine. It would be troublesome if they were discovered and caught.
Ye Shuo took Yao Zhi and quickly found the master and Wu Yi and the others.
When he learned the purpose of the two people’s visit, Huo Tianyi almost spit out water.
“What? What are you two going to do?!”
Ever since she heard Ye Shuo’s proposal, Yao Zhi has been in an excited state. Although it is good to go to the capital and her life has been very comfortable for more than a year, Yao Zhi is from the underworld after all, and after a long time, she will inevitably yearn for the adventurous life of the past.
This emotion was not so strong before, but since Ye Shuo opened his mouth, Yao Zhi could no longer control herself.
“Master, we don’t belong here. Why don’t we take this opportunity to leave together?” It just so happened that Yao Zhi also wanted to take her little husband to see what the real world of martial arts is like.
My disciple must have gone crazy. Now he even dares to steal from the imperial concubine…
She had never had such courage before. She didn’t need to think about it. It was the young man next to her who did it. Looking at his disciple who was becoming more and more daring, Huo Tianyi couldn’t help but feel a headache.
As for Wu Yi standing aside, he could never have imagined that after changing his master, the first task he received was to secretly send away the wife of his previous master.
Also, His Majesty’s original intention in arranging me was not like this…
For the first time in his life, Wu Yi tried to express his opinion, but was ruthlessly suppressed by Ye Shuo.
Wu Yi wanted to say something but stopped himself, and finally had to shut his mouth.
Once the so-called Queen Mother was established, it was as if the floodgates had been opened. Emperor Taicheng began to settle accounts one by one with the fifth, seventh and eighth princes who had been playing tricks behind his back after he ascended the throne.
In the court, the situation changed in an instant.
Even if the eldest prince was unwilling, he had to behave himself.
Emperor Taicheng is now the legitimate emperor. The fifth, seventh, and eighth princes were no match for him in the past, and they are even less capable now.
After vaguely hearing about this matter, Ye Shuo became more determined to leave.
If this imperial city could barely be considered a home, then this home had been broken up since the death of Emperor Jingwen.
No one can go back to the way things were before.
Everyone has their own ideas, everyone has their own constraints and desires, and everyone knows the severity of it even better than Ye Shuo, but no one can turn back.
It is indeed time for me to leave.
When Emperor Taicheng finally freed his hands, he suppressed the urge to cough in his throat and exhaled deeply. When he sat down on the chair, a thought flashed through his mind.
Among all the brothers, only Xiaojiu is different from the others.
Only Xiaojiu has such a sincere heart.
However, the younger brother who was the least worrying in Emperor Taicheng’s eyes never returned after he left Shangjing with the Imperial Concubine Dowager and Princess Jianjian.
One day, two days, three days… four days, five days, six days…
Emperor Taicheng waited and waited, but they still didn’t come back.

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Here we are
chapters.content:
the other side.
Sitting in the carriage, seeing that the young man seemed to be in a daze, Yao Zhi sat down next to him and asked, “What are you thinking about?”
“Don’t worry, we have several masters here, we won’t be discovered.”
However, Ye Shuo shook his head upon hearing this and said, “I’m not worried about that.”
What Ye Shuo was thinking about was Ye Xun.
Since he was leaving, and they were living under the same roof, he certainly couldn’t hide it from Ye Xun. Of course, Ye Shuo didn’t want to hide it either, so he asked Ye Xun for his opinion almost immediately.
Ye Shuo originally thought that Ye Xun would agree. After all, when he got outside, he could also go and see his mother.
However, what Ye Shuo did not expect was that Ye Xun refused.
For about this long, Ye Shuo had habitually protected him under his wings, treating him as the child he was back then, but forgetting that he also had his own ideas.
Ye Shuo didn’t force him, but he couldn’t help but worry about his safety. However, Ye Xun smiled at that time.“Ninth Uncle, I’m not a child anymore. Can I be kidnapped?”
You can’t kidnap someone, but I can’t guarantee anything else.
As if seeing his worry, Ye Xun couldn’t help but comfort him, “Don’t worry, Uncle Jiu, I can protect myself. Besides, it’s time for me to live in my own mansion. I can’t stay here with you forever, right?”
Ye Xun is already eighteen years old this year, which would make him an adult even in modern times.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh deeply: “Alas… the child has grown up and has his own ideas.”
At this moment, he looked like an old father full of the vicissitudes of life. Seeing this, Yao Zhi, who was standing by, couldn’t help but burst out laughing.
“How old are you and you want to be someone’s father?”
Ye Shuo thought for a moment and said, “I am not your biological father, but I am better than your biological father.”
Yao Zhi felt that if the former prince heard this, he would probably jump out of his tomb and beat him to death.
“Why don’t you keep this to yourself and tell it to Madam Zhen?” Madam Zhen was none other than the former Crown Princess.
Ye Shuo shut his mouth instantly: “Forget it.” He didn’t have the courage to do that.
With laughter and joking along the way, the group was getting farther and farther away from Shangjing.
It’s not that no one came to track them down along the way. There were even waves of people every few hours, wave after wave, almost a carpet search. After all, the missing people this time were the late emperor’s imperial concubine and the late emperor’s favorite princess, who were of extremely high status. How could the local people not be anxious? If anything went wrong, they couldn’t afford it. R̃𝐀₦ỔʙĚS
At first, the Imperial Concubine and Jianjian were very nervous, afraid of being discovered, but gradually, they found that their worries were completely unnecessary.
Huo Tianyi and his men were veterans who had been in the business for many years and were extremely good at destroying all traces. Sometimes, the imperial concubine couldn’t even see clearly what they did. In a short while, all the footprints on the ground disappeared.
Jianjian learned a lot of things in one go, and suddenly felt that this was much more interesting than staying in the study room every day.
No wonder my brother always likes to run outside!
“Luckily, we have you, otherwise we don’t know what to do.” The Royal Concubine felt that this group of people in the martial arts world were really amazing. They could even think of such a solution. In comparison, she couldn’t help at all and was simply useless.
When she was young, the Imperial Noble Concubine Dowager envied Concubine De and other concubines who were good at reading, but now she has begun to envy her daughter-in-law who is good at everything.
If only I could be that powerful…
When she was carrying the person on her back, the Imperial Concubine tried to imitate Yao Zhi’s martial arts moves in the air. However, because she had no martial arts skills at all, her movements were quite weird, which made the Imperial Concubine feel very frustrated.
She was neither good at literature nor martial arts, and had long been spoiled by his father, brother, and the late emperor.
However, this is how the Imperial Concubine sees herself, but it is not the case in the eyes of the beautiful ladies.
At first, the beautiful woman was a little worried that the Royal Concubine would be difficult to get along with. After all, her status was there, and these were inevitable. But after really getting along with her, they discovered that there really are women in the world who are born different from others. Their every move naturally reveals calmness and elegance. She is naturally more delicate than ordinary people, but even her delicacy seems so cute.
The old emperor is indeed very lucky.
Such thoughts could not help but cross the minds of the beautiful women and others.
Seeing her say this, the beautiful woman paused and said, “We are all family, why should we be so polite?”
The Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but laugh.
Her smile made the beautiful woman laugh uncontrollably as well.
They walked and stopped along the way, just like they were on a picnic. Even though they were in the wild, they didn’t feel worried at all. They went fishing and hunting every day, and picked wild fruits. They didn’t have to worry about getting sick, as there were two doctors in the team… Under the leadership of Huo Tianyi and others, the Imperial Concubine Dowager managed to live her life on the run as if she were on a picnic.
Of course, the conditions outside were not as good as those in the palace, so after a period of time, the Imperial Concubine was not as plump as before, and she lost a lot of weight, but her spirit was becoming more and more full.
On the other hand, Huo Tianyi and others had lived a life of luxury in the capital for too long, so they were a little uncomfortable when they suddenly returned to the past.
At the same time, in Shangjing City——
In the blink of an eye, more than half a month had passed, and the last bit of hope that Emperor Taicheng had in his heart was shattered after the secret guards returned.
“Your Majesty, the Imperial Concubine and the others have indeed…run away.”
Emperor Taicheng’s eyes went dark immediately.
Fortunately, he was used to staying calm, so he managed to maintain his facial expression.
“In that case, why don’t you go and chase him?”
However, it was easy for Emperor Taicheng to say that. In order to plan this escape, Ye Shuo specially hired a team. Not to mention Wu Yi, Huo Tianyi and his group of veterans were enough, and they were even wealthy.
Not only them, there were also many people in the martial arts world who helped secretly along the way. With people constantly disrupting the vision, even the secret guards were not very effective.
For a moment, Emperor Taicheng was very pleased that his younger brother had this ability. But at the same time, it would be even better if his intelligence could be used in the right way.
It’s really hard for him. He put so much effort into escaping.
For a moment, Emperor Taicheng was neither happy nor unhappy.
Then, the secret guard took out another thing: “Your Majesty, this is the note that the innkeeper gave us when we chased us to the city of Ling. It should be the note from His Royal Highness Prince Rui to you.”
“…Present it quickly.”
Emperor Taicheng took a deep breath and quickly opened the note. Seeing the dog-like handwriting on it, Emperor Taicheng immediately confirmed that this was undoubtedly the handwriting of that bastard brother.
Emperor Taicheng himself was not that angry, but after reading the content clearly, his anger suddenly rose.
[I’m taking my mother out to relax. I don’t know when I’ll be back. I’m counting on you in the court, Sixth Brother. Please, please.]
In addition to these, there was also a little man with his hands clasped together at the end. For a moment, Emperor Taicheng almost crushed the note.
“Cough cough cough…”
Emperor Taicheng couldn’t control himself and coughed violently.
Wang Ziquan, who was by the late emperor’s side, had already left the palace to live out his retirement, and had been staying with Emperor Taicheng. When the newly appointed eunuch in charge of the Imperial Household Department was about to speak upon seeing this, he saw that Emperor Taicheng had already stood up.
Emperor Taicheng did not intend to intervene at first, thinking that he must teach him a lesson this time. However, when he went to court the next day, he found that it was not the case at all.
When a group of veteran officials, especially the censors, heard about this, they immediately jumped up like a cat whose tail had been stepped on.
“The late emperor has just passed away, and His Royal Highness Prince Rui is still in mourning. He is so indulgent in pleasure. This is truly disobedient and unfilial!”
How could it be so serious? I was just going out to relax, not to play.
“Especially since he secretly brought the late emperor’s favourite concubine with him, his crime is even more serious!”
“Your Highness Prince Rui is so absurd and has brought disgrace upon the royal family. He deserves severe punishment!”
“Your Majesty…”
Emperor Taicheng finally understood that these people just wanted to see Xiaojiu suffer. This is the disadvantage of having no one in the court, not even one person to speak for him.
Seeing that more and more hats were being put on Xiaojiu’s head, Emperor Taicheng had to help him clean up the mess, otherwise the matter would get bigger and bigger and there would be no way to resolve it in the end.
In this way, Emperor Taicheng had to suppress the affairs concerning Prince Rui in the midst of his busy schedule. This lasted for several days and made him exhausted. Little did he know that while he was so busy, Ye Shuo, who was thousands of miles away, was very happy.
After everything was finally dealt with and things finally quieted down, Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help feeling lonely.
In this world, sincerity is exchanged for sincerity. How can a person without sincerity be treated with sincerity by others? The price of being used everywhere is that no one will get close to you.
As the saying goes, it’s lonely at the top. As time went by on the throne, Emperor Taicheng finally realised the loneliness that his father had felt before. He also vaguely understood why his father was never willing to punish Xiaojiu severely even though he was so noisy.
This supreme power is good, but it also comes with a high price.
Throughout the palace, except for the empress who could say a few more words to Emperor Taicheng, the other concubines could not even arouse Emperor Taicheng’s attention.
If the concubines do their job well, they will be rewarded; if they do not, they will be punished. Occasionally, new people will enter the palace, and when the novelty wears off, they will start to repeat the behaviours of the above.
But in fact, Emperor Taicheng and the Queen were not completely devoted to each other.
Now that his only son Ye Jin has become the crown prince, the queen is no longer just his wife. There are too many interests involved. There are also many concubines in the palace, which makes the two of them unable to help but want to test each other.
Everything is full of exploitation and calculation. Even if you sleep in the same bed, you cannot understand each other’s minds.
There are some things that no one can say.
Emperor Taicheng, who had passed by Qiuwu Palace for countless times and had gradually become like other emperors, could not help but think that when he was not emperor before, he had planned that if such a day really came in the future, he would summon Xiaojiu to the palace to talk and relieve his depression.
But I didn’t expect Xiaojiu to run so fast that I couldn’t even catch his shadow.
There were not many people who could talk to Emperor Taicheng, and there were even fewer after this.
As the saying goes, you reap what you sow. In this world, it is impossible to have the best of both worlds.
On the other side, in Liangzhou City——
After informing Mrs. Zhen that Ye Xun did not come, she was first disappointed, and then a little worried.
My son is in good health but he refuses to leave Beijing. He doesn’t even bother to see his biological mother. What other reason could there be?
Xun’er seems to value power more and more now. That’s right. From being the legitimate son of the crown prince, he has fallen to his current state. Although he has successfully inherited the title, he still has to stand at the end of the line when attending every court ceremony. He has to watch people who were far inferior to him in the past now standing over him and yelling at him. No matter who it is, I’m afraid they would not be able to tolerate it.
Ye Shuo at the side paused and said, “It’s a good thing that the child is ambitious.”
It turns out that Ye Shuo was not unaware, he was just pretending not to know.
Ye Shuo had tried to persuade him, but Ye Xun had grown up after all, and he knew clearly what he was doing.
Mrs. Zhen had nothing to say about this.
Each of them had their own ideas in mind, how could she persuade them?
But Madam Zhen didn’t want to implicate the person in front of her, and she was relieved when she learned that her son had moved out of the Ruiwang Mansion.
After all, the Imperial Concubine Dowager was not very young. Although she had the will, she did not have the physical strength to keep up. So after arriving in Liangzhou, she decided to rest here temporarily, planning to wait for two or three months to see all the beautiful scenery in Liangzhou City before doing anything else.
Looking at Jianjian again, she has been eager to try and go out on her own.
Jianjian is very good at kung fu, but what she lacks is some experience. It would be nice to take this opportunity to let her suffer a little loss and see the world.
As soon as Jianjian left, Ye Shuo asked Wu Yi to follow him and told him not to take any action unless his life was in danger or there were other serious situations.
Wu Yi couldn’t help but wonder if this was really his biological sister, but in the end, he agreed.
Huo Tianyi and his friends were too lazy to get involved with the young couple. They were too jealous and their old arms and legs couldn’t stand it.
Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi were left, staring at each other. Finally, Yao Zhi smiled and took the initiative to extend her hand.
“Come on, follow me.”
“Let’s travel the world together. You won’t be prince, and I won’t be princess. From now on, we will be a knight-errant and a heroine.”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and then put his hand on hers.
“good!”
“I will go with you to see all this beautiful country and never go back!”
What prince, what princess, let all these things say goodbye!
At this moment, Ye Shuo really thought that everything was over.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Note
chapters.content:
Because Yao Zhi was so famous before, everyone knew that the red-clothed heroine in the martial arts world had married a prince from the royal family. In order to avoid being discovered, the two had to change their appearances.
Fortunately, Yao Zhi had learned the art of disguise, so such a trivial matter was no problem for her.
After leaving Liangzhou City, the two men, one holding a gong and the other carrying a shoulder pole, on which were some small odds and ends. The outfits of the two men were exactly what Yao Zhi had just bought from the brother and sister who performed magic in Liangzhou City.
Magic tricks are highly mobile and rarely confined to one place. Most of the time they are performed wherever there are temple fairs or celebrations, which is just right for two people to travel with.
The art of disguise itself is not limited to the face. If you want to play another person, you must not only work hard on your appearance, but also be able to do what the person you are playing is able to do.
Therefore, some simple and popular magic tricks were not difficult for Yao Zhi, and there were also female magicians. A couple would have the man beat drums and gongs to collect money from the onlookers, while the woman would be responsible for the performance. There were so many such things that it was nothing unusual.
Therefore, at the beginning, Yao Zhi subconsciously put herself into the role of earning money to support the family.
In order to experience the fun more immersively, the two deliberately did not bring much money when they went out. Ye Shuo was used to a wealthy life. It is easy to go from frugality to extravagance, but difficult to go from extravagance to frugality. Even he could not change his habit of spending money lavishly in a short time. In just two days, the money they had was basically gone.
When Ye Shuo shook his purse, only a few scattered copper coins fell out, and he was completely dumbfounded.
I was careless. I didn’t expect that money could be spent so easily.Seeing the young man’s guilty face, Yao Zhi was not very angry. He had been spoiled since he was a child, so it was normal for him to be unaccustomed to living outside.
Besides, Yao Zhi couldn’t bear to see him live a hard life.
Seeing his head drooping, Yao Zhi subconsciously comforted him, “Don’t worry, I will be able to solve it before dinner, and I will definitely let you stay in the inn.”
Let her think about what to do?
Just when Yao Zhi was hesitating whether to go to the black market, she saw the young man go out at some point, and when he came back, he had a bag of silver in his hand.
“Where did you get the silver?” Yao Zhi was stunned and couldn’t help but wonder if he had secretly taken some silver notes when he came out.
However, Ye Shuo said: “Just now I went to the restaurant next door, and asked the boss there about a few recipes for snacks.” Ye Shuo has lived in the palace for so many years, and he has memorised a lot of beauty recipes, health recipes, snack recipes, etc., even if he didn’t pay much attention.
These recipes from the palace were like a dimensionality reduction blow to the people.
The owner of the restaurant didn’t believe it at first. Although the young man in front of him was good-looking, his appearance didn’t look like that of someone who knew some precious secret recipe.
But the other party finally succumbed to Ye Shuo’s persuasion and let his chef have a good try.
Well, it’s true that the desserts made with the recipe the young man mentioned are indeed more delicate and sweeter than those made in the best pastry shop in the city. The only drawback is that they are too expensive, and probably not many people can afford them.
However, snacks like this are not popular items and are originally supplied to a small number of people in the city.
Then, the owner of the restaurant had evil intentions.
In this day and age, how could it be so easy to get by in the outside world? How could the owner of the restaurant pay a magician who had no background so readily? ṙâɴǒ𝐛Ę𝒮
In the end, Ye Shuo had no choice but to show his fist.
Seeing that the other party was actually a gangster, a gangster was a bunch of desperate criminals. If he got angry, what would he do if he came to seek revenge in the future? It was better to spend money to avoid disaster, so Ye Shuo successfully got the silver.
But selling those prescriptions is only temporary after all. It can be used to meet occasional emergencies, but it is not a long-term solution.
Ye Shuo recalled carefully, then locked himself in the room for two whole days. On the third day, he suddenly took out a bunch of drawings.
“What are these things?” Yao Zhi flipped through them. Although she couldn’t fully understand the modern drawing techniques, she could at least understand some of them. She vaguely guessed that these seemed to be some small props or something.
Yes, these are some of the props needed for magic tricks.
Now that Ye Shuo has this identity, he has to do something related to this identity.
Breaking a big stone on the chest is too rough. The most important thing is that the big stone is too heavy and it is not very convenient to move it. Small objects like playing cards are still very ornamental.
As for breathing fire, swallowing swords and the like, there are simply too many people who are good at these things. No matter how much Ye Shuo practices, he can’t compare to others who have accumulated skills for dozens of years. He can only work hard in other areas.
For example, if you are good at chemical reactions, you can be regarded as a god in ancient times.
