The more Ye Shuo thought about it, the more ideas came into his mind. In just a day or two, Yao Zhi watched him playing with various things in his hands, sometimes it was a copper ball, sometimes it was an unknown powder, and sometimes it was some cards.
Thanks to Qinglufang’s fame, playing cards have become popular among the people.
The young man became more and more skilled at the game, and his tricks increased. At first, everything was still within an acceptable range, until Yao Zhi watched him put his fingers into the bowl, and the water in the bowl froze into ice in the blink of an eye. Yao Zhi could no longer hold back.
However, Ye Shuo seemed not to notice and asked, “What do you think? If we go to the temple fair, can we compete?”
Yao Zhi was silent for a while, then said, “Maybe… I will be invited to perform at the home of a noble official…”
Well…
That’s not necessary. I managed to escape with great difficulty.
The two looked at each other, both full of confidence.
Then, they took these odds and ends and went to the nearby city where the temple fair was about to be held.
When the group of black-armored guards sent by Emperor Taicheng to look for someone arrived, they found nothing.
Seeing the snacks becoming popular in the city and slightly similar to those in the palace, the black-armoured guards hesitated for a moment and then reported what had happened here.
Although Ye Shuo fled from Shangjing, there was still some news about him. People had to know that he was still alive and well, so there were occasional clues left behind.
After briefly reading the letter, Emperor Taicheng paused and said nothing.
After a while, Emperor Taicheng sent another letter to ask how Xiaojiu and his wife were doing. As expected, the result he got was that his younger brother had become a famous magician. Every time he performed, most people in the city would come to watch.
I don’t know where he got so many ideas, but almost every time they were different. This was simply amazing for ancient people who had not received systematic scientific education.
Later, just as Yao Zhi said, Ye Shuo was often invited to the homes of local officials and wealthy businessmen.
Then…he was forced to witness many crime scenes.
After all, no family would be so idle as to invite people to perform at their home just for the sake of watching magic shows. Most of them would use the excuse of watching the performance to commit illegal acts.
No one took the two magicians seriously and regarded them as just extras.
This was indeed not his intention, but since it happened, he couldn’t just pretend not to see it.
Although termites are not very aggressive, if there are too many of them, they will erode the foundation that has been built with great difficulty.
But Ye Shuo really didn’t want to get involved. After thinking about it, he decided that this matter could only be handed over to Xiao Ming to handle. He probably would be happy to do so.
Xiao Ming is the emperor, who will take care of this matter if he doesn’t?
Then, Emperor Taicheng received many small notes with names on them.
When Emperor Taicheng was hesitating whether to praise Xiaojiu, he saw that the small note suddenly disappeared. It turned out that the young couple was tired of playing, so they changed their faces and clothes and rushed to the next place.
It took Emperor Taicheng a long time before he got any news about the two again.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: Coughing up Blood
chapters.content:
As time passed, the two would change their identities every once in a while. Gradually, avoiding the pursuit of the Black Armor Guards became a kind of fun for the two.
In addition to magic tricks, the two have also played the roles of doctors, musicians, and street vendors… They have watched the sunrise on the top of a mountain and danced with the waves on a deserted beach.
In the summer, the two of them specially got a set of diving suits made of shark skin and swam in the sea to their heart’s content.
The population in ancient times was far less than that of modern times, but the creatures in the sea were constantly multiplying. When the weather was clear and the waves were not too strong, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi would usually have a good harvest.
In the modern era where seawater pollution is quite serious, Ye Shuo had only seen several sea cucumbers, sea urchins and abalone being caught with a sieve in some sparsely populated countries in his previous life. After travelling through time, he can now achieve this without going abroad.
Due to the crude storage methods available today, many seafood would not survive long even after being brought ashore. So after satisfying themselves, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi would usually distribute the excess seafood to nearby poorer beggars or villagers who were unable to go into the water.
Looking at the abalone and crabs jumping around in the bamboo basket, Ye Shuo borrowed a stove from a villager in the fishing village and steamed them in a steamer. The whole process did not even require any seasoning. After a quarter of an hour, when he opened the lid of the pot, the room was filled with fragrance.
While steaming the crabs, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had already found time to finish off several lively sea urchins.
The delicate sea urchin slid into the throat, and the sweet, soft taste immediately spread in the mouth. As for the sea cucumber, of course Ye Shuo roasted it with green onions.
The two of them lived like this for nearly a month. After a full meal, Ye Shuo gradually thought of Xiao Ming who was far away in Beijing.He asked someone to send a lot of dried scallops, dried abalone and dried sea cucumbers to his mother, Madam Zhen, and several masters. When it was Xiao Ming’s turn, Ye Shuo was in a dilemma.
There is no shortage of these dried seafood in the palace, and the quality is much better than what the two non-professionals catch. Xiao Ming must not be rare. As for the fresh shrimps and crabs, Ye Shuo does not have the ability to transport them to Shangjing alive.
After much thought, Ye Shuo washed the shells he picked up from the beach, punched holes in them, and then strung them together with a hemp rope.
About a month later, Emperor Taicheng received a wooden box. When the box was opened, it contained a few scattered shells strung together with ropes.
There are about twenty shells in total, in all kinds of shapes. They are very delicate when viewed separately, but when put together, they are a disaster.
Emperor Taicheng lifted it up by the rope, and as he moved, the shells collided with each other, making a ding-dong sound. The colourful shells almost made him dizzy.
Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but look at the person in front of him.
The black-armoured guard understood and said hurriedly, “His Royal Highness Prince Rui said that this is the ‘Duo’ he made for you personally.”
The so-called Duo is what modern people call wind chimes.
Such crude craftsmanship must be the work of his bastard brother. Upon hearing this, Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but twitch his lips.
Seeing that His Majesty did not say anything, the Black-Armored Guards tactfully retreated.
By the time Emperor Taicheng finished reviewing the memorials, it was already evening. He stood up and once again saw the wooden box on the table.
Just when the eunuch next to him thought that the emperor would have it taken away, he saw Emperor Taicheng pause, and then said: “This thing doesn’t look very good, but it sounds pretty good.” ṝᴀℕó𝐁Êʂ
“Have someone hang this string of ‘duo’ on the door frame later.”
The eunuch was stunned and said hurriedly: “…Yes.”
The next day, after the court session, He Xiang and others came to the Qinzheng Hall. From a distance, they saw that there seemed to be something hanging on the door of the Qinzheng Hall.
When they got closer, they found that it was actually a string of “duo” made of shells.
Those people in the Imperial Household Department must be so bold that they actually presented such things, without any fear of offending the emperor’s eyes.
Later, He Xiang and others found out that it was the work of His Royal Highness Prince Rui, which was no wonder.
He Xiang suddenly didn’t find it strange anymore.
It was another busy afternoon. After several important ministers left, Emperor Taicheng suddenly felt a little tired.
He didn’t know if it was an illusion, but Emperor Taicheng just felt that his energy was really low in recent days, and even the imperial physician advised him to rest more.
But he had just ascended the throne, and many things were waiting for him to deal with, one after another, how could he easily stop?
Just at this moment, a gust of wind blew, and the string of shell wind chimes also made a “rustling” sound. Even though the shells had been made into an object now, they still faintly revealed the freedom and joy of the sea.
Accompanied by the sound of wind chimes, Emperor Taicheng was busy and lowered his head again.
By autumn, the Imperial Concubine had almost rested. Ye Shuo originally wanted to ask his mother to go to the mountain to see the maple leaves, and then go to Ye Ling and Xiang Hu to eat crabs.
The Imperial Concubine Dowager was also very enthusiastic at first, but after following them for two days, she couldn’t stand it anymore.
Is this still a life for human beings?
No matter how much the Imperial Concubine likes the outside world, she can’t stand such a toss. These two people are really too noisy. There is no moment of rest. The Imperial Concubine has been raised in the deep palace for many years and has long been accustomed to wealth and comfort. Not to mention how luxurious it is, there must be everything she should have, right?
After only two days, the Imperial Concubine clamoured to go back. The Imperial Concubine was almost regretting it to death.
“I don’t care. Anyway, you two have to send me back to Liangzhou. I’m not going!”
Even though Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had tried their best to slow down their pace, it was still too fast for the Imperial Concubine, who had been lacking exercise for many years, to keep up. Rubbing her sore calves, the Imperial Concubine refused to take another step.
Ye Shuo was suddenly in trouble.
However, what the two men did not expect was that in the end it was the beautiful woman driving the carriage who rescued them from the fire and water.
The beautiful woman had already anticipated this. Although she was going out to relax, a luxury car and a group of servants would be more suitable for her.
Young people are playful and have strong adaptability. They can travel around the entire city within a day, but the imperial concubine is not like that. Sometimes it takes her three to five months to gradually explore the fun of it.
Ye Shuo suddenly remembered the difference between the young people’s budget travel and the sunset red travel group…
In the end, it was naturally the beautiful woman who took the Imperial Concubine away with her people. Before leaving, the Imperial Concubine looked at the two of them and said bitterly, “I will never go out with you again!”
They were really moving very slowly…
How could they have only walked such a distance in the past two days? Now two days have passed, and they have not even walked a few dozen miles in total. At this speed, it will probably take them more than half a month to reach their destination.
Ye Shuo opened his mouth and wanted to explain, but the Imperial Concubine refused to listen and only left him with the billowing smoke and sand raised by the turning wheels.
Compared to her bastard son, her daughter-in-law’s second master is much more careful. They are the same age and both are women. Wouldn’t it be more comfortable for her to stay with two young people?
What’s more, the beautiful woman has learned a lot of kung fu, and the key is that she has a good temper, can coax people, is patient, and knows everything. No matter what happens on the road, she doesn’t have to worry about it, she can solve it well. The imperial concubine knows that she has no other skills except this identity, so she listens to the arrangements of the beautiful woman attentively. Basically, they will stay in one place for three to five months before moving to a new place. This leisurely but rhythmic travel experience is what the imperial concubine needs. It must be said that the other party really understands her thoughts.
As time went by, the Imperial Concubine became more and more dependent on the other party.
As for the beautiful woman, she also did not feel bored. Although the royal concubine was sometimes a little picky and pampered, it was the most wonderful thing to have someone to accompany her during the journey.
In the end, Master Six couldn’t hold back any longer and joined in.
In Liangzhou, there were only a few male masters left who went in and out of Qinglufang all day long. The old men gathered together and became more and more slovenly.
The third master, who looked feminine and like a good girl, couldn’t stand it anymore and was secretly preparing to rebel and go to find the Imperial Concubine and the others.
Summer turned to autumn, autumn turned to winter, Ye Shuo, Yao Zhi and the Royal Concubine Dowager travelled all the way to the southernmost part of the Great Zhou. The climate here is pleasant, and it is very warm even in the dead of winter.
The Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but sigh: “When I was in the capital before, I only knew that it was very comfortable when the palace was burning floor dragons, but I didn’t know that it was the most comfortable when the weather was warm.”
The more vigorously the earth dragon burned, the drier the Qiuwu Palace became. Even if there were several braziers in the room, the dry feeling could not be curbed. It was really torture.
More than half a year passed, and the Imperial Concubine Dowager couldn’t help thinking that she had been trapped in that cage for too long in the first half of her life, and it seemed not bad if she could live like this for the rest of her life.
Just as she was talking to the beautiful woman and the Sixth and Third Masters, Ye Shuo finally finished cleaning up and brought up the prepared pot.
“Come and try it. The hotpot is freshly made and there is fresh beef.”
Beef was not easy to get in ancient times. Although the government stipulated that working oxen could be slaughtered after being reported when they were old, the beef at that time was already old and tough and difficult to chew. Fresh and tender beef like this was almost impossible to find.
There were only a few of them, and Ye Shuo had gone to great lengths to get them in the city. They were genuine first-hand goods, but they were snatched up by Ye Shuo before they could even be sold at the market.
It has to be said that the beef hotpot is fresh and tender. Even without the chilli to stimulate the taste buds, the imperial concubines and others still love it very much. Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi are also eating happily on the side.
This was the first time that the Imperial Concubine Dowager did not spend New Year’s Eve in the capital. Apart from missing her parents and brothers, everything else was fine.
Also, she didn’t know how Jianjian was doing recently. With Wu Yi watching beside her, the Imperial Concubine was naturally not particularly worried. She just heard from her son that Jianjian had been playing too much recently and even dared to leave Da Zhou and go to a farther place. She was simply lawless!
However, Jianjian was like a bird out of the cage now. The Imperial Concubine could no longer control her. Apart from being anxious, the Imperial Concubine had no other choice.
Forget it, it’s New Year’s Day, don’t think about these things.
The steam from the beef hotpot gradually rose, and the whole room became warm. Because it was a special day, Ye Shuo made an exception and had two drinks. The moon was high in the sky, and looking at the tipsy people, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh. He couldn’t be more satisfied in his heart.
However, at this moment, what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that Emperor Taicheng, who was far away in the palace, suddenly felt some discomfort in his throat after everyone left.
Then, he actually coughed up a mouthful of blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Clouds Clear
chapters.content:
“Your Majesty!”
The chief eunuch next to him was startled, but when the other palace people looked over, Emperor Taicheng had already quietly put the handkerchief in his hand into his sleeve.
The chief eunuch acted almost instantly, faster than his brain could think, and said, “What are you all standing there for? Lead the way ahead. If you fall, watch out for your heads!”
After the palace maid realised what was happening, she quickly lowered her head and dared not look again.
On the way, Emperor Taicheng spoke in a voice that only the two of them could hear.
“What happened today must not be spread outside.”
Facing the emperor’s murderous eyes, the eunuch’s back was instantly wet with sweat.
Ignoring him, Emperor Taicheng endured the discomfort and returned to Chengming Palace.
He has only been on the throne for more than half a year. If he summons the imperial physician on New Year’s Eve, it will probably arouse suspicion from others. Emperor Taicheng does not want to see such a scene, so he waited until the next day, when the director of the Imperial Medical Bureau came to check Ping’an’s pulse as usual, and then he slowly spoke.
“How? Do you know what caused it?”With secret guards watching him all day long, Emperor Taicheng was not too worried that anyone would reach into the palace.
The fifth, seventh and eighth brothers do not have such ability yet, but Emperor Taicheng still has some confidence in this.
But if they hadn’t done it, then there must be something wrong with his body… Thinking of this, Emperor Taicheng’s heart sank.
After the doctor of the Imperial Hospital finished examining his pulse, he immediately fell to his knees.
Seeing this scene, what else did Emperor Taicheng not understand?
In the end, he naturally issued a gag order and sent the Imperial Hospital Director away. Emperor Taicheng sat there alone, his mind full of what the Imperial Hospital Director had just said –
He said that he had not taken good care of his health since he was a child, and had been busy during his youth, which damaged his foundation. He also did not pay attention to maintenance during his youth, and was eager to have a child, so he indulged himself during this period. Over the years, he became ill from overwork and completely damaged his body.
If a person endures this all day long, even the best medicine will be of no help.
Emperor Taicheng never thought that all his efforts would turn into sharp arrows and reflect back at him at this moment.
But on the surface, Emperor Taicheng remained calm. When dealing with the fifth, seventh and eighth princes, he became more ruthless and merciless.
For a time, the fifth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince were suppressed like dead dogs and looked extremely embarrassed.
With Emperor Taicheng’s current momentum, let alone the other fifth or eighth prince, even the eldest prince would have to keep a low profile and behave himself.
Because the eldest prince discovered that he really did it!
The eldest prince suddenly became obedient and no longer dared to challenge his younger brother. Emperor Taicheng sneered in his heart, but was also satisfied with his tact.
If the eldest prince didn’t make trouble, he could save a lot of effort.
In addition to madly suppressing several princes in the court, Emperor Taicheng privately began to look for prescriptions and medicines everywhere, and even went so far as to pray to gods.
Emperor Taicheng had been extremely rational since he was young, but now he is no longer rational.
When Ye Shuo, who was far away in the south, received the news, it was three months later.
When Ye Shuo heard that the new emperor had hired a group of Taoist priests who were refining elixirs in the palace every day, his first reaction was disbelief. ꞦаƝÓВËS
How could Xiao Ming, such a rational person, believe these things? If Xiao Ming was older, it might be understandable, but he was still so young, how could he –
For some reason, Ye Shuo felt a little uneasy in his heart.
After thinking about it, Ye Shuo finally sent him a letter. There was no need to think too much about the content of the letter. It was naturally advising him not to believe those Taoists, as they were all liars. The cinnabar in the elixir was even poisonous, so he was told not to eat it.
Ye Shuo’s words were sincere, and one could sense his inner anxiety even through the letter.
Even when his younger brother was studying, he had never written so many words. If he were in a different situation, Emperor Taicheng would definitely feel very pleased, but now…
Holding the thick stack of letters in his hand, Emperor Taicheng slowly closed his eyes.
It’s too late. It’s too late…
Perhaps it was really as he said, those pills were poisonous and those Taoists were even some evil ones, but the pills they refined were indeed effective and could make people excited, and could also allow Emperor Taicheng to maintain his current state.
Otherwise, those people below might make some small moves again. Just like flies, they can never be completely hit or killed, and it makes people feel annoyed.
Emperor Taicheng remained silent in the end and did not respond at all.
Ye Shuo thought that he had not explained himself clearly enough, so he sent out several more letters. The explanations in the letters became clearer and clearer, and the letters became thicker and thicker.
Seeking immortals and asking for the way is not the right path. Self-cultivation is the key. Throughout history, many emperors have died tragically. There are many examples in the dynasties before the Great Zhou Dynasty. Why did Xiao Ming get confused about this matter? Ye Shuo couldn’t figure it out no matter how hard he tried.
If it were someone else, they would have hoped that he would lose his mind so that they could push him off the throne. Who would have asked him any more questions? Most of the ministers in the court also advised him not to believe in the evil ways, otherwise there might be disasters caused by the evil ways.
However, no one among them said that this medicine was bad for his health.
No one knows? Not necessarily. It’s just that no one thinks in this direction.
Only Xiaojiu’s first reaction was to worry about himself.
Just when Ye Shuo was hesitating whether to go back, Emperor Taicheng finally showed mercy and told him to get out and stop interfering in other people’s affairs, otherwise don’t blame him for being rude.
After Ye Shuo received the letter, he was almost angry to death.
What kind of person is this? He took my kindness for granted!
However, after calming down, Ye Shuo thought about it and felt that it was really unlikely that Xiao Ming would do this. Unless he was suddenly possessed by someone, how could a person change so much in less than a year?
Then Ye Shuo asked him if he had encountered any difficulties, and told him not to be depressed and that taking good care of his health was the most important thing.
Xiao Ming has been weak since childhood. It would be difficult for a normal person to eat so much cinnabar, let alone him. With his physical condition, it is estimated that he will be completely ruined within two years. There is really no way to live forever in this world, so he should not be confused.
Ye Shuo would only dare to say this in public. If he were to say it face to face, he really wouldn’t have the courage to do so.
It’s just that my grandfather’s family has to bear a lot of pressure…
But after all, it was he who said this. Xiao Ming might be angry, but he shouldn’t take the risk of implicating others.
Even if Xiao Ming has changed, there are still Zou Wu and others in the court, so it won’t be a big problem.
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that when Emperor Taicheng received the letter, instead of being angry, he felt extremely sad and almost cried.
Sick people are particularly vulnerable, and even the emperor is no exception. Emperor Taicheng, who had been holding on alone, almost collapsed at this moment.
Keeping a secret all by yourself, with no relatives to turn to, and having to bear it all by yourself, even the strongest person will want to have someone to rely on at this time.
And the one you rely on is either your parents, or your wife and children…you can’t be alone.
Emperor Taicheng finally understood why his father was so dependent on Xiaojiu during his last days when he was seriously ill.
However, Emperor Taicheng was born without a mother and was never very close to Emperor Jingwen. As for his wife and children… As the granddaughter of Prime Minister He, the Queen was involved in too many things. She was not only the Queen of the Great Zhou, but also a woman of the He family. As for Jin’er, he was really too young.
For a moment, Emperor Taicheng almost told Xiaojiu everything about himself, but after just a moment, he gave up.
As an emperor, everyone can be weak, but he himself must always remain invulnerable.
Some things really…can’t be said.
Emperor Taicheng naturally refused in the end.
After two times, Ye Shuo understood that Xiao Ming was determined. There was no other way, so Ye Shuo could only settle for the second best. No matter how Xiao Ming behaved, the people were innocent after all, so he must not do anything bad.
Then…Emperor Taicheng agreed.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask again, is it really impossible not to believe in things?
As expected, there was no news from Emperor Taicheng again. Seeing this, Ye Shuo almost collapsed.
“Forget it, forget it, I can’t do anything about it.” It’s going to rain, who can stop it?
He asked the students to help him find out, but it was hard to find a loophole for Emperor Taicheng. In the end, they returned empty-handed.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to give up.
After a while, around the summer of the following year, news suddenly came from my eldest cousin that Emperor Taicheng had promoted him to an important position. He asked what was going on. Was it a trap? Was Emperor Taicheng planning to liquidate his family?
Ye Shuo was a little stunned when he heard this.
My grandfather’s family, who had never been given important positions during the reign of Emperor Jingwen, suddenly saw the light of day at this time, during the reign of Emperor Xiao Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Serious Illness
chapters.content:
There is a high probability that there will be no liquidation. The ministers under the emperor are like tools. There is no fixed answer. They are reused when needed and abandoned like pawns when not needed.
It would be fine if the emperor was merciful, but if he met a cruel person, losing his life would be a small matter, and his family might even be implicated.
Now, more than 20 years have passed since his father ascended the throne, and the influence of his grandfather’s family in the army has been almost eliminated. Besides, Xiao Ming had no direct conflict with his grandfather’s family before, so the possibility of being purged is not great. It should just be the time to recruit people again.
Ye Shuo thought about it and didn’t think this was a trap, so he just told his cousin to relax.
Seeing that his younger cousin agreed with him, the older cousin slowly let down his guard.
In addition to the eldest cousin, not long after, Emperor Taicheng named the youngest and most talented grandchild in the entire Zhen Mansion and asked him to go to the military camp for training.
Ye Shuo’s eighteenth cousin is only one or two months younger than him. He is only in his twenties this year, at the prime of his life. After entering the military camp, he was like a fish in water and he was doing very well in just a few days.
Of course, this was due to his own abilities, but also to the influence of his father and grandfather. After all, who doesn’t know the title of the old Duke of Zhen?
From the current point of view, everything in the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion is going well.
While Ye Shuo breathed a sigh of relief, he couldn’t help but start to worry about Xiao Ming.Then, just three months later, my cousin brought me another shocking news.
It turns out that Xiao Ming’s temperament didn’t change suddenly, but he… was sick.
Although Emperor Taicheng concealed the secret very well and deceived so many people, he was unable to hide it from Wei Wen.
Wei Wen is such a smart man. He has been very meticulous since he was a child and vaguely felt that something was wrong. After daily observation, he discovered such a shocking secret.
The new emperor has been on the throne for less than two years and the crown prince is still very young. If this news were to get out, there would probably be chaos throughout the country.
No wonder, no wonder Xiao Ming suddenly became like this!
This way, everything makes sense.
Ye Shuo’s first reaction was to prepare to return to Beijing and scold him severely, but then he realised, what else can he do after scolding?
Help him cure his illness? Although Yao Zhi’s medical skills are good, they are not to the extent of changing people’s fate. When his father was cured, Xiao Ming was also present. He could not hide whether those people in the Imperial Hospital were doing their best.
After returning home, should he be advised to take medicine and rest? If he could make it in time, even if there was a glimmer of hope, Xiao Ming would not take this step.
Or help him share the burden? How could Xiao Ming allow himself to lose power?
He has been an extremely insecure person since he was young. He only believes in himself, so from birth to death, Xiao Ming will only keep everything firmly in his own hands.
Just like what happened with the crown prince at that time, Ye Shuo could only watch helplessly as they walked towards the abyss step by step.
Ye Shuo could do nothing and no one would listen to him.
It is always like this between him and his brothers. They know everything in their hearts, but because they know it too clearly, they feel powerless.
He can’t say he can’t do it or move, otherwise Xiao Ming will be the first to attack him, and it will be like a vicious circle.
He will never be able to change a person’s thoughts and character, or change a person’s predetermined fate, like a saviour.
On the other side, in the palace——
“Your Majesty, please spare my life! Your Majesty, please spare my life!”
The young eunuch came to serve tea as usual and accidentally saw the emperor holding the brush habitually, but the brush suddenly fell from his hand. The emperor’s fingers were trembling constantly. By the time the young eunuch reacted, it was too late. 𝙧𝘼Ŋ𝖔ＢĚṥ
Emperor Taicheng was silent for a moment, then waved to the eunuch beside him.
“Let’s deal with it.”
“Remember to be careful.”
The head eunuch understood and immediately stepped forward to cover the mouth of the younger eunuch, then ordered his men to drag him out.
The young eunuch had no power to resist, and couldn’t even make a sound, and just died.
He was just a servant, so he was killed without causing any commotion. When the chief eunuch personally followed the situation and came back, he found that the box of elixirs in front of the emperor had been emptied without him noticing.
At this moment, Emperor Taicheng had picked up his pen again, and there was no sign of anything unusual.
It is already autumn now, and Emperor Taicheng’s usually cold hands and feet no longer feel cold. Instead, his body is getting hot, and his heartbeat is much faster than usual. He seems to be drunk and a little tipsy. However, within half an hour, sweat begins to appear on Emperor Taicheng’s forehead.
After such a long time, Emperor Taicheng had become very familiar with this scene. He knew that this was the effect of the elixir. He had never felt so comfortable before. He felt as if he was soaking in warm hot water.
Those Taoists do have some skills, but it would be great if this medicine could really make people immortal.
In just over half a year, the dosage of the medicine has been increasing. At first, it was just one or two pills, and later it became three, four, and five pills… I don’t know how long I can last like this?
I am becoming more and more dependent on these things, and I am revealing more and more flaws. The court is full of cunning people, so how long can I hide it?
I just hope this matter will be exposed slower and slower.
I hope no blind people will show up, otherwise…
As time went on, the effect of the medicine became stronger and stronger. Emperor Taicheng could not bear the heat at all, so he threw away the pen in his hand. It was not until he went outside and the cool wind blew that he felt much better.
When night came, Emperor Taicheng stayed in the Queen’s Palace.
Naturally, the changes in the palace could not be hidden from the Queen’s eyes, especially the smoke rising from the stoves in the palace every day, which made the Queen very worried.
However, whenever she mentioned it, the emperor would get furious. After a long time, the queen dared not say anything more.
Although she was the Empress and had the responsibility to advise the Emperor, she could not go against the Emperor’s will.
I don’t know if it’s an illusion, but since the beginning of autumn, the emperor’s temper has become more and more moody. He especially can’t stand seeing withered flowers and fallen leaves. Whenever he sees them, he will punish the palace servants who are responsible for sweeping the floor every day.
As time went on, the emperor’s prestige grew, so much so that everyone in the palace was on tenterhooks.
The queen always felt that the emperor seemed to have something to say to her, but in the end he didn’t open his mouth, so the queen didn’t ask.
But for some reason tonight, the emperor was particularly crazy. When he was in love, he suddenly said in his ear: “Ah Tan, give me another prince.”
The emperor only called me by this name on our wedding day, and never did so again since then.
The queen subconsciously wanted to look into Emperor Taicheng’s eyes, but she saw that Emperor Taicheng had taken a step ahead of her and touched her eyes with his hands.
The queen hesitated for a while, and finally nodded slightly.
“It’s all up to the Emperor.”
What the queen didn’t expect was that there was no movement in her belly, but a little beauty who was selected to enter the palace last year became pregnant first.
Upon hearing the news, Emperor Taicheng was naturally overjoyed. He had few children, so he naturally hoped to have more pairs of children. Especially at this time, when the news came out, Emperor Taicheng could not help but be happy.
However, in just over a month, before the imperial physician could even diagnose whether the child was a boy or a girl, the beauty just sneezed and the child was gone.
Emperor Taicheng thought that it was other women in the palace who did it, so he asked the secret guards to investigate, but they found nothing.
In other words, the child was gone by himself.
After experiencing great ups and downs, joy and sorrow, Emperor Taicheng’s sanity finally collapsed completely.
“The heaven is blind! The heaven is blind!”
Emperor Taicheng didn’t know what he had done wrong to deserve such a punishment from the heavens. He didn’t understand why the heavens first let him have it, but then let him lose it.
That day, Emperor Taicheng smashed everything that could be smashed.
From then on, Emperor Taicheng became more and more cruel and ruthless, and Ye Shuo, who was far away, heard one piece of news after another, each one worse than the last.
In the end, there was really no other way, Ye Shuo could only cut off most of the connections.
However, despite such caution, the news that Emperor Taicheng was seriously ill eventually broke out, like a spark falling into an oil pan, immediately causing a huge earthquake.
In a rage, Emperor Taicheng was merciless and executed the man, but what was the use? Once someone opened a hole, it could never be closed again.
At that time, Ye Shuo was still performing in Bingzhou City. Now he is considered one of the world’s top magicians, so his performance is naturally different.
Knowing that he was coming, the wealthy businessmen in the city paid out of their own pockets and spontaneously built a stage for him in the most prosperous area.
The stage was more than half a person’s height, and the people below were surrounding it in a crowded manner. Ye Shuo’s top hat kept fluttering, and soon a white dove appeared out of thin air. Before the people could marvel at it, the dove in his hand suddenly turned into a rose.
I saw the young man on the stage suddenly throwing the rose, and then a strong wind blew, and the rose turned into petals in the air, falling from the sky one after another.
After all, human vision is limited, and with some sleight of hand, for a moment, these petals seemed to be falling directly like rain.
Just as Yao Zhi turned the gong over and caught the copper coins thrown by the people one by one, Ye Shuo saw from afar that there seemed to be an army coming not far away.
The army consisted of only about a hundred people, and their attire was extremely familiar.
If it were normal, it would be fine, but now is different from the past, Ye Shuo does not want to get involved in the turmoil in the imperial city of Shangjing.
Because just three months ago, Yao Zhi was diagnosed with pregnancy.
After five years, the two were finally ready to welcome the arrival of their new life.
Ye Shuo naturally hoped that she could live in a stable and peaceful environment, rather than living in Shangjing, which was full of dangers.
Ye Shuo did not hesitate and was about to take his wife and run away, but he saw that the group of black-armoured guards surrounded him from the front and back, blocking his way as if they had expected it.
The people who were originally spectators were all panicked when they saw this scene. At first, they thought that the magician in front of them had committed a serious crime that caused such a big commotion.
As a result, when they turned their heads away, they saw this majestic army kneeling down at the same time.
“The emperor has ordered us to welcome His Royal Highness Prince Rui back to the palace.”
Seeing that the young man turned a deaf ear, the leading black-armoured guard took a deep breath and had to shout again.
“The emperor is seriously ill, please return to the palace!”
As soon as the words fell, the people around were shocked. They never thought that the young man in front of them, wearing coarse clothes and with an ordinary face, was actually a prince.
When he heard the word “serious illness”, Ye Shuo lost control and his breathing suddenly stopped.
After the Crown Prince, the Second Prince, the Fourth Prince, and his father, Xiao Ming was ultimately not spared.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Return
chapters.content:
In the end, Yao Zhi nodded and said, “In that case, you should go back and take a look.”
If it was an ordinary case, it would be fine, but the emperor was seriously ill… If it was not an extremely serious situation, the group of black-armoured guards in front of them would not say it in public.
This trip might be the last time they see each other, so Yao Zhi naturally wouldn’t stop it.
Although Yao Zhi is pregnant now, she does not feel any discomfort because of her strong body. Everything is still the same as usual, and she is not even showing any signs of pregnancy.
So there is definitely enough time.
Ye Shuo, on the other hand, was extremely reluctant: “I’m worried about you and Ding Ning.”
Although Yao Zhi is an expert in martial arts, childbirth is an extremely dangerous thing for a pregnant woman, and he should always be by her side, not leaving her side for a single step.
If anything goes wrong, he can react in time.
Yao Zhi smiled when she heard this: “Don’t forget, I am a doctor myself.”
“It’s not that easy to treat yourself.” What if she accidentally bumped into something, how could she handle it alone?Yao Zhi felt that she hadn’t felt anything since she became pregnant, but it made him very nervous.
Not only did she give the child a name early on, but she was also treated like a piece of porcelain every day, fearing that she would make the slightest mistake. Although it felt good to be cherished, and Yao Zhi enjoyed it very much, she would get bored after a while.
Finally, the two of them came to a conclusion: send Yao Zhi to the Imperial Noble Consort and several masters to be looked after by the Imperial Noble Consort and others, and then Ye Shuo would return to the capital.
“I’ll try to go early and come back early.” Ye Shuo knew that there weren’t many things he needed to deal with in Beijing, and he would be back in a while at most, so he said so.
Yao Zhi didn’t think about what he could do, so she nodded: “Okay.”
The black-armoured guards wanted to urge them on, saying that the emperor could not wait any longer, but they were met with a look from Prince Rui, and everyone stopped talking.
As the emperor was far away, the situation in Shangjing was tense, and there was no way to send so many black armour guards to search for him. In addition, there were so many people from the martial arts world helping him. If His Royal Highness Prince Rui refused to go with them, they really had no other choice. Especially since His Majesty had said that force was not allowed, these people were even more restrained.
Fortunately, His Royal Highness Prince Rui finally agreed, which made the leader breathe a sigh of relief.
Yao Zhi originally wanted to ride a horse, but when she saw the nervous and pitiful look of the young man next to her, her heart softened and she finally gave up and took a carriage instead.
Under the watchful eyes of the public, the people of Bingzhou stared blankly at him as he left. When the governor of Bingzhou hurriedly arrived, he could only see the backs of the group of people.
When everyone reacted, there were bursts of exclamations.
——They actually had the honour to watch the prince’s performance!
As for those who did not go out and wait for Ye Shuo’s second performance tomorrow, they regretted it very much. They thought that there would be fewer people tomorrow, but they didn’t expect… Alas!
On the other side, on the carriage——
“Azhi is so nice to me.”
Hearing this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but smile and scratched his chin: “You’re almost going to be a father, why are you still so childish?”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say, “Even if Ding Ning is born, I will still be the one that Sister Azhi loves the most. You can’t just take care of her and ignore me when the time comes.” ꭆÁＮ𝐎ꞖĘs̩
He was actually jealous of his own daughter. Yao Zhi didn’t know what to say.
Before leaving, Ye Shuo first kissed Yao Zhi’s cheek, then kissed Yao Zhi’s belly, and then left reluctantly.
If it were an ordinary man, how could he behave like this? Yao Zhi liked the fact that he did not hide his feelings, and she liked him more and more. This made Yao Zhi’s heart always seem to be filled.
He would not force her to have a child, and would attribute any gossip to his own fault. Even after she got pregnant, he would not stop her from doing this or that. Even if he had an opinion, he would just look at her pitifully, as if he was anxious but dared not say much. It was really interesting.
Of course, Yao Zhi would often be soft-hearted at this time, and he could still achieve his goal, but Yao Zhi liked him to use this method rather than like ordinary people.
After living with him for so long, Yao Zhi could no longer imagine what it would be like if she married another man. The thought of it was terrifying.
When Ye Shuo left, he didn’t even take Xiao Luzi with him. Xiao Luzi has become more and more experienced in handling various matters in the mansion. With him helping to keep an eye on things, Ye Shuo can feel more at ease.
When they got out of the door, Ye Shuo’s expression changed instantly. He jumped on the horse and said with a stern look: “Gee!”
With the idea of ​​going early and coming back early, Ye Shuo travelled almost day and night. Except for eating and sleeping, he did not waste a single moment.
However, in just seven or eight days, Ye Shuo arrived in Shangjing.
Although Ye Shuo has lived here since he was a child, at this moment, for some reason, he felt as if he was in another world.
Seeing this, the black-armoured guard next to him hurriedly asked, “Your Highness, can you go back to the mansion to clean up and settle down?”
“No need.” He came back this time just to visit the seriously ill Xiao Ming, so naturally he didn’t want to waste any more time.
“Go straight to the palace.”
The black-armoured guards hurriedly led the way.
Now that more than two years have passed, no matter what happens in court, there does not seem to be much change in the capital city.
It seems that Xiao Ming did as he said and did not bring harm to the people.
Before, Ye Shuo often wandered the streets of Shangjing, and since he was extremely handsome, many people had a deep impression of him. When they noticed the direction he was going, they couldn’t help but be stunned.
The Emperor actually summoned Prince Rui back…
Arriving at the gate of the imperial city, Ye Shuo took the initiative to dismount from his horse, ignoring the black-armoured guards who were hesitant to speak.
Walking straight towards Chengming Palace, halfway there, Ye Shuo suddenly heard crying sounds coming from a corridor not far away. Such things happened from time to time in the palace. Ye Shuo did not take it seriously at first, but when he turned around, he saw a corner of a Taoist robe.
I guess this is one of the Taoists Xiao Ming invited to the palace.
Ye Shuo stopped and looked at the palace servant who was kneeling on the ground beside him: “Stand up and answer, what happened?”
When His Royal Highness Prince Rui was in the palace, he was always very kind to the palace maids. The maid in front of him got excited and told the whole story.
It turned out that the Taoist named Zhang Fu had taken a fancy to a maidservant who was close to a concubine in the palace, but how could the maidservant fancy him? As a result, Zhang Fu failed to marry her, so he became resentful and made things difficult for her. This was the nth time, and the maidservant was tortured beyond words.
Ye Shuo was stunned when he heard this. After he realised what was happening, he couldn’t help but frown: “Is there no one in charge of this palace?”
The palace maid shook her head and said, “Zhang Fu is the Taoist priest that His Majesty relies on the most. Who dares to make things difficult for him…”
When Ye Shuo heard this, he held his breath.
It hasn’t been long since then, and the entire imperial city is already in such a mess. If his father knew about this, he would probably jump out of the imperial mausoleum.
Ye Shuo pursed his lips and walked towards the Taoist.
Looking at the beautiful maid in front of him, Zhang Fu couldn’t help but have a hint of pride in his eyes. This bitch looked down on him because she thought he was ugly, and now she is kneeling down to beg?
Just when Zhang Fu was about to do something, he was hit by a huge force and he lost control and flew backwards.
“Who dares to attack me?”
Ye Shuo’s kick was extremely powerful. Zhang Fu lay on the ground for a long time before he could barely raise his head.
Then, he saw a very handsome but unfamiliar young man. The young man looked down at him as if he was looking at a dead person.
Zhang Fu was born ugly, and therefore suffered a lot of ridicule and mockery. He hated it most when others were prettier than himself, and much prettier, so he couldn’t help but have the urge to destroy them.
“Who are you? Do you know my identity?” Zhang Fu asked coldly, suppressing the jealousy in his heart.
Seeing this, the black-armoured guards at the side shouted even louder than him: “How dare you! You don’t kneel down before seeing His Royal Highness Prince Rui!”
It turned out to be another prince.
Because Ye Shuo was no longer in the capital when Emperor Taicheng was searching for immortals, Zhang Fu had never seen Ye Shuo’s true appearance. He only heard rumours that he was the most beloved son of the late emperor.
It is known that Emperor Taicheng came from a poor family. Zhang Fu judged others by himself and believed that Emperor Taicheng must be very jealous of his younger brother who had been so brilliant since childhood. In addition, the examples of the fifth king, the seventh king and the eighth king were there, so the current Emperor Taicheng was not a person who was close to his brothers.
Even if he was a descendant of the emperor, what could he do? He provided the best prescription in the world for His Majesty, and even the emperor had to rely on him, so Zhang Fu did not take the King of Rui in front of him seriously.
But Zhang Fu was not that stupid, but he still pretended to be stupid.
Holding back the pain, he bowed reluctantly to the young man. Upon learning that he was here to visit Emperor Taicheng in Chengming Palace, Zhang Fu managed a smile with great difficulty and said, “It’s Prince Rui. I’m really blind. Please forgive me, Your Highness. It just so happens that I have just refined a new pill today. Why don’t I go with Your Highness?”
The man in front of me is a complete villain. Although he hates me very much in his heart, he still looks servile and fawning on the surface.
If Ye Shuo had not caught the hatred in his eyes just now, he might have been deceived by him.
Ye Shuo looked at him coldly, as if he didn’t notice anything, and walked with him to the front of Chengming Hall. When the door curtain was lifted, Ye Shuo had a lot to say, but when he saw Xiao Ming, he suddenly couldn’t say it.
Perhaps it’s not that he doesn’t want to take care of the chaos in the palace, but he is just powerless.
Although Xiao Ming was thin in the past, he had not reached this point. Now he is emaciated, with sunken eye sockets, and no longer has the complacency and ambition he had when he first ascended the throne.
Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly felt a pang.
Noticing the movement not far away and hearing the familiar voice, Emperor Taicheng reluctantly opened his eyes. His lips moved, and finally he just said: “You are here.”
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, then nodded: “Yeah.”
Then, the entire hall fell into an eerie silence.
Zhang Fu, who was standing by, was suddenly delighted when he saw this, thinking that this was a good opportunity, so he quickly took advantage of the time to offer the elixir and narrated what had just happened, adding some exaggerations.
“Your Majesty, you don’t know that His Royal Highness Prince Rui almost broke the medicine box in my arms with his kick. If I hadn’t tried my best to save it, Your Majesty would not have been able to use the medicine today.”
Now the elixir is the life of Emperor Taicheng, and no one else can touch it. Even the little prince, who accidentally touched the medicine box before, made Emperor Taicheng furious and scolded him, not to mention Prince Rui in front of him.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo had no desire to defend himself. If Xiao Ming believed such words, their brotherhood would be over. Ye Shuo promised to turn around and leave without saying a word.
After hearing this, Emperor Taicheng frowned, and Zhang Fu couldn’t help but become even more delighted.
However, just when Zhang Fu was about to lose control of his pride, he heard the emperor on the bed slowly speak, and his voice became extremely cold.
“What are you still standing there for? Someone, drag him away and sentence him to death.”
When these words were spoken, even Zhang Fu was shocked. Even Zhang Fu felt that it was too unbelievable that the emperor would sentence his own brother to death.
It was not until Zhang Fu noticed that Emperor Taicheng’s eyes were on him.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Let Him Go
chapters.content:
“Your Majesty, please spare my life, Your Majesty, please spare my life!”
Zhang Fu never imagined that Emperor Taicheng would kill him because of this incident.
Wasn’t Emperor Taicheng always polite and obedient to me before?
However, Emperor Taicheng now didn’t even look at him, as if he was just an object that could be discarded at will.
When Zhang Fu was useful, Emperor Taicheng would naturally turn a blind eye to him. But now that he is useless, how could a mere Zhang Fu get so much face?
Even from a long distance away, one could still hear Zhang Fu’s pleas for mercy and screams.
Zhang Fu had been accustomed to bullying others in the palace by relying on the favour of Emperor Taicheng, and had long been hated by others. Now that he finally got the chance, naturally no one would let him off easily.
Zhang Fu finally understood the truth that he should not offend anyone in the palace. There was a reason why the palace people were polite to each other. But by the time he realised it, it was too late…
When Zhang Fu was in power, even the eunuchs around Emperor Taicheng had to show him courtesy. Now, when Prince Rui came back, the Taoist got his retribution, which was really gratifying.
At the same time, the chief eunuch became more respectful to Prince Rui.However, what Ye Shuo thought in his heart was, it’s not bad, at least he wasn’t completely confused by those pills.
Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help coughing, looking extremely helpless: “So, you should be satisfied, right?”
Ye Shuo pulled the corner of his mouth and said in a gloomy tone: “That’s nothing, you are just a demon. If the emperor knew that you had messed up the palace like this, he would be very angry with you.”
Emperor Taicheng’s expression suddenly froze.
Emperor Taicheng’s first reaction was to get angry. After all, no one had dared to talk to him like that for a long time. Also, ever since Emperor Taicheng took the medicine, his temper had gradually become more irritable and he was not as calm as before.
But on second thought, the only one who is willing and dares to talk to me like this is Xiaojiu.
Since he was willing to mention his father, I knew that he still considered me a brother.
Although Xiaojiu was far away in the martial arts world, Emperor Taicheng didn’t believe that he had never heard of the affairs of the Five Kings, Seven Kings, and Eighth Kings. But he was still willing to come back. What could it be for?
At this moment, what else can he gain?
Thinking of this, Emperor Taicheng controlled himself and suppressed the evil fire in his heart.
Seeing this scene, the eunuch next to him had his eyelids twitching. You know, there are not many people in the whole Zhou Dynasty who can make the emperor restrain his temper. ṘÀ𝐍ǑBΕs
Seeing Xiao Ming like this, Ye Shuo really couldn’t get angry. After a while, he sighed deeply, sat down, and asked, “Tell me, why do you want me to come back at this time? Is there something you want me to do?”
Although Xiao Ming was weak, he was still in good spirits. It was far from the time to call him back for mourning, so Ye Shuo guessed that he must have other things to do.
“For my brother’s sake, what do you want me to do?”
At this point, Ye Shuo was too lazy to play along with him anymore. He wanted to finish his work quickly and then go back to hug his wife.
Xiao Ming went to so much trouble, he probably didn’t want to recall him to Beijing and kill him.
Xiaojiu has always been so straightforward, so it is always very easy to talk to him, without having to guess and waste time.
Although Emperor Taicheng was not quite used to this method, he managed to keep up with his pace.
Emperor Taicheng thought for a moment and said, “Nothing else, I just want you to take good care of Jin’er and raise him to adulthood after I leave.”
Knowing that there is no reason to let people work for nothing without giving them benefits, Emperor Taicheng hesitated for a moment and added: “I… want to appoint you as regent.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
The moment he heard this, Ye Shuo just wanted to turn around and leave.
——Run, run as fast as you can!
Is it because he is not so carefree outside, or his wife is not pretty enough, or his unborn daughter is not cute enough? Why does he have to give up his good life outside and come to worry about all these things for him?
The three words “regent” sound glorious, but it is not much better than being an emperor. He has to worry about everything that the emperor has to worry about, and he also has to worry about things that the emperor cannot worry about. The most important thing is that it is difficult for him to have a good ending.
Although Jin’er is cute now, Ye Shuo cannot guarantee what he will be like when he grows up.
Once one sits on the throne of emperor, he will gradually turn into a monster, from being naive to being indifferent, and finally into something completely different.
Even Ye Shuo could not guarantee that he could break the curse.
Besides, how old is little Ye Jin now? He is only ten years old. When he turns eighteen and takes power, it means that I have to stay in Shangjing City for a full eight years, and I can’t leave for a moment during this period. Is this still a life for a human being? ? ?
In a flash, Ye Shuo was ready to run away.
But his face showed a different expression.
Seeing that Ye Shuo was a little resistant at first and kept saying “this is not good”, Emperor Taicheng then promised him many benefits. He seemed to be moved, and a look of intense hesitation flashed in his eyes. Finally, he nodded reluctantly.
“Well… okay then.”
Upon hearing this, Emperor Taicheng breathed a sigh of relief.
After Ye Shuo left and Emperor Taicheng calmed down a little, he began to think that something was wrong.
It seemed like it was going too smoothly. Although Xiaojiu was a little reluctant, he finally agreed.
So Emperor Taicheng said it out loud. The eunuch next to him couldn’t help but whisper, “After all, he is the regent.” He is much more powerful than the prince.
However, the eunuch’s words reminded Emperor Taicheng that if Xiaojiu really cared about these things, would he have waited until today?
The matter was of great importance, and Emperor Taicheng felt uneasy, so he summoned the secret guards around him.
However, there was nothing unusual about Ye Shuo’s behaviour. According to the secret guards, after he went out, he hesitated for a while, but finally showed a hint of joy, which was completely consistent with the eunuch’s guess just now. Deep down in his heart, who doesn’t like power?
What’s more, when he met the eldest prince outside the palace, he even greeted him in a good mood, which confused the eldest prince. He stood stupidly on the street for a while before he barely reacted.
“Why did you come back suddenly? Was it the person who called you back? Did he have something to tell you?”
“Well, don’t worry about it. It’s a good thing after all. You’ll know when the time comes.”
Ye Shuo walked out of the imperial city with a little joy, met the eldest prince with a little joy, and talked to the eldest prince with a little pride. So far, everything was very normal.
After listening to the secret guard’s description, Emperor Taicheng was silent at first, and then he spoke decisively: “Keep a close eye on him, especially at night.”
Ye Shuo was completely unaware. He took a bath quietly, then had a quiet dinner, and as soon as it got dark, he went to sleep quietly.
Around three o’clock in the morning, Ye Shuo suddenly opened his eyes.
If we don’t leave now, when will we leave?
Ye Shuo mounted his horse and rushed towards the city gate as if he was risking his life.
Then, he was arrested.
In the middle of the night, Emperor Taicheng was awakened. Seeing the circle of secret guards around him, what else did Emperor Taicheng not understand?
However, before he could open his mouth, the young man in front of him knelt down with a plop.
“Sixth brother! Please, let me go!”
In the past, even when my father beat him with a rattan stick, he had never screamed as miserably as he did this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Attacking the Heart
chapters.content:
His behaviour seemed as if what he wanted was not to promote him but to take his life.
“Why are you crying? I don’t want to kill you.” The fifth king, the seventh king, and the eighth king have never done this.
Ye Shuo had a sad face: “What’s the difference between this and asking for my life?”
Emperor Taicheng quickly calmed down and said, “This is a good thing.”
Good fortune, huh? Who are you trying to fool? He had seen this trick in his previous life.
With tears in his eyes, Ye Shuo looked at his good brother with accusatory eyes.
Emperor Taicheng subconsciously looked away.
“As the regent, you will be second only to one man and above everyone else.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
“…Such a good thing, you should leave it to others, such as…big brother?” The eldest prince has lost a leg now, and he can’t take that position anyway, so it’s okay to let him take it!Upon hearing this, Emperor Taicheng said: “The eldest prince has his own son.” Having a son of his own will make one selfish.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but curl his lips: “I also have my own child, my wife just got pregnant, and she will give birth in six months.”
Emperor Taicheng did not expect that Princess Rui was pregnant, especially at such a critical juncture.
But it does make sense when you think about it. The two have been married for more than four years, almost five years. Logically, they should have had their own children a long time ago. It is already very late to have their first child now.
Emperor Taicheng instinctively wanted to ask if it was a boy or a girl. If it was a princess, it would be fine, but if it was a prince…
But he still held back.
Even if he is the prince, what can he do? Without this one, there are still the second, third, and fourth… Xiaojiu is still young, and he will have other children sooner or later, unless he can no longer have children.
Such a thought flashed through Emperor Taicheng’s mind quickly, but he dismissed it immediately.
Although Xiaojiu doesn’t like power struggles, he is not stupid. If he does anything about it and he is found out, he will make a big fuss and end up making things worse.
At the beginning, he even dared to retaliate against the eldest prince, and killed the Beiting envoy in the posthouse with a knife, proving that he was not a coward. With his temper, he might even poke a hole in the sky.
Therefore, Emperor Taicheng paused and said sincerely: “Congratulations.”
Ye Shuo never expected that he would react like this. His expression froze slightly, and he suddenly felt as suffocated as if he had punched cotton.
At first, the former prince treated Xiaojiu in a similar way, and there was no record of the late prince doing anything specific for him. But despite this, after the late prince’s death, he still diligently took the late prince’s son to his house and raised him. R𝘢ŊŎᛒĘs
And when his father was seriously ill, he disregarded all consequences and risked being criticised by the whole world for letting Princess Rui use the medicine, which allowed his father to live that much longer.
If he was not sincere, and had even a little bit of selfishness, he would not be able to do these things. If even he could not be trusted, then there would be no one in the entire royal family that Emperor Taicheng could trust.
Emperor Taicheng probably knew how to deal with him.
After thinking for a while, Emperor Taicheng said, “It’s a pity that I’m afraid I won’t be able to make it to that day. I originally wanted to hug your child after he was born.”
Seeing that Xiaojiu’s expression was indeed beginning to fail to hold, Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
As the saying goes, attacking the city is inferior, attacking the heart is superior, it is so.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but grit his teeth. He was talking, but why did he stir up emotions? Xiao Ming was indeed insidious.
This is what Ye Shuo can’t stand the most.
But at the same time, Ye Shuo was not so easy to compromise: “If big brother can’t do it, then He Xiang, He Xiang should be fine, right? Jin’er is his great-grandson!”
However, Emperor Taicheng shook his head upon hearing this: “It is precisely because of Prime Minister He that I want you to take the position of regent.”
He Xiang has been in the court for many years, and his power has long been deeply rooted. Emperor Taicheng relied on him before he ascended the throne, so he naturally hoped that He Xiang’s power would be as large as possible. Now that he has become the emperor, he has to be on guard against it.
In order to avoid the chaos caused by external relatives in politics, the little prince became a puppet of the Queen and the He family. Emperor Taicheng needed a member of the Ye royal family to check and balance him.
“This matter concerns the Ye family and is not my business alone. As a prince, you must also shoulder your own responsibilities.”
That’s why Ye Shuo recommended the eldest prince. The eldest prince must be very happy about it.
But the eldest prince was happy, but Emperor Taicheng was not.
“I don’t trust them. The only one I can trust is you.”
It’s like this again, and it’s like this again!
Ye Shuo almost vomited blood, because he thought he could be trusted, so he was thinking of him for all the work, right!
The crown prince was like this, the eldest prince was like this, and now Xiao Ming has become like this too.
What kind of people are they!
Ye Shuo couldn’t hold it in any longer, and wanted to pound the ground on the spot: “I beg you, brother, can you please let me go!” He only wanted to be a prince in peace and live his life happily, why couldn’t he do that?
The more he thought about it, the more wronged he felt, and Ye Shuo almost cried.
If he had a choice, Emperor Taicheng would not want this.
Emperor Taicheng sighed, but his tone was particularly firm: “No.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
For God’s sake, kill him, kill him now!
Ye Shuo tried to make a final struggle: “But I’m definitely not made of this material!”
However, Emperor Taicheng himself did not have high expectations for him. If they were too high, Emperor Taicheng would not dare to ask for them: “I don’t need you to do anything, you just need to occupy that position.”
At first, Emperor Taicheng promoted people from the Zhen Mansion only for Xiaojiu’s sake. Now, thinking about it, it was fortunate that the eldest and eighteenth sons of the Zhen Mansion were promoted at that time.
A lean camel is bigger than a horse. With the support of the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, even if Prime Minister He has rebellious intentions, he will not be able to accomplish anything big.
And what Xiao Jiu said, isn’t this quirky, playful personality just right?
Ye Shuo understood it immediately. He never thought that the image of a dandy boy that he had established would end up hurting himself.
It is true that man proposes, God disposes.
Oh my god, are you kidding me? Ye Shuo couldn’t help it and sat down on the ground.
Seeing him so distraught, Emperor Taicheng’s eyes flashed with a hint of pity, but in the end, he still did not give in.
“There is no rush for this matter. You can stay in the palace for a while and just keep me company.”
It was already against the rules for an adult prince to stay overnight in the palace, and it was even more unprecedented for a new emperor to ask his own brothers to stay overnight after ascending the throne. His Royal Highness Prince Rui was indeed different from others.
Also, I have never seen a regent being kicked around like a ball, so the eunuch has learned a lot this time.
Having said that, Ye Shuo lay on his own bed in Qiu Wu palace, feeling that things were definitely not that simple, and Xiao Ming must have another trick up his sleeve waiting for him.
Sure enough, the little prince was seen early the next morning.
Almost three years had passed, and Ye Jin had grown a little taller, but his pale face was exactly the same as Xiao Ming’s, which really made Ye Shuo’s eyes hurt.
Maybe it was because he heard about what happened last night, but Ye Jin knew in his heart that this was all caused by him. He also knew that the Ninth Prince was in a bad mood, so naturally he didn’t dare to bother him like usual.
But he dared not disobey his father’s words.
So Ye Jin found a corner where Ye Shuo wouldn’t see him and quietly picked up the book to read.
The dignified prince is now huddled aside like a poor little thing, not daring to make a sound. Ye Shuo has reason to suspect that he did it on purpose.
“Did your father tell you to do this?”
The young man spoke out of the blue, which scared Ye Jin so much that he almost dropped the book in his hand.
Ye Jin was a little confused about what he meant by his flustered movements: “What?”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and asked, “What did your father ask you to do?”
After Ye Jin realised what was happening, he answered honestly, “My father didn’t tell me anything else. He just told me to do what I usually do after I come to your place.”
It is enough to perform normally, why do anything extra.
This Xiao Ming!
Ye Shuo guessed Xiao Ming’s thoughts. At first, he didn’t want him to get his wish and didn’t intend to care about it. But then Ye Jin came here for several days in a row and studied until dark. Ye Shuo really couldn’t pretend not to see it.
It was another evening, and Ye Jin couldn’t hold it in any longer, so he said, “Uncle Jiu, I need to go to the bathroom.”
Having said that, Ye Jin ran away.
After leaving the gate of Qiuwu Palace, Ye Jin could no longer hold it in and started coughing violently.
“Cough, cough, cough, cough…”
Ye Jin had been in poor health since childhood, and as he grew older, his condition not only did not improve, but became worse. However, he did not want to worry Emperor Taicheng and the Queen, so he kept it a secret out of habit.
However, this time, after Ye Jin finished coughing, he looked up and found that the Ninth Prince was standing not far away, just looking at him quietly.
Ye Jin’s expression suddenly became stiff.
“Ninth, Ninth Uncle…”
He just noticed that the child’s face looked a little strange, so he wanted to come out to check it out, but he didn’t expect to see this scene.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but take a deep breath, “How long have you been like this?”
Ye Jin stumbled more and more: “It’s been more than a year…”
“It’s been more than a year?” Ye Shuo’s voice rose, “How dare you learn like this?”
Even an adult can’t stand reading from dawn till dusk.
Ye Jin was entangled for a long time, and really didn’t dare to hide it: “I just want to be able to share the burden for my father as soon as possible…”
…Fuck! How did Xiao Ming raise a child?!
Ye Shuo’s expression became uncontrollably ferocious.
Ye Jin was immediately startled and hurriedly grabbed his clothes: “Ninth Uncle, don’t be angry.”
Ye Jin had already felt very uncomfortable because of the Regent incident before, and now seeing him like this, Ye Jin was almost upset to death.
He didn’t want to cause trouble to others, but unfortunately, he seemed to be a ‘trouble’ himself.
“It has nothing to do with you.” Ye Shuo also knew that his performance had scared him, and he forced a smile.
No matter what, Ye Shuo would not involve innocent children.
After finally calming the little prince down, Ye Shuo turned around and went to look for Xiao Ming. He felt that it seemed necessary for him to have a chat with his good brother.
However, what Ye Shuo never expected was that when he arrived at Chengming Hall, he actually ran into Xiao Ming applying medicine.
His legs were a bloody mess. When the imperial physician was using a knife to cut away the rotten flesh on his legs, large beads of sweat could be seen rolling down his head.
The veins on Emperor Taicheng’s forehead were all exposed, and his hands, which were grabbing the quilt, were turning white.
About an incense stick later, Emperor Taicheng finally pulled himself together and looked at his brother who suddenly broke in.
“Why are you here at this time?”
Ye Shuo opened his mouth: “Your legs…”
Emperor Taicheng asked someone to wipe the sweat off his face and casually said, as if he was talking about the weather, “Well, it should be erysipelas, and it’s rotten.”
Only then did he remember that he had never seen Xiao Ming get out of bed since he came back.
In an instant, Ye Shuo’s heart trembled violently.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Death
chapters.content:
“What’s that expression on your face?” Why does it seem like he was the one who was hurt?
Emperor Taicheng pulled the corners of his mouth, as if he wanted to laugh, but he tried several times and failed.
Seeing this scene, Ye Shuo’s heart sank.
“By the way, you are looking for me at this time, is there something?”
It existed before, but it’s gone now.
Xiao Ming can’t take care of himself anymore, and there are some things he can’t take care of even if he wants to.
“No, it’s okay…”
Ye Shuo couldn’t tell what he felt in his heart. It was as if it was filled with lead and was heavy.
Looking at his brother’s departing back, Emperor Taicheng, who was lying there, couldn’t help but close his eyes.
He was so angry that he had no place to vent it. He took a deep breath and turned around to look for Concubine Xu Gui and Concubine Li Gui.His mother and Yao Zhi were not around, so the only people in the palace who could comfort him were the two imperial concubines.
When Ye Shuo came out of the palace of the two imperial concubines, his emotions had barely stabilised. However, when he saw a group of Taoists in Taoist robes, he quickly became restless again.
But this is nothing, those Taoists are what are afraid of.
Among them, Zhang Fu, who had presented prescriptions to the emperor several times, was sentenced to death by King Rui. It is said that his death was particularly miserable. How dare this group of Taoists provoke him?
Seeing His Royal Highness Prince Rui looking at them, several Taoists trembled in fear, fell to their knees in fear, and kowtowed continuously.
“Your Highness, please spare my life! Your Highness, please spare my life!”
However, Ye Shuo remained unmoved. Anyone who has harmed others will not be able to escape.
There are seven Taoists in total, and except Zhang Fu there are only six left. They all use unorthodox methods, and even truly skilled people would not do such things, so once they gain power, it is easy for them to become arrogant.
Those who abuse their power and take human lives lightly should be punished!
After Ye Shuo had found out the truth, he dragged four of them away on the spot, leaving only two. They had the will but not the courage to steal, and this saved their lives instead.
Ye Shuo had to remind them: “If I let you out of the palace one day, you are not allowed to leak those recipes unless you are curing illnesses and saving lives. Do you hear me?!” 𝔯α𝐍Ŏ𝐁Êś
The remaining two Taoists had already been frightened out of their wits, and now seeing that there was hope for survival, they naturally agreed one after another.
After taking a steady look at the two of them, Ye Shuo flicked his sleeves and left.
The two Taoists who stayed there were almost exhausted. After looking at each other, they saw relief in each other’s eyes.
In the past, they laughed at me. Fortunately, I didn’t do evil with them…
Emperor Taicheng received the news quickly.
Xiaojiu is good in every way except that he is a little soft-hearted. Emperor Taicheng had not intended to keep them, but now that Xiaojiu is like this, forget it.
They are just a bunch of small characters, not worth bothering about.
As for the Fifth king, Seventh King, and Eighth King, although they had been beaten back and forth by me and now had no strength to resist, and their power had been mostly wiped out, they would still be a hidden danger if they were kept.
The conflict between the two sides was already irreconcilable, and Emperor Taicheng was afraid that letting the tiger go back to the mountains would lead to endless troubles.
If Emperor Taicheng still had some brotherly feelings towards Ye Shuo, then he had no good feelings at all towards the Fifth, Seventh and Eighth Kings.
So the best way is to take them away before leaving.
Emperor Taicheng was not afraid of being branded as a man who killed his brothers, but he was afraid that the country would be unstable after the young prince ascended the throne.
However, what Emperor Taicheng did not expect was that as soon as this thought arose in his mind, not long after, Prince Su and Prince Jin came together, and brought with them an imperial edict.
So this is what my father meant when he said, “I’ll have to trouble you with the rest of the things.”
At that time, I thought that my father first called the two uncles in to arrange his affairs after his death. Now I know that it is actually the case.
Although Emperor Jingwen did not care much about his sons, the fifth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince, they were his blood after all. Before his death, Emperor Jingwen still made arrangements for each of them.
The brothers had already quarrelled so fiercely when he was alive, and it was even more imaginable after his death. No matter what, he had to keep them alive.
After seeing the edict and confirming that it was written by his father himself, Emperor Taicheng’s expression suddenly became uncertain.
Prince Su and Prince Jin are both sixty years old now, and they still have to worry about the affairs of the whole family of their brother’s lineage. It’s really, alas…
The two looked at each other and sighed in their hearts.
The two had thought countless times about what the scene would be like when they took out this will, but they had never imagined it would be like this.
Even though my brother had made all kinds of calculations, he still hadn’t expected this day to come.
If my brother is still alive in heaven, I wonder if he would regret seeing that the Sixth Prince, whom he had carefully selected, has reached such a state after only being in power for a little over two years.
The Sixth Prince is indeed smart, but too smart. Too much wisdom can lead to harm, just as water overflows when it is full and the moon wanes when it is full. Being too extreme is sometimes not a good thing.
Prince Su and Prince Jin are not only the emperor’s brothers, they also represent the royal family. If they disobey the emperor’s last will, the royal family will probably not agree, and Jin’er’s throne will become even more unstable.
Father, oh father, since you have handed over the country to me, why did you leave such a will?
Emperor Taicheng struggled for a long time, weighed it for a long time, and finally compromised.
“This is the order of my father. I will obey the order.”
Prince Su and Prince Jin had achieved their goal and left soon.
Emperor Taicheng looked at the bed curtains above his head and his hands tightened unconsciously.
As long as the fifth, seventh and eighth kings are alive, the position of regent Xiaojiu will become more and more important.
However, the more this happened, the less Emperor Taicheng could force him.
Ye Shuo thought that Xiao Ming would be extremely anxious once the will came out. He had it all planned out that if Xiao Ming dared to show any sign of force, he would immediately seize the opportunity and turn around and leave.
Ye Shuo admitted that he really couldn’t get over the hurdle in his heart, but if it was Xiao Ming’s problem, then he couldn’t be blamed, right?
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t expect was that Xiao Ming’s method was even more advanced than he imagined. He refused to reveal any flaws and kept attacking his weaknesses.
