Ye Shuo accidentally saw the string of wind chimes hanging at the entrance of the Qinzheng Hall. He asked the palace servant next to him and found out that the wind chimes had been hanging there since the day they were received.
All the ministers knew about this matter, even Concubine Xu Gui and Concubine Li Gui had heard of it.
Not only that, he kept everything Ye Shuo sent back and didn’t throw away any of them. Some of them were so simple that even Ye Shuo himself felt embarrassed when he looked back at them.
Seeing that his brother looked a little strange, Emperor Taicheng did not say anything, but just said: “I heard that you learned magic tricks outside? I have never seen what it looks like. Can you show it to me?”
Ye Shuo would naturally not fail to fulfil his small wish.
The playing cards flew up and down in Ye Shuo’s hands. Emperor Taicheng initially thought it was just an ordinary trick, but he didn’t expect that he could play it so well.
Or maybe, Xiaojiu can live well no matter where he is.
Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but praise: “It’s great…”
Ever since the imperial physician diagnosed his illness, Emperor Taicheng took pills just like eating. The poison from the pills had already penetrated deep into his bone marrow. Although he was still holding on, his body was getting weaker day by day.
Especially in the last few days, Emperor Taicheng’s body was ulcerated and his mind was a little unclear.
It was obvious that the person was about to die. The queen was beside him with red and swollen eyes. The little prince was kneeling in front of his bed, holding back tears, looking anxious.
The dying Emperor Taicheng, the tearful empress, and the young prince. This scene would be unbearable for anyone who saw it.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but start cursing in his heart.
Ye Shuo thought, this time Xiao Ming should finally speak up, right?
Who would have thought that until this time, Emperor Taicheng still had not forgotten his original intention and vowed to trap his younger brother.
Ye Shuo wanted to see what tricks he could play, but Emperor Taicheng first summoned Ye Shuo to his side and then handed him a gift list.
“This is… Dingning’s dowry…”
“I’m afraid… I can’t wait to see her born…”
Ye Shuo: “…”
“…Fuck, that’s awesome!” Ye Shuo was convinced.
“I give in. I give in, okay?”
Although I know this person did it on purpose, I still can’t help it…
Even at this time, Emperor Taicheng was about to die, but he was still scheming and scheming.
He had been exploited all his life, so he suffered retribution. Apart from Xiaojiu, there was no one he could really trust. There were gains and losses, and Emperor Taicheng accepted it.
It’s not that he knew that Xiaojiu was right, but he couldn’t stop. He always thought to himself to wait a little longer, and as a result, he kept putting it off until today.
Emperor Taicheng thought that as long as he worked hard enough, he would succeed. But now he realised that diligence and hard work are such useless things…
If something does not belong to you, even if you get it, you will lose it soon.
I worked hard for half my life, but in the end it was all in vain.
Even if you have tried your best and sacrificed everything that can be sacrificed, the final result is still unsatisfactory.
Emperor Taicheng never regretted his choice in his life, nor did he regret anything he had done, except for Xiaojiu…
Thinking of his smooth movements when playing poker, Emperor Taicheng finally opened his mouth at the last moment: “I’m… I’m sorry…”
I’m sorry to have to trap him in this palace.
Noticing the apology in his eyes, Ye Shuo suddenly understood what he meant.
It has come to this, Ye Shuo doesn’t mind letting him leave with peace of mind.
After thinking for a moment, he said in a voice that only the two of them could hear: “Actually, I know about the incident at the rockery more than 20 years ago.”
More than 20 years ago, Emperor Taicheng scratched his forehead with a stone and moved into Qiuwu Palace, which led to everything he has today.
Everything started from that day.
Emperor Taicheng’s eyes suddenly widened.
He said he knew, didn’t it prove that he knew from the beginning to the end that he was a man who would do anything to achieve his goal?
At the last moment, Emperor Taicheng shed tears for the first time in his life.
“Thank you…”
Thank you for letting me know that there is still someone in this world who is willing to love me after knowing my true self.
After the skinny Xiao Ming closed his eyes completely, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but take a few steps back.
Then, the whole hall was filled with the sound of crying at the top of one’s lungs.
In September of the second year of Taicheng, Emperor Taicheng died.

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Tolerance
chapters.content:
Emperor Taicheng started his life from humble beginnings when he was young, and has made it to where he is today step by step.
He is not a good person, but he is not a purely evil person either. He is the most diligent and hardworking, but his ending is also the most tragic.
At least the bodies of the others were intact, but Emperor Taicheng ended up festering all over his body and had to endure tremendous pain every day.
Maybe God is not so fair after all.
In addition to the edict appointing Ye Shuo as regent, Emperor Taicheng also left another edict, appointing his only daughter Shuqin as Princess Zhaocheng and forbidding any marriage to another princess.
Emperor Taicheng was rational all his life, but in the end he became as willful as Emperor Jingwen.
Before he left, he might have been extremely worried about his two children, or perhaps there were other people besides his children, but he never said a word, so others had no way of knowing.
Perhaps even Emperor Taicheng himself didn’t know whether he had ever truly loved anyone in his life.
Love is an extremely luxurious thing. He had already staked everything he had when he embarked on this path.
When Empress He looked at her husband’s face, her youthful memories came to her mind. At that time, one was sixteen and the other was nineteen. Empress He thought that she only had a respectful relationship with him as a couple, but when that day really came, Empress He was still out of control and was overwhelmed with grief.But now is not the time to cry.
The death of Emperor Taicheng shocked the whole government and the country. Many people could not help but wonder: Can such a young prince stand firm and control such a big country?
Regardless of what happened to Ye Shuo, He Xiang would make his own assessment. He immediately went to find the Fifth King, the Seventh King, and the Eighth King.
After nearly three years of continuous suppression, the former fifth prince, seventh prince, and eighth prince are now living like ghosts, and it seems that they are about to have mental problems.
How should I put it? The three wanted to resist but couldn’t. They felt that they would be killed by Lao Liu at any time. Under such circumstances, the three of them lived for nearly three years. Who wouldn’t be crazy?
Facts proved that their thoughts were not random guesses. Lao Liu really wanted to kill them before he died.
If the emperor had not left a special will, they might have been killed by the sixth elder with a cup of poisoned wine. How could they still sit here and talk?
“I’ll tell you, I’ll tell you, he is a cruel and vicious person. I don’t know how much he hates us in his heart. It would be strange if he let us go!” At this moment, the Fifth Prince really wanted to say, “It’s a good death, a wonderful death.” He finally died, and he starved himself to death. It’s really laughable.
The Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince also breathed a sigh of relief. The huge mountain pressing down on them was gone, and they could finally take a deep breath.
But in fact, this matter itself is a vicious circle. The fifth prince, the seventh prince and the eighth prince felt that Emperor Taicheng would not let them go, so they tried their best to make trouble during Emperor Taicheng’s reign and tried to bring him down. As for Emperor Taicheng, the more they did this, the more severely Emperor Taicheng would punish them. Unless one of them stops first, there is no solution to this problem.
But… with their temperament, who would stop on their own initiative?
Once they stop, they will die.
“Forget it, let’s not talk about this. What is the matter that Xiaojiu wants us to come here for today?”
The relationship between the brothers is not always good or bad. It is often good today and bad tomorrow, or bad today and good tomorrow. Even though there was a great hatred between the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince, the Seventh Prince chose to make sure that the Fifth Prince would never get what he wanted rather than take his life, not to mention their petty quarrels with Ye Shuo. ŔＡɴỒʙЕṣ
The Seventh Prince shook his head. As for the Eighth Prince, he did not speak because he still had some grudge against his younger brother due to the eldest prince’s incident.
Just when the three were puzzled, they saw Ye Shuo rushing in from outside. He was probably in a hurry, and even moved with the wind. As he walked, he said, “Brother, I’m late. I hope you brothers don’t mind.”
“Now that my brother has just passed away, it is not appropriate to drink alcohol during the period of national mourning, so I did not bring any alcoholic beverages, but only some vegetarian food. I hope that my fifth, seventh, and eighth brothers will not dislike it.”
He opened the curtain and walked in. Ye Shuo didn’t care about anything and just sat down.
The first reaction of the three people when they heard this was that something must have happened. Otherwise, under such circumstances, why would he have nothing to do and come to them for dinner?
The Fifth Prince was impatient to keep him in suspense, and before Ye Shuo could finish placing the dishes in his hand, he asked, “If you have something to say, then say it. If not, don’t waste time.”
Ye Shuo paused, and without any hesitation, he spoke directly: “If that’s the case, then I’ll tell you.”
There are some things that everyone knows in their hearts, so there is really no need to hide them, it’s pointless.
Ye Shuo said bluntly: “You also know that after the Sixth Brother passed away, only Jin’er was left. The child is pitiful. He lost his biological father at such a young age.”
“I don’t mean anything else. I just hope you brothers…don’t make things difficult for him.”
Ye Shuo made his demands clear on the spot.
It is always better to speak frankly than to make guesses based on one’s own thoughts.
However, when the Fifth Prince heard this, he could no longer bear it. With a “bang”, he slammed his hands heavily on the table and stood up in an instant: “You said so, so I let him go. Why?”
If they were really released, then what would the suffering they had endured in the past few years mean?
“Don’t tell me about the big bullying the small. It is only natural that the son should pay for the father’s debt!” The Fifth Prince could not bear it no matter what.
However, Ye Shuo sighed when he heard this. Although his words were gentle, they did not mean that he wanted to discuss things with them at all…
Ye Shuo just hopes that it will end here. It will save trouble for them and himself as well. It would be better to avoid trouble if possible.
But if they don’t want to, Ye Shuo has no choice.
“This… If the fifth brother insists on doing so, then don’t blame me for being rude.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but scratch his head.
The young man acted innocent, but what he said was not innocent at all.
The fifth prince’s eyes widened immediately: “What do you mean?”
Forgive the Fifth Prince, because Ye Shuo’s expression was too casual, for a moment the Fifth Prince couldn’t even tell whether he was uttering a harsh word.
The Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince also turned their heads and looked over.
Ye Shuo had to count on his fingers: “Look, although the emperor left you a will to save your lives, he also left me a will. He only said not to let my sixth brother kill you, but he didn’t say not to let me kill you. The will he left me said ‘except for the crime of treason, you can’t be killed’. I have specially asked the two uncles, and you guys… should not be guilty of such a crime.”
In other words, if Ye Shuo took action, killing him would be in vain.
Ye Shuo would at most be beaten, but now the people who could beat him are gone, so he doesn’t even have to be beaten.
“And what about you? You are now the princes. Although I am not talented, I still retain the title of prince. Although I am not as capable as my brothers, as far as I know, my brothers don’t have much left now, right? So no matter how you look at it, you definitely can’t beat me.”
“I wonder what you brothers think?” Ye Shuo glanced at a few people tentatively.
The fifth prince finally understood now.
“So you have to get involved, right?”
If Xiao Jiu hadn’t intervened, even if He Xiang was powerful, what would he have done? Could he still touch the prince of the Ye royal family?
The only ones who could threaten the royal family were the royal family.
They really didn’t take Xiao Jiu seriously in the past, but now it is different after all. Thinking of this, the Fifth Prince almost vomited blood: “What benefits did the Sixth Prince give you to make you support him so much? He is your brother, but we are not, right?”
Ye Shuo had no choice.
“Well, I’ve already promised, what can I do?”
“Anyway, my brother has made his words clear today. You must give me a definite answer today, otherwise no one can leave the table.”
This scoundrel and domineering character is indeed Xiaojiu’s style.
Compared to the Fifth Prince who was glaring with anger, the Seventh Prince was relieved that he could say it. The Eighth Prince, on the other hand, almost couldn’t keep up with the pace.
After a long silence, the Seventh Prince suddenly asked, “Are you really going to… kill us?”
“Under normal circumstances, that won’t happen.” Ye Shuo was honest.
“But you also know that sometimes it’s not a question of whether I want to or not.” Sometimes, it’s really a matter of circumstances. “If it really comes to that, I think… I will.”
These two light words, however, were like a heavy hammer, hitting the three people’s hearts hard.
The atmosphere suddenly became tense.
The Seventh Prince subconsciously picked up the teacup in front of him and took a sip. The slightly dry throat was slightly relieved.
He had to admit that Xiaojiu was right. From any point of view, they were no match for him now.
If it was him, then they really had no better solution.
The Seventh Prince gradually calmed down.
“It’s okay for me to back down, but can you guarantee that the little prince will not make things difficult for us again?”
The seventh prince also wanted a guarantee.
However, what he didn’t expect was that his brother shook his head again and uttered two words: “No.”
Prince 5, 7, 8: “…”
The fifth prince was angry: “If you can’t do that, what the hell are you talking about!”
“How would I know what the little prince is thinking? I can’t influence him. I can’t lie to you!”
“Even if I say he won’t, can you believe it?” Ye Shuo rolled his eyes.
What you said… does make sense.
The fifth prince opened his mouth, but he couldn’t refute it. After a long pause, he finally uttered, “You… continue.”
Ye Shuo spread his hands: “So actually the situation is now very clear. Either I take action now, or wait until eight years later, when the young prince takes power. Then he may take action. You can choose.”
One is certain and it will happen right away, the other is in the future and it is just possible. Even a fool knows how to choose.
The eighth prince was about to speak when he suddenly realised something.
Huh? Wait, something seems wrong.
“Why do you have to make us give in? Can’t you just give in?” No matter which option they choose, they seem to be the ones who give in, right?
The moment the words fell, Ye Shuo laughed immediately, but the words he said made the faces of the three people darken instantly.
“You guys must have given in, right? In all these years, when have you ever seen me give in to anyone?”
“Anyway, you’ve already given in for so many years, it doesn’t matter if you do it once or twice, just bear with it.”
Seeing Xiaojiu’s look that said, “You can take it or not, if you don’t want it, forget it,” the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince, and the Eighth Prince were so angry that their teeth were about to break.
Arrogant.
It’s really too arrogant!

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Ascending the throne
chapters.content:
Listen, is this human language?
Ordinary people at least have a cover-up, but he said it directly.
But the most amazing thing is that although they were angry, they didn’t really hate him that much.
He has been like this since he was young, so what can I do? He is not only like this to me, he is also like this to my father.
Since Xiaojiu has said that he will not give in, then he will definitely not give in.
After weighing the pros and cons for a long time, the seventh prince was the first to compromise.
“I… agree.”
The fifth prince and the eighth prince looked at him in disbelief.
The Seventh Prince could not help but rub his brows. To be honest, he was tired after so many years and wanted to take a break. However, since he had chosen to take action in the first place, there was really no way to stop. Now that Emperor Taicheng is gone, it would be a good thing if this matter could be brought to a complete end.
After struggling for so long, the Seventh Prince finally realised that he might not be cut out for it, so he might as well retreat.Ye Shuo was not afraid that they would lie to him. Firstly, these brothers always cared about their reputation. Secondly, if they really wanted to break the contract, he would not be able to stop them. It was better to be open and honest. After all, he was not in the wrong.
The Seventh Prince thought that he would pester him to sign or seal the agreement himself, but he didn’t.
Ye Shuo knew very well that some things should not be pushed too hard, otherwise it would be bad. After all, his brothers were legitimate princes.
A desperate dog will jump over the wall, let alone them.
The Seventh Prince was the first to leave. When he passed by Xiao Jiu, his lips moved. Ye Shuo heard him whisper, “I’m sorry…”
In the past, he was not targeting Xiaojiu, but the Sixth Prince. Xiaojiu was just a raft for them.
Ye Shuo did not deny it, and even replied: “It’s good that you know it.”
The Seventh Prince was silent for a moment, then burst into laughter.
The Seventh Prince left smoothly, but the remaining Fifth and Eighth Princes were dumbfounded. They had never expected that the Seventh Prince would betray them so quickly. What should they do? Ȑ𝔞ΝỘＢÈS
The Fifth Prince wanted to struggle, but he couldn’t.
“Alright, alright, I give in, alright?” The fifth prince said helplessly.
“But can we discuss this and cancel my three conditions?” Since there was no way to give their little prince a guarantee, could we change to other conditions? The fifth prince always remembered that he owed him those three conditions. He felt uncomfortable when he thought about them from time to time. It would be great if they could cancel them.
However, what the Fifth Prince did not expect was that he was unwilling to satisfy even such a small request.
Ye Shuo felt that there was really something wrong with the Fifth Prince. He had already admitted defeat, so why should he get involved?
“no.”
Ye Shuo’s straightforward attitude made the Fifth Prince grit his teeth. He wanted them to compromise but they were unwilling to pay even the slightest price. He really wanted them to retreat to the end, right?
“…You’re so cruel!”
Seeing this, Ye Shuo knew that he agreed, and then looked at the Eighth Prince who was still holding on.
The Fifth and Seventh Princes have surrendered, what can the Eighth Prince do alone? Besides, if things really don’t work out, there’s still the First Prince standing there. If you think about it carefully, it doesn’t matter whether he’s there or not.
“Okay, I know everything. I’ll be leaving now.”
The eighth prince was still struggling with his thoughts, but when he heard these words, he immediately raised his head.
“Wait, you only ask them, why don’t you ask me???”
Ye Shuo scratched his head: “Ah? You didn’t express your opinion for so long, I thought you didn’t agree.”
“Forget it, just assume that you don’t agree.”
What does “just assume he disagrees” mean? The Eighth Prince understood. He must have guessed that he had a grudge against him because of his elder brother’s matter and was worried that he would bear a grudge against him, so he simply found an opportunity to kill him legitimately to eliminate future troubles and gain the reputation of supporting the new emperor.
When did Xiaojiu become so sinister? !
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this was the case. The Eighth Prince hurriedly said, “Who said I disagree? I agree!”
I am the only one left and can’t do anything, so I must not give him an excuse to kill myself.
“Well… that’s fine.” Ye Shuo reluctantly accepted his surrender.
But what needs to be said still needs to be said.
“It’s not an ugly thing to say in advance. You made this promise voluntarily. If you want to go back on your word in the future, don’t blame me for being ruthless.”
Until Ye Shuo left, the Fifth Prince and the Eighth Prince were speechless for a long time.
When he returned to the palace, as expected, Ye Shuo saw little Ye Jin in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, kneeling in front of Xiao Ming’s coffin.
It was already dark at this time, and Ye Shuo did not hesitate and carried Ye Jin on his shoulders.
Caught off guard, Ye Jin was startled. After he came to his senses, he hurriedly said, “Uncle Nine, Uncle Nine, please put me down! I still need to keep vigil for my father!”
According to the rules, when the emperor passed away, Ye Jin, as the crown prince, needed to keep vigil for Emperor Taicheng for three days.
But Ye Jin’s physical condition is such that it would take him even three hours, let alone three days. He should not go with his father at that time.
Ye Shuo had given specific instructions before he left, but now it seems that it was of no use at all.
“Rules are dead, but people are alive. Since your father has entrusted you to me, you have to listen to me for the time being.” Ye Shuo didn’t care what others would say. The most important thing now was to save his nephew’s life.
Besides, there are no outsiders here at this time.
Ye Shuo looked around, and when the palace servants around him noticed his gaze, they all lowered their heads.
After putting several futons together, Ye Shuo put Ye Jin down and said, “From now on, sleep.”
The little prince was about to say something when Ye Shuo said, “You can either sleep by yourself or I can press your acupoints. You can choose one.”
The eunuchs around the prince couldn’t help but gasp when they heard this. This was a new emperor who was set in stone. How could this be so shameful!
Even Ye Jin couldn’t help but whisper back, “Uncle Nine, I am the prince now…” The most important thing is that he will be the emperor tomorrow. Can you please respect him?
Ye Shuo narrowed his eyes immediately.
Ye Jin quickly closed his eyes.
Empress He, who was standing by, was so happy that she couldn’t even wait to be happy. How could she not be happy?
It’s not that she doesn’t want to do this, but there are some things that the prince with the surname Ye can do, but she, a queen with a different surname, cannot do.
If she did it, not only her own reputation but also Jin’er’s reputation would be affected.
“Thank you…”
Ye Shuo lifted up his robe, knelt down, and heard these two words.
“You are too kind, sister-in-law. Jin’er is my sixth brother’s only child and also my nephew.”
Queen He looked at the little beggar from that year, who had grown into a tall young man today. She couldn’t help but look dazed. So many years had passed in a flash.
As the queen, Empress He naturally knew what he had done when he left the palace. Empress He hesitated for a moment and asked, “What about the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince, and the Eighth Prince…”
“Don’t worry, sister-in-law. It has been resolved. They will definitely not cause trouble again during the coronation ceremony tomorrow.”
Emperor Taicheng passed away in a hurry, and the little prince was young and weak. He could not wait until the 27-day mourning period was over, so he had to be asked to take the position early. Ye Shuo discussed it with Prime Minister He and decided to push him up as quickly as possible.
Besides, the little prince’s body simply can’t hold on that long, so tomorrow’s coronation ceremony must be kept simple. It’s better to be hasty than to delay it for too long and cause trouble.
Hearing this, Empress He couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief: “Good…”
She was about to thank him, but then she thought of what he had just said, so she changed her words: “Thank you for your hard work.”
Ye Shuo shook his head.
After all, He Xiang is the old prime minister, so there should be no problems on his side. The rest is Ye Shuo’s own business.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh.
Empress He was stunned for a moment, and couldn’t help asking, “But are there other things that haven’t been resolved?”
“…No.” Ye Shuo curled the corner of his mouth.
“I was just thinking that if Azhi knew, she would be angry. I told her when I came out that I would be back soon.”
Who would have thought that once they entered the imperial city, they would be tied up tightly in one breath.
After Emperor Taicheng passed away yesterday, Ye Shuo sent someone to deliver the news as quickly as possible. It was estimated that it would arrive in ten days or half a month.
Ye Shuo was not afraid of anything else, but he was afraid that Yao Zhi would simply run away with the baby in her belly.
“I clearly promised her that I would stop being a prince and live a carefree life with her for the rest of my life…” Who knew that Xiao Ming would be so disappointing!
Ye Shuo didn’t care about it and just said it casually.
Empress He was a little stunned when she heard this. For a moment, she felt that the young man in front of her was as far away from them as if he was a world away.
What he said was simply incredible to them and was truly enviable.
He just gave up the throne, it’s really…
Perhaps only people who have everything can be so willful.
Queen He opened her mouth: “It should be… not?”
Ye Shuo sighed: “I hope so.”
Oh my God… No, Xiao Ming, please don’t do that! Please!!
The next morning, the princes and dukes of the royal family came one after another. Prince Su couldn’t help but ask when no one was paying attention: “Xiao Jiu, when did I, your uncle, tell you that you can kill your brothers?”
“Uh…it’s not important. Look, I’m my father’s favourite son, right? I must know my father best, right? I think my father must think so, isn’t that right?”
Prince Su: “…”
Bullshit!
If my brother knew that this kid was playing with his will, he would definitely –
Wait a minute, actually if you think about it carefully, it’s not necessarily true…
Everyone first paid tribute to Emperor Taicheng, and then came to the Xuanzheng Hall. At this time, all the civil and military officials had arrived.
After all, Ye Jin is only a ten-year-old child. It is inevitable that he is nervous when he encounters such a big scene.
But he couldn’t show it. He couldn’t appear weak, and he couldn’t let others laugh at him.
It’s not just a joke on himself, but also a joke on his father.
Emperor Taicheng had difficulty in having an heir, so naturally people below him were talking about it. Ye Jin could only do his best, better, and even better to silence the gossips of the world.
However, just when Ye Jin was nervous and didn’t know what to do, he saw Ye Shuo next to him gently holding his hand.
“Your Majesty, do not worry. I am here to clear all obstacles for you.”
“See that chair? All you have to do is sit on it.”
The young man’s voice was extremely deep and steady, totally unlike his previous nonchalant demeanour. Ye Jin inexplicably became calm.
Ye Shuo held his hand, walked across the white marble bridge, walked up the white marble steps, stepped over the threshold of the Xuan Zheng Hall, and entered the Xuan Zheng Hall.
Ye Shuo accompanied him all the way, and only at the end did he have to go up to the high imperial throne alone.
Then, what should I do next?
Ye Jin only remembered that when his father held the enthronement ceremony, as soon as he sat in this position, the voices of the ministers cheering for him were like a tsunami. Now that he has sat down, why are they still not moving?
What Ye Jin didn’t know was that this was the case with the young ruler.
Just when Ye Jin was in a dilemma, he saw Prince Rui, now the regent, take the first step, kneeling at the feet of the new emperor and submitting.
“Welcome our emperor to the throne. Long live the emperor.”
The situation is now a foregone conclusion and there is no other way.
Prince Su and Prince Jin sighed in their hearts, then knelt down as well.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but turn his head to look at the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince, and the Eighth Prince behind him.
What can the fifth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince do? Kneel.
Then, there is the current Black Armor Guard Commander Li Yuheng, the Minister of War Wei Wen, the Minister of Works and the Junior Official of the Dali Temple Xing Yucheng…
Seeing that the teacher had knelt and acknowledged the identity of the new emperor, Zou Wu and others also took action.
Then, Ye Jin heard the sound of congratulations that was like a tsunami.
“Welcome our emperor to the throne. Long live the emperor, long live the emperor, long live the emperor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Ending
chapters.content:
He Xiang was very worried at first, fearing that the Fifth King, Seventh King and Eighth King would cause trouble at this time, but when he saw that they had been honest throughout the whole process, He Xiang finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Although the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince and the Eighth Prince are no longer of any significance nowadays, they are still a huge trouble just because they are the sons of Emperor Jingwen and princes of legitimate birth.
Fortunately, Prince Rui was there. Prime Minister He never thought that Prince Rui’s carefree character would play a miraculous role at this time, but at the same time, when he thought about assisting the new emperor with him in the future, Prime Minister He had a terrible headache.
Speaking of which, Prime Minister He was also miserable. Although he had a keen eye and picked out the latent Emperor Taicheng at first sight, and it turned out that he had indeed bet on the right horse and successfully continued the glory of the He family, but unfortunately Emperor Taicheng passed away too early, forcing Prime Minister He, who was already at the age of retirement, to work so hard and even had no time to rest.
After most of the ministers and clan members had left, Ye Shuo’s true colours were revealed.
“Phew…I’m so tired.”
He Xiang, who was standing by, saw that he was not standing properly, frowned, and seemed to be hesitant to speak.
I wanted to say something, but I was afraid of being pestered by Prince Rui.
“Now, can we finally leave?” The fifth prince said unhappily. I really didn’t know what he was thinking. He was willing to kneel at the feet of a baby. If it were him, he would definitely not be able to bear it.
“Just performed well.”Ye Shuo waved his hand: “Alright, alright, let’s go.”
The fifth prince turned around and left, but the seventh and eighth princes bowed to the new emperor before leaving.
Now that Emperor Taicheng is gone, the eldest prince, who has been as obedient as a quail for nearly three years, finally has a chance to speak again.
“Emperor Taicheng actually chose you to be the regent.” The eldest prince now finally knew what the good news he had mentioned before was.
But the eldest prince still found it unbelievable. He felt that Emperor Taicheng was desperate and tried every possible means in the end. He really dared to do anything.
“He’s not afraid that you will destroy his only child.” In this regard, Lao Liu is quite courageous.
“What do you mean?” Ye Shuo frowned.
“Do you look down on me?”
To be honest, the eldest prince really doesn’t look down on him.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and decided not to bother with these trivial matters.
Ye Shuo thought for a moment and said, “Since you know, then give me a hand instead of just standing there and watching.”
“It’s that easy.” The eldest prince was too lazy to meddle in such trivial matters. Besides, it was like that when Emperor Taicheng was in power. It would be good enough if he didn’t cause trouble after his death. 𝘳𝔞NȯᛒЁ𝐒
Ye Shuo probably knew what the eldest prince was dissatisfied with, but father is father and child is child.
“The kid didn’t offend you, did he? When did you become so petty?”
“I’m stingy? I’m still stingy?” The eldest prince pointed at his nose, looking incredulous.
Not wanting to say anything more to him, the eldest prince turned around and prepared to leave. However, he had just taken two steps when Ye Shuo grabbed his arm.
“Brother, brother, no, no, no. My request is not high. I just ask you to keep an eye on the starlings.” After all, Ye Shuo is alone and it is impossible for him to take care of everything. As for the secret guards that Emperor Taicheng left for the little emperor, forget about their quality. Their quality is so bad that even a wooden man like Wu Yi would be pissed off when seeing them. They are probably of no use for the time being.
Without the useful secret guards, the little emperor’s control over Shangjing would be greatly weakened.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to find a few more helpers.
As for the Fifth Prince, he and the Seventh Prince were restraining each other and could only expose each other.
The eldest prince had already had a grudge against the eighth prince because of what happened before, so what if they were brothers? Now the one who least wanted the eighth prince to regain power was probably the eldest prince.
“Brother, please be kind and help your younger brother.” Ye Shuo has always been very thick-skinned and doesn’t care about his face at all.
Seeing the young man behaving like this, the eldest prince’s brows suddenly furrowed.
“Let’s talk properly, why are you being so fussy?”
“Brother, if you don’t agree, I won’t let go.”
The eldest prince: “…”
“Okay, okay, okay, I promise, just get out of here.”
After cursing the man as shameless in his heart, the eldest prince limped away on his crutches.
On the other hand, after the coronation ceremony, Xing Yucheng became extremely anxious and his first reaction was to prepare to run away.
However, although he was already the Shaoqing of Dali Temple in his early thirties, a fourth-rank official was not considered a low position at his age. You have to know that his father was only a third-rank Shangshu all his life. But it was still not high enough to be in the hall today, so he had to wait until all the adults left before he could leave.
For some reason, the Minister of Works felt that his son was particularly impatient today.
“What are you in such a hurry for?”
Xing Yucheng noticed that the Regent had let go of Prince Ding, and his heart immediately sank: “…You will know soon.”
Almost as soon as the words fell, the young man’s voice was heard.
At this time, Xing Yucheng was only one step away from the gate of Xuanzheng Hall.
“Xing Shaoqing, please stay for a moment, don’t leave yet.”
Who in the whole of Shangjing didn’t know that the third son of the Xing family was the companion of His Royal Highness Prince Rui in the past? Even though so many years had passed, Xing Yucheng had been tied to His Royal Highness Prince Rui from the very beginning, and there was really no need to hide it.
In an instant, everyone’s attention was focused here.
The Minister of Works was silent for a moment, took a few steps back, and huddled into the crowd, pretending not to know him.
Xing Yucheng took a deep breath, then came to Ye Shuo and bowed to him: “Your Highness, what can I do for you?”
“Nothing much, I just need someone I can use right now. Could you please fill in for me?”
Feeling that it was really inhumane to make people work overtime without compensation, Ye Shuo hurriedly added: “Don’t worry, you won’t work for nothing.”
Xing Yucheng thought to himself, Your Highness, you might as well let me work for nothing!
But Xing Yucheng had no room to refuse, so he could only agree with tears in his eyes.
“yes.”
Compared to him, Wei Wen was much smarter. He left under the pretext of supporting the old Duke Zhen when Ye Shuo was talking to the Fifth Prince and the others. When Ye Shuo looked for him again, there was no one in the hall.
After returning to the bedroom, the little emperor was the only one left in the palace, and he finally relaxed.
The little emperor sat there, coughing and twisting wrinkles on both sides of his clothes with his hands.
I don’t know how I performed today, whether I showed any weakness, whether I made others laugh at me, and… whether I brought shame upon my father’s reputation.
Then, the little emperor was awakened by the sound of a communication outside.
“Your Majesty, the Regent requests an audience.”
The little emperor straightened his back subconsciously.
When Ye Shuo came in, the little emperor found that he seemed to be holding a box in his hand. When he opened the box, inside lay a bunch of candies wrapped in brown paper?
“These are throat lozenges. During the ceremony just now, I saw His Majesty seemed to be wheezing. Maybe he had a cough, so I went to the Imperial Hospital to get these.”
Although the coronation ceremony was kept simple, the entire process still took an hour.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say, “Thank you for your hard work, Your Majesty.”
The little emperor felt warm all of a sudden, but what made him even happier was yet to come.
“Your Majesty behaved very well today, just like your father.”
“Really?” This time, the little emperor could no longer sit still.
“But I… No, I feel like I’m not steady enough when I walk. I stumbled when I climbed the stairs, and my hands shook when I sat on the throne. Also…”
Seeing the child talking more and more, Ye Shuo smiled and shook his head: “No, Your Majesty is already very good now. When Your Majesty grows up, he will definitely be even better.”
The little emperor finally let out a long breath.
After Ye Shuo left, the little emperor picked up a throat lozenge, peeled it and put it in his mouth. The cool and sweet taste quickly spread. Sure enough, after a while, the cough in his throat gradually became less severe.
A few days later, it was the day for Emperor Taicheng to be buried.
The little emperor was weak and young, so he naturally could not do the job of carrying the coffin. At this time, it was immediately clear how unpopular Emperor Taicheng was during his lifetime.
It was not proper for Ye Shuo, as a younger brother, to carry his elder brother’s coffin. He had no choice but to look at the eldest prince.
The eldest prince felt that he had offended someone, but in the end, he still resisted the urge to curse, waved his hand impatiently, and motioned Ye Yan and his brothers to come forward.
What Ye Shuo didn’t expect was that Ye Xun actually took the initiative to lend a hand. After all, Emperor Taicheng was his uncle, right?
Ye Shuo opened his mouth, but didn’t say anything.
Then, the posthumous title for Emperor Taicheng was decided.
Ye Shuo and the young emperor studied for several days and selected several titles with good meanings for Emperor Taicheng. As expected, they were all rejected.
The one who governs the heavens and the earth is called Wen, the one who is knowledgeable and talented is called Constitution, the one who makes the people turn to is called Benevolence, the one who keeps the people safe and secure is called Virtue, the one who works hard for the people and makes them well-fed is called Kang… None of these can be used.
Emperor Taicheng’s reign was short, just over two years in total, less than three years. He had just taken control of the imperial power, and his various decrees had not yet been implemented. Those that had been implemented had not yet produced results. In addition, Emperor Taicheng later raised demons in the palace and was obsessed with the way to immortality. He was not a wise ruler at all.
If no disaster had occurred in the end, and if the person who succeeded to the throne had not been the offspring of Emperor Taicheng, the situation would have been even more serious.
But even if Emperor Taicheng’s descendants succeeded to the throne, these beautiful posthumous titles still could not be used, but bad posthumous titles would not be used either, so a compromise was made and neutral posthumous titles were chosen.
Finally, after discussion among the royal family and the court, Emperor Taicheng was posthumously named Emperor Yuanzhuangping.
To desire kindness and love but have no virtue within is called being mean.
All talk but no moral character, the Sixth Prince ascended to the throne during the reign of Emperor Jingwen with his great ability, but he made no further achievements after ascending the throne, which is really disappointing.
When the ceremonial officer read out these words in the court, the little emperor was confused. When the court was over, the little emperor could no longer hold back and burst into tears.
No one knows his father’s abilities better than him. He just doesn’t have enough time, and other people will never know this.
Civil and military officials as well as the people could only see what Emperor Taicheng did on the surface, and no one cared whether he was good or bad.
From this moment on, the little emperor suddenly understood that if he failed to be a good emperor, this would be the end of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Honesty
chapters.content:
“Fuck! Aren’t these people just bullies?!” There are countless emperors in history who were much worse than Xiao Ming, but still got a good posthumous title in the end. Now that things have come to this point, it is not just about the quality of the posthumous title, but the attitude of the royal family and court officials.
No matter how great Emperor Taicheng was, he is no longer with us after all, so the quality of his posthumous title is not that important.
Their real intention was not on Emperor Taicheng at all. They were trying to find out the bottom line of the young emperor.
Even if Ye Shuo and He Xiang were combined, they would not be able to cover the sky with one hand. With so many officials and factions in the court, there would always be different voices.
In the court, the east wind always prevails over the west wind, or the west wind prevails over the east wind. Whether the ruler is weak and the ministers are strong, or the ruler is strong and the ministers are weak, is actually all discovered bit by bit through testing.
Everything is just about interests. They don’t care whether the emperor is young or not.
When Ye Shuo finished scolding, he lowered his head and saw that the little emperor looked unhappy.
Ye Shuo hurriedly said, “Don’t worry, the emperor’s uncle will have a good talk with them tomorrow and will definitely not let them make such a decision.”
Ye Shuo had had an argument with them during the morning court today. They were at loggerheads and almost came to blows. But this kind of thing would not be helped even if Ye Shuo came.
Emperor Taicheng is not capable of anything, this is an established fact, unless Emperor Taicheng’s descendants are powerful and capable, his father can also benefit from it. Here, parents and children have always been involved.But if they can’t, the situation will only get worse than it is now, and both the father and the son will be trampled into the mud in one go.
Obviously the little emperor knew it in his heart.
Upon hearing this, the little emperor grabbed Ye Shuo’s sleeve tightly and blurted out: “Don’t go!”
Bringing up this matter again will not help, and it will not save my father’s reputation. It will only cause my father to be discussed and humiliated in public once again.
The little prince really didn’t want to go through the same thing again. It felt like he was being fried in a frying pan or roasted in fire.
“If I were strong enough, they would not dare to say anything.” In the final analysis, he was not a good enough son.
However, when Ye Shuo heard this familiar argument, his scalp went tingling.
Xiao Ming is gone just like that. If Xiao Ye Jin also…
Ye Shuo was startled and said hurriedly: “You must not think like that, do you hear me?”
The young emperor had never seen his ninth uncle so serious, and his tone became heavy.
“Listen to me, your father’s problem is not that he is not capable enough. On the contrary, it is because he is too capable and too strong-willed. No matter what he does, he will not stop until he has done it to the best of his ability. As a result, he became ill from overwork and died young. If he had lived longer, do you think this would have happened?” Ȓ𝘢ɴȮᛒÊṡ
Ye Shuo knew in his previous life that the body is the capital of revolution. Without a good body, everything else will be in vain.
“So you must take good care of yourself. Don’t be anxious. Take it step by step. You still have plenty of time. Besides, posthumous titles are not set in stone. When you become an adult, you can change it however you want. By then, no one will dare to say a word.”
Having said that, but…but it has been too long, so long that it makes people despair.
The young emperor simply couldn’t stand the thought that his father would be talked about like this for eight or ten years, or even ten to twenty years.
That was the father he revered the most in his life…
“Ninth uncle, my father is not as useless as they say. He is really, really powerful. He once told me that he would be a better and more powerful emperor than my grandfather. Even when he was so sick that he couldn’t get out of bed, he didn’t relax at all. He had people send memorials to the Chengming Hall every day, and he would not rest until he had approved them. And he didn’t raise those Taoist priests for himself, but for me. And the fifth uncle, the seventh uncle, the eighth uncle, is also for me…”
Others said that Emperor Taicheng was cruel and had poor popularity. After his death, no one even volunteered to help carry his coffin. But the young emperor knew that his father acted like this in order to clear obstacles for him before his death.
How could the young emperor endure this?
And how could Ye Shuo not know what he said?
“Uncle knows. Uncle knows everything you said.” Ye Shuo had watched Emperor Taicheng grow up. No one knew better than him how much Emperor Taicheng had sacrificed in his life.
“But… as I said before, your health is the most important thing.”
Ye Shuo has experienced this, so he knows this, but those who have not experienced it will never know the meaning of this sentence.
Those who don’t know will fall into this trap one after another.
Emperor Taicheng, an adult, could not do it. How could the little emperor, who was only ten years old, do it?
Therefore, the little emperor’s next words only made Ye Shuo feel a chill to the bone –
“But if I can’t get what I want, then what’s the point of having this body?”
The moment the words fell, Ye Shuo’s eyes went dark.
As expected, the little emperor did what he said. Look at what this good child has been taught to do. Ye Shuo really wanted to pull Xiao Ming out of the imperial mausoleum and give him a beating.
However, this time, Ye Shuo could not just sit back and watch.
It would have been fine if he had not agreed at the beginning, but now that he has already promised Xiao Ming, he naturally will not go back on his word.
Ignoring the little emperor’s desperate protests, Ye Shuo simply moved into the palace to live and eat with him.
Struggle, struggle, let’s see who can prevail!
What’s more, Ye Shuo even asked Xing Yucheng to help him make a schedule. When Xing Yucheng knew that this thing would be used on the current emperor, he felt terrible.
Although the new emperor is young, he is still the emperor after all. When he grows up, how can he not hate me as his accomplice?
Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but comfort himself: “Not necessarily, what if the emperor doesn’t know it’s me?”
“What are you thinking about? Can I write such beautiful characters?” Over the years, Xing Yucheng has perfected his left-handed handwriting, but Ye Shuo, the lazy guy, is still standing still.
Ignoring Xing Yucheng’s bitter face as his dream was suddenly shattered, Ye Shuo picked up the page of paper in front of him and began to read.
Go to bed at the hour of Shu and get up at the hour of Mao. No matter what, you must ensure four hours of sleep a day. The little emperor is in poor health, so it is not suitable for him to do strenuous exercise. After getting up at the hour of Mao, it is just right to do the Five Animal Exercises or radio gymnastics for half an hour facing the rising sun.
Then it’s time for breakfast. For breakfast, you should eat a combination of meat and vegetables, eat more fresh vegetables, drink a glass of milk every day, and supplement with more calcium and vitamins.
After breakfast, listen to the lectures given by Prime Minister He and Lord Cen. Rest for a quarter of an hour every half hour. It is compulsory. Do not sit, stand or lie down for a long time. You must move more.
Have a picnic every seven days, go out for a walk, and relax. Children are at an age of having fun, how can they stay at home all the time?
Get more sun, wash your hands frequently, and occasionally do some handicrafts, cultivate hobbies and artistic cells.
After looking through it carefully again and not finding any problems, Ye Shuo personally pasted the paper on the wall with glue to ensure that the little emperor could see it as soon as he got up.
The little emperor opened his mouth and was about to say that he didn’t have so much time to waste on such trivial matters, but he saw that the young man had someone spread his bedding on the ground, as if he wanted to supervise him at all times.
Ye Shuo’s sacrifice was extraordinary, and he was determined to correct the little emperor’s “bad habits”.
The young emperor was not an ungrateful person. He knew that his uncle was doing this for his own good, but the urgency in his heart was not so easily extinguished.
Ye Shuo played a game of cat and mouse with the little emperor.
Almost every day, He Xiang and his men were interrupted several times by the young regent.
“bite.”
“The time has come. Stop for a moment. Stop for a moment.”
The two people couldn’t help feeling a little depressed as they were talking about the critical moment.
Ye Shuo pretended not to see anything and walked out with the little emperor.
Of course, Ye Shuo did not completely deny the little emperor a chance. Seeing that the little emperor was not convinced, Ye Shuo suggested that the little emperor play games with him, such as drawing lots, rock-paper-scissors, or even Gobang. If the little emperor won, Ye Shuo would exempt him from his rest time for the day. On the contrary, if the little emperor lost, he would have to listen to Ye Shuo for the whole day.
This method sounds fair at first glance, but the little emperor is only ten years old now, how can he be a match for Ye Shuo?
Drawing lots was originally a game based purely on luck, and with Ye Shuo’s crazy cheating, the little emperor never won once.
As expected of a contemporary magician, his hand speed is so fast.
He Xiang, who was standing next to him, looked at the chess game in front of him, which was obviously different from the previous one, and couldn’t help but fall into deep thought. On the one hand, he was glad that the regent had not yet mastered this skill, and on the other hand, he felt that he was being too bullying now.
“Your Highness, the Emperor is still a child.”
Ye Shuo nodded: “Well, then we can’t let him go.”
He Xiang: “…”
He Xiang thought he knew him well enough, but he couldn’t help being shocked by his shamelessness.
After dark, the little emperor, who had lost once again, reluctantly put down the book in his hand and climbed onto the bed at Ye Shuo’s urging. Thinking of today’s disastrous defeat, the little emperor couldn’t help but said bitterly: “Uncle Nine, I hate you.”
Ye Shuo nodded absentmindedly and replied casually: “Yeah, uncle loves you.”
The little emperor’s face turned red and he swallowed back the words he was about to say.
Ye Shuo was tucking in the quilt for him and didn’t notice it at all.
When he lay down in bed, Ye Shuo couldn’t help thinking, if he counted the days, there should be news from Liangzhou, probably in the next few days.
Furthermore, the little emperor’s situation is different from Xiao Ming’s. Xiao Ming originally had a good body, but he ruined it himself. The little emperor, on the other hand, was born like this, and it is difficult to recover even if he wants to.
But after all, it was still of some use. At least the little emperor’s complexion was better than before.
Immediately afterwards, Ye Shuo received a letter from Yao Zhi.
The moment he opened the letter, Ye Shuo had a bad feeling, and after reading it, his premonition came true.
When Yao Zhi didn’t see Ye Shuo return after the national mourning, she knew that something must have held him back from going to the capital. But thinking about it, this was normal. If Emperor Taicheng was still alive, he would definitely not stay. Now that Emperor Taicheng was gone, leaving only two young children, given his personality, it was impossible for him to sit idly by.
Even if it were Yao Zhi herself, she would make the same choice.
She would definitely not blame him, but whether she would come back or not was another matter.
Yao Zhi wrote a lot of thoughtful words in the letter, but it all boiled down to one sentence: Come on, I believe in you, so I took my daughter out to play by myself.
Sure enough, after the novelty wore off, she finally got tired of herself.
Ye Shuo almost cried after reading it.
He knew it would turn out like this!
The little emperor was wondering when no one came to urge him for a long time. As a result, when he went out, he saw his uncle squatting at the wall outside, holding a letter in his hand, his fingers constantly stroking the letter papers, his eyes full of nostalgia.
If it weren’t for me, he should have been reunited with Princess Rui.
The little emperor felt inexplicably sad.
The little emperor suddenly became obedient.

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Greed
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo read the letter over and over again several times. When he was sure that Yao Zhi really had no intention of coming back, he finally gave up.
Forget it, if she doesn’t want to go back, then don’t go back. Travelling back and forth is tiring enough, not to mention she is pregnant now. Even if she is in good health, accidents are unavoidable. It is safest to stay in Liangzhou.
Besides, he was the one who was sorry for her. He had promised to stay away from the court, but he didn’t do it in the end. His first crime was that he couldn’t be with her at such a critical moment. What’s more, he couldn’t even spare the time to go to Liangzhou to pick her up. His second crime was that.
If it wasn’t done, it wasn’t done. No matter what the cause was, the result was like this. Ye Shuo was not the kind of person who liked to make excuses for himself.
If Yao Zhiruo doesn’t come back now, she will definitely not be able to come back when she reaches the late stage of pregnancy. Then she will have to give birth and go through the confinement period. She won’t have to breastfeed, and she can find a wet nurse at that time, but the child will have to be at least one year old before she comes back.
It takes about half a month to travel from Liangzhou to the capital by horse, and even longer by carriage. Although Zou Wu and his team have improved the shock absorption system of the carriage, it is still impossible to completely eliminate the sense of vibration. Babies have soft bones, especially their skulls and brains, which are extremely fragile. If you want to take them out, they must be at least one year old.
Oh my God, Dingning won’t disown me as his father by then, right?
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel sad.
But no matter how sad it is, we still have to do our work.
After Ye Shuo calmed down, he found that the several pieces of letter paper in his hand were almost crushed by him. He hurriedly folded the letter papers, put them back into the envelope and put them in his arms. When Ye Shuo stood up, he found that his legs had become numb from squatting.Then, Ye Shuo saw that the little emperor suddenly became obedient, and went to the activities obediently without his urging.
Ye Shuo looked at his figure, confused.
Oh my God, the sun is rising from the west!
“What… is wrong with you?” Ye Shuo asked tentatively. When he saw the little emperor stiffen, he immediately understood that something must have happened.
The little emperor had no choice but to speak out what was in his heart.
“Ninth Uncle, if Father hadn’t forced you to stay, you wouldn’t be separated from Auntie now.”
“That’s right.”
The little emperor initially thought that he would comfort him, but he didn’t expect him to say such a thing. This reminded him of when he asked him which nephew he liked more…
He was just as ruthless back then.
Although it is ruthless, it is not annoying.
“So, let’s work hard together. When you turn 18, I, your uncle, can take a break.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but reach out and pat his nephew’s shoulder.
The little emperor was silent for a moment, and finally nodded: “…Okay.”
Maybe it’s because I’ve been going out more recently and having more time to play, and my childish nature hasn’t completely subsided, so I’m not as picky as before. ʀÀNƟᛒÊＳ
All in all, everything is moving in the right direction.
“What are you still standing there for? It’s time for radio gymnastics, why don’t you get moving?”
The little emperor was somewhat happy at first, but his expression suddenly fell when he heard this.
This gymnastics is really indecent when doing it, with bending over, sticking out the buttocks, and shaking and raising hands. The little emperor simply couldn’t bring himself to do it at first, but he had no choice but to be forced by Ye Shuo, so he had to do it even if he didn’t want to.
Fortunately, he had the Ninth Prince Uncle to accompany him. Even though he was an adult, he was not shy at all. He did some radio gymnastics while shouting the beat.
“One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four. Four, two, three, four…”
When Mrs. He arrived, she heard such sounds coming from the courtyard outside Chengming Palace from a distance.
Through the gap in the palace gate, one could see the Regent doing morning exercises seriously. As for his son, he had a sad face, as if he was enduring great torture.
Since the Regent came, Jin’er has become much more lively than before. Empress Dowager He remembered that her son complained to her a few days ago, saying that the Regent was too strict with him. In the past, the child kept everything in his heart and never said much. Now he finally behaves like a child, which is what Empress Dowager He wanted most. How could she help him?
Naturally, the little emperor returned empty-handed in the end.
Prime Minister He and Empress Dowager He now have complicated feelings towards the Regent. On the one hand, they know that this so-called Regent was specially set up by Emperor Taicheng for them to restrain them. On the other hand, they also know that only if the little emperor is alive and well will there be things that happen later. Therefore, they all maintain a tacit attitude towards Ye Shuo’s actions.
In the end, Wei Wen was unable to escape the clutches of his little cousin and was dragged over by Ye Shuo to serve as a soldier.
To ensure fairness, the memorials submitted by the subordinates cannot be sent directly to the prime minister’s residence. If so, what kind of speech would that be? We should review them together.
I didn’t expect the Regent to say it so directly, which made it impossible for Prime Minister He to refuse. After all, the Ye royal family were watching them.
He can watch it if he wants, he can’t understand it anyway. This is what He Xiang thought.
It’s not that Ye Shuo really couldn’t understand it, he was just too lazy to read it, so he waited for He Xiang to finish reviewing it before giving it to Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng to review. If there were any loopholes, they would discuss it together. If there were no loopholes, it would be considered passed.
When Xing Yucheng touched the memorial for the first time, he was almost frightened to death. Although Wei Wen was a little better, he could only barely remain calm.
How can ordinary people touch this thing! My little cousin must be crazy.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo not only didn’t take it seriously, but instead added fuel to the fire: “Work hard, if you do well, the emperor might even give you a promotion.”
Promotion? ? It would be great if His Majesty didn’t want their lives when he grows up.
This action made the little emperor who was in class next to him very jealous.
After all, he was an emperor, so how could he not have some ambitions? But he was still young, and it was far from the time for him to be exposed to these things.
Just when the little emperor was feeling extremely disappointed, he suddenly heard a slight sound and a memorial paper fell right in front of him.
It turned out that Ye Shuo, who was standing next to him, had put it on his desk.
The little emperor was stunned for a moment, then opened it tentatively.
Prime Minister He and Lord Cen could not help but frown when they saw this. They were about to say something when Ye Shuo said, “It’s not a big deal. Your Majesty will have to participate in politics sooner or later. It would be a good thing to ask Your Majesty to have more contact with it from now on.”
Although his little nephew is young, he is extremely precocious. Ye Shuo believes that he will not do anything out of line.
Sure enough, the little emperor just took a look and didn’t express any opinion, so Prime Minister He had no reason to say anything.
After everyone left, he secretly asked Ye Shuo why he did that.
Ye Shuo was quite good at giving lectures to children, but Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng were both there, so why would he be needed?
Noticing the gaze of their little cousin/his highness, Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng could only bite the bullet and stand up to answer the little emperor’s questions.
Xing Yucheng was still far inferior to Wei Wen. He was well-educated, but had little experience. Wei Wen, on the other hand, was able to explain things in simple terms and in a clear and thorough manner to the young emperor.
“Ninth uncle, what do you think about me asking Wei Qing to be my teacher?” Not an ordinary teacher, but a teacher of the emperor, just like the third uncle and the grand tutor in the past.
Ye Shuo nodded hurriedly after hearing this: “Okay, no problem, it just saves me some trouble.”
The little emperor felt that he could not really rely on his uncle in this regard.
There was no way, the little emperor could only think independently.
He remembered that his father had said before his death that the so-called art of checks and balances also meant checking each other. So his great-grandfather was the head of the civil officials, and the old Duke Zhen, who had now retired and returned to his hometown, was the head of the military officials. So were these two people considered checks and balances?
The little emperor lay on the bed thinking about it, but he was really unsure. As if seeing his troubles, Ye Shuo below couldn’t help but say, “Why not ask your mother?”
Although she knew that her son was always intelligent, Empress Dowager He was still troubled when she heard him ask this question.
If the current Vice Minister of the Ministry of War were to be the teacher of his son, his grandfather’s influence in the court would certainly not be as great as it is now.
But in the end, under the gaze of the little emperor, Empress He nodded: “…Yes, it is a check and balance.”
In fact, think about it, no matter how powerful the He family is, what can it do? They can’t really change the dynasty. Since they can’t change the world, the prosperity of the He family will eventually depend on the emperor’s wishes.
With the identity of being the emperor’s maternal family, as long as the He family does not make any big mistakes and the family members are more motivated, no family will be able to surpass the He family.
“Jin’er is only ten years old and he can think of these things. Jin’er is really amazing.” This is a mother’s praise and earnest expectation for her child.
The little emperor was naturally very happy to get the answer from his mother. When the mother and son were having dinner together, the little emperor said a few more words.
“In the past, my mother only talked to my great-grandfather, and never told me about the royal family. I thought she liked my great-grandfather more.” The little emperor was still young, and he didn’t express himself very clearly. Subconsciously, he was thinking about whether he liked or disliked someone, rather than whether he valued or not.
How could Empress Dowager He not understand what the little emperor did not understand?
Empress Dowager He was stunned and then broke into a cold sweat. Only after the little emperor left did Empress Dowager He come to her senses.
From obeying the family’s order to marry the Sixth Prince to now, perhaps my thoughts are really too much towards the He family.
Fortunately, it is not too late now. If Jin’er is older and he finds out, then…
Empress Dowager He suddenly understood something.
As the days passed, the little emperor’s condition gradually stabilised. Although Ye Shuo still could not leave Shangjing, he had no problem entering and leaving the palace.
Anyway, Wei Wen and He Xiang were taking care of him in the palace. In the afternoon, Ye Shuo could finally go out for some fresh air, go back to the mansion to soak in the hot springs, change into clean clothes, etc.
There was nothing for Ye Shuo to worry about. The only thing he needed to pay attention to was the little emperor’s health.
Ye Shuo’s only goal is to take good care of the little emperor’s health, and the rest of the problems can be solved by others.
The eldest prince beside him couldn’t help but laugh at what he said, “You really are addicted to being a wet nurse.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but roll his eyes at him.
“What else? Whether my brother can live a comfortable life in the future depends entirely on Jin’er.” Seven years and five months, now there are only seven years and five months left.
Several months have passed since the new emperor ascended the throne. Calculating the time, it will soon be the day for my daughter to be born. I don’t know how Ah Zhi is doing, and whether Ding Ning is well behaved.
God bless, I hope everything goes well!
Being nervous, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but talk a little. The eldest prince beside him couldn’t stand it anymore and said, “She’s just a girl, not a son. Why do you care?”
Then, he saw his always smiling brother staring at him with eyes that seemed to be spitting fire.
But who is the eldest prince? Of course, it is impossible to take back what has been said.
Half an incense stick later, Ye Shuo started fighting with the lame eldest prince.
“…Fuck! She is just a worthless girl. Was there anything wrong with what I said?” The eldest prince returned to the mansion, rubbing the dark circles under his eyes, and was indignant.
“I am his elder brother!”
Princess Ding wanted to ask at first, but when she heard these words, her expression suddenly darkened.
After putting away the medicine bottle, she turned around and left, leaving the eldest prince alone for a long time without anyone coming to give him medicine.
Perhaps because his health improved and the pain was not so severe, his mood also became much more cheerful, and gradually, the little emperor got used to this kind of life.
Although he couldn’t help but compete with the Ninth Uncle, but after careful consideration, the little emperor felt that it was pretty good to grow up like this.
He had someone who cared for him and loved him, someone to play with him and someone to read with him. He was very happy playing and fighting every day. He had never had such a life before. As time went on, the little emperor inevitably developed a greedy heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Plague
chapters.content:
“It’s already the fourth day…” It has been four days since the due date, and I don’t know if Ah Zhi is doing well.
Ye Shuo was always worried about this matter, which made him unable to concentrate.
No matter what, he couldn’t calm down at this time.
Looking at the restless Regent, Lord He Xiang, Lord Cen, Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng in the Qinzheng Hall could not help but glare at him.
Is it still possible? If not, get out!
He was not doing his job here, and he would flip through the memorials from time to time, making a clattering sound. Or he would touch here, scratch there, and even sleep on the table. Everyone disliked him very much, and now they could no longer tolerate him.
The little emperor on the side wanted to be a peacemaker. Seeing the four of them bullying the Ninth Prince, the little emperor couldn’t bear it, so he said a few words to mediate. However, despite this, he still couldn’t prevent Ye Shuo from being driven out.
Although Ye Shuo now lived in the palace, it was not convenient for him to move around the harem at will, so he left the palace again.
“Don’t worry about it. I’ll be back before dinner.” Noticing the movement behind him, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but waved his hand.
The little emperor swallowed the words he was about to say and nodded hurriedly.“Then I’ll ask the imperial kitchen to cook the Longjing shrimp that the emperor’s uncle likes to eat.”
Ye Jin seldom calls himself “I” in front of Ye Shuo, and Ye Shuo treats him like an ordinary son or nephew.
After Ye Shuo left, the little emperor hesitated for a long time and finally took the initiative to interrupt Lord Cen who was giving a lecture.
“Master Cen, I, I need to rest for a while.”
Lord Cen paused holding the book, and then the little emperor bowed slightly and left. Seeing this, He Xiang felt mixed emotions.
After about two incense sticks of time, Ye Shuo stood at the gate of the imperial city and couldn’t help scratching his head.
Ye Shuo had just had a fight with the eldest prince a few days ago, and the two were still angry with each other, so it was naturally impossible for Ye Shuo to go find him.
The fifth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince, these three people probably wouldn’t be happy to see him. Prince Su and Prince Jin would be a good place to go, but halfway through, Ye Shuo met Ye Xun first.
Ye Xun came out of the mansion and saw the familiar figure not far away. He couldn’t help but be stunned.
“Uncle Jiu? Why are you free today?”
Ye Xun naturally knew this. Ever since the little emperor ascended the throne, he had been guarding the little emperor every day.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh: “Oh, don’t mention it, I was kicked out.”
“Let’s go to the teahouse. I haven’t talked to you in a long time.”
Ignoring Ye Xun’s protest, Ye Shuo took him to the teahouse without further ado. After a few snacks, Ye Shuo started to talk: “Tell me, am I wrong to worry about my wife and daughter? Right?” ɽ𝘼Ɲỗ฿Εș
Sometimes the Ninth Prince’s nagging was really unbearable. No wonder the First Prince would fight with him.
Ye Xun thought for a moment and said, “I heard that there is a temple outside the city that is extremely effective. If Uncle Jiu is really worried, why not go to that temple?”
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo hurriedly asked, “Where is the temple? How far is it from here?”
“This… I don’t know, I just heard about it.” Ye Xun shook his head.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to call the owner of the teahouse and ask him if he knew this place called Lingjian Temple.
The Ninth Prince never believed this before, but now he reacts like this, which shows how worried he is.
However, after the shopkeeper left, he heard the person opposite him sigh suddenly. Ye Xun paused holding the teacup and asked, “What’s wrong?”
Didn’t the shopkeeper say it was a good thing? There’s no problem.
Ye Shuo shook his head: “The Lingjian Temple is indeed effective, but it’s too far from Shangjing. It will take two or three days to go back and forth. Forget it.”
“Pfft…cough cough cough.” Ye Xun choked and coughed when he heard this.
“Two or three days round trip, this… this is also called far?”
If Ye Xun remembered correctly, the Ninth Prince used to go out on a yearly basis. Even when he went out hunting, it would not be just this much time, right?
“You don’t understand if you don’t raise a child.” Ye Shuo said in a gloomy tone.
“That’s something I really can’t live without for a moment.”
Ye Xun couldn’t help but muttered softly: “Aren’t you out now? And I heard that you don’t have anything to worry about. It’s all Prime Minister He who is busy…”
“You know shit!” He Xiang’s solution was only treating the symptoms but not the root cause, while I was treating both the symptoms and the root cause.
“Forget it, let’s not talk about this. It suddenly occurred to me that you seemed to be planning to go out just now?”
Hearing this, Ye Xun couldn’t help but twitch his lips: “…It’s really hard for you to still remember this.”
Ye Shuo: “Hey kid, what’s wrong with you? Why are you talking so sarcastically?”
“What kid? I’m almost twenty-two this year… forget it.” She was almost led astray by the Ninth Prince again.
Ye Xun discovered that whenever he was with the Ninth Uncle, he couldn’t help but talk nonsense.
Ye Xun immediately stopped talking and said, “Before the Sixth Uncle passed away, he assigned me a task. Now that I have finally handed over the task and am about to step down, I was just about to go take a look when you stopped me.”
After all, Ye Xun is the legitimate son of the crown prince, the legitimate grandson of Emperor Jingwen, and now he has retained his title. After he comes of age, he will be a real prince. Even Emperor Taicheng should not do too much, right? So he casually pointed out an errand to him.
Ye Shuo was stunned: “Uh…you mean, today is the first day of reporting?”
Ye Xun nodded.
Ye Shuo felt embarrassed all of a sudden.
“Then why are you still standing there? Why don’t you get to work?”
“Uncle Jiu, you!”
Ye Xun was nearly mad at him. It was clearly him who stopped him and forced him into the teahouse, but in the end, he acted so confidently.
However, Ye Xun had already gotten used to it over the years. He took a deep breath, and when he saw that he had let go, he naturally stood up and hurried away.
“Uncle Jiu, you’ve kept me here for so long. I’m afraid I won’t be able to make it back in time for dinner. In that case, I’ll take these snacks with me.”
“Hey! That’s my favourite chestnut flour cake!”
However, Ye Xun acted as if he didn’t hear it and didn’t even turn his head.
After a while, Ye Shuo sat down again, laughing uncontrollably.
“I haven’t seen you for three years. This kid has become much more lively…”
He flipped through the scripts he had stored in the box, but he really didn’t want to do it. When the time was almost up, Ye Shuo threw down a silver ingot and went back to the palace.
Although it is not advisable to go to the temple, if one really believes in ghosts and gods, then worshipping Emperor Jingwen would probably be more effective.
“Dad, and Sixth Brother, if you are still alive, please keep Azhi and my daughter safe and sound.”
“Please, please.”
He inserted the incense stick in his hand into the incense burner. When Ye Shuo returned to Chengming Hall from Taihe Hall, it was almost time for dinner. Ye Shuo had eaten more cakes and pastries outside in the afternoon and drank more tea, so he naturally ate less for dinner.
The Ninth Prince always reminded himself to eat less candied fruits and sweet cakes, but he did not restrain himself at all and ate whatever he wanted every day.
But there was nothing that could be done about it. What was Ye Shuo’s physical condition? What was the physical condition of the little emperor? Ye Shuo ate three bowls of rice in one meal, but what about the little emperor? Half a bowl in one meal was already a big deal.
The little emperor was already very unhappy, and he became even more unhappy when he learned that the emperor was eating with his cousin.
After so many months, the child had finally forgotten about his cousin. But now, his young heart was shattered again.
If he treated his nephew like this, what would have happened if he was his own son?
The little emperor had learned from his failures and had learned not to humiliate himself again, but unfortunately, he still couldn’t escape.
It all started because the little emperor asked, “When I turn eighteen, uncle…will you come back?”
“Ah? No way.” The regent is such a high-risk job. The emperor is over 18 and he doesn’t run away quickly. What is he waiting for? As soon as Ye Shuo said this, he knew it was not good.
Sure enough, the next moment, the little emperor burst into tears with a “wow”.
Ye Shuo: “…”
It’s over. It’s over.
In the end, Ye Shuo suffered the consequences of his own actions and coaxed his nephew for a long time before he finally stopped crying.
But even though he didn’t cry, the little emperor turned over, faced the wall, and refused to pay any attention to him.
As a child who rarely showed his emotions, the little emperor would never shed tears unless he was extremely sad.
Sometimes the Ninth Prince was really considerate, but sometimes he was really infuriating. How could he be so ruthless?
Fortunately, there were only Ye Shuo, Ye Jin, and the eunuch who was with Emperor Taicheng at the time in the entire palace. No one else knew about it.
The little emperor was young, and the young eunuchs around him were naturally not very old either. Emperor Taicheng finally asked the senior eunuchs around him to continue to help manage the affairs of the palace and the palace people around the little emperor.
I’m afraid that when the late emperor passed away, he couldn’t have imagined that this would happen.
When the Regent is reliable, he is quite reliable, but when he is unreliable, he is really unreliable.
For some reason, Ye Shuo always felt that the eunuch’s eyes when looking at him had changed.
A few days passed like this, and just when Ye Shuo was struggling to figure out how to repair his relationship with the young emperor, news finally came from Liangzhou.
It is said that Yao Zhi gave birth smoothly half a month ago, both mother and daughter are safe, and the daughter weighs exactly 15 pounds. Although she has not grown up yet, one can vaguely see that her eyes look like his.
After reading it, Ye Shuo wished his heart could fly to Liangzhou.
If possible, I really want to see Azhi and Dingning…
However, the following news soon brought Ye Shuo’s heart back.
While Yao Zhi was giving birth, Mei Yingzhuo was walking around the city when he accidentally noticed someone fainted on the street and vomited continuously.
