Under normal circumstances, Mei Yingzhuo would definitely not care about such trivial matters. What does the life or death of others have to do with him?
But now, isn’t his little disciple about to be born? In order to accumulate blessings for the child, Mei Yingzhuo would go out to practise medicine from time to time since the beginning of Yao Zhi’s pregnancy, and it has been almost half a year now.
Mei Yingzhuo went forward to check. It would have been better if he hadn’t looked. After he looked, his face changed drastically.
Headache, fever, sore throat and neck, vomiting, diarrhoea, etc., these are typical symptoms of pestilence!
The so-called evidence of pestilence is what the people call plague.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo was on good terms with the governor of Liangzhou, who knew the identities of several nobles in the city. Naturally, he did not dare to neglect him after learning about this matter.
Because it was handled promptly, Liangzhou was not in serious trouble. However, after Mei Yingzhuo took the doctors in Liangzhou to trace the source, they found that the disease was not native to Liangzhou, which means it was transmitted from outside. Mei Yingzhuo could only take care of Liangzhou at most, and he could not reach other places, so he could only inform Ye Shuo about the matter.
At the same time, Mei Yingzhuo also told him not to worry, saying that he was already studying the prescription, and once there was any progress, he would send it to him as soon as possible.
There are many merchants in the south, and the mobility is high, so the disease spreads the fastest. Since such symptoms have appeared in Liangzhou City, one can imagine the situation in other places.
After a quick glance, Ye Shuo’s face changed drastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Infection
chapters.content:
“What’s wrong?”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath, then handed the letter to He Xiang next to him. After reading it, He Xiang was also shocked.
“Is this news true?”
The handwriting on the letter was Yao Zhi’s own, with no signs of tampering.
Ye Shuo nodded: “Nine out of ten.”
That would be troublesome.
The most troublesome thing is that the disease is just like cockroaches. Often when you find one, there are already cockroaches everywhere.
What’s more, it has only been half a year since the little emperor ascended the throne.
The little emperor knew that it was his turn to take the stage, but at this moment, he was still extremely nervous.
But he couldn’t panic, because he was the emperor. No matter how young he was, he was still the emperor.The little emperor’s hands on both sides were sweaty, but he still maintained his composure.
“Prince Regent, Prime Minister He, listen to my orders. I order the two of you to handle this matter immediately and notify the counties below to be aware of this matter.”
The young emperor is worthy of being the son of Emperor Taicheng, and is not inferior to his father.
Ye Shuo and He Xiang knelt on one knee and said in unison: “Your Majesty, I respect your order.”
Prime Minister He went to inform all the subordinates, ordering them to start patrolling the places under their jurisdiction as soon as they received the news. Ye Shuo began to conduct strict inspections in various places around the capital, making sure that the epidemic would not spread to this place. This matter required the help of the Black Armor Guards.
This is an official matter, an order personally issued by the young emperor, so the current commander-in-chief Li Yuheng naturally dare not neglect it.
You don’t know until you check, and you’ll be shocked when you do. Shangjing is doing well now, with only a few suspected cases found so far, and they were all brought here by merchants recently. As for other places, two months have passed, and the news that has been received one after another is not so optimistic.
Not all prefectures and counties were as prosperous as Liangzhou, with abundant water and fields. The governor of Liangzhou closed the city gates and isolated it from the outside world. The people, merchants and officials inside were still able to be self-sufficient, but how many counties in Dazhou could compare with Liangzhou?
Moreover, they were delayed on the road for such a long time, and the plague naturally spread.
Even though everyone had been notified, due to various factors, the situation gradually got beyond the control of Ye Shuo and others.
To make matters worse, some people in the royal family and the court didn’t care about that. They didn’t care whether the little emperor’s decision was correct or not. They just knew that this was a problem that occurred during the little emperor’s term of office, and that was enough.
Then, rumours began to spread.
It was unknown when it started, but there was suddenly a voice in Shangjing City saying that Emperor Taicheng was foolish in his later years, had committed too many sins, and had been searching for immortals and asking for advice everywhere, which had angered the gods, so the gods had brought down such a punishment.
This is complete nonsense!
Such arguments really made Ye Shuo very angry.
In the eyes of these people, the dead Emperor Taicheng was nothing more than their tool.
What made Ye Shuo even more unbearable was that they actually implicated Ye Jin, or in other words, their target was Ye Jin from the very beginning.
Because Emperor Taicheng was a ruthless ruler, the little emperor was also labelled a sinner. The royal family and court officials forced the little emperor to issue a self-criticism edict, even though the little emperor had done nothing wrong and had even done well enough. 𝙧𝐚ƝỒ₿È𝐒
“How outrageous! He is spreading rumours and misleading the people. Come, drag him away and kill him for me!” Ye Shuo’s words still worked. At least three or four people took action, but what would be the point of killing only this one?
Even though this matter had nothing to do with the little emperor, and he had not even taken power yet, he was forced to admit his “mistake” by those people who were eyeing him covetously.
If it was an ordinary person, it would be fine. Ye Jin was a sensitive and thoughtful person, and this group of people tried their best to poke at his most painful points. Even if Ye Shuo later ordered the arrest of the person who spread the rumours, it was still of no avail.
After the court session, blood oozed from the little emperor’s lips until he fell into a coma, with his teeth clenched.
Even though Ye Shuo told him a hundred times that it was not his fault, the little emperor still fell visibly silent.
He was still a child, how could he bear so much?
Since Emperor Taicheng passed away, he had endured too many sins that he should not have endured at his age.
However, this was not the end. Another month passed, and the little emperor sent out two groups of people to distribute silver for disaster relief, but in the end the silver disappeared, and even the people who were sent out were killed.
Ye Shuo followed the clues and finally they all pointed to the Tenth Prince, the Eleventh Prince, the Twelfth Prince and others who had never been taken seriously in Shangjing City.
They were all princes, and they also had legitimate identities, so why were they always inferior to their brothers?
Ye Shuo was annoyed, but he had no way to really do anything to them based on these.
It’s just guesswork, without real evidence it won’t count.
The most important thing now is to calm the people in several places where the plague is most severe.
The two previous failures had caused public outrage, and no accidents could happen for the third time. The person must be delivered safely, and the status of the escort must be high enough, otherwise the anger of the people could not be quelled.
The best candidates are Ye Shuo, He Xiang, Prince Su, Prince Jin and Prince Ding. He Xiang, Prince Su and Prince Jin are all old, especially He Xiang. His old bones cannot withstand such torture. He might die before he even arrives. As for Prince Ding, his legs are too slow. If his journey is delayed, the situation will be even more serious.
In the end, after counting, only Ye Shuo was left.
Ye Shuo didn’t know whether the Tenth Prince and his men had done this on purpose, but now the arrow was on the string and he had to shoot.
Just as Ye Shuo was about to speak, he heard the Seventh Prince take the initiative to take on this task.
The Seventh Prince is such a smart man, how could he not understand his current difficulties?
“This time, just consider it as paying back what I owe you.”
Leaving Ye Shuo in shock, the Seventh Prince left with his men.
As expected, the seventh prince also failed to escape the assassination.
What’s more, this assassination came earlier than any previous one.
I’m afraid Xiao Ming’s attention at the beginning was all on the fifth prince and other two princes. He didn’t even know where the tenth prince, the eleventh prince, and the twelfth prince had such a group of people.
Xiao Ming doesn’t even know how long Ye Shuo has been here. It would be strange if he could find out where they hide their people.
Without caring about anything else, Ye Shuo asked Li Yuheng to help keep a close eye on the Tenth, Eleventh, and Twelfth Princes. He also asked his eldest cousin to place people in the palace to help take care of the little emperor. Only then did Ye Shuo lead his troops to rescue people.
I thought this time it would be foolproof. The Seventh Prince wasn’t far away, and the round trip would only take two days at most.
As a result, just as Ye Shuo rescued the seventh prince, news came that the little emperor had a high fever and seemed to have contracted an epidemic.
It turns out that there are so many people who want the little emperor to die.
Ye Shuo’s mind suddenly went blank.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Farewell
chapters.content:
“…Come back soon.” The Seventh Prince opened his mouth, feeling that something was a little unusual.
“Be careful.”
“The same to you.”
Ye Shuo didn’t say anything, and without even having time to wash the blood off his body, he gritted his teeth and climbed onto the horse.
The next moment, Qingfeng rushed out like lightning, as if to break through the night.
On the other side, Liangzhou.
Ever since the plague began to spread, Yao Zhi has been feeling uneasy.
Although Ye Shuo is now the regent, Yao Zhi knows that he does not have much power. If Shangjing City is really that safe, Emperor Taicheng would not have entrusted the position of regent to him before his death.
Now that the new emperor is young and the Great Zhou has suddenly suffered such a natural disaster, his days in the capital must be extremely difficult. Although I don’t have much ability, it is not a problem for me to guard him and protect him.
Things have changed so much at this time and such a big change has happened. If I continue to stay like this, I’m afraid it won’t work.Yao Zhi looked at her daughter who was sleeping soundly on the bed. After a while, Yao Zhi finally carried her daughter out. Yao Zhi handed her daughter to the Imperial Concubine and several masters, and expressed her wishes. The Imperial Concubine was about to speak, but Dingning was still so young, but she heard another voice coming from not far away.
“Sister-in-law, I will go with you.” Regardless of whether she is a princess of the Great Zhou or her brother’s sister, Jianjian has the responsibility to do so.
Jianjian usually wanders around outside and doesn’t come back, but she still had to go back after her niece was born. As a result, this time, she was delayed for so long.
After more than three years, Jianjian has become much more mature than before. Although her face is still childish, her eyes are exceptionally bright.
Even Wu Yi made a rare appearance.
Emperor Jingwen’s last will asked him to protect the safety of the Ninth Prince. At this moment, it was impossible for Wu Yi to sit still.
Seeing this, what could the Imperial Concubine say against it?
“It’s a blessing for Shuo’er to marry you.” How many people in the world can do this?
It’s human nature to covet pleasure and stability, to seek benefits and avoid harm. Even between husband and wife, most of them will flee when disaster strikes. Dingning is only two or three months old now, and it’s the time when she needs her mother. Even if Yao Zhi doesn’t go back, no one will say anything.
Yao Zhi shook her head when she heard this: “Xiao Shuo and I are just supporting each other.”
Yao Zhi was confident that if it were her and she were in danger, he would rush to her side regardless of the consequences.
The Great Zhou was in a precarious situation right now. They were far away in Liangzhou and didn’t know what was happening in the capital. Ye Shuo hadn’t sent a letter for some time. If something really happened to him, Liangzhou might not be safe.
Therefore, before leaving, Yao Zhi specifically reminded: “The situation is complicated now, no matter who it is, please pay more attention to it, Master.”
Once they find something wrong, several masters, together with the people in the martial arts world who are on good terms with Yao Zhi, should be able to help the Imperial Concubine and her daughter escape.
Huo Tianyi and the beautiful woman are also old hands, experienced and with sharp eyes, so they naturally understand what their disciple means.
“Don’t worry, with us here, nothing will happen.”
After explaining everything that needed to be explained, Yao Zhi, jianjian, and Wu Yi looked at each other, mounted their horses, and headed for the mysterious and dangerous Shangjing at full speed. Ɍ𝘈𐌽ꝋ𝐁Ës̈
*
When Ye Shuo returned to the palace, the entire Chengming Palace had been sealed off.
Ye Shuo casually pulled a palace servant over and asked sternly, “Where is the emperor? How is the emperor?”
Such a thing happened in the palace, and there was already chaos. The palace servants were panicked, and when they heard the voice, they subconsciously wanted to salute, but Ye Shuo grabbed them and asked again.
“I ask you, is His Majesty in there now?”
The palace servants responded and nodded hurriedly: “No, not only His Majesty is here, but the Empress Dowager is here too.”
When the little emperor was diagnosed with an illness by the imperial physician, Empress Dowager He issued an imperial decree to seal off the palace immediately. Seeing that the little emperor was so young, how could Empress Dowager He bear to leave him alone in there? So she was sealed in along with the little emperor.
The little emperor is still young and has not yet started a family. The ones who are in charge of everything in the palace now are the childless concubines of the previous emperor, Concubine Wu and several others.
Hearing this, Ye Shuo wanted to walk in without thinking. However, he was stopped by someone after taking just two steps.
“Your Majesty, you must not do that, Your Majesty! You cannot go in!”
Now, Ye Shuo just wanted to know how his nephew was doing.
However, what he didn’t expect was that Empress Dowager He seemed to have anticipated it and had issued an imperial decree in advance.
“It’s the Ninth Uncle, the Ninth Uncle is back…” The little emperor lying on the bed heard the familiar voice and forced himself to open his eyes.
When Empress Dowager He heard this, she couldn’t help but feel a lump in her throat.
“Yes, Jin’er, your uncle is back. He definitely doesn’t want to see you like this, so Jin’er, promise your mother that you will cheer up, okay?”
“But… son is really sleepy…” The little emperor, who had vomited five or six times, tried to stay awake, but had no choice but to fall into a deep sleep.
Empress Dowager He felt nervous and looked hurriedly at the imperial physician beside her. When she saw that the little emperor was fine for the time being, she reluctantly breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, Empress Dowager He came to the door.
“The Regent.”
Looking at the tightly closed palace gate, Ye Shuo was filled with anxiety when he suddenly heard a familiar female voice from inside.
Ye Shuo subconsciously bowed: “Empress Dowager, how is the emperor?”
The place where the Seventh Prince had the accident was a full day’s journey from Shangjing. He rushed back before dawn today. One can imagine how anxious he was on the road. Empress Dowager He looked through the crack in the door and saw that the blood on his body had dried up and turned dark red, which made her even more certain.
Empress Dowager He was not blind. She knew very well how much the Regent cared about her over the past six months, and there was no doubt whether it was true or not.
Empress Dowager He knew that he was anxious, but the more anxious he was, the more he could not lose his composure.
What happens to mother and son depends entirely on him and his grandfather.
“The Emperor is safe for now. Prince Regent, please do not worry and do not come in. Remember, you are still in charge of all matters in the court.”
No one in the royal family or the court is at peace, and there are too many eyes watching her and her son.
With Empress Dowager He’s attitude, it was confirmed that it was an epidemic. Ye Shuo no longer had any hope.
“I understand.”
“I will definitely live up to the trust of His Majesty and the Empress Dowager.”
But Jin’er is still so young. If he were to find out who did this, he would be skinned alive and tortured to death!
He reluctantly responded, and when Ye Shuo turned around again, his eyes were filled with an unprecedented murderous intent.
The little emperor was already weak, and it was inevitable that he would die even if he was well taken care of, let alone now! ?
Noticing that a palace servant next to him had a strange look on his face, Ye Shuo turned a corner and saw that the other party had followed him.
After a little verification, Ye Shuo knew that this person was the one who was planted in the palace by his eldest cousin.
Ye Shuo did not hesitate and spoke: “Do you know who did this?”
Ye Shuo quickly filtered out several names in his mind, even the seventh prince was on the list.
However, what he did not expect was that the palace servant said that this was a complete accident. It was a servant who went out to purchase goods in the palace who accidentally contracted the epidemic while out. After several rounds of infection, he accidentally infected the little emperor.
Ye Shuo’s first reaction after hearing this was: “Impossible.”
How could there be such a coincidence in the world? As soon as he left, the little emperor was infected with the plague. It was as if the plague was specially targeted at the little emperor when his defence was weakest. It must be man-made.
But Ye Shuo’s cousin’s servant still believed it, so there was only one possibility.
That person hid himself so well that he even managed to deceive the Empress Dowager and my eldest cousin.
Ye Shuo then went to find General Li Yuheng. Before Li Yuheng could salute, Ye Shuo’s voice, as if filled with ice, came over.
“Commander Li, if you are really so afraid of the powerful, you don’t have to take this position as commander.”
“When I left the capital, I asked you to keep a close eye on the Kings and the others. Is this how you did it?”
It’s called surveillance, but in fact it’s almost the same as house arrest.
Sure enough, when Li Yuheng heard this, he knelt down immediately and said, “The Regent King is very observant. I am sure that every move of the Tenth King, the Eleventh King, and the Twelfth King is under my surveillance.”
If he doesn’t even have this ability, how can he sit in this position?
Ye Shuo stared at him for a long time, and Li Yuheng broke out in a cold sweat.
After a while, Ye Shuo didn’t say anything and let him go.
The little emperor was born with a defect, and he was deficient since birth. He managed to grow some flesh on his face, but he was unable to resist the aggressive epidemic.
In just two days, countless medicines were taken, but to no avail.
Empress Dowager He watched helplessly as the look of death visibly spread across her son’s face.
“Mother…Jin’er is so scared. Jin’er doesn’t want to die…”
The little emperor was just a child after all. When that day really came, how could he not be afraid? The little emperor was so scared that he was shaking.
“Uncle Jiu, Uncle Jiu, save me…”
Standing outside the wall, Ye Shuo felt as if his heart was about to burst, and a fishy and sweet taste kept surging in his throat.
“Don’t panic, Jin’er. Don’t panic, Uncle Jiu is here. Uncle Jiu is just outside.”
In a trance, the little emperor seemed to hear a familiar voice. Later, perhaps realising that struggling was useless, the little emperor gradually gave up.
“Mother, I seem to have seen Father…”
I’m sorry, father. Jin’er is useless and cannot fulfil your request.
But don’t worry, Father, Uncle Nine will definitely complete it for me.
“Mother, Mother… I left something for Uncle Nine…”
Since so many people want this position, I will not give it to them. Even if I have to give it to them, I will keep it for the person who treats me the best.
Although he was not Uncle Jiu’s most beloved nephew, he left all the best things to him. In this way, even if Uncle Jiu had his own children, he would surely remember him.
Ye Jin has never really been a child in his life, but now he is finally being willful.
Anyway, when he dies, he won’t know anything. Even if it is a problem, it will be others who find it troublesome.
Maybe it was because he had foreseen the headaches everyone was having, but the little emperor suddenly felt his stomach ache go away. Foreseeing the chaos that would come with the adults in the future, he couldn’t help but laughed triumphantly.
The next moment, the smile shrank and withered like a flower bud. When the imperial physician checked again, he found that the little emperor had already died.
Then, a roll of imperial edict made of precious silk fell into Ye Shuo’s hands.
Uncle, uncle, I’m leaving now. I leave this place to you.
In a trance, Ye Shuo seemed to see his little nephew waving goodbye to him in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 270: Ye Xun
chapters.content:
“I don’t know when Jin’er wrote this will, but since it is Jin’er’s wish, I will give it to you.” Within a year, she lost her husband and then her son. Although Empress Dowager He was very lucky and did not contract the disease, she was exhausted and haggard.
Of course, Empress Dowager He was not completely selfless. Emperor Taicheng did not leave any other offspring, and Jin’er was still young and had not yet reached his first stage of pregnancy, so it was impossible for his bloodline to exist in the palace.
If Jin’er was older, Empress Dowager He would find a way to ask him to keep the child no matter what. Really… Empress Dowager He didn’t care no matter what method was used.
But now, things have become a foregone conclusion and there is no way to change them.
No matter who will succeed him, he and his family will be thorns in the eyes of the new emperor. Only if he is the regent, the situation may be slightly better.
“I have already conveyed Jin’er’s intentions. The regent will decide the details on his own…”
At this moment, Empress Dowager He no longer had any energy left. She just felt extremely tired, so tired that she didn’t even have the strength to speak. Without waiting for the young man opposite to speak, Empress Dowager He left with the help of the palace maids.
Before leaving, Empress Dowager He seemed to remember something, and finally said: “By the way, after daybreak, Jin’er’s body will be burned. Jin’er missed you the most before he died. Please ask the Regent to send Jin’er off tomorrow. This way, it can be regarded as Jin’er’s last wish.” Burn? !
Ye Shuo suddenly raised his head.
You have to know that in ancient times, the ancients paid attention to being buried in peace. Even if they died, they wanted to keep their bodies intact. This was true for common people, let alone the emperor.Since they were burning the bodies, they were treating themselves as ordinary patients suffering from the plague.
If the superiors lead by example and set a good example themselves, if this matter were to spread among the people, it would surely be of great help in eliminating the epidemic.
You know, one of the reasons why the plague spread repeatedly was that many people could not bear to see their loved ones being burned, so they sneaked in, then found the bodies of their loved ones and took them home to bury them, which caused the plague to spread again and affect the neighbours.
Ye Shuo didn’t know who came up with the idea, was it Empress Dowager He or Jin’er himself, but no matter who it was, it was enough to make people heartbroken.
Ye Shuo stood where he was, pinching the joints made of precious silk, which turned fiercely white.
Obviously everything was moving in the right direction before. If only I had been more careful, everything would have been fine.
A night passed, and even though the little emperor of the Great Zhou died last night, the sun still rose as usual early this morning.
The little emperor was weak, fell ill quickly, and left in a hurry, so Prince Su and Prince Jin entered the palace early in the morning.
Although the purpose was to burn the remains to completely stop the plague from spreading in the palace and even in the capital, the necessary procedures could not be omitted at all.
Prince Su and Prince Jin, wearing thick clothes and with their faces covered, examined the little emperor’s body. After confirming that the little emperor died of plague and was not murdered by anyone, they poured strong liquor on the little emperor’s body in front of the two witnesses. ꞦＡNȮBËŜ
Then, there was a raging fire.
The clothes of the two were also thrown into the fire and were quickly burned to ashes.
Including this time, since taking over the royal family, Prince Su and Prince Jin have helped deal with such matters for the nth time. Sometimes it was their biological brothers, sometimes it was their nephews, and now it is finally the turn of their grandchildren.
It would be fine if they were older and had more experience, but the young man next to them had no less experience than them at a young age.
Finally, Prince Su stood beside the young man and said, “Alas…take it easy.”
Birth, ageing, illness and death are the norm in life. How many people in this world can live in peace and happiness until the end of their lives? Even if you are a member of the royal family, you are no more noble than ordinary people in this regard.
What Ye Shuo was concerned about was not this, but…
“My two uncles, what do you think? If I hadn’t said those words to him before, would Jin’er have been less miserable in the end?” Since he was going to die in the end, wouldn’t it be better for him to stay the way he was?
If Jin’er was like his father, he would at most be unwilling in the end, but he clearly didn’t want to die in the end. He wanted to live, but he still died in the end.
A person who originally had no hope was given hope by himself, but in the end this glimmer of hope was ruthlessly taken away. Ye Shuo felt it was extremely cruel just thinking about it.
“He is still so young. He has not experienced all the beautiful things in the world.”
“Tell me, has Jin’er ever been truly happy in his life?”
Prince Su and Prince Jin didn’t know, and Ye Shuo didn’t know either.
Prince Su opened his mouth, but in the end only said two words.
“…My condolences.”
Ye Shuo looked at the flames in the distance, shook his head and said nothing.
Finally, after Prince Su and Prince Jin left and the fire burned out, Ye Shuo saw Empress Dowager He and many palace servants carefully picking out the little emperor’s bones, then breaking them up bit by bit with a hammer and putting them into a jar.
There were traces of charcoal on Empress Dowager He’s hands, face and body. The moment the jar was sealed, Empress Dowager He could no longer hold back and burst into tears.
The entire palace seemed to be crying for it.
He quickly wiped his face with his sleeve, and before the palace servants around him could see clearly, Ye Shuo turned around, leaving only his back to everyone.
For some reason, the palace people always felt that the Regent seemed to have changed at this moment, but when they looked carefully, it seemed not to be the case, as if the moment just now was just an illusion.
After Ye Shuo left the palace, the first person he visited was his eldest cousin.
There was a slight “dong” sound. Looking at the precious silk scroll on the table, Wei Wen was wondering what it meant. Wei Wen opened it and took a look. When he saw what was written inside, his face changed drastically.
“This… this is actually…” This is actually the edict of succession left by the young emperor!
Although Wei Wen had just become the little emperor’s teacher, he still recognized the little emperor’s handwriting.
“It’s just what you thought.” Ye Shuo didn’t know what to say. When Emperor Taicheng died, he became the regent. Now that the little emperor was gone, he was going to become the emperor soon. The way these father and son acted made Ye Shuo want to curse.
“Cousin, what do you think?”
Wei Wen curled his lips: “…How should I know?”
Wei Wen had indeed seen many storms, but this was the first time he had seen such a big scene.
The only thing Wei Wen knew was that his little cousin couldn’t run away this time even if he wanted to.
Once this edict was issued, he had to become emperor even if he didn’t want to. Otherwise, no matter which prince succeeded to the throne next, he would surely die.
Not only will he die, but everyone around him will die too.
I would like to ask, which emperor would let go of his little cousin who is the most legitimate and orthodox? If he doesn’t die, the new emperor will not be able to maintain his position.
But in fact, where are the princes?
“The eldest brother is disabled and powerless. The fifth, seventh and eighth brothers were beaten by the sixth brother and are now barely alive. It is simply a pipe dream to want them to rise again in a short time.” And a prince who has no power in his hands, even if he is healthy, will never be able to take the throne.
“Little Ten, Little Eleven and Little Twelve are indeed capable, but once this matter is over and the whereabouts of the dirty silver is found out, they will definitely not have a good ending.” Not to mention the princes after Little Twelve, as they are naturally incompatible with the throne.
So after counting, who else could there be besides me?
“If they can ascend to the throne, then the princes of the royal family can also ascend to the throne.”
Wei Wen opened his mouth and finally said, “Look at the bright side… At least, the backup plans you arranged won’t be needed.”
At the very least, the Duke Zhen’s Mansion is completely safe.
Ye Shuo paused and sighed: “Yeah…”
Wei Wen always felt that something was wrong, but before he could think about it, the young man in front of him suddenly said, “By the way, what do you think about me passing the throne to Xun’er?”
The moment the words fell, Wei Wen’s eyes widened: “Are you crazy!? Or are you kidding?”
“I’m not kidding. I’m serious.”
Ye Shuo counted on his fingers: “Think about it, Xun’er is the prince’s legitimate son, and now he is a prince, and he is also of legitimate birth. If we brothers fail, it will be the same for him.”
“You have to know that Xun’er’s status is naturally more noble than the Tenth Prince, the Eleventh Prince, and the Twelfth Prince. If it weren’t for the problem that Third Brother had back then, he should have been the one sitting in this position now.”
“Now, I am just returning what belongs to him.”
After listening to this analysis, Wei Wen was almost irritated to the point of vomiting blood by his little cousin, and his whole body was shaking.
Crazy, crazy, really crazy!
“My little cousin, do you know that people can change?” Even if he was raised by his own hands, what would that do? When was the imperial power not stained with blood?
However, Ye Shuo ignored him.
“Xun’er and I grew up together, so he is different… Never mind, I won’t tell you anymore. I might as well go and ask him directly.”
Looking around, I accidentally saw something hanging on the wall of my eldest cousin.
The Duke of Zhen’s Mansion was founded by military generals, so naturally, weapons are the majority of its decorations.
“This sword is quite good. It should be made of cold steel that was made by the Ministry of Industry in the past two years. I see it is covered with dust. I guess you don’t use it on weekdays. How about lending it to me for a while?”
Without waiting for Wei Wen to react, Ye Shuo took off the long sword.
Seeing his little cousin turning around and about to leave, Wei Wen became completely anxious.
“This matter is of great importance. I hope my little cousin will think twice!”
It was a different time at the moment. Wei Wen didn’t want him to fight at first. He was even more determined to protect the entire Zhen Mansion. He put the safety of the Zhen Mansion in the first place and regarded his family as more important than anything else. But now it has come to the point where he has to fight.
It was not until this moment that Wei Wen’s thoughts completely changed.
From a distance, Wei Wen saw his little cousin waving at him.
“Don’t worry, cousin. I know what I am doing.”
In fact, what Ye Shuo didn’t say was that if Ye Xun didn’t move, Ye Shuo would pass the throne to him. If Ye Xun had any other intentions, then…
Ye Shuo closed his eyes and clenched the long sword in his hand.
So Xun’er, please don’t move around.

chapters.title: Chapter 271: Murder
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo came at the right time, as Ye Xun was at home when he arrived.
“You seem to be free, but things are going haywire outside. Didn’t you say you just got an errand? Why didn’t you go today?”
At that time, Ye Xun was practising calligraphy in the study. When he heard the noise outside, his hands trembled and the words he wrote were almost ruined.
“Tsk, the word ‘静’ is written very well.” Ye Shuo looked down and couldn’t help but praise him. Unconsciously, the young man in front of him had grown from a teenager to a real adult.
Looking at the person who suddenly appeared, Ye Xun shouted helplessly: “Uncle Jiu.”
“Uncle Jiu, next time you come in, could you please give me a heads up or ask someone to let me know? It’s really scary.”
Ye Shuo didn’t care: “What’s the matter?”
Ye Xun had long been accustomed to his lazy behaviour and was now too lazy to correct it. He carefully lifted the word “静” and looked at it carefully. Still not satisfied, Ye Xun crumpled it into a ball and threw it aside.
As he threw the ball, he said, “The court has been in a mess lately, and the superiors couldn’t take care of me, so they asked me to come back first.”
“Besides, Uncle Jiu, you are the same, too, with so much free time.”“What nonsense are you talking about? Your uncle is so busy. I just came back from my eldest cousin’s place and happened to pass by here, so I wanted to hide away for a while.”
The handsome young man seemed to be very tired. Indeed, so many things had happened in the palace recently, which really kept him very busy.
These things shouldn’t be his business.
Hearing this, Ye Xun couldn’t help but sigh: “Thank you for your hard work, Uncle Jiu.”
“So, just ask Uncle Jiu to stay here and be lazy for a while, just half a day.” Ye Shuo couldn’t help but put his hands together.
Ye Xun was extremely helpless.
But then Ye Xun thought again, didn’t he go to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion just now? Why didn’t he rest there? Also, the long sword in his hand is——
Noticing that his eyes fell on his right hand, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but shrug: “It’s beautiful, right? I just snatched it from Wei Wen’s study.”
Ye Xun was stunned: “You and Lord Wei are…”
“Oh, don’t mention it. We just had an argument and almost got into a fight. But I snatched his knife, so it wasn’t too bad.” Ye Shuo put the long knife on the table next to him with a clang. ȓ𝐀𝐍ọВЕŚ
Ye Xun couldn’t help but sweat.
In the morning, Ye Shuo watched helplessly as a huge fire burned the little emperor’s body to ashes. He did not even have time to eat lunch before going to look for his eldest cousin. Now, after such a delay, it was already the afternoon and it was almost evening time. It was almost dark. Ye Shuo felt hungry all day.
Now that he had arrived at his nephew’s house, Ye Shuo collapsed all of a sudden.
“Hurry up, ask someone to prepare some good wine and food. Your uncle will starve to death if he doesn’t eat.”
Ye Xun was just about to say that no eating was allowed in the study, not even cakes or snacks, let alone good wine and delicious food.
But before he could open his mouth, Ye Shuo closed his eyes and even started snoring. Ye Xun immediately closed his mouth.
…Forget it, just this once.
About half an hour later, Ye Shuo heard someone calling from the side: “Uncle Jiu, Uncle Jiu, the food is ready, get up quickly.”
Ye Shuo opened his eyes and saw that the table not far away was filled with hot food.
“Come on, come on, sit down and eat together.”
Ye Shuo was sleepy and yawned. Then he pulled the reluctant Ye Xun to sit down without saying anything.
Ye Shuo never drank alcohol before, but today he drank for the first time in his life, as if he wanted to swallow down the pain in his heart along with the liquor.
As Ye Shuo drank more, he talked more. He couldn’t help but put his arm on Ye Xun’s shoulder and kept mumbling: “Tell me, why are all of you leaving in such a hurry?”
From the Crown Prince, the Fourth Prince, the Second Prince, the Thirteenth Prince, and later Emperor Taicheng and the Little Emperor, even he was plagued by illness and pain in the few months before his father’s death. It can be said that none of them had a good end.
Especially Jin’er.
“He is still so young, he doesn’t know anything, he is still a child. Xun’er, you don’t know, Jin’er was still calling my name when he died. He asked me to save him, he asked me to save him!”
“But not only did I fail to save him, I couldn’t save others either.” There were so many people, and he couldn’t save any of them.
When he said the latter part, Ye Shuo was trembling all over.
Feeling the alcohol smell coming towards him, Ye Xun subconsciously said, “Uncle Jiu, you are drunk.”
Ye Xun wiped his face, then put the drunkard Ye Shuo on the table, and then stood up hurriedly: “Uncle Jiu, you stay here first, don’t move, I’ll go to the kitchen to bring you a bowl of sobering soup.”
Having said that, Ye Xun hurried out.
The moment Ye Xun walked out of the yard, a black shadow appeared in front of him.
This person was none other than one of the assassins that the crown prince had raised before. Emperor Jingwen suspected that the assassination was done by the crown prince because of these people, which shows that the crown prince also had extraordinary means in private.
Since the crown prince committed suicide, the matter of the assassins has been left unresolved. As the prince’s only legitimate son, Ye Xun, after the prince’s death, everything eventually fell into his hands after several twists and turns.
The black shadow was like a secret guard, kneeling as soon as he saw them.
“Your Highness, I have indeed found out that only the Regent came here.” He has been alone since he entered the door, and more than an hour has passed, but no one has come to look for him, which shows that the Regent has indeed not suspected anyone else.
Uncle Jiu has always been like this, always trusting the people around him.
Ye Xun grew up beside him, so he was naturally familiar with his personality and all his little hobbies and habits.
But now, the time has come to make a choice.
The tenth king, the eleventh king and the twelfth king planned to launch an uprising tonight. If they could not make a decision in time, all their previous plans would be in vain.
The only way for him to get his hands on that position is to use the banner of clearing the court of emperors. By then, he will be the righteous one and the princes will be the rebels. As long as he shows his power at the right time, it will be enough to intimidate the officials of the royal family. Who can deny him by saying that his father was deposed?
As for the Fifth, Seventh, and Eighth Kings, they are now just useless people without any power, and have long been driven out of the competition. Speaking of this, we have to thank the Sixth Emperor uncle. If the Sixth Emperor uncle had not held them to death with his last breath, all this would not have been so easy.
Ye Xun didn’t learn anything else from his uncle, but he learned patience and endurance completely.
As long as one waits patiently and prepares carefully, the opportunity will always come. Facts have proved that after waiting for so long, he finally got it.
The only thing that caught Ye Xun off guard now was the sudden appearance of the Ninth Prince.
Ye Xun had made a thousand calculations, but he could never have expected that the little emperor would leave behind such a will before his death. With the will in hand, the Ninth Prince suddenly became a more legitimate and orthodox person than anyone else.
If the Ninth Prince is not removed, all other matters will be in vain and only empty talk will remain.
If it were anyone else, it would be fine. Ye Xun was no longer the dotted grandson of the emperor and he could kill him without blinking an eye. But the Ninth Uncle… Ye Xun really couldn’t bring himself to do it.
However, now that things have come to this, it is too late to ask him to stop now.
As if seeing the prince’s dilemma, the man in black couldn’t help but urge, “I have received news that the bandits outside have already started to gather half an hour ago. They will come to Shangjing at night. I hope your highness will not be soft-hearted and make a decision early!”
Now that they have such a good opportunity, they can simply push the death of the regent onto the Tenth King, the Eleventh King, and the Twelfth King. Then their trip will definitely be more legitimate. If they accidentally miss it, they will never have it again.
Behind the Regent stood the Zhen Mansion, General Wei, the former retainers of the Zhen Mansion, and even the eldest prince was standing behind him. Although some things were not what he wanted, he was innocent until he was found guilty of possessing a treasure.
“Young Prince, if you don’t take action, His Royal Highness the Crown Prince will have died in vain!” Even people like them will be buried with him. The arrow is on the string and must be shot.
Maybe it was the word “Crown Prince” that touched him, but after a while, Ye Xun spoke in a hoarse voice: “In that case, then… let’s do it.”
The reason why his father died might not be because he was too soft-hearted. Even if he had the chance, he would never kill his brothers. So in the end, it was him who died and not others.
Uncle Six wins because he is ruthless. Not only is he ruthless to others, he is even more ruthless to himself.
Ye Xun will not make the same mistake twice.
As for Uncle Jiu’s kindness in the past, I can only repay it in the next life.
“Uncle Jiu, don’t blame me…”
When he noticed the unusual movements around him, Ye Shuo, who was leaning over the table, couldn’t hold back his tears.
Ye Xun could even kill him, let alone the little emperor.
And if he wanted to kill me, it couldn’t be without reason, unless… he knew that the little emperor left a will for me.
As for the matter of the will, up to now, only the Empress Dowager He and my eldest cousin knew about it. If anyone else knew about it, they must have deep roots in the palace.
How many people in this world can hide the truth from the Empress Dowager and Wei Wen in the palace?
The former crown prince had been the heir to the throne for thirty years, so how could he not have some foundation in the palace? It was no big deal for Ye Xun to find a few spies.
Maybe I should have thought of it earlier.
The long sword narrowly grazed Ye Shuo’s cheek, and a few strands of hair were cut off. The uncle-nephew relationship between Ye Shuo and Ye Xun was also cut off like the hair.
Ye Xun and Ye Shuo are uncle and nephew after all, so he naturally couldn’t bear to see his closest uncle die under the knife of the assassins, so he wanted to leave when everyone started to attack.
But what did he see the next moment?
When Ye Xun turned around, he saw only the flash of swords all over the sky.
Gorgeous, beautiful and… endless murderous intent. With just one knife, the first assassin who rushed into the study was killed on the spot.
One drop, two drops, three drops, in just a moment, a small pool of blood had gathered under Ye Shuo’s feet, but he was still walking steadily towards Ye Xun’s direction.
When he saw this scene, Ye Xun’s pupils suddenly shrank.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Heart Piercing
chapters.content:
Ye Xun had just imagined many scenes, but he had never thought it would be like this.
You know, the group of death warriors left by my father may not be as good as the secret guards under my grandfather, but they are on par with those under Emperor Taicheng, and much stronger than those under the young emperor. They are all good seedlings that can fight ten against one, and are far from ordinary people.
But now, his uncle, the dandy in the eyes of the world, was chopping his sword as easily as cutting melons and vegetables. Every time he swung his sword, a string of blood was drawn.
For the first time, Ye Xun discovered that when the Ninth Prince didn’t smile, he was so terrifying.
If Ye Shuo was still immature when he encountered the assassination attempt, now under the careful teaching of Yao Zhi and several masters, his profound internal strength has been completely mastered and can be used at will.
Not to mention Ye Xun, even the leading assassins did not expect things to turn out like this.
In the past, the leader of the death squad had heard a lot about the Ninth Prince’s deeds during his training. He had been hearing these stories for so many years and had heard them so many times that he thought he was just an ignorant and incompetent prince. But when he saw him today, he realised that what he heard was untrue.
The leading assassin’s veins popped out, and he saw the right opportunity and swung his sword at the young man’s back. Unexpectedly, the young man’s back seemed to have eyes. The leading assassin’s eyes blurred at first, and then he was attacked by a huge force.
With a “clang” sound, the horizontal sword hit the back of the sword hard, and almost instantly, the long sword in the hand of the assassin broke.
The leading assassin instinctively wanted to retreat, regardless of his numb right hand and cracked knuckles, but it was too late.In the last moment of consciousness, all that was left in the eyes of the dead man was the sharp cold light of the sword and the icy eyes of the young man.
However, within a short period of time of just one stick of incense, all the eighteen assassins here were wiped out!
Ye Xun’s steps stopped abruptly when Ye Shuo came over.
Obviously, he also knew that with the force that the Ninth Prince had just displayed, he would not be able to escape no matter what.
At this moment, Ye Xun’s throat kept tightening and a trace of cold sweat slid down his forehead.
“You…are not drunk?”
“No.” Sometimes, Ye Shuo really wished he was drunk.
Ye Xun’s gaze fell from his face to the tip of the knife in his hand that was dripping with blood.
At this moment Ye Xun felt that the uncle in front of him, who was closer to him than his own brother, suddenly became a stranger.
“I never knew before that you, Ninth Prince, are so powerful.”
Or maybe, all of them were deceived by the person in front of them.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but tighten the sword in his hand: “I never thought that the first person who made me use all my martial arts would be you.”
Ye Shuo thought of many people, including his biological father in this life, but he was not one of them.
At this point, is there anything Ye Xun doesn’t understand?
The reason why he came alone was not because he had no doubts in his heart, but because he had the ability and the confidence. Even so many well-trained assassins combined were not his match. ṟÅ₦о𐌱Еṣ
so……
“Are you here today specifically to test me?”
Ye Xun really couldn’t understand where he had been exposed. It had only been three days since the little emperor fell ill and died. How could he have suspected himself?
But in fact, Ye Shuo couldn’t find any evidence at all.
“I have to admit that you are much more capable than your father, and you hid it very well. Even Wei Wen and Queen Mother He combined could not find anything, let alone me.”
“I even suspected Wei Wen before.”
Ye Shuo believed in the old Duke Zhen because he was his mother’s father and his grandfather. Ye Shuo believed in his uncles and cousins ​​because they were indeed kind-hearted. As for Wei Wen, although Ye Shuo had known him for so many years, they came together for their own interests, just to protect the people they cherished.
Although the possibility that it was Wei Wen was not high, it was still possible. After Ye Shuo tested it, it was finally confirmed.
If we rule out the internal traitor, the person must be an external thief, and this person has very deep roots.
The royal family, like Prince Su, has had so many emperors. How can they have any power in the palace? The fifth and seventh princes are restraining each other, the eldest prince is always keeping a close eye on the eighth prince, and as for the tenth prince, they are also under Ye Shuo’s surveillance. Who else can have such ability and let himself be defenceless?
“You are indeed smart, but it is because you are too smart that it is easier for people to guess.”
However, Ye Xun felt that this clever remark should clearly be given to himself.
“So you have no evidence, so you can only use yourself as bait to lure me into the trap.”
“Yes, I want to see if it is you. If it is you, how far have you come now and what are your intentions.”
Ye Xun took some action, proving that he knew about the will.
The fact that Ye Xun wanted to kill him even proved that he had gone a very long way and now the arrow was on the string and had to be shot.
Ye Xun took such a big risk and was so cruel, which proved that his purpose was not only to avenge his father, but also proved that he had bigger ambitions.
“You want to be the emperor.”
Ye Shuo’s answer was not doubt, but affirmation.
“The Ten Kings, the Eleven Kings, and the Twelve Kings are just a means for you to cover up your tracks. I guess the reason why Sixth Brother couldn’t find out about them is not because the Ten Kings, the Eleven Kings, and the Twelve Kings are so powerful, nor because Sixth Brother is negligent, but because you are behind them, cleaning up the mess for them. Am I right?”
The Tenth King, the Eleventh King, and the Twelfth King probably don’t know until now that the reason their power has developed so smoothly is because there is a hand supporting them from behind.
However, Ye Xun hid behind the three of them and thus deceived everyone.
As Ye Shuo talked more and more, Ye Xun became more and more powerless.
“It’s true… I can’t hide anything from you, Uncle Nine…”
“But there is one thing that I don’t understand. You obviously know everything, so why are you still like this?” What Ye Xun was referring to was, of course, his absurdity and confusion.
None of them are stupid. Are they really careless or are they just pretending? If they are really pretending, no matter how smart they are, how could none of them notice anything?
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, then asked, “What do you think?”
Ye Xun finally couldn’t help laughing, and tears came out of his eyes.
“My God, he really likes to play tricks on people.”
Isn’t that right? You don’t get what you want, you lose what you try so hard to get, and you can’t get rid of what you don’t want.
He kept hiding and avoiding it, but in the end the throne fell on his head.
Ye Xun gradually became a little crazy, but Ye Shuo was not too worried.
Because of the plague, entry and exit to the capital are now strictly controlled. Even for Ye Xun, there is no way to get so many people into the city quietly.
At most, they were just some scattered assassins, and now they have all been killed by Ye Shuo’s knife. In this situation, Ye Shuo naturally didn’t mind talking to him more.
“Things have come to this point. I still have a few questions. For the sake of our relationship as uncle and nephew, I wonder if you could help me clear them up.”
Ye Xun paused and said, “You say.”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and asked, “Did you intervene in this plague?”
Ye Xun shook his head: “No.”
The plague is a natural disaster, how can it be controlled by human power?
“I also learned this trick from my sixth uncle.”
Ye Xun not only learned forbearance and ruthlessness from Emperor Taicheng, but also learned that he never went against the will of heaven, and learned the principle of going with the flow and taking advantage of the situation.
Take advantage of the natural force and seize every opportunity to achieve your goals.
Ye Xun felt that his Sixth Uncle was a really good teacher. In just a few years, he learned much more from his Sixth Uncle than he learned from his father.
“I just did the same thing as my sixth uncle.” Back then, the Sixth Prince and his entourage put pressure on his father little by little, forcing his father to take action, and watched his father go astray.
The Sixth Prince and his companions knew what his father had done behind his back, but they kept their mouths shut and refused to utter a single word. They waited for the situation to ferment gradually and eventually lead to a catastrophe, and then they would use a needle to pierce it and deal a fatal blow to his father.
It was the same with Ye Xun today. He just watched the Tenth King, the Eleventh King, and the Twelfth King loot the disaster silver to fill their own pockets, and then took this opportunity to fish in troubled waters and lure Ye Shuo out of the capital.
What’s more, even the idea of ​​poisoning the little emperor was not his. He just borrowed a few people to help them.
Just like Emperor Taicheng did back then, he would watch first, wait for the right time, and then take decisive action.
“So Uncle Jiu, don’t blame yourself too much. If it’s not the plague, it could be something else. You can’t stay by the little emperor’s side for twelve hours a day. If you make a mistake even once, the little emperor will eventually die.”
There is still a quarter of an hour before another wave of assassins will arrive to support him. If he can hold out for a quarter of an hour, he may still have a chance to escape.
Ye Xun thought for a moment and said, “Be careful of the Tenth Uncle and the others.”
Ye Shuo paused for a moment and said, “Are you saying that the three of the Ten Kings are planning to rebel tonight?”
He actually even knew this…
That’s right, if he didn’t know, he wouldn’t have chosen to come to me today and force me to take action.
Ye Xun was stunned, then smiled bitterly.
Soon, Ye Xun pretended to be relaxed and said, “I thought, Uncle Nine, you would ask me why it became like this.”
Ye Shuo shook his head: “There is nothing to ask, it’s just those reasons. Over the years, your uncle has heard too many of them, and I’m tired of them.”
Ye Xun is the legitimate son of the crown prince, and the future crown prince and even emperor. The throne of the Great Zhou should have been his.
Falling from the noble grandson of the emperor to the status of a prince, he would be completely indistinguishable from the crowd in a dozen or twenty years at most. Whenever he attended a palace banquet, as the grandson of the emperor, he was always seated at the forefront. But now he even has to burn incense to his grandfather and father in secret. Such a gap is really hard to accept.
“My mistake was that I thought you were different from others.”
Ye Xun couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this: “I am no different from other people. The Ninth Prince thinks too highly of me. I am just an ordinary person.”
Since he was born, Ye Xun was taught that he would be the future crown prince and the future emperor. But when he was sixteen years old, he was suddenly told that he was no longer the future emperor. So what were all the things in the past?
“Yeah… everyone is the same, there is no difference at all.” It was as if I was about to take this step now.
Ye Shuo lowered his eyes: “One last question.”
“Besides me, do you plan to do anything to my wife, my mother, my sister, or my daughter?”
Ye Xun was stunned, then avoided his gaze: “…If we send someone to chase them now, maybe we can still make it in time.”
When you cut the grass, you must remove the roots.
The moment the words fell, a cold light passed through Ye Xun’s chest.
At the same time, Ye Shuo also said the last words to him.
“You know, the reason why I quarrelled with Wei Wen before I came here today was because I told Wei Wen that if you don’t take any action, I will pass the throne to you.”
“Unfortunately, you finally disappointed me.”
“No, this is impossible!” How could anyone in this world do such a thing?
But Ye Xun also knew that the Ninth Prince would not lie to him.
In the end, Ye Xun left in shock and reluctance.
With a “clang”, Ye Shuo pulled out the sword in his hand and threw it down.
Looking at the young man who fell heavily to the ground, Ye Shuo’s mind was filled with scenes of his time with him. At that time, the two were still young, one was three years old, and the other was seven years old. The little children stamped their feet and shouted at him angrily: “Ninth Uncle!”
From now on, the emperor uncle might never hear these words again.
The people around you will eventually leave one after another.
Ye Xun once promised the former Crown Princess that he would repay his kindness, but Ye Xun did not do it in the end.
Ye Shuo had promised the former prince that he would take good care of him. Once upon a time, on the way to the palace, Ye Shuo even said that no matter what mistakes he made, he would forgive him in the end. However, Ye Shuo did not do so.
Those who reach the highest position indeed have their hands soaked in blood, and even he, a time traveller from modern times, is no exception.
When Yao Zhi and the other two arrived, they only heard the sounds of fighting outside the city, and their hearts immediately tightened.
“Where is the Regent? Where is the Regent now!?”
Yao Zhi asked many people in a row but they all said they didn’t know. In the end, she didn’t know who said that the Regent was with the Prince. Without bothering to verify the truth, Yao Zhi broke through the crowd and ran towards Ye Xun’s mansion.
“Xiao Shuo, outside Shangjing——”
Pushing open the heavy door in front of me, I saw corpses all over the ground. Even Ye Xun was lying there, and the young man sitting there alone had his hands and body covered in blood.
The incident must have happened not long ago, and the blood on his hands was still dripping into the soil under his feet.
In an instant, Yao Zhi’s pupils shrink suddenly.
Then, she watched the young man turn around when he heard the noise, his expression seemed dazed. He seemed to want to say something, but when he opened his mouth, he spat out a mouthful of blood.
Yao Zhi, Jian Jian, and Wu Yi were shocked, and Jian Jian even screamed uncontrollably—
“elder brother!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Make Do
chapters.content:
Yao Zhi rushed forward and subconsciously grabbed Ye Shuo’s wrist to check.
Soon, Yao Zhi breathed a sigh of relief. It was all right. It was just that his emotions were so fluctuating that he got angry.
And then there is…
“It’s been such a short time since we last met, how did you become like this?” Yao Zhi was naturally referring to Ye Shuo’s body.
Ye Shuo has been worrying about the plague for the past few months, day and night. Even a strong man can’t stand it and his body will naturally develop various minor ailments.
“I… now is not the time to talk about this.” Ye Shuo suddenly remembered something. Regardless of the fact that the blood on his hands had not dried yet, Ye Shuo grabbed Yao Zhi’s hand and said, “Quick, go inform my mother and Ding Ning. I’m afraid someone is going to harm them!”
Has it come to this?
Yao Zhi was startled, then hurriedly comforted him, “Don’t worry, I have already explained everything before I left. I believe that Master and the others will definitely protect Mother and Dingning.”
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo breathed a sigh of relief.
“It’s okay, it’s okay…”However, to be on the safe side, Yao Zhi still found a way to spread the news and asked her master and others to be on high alert.
Then came the events outside the capital city.
Seeing that he seemed to be going out, Yao Zhi hurriedly said, “You should rest now.”
Hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but shake his head: “Wait a little longer, it’s not the right time yet.”
Ye Shuo now understood a little bit why his father and Xiao Ming were so suspicious in the first place, because even the closest relatives would be betrayed without mercy.
But as a king, you cannot make the slightest mistake, otherwise you will be doomed.
The reason why Ye Shuo killed Ye Xun might be because Ye Xun had let him down, but there might be other reasons.
As a prince and an uncle, Ye Shuo can be soft-hearted, but if he were an emperor, Ye Shuo could not.
Once his weaknesses are discovered and he is found to be weak and vulnerable, chaos will arise. Not only him, but also his mother, wife and daughters around him will be implicated.
And now, the situation requires even more iron-blooded means.
Ye Shuo thought that the first person to sacrifice the knife would be the Tenth King, the Eleventh King, the Twelfth King and others. However, he did not expect that the first person to sacrifice the knife would be Ye Xun, who grew up with him. It was really ironic when he thought about it.
Just like that, under the guard and protection of Yao Zhi, jianjian and Wu Yi, Ye Shuo came to the top of the city wall. He witnessed with his own eyes Li Yuheng leading his troops to wipe out all the rebels disguised as bandits.
At the same time, in the military camp west of the city——
Recently, General Yun Hui happened to lead his troops back to the capital to report on his work, but with the plague raging everywhere, the event that was originally scheduled for a month ago has been delayed until now. ℞ÄΝО𝐛ƐS
As usual, General Yun Hui was reading in his tent. In the middle of the night, he heard a noise outside, followed by a young man’s loud laughter.
“Hahahaha… I’ve heard of General Yun Hui’s name for a long time. Seeing him today, I realise that he is indeed extraordinary.”
Looking at the person who suddenly broke in, General Yun Hui paused and said, “Young General Wei.”
Wei Shang: “General Yunhui has only been in the capital for a month. You are in the west of the city, and I am in the east. You are a general of the third rank, and I am only a guerrilla general of the fifth rank. How do you know who I am?”
General Yun Hui’s expression was slightly restrained.
The next moment, the young man’s expression suddenly changed: “You colluded with the son of the deposed crown prince and plotted rebellion. General Yun Hui, do you know your crime?”
It turns out that the prince at that time did not have any power at all in the army.
It’s just that the deposed prince had developed a lot in the beginning, but he is the only one who has gained a firm foothold.
Once you step into the trap of standing in line, it is difficult to get out. As long as he has dealt with the deposed crown prince, it will not be difficult to find out.
After many years, Ye Xun found the account book from that year and naturally contacted the person in front of him again.
It can be said that General Yun Hui is the biggest trump card in Ye Xun’s hand.
“Someone, catch him for me!”
“How dare you!” General Yun Hui was furious. “The military has strict discipline. You are just a fifth-rank guerrilla general. How dare you act wildly here?”
Wei Shang naturally wouldn’t dare to do that alone.
Wei Shang flipped his hand and showed the token.
“According to the order of the Regent, arrest the rebels. Push all the outsiders away immediately! Otherwise, you will also be charged with treason!”
You must know that since the death of the young emperor, the only person who can make decisions in Shangjing City is the regent.
The soldiers who were originally about to advance upon hearing the word “treason” instantly became hesitant.
As for General Yun Hui’s confidants, they were naturally there to protect him. However, Wei Shang came well prepared this time. Although he did not bring many people, each of them was an elite. What’s more, Wei Shang himself was extremely powerful and had great strength. In a one-on-one situation, it didn’t take long for him to put the sword in his hand against the throat of the middle-aged man in front of him.
“General, the emperor’s grandson is dead. You’d better surrender.”
The emperor’s grandson…died???
Upon hearing the news, General Yun Hui knew the situation was hopeless and could not help but close his eyes.
Afterwards, Wei Shang captured several rebels and left the military camp in West City openly.
When everything is over, daybreak will soon begin.
Ye Shuo naturally did not sleep all night. Not only him, but Prince Ding’s mansion was also brightly lit.
By now, the fact that the little emperor left behind his last will was finally no longer a secret.
The eldest prince sat on the top and looked at his sons: “Tell me what you think.”
How could Ye Yan and the others not understand what this meant?
To be honest, this was indeed a good opportunity, but…
Ye Yan was filled with trepidation, then he looked up at his father with a hint of expectation: “Father, with your experience as a prince for so many years, what do you think of… your son? Is there any hope? Is it feasible?”
Well, such a big pie is placed in front of you, how can you not be tempted?
“Since you asked, I will tell you the truth.”
The eldest prince was silent for a moment, then said, “Among my sons, you are the best in terms of academics and martial arts. If you consider all aspects… you are about the same as your fifth uncle.”
It’s not that the eldest prince wants to boost others’ morale and destroy his own prestige, it’s mainly a matter of losing his head, so he has to tell the truth.
The eldest prince had experienced the period of the fight for the throne. To be honest, compared with Yan’er’s generation, the quality is really not that good.
Upon hearing this, Ye Yan immediately wilted.
“Son understands.”
Compared to how the others are, what is the Fifth Prince like now? Is it necessary to say clearly whether it is possible or not?
The most capable of my brothers is only this good, and the remaining three are even worse.
After hearing this answer, Ye Yan and his brothers felt depressed but also relieved.
To be honest, the little emperor died so suddenly and strangely, and they would not be much better off when they went up. They were only slightly older than the little emperor, and not much better than him in other aspects. Moreover, the little emperor had Uncle Jiu and He Xiang to protect him, but they failed to protect him in the end. If it were them, they would not necessarily survive.
If you think about it carefully, being a prince is much worse than being an emperor, but at least you don’t have to die.
Especially at this critical juncture, the Great Zhou was ravaged by an epidemic and was in a precarious situation. Even tying up the four of them would not be able to solve such a big problem.
Ye Yan couldn’t help but sighed: “Uncle Jiu is so pitiful…”
The other three couldn’t help but feel pity: “Yeah…”
I don’t know what my little cousin was thinking in the end. He suddenly went crazy and threw such a heavy burden away. It’s true that when children become willful, they are much more destructive than adults.
When the eldest prince heard them say this, the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
I really don’t know what kind of magic potion my younger brother gave them to make them say such things.
That was the emperor! The supreme ruler! Even in this situation, even if he only held the throne for one day, his name would be recorded in the history books of the future, and he would be completely different from the princes.
Never mind.
That’s it.
No matter how unwilling he was in his heart, it was useless if he and his sons did not have such ability. The eldest prince had completely accepted his fate.
“Alright, alright, go to sleep!”
The eldest prince is decisive and out of sight, out of mind.
Then it’s Prince Su and Prince Jin’s side.
The two old men in their sixties sat opposite each other, both with sad faces. In the end, it was the Prince of Jin who couldn’t help but speak first: “What do you think, if the emperor knew about this…”
Think about it, my brother has worked diligently to protect the country for so long, but in the end it fell into the hands of that kid…
Prince Su’s eyelids twitches violently.
“Needless to say, my brother will be so angry that he will crawl out of the imperial mausoleum.”
But what else can we do now?
The eldest prince is now a cripple, and his sons do not look like capable people. The fifth prince, the seventh prince, and the eighth prince are fighting with each other, and the rest will not accept whoever occupies that position. The tenth prince, the eleventh prince, and the twelfth prince were captured first by the commander-in-chief of the Black Armor Guards, and no one bothers to mention the rest of the princes after that.
Those who were really capable were either killed or injured, and after counting them, there was only Xiaojiu left.
Prince Su’s face showed even more bitterness, and the atmosphere around him suddenly fell into deathly silence.
King Jin opened his mouth and said with great difficulty: “Look at the bright side. After all, our nephew is in very good health.”
Good health may not be obvious under normal circumstances, but for the Great Zhou Dynasty, which had experienced two emperors with poor health, it was like timely rain.
The King of Jin did not ask for anything else, he just wanted to sit in that position safely and securely.
Three emperors had died within the first year of the Fourth Zhou Dynasty, almost destroying the glory that the emperor’s brother had worked so hard to create. The dynasty could not withstand any more setbacks.
Coincidentally, Prince Su was thinking the same thing at this moment.
I don’t ask for anything else, I just hope that my nephew can live a long life, so that the Great Zhou can breathe a sigh of relief!
Prince Su and Prince Jin looked at each other, and several strands of their hair turned gray due to worry.
By the next morning, the news of the will had spread throughout the capital, and all the court officials were in an uproar.
“No, I absolutely disagree!”
When they thought of the ridiculous things the Ninth Prince had done in the past, the first reaction of the Shangshu Ling and other court officials was this, especially those who had taught the Ninth Prince, who cursed him on the spot.
Being a regent would be fine, after all, his status is there, but this time he is the emperor! The emperor who decides the life and death of the Great Zhou!
However, compared to their fierce words, the royal family was completely silent. Even Empress Dowager He, the young emperor’s biological mother, did not speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Crying
chapters.content:
“The new emperor is young and has not yet taken power. How can his will be valid?”
“Yeah yeah.”
The ministers were arguing, but Prime Minister He on the side was also unhappy and had the same sad face.
Judging from the current situation, although the regent’s ascension to the throne is the best outcome for the He family, on the other hand, in addition to being the head of the He family, He Xiang is also the prime minister of the Great Zhou. How can he not be worried?
He Xiang didn’t even have time to feel sad for his great-grandson before he received such news. Now he is mixed with sadness and joy, and is almost worried to death.
After arguing for a long time without any result, Shangshu Ling and others could not help but look towards the royal family.
It’s already this late, why don’t they say a word?
The first to be questioned were naturally the Prince of Su and the Prince of Jin, who were now in charge of the royal family.
However, what they didn’t expect was that Prince Su and Prince Jin acted as if they had discussed it beforehand and had no objections at all.
“We agree.”The two of them seemed to have no complaints at all and were even more obedient than when Emperor Taicheng came to power. If you didn’t know him, you would think the regent was very wise and powerful.
Anyway, Prince Su and Prince Jin now have only one request for the new emperor, that he must be alive. As for the rest, they don’t have too high demands.
There is no way. Two emperors have died in succession. They are really scared of death.
In fact, if you think about it carefully, Xiaojiu is not completely without merit. Although he is a bit absurd, at least he will not bully the common people. He has been a prince for so many years and has not done anything that is harmful to the world. He is not a cruel person, so… Well, let it be.
The breath was stuck in his throat and he couldn’t swallow it or exhale it. There was no choice but for Shang Shu Ling and others to turn their attention to Prince Ding and his men.
They thought that Prince Ding and others would object, but they didn’t expect that Prince Ding would surrender without saying a word.
Anyway, it’s impossible for me to get along with Yan’er and the others, so I’ll just choose the best solution.
Xiaojiu was the best to their family among all the brothers. He had been like this since he was a prince. He had never coveted anything. Wasn’t he much better than the eighth prince?
As for the fifth prince, he thought about it carefully and felt that if it was Xiaojiu, he might be able to… barely accept it?
He was much better than the seventh prince.
As for the Eighth Prince, he did have some ideas, but he was not even the match of the First Prince, so how could he talk about anything else?
I really don’t know what kind of magic potion Xiao Jiu had given to the eldest prince, so that he would not even care about his own brother. The Eighth Prince was resentful and hateful, but he could do nothing about it.
Then there is the old Duke of Zhen. The Prince Regent is the grandson of the old Duke of Zhen. As the saying goes, even a broken ship still has three pounds of nails. Although the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion has declined, at this time, anyone who is not a fool will stand on the side of the old Duke of Zhen. 𝖗άNőＢƐş
Regardless of whether they still believed in the old Duke in their hearts as much as they did in the past, this obvious free opportunity to follow the emperor was simply a godsend.
So this was another wave of obedience.
Then there was the group of students that Ye Shuo let loose in the court. Although they didn’t know how the teacher who had always said that he would never become the emperor ended up in this situation, as his students, Zou Wu and others naturally had no choice but to follow his lead.
Originally they had some doubts as to whether they could be of any help as they had little influence, but it had only been a short time since the morning court session and they were just one step away from the final blow, so naturally they wanted to help out.
Soon, the Shangshu Ling felt as if someone was pulling his official robe. When he turned around, he saw that it was his disciple.
“Teacher, if it really doesn’t work, let’s just leave it at that. There’s really no other way…”
“Apart from being too playful and not interested in studying, the Prince Regent has no other obvious faults.”
Moreover, these two problems were not considered problems in the eyes of Zou Wu and others. After all, they knew exactly how capable the teacher was, but they just couldn’t say it out loud.
The Shangshu Ling and several other important officials looked around and saw that everyone was looking at them. For some reason, they suddenly felt that the situation was hopeless and they were powerless to reverse it.
No matter what they did, they couldn’t win over so many people!
Most importantly, if they continued to oppose, things would probably get worse.
The regent is now the only choice. If it were any other prince or grandson, how could they have such great power? Even if they were in power, others would not accept it, and chaos would still occur in the end.
So indeed, there is only this one left.
At this moment, the Shangshu Ling and others could no longer deceive themselves. It was not that the royal family did not want to choose, but that they really could not choose.
Finally, Empress Dowager He announced in person behind the curtain that the matter was settled. The next emperor of the Great Zhou would be the Ninth Prince back then, and now the Ninth Prince Uncle.
The Regent’s life was worthwhile. He didn’t have to study late into the night, and he didn’t even have to do any work for the court. Yet, he was able to become the emperor.
Thinking about Emperor Taicheng again… everyone suddenly felt that when the posthumous title “Ping” was given to Emperor Taicheng, it might have been too harsh.
“Your Highness, congratulations to the Regent… Wait, where’s the Regent?”
Looking around, everyone was arguing for a long time before they realised that among the royal family uniforms, there was no trace of Ye Shuo.
It’s already this late and he’s still late.
Even though Prince Su and Prince Jin were prepared, they couldn’t help but gasp.
Oh my god…
On the other side, Prince Rui’s Mansion——
It was already late at night when Ye Shuo watched Li Yuheng clean up the rebels last night. After everything settled down, Ye Shuo hurried back to his home and fell asleep.
Take advantage of this time to catch up on some sleep, there are still many things to do later.
As a result, I slept until dawn.
Looking at the sun outside, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think, it has been such a long time, the Xuanzheng Hall must have had some results, and it would be a good opportunity for him to go there now and pick up the ready-made ones.
Just at this moment, Yao Zhi walked in from outside with a lunch box.
It’s late anyway, so it doesn’t matter if I wait a little longer, but I can’t miss breakfast.
Although Ye Shuo’s current behaviour was extremely normal, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but think of the scene last night when he was sitting there alone, with his arms on his knees, blood dripping from his fingertips, facing the corpses all over the ground.
At that moment, Yao Zhi saw deep fatigue in his eyes.
Yao Zhi understood clearly that it was not physical tiredness, but… mental tiredness.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help it, and when he put down his chopsticks, she hugged him from behind.
“Are you… okay?”
“sorry.”
The two spoke almost at the same time. After they reacted, Yao Zhi and Ye Shuo understood what the other was saying.
Yao Zhi was naturally worried about him, and Ye Shuo’s words were naturally referring to the fact that he was about to become emperor.
Yao Zhi had never thought about it this way before, but now she realised it belatedly. If he became the emperor, then wouldn’t she be the queen? ? ?
“…I still remember that a few years ago you said that you would be an idle prince for the rest of your life.” Yao Zhi now felt deeply that she had been deceived.
