Ye Shuo pulled the corner of his mouth: “I don’t want to either…it’s because my sixth brother is so disappointing.”
If Emperor Taicheng had been more motivated, this would never have happened.
Yao Zhi and Ye Shuo looked at each other, and as their eyes met, the couple sighed in unison.
Yao Zhi opened her mouth, wanting to say something but stopping herself: “So…what should I do now?”
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, then asked, “Do you want to leave?”
Yao Zhi also asked: “Will you let me go?”
If it was before, Ye Shuo might have let her go, but now…
Ye Shuo shook his head and said very honestly: “No. Even if you want to run away, I will find a way to catch you back.”
Under such circumstances, Ye Shuo had no way of opening up to any other woman again and entrusting himself to her again like he did to her.
That’s it, what else is there to say? Yao Zhi couldn’t help but glare at him.
“Now that you’ve said that, do I have any other choice but to stay?”
Ye Shuo still shook his head: “No more.”
Yao Zhi couldn’t help it and gritted her teeth. She felt a mixture of love and hate for him in her heart.
But what can I do? I have to accept my fate by meeting such an enemy in this life.
“But I’ve already said that even if you become the emperor, you can’t have other women.” Wasn’t that the reason why Yao Zhi married him in the first place? A lifelong couple, even a chivalrous woman would want that…
Otherwise, even if Yao Zhi was blinded by beauty, she would not have jumped into this big pit!
“Or, if you have another woman, you have to let me go.”
Ye Shuo tightened his grip on her arm: “Okay.”
Now that everything had been said, Yao Zhi had nothing to worry about. Because it was him, Yao Zhi was willing to entrust her trust.
“Also, I come from a humble background and I don’t know how to be a queen. If there is anything I don’t do well enough, you can’t blame me.”
Ye Shuo thought about it and was about to say that it was okay, as it was his first time being an emperor, but he heard her say, “Of course, I will work hard to learn, and I hope I can learn it.”
“Before you brought me here, you lied to me twice, but I am willing to trust you one more time.”
That’s enough.
About half an incense stick later, Ye Shuo went out and saw Li Yuheng already waiting there.
As for the several bandit leaders, the three of the Tenth King, the Eleventh King, and the Twelfth King, as well as General Yun Hui were naturally also in Li Yuheng’s hands.
Li Yuheng had not expected that the Ninth Prince had indeed not asked him to repay his favour, but now he had to desperately try to please him.
If he was not the ninth prince, which prince or grandson of the emperor would be willing to use him after ascending the throne?
Li Yuheng had spent more than ten years to finally climb to his current position, so how could he be willing to give it up to others?
So following Ye Shuo was his only choice.
By the time Ye Shuo arrived at the Xuan Zheng Hall, the court officials and royal family members had already finished their discussion.
Then came the matter of Ye Xun and the Tenth King, the Eleventh King, and the Twelfth King.
Everyone gnashed their teeth, but Ye Shuo pretended not to see it and asked them what they were going to do.
It’s sad to say that Ye Xun, the legitimate grandson of the emperor, is not even as important as the Tenth King, the Eleventh King, and the Twelfth King.
Although Ye Xun’s planning of rebellion was shocking, he was dead now, and General Yun Hui behind Ye Xun was also captured. Everyone just sighed a few words and threw him aside.
However, the Tenth Prince, Eleventh Prince and Twelfth Prince are a bit more difficult to deal with. After all, these three are legitimate princes. Even if they do not attract much attention, they are undoubtedly the biological sons of Emperor Jingwen.
Therefore, Prince Su and Prince Jin advocated staying.
But then again, the Regent/Xiaojiu/this guy doesn’t seem to be completely incompetent. At least Ye Xun’s rebellion failed.
Just when everyone was wondering if they could possibly pick up a treasure, they heard him say, “But my opinion is to kill.”
“I don’t care about other things, but Lao Shi (10th) is the mastermind. I can’t possibly keep him here.”
Making trouble at this time, and even robbing the silver that the young emperor was distributing for disaster relief, is simply a crime that cannot be forgiven!
Prince Su and Prince Jin also knew that this boy was guilty of a serious crime, but they still wanted to smooth things over. After all, they were not the emperor, and they only cared about the harmony of the Ye family.
“No matter what, he is still your brother…”
However, before Prince Su could finish his words, Ye Shuo retorted.
Since Empress Dowager He has spoken, they must all know that he is the only one who can do it now. Although Ye Shuo himself has no way out, he must not let them control him in this regard.
Once you are caught, you will definitely be caught again and again.
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate and said, “Since I was a child, I have only heard people say that the emperor is the greatest in the world. Since I am the emperor now, you have to listen to me. If you have the final say, then you can be the emperor.”
“Or you guys can clean up and choose another one.”
Ye Shuo’s attitude was very straightforward. If he became the emperor, he would have the final say on everything. If he didn’t have the final say, then whoever wanted to be the emperor could be the emperor.
But the question is, where can we choose anything else?
If the Great Zhou is elected again, there will be chaos.
Prince Su and Prince Jin were stunned.
King Jin was silent for a moment, then said, “Don’t let go, this guy might be trying to trick me—”
However, before Prince Jin finished his words, Ye Shuo signalled Li Yuheng to throw the tied-up people to the ground.
When did even Commander Li join him?
What the hell!
While everyone was stunned, Ye Shuo turned around and left without hesitation. Damn it, if you want to be the emperor, you have to be happy. He doesn’t want to suffer this!
King Jin became anxious all of a sudden: “No, no, no! Come back, come back, we can discuss this!”
In the face of the stability of the Great Zhou, a mere ten kings seemed… to be nothing…
The Tenth Prince thought that his status as a prince could save his life, but he never imagined that he would be abandoned so easily.
Now he finally understood that, in fact, the identity of a prince was not that secure. When he was useful, he was high and mighty, but when he was useless, he could be easily discarded.
“Ye Shuo! My mother died because of you, and now you have killed your brothers and sisters. You will be punished!”
Ye Shuo didn’t care about all that. If there really was such a thing as retribution, then there would be so many victims in the epidemic area who would drag him down to the eighteenth level of hell.
“Ye Shuo! Ye Shuo! Did you hear me? I curse you to die a miserable death!”
Ye Shuo has a lot of shortcomings, especially when it comes to his face and ego, which he is not ambiguous about at all.
No matter how harshly the Ten Kings scolded, it was just like a tickle to Ye Shuo.
But Ye Shuo was not angry, but that did not mean that the Prince of Jin and the Prince of Su were not angry. You know, they had finally found a healthy emperor. What if he was cursed to death by accident?
They had been planning to find a way to save him, but now… forget it!
Looking at the regent who had returned, the ministers felt mixed emotions. They probably did not expect that they would have to ask him to sit on the throne for such a thing.
They didn’t know how to cherish Emperor Taicheng before, and now, isn’t this retribution?
When they were offering sacrifices to the little emperor in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Shangshu Ling and the others could no longer hold back and burst into tears on the spot.
All the capable princes of the Ye royal family died, and the Great Zhou was devastated in just a few years. Allowing such an unlearned person to be emperor is indeed a sign of the country’s demise!
Could it be that there were really too many capable princes before, so the luck of the Great Zhou was exhausted?
At this time, no matter what party they were from, they were all subjects of the Great Zhou, so they didn’t have time to care about so many things.
As for He Xiang, thinking of his lovely great-grandson, even at his old age, he cried even louder.
I can’t bear it anymore, I really can’t bear it anymore!
Not to mention them, even Prince Su and Prince Jin burst into tears.
“Royal brother, royal brother!”
The two brothers really tried their best.
Looking at so many people with tears and snot streaming down their cheeks, Ye Shuo, who was standing at the front, felt so out of place for a moment.
Just when Ye Shuo was hesitating whether to help He Xiang up from the ground, he saw that He Xiang cried even harder when he saw his handsome face.

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Queen
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo had no choice but to follow suit. He personally took three incense sticks and went straight to the tablet of Emperor Jingwen.
“Dad, dad, your spirit in heaven, please bless your son. The future of your son and the Great Zhou depends on you.” Anyway, whether it is useful or not, just pray first, what if?
As expected, as soon as Ye Shuo said this, the ministers became even more panicked.
How is it different to hope for the blessing of Emperor Wen and hope for mercy from God? If praying to gods and Buddhas was useful, there wouldn’t be so many injustices in the world.
At this moment, the ministers had even thought about how they would die.
Rather than falling into the hands of the brutal and cannibalistic Beiting people or Chen people, committing suicide would be less painful.
Maybe it was because they were too desperate, but He Xiang and the others suddenly felt a surge of courage to resist.
No, this is too cowardly!
A dynasty will naturally rise and fall, and no dynasty from ancient times to the present can escape this.
Today’s Great Zhou has finally ushered in such a day.At this moment, each of He Xiang and the others were filled with genuine feelings.
Not to mention the common people, their entire families are in the Great Zhou, in the capital city of Shangjing. If the Great Zhou is not doing well, they will certainly not be doing well either.
As for betraying the Great Zhou? They had not thought that being a minister of two surnames was not so easy, especially when Beiting and Chen were so unfriendly to their Great Zhou. It was more reliable to expect the two countries to treat Zhou officials well than to expect Emperor Jingwen to crawl out of the imperial mausoleum to save the people from the water and fire.
So even if he cried, he still had to do his job, especially when he knew that the emperor was incompetent. Even though Prime Minister He was over seventy years old this year, he still had to find a way to support the Great Zhou.
He Xiang felt that it was time to sit down and drink tea with Shangshu Ling and others.
Things have come to this point, is there any deep hatred that cannot be let go?
He Xiang suddenly felt no more pain in his legs or waist, and he instantly regained the fighting spirit he had in his twenties.
Then came the preparations for the coronation ceremony.
Now that the plague is rampant, Ye Shuo, who was temporarily installed as emperor, naturally does not want to waste people’s money and energy on grand ceremonies, so he naturally keeps everything simple.
Ye Shuo was really looking forward to it, so how could he disagree?
Seeing that he nodded in agreement without much thought, He Xiang and others immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, the new emperor is not completely without merit.
However, before He Xiang and the others could finish praising him in their hearts, they heard him say, “But you have to agree to one condition of mine.” 𝘳𝔞ɴỌꞖĚṣ
He Xiang’s heart immediately rose to his throat.
Here it comes, the test is coming!
He Xiang pondered for a long time, and cautiously asked: “Your Majesty, what are the conditions?”
Ye Shuo said casually: “It’s nothing else, I just don’t want to do it twice, the coronation ceremony and the queen ceremony must be held on the same day.”
“How can this be done?” The emperor and the empress are of different ranks, so how can they be enthroned on the same day? Wouldn’t that be a mess? Normally, the emperor would ascend the throne first, and then a few days later, the empress would be welcomed into the palace.
He Xiang opened his mouth subconsciously, but just as he finished speaking, he saw his disciple seemed to be pulling his sleeve.
He Xiang looked down and heard his favorite student lower his voice and reminded him: “Under the current circumstances, if the two ceremonies are combined, at least this amount can be saved for the national treasury.”
As he spoke, the young man secretly drew a number towards He Bi.
He Xiang couldn’t help but gasp.
If you put it that way, it doesn’t seem to be impossible.
Extraordinary times call for extraordinary things. After thinking for a while, He Xiang felt that it would be more cost-effective to go together.
Prime Minister He quickly changed his words: “In that case, I will follow your Majesty’s wishes.”
Before His Majesty finds out, He Xiang must quickly settle the matter. Since He Xiang has spoken, it is not easy for others to say anything.
In fact, the new emperor’s laziness has its advantages.
Ye Shuo was very satisfied with his student’s cleverness. While He Xiang and others were not paying attention, he couldn’t help but give him an admiring look.
The others immediately understood what to do.
The young man was excited and was ready to fight.
Is there anything in this world that could make one happier than seeing one’s most beloved teacher become the ruler of the Great Zhou?
After Ye Shuo left, He Xiang and the others realised belatedly that they seemed to have not yet agreed to let the humble Princess Rui be the queen.
“Sir, at this time, the lower the origin of the queen’s mother’s family, the more beneficial it will be to you and the Great Zhou…”
When the Prince Regent ascended the throne, the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, as the Prince Regent’s maternal family, was going to re-enter the court. If there was another person from the Queen’s maternal family, what status would He Xiang, the previous foreign relative, have?
He Xiang was speechless for a moment.
“I… am ashamed of my life…”
The new emperor didn’t know the pros and cons, but he knew all the twists and turns clearly. Because of his own selfishness, even Prime Minister He felt guilty.
Let’s talk about Duke Zhen’s Mansion.
The old Duke Zhen couldn’t understand no matter how he thought about it. How could his grandson become the emperor?
So the old Duke Zhen secretly called his eldest grandson over and asked in a low voice, “Did you two do something bad behind my back?”
It’s not the old Duke of Zhen, right? Believe them, the key point is that this matter is too bizarre. The old Duke of Zhen feels like he is dreaming until now.
To be honest, if Wei Wen hadn’t experienced it himself, he wouldn’t have imagined that being an emperor would be so easy.
But that’s what happened.
Wei Wen couldn’t help but ask: “Grandfather, how powerful do you think we must be to be able to hide this from the entire court of civil and military Ye clan members?”
The old Duke of Zhen thought about it, then curled his lips and said, “It’s really amazing…”
Seeing his grandfather mention this, Wei Wen also thought of something: “Oh, grandfather, I am undecided about something, so I want to ask you for advice.”
The old Duke of Zhen came back to his senses: “You say.”
Wei Wen: “It’s nothing else, it’s just that my little cousin now only has a queen, and no concubines around him, and my sister is now at the age of engagement, so I’m thinking about whether I should get closer to my little cousin and aunt.”
Wei Wen did not deny that his younger cousin had deep feelings for the Duke of Zhen Mansion, but it was only for him. If he was still alive, it would be fine. If he was no longer alive, what would happen?
But if the next emperor also had the blood of the Duke of Zhen Mansion, then it would be different.
“We have few daughters in our family, and they are His Majesty’s cousins. His Majesty will not let the sisters suffer.”
“Let’s not talk about other aspects. As far as the relationship between husband and wife is concerned, Your Majesty is definitely a good match.”
He doesn’t mind if a woman is better than him in some aspects, and he doesn’t mind having children. Princess Rui has been getting married for several years without any progress, and her aunt hasn’t urged her, and there haven’t been any major conflicts between the mother-in-law and the daughter-in-law. Wei Wen doesn’t believe that if there wasn’t his little cousin to help him, his little cousin never used his status as a prince to control his princess. How many men are there in the world like this?
Wei Wen thought, if he were a woman, he would also be willing to marry such a man!
However, just as Wei Wen finished speaking, he heard the old Duke Zhen say unhappily, “You also know that the emperor and the queen have a good relationship? You still dare to mention it even though you know it?”
The old Duke of Zhen felt that his grandson was smart all his life but foolish for a moment.
“If you don’t say anything and don’t embarrass him, at least our family still has His Majesty caring about us, and the feelings won’t change. If you say it or mention it, that may not be the case.”
If His Majesty marries his cousin as his concubine, he will surely marry another woman as his concubine in the future. It is still unknown who will be the concubine by then.
With His Majesty’s good health, it would be strange if there were not many children in the palace. Where did the eldest grandson get the confidence to think that a child with the blood of the Duke of Zhen would definitely be able to sit in that position?
Compared with the uncertainty of the future, the old Duke of Zhen prefers to grasp what he can grasp at the moment. After all, what he has in his hands is his own, and it is useless to envy what he can’t get.
“You know His Majesty’s temper. He is not stupid, and will not be easily deceived.”
Let’s not talk about the grandson of the emperor. Just talking about the period of Emperor Wen, Emperor Wen doted on him so much, but didn’t he still not lose his mind? He remained calm from beginning to end, and he never relaxed for a moment until Emperor Wen passed away.
From then on, the old Duke Zhen knew that the child born by his daughter was extraordinary.
Wei Wen couldn’t help but say, “I just thought that this day will come sooner or later. Instead of letting others benefit, it’s better to benefit ourselves.”
The old Duke Zhen curled his lips and said, “Oh? Don’t say that so early. This is not certain.”
“It’s not like all men in the world will have other women.” When his grandson was a prince, he only had this one person. Who can say that he will change when he becomes emperor?
Wei Wen was stunned for a moment, then took a breath of cold air: “You, you mean…he will only have one woman in his life, the queen?”
How is this possible?
Although Wei Wen is not married, as a man, how can he not know what a man is thinking?
If this is true, then it can only be said that this little cousin of his is really a rare thing that has never been seen in the past dynasties…
The old Duke of Zhen was not so sure: “Who can say for sure about this matter? From what I can see now, it should be like this.”
“Anyway, no matter what the future holds, you should not try to displease others now, or the emperor will punish you.” His grandson was born in the year of the dog, and he would bite anyone who displeased him.
As he said this, the old Duke Zhen suddenly remembered Prince Su, Prince Jin, and Shangshu Ling.
“These old guys are probably still planning to let His Majesty have many children. If they dare to bring it up, they will cry.”
These people don’t know how powerful their grandson is, so they naturally think that when the grandson gives birth to a son, at worst they can turn around and teach the little prince. If they can’t count on him, they can count on his son!
But is it really that simple? Impossible.
As he thought about it, the old Duke Zhen couldn’t help but laugh. He had been waiting for that day.
This was indeed the case. When they left the imperial city, Prince Jin comforted Prince Su: “If it really doesn’t work, we can just wait a little longer until His Majesty gives birth to a son, and then everything will be fine.”
Prince Su sighed: “This is the only way for now.”
Prince Su has already made up his mind. After the coronation ceremony, he will immediately arrange a selection of concubines, hoping to have eight or ten children within a year. This is better than having no one to pass on his legacy to, like Emperor Taicheng.
In such an atmosphere, on the fifth day, the coronation ceremony and the queen-crowned ceremony were held as scheduled.
The noble ladies who came to the capital watched helplessly as a woman from the Jianghu became the Princess of Rui, and then within a few years, she first became the Regent Princess, and within a year, she became the Queen. They were dumbfounded.
At first they thought that even if King Rui ascended the throne, the court officials would not agree to let such a woman of commoner origin become the mother of a country.
Now that it has really happened, the entire Shangjing is stunned.
I regret it so much!
At the same time, the person who announced the news finally rode at full speed and arrived in Liangzhou.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Joy
chapters.content:
When the governor of Liangzhou received the news, he was stunned.
The young man who had called me his brother back then has now become the emperor…
No, it should be said that he actually called the current emperor a brother!
The governor of Liangzhou suddenly felt a little weak in the knees.
After the visitor left, the governor of Liangzhou tried hard to recall whether he had done anything offensive. It seemed that he probably hadn’t…
On the other side, the Wei family mansion in Liangzhou City——
Since the Imperial Concubine’s surname was Wei, when Ye Shuo built this house he naturally named it Wei Mansion, which could be considered the house Ye Shuo bought for his mother.
Built in a hurry, the Wei residence is not particularly large, but it is comfortable. Recently, due to the rampant plague outside, the Royal Concubine has been forced to stay at home, but with caring maids like Su Yue, as well as the beautiful lady and Sixth Master, two women of similar age, around her, life is not so lonely.
Although not many people in Liangzhou City knew the identities of the Imperial Concubine Dowager, seeing how the governor of Liangzhou treated them, the wealthy merchants and gentry in Liangzhou City had some guesses in their minds. Knowing that they were either rich or noble, no one was so blind as to come and cause trouble.
Therefore, the Imperial Concubine Dowager can live as comfortably as she wants here.When the person who delivered the message arrived, the Imperial Concubine Dowager was holding little Dingning and listening with great interest to the woman in front of her talking about all kinds of interesting things in the martial arts world.
This woman was none other than Madam Lu, who was known in the martial arts world as the Wind-killing Blade and was also one of the good friends of the beautiful woman back then.
To avoid disaster, Madam Lu came to Liangzhou City, but accidentally ran into her old friend. She was so happy that she stayed here for a few days.
Although the news of Miss Yao marrying into the royal family had caused a lot of buzz, even people in the martial arts world didn’t know much about Miss Yao’s background, not to mention who her master was. Therefore, Madam Lu didn’t know that the noble lady sitting in front of her was the imperial concubine who was famous in the Great Zhou Dynasty.
At first, Madam Lu wondered how her good friend, who she hadn’t seen for several years, could have gotten to know such a powerless woman from a secluded house. But after a few days of getting along with her, Madam Lu discovered that although this lady was not young, she still had the innocence of a child who was ignorant of the world. She was extremely curious about everything, especially about the world of martial arts. She looked full of yearning and it was obvious that she had never suffered much.
Under the repeated questioning of the noble lady, Madam Lu got excited and told her so much.
Madam Lu was eloquent and very talkative. Even the royal concubine was seduced by her and developed a yearning for the world she talked about.
In addition, Jianjian had been wandering outside for a long time and was unwilling to go home, so the Imperial Concubine couldn’t help but look at the beautiful woman beside her.
If there is a chance, she would also like to see it.
But soon, a knock on the door broke the imperial concubine’s fantasy.
Afterwards, the Imperial Noble Consort Dowager learned that her son was going to be the Emperor, and that she did not even have to wait for the enthronement as she was now a foregone conclusion that she was the Empress Dowager.
When she first saw the man, the beautiful woman was very alert seeing the black armoured uniform he was wearing. After all, two days ago a suspicious person tried to sneak into the Wei Mansion, but fortunately he was discovered by them in time and no noise was made.
I thought this time they were targeting the Imperial Concubine and Dingning, but… what is this?
Madam Lu’s voice also stopped abruptly. Wait, what did I hear?
However, the reaction of the Imperial Concubine next to her was even greater than hers. Her scream almost scared little Dingning.
“What? Who are you talking about?”
The visitor sweated and said again: “The emperor ascended the throne ten days ago. When the plague subsides a little, you will be welcomed back to the capital.” ʀÄ𝐍ő฿Ë𝘚
For a moment, the Imperial Concubine Dowager thought she had heard it wrong. Since her son turned ten years old, she had never had such an idea again.
After finally getting out, it’s only been a short while and I have to go back again.
The Royal Concubine Dowager suddenly felt an endless amount of complexity in her heart.
Just when Madam Lu was stunned and didn’t know how to react, she saw the noble lady in front of her fall back into the chair, and then… started crying.
Madam Lu: ???
The beautiful woman almost didn’t react. After she came to her senses, she hurried to help her: “Isn’t this a good thing? Why are you crying?”
The Imperial Concubine didn’t want to do it, but she couldn’t help it.
“At first, I was so hopeful that he would become successful, but in the end, he failed to do so. Later, I finally managed to break free from it and had a few happy days, but now they are urging me to go back. Isn’t this a joke?”
The Imperial Concubine Dowager had just tasted a little of the sweetness of freedom, but it was suddenly severed. How could she bear it?
And then there is…
“Under the current circumstances, how can Shuo’er bear such a heavy burden!”
Now that both emperors are gone and there’s a plague raging outside, if things go wrong her son’s life might not be saved. How can the Imperial Concubine not cry?
The Imperial Concubine Dowager felt that her son must have been deceived by that group of court officials and royal family members.
“My Shuo’er…”
Hearing the noise, the rest of Huo Tianyi and others also walked out of the house next door. As soon as they arrived at Wei’s house, they heard about this and fell silent.
If the disciple’s husband becomes the emperor of the Great Zhou, then wouldn’t their disciple be the empress?
Seeing Huo Tianyi asking this question, the black-armoured guard hurriedly said, “The coronation ceremony and the queen coronation ceremony will be held on the same day.”
In other words, Zhier is undoubtedly the queen now.
Ha, it seems that I really found a “treasure” back then. Huo Tianyi felt that there might be a reason why he was so unlucky in the first half of his life.
A person only has so much luck in his life, and his luck might have been used up when he picked up the young man and brought him back to the valley.
Mei Yingzhuo stopped for a while, then turned and left.
Huo Tianyi reacted and blurted out: “What are you going to do?”
Mei Yingzhuo took a deep breath and said unhappily, “What else can you do besides researching a cure for the plague?”
There have been queens of commoner origin in the past, but it was always more difficult for her to become a queen than for women of status, background and family. Now Zhi’er is already the queen, and the matter is a foregone conclusion. As her master, Mei Yingzhuo naturally hopes that her path to becoming a queen will be smoother and more stable.
Originally, the plague was a matter of the imperial court, but now it had inexplicably become his own family matter, and Mei Yingzhuo could not help but take it seriously.
Even Madam Lu, who was standing by, spoke up belatedly: “Uh…is there anything I can help you with?”
However, his ascension to the throne brought joy to some and sorrow to others.
Compared to the Wei residence, Mrs. Zhen, who was also in Liangzhou, received her son’s body.
Back when she was in the East Palace, the Crown Princess, now Madam Zhen, often spoke up for Ye Shuo. What’s more, it was Madam Zhen who made it possible for Ye Xun to be so close to Ye Shuo.
Looking at it now, everything has changed.
The moment she saw Ye Xun’s body, Mrs. Zhen, who had been working hard for many years, could no longer hold back, and a fishy-sweet smell suddenly surged in her throat.
If it weren’t for the timely support of the former crown prince’s concubine next to her, Madam Zhen almost fell to the ground.
“lady!”
Madam Zhen barely came back to her senses and looked at the corpse of General Yun Hui beside her. What else did Madam Zhen not understand?
When Madam Zhen was the Crown Prince’s consort, the Crown Prince never told her about the affairs in the court, but as the Crown Prince’s bedside companion, how could Madam Zhen not notice anything?
Xun’er, after all, followed the Crown Prince’s old path, and even went further and deeper than the Crown Prince.
As early as when Xun’er refused to come to Liangzhou, Madam Zhen knew that this day would come sooner or later. But Madam Zhen still held on and asked, “What crime did the prince commit?”
The man opened his mouth and finally uttered a few words: “Conspiracy for treason, poisoning the previous emperor, assassinating the new emperor.”
No blame, no blame…
Mrs. Zhen didn’t say anything, she just asked someone to unload the coffins of the two men and told them to leave.
Over the years, the concubines and the former prince’s children have all received the favour of Madam Zhen. If they put themselves in her shoes, they would go crazy if their children ended up like this.
Therefore, the concubine couldn’t help but say: “Your Majesty, this is too inhumane…” After all, he is still his nephew…
However, before the other party could finish his words, he was interrupted by Mrs. Zhen.
“Shut up! Stop talking nonsense!”
Madam Zhen took a deep breath and said, “Don’t forget how we were able to stay alive and live such a comfortable life.”
“Everything is Xun’er’s own fault.”
But having said that, Ye Xun is still Mrs. Zhen’s biological son no matter what.
Mrs. Zhen openly asked someone to find a vacant lot outside the city to bury him hastily, but secretly, she gave a lot of silver and asked someone to find a Feng Shui good place for Ye Xun.
After everything was done, Mrs. Zhen knew it was time to leave.
The new emperor was merciful and did not implicate them, but they had to be tactful. A few days later, the vendors around felt that the huge Gu Mansion had suddenly become extremely quiet. When someone couldn’t help but peek inside through the crack in the door, they found that the entire Gu Mansion had been deserted for a long time.
At this point, the lineage of the former prince completely disappeared.
Yesterday’s old friends are finally drifting away.
Ye Shuo, who was far away in Shangjing, heard the news. After a moment of silence, he waved his hand and told the person to leave.
Now he has more important things to do.
It has been nearly half a month since Ye Shuo ascended the throne. It is true that Yao Zhi was a chivalrous woman in the past, but she was inevitably full of limitations. Now that she has suddenly become the queen, the people of the world have suddenly become her responsibility.
Although Yao Zhi was not quite used to it, her personality made it impossible for her to ignore it. Now she was leading a group of imperial doctors to study a prescription for treating the plague.
As for the plague, it was a natural disaster that could not be controlled. All Ye Shuo could do was to try his best to avoid man-made disasters.
Because of Yao Zhi’s relationship, Ye Shuo also received a lot of news from people in the underworld, from all over the place, most of which were things that local officials had never reported.
Yao Zhi, the queen who came from the underworld, actually played a miraculous role at this time.
The reason why the plague is so rampant is closely related to the people below who are eager to keep their positions.
Ye Shuo originally wanted to take a trip to Prince Ding’s Mansion, but then he suddenly remembered that he seemed to be the emperor now.
Ye Shuo immediately ordered people to summon Prince Ding and Ye Yan and others into the palace.
Prince Ding was just wondering what the emperor wanted them to do. Just as he was thinking, he heard the young man above him say, “Yan’er, I see you don’t have anything to do recently, so go help the emperor’s uncle kill a few people.”
Seeing him speak so easily, for a moment, Prince Ding thought he was calling his sons to have lunch together.
Ye Yan and his companions were straightforward and asked in the same manner: “May I ask Your Majesty, who should be killed?”
Prince Ding: “…………”

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Emperor
chapters.content:
Prince Ding said, “Forgive me for being so nosy, but there is one thing I don’t understand. Why is it Yan’er and the others?”
“Because there is really no one around me who can be used right now.” The Seventh Prince has not returned yet, and there are really few people who seem to have status and are good at martial arts.
Ye Shuo’s cousins ​​are quite skilled in martial arts, but they lack intelligence. Ye Yan and his cousins ​​are the emperor’s grandchildren after all, so they are much better than ordinary people in both civil and military strategies.
“Let’s not talk about this for now, Yan’er, come here and take a look at these.” As he said that, Ye Shuo handed over a bunch of letters he had received.
The eldest prince was about to say something, but he saw his sons had already picked up the paper in front of them and started reading it. As time went by, Ye Yan and the other three frowned more and more.
They are not fools, how can they not see how many things are hidden here?
Unable to hold back, Ye Yan slammed the table fiercely: “This is outrageous! The court pays them salaries just to let them fool around like this?!” Concealing the truth, lying, buck-passing, and prevaricating, the officials of their Great Zhou are all such bastards!
As long as the consequences are not particularly serious, Ye Shuo is not intolerant of some minor mistakes. After all, as long as one is a human being, it is impossible for him to be without the slightest mistake. It is normal that he is not perfect in the process of moving forward. What Ye Shuo cannot forgive is that they have no care for the people at all. When the disaster comes, they only think about the black hat on their heads, which causes the plague to rage. It is simply unforgivable.
Since those people have a higher status than ordinary people, it is natural that they should bear greater responsibilities than ordinary people.
When the water is too clear, there will be no fish. Normally, Ye Shuo could turn a blind eye to it, but at this time, it would be better to be strict with them.If you don’t have that ability, you should give up your position as soon as possible and let someone with that ability take over.
Of course, Ye Shuo doesn’t blindly believe what the people in the martial arts world say. Since they are human beings, they also have selfish desires.
“I called you here this time because I wanted you to check these places. If what is said in the letter is true, kill them on the spot to appease the public anger. If it is false, tell me as soon as possible. Do you understand?”
“This matter concerns the survival of the Great Zhou. I hope you will take it seriously.”
After listening to this, Ye Yan suddenly felt heavy in his heart.
Prince Ding tried to interrupt, but he couldn’t.
Ye Yan and his brothers took a deep breath and said, “We, your subjects, will definitely live up to the trust of the Emperor’s uncle!”
In the end, Ye Shuo stood up and helped them up one by one.
“Well done, you are all great.”
Ye Shuo’s expression relaxed a little. Seeing that the sun was almost reaching the top of his head, he spoke: “It’s just right. It’s almost time for lunch. Let’s have a quick meal together.”
Only then did Ye Yan and the others notice the dragon robe on him and realise that the Ninth Uncle was now the emperor.
“Isn’t this…inappropriate?”
Seeing Ye Yan’s hesitation, Ye Shuo knew what he was thinking, so he said, “Although I am the emperor now, I am still your uncle. Could it be that, even you want to be estranged from me?” ꞦἈꞐɵᛒÊŚ
Speaking of this, Ye Shuo was really a little sad.
Ye Yan and the others couldn’t help but think of Ye Xun and Ye Jin.
One was the Ninth Prince’s favourite, and the other was the one the Ninth Prince took good care of. In the end, the one he loved the most not only killed the one he took good care of, but also wanted to kill him. What the hell was going on!
The two nephews were useless. As expected, in the end, it all depended on them.
After the Ninth Prince became the emperor, there didn’t seem to be any changes in the way he treated them. After a meal, the three brothers Ye Yan gradually relaxed.
I thought things would be different after my uncle became emperor, but fortunately it didn’t. It seemed like Ye Yan and his brothers were back to the way they were before.
As I grow older, I realise more how precious it is to be young and ignorant of the world, and I cherish the few people and things that are left.
That’s great…
Putting down the bowl and chopsticks, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but remind them as an uncle: “Although you are on duty, you must also take care of yourselves, especially don’t have too much contact with patients. Once you enter the epidemic area, you need to wash and change your clothes frequently every day, and your underwear needs to be boiled and disinfected with boiling water. Remember?”
Ye Shuo also didn’t want to risk their own lives because of this matter.
Only their mothers would say such things. As for their father… Never mind, their father is not that kind of person.
Ye Yan nodded hurriedly: “Remember.”
Looking at the happy scene in front of him, the eldest prince on the side was deeply doubtful whether this was his own son or the son born to him.
After lunch, Ye Yan and his brothers went back to discuss what to do.
Ye Shuo turned his head and was startled by the eldest prince’s face full of resentment: “Why are you still here?”
“I thought you had left a long time ago.”
If it weren’t for the fact that he was the emperor now, the eldest prince would have jumped up from his chair long ago.
From the beginning to the end, has anyone ever cared about him?
But even though he is now the emperor, the eldest prince still has to say: “Your Majesty is really a good man.”
“Thank you for the compliment.” Ye Shuo coughed lightly.
“Don’t worry, Yan’er and the others are my closest nephews and nieces. If they do their job well, I won’t treat them unfairly in the future.”
Ye Shuo has always been clear about rewards and punishments. He would never ask those who have made contributions to work for nothing.
Even if he is your own nephew, if you only consider family affection, the family affection will be exhausted sooner or later. Only when there is give and take can the relationship last long.
Hearing this, the eldest prince’s heart was moved.
You know, although he is a prince now, when the title is passed to Yan’er, it will become a county prince. Not to mention the remaining ones, it will only be lower. It will be a question whether he has it or not at that time.
In the end, it would be totally worth it if I could give my son the title of prince.
Nowadays, as long as there is benefit, you will work for anyone. So far, the eldest prince has never seen his younger brother go back on his word, which shows the importance of reputation.
Anyway, things have already been decided, so I might as well find a way to get more benefits. At least I can feel more at ease with the one in front of me.
Upon hearing this, the eldest prince’s attitude quickly softened: “Well… In that case, I would like to thank the emperor on behalf of Yan’er and the others.”
Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows, as if he had thought of something, and said, “I remember that Yan’er has been married for a few years, right? He has children too. Counting the days, he will soon be old enough to start learning. When the time comes, I will take him to the palace to study. What do you think, my brother?”
When Emperor Jingwen was alive, the eldest prince, as the son of Emperor Jingwen, could send his own children to study in the palace. Now that Emperor Jingwen is gone, and it is Ye Shuo’s turn to be in charge, his status as a prince is no longer useful. Even the eldest prince is not useful, let alone the son of the eldest prince’s son.
Whether or not one can have this honour depends on the emperor’s own wishes.
Seeing that his grandchildren would have to rely on his younger brother in the future, the eldest prince immediately changed his tone: “Your Majesty, do you have any other instructions? Although my legs and feet are not very good now, ordinary things are not difficult for me.”
The eldest prince thought that if his sons were not enough, he could fill in the gap as he was just sitting there doing nothing anyway.
Since the eldest prince said so, why would Ye Shuo be polite to him? But there was no need to use them for the time being, so let’s just leave it alone.
After discussing official business, what remains is personal matters.
Ye Shuo looked out the window and sighed: “Think about it, time flies by so fast. In the blink of an eye, only a few of us brothers are left.”
Speaking of this, the eldest prince couldn’t help feeling sad.
“yes……”
If only time could stay at the most beautiful place forever.
What happened in the past has already happened, so let it go. I hope there won’t be any more trouble in the future.
Ye Shuo and the eldest prince had almost the same thought in their minds.
After the eldest prince left, Ye Shuo immediately invited his eldest cousin into the palace.
After Wei Wen finished his greetings, he heard him say, “You are in charge of the Ministry of War now. Have you counted the number of weapons and horses in the army?”
Wei Wen had an excellent memory and quickly reported a string of numbers.
Although this number is not small, it is not much in comparison. It is only enough to deal with small-scale conflicts. If the Great Chen and Beiting raise troops to attack, it is probably far from enough.
But now the plague is rampant. Before the plague is under control, we probably don’t have the power to refine weapons on a large scale.
Ye Shuo could only turn his attention to Lu City again.
“Although there is no movement between the two countries now, it may not be due to the plague.” Even if a country is as powerful as Beiting or as ruthless as the State of Chen, once it is infected with the plague, it will not be much better than the people of the Great Zhou.
They don’t dare to come now, but if the plague is over, that may not be the case.
Ye Shuo thought it would be better to prepare early.
Wei Wen also had some guesses in his mind, so he nodded and agreed, “Yes.”
As soon as the two finished talking, a gust of wind blew, and the sound of tinkling bells came from the entrance of the Qinzheng Hall.
The source of the sound was none other than the shell wind chime.
When Emperor Taicheng left, he did not have time to order people to remove the things. After the young emperor ascended the throne, he naturally would not let anyone touch his father’s things. Now it was Ye Shuo’s turn. He also felt that the ding-dong sounds were quite nice. What’s more, he made it with his own hands and it was very commemorative.
Now that I have lost my freedom, it would be nice to listen to the sound of wind chimes more often.
Wei Wen looked at the young man in front of him who was reading the memorials with his head down, and he felt that he was becoming more and more like an emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Trivial
chapters.content:
After the afternoon, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but put down the brush in his hand.
Looking at the barely legible handwriting on the memorial, Ye Shuo twitched the corners of his mouth, feeling a little bit unable to look at it.
But who cares? It’s not me who wants to watch it.
When Ye Shuo arrived at the Imperial Medical Bureau, Yao Zhi was debating something with a group of imperial doctors.
Plague is an extremely complicated issue. It takes a lot of time just to trace the source and analyse the cause, not to mention how to use medicine and prescribe medicine in the future.
These days, the moment Yao Zhi opened her eyes, she would flip through medical books. Even their bedroom was piled with all kinds of medical books. Hard work pays off. The imperial physicians in the Imperial Medical Bureau followed the right path, and their medical skills were all inherited from their family. When they collided with Yao Zhi’s “evil ways”, they were able to make some progress in their research.
But it is still in the discussion stage, and there is still a long way to go before we can prescribe medicine.
“Azhi, it’s time to eat.” After their discussion came to a temporary halt, Ye Shuo stood outside and shouted.
“Greetings to the Emperor. Long live the Emperor.”
The imperial doctors were shocked at first, and then hurriedly saluted.“Everyone, please get up. Thank you for your hard work.” Ye Shuo walked in and raised his hand.
Yao Zhi opened her mouth and wanted to say something at first, but when she saw the disapproval in the young man’s eyes, she couldn’t help but say helplessly: “…Okay.”
Yao Zhi also felt that she seemed to be too crazy recently.
The two walked side by side as usual. Although there were no special movements, they looked extremely harmonious to outsiders.
Even in ordinary families, it was rare for wives to stand shoulder to shoulder with their husbands, let alone in the royal family.
It was the same at the coronation ceremony half a month ago. His Majesty, regardless of the looks of the crowd, insisted on walking down the stone steps, holding hands with the Queen and walking up again. I don’t know how many adults were shocked at the time. If the ceremony could not be interrupted midway, so many people would have rushed up to separate the Emperor and the Queen.
The next day, when the emperor was in court, the censors were so angry that they spit all over the floor. But what was the use?
Of course, the emperor did not punish those people. In fact, his attitude was very good. He admitted his mistakes on the spot, which made the censors very proud, thinking that their spring had finally come. 𝐑𝐀ＮȰВЁ𝐒
That’s right. Throughout history, how many emperors did not cherish their reputation? The censors and imperial censors were a group of people that even the emperors did not dare to offend.
As a result, a few days later, everyone discovered that although the emperor admitted his mistake, he had not changed at all behind the scenes and continued to do things the same way.
When pointed out by the censors, they continued to speak in a nice manner, and kept pointing and recognizing, and then recognizing and pointing again. After all this, several censors almost vomited blood.
The emperor is clearly being a scoundrel, what can a few censors do to him?
Bang your head against the wall and make a last accusation, it’s not worth it, it only makes you look petty, keep talking, it’s useless even if you wear your lips out.
Just when several imperial doctors were sighing in their hearts, after Ye Shuo left, the young eunuch beside him took the initiative to stand up.
The young eunuch was holding a tray covered with a layer of red silk. Just as several imperial doctors were puzzled, the red silk was lifted, revealing some snow-white silver coins inside.
Seeing the doctors stunned, the young eunuch explained softly, “The weather has been hot in recent days. His Majesty wants to thank you all for your hard work. Although this amount of silver is not much, I think it would be good to ask you to make some mung bean soup to cool you down.”
Even if he was the emperor, Ye Shuo wouldn’t ask people to work for nothing, right?
The several doctors in the Imperial Medical Service are considered to be the top people in the medical field of the Great Zhou Dynasty. They are technical talents. No matter how loud the slogans are, they are not as reliable as the practical benefits.
The imperial physicians in the Imperial Medical Bureau are also human beings. They cannot survive by living in the open air. They also have a family to support. Although money is a common thing, no one can live without it.
As the young eunuch in front of them said, the money was indeed not much, just about one month’s salary for them, but it gave them hope.
If you work harder, you will naturally reap the benefits.
Seeing this, the young eunuch also added, “The emperor also said that after this plague is over, he will reward you according to your performance. At that time, you will move into the Hall of Supreme Harmony, be given imperial decrees, and be given titles for your wives and children.”
Considering the present state of the Great Zhou, if the plague could be contained, it would not be an exaggeration to move into the Hall of Supreme Harmony and enjoy offerings together with the Ye royal family.
You know, in the past, only some important officials of the court, such as Prime Minister He, could enjoy this kind of honour. When would it be the turn of those imperial physicians like them?
Once they enter the Hall of Supreme Harmony, it is not important for them to have a good face. What is important is that they can benefit their offspring. How can they not seize such a rare opportunity?
However, the imperial doctors were just getting excited when the young eunuch saw that no one was around and lowered his voice to remind them: “It’s just that this afternoon, I saw that the emperor personally wrote a notice and prepared to send it to the people early tomorrow morning.”
In other words, such rewards are not only for oneself, but also for all the people of the Great Zhou. Anyone who has made a contribution, regardless of their background, will be included in this group.
There will always be brave men when there is a big reward. In such a big Zhou, is it possible that we can’t find a few useful people?
As expected, although there are many benefits, they are not free.
The chief judge of the Imperial Hospital calmed down a little, and then asked, “Excuse me, eunuch, does the emperor have anything else to tell you?”
The young eunuch thought for a moment and said, “The emperor also said that the plague is a matter of great importance. We must not falsify information or take credit for other people’s achievements. Otherwise, once discovered, no matter who it is, they will be punished without pardon.”
What belongs to whomever it belongs to, even if the other party is just a nobody.
“I believe that with your abilities, you would not bother to do such a thing. Your starting point is much higher than that of ordinary people, and you have your own abilities. Your Majesty may be worrying too much.”
The imperial doctors remembered again that the current emperor would not mention anything else, but he would definitely not show mercy.
After the conversation, everyone was excited, but also felt cold sweat on their backs.
“Thank you, eunuch. We understand.” The judge calmed himself down and then politely sent the young eunuch out.
When he returned to the room, he found that everyone’s minds were indeed beginning to waver, and the judge couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
It is already difficult for the imperial physicians in the Imperial Medical Bureau to be promoted, and the opportunities are fleeting. No one knows how many people will make it through this time, and how many will be eliminated. Especially for a judge like himself, it would be embarrassing if he fell behind.
After the judge returned home, he gave the silver to his wife. Seeing that his wife was very happy and was planning to buy some big items for the house, the judge had no choice but to light the oil lamp and continue reading the medical book.
The other side.
Just as Ye Shuo was about to have dinner, he heard the news that Prince Su and Prince Jin had entered the palace.
Recently, his two uncles have been urging him to select concubines every day, and Ye Shuo is getting a headache.
He is almost busy to death every day, but even so, he is still required to be the seed drill of Da Zhou, and he can’t even have a quiet night. Is there any humanity left?
So when he saw Prince Su and Prince Jin, Ye Shuo didn’t wait for them to speak, but hurriedly assigned a bunch of work to their sons.
Anyway, Ye Shuo is short of manpower recently, so it’s better to take advantage of a free job. Although the two uncles are old, their sons are still young.
“The military camp in the east of the city is under the command of General Wei. There has been no suitable candidate for the west of the city since General Yunhui was executed. If I remember correctly, my uncle also led troops in the past, but he is old now. I am not such a ruthless person. As the saying goes, a tiger father will never have a dog son. So let my cousin take charge. It is also a good opportunity for my cousins ​​to show their skills.”
Compared to the outside world, the military camp is of paramount importance. If the plague spreads in the army, that would be really bad.
Prince Su’s heart suddenly jumped: “This… is such a heavy burden, how can Guang’er bear it?”
Ye Shuo had investigated and found that Prince Su’s sons did have some abilities, but they were just afraid of taking responsibility.
“If he can’t handle it alone, then he can ask a few cousins ​​to go with him, so that they can take care of him.”
Ye Shuo got all of Prince Su’s sons in at once, and then he looked at Prince Jin who was standing beside him: “If I remember correctly, the youngest son of the emperor’s uncle seemed to have caused trouble outside a few days ago. I heard that he beat up the son of some master’s family?”
Prince Jin was a ridiculous person when he was young, and his son followed suit. Now, in front of Ye Shuo, he suddenly lost his composure.
“This… is just a common fight between children. It’s not worth mentioning, not worth mentioning…”
How dare the King of Jin say anything more!
After Ye Shuo left, the two old princes both had bitter faces. Now, not only did they fail in the beauty pageant, but their sons were in trouble.
But what can be done? They are not invulnerable.
“Forget it, forget it. Since His Majesty doesn’t have this idea for the time being, let’s wait a little longer until the plague is over.” Let’s see what excuses he can come up with after the plague is over.
King Jin sighed, “This is all we can do for now.”
When Ye Shuo returned to Chengming Palace, Yao Zhi had been waiting for him for a while.
This was the bad thing about ancient times. If he was not there, the imperial kitchen would not even dare to serve any food.
“I’ll talk to them about it later.” Ye Shuo subconsciously kept this matter in mind.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but shake her head: “Just wait a little longer, what’s the big deal.”
Seeing that the young man opposite did not mention anything else, Yao Zhi knew that the two old princes had been blocked by him again.
It would be too false to say that I was not moved in my heart.
But soon, Yao Zhi’s attention was attracted by the dishes in front of her.
Ye Shuo seemed to have guessed what she wanted to say, and said, “I’m not used to so many varieties of food for every meal, so I told them to remove some of them.” Otherwise it would be a real waste.
Yao Zhi naturally had no objection to this.
only……
“Even if the two of us try to be frugal, we can’t save much.” But asking the palace maids and eunuchs to be frugal is not very realistic.
“But in fact, if it is normal spending and not so much is pocketed, a lot can still be squeezed out.”
Ye Shuo said this while picking up some food.
Just when Yao Zhi was a little confused about what he meant, she saw Wu Yi suddenly appear. Yao Zhi tensed for a moment, and then she breathed a sigh of relief when she saw it was him.
Wu Yi never expected that, after he was already in his forties and had finally escaped from the secret guards, he ended up being thrown back in.
There was no way. The previous two generations of emperors died too quickly, and when it was Ye Shuo’s turn, there was even nothing left. Wu Yi could only take on the responsibility of training the secret guards again.
Most of the people in front were dead, and few of them could recognize him. Even if they felt he looked familiar and guessed Wu Yi’s identity, no one dared to say it out loud under the current circumstances.
Wu Yi went back this time not to do anything else but to throw something to the eunuch in charge of the Imperial Household Department.
The thing was very ordinary, just a few ordinary whiskers, but when the eunuch saw it, his face changed drastically.
This beard is only found in his secret room. Now that the masked man in black can find it, it proves that his secret room has been exposed and the things inside are no longer a secret.
The eunuch in charge of the Imperial Household Department naturally knew that the emperor seemed to have found out about him, and he had no power to resist at all. He could only hope that the emperor would spare his life.
However, in just one day, the other party vomited out all he had accumulated over the years, and only then was he able to barely keep his life.
It’s not that Ye Shuo didn’t want to kill him, but if he killed him at this time, others would be scared. Ye Shuo’s goal was only to get the silver they embezzled, so he had to get the silver first.
What was given to the imperial doctors today was confiscated from the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
The person in charge of the Imperial Household Department now has been replaced by the chief eunuch beside Emperor Taicheng. That eunuch had followed Ye Shuo for a while before Xiao Luzi came back. He vaguely understood the temperament of the current emperor and roughly guessed where his bottom line was.
What’s more, few of the eunuchs in charge of the Imperial Household Department who served as the chief eunuchs of the previous emperor had a good ending when the next emperor ascended the throne. They were able to be transferred to the Imperial Household Department. The eunuchs around Emperor Taicheng were already very self-sufficient, so the Imperial Household Department must have had a long period of peace.
After listening, Ye Shuo nodded with satisfaction: “Well done.”
Just as Wu Yi was about to salute, he heard him say, “That’s great, let’s sit down and eat together.”
Caught off guard, Wu was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Title
chapters.content:
Wu Yi’s subconscious action: “I dare not.”
However, before his knees could touch the ground, Ye Shuo grabbed his arms.
“Alright, alright, Master, there are no outsiders here, why are you being so polite?” Ye Shuo had finally straightened him out before, how could he change back?
Wu Yi glanced subconsciously, and indeed saw that all the palace servants around him had been sent out by him.
While Wu Yi was distracted, Ye Shuo pushed him onto the stool next to him without saying a word.
Wu Yi couldn’t resist and could only pick up the chopsticks tentatively. However, Ye Shuo’s first sentence made him freeze there.
“By the way, Master, you’re almost fifty, right? Have you ever thought about getting married, having a baby, etc.? If so, you’d better hurry up, otherwise it will be too late.”
“While you still have your beauty and figure, and you have great martial arts skills, there are still girls and widows who like you. In a few years, it will be really difficult.”
Yao Zhi, who was standing by, was almost choked to death by his sudden words.
Looking at Wu Yi again, he didn’t know whether to put down the chopsticks or not. After a long pause, he could only utter one sentence: “I have never thought of this before.”What wife and children? These things have nothing to do with him since his first day of training. Decades have passed, it would be strange if Wu Yi could turn things around.
But Ye Shuo wanted him to have a home from the bottom of his heart. Ye Shuo didn’t mind asking Ding Ning to call him master, but others’ things are always not as good as your own, right?
Then it became Ye Shuo’s one-sided urging. Wu Yi kept shaking his head. After finally finishing the food in the bowl, Wu Yi couldn’t stand it anymore. After saying “I should go back to training”, he disappeared in an instant.
Ye Shuo’s eyes were full of regret.
Yao Zhi always felt that he was being pushed too hard by Prince Su and Prince Jin, and then he transferred his pain to Wu Yi. Poor Wu Yi…
At night, the palace maids cleared away the dishes and the room was brightly lit with candles. Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi were reading memorials and medical books respectively.
Ye Shuo felt that the scene before him was extremely tragic.
“Wait until the plague is over. I will transfer Xing Yucheng to my side no matter what.” Now is a special situation. He has to do both. Otherwise, the noise will be too complicated and the efficiency will inevitably be reduced. Later, Ye Shuo will have to be released. Otherwise, he will be too busy to handle it even if he is exhausted.
Coincidentally, Yao Zhi thought so too.
“I need to have a good rest after the plague is over.” She was almost sick of reading so many medical books recently.
“Come on, let’s not talk about this, go to sleep.”
Ye Shuo jumped onto the dragon bed and patted it with his hand.
The young man had beautiful eyebrows and eyes, and Yao Zhi was naturally moved, but…
“If the censors knew about this, they would cry out to the heavens and accuse us of being unruly.” Now, whenever Yao Zhi thought of that scene, she couldn’t help but want to laugh. ŘåŊŏᛒÈṨ
“What rules are there between husband and wife?” Just scold her, it won’t cost you anything, right?
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows: “Besides, when did you ever talk about the rules?”
Yao Zhi herself is a person who is not very bound by worldly matters.
“That’s true.” After hearing what he said, Yao Zhi no longer felt any psychological burden. She lifted the quilt and crawled in immediately.
The young couple quarrelled for a while. Before going to bed, Yao Zhi suddenly thought of something.
Isn’t it said that there is always someone beside the emperor to record the emperor’s sleeping, how come it has been so long since I saw him?
What Yao Zhi didn’t know was that seven or eight metres away outside the palace, the Ye Ting Ling, holding a pen, was looking at the newly appointed Si Li Jian’s seal-holding eunuch Wang Lu in front of him, and he was about to cry.
How could he write this? If he did, would His Majesty forgive him?
But he had to write it, so the Ye Ting Ling almost exhausted all his efforts to make the booklet not so ridiculous.
He glanced at Xiaoluzi, which was in the middle of Wanglu, and nodded, quite satisfied.
Seeing this, the Ye Ting Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
Finally, in a state of half-sleep and half-wakefulness, Yao Zhi said, “I have learned a little about the cause of this plague from the imperial physician of the Imperial Hospital, and I have some ideas in my mind, but this alone is not enough. I need to go outside and meet enough people who are infected.”
Without enough patients, how could they develop an effective prescription?
Ye Shuo certainly didn’t want her to take risks. Now he was the emperor and she was the queen. There were so many people in the world who could be used, why did it have to be her?
Ye Shuo was also a very selfish person. He wished that everyone around him was fine and nothing would happen to them. But in the end, he nodded: “…Yeah.”
“good.”
Then, Ye Shuo even gave her an idea.
“With just a few of you, a dozen people is definitely not enough. You might as well find some more helpers.”
Yao Zhi laughed when she heard this: “Most people are illiterate, let alone know medical skills. If they mess around, it will not only fail to help, but will cause more trouble.”
What Ye Shuo was talking about was not a doctor at all.
“You don’t need them to know so much. You just need to teach them how to prevent and deal with patients after they are found, how to assist you, and how to regulate sick people.”
If such a role were placed in modern times, it would be called a nurse.
Training such a group of people in advance will definitely reduce a lot of the burden on Yao Zhi and other imperial doctors.
Yao Zhi was no longer sleepy all of a sudden. After weighing the options, she felt that this idea seemed very good.
“I suddenly feel that He Xiang and the others seem to have underestimated you.”
However, Ye Shuo hurriedly shook his head after hearing this: “No, no, no, please don’t praise me like that, I can’t bear it.”
If everyone thinks this way, who would be willing to help him with his work?
The next morning, Yao Zhi went out before daybreak. By the time Ye Shuo had washed up, dressed, and finished breakfast, it was almost dawn.
The court officials looked numb, having long been accustomed to this.
When Ye Shuo arrived at the Xuanzheng Hall, he sat on the dragon chair and yawned as he said, “If you have something to say, then talk about it. If not, then leave the court.”
When the plague is over, he will definitely change the time of this morning court session.
Completely unaware of what the emperor above him was planning, the moment Ye Shuo finished speaking, the censor was the first to stand up and say, “Your Majesty, you and the Empress, this, this is not right!” How could an emperor and an empress share the same bedroom and sleep on the same bed?
Ye Shuo was speechless: “It’s already this late, why are you guys still focusing on the trivial matters between a couple? Has the plague been cured? Are the people living and working in peace and contentment? If not, then pick the most important ones and solve them first. Okay, shut up, next one!”
Without waiting for the censor to speak again, Ye Shuo pointed decisively at Prime Minister He.
Prime Minister He didn’t have any way to cure the plague, but he had a plan for the national treasury. He couldn’t get money from the people at the moment, so he could only find a way to get money from the rich merchants.
Among the four classes of people, scholars, farmers, merchants and artisans, merchants are the last but the richest. Now that they have money, they begin to think about pursuing fame and fortune.
For the emperor, fame and fortune were just a matter of words.
Ye Shuo thought about it and thought this was a good idea, so he nodded: “Okay, I agree.”
The plague issue came to an end for the time being, and Ye Shuo started asking questions about himself again.
“By the way, I asked you to help me draft my title and reign title. Have you finished it?”
This time Ye Shuo learned his lesson and didn’t choose the words himself. He asked them to choose for themselves. Ye Shuo wanted to see what these people in front of him could choose for him.
If they dared to treat him the same way they treated Xiao Ming, Ye Shuo guaranteed that they would not have an easy life.
The moment the words fell, He Xiang and the others fell silent.
Speaking of this, He Xiang and others felt extremely worried, and felt that it was more difficult for them than the plague, because they knew in their hearts that if they failed to handle it well and made the emperor unhappy, he would definitely lose his temper again.
It’s just a mere title. There’s no need to make him unhappy over such a small matter. You will be the one who suffers then.
He Xiang hesitated for a long time and asked tentatively: “Zhending… What does His Majesty think?”
Ye Shuo frowned: “Is there anyone who is more majestic and domineering?”
How long have you been here? What have you done? If you want to be powerful and domineering, why don’t you turn the world upside down!
He Xiang held his breath, but he didn’t dare to say anything, and decisively changed to another one.
“So…Yongxi?”
Ye Shuo: “Anything else?”
He Xiang: “…”
“Wanhe? Zhenhong? Rongkang?”
It can be seen that He Xiang and his companions did not slack off and tried their best to fit him into these words with excellent meanings.
However, when he said it, He Xiang still felt a pang of heart pain. He Xiang, Shangshu Ling and others thought they could hold it in, but as soon as they finished speaking, Ye Shuo said something.
“Forget it. After listening for a long time, I feel that Yongxi is better. Let’s choose this one.”
After talking for a long time, he finally chose the second one.
“Just barely, worthy of me.”
“Okay, let’s adjourn.”
“Oh, by the way, Wei Wen, come with me.”
He still despised it, he actually still despised it!
Looking at the young man’s back, He Xiang and others were speechless for a long time. When He Xiang and others’ students looked over, they found that the teachers’ hands were now trembling slightly.
*
“…Lord He and the others must be very angry.” Wei Wen didn’t even dare to imagine how they felt at the moment.
Ye Shuo thought, this is just the beginning, but on the surface, he asked another question.
“Is there any news from Lucheng? What’s going on with Beiting and Chen?”
Upon hearing this, Wei Wen’s expression became serious: “As Your Majesty expected, there have indeed been unusual movements between the two countries in recent times.”
The Great Zhou had lost two emperors in a row, and now the one who came to power is the notorious one. It would be strange if Beiting and Chen could endure it.
“Think of a way to give them something to do.” So that we don’t have to stare at them all day long.
“By the way, let more people from Lucheng go to Chen State to investigate, especially the miasma on the border of Chen State. I think it should be useful when the time comes.”
Lu City is far away from the Emperor of the Great Zhou, and the people sent there to garrison are not without ulterior motives. However, Ye Shuo once sent someone to deliver a black box. After seeing the objects in the black box, the people stationed in Lu City suddenly became obedient.
“yes.”
After Wei Wen left, Ye Shuo stood on a high place and looked into the distance.
It is true that the Great Zhou is weak now, but he still hopes that Chen State and Beiting will not be tactless. Otherwise, don’t blame him for being rude.
After so many years, with new and old grudges, these two countries are really annoying.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Zhao Cheng
chapters.content:
In addition to weapons manufacturing, food security is also a top priority. Especially now that the plague is raging, a reduction in food production this year is almost certain to happen.
In ancient times, productivity was low, and even in years of plenty, people might not be able to have enough food to eat, let alone in a year of disaster like the current one.
Ye Shuo thought about it, then summoned Zou Wu into the palace.
“Your Majesty, long live Your Majesty.”
It was a rare opportunity to see the teacher alone, so Zou Wu couldn’t help but feel excited.
Ye Shuo didn’t waste time and got straight to the point: “How are the experimental fields and seeds that were granted to you in the suburbs of Beijing?”
The seeds were none other than the excellent rice seeds introduced from Lucheng. However, no matter how good the rice seeds were, no one would believe Ye Shuo’s empty words. Not to mention Prime Minister He and others, he would not be able to pass the test of the common people.
Think about it, their own land is growing well, and then suddenly they are told to change the seeds, and they have to change them uniformly and compulsorily. Who would be happy about this?
The rice grown with the previous seeds will not make people starve to death. What if the yield of the new rice seeds is not good? For ordinary people, if they fail to harvest food in one season, they are at risk of starvation.
Ye Shuo had to produce evidence before he could promote planting on a large scale, so he approved several experimental fields as early as when he ascended the throne. After such a long time, there must have been some results.The result was similar to what Ye Shuo had expected.
“Reporting to Your Majesty, the seeds you gave me earlier have now grown more than two feet tall. According to your instructions, I applied ammonia fertiliser and they are growing well. I believe that they will be harvested soon in late autumn.”
The so-called ammonia fertiliser mentioned by Zou Wu is not a very rare thing. After all, for the common people, cost is also an extremely critical factor. Once the cost is high, no matter how much it is produced, it will be in vain and unrealistic.
It can be used on a large scale and the method is simple. Just mix a certain proportion of cow dung with soybean powder, and then put it in a sealed container for fermentation. After three days, it can be used. The cost is quite low and everyone can do it.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but nod: “As long as it goes well.”
No matter what, people must not starve to death after the plague.
The Great Zhou cannot afford another severe blow.
After finishing the conversation, Ye Shuo quickly moved on to something else: “By the way, I heard that you have started to accept disciples? According to seniority, you can be considered my disciple’s goddaughter.” ŘÃＮŎβËⱾ
Speaking of this, Zou Wu couldn’t help but feel a little embarrassed: “…They are just a few girls with miserable lives. I couldn’t bear to see them, so I kept them in my home. They are nothing.”
In this world, there are too many women with tragic fates. As a woman herself, Zou Wu couldn’t bear it, so she selected a few of them.
Now that his teacher called him “disciple”, Zou Wu was naturally excited and couldn’t help but clench his hands on both sides.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo paused and then sighed inaudibly: “Thank you for your hard work over the years.”
Zou Wu was obviously the most capable and talented one among these batches of students, but due to her identity as a woman, almost no one looked up to her. The others were either accepted as disciples by He Xiang and others at an early stage and rose to high positions, or were appreciated by two emperors and sent to important positions in local areas. Only Zou Wu and a few other women had been working in low-paying government offices such as the Ministry of Works for more than ten years, and it was a good thing for them to be a minor official of the fifth or sixth rank.
If we only consider ability, it must be far more than that.
Higher ability, but different treatment, it’s really unbearable.
Zou Wu is already in her twenties or thirties now, but when she heard the word “hardship”, she couldn’t help but feel a little sad.
“It’s still better after all.” So be it, a small official. Even if it’s a small official, not everyone can do it.
Zou Wu couldn’t help but think of the joy in suffering.
However, Ye Shuo had never heard of any country that could become rich and powerful without relying on women. Among all the top countries, women played an extremely important role.
If the Great Zhou wants to become stronger than Beiting and the State of Chen, it must first change its concept. Whoever takes this step first will be able to seize the initiative.
“Don’t worry, everything will be fine in the future.” After a moment, Ye Shuo suddenly said this.
Zou Wu was suddenly stunned.
What does the teacher mean?
Seeing her hesitation, Ye Shuo nodded slightly, confirming her guess.
Zou Wu’s heart suddenly began beating violently.
If this is true, if this is true…
“teacher!”
Zou Wu felt that being his student was the luckiest thing in the world.
In the end, Zou Wu was afraid that others would see her red eyes, so she walked out with her head down.
Looking at her back, Ye Shuo let out a long breath.
A few days passed like this. Ever since Yao Zhi left, the palace became increasingly empty. Ye Shuo didn’t even have anyone to talk to.
There was no way, Ye Shuo could only turn his attention to Jian Jian.
At first, Jianjian was very patient and felt sorry for the lonely old man who had lost his wife, but after a long time, Jianjian could no longer bear it.
“Royal brother, don’t you have anything else to do?”
The plague outside hasn’t gone away yet.
But in fact, Ye Shuo had done everything he should do and issued all the orders he should give. It would be useless for him to worry about the rest.
“Why should I care about them? Now I just eat, review documents and sleep every day.”
Hearing the news from the students below, it was said that He Xiang and Shang Shuling were now gathering together for meetings every day, discussing what to do now and what to do in the future. Ye Shuo was so worried that he wanted to break his heart. After all, if the Great Zhou wanted to become strong again, he couldn’t rely on him alone, right? Everyone worked together, and the wheels below could turn fast and steadily.
The word “development” has never been just one thing.
The more relaxed Ye Shuo spoke, the more distorted Jian Jian’s expression became.
Jian Jian was almost pissed off by him: “Why don’t you think about what to do if He Xiang and the others sideline you?!”
Jianjian lowered her voice to the lowest possible level, her eyes full of disappointment.
“Also, my royal brother, you should call yourself ‘I’ now. Even if you are not used to it, you can’t do it like before.” My, my, my, how can I convince others after such a long time?
The little girl has learned a lot now…
Ye Shuo blinked: “Ah?”
“It shouldn’t be…right? I think He Xiang and his people are pretty nice people.”
That look is simply that of a naive and innocent person.
He actually felt that there was a good person among the group of old foxes in the hall.
Jianjian almost vomited blood.
He is hopeless, he really is hopeless.
Did the man who killed all the warriors in the yard with a sword really exist?
But he was her brother after all, and Jianjian couldn’t really ignore him. Although Jianjian really wanted to run as far as possible, in the end, Jianjian still gritted his teeth and spoke.
“Brother, give me a team.”
Now the secret guards haven’t been trained yet, and his brother has almost no control over Shangjing. If there is no one to supervise, if someone with ulterior motives mixes in, he won’t even have time to cry.
And Ye Shuo’s next words made Jian Jian’s eyes go dark.
