“You want someone, right? Here, this is the token. Go find Li Yuheng and pick one from the Black Armor Guards.”
He didn’t even ask what she was going to do…
Oh my God, the current situation is special, but if he is still like this after the plague is over, it will really be a big deal, right?
Jianjian clenched her fists until they creaked, looked at him intently, and turned away.
After a while, a light laugh was heard from the Qinzheng Hall.
This sister was really not raised in vain. Now she knows how to worry about her brother.
Now, another burden was relieved from Ye Shuo’s shoulders, and he even had time to stroll around the Imperial Garden.
“By the way, do you know where Princess Zhaocheng is now?” In his spare time, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think of the last trace of blood left by Xiao Ming.
After Ye Shuo ascended the throne, he did not issue an order to expel them. He just wanted to avoid suspicion and asked Emperor Taicheng’s concubines to move to other palaces, farther away from where Ye Shuo lived.
Being aware of all kinds of news in the palace is a basic quality worthy of the eunuch in charge of the Imperial Household Department. Xiao Luzi gave the answer after just a little thought.
“Princess Zhaocheng is now living with Concubine Sun in the westernmost Jinghuan Palace.”
“Take me over to have a look.”
Ye Shuo was not too worried as he had so many palace servants following him.
When they were about seventeen or eighteen metres away from Jinghuan Palace, Ye Shuo heard the noise of playing and waved to the palace servants.
The palace maids understood and immediately became quiet.
Perhaps it was because they had been suppressed for too long. During the last period of Emperor Taicheng’s reign and the period of the young emperor, no laughter was heard in the palace for nearly two years.
Now that the situation has improved, the child’s repressed nature has finally been released.
Princess Zhaocheng is only nine years old now, and will be ten years old in two months. She is at a playful age, and is currently playing hide-and-seek with Concubine Sun’s personal maid.
From time to time, you can hear the cries of children.
“Cuiyun, Cuiyun, run slower. Don’t run outside. Do you hear me?”
Listening to the little girl’s clear voice, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think of his daughter.
Counting the days, Dingning is now more than half a year old. In another half a year, when she is strong enough, she will be able to return to Beijing.
Perhaps because he loves the girl so much, Ye Shuo can’t help but feel soft-hearted whenever he sees the little girl.
While Ye Shuo was stunned, Princess Zhaocheng seemed to have noticed something, and she approached stealthily, and then without thinking, she hugged the blurry figure in front of her.
“Cuiyun, I finally caught you! Let’s see where you can run this time!”
The little princess was so excited that she took off the blindfold without thinking.
But soon, she found something wrong. The waist of the person in front of her was not as soft as Cuiyun’s, and the smell on her body was not right. Looking from bottom to top, what caught the little princess’s eyes was a dark silk brocade that seemed to sink into water, and on top of the silk brocade was a ferocious golden dragon embroidered with gold thread.
Then, there was a very unfamiliar, but particularly handsome face.
The little princess had seen her father and brother wearing clothes like this.
Hearing the noise, Concubine Sun walked out of the house. When she saw Ye Shuo, her face subconsciously turned pale.
“Qin’er, you have offended His Majesty, why don’t you kneel down!”

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Arrival
chapters.content:
Concubine Sun had never dealt with Ye Shuo before, but she knew the principle of a new emperor and new ministers. Even though her daughter was an extremely noble princess, after her father and brother were gone, only a nice name remained.
Although she didn’t fall into the mud, she was not much better than an ordinary royal family girl, and even worse than the legitimate daughters of Prince Su, Prince Jin and Prince Ding. After all, several princesses and their fathers helped her fight for her life.
Concubine Sun didn’t know what the new emperor was here for, but it wouldn’t hurt to be respectful.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help feeling sad when he saw this scene.
This was probably the reason why Xiao Ming tried his best to hold on. Once he was gone, his children would be bullied by others.
Ye Shuo felt that he had to live longer, otherwise today’s Zhaocheng would be tomorrow’s Dingning.
The little princess was also frightened by her mother’s stern shout. After a moment of hesitation, she quickly let go: “Zhao, Zhao Cheng pays respects to the Ninth, Ninth Uncle…”
The little girl, who was so cheerful just now, suddenly started to stutter.
However, before she could kneel down and salute, she was stopped by Ye Shuo.
“Why should my niece be so polite? If there is any fault, it is the uncle who came unexpectedly without saying hello. Concubine Sun doesn’t have to be too rigid about these etiquettes.”Concubine Sun hurriedly said, “I dare not.” However, when she saw Ye Shuo calling the little princess “niece”, Concubine Sun finally breathed a sigh of relief.
However, after the little princess came back to her senses from her nervousness, the anxiety in her heart suddenly subsided a lot. Perhaps it was because children were naturally more sensitive. She realised that Ye Shuo had no ill intentions, and gradually began to look at the strange uncle in front of her.
Seeing curiosity in the little girl’s eyes, Ye Shuo spread out his arms and let her look at him.
Concubine Sun was about to speak, but when she saw the faint smile on Ye Shuo’s face, she thought about it and finally said nothing.
In the end, the little princess was awakened by Ye Shuo’s voice.
“Well, can you see anything?”
The little girl thought her actions were subtle, but in the eyes of adults they were no different from obvious.
The little princess opened her mouth hurriedly: “No, no…”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows.
The little princess finally got the courage from somewhere and blurted out, “The emperor uncle is so handsome.”
In fact, my father and my elder brother are also good-looking, but in comparison, they are not as good-looking as him.
Who says that children don’t look at faces? Children also look at faces.
Shu Qin, what nonsense is she saying! Concubine Sun felt her scalp numb and her head dizzy. She was about to scold her, but she heard the young man laugh without paying any attention. The noise was so loud that the birds that were roosting in the corner of the west side of the originally deserted palace were frightened and flew away in all directions. ŔãΝŎᛒĘ𝘚
It’s okay when Ye Shuo doesn’t smile. He looks even better when he smiles. He can simply make people stunned.
Ye Shuo was obviously very aware of his own “beauty” and had gotten used to it over the years.
“What a coincidence, other people said the same thing.” Especially He Xiang, who now completely treated him as a beautiful vase.
Ye Shuo didn’t expect that Xiao Ming’s son looked exactly like him, but his daughter was extremely lively.
Come to think of it, in Xiao Ming’s eyes, Jin’er will be the heir to the throne sooner or later. As an emperor, he naturally cannot play around as he pleases, but he can’t help but dote on his only daughter a little more. In such an environment, the little girl will naturally have more childish innocence than Jin’er.
Or maybe in Xiao Ming’s heart, he also longed for innocence and willfulness, so he raised his only daughter to be like this.
In particular, the little princess seemed to look more like her mother and did not inherit Xiao Ming’s weak body. After playing just now, the little girl’s cheeks have become rosy, like a ripe apple, and she does not have the shortcomings like Jin’er.
After heaving a sigh of relief, Ye Shuo then said, “Not only is the emperor uncle handsome, but little Shuqin is also pretty. I just wonder if I have the honour to ask the lovely little Shuqin to accompany the emperor’s uncle to stroll around in this imperial garden?”
In the past, the little princess was loved by her mother, respected by the palace maids, tolerated by other concubines, cherished by the queen, and even her father was extremely tolerant of her. She actually listened to a lot of nice words, but she had never listened such straightforward words as this one.
After all, no matter what, Emperor Taicheng would never say the word “lovely” so bluntly, right?
Before Concubine Sun could speak, the little princess blushed and nodded: “Okay.”
Ever since Ye Shuo ascended the throne, he had never seen Emperor Taicheng’s concubines or the little princess in the imperial garden. He naturally guessed that in order to avoid suspicion, the little princess had not left Jinghuan Palace for a long time.
The little child, at such a young age, is confined to this small world.
After Ye Shuo took her out, he saw that Princess Zhaocheng was like a bird out of a cage, and she talked more.
Ye Shuo laughed, and then chatted with the little girl from time to time.
*
Looking at the backs of the two people, one big and one small, Concubine Sun couldn’t help but let out a long sigh of relief. Judging from the emperor’s appearance, he should not be annoyed with his daughter.
But soon, Concubine Sun’s heart suddenly rose again. It turned out that after she asked carefully, she found out that when the emperor just came, her daughter was playing hide-and-seek with Cuiyun.
You have to know that it has been less than a year since the death of the little emperor. As the uncle of the little emperor, the new emperor does not need to observe mourning for the little emperor, but Zhaocheng is the little emperor’s sister. Will Zhaocheng’s behaviour be disrespectful and cold?
Forgive Concubine Sun. The successive deaths of Emperor Taicheng and the little emperor made her become cautious and careful, fearing that her daughter would hinder someone’s eyes and block someone’s way. She was trembling with fear every day, treading on thin ice.
Concubine Sun’s emotions finally calmed down an hour later, when the sleeping little princess was carried back by the eunuch serving the new emperor.
After all, she was just a child, and she would lose energy when she was tired from playing. It happened that Ye Shuo had some memorials to review, so he did not accompany her back.
After waiting for a while, the little princess woke up rubbing her eyes. Concubine Sun then realised that the two of them not only strolled around the garden in the afternoon, but also had snacks together in the pavilion.
“My uncle told me that from now on I don’t have to stick to those etiquettes. I can go anywhere except his and my aunt’s bedroom. He also told me to go and play with him when I’m free.”
It seems that the new emperor is not a narrow-minded person as rumoured, and he will even tolerate a princess.
If Zhao Chengzhen is close to him, it will naturally be of great benefit to Zhao Cheng’s future selection of potential spouse.
Concubine Sun said, “If that’s the case, then you should get closer to His Majesty.”
“Yes!” The little princess nodded hurriedly. It just so happened that she also liked this imperial uncle very much.
Soon after the mother and daughter finished their conversation, they heard the voice of the young eunuch outside, followed by various things sent from the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
It wasn’t Ye Shuo’s order. He didn’t need to give any orders at all. It had always been like this in this palace.
There are many people in the palace, and even the Ministry of Internal Affairs cannot take care of everything. They are divided according to their closeness to the emperor, empress, and empress dowager. Those who are close to the emperor, empress, and empress dowager will naturally have an easier life.
“Empress Dowager Sun, Princess Zhaocheng, the chief steward said that all the furnishings in Jinghuan Palace are old, and he specifically asked me to replace them.”
How could Concubine Sun not know this after being in the palace for so many years? She was just used to it.
The next day, not long after Ye Shuo woke up from a nap and was about to sit on a chair, he saw a little head suddenly pop up at the door.
In the evening, when Jianjian, who was exhausted as a dog, came back from a group called the Supervisory Department, he saw a scene in the house where a big and a small figure were sitting on the floor having fun.
Almost instantly, the pointy head exploded.
Ye Shuo blinked, looking innocent.
“Ahhhhhhhhh, this princess will fight you!!!”
The other side.
After half a month of investigation, Ye Yan and his colleagues discovered that most of the letters of investigation were true, and they didn’t know how many officials had been brought down along the way.
According to Ye Shuo’s request, Ye Yan and the other three did not need to go through several procedures to be transferred to Shangjing once the facts were verified. As soon as Ye Shuo’s order arrived, they would be killed on the spot.
As a result, most of the public anger was eliminated and there were not many rebels.
There is just one thing: if there is such a random killing, without the person in charge, the situation in the local area can easily become chaotic.
He Xiang and others had no choice but to think of ways to clean up his mess. The emperor handled things too simply and took action right away. They could only follow behind and try their best to make amends.
Just selecting the top people gave them a headache, and with so many things happening recently, the adults had no choice but to rely on their own students.
At this time, no one wanted to be left behind, and several disciples put in their best efforts, picking those who were extremely capable, fearing that if the problem came from them, they would be laughed at by the other side. Sometimes, even the Minister He and the others couldn’t help but sigh that their students were really sharp-eyed, and some people could be found even if they hid so deeply and so inconspicuously.
The group of people who were selected were quite sensible and knew how they came to power, so not long after taking office, they showed their intention to surrender, which made everyone happy.
But after thinking about it, He Xiang and others did not dare to accept it. Recently, the princess set up a place called the Supervisory Office, which was keeping a close eye on people and was coming in with great force, so He Xiang and others naturally did not dare to make any unusual moves.
Prime Minister He and his men had protested before, but His Majesty simply refused to buy it, as if he could not see the power of their unity. Even if they went on strike and suspended court, it would be of no use.
Just stop, just stop. At worst, the people below will rebel and we will all die together.
What else could He Xiang and his colleagues expect from such a mess? Finally, seeing that the emperor simply refused to approve the memorials, He Xiang and his colleagues could no longer bear it and had no choice but to come back.
However, under such circumstances, the plague was gradually brought under control, or at least it stopped spreading further.
Another month passed, and Yao Zhi, together with the imperial physician, Mei Yingzhuo and doctors from all over the Great Zhou, finally developed several effective prescriptions.
Winter arrived in the blink of an eye, and the epidemic that had been contained somehow disappeared miraculously in just over ten days.
As soon as the New Year passed, before the beginning of spring, envoys from Beiting and Chen State arrived as expected.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Tactics
chapters.content:
These two countries are really amazing. It seems that they care more about the affairs of the Great Zhou than they do themselves. As soon as the plague here eased, they sent envoys over.
The eight words “coming with ill intentions” and “taking advantage of the situation to rob” were almost written on their faces.
Ye Shuo wanted to see what they were trying to do.
Even though so many people have tried their best and done everything they should, the population of the Great Zhou still suffered a considerable loss.
Each of these are human lives.
Putting down the household registration statistics results submitted by various places, Ye Shuo let out a long breath. A feeling of pain and heaviness flashed through his heart. When he opened his eyes again, his vision became clear again.
The two countries came together, so there was bound to be quite a stir. Just the discussion on how to entertain them caused a huge uproar in the court.
Ye Shuo sat on top, listening to them cursing, and felt a headache.
In the end, there was really no other way, He Xiang and others couldn’t help but look at him. After all, he was still the emperor.
“May I ask your Majesty, what do you think?”Ye Shuo didn’t even think about it: “I think what you said is wrong. It’s better to listen to my ideas.”
He Xiang thought that Ye Shuo had some brilliant ideas, but he didn’t expect that Ye Shuo’s idea was just to do it casually, just to save face. It was even worse than the suggestions of several generals.
I really shouldn’t have expected anything from him…
He Xiang pulled the corner of his mouth and couldn’t help but remind him: “Chen Guo and Bei Ting came at the same time, I’m afraid they have other intentions.”
“That’s why we must treat them like this because they had bad intentions.”
Ye Shuo said, “Let me ask you, if they really have bad intentions, will treating them with good food and wine be effective? National affairs are not a joke.”
He Xiang hesitated: “This…”
Ye Shuo added: “Similarly, if they have no other intentions, they will not turn against each other just because of a banquet.”
If it was normal, it would be fine. It’s not like the Great Zhou couldn’t afford a few meals, so they would just give it. But in this situation, the people can’t even eat, so where would they get so much spare money to feed these enemies who are obviously unfeedable?
“So listen to me, there’s no need to make a big fuss.”
He Xiang suddenly felt that what he said seemed to make sense.
Wait, I almost got led astray by him.
After calming down, He Xiang said hurriedly: “The matter of hospitality is not only about money, but also about the reputation of the Great Zhou.” It’s not that simple. If we could really save money, we would have saved it long ago. 𝐫𝙖𝐍οʙΕṤ
“We must not lose the face of the Great Zhou, and we must not let the surrounding small countries laugh at us. If that happens, I’m afraid those people will also have rebellious thoughts.”
Face, face, and face again. Ye Shuo didn’t know how many times he had heard this word.
The so-called face, in the final analysis, is that they themselves are not strong enough, otherwise, if they fart, Beiting and Chen will think it smells good. And if the Great Zhou itself is not good enough, no matter how luxurious and gorgeous they make the ceremony, the other two countries will only think that they are bluffing and they don’t know how to laugh at them behind their backs.
As for those small countries on the periphery, they can only envy them, envy that even if the food was replaced with slop, the envoys from Beiting and Chen would eat it with a smile.
Of course, this is a bit exaggerated, but it is the truth.
“What’s the point of talking about face or not? Don’t you think they don’t know about our situation?” The other party knew the situation of the three countries very well. There was no secret.
The plague just ended in the Great Zhou, and they arrived right after. Isn’t that enough to explain the problem?
“Also, don’t forget that my father died in his prime because Beiting was rampant in the Great Zhou, which damaged his foundation. You have forgotten such a deep hatred, but I can’t forget it. Or are you so soft that you can even forget such a thing?”
Speaking of this, Ye Shuo became even angrier.
Seeing that he had brought up Emperor Jingwen, even Prime Minister He was at a loss for words. After all, tracing back, Emperor Jingwen did die because of Beiting.
The hatred for killing one’s father is irreconcilable. If Your Majesty lets it go, it would be unfilial, and if they, as his subjects, let it go, it would be disloyal.
Such words actually aroused the thoughts of He Xiang and others. After all, if Emperor Jingwen was still alive, why would the Great Zhou Dynasty be in such a state…
Seeing that they were silent, Ye Shuo spoke up at the right time: “Do you have any objections, my dear ministers?”
After waiting for a while, Ye Shuo waved his hand and said, “In that case, then do as I say.”
“Resign!”
He Xiang opened his mouth and hesitated for a long time, but he really couldn’t say anything like asking him to put the overall situation first.
As we all know, the emperor has been willful since he was young. How could he know what the overall situation is? When has he ever considered the overall situation? It’s useless to talk about it. When has he ever changed his decision?
There is no way. The person above can’t be relied on. Prime Minister He can only wait until the court is dismissed to have a meeting with the Shangshu Ling and others to work overtime.
The Minister of Rites and the Minister of Honglu Temple were the two people who were most tormented at the moment, because if nothing unexpected happened, the task of receiving the envoys would definitely fall on them.
Especially at this time, if they make any mistake, they may be pushed out as scapegoats.
“Master He, what do you think? Should we… relax a little bit at that time?” The only solution now is to tighten up and loosen up.
During the meeting today, Xing Yucheng, Li Yuheng and the Minister of Works were deliberately avoided because they were afraid that they would complain. That’s why the Minister of Rites and the Minister of Honglu Temple dared to speak like this.
But what’s the point of avoiding Xing Yucheng and the others? Now that the eldest princess controls the Supervisory Office, if anyone dares to disobey her orders, the news will reach the emperor’s desk within two quarters of an hour, and they can only think about it.
Just when the Minister of Rites and the Minister of Honglu thought that the old man at the head was at least verbally supporting them, they didn’t expect that as soon as they finished speaking, they heard He Xiang hurriedly say: “Absolutely not.”
“If His Majesty knew about this, the consequences would be disastrous.”
If the emperor starts to make a scene, who can control him? Even if Prince Su and Prince Jin come, it won’t work. Things will get worse.
“So it’s impossible to tighten the top and loosen the bottom. All we have to do is tighten the top and tighten the bottom even more.”
As soon as He Xiang said this, everyone was dumbfounded.
But soon, Shang Shu Ling was the first to understand what he meant: “You mean, we should keep an eye on those envoys for His Majesty?”
He Xiang nodded: “This old man does have this intention.”
After all these years, how could He Xiang not know what kind of people those envoys were? A bunch of scumbags.
Prime Minister He has never forgotten the time when the current emperor, who was only that old, came to the post station with a knife and killed people. So many years have passed, and the emperor’s temper has not only not been restrained, but has become even worse. If the same thing happens again, a group of envoys will surely die. Not only will the leader die, but the others may not survive either.
But it’s different if they fall into their hands. No matter what, they will not harm their lives. As long as the person is still alive, there is still room for manoeuvre. It’s always better than being completely dead, right?
When it comes to choosing the lesser of two evils, how could He Xiang, who is old and experienced, not know what to choose?
“Or, before the envoy arrives, can one of you ask His Majesty to change his temper? There may be a chance for this matter to turn around.”
The moment the words fell, everyone present shook their heads like rattles. Forget it, why say something like this that is impossible to come true.
Shang Shu Ling couldn’t help but cough lightly: “I think that He Xiang’s idea is not bad, very good, very good.”
“Yeah yeah.”
“I agree.”
He Xiang: “…”
well……
After everyone left, the Minister of the Chancellery heard him sigh and couldn’t help asking, “Now that the matter has been resolved, why is the old Prime Minister sighing?”
He Xiang did not hide his feelings: “I just hope that Beiting and Chen will not mess around this time, and will not deliberately provoke His Majesty.”
Otherwise, God knows what will happen.
He Xiang couldn’t help but pray in his heart, please don’t do anything reckless! The emperor is a very straightforward person, and he is not a soft-hearted person. He is not controlled by the court officials at all. If he gets impulsive, he can do anything. He doesn’t care so much.
The Minister of the Chancellery also thought of this, and even his tone became particularly difficult.
“Your Majesty should…have some sense of propriety, right?”
“Oh, what do you think?”
Shangshu Ling: “…………”
Oh my god…
Just when several ministers were feeling gloomy and depressed, the envoys’ team finally arrived.
Whether intentionally or unintentionally, the troops of both sides had gathered together dozens of miles away from the outskirts of the city. Beiting and Chen State entered Shangjing City almost at the same time.
After entering the city, the two teams immediately found something wrong.
If it had happened before, the people of Shangjing would have lined the streets to welcome him, and it would have been bustling everywhere, but look at this time… so many people were doing nothing, with only a few people watching the fun, and the rest didn’t even bother to raise their heads.
If the envoys randomly asked the people in the post station, they would definitely get the same answer: Busy! Very busy! The plague had just ended, people from all over the country had just resumed circulation, and it was almost time for farming. How could they have so much time to visit these envoys who were never very friendly?
In the past, it was the emperor’s order, and they had to show their support. Now… forget it, they don’t have so much free time.
Originally, the envoys of the two countries thought that this was a coincidence, or that it was because the plague had just ended and the people were in panic, but what followed was the Minister of Rites.
There were envoys from two countries, but the Great Zhou did not even send a prince or nobleman, and only asked a small minister to receive them.
Seeing this, the two countries, which were originally full of confidence, frowned and couldn’t help but become alert.
When something is abnormal, there must be something wrong, so they should be more vigilant.
Soon, the two teams of envoys discovered that the matter was far more complicated than that. If sending only one Shangshu was just bluffing, then the group of soldiers in black armour surrounding the post station were a real deterrent.
The Beiting envoys instinctively wanted to protest, but the group of black-armoured guards remained unmoved and forcibly separated them from the Chen State’s team.
The moment the door of the posthouse was closed, the envoy’s face changed.
Oh no, when did the officials of the Great Zhou become so tough?
If a person is really tough, even if the other person is very thin, it will make a sturdy man feel afraid. Otherwise, what if the other person fights you to death?
Even if the Great Zhou has just experienced a huge change, if you really don’t care, you can still scrape off a few layers of flesh and blood from one of them.
Then, the Beiting envoys heard that the newly enthroned emperor had said in front of everyone during the morning court session that he had a deep hatred for them, especially Beiting…

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Marriage
chapters.content:
Which emperor would say such words publicly?
However, this is consistent with the image of the new emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty that they found to be reckless and foolish. As for the details… let’s wait and see.
The envoys from Beiting decided to observe the situation for a while, but it was undeniable that the behaviour of the Great Zhou had caused them a lot of trouble.
From then on, no matter where the Beiting envoys went, they were followed by the Black-Armored Guards. Not only the Black-Armored Guards, but even the people of the Great Zhou were not as obedient as before.
What the envoys could not accept the most was that people in their own team had a conflict with the people in Shangjing, and eventually they were swarmed by the people of the Great Zhou who could no longer tolerate it. When the two sides were fighting, they did not gain any advantage.
The envoys would habitually make trouble with the Ministry of Rites.
“I will tell your emperor. I will let your emperor punish you!”
The Minister of Rites was kind and courteous at first, but his expression changed immediately when he heard that the other party was going to report the incident to the Emperor.
“Excuse me for being blunt, but it was the people in your team who provoked us first. Our people were just forced to defend themselves. According to the laws of the Great Zhou, anyone who causes trouble in the streets will be punished with twenty strokes of the cane. Come on, fight!”
The Minister of Rites was acting out of kindness, but if this were to get to the emperor, it would be more than just a beating.But it’s easy to tell that Beiting will definitely not be grateful to him. Not only will they not be grateful, they will also look at him as if he were the enemy who killed their father.
“We are the most distinguished guests of the Great Zhou. How dare you treat us like this? Just wait, we will not let you go!”
But no matter what, the envoys from Beiting never really left Shangjing.
The Minister of Rites, who was originally very nervous, couldn’t help but feel a little dazed when he heard the news.
It turns out that the people of Beiting are not as scary as they imagined…
*
“Asshole! Such an asshole!”
After returning to the posthouse, the envoy from Beiting was naturally furious, and his face was gloomy.
The Great Zhou has changed, it has really changed, and a lot. From top to bottom, everything is different from before.
It only took a few days for the Beiting envoys to go from being full of confidence and high spirits at the beginning to being frowned upon now.
After the plague, the Great Zhou seemed to have become even more difficult to deal with, which was completely different from the expected servility and fawning. ɽΆＮǒ𝔟ËŜ
This made everyone hesitate all of a sudden. The people below even raised their heads and looked at Hu Yanzheng, tentatively saying: “Your Highness, in this situation, what about our previous plan…”
Before coming, they had already discussed it with Chen Guo.
Hu Yanzheng’s expression changed several times, and he finally spoke: “The plan remains unchanged, we will do what needs to be done.”
Hu Yanzheng believed that the weakness of the Great Zhou was not fake, and they could not be deceived by this appearance.
The more powerful Da Zhou appears to be, the more broken it is inside. It needs to put up such a tough image to confuse the enemy. In the final analysis, it is just holding on.
On the other hand, Ye Shuo didn’t care what Beiting thought. He just knew that he couldn’t pin his hopes on others. Even if he managed to escape this time, there would still be next time. What’s more, isn’t this far from over?
The two countries are together, and it is obvious that they have discussed it beforehand and are in cahoots with each other.
The rice in the experimental fields outside Beijing had been harvested, and the rice seeds had been distributed to various places. Many people had died from this plague, so naturally the demand for food had been greatly reduced. Without people, there would be no need to eat, right?
When this kind of thing happened in the past, it was Ye Shuo’s compatriots who died, but now, it was his own people who died.
This is why Ye Shuo does not want to be emperor, because even he himself does not know whether he has the ability to take responsibility for hundreds of millions of ordinary people. After becoming emperor, every decision he makes will affect countless lives.
The life and death of so many people just depends on his thoughts.
Ye Shuo did not feel the pleasure of control. All he could feel was a heavy responsibility and deep pressure.
For now, I still have to find a way to pass this level…
Just as both sides were thinking about their own things, the time for the envoys to meet the emperor finally arrived.
This time, as expected, when they arrived at the palace gate, Hu Yanzheng and his group’s scimitars were once again seized. If he remembered correctly, it had been like this since Emperor Jingwen, and it had not been changed back for so many years. But it didn’t matter, they would make history repeat itself sooner or later.
Beiting and Chen State came with ill intentions, and Ye Shuo was too lazy to treat them with good food. Wild boars cannot eat fine bran, and it would be a waste to treat them with state banquet dishes. It would be better to save the money to fill the national treasury.
Same place, same scene, the only difference is that Ye Shuo has grown up.
He sat in the highest seat, wearing a black dragon robe, looking down at a group of envoys entering.
Beiting and Chen State never tried to hide their closeness from beginning to end, or perhaps they were just performing this show for Da Zhou to see, so that Da Zhou would know that the two sides had joined forces.
I remember that Beiting once fought a war with the State of Chen. However, there is no stability between countries. There are no eternal allies, only eternal interests.
Huyan Zheng glanced at the old and frail Duke Zheng, then glanced at Prince Ding who had lost his right leg, and suddenly he made up his mind.
Since the Duke of Zhen and Prince Ding, the Great Zhou has not produced any talented generals. This time, they are determined to eat every bone of the Great Zhou!
Hu Yanzheng was not there when Emperor Jingwen came to power, so he had never seen what Ye Shuo looked like as a child. To him, the young emperor above him was extremely unfamiliar.
But according to Hu Yanzheng, the new emperor… is really not that good. There is no one left in the Great Zhou, so they pushed him to be the emperor.
In this situation, how could the other side stop the joint attack of Beiting and Chen?
I don’t know if it’s just Beiting’s character or what, Hu Yanzheng was exactly the same as Hu Yanjue back then. After a hasty grassland salute, he was ready to take his seat.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frown slightly.
Prime Minister He did not hesitate, he immediately stood up and shouted: “How dare you! Now that you are in front of our emperor, why don’t you kneel down and salute?”
This old man must be crazy. When did the envoys from Beiting ever kneel down and kowtow to the Great Zhou?
Hu Yanzheng was about to laugh, but when he turned around, he saw that all the civil and military officials in the court were staring at him hungrily, as if they were going to eat him alive in the next moment.
Huyan Zheng felt that not only the old man was crazy, but the entire Great Zhou was crazy.
“How can the Emperor of Great Zhou dare to receive my respect?”
Ye Shuo frowned even more tightly, and called out, “Li Yuheng.”
If the emperor changes again, his position as the commander-in-chief will certainly be lost. Li Yuheng has already made up his mind to follow him to the end. The moment he finished speaking, Li Yuheng and a group of imperial guards drew their swords without hesitation.
“……?”
Hu Yanzheng was confused for a moment. He had said so much, why did he show his weapons?
Ye Shuo picked up the teacup in front of him and took a sip: “Since your country has no sincerity, there is no need to discuss the rest.”
“Someone, show the guests away!”
This, this, this… this won’t do! If the emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty refuses to listen to them, then all the discussions in Beiting for so long will be in vain.
Hu Yanzheng thought he was bluffing until the guards came down to chase them away. Then an idea came to Hu Yanzheng’s mind: he was serious.
“Emperor Zhou, you humiliate us like this. Aren’t you afraid that the iron hoofs of Beiting will crush your Great Zhou?”
Ye Shuo didn’t care about that. He spoke as if he spoke nicely, they would also be polite.
Since you are not polite, why not take advantage first?
He Xiang wanted to say something but hesitated, but he didn’t dare to say anything.
The emperor is a man who only responds to soft words and does not respond to hard words. The more you tell him not to do something, the more he will do it. Things will only get worse.
Forget it, if you endure for a while, everything will be fine. If you take a step back, the sky will be clear.
Why bother with a fool? It will only make you lose face.
Just when Hu Yanzheng was about to be kicked out of the hall, he finally gave in, gritted his teeth, and saluted Ye Shuo.
“Huyan Zheng, I pay my respects to His Majesty the Emperor of Zhou.” Wait, he will cry later.
As if he didn’t notice the other party’s hatred, Ye Shuo sat there upright and accepted it calmly.
“It’s okay.”
“Come here, please take a seat.”
Hu Yanzheng was about to get angry when he heard the last sentence. For a moment, he didn’t know whether to leave or stay. But he had already knelt. If he started to make trouble again, wouldn’t it be in vain?
Hu Yanzheng finally sat down.
The envoy of the State of Chen standing by was very nervous. Just when he thought he would do the same, he saw the young man above him didn’t even look at him and just walked past him.
Although the envoy of the State of Chen did not kneel, he felt more humiliated than if he had kneeled at this moment.
“By the way, what exactly are you two doing here?”
Hu Yanzheng and the envoys from the State of Chen were just about to start eating when they heard these words, and He Xiang and others also became nervous.
Please, please, don’t talk nonsense!
Putting down the chopsticks, he resisted the hunger in his stomach. After all, they were envoys from Beiting. Even Hu Yanzheng couldn’t just say we want your land, your city, and want to enslave your people.
But what Hu Yanzheng said was even more vicious than the above.
“Emperor Zhou ascended the throne, and we should have visited to congratulate him, but the plague was rampant before, and the road was blocked, so we have been delayed until now.”
“Since it is a happy event, it is better to double the happiness… As far as we know, the seventh princess of Emperor Jingwen is the daughter of the Empress Dowager and the younger sister of the emperor. She is now in her prime and is a perfect match for our Beiting Wolf King. If this is accomplished, we Beiting are willing to form an in-law relationship with the Great Zhou.”
You know, the Wolf King of Beiting is almost seventy years old now, even older than Emperor Jingwen. How can he be a match for a princess who is in her prime?
The moment the words fell, Jianjian, who was sitting below, almost crushed the cup in his hand.
Ye Shuo’s eyes darkened, and then he smiled and looked at Chen Guo who was silent beside him: “What about you? Do you have the same idea?”
The envoy of the State of Chen looked at Huyan Zheng, and noticing the affirmative look in Huyan Zheng’s eyes, the envoy of the State of Chen could not help but bow to Ye Shuo.
“To be honest, the one that my Chen State has set its sights on is Princess Zhaocheng.”
Both were the most beloved daughters of two generations of emperors. When Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng passed away, they issued clear decrees that the two princesses would never be married off. Beiting and Chen State could not have been unaware of this, but they still made such a decision even though they knew it. Their intentions were extremely vicious.
The little Princess Zhaocheng, who was sitting next to Yao Zhi, turned pale.
Noticing that the emperor’s expression was no longer ugly, He Xiang and others below felt dizzy.
It’s over…

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Personal Expedition
chapters.content:
But the magical thing is, the emperor did not draw his knife to chop anyone on the spot, but for some reason, He Xiang and others felt more and more uneasy.
Ye Shuo asked again: “What if I don’t allow it?”
It would be better if he didn’t agree. They came here to cause trouble in the first place, and asking for the princess’ hand in marriage was just a cover. Of course they would be happier if he didn’t agree.
But Hu Yanzheng looked embarrassed: “We came here with good intentions, and it is the Wolf King himself who is paired with the princess. Could it be that even so, Emperor Zhou feels that it is an insult to the princess?” “Or does Emperor Zhou look down on us? And even more so, he looks down on His Majesty the Wolf King of Beiting?”
This is what is called the final reveal of the true colours of Beiting and Chen State. Anyone with a discerning eye can see it now. If the Great Zhou dares not agree, Beiting and Chen State will probably send their armies to attack the border in the next moment.
Isn’t it true? Now that the Great Zhou is weak, it is like fat meat in the eyes of both.
Ye Shuo asked again: “If I agree to give the princess away, can you promise not to attack my Great Zhou?”
Of course… that’s not possible.
The more the Great Zhou compromises, the more it proves that it is weak inside. Beiting and Chen will just fight desperately. As for the promises? Aren’t they just for fun?
Sure enough, their previous performances were just a show of strength. That’s right, how could the Great Zhou Dynasty stand up again so easily?Hu Yanzheng smiled and said confidently, “Of course.”
“When that happens, we will form a friendly alliance with your country and become one family.”
Damn bullshit!
The two conditions they proposed clearly left no room for the Great Zhou at all.
Ye Shuo didn’t say yes or no. His expression was calm, making it impossible to guess what he was thinking.
The three parties naturally parted unhappily as they failed to get the answers they wanted on the spot.
After the envoys from the two countries left, Yao Zhi immediately said, “No.” No matter who it is, they cannot be sent out.
Beiting and Chenguo clearly had bad intentions. The two princesses were given by the two previous emperors. If they were given away, how could the Great Zhou retain its reputation?
Putting all this aside, if they were really given away, how could the two princesses survive?
But in fact, Beiting and Chenguo were planning more than that.
Not only did they want to break the backbone of the Great Zhou and make it lose face, they also wanted to sow discord and plunge the Great Zhou into chaos.
Although Beiting and Chen State seemed to be aggressive, they still had some room for manoeuvre. According to Huyan Zheng, if each of the two families asked for a princess in marriage, they would promise not to send troops if they got one. 𝐑𝘈ℕ𝐎𐌱È𝘴
Given the current situation of the Great Zhou, it is certainly unable to withstand the attacks of the two countries, but if there is only one, it may still be able to cope with it.
In other words, Da Zhou only needs to send away one princess, not two.
The real test for Beiting and Chen State lies in which princess to send away.
One is the younger sister of the current emperor, and the other is the only remaining blood of Emperor Taicheng. If the former is sent, it will mean killing Emperor Zhou, which is what Ye Shuo wants, and it will also cause the Queen Mother and Emperor Zhou to become alienated.
If he gave the latter… Emperor Taicheng would only have this one child left. How would the world view the current emperor? Would the old ministers left by Emperor Taicheng agree?
It is necessary to send it, but if you send it, there will be endless troubles. This plan is really vicious.
Everyone present was a smart person. After they figured out Beiting’s plan, the Concubine Sun who was sitting in the back had already turned pale.
In Concubine Sun’s view, since she had to send a princess away, it would only be her own daughter no matter what.
It is obvious at a glance which is more important, a biological sister or a niece who is one level away from the emperor. Even if one’s own daughter is close to the new emperor, what does it matter? Haven’t you seen how many emperors have given up their own daughters when they should, let alone the daughters of others?
Even if Emperor Taicheng were still alive, he might not be able to make the decision for the little princess.
But Concubine Sun was so frantic that she didn’t care about all these things. Even though she knew it was impossible, she was determined to give it a try for her daughter.
Concubine Sun ignored etiquette and knelt down with a plop.
She was able to appear here today thanks to her daughter, but she never expected that when she appeared in public again, she would see such a scene.
Concubine Sun felt as if her heart was being torn into pieces, but she did not dare to pause for even a moment. In just a few breaths, Concubine Sun’s head was broken, and even the gold bricks on the ground were stained with blood.
“Your Majesty! I hope Your Majesty will have mercy on me. I only have this one daughter. She is so young, and the journey to the State of Chen is so long. She is not even eleven years old yet. How can she get married?”
After Emperor Taicheng’s death, Concubine Sun was no longer the same as she used to be. She had little influence and could only beg for mercy, trying to arouse the sympathy of those in power.
Even if she died, Concubine Sun was willing to do so as long as it could bring her daughter’s safety.
While kowtowing, Concubine Sun looked up at Empress Dowager He for help. At this time, she could only hope that Empress Dowager He could say a few words for her.
Noticing the pleading look in Concubine Sun’s eyes, Empress Dowager Sun couldn’t help but tighten her grip on the armrest at her side, feeling bitter in her heart.
Although she still holds the title of empress dowager, she is no longer the real empress dowager. The real empress dowager is on the way, and she is only able to continue living in the palace because of the new emperor’s kindness.
Back then, Empress Dowager He had a brief encounter with the new emperor, who was dressed as a little beggar, in front of the Treasure Pavilion. After so many years, everyone was no longer the same as they were before. If they wanted to seek the emperor’s pity, how could they rely on just this?
Empress Dowager He… couldn’t help Concubine Sun.
Seeing Empress Dowager He gently shaking her head, Concubine Sun was suddenly overwhelmed by endless despair.
Looking at He Xiang and the others, they had made up their minds in just half an incense stick of time.
Given His Majesty’s temper, he would definitely not let Princess Jianjian go to Beiting. Although this is the best choice and Chen State is always easier to deal with than Beiting, it will be useless if His Majesty disagrees.
He Xiang and others could only settle for the second best and choose Princess Zhaocheng.
Not to mention that Princess Zhaocheng was not He Xiang’s great-granddaughter, she was just the princess of Emperor Taicheng. Even if she was, He Xiang would give up on her without hesitation at this time.
When it comes to state affairs, everything else can be abandoned.
The Great Zhou now needs time to recuperate. If a mere princess can appease the enemy country, that would be perfect.
Prime Minister He and a group of court officials also stood up and bowed.
“I hope Your Majesty will put state affairs first and send Princess Zhaocheng to marry.”
In the past, the eldest prince looked down on these spineless people, and he still doesn’t think much of them now.
The eldest prince watched coldly from the side, then raised his hand and drank the wine in the glass.
But what can they do if they don’t like it? In the end, they can’t do whatever they want in this world.
No matter how young Princess Zhaocheng was, she knew that the word “marriage” was almost a dead end for a princess. The little child was so frightened that she trembled and subconsciously grabbed Yao Zhi’s clothes.
“Aunt…Uncle…”
Ye Shuo watched quietly, he knew in his heart that He Xiang and the others knew that even if they sent the princess away, Chen State would most likely not fulfil its promise. But people are like this, as long as there is a glimmer of hope, they don’t want to take risks, even if the price is the little princess’s life.
Seeing that the emperor didn’t say anything, thinking that he didn’t want to be the bad guy, when Prime Minister He looked at Princess Zhaocheng, a trace of pity flashed across his eyes, but in the end, Prime Minister He finally hardened his heart.
“Your Highness, please do not be willful. Your Highness, please put state affairs first.”
The ministers behind him also responded.
“Please, Princess, state affairs are more important.”
As the sound lingered, Concubine Sun collapsed completely to the ground.
“Enough! How can you feel at ease forcing a child like this?” As expected, when it came to a certain point, even the late emperor’s will was of no use. At this moment, Ye Shuo was extremely glad for his decision back then.
For a princess, marriage is not that far away. Some princesses may never encounter such a situation in their lifetime, but once they do, they will never be able to turn over a new leaf.
Ye Shuo glanced around, and all the ministers who were caught in his sight lowered their heads subconsciously.
“Your Majesty…”
He Xiang opened his mouth to speak, but was interrupted by Ye Shuo: “There is no need to mention this matter again, you are all fine, I will only say the following words once–“
“Whether it’s Jianjian, Zhaocheng, or any other princess, I won’t give any of them away.”
He Xiang wanted to say something, but Ye Shuo lost his patience and left in a huff.
Everyone looked at each other, all of them at a loss.
Caught off guard, Concubine Sun suddenly felt an endless burst of hope in her heart.
In the end, Prime Minister He and his companions miscalculated. They thought that as long as they avoided Princess Jianjian, the emperor would definitely send Princess Zhaocheng away. After all, Princess Zhaocheng had only met the emperor a few times since she grew up.
How, how could this happen…
Not to mention Prime Minister He and his men, even Concubine Sun and Empress Dowager He could not have imagined this.
The eldest prince was both surprised and not so surprised at the current situation.
Xiaojiu…has once again refreshed his cognition. If this is the case, perhaps only he can say it…
The other side.
Ye Shuo walked down the stairs, and the night wind helped him calm down a little. He was really pissed off by what he had just done.
Not long after, Jianjian caught up.
“Brother, sister-in-law.” Jianjian also felt that this matter would never be possible. How could the greed of Beiting and Chen be stopped by just two princesses?
But there was no other way at the moment.
Jianjian thought that she could pretend to enter Beiting. With her skills, she might be able to escape by then.
But before she could finish her words, Ye Shuo interrupted her: “This matter is too dangerous, don’t even think about it.”
“But if not…” What else can we do?
Jian Jian was about to ask, but she heard Ye Shuo speak again: “Bring the people from the Supervision Department to help me do something.”
Jianjian was stunned: “What?”
Many thoughts flashed through Jianjian’s mind, but she still couldn’t imagine that what her royal brother was talking about was asking her to kill all the envoys from Beiting.
Kill Beiting and keep Chen. Since the Great Zhou cannot resist two countries at the same time, find a way to break up their alliance!
Although… it would be bad to kill all of Hu Yanzheng and the others, right?
Ye Shuo glanced at Jian Jian and said, “If you don’t want to, I’ll ask Wu Yi to go.”
Now that things have come to this, what else can Jianjian say? If it’s not her, it will be someone else, and Jianjian would rather be herself.
She herself disliked those people from Beiting.
“…As you command!”
Jianjian’s face became serious.
However, in just a quarter of an hour, Jianjian and the people from the Supervisory Office had surrounded the Beiting Posthouse.
Huyan Zheng could never have imagined that the newly enthroned emperor of the Great Zhou was so bold and didn’t care about his threat at all.
Until the last moment of his life, Huyan Zheng never thought that he would die here.
Huyan Jue at least returned to Beiting back then, but he is not even as good as Huyan Jue.
The State of Chen, which was next door to Beiting, listened to the screams all night long, and the smug look on their faces was gone. The envoys of the State of Chen were even scared to death.
The next morning, when the 218 bodies of the Beiting envoys were laid out in front of them, He Xiang and others had no other choice.
In this situation, the only option is to fight.
Prime Minister He could not have imagined that the emperor would resort to such a method to completely cut off everyone’s escape route.
He Xiang hated his impulsiveness, but he had to help cover it, and couldn’t help feeling a little frustrated.
“Your Majesty thinks that we are weak and incompetent. Yes, I admit that I am indeed weak, but has Your Majesty ever thought about whether the people of the Great Zhou are willing to go through such a war with us? Are the soldiers willing to risk their lives for this?”
After the plague, the people just want to recuperate. If they are easily involved in war, public resentment will boil over and the Great Zhou will surely collapse!
Going to war after sending a princess is completely different from going to war directly without sending a princess.
How could His Majesty be so foolish!
Ye Shuo also knew this, but thinking carefully, is this really the only way to go?
Now that spring has not yet arrived, do the cattle, horses and sheep in Beiting that rely on pastures have a lot of them? Fighting when everyone is short of food is better than dragging it out like this until Chen and Beiting have enough food and grass, and then fighting them when they still don’t have enough, right?
As for the soldiers’ unwillingness to fight…
“I have decided to lead the army in person. If they die, I will die.”
The emperor guards the national gate, and the king dies for the country.
Since the Great Zhou had lost its blood spirit since the time of Emperor Gaozong, Ye Shuo would help them regain it today.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Going to War
chapters.content:
When the words “the emperor will lead the army in person” were uttered, all the civil and military officials in the court were shocked.
He Xiang’s eyes were even more dull. In the entire Great Zhou, except for the founding emperor, no emperor had ever personally visited the battlefield, not even Emperor Jingwen.
Swords and knives are merciless on the battlefield and the emperor is of noble status. If someone dies or gets injured, no one can bear the consequences.
Based on everyone’s understanding of the emperor, since he has already said it, he must have made up his mind.
He Xiang panicked all of a sudden, and didn’t even bother to argue with Ye Shuo. The new emperor in front of him was willing to commit suicide if they disagreed with him. He Xiang’s demands were lowered again and again. At this moment, what he thought in his heart was that as long as he didn’t go to the battlefield, everything else could be discussed.
Those two hundred envoys, let them die!
“Your Majesty, please put the country first. I beg you to take back your order!”
If the soldiers are unwilling to fight, then they don’t have to fight. The worst that can happen is a loss. As long as the emperor gives the order, the generals dare not disobey. Even if the effect is a little worse, it’s better than the emperor’s death, right?
Based on He Xiang’s understanding of him, He Xiang really never thought that he would be able to come back safely.
If you are lucky, you will be kidnapped by Beiting and held hostage. If you are unlucky, you will die instantly. This is not just talk.But Ye Shuo’s goal was to win, and he must win. As long as he won, everything would be easy. There would be no need to cede land, marry a princess, pay compensation, or impose heavy taxes on the people.
Besides, Ye Shuo was not completely unprepared. Judging from the estimation, their chances of winning were still quite high.
Therefore, Ye Shuo said: “Don’t worry, Prime Minister He, I have confidence.”
He was confident, how could he not have confidence?
Even when all the civil and military officials knelt on the ground, they could not change his mind. Now, it was He Xiang and his men’s turn to be surrounded by despair.
Ye Shuo had already made up his mind that this war must not be prolonged and must be resolved before the arrival of spring. With this calculation, the time left for them was really not much.
When they returned to Chengming Palace, Ye Shuo immediately spoke: “The Ministry of War has already made arrangements. I plan to leave the day after tomorrow.”
When Yao Zhi heard this, she paused for a moment and suddenly understood how the young man felt when he released her to the epidemic area.
It turns out to be such torture.
“…good.”
At this moment, Yao Zhi felt both proud and worried. She was proud that the man she liked was not a coward who would exchange a woman’s life for a night of good sleep. The moment he flatly refused to send the two princesses to marriage last night, Yao Zhi inevitably loved him a little more.
Everyone was hoping for a lucky break at that time. Even though they knew that Beiting and Chen would never let Da Zhou go just for two princesses, others still wanted to try with the lives of the two princesses, but he was the only one who didn’t.
What worries her is that swords and knives are merciless on the battlefield. Yao Zhi is afraid that he will die. Yao Zhi dared not imagine that he would die one day.
“I had thought I would be able to see Dingning soon, but now it seems that that may not be possible.” Dingning is now one year old and can be taken out. News had come from Liangzhou before that his mother was on the way, and judging by the time, she should be here soon.
But now that this incident has happened in Shangjing, Ye Shuo really can’t stay that long.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but shake her head: “It doesn’t matter. I believe our daughter won’t mind. One day she will know what a great man her father is.” Ɍ𝐀ΝŎβΕS̩
Yao Zhi originally wanted to go to the battlefield with him, but unexpectedly, the young man in front of her had other plans for her.
“Regent? You want me to stay as regent?”
Yao Zhi was obviously a little nervous: “But, but I don’t know what to do!”
Forgive Yao Zhi. She has just learned how to be a good queen, but after such a short time, she has been burdened with another heavy burden. It is inevitable that she feels a little at a loss.
But Ye Shuo felt that she was really a very smart girl, and she did a good job as a queen, so Ye Shuo was so relieved.
“No one is born to rule a country. Even for me, this is the first time I have ever been an emperor.”
Yao Zhi was still a little hesitant.
Ye Shuo understood her concerns, but he had already made arrangements for these things. He would not force her to grow up deliberately or put her in a difficult position.
“Jianjian and her Supervisory Department will assist you, as well as your eldest cousin and Xing Yucheng. If you have any questions, you can ask them for their opinions.”
“Also, I invited the tutor back as well.”
Although the old man Taifu is a bit stubborn and pedantic, he is still capable. Since the death of the crown prince, Taifu has changed a lot without anyone noticing. After several years of reflection, Taifu is now much better than before at such an old age, and can be regarded as a great help.
When Ye Shuo first arrived at the Grand Tutor’s residence, the Grand Tutor was not prepared to agree.
In the eyes of the Taifu, he is nearly 80 years old and is no longer the man he used to be. He just wants to teach and then spend the rest of his life. What’s more… Ye Xun is the Taifu’s grandson, and Madam Zhen is the Taifu’s biological daughter. The relationship between Taifu and Ye Shuo is too complicated and is no longer as pure as it was in the past.
There are so many things mixed in this period of time.
But as soon as Ye Shuo said that he was going to go to the battlefield in person, the Grand Tutor could no longer sit still and almost jumped up from the armchair on the spot. His movements were so agile that he didn’t look like a dying old man at all.
And then… nothing happened.
After all, even the Grand Tutor couldn’t just sit there and watch the country perish, right?
As soon as Ye Shuo left, the Grand Tutor dug out his official robes. Ye Shuo felt that judging from the Grand Tutor’s final performance, he would definitely do his best.
What’s more, the Grand Tutor didn’t even express any opinion on the fact that the person he would be assisting was the Queen. Well, it wasn’t the first time anyway, so let it be.
So, Ye Shuo’s decision was not made on impulse.
Since he already had a plan in mind, Yao Zhi would naturally not hold him back. However, there was one thing that Yao Zhi had to clarify.
“You’re not afraid of that. You’ve whetted my appetite.” Even though she’s a woman, Yao Zhi isn’t completely without ambition…
She is a woman but she is also a human being. With such good things in front of her, even she would find it hard to resist being tempted. What if she gets a taste of power and can’t let it go?
But for Ye Shuo, since he chose to marry her and become her husband, he tacitly agreed that everything they have can be shared.
Hearing this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but remain silent.
After a long while, Yao Zhi said, “Your grace is so great, you will not let me down, and I… will definitely not let you down.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh, and even felt like joking: “In that case, can you agree to one of my requests?”
“What?”
At first, Yao Zhi thought it was something important, and even her expression became solemn. But after a few breaths, Ye Shuo leaned close to her ear and said something. After Yao Zhi reacted, her whole body started to burn at a speed visible to the naked eye.
“You, you, you…you are so shameless!”
It’s already this late, and he’s still thinking about that!
“I can’t do anything about it. I was born lustful and my skin is full of filth. What can I do?” Ye Shuo also wanted to be free of desires, but there was no way. Who told him to be born a vulgar person?
Seeing that the situation was not right, Xiao Luzi retreated quietly. Just when Ye Shuo was about to take advantage of the last time to do something happy with Yao Zhi, King Ding arrived.
He definitely wouldn’t go in at such a critical moment. I don’t know where he got all those tricks from. He could have so much fun even if he didn’t go in. But it’s definitely not possible now.
Yao Zhi snorted lightly and pushed him away.
Ye Shuo had no choice but to suppress the restlessness in his heart and slowly climbed down from the bed.
When Prince Ding saw him for the first time, before he could say anything, he smelled the faint scent of woman’s makeup coming from him, and the slightly messy golden crown on his head.
Prince Ding was an experienced man after all, and his mouth corners twitched immediately.
“It’s already this late, and you’re so relaxed.”
Ye Shuo reached out his hand to support the top of his head, and straightened the golden crown: “There’s nothing wrong between husband and wife.”
Prince Ding was really completely convinced by his younger brother, who was so dishonest all day long: “You have no shame.”
Ye Shuo narrowed his eyes instantly: “Speaking of which, I have a question that I have always wanted to know. Since you broke your leg, are you still the same as before?”
It’s definitely impossible to be the same as before. How can I support myself without a leg? Prince Ding’s eyes were vague for a moment.
After that, the two of them tacitly agreed not to mention the matter again.
“By the way, are you here today for something?”
Prince Ding nodded: “Of course.”
Then he put aside his crutches and knelt down obediently: “Your Majesty, I have been guarding the border for many years and have a lot of experience in deploying troops in Beiting. I hope Your Majesty will grant me permission to follow you in this battle.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch his chin: “Brother, are you worried about me?”
“…The emperor has not fulfilled his promise regarding the last plague.”
“I know that my elder brother loves me.”
“I already said no!”
Looking at Prince Ding who was red in the face and trying desperately to explain himself, Ye Shuo thought about it and didn’t dare to ask any more questions.
“It’s a long journey to the border, and we have to march quickly. Are you sure you can handle it?”
Prince Ding curled his lips and thought that he was too arrogant. He was not good at beating others, but he was really good at beating Beiting.
So, the matter is settled.
Two days later, Ye Shuo finally saw his daughter Dingning, but unfortunately, Dingning fell asleep due to the long journey.
At this moment, there is only less than half a quarter of an hour left before the expedition.
Dingning, who is over one year old, has gradually grown up. It is obvious that little Dingning looks a lot like Ye Shuo. She will surely become a great beauty in the future.
Ye Shuo only had time to reach out and touch the little girl’s fair and soft face. Seeing Ding ning make a gesture to himself, as if urging him to do so, Ye Shuo hurriedly withdrew his hand and then jumped on the horse.
Ye Shuo opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something, but when he thought that saying some words would be like setting a flag, which was really unlucky, Ye Shuo quickly closed his mouth, trying not to let metaphysical factors take advantage of him.
The former Imperial Concubine, now the Queen Mother, almost watched him leave with tears in her eyes.
At the last moment, the Queen Mother was thinking, I only hope my son will be healthy and everything will go well, I am willing to shorten my life by ten years in exchange for his safety.
The jet-black horse galloped through the streets of Shangjing. When passing by a certain place, Ye Shuo seemed to notice something and then turned his head to take a look.
Just one glance and the envoy from the State of Chen felt a chill run through his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Injustice
chapters.content:
In an instant, the envoy of the State of Chen recalled the tragic screams from next door the night before.
The emperor of the Great Zhou is clearly a madman!
No, I must pass this news back to the State of Chen.
The only problem now is whether he can return home safely. Beiting brought more than 200 good fighters with him, but none of them survived, let alone them.
However, what the envoys of the State of Chen did not expect was that the State of Zhou actually released them after their emperor left.
The previous massacre had already frightened them out of their wits. The envoys of the State of Chen did not think too much about it. After sensing the slackness in the capital, they almost fled from the capital in a hurry.
At the same time, General Wei also led his men from the military camp in the east of the city and rushed to the border of the State of Chen.
General Xu on the border is one of the few still active figures in the lineage of the Duke of Zhen. The reason why Zeng Mohuai was able to build a school so smoothly was because of General Xu.
Now General Wei is rushing to the border in such a hurry because he has received Ye Shuo’s order. He wants to take the opportunity to make a name for himself in this battle. Secondly, he is helping Ye Shuo to deliver a message.
When dealing with the State of Chen, there is no need to advance rashly, just defend. This is not too difficult for a veteran who has been marching for decades. What’s more, Zeng Mohuai and so many students are here. With careful calculations, the consumption of food and grass can be reduced to a minimum by then.Although General Wei didn’t quite understand why he did this, he still conveyed Ye Shuo’s words verbatim.
General Xu frowned subconsciously, but after seeing the imperial edict, he didn’t say anything.
The emperor acted rashly and slaughtered all 200 envoys from Beiting, which led to the impending war. Although General Xu was a little dissatisfied, his orders were as strong as a mountain, and they, as his subjects, had no choice but to obey.
Fortunately, the emperor only asked him to defend, not to defeat the State of Chen. General Xu couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, and what happened next made General Xu even more surprised.
Soon after General Wei arrived, the imperial court sent many swords and spears to the barracks, which made the barracks rich all of a sudden. Now even the soldiers who usually had to go to the battlefield with bare hands could be equipped with weapons, and the possibility of winning increased a lot. General Xu began to doubt whether the emperor really only had such a small request. It seemed unlikely.
To be on the safe side, General Xu asked several times in a row: “Do we really only need to defend the city and not do anything else?”
General Wei explained for the umpteenth time: “That’s exactly what the emperor said. Isn’t the imperial edict clearly written in it?”
I always feel that the Ministry of War only has so much in stock. If we give them all, what will Beiting use?
General Xu looked at the boxes of arrows, feeling both happy and worried.
The good news is that with so many expendable weapons, they are more than enough to defend the city. The bad news is that even if they succeed in defending the city, it will all be in vain if Beiting fails.
But these are not things that General Xu can worry about.
The other side.
Ye Shuo led the army in person this time and did not even ride in the imperial sedan chair. He led his men on horseback and galloped northward.
As expected of someone who has been wandering outside for so many years, he doesn’t seem tired at all after such a long journey.
Prince Ding, who was over 40 years old, felt that he might be too old and couldn’t even keep up with his pace, but before coming, Prince Ding promised that he would not fall behind, so now he could only grit his teeth and hold on.
Along the way, Prince Ding told Ye Shuo a lot, all about Beiting and the border, including but not limited to the border terrain, the appearance, personality, style of doing things and areas of expertise of the Beiting generals, etc. ℝ𝐀ℕ𝐎𝐁Е𝘚
Then there is the border defence of their Great Zhou.
“Now, General Xu and General Fang are guarding the border of the Great Zhou.” Perhaps because a long time had passed, Prince Ding found that he no longer had the same gnashing of teeth when he mentioned these two people.
“And the one who is hostile to him is Lan Feng, who chopped off one of my legs that year.” Lan Feng is cruel and cunning, and is indeed a fierce general in Beiting. Or maybe all of them in the Lan family are like this, Lan Feng is from a family of military generals, and compared to Lan Ruo who died at the hands of the eldest prince that year, he is better than his teacher.
Ye Shuo nodded: “So it’s the younger generation.”
Prince Ding thought about it for a moment and nodded: “That’s about right.”
“Then how does Lan Feng rank in Beiting?”
“Regardless of other things, based on his ability to lead troops, he can at least be ranked in the top three. This man is a natural general.” Although Prince Ding has had a broken leg for a long time, his understanding of Beiting is still far beyond that of ordinary people.
The top three… In other words, as long as we can find a way to get rid of this guy named Lan Feng, or at the very least defeat him, the crisis of the Great Zhou will be almost resolved.
We must win the war quickly and decisively, and never turn it into a protracted war, otherwise the Great Zhou cannot afford the consumption.
Ye Shuo looked at the young man beside him. The young man understood and said hurriedly: “Reporting to His Majesty, based on the border military camps and the amount of food and grass that can be mobilised from various places, we can only hold out for one month at most.” After the plague, everything needs to be rebuilt, and it is not the harvest time, so this is already the limit.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
“Time waits for no one, so let’s get on the road quickly.”
The moment the words fell, Prince Ding choked violently.
Fortunately, Ye Shuo brought two thousand cavalrymen with him this time, otherwise they might not be able to keep up with his pace.
It only took Ye Shuo six days to travel from Shangjing to the border.
When he saw the border town so close, Prince Ding couldn’t help but let out a long sigh. No matter what happened elsewhere, at least his younger brother had really put in enough effort.
Prince Ding also decided that he would never compete with him in physical strength again. It was not worth it. He should admit defeat when the time comes.
Hearing the noise outside, General Xu and General Fang, who were looking worried in the tent, were startled.
Did His Majesty come so quickly?
General Xu and General Fang looked at each other and hurried out of the tent to greet them.
So, this is their emperor…
Unlike modern times, the ancient people’s fear and admiration for the emperor seemed to be engraved in their bones. From birth, they were taught that Heaven, Earth, the Emperor, parents and teachers are the most important. Heaven and Earth are greatest, and the Emperor is supreme.
Sitting on horseback, Ye Shuo clearly saw that every soldier looked at him with deep fear and a little curiosity in their eyes.
Almost all the people here were born into poor families. They didn’t know the rules, let alone the fact that one should not look directly at the Holy Face. They just followed him subconsciously.
I have to say, if you only look at his appearance, Ye Shuo is still quite intimidating.
He had a handsome and resolute face, a tall body, and well-made black armour that shone with a somewhat eerie dark glow under the sunlight. At that moment, the ordinary soldiers felt as if he were a god descended to the earth, and their hearts beat wildly.
Especially the young man’s eyes, which made people dare not look directly at him.
No one knew who started it first, but as Ye Shuo walked, the soldiers knelt all the way.
How can the people at the bottom know the movements of those above them? They have no idea about the level of the person they are kneeling to. Just the two words “emperor” are enough.
Your Majesty is the Son of Heaven, blessed by heaven. With Your Majesty in charge, what does Beiting mean to you?
When Ye Shuo approached, General Xu and General Fang clasped their hands together, knelt on one knee, and said respectfully: “Your Highness.”
“Your majesty.”
“Your Majesty, welcome.”
“Well, get up.” Ye Shuo turned over and got off the horse, then personally helped the two of them up.
“You two have been stationed at the border for many years. Thank you for your hard work.”
After years of wind and sand, they finally got the word “hard work”. General Fang and General Xu couldn’t help but feel a little excited. They, the generals, were all like this, not to mention the people under them.
“Protecting the Great Zhou is our duty, so how can it be considered hard work? Your Majesty, this is really too much for us two.”
Perhaps it is because there have been so many great generals in the Great Zhou Dynasty in recent years that the generals of the Great Zhou Dynasty are quite humble.
After entering the main tent, Ye Shuo did not hesitate to be polite with them and said bluntly: “The news of the death of the Beiting envoy has not yet reached Beiting. If we launch a surprise attack at this moment, what do you think is our chance of success?”
“this……”
Your Majesty is being too hasty!
General Xu and General Fang were in disbelief for a moment, but then they thought about it and it didn’t seem so unacceptable.
They had just seen the enthusiasm of the soldiers outside. Now that their morale was boosted, a little contact with Beiting, even if it was just burning down one of their tents, would be very helpful for the next battle.
But… General Fang and General Xu would never dare to put His Majesty in danger.
Ye Shuo also knew his own importance. It wasn’t that his life was more valuable than others, but mainly because he was now the emperor, and if anything happened, it would be a disaster for the people under him.
Ye Shuo knew his limits.
“Don’t worry, I will just watch from afar and will never take action myself.”
Prince Ding was about to say that he must not believe him. How could he not know what kind of personality his brother had? However, General Fang and General Xu did not have a clear understanding. Seeing Ye Shuo’s insistence, they hurriedly responded.
“…yes.”
Prince Ding couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
General Fang and General Xu personally selected more than twenty good soldiers in the army. They were really good soldiers, the kind that could fight ten people at a time. They surrounded Ye Shuo and could block swords and arrows for him when necessary. Their role was to act as meat shields.
Despite this, General Fang was still worried and finally followed him in person.
Ye Shuo felt like a baby in their eyes, no longer so fragile, but in the end, Ye Shuo knew their concerns and did not refuse.
The two generals couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief when they saw this.
Originally, they had no plan for what the emperor could do. The emperor came here only to boost morale, and they still had to do the job of deploying troops.
General Fang and General Xu are not afraid of confronting Beiting, they are only afraid that the emperor will feel good about himself and then act recklessly, which would be the end of him.
For now, General Fang and General Xu are already quite satisfied.
At night, after midnight, people are at their lowest level of alert.
Ever since the envoys left Beiting, Lan Feng has been waiting for the Wolf King’s order. As soon as the envoys return and the Wolf King gives the order, he will lead his men to attack Da Zhou without hesitation.
However, what Lan Feng did not expect was that before they, who had an absolute advantage, could make a move, the Da Zhou side took action first.
When the horn of the enemy attack sounded, Lan Feng was in disbelief for a moment.
I’m afraid Da Zhou is crazy.
Ye Shuo came today just to remind Beiting and tell them that he had arrived. He didn’t think about what else he could do, so he just picked a corner that was close and easy to retreat to.
Beiting probably didn’t expect that they would be so bold, so their defence was naturally lax.
General Fang was just about to say something when he saw Ye Shuo taking the bow handed to him by the guard next to him.
This bow is not very powerful, but it has a long range.
Looking at the fire in the distance, Ye Shuo took the flaming arrow from the guard, then bent the bow and put the arrow on it.
Then, tiny sparks of light streaked across the sky.
Lan Feng had just rushed out of the tent with a scimitar in hand when he saw Liuhuo falling into the tent.
