In a flash, a fire broke out in one of the tents. Lan Feng looked back instinctively and could vaguely see a blurry figure dozens of feet away.
At this moment, Ye Shuo’s goal had been achieved, so he naturally would not continue fighting. He then pulled the reins and led his men away.
The whole process took only a short time, and apart from a worthless tent, not even the slightest damage was caused to Beiting.
However, the surprise attack launched by Da Zhou late at night still caused a shock.
Lan Feng naturally learned the news of the arrival of the Emperor of the Great Zhou, and also learned that more than 200 envoys from Beiting had been massacred.
Lan Feng’s first reaction was to be furious.
“Asshole!”
The current Great Zhou actually dares to challenge them.
The second reaction is.
“Why?!”
Everyone went to the Great Zhou with the same purpose, so why were only their envoys killed? Also, why did the emperor of the Great Zhou only come to their place? And he brought a full 2,000 cavalry with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: Notice
chapters.content:
After blurting out these three words, Lan Feng’s face immediately darkened, and he immediately had a bad guess in his mind.
It’s not that he doubts Chen’s loyalty. As a general of the younger generation in Beiting, Lan Feng is not so short-sighted. Instead, he suspects that Da Zhou did it on purpose.
This was done intentionally to sow discord between Beiting and Chen. It was easy to guess, but it didn’t mean it could be easily avoided.
Now, Lan Feng just hopes that it is not what he imagined.
But no matter what, the envoy was killed and the Wolf King was furious. The next day, the Wolf King gave the order to fight quickly.
It was a situation where we had all the advantages, but it was disrupted so easily. Just thinking about it really makes me feel… uncomfortable.
Although Lan Feng had not seen the true face of the Emperor of the Great Zhou at this moment, he had already remembered him deeply in his heart.
Cutting off a prince’s leg was nothing, killing the emperor of an enemy country was much more satisfying. Just thinking about it made Lan Feng tremble with excitement.
On the other side, Ye Shuo, who had been targeted, returned to the tent under the escort of everyone. As soon as Ye Shuo stepped in, he was greeted with thunderous cheers, as if he was not burning an unknown tent, but the enemy’s food and fodder camp.
Because he is the emperor now, any merits he has will be infinitely magnified.Ye Shuo knew what the army lacked most right now, so he accepted it calmly.
Upon seeing this, Prince Ding couldn’t help but twitch his lips slightly, but he thought in his heart, if he and Ye Ming had such nerve, they wouldn’t do that… Alas!
It wasn’t like this when he beheaded General Lan Ruo, right?
Ye Shuo took this opportunity to strike while the iron was hot.
“When Beiting attacks tomorrow, I will personally lead you to fight.”
What an honour it is for His Majesty to personally command the battlefield?
Most people have a herd mentality. At this time, as long as one person responds, the rest will basically follow. After a while, bursts of roars were heard in the camp of Da Zhou.
“Fight!”
“Fight!”
The noise was so loud that it almost alarmed the people in the entire city, and even Beiting in the distance could feel it.
Lan Feng frowned subconsciously.
I don’t know how capable this emperor of the Great Zhou is, but his ability to create momentum is extraordinary.
But what does it matter if you make a big noise? In the end, what counts on the battlefield is real ability.
In just one afternoon, the king’s tent was set up. When Ye Shuo returned to the tent, he found a relatively unfamiliar face. The other person was dressed in a blue shirt and seemed a little out of place in front of the group of burly men.
The calculating man who was personally selected by Emperor Taicheng from the Ministry of Revenue and sent to the army is now doing very well. Looking at the cautious attitude of General Xu and General Fang, we can tell that he is living well here.
Seeing His Majesty’s eyes fall on Military Advisor Cheng Yi, General Xu hurriedly explained: “Your Majesty, this is Military Advisor Cheng Yi. This afternoon, Cheng Yi was not in the army, so he was unable to come to see you. I hope Your Majesty will forgive me.”
But what General Xu didn’t know was that the person in front of him was his own man, so how could Ye Shuo blame him?
The moment he saw Ye Shuo, Cheng Yi almost called out “teacher”. The next moment, after coming back to his senses, he hurriedly said, “Your humble servant Cheng Yi, kowtows to His Majesty.” ṙÅΝƟ𝐛Εŝ
When Ye Shuo was the Prince of Rui, he was already an unattainable existence. Now that Ye Shuo has become the emperor, Cheng Yi and others have no intention of resisting.
Perhaps in the eyes of General Xu and General Fang, his ability to dispatch food and be responsible for logistics is extremely impressive, but Cheng Yi knows in his heart that he is nothing in the academy, and there are many people who are better than him.
General Xu and General Fang only think of themselves as modest, but they don’t know that there are always people better than you and there are things better than you.
Ye Shuo raised his hand: “Well, get up.”
“I have heard that Military Advisor Cheng is known for his calculation skills. It just so happens that I have just found a group of people who are good at calculation. How about you two have a discussion?”
The moment the words fell, Cheng Yi immediately understood that the young man in front of him was probably also his teacher’s student. Judging from his age, he should be his junior fellow apprentice.
In an instant, Cheng Yi felt a sense of crisis, but at the same time he was somewhat fortunate that he had not slacked off in his studies over the years. Otherwise, if he could not compare with the current one, he would probably be replaced.
But in fact, although the young man Ye Shuo brought was good at calculating, he was completely different from Cheng Yi.
Cheng Yi is good at actuarial science and wants to take into account the deployment of every grain of food, while the man in front of him is good at models and deductions. One focuses on reality, while the other is accustomed to calculations and conception.
But these are not the reasons why Ye Shuo brought him with him. The most important reason why Ye Shuo brought him with him was that Zeng Mohuai said he was the best at Lanchester equations.
In ancient times when people had to rely on cold weapons, they relied most on lineups and formations. As long as the lineups and formations were reasonable enough, they could be invincible.
But even the Lanchester equation still requires human lives to fill in. If possible, Ye Shuo certainly wants to reduce the death rate of the Great Zhou soldiers to the lowest level.
So after Cheng Yi and the young man named Xia Ying he brought with him had a few words of probing each other, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at General Fang and General Xu standing beside him: “Do you know about the border defence arrangements of Beiting?”
In front of the emperor, General Fang and General Xu naturally told him everything they knew.
“Reporting to your Majesty, I knew something about it before, but after being discovered by Beiting, I’m afraid it can’t be used now.” General Fang felt a little ashamed when talking about this. They had finally obtained Beiting’s defence map before, and originally wanted to do something big, but in the end they didn’t succeed. Instead, Beiting discovered it, and they wasted so much effort in vain.
“I have failed to do my job well, Your Majesty, please punish me.”
Ye Shuo waved his hands and ignored him, but he frowned quietly in his heart.
Although it was just a few words, Ye Shuo understood one thing -
There are spies from the Great Zhou in Beiting. Conversely, the Great Zhou may not have spies from Beiting.
This place is both similar to and different from the ancient times that Ye Shuo knew in his previous life. Here, things like martial arts and internal strength are real, and the existence of Wu Yi and the secret guards proves the terrifying nature of the intelligence organization.
Ye Shuo simply asked: “I want to know one thing. If the Great Zhou has a military secret that can decide the outcome of the war, what is the chance that Beiting can obtain it under the layers of protection?”
Although General Fang was very surprised by this question, he still told the truth: “If you don’t care about the cost, it should be at least 20% to 30%, right?”
Even the defence map of the Beiting border can be leaked, which is enough to be called a secret that affects the war situation. What else can’t be stolen?
When Ye Shuo heard this, he completely gave up.
Ye Shuo had been thinking about whether or not to get the explosives out, but now it seems that it is impossible.
Although explosives are very powerful, their formula is not complicated. Saltpeter, wood carbon, and sulphur are not very precious things. If they can make them, Beiting can also make them. When the two sides explode each other, the casualties will be more than what can be estimated.
As for the more complex and extremely difficult to replicate thermal weapons, Beiting cannot make them. But can Da Zhou make them with its current level?
Ye Shuo did send a black box to Lucheng. Inside the black box was nothing but a gun. However, he had made it with great difficulty. Given the current situation in Da Zhou, where people can barely afford to eat, it is simply a dream to think of mass production.
Therefore, it is better to fight a war with cold weapons honestly and not easily drag the ancient times with such low productivity into a war with hot weapons.
One must eat one bite at a time. Forcing things to happen will not end well. Human hearts are unpredictable. Even Ye Shuo cannot control the abuse of weapons of mass destruction.
At that time, he would no longer have the final say.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and then asked everyone else to leave.
The next day, Beiting arrived as expected.
Under layers of protection, Ye Shuo watched Beiting’s army and Lan Feng, whom his cheap elder brother mentioned, from afar.
To be honest, Lan Feng looks good and young, less than 30 years old. He is only one or two years older than Ye Shuo, yet he has achieved his current position. He deserves the title of genius.
Lan Feng also saw Ye Shuo.
The emperor of the Great Zhou was really crazy and also very afraid of his life. He clearly had the guts to kill their 200 envoys, but now that they were on the battlefield, he was unwilling to expose himself easily.
While the two sides were sizing each other up, Xia Ying was calculating something with a pen and paper.
Although the Lanchester equation is easy to use, you must first know the number of enemy troops!
Prince Ding, two generals, and a group of deputy generals took the opportunity to take a look, and then looked away. What the hell is this?
Although they couldn’t understand the maths, everyone instinctively felt uncomfortable.
Xia Ying had been counting on Cheng Yi, but who knew that Cheng Yi was also in such trouble? After all, the soldiers of Beiting were constantly moving, and it was really difficult to count them.
Just as the two were sweating profusely, their teacher suddenly spoke.
“There are about 28,300 people in total. From left to right, the first square has 3,400 people, the second square has 2,700 people, and the third square has …”
Xia Ying had no doubt at all and wrote it down quickly on the paper.
Prince Ding was stunned for a moment, then looked at his brother.
After a while, Xia Ying found General Fang and General Xu with the results.
General Fang and General Xu never expected that they were about to fight, but Xia Ying asked them to temporarily change their formation. Is this crazy?
But Xia Ying is the emperor’s man, and his words are the emperor’s words. As long as General Fang and General Xu have no intention of rebelling, they must obey him no matter what.
General Fang and General Xu began to give orders almost with gritted teeth.
Lan Feng watched as the Da Zhou team changed in just a few blinks of an eye, and felt that this was a good opportunity. No matter what the other party’s purpose was, he must not let them succeed.
Seeing so many soldiers from Beiting rushing up like wolves, Ye Shuo quickly took out a longbow.
This bow weighs seven stones, and the arrow is about as thick as a finger. Normally, it would take four people to pull it together, but now Ye Shuo pulled it to a full moon shape by himself.
Lan Feng felt a chill in his heart when he saw this. He didn’t know that the emperor of the Great Zhou was born with supernatural powers.
At the moment the arrow was aimed at Lan Feng, Lan Feng instinctively grabbed the shield of the soldier next to him.
Almost at the moment when the shield was blocked in front of him, a sound of breaking air was heard, and an arrow as thick as a finger pierced through the shield and shot straight towards the people behind Lan Feng. The arrow continued to shoot until it had pierced through four people before it stopped completely.
Even though the Great Zhou and Beiting had been enemies for many years, it was rare to see such a stunning arrow. The last time it was seen was several decades ago when the Duke of Zhen led the troops.
In just a short moment, Beiting’s morale fell to the ground.
The eyes of the soldiers on the Great Zhou side lit up, and then roars rang out –
“God bless the Great Zhou, charge!”
The sounds of fighting rang out all around, and Prince Ding alone could not help but look at his younger brother who seemed to still have some room for manoeuvre.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Equipment
chapters.content:
“Tsk, the shot went astray.”
“Sure enough, you still don’t have the skills…”
Although Ye Shuo had never thought of killing Lan Feng with just this, he couldn’t hide his disappointment when he saw Lan Feng continuing to be active on the battlefield.
It turns out that there is no such good thing in this world. Even if there is, it will not be my turn. Expecting justice from heaven to kill the enemy is indeed something that only happens in myths. It is too unrealistic.
Prince Ding on the side opened his eyes wide, looking like he wanted to curse but didn’t dare to.
That shocking arrow just now almost frightened Prince Ding to death. If Lan Feng hadn’t reacted quickly and escaped quickly, that arrow would have almost shot him through.
Seeing the shield shattered into several pieces in an instant, even Prince Ding couldn’t help but feel his scalp tingling. He could imagine how Lan Feng felt at the moment.
Prince Ding had never expected that his brother would have such ability.
“When did you learn archery?” Prince Ding didn’t remember him being good at it. If he was really good at it, how could he not show it off given his father’s temperament? Especially when he was so bad at studying.
Although he went to the battlefield, Ye Shuo basically stayed in the rear. His current status meant that he could not take risks easily.Ye Shuo also knew his own limitations and didn’t intend to cause trouble for others, so he was still free at the moment.
Ye Shuo casually replied: “Didn’t I often go out hunting before?”
Hunting, hunting, how can you hunt without good aim? The deer and hares in the mountains are all very cunning, how can you succeed without some skills?
Upon hearing this, Prince Ding almost blurted out, “You are talking bullshit!”
He had only gone hunting a few times and he had already mastered it. Could he be some kind of genius?
However, before Prince Ding could speak, Lan Feng noticed that something was wrong on the field. For some reason, his soldiers, who were as ferocious as wolves and tigers, were now like being stuck in a quagmire. Every step forward was extremely difficult.
The most important thing is that Lan Feng clearly saw that with every swing of the sword, the number of soldiers on their side wearing clothes made of animal fur who fell was much greater than that of the Great Zhou.
This kind of thing had never happened before. Each of their Beiting people was worth three at a time. The people of Da Zhou were weak and were no match for them in a one-on-one fight. Even if their numbers were twice as many, Da Zhou would hardly be a match for them.
The Great Zhou’s impression of Beiting’s ferocity and its fear of Beiting probably originated from this.
But this time it was clearly different.
Because of the previous incident in which the Great Zhou stole their Beiting border defence map, Lan Feng subconsciously thought that the formation they were training had also been discovered by the Great Zhou.
The people of Da Zhou are so insidious!
Lan Feng responded quickly to this.
“Look, the formation in Beiting has changed!” On the other side, someone beside Ye Shuo shouted, and when he looked closely, it was true.
On the battlefield, Beiting’s soldiers began to move quickly. Cheng Yi and Xia Ying were sweating profusely, especially Xia Ying, who subconsciously picked up the paper and pen and prepared to start writing. Ɍã₦őＢËș
“The leftmost are 2,128 people, and the next are 3,642 people…”
“The calculation results are…”
Beiting’s speed was too fast this time, and Cheng Yi and Xia Ying might not be able to make it in time alone, so Ye Shuo simply reported all the calculation results.
With this string of numbers, Xia Ying went to find General Fang, who was in charge of the command, without hesitation.
This time, General Fang shouted at the flag waving high up in the air, “Change the formation quickly! Change the formation quickly!”
The advantage of the Lanchester equation is that no matter how the opponent’s lineup changes, as long as they have enough people and their combat effectiveness is not damaged, they can suppress the opponent.
But not everyone can do this job. First of all, you need to know the number of people in the enemy lineup after the change. Only a very few people can do this. Ye Shuo happens to be someone who has this ability.
Prince Ding imitated his brother and scanned the battlefield wildly with his eyes, but apart from his eyes being sore from looking, he could not see anything, let alone count how many people were on the opposite side.
So the question is, how did he count them?
As soon as Prince Ding had this question, Lan Feng quickly took action.
Lan Feng’s wolf-like eyes stared straight at Ye Shuo.
No matter how the lineup changes, as long as the emperor on the opposite side is captured, everything in the Great Zhou will collapse.
“Tikang, take the men and follow me!”
Lan Feng made quite a noise, and soon the people of Da Zhou noticed it.
After all, they were old rivals for many years. General Fang understood the other party’s intentions in an instant, and his heart was lifted up: “Protect the emperor!”
Seeing that Lan Feng’s target was him, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but narrow his eyes.
“Someone, bring me arrows.”
If it doesn’t work once, then shoot a few more times, just in case it works?
Almost the moment the words fell, Ye Shuo had an arrow as thick as a finger in his hand.
Prince Ding was stunned by the sight. He thought that the arrow he had just shot had exhausted all his strength…
Prince Ding thought that his brother had shot the arrow just now with gritted teeth in order to boost morale, and that the thought of him having some spare strength was just an illusion. But now it seems that it is not the case.
When the arrow was aimed at him again, Lan Feng couldn’t control himself and his eyelids twitched wildly. In his heart, he couldn’t help but comfort himself, it’s okay, it’s okay, he’s just one person, how much ability can he have?
However, what Lan Feng never expected was that this was not just one arrow, but arrow after arrow.
A teeth-grinding sound of breaking through the air was heard. Lan Feng, who had been prepared, naturally could not be hit by him so easily, although he was extremely embarrassed when dodging.
As for the people around Lan Feng, they were not so lucky. The arrows shot from the seven-stone bow were fast and powerful. Ye Shuo shot a total of seven arrows, which dispersed the team led by Lan Feng, a team of nearly two thousand people.
When the arrows came, everyone subconsciously tried to dodge. When they dodged, they would inevitably leave a gap. Once the arrow passed, it would be difficult for them to get closer to fill the gap.
Of the six guards around Tikang, only three were left in an instant.
When Tikang, the big pawnbroker, was shot by an arrow, Lan Feng calmed down and finally gave up.
“Retreat! Retreat quickly!”
Beiting’s horn sounded, and in a short while, the Beiting soldiers who had been so aggressive before retreated like the tide.
General Fang and General Xu were unable to come back to their senses for a long time. Soon, they were awakened by deafening cheers.
“God bless the Great Zhou, long live our emperor!”
General Fang and General Xu suppressed their enthusiasm and knelt on the ground.
“Your Majesty is mighty and mighty! Long live the Emperor!”
This is what morale is. From very little at the beginning, it expands rapidly little by little like a snowball.
Looking at the Beiting people who had thrown away their weapons and armour, for the first time in their lives, the soldiers of the Great Zhou felt that Beiting, which was like a mountain pressing on their hearts, seemed…nothing more than that.
Whether it is an ancient battlefield or a modern battlefield, it is like a meat grinder. No matter how much laughter there is, it cannot cover up the corpses on the ground.
Many people from Beiting died. Although fewer people died in the Great Zhou, that was only relative. And there was no way to resurrect the dead.
The conflicts between Da Zhou and Beiting, Da Zhou and Chen, and Chen and Beiting seemed to have become a normal situation. So many people died that everyone had become numb. But Ye Shuo was thinking that it would be great if this dispute could be ended one day. In that case, there wouldn’t be so many deaths every other day.
At the beginning, Ye Shuo couldn’t help shaking his hands when he picked up the knife to kill the two Beiting envoys, but now he can draw the bow and arrow and shoot candied haws. Even he is constantly changing.
It seems that nothing in this world remains constant.
Now that spring has not yet arrived, the weather is still chilly. The sandstorms at the border are already strong, and it is even colder at night. Even in this month, many people will still freeze to death. But once the fur coats of the Beiting people are taken off, perhaps the situation will be much better.
Then there are the weapons.
Zou Wu, who worked in the Ministry of Industry, did successfully smelt steel, but that amount of steel was far from enough. It was no problem to equip a few elite teams like the Inspectorate, but a team of tens of thousands of people like this was far from enough.
However, crudely made swords were just consumables on the battlefield. They would become blunt after killing two people and would be unusable in the next battle. The Great Zhou was not used to Beiting’s scimitars, so in every conflict with Beiting, the court’s supplies were particularly critical.
Counting the days, the Ministry of War should be here by now.
In Prince Ding’s current situation, it is impossible for him to claim to know everything. Besides, the Ministry of War is now headed by Ye Shuo’s eldest cousin, so Prince Ding has no way of knowing the news.
So it was not until now that Prince Ding found out that his younger brother had transported most of the court’s weapons inventory to General Xu.
Prince Ding was stunned for a moment.
“This… you have transported all the weapons to the border of Chen State, what can we use here?” Are we really going to fight the Beiting people with bare hands? We will be beaten to vomit blood.
Regarding this, Ye Shuo had already made other arrangements.
“When I came here, I heard that there was an unknown group stationed at the border, often harassing Beiting. That group of people are well-equipped and can be reused. If we drive them away and seize their weapons, then we don’t have to worry about weapons, right?”
The moment the words fell, not to mention Prince Ding, even General Fang and General Xu, who were in an excited state, broke out in cold sweat.
“Your Majesty, you must not do this!”
Rather than fighting against that group of people, they would rather fight Beiting. If they fight against Beiting, they might be able to fight back and forth, with the chance of winning or losing only being 40% to 60%. But if it were that group of locusts, the chance would be 20% to 80%.
Prince Ding just thought that his brother was a hidden talent, but now he wanted to kneel down and kowtow to him, and beg him to stop scaring people.
Prince Ding felt that his brother might have tasted the sweetness of victory over Beiting and became inflated.
But that group of locusts is nothing like Beiting!
However, what Ye Shuo decided, how could Prince Ding stop it?
When it was night, Prince Ding heard that Ye Shuo had left the tent with 800 people, and he almost jumped out of bed, but it was too late for him to stop him.
Finished…
My younger brother is finally going to kill himself.
“Why are you still standing there? Go and follow him!”
Prince Ding didn’t even bother to put on his clothes. He rushed out with a cane, then turned over and mounted his horse.
However, before they could walk out of the area of ​​ten miles, he saw the figure of his brother returning.
Fortunately, fortunately, the person is still alive.
Prince Ding initially thought that he must have given up, but when he took a closer look, he found something wrong.
Wait, what are they holding in their hands?
Just as Prince Ding was stunned, Ye Shuo reined in his horse, and then the eight hundred soldiers behind him followed suit, with all kinds of weapons falling to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Play
chapters.content:
“This, this is…” The weapons on the ground stunned Prince Ding.
Ye Shuo said hurriedly: “They are all useful swords, bows, arrows and crossbows.”
“By the way, big brother, you came just in time. There are still a lot of them over there. Hurry up and bring the others with me to move them.”
“Move?” Upon hearing this word, Prince Ding was even more stunned.
Of course they had to move so many things, each weighing at least four or five pounds, and at most more than ten pounds. Ye Shuo brought too few people, and each person could only carry five or six items at most. If there were more, the horses would not be able to support it. He did not expect that so many items would be sent over from Lu City.
And these things must be brought back to the tent before dawn, otherwise it would be bad if Beiting discovered them at dawn.
When Prince Ding saw that his brother had changed direction again, he hurriedly said, “Notify the general to send people to get it immediately. The rest, continue to follow me,” and subconsciously followed him.
After a while, Prince Ding followed Ye Shuo to an open space. The open space seemed to be nothing special, except for a few large pits that appeared out of nowhere.
Unlike the hinterland, the sandstorms at the border are extremely strong. Once something is buried, it will be blown away without a trace in just three to five days. But this pit is brand new, and the sand underneath is still slightly moist, which shows that it has just been dug out.
Calculating the distance, the open space was less than ten miles away from the camp of the Great Zhou. If they walked fast, they would arrive in a quarter of an hour. When Prince Ding thought that the locusts had set up camp so close to them and they hadn’t discovered it yet, he couldn’t help but feel a chill down his spine.Isn’t it true? Everyone knows that the closer the distance you move things, the less effort you will have. Especially for such heavy weapons, the closer they are buried, the better.
Ye Shuo observed for a while, then pointed to a location. Sure enough, the people below shovelled down a few times, and then there was another new box.
Prince Ding was stunned watching from the side, and when he came to his senses, he thought something was wrong.
“Where are those locust people?” Why can’t I see any of them?
Forgive Prince Ding, it’s not that he has a bad brain, it’s mainly because the name of the locusts is known to everyone in the border areas, and they are too strong and no one dares to provoke them. What kind of people can raise such a team? So at this time, Prince Ding didn’t think of his own people at all.
Ye Shuo coughed lightly and said, “I just thought of a way to get them to leave. They probably didn’t expect that they buried their weapons so secretly that I would find them.”
Indeed, who can see this?
Looking at the sandy land in front of him, which seemed to be no different, Prince Ding came back to his senses and said hurriedly, “What are you still standing there for! Why don’t you dig it quickly?”
“You, you, you, and you, get off your horse immediately!”
If there are not enough shovels, then they have to dig with their hands. Anyway, they have to finish this matter before the locusts come back. Otherwise, all of them will be killed, and the military camp of the Great Zhou will not have an easy time in the future.
Didn’t you see how Beiting was ruined by them? Even Lan Feng would be terrified if he met this group of people.
Although the number of locusts was small, it was precisely because of their small number that they harassed Beiting so much that they were annoyed. This group of locusts had no fixed residence, and they didn’t even have a fixed target to attack, so it was impossible to control them.
If there are too few people, they cannot win in a one-on-one fight. If there are too many people, the enemy can run away at any time. Once they are entangled, there is no way to escape easily, which makes people feel disgusted and afraid.
Seeing that Cheap Big Brother was starting to do it himself, Ye Shuo opened his mouth and wanted to say, in fact, there is no need to rush, they are all his people, without his orders, they can dig as long as they want, and before receiving the signal, the “locusts” mentioned by Cheap Big Brother will not come back…
But seeing that the eldest prince was so excited, Ye Shuo really didn’t dare to say a word. Given his adopted eldest brother’s temper, if he said anything, he would definitely be furious and might even fight with him.
On the other side, Prince Ding below became more and more excited as he dug. In the past, he had only heard that the locusts’ weapons were extremely sophisticated, but now that he had seen them, he realised that the truth was even better than the rumours.
These weapons can’t be described with just one word: excellent.
The two highest generals in the army, Fang Shiquan and Xu Zhong, only received this level of rewards, but now, there are so many.
In a short while, Prince Ding’s body, legs, and hands were all covered with sand and mud, but his heart was extremely hot. How could a general control himself? ṜÅΝồ𝐛Еś
Prince Ding had only seen such scenes in his dreams, but they were not so exaggerated.
“These people are so damn fat!” Prince Ding cursed as he dug. He lost all his composure and was almost drooling.
Ye Shuo on the side: “…”
It’s not that bad.
Seeing that the time was almost up, Ye Shuo seemed to have noticed something and hurriedly said, “Brother, they are back.”
Prince Ding and his soldiers almost crawled onto their horses. Fortunately, there were many of them, at least a thousand in total. On average, each of them took three weapons, which added up to several thousand.
The main thing is the arrows made of fine steel heads. This is the most important thing. To deal with Beiting’s cavalry, there is nothing more suitable than the crossbow arrows. The most important thing is that they can be reused. These arrows will not break even if they are used eight or ten times. When you are done fighting, you can recycle them. It is simply too wonderful.
“Retreat! Retreat quickly!”
Prince Ding pulled the reins suddenly and ran back with his brother and others as if he was risking his life.
Caught off guard, Ye Shuo was nearly choked to death by the oncoming wind.
When the so-called “locusts” came back, their camp was left in ruins.
The people who had always robbed others and had never been robbed by others showed angry expressions at the right time. The leader even howled loudly, and their angry shouts could be heard from a long distance away.
“………………”
Ye Shuo felt that it was really difficult for the leader, who was so serious about everything, to behave like this.
However, Prince Ding was not a fool. He was just overwhelmed by so many swords and knives. After returning to the camp and cooling down his brain, he felt something was wrong.
I always feel like things are going too smoothly…
What’s the difference between this and taking it for free?
However, before Prince Ding could think about it, he was interrupted by General Fang and General Xu.
Looking at the long swords shining with cold light and the arrows made of fine steel all over the ground, General Fang and General Xu immediately became incoherent.
Forgive them, they have never been so rich after leading troops in wars for so many years.
Although the Great Zhou claims to have hundreds of thousands of soldiers guarding the border, in fact most of them are only responsible for logistics. Only about 30,000 to 50,000 of them can serve as combat forces and go to the battlefield. Although a few thousand weapons does not sound like a lot, if all are distributed, it is no problem to increase the combat effectiveness of the entire army by 20%. This is still a conservative estimate. In actual operation, it will probably be much more.
There is no way. In the era of cold weapons, a sharp sword can cut the enemy’s throat with just one strike, but using only fists and feet, seventeen or eighteen strikes may not kill a person. The gap is so huge.
However, at this time, General Fang and General Xu became stingy instead. This was just like farmers who suddenly had a good harvest. After finally having a good harvest, they subconsciously thought of hoarding the food and then using it slowly.
However, if that were the case, wouldn’t all of Ye Shuo’s efforts have been in vain?
“Use them, use them with confidence.” The loss rate of fine steel is not high. Even if it is worn out, it can be remelted and poured into the mold and become new again.
Ye Shuo gave the order, and General Fang and General Xu had to give up the gift even if they were reluctant.
That night, most of the brave and capable soldiers in the military camp had changed into new weapons. To the soldiers, a good weapon was like a partner, and a partner that could help them survive. Who wouldn’t like it?
They have never used anything so good in their lives.
In order to prevent theft, all those who were qualified slept with their new long swords that night, while those who were not qualified had tears in their eyes.
At the same time, there was a completely different scene in the Beiting camp.
Lan Feng returned to the tent with a gloomy look in his eyes and filled with resentment.
Although he had tried his best to dodge on the battlefield, he was still injured. Feeling a sharp pain in his shoulder, Lan Feng couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
While the people beside him were applying medicine to him, the number of casualties in the battle between Beiting and Da Zhou was quickly reported.
A total of three thousand people, just in one encounter, they lost a total of three thousand people, not to mention the number of injured, there were at least two thousand injured.
“What about Da Zhou? How is Da Zhou? How many people died?”
The man became nervous upon hearing this: “To answer the general’s question, a rough estimate is that there should be less than a thousand people.”
The gap is three times as big, which has never happened before.
Lan Xian almost broke the corner of the table, and the wound on his shoulder was bleeding.
However, this was not what made Lan Feng most depressed. What was even more depressing was yet to come.
Compared to them, the Chen State suffered basically no losses. After all, the only order General Xu received was to defend the city. As long as the Chen State’s army was not allowed to attack, nothing else mattered.
At this time, the Great Zhou was indeed unable to fight against the two countries, but if it could focus on one thing, it might not be so miserable.
“Why?”
This is the second time Lan Feng has said this.
Why should they take the blame when the idea came from Chen State? Why is it always Beiting that suffers? Even the only ones who died were the envoys from Beiting.
Doesn’t the Great Zhou care at all?
Yes, the Great Zhou doesn’t care. As long as they pick one to fight, no matter if it is Beiting or Chen State, they are all birds of a feather. No one is innocent. I don’t even bother to guess who started it. They are all the same. It is better to just choose the one with the biggest enemy. At least it will make them feel better.
But Da Zhou was happy, but Beiting felt uncomfortable.
The so-called alliance is bullshit, it is obvious that they are the only ones getting beaten.
Lan Feng was considered to be a more sophisticated general among Beiting. After guessing the thought process of the Emperor of Great Zhou, he could not help but curse all of the Emperor’s ancestors.
The idea is simple, but extremely effective.
Lan Feng still couldn’t control the imbalance in his heart even though he knew it clearly. This was exactly what Ye Shuo wanted. No one who could lead troops to fight was a fool, so what Ye Shuo had to do was to make them know clearly but still not be able to help thinking about it.
“You son of a bitch, the Great Zhou Emperor, I’ll fuck your ancestors!”
“Damn it, the emperor of the Great Zhou is a mad dog!”
If he wasn’t crazy, he wouldn’t do this. If he wasn’t crazy, he wouldn’t dare to take such a risk.
The most fucking unacceptable thing is that he took the risk and succeeded.
From the burning of the camp at the beginning to the current defeat against the enemy, their rhythm has been completely disrupted, and the initiative has gradually shifted. Now they seem to be led by the nose.
There is a huge difference between being active and being passive.
Recalling the day when the Emperor of the Great Zhou hid behind the crowd with a faint smile and a playful look on his face, as if a cat was playing with a mouse, Lan Feng couldn’t help but scold him all night long.
Then there is the Great Zhou.
Ever since Ye Shuo left, He Xiang and the others acted as if their father had died. It was no exaggeration to say that their faces were extremely grim.
The entire court was dead silent. They didn’t even care about the Queen’s regent status. What’s more, Prime Minister He and others were already prepared to cede land and pay compensation in order to redeem their emperor.
If land is lost, you can find a way to get it back; if money is lost, you can earn it again. But in the current situation, if the emperor is gone, the Zhou Dynasty will be doomed.
However, the more this person feared something, the more likely it would come to happen. On the fourth day, news came from the border.
Prime Minister He never imagined that information from the border would be transmitted so quickly. Even if it was sent by a carrier pigeon, it would take at least two days. This meant that their emperor would confront the Beiting group the next day.
Similarly, if the emperor was captured the next day, it would be a precedent of some kind…
He Xiang and others felt hopeless.
However, Ye Shuo’s students still knew something about their teacher. Seeing that He Xiang and the others didn’t dare to look at it, Ye Shuo’s students took the battle report on their own initiative.
Then, the young man’s slightly excited and even erratic voice sounded.
“Your Highness, Lord He, and Grand Tutor, we… have won.”
Not only did we win, but we won big.
Even Ye Shuo’s students were shocked, let alone He Xiang and the others.
Almost instantly, He Xiang and others raised their heads suddenly.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Awakening
chapters.content:
“Did we really win?” He Xiang couldn’t believe it, and asked again tremblingly.
However, who would dare to lie about such a thing?
Without waiting for the young man to speak, He Xiang quickly snatched the battle report from the young man’s hand. He did not pay attention to the three words “Emperor is very brave” on it, and his eyes fell directly on the “great victory” at the bottom.
He Xiang felt that this might be the best news he had ever heard in his life.
Seeing this, Yao Zhi, who was sitting above, couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
It’s all right, it’s all right…
Because of this extremely brief battle report, the entire court was in an uproar.
On the other side, the border—
No matter how much Lan Feng cursed, as long as the Wolf King’s orders remained unchanged, he would have to suppress the resentment in his heart and find ways to restrain the current Great Zhou.
I really don’t know where the Great Zhou found this way of fighting. It is too restraining for them.An unprecedented feeling of suffocation rose in his heart. Lan Feng carefully recalled every detail, and worked hard with his deputy general and military advisor to deduce despite his injuries. After a whole day, he still couldn’t come up with any results. He only knew that the other party did not change randomly, but followed a certain rule, but they didn’t know what the specific rule was.
The Lanchester equation was not discovered until the 20th century. In the 20th century, the world had already entered industrialization. Now let’s look at what stage Beiting and Da zhou are in. In this case, even if Beiting racked its brains, it probably couldn’t figure it out.
Lan Feng’s face looked increasingly uglier.
Lan Feng still wanted to lead others to continue the research, but Ye Shuo was not going to give him this opportunity.
Strike him while he is weak. War is a matter of one-shot. The longer it takes, the greater the risk. Moreover, they don’t have much food and grass. Every day of delay means one more day of consumption.
Therefore, the Great Zhou only rested for one day, and on the third day it took the initiative to challenge Beiting again.
In the past, only Beiting had the right to challenge Da Zhou. How could Da Zhou have the courage to challenge Beiting? It was not as if they were tired of living.
Now the situation has changed, which is really gratifying.
Since the arrival of the Holy Spirit, everything has changed. An unprecedented sense of relief rose in their hearts. General Fang specially selected a dozen people with loud voices, who couldn’t help but curse. The more they cursed, the more intense and enjoyable they became. Beiting and the Lan family’s ancestors of eighteen generations were all cursed by them.
Now it is finally Beiting’s turn to be a coward.
“Lan Feng, you coward, come out and fight us!”
“And you Beiting people, weren’t you very capable in the past? Why aren’t you showing off anymore? If you really don’t have this ability, then just roll back into the arms of your wolf king and drink milk! Hahahahaha!” ŕãŊＯＢÊs̈
The moment the words fell, the faces of all the Beiting soldiers turned green, and General Lan Feng’s face turned even darker.
Lan Feng had led the army for so many years, whether it was against the State of Chen or the Great Zhou, had he ever been so angry? He almost took his men out on impulse.
But when his eyes fell on the group of Great Zhou soldiers, Lan Feng immediately calmed down.
After not seeing each other for one night, Da Zhou seemed to have another adventure. Noticing the long swords shining with cold light in the hands of the people opposite him, Lan Feng’s pupils suddenly shrank, and he was puzzled. Where did they get so many well-made weapons?
It feels like the peerless magic weapon bestowed upon him by the Wolf King is just this good.
But Lan Feng also knew the current situation of the Great Zhou. The country was devastated after the plague, and they simply did not have the capital to challenge Beiting. As long as he could find a way to delay them, the arrogance of the Great Zhou would surely collapse.
Compared to victory, being humiliated is nothing.
Although Beiting is known for his bravery and ferocity, he is not really stupid.
Seeing that there was silence on the other side and no one showed up no matter how he shouted, Ye Shuo immediately understood that the other party was planning to use the tactic of delaying and was ready to starve them to death.
But they didn’t think about it. How could Ye Shuo let them succeed so easily?
After nightfall, Lan Feng was looking for a way to crack the problem among the battalion commanders. As a result, he accidentally looked up and saw countless “meteors” passing through the sky and then falling straight down, aiming directly at their camp.
Looking closely, it was not a meteor, but an arrow soaked in pine oil that was now burning wildly!
It was not spring yet, and the border was dry and cold at night. Beiting was rich in cattle and sheep, and the material for tents was mostly felt, which was the most flammable. Especially with such a dense and large number of arrows, it was difficult to extinguish them in a short time.
Logically speaking, the bows and crossbows equipped by the Great Zhou army should not have such power, and it is even more impossible for them to shoot here, but at this moment, they have indeed done it.
Just as Lan Feng and Beiting’s generals were organising the fire-fighting, the sound of horse hooves like thunder was heard.
“Go!”
Lan Feng immediately realised that the Great Zhou was attacking the camp. He no longer cared about anything else and shouted at the top of his lungs: “Form a battle array—”
However, Ye Shuo came well prepared this time, while Beiting was thrown off balance by the crazy burning arrows. Their hasty response was even less effective than a proper battle. As expected, Beiting abandoned the camp and retreated fifty miles.
The Great Zhou had always been the one being robbed. Today was the first time they robbed others, and they had mixed feelings. Even the sticks that the Beiting people used to make fire were something they found particularly rare.
Lan Feng felt that this was not going to work.
He had been defeated in head-on combat twice in a row, and he thought the next time would be the same. Swallowing the frustration in his heart, Lan Feng had no choice but to give up the frontal attack, which he was best at, and began to adopt a roundabout tactic.
Over the years, Beiting’s fight with the locusts was not without gain. Lan Feng even discovered that the tactics of the locusts could indeed produce miraculous effects at certain times.
On the seventh day, Ye Shuo received news that the food and fodder transported from Da Zhou had been intercepted by two hundred Beiting people. There were not many Beiting people, and they could not take away so much food at once, so the other party did not hesitate to set fire to the carriages transporting the food and fodder to ashes, which made the already poor Da Zhou even worse.
After they succeeded, the group of Beiting people showed no desire to fight and immediately scattered like birds and beasts, making it impossible to catch them.
Ye Shuo’s heart immediately skipped a beat.
It’s bad. The guerrilla warfare he taught to Lucheng was learned by Beiting.
This kind of thing is sometimes a double-edged sword. Ye Shuo certainly cannot let his own people fight against his own people, so the Great Zhou has never fought against the “locusts”, and naturally cannot learn their fighting style.
On the contrary, Beiting suffered a lot of losses and gradually grasped some of the essence.
But if Beiting does this in the future, it will be a big problem.
Just when Prince Ding was filled with worry, he saw his brother go out again in the middle of the night and come back with food and fodder.
Prince Ding felt that this scene was very familiar, so he asked and found out that it was indeed “borrowed” from the locusts.
After this incident, Beiting became even more aggressive.
Although Ye Shuo, together with General Fang and General Xu, cleared out a small group of people and found ways to strengthen the defences, the grain and grass transportation of the Great Zhou was never exposed again, but what was unexpected was that Beiting did not have the slightest hesitation. Seeing that he could not move the grain and grass, he turned around and moved on to other things.
After harassing and feinting from time to time, and retreating immediately when the situation got bad, Beiting suddenly became slippery like a loach. In this situation, no matter how useful the Lanchester equation was, it would be useless if the enemy didn’t fight you head-on. On the contrary, the Great Zhou side, under the continuous harassment from Beiting, became exhausted at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Once or twice would be fine, but after three or four times, the previously high morale gradually became low. The soldiers of the Great Zhou Dynasty did not get enough rest, and their combat effectiveness inevitably plummeted.
The Great Zhou was constantly moving forward, but its combat power was not as strong as it was at the beginning.
Ye Shuo didn’t know if this could be considered as shooting himself in the foot. The only thing he knew for sure was that if this continued, the opponent’s fatigue tactics would have a great chance of succeeding.
Ye Shuo felt that it was time to use magic to fight magic, and it was also time to let the people in Beiting see what real guerrilla warfare was.
Also, Ye Shuo decided to let Beiting see what the infiltration tactics are.
Damn it, they will tear my internal organs apart! Then, Prince Ding learned that his brother had cooperated with the group of locusts.
Prince Ding: “…”
His younger brother first led people to rob the locusts’ weapons, and then led people to rob their food. As a result, the locusts were not angry at all. Instead, they were very good-tempered and rushed to help their Great Zhou deal with Beiting.
For a moment, Prince Ding couldn’t help but wonder if the leader of the locusts was his brother’s biological father. No, that’s not right. Even his biological father wasn’t as considerate as the locusts!
Damn! It turned out that he was the fool!
At this moment, Prince Ding finally figured out what was going on. Then, he felt a mouthful of blood stuck in his throat.
Just when Ye Shuo was about to wait for the leader to arrive and discuss with him what to do next, he suddenly heard an extremely resentful voice coming from the side.
“Your Majesty, am I so stupid in your heart?”
He just hurt his leg, not his brain!
Prince Ding did not have high demands, he only hoped that his brother could make up a decent excuse when he lied. However, what Prince Ding did not expect was that he was unwilling to satisfy even such a small request.

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Poor
chapters.content:
“From the very beginning, you could tell the number of enemy troops with just one random sweep, to the subsequent seven arrows, and now the leader of the ‘locusts’ has appeared. I wonder how long Your Majesty will keep this a secret from me.”
The more Prince Ding thought about it, the more he felt something was wrong.
How could such a coincidence happen in the world? And he managed to do it.
In this situation, either Beiting is stupid, or the locust is stupid, or I am stupid, or… someone is pretending to be stupid.
Prince Ding knew whether Beiting was stupid or not, and Prince Ding also knew whether he was stupid or not. Since Locust could make such a big name here on the border, it was obvious that he was not a fool. So, there was only the last possibility left.
I wasted my time, only to find out now. Or maybe he hid it too deeply.
I was so worried about him!
The more I thought about it, the more aggrieved I felt, the angrier I felt. If it weren’t for the last bit of rationality that stopped me, Prince Ding’s resentment would have almost burst out of his chest: “Your Majesty, you deceived me so badly…”
“This… I didn’t mean it.” Unexpectedly, he would suddenly react at this time, and Ye Shuo coughed lightly.
“You also know that I was forced by circumstances before, and I had no choice, right?”Bullshit!
Prince Ding was so excited that he almost cursed.
Trying his best to suppress the impulse, Prince Ding said dimly: “Then why doesn’t Your Majesty continue to lie now?” He would feel better if he continued to lie, but he left too many clues, and even if Prince Ding wanted to lie to himself, he couldn’t.
What else could it be? There was definitely no need to continue lying. He was already the emperor now, who could make things difficult for him because of his private army?
Ye Shuo looked back quietly, hesitant to speak: “…I think, big brother should be able to guess it.”
Speaking of which, anyone who is sensible would not ask this question, but the cheap brother actually asked it, and Ye Shuo found it very magical.
Looking at his brother whose face almost had the word “perfunctory” engraved on it, Prince Ding felt at that moment that all the blood in his body rushed into his brain.
So he used such a lame excuse and didn’t allow himself to speak, right?
Prince Ding really risked everything today. He decided to ask about the locusts!
“Your Majesty, could you please have mercy on me and tell me, for your mercy, when did the locust incident start?” Prince Ding made up his mind to know the truth no matter what.
“…”
As if seeing his persistence, Ye Shuo felt helpless, but he did not lie to him: “More than ten years ago, right? Counting the days, it’s almost twenty years.” Ŕä𝐍ÓᛒƐ§
“Twenty years???” How old is he this year? How old was he twenty years ago?
At this moment, Prince Ding was really shocked.
Ye Shuo put his fist on his lips and said slowly: “Brother, you also know the situation of me, my mother, and the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion at that time. I had to be on guard at that time.”
Hearing him say this, Prince Ding suddenly recalled the precarious situation of the Duke Zhen’s Mansion back then. At that time, anyone with a discerning eye could see the murderous intent behind the Royal Concubine’s favour.
Prince Ding had always believed that the Imperial Noble Consort and the Duke of Zhen were able to survive because of his father’s kindness, but now it seems that is not the case.
“I originally thought that if a disaster were to happen one day, I would unite with my grandfather and uncles, as well as the family generals and old subordinates of the Duke of Zhen Mansion to fight my way out of the siege. After leaving Shangjing, I would go all the way west and never come back.”
At first, Ye Shuo raised private soldiers just for support purposes, but he didn’t expect that it would be like a snowball, getting bigger and bigger, and he raised more and more private soldiers, from dozens or hundreds at the beginning to thousands or tens of thousands now.
“And as you can see, it became what it is now.”
Seeing his brother’s innocent face, Prince Ding almost cursed, what does it mean to be ungrateful after getting an advantage? This is what it means to be ungrateful after getting an advantage.
It was indeed not easy for someone to remain in favour forever. How come I didn’t notice anything unusual at the beginning? I really thought he was a fool. Today I realised that I was the fool who couldn’t be any more stupid.
“…I never imagined that the means you used to save your life could even deceive my father.” Not only my father, but none of them knew about this. How could Prince Ding not feel frustrated?
“Especially the Sixth Prince, he has lived in Qiuwu Palace for so many years.” The Sixth Prince prided himself on being extremely smart, but he probably didn’t expect that he would be tricked by their Ninth Prince right from the start, as well as the Crown Prince, the Second Prince, the Fourth Prince…
Thinking of this, Prince Ding suddenly felt much more balanced.
However, it would have been better if Prince Ding hadn’t said this. Once he said this, Ye Shuo became furious: “How dare you say that? If there was one person among you who was willing to do his best, I wouldn’t have done this!”
Ye Shuo initially thought that the crown prince would be a good choice, but the crown prince fell from power not long after. Later, he thought Xiao Ming was not bad either, but Xiao Ming also passed away within two years, leaving behind his only son. After a lot of effort, Jin’er got better, which gave him some hope. However, Jin’er was killed by Xun’er, forcing him to take this position.
If he still had some hope when it came to Jin’er, now he really has no hope at all.
“You guys fought fiercely, but in the end, it was all just fancy moves and internal friction.”
In the past, Prince Ding only knew that his younger brother was lazy and didn’t like to take charge of things. Now he clearly realised how lazy he was.
Honestly speaking, if he had such a team, he would definitely take the path of forcing the emperor to abdicate, but if it were him, he would only want to protect himself.
Prince Ding didn’t know whether to say he had no ambition or to blame God for playing tricks on people. He was allowed to sit on the throne under such circumstances. How could they feel about this group of people?
“Yes, if we hadn’t fought so hard in the beginning, we wouldn’t have ended up like this…” Prince Ding suddenly felt a little guilty, and the next moment, he reacted suddenly.
Wait, why should I feel guilty?
I didn’t make a fortune and my leg was broken, but I actually felt sorry for my brother who had become the emperor. It was like a beggar feeling sorry for a rich businessman. Prince Ding thought he might be crazy.
“Besides this, is there anything else?” It has come to this point, Prince Ding no longer cares and just asks all the questions in one go.
Seeing that there was no one around except him, Ye Shuo thought for a moment and counted on his fingers: “Of course there are. Lucheng is mine now, and the distilled liquor that Beiting relies on is also mine. Commander Li is my man, Zeng Mohuai is a teacher I hired, and I also contributed to the flood that year. Zou Wu is my student, and the students of He Xiang and others are also my people, as well as the current salt transport envoy. By the way, brother, do you still remember the group of prefects and county magistrates that I asked Yan’er and others to execute on the spot? After they died, most of the people who took office were my people.”
Ye Shuo realised belatedly that he actually had such a strong team without him knowing it.
Prince Ding, who was standing by, felt his scalp tingling after hearing this.
Again, if he wanted to, he probably wouldn’t be able to wait that long, he would have already sat in this position.
Prince Ding couldn’t help but utter, “Fortunately, Lao Liu didn’t attack you.”
But after thinking about it carefully, Prince Ding felt regretful. Old Six forced all his brothers into a corner, but he let him go. If Old Six was more jealous and petty, Prince Ding would like to see what kind of scene that would be.
Ye Shuo seemed to see what he was thinking, and couldn’t help rolling his eyes: “I’m sorry to disappoint you, but I can’t beat Sixth Brother, I won’t fight with Sixth Brother.”
Prince Ding thought, what a loser…
When Prince Ding looked up again, he looked at the young man in front of him and suddenly couldn’t tell whether what had happened in the past was true or false.
Another question is how real and fake he is.
Everyone was deceived by him, even the one that his father missed the most before his death was him, but what about him? Was he acting or was it real?
Prince Ding suddenly saw one thing clearly. No matter whether he was real or fake, at least this seemingly most dissolute brother was the most sober one when dealing with his father. Those who were not sober would either die or become disabled, and they would not have a good ending anyway.
Now that Ye Shuo had said everything he needed to say, he thought for a moment and said, “Oh, big brother, remember to keep this a secret for me and don’t tell anyone. I don’t want to end up like my father and my sixth brother.”
Being too capable as an emperor is sometimes not a good thing. For example, if a good person has been in office for a long time, people will habitually think that he is a good person, so they should be this and that. But if he makes any mistake, others will not tolerate it.
But if a person is not that good in himself, but he does something good, he will be remembered by others, and the catchphrase will become “Although he is not good here and there, he is not completely without merits”. In comparison, the difference is not too obvious.
People will hold a good person to the standards of a saint, but will not hold a bad person to normal standards, because in their view bad people are bad, but they have never considered whether this is fair to good people.
Prince Ding opened his mouth and said, “How long do you plan to keep this a secret from Prime Minister He and the others?”
Ye Shuo did not hesitate: “We’ll keep it a secret for as long as we can, otherwise there will be no one to help me with my work.”
This was probably the first time that Prince Ding heard of someone being an emperor in this way, but when he thought about it carefully, he suddenly felt that it seemed to make sense.
My brother’s words are really scary.
Some people had previously speculated that it was the group of locusts that rescued him when he was seriously injured and unconscious, but Prince Ding did not quite believe it. Now that he suddenly learned that the locusts were his people, everything could be explained.
It turned out that he really saved his life a few years ago.
And the hole that the prince had made back then was probably filled by him.
Perhaps it was really as he said, he was worried sick about them, the brothers, and it was true that they were too disappointing.
“I have behaved badly, please forgive me, Your Majesty.” After calming down completely, Prince Ding was convinced.
However, Prince Ding forgot one thing. He forgot that no matter how Ye Shuo changed, his character of taking advantage of others would never change.
Since the cheap big brother has come to his door, Ye Shuo would rather take it than refuse it.
So Ye Shuo thought for a moment, then said solemnly: “I want to be honest with you, brother. I wonder if you can promise me one thing?”
Prince Ding was stunned for a moment, and suddenly had a bad feeling: “May I ask your Majesty, what is the matter?”
Ye Shuo spoke slowly: “The world has been in turmoil for a long time, and now the people are living in misery. I want to end this chaotic world, but I also know that this road is difficult. I wonder if Big Brother is willing to accompany me and create a prosperous world with me?”
Prince Ding froze for a moment, then realised that he might have been on a pirate ship.
If I had known that listening to my brother’s secret would come at such a heavy price, I should not have listened to it in the first place.
Also, this happened so many years ago, how the hell has he not forgotten it!

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Fighting
chapters.content:
Prince Ding couldn’t help but curl his lips: “I think…what the emperor said back then was just a joke.”
Ye Shuo shook his head: “I never joke around.”
“Beiting and Chen have invaded repeatedly. Over the years, the people have suffered terribly. I thought it should have been like this long ago.” Instead, this world has not been unified until now, which is a strange thing.
It turns out that not every world has a powerful person descending from the sky, so the first person to achieve great unification is even more precious.
It was because of this person that the concept of great unification came into being in later generations. This can be said to be an unprecedented achievement.
Prince Ding was disappointed to see that his brother seemed determined. “Your Majesty, is it too late for me to regret it now?”
“I promise that I will never tell anyone about this!” Prince Ding almost swore an oath.
Ye Shuo glanced at him and said in a cold tone: “What do you think?”
After hearing his secret, I was destined to follow him and work for him.
It turns out that there is no free lunch in this world. This time, not only will I be implicated, but Yan’er and the others will also have a hard time.Prince Ding was not a fool. How could he not know that his brother’s so-called “creating a prosperous world together” meant that he was asking him to contribute?
But now, he has no chance to regret it.
In an instant, Prince Ding felt hopeless.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but reach out and pat his cheap brother on the shoulder: “Don’t be discouraged, if it really works, you and I will be recorded in history.”
Yes, it is indeed a great achievement, but the premise is that it must be successful!
Even if his brother is not the idiot he imagined, Prince Ding still has no hope.
Unification… How is this possible?
Just as Prince Ding was thinking about something, the leader of the locusts finally arrived.
The chief’s surname is Tai and his given name is Tailong. He is not from Lucheng, but he is not from Da Zhou or Chen either. He is about 30 years old this year, with a stern face, as sharp as a knife.
Even General Fang and General Xu couldn’t help but be extremely alert when they saw him.
You must know that although the other side does not have many people, each of them is a good fighter, especially good at hiding, circumventing and sneak attack. The troops led by this person are too flexible, even the two generals have to be wary of them.
When General Fang and General Xu learned that Tailong was coming, they didn’t think too much about it. They just thought that the emperor was very powerful, or that the emperor had promised the other party some benefits.
After all, as long as the title of emperor is added, everything becomes natural.
When Tailong saw Ye Shuo, he was still hesitant about how to greet him. Should he kneel or not? That was a problem.
Tai Long had no rebellious intentions towards Ye Shuo, or rather, anyone who had rebellious intentions towards him was dead. The main reason was that he didn’t know whether he should reveal his identity or not. Ȓ𝙖Νô𝐛Ès
While Tailong was hesitating, he saw the young man seemed to be making a gesture to him. Tailong made up his mind and bowed slightly: “Emperor Zhou.”
Now that we have met the leader of the locusts, the next thing will be a natural progression.
Tai Long asked for some benefits appropriately, Ye Shuo pretended to think about it, and then nodded.
Watching this scene, Prince Ding found it a little funny, especially the fearful General Xu and General Fang, who made Prince Ding even more amused.
These two people followed me in the battles for ten years, and at the critical moment it was revealed that it was all arranged by my father. Now the situation has changed, and it is finally their turn.
I’m afraid Fang Shiquan and Xu Zhong would never have imagined that Cheng Yi, the military advisor they respected so much, would actually be their brother’s man.
Prince Ding had just heard a lot of secrets, and this was just a trivial one. Thinking of this, Prince Ding suddenly felt that working for him was not so unacceptable.
It’s the feeling of being the only one sober while everyone else is drunk. It’s not a pleasant feeling…
On the day when the Great Zhou reached an agreement with the locusts, Beiting had retreated several hundred miles compared to the beginning. The three cities on the border of Beiting have now been taken over by the Great Zhou.
No matter how harassing Beiting was and how tired the soldiers of Da Zhou were, Beiting could not stop Da Zhou’s advance as long as it did not engage in head-on combat with them.
Lan Feng originally planned to deplete their fighting power almost completely and then take back what he had lost in one fell swoop, but he never expected that Locusts would appear halfway and disrupt his plan.
How did they get in touch with the locusts? Most importantly, how could the locusts cooperate with them?
Lan Feng was shocked and angry, but when he received the news and wanted to react, it was obviously too late.
The military camp where they were stationed suddenly became chaotic. It was obvious that Tailong and his team had quietly sneaked into the rear of Beiting at some point in time, penetrated from the weakest point of defence, divided and disrupted their deployment, and prevented the transmission of their information.
Another advantage of Tailong is that he never fights to the end. Once he succeeds, he retreats immediately.
Therefore, under his leadership, as soon as the others noticed that they were about to be surrounded, they immediately disappeared. The whole team sometimes gathered and sometimes dispersed, and their strong execution ability was simply astonishing. On the other hand, on the Beiting side, the soldiers fell one after another.
Tailong has a complete theoretical system compiled by Ye Shuo, while Beiting has only learned the basics after so many years.
For three whole days, the swarm of locusts wreaked havoc in Beiting’s military camp, leaving Beiting with almost no ability to fight back.
On the hillside, General Fang held up something called a telescope that had just been sent from the Ministry of Industry and had a panoramic view of the entire process.
General Fang and General Xu remained silent for a long time, feeling a chill down their spine.
Even Prince Ding felt that such a team was too terrifying. He really didn’t know how they were trained normally. But Prince Ding felt that what was even more terrifying was his younger brother who held this team in his hands.
Prince Ding racked his brains but couldn’t figure out how he could make such a group of people so obedient.
“When can you teach us the training methods?”
Even though Prince Ding had not led troops for a long time, he still felt his heart burning with excitement.
Looking at his cheap elder brother who had the word “desire” engraved in his eyes, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but shake his head, his expression slightly helpless: “It’s not that I don’t want to teach, it’s that I can’t teach.”
“If we want to learn anything, we must at least let the soldiers have enough food.”
The reason why Lucheng has this condition is that there is enough food. According to the training methods of modern special forces, the consumption is really too great. If the nutrition cannot keep up, forced training will be like asking for the lives of the soldiers.
Upon hearing this, Prince Ding couldn’t help feeling disappointed.
“Okay, let’s not talk about this. It’s almost time for us to go on stage.” After all, the number of locusts is small. Even if they work themselves to death, they can’t completely wipe out Beiting. What’s more, three days have passed. Although Tailong and his men have arranged supplies in advance, their physical energy consumption has almost reached the limit.
The moment he finished speaking, Ye Shuo came to the front of the team for the first time.
Success or failure depends on this one move.
Just when Lan Feng was busy dealing with the situation, he heard a rumbling sound coming from the hillside not far away. Upon closer inspection, he saw countless black spots pouring down. In the blink of an eye, the black spots revealed their true appearance.
It turned out that the emperor of the Great Zhou had personally brought his men to reap the battlefield.
Seeing this, Tai Long hurriedly led his men to retreat.
The Emperor of the Great Zhou was seen wearing a black armour with a red tassel fluttering on his helmet. Now that the ornamentation was gone, he looked extremely imposing.
Although he is not tall and strong, he has the noble aura of a king.
After a moment of trance, Lan Feng immediately grinned.
“You’ve come just in time!” He was just worried about not being able to turn over!
The moment he finished speaking, Lan Feng jumped on his horse and rushed forward.
Ye Shuo held a sword in his hand, and the next moment, the sound of the collision of swords was heard, and at that moment, sparks appeared faintly.
At the same time, Ye Shuo also spoke up –
“Since you are not convinced, today, I will make you convinced.”
“How can we, the mighty Zhou, allow you to invade us?”

chapters.title: Chapter 293: High Danger
chapters.content:
“What a boast!” Who can’t boast? Lan Feng didn’t think that a pampered emperor could be a match for him.
However, Ye Shuo was not blindly arrogant. He had specifically inquired before and found out that although Lan Feng was fierce, his kung fu was only comparable to that of Prince Ding. Moreover, Lan Feng’s injuries had not yet healed, so Ye Shuo was still confident.
General Fang and General Xu were shocked when they saw this: “Come here, protect the emperor!”
Lan Feng couldn’t help but sneer: “Nothing special.”
It turns out that he was just shouting loudly, but in fact…it was nothing more than that.
The next moment, Ye Shuo waved to everyone: “Everyone, step back!”
…Fuck! It’s too early to be happy. I forgot that His Majesty is not a worry-free person.
General Fang and General Xu, who had been delighted by the emperor’s wisdom and bravery, now wanted to kneel down on the spot: “Your Majesty, you must not take any risks!”
However, Ye Shuo still insisted.
Previously, Beiting wanted to break the backbone of Da zhou in one fell swoop. Today, Ye Shuo wanted to retaliate and completely suppress the arrogance of Beiting.Lan Feng was startled, then overjoyed: “Since you are looking for death, don’t blame this general.”
It seems that even the emperor cannot escape from being ambitious and having high aspirations but low skills.
Lan Feng thought that Ye Shuo was carried away by his previous victory, but he did not expect that Ye Shuo came prepared today.
In an instant, the two of them had already exchanged three moves.
Even though he knew that his brother was no ordinary person, Prince Ding on horseback still broke into a cold sweat. As for Lan Feng, his expression was also changing rapidly.
Be it strength or martial arts, what Ye Shuo showed was far beyond Lan Feng’s expectations.
Lan Feng never imagined that the Emperor of the Great Zhou was actually a hidden master, whose skills were not inferior to those of the commander in charge of secrets under the Wolf King.
And that commander is the best master in Beiting.
Lan Feng was sweating profusely, and had to turn his attention to other people. Seeing the lonely Prince Ding, Lan Feng’s eyes flashed: “Come on, capture Ye Liancheng alive at all costs!”
Prince Ding, who had a limp in one leg: “…”
Oops, I have become a flaw.
“Fuck you, Lan Feng!” Prince Ding, who could no longer laugh, became furious and roared as he beat back the Beiting people who were rushing towards him.
However, Ye Shuo’s subsequent words “protect Prince Ding” made Prince Ding want to beat them both to death. He swung his sword with all his might, and his broken leg almost left a shadow.
It’s so infuriating!
While Lan Feng was giving the order, Ye Shuo’s attack became more and more fierce: “How dare you be distracted when fighting me? You are simply courting death.” ṜÂɴȯＢΕṥ
One knife, two knives, three knives…
In a flash, under the tremendous force, Lan Feng’s knuckles broke and blood flowed down his cuffs, quickly dyeing both sleeves red.
Lan Feng pretended to be defeated and retreated step by step, but he was silently looking for an opportunity in his heart, looking for an opportunity to find his weakness.
Here we come!
Feeling that the moment he had been waiting for had finally arrived, Lan Feng swung the scimitar in his hand at an astonishing speed towards Ye Shuo’s leg. As long as he crippled him first, it would be easy to take his life later.
“You are really good at this trick.” Prince Ding fell under Lan Feng’s hand, so how could Ye Shuo repeat the same mistake?
By the time Lan Feng realised something was wrong, it was too late. But while he was waiting for his chance, Ye Shuo was also lying in wait.
Lan Feng only felt his vision being lifted up, and then, he only saw the battlefield full of wounds, and… corpses splattered with blood.
But in an instant, Lan Feng was completely dead.
Lan Feng’s knife just now hit the horse’s abdomen. Although the armor blocked it, the horse still screamed and fell to the ground. Ye Shuo flew out and grabbed Lan Feng’s hair before his head fell to the ground.
No matter how much time has passed, such a scene is still extremely shocking to modern people.
If possible, I really hope this will be the last time.
Then Ye Shuo took a deep breath and shouted in a deep voice: “Lan Feng is dead, why don’t you surrender quickly!”
“Quickly surrender…”
“surrender……”
“drop……”
Sounds mixed with internal force came out in waves. The Beiting soldiers looked closely and saw that the bloody head was held in the hand of the Emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty, who else could it be but their General Lan?
The soldiers of the Great Zhou also showed fierce expressions at the right time.
“surrender!”
“surrender!”
“surrender!”
The main general was dead, and the deputy generals were almost all dead as well. The remaining soldiers were naturally in disarray. Ye Shuo glanced around, and everyone within his sight involuntarily put down their weapons.
At this point, Beiting, which claimed to have 100,000 soldiers, had 20,000 deaths, 30,000 injuries, and 30,000 surrendered. The rest fled in all directions all the way to the north, which was a complete defeat.
General Xu and General Fang thought that this was about the end of it. After all, their food and fodder were only enough to last for a month. Even with the food confiscated from Beiting, there were now 30,000 more mouths to feed. It was really hard to sustain.
“It’s true that the original plan was for a month, but hasn’t it only been more than half a month? There are still ten days left, so there’s no rush.”
After understanding what the emperor meant, several generals couldn’t help but gasp.
Originally, they thought that they could not accomplish anything in ten days, but then they thought that His Majesty had only taken half a month to capture three cities, no, now it should be four cities, so in ten days… maybe something incredible would really happen?
And Beiting probably didn’t expect that they would be defeated so quickly, and in addition, ancient communications were far less convenient than modern ones, so it was not so fast to mobilise troops and generals.
After Lan Feng’s death, the army of the Great Zhou advanced almost straight ahead.
Because the Beiting army had fewer troops than the Da Zhou, it could not defeat the Da Zhou. But when its troops were larger, it was too late to deploy them. By the time the Wolf King wanted to react in time, it was obviously too late.
On the other side, Da Zhou——
Ever since the first battle report, He Xiang and others have become increasingly uneasy, fearing that they will be happy too soon and be beaten back to their original state the next moment.
They knew clearly what the Great Zhou was like today, so they did not dare to have too high expectations.
However, what shocked them was that the development of things was almost rushing towards an unbelievable direction.
The second battle report arrived very quickly, but He Xiang and others still didn’t dare to read it.
