Before this, no one knew that Prime Minister He and his men were so timid. In the end, it was the Empress who opened the envelope herself.
After a quick glance, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but flash a hint of surprise in her eyes. However, she remained silent for a long time, which immediately caused He Xiang and others to misunderstand her.
Sure enough, the first time was just an accident, right?
But the current Great Zhou really can’t afford the ransom, unless we increase taxes.
However, Yao Zhi did not ask everyone to wait too long. The next moment, she spoke: “The battle report said that the emperor and the two generals have joined forces and have now taken Qicheng.”
In other words, Qicheng now belongs to their Great Zhou…
The old and frail Duke Zhen below suddenly raised his head. Even Wei Wen couldn’t help but smack his lips. It had only been a few days and his little cousin was already too fierce.
As for He Xiang and others, they opened their eyes wide and were speechless for a long time.
“God bless the Great Zhou! God bless the Great Zhou!”
Emperor Jingwen has appeared!
I don’t know who shouted it first, but the noise was so loud that the old man’s hands trembled and he pulled out two strands of his beard.
He Xiang and others were even more moved to tears.
Enough, enough, that is enough. They are already satisfied that His Majesty can achieve this level. It is so satisfying that they would wake up laughing in their dreams.
However, this kind of thing cannot be stopped just because they want to. In the following half month, the frequent good news almost made people numb.
First it was Qicheng, then Baicheng, Beibing, Bingnan… Perhaps because there were too many explosive good news, He Xiang and others felt it was unreal. They couldn’t help but start to doubt whether the emperor had become so absurd that he even dared to fabricate battle reports.
Or maybe this is all an illusion, a lie, and it is actually their Great Zhou that was occupied.
“Your Majesty, this time, is really too absurd…” It’s not that He Xiang and others don’t believe it, but they dare not believe it. After all, at this speed, Your Majesty will soon go straight to the Beiting Royal Court. What a joke!
Although He Xiang and others have never led an army, they also know that this is definitely not normal, so there is no other possibility except that the Majesty is lying.
As for the people they sent saying the same thing, they must have been bribed by the Emperor, so it definitely cannot be true.
Not to mention Prime Minister He, even the old Duke Zhen couldn’t help but wonder in his heart, after all, even when he was young, he wasn’t so fierce…
After returning home, the old Duke of Zhen couldn’t help but ask his eldest grandson: “How true and false do you think the war reports from the border are?”
Wei Wen, who always had a clear mind, hesitated for a rare moment: “This… my grandson doesn’t know either.”
If it’s true, my little cousin is too fierce.
If they were not too old and too busy to leave, the old Duke Zhen and Wei Wen would really like to go to the border in person to see for themselves what the scene is like.
Just when He Xiang and others were worried about gains and losses, another half a month passed in the blink of an eye. At this time, Ye Shuo had already captured seven cities in a row, and only needed four cities to attack the Beiting Royal Court.
Even as eyewitnesses, the soldiers of the Great Zhou could not help but feel dazed.
This is too fast…
Beiting went from being indifferent at first to being in a panic later on, and then finally faced up to the reality and hurriedly sent envoys to ask for peace.
Beiting no longer cared about the two hundred envoys. In his heart, he was gritting his teeth at Chen Guo, who had suffered almost no losses.
If it weren’t for Chen Guo’s bad idea, how could they have fallen to such a state?
The most hateful thing is that they were the ones who came up with the idea, but in the end it was Beiting who suffered. Instead of attacking the relatively less powerful Chen State, they targeted Beiting. The emperor of the Great Zhou is simply sick!
And the person you should never mess with in this world is a madman.
Seeing that Da Zhou was determined to take you with him at all costs, even the Wolf King, who had been tough all his life, couldn’t help but feel nervous.
At this time, all the food and grass that the Great Zhou could gather had almost been consumed.
It seems that this time, we have to stop here.
Ye Shuo knew clearly in his heart that the reason why things went so smoothly was mostly because he took advantage of the rapid march and Beiting’s underestimation of the enemy. Next time, it might not be so easy.
But there is no way, no matter how difficult it is, you have to give up.
Restraining his resentment, Ye Shuo’s slightly fanatical look gradually calmed down. Seeing this, General Fang and General Xu beside him couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, His Majesty was not carried away by the successive victories.
You must know that Beiting’s army has been successfully assembled. If you want to capture any of the next four cities, it will definitely be more difficult than the previous seven cities combined.
If they cannot extricate themselves in time, once they are trapped, all the achievements they have made before will be lost.
Just as General Fang and General Xu were praying frantically in their hearts, Ye Shuo finally waved his hand.
“Come here, please invite the envoy into the tent.”
However, what Ye Shuo didn’t know was that when the Wolf King’s nephew, Huyan Jue’s son Huyan Guang, learned that he had become the new envoy, he almost cried out loud.
Everyone in Beiting knows that the envoys sent to Da Zhou are more dangerous than hunting wolves with bare hands.
When Hu Yanguang trembled as he walked into the tent, and saw the young man at the head, an idea popped up in his mind uncontrollably –
Help, help!

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Human Slaughter
chapters.content:
In the past, being an envoy of Beiting was a good job. No matter where you went, you basically just needed to eat and drink. Anyway, no matter whether it was the Great Zhou, the State of Chen, or other small countries, they would give Beiting a satisfactory result.
Now…it’s good enough to be alive now!
Huyan Guang’s first reaction when he saw the Emperor of Great Zhou was that this young man was too handsome. According to the aesthetic standards of Beiting people, he was a pretty boy with nothing good except his face.
Not strong enough, not majestic enough, but when Hu Yanguang thought about this man’s behaviour, he suddenly came to his senses.
Although the emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty did not look brave enough, he was ruthless and did not hide his hatred for Beiting. He killed people without hesitation, which made Hu Yanguang suspect that if he had the chance, he would kill all the Beiting people in one go.
Ye Shuo frowned subconsciously, but before he could say anything, he saw that the envoy from Beiting bent his legs and knelt down without saying a word. The whole set of movements was smooth, as if they had been rehearsed in advance, and as smooth as possible.
Hu Yanguang shouted without any pause: “Hu Yanguang, the envoy of Beiting, greets the Emperor Zhou.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
To be honest, this was probably the most sensible Beiting envoy Ye Shuo had ever seen. Compared with the two arrogant envoys in the past, they were totally different.
Ye Shuo couldn’t find any fault with the other party’s behaviour. He looked at him with a frown for a long time, and finally raised his hand with a helpless look: “Well, get up.”Hu Yanguang heaved a sigh of relief and stood up. Then he heard the young man speak again: “You are different from the others.”
“…Your Majesty Zhou is too kind.”
Huyan Guang curled the corners of his mouth, but what he thought in his heart was that, in fact, not all people in Beiting are not afraid of death.
The biggest misunderstanding outsiders have about Beiting people is that they are not afraid of death.
Well, he didn’t mean to praise the other party…
But these are all minor matters and do not affect the overall situation. Now that they have the initiative, Ye Shuo is not very anxious, but is in the mood to chat with him about other things.
However, Ye Shuo’s lack of anxiety does not mean that Huyan Guang is not anxious, especially when the other party said, “You look familiar to me, as if I have seen you somewhere before,” which made Huyan Guang’s heart instantly tense.
Isn’t it similar… As the king’s late-born son, the reason why Huyan Guang stands out among his brothers is that he has a face that resembles Huyan Jue.
But this face can not only bring luck, but also bring disaster, just like now.
Huyan Guang had not personally experienced what happened back then. Although according to others, his father did not do anything outrageous back then, judging from the fact that his father had escaped from the capital of the Great Zhou in a panic, he probably did not have a happy time. So no matter what, he could not let the Emperor Zhou guess his true identity.
Hu Yanguang’s smile froze for a moment, but then he saw that the young man seemed to want to continue, so he quickly changed the subject to business: “In reply to Emperor Zhou, our Wolf King wants to negotiate peace with your country. What do you think…?”
Here it comes.
General Fang and General Xu on the side had a flash in their eyes, knowing that the highlight was finally here. Even Prince Ding couldn’t help but lean forward slightly when he heard it.
Ye Shuo did not keep the secret and said bluntly: “There is no problem in negotiating peace, but I don’t know what conditions you Beiting can offer.”
If it were someone else, they would have to speak sternly and loudly to express that they were not prepared to negotiate for peace, using this as a threat in order to make higher demands later. However, Ye Shuo said it directly.
After all, the moment they nodded in agreement to let the envoy enter the tent, the calculations of both sides were already clear, and there was no point in beating around the bush. ȓ𝐚ɴŐΒΕ𝙨
Ye Shuo not only said it, he also made it clear: “After all, we in the Great Zhou do not have much food and grass left.”
General Fang and General Xu, who were originally calm and composed, immediately widened their eyes and were horrified. How could His Majesty reveal all this? It goes without saying what the word “food and grass” means to the army. Exposing the weakness so bluntly would not give Beiting an opportunity to raise the price?
Prince Ding, who was standing aside, was even more terrified by his brother’s sudden words.
Although he had already understood that his brother was no ordinary person, every time he acted, Prince Ding was still worried.
My younger brother is very capable, but it is also true that he is abnormal. No wonder no one treats him as a normal person.
Even Huyan Guang almost didn’t react. After all, when Beiting chose him as an envoy, he was not taught what to do when encountering such a situation.
Fortunately, Huyan Guang was quite smart. Under the threat of death, Huyan Guang’s mind worked quickly and he understood Ye Shuo’s meaning in an instant.
What he wanted to express was that there was no problem in negotiating peace, but the prerequisite was that his conditions had to be met.
If you are not satisfied, you still have to keep fighting.
In a flash, Huyan Guang became more cautious, which stunned General Fang, General Xu and Prince Ding. They thought that maybe the envoy in front of them was not normal either, and two abnormal people together made him become normal.
“In reply to Emperor Zhou, our Wolf King wants you to return the seven Cities. We can then exchange it for silver and money. We can also drop the marriage proposal. There is no need for the Great Zhou to send the princess over. We, Beiting, will send the princess to the Great Zhou…”
Before Hu Yanguang could finish his words, he was interrupted by Ye Shuo’s sneer.
“Princess again? You Beiting, do you really think I’m a fool?”
Last time, it was Beiting who sent the princess, but what happened? Beiting really had the nerve to bring up such a condition again.
Ye Shuo unexpectedly thought of his biological father again.
Noticing the undisguised murderous intent in the young man’s eyes, Huyan Guang really wanted to cry. He knew that this wouldn’t work. It had come to this point, and the Wolf King and the others were still unwilling to put down their airs. As a result, he was the only one in trouble.
“No, no, no, Emperor Zhou, calm down. I will tell the Wolf King when I get back!”
The benefits belong to the entire Beiting, but his life is his own. Huyan Guang can fully distinguish the priorities.
At this point, Ye Shuo didn’t intend to keep him in suspense and said bluntly: “I conquered these seven cities with great effort, and I will not return any of them. Not only that, you Beiting must pay me 20 million taels of silver, otherwise, I will kill all the 30,000 Beiting soldiers. Whether those 30,000 soldiers can survive depends on whether your Wolf King is willing to pay for their redemption.”
If they lost these 30,000 mouths, and used the spoils of war such as cattle and sheep seized from cities and other places for military use, their Great Zhou might not be unable to continue to fight forward.
As for the killing… although it is against the harmony of nature, if it is necessary, Ye Shuo doesn’t mind becoming a massacre.
Twenty million taels of silver!
This is one fifth of the annual treasury income of Beiting!
You should know that the annual income of the Beiting treasury is only 100 million taels of silver. Hu Yanjue broke out in a cold sweat.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t care about that.
“I will only give you three days. For every day that passes after three days, I will kill 5,000 people until they are all gone.”
“This matter is not my fault, but your Beiting’s. It has nothing to do with me.”
If they were unwilling to give up their own country, how could Ye Shuo, the emperor of an enemy country, pity them? If he pitied them, who would pity the people of Da Zhou?
Even if 30,000 people really started to use knives, they could only last for six days.
Huyan Guang wanted to say something else, but Ye Shuo waved his sleeves and drove him out mercilessly.
Huyan Guang was really at a loss for words this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Killing
chapters.content:
Huyan Guang had no say in this matter. After being driven out, he stood there in a daze for a long time. Finally, he gritted his teeth and rode back to the royal court at full speed.
After Hu Yanguang left, Prince Ding couldn’t help but look at his brother beside him. After hesitating for a while, Prince Ding finally asked, “Your Majesty, are you… serious? Are you kidding?”
“If Beiting refuses to give you money, will you really kill the captives?”
Although my brother always keeps his word, the massacre… is still too bloody.
Perhaps the Great Zhou had always been in a weak position before, and Prince Ding had only heard about it, and he had never done it himself. But Prince Ding still knew that if he killed one person, he only needed to be ruthless, but if he killed so many people, it would not be enough to be ruthless.
This requires an extremely strong heart, otherwise the nightmares every night alone would drive a person crazy.
Ye Shuo nodded, although reluctant, but firm: “Yes.”
It was just like when the young emperor first ascended the throne, and when he faced questions from the fifth, seventh, and eighth princes, he always answered with the same word: “yes”.
Ever since he took this position, Ye Shuo never thought that he would be able to escape unscathed and stay clean.
If he was just a prince, it wouldn’t matter what he did, but now that he has become the emperor, everything depends only on profit.Not everyone is qualified to be merciful. It can be said that he is no different from the emperors recorded in history.
“Whether Beiting agrees or not, it will only benefit us.”
If Beiting agrees to compensate, he can use the money to buy grain to reclaim wasteland, provide relief to disaster victims, and help the people who are in dire straits to overcome difficulties. If Beiting does not agree to compensate, that’s fine too. Killing these 30,000 prisoners and further weakening Beiting’s national strength will also be a good thing for their Great Zhou.
But I am still going further and further on this road to becoming an emperor.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look into the distance, towards the place where the prisoners were being held.
Prince Ding suddenly felt that even if he, the crown prince, or Emperor Taicheng were in their current situation, they probably wouldn’t be able to do better than him.
Afterwards, not long after Huyan Guang left, Ye Shuo ordered the soldiers of the Great Zhou to take shovels and start digging holes on the spot.
No matter how strong the Beiting soldiers were, they were just lambs to be slaughtered without their weapons. A few smart ones vaguely sensed something and were unwilling to die like this, so they tried their best to run away.
However, fists were still too weak compared to swords and knives. After killing several people in succession, the Beiting group had to calm down when looking at the corpses neatly laid out in front of them.
Ye Shuo thought about it, and then whispered a few words to one of the guards who had been protecting him recently.
The guard understood and nodded hurriedly: “I understand.”
When the group of people in Beiting started to riot again, one of the soldiers of the Great Zhou whipped them and cursed them: “Why are you yelling? It’s not like we didn’t give you a chance. As long as the Wolf King and his men pay the ransom, you can leave when the time comes. Who will stop you? Do you really think that our Great Zhou wants to keep you? There are so many people, how long will it take to kill them? When the knives are blunt, they will have to be replaced with new ones. You really think you are important people, bah!” řἁΝổВĚ𝐒
Only then did these 30,000 captives learn about the ransom.
To be honest, 20 million taels of silver is not a lot, it is only one-fifth of the tax revenue of the entire Beiting. After all, Ye Shuo’s purpose is to gain benefits, not to go against Beiting regardless of the consequences under such circumstances.
Although Ye Shuo acted rather crazy, he was not a real madman after all. Compared to expanding territory, the most important thing right now was to keep the people of the Great Zhou alive.
But despite this, there are still many difficulties in achieving this goal.
First of all, Beiting may not be able to accept the reversal of status with Dazhou. In the past, Dazhou ceded land and paid compensation to Beiting, but now the situation has suddenly reversed. Beiting may not bow its head so easily. Secondly, it is not the farming season now, and the Beiting royal family is extravagant. It is hard to say whether there are 20 million taels in the national treasury. Even if there is, Beiting may not be willing to give it up.
Anyway… let’s take a gamble.
Ye Shuo had already prepared for the worst.
On the other side, Huyan Guang brought back the news, and the Beiting Wolf King was indeed furious.
“How dare you!” The emperor of the Great Zhou was just a young man in his twenties. He got the throne because the Ye family had no more people. Under such circumstances, he dared to challenge him. He was simply courting his life.
But then again, Beiting is indeed at a disadvantage now. No one knows what Lan Feng did, but in less than a month, they lost three cities and in the end even had their heads chopped off. The Wolf King not only did not feel pity, but instead regretted why he let such a waste lead the army.
First it was Lan Ruo, then Lan Feng. This made the Wolf King even doubt the Lan family, wondering if they were still as brave and warlike as they were in the past. He had also been very cold towards the Lan family in recent times.
Just when the Wolf King was about to order the army to attack, he was suddenly stopped by Zuo Xian King standing nearby.
“Wait a minute.” Then Zuo Xian turned around and looked at Huyan Guang beside him.
“You just said that the emperor of the Great Zhou said personally that they were running low on food and fodder?”
Huyan Guang did not dare to be negligent and nodded quickly.
It should have been a good thing that the enemy’s weakness was exposed so easily, but instead of feeling any joy, King Zuo Xian frowned even more tightly.
The Emperor of the Great Zhou not only told them the weaknesses, but also what to do next.
When food and grass are insufficient, the prisoners must be killed. This is not a threat; the other party is just stating a fact.
Since the Emperor of Great Zhou allowed Hu Yanguang into the tent, it proved that he did not necessarily want to fight. The Emperor of Great Zhou also wanted to negotiate, but the prerequisite was that they had to meet the conditions he proposed. If they failed to do so, the other party would probably turn against him immediately.
After studying the current Emperor Yongxi for a while, Prince Zuo Xian had some understanding of his personality.
Seeing that Zuo Xian Wang remained silent for a long time, Hu Yanguang could not help but whisper: “Maybe the matter is not as serious as we thought. Maybe we can continue to talk about it?”
However, Zuo Xian Wang shook his head: “Impossible.”
“The emperor has made it very clear.” The other party’s reasoning was very clear. He did not ask for an exorbitant price, nor did he lower his attitude. The reasonable conditions proved that there was no room for negotiation.
Either meet his conditions or continue fighting. He has made it very clear. It is up to them to choose or not.
Although the wolf king was old, his character meant he was not afraid at all: “If you want to fight me, then fight me. Who’s afraid of who?” He just didn’t believe that he couldn’t deal with this man.
Upon hearing this, Zuo Xian Wang couldn’t help but take a deep breath: “If it were anyone else today, even the previous Emperor Jingwen would not have hesitated at all.”
“But this Emperor Yongxi… is really hard to judge. He is different from everyone else.”
He didn’t even bother to investigate, but simply blamed the entire alliance incident on Beiting. It’s hard to say that there wasn’t some old personal grudge involved.
Just because Beiting sent assassins to assassinate Emperor Jingwen, which led to Emperor Jingwen being seriously injured and died later, he still remembers it until now and even expressed his resentment in public. It can be seen that when Emperor Yongxi goes crazy, he is likely to do nothing.
Beiting is powerful, so he is not afraid of normal people, but no matter how powerful a person is, he has to be courteous when meeting a madman. King Zuo Xian feels that the current emperor of the Great Zhou is not very normal.
And his speculation is not entirely without basis. Look, whether before or after he ascended the throne, has he ever done anything that a normal person would do?
If there hadn’t been that group of locusts, the outcome of the battle between Da Zhou and Bei Ting would have been 40-60. But if the locusts continued to get involved, it would probably be 50-50.
What if, as Zuo Xian Wang said, the Great Zhou Emperor suddenly went crazy and insisted on dragging them to gamble on the fate of the country, so that both sides would suffer losses, and in the end, wouldn’t Chen State benefit for nothing? The Wolf King was already very dissatisfied with this matter. If Chen State was allowed to reap the benefits, the Wolf King would definitely vomit blood.
The wolf king’s expression was uncertain, and he hesitated for a moment.
Huyan Guang on the side was extremely anxious, wondering if the Wolf King and the others could come up with a decision quickly. You know, it took him a day to get back to the royal court, and the three-day deadline was getting closer and closer. If he continued to hesitate, the 20 million taels of silver would be in vain.
However, what Hu Yanguang did not expect was that at this time, the Wolf King actually said: “Send the message to the State of Chen and ask them to send troops to reinforce.”
Huyan Guang almost fainted, but since the Wolf King had given the order, they had no choice but to follow it.
Three days passed in a flash. It was noon, but Beiting still didn’t come with the silver. He only sent a soldier to ask them to give them more time. After the soldier left, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but close his eyes.
After a moment, Ye Shuo swung his right hand fiercely: “Do it!”
Soon, a total of 5,000 Beiting soldiers were forcibly pulled out of the team.
Needless to say, the bloody scene afterwards was extremely violent, and the strong smell of blood attracted countless hawks and falcons that loved to eat flesh and blood. It took four full hours for the screams to gradually disappear.
The next day, still no one came from Beiting, and then another five thousand lives were lost. This time, the pit was dug even deeper.
On the other hand, although the Wolf King knew the temperament of Emperor Yongxi of the Great Zhou, when he saw that he really started to bury people, he couldn’t help it and his eyelids twitched wildly.
On the third day, news finally came from the State of Chen.
“Reporting to the Wolf King, Chen, Chen Guo said that they can’t spare the time for the time being, so they can’t come over…”
The alliance between countries is already very weak, and the so-called alliance is essentially a piece of waste paper. The State of Chen hopes that both sides will suffer losses so that it can reap the benefits.
The moment the messenger finished speaking, there was a loud “bang” and the table in front of the Wolf King was split in half.
“Good! What a ruthless and heartless Chen State!”
Seeing that half of Beiting’s soldiers had been lost, just when Ye Shuo thought that he had to continue killing until they were all gone, at noon on the fourth day, Huyan Guang finally arrived.
“Emperor Zhou, wait a minute!”
“The Wolf King has ordered that we pay 20 million silver coins. I hope that Emperor Zhou will show mercy and let these soldiers live!”
Beiting finally compromised.
Ye Shuo raised his hand, signalling everyone to stop. When Hu Yanguang came closer, he saw that there was nothing behind him. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask, “Where’s the silver?”
Hu Yanguang: “I, Beiting, keep my word. I will definitely deliver it within seven days!”
Ye Shuo thought it was okay, at least give people some time to prepare.
So he decided to just kill a thousand people today as a token of his appreciation.
Hu Yanguang watched on helplessly, unable to maintain the smile on his face any longer, and his whole body stiffened instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: Brutal
chapters.content:
“Emperor Zhou, what do you mean?”
Hu Yanguang was so shocked and angry that he even forgot to pretend to be respectful.
Ye Shuo did not waver at all in the questioning. Instead, he was full of confusion: “I think my request is not high. It’s just 20 million taels of silver. When my Great Zhou won the victory, we paid more than this amount. But you keep delaying. I have to wonder if you Beiting did it on purpose.”
What Ye Shuo was talking about was naturally the things that happened during the time of his step-grandfather. At that time, his step-grandfather lost too much money, and it was enough to infuriate both humans and gods if it was singled out.
Hu Yanguang took a deep breath and managed to regain some rationality: “Our Wolf King is a man of his word. Isn’t this enough to prove our sincerity? Emperor Zhou is too cruel to even wait for a few days.”
As soon as the word “brutal” came out, Ye Shuo didn’t know how the other party had the nerve to say it.
“I don’t know how many people you Beiting have slaughtered in my Great Zhou. The number of Beiting soldiers I killed today is just a drop in the bucket.”
Besides…
“Have you not torn up enough agreements between Beiting and my Great Zhou?” As for the so-called agreement between these three countries, it was almost like a piece of waste paper, signed and torn up, and it had lasted for so many years.
Hearing this, Huyan Guang’s face couldn’t help but turn red.“I don’t know about the little tricks you have been doing in private recently. I hope you can send the ransom as soon as possible. We don’t have much food left here, and we really don’t have time to wait any longer.”
Huyan Guang didn’t expect that he actually knew that Beiting asked Chen State for help. When such a secret was exposed, Huyan Guang’s momentum immediately dropped.
“No matter what you say, I will not release you unless I get the silver.”
“Someone, show them away!”
The moment he finished speaking, Huyan Guang was driven out again. Huyan Guang did not bother to express his anger and hurried back to report the situation.
When the wolf king learned about this, his face immediately turned pale.
“This is really too much!”
But at the same time, the Wolf King also felt a little powerless.
Chen State went back on its word and refused to send troops. The odds of victory and defeat between us and the Great Zhou were only fifty-fifty, and we really couldn’t afford to gamble. The more decisive and ruthless Ye Shuo was, the more the Wolf King feared him.
The lethality of an unreasonable emperor is completely different from that of an emperor who can reason with reason.
In the past, it was always them, Beiting, who were unreasonable, but now the situation has changed and it is finally their turn.
Even King Zuo Xian who was standing by found the situation difficult, if not for anything else, just because that group of soldiers was difficult to deal with. 𝙧åNŐΒĚȘ
It would be fine if all of them were rescued or all of them died, but now half of them are dead and half are left, neither up nor down, which is the most distressing thing.
However, now that things have come to this, I can only close my eyes and keep moving forward.
Wait, if you think about it carefully, it seems that there are other ways to remedy the situation.
Out of habit, King Zuo Xian and King Wolf naturally felt that the small State of Chen would not dare to resist. Although they trusted the wrong people and took the wrong path at the beginning, they still had a chance if they wanted to correct it now.
Just when the Wolf King was helpless and finally started to raise money, he heard the Left Wise King beside him suddenly say: “I have a plan, I wonder if Your Majesty is willing to listen to it?”
The Wolf King relies on him the most, so naturally he will respond to everything he asks.
“you say.”
Zuo Xian Wang took a deep breath and then lowered his voice: “Your Majesty, don’t be too anxious about the money. Even if we can successfully raise 20 million taels, we should wait a few more days.”
The wolf king pondered for a moment, and suddenly an idea came to him.
“You mean… using the Great Zhou Emperor’s hand…?”
As expected, he was the one who promoted Zuo Xian Wang to the position, and the Wolf King knows him best.
Zuo Xian Wang did not hide his true feelings and said bluntly: “If I were the Emperor of Zhou, I would not miss such an opportunity to sow discord.”
Think about it, the emperor of the Great Zhou ordered people to randomly select 5,000 people from the prisoners of war every day. Now the survivors live in despair and fear every day. After a long time, wouldn’t they feel resentful?
If it were him, he would definitely hate it.
As the emperor of the Great Zhou was from an enemy country, it was natural for him to kill them. Instead of hating him, those soldiers could have saved their own country…
“Your Majesty, even if those people are rescued, I’m afraid they can’t be used anymore. It’s better to use Emperor Zhou to deal with them.”
It is one thing to be afraid that those people will have other ideas, but even if they don’t have other ideas, I am afraid they have already been scared out of their wits and become useless. It is even questionable whether they will have the courage to confront the Great Zhou again in the future. In addition, resettlement will cost a lot of money. Beiting is not rich now, so how can it afford it?
If we can’t kill the enemy, we have to feed them with food and grass.
It would be better to recycle the waste and divert the trouble away.
The wolf king thought about it carefully and felt that this made sense.
The Wolf King is now over seventy years old, but his character has not softened or become nostalgic as he grows older like Emperor Jingwen. Instead, he has become more cruel and ruthless. Especially in recent years, the Wolf King has become more suspicious, irritable, and intolerant of resistance.
Previously, the Wolf King’s cruelty was only seen in the Great Zhou and the State of Chen, but now he is targeting his own people.
Hu Yanguang, who was standing by, couldn’t help but feel a little scared after hearing this. That being said, it was too cruel. However, he was just an insignificant prince who was about to be expelled from the power centre of Beiting. In Beiting, there were a lot of people like him, so although Hu Yanguang was afraid, he didn’t dare to say a word.
Then Ye Shuo discovered that after being shocked by him, Beiting’s movements did not become faster. He didn’t know if it was his illusion, but it felt even slower than before.
Even if the Beiting Treasury couldn’t gather enough money at once, it wouldn’t be the case that not a single silver ingot was missing, right? If they really cared, it would never be like this.
They asked questions diligently, and envoys like Huyan Guang seemed very busy running around, but they did not take any substantial action. How could Ye Shuo believe that Beiting really wanted to redeem the person?
After so many days, Prince Ding had already gotten used to his brother killing the group of prisoners of war in Beiting from time to time.
But the strange thing is, for some reason, he suddenly stopped today.
Seeing that the time was about to pass, Prince Ding couldn’t help but ask.
Ye Shuo frowned and shook his head: “We can’t kill them anymore, or we’ll kill them all.”
Beiting’s abnormality forced Ye Shuo to pay attention.
“I always feel like something is wrong.”
Prince Ding was startled by his sudden serious expression and said casually, “What’s wrong with that? Beiting wouldn’t even abandon his own people, would he? Even if more than 10,000 have been killed, there are still 10,000 more.”
Prince Ding was just joking, but when Ye Shuo heard it, his heart skipped a beat. Then, as if he had figured something out, Ye Shuo’s pupils shrink.
Perhaps he still underestimated the cruelty of ancient wars.
Human life is like grass, and all things are like straw dogs. This is not just a saying.
After a long time, Ye Shuo slowly exhaled.
“What if they really don’t want it anymore?”
The moment the words fell, Prince Ding’s smile froze on his face.
“No, not really…”

chapters.title: Chapter 297: Sluggish
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo: “Given the current state of those people, I’m afraid it will be very difficult.”
From a distance, the prisoners of war in Beiting looked like frightened birds. The slightest movement of the people of the Great Zhou would make them tremble. In addition, they had little food and did not have enough to eat every day. They relied on a mouthful of rice soup to survive. Even if they were given weapons now, they might not be able to hold them.
Prince Ding couldn’t help swallowing his saliva and said with difficulty: “If this is the case… Beiting is too cruel.”
No matter what the result is, these are soldiers defending their country, how could they have the heart to do this!
But if you think about it carefully, this is actually Beiting’s style of doing things.
Beiting people believe in the Wolf King and regard the wild wolves on the grassland as their totems. Beiting people who grow up in such an environment are cruel by nature and not polite people. They cannot be judged by common sense. In their eyes, human life is no different from lambs, and they have always divided it into useful and useless, edible and inedible.
Ye Shuo sat down again, pondered for a while, and said, “Let’s wait a little longer.”
Wait another seven days, and there will definitely be a result no matter what. By then, Ye Shuo will be ready to send the people back and then withdraw his troops.
And so, the sudden silence of the Great Zhou made the prisoners of Beiting even more frightened and uneasy, fearing that they would be the next.
These seven days were almost the most tormenting time in their lives.When the executioners become prey, they are no better than the souls killed by their knives. Before they die, even if they once regarded human lives as cattle and sheep and livestock, their ugly side is revealed.
Every time at this time, everyone would ask themselves: Why hasn’t their wolf king come to pick them up yet? It doesn’t matter, just hold on a little longer, maybe he’ll arrive tomorrow.
What? If he didn’t come tomorrow, then it should be the day after tomorrow. No, that’s not right. It must be the day after tomorrow!
Day after day, from hope to despair, this question never has an answer.
However, even the Wolf King cannot do such a thing openly and too obviously, otherwise the other soldiers would be disheartened.
As the days passed, it was not known whether the Emperor of the Great Zhou was tired of killing, or had a change of heart, or had guessed their intentions. When the agreed time came, the Wolf King had no choice but to pack the 20 million taels of silver into a box and send it to the border.
This time, it was not only Huyan Guang who delivered the silver, but Zuo Xian Wang of Beiting also arrived.
With a sinister look on his face, Zuo Xian Wang took a cursory glance at the remaining ten thousand people and realised that it was just as he had expected. These people had become timid over the past few days and were afraid of the Great Zhou as if they were a tiger. It seemed that they were no longer useful.
However, the emperor of the Great Zhou was not quite what he thought.
The young man was not as crazy as he imagined. He looked like a normal person, but his actions were not consistent with his harmless appearance at all.
Regardless of whether he was really crazy or not, the fact that he killed all the envoys from Beiting in one breath without blinking an eye, cutting off his own retreat, and taking the initiative to resist the joint attack of the two countries showed that few emperors had such courage.
If we wait two more months, and if the Great Zhou agrees to let the princess come, we can delay the journey a little longer on the pretext of the wedding ceremony. By the time spring comes and the grass in Beiting sprouts new buds, the scene will be completely different.
What a pity. What a pity.
Noticing the look in Zuo Xian Wang’s eyes, Prince Ding immediately became alert.
What does this person mean? What is he trying to do by staring at his brother?
Just when Prince Ding was sure that this person must hate them very much in his heart, he suddenly heard Prince Zuo Xian change the subject and bowed to Ye Shuo and said, “Emperor Zhou has a good method. I, Beiting, am convinced.” R̃ＡΝọꞖЕS̈
Ye Shuo was so focused on the boxes that he didn’t hear what he said clearly. He just said perfunctorily, “Prince Zuo Xian, you are too kind.”
Ye Shuo kept calculating in his mind how much he could do with so much money. At least he wouldn’t have to worry about anything during the months from spring ploughing to harvest.
But for the current Zuo Xian Wang, how to deal with these ten thousand people has become a problem.
The national treasury cannot support treating them too well, but if we try to get rid of them, we are afraid of being discovered. Now these people are more like hot potatoes, which is really tricky.
King Zuo Xian left quickly, and out of concern, General Fang, General Xu and others quickly gathered around.
“May I ask your Majesty, what did Zuo Xian Wang just say?” Zuo Xian Wang was a cunning and sinister person, and they had killed so many people from Beiting, so General Fang and General Xu couldn’t help but feel worried.
Ye Shuo didn’t hesitate and said, “Zuo Xian Wang said that this is a different time, and a temporary victory can’t prove anything. He told me to be careful, because Beiting will retaliate sooner or later.”
Caught off guard, Prince Ding was stunned.
Wait, I was there the whole time, how come I didn’t know that Zuo Xian Wang had said this?
However, General Fang and General Xu believed it without a doubt. In their opinion, the emperor would not lie, or in other words, this answer was more in line with their expectations.
Besides, Beiting had suffered such a great loss, and according to their temperament, it was impossible for them not to retaliate. Not only would Beiting retaliate, but they would also retaliate in a more cruel way than before.
The joy of victory faded away quietly, and the two generals became nervous at a speed visible to the naked eye.
“I understand. I will be more careful in the future.”
After everyone left, Ye Shuo suddenly saw the eldest prince looking at him with an indescribable look, as if he had just committed an unforgivable crime.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo was speechless: “What’s that expression on your face?”
Prince Ding calmed down instantly: “I dare not.”
Knowing what he was thinking, Ye Shuo said righteously: “There is nothing we can do about it. For the sake of the great cause of unification, we can only put them in a difficult position temporarily.”
Be prepared for danger in times of peace. The more this happens, the more you should not be complacent.
What Ye Shuo said sounded good, but it was not so easy to really achieve this goal. Moreover, this kind of thing could not be accomplished by his efforts alone. Everyone had to unite and work together to have a chance to truly realise it.
So he not only wanted to deceive General Xu, but also wanted to deceive the people of the Great Zhou.
This is the truth, but Prince Ding couldn’t help but feel sympathy for General Xu and the people.
But soon Prince Ding stopped laughing, and immediately heard his brother: “Don’t be silly and laugh, I also have something to ask you to do.”
What is the cheap brother thinking? Everyone is included, so how can he be left out?
Although Prince Ding had already made preparations, he still felt a tingling sensation on his scalp when Ye Shuo said it.
“What? You want me to take all the credit for this?”
“What else can we do? It wouldn’t be good to let He Xiang and the others know that it was all done by me, right?” Although He Xiang and the others would know sooner or later, it certainly wouldn’t be now. After all, Ye Shuo still had to rely on He Xiang and the others to do work.
It is too late to worry about the outside world now. If party disputes are added, it will take a long time to accomplish anything.
Ye Shuo was not afraid of being exposed at all. Given his bad deeds in the past twenty years, it was impossible for them to believe it unless they saw it with their own eyes.
However, for Prince Ding, this matter was almost the same as asking for his life.
Asking him to claim military merit would be more painful than killing him.
Prince Ding held his breath for a long time before finally saying, “I really don’t have the nerve to do that.”
Ye Shuo’s tone was equally sincere: “For the sake of the Great Zhou, you can have it.”
“Besides, no one asked you to say it yourself. When the time comes, you just need to not refute or say anything.” He Xiang and the others would guess in this direction.
“Okay, you don’t have to say anything more, it’s settled!”
Without waiting for his cheap brother to refute, Ye Shuo made the decision immediately.
Prince Ding: “…”
Prince Ding felt that he must have committed some great sin in his previous life, which was why he had such a younger brother. What’s more, this younger brother was the emperor who had the final say.
Why the hell did he have to be the emperor!
However, Ye Shuo didn’t care what his cheap brother was thinking. After counting the last box of silver, it was time for Ye Shuo to return to Da zhou.
General Xu and General Fang are veterans, and they are the ones who will handle border affairs.
On the other hand, as soon as the news of the peace talks between Da Zhou and Beiting spread, the State of Chen knew that it could not hold on alone and quickly retreated.
At this moment, the State of Chen was extremely annoyed. This time, not only did Beiting make a mistake, but even the State of Chen never expected that the usually tough Beiting would surrender on its own initiative and also pay seven cities and 20 million taels of silver to the Great Zhou.
Chen State’s plan to reap the benefits was suddenly shattered.
Seeing that Beiting seemed to be preparing to target itself, the State of Chen had no choice but to hurriedly send envoys to speak good words, but this time Beiting did not believe them.
In anger, Beiting followed the example of the Great Zhou and killed all the envoys of the State of Chen in one go. The relationship between the three countries became unprecedentedly tense.
Before Ye Shuo left, he looked back at the endless grassland in front of him from afar. What he thought in his heart was that this time he had reached his limit and it would not be so easy next time.
I will come back sooner or later.
It has only been more than twenty years since Ye Shuo was born. During these twenty years, Chen State and Beiting have invaded many times, and it can almost be said that they have no taboos. He has witnessed so many things with his own eyes alone, and what he cannot see will only be more serious. Massacres and city destruction are just commonplace.
Today, the danger of the Great Zhou being destroyed has been temporarily resolved, but it will come back again tomorrow, and this cycle will repeat itself for hundreds of generations. Ye Shuo feels extremely annoyed just thinking about it.
So we still need to encourage Prime Minister He and the people to work harder…
After thinking about it, Ye Shuo turned around and raised the whip in his hand high: “Go!”
In this way, more than a thousand cavalrymen followed behind him, the sound of horse hooves was like thunder, smoke and sand rolled, and it was extremely ostentatious.
After about three to five days, the 20 million taels of silver were distributed to various parts of the Great Zhou according to Ye Shuo’s original instructions.
While the people of the Great Zhou were receiving relief, another matter inevitably reached their ears.
The reason why the imperial court was so generous this time was that it was all extorted from Beiting. The people of Beiting were cruel and bloodthirsty by nature. After suffering a loss this time, they made a harsh statement on the spot that they would retaliate in the future. Not only would they take back the 20 million taels of silver, but they would also rob their fields and kill their husbands/wives/children/parents, making them into human skin lanterns, and then everyone would have one to light for fun.
For a time, the people were in danger, but at the same time, they were reluctant to give up the relief they had received, after all, they had to survive. Moreover, the people could not run away, their fields were here, and if they ran away, they would starve to death.
Fortunately, there is a solution to this problem. As long as everyone plants more crops, exercises more, and actively responds to the call of the court, and everyone is united, then we will not be afraid even if the people from Beiting come.
Looking back at history, there are very few lands under our feet that have not been occupied by enemy countries, so the rumours should be true.
Knowing that there might be dangers in the future, people gradually became less confused.
On the other hand, after leaving the border, Prince Ding was still thinking that although his brother’s words sounded nice, it might not be so easy for him to hide it from Prime Minister He and others this time.
However, what Prince Ding did not expect was that soon after he walked out, Ye Shuo began to weaken at a speed visible to the naked eye. What shocked Prince Ding even more was that by the evening of the second day, his younger brother, who was already 27 years old this year, actually… actually started to have a low-grade fever!
“Did you catch a cold? Or did you catch a chill?”
When Prince Ding heard the noise at night, he stood there in a daze for a while. After putting on his clothes, he hurried to Ye Shuo’s room.
“Neither…”
Ye Shuo shook his head and lay on the bed, his face pale: “I killed too many people, I was scared.”
“………………”
Prince Ding: “???”
What? ? ?

chapters.title: Chapter 298: Taking the Blame
chapters.content:
When Prince Ding heard this, his first reaction was –
He is lying again!
After all, when he was on the battlefield killing the enemy before, he showed no mercy. He killed and buried as he said. Now that everything is over, why should he be afraid?
Prince Ding felt that his brother was too unkind and even kept it a secret from him. He couldn’t help feeling dissatisfied.
However, after waiting for a while, he saw that he was still lying there sick. Prince Ding hesitated for a while, then sat down and reached out to touch his forehead.
Hey, you know what, it’s really hotter than ordinary people’s.
Prince Ding couldn’t help but widen his eyes: “It’s really burning!”
Ye Shuo watched his actions with his own eyes, and after hearing these words, he could not help but say faintly, “What else? Big Brother.”
Prince Ding finally realised what was happening and said, “I will go find a doctor for you right away!”
However, before he arrived, Ye Shuo had already sent people to look for him, and while the two were talking, the doctor had also arrived.The doctor was woken up from his sleep. He was a local celebrity, famous for his superb medical skills. Many local dignitaries would invite him to their homes to treat their illnesses.
He was busy preparing medicinal materials today and was busy until late at night. As soon as he lay down, he heard a knock on the door.
The doctor originally planned to send his students, but who would have thought that when he opened the door, he would see a group of people in armour. The doctor had seen some of the world, so he knew that with such a big scene, the sick person must be rich or noble. However, the doctor never thought that the handsome young man in front of him, who was curled up in the quilt and almost buried by the soft bed, would be so rich.
When he inadvertently saw the golden dragon pattern embroidered on the handkerchief used for cleaning next to him, his heart was filled with shock.
Looking at the middle-aged man pacing nearby, there was also a ferocious giant python embroidered on his clothes. The middle-aged man seemed to notice his gaze and looked over immediately.
“How is it? Is there anything serious?”
Prince Ding had just come down from the battlefield, and his fierce aura was still there. The man in front of him looked like a murderer, and the doctor could not control himself and became nervous.
“Reply, reply to this lord, this nobleman is frightened and shocked. I will prescribe some prescriptions to calm his nerves and perhaps he will feel better…”
It turned out to be a real problem caused by fear!
Prince Ding was stunned.
However, the doctor misunderstood the way Prince Ding’s eyes widened. Seeing that the old man in front of him was getting more and more nervous, Ye Shuo had to remind him: “Brother, you scared this old man.”
Since the young man in front of him called the middle-aged man “big brother”, he must be the famous Prince Ding of our dynasty.
As for the young man… is there any need to guess? In the entire Great Zhou, apart from that person, who else could use, who else dared to use this golden dragon as a pattern? ꞦÅＮȮꞖÊS
The doctor felt that his ancestors’ graves might be smoking. He never thought that he would see the day when he would treat the emperor.
Although the doctor was far away at the border, he knew that several emperors had been replaced in the past few years. He also heard that the one who ascended the throne recently had a bad reputation. When he met him today, he realised that the rumours did not seem to be true.
The emperor has a good temper!
Besides, the doctor was close to the border, and it only took a day to go back and forth, so the doctor knew the news of the Beiting army’s approaching the border early on. He thought that there would be another fight this time. Basically, all the dignitaries in the city who could run away, and even those who couldn’t run away, tried every means to send their relatives to a place closer to the centre.
The doctor was originally hesitating whether to go out and seek refuge. After all, once the Beiting people invaded, local people like him would have no way out.
The result was unexpected. Although they did fight, Beiting did not attack as they wished. Combined with the appearance of the two people, how could the doctor not guess what happened?
Throughout history, few emperors could do this. In addition, the young man spoke in a soft tone, and gradually, the doctor relaxed.
“Don’t worry, my dear sir. I will do my best to keep you healthy.”
Ye Shuo heard this and nodded slightly: “Thank you for your help.”
Another word of trouble made the doctor try his best to write out the prescription, and then he personally supervised the decoction of the medicine.
However, when facing Prince Ding, the doctor showed a completely different expression, being extremely fearful and cautious.
After the doctor took the prescription and went down to get the medicine, Prince Ding couldn’t help himself anymore and pointed outside, saying, “What does he mean by this?”
Ye Shuo coughed lightly, looking quite innocent: “Maybe it’s because my eldest brother is too fierce, so he is feared.”
He… is fierce? ? ? Who of the two of them is more fierce?
Prince Ding’s throat was blocked by a mouthful of blood. Looking at his harmless brother lying in the quilt, Prince Ding felt even more suffocated.
Prince Ding finally realised what was going on and felt that he suffered because of his face. His younger brother was thin and strong, while he looked fierce, so once something happened, everyone would subconsciously think that he did it.
About half an hour later, Ye Shuo drank a bowl of tranquilliser and barely fell asleep. On the next day, Prince Ding saw, as expected, that his brother had started chatting with the doctor again. As for the doctor, he no longer looked fearful and timid as he did when facing him.
Now that Ye Shuo was the emperor, he had to understand the people’s sentiments occasionally. So after the doctor had taken his pulse, he casually asked about the local customs and people’s living conditions.
The doctor hesitated for a moment, but finally spoke: “It would be fine if it was an ordinary year, but once there is a disaster or famine, the people of Beiting will come here to rob, just like this time, almost everyone in the city ran away.”
In the past, these things might have been just a battle report to Ye Shuo, but now that he was there in person, he knew what the situation was like.
After going out, Ye Shuo saw that the people who had fled were coming back one after another, and those who had stayed in the city waiting to die must have heard something, so smiles appeared on their faces unconsciously.
They heard that the fighting was over and that the Beiting people didn’t break in. Aren’t they happy?
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say, “Don’t worry, these days of worrying will be over soon.”
The doctor standing by was stunned for a moment, and before he could carefully look, he saw that the young man had turned around.
For some reason, the doctor subconsciously remembered this scene.
Although Ye Shuo had not retreated completely, it was not a good idea for him to stay here for a long time. After he felt a little better, he prepared to set off again.
Although Ye Shuo knew in his heart that there were some things he had to do and he had no regrets, the hurdle in his heart was not so easy to overcome after all.
Due to fatigue and psychological factors, Ye Shuo’s condition recurred. When he arrived in Shangjing, Prince Ding watched helplessly as his face, which had finally recovered, turned pale again.
My younger brother was born white and not as strong as me. If he gets sick, he will look particularly bad.
Prince Ding felt that if the doctor saw this scene, he would be very sad.
At that time, Yao Zhi received the news and brought all the civil and military officials to pick up the people. In addition to her, there was also the current Queen Mother Wei.
Seeing her son from afar, Queen Mother Wei’s heart suddenly tightened. Looking at him, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but frown.
When Ye Shuo approached, Yao Zhi noticed that the young man seemed to have lost a lot of weight and his complexion did not look normal.
The first thing Ye Shuo said when he saw her was——
“I killed someone.”
“I killed a lot of people.”
Every time in his dream, all he could hear were the struggling and wailing sounds of Beiting soldiers, and Lan Feng, whose head he had chopped off, with a bloody face and eyes wide open staring at him, as well as… the corpses and countless broken limbs scattered all over the battlefield.
As his voice sounded, Yao Zhi’s heart twitched violently.
Then, Ye Shuo let out another long breath: “But fortunately, Beiting has paid the silver, and the plague and the disaster of national destruction should be resolved.”
Although Prince Ding didn’t hear what they said, he noticed the pity in the queen’s eyes and wanted to poke his eyes out. He shouted in his heart, “Don’t be fooled by him. This guy was so ruthless on the battlefield! He even scared Bei Ting!”
As for He Xiang and others on the side, they looked at this one, then looked at that one, and after a little consideration in their minds, they finally shifted their attention to the former eldest prince.
At this time, his brother didn’t even have time to say a word to them.
Prince Ding: “…”
Damn!
Why are they all like this!
In addition, even the fifth, seventh, and eighth princes in the crowd had strange looks on their faces. Ye Yan and the others even stepped forward and couldn’t help but whisper, “Father, the noise you made this time was a bit too loud.”
“But you made the Ninth Prince bear such a crime. You lied to him like this. Isn’t that… not good?”
The moment the words fell, Prince Ding’s expression turned even greener.
Prince Ding suddenly felt that sometimes knowing more than others was not a good thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 299: Weird
chapters.content:
“Who said I…”
Prince Ding opened his mouth, as if he wanted to explain something, but before he could finish his words, he heard the sound of wheels moving – it turned out that it was time to return to the palace.
The imperial carriage moved slowly and came in front of Ye Shuo.
Yao Zhi originally wanted to pull her hand away and sit on the carriage at the back that symbolised the phoenix, but the young man refused to loosen his grip no matter what. Yao Zhi had no choice but to be forced to ride in the same carriage with him.
He Xiang and others on the side frowned immediately when they saw this.
If His Majesty was not here, it would be fine. But now that His Majesty is back, the two of them are still riding in the same car. How can this be considered proper?
He Xiang and the others subconsciously prepared to speak, but then they thought… maybe forget it.
It is a happy event that His Majesty has returned victoriously. No matter what, His Majesty has successfully repelled Beiting. Just based on this, He Xiang and others cannot find any fault.
The current result is much better than they expected, and He Xiang and others can’t help but feel relieved. Under this circumstance, He Xiang and others don’t want to cause trouble.
The emperor finally trusted him once. If we start to teach him a lesson and annoy him, what will we do if he never behaves like this again? Moreover, the emperor is still ill now. What’s wrong with just obeying him this time?Unconsciously, He Xiang and others have become almost tolerant of Emperor Ye Shuo.
After Ye Shuo returned to the palace, after closing the door and leaving only his own people, Ye Shuo enjoyed almost the highest level of treatment.
First, the two concubines Xu and Li came to visit, and then Ye Shuo’s biological mother, Empress Dowager Wei, sat in front of Ye Shuo’s bed. Seeing that her son seemed to have lost a lot of weight, her eyes were red with heartache.
When Ye Shuo was a child, whenever he bumped into someone and got hurt, Empress Dowager Wei would feel distressed for a long time, let alone now. Even Jian Jian who was standing next to him rarely said anything.
“Where’s the imperial physician? Why hasn’t the imperial physician come yet?”
While waiting for the imperial physician, Yao Zhi had already examined him thoroughly. Seeing that he was just too frightened and would recover in a few days, and that he had not suffered any other injuries, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
His Majesty is in poor health, so more than half of the imperial physicians have come. Whether they are discussing the condition or prescribing medicine, they are all extremely cautious and careful.
In the eyes of the directors of the Imperial Medical Service, the emperor’s behaviour may not be in line with the wishes of Prime Minister He, but he is an excellent leader for them, a group of imperial doctors. The emperor is extremely generous to people with real talent and knowledge. Since he came to power, the entire Imperial Medical Service has been living a much better life, which was never the case before. So if possible, the imperial doctors in the Imperial Medical Service naturally hope that he can always be healthy.
When Concubine Dowager De arrived, what she saw was Ye Shuo surrounded by people in the centre.
Concubine Dowager De is the biological mother of Prince Ding. Although Emperor Yongxi is not on good terms with his youngest son, he is close to his eldest son. Now that she has learned that he is ill, it is natural for Concubine Dowager De to come and visit him. ɌаɴɵβЕṣ
Although she was mentally prepared, when Concubine Dowager De actually saw this scene, she still felt very complicated.
Concubine Dowager De remembered that Emperor Yongxi was extremely pampered when he was still a prince. He could be said to be the most spoiled among all the princes. He had the best food, clothing and other necessities. Both the late emperor and Empress Dowager Wei, who was still the Imperial Concubine at the time, doted on him to the utmost, especially Empress Dowager Wei, who almost gave him her heart and soul. Even when Emperor Yongxi didn’t like going to school when he was a child, Empress Dowager Wei still indulged him. It was simply unheard of.
You know, even ordinary people hope their children will become successful.
The Concubine Dowager De, who was still the Concubine De at that time, watched coldly, but what she thought in her heart was that with the way His Majesty and the Imperial Noble Concubine were raising children, when the Ninth Prince grew up, he would be nothing more than a playboy. The Concubine Dowager De even dared to directly assert that the future Ninth Prince would never become a great talent.
What happened afterwards was exactly as Concubine Dowager De had expected. After the Ninth Prince became Prince Rui, he was still the same. He was able to secure the throne of prince only because of the late emperor’s favour. However, what Concubine Dowager De did not expect was that the Ninth Prince did not have much ability, but he had good luck. In the end, after many twists and turns, the throne actually fell on his head.
Then she thought about herself again. The two sons she had raised with great care were now at odds with each other. Old grudges were growing deeper and deeper, especially the eldest son. Even towards his own younger brother, he was not as sincere as he was towards the young man in front of him.
When she thought of this, even the usually rational Concubine Dowager De couldn’t help but flash a hint of envy in her eyes. Among so many people, the Imperial Noble Concubine, whom they least favoured, was the one with the best fate after all.
After sitting for a while, Concubine Dowager De was ready to leave. At that time, Concubine Dowager Sun and Princess Zhaocheng also arrived.
Concubine Sun came here for no other reason than to thank Ye Shuo for the marriage.
Originally, Concubine Sun had already despaired at that time, but she didn’t expect that there would be a sudden turn of events in the end. Concubine Sun knew very well that if it were someone else, even if Qin’er’s father, Emperor Taicheng, were still alive, he might not be able to protect her, or… he might not be willing to protect her at all.
Only the Emperor Yongxi before her would make such a choice.
It would be fine if she was a biological sister, but this was a niece who was a step away from her. Concubine Sun asked herself that she couldn’t even do that.
So no matter what others thought, Concubine Sun felt that the young man in front of her was simply the best emperor in the world, no doubt about it.
“Qin’er, what are you still standing there for? Why don’t you go and pay your respects to your uncle?”
Princess Zhaocheng is almost eleven years old and has been able to remember things for a long time. She is still frightened by what happened in the palace that day.
At that time, so many ministers forced her to marry, and she was filled with fear and despair. Princess Zhaocheng would never forget that feeling of powerlessness. If it weren’t for the protection of the Ninth Prince, she would have married the King of Chen whom she had never even met.
So after hearing her mother’s reminder, Princess Zhaocheng came to Ye Shuo’s bed and bowed to him obediently.
“Zhao Cheng thanks the Emperor uncle.”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think of his daughter again. Seeing that the child was very well behaved, he wanted to reach out and touch her head, but then he remembered that she would soon be eleven years old, which was already a big girl in ancient times. It might be inappropriate for him to do so, so he gave up.
“Get up quickly.”
“Stay away from me, be careful of getting sick.”
Princess Zhaocheng felt extremely guilty. After she stood up, she saw Ye Shuo’s current appearance and finally couldn’t help crying.
“Uncle…if it weren’t for Zhao Cheng, you wouldn’t have become like this…”
“Uh… Xiao Zhaocheng, actually the emperor uncle is not in any trouble…”
For a moment, Ye Shuo felt his conscience hurt.
Although the little princess’s reaction was normal, crying was not auspicious after all. Seeing that the emperor seemed a little tired, Concubine Sun hurriedly wiped her daughter’s tears and took her out.
In the end, Ye Shuo almost fell into a deep sleep while listening to the voice of Queen Mother Wei.
When her son fell asleep, Queen Mother Wei gradually stopped. Seeing that it was getting dark outside, Queen Mother Wei couldn’t help but whispered, “I’ll trouble you with the rest of the matter.”
Even if we are biological mother and son, I can’t always be with him, right?
Yao Zhi nodded gently: “I understand.”
“Thank you for your hard work.” Queen Mother Wei couldn’t help but pat her hands.
With the help of Jianjian, Queen Mother Wei prepared to leave Chengming Palace. Before leaving, Queen Mother Wei couldn’t help but look back. She saw that her son seemed to be sleeping a little uneasy, but with the soft voice of her daughter-in-law, his brows gradually relaxed.
Queen Mother Wei was stunned at first, then she let out a long breath and looked at her daughter.
“Let’s go.”
Looking at Ye Shuo again, although this palace always gave people a cold feeling, it was the place where Ye Shuo had lived for more than 20 years. He suddenly returned to the familiar environment. Moreover, he knew that with Yao Zhi by his side, he would hardly be in danger. Ye Shuo relaxed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Of course, it would be nice if she could lie down with him.
Seeing the young man clinging to her, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel helpless: “Stop it, let go, I still have a lot of things to deal with.”
Since Ye Shuo went to war, Yao Zhi has been handling most of the affairs in the court. At first, He Xiang and his men were extremely opposed to it, thinking that how could a woman interfere in government affairs? Even if she was the queen, it was not allowed.
However, what He Xiang and his companions did not expect was that the first person to jump out and express support was the always old-fashioned Taifu.
I’m afraid he is crazy.
Prime Minister He and the Minister of the Chancellery almost popped their eyes out and expressed their incomprehension.
However, the Grand Tutor did not need their understanding. When he came back again, he had become very different from before. With the help of Wei Wen and others, the government affairs finally fell on Yao Zhi.
Yao Zhi was unfamiliar at the beginning, but now she has gradually adapted to it.
Yao Zhi is a genius in herself and learns things quickly.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but reveal a look of resentment when he heard this. Why couldn’t she accompany him on his first day back?
However, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but sigh when she saw this: “What else can I do? How about I keep it and let you deal with it tomorrow?”
Ye Shuo let go of her hand instantly.
Again, he had just returned and didn’t want to be immediately overwhelmed by tons of work.
But Yao Zhi also knew that he was rather vulnerable at this time, so she did not return to the Qinzheng Hall, but instead had someone deliver the memorial to the Chengming Hall.
She sat next to the bed, making sure the young man could see her as soon as he opened his eyes.
Ye Shuo thought about it and felt that it was barely acceptable.
Another wave of sleepiness came over him, and Ye Shuo forced himself to ask one last question: “Where’s Dingning?”
Speaking of her daughter, Yao Zhi’s eyebrows softened for a moment: “Wait until tomorrow. Second Master will send her here early tomorrow morning.”
There were a lot of people coming and going today, so Yao Zhi didn’t let anyone bring the little princess here.
It turns out that he was playing with the Second Master…
Ye Shuo subconsciously wanted to nod, but then he thought of something and said hurriedly: “No, no, I can’t let Dingning see me like this.”
In front of his daughter, Ye Shuo finally saved his face.
“I’ll go see her after I recover.” No matter what, Ye Shuo was determined not to leave such an impression on his daughter. Unlike others, Ye Shuo hoped that in his daughter’s memory, he would have a tall and mighty image.
Yao Zhi has known him for so many years, but has never seen this side of him.
After all, Yao Zhi couldn’t bear to destroy his fatherly love, so she subconsciously agreed.
“Okay, it’s getting late, go to bed.”
Under the dim candlelight, the woman sat there, the brush in her hand moving non-stop. She sometimes frowned, sometimes relaxed. After roughly browsing the contents of the memorial, she made blue comments one by one.
After what happened to Ye Xun, if you ask Ye Shuo if he is afraid, of course he is afraid.
Ye Xun, who was so close to him back then, would betray him and want to kill him. So might his other closest relatives… do the same.
But Ye Shuo still chose to believe it in the end.
Ye Shuo didn’t want to end up alone, so he decided to entrust his trust. Ye Shuo cherished his life the most, but if it was Yao Zhi and the others, if even they couldn’t let him entrust his life to them, if that day really came, Ye Shuo would rather die in their hands.
Yao Zhi next to her seemed to sense something and subconsciously raised her head. However, at this time, Ye Shuo had already closed his eyes and fell asleep.
The other side.
Compared to Ye Shuo, Prince Ding’s life was not so easy, because no matter where he went, strange looks followed him.
Including Princess Ding, everyone was looking at him with strange eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Ferocious
chapters.content:
Ferocious Princess Ding felt that her husband was really brave and strong. He was already over 40 years old and was even stronger than he was back then. But on the other hand, Princess Ding felt that he was too brave and strong. Wasn’t the look in his eyes strange?
Being stared at like this by his wife and children, Prince Ding had no words to express his grievances. Feeling depressed, he could only go outside to relieve his anguish.
However, what Prince Ding did not expect was that even outside he could not live in peace. The Fifth Prince changed his usual behaviour and came up to Prince Ding on his own initiative after seeing him.
Now that everyone is a prince, and things have already been decided, they are not as competitive with each other as before. Except for the Eighth Prince, the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince have started talking more.
Especially at this time, the fifth prince actually took the initiative to tease his elder brother: “If you had this ability back then, I’m afraid you wouldn’t be in this situation today.”
The Fifth Prince was known for his outspokenness, and he spoke directly whatever was on his mind.
The seventh prince’s eyes were also extremely strange. How could he not know before that his elder brother was so brave and brave, and he single-handedly turned the tide and saved the Great Zhou from danger? Could it be that he, with a broken leg, had opened up his Ren and Du meridians?
This was really not done by him!
Can you at least ask these people a few questions?
Upon hearing this, Prince Ding became even more annoyed: “Get out, get out, all of you!”The fifth prince was immediately furious: “Hey! Who is this? We are praising him, aren’t we? Why is he not happy?”
However, Prince Ding turned a deaf ear to him and was too lazy to talk to him. He just left the Fifth Prince with his back.
The Seventh Prince stood there and thought for a while, and felt that this matter was a bit strange, and even his eldest brother’s reaction was strange. Look at how he reacted when he won the battle, and then look at how he reacted now. Could it be that a person can really change so much after breaking a leg?
But no matter what the truth is, it’s a good thing that the Great Zhou won.
The Seventh Prince and the Fifth Prince only stopped after seeing Prince Ding. As soon as Prince Ding left, they turned around almost subconsciously and went about their own business without saying a word to each other.
Prince Ding felt that he should not have come out today. He did not expect that he would be so unlucky.
First, he met the two younger brothers, and after a while, he ran into the two uncles in the teahouse.
Prince Jin and Prince Su are old, and various injuries are gradually showing. Since they helped Ye Shuo ascend the throne, they have gradually stopped taking care of things. The burden they are now carrying will sooner or later fall on Prince Ding. After such a long period of observation, Prince Ding is almost certain to be the next person in charge of the royal family.
As for the Fifth Prince and the others, we still have to observe them. However, in Prince Su’s opinion, there is not much hope for the remaining people. R𝐚𐌽ΟＢƐṨ
Seeing a familiar figure, Prince Su took the initiative to invite him, “It’s rare to meet on the street, come sit together.”
After all, he is his uncle, and Prince Ding cannot fail to give him face. He can only suppress the depression in his heart and go upstairs.
As expected, Prince Ding soon noticed the slightly regretful looks in the eyes of his two uncles when they looked at the crutches in his hands.
What a good child, how come he is missing a leg? Or, why didn’t he show such talent in his early years? The eldest son of the emperor’s brother finally woke up too late.
Prince Ding dared to lose his temper with his two younger brothers, but he had to be careful when facing Prince Su and Prince Jin.
After finally sending the two old princes away, Prince Ding’s face was frozen with a smile.
I thought the matter was over here, but when I went to court the next day, there was another wave of complaints from the censors.
Now that the affairs of the Great Zhou are returning to their normal track, you gentlemen don’t need to worry so much. Once people have free time, won’t they start looking for trouble?
There were endless arguments in the court regarding the killing of the surrendered soldiers. Some people felt that they had to be killed no matter what under the circumstances at the time, while others who had not personally experienced the cruelty of the battlefield felt that such bloodlust was too brutal.
Seeing the ministers in front of him arguing with red faces and saying all kinds of things, Prince Ding, who was at the centre of the storm, not only did not feel the slightest ripple in his heart, but he even wanted to laugh.
If they had asked, it wouldn’t have turned out like this.
However, in the opinion of several censors, Prince Ding’s sudden outburst with a basis is much more reliable than the emperor’s single-handed effort to turn the tide.
The resentment in Prince Ding’s eyes almost solidified into reality.
This group of people had no idea what the scene was like at the time because they had not seen it with their own eyes. General Xu and General Fang later became even more obedient to him, and the military power on the border also fell into the hands of his younger brother in disguise. Thinking about it this way, all the benefits were his, and all the infamy was his.
The more Prince Ding thought about it, the more he felt that his brother might have planned this from the beginning.
Ye Shuo felt uneasy when being stared at by his cheap brother. After thinking about it carefully, Ye Shuo felt that this was indeed not fair.
So Ye Shuo decided to let him die with a clear conscience.
“Okay, stop arguing!”
Following a loud shout, the ministers below suddenly became quiet.
After resting for a few days, Ye Shuo gradually recovered and was in much better spirits than before.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said very seriously: “To be honest, I did all the things you said. Not only did I personally order the killing of the Beiting people, I also personally killed General Lan Feng and the deputy general beside Lan Feng, who were also pierced like candied haws by a few of my arrows.”
“Do you have anything else to say now?”
When Prince Ding heard this, his expression suddenly changed. He felt that his brother was not so annoying anymore. At least he defended himself in the end, didn’t he?
After Prince Ding broke free, he felt a little guilty. It was just some gossip, so why should he be afraid?
However, before Prince Ding could begin to be moved, He Xiang and others who had been silent finally spoke: “Your Majesty, we have no objection.”
Several censors did not expect that He Xiang and others would actually say such words. Seeing that they really did not seem to care, several censors who were arguing with reason felt as if their necks were strangled and they were completely stunned.
Why did He Xiang and the others become so tolerant when his younger brother said he did it?
Prince Ding observed for a while, and then discovered with sadness that they didn’t believe it at all!
In the eyes of He Xiang and others, unless they saw it with their own eyes, they would never believe that the emperor could have such a brave side.
