You know, when the emperor came back a few days ago, his pale face was still fresh in the memory of Prime Minister He and others.
As for the battle reports and various news coming from the border, they are also easy to explain. After all, His Majesty is the emperor. As long as something happens in the army, as long as it is a good thing, it will naturally be attributed to his credit.
What’s more, in the eyes of He Xiang and other old ministers, the reason why his younger brother said this was probably to protect him as the eldest brother.
But what he said was obviously true! It was true to every word!
Prince Ding finally understood how his father had been deceived by him. No, that’s not right. He was not deceived at all, because he seemed to never tell lies. It was just that the truth he said was even more false than the lies.
His younger brother just happened to have such ability, and Prince Ding was completely unprepared to resist.
However, after He Xiang and the others left, Ye Shuo showed a different look.
“I plan to start with the State of Chen. What do you think?”
Ye Shuo’s tone was extremely calm, but over the years, Wei Wen had gotten to know him quite well, so he naturally knew that since he had already said it, he must have already made up his mind.
As for Xing Yucheng, who had just been pulled in, he was still confused.
Looking at Prince Ding standing aside, his expression had gradually become ferocious.
At this moment, Prince Ding really wanted to pull He Xiang and the others over to see what the emperor, who was like a sheep in their hearts, was like behind the scenes.
But no matter how much he was in turmoil, Prince Ding finally said, “…Your Majesty, please give your orders.”
This time, even Wei Wen couldn’t help but begin to sympathise with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 301: Glass
chapters.content:
The miasma in Chen State was caused by rotting leaves.
Chen State has many trees and is blessed with unique natural conditions. If you want to get into it, you must find a way to tear open a hole.
“Here, here, and here.” Ye Shuo pointed to the map.
Prince Ding had fought in wars, and Wei Wen came from a family of military generals, and was best at analysing maps and terrain. Xing Yucheng was a typical scholar, and was slightly inferior in this respect.
After reading it, Prince Ding and Wei Wen nodded at the same time: “Your Majesty, these are indeed some excellent breakthrough points.”
Judging from the map alone, several places are relatively less dangerous and the terrain is relatively flat, so it is not so easy to be trapped there compared to other places.
Ye Shuo nodded: “So as long as we find a way to break the miasma barriers in these places, my Great Zhou will be able to send troops to advance.”
The State of Chen was isolated and weak. If it were not for its unique geographical location, it would not have been a match for the Great Zhou and Beiting.
Relying on this piece of land, the State of Chen was able to stay entangled with the other two countries for so long.
At this time, Xing Yucheng finally remembered the books he had read, especially some travel notes, and some scattered content in them.Since His Majesty said that the miasma did not fall from the sky but was caused by rotting leaves, we must find a way to cut down those trees. Over time, the miasma will naturally dissipate.
But because the places where the miasma was formed were all within the territory of the State of Chen, the people of Chen had to take action themselves. Otherwise, if the Great Zhou made any move, the State of Chen would quickly discover it. The State of Chen was not stupid and would not just sit there and watch, so it was unlikely to succeed.
The best way is to ask the State of Chen to destroy the Great Wall itself.
Xing Yucheng, who is in his thirties and gradually matures, gradually discovers that there are essential differences between people. Some people do not care about their own country, nor do they care whose subjects they are. As long as they live a good life, it is enough.
There are many such people in Chen State, Beiting, and their Great Zhou, so this matter seems difficult to accomplish, but as long as one condition is met, it may not be that difficult.
The world is bustling with people all because of profit. In the final analysis, it is nothing but profit. As long as the profit is big enough, there is nothing that will not be sold out.
Thinking of this, Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but sigh: “If you promise a large sum of money, maybe it will work.”
If we spread the word that we will purchase the trees in these places at a high price, there will naturally be people who are interested. Then the barrier on which the State of Chen relies for its survival will be broken from within.
But the key is… I have no money!
The purchase cost a huge amount of money, and the treasury of the Great Zhou Dynasty may not be able to support it. If they force themselves to do so, the treasury of the Great Zhou Dynasty will collapse before the barrier of the State of Chen is broken.
Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but say, “It would be great if the Great Zhou could suddenly have an extra sum of money.”
After all, Xing Yucheng is not a professional in economics, and he couldn’t think of any way to increase fiscal revenue for a while.
However, after Xing Yucheng finished speaking, he noticed that Wei Wen and Prince Ding’s gazes immediately fell on Ye Shuo.
If it’s money, my younger brother/cousin has it!
Although most of the money had been spent during the plague, his silver was not gone. As long as there was demand from Beiting, the money earned from selling wine would continue to flow into his pocket. 𝔯𝘢₦𝙤βËṡ
At first, Xing Yucheng didn’t know what Prince Ding and Wei Wen meant. Wei Wen thought about it and then gave him a rough explanation. Xing Yucheng was stunned.
It turns out that the plague was able to be successfully overcome because he put in so much effort behind the scenes.
The amount of money he spent alone was probably more than what was withdrawn from the Great Zhou treasury.
Xing Yucheng knew since he was a child that he was rich, but he never thought that he could be so rich. Excluding his identity as emperor, he was probably the richest man in the entire Great Zhou.
Isn’t it? That’s the revenue of an entire country’s wine industry! And it’s a monopoly industry, how can it not make money?
Xing Yucheng couldn’t help but think of the private money he had saved over the years. It was already quite a lot for him, but in the eyes of the emperor, it was probably not even a drop in the bucket.
It turns out that there are really people who can become as rich as a country…
But this is only a temporary choice. As I said before, if Da Zhou wants to develop, it cannot rely on him alone. Ye Shuo can solve Da Zhou’s temporary problems, but if Da Zhou encounters difficulties, it cannot rely on him every time.
Besides, Ye Shuo felt that only liquor might not be enough in the future.
“Come here and take a look at these three things.”
What Ye Shuo took out was nothing else but the three essential items for time travel – glass, sugar, and soap, all of which were just made by Zou Wu.
Prince Ding had seen glass once before on the battlefield, but even so he still found it magical, not to mention Xing Yucheng and Wei Wen.
Especially the telescope made of glass. Just a few pieces of this thing called glass filled in it could actually allow one to see various scenes hundreds of feet away. This scene almost overturned Wei Wen’s cognition.
Wei Wen considered himself knowledgeable, but he had never seen such a magical sight. He was the eldest son of the Zhen Mansion, so how could he not know what such a little gadget meant?
With this thing called a telescope on the battlefield, the scouts’ reconnaissance capabilities would definitely be taken to a higher level.
There is no need to think about it. This thing might have been made by my little cousin again. Just like before, he couldn’t even understand what he wrote, let alone what it meant.
However, Wei Wen had little desire to explore. As long as it was beneficial to the Zhen Mansion and the Great Zhou, Wei Wen never cared where the thing came from. That was why Ye Shuo had cooperated with his eldest cousin for so many years.
Xing Yucheng had seen crystal cups and glass cups, but neither of them was as pure as the one before him.
No matter how pure the crystal is, as long as it is natural, it cannot be completely free of impurities, but the cup in front of you is much more transparent than glass and crystal.
“A treasure! A first-class treasure!” Xing Yucheng was the son of an official after all, and he had been fond of elegance since childhood. The moment he held the cup, his expression gradually changed.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but pause, thinking, if he knew that this thing was used to drink water in modern times, I wonder what he would think…
Ye Shuo coughed lightly and said, “If you like it, I will give it to you.” Anyway, this thing is rare only when it comes out, and it will be worthless after a long time.
“Just take it and use it. If it’s not enough, just ask for more.”
Zou Wu and her students refined a whole furnace, and now she still has a lot.
Xing Yucheng calmed down instantly: “This…I am too ashamed to accept it…”
“Okay, okay, just take it. I’ve already given you enough before, so one more thing won’t make a difference.” Ye Shuo waved his hand.
Oh, so this Minister of the Ministry of Rites was tricked into getting on board the ship in this way.
Wei Wen and Prince Ding understood what was going on immediately.
Ye Shuo thought about it and said, “Of course, it’s not free. Remember to discuss with your father when you go back and decide what the appropriate price should be for this thing.”
Xing Yucheng: “…”
Sure enough, he knew it.
When Ye Shuo looked over, Xing Yucheng bowed hurriedly: “…Yes.”
Then there is sugar and soap. There is nothing much to say about soap. It is used for cleaning by wealthy families. It is much better than the current pig pancreas soap. When added with various essential oils and flower juices, it has different fragrant smells.
As for white sugar…white sugar can be called a strategic material in modern times, not to mention in ancient times.
Looking at the white thing as fine as sand in front of them, Prince Ding and the others did not understand what it was at first, and they made all kinds of guesses in their minds. It was not until Ye Shuo said it was food that Prince Ding and the others picked up a little and put it into their mouths with doubt.
How big can these tiny things be – huh?
The moment the sugar entered his mouth, the sweet and delicate taste spread across his taste buds. Even Prince Ding had never tasted such pure sweetness.
Unlike honey, the white sugar in front of you is clearer.
Then Ye Shuo took another glass, put some sugar and hot water in it, and handed it to them one by one.
Even a middle-aged man like Prince Ding couldn’t help but savour the taste after tasting it.
“What do you think? Do you think Chen State and Beiting will buy these three things?”
Yes, Ye Shuo planned to use the money from their two families to strengthen the Great Zhou. After feeding his subjects and strengthening his soldiers, he would turn around and attack them.
Especially the trees cut down by the State of Chen, the wood is relatively hard and can be used to build houses.
As for how to transport such heavy timber, this is also a very simple matter. Chen State has many rivers and mountains. I believe that Chen State will be able to solve the problem by then. They can just find a river, let the timber float downstream, and float to the territory of Da Zhou, and then set up obstacles to salvage it. It is not a difficult task.
It would probably take more money to buy trees, so Ye Shuo had already thought about how to use the remaining money. He would simply build more roads. In ancient times, there were no cars, let alone heavy trucks, so the strength of the cement did not need to be too high, just enough.
As long as the roads are repaired, transportation in various places will become convenient, the movement of people will become easier, and it will even stimulate domestic demand, forming a cycle.
As for whether this is fair to the State of Chen and Beiting… In this world, what is truly fair?
Ye Shuo didn’t need to say much, and Prince Ding and the others quickly understood what he meant. They were inevitably silent. Then, they suddenly felt infinite sympathy for the State of Chen and Beiting.
But there is no way, who made my younger brother/Your Majesty born in their Great Zhou?
“The rest of the matter you guys discuss among yourselves, I’m going to find Ding Ning.” Ye Shuo just focused on the key points. As for how to maximise the benefits, let the subordinates discuss it. Otherwise, why keep them?
Not long after he finished speaking, Ye Shuo stood up and walked out.
Prince Ding, Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng were left behind, writing and painting, and they did not leave the Qinzheng Hall until it was dark.
Although Ye Shuo, the superior, gave Xing Yucheng a separate house outside, Xing Yucheng would still return to the old house occasionally, and didn’t the emperor give instructions before?
Xing Yucheng carefully placed the glass on the table, asked the maids and servants at home to take good care of it, and then was called away by his mother.
When Minister Xing came back, as soon as he entered the room, he saw the maids and servants looking at the same cup from time to time. There was nothing they could do, as it was the first time they had seen such a beautiful cup.
When Minister Xing learned that this was a gift from the emperor, his first reaction was, it’s over, his son has accepted things given by the emperor again.

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Willfulness
chapters.content:
In addition to the Shangshu Mansion, the Taifu Mansion also received two things——
A pair of reading glasses and a mercury mirror.
The moment he took the mercury mirror in his hand, the old master was immediately shocked. What a clear reflection!
The old master had only seen bronze mirrors in his life, how could he have seen such a thing? He could not help but burst into surprise.
However, before the old man could take a closer look, Madam Zhen snatched the mirror away and said, “This is what the emperor gave me last time. That one is yours. Go and look at yours.”
Madam Zhen pointed to the remaining pair of reading glasses.
When someone came to the palace today, the young eunuch said that one of the things was for her. Madam Zhen went forward to check it out and immediately fell in love with it.
“The emperor said that this thing is very fragile and can’t withstand your tossing and turning.”
The old master had no choice but to settle for the next best thing and look at the two transparent objects that looked like crystals on the side.
When the old tutor learned that this thing was called reading glasses and could make originally blurry eyes clear, he was stunned.The old tutor is very old. No matter how well he takes care of himself, all old age diseases will still come to him one after another. His teeth are fine, but his eyes are getting worse day by day.
But this kind of thing has not happened for a day or two. In the past two or three years, the old master has long been accustomed to it. But habits are habits, and who doesn’t want to return to normal?
The only question is, can such a small thing work?
According to the instructions in the letter, the old master fumbled to put the glasses on his nose little by little, and then opened his eyes. He was immediately shocked by the scene in front of him.
Wow, it’s so clear! Next time I read a book, I won’t need someone to read it to me.
The old tutor was already very old, but now he looked at it over and over again, as if he had got some new toy, taking it off and putting it on again. After a while, he felt a little dizzy and dared not move anymore.
Like Xing Yucheng, the old tutor also subconsciously thought that this thing must be very expensive since it was so transparent, so when he went to sleep, he specially found a wooden box to put it in, for fear that it would be bumped.
“If you ask me, the fate between people is really mysterious.” Who could have thought that the prince that her husband most favored died halfway, and her husband resigned from his official position because of this, and later it was the prince that her husband least favored who became the emperor, and he ended up becoming the imperial tutor. Just thinking about it, Madam Zhen felt like she was dreaming.
Who says it isn’t…
The old tutor thought the same thing in the darkness, especially since his own grandson died at the hands of his student.
When you count it all, it’s nothing but a debt of sin.
Thinking of this, the old couple felt a little sad. However, since their daughter didn’t ask them to pursue the matter further, there was really nothing more to say about this matter.
The old tutor and Madam Zhen said no more and fell into a deep sleep.
The next morning, the old tutor thought that the glasses might be useful, so he fastened the silver chain next to the glasses to the glasses, hung them in front of his chest, and then went to court.
The other side.
Ye Shuo followed the sound and came to a hall. According to Xiaoluzi, little Dingning now lived here. This hall was the closest to the Queen Mother Wei’s bedroom. Before, Yao Zhi was busy with government affairs, so it was basically Queen Mother Wei who took care of her and the second master raised her.
The second master is a female relative, and she is the only one in the family. Besides, given her status, it doesn’t matter if she lives in the palace permanently.
The only voices of opposition before have now been suppressed by Yao Zhi.
Even from a distance, Ye Shuo could still hear the sound of his second master and his mother teasing the child.
“Little Dingning, come quickly, come to your grandmother.” Dingning was born under the watchful eyes of Empress Dowager Wei herself. Since her son and daughter-in-law were busy, she had been raising him by her side ever since, so naturally their relationship was special. 𐍂âΝ𝘰βĚＳ
When Ye Shuo got closer, he saw a little child wearing tiger-head shoes, staggering after two adults.
Queen Mother Wei had been unproductive since childhood and had poor physical strength and power. Although she has gotten better in recent years due to running around outside, she is almost fifty years old after all, and she felt tired after playing with Dingning for a while.
The second master was used to this and just asked her to sit aside and rest, while she continued to train the little princess to walk.
The little princess is now over one year old. She is learning to walk and is always wobbly and unsteady. The little princess got anxious and tripped over her left foot. She was about to fall. The second master subconsciously reached out for her hand, but what she didn’t expect was that someone got there first and picked the little princess up from the ground.
The second master was startled at first, then he looked up and saw that it was his disciple’s husband who had come.
Ye Shuo loved playing with children since he was young, and he had already mastered the technique of holding a child to perfection. But now it was different from the others. As soon as little Dingning fell into his arms, Ye Shuo, who remained calm in front of so many people in Beiting, couldn’t control his heart and started beating wildly.
Ye Shuo lived for nearly thirty years in his previous life without having any children, so he subconsciously thought that the so-called blood relationship was just fabricated by outsiders. But now he knows that it was all true.
Ye Shuo had not seen Dingning since she was born. Two months ago, he was in a hurry to go to the war, and he only saw her sleeping. Strictly speaking, today was the first time the father and daughter met.
Ye Shuo seemed calm, and when Xiao Dingning looked over, probably no one knew how nervous he was at the moment. However, if you listened carefully, you could still hear that his voice was a little hoarse than usual.
“Little Dingning, call me daddy.”
Queen Mother Wei seemed to have noticed something. She pulled the beautiful woman to sit down and watched the scene leisurely.
This kid has been living a dissolute life for so many years, and now he has finally met his nemesis. It’s really a changing world, you can’t help but believe it.
Queen Mother Wei couldn’t help but burst out laughing.
“…”
Ye Shuo didn’t bother to look at his mother. All his attention was now on his daughter who looked very nervous.
Little Dingning only felt a flash before his eyes, and then he was picked up by someone.
Although Ye Shuo knew that this was his daughter, the man in front of him was extremely unfamiliar to little Dingning. Subconsciously, she put her two small hands on Ye Shuo’s shoulders and shook her head continuously, looking very resistant.
“Little Dingning, it’s daddy.”
The child was young and could not understand what the adults said, but Ye Shuo’s voice was too nice and his actions were extremely gentle. In addition, the two people closest to her did not object. Gradually, after they became a little familiar with each other, little Dingning stopped struggling.
Ye Shuo grabbed a palm-sized wooden ball from the ground at the right time, and then kept throwing it. After attracting all of Xiao Dingning’s attention, she completely forgot who was holding her.
Queen Mother Wei’s smile stiffened slightly. Not seeing the scene she wanted to see, she suddenly felt it was very boring.
I have forgotten that my son is best at coaxing children.
However, in just one afternoon, Ye Shuo coaxed little Dingning into calling him daddy.
“…Your body is almost recovered.” Looking at the little princess sleeping soundly in Ye Shuo’s arms, Queen Mother Wei couldn’t help but pick up the tea and took a sip leisurely.
“It’s okay. Since I’ve been staying with Azhi every night, I don’t have nightmares all night long like before.” Especially after Yao Zhi drew two Taoist talismans for him, maybe it was a psychological effect, but Ye Shuo slept more soundly.
Looking at her son who was proud of it instead of ashamed, Queen Dowager Wei suddenly didn’t know what to say.
“You, you are so old, and you have no shame.”
Ye Shuo didn’t take it seriously. When the time was almost up, Ye Shuo put Ding Ning in his arms and said, “Ding Ning, sleep at my place tonight.”
After finally seeing his daughter, Ye Shuo just couldn’t let her go.
Queen Mother Wei was just about to say that this was against the rules, but then she saw her son pat his butt and leave.
…Forget it, when did he ever talk about rules?
He took the child away, which saved me a lot of trouble.
“Take me with you tomorrow and let’s go for a walk outside.” Since her son went to the battlefield, the Queen Mother Wei had been worried all day long, unable to eat or sleep at night. She had even kneeled on the cushion in the small Buddhist temple at the back of her palace until it was broken. Now that her son has returned safely, the Queen Mother Wei can finally feel at ease.
After calming down, Queen Dowager Wei’s mind began to waver.
How could the Second Master not know what she was thinking? She agreed without thinking.
In addition to Queen Mother Wei and the others, Yao Zhi was also very tired recently. When Ye Shuo carried Ding Ning back to Chengming Palace, Yao Zhi was still asleep.
Another half an hour later, Yao Zhi woke up slowly. When she walked out, she saw the young man holding his daughter and feeding her.
The meat and liver were mashed into a paste, and the little princess was sitting on the emperor’s lap. This scene was so incredible that all the palace servants, including Xiao Luzi, lowered their heads and dared not look at it a second time.
Little Dingning was still young and could hardly sit still. She would lose her temper from time to time, or look elsewhere or try to grab the dishes and chopsticks on the table. Ye Shuo was not tired of it and scraped the meat paste with a spoon and fed it to her little by little.
If the little princess really went too far, Ye Shuo would pat her hands and tell her not to do that.
Yao Zhi, who was standing by, was amazed and thought that even if it were her, she probably wouldn’t have such good patience.
I thought it was good enough that the young man fed his daughter himself, but I didn’t expect that he would have to sleep with his daughter at night.
Yao Zhi had no objection to this. When he was not around, Yao Zhi would occasionally sleep with her daughter. However, she always felt that he, who grew up in the palace, should not do this.
As if seeing Yao Zhi’s confusion, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but say: “When I was little, I liked the three of us lying on the same bed the most.”
Of course, it would be better if he didn’t sleep in the middle as a child, because… sleeping in the middle is really hot…
Yao Zhi didn’t even know that he had such a wish, but the Queen Mother Wei and the late Emperor… I’m afraid that will never happen.
And what Ye Shuo was talking about was naturally not about his mother and father in this life.
Ye Shuo did not explain. He lifted the quilt and stuffed little Dingning in. When little Dingning came to her senses, she was surrounded by her father and mother.
Little Dingning blinked his eyes, looking confused and dizzy.
As for the historians outside, their pens are almost broken.
The next morning, Ye Shuo packed up and prepared to go to court, but unexpectedly, Ding Ning had a premonition of something and grabbed his sleeve.
“Dad…Daddy…”
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel jealous. It had only been one day, and her daughter was already so clingy to him. What a heartless little thing.
Then Yao Zhi spoke up: “You go to court first, I will take care of my daughter–“
However, before Yao Zhi could finish her words, she saw the young man easily pick up her daughter.
After reacting, Yao Zhi’s eyes suddenly widened: “You don’t think…Oh my God, He Xiang and the others will go crazy, right?”
“What’s the big deal?” Ye Shuo didn’t care.
Yao Zhi could see that he really didn’t care.
Just like that, Yao Zhi watched the two of them, one big and one small, leave. She suddenly felt that He Xiang and the others were quite pitiful for encountering such a willful emperor…

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Giving Birth
chapters.content:
“It’s time to go to court, it’s time to go to court.”
The sky above was still dark. A group of ministers saw from afar the emperor wearing a black dragon robe and accompanied by palace servants and eunuchs walking towards them. He Xiang and others did not react for a long time. After asking each other about the time, everyone felt relieved.
His Majesty finally arrived on time for once!
However, when Ye Shuo gradually approached, He Xiang and the others found something wrong.
There is a red patch on His Majesty’s shoulder, as if he is carrying something.
The reason why Ye Shuo got up so early today was not for any other reason. It was because it was difficult for little Dingning to get a full night’s sleep, so she woke up before the morning. When she woke up, Ye Shuo woke up too. If Emperor Jingwen saw this scene, he would not know whether he would be pleased or scold him.
In the past, Emperor Jingwen scolded him so much but he refused to get up early. Now that the little princess came, he also got up without any complaints. This treatment is too different.
As Ye Shuo walked, he pointed at the surrounding scenery and explained something to Ding Ning: “That is the Taihe Gate, that is the Four Corners Pavilion, and this, this is the Xuanzheng Hall…”
However, the child was too young to understand at all.
It was early spring now, and the air was chilly. Feeling a cold wind blowing, Ye Shuo subconsciously pulled his cloak closer and wrapped up little Dingning completely, leaving only his two round eyes exposed.When Prime Minister He and his men came closer, they realised that the person lying on the emperor’s shoulder was not an object at all, but a little princess who was less than one and a half years old.
His Majesty actually brought the little princess to the morning court!
Under everyone’s dull gaze, Ye Shuo slowly sat on the dragon throne at the top, untied his cloak, and in front of everyone, placed the little princess on his lap.
“Dingning, be good. Daddy has some important things to do. You can play with the toys for a while first.”
Xiao Luzi at the side handed something to her at the right time, so Ye Shuo handed her the little gadget made by the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
The Seventh Prince curled his lips, feeling that his younger brother seemed to be radiating a kind of brilliance at the moment.
Several censors opened their mouths to scold without thinking, but before they could open their mouths, Prime Minister He spoke up.
In Prime Minister He’s opinion, since the emperor would not listen anyway, it would be useless to say anything and it would be a waste of everyone’s time. Since the emperor might quit at any time, it would be better to say something useful.
Let’s solve the important things first, and deal with the remaining trivial matters when we have time.
“Your Majesty, the batch of seeds that the Ministry of Works accidentally discovered has now all been shipped to Liangzhou, Bingzhou, Xianghu and other places.” When the Ministry of Works first said that they had found a kind of rice that could achieve two harvests a year, Prime Minister He and his men were a little bit unconvinced. After all, they had only heard of one-season rice in the past, but had they ever heard of rice that could be harvested twice a year?
Not to mention that this rice is early maturing and drought-resistant, so there is no need to worry too much even in a drought year, as it only takes more than fifty days from planting to harvesting.
If this is true, the grain output of the entire Great Zhou will definitely more than double, and the population lost due to the plague a few years ago will be able to be made up.
Prime Minister He did not have much hope at first, but the plots of land specially approved by the emperor for the Ministry of Works did eventually produce some results. Prime Minister He and his colleagues went to see them in person, and they could not help but believe it, so the change of crop production went exceptionally smoothly.
When the plague first broke out, many merchants smelled an opportunity and began to frantically hoard food, preparing to raise prices when the time was right. It can be said that the silver sent to various places this time stabilised the price of food in a timely manner.
With subsidies from the imperial court, it would be fine if the people could have normal food supplies, but if this is still not possible, then a few typical cases will be picked out and killed.
Be polite first and then use force, be appropriately lenient, but once that group of people cross that line, don’t blame the court for being rude.
Combined with the fact that we can still buy grain from Beiting and the State of Chen, it is only a matter of time before we can completely recover from the plague.
Prince Ding suddenly felt that his brother’s behaviour was really beneficial. You see, once any problem arose, he was afraid that the emperor’s reckless actions would make the situation worse. Prime Minister He and the others racked their brains, and he came up with an idea. Ȑα₦𝘰ᛒЕṦ
Things must not only be done well, but also done beautifully. Otherwise, the emperor might kill people if he disagrees with something, regardless of the consequences. How scary that is.
Also, since his younger brother ascended the throne, Prime Minister He and others were no longer as slow in attending court as before. Prince Ding still remembered that during the reigns of Jingwen and Taicheng, a group of civil and military ministers were used to making witty remarks, and they would take a long time to get to the point of a matter, or they would argue for a whole hour over some nonsense.
If the emperor and the sixth son did not listen, the censors on the side would join in and start scolding and mocking them, saying that the emperor was incompetent and intolerant. However, for the sake of their own reputation after their death, Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng usually endured it.
But his younger brother was not like that. He was like, “Write whatever you want, write however you want, let the neighbouring Beiting and Chen State see who is more embarrassed.” What is he afraid of as an emperor who was forced to take the throne? Since he was forced to come here, he shouldn’t ask for so much, right? He was lucky to be alive.
Prince Ding dared to swear that this was what his brother said personally, not a single word changed. However, what made Prince Ding feel magical was that after he said these words, He Xiang and others seemed to have opened up their Ren and Du meridians, and suddenly they became open-minded.
Yes, now that things have come to this, why do we still ask for so much?
From the moment the regent ascended the throne, the future of the Great Zhou Dynasty can only rely on this group of old officials.
From then on, He Xiang and his group of old men no longer procrastinated during court sessions, knowing that the emperor had little patience and would adjourn the court session when he said so, regardless of any rules. He Xiang and his group gradually got used to getting straight to the point and talking about business.
How could the censors waste such precious time on trivial matters that were insignificant and did not matter? He Xiang and his friends began to divide the time with the censors.
The morning court sessions that took a full hour to complete during the Jingwen and Taicheng dynasties could be completed in less than half an hour for Ye Shuo.
After the court session, He Xiang and the others had to go to the Qinzheng Hall to help Ye Shuo deal with various matters reported by other states.
Ye Shuo was not in charge of everything, but he would conduct random checks from time to time. There was basically no pattern in his checks, he just did it at will, and he would just look at whichever he touched. In this situation, He Xiang and the others would not be able to fool them even if they wanted to.
They deserved to be unlucky to have such a bad-tempered and difficult emperor.
“Thank you ministers for your hard work. I will take Dingning outside first.” Ye Shuo had just seen his daughter and he was so excited that he really didn’t want to let go of her.
He left in a very elegant manner, leaving He Xiang and others to work hard to deal with government affairs.
The old tutor took a deep breath, then took out his reading glasses and put them on his nose.
He Xiang and others then noticed that the old tutor seemed a little different today.
He Xiang and others found it strange. After all, they had never seen the Taifu wearing any ornaments before, so they asked about it.
Later, they learned that this thing is called reading glasses, which can help people with blurred vision see clearly again.
Seeing their surprised faces, the old master was stunned, and then blurted out: “Why? You don’t have any?”
The moment the words fell, He Xiang and others fell silent at the same time.
Yes, they are all about the same age, why does this old man have it but they don’t?
The old tutor is not a fool after all, and he quickly understood it. He couldn’t help but wonder, what’s wrong with the emperor? This partiality is too obvious.
The old tutor complained in his heart, but his expression was completely different. Anyone with normal hearing could tell that he was in a good mood at the moment.
Not only is it good, its tail is almost reaching the sky!
He Xiang and others felt more and more uncomfortable.
Although the Grand Tutor and Lord Cen were the two formal teachers of the Emperor, they taught him a lot in those days! And haven’t they worked hard enough these days?
Given His Majesty’s temperament, he would not be so stingy, unless… he did it on purpose.
Could it be that they had done something to offend the emperor? He Xiang and the others thought about it carefully, and then they suddenly realised that it could not be the last time when the queen was the regent? Except for the Grand Tutor, almost all of them expressed their opposition.
Yes, that’s definitely the case!
However, what He Xiang and the others didn’t know was that Ye Shuo didn’t give it on purpose, it was mainly because Zou Wu hadn’t made it yet, right?
When Ye Shuo came back with Xiao Dingning after flying the kite, he clearly felt that the atmosphere in the Qinzheng Hall was not right, and it seemed that He Xiang and the others were holding a grudge.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at the old tutor beside him. While everyone was not paying attention, Ye Shuo lowered his voice and asked, “Teacher, what’s going on? What happened just now?”
The old tutor coughed lightly and said, “It’s all because of these glasses. I thought the emperor had given them to everyone.”
Unexpectedly, he was only given one.
The old tutor thought about it and felt that he was his teacher after all, so he couldn’t help but remind him: “Your Majesty should make up for it as soon as possible, and don’t let the old ministers like Prime Minister He feel disappointed.”
“You treat me well, I know that, but don’t be partial to me in the future.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Ye Shuo wanted to say that he really didn’t mean that, but seeing that the old tutor seemed very happy, Ye Shuo didn’t have the heart to speak.
On the third day, He Xiang and others finally received rewards from the palace. In addition to reading glasses, there were also some small glass gadgets.
Ye Shuo thought about it and finally explained that it was not that he did not give it on purpose, but that this thing was made a few hours ago, and it was sent to them as soon as it was made?
He Xiang heard that these glass products were priced very high, and they also asked around and found that the emperor did not send any more to the Taifu Mansion, which means that except for the reading glasses, the Taifu did not have the other items. He Xiang and others felt more balanced.
Ye Shuo and several old ministers spent a whole half month getting along well with each other.
Prince Ding, who was standing by, watched helplessly, feeling quite a bit of pity in his heart. It took only a few things to bribe He Xiang and his men. Why hadn’t they been so easy to talk to before?
Isn’t it true? If someone who has always been nice to you suddenly becomes not nice to you one day, most people’s first reaction would be to feel unhappy. But if someone who has always been bad to you suddenly gives you something very expensive one day, ordinary people will inevitably subconsciously feel flattered.
However, feelings are feelings, and they still have to do what they are supposed to do.
At the morning court session that day, after Ye Shuo had dealt with everything that needed to be dealt with, he was about to signal Xiao Luzi next to him to leave the court session, but he saw He Xiang walk out from the queue, bowed and said, “Your Majesty has been married to the Empress for seven years, but now you only have one princess. I hope Your Majesty will take in more women, expand the harem, and have more children for the Great Zhou.”
He Xiang and others had this idea in mind since the day Ye Shuo went to war.
Following Prime Minister He’s words, the other civil and military ministers, including Prince Su and Prince Jin, also knelt down and begged.
“I also ask Your Majesty to have mercy on the people of the world and help the Great Zhou to have many descendants.”
Even though he knew this day would come, Ye Shuo still paused slightly while holding the little princess.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: Thank You
chapters.content:
Almost at the same time when He Xiang and the others spoke, Ye Shuo saw that the situation was not right and directly asked Xiao Luzi to carry the little princess away.
To be honest, regarding the matter of having children, Ye Shuo really cannot have just one. The reason is that the infant mortality rate in ancient times was too high.
As a father, Ye Shuo naturally doesn’t want anything to happen to his daughter. If possible, he only hopes that Dingning can live a peaceful and worry-free life.
But if he were the emperor, Ye Shuo could not place all his bets on Dingning alone, otherwise he would be playing with the lives of so many people in the Great Zhou.
But let’s forget about taking a concubine. Even if Ye Shuo wants to have a child, he will only have it with his queen, so the final decision on this matter will still have to be made by Yao Zhi.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo’s face became furious, and then, as expected, he once again refuted the civil and military officials under him.
“When I first ascended the throne, what did you promise me? You said that I would not have to worry about anything after I ascended the throne and that I only had to live a good life. What about now? What are you doing?”
“Now you are even trying to control whether I have children or not. In the future, I’m afraid you will even control what I eat and drink!”
“And they said that no matter what happens, I will make the final decision. It turns out that they are just empty talk!”
That being said, the situation has changed. Human desires will never be satisfied. At the time, they said so only as a temporary measure. Now that they have obtained it, don’t they want more?What’s more, they didn’t expect that the emperor could really bear it!
There are very few men in the world who only love one person, but they were unlucky and could encounter such a thing, especially in the royal family. It was simply unbelievable.
However, He Xiang and others were determined this time and had no regard for their reputation. They just kept forcing Ye Shuo to expand his harem. Several censors even kowtowed their heads loudly.
“Your Majesty, please put the country first!”
The final result was naturally that Ye Shuo walked away in anger.
Fortunately, He Xiang and others did not expect to succeed in one go. After dealing with Ye Shuo for a long time, their ability to withstand pressure has been constantly improving.
After a long silence, He Xiang stood up very naturally with the help of his students.
After Ye Shuo returned to Chengming Hall angrily, the anger on his face disappeared after a while.
After a while, Yao Zhi also came in.
There was such a big commotion in the court, so it was natural for Yao Zhi to hear about it. So, the couple sat on the stools facing each other and started staring at each other. ɽ
But after all, it wasn’t Ye Shuo who was suffering, so how could he say it? It wasn’t a good idea to just stand there like this, and with the nervousness in the young man’s eyes, Yao Zhi finally softened her heart and sighed, “If it is for the Great Zhou, I don’t mind.”
It is indeed difficult for women to give birth, but there is no other way, because the Great Zhou needs children now. They have an emperor and a queen, so they really have to consider the country’s perspective.
“I have practised martial arts since I was young, and I am in good health. Giving birth to Dingning was relatively easy, and the child was not too tiring. Dingning was born in less than two hours. But I am afraid that if I give this response, there will be no future for me.”
There is no problem with having one or two more children. Yao Zhi doesn’t care whether it is a boy or a girl. If she hadn’t sat in this position, she thinks Dingning would be enough.
But looking at the expressions of He Xiang and the others, she must give birth to a prince. One may not be enough. According to what He Xiang and the others thought, the more princes the better, so that she would have more choices in the future.
Although she was reluctant to separate from him, Yao Zhi had her own bottom line after all.
However, the moment she finished speaking, the young man also spoke: “What a coincidence, I thought so too.”
Sometimes Ye Shuo is not completely unwilling to give in, and he is not so ruthless in doing things. But at the same time, he can retreat, but he cannot retreat without a bottom line.
So far, Ye Shuo has done his best for the Great Zhou Dynasty, and he has no regrets about what he has done. As the emperor, Ye Shuo has an unshirkable responsibility for the Great Zhou Dynasty. It doesn’t matter if he makes painstaking efforts or simply fights for it, but the premise is that he must be a human being. If he can’t be a human being, then he certainly won’t be willing to do it.
As a couple for many years, Yao Zhi naturally believed what he said. So since both of them had left room for manoeuvre, what they needed to discuss now was how many children they should have next.
In the past, Ye Shuo was just a prince. Since he was a prince, couldn’t he do whatever he wanted? It didn’t matter if they only had one child, so the two of them had not had children until now.
But now, time is running out. In seven years, the two of them have only given birth to one child, Dingning. So, the task in the next few years may be a bit heavy.
Yao Zhi studied medicine, and after a rough estimate, she stretched out three fingers.
“Three at most, no more.”
Considering her physical condition and her age, if the pressure is increased further, I’m afraid she won’t be able to bear it.
When Ye Shuo heard this answer, his heart couldn’t help but feel sad. Although Yao Zhi kept saying that she would not sacrifice herself to the end, this number was already very close to her limit.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and subtracted another one within this range.
“Two, no matter if it’s a boy or a girl, just two.” Theoretically, the ratio of boys to girls is close to 5:5, and there is a 50% chance of giving birth to the prince that He Xiang and his men want. If this doesn’t work, then it can only be said that He Xiang and his men are not destined to have this.
“It’s my fault. I made things difficult for you. From the beginning to the end, you were the one who gave in to me.”
If Ye Shuo had known from the beginning that things would turn out like this, he didn’t know whether he would still choose to drag her into the vortex of the palace.
But in fact, for Yao Zhi, there was nothing reluctant about meeting Ye Shuo and giving birth to a child for him.
Think about it, this is the Queen, the most precious position in the world. How many people have tried their best to get close to the Emperor, let alone be the mother of the country.
Although Yao Zhi had not originally intended to do this, to be honest, she did not suffer any loss at all.
This young man of mine is good in every way except that he is too soft-hearted.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but sigh: “Even for ordinary families, having three, four, or even five or six children is just the norm. You really don’t need to feel so guilty.”
Others are others. After all, Ye Shuo has experienced the influence of modern society. In his opinion, having so many children is not a good thing.
Ye Shuo thought of something and asked hurriedly, “By the way, has the loss from giving birth to Ding Ning been made up? Should we ask the imperial physician to take a look? If not, it won’t work.”
Upon hearing this, Yao Zhi suddenly understood why he had been wandering outside for so long and refused to come in.
Originally Yao Zhi was still a little resistant, but now she has more thoughts in her mind.
I rarely behaved like this before I met him, but now I’m afraid I have learned bad things from him.
Noticing that it was still daylight outside, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but cough lightly: “Don’t worry, you will almost make up for it in less than three months after the confinement.”
At that time in Liangzhou, even if Ye Shuo was not there, Yao Zhi would not lose out, not to mention that with such a large amount of money, what kind of medicinal materials could not be found? With the masters watching beside her, it would be difficult for Yao Zhi not to make up for it even if she wanted to.
Only then did Ye Shuo feel relieved.
However, when facing He Xiang and the others, Ye Shuo still couldn’t give in so easily. Although he and Yao Zhi had discussed it, he couldn’t agree to it so quickly.
There are some rules that cannot be broken. Once they are broken, there will never be peace again.
Therefore, in the next few days, Ye Shuo was still furious. Whenever someone mentioned this, Ye Shuo would walk away on the spot, even Prince Su and Prince Jin were no exception.
Prince Su and Prince Jin knew from the beginning that this kid was born with a bad temper, but they still suffered a lot from him.
The emperor refused to agree, so they couldn’t force him to have sex, could they? There was really no other way. After the morning court session, Prime Minister He and his men refused to leave, and knelt on the ground in front of Ye Shuo.
Looking at the white-haired, trembling He Xiang and others, although Ye Shuo couldn’t bear it, he finally hardened his heart and left.
“Kneel if you want to. Even if you die here, I will never agree to your request!”
Prince Jin and Prince Su couldn’t help but look at Prince Ding who was standing beside them. Prince Ding had the best relationship with the emperor right now. If he went to persuade them, there might still be a glimmer of hope.
Prince Ding felt frightened by the gazes of the two old princes and secretly groaned in his heart. To be honest, ever since he knew his younger brother’s ability, Prince Ding really didn’t dare to stroke the tiger’s whiskers.
As for the Fifth Prince, the Seventh Prince, and the Eighth Prince, what does this have to do with them? First of all, this younger brother will never listen to them. Secondly, they don’t have the guts to do this. They are not stupid to offend people for no benefit.
As for the Zhen Mansion… the old Zhen noticed that something was wrong early on, so he simply claimed to be sick and refused to see guests. Even if others asked for something, they couldn’t ask him for it.
Then there is Wei Wen. Now that Wei Wen has witnessed the loyalty of his little cousin, he really doesn’t want to cause trouble.
Prince Jin and Prince Su had no choice but to go to Queen Dowager Wei.
Queen Mother Wei now has such a good relationship with the beautiful woman, and Yao Zhi is the only disciple of the beautiful woman. How can Queen Mother Wei have the nerve to say this?
Even if she considers Da Zhou, Queen Mother Wei secretly mentions it to her son. In the end, Ye Shuo said, “Mother, my son just wants to live a simple life in this life. I really don’t want to go through so many calculations that there will be no one to accompany him in the end.” Queen Mother Wei was also speechless.
Then, what shocked He Xiang and the others was that even the old tutor did not stand on their side.
In this way, Ye Shuo and the court officials became entangled for several days. He Xiang and his old bones were about to fall apart from kneeling, and several censors wanted to bang their heads against the pillars on the spot. Only then did Ye Shuo give in.
“I can have a baby if you want, but I will only have one baby with the queen, and I will only have one baby. As for taking a concubine, don’t even think about it!”
Although the conditions given by the emperor were extremely harsh, at this moment, He Xiang and others still felt as if they heard the sound of nature.
Fearing that he would go back on his word, He Xiang and the others were almost in tears.
“Just one.” It would be nice to have just one.
When they thought that this was the first time the emperor had given in, He Xiang and the others were so excited that their hands were shaking: “Your Highness, thank you for your grace!”

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Pregnancy
chapters.content:
If He Xiang and the others knew that I was expecting two children, I wonder what would happen…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh.
Ye Shuo can understand what He Xiang and the others are thinking, but understanding is one thing and everyone has their own stance, right?
There was nothing wrong with the health of both Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi. Since they had decided to have a second child, naturally the result came soon.
Ever since Yao Zhi started preparing for pregnancy, Ye Shuo has always kept Dingning by his side. Although the girl is still young and knows nothing, Ye Shuo still feels a little guilty. After all, as a member of the family, things should always be discussed with her if she wants to have younger brothers and sisters. However, Dingning now has no power to choose at all. This is the difference between modern times and ancient times.
No matter how unconventional Yao Zhi was, it was still difficult for her to escape from the ancient background, and she couldn’t help feeling surprised by this.
“This is the first time I’ve heard such words.” In the past, Yao Zhi had never heard of asking children for their opinions on whether to have a child or not.
“It has always been the father who leads the son, the king who leads the minister, and the husband who leads the wife.” Yao Zhi had heard this many times and had long been accustomed to it, but being accustomed does not mean agreeing with it.
If the secular world is right, then Yao Zhi should be considered a traitor.
Looking at her husband who was also a betrayer, Yao Zhi hurriedly said, “It’s fine if you only say this to me, but don’t be so stupid as to tell He Xiang and the others.”If He Xiang and the others knew about this, there would probably be a huge uproar. This would be equivalent to one person being against the entire secular world. Even if Da Zhou still needed him right now, he would surely die.
In this era, there is no room for such shocking remarks. The Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues are merely means to maintain rule and should not even be mentioned. Especially since he is the emperor, it is even more damnable for him to harbour such thoughts in his mind.
“I understand.” Ye Shuo is not stupid. He only said this in front of Yao Zhi. How could he dare to say a word to others? It’s not like he wants to die quickly. Even he has to compromise when it’s time to compromise.
You can’t become fat in one bite. Some things can only wait to change slowly in the future. Of course, they may never change.
But it is still too early for him to worry about these things now. He has just started, and he should not be too ambitious. He should just take it step by step.
Nowadays, people still can’t get enough food to eat. It’s nonsense to talk about other things under such circumstances.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo quickly put the matter behind him.
While Yao Zhi was preparing for pregnancy, and the follow-up to the plague was already on track, Ye Shuo didn’t have much to do. Seeing that he had plenty of time, he began to study the technology of cutting grafting in the palace.
Over the years, the farm tools of the Great Zhou have been modified many times by Zou Wu and his team. In addition, the iron smelting technology has improved a lot, and the farm tools are more practical than before. Some basic fertilisers, such as crop pest control, have also been popularised. However, despite this, the increase in grain production is extremely limited. Overall, it has only increased by 30% to 40%. In the eyes of others, it is already quite good. All those who participated in it were given official titles during the Jingwen and Taicheng dynasties, but for Ye Shuo, it is far from enough.
I hope the rice seeds from Lucheng can bring new changes this time.
These things sound simple, but due to underdeveloped information and inconvenient transportation, it takes a lot of time to achieve them. And these alone are enough to keep Zou Wu and his team busy. There are still too few technical talents in the Great Zhou. Recently, Zou Wu and her students are busy with seed selection and breeding, striving to cultivate stronger and higher-yielding rice varieties. Ye Shuo thought about it and came up with the idea of ​​grafting.
Just like that, everyone in the entire palace knew that the emperor had asked the Ministry of Internal Affairs for various kinds of plants. Then, the palace people watched helplessly as the emperor cut and chopped these vegetable and fruit seedlings.
Plant grafting is generally divided into the following categories: approach grafting, cleft grafting, plug grafting and machine grafting.
Among them, machine implementation is the first choice, with fast speed, high productivity, and a success rate of about 90%. Although this machine is simple to make, Ye Shuo also knows how to draw the blueprint, but unfortunately, the Great Zhou has neither oil nor electricity at present, and the cost is too high. Even if it is built, the people cannot afford it.
So we can only settle for the second best and choose to do it ourselves. Although the success rate is a bit lower and it is probably not as standardised as that produced by machines, practice makes perfect, especially for ordinary people who make a living on the fields. After a long time, they will become proficient and may be able to compete with machines.
Although Ye Shuo knows a lot of theoretical knowledge, he is quite weak in practice.
The batch of seedlings fell into his hands and he killed them within two days. Fortunately, they were not very valuable and he could afford to consume them in large quantities. For this reason, Ye Shuo specially designed a greenhouse with glass on the top to absorb sunlight and allow some seeds to germinate faster. ℝ
When Ye Shuo first proposed the idea, the censors wanted to object, but were quickly stopped by He Xiang and others.
In He Xiang’s opinion, it was just a glass house and it was not a major construction project. Besides, the emperor had just promised them to have another child with the queen. At this critical juncture, He Xiang and others naturally would not want to displease him.
Just build it, it’s not a big deal.
To be honest, His Majesty is already extremely frugal, so it is not so difficult to understand that he has such a little hobby. As long as he does not learn bad things and do something that is harmful to the world and shakes the foundation of the Great Zhou Dynasty, it will be fine.
Then, Yao Zhi and Prince Ding watched helplessly as the man in front of them cut off the watermelon seedlings and placed them on the gourd vines, placed the white eggplant seedlings on the thorny eggplants, cut off the white radish seedlings and placed the cabbage seedlings…
Yao Zhi and Prince Ding had never seen such a thing before and they were stunned as they watched from the side.
“Can this…really survive?” Prince Ding imagined cutting off a cow’s head and attaching it to a horse’s head. He couldn’t help but shudder. If this really happened, what would it be like?
However, Ye Shuo nodded: “It should be fine.”
After a few days of practice, Ye Shuo has gradually mastered the tricks, and there should be no problem today. It’s just that the local crops in the Great Zhou are too few, even if you add Beiting and Chen State, they are not as abundant as in later generations.
Outside of Beiting there is Xijiang, and outside of Xijiang there are overseas. When the time comes, we must find a way to enrich the various crops of the Great Zhou.
As soon as he finished speaking, Ye Shuo stood up. Xiao Luzi saw this and quickly asked someone to bring a basin of water over. Ye Shuo took the opportunity to wash the mud off his hands and arms.
“If these seedlings don’t die, we’ll have watermelons to eat after a while.”
It would have been better to use pumpkin vines, but pumpkin is also a product of America, so it may not be available in the short term, so we can only use gourd vines as a substitute.
If this really works, the output of these fruits and vegetables can at least double, or maybe more than double, and it can also provide strong protection against diseases and pests. In short… any improvement is better than nothing.
Prince Ding curled his lips, not knowing whether he should believe such nonsense. Among the few people, only Wei Wen was used to it. After all, he had seen too many miraculous things about his little cousin, and a mere transplant… shouldn’t be a big problem.
In addition to cuttings and grafting, it is also time to start scientific breeding, especially since the Great Zhou had just conquered the seven cities of Beiting. Beiting has few arable lands, and most of the livestock are cattle and sheep. Even if it cannot be achieved like modern times, a little more improvement can also result in more meat production.
Thinking of the seven cities that had just been conquered, Ye Shuo thought for a while, then took the initiative to pick up the charcoal pencil and paper.
When it was evening, Yao Zhi first played with little Dingning outside the hall for a while. When she came in again, she saw the young man writing and drawing there, and she didn’t know what he was doing.
When Yao Zhi approached, she found that he had already written a very thick stack. Seeing that the young man did not seem to have any intention of covering up, Yao Zhi hesitated for a moment, then picked up the top page – Postpartum Care for Sow Pigs.
Yao Zhi was stunned: “What, what is this?”
Ye Shuo glanced at it casually and said, “Oh, that. I thought since I have written about cows and sheep, I might as well write about pigs, ducks, chickens, etc.”
Yao Zhi continued to scroll down, and various titles came into view.
“On the feeding of lambs, basic diseases of cattle and sheep and their prevention, tips for laying eggs by hens, hatching eggs, veterinary medicine…”
There were not only words but also pictures on the various pages. Ye Shuo knew that not many people read books, so he planned to distribute them to the prefects under him, and then ask the prefects to notify others to send people to various villages every once in a while to provide professional training.
Yao Zhi wanted to laugh at first, after all, these titles were really funny, but as she read on, Yao Zhi was stunned.
The above content does not seem to be nonsense, and it is written in a very easy-to-understand manner. Anyone who can read a few words can almost understand it.
Just in the process of hatching chicks, Yao Zhi saw more than one trick.
Yao Zhi gradually discovered that her husband seemed to know a lot of things, especially now. Looking at the young man lighting the lamp and working at his desk, after a while, Yao Zhi was stunned again. It was not until Xiao Luzi came back with Xiao Dingning that Yao Zhi suddenly came back to her senses.
Then, there was the matter of the Minister of Works being in mourning, and the court officials were arguing about who should be promoted to this position.
It is true that the Ministry of Works was a low-income government office in the past, but its status has gradually improved since Ye Shuo took the throne, so it is no longer considered an unpopular department now.
Ye Shuo listened everywhere but never heard of Zou Wu’s name. No matter how capable she was or how many contributions she had made over the years, based on her status as a woman, being an official of the sixth or seventh rank was already the limit for her. Even so, Emperor Jingwen had shown her special favour. However, her peers, or even later students, who were as capable as Zou Wu, had already achieved more than that.
Therefore, Ye Shuo promoted Zou Wu to the position of fourth-rank assistant minister of the Ministry of Works without much hesitation.
At this moment, He Xiang and others were immediately furious.
But soon, more important news overwhelmed this matter.
It has been just over two months since a group of officials knelt outside the Xuan Zheng Hall. With the spring ploughing, the news that the Empress was pregnant again spread throughout the court and the country.
In an instant, He Xiang and others were like they were injected with chicken blood and almost jumped up in public.
“God bless, Emperor Jingwen bless!” No matter what, it must be a prince!
Seeing them so excited, Ye Shuo on the side said nothing. After leaving the court, he went to find his wife and daughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 306: Production
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo found Yao Zhi in the Imperial Garden. At that time, Yao Zhi was taking a walk in the Imperial Garden. She was alone with a dozen palace maids and looked very relaxed.
Now Ye Shuo’s harem is extremely clean, with only her as the only one. Yao Zhi does not need to compete with others for favors or scheme against others. Queen Mother Wei almost never makes things difficult for her for Xiao Shuo’s sake, and her sister-in-law adores her even more. Under such circumstances, although Yao Zhi’s life is a bit boring, it is still relatively peaceful.
“Well, what does the doctor say?”
Yao Zhi had just sat down in the pavilion when she heard a familiar voice shortly afterwards.
Yao Zhi was even willing to perform some formalities at first, but as time went by, she slowly got used to it. She didn’t even turn around, and directly said, “The imperial physician said that the pulse is very stable, and it has been more than a month now.”
As a doctor, Yao Zhi had guessed something was wrong when her period was delayed for a few days this month. After taking her pulse, she found that it was true. She called the imperial physician over just to confirm it.
“That’s good. That’s good.”
Ye Shuo let out a long breath, then thought of something and asked hurriedly, “Is there anything you want to eat? Anything you want to play with?”
Ye Shuo didn’t accompany her when she gave birth last time, so he had to make up for it this time.
Yao Zhi shook her head: “I don’t want anything to eat or play with right now.”“Then…are you feeling unwell anywhere?” The last time they met in Dingning, Yao Zhi didn’t react much before he left, but this kind of thing is different every time, so Ye Shuo couldn’t help but ask a few more questions.
“No, no, nothing at all.”
This is what Yao Zhi said at the time, but when it came to the third month, Yao Zhi found that what she said before was too early. In fact, it was not that there was no reaction at all, but that the reaction was rather strange, so Yao Zhi did not realise it until much later.
She seemed to like the smell of Ye Shuo’s body. The reason was that Ye Shuo discovered that Yao Zhi seemed to like being close to him recently.
In the past, he was the one who got close to Yao Zhi, but in recent times, it was obvious that Yao Zhi liked to be close to him more.
At first, Ye Shuo thought that he had accidentally gotten something on his body, so he asked Xiao Luzi, who was standing next to him, but Xiao Luzi quickly denied it.
That’s strange.
Yao Zhi also felt it was strange, but she just… couldn’t help it.
“Why do you have to restrict yourself like this? It’s not like we don’t have the conditions.” Ye Shuo opened his arms, looking ready to be picked.
Yao Zhi hesitated for a long time, but finally came forward and inhaled it to her heart’s content. During the whole process, the historian outside was the only one who scratched his head. 𝐫
The historian could be considered an old man in the palace, he had been there during the time of Emperor Jingwen, and among them Emperor Taicheng had a few concubines. Unexpectedly, the most troublesome one turned out to be the current Emperor Yongxi.
Although Emperor Yongxi only had one empress, it was still daytime!
The historian racked his brains every day, trying to find ways to beautify the two’s behaviour. After a long while, the historian finally wrote: “In the first year of Yongxi, on April 18th, at 3:30 pm, the empress felt unwell during her pregnancy, her face was pale and she was short of breath. The emperor felt very sorry for her…”
Looking at the spirited Queen, the historian curled the corner of his mouth. He only needed to ensure that the emperor’s sexual intercourse time was accurate and that the royal bloodline was pure. Everything else… shouldn’t matter, right?
Even if this matter reached the ears of He Xiang and others, they did not say anything. After all, at this time, such little facts were really insignificant. The most important thing was whether the Queen’s baby was a prince.
In the past, He Xiang and others never cared about this, but now they are like those women on the street, sneaking around and asking all kinds of questions.
The imperial physicians of the Imperial Medical Bureau have been in great demand recently. The adults who usually don’t take them seriously have begun to send things to their houses, just for one thing – to know whether the baby in the Empress’ belly is a boy or a girl.
The imperial physician was a little confused. Even if they knew, what would it matter? Could they still change the situation? Moreover… His Majesty had noticed him earlier than Prime Minister He and the others.
The imperial doctors thought very clearly that no matter how capable the emperor was, he was someone they needed to rely on, and no matter how capable people like Prime Minister He were, they had nothing to do with them.
After thinking about it, the imperial doctors began to laugh with these people.
The attitudes of the imperial doctors were so ambiguous that when it came time to treat the case, He Xiang and the others didn’t know what the result would be. He Xiang and the others were anxious and angry, but they could do nothing about it.
In the blink of an eye, another three months passed. In July, Yao Zhi, who was nearly seven months pregnant, had a belly that was relatively small. The thin summer clothes made it a little visible. If it was covered up a little in winter, it would probably not even be noticeable.
People in ancient times generally believed that it was better for their children to be white and plump, but Ye Shuo knew that if the child was too big, it would not only be too much of a burden on the mother, but it would also easily cause a difficult delivery. Therefore, Ye Shuo had been trying to find ways to help Yao Zhi control her weight.
Too much nutrition is not good, and malnutrition is not good either. Fortunately, Ye Shuo had read some books on nutrition in his previous life, so he has quite a bit of experience in matching daily food.
“You even understand this?” The first time, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but feel surprised. Combined with what he had written before, an idea flashed through Yao Zhi’s mind.
Then, she saw the young man pointing at his head, leaning close to her ear, and whispering, “I’ll tell you in secret, I can remember anything I’ve seen once.”
really……
Yao Zhi first thought of the old master and the others, and then thought of herself. She couldn’t help but push him: “So you were lying to me before.”
All that weakness and pity is fake.
Even though Yao Zhi had vaguely felt that something was wrong, she couldn’t help but fall for his tricks every time.
Ye Shuo blinked, and seeing that the situation was not good, he hurriedly changed the subject: “By the way, the watermelons I planted are ready, let’s have some together?”
As Ye Shuo spoke, he took out a big round watermelon from behind him.
Compared to the watermelons Yao Zhi had seen before, the one in front of her was indeed big and round, with a few water droplets on it, as if it had just been washed.
“I didn’t ask anyone to take it to the well to cool it down because I was afraid it would irritate your stomach. I’m sorry for putting you in such a pity. You can eat as much as you want in the future.” Ye Shuo took out two silver spoons. Xiao Luzi, who was standing by, was very smart and skillfully drove the palace servants out. He took Princess Dingning to play in the yard.
Just when Yao Zhi was puzzled, she saw the young man split the watermelon in half with one palm strike. If Yao Zhi remembered correctly, this should be the old Duke of Zhen’s signature skill. If the old Duke of Zhen knew that the young man used the palm method he taught to split the watermelon and eat it, I wonder how he would feel…
Completely unaware of what his wife was thinking, Ye Shuo wiped the juice off half of it and stuffed it into her hand.
“Don’t worry, there’s no one here, just eat without worry.”
Even when Yao Zhi was travelling around the world, she seldom ate so wildly, but eating it one spoonful at a time like this really had a unique taste.
Especially after the evening when the sun sets, the temperature outside gradually decreases, and it is not as hot as in the afternoon. It is even more comfortable to eat watermelon, watch my daughter play, and chat with the young man.
When Queen Dowager Wei arrived, she happened to see the palace maid walking out of Chengming Hall with her head lowered. She was puzzled at first, but when she got closer, she saw her son and daughter-in-law, regardless of their status and image, sitting shoulder to shoulder on the stone steps outside Chengming Hall.
While they were eating bites of watermelon, they would occasionally pick up the hydrangea that had rolled down to their feet and throw it to little Dingning. Queen Mother Wei was stunned as she watched. In a trance, she seemed to understand what “a simple life” meant.
Jianjian on the side was hesitating whether to speak or not, but was stopped by Queen Dowager Wei.
“Don’t make a sound.”
“Let’s go.”
Queen Mother Wei really couldn’t bear to ruin this scene, but in fact, she felt quite uncomfortable in her heart, as if… she was not quite balanced.
Little bastard!!
But Queen Mother Wei also knew that her mentality was wrong. Just when she was struggling, she unexpectedly saw half a watermelon appear in front of her.
It turned out that the beautiful woman had noticed something early in the morning. While Queen Dowager Wei was not paying attention, she ordered the palace servants to go to the greenhouse and get one, and then she also split it into two halves with one palm.
Queen Mother Wei suddenly felt embarrassed.
“Ah, I’m not…”
Queen Mother Wei subconsciously wanted to defend herself, but was defeated by the beautiful woman’s eyes that seemed to see through everything.
“Well, I really didn’t feel comfortable just now…”
About half a quarter of an hour later, Queen Mother Wei also experienced the joy of eating watermelon directly with a spoon, but she was not so bold. She just closed the door and chattered incessantly with the woman in front of her.
The beautiful woman listened quietly, occasionally agreeing with her. After a while, Queen Mother Wei calmed down.
Jianjian on the side
So, what qualifications does the Queen Mother have to say about the Emperor’s brother?
Jianjian left in disappointment. Walking on the streets of Shangjing, Jianjian suddenly felt so lonely, like a dog.
Jian Jian was filled with anger and when Wu Yi came with the secret guards who were in training to hand over official business to the Censor General, Jian Jian forced him to sit down without saying a word.
Soon, Wu Yi was holding a watermelon in one hand and a spoon in the other, and even his mask revealed a hint of confusion.
The days passed one by one, and when the autumn harvest came, Ye Shuo couldn’t help feeling surprised when he saw the grain quantities reported from various places.
Champa rice is indeed worthy of being the ancient divine rice from the previous life. Although Champa is not called Champa in this life and has been renamed Lucheng, the essence of this rice has not changed. It turns out that the sentence “enough food every year” in the ancient books from the previous life was not false.
Although this kind of rice alone cannot completely solve the famine problem in ancient times, it is enough for now.
In addition to rice, it is time to spread methods such as cuttings and grafting to the people.
Then, when the early rice in the south was harvested and the mid-season rice matured, Yao Zhi’s due date was almost here, and in a blink of an eye, her delivery day arrived.
When hearing the news, almost everyone became nervous. He Xiang and others thought about it and for the first time in their lives, they came to the small Buddhist temples set up in their respective homes.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Results
chapters.content:
God bless, the Queen must give birth to a prince this time…
He Xiang and his friends had never been so pious in their lives as they were today.
The other side.
Yao Zhi started the attack at night. Ye Shuo was sleeping at that time. Hearing the movement on the other side of the bed, Ye Shuo was awakened almost instantly.
Ever since Yao Zhi entered the third trimester of pregnancy, he had been living in fear all day, preparing for such a day. After a brief panic, Ye Shuo quickly calmed down.
The more time passed, the calmer Ye Shuo became.
Yao Zhi’s water had just broken, and the formal delivery process had not yet begun. Ye Shuo first entrusted the sleeping Ding Ning to Xiao Luzi. Then Ye Shuo, without bothering to get dressed and only wearing underwear, carried Yao Zhi to the side hall, to the delivery room that had been prepared long ago.
“Someone, come here!”
“Hurry up and call the midwife and the imperial physician over!”
Following Ye Shuo’s roar, the palace guards on duty outside reacted and quickly became busy.Xiao Luzi had been trained in these things early on, so following Ye Shuo’s orders, everyone in Chengming Hall followed suit.
Ye Shuo seemed to be in good order, until the sweat on his chin fell onto Yao Zhi’s face, and then Yao Zhi realised that he was not as calm as he looked.
“Don’t be nervous, there’s no need to be nervous. I’m fine, right? Besides, I’ve checked it myself before, and I didn’t find any problems. Just let me go. Within two hours, I will definitely–“
However, before Yao Zhi could finish her words, Ye Shuo covered her mouth.
“No! Please, don’t set a flag!”
Before Yao Zhi could figure out what he meant by “Flag”, Ye Shuo was quickly driven out by the beautiful woman who had hurried over.
Although they are husband and wife now, the young man’s presence here is really a nuisance.
Ye Shuo wanted to say something else when he saw Yao Zhi shaking her head at him. Ye Shuo took a deep breath, fed Yao Zhi a bowl of ginseng soup, and left. �
The beautiful woman was stunned to see how skillful his movements were.
As if she had seen what her master was thinking, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but say, “He has been taking care of Dingning these days.”
The beautiful woman felt that her disciple had a pretty good life. Although she had many setbacks in her childhood, she finally found someone worthy of spending her life with.
So…
“You must hold on for a while, and don’t let your daughter and your man end up being taken away by someone else.”
The beautiful woman spoke in a voice that only the two of them could hear.
When Yao Zhi thought about the handsome young man calling others ‘sister’ as if they were her, acting like a spoiled child to others, or sharing the same watermelon with others, being affectionate and loving, and sleeping on the same bed with others, her teeth almost broke.
“He dares!”
“That’s right.” No matter what, it’s always better to have a goal.
Although the beautiful woman’s medical skills were not very sophisticated, they were sufficient to deal with general situations. With her around, ordinary evil spirits could not get close to Yao Zhi, so Yao Zhi just had to focus on giving birth.
The other side.
Ye Shuo was outside, listening to the noise inside and feeling quite uneasy. Seeing this, Queen Mother Wei first tried to comfort him, but seeing that it seemed to be of no use, she let him go.
In the middle of the night, little Dingning woke up and found herself in Xiao Luzi’s arms. As for her parents, they were nowhere to be seen. The little girl couldn’t help feeling a little panicked.
“Daddy, Mommy…”
