Hearing the child crying, Ye Shuo took a deep breath, then stood up and returned to the main hall, and took his daughter from Xiao Luzi.
Children are naturally sensitive, and they seemed to have sensed something, and subconsciously grabbed Ye Shuo’s sleeve.
Although Dingning is only two years old now, the child is smart and can basically understand what adults say, so Ye Shuo did not perfunctorily comfort him, saying: “Dingning, be good, mother is giving birth to a younger brother or sister, and they will be out soon, Dingning, don’t cry, okay?”
Although Ye Shuo was not very reasonable with other people, he was very reliable and safe in the eyes of the little princess. After a while, the little princess really stopped making trouble.
“Dingning will accompany Daddy…together…”
The child finished speaking haltingly, and Ye Shuo couldn’t help but kiss her head gently: “Okay, Dingning stay with Daddy.”
After a while, Empress Dowager He also arrived.
Ever since Queen Mother Wei came to power, Empress Dowager He has not appeared in public often. After all, according to seniority, Queen Mother Wei should have been her mother-in-law. As a result, now both of them are empress dowagers, and it is inevitable that it would be a bit awkward for them to meet.
It was not until later that Empress Dowager He gradually realised that Empress Dowager Wei and the Emperor really did not care about these things, and she gradually relaxed a lot.
Sure enough, the late emperor was not wrong at that time. He was indeed a generous person.
Empress Dowager He first bowed to Ye Shuo, and Ye Shuo hurriedly returned the greeting: “Sister-in-law, please sit down first. I am sorry for being rude, but I hope you will not mind.”
The young man couldn’t hide the anxiety on his face, so how could Empress Dowager He blame him?
“Your Majesty, you are too kind.”
Soon, Empress Dowager He sat next to Empress Dowager Wei.
Empress Dowager He had seen scenes like this before at the Empress’s coronation ceremony. After so many years, the two of them have not changed at all. It’s really enviable…
At the same time, Concubine Sun believed that she was not qualified, and she did not dare to show off with her current status, so she just knelt in front of the Buddhist shrine in her palace and prayed devoutly, hoping that the gods and Buddhas would bless the Queen and allow her to give birth safely.
Whether it’s His Majesty or Her Majesty the Queen, good people should have a peaceful life.
About half a cup of tea later, when Princess Zhaocheng walked in and saw this scene, she did not say a word, but knelt down quietly with her mother, clasped her hands together, and was extremely pious.
“May the Buddha bless my aunt and keep her healthy and successful.”
Then, the mother and daughter bent down and kowtowed almost at the same time.
Time passed little by little, accompanied by all kinds of noises in the delivery room. Ye Shuo finally couldn’t bear it any longer and found all the relics left by Emperor Jingwen, including the string of Buddhist beads that he always held in his hand.
Normally, Ye Shuo doesn’t believe in ghosts and gods, but in this situation, it doesn’t hurt to believe in them.
About an hour later, a loud cry was heard from the delivery room. The tense feeling in Ye Shuo’s heart suddenly relaxed. His legs went weak and he almost fell down.
Fortunately, Xiao Luzi, who was standing nearby, took action in time and no one noticed.
“Dingning, be good and wait for daddy with Eunuch Lu first.”
Ye Shuo handed the child to Xiao Luzi, and then he walked straight forward: “How is Ah Zhi?”
Ye Shuo couldn’t see anything through the gap in the screen, and subconsciously wanted to step in. However, almost instantly, he was stopped by the beautiful woman.
“Azhi is fine. She just fell asleep due to exhaustion. Don’t worry. But the midwife is cleaning her body now, so it’s not convenient for you to go in.”
Seeing that he had become so impulsive without her noticing, the beautiful woman waved her hands hurriedly.
Ye Shuo: “What’s the big deal?” The beautiful woman was taken aback by the surprise. When she reacted, she still shook her head: “You don’t care, why don’t you ask Zhi’er if she cares?”
“Well… okay.” Ye Shuo could only take two steps back unwillingly.
Then Ye Shuo remembered to ask about the child: “Where is the child? Is the child okay?”
As they were talking, Empress Dowager Wei and Empress Dowager He came forward, supported by their maids.
“The child is also very healthy. Although the child is a little smaller than an ordinary baby, the child is fine.” This can be seen from the loud cry just now. He is really full of energy.
“Just what?” Ye Shuo’s heart, which had originally been relieved, was once again hanging high.
“Is something missing? An arm missing? Or are legs and feet not working?” In an instant, countless bad thoughts popped up in Ye Shuo’s mind.
“It doesn’t matter, it doesn’t matter. I am the emperor. Even if my child has a disability, it doesn’t matter. I can still take care of him for his whole life and ensure that he will have no worries for the rest of his life.”
After being interrupted again and again, the beautiful woman’s emotions, which had just been building up, suddenly became shattered.
“…No.”
“It’s just that it’s a princess again this time.”
Although the beautiful woman was in the palace, after so much time had passed, she had already known that Prime Minister He and the others were eagerly looking forward to a prince. However, she was afraid that they would be disappointed this time.
The beautiful woman didn’t think that being a princess was a bad thing, but she couldn’t help but worry about her disciple’s future.
The moment the words fell, the expressions of Empress Dowager Wei and Empress Dowager He became complicated. The complexity of Empress Dowager Wei was that if she didn’t have a son, her son would suffer more, and the complexity of Empress Dowager He was that at this moment she couldn’t tell what she was feeling in her heart.
From the perspective of a loser, she wanted the emperor and the empress to be good to her, because if they were good, she would become better as well. But if they were really too good, Empress Dowager He would feel a little uncomfortable when she thought of her husband and son.
However, when he looked at Ye Shuo again, he stretched out his hand hastily: “Where’s the child? Bring her here for me to see.”
Soon, the small swaddling clothes fell into his arms. Seeing this scene, Dingning stopped. Due to the natural possessiveness of a cub, little Dingning, who was only two years old, instinctively felt angry.
It was as if her territory was being invaded. After all, who wouldn’t want to monopolise the love of her parents?
Seeing that her eldest daughter’s expression seemed a little bad, Ye Shuo hurriedly took one in each hand. Fortunately, he was strong and didn’t care about the weight.
Although Dingning was still unhappy about this, at least the noise wasn’t as severe.
Ye Shuo thought for a moment and said, “Since the second child is also a princess, then let’s call her An Ning.”
Changle and peace are also excellent meanings.
She didn’t know if it was an illusion, but the beautiful woman always felt that he had prepared this in advance.
But no matter whether it was prepared in advance or not, after seeing that he was still very happy, the beautiful woman gradually put her mind at ease.
Ye Shuo was happy, but He Xiang and the others were not so happy.
As soon as the hour of Mao passed, news spread from the palace.
“How is it, is it a boy or a girl?” Looking at the person who came, He Xiang asked this question almost tremblingly.
Seeing this, the prime minister’s eldest son, who was also pulled over to pray to the gods, couldn’t help but start recalling whether his mother had ever mentioned when she was alive whether his father was as nervous as this when his mother gave birth to him?
I always feel that it should be… not.
Although the old prime minister looked at him like this, the established facts could not be changed by a small pawn like him, so when Prime Minister He was about to burst into tears, the visitor said:
“To reply to the Prime Minister, it is… a princess.”
Finished…
He Xiang’s eyes went dark.
Then, the entire Prime Minister’s Mansion was filled with the eldest son’s anxious cries: “Father, father, what’s wrong with you? Someone, please call the imperial physician!”
When it was time to go to court, half of the leaders claimed to be sick and did not come. The seats of Prince Jin and Prince Su were also vacant. I guess they must have been in a lot of trouble after the ups and downs of their moods all night.
Ye Shuo pretended not to see it and finished the morning court very quietly. In just a quarter of an hour, everything was dealt with. As soon as Ye Shuo announced the adjournment of the court, he returned to Chengming Hall.
At that time, Yao Zhi had already woken up. Looking at the little baby at the head of her bed, her heart was filled with joy.
Although the second daughter was not as fair as the eldest daughter, her facial features should be pretty good.
“An Ning…huh?”
When Ye Shuo brought Xiao Dingning over, this was the scene he saw.
This scene was happiness for Ye Shuo, but not necessarily for Xiao Dingning.
Little Dingning ran to his mother, tilted his head to look at her, and called out sweetly, “Mom.”
Yao Zhi’s attention was subconsciously drawn to this talking person.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Wait, something seems wrong…
But…it must be my illusion…
At this moment, the little baby seemed to sense something, opened his eyes, and started crying loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Solution
chapters.content:
When the younger one started crying, Yao Zhi would definitely take care of the younger one first. The younger one had just been born, and the slightest setback would cost her life. Ye Shuo hurried to comfort the older one.
Ye Shuo didn’t expect this scene.
In fact, when you think about it, how could everything go as smoothly as he imagined?
But the days still passed by in this situation.
Even if Prime Minister He cannot accept such a result, he still has to accept it. Otherwise, wouldn’t it be irresponsible? Moreover, with the emperor’s temper, the chances of him giving in in the future are slim.
Just like that, while He Xiang and the others were disheartened and Ye Shuo treated everything as normal, the mid-season and late-season rice were harvested one after another.
To be honest, the taste of Lucheng rice is not good, it is even very rough, but it can keep people alive, so it is a good thing for them.
It seems that two harvests a year is still a conservative estimate. The southernmost part can even achieve three harvests a year, and the data reported by the people below are also very encouraging. If this trend continues, the population lost by the Great Zhou Dynasty will not only be made up, but may even increase. After all, in the previous life of the Song Dynasty, Emperor Zhenzong relied on this thing to make the population of the entire Song Dynasty exceed 100 million.
Look at how many people there are in Da Zhou. It’s only 30 million, and there will be more to come in the future.
When An Ning was half a year old, the second year of Yongxi had just passed. In the following one or two months, the household registration statistics were reported one after another.Not many new babies were born this year, which is very reasonable if you think about it carefully. After such a great disaster last year, it would be very difficult to recover in a short time. Just wait another one or two years, and everything will be fine.
Then there is the issue of the sales of glass products, white wine, sugar and soap.
Glass products were very popular among the nobles of the two countries, as was white sugar. The nobles of the two countries had never seen something so clean and sweet, and they did not know how to make it for the time being, so this gave the Great Zhou a lot of room to raise the price, and naturally made a fortune in the end.
As for soap and liquor, as expected, liquor was more circulated in Beiting. Moreover, another winter had passed. More than 70% of the liquor was bought by Beiting, and the remaining 30% was shared with Chen State.
As for soap, there was little water in Beiting and the water resources were not abundant. There was not even enough for people to drink, let alone wash hands and take a bath, so few people used it. On the contrary, Chen State had many mountains and abundant water, so most of the people bought it.
What Ye Shuo also didn’t expect was that the purchasing power of their Great Zhou was not much different. The common people below became hungry and homeless because of a plague, and although the noble families, officials and wealthy businessmen above also died, they were not seriously injured, and most of their assets were successfully retained.
Looking at the numbers in front of him, Ye Shuo was both surprised and happy, so he allocated a part of it for the infrastructure construction of the Great Zhou, the most important of which was roads, and another part was allocated to the army.
Now that the food in the Great Zhou Dynasty is finally sufficient, although it cannot be fully implemented, at least they can train a special forces team like the one in Lucheng.
When An Ning was one year old, the city of Shangjing had changed a lot.
Although the bluestone roads of the past were good, they were not as smooth as cement roads, not to mention dirt roads.
Ye Shuo specially picked a sunny day and took Yao Zhi and Ding Ning out of the imperial city. An Ning was still young and not easy to take out. The training of the secret guards happened to come to an end temporarily, and Wu Yi had nothing to do recently, so Ye Shuo handed An Ning over to him.
Ignoring Wu Yi’s eyes that were about to collapse, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi took their men on horseback and left Shangjing.
As for his mother, she had just gone out a few days ago. Ye Shuo asked about it, and Queen Mother Wei said she will not go.
Ye Shuo vaguely felt that his mother’s mentality had changed. Compared to him and his sibling, his mother now seemed more willing to be close to the beautiful woman.
That’s right. He had to go to court and handle government affairs every day, so there was not much time left for his mother. The same went for Jianjian. She spent the whole day in the Supervisory Office. I heard that she was busy catching spies recently and was working very hard. She didn’t have much time to accompany Queen Mother Wei.
“Luckily I have you, otherwise I would really be bored to death in this palace.” All of them are ungrateful little wolves. Now that they have grown up and have strong wings, they want to fly away. They are all unreliable. Only the sisters I met later can have a say.
After Ye Shuo left, Queen Mother Wei couldn’t help but complain.
At first, the beautiful woman was only doing it out of consideration for her apprentice. Plus, the Queen Mother Wei couldn’t carry anything, so she couldn’t help but take care of her a little. After a long time, the beautiful woman got used to it.
Although Queen Mother Wei was a little pampered, she was not annoying.
Therefore, the beautiful woman did not hesitate, and bowed, saying: “As long as the Queen Mother does not mind, I am willing to stay by her side forever.”
The other side.
He Xiang and his companions soon received the news that Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had left Beijing together. Their first reaction was: they had to catch up with them quickly, otherwise they would run away again.
Later, I heard that Princess An Ning was still in the palace, and I breathed a sigh of relief.
Even if they wanted to flee, they wouldn’t abandon the little princess, right? The emperor and empress wouldn’t… do that, right?
Finally, to be on the safe side, Prince Su and Prince Jin sent people to the city gate of Shangjing City to inquire more and count the time to see when the two would return.
At the same time, Ye Shuo had heard that the road between Shangjing and the nearest city had been repaired two months ago, and he came here today specifically to see it.
After all, Shangjing is the capital of the Zhou Dynasty. No matter what policy is implemented, Shangjing and its surrounding areas will be the first to respond.
The muddy roads in the countryside may not be able to realise such a luxurious wish for the time being, but the official road must be repaired first.
Along the way, Ye Shuo saw not only cement roads, but also farmlands on both sides. Most of them were arable land, with occasional small amounts of vegetables interspersed among them. Each one was growing lushly. Judging from the leaves, the number of pests and diseases should have been reduced a lot compared to before.
Although vegetables nowadays cannot be transported over long distances, people can still eat them themselves, or sell them at nearby markets, which can also replace part of the grain.
From a distance, Ye Shuo could still hear the discussions of the old farmers around him.
“You know what, this method taught by the emperor really works.”
When the soldiers first arrived, the people refused to agree to have their own vegetable seedlings cut. But as long as they targeted one family and let the others see the effect, the vegetables would grow well, and word would spread from one person to ten people, and from ten to a hundred people. Without much effort, the rest of the people would take action spontaneously.
Although those who came to provide guidance suffered a lot during this process, there were also benefits. When more than half of the people adopted this method, the court would issue rewards, so it was quite worthwhile.
Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi ran all the way until another city appeared in front of them. Noticing that there were almost no traces left along the way, Ye Shuo knew that the strength of the cement was good, and the people under him did not dare to mess around.
Ye Shuo was unable to inspect the remaining states personally, so he could only rely on Yao Zhi.
“Don’t worry, I will pass the news to my friends in the martial arts world when the time comes.” Yao Zhi’s friends in the martial arts world may change, but there will always be loyal and righteous people in the martial arts world.
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, and as if making a promise, he said: “When we accomplish great things in the future, they will also be heroes.”
Ye Shuo didn’t know whether this could be considered a civilian inspection team. In any case, the presence of these people from the martial arts world made Ye Shuo’s ears and eyes much more sensitive than those of an ordinary emperor.
Not long after, a lot of news came from the public.
In the blink of an eye, another year passed. In the third year of Yongxi, as Ye Shuo had expected, after the plague, the population of the Great Zhou suddenly skyrocketed with sufficient food. In just one year, according to household registration, the Great Zhou had almost two million more people.
In the fourth year of Yongxi, Ye Shuo’s third daughter, Yongning, was born. At this moment, He Xiang and the others were not just looking unhappy, they were almost in despair.
In the spring of the fourth year of Yongxi, after the two-and-a-half-year-old Second Princess An Ning fluently recited the Thousand Character Classic, Lord Cen discovered that the usually lazy First Princess suddenly became a different person. She was now willing to listen to what he had never listened to before.
“Teacher, I was reckless and ignorant before. I hope you can forgive me.”
Looking at the well-behaved little princess in front of him, Lord Cen’s eyes almost popped out.
Not to mention Lord Cen, when Ye Shuo returned and saw his eldest daughter bending over the desk, practising calligraphy diligently, he was also stunned.
Yongning is too young to be seen, and Anning hasn’t started school yet so it doesn’t count. Ye Shuo thought that the eldest daughter would be the one who looks most like him, but…it doesn’t seem to be the case…
In the autumn of the fourth year of Yongxi, one morning at court, General Wei, who was far away at the border, sent a message:
“Re
“Your Majesty, seven days ago, an earthquake occurred in the Kingdom of Chen, which caused a landslide. According to the information sent by the spies, the impact was widespread.”
A few days later, General Xu and General Fang at the border also sent news that Beiting had experienced a drought this year and the harvest seemed to be not very good. Although they would not starve to death, they would definitely not have enough to eat.
Now the situation has changed and it is finally their turn.
Thinking back on the changes that had taken place in the Great Zhou over the past four or nearly five years, Ye Shuo felt that the time was about right.
But if he wants to take advantage of the opportunity to send troops, he may need to resolve one thing.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at He Xiang and others.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Abandoned
chapters.content:
“What do you think, Prime Minister?” Ye Shuo asked.
Prime Minister He thought for a moment and said, “Your Majesty, this is a good opportunity for the Great Zhou. Perhaps we can also follow the example of the State of Chen.”
It has always been like this between the State of Chen, Beiting and the Great Zhou. Once someone is in trouble, the others will attack in groups like sharks smelling blood and share the trouble, so it can’t be considered taking advantage of someone’s misfortune.
Although the Great Zhou has completely gotten rid of the sequelae of the plague and temporarily does not have to worry about food, who would complain about having too much silver?
Ye Shuo was very surprised when he heard the first half of the sentence. He did not expect that He Xiang, who is so old, still has such ambitions. But after waiting for a long time without hearing the next part, Ye Shuo was stunned.
That’s it… That’s it?
Seeing that Prime Minister He really had no intention of continuing, Ye Shuo looked around and saw that Shang Shu Ling and the others were in the same mood. Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, and without saying anything, he announced the adjournment of the court.
After arriving at the Qinzheng Palace, Wei Wen immediately spoke up: “This is a good opportunity.”
Wei Wen knows him best among almost everyone, not only his character, but also his abilities.
Prince Ding was stunned at first, then he immediately reacted: “No way, so fast?”Prince Ding blurted out: “Although His Majesty has been making preparations, but, but isn’t this too sudden?”
Even Prince Ding, who already knew the inside story, was like this, let alone Prime Minister He and the others.
No matter what time it is, it is always difficult for people to overcome that hurdle and step out of their comfort zone, even if he is the prime minister or a prince.
Even Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think, why not just leave it at that? After all, he has done quite well so far. Why must he set such high standards and work so hard?
Didn’t he fail to achieve the goal of unification even though he was as wise as his father? Some things can be dealt with in a makeshift way. After all, life is pretty stable now, isn’t it?
Now that he was the emperor and at the pinnacle of power, he could not enjoy absolute freedom, but he was relatively free. There was really no need to make any more trouble.
Another thing is that the more you do, the more mistakes you make. As long as you don’t do it, you won’t make mistakes. If you win, it’s fine. But if you lose by mistake, why bother yourself with trouble?
However, in just a second, Ye Shuo woke up.
What else? Let these three countries continue to be entangled in this way for generations? How many people will die?
To be honest, Ye Shuo was not a very noble person, and was even a little selfish. Like most people, he also coveted enjoyment. But… Ye Shuo also wanted to let the people of the Great Zhou and future generations see that the so-called great unification was not just a crazy talk.
Slowly exhaling, Ye Shuo looked at Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng beside him and said, “You two, hurry up and make a report.”
As for the content of the report, it is naturally an analysis of the combat power of the current Great Zhou, Chen State and Beiting.
Ye Shuo is not a reckless person, and he still lets the data speak for itself.
Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng followed him for a long time and gradually got used to the words that came out of his mouth from time to time that they didn’t quite understand. After a long time, they could almost understand what he meant.
“I understand. I will prepare it immediately.”
Several countries have some understanding of each other, such as the number of troops and their general situation. Especially the generals who lead the troops know them very well. Even if the comparison is not too detailed, there is generally no problem.
About three days later, Xing Yucheng and Wei Wen listed them one by one in a way that He Xiang and others could understand.
On the left is Chen State, and on the right is Great Zhou. In addition to the home advantage, Great Zhou is basically in an advantageous position in terms of the number of troops, food, and military pay. In addition, Chen State has just experienced such a big earthquake. If it doesn’t send troops now, when will it? �
On paper, Great Zhou has a great chance of winning.
Prime Minister He didn’t react at all at first, because he could not imagine that the emperor in front of him, whom they had supported with their own hands, would be so bold.
It was simply unimaginable to annex the State of Chen and unify the world.
Throughout history, no one had ever been able to do it, so he certainly couldn’t do it either.
He Xiang refused without a second thought: “Your Majesty, I am sorry that I cannot obey your order.”
He Xiang is not going to cooperate.
He Xiang even thought that the emperor in front of him was crazy. After just a few days of peace, he was going to start a war again. In this way, where would he put the people?
Ye Shuo made this decision just to avoid bloodshed in the future.
He also didn’t want the people to shed blood, but if there was no bloodshed now, more blood would be shed in the future.
Although it was not the same group of people who enjoyed the fruits of victory, he was the emperor, and he was destined to disappoint some people and then help more people.
It is difficult to have the best of both worlds. The way of being a king is to make choices.
Similarly, in order to make up for it, Ye Shuo will still stand with those people this time and will never back down.
“I have ordered people to clearly list all the conditions. If there are any omissions, Prime Minister He can just bring them up and we can discuss them then. But…if there are no omissions, why would the old Prime Minister object?”
Prime Minister He could not help but take another look at the report in his hand. To be honest, Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng were worthy of being the emperor’s close ministers. Although Prime Minister He was not optimistic about Ye Shuo, he had nothing to say about Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng. Their abilities were obvious to all. The report they jointly compiled was also very detailed and clear. Prime Minister He had nothing to complain about.
But if you disagree, you disagree. Why do you need so many reasons?
“Your Majesty, allow me to ask you a question. Are you absolutely sure? Otherwise, you are gambling with the entire Great Zhou!”
“Once the army is trapped in the territory of Chen, there will be no power to fight back. What will Your Majesty do then?”
“What the old prime minister said is really far-fetched and unreasonable.”
Ye Shuo was not shaken when he heard this. Instead, he sneered and said, “The old Prime Minister is so much older than me, how could he not know that there is no such thing as absolute certainty in this world.”
How can you say that you can definitely do anything? When it comes to the court and the country, no matter how obvious the advantages are, there is always a bit of gambling.
Any decision made by any country is made by analysing the pros and cons, looking at the advantages, and then experimenting and exploring little by little. If you really wait for the day when you will definitely succeed, then that day will never come, and things will become even worse.
“What the old prime minister said may seem reasonable, but it is actually totally untenable. It might be better to just admit that you are afraid.”
Fear is human nature. As long as he is a human being, no matter what position he is in, there will always be things that make him afraid. This is normal.
But if you still refuse to admit it at this point, then there will be a problem.
Ye Shuo’s words hit the nail on the head and touched He Xiang’s mind, and He Xiang’s expression changed.
“What does your Majesty mean? Does he think that I am old? Or maybe in your Majesty’s mind, I am just a timid and cowardly person from the beginning.” Prime Minister He still remembered the last time the two countries joined forces.
Ye Shuo had not expected that this old man would use this trick on him. As they were discussing, he realized that he could not win the argument with reason, so he actually started to talk about human feelings.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t buy it, and his thoughts wouldn’t be disturbed so easily.
“I have no such intention. I just want to take this opportunity to tell you that if you feel that there is something that Wei Qing and Xing Qing said that is not perfect, just point it out directly. Not only will I not blame you, but I will reward those who make up for the omissions.”
“If failures outweigh successes, I won’t say anything. If I insist on doing it, it will be my fault, I admit it. But if successes outweigh failures, and I lose the opportunity because of your fears, I’m afraid… I will never accept it.”
Ye Shuo dared to fight because he had data to support him. He Xiang and the others wanted to persuade him not to fight. Okay, just show them the evidence. Ye Shuo would definitely not ignore the facts and drag others to death.
Ye Shuo had even excluded himself. He knew that He Xiang was full of doubts about him. Plus, he was the one who instigated this matter, so he deliberately did not include himself in it. But despite this, Da Zhou still had a much greater chance of winning.
Of course… this is the principle, but how to do it is another matter.
It has nothing to do with the data. It is a conflict between radicals like Ye Shuo and conservatives like He Xiang. From the very beginning, the two have different personalities, so what they think and the decisions they make are naturally different.
No matter what, even if all the evidence was laid out before him, He Xiang still refused to give in. And if He Xiang and Shang Shu Ling refused to cooperate, what Ye Shuo wanted to do would not be accomplished no matter what.
With this in mind, Prime Minister He and the Minister of the Chancellery did not say much, but simply said, “We are incompetent and old, weak and weak, and we are not as young and strong as Your Majesty. We are really powerless and cannot stand this torture.”
The subtext is: If you have the ability, go do it yourself.
In the minds of He Xiang and others, just like the parents of many people, they believe that their ideas are right. No matter what they do, they feel that they are doing it for the good of Da Zhou.
To be honest, although He Xiang and his men have worked hard over the years, they actually don’t think highly of the Yongxi Emperor in front of them. To put it bluntly, without these old ministers, what kind of emperor would he be?
Ye Shuo did it deliberately before, but a sword has two edges, and no method is always effective. Now… this trick has come to an end.
From the reign of Emperor Jingwen to the present, it is obvious that although people like He Xiang are capable, they are more inclined to maintain the status quo and all they seek is stability.
It is not a bad thing to proceed step by step, but the current Great Zhou needs to be more radical.
The development after the plague depends on them. Facts have proved that Prime Minister He and others have done a good job. Now that the Great Zhou has recovered so steadily and quickly, several old ministers have made great contributions. There is nothing much to say, but things in the world have always changed. Different situations require different things to be considered.
Ye Shuo is now thirty years old. After twenty years of study, Zou Wu and others are now qualified to take over. Over the years, many new people have come to the court, both openly and secretly. Little by little, they have gradually spread throughout the court.
One has to admit that old ministers like He Xiang are very powerful and capable, and they have taught these former young talents very well, so actually… it is time for He Xiang and others to leave.
Killing the donkey after it has done its job…is never groundless.
Looking at the several old men in front of him with white hair like his grandfather, Ye Shuo’s eyes suddenly became clear again.
“If Prime Minister He and the others really don’t want to, I won’t force them.”
Ye Shuo looked past them and cast his gaze towards a wider area.
“Among those present, is there anyone willing to follow me?”
He Xiang and the others were startled, then laughed, thinking that the emperor was too naive. Without their nod, who else would dare to step forward except Wei Wen, Xing Yucheng, and the few people of Prince Ding?
However, what He Xiang and the others never expected was that the moment the Emperor Yongxi finished speaking, almost everyone except them took a step forward.
“Your Highness, I swear to follow you till death.”
“Long live the emperor, long live the emperor, long, long live the emperor.”
The sound of the ministers’ oaths was sonorous and powerful, echoing in the Xuanzheng Hall for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Answer
chapters.content:
When, exactly when?
The calmness on his face was gone, He Xiang stared at his disciple not far away, the peace in his heart was suddenly broken, his eyes were full of disbelief, and he even felt like he was dreaming at this moment.
He Xiang thought he had been good to him, so why would he betray him?
He Xiang had seen countless people in his life, but now, at the last moment, he was tricked by his own student. He couldn’t believe that he had such an ungrateful person by his side.
Looking at the Shangshu Ling and others, it is the same, not much better than them.
Let’s not talk about the military generals. He Xiang and others have never had a close connection with General Xu and General Fang. General Xu and General Fang vaguely guessed something, so they naturally wouldn’t say much to He Xiang’s people.
But it was different for other generals. As colleagues, they knew that it would not be easy to defeat Beiting and there must be something fishy going on.
Military generals have fought on the battlefield for many years, and their minds are clearer than ever. Although they don’t want to admit it, the upper limit of a general is basically determined from the beginning. Talent is something that you will always have when you first lead the troops, but if you don’t have it at the beginning, it will be extremely difficult to cultivate it later.
It’s not that Prince Ding is not powerful, but according to their judgement, he is not that powerful.
Rather than believing that Prince Ding had suddenly come to his senses, they would rather believe that a powerful person had emerged out of nowhere.In the past few years, a certain type of military general has already learned almost everything about General Xu and General Fang, both openly and secretly. In addition, the emperor’s maternal grandfather is the famous Duke of Zhen, who can almost be said to be the leader of the military generals at that time. Rounding it off, he is half a family member. Naturally, the military generals will become closer to the Emperor Yongxi in front of them.
Since the reign of Emperor Jingwen, civil officials have in most cases suppressed the military generals. Now, whether the military generals can make a comeback depends on this time. Even for this reason, most of the military generals in the court will most likely support the emperor in fighting this battle.
Only by fighting can they have the possibility of making further progress as military generals.
Ye Shuo used He Xiang and others to promote his own people. Twenty years later, they have reached old age and are no longer as powerful as they were before, so He Xiang and others are actually not that important anymore.
The old men did nothing wrong. In fact, they had dedicated their entire lives to the Great Zhou, and the whole process had exhausted their energy. It was just that they were old and could not keep up with the times, and now they were facing the fate of being eliminated.
Ye Shuo has no intention of doing such a thing, but the premise is that He Xiang and the others must know what’s good for them, otherwise…
So far, Ye Shuo has killed many people and it is impossible for him to turn back.
“good!”
After a long breath, Ye Shuo’s eyes were determined: “Everyone must organise the military affairs. In one month, I will lead the three armies and set off to the border on time.”
The emperor actually wanted to lead the army in person… But because he had done this once before, everyone was only a little surprised and quickly accepted it.
“This subject will obey your majesty’s orders.”
As these voices fell, the faces of He Xiang and others became extremely ugly.
In the end, He Xiang and his companions didn’t even know how they left the Xuan Zheng Hall. They just felt cold all over. He Xiang failed to get on the carriage several times. In the end, He Xiang and his companions were basically helped up by the eunuchs next to them. ṛ
At this moment, He Xiang and the others finally realised that they were at least in their seventies and the oldest was over eighty, and seemed to be old.
The other side.
After everyone left one after another, He Xiang and the disciples of Shang Shu Ling and others, namely Lu Mu and others, hesitated for a long time, but finally stayed.
Although Lu Mu and the others had already made their choice just now, they had been disciples of He Xiang and others for so many years, so how could they not have any feelings for him?
“I hope Your Majesty will be lenient…”
Ye Shuo had already guessed what they were going to say as soon as they stood still. After thinking about it, he did not try to hide it and told them the whole story directly.
“At present, I still remember the hard work of He Xiang and other old ministers, so for the time being… I will not bother with them.”
But if it goes on for a long time, or if He Xiang and others are ignorant and insist on stopping it, and do something behind the scenes, that would be another matter.
No matter what, Ye Shuo will not let He Xiang and others become obstacles to the attack on the State of Chen.
For this battle, Ye Shuo was willing to become an ungrateful person.
Lu Mu and others were no longer the young men they used to be. They immediately understood the emperor’s unspoken intention and felt relieved at first. But when they noticed the emperor’s eyes, their hearts were suddenly lifted up again.
The emperor’s determination is extraordinary.
Seeing that the emperor has made up his mind and will not do it anymore, Lu Mu and the others are worried about nothing else but that if Prime Minister He and the others suddenly rebel at this moment, the emperor is afraid that… he will really execute the old prime minister and the others without hesitation.
Therefore, the best plan for now is to visit the homes of all the elders.
Lu Mu’s eyes narrowed and he said respectfully, “Your Majesty, thank you very much.”
If this matter could be resolved peacefully, it would of course be a good thing, so Ye Shuo did not stop it.
At the same time, Empress Dowager He in the palace also heard about this. She lost control and accidentally broke the teacup in her hand.
However, Empress Dowager He was in no mood to care about these things at this time. She looked at the visitor and asked anxiously, “Is this true?”
“To answer the Empress Dowager, this matter has just spread throughout the palace, how can it be false?” Perhaps the commotion in the previous dynasty was so loud that everyone in the harem who was a little more alert knew about it.
Empress Dowager He had never expected that her grandfather would actually humiliate the Emperor in public. Empress Dowager He knew that her brother-in-law seemed to be out of touch, but he was not someone who could be easily bullied.
Everything will be fine if you don’t provoke him, but once you provoke him, he won’t give anyone face.
Didn’t you see that when the previous emperor was alive, even when he was about to die, he didn’t use his status as an emperor to suppress him?
But fortunately, the current emperor is not a mean and ungrateful person who doesn’t recognize his relatives. Empress Dowager He thought that her grandfather still had some affection in front of the emperor, just like the Duke of Zhen in front of Emperor Jingwen.
The old Duke of Zhen has lived safely to this day, and His Majesty will not take his grandfather’s life now.
Therefore, there is still room for manoeuvre in this matter.
Thinking of this, Empress Dowager He didn’t care about anything else and quickly handed her personal badge to her most trusted maid: “I can’t leave the palace now, you go to our house under the pretext of going out of the palace to buy things, and tell grandfather that no matter what, don’t go against the emperor.”
“Yes, I will go right away.”
The maidservant was in a panic and disappeared in a short while.
Looking at her back, Empress Dowager He couldn’t help but pray, Grandfather, please don’t be confused at this time.
Now that things have come to this, it is futile to struggle any further. No matter what Grandfather thinks, they can only accept their fate at this point.
About a quarter of an hour later, the adults returned to their homes one after another.
After the door of the prime minister’s residence was closed, not long after, all the maids and servants in the main hall were sent away. Then the eldest son of the prime minister’s residence spoke in a very low voice, which was not without anger.
“How can His Majesty be so heartless!”
When my father was needed, he was used almost to death. Now that he is no longer needed, he is kicked away. It is really heartbreaking.
“I’m afraid his majesty has forgotten how much you and the other elders have contributed to the previous plague incident, and how many ideas you have given to Your Majesty over the years.”
He Xiang frowned and said nothing.
Perhaps the shock he received during the court session today was too great, and Prime Minister He was unable to stop his eldest son from making such rebellious remarks.
At this moment, He Xiang still couldn’t figure out what benefits the emperor had promised to Lu Mu and the others that made them join forces to betray their teacher.
From the time Lu Mu appeared in the capital at the age of thirteen, to now when He Xiang single-handedly promoted him to the position of Junior Secretary of Zhan Shi Mansion, a fourth-rank official and a man of real power. He Xiang treated him better than his own sons. He Xiang didn’t understand what he had done to let him down.
Zhen Shifu is the institution responsible for the crown prince. Once a prince is born and is made the crown prince, Lu Mu will be a close minister of the future emperor for sure. His future is naturally limitless, and his future may not be worse than that of the prime minister himself.
And Lu Mu has now surrendered to the emperor. Doesn’t he know that the emperor already has Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng? Once he, the old prime minister, is deposed, the future prime minister position will definitely fall on one of them. How can it be their turn?
He Xiang was both shocked and angry. At this moment, a report suddenly came from the gatehouse.
“Your Excellency, Prime Minister, Lord Lu has arrived and wants to see you.”
Just as Prime Minister He was frowning, the eldest son of the Prime Minister’s Mansion beside him held back and spoke before him.
“Well, after something like this happened, he still dared to come!”
“Shut up.” He Xiang came to his senses subconsciously.
“You are already old, why are you still so irritable?”
Prime Minister He is already eighty years old this year, so you can imagine that the eldest son of the Prime Minister’s Mansion is not young either.
The eldest son’s breath was stuck in his throat, but he didn’t dare to refute. He Xiang took a deep breath and raised his hand towards the housekeeper: “…Forget it, let Lord Lu come in.”
Now that things have come to this, Prime Minister He just wants to die knowing clearly where he has lost compared to the emperor.
How well the people in the prime minister’s mansion treated him in the past, but now they treat him like a nobody.
But Lu Mu did not refute. No matter what, he was indeed unfair to Prime Minister He in this matter.
When Lu Mu walked into the main hall, he was greeted by the eldest son’s angry eyes. Lu Mu felt guilty and lowered his head subconsciously.
When He Xiang saw him again, his emotions were surging, but his face showed no emotion.
After all, Lu Mu had been following He Xiang for twenty years, so how could he not understand him? Therefore, Lu Mu’s first sentence successfully stunned He Xiang.
“I did not betray my teacher. It’s just that from the very beginning, I have been His Majesty’s person.”
Caught off guard, He Xiang’s hands on his knees suddenly tightened.
“So, the others are also…?”
Lu Mu lowered his eyes and said, “Looking around, seven or eight out of ten people in the court follow His Majesty.”
Some of them were appointed by Ye Shuo after he ascended the throne, and some of them were promoted by Prime Minister He at his instruction. Over the years, the number has become quite large.
He Xiang never expected that the answer would be like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: Getting Old
chapters.content:
But Prime Minister He still didn’t understand how the emperor could make so many people listen to him.
The eldest son at the side asked directly: “Lu Mu, who are you fooling? I can’t understand it even more when you say that. This must be a supernatural power.”
Otherwise, it would be inconceivable to achieve such a goal. From the eldest son’s perspective, it is impossible.
However, He Xiang on the side calmed down.
He has been the prime minister for so many years. Although he cannot tell which words are true and which are false 100%, he is almost right.
This seemingly impossible reason is actually closer to the truth.
He Xiang remembered that the reason why he accepted him as his disciple without any hesitation was simply because he was a student taught by Zeng Mohuai, had no foundation in Shangjing, and had a clean background. At that time, He Xiang accepted him because he was easy to control, young and talented.
The only connection between Lu Mu and the others was his experience of studying under Zeng Mohuai…
Wait, Zeng Mohuai?
He Xiang reacted quickly: “Zeng Mohuai is the emperor’s man?”Things have come to this point, and the more He Xiang knows, the better it is.
Lu Mu remained silent and nodded.
He Xiang was stunned: “How could it be… How could it be…”
“I remember clearly that Zeng Mohuai is not the kind of person who plays with power, so how could he get involved in court affairs?” If Zeng Mohuai really had this intention, he would not have resigned when Emperor Jingwen treated him with such generous gifts.
Unless there is another reason.
It had been several decades since the incident, and He Xiang could hardly remember it clearly. But now that it was suddenly brought up, he could barely recall something after thinking about it carefully.
“If we were to say what Zeng Mohuai cares about most in his life, it would be his ability. Emperor Jingwen invited him here on the pretext that he could enter the palace at any time and read the palace books.”
“Could it be that His Majesty has accidentally obtained some ancient book?”
Based on our knowledge, He Xiang’s inference can only go so far at best.
Lu Mu was silent for a moment, and then said, “If it was just a few books, how could Mr. Zeng devote himself to it so much? Mr. Zeng has never left the border for twenty years.” 𝑅�
Zeng Mohuai had stopped teaching students ten years ago, and now it is Zeng Mohuai’s apprentices who are teaching. As far as Lu Mu knows, it has been only about a year since the emperor ascended the throne, and not only has the previous school been preserved, the emperor has also opened branches in other places.
There are not many branch schools, but they are built steadily, with only one or two schools opened each year. This year is the fourth year, and there should be about four or five schools in total. They are basically located in relatively less developed areas. On the one hand, such places are extremely isolated and not easy to be discovered, and on the other hand, there are relatively few prestigious families.
Lu Mu had a vague guess in his mind that the emperor might have some plans to make changes in the education sector, otherwise he would not have opened a school specifically to avoid those aristocratic families.
It would be fine if it was just the one under General Xu’s protection, and that one could be said to be needed by the emperor. Now the emperor is far less urgent for a useful person than before, but he still took such a big risk, which proves that what the emperor is planning must be extraordinary.
But no matter what, if His Majesty wants to promote it on a large scale, sooner or later he will have to confront the aristocratic families. He can avoid it for a while, but not forever. At that time, it will surely cause a major earthquake, and the commotion will be no less than this expedition.
The saying “emperors come and go, but the clan remains forever” has never been an empty talk.
The power of the noble families was extraordinary, and could almost be said to be the foundation of the entire Great Zhou. However, if the people of the entire Great Zhou wanted everyone to have access to books and be eligible for education, as they did in the past, they could only choose to break the noble families’ monopoly on knowledge and books. There was no other way.
It is simply impossible to ask the aristocratic families to voluntarily give up the interests they have in their hands. This hatred is worse than killing one’s parents, so once the other party finds out, one can imagine how fierce the resistance will be.
However, this kind of thing was just speculation after all. Even if it was true, it was not something he could control, so Lu Mu subconsciously covered it up and did not mention it.
Lu Mu thought for a moment and said, “It was the emperor who impressed Master Zeng with his knowledge.”
After hearing this, He Xiang felt it was even more unbelievable.
Knowledge? ?
What knowledge does His Majesty have?
Several years ago, when the emperor was still a prince, his ignorant appearance was still vivid in people’s minds. Even if he died, Prime Minister He could never forget the pain that the Ninth Prince had brought him.
Even now, I haven’t seen His Majesty read many books!
Prime Minister He was silent for a moment, then he picked up the memorial approved by the emperor and opened it. The handwriting was still the same. Has anything changed over the years?
Lu Mu vaguely sensed something and choked up: “…Actually, Your Majesty is just not good at writing with a brush. Your Majesty’s charcoal writing is pretty good.”
I swear to God, what Lu Mu said was the truth, but it still sounded a bit like a lie.
“…Let’s not talk about that.”
He Xiang exhaled deeply and said, “For the sake of our relationship as master and disciple, please answer my last question.”
“No matter how you think of me, I will still regard you as my teacher.” Lu Mu said this first, and then said: “Please ask me everything you want to know. I will tell you everything I know.”
He Xiang: “I have been an official for many years, and I have never suffered such a big setback. If I can’t figure it out now, I am afraid I will not be willing to die.”
“Even though His Majesty has shown you great kindness and invited Master Zeng to teach you, and even though you knew each other before I did, why didn’t you hear anything about us for so many years? From the beginning to the end, don’t you have any ulterior motives?”
No matter how sincere a person is, he or she can be selfish, right? Or has His Majesty encountered all these stubborn people? His Majesty is just too lucky, isn’t he?
He Xiang’s question was asked cleverly, and it hit the critical point, between what can be said and what cannot be said.
After a while, Lu Mu looked at the eldest son beside him.
Prime Minister He understood and winked at his eldest son, signalling him to leave.
Although the eldest son was unwilling, he did not resist in the end. Before leaving, he could not help but glare at Lu Mu.
After the main hall was completely empty, Lu Mu finally spoke.
“It’s not that I don’t have any other intentions, it’s that I dare not have any other intentions.”
“The emperor seems to dislike being in charge of things, but he actually knows exactly what should and should not be done. We seem important to him, but in fact, we can be discarded at will. There are too many people who want to replace us and have the ability to replace us.”
Students from several schools came in waves and batches, which made Lu Mu feel uneasy.
“Now that things have come to this, I will not hide anything from you. From the time I learned to read to now, I have had three teachers, including you. Master Zeng has a bad temper, but he is straightforward. Prime Minister He, you, treats us better than your own sons and nephews. Only Your Majesty… At first, perhaps because of His Majesty’s mysterious identity and because we were young, we admired Him the most. But now, as time has passed, I have gradually realised how terrifying His Majesty is. He knows so much, so much that it makes me despair.”
“What His Majesty has learned seems to be endless. I’m not afraid of being laughed at by the teacher when I say this. There have been many times when the students even felt that His Majesty was like a god from heaven.” Moving mountains and filling the sea can certainly be called a godly method.
What Lu Mu didn’t mention was the identity of the emperor. At first, he was the most favoured prince, and then he became a prince. Who could they tell? They were all members of the royal family with the surname Ye. They were all one family. Why would these outsiders join in the fun?
Even if it was leaked, the emperor would most likely not get into any serious trouble, but they would not. However, they would definitely die.
Besides, the emperor was not bad to them from the beginning and did not restrict their freedom. Later, when the emperor really needed them and he himself became the emperor, they would have to be crazy to choose to betray him.
Timidity, fear, reverence, threats, freedom… These combined are enough to make them shut up.
“Teacher, for the sake of our long-term relationship as master and disciple, please listen to my advice. At this critical moment, please do not go against His Majesty.”
“Your Majesty is ambitious and cannot be stopped by you gentlemen.”
In the end, Lu Mu left these two sentences.
He Xiang couldn’t come back to his senses for a long time. He was wondering what a god-like figure would be like.
Prime Minister He was a little bit unable to imagine, but what was certain was that the last time we dealt with Beiting, it must not have been Prince Ding’s credit.
Not long after Lu Mu left, Empress Dowager He’s maid arrived. As expected, the Empress Dowager also wanted him to keep his head down.
He Xiang then gradually realised that he had unknowingly fallen into this situation.
Your Majesty is really good at boiling a frog in warm water!
Even if Prime Minister He was unwilling, he had to listen to the advice in this situation. Otherwise, it would be a question whether the whole family could be saved.
They couldn’t stop him before when they didn’t know the inside story, and now that they know it, they can’t stop him even more.
In about two days, Ye Shuo received the news, and six letters of resignation were placed on his desk. Everything in front of him was not much different from what Ye Shuo had expected, but he still breathed a sigh of relief.
As long as He Xiang and his men behave themselves and do not act recklessly at this critical juncture, they will still be heroes of the Great Zhou.
Ye Shuo pondered for a moment, then looked at Wei Wen beside him: “I remember that Prime Minister He has a great-grandson, the third son of the Minister of Chancellery, and… “
Ye Shuo listed several people in succession, and then said: “Since they are the most outstanding people in their respective families, let’s find a way to promote them.”
This can be regarded as a reward for He Xiang and his companions for their understanding, and at the same time it is also sending a signal – he has no intention of making things difficult for them, and will even protect the honour of their entire family.
After all, we can’t let those who have contributed to the Great Zhou feel disappointed, right?
After hearing this, He Xiang was surprised and happy, but more of it was complicated.
It turns out that without realising it, His Majesty has already become very adept at doing these things. They have always underestimated him…
He stood there in a daze for a long time, as if he was recalling his life as prime minister. After a while, he finally reacted, then knelt on the ground and bent down.
“Thank you, your Majesty, for your grace.”
At this moment, He Xiang seemed to be really old.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Another Expedition
chapters.content:
About a quarter of an hour later, Xiao Luzi led his men back to the palace to report.
At that time, Ye Shuo was thinking about the war, how to arrange and deploy, and who to listen to. After seeing Xiao Luzi, he casually asked, “How is He Xiang’s condition?”
Upon hearing this, Xiao Luzi naturally reported the truth: “Your Majesty, Lord He seems to have been somewhat shocked, but his mental state is still okay.”
Ye Shuo let out a long sigh: “It’s okay.”
Ye Shuo also knew that this incident was too shocking for He Xiang and the others, but there was no other solution. Seeing that the expedition was imminent, no matter what the future held, at least the rear must be stabilized.
Ye Shuo can accept failure due to unknown reasons, but he cannot accept failure without preparation.
“It’s normal for Prime Minister He to feel hit. After all, he has been the Prime Minister for his entire life.”
When saying this, Xiao Luzi could feel that the emperor was sincere. Over the past few years, he could clearly see that the emperor had become different from before.
Sometimes the emperor is even more cruel than Emperor Taicheng, but sometimes he is exceptionally kind.
When Xiao Luzi was given to the Ninth Prince, he never imagined that this day would come.“By the way, I heard that you just adopted a godson recently?” When walking from the Qinzheng Hall to the Chengming Hall, Ye Shuo seemed to have thought of something and asked.
The godson was yesterday’s story. He was a very clever little eunuch, very much like him back then, so Xiao Luzi couldn’t help himself and…
Xiaoluzi had never told anyone about this, so how could His Majesty——
Xiao Luzi was shocked and said hurriedly: “Your Majesty, this is what happened. I felt sorry for the child, so I–“
“No need to explain, I don’t mean anything else.” Ye Shuo waved his hand.
“I was just thinking, if you really decide to have him worship you in the future, when he is trained, you can transfer him to the imperial court, and then assign him to the queen, or a few princesses.”
Xiao Luzi was stunned by the good news.
“To reply to Your Majesty, if Your Majesty really likes it, it will naturally be a blessing for that boy.”
In the blink of an eye, Xiao Luzi has reached the age to be adopted as a godson. Xiao Luzi has been with him for so many years, so Ye Shuo naturally has to give him some respect.
“If your godson really takes after your personality, I would like him.”
“Oh, by the way, after I go on this expedition, I’m afraid I won’t be back for a long time. The Queen will still be the regent at that time. You must help the Queen and take care of everything in the palace. Don’t make it difficult for the Queen.”
Naturally, I will do whatever it takes to get a small advantage.
About half a quarter of an hour later, Yao Zhi came back from strolling in the imperial garden with the infant Yongning, and saw the young man standing in front of the mirror, looking at something.
Yao Zhi waved to the senior palace maid beside her, signaling her to take the others down. When most of them had left, Yao Zhi spoke up, “What are you looking at, gesticulating over there?”
The mirror in Chengming Hall is naturally a mercury mirror that is hard to come by these days. Looking at the extremely clear reflection on it, Ye Shuo was silent for a moment and said, “I didn’t see anything, but I just felt that the person in the mirror was a little strange.”
The face was still the same, but everything else was different. Sometimes, even though Ye Shuo had such a good memory, he couldn’t remember what he looked like when he was still a prince.
Yao Zhi immediately understood what he meant.
But this kind of thing cannot be avoided.
Yao Zhi didn’t say anything like “It’s not your fault”, but just said: “If you really think you are the only one who is right, then find a way to prove it to He Xiang and the others.”
“…I think you’re right.”
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said, “Wait until I find a way to defeat the State of Chen, and then we’ll see what they can say!”
At this moment, Ye Shuo was also feeling a lot of energy in his heart.
After waking up, he noticed that Yongning seemed to have fallen asleep. Ye Shuo was making the bed skillfully while muttering something non-stop: “I told you not to let me be the emperor, but everyone pushed the burden onto me. I think they just can’t see others doing well. Now, no matter what I do, all I can think about is profit, profit, profit.”
Being an emperor is much more stressful than being a boss in his previous life. If a boss fails to do his job well, the worst that can happen is that his employees will lose their jobs. But if an emperor fails to do his job well, the lives of the people under him may be in jeopardy.
“Also, now no matter who talks to me, I can’t help but go over it in my mind, wondering what this person means, why he says that, and whether he has other purposes.” Ye Shuo knew that this was not good, but he really… couldn’t control it.
“Now I finally understand where my father and Xiao Ming’s suspicion comes from.”
Yao Zhi had no better solution and could only give him a hug from behind.
After a while, the young man’s slightly tired voice was heard.
“Fortunately, I still have you, my mother, Jianjian, Dingning and the others…”
Whether it is Yao Zhi’s character, personality, or feelings for him, she is very trustworthy.
Thinking about it this way, Ye Shuo felt that he was still lucky in this regard.
About an hour later, Dingning and Anning came back from the study together.
Yes, An Ning, who was only three years old, had already gone to the Shangshufang to study with her school bag on her back. The reason was that she saw her elder sister being praised by her father, the emperor, the empress, and the empress dowager, and she was not convinced, so she clamoured to go to school, so she became like this.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but wonder in his heart, thinking that he was not so studious in the past.
How come the two daughters seem to have had a genetic mutation?
The sky outside was getting darker. The family had dinner together and went to the Imperial Garden hand in hand to digest the food. As they were walking, Dingning, who was already five years old, suddenly said something.
“Dad, is there going to be a war?”
Ye Shuo was stunned. How did Ding Ning know this? It seemed like he had never specifically told her about this.
Ye Shuo looked at Yao Zhi standing beside him, and sure enough, Yao Zhi also shook her head.
“I didn’t say that either.”
It seems that either Lord Cen said it, or it was said by other royal family members in the Shangshufang.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but squat down and asked, “Since Xiao Dingning already knows, can Xiao Dingning tell Daddy? Do you think this is a good thing or a bad thing?”
Dingning didn’t expect that her father would ask for her opinion. She had heard a lot of things these days, all kinds of things. Dingning didn’t know who to believe, so she could only rack her brains and give her own answer to the best of her ability.
“If you win, it’s a good thing, but if you lose, it’s not.”
The little princess thought relatively simply: since there were right and wrong, she could just decide based on wins and losses.
“…Yes, the winners are the kings and the losers are the bandits. It has always been like this.”
Ye Shuo touched his eldest daughter’s head and said nothing more.
Dingning is five years old now, and An Ning is three years old if rounded up. Dingning had already started laying the foundation more than a year ago. She had learned horse stance and some common boxing and sword techniques, all of which were taught by Yao Zhi herself. Her every move and gesture really looked like the real thing. As for An Ning, Yao Zhi didn’t teach her formally because she was afraid that she would hurt herself if she started practising too early. Now, she watched her sister wielding a peach wood sword with great power, and then looked at her own turtle fist, and she was so angry that she screamed.
Ye Shuo in the room was holding Yongning and watching, and couldn’t help laughing out loud.
Peaceful days are always short. In the blink of an eye, a month has passed and it is almost time to set out.
“Thank you for your hard work again.”
“It doesn’t have to be like this between you and me.”
In the end, Yao Zhi took Dingning and Anning to see Ye Shuo off.
Originally, Jianjian also wanted to go with them, as she had visited the State of Chen many times when she was travelling abroad. However, as soon as she said it, Ye Shuo rejected her.
Ye Shuo was not afraid that she would be in danger, but he still needed her Inspectorate to help watch over Shangjing.
Even though Jianjian had the intention, she had no choice but to agree.
“Next time, you must take me with you next time!”
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this: “This time is already a big deal, is there going to be a next time?”
Then he saw that the sharp eyes suddenly turned into contempt.
“Brother, you don’t think I’m a fool, do you?”
“Even if you didn’t tell me anything, can’t I guess it?”
“…You are smarter than before.”
Without waiting for Jian Jian’s response, Ye Shuo hurriedly said, “Okay, I won’t talk to you anymore. It’s almost time. I have to go.”
My goodness, he is mocking herself for being stupid in the past!
Jian Jian subconsciously wanted to refute, but when the words came to her lips, they became: “Royal brother, be careful on your journey!”
Please don’t let anything happen…
As if sensing something, Ye Shuo, who had turned his head away, waved his hand.
After a whole month, the troops from all over the country were reorganised and marched towards the border in a mighty manner.
Watching from afar, Dingning and Anning widened their eyes at the same time.
Prince Ding didn’t know whether he was intentionally joining in the fun or for some other reason. Although he didn’t know much about the State of Chen, he still followed.
“You’re not in a hurry this time.”
Prince Ding still remembered how anxious he was last time and couldn’t wait to confront the people of Beiting the next moment.
“Isn’t the situation different this time?” Since an earthquake occurred in the State of Chen, the State of Chen must find a way to provide disaster relief. If this task is done well, it will consume the food and grass of the State of Chen, and the food and grass distributed to the soldiers will not be so abundant. If this task is not done well, that would be even better. If the State of Chen is unwilling to distribute food, then he can distribute food on behalf of the State of Chen.
The State of Chen did not feel sorry for its subjects, but he felt sorry for the State of Chen. As long as the State of Chen did not regret it at that time, it would be fine.
This is the truth, but Prince Ding always felt that it sounded strange.
There were many people on the march this time, so the pace was slow, but with Prince Ding by their side to chat and talk, it wasn’t boring at all.
What Ye Shuo didn’t know was that on the day of the expedition, He Xiang and his men were also there, but they didn’t go up to the city wall, and there were too many people, so Ye Shuo didn’t know about it.
Since Lu Mu and others praised him to the sky, He Xiang and others wanted to see how powerful this so-called god-like figure was.
“snort.”
He Xiang couldn’t help but snorted coldly.
The old tutor at the side looked on, the corners of his mouth twitched uncontrollably twice.

chapters.title: Chapter 313: Boredom
chapters.content:
There were more people marching this time, so the time spent on the road was much longer than before.
It took Ye Shuo and his group a full half month to reach the border.
Four years have passed. The young General Wei, who was still a little green back then, has now lost his last bit of innocence and is gradually able to stand on his own. His every move and gesture also reveals some of the heroic spirit of the Duke of Zhen.
Although General Wei’s title contains a small character in his title, he is already over 30 years old this year. As General Wei, a fourth-rank official position, it is not too high, but it is still acceptable for his age. The main reason is that he has no chance to do meritorious deeds. Since the last time he defended the city, there has been nothing he can show.
But if he is lucky this time, he should be able to move up a level.
The first thing General Wei said when he saw Ye Shuo was, “Welcome to His Majesty.”
General Xu next to him followed closely behind: “This general greets His Majesty. Long live the emperor.”
Old General Xu is not very old, just over sixty years old. However, due to too many hidden injuries from his youth, he does not look much younger than the old Duke Zhen. His hair is gray and his temples are frosted. He is a little weak and can no longer lead troops to fight. However, the court has not yet selected a qualified successor, so he will remain in this position for the time being.
This was the first time that Ye Shuo saw the true face of General Xu. General Xu had spent more time at the border than his grandfather. It could be said that he had truly dedicated his entire life here.
“General Xu, please stand up.” Ye Shuo hurried forward and helped him up personally.“I have to thank General Xu for his help back then.” Ye Shuo was talking about Zeng Mohuai and the original school.
But in fact, General Xu was not doing it just for him. After all, if the Zhen Mansion collapsed, he, as a subordinate of the old Zhen Duke, would be in trouble.
I just didn’t expect that by some strange coincidence, I would end up with such a good relationship.
“Your Majesty, please forgive me.” General Xu shook his head hurriedly, feeling extremely terrified and respectful.
After a long round of conversation, Ye Shuo finally came to the king’s tent that had been prepared long ago under the guidance of General Xu.
There are naturally layers of guards in the king’s tent.
General Xu had arranged guards in advance, but when he accidentally saw one of the young men, his face changed instantly.
“Evil creature, why are you here!?”
Following General Xu’s scolding, Ye Shuo looked in the direction he was directed and saw a young man who was no more than seventeen or eighteen years old, but less than twenty years old.
The boy’s appearance was not the best, just average. The most outstanding thing about him was his eyes, which were black and bright, full of the vitality of a young man.
Ye Shuo was startled, then raised his eyebrows slightly.
When the boy saw his position being pointed out, he froze for a moment, then gritted his teeth and walked out.
“I pay my respects to His Majesty, the Prince, and… General Xu.”
Prince Ding was totally confused and had no idea what was going on.
Then General Xu said ruthlessly, “Xu Kui, the halberd commander, disobeyed orders and disregarded military law. According to military discipline, he shall be punished with sixty strokes of the cane. Come, drag him out!”
Xu Kui…? Xu?
Ye Shuo vaguely understood something, so he raised his hand and said, “Wait a minute.”
“I think he seems to have something to say, so why not let him say it.” Ye Shuo didn’t think that General Xu’s grandson would be ignorant of military discipline and knowingly violate it.
The young man was still hesitating, but after hearing this, he finally gritted his teeth and seemed to have made up his mind. He spoke straightforwardly, “It is clear that General Xu had said before that anyone who ranked in the top 30 in the military competition could serve as a guard. It was General Xu who broke his promise first, so I had no choice but to resort to this desperate measure.”
This is the case for all Hui people. They do not seek to rely on their grandfather’s protection, but only hope not to be restricted by it.
As time went by, day after day, he no longer wanted to endure it any longer.
Top 30 in the military competition?
If Ye Shuo remembered correctly, there were tens of thousands of people in the entire Southwest Military Camp.
Ye Shuo didn’t expect that the young man in front of him had such ability. However, it was really hard to understand that he didn’t even have an official position despite having such ability.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look at General Xu standing beside him: “General, are you serious about this?”
General Xu opened his mouth and said, “Your Majesty, this is true, but——”
“If that’s the case, then it’s your fault, General Xu. You shouldn’t avoid relatives when selecting talents, and going back on your word is a big taboo in the army. General Xu is a bit overbearing.” It would be too unfair to the young man if he deliberately suppressed his relatives just to avoid suspicion.
“The military only looks at merit, not kinship, let alone faction. What do you think, old general?”
The young man had waited for so long, and finally someone came to support him. He was instantly excited.
“Your Majesty is wise! Your Majesty is mighty!”
Without saying a word, the young man bowed his head and shouted “Long live the Buddha” three times with a very pious look on his face.
General Xu: “…”
General Xu couldn’t help but glared at him fiercely. The young man trembled instinctively at first, and then regained his complacent look. Coupled with Ye Shuo’s calm eyes, General Xu had no choice but to lower his head.
“Your Majesty has taught me, and I will obey your orders.”
Just wait for this bastard. Once this matter is resolved, I will definitely teach him a lesson! He is so young, but he has gone crazy!
General Xu glanced at him and gave him a threatening look that said “Just wait for me” before leaving.
However, what General Xu didn’t know was that the more he did this, the more the young man in front of him wanted to show himself in front of Ye Shuo.
After General Xu left, the young man immediately became well behaved.
“Xu Kui, right?” After a while, he suddenly heard such a voice coming from above.
“Which Kui character?”
“It’s… the character Kui from the Kui beast.” Seeing that the emperor and Prince Ding were still a little confused, the young man plucked up his courage, borrowed the pen and ink on the table, and wrote for them to see.
Prince Ding took the time to take a quick look and discovered that the handwriting of any of the pawns was several times more beautiful than that of his own brother.
Seriously, after all these years, doesn’t he have the slightest bit of shame?
Ignoring his cheap brother’s weird look, Ye Shuo borrowed the paper and finally understood a little.
Kui is a one-legged monster in myths and legends. According to the “Classic of Mountains and Seas: Great Wilderness Classic”, there is a beast on the Liubo Mountain in the East China Sea, which is 7,000 miles into the sea. It looks like an ox, with a blue body and no horns, and one foot. When it comes out of the water, there will be wind and rain. Its light is like the sun and the moon, and its sound is like thunder. Its name is Kui. Huangdi got it, used its skin to make a drum, and peg it with the bones of thunder beasts. The sound could be heard 500 miles away, and it intimidated the world.
This name is appropriate and impressive, but I don’t know if he can live up to it.
“You just said you were in the top 30, how many points exactly?” Ye Shuo asked.
Xu Kui answered honestly: “Your Majesty, I am the third.”
“It’s actually the runner-up.” Prince Ding at the side couldn’t help but exclaim: “You’re amazing.”
Xu Kui was a little embarrassed by Prince Ding’s straightforward praise, and couldn’t help but chuckled: “To reply to your Highness, I was born with supernatural powers, and I got up too late that day and didn’t have a full meal, otherwise I might be able to compete for the first place.”
“…He’s young, but he speaks so arrogantly.” If he hadn’t had a lame leg, King Ding might have really wanted to compare himself with him.
Then, Prince Ding changed the subject: “However, I like your straightforward temper, which suits my taste the most.”
As he spoke, Prince Ding couldn’t help but pat the young man on the shoulder.
The boy didn’t care at all, he was even very happy.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo on the side couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
While the two were chatting, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but lift the door curtain and walk into the innermost resting and sleeping area.
The sand table, maps, etc. are all here. These were originally things only in the main tent, but now General Xu has put them all in his own tent.
General Xu had thought clearly. He knew that since the emperor had come, the command of the army would naturally fall into his hands. Moreover, due to his health, General Xu had already thought about resigning. Since he could no longer march and fight, the best strategy was to hand over the military power as soon as possible.
As generals, most of them spend their whole lives in military service, either dying on the battlefield or being liquidated by their superiors at a certain time. General Xu does not ask for anything else but to be like the old Duke Zhen.
Besides, Xu Zhong and Fang Shiquan had already informed him of the matter, so what was there for General Xu to worry about?
Ye Shuo thought about it, and then called in Xu Kui and Prince Ding.
Xu Kui was the grandson of General Xu, so he should be trustworthy. After the two entered the inner tent, he pointed at the sand table and then at the map: “Do you know these two things?”
“Of course.” These two things were what Xu Kui had read the most since he could remember. How could he not understand them?
The moment he finished speaking, Xu Kui slowly began to explain at Ye Shuo’s signal.
“This is the heartland of the State of Chen. Most of the trade flows here. This is the capital of the State of Chen, and there is also this river…”
