I have to say that although this young man is only seventeen or eighteen years old, he speaks very fluently. When he counts the cities and terrain of the State of Chen, he knows them like the back of his hand. This is the benefit of family education.
It was not until late at night that Ye Shuo felt that he had heard enough and that it was not much different from what he heard when he went to Beijing, so he let him leave.
“I’ll take my leave.”
After the young man left, Prince Ding belatedly remembered something: “If I remember correctly, General Xu’s six sons seem to have already…”
“Well, I know. They have all died in battle. Now I’m afraid this is the only one left who has a future.”
None of the six sons survived. This would be considered an extremely rare event outside, but it is quite normal at the border or on the battlefield. If one’s luck is a little worse, most of them would have died in the battle.
Prince Ding, who had also led troops, could not help but sigh: “No wonder General Xu acted like this, he must have had the intention of protecting this young man.”
“But it is obvious that he, like his uncles and grandfather, is extremely eager for the battlefield.” Ye Shuo easily caught the word “desire” from the young man’s eyes.
“Look at what you said, these are clearly two different things. If it were you, I’m afraid you wouldn’t be able to accept it so easily.” Prince Ding looked at his younger brother who was already the father of three children.
Ye Shuo thought of his three daughters. If they were like this young man in the future, wandering on the edge of life and death…
Ye Shuo’s breathing stagnated.
However, Brother Cheap was wrong about one thing. The reason why General Xu suppressed this young man so much was not only to avoid suspicion and protect him, but there were more important reasons.
Just when Ye Shuo was thinking about something, he suddenly saw the cheap brother opposite him touching his chin and saying something.
“Your Majesty, did you hear just now that young man said he was born with supernatural powers?” If we talk about people with supernatural powers, Prince Ding himself can be considered one.
At first he thought this thing was extremely rare, but as more and more people around him were born with supernatural powers, he felt that it was no longer valuable.
“It’s okay that I’m old, but Your Majesty, you are also born with supernatural powers. I wonder how this young man compares to you.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
“boring.”
He didn’t know if it was an illusion, but he always felt that his cheap brother was becoming more and more leisurely, just like… him in the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: School
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo reacted belatedly and his eyes instantly became sharp.
Prince Ding sensed that the atmosphere was not good and immediately put away the smile on his face.
“It’s getting late. I’ll take my leave.”
Not long after Prince Ding left, Ye Shuo also lay down, thinking that it would be great if he had a cell phone at this time. He didn’t know what Azhi and Dingning were doing now, as well as his mother and Jianjian…
As Ye Shuo was thinking, he fell asleep, and a night passed in the blink of an eye.
The next morning, Ye Shuo was awakened by the sound of training outside. Since becoming emperor, Ye Shuo basically never slept in again.
After washing up and eating, Ye Shuo walked out of the tent and soon saw several lieutenants directing the soldiers in training.
There were a lot of soldiers receiving training, a huge group. They saw the emperor and the prince coming last night, so they worked extra hard today.
Ye Shuo stood on the stage and looked around, feeling very satisfied.
Although the condition of these soldiers in front of him is not as good as the soldiers Ye Shuo has seen in modern times, their living conditions are already quite good.Nowadays, the food and grass in the Great Zhou are relatively abundant, so there is no need to worry about the problem of food. In order to give the soldiers a place to vent their energy, after training and eating, some of them went to farm, weed, raise pigs, ducks and chickens, while the rest continued to wrestle and fight there.
Xu Kui was just like his name, like a bull. In a short while, he knocked the burly man opposite him to the ground with one punch.
“…I haven’t seen you for a few days. You seem to be getting stronger.”
After a long while, the man finally got up from the ground, holding his stomach. When the fist landed on him just now, he really felt like he was about to die.
The man was an expert in the army, and he was like this, let alone ordinary people. If they were hit in a vital part by him, they would probably die on the spot.
“By the way, I haven’t congratulated you yet. You finally got what you wanted.”
The man was Xu Kui’s roommate who had once lived in the same tent with him. He often laughed at Xu Kui for being picky. In addition, Xu Kui was young, so everyone treated him as a green hand.
It was not until later that Xu Kui refused to accept the defeat and started a fight with them. Only then did everyone realise that although the young man in front of them was only in his teens, he was really ruthless. He hit them in the vital parts. After a long time, no one dared to mess with him.
Then, everyone realised that this ordinary boy was actually the grandson of General Xu. At that time, the men were envious and even a little jealous. After all, who doesn’t want to have a grandfather with high power? Especially those of them who were born in the mud, they envied the children of officials even more, envious of them for having a good birth and a good father, so they could rest easy in their lives.
But gradually, Hanzi and his friends discovered that not all children of officials were so happy. Just like the one they met, it would be worse if they didn’t have this grandfather.
To be honest, there is no doubt that General Xu is strict in military discipline, and the entire army is grateful to him, but he is not fair at all to his grandson.
After two years, under normal circumstances, Xu Kui’s accumulated military merits should have allowed him to be promoted to the 8th rank Xuanjie Colonel. However, due to the deliberate suppression by General Xu, he is still a commoner today.
Those who lived in the same tent were promoted one after another. The man with the best performance has now become a seventh-rank deputy captain, thanks to Xu Kui’s help. Many times, they even relied on Xu Kui’s tactics to survive the battlefield.
As envious as they were before, as sympathetic as they are now.
When Ye Shuo walked out of the tent again, he saw a group of people gathered there, watching Xu Kui lift the stone lock.
The two stone locks weighed about 200 pounds in total, which seemed heavy to others. However, in Xu Kui’s hands, he lifted them up easily, which shows that Xu Kui’s limit was far more than that.
Even though they have seen it many times, every time this moment comes, others can’t help but be amazed.
“That’s amazing…”
“It would be nice if I had this ability…”
With a “dong” sound, Xu Kui put down the stone lock in his hand and let out a long breath. Noticing the envious eyes of others, Xu Kui, who was still a teenager, couldn’t help but feel a little proud.
Just as he rolled up his sleeves and wildly showed off his arm muscles to his colleagues, a loud laugh from not far away suddenly interrupted the cheerful atmosphere.
“What are you all doing together?!”
The person who came was none other than General Xu.
When General Xu saw this scene, his face turned green.
“The barracks craftsmen made this stone lock for you to play with? That’s ridiculous!”
Seeing this, the men didn’t dare to refute at all, and their whole body tensed up in an instant.
However, soon, just like many times before, General Xu directed his spearhead at Xu Kui, who was standing aside, trying to lower his shoulders and reduce his presence.
“Especially you, who are grandstanding and acting like a clown. How can you be restrained? How can you say shame?”
As soon as he finished speaking, Xu Kui, who had been trying to maintain his composure, suddenly changed his expression.
He just couldn’t understand how lifting two stone locks could be associated with shame.
Seeing that the grandfather and grandson were about to quarrel again, and it might end with twenty military sticks, just when everyone was very nervous, a soldier came over and said something to General Xu, and General Xu’s expression suddenly became respectful.
“…Yes, I will obey your order.”
Everyone subconsciously looked back and saw that His Majesty and Prince Ding were standing there at some point in time. Especially His Majesty, who was dressed in a dark tight-fitting outfit and stared at this side quietly, with an expression that could not tell whether he was happy or angry.
The men were startled and instinctively knelt down: “Greetings to His Majesty, may His Majesty be well and safe.”
Ye Shuo nodded and said calmly, while Prince Ding on the side waved towards Xu Kui.
It turned out that the emperor was going to leave the military camp, and as one of the guards, Xu Kui should naturally accompany him.
Xu Kui had never felt so proud in his entire life. In the past, his grandfather would pin him down and scold him, and would not allow him to talk back. But now, when he thought of his grandfather’s aggrieved look, Xu Kui felt refreshed.
It really is… so comfortable!
Xu Kui was a young man with a temperament that was all written on his face. Prince Ding, who was standing by, couldn’t help but think of his own sons when they were young. He also felt that General Xu had gone a little too far.
In the army, no matter who you are, you will be rewarded according to your merits. Doing it deliberately like this will actually make people unhappy.
Ye Shuo thought for a moment and asked, “Do you hate your grandfather?”
“To answer your Majesty, I can’t say I hold a grudge against him. Although he has never looked at me straight in the eye since I joined the army, I still remember when he held me in his arms to look at maps and sand tables when I was little.”
“It’s just a few words, what’s the big deal?”
Noticing that the young man’s words seemed a little numb, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frown slightly.
Then Xu Kui added: “But the more he says this, the more he says I can’t do it, the more I have to prove it to him.”
As expected of a military man, Xu Kui’s temper can be described as both stubborn and obstinate.
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, and suddenly said: “Have you ever thought about listening to your grandfather and choosing a comfortable life? Or maybe… your grandfather was also frightened by the things that happened to your father and uncles, and now he just wants you to be safe and sound.”
Oh my god, is this what the lawless Ninth Prince could say? Prince Ding was stunned.
One day, the word “obedient” actually appeared in his mouth.
“This…” Thinking of his father and the others, Xu Kui hesitated for a moment: “Maybe.”
“But what can I do? Even if that’s true, what Grandfather chose is not what I want.”
“I prefer to stay here, fight in battle, and make achievements like my grandfather and father did. It would be even better if I could sit in a higher position than my grandfather.”
Prince Ding felt that the last half of the sentence should be the key point.
“I didn’t expect that you have such big ambitions at such a young age.” General Xu was a second-rank General of the Zhenjun Army. In the absence of a first-rank General of the Cavalry in the Great Zhou Dynasty and a second-rank General of the Auxiliary State, a second-rank general was already the top military general. If Prince Ding was not judged by his title and rank, he would have been only a third-rank general. Ordinary people could not reach General Xu’s position even if they spent their entire lives. Doesn’t Prince Ding think that the kid in front of him is arrogant?
Xu Kui couldn’t help but chuckle: “In reply to your Highness, I just said this casually. What if, what if it comes true?”
Whether it can come true is one thing, but whether you dare to think about it is another.
My own pursuit… Seeing this, Ye Shuo became even more silent.
But Xu Kui also knew that under the current circumstances, as long as his grandfather was alive, he would have no chance of getting promoted, so Xu Kui could only surrender to someone else. The emperor was the ruler of a country, and even his grandfather was his subject, so he believed that his grandfather would not mind.
Xu Kui bravely asked, “Your Majesty, I heard that a special team was established in the army three years ago. I was not old enough at that time and could not sign up. I wonder if Your Majesty can have mercy on me and tell me when the team named Special Forces will expand its enrollment?”
The discipline and requirements of that special army are different from many places outside. As long as I can get in, it will be a one-time and all solution.
In this way, you no longer have to worry about others discovering your secrets.
Xu Kui suddenly remembered that when the emperor came this time, he didn’t seem to bring any team that looked like special forces with him. Or maybe they were hiding in the crowd and he didn’t notice them?
However, before Ye Shuo could answer, Prince Ding beside him suddenly narrowed his eyes.
It must be said that this kid is really well-informed. When the team was first formed, it was kept strictly confidential, unless General Xu told him. But judging from the current situation, it should not have been leaked by General Xu.
So Prince Ding guessed that he must have other channels.
Special forces were created to carry out special missions, and he met the requirements. In addition, he is the grandson of a loyal minister and a capable general… Prince Ding felt that they might have run into a cunning guy.
But if you think about it carefully, he is capable enough, and he is well-versed in the art of war, let alone sand table maps. Such talents are indeed rare, and it is not a bad idea to absorb him through special channels.
But this matter still depends on my younger brother. After all, this team belongs only to him, and even I can’t get involved.
Ye Shuo on the side didn’t nod, but didn’t refuse either.
Now is not the time. Now a small half of the team is in Beiting, and most of the rest have entered the State of Chen a month ago. It will be useless even if I agree now.
Ye Shuo did not take any action immediately at that moment, he was just waiting for news from the front.
“You are now just a temporary guard selected by me.”
Since you are a guard, you should do your job well.
Xu Kui immediately understood the hidden meaning of the emperor’s words and shut his mouth, not daring to say anything more.
After a while, when Xu Kui was still wondering what the emperor was doing outside the military camp when he was unfamiliar with the place, he learned that he and Prince Ding were specifically looking for the special school at the border, so he hurriedly said, “I am very familiar with this place. I will lead the way for the emperor and the prince.”
Is he familiar with this place?
Prince Ding looked at his younger brother beside him and couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows.

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Insidious
chapters.content:
“He said he is very familiar with your territory. Don’t you have anything to say?”
Taking advantage of Xu Kui’s inattention, Prince Ding said this, his eyes full of ridicule.
“…Brother, if you are really so free, why not help General Xu to handle military affairs.” This time they have gathered a total of nearly 200,000 soldiers and horses, almost half of the soldiers of the Great Zhou Dynasty. This is the effective combat power alone, not to mention the logistics.
Now General Xu is actively coordinating with several other generals to arrange transfers and resettlement. He is busy every day. In comparison, the cheap brother seems to have too much free time.
When Prince Ding heard this, he shut his mouth instantly. Forget it. He has gradually tasted the sweetness now. Unless his younger brother personally orders him to do it, he would rather not do it. People are like this. Once they relax, it will be difficult to return to their original state.
Well, it’s true, Prince Ding also gradually discovered the fun of slacking off. He finally understood why his younger brother was lazy every day.
I can’t say that the days of fishing, drinking tea, listening to music and reading novels every day are very happy, but they are relaxing.
It feels so good to not have to think about anything.
Just when Prince Ding was hesitating whether to pretend to have a sore leg, Xu Kui finally returned: “Your Majesty, I have already inquired and Master Zhu is in the school right now.”
Zhu…?If Ye Shuo remembered correctly, one of Zeng Mohuai’s students was named Zhu.
Ye Shuo nodded slightly, indicating that he should lead the way.
Under the rule of General Xu, the border was relatively safe as there was no invasion from the State of Chen, so Ye Shuo did not bring many people with him and they were all wearing casual clothes.
As the distance got closer, gradually more and more children appeared around.
In ancient times, the living environment was harsh and life expectancy was short. In such a precarious environment, even children of three or five years old had to be forced to become sensible in order to survive. So along the way, the children Ye Shuo saw were all very precocious, as if adults had possessed them. From a modern person’s perspective, it was really very strange.
Although the child was small, he was very vigilant. When he saw Ye Shuo and other unfamiliar faces, he subconsciously became alert.
It was not until they saw Xu Kui that they breathed a sigh of relief.
“Major General.”
It seems that what Xu Kui said was correct. He must have been coming here frequently, and almost no one around him didn’t know him.
“Great General.”
Xu Kui led Ye Shuo to the door of one of the classrooms. Ye Shuo then noticed that Master Zhu was still teaching a class and most of his students were listening attentively.
Seeing Xu Kui was about to step forward and call for help without hesitation, Ye Shuo hurriedly said, “Don’t bother them, let the students finish this class.”
Besides, Ye Shuo’s purpose of coming here today was not to see Master Zhu in front of him. He wanted to visit the school more, and also… to meet Zeng Mohuai.
Xu Kui was stunned for a moment, then he realised that he seemed to have misunderstood. But the purpose of His Majesty’s visit this time was not Master Zhu, so who else could it be?
Ye Shuo had just noticed that there was a courtyard behind the school, which was isolated. Judging from the conversations of the students around him, the person he was looking for was probably in there.
Ye Shuo looked at the young man beside him: “Is Master Zeng here?”
“This is indeed Master Zeng’s residence, but…” Xu Kui did not expect that the emperor actually came to find Zeng Mohuai.
You have to know that Master Zeng has always had a bad temper and doesn’t give face to anyone. If His Majesty gets rejected by him…
When Xu Kui was young, his father followed his grandfather to fight outside. His mother had to take care of household affairs and help appease the people in the city, so she had no time to take care of him. His mother thought about it and sent him to school. ȑ�
Master Zeng founded this school, and both men and women were welcome to attend. In addition, the gender separation at the border was not as strict as outside, so people just talked about it for a while at first, but didn’t think it was a big deal. In addition, the school was not closed, so at first everyone thought it was a charity, and most of the students were orphans without parents. But as time went on, the people in the city found that their children could really learn something real here, and gradually, they were willing to send their children to study.
Even Xu Kui was considered half a student in the school. Under such circumstances, Xu Kui naturally did not want to see a conflict between Master Zeng and the emperor.
Although Xu Kui had a vague guess that the school must be related to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, otherwise his grandfather would not be so partial to it, and the Duke of Zhen was the current emperor’s maternal grandfather, but after all, there was a layer of separation in between, right?
To be on the safe side, Xu Kui hurriedly said, “I will go and inform Master Zeng to come out to greet you.”
How could Ye Shuo not know his little thoughts? But his worries were really unnecessary.
“No need, I will go there myself.”
Ye Shuo raised his hand.
Seeing that the emperor was about to walk towards the courtyard without saying a word, Xu Kui could not help but stamp his feet. At this moment, he only hoped that Master Zeng would not treat the emperor with the same attitude as he treated them.
After a while, Zeng Mohuai, who was lying on the bed, noticed some movement at the door and said impatiently, “How many times have I told you not to come and disturb me?”
“It’s me.”
Noticing that the voice was very unfamiliar, Zeng Mohuai subconsciously looked up and saw a man who looked to be in his early twenties standing not far away, bowing to him.
“It’s our first time meeting you. Master Zeng, are you all right?”
Logically speaking, Zeng Mohuai had never seen him before and should not have recognized him, but Zeng Mohuai recognized him anyway.
In addition, there are recent rumours that the emperor has personally led troops to the border…
Zeng Mohuai, who originally looked sick, became excited almost instantly: “You came at the right time. I just happened to have several questions to ask you. If these questions don’t have answers, I will not be willing to die.”
The look and tone were as if he had met a close friend of decades.
Since more than 20 years ago, Ye Shuo has been writing to the school once a month. From this perspective, the two can indeed be considered good friends.
Time makes people grow old, and no one can resist the torrent of time. Ye Shuo came here just because he knew Zeng Mohuai was seriously ill.
This was the first time the two met, and perhaps also the last time.
Ye Shuo didn’t care about Zeng Mohuai’s rudeness. What he was thinking was that if Zeng Mohuai could get through this time, it would be fine. If not… Ye Shuo also hoped that he would not be so regretful.
Ye Shuo sat down and said straightforwardly, “Master Zeng, please speak.”
In an instant, Xu Kui, who was standing beside him, was dishevelled in the wind.
No wonder, no wonder with Mr. Zeng’s temper and his restless nature, he would stay in one place for so long.
Therefore, the entity behind the academy is not the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion, but the Emperor himself.
Oh my god!
After sitting in the open space in the yard for a long time, Xu Kui finally figured out everything.
Prince Ding, who was standing by, could not help but marvel at the sight. In Prince Ding’s impression, General Xu had always been an extremely safe and conservative person, but he did not expect that his grandson was so smart.
Xu Kui was thinking that if that was the case, then he could be considered a disciple of the emperor. Or perhaps, only an emperor who advocated education for all and treating men and women equally would set a rule that everyone, regardless of gender, could join the army when establishing that special team.
The one who is close to the water gets the moon first. Xu Kui felt that he could not miss such an opportunity no matter what.
Although competing for family background is a shameful act, it is undeniable that it is indeed an advantage. Besides, he is now the emperor’s guard. As long as he can perform well and try his best on the battlefield, his career will most likely be secured.
In Xu Kui’s view, not seizing opportunities is a waste of resources.
After figuring out the key, Xu Kui seemed to see hope again. His eyes lit up instantly, almost blinding Prince Ding who was standing next to him.
What’s wrong? This is…
Looking at the young man who was radiating excitement and fighting spirit, Prince Ding suddenly felt that he seemed to be old.
Three hours later, on the other side.
“…Stop, stop, stop, let’s stop here.” Zeng Mohuai wanted to clear up his confusion at first, but he didn’t expect that the more he listened, the more confused he became. The more he listened, the more desperate he became. It was a kind of panic and fear of the unknown.
Zeng Mohuai felt that he could not leave with peace of mind this time, so he decisively called a halt.
A mere twenty years is as insignificant as a grain of sand compared to the evolution of organisms and the mysteries of the universe.
Zeng Mohuai’s face turned pale. For the first time in his life, he suddenly didn’t want to think so much. His head hurt.
“Or… you should talk to me about something else.”
Ye Shuo laughed, and then naturally mentioned some trivial matters.
Although Zeng Mohuai did not intend to do so, he did run the school very well after all. Ye Shuo paid close attention and found that there were more than 30 teachers in the school now. Among them, Master Zhu was Zeng Mohuai’s student, and the rest were basically former students of the school. After they finished their studies, they became teachers.
The entire school has a total of 23 classes, with 40 to 50 students in each class, which is similar to modern schools. In terms of number, it is not much different from several famous academies in Da Zhou. But it is still far from enough. Many families in the border areas are now trying their best to send their children to the school, hoping that their children can also go out of here. Therefore, the school has been expanding again and again, but it still cannot keep up with the speed of children being born.
After all, there are no effective contraceptive measures at present. It is normal for a family to have five or six children. In this case, how can a city with only one university and a few elementary schools be used?
“If it really doesn’t work, we can only open branch schools.” The border area can be used as a pilot project. With a basis, it will be more convincing in the future.
Zeng Mohuai was not stupid. After thinking about it for a while, he gradually realized what he meant.
“I’m afraid I have to remind you that aristocratic families are not that easy to deal with.” Zeng Mohuai himself was born into an aristocratic family, so he naturally knew the power of aristocratic families. There were many places that were even controlled tightly by aristocratic families behind the scenes.
Furthermore, how easy is it to completely open up knowledge? Paper is expensive, and pens and ink are not affordable for ordinary people.
Of course, this should not be a problem for him. The most important thing is that if he really wants to do this, even the people he promoted will most likely not agree.
The hunter hunted the tiger, took the tiger’s place, and gradually became the tiger himself.
“It doesn’t matter. We just need to resolve the matter while the little tigers are still not deeply rooted.”
“As for the noble families… we can’t just put up a target and ask them to focus their efforts on it. We have to think of a way to let them fight among themselves.”
Ye Shuo then lowered his voice and said something to Zeng Mohuai.
Then, Zeng Mohuai’s eyes changed.
He actually planned to use such a method, what a… sinister emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: General
chapters.content:
In the evening, Ye Shuo returned home.
Although Ye Shuo and Zeng Mohuai were chatting happily, it was still obvious that Zeng Mohuai had an unconcealable look of fatigue and old age on his face.
Life at the border is not as hard as in the capital. If you are exposed to the wind too much, you will naturally age faster.
As soon as Ye Shuo came out of the house, he ran into a middle-aged man. Ye Shuo immediately guessed this man’s identity.
“Master Zhu.”
“Your Majesty.” The middle-aged man was not as quick as Zeng Mohuai in bowing.
“Greetings to His Majesty, may His Majesty be well and safe.”
Before the middle-aged man could kneel down, he had just bent his knees when Ye Shuo helped him up.
Ye Shuo didn’t say much, just patted the middle-aged man on the shoulder and said, “Thank you for your hard work.”
These three words were plain, but Master Zhu felt jealous. After all, no matter how little fame and fortune he cared about, who wouldn’t want to be recognized for their hard work?“You’ve taught these children very well.”
It was already time to go home from school, but most of the children in front of him were orphans and were in no hurry to leave. Ye Shuo looked around and saw that the children in front of him seemed to be playing games, but this game was not ordinary. When Ye Shuo created that special team, he suddenly had an idea and sent some of the things here.
The group of children in front of me seem to be playing, but they are actually playing a confrontation game. All students are roughly divided into three teams. The content of the game is that each team must find ways to eliminate the other side while preventing themselves from being attacked. Some of them are responsible for digging trenches, some are responsible for transporting “weapons”, which are small stones covered with white lime, and some are responsible for attracting the enemy and leading people to launch sneak attacks.
If the group in front of me were not children, and the objects they used were not harmless branches and stones, this could be called a small battle.
In the eyes of the children, this might just be a form of entertainment, but in Ye Shuo’s eyes, it was not the case. After careful observation, he even saw that most of the children knew some basic boxing and kicking skills. The ones who learned well had extremely stable lower bodies, and it was obvious that they had been taught by famous masters. However, Ye Shuo had clearly observed carefully when he came here, and no matter whether it was Zeng Mohuai or the group of teachers like Master Zhu, none of them were particularly good at this.
These children’s behaviour is somewhat similar to that of General Xu.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but glance at Xu Kui who was standing beside him.
In the ancient environment without much entertainment and with life in danger, the skills learned by the children here were naturally more practical.
Seeing this, Prince Ding clearly understood what was happening.
“…You taught them?”
Xu Kui coughed lightly and said, “In reply to Prince Ding, my dream is to take over my father’s position and become a general. In addition, Master Zhu has many good talents. I think there may be people among them that I can use in the future, so…”
How can a general be successful without his own team? It is always better to have someone to help you than to fight alone.
But even if there is really no one to turn to, it doesn’t matter. Considering that they are classmates, Xu Kui will not be stingy.
Prince Ding understood what he heard, and then turned around and said, “Your Majesty, this kid has poached your people.”
Ye Shuo: “…”
Now that he is his cheap elder brother, he would probably suffocate to death if he doesn’t find trouble for a day.
Or maybe, Prince Ding finally found the fun that he had never discovered before.
Master Zhu, who was standing by, believed it and explained hastily, “The young general only has good intentions. Your Majesty, please understand.”
The Great Zhou and the State of Chen were often at odds with each other, and the situation was not stable. The people were always the unlucky ones. In this situation, the more you learn, the more power you will have to protect yourself. Even if you are running for your life, you have to run faster than others. Р
“…I know, Master Zhu, there’s no need to be nervous.” Ye Shuo glared at his cheap brother and took a deep breath.
“I am so happy that Young General Xu is so selfless, so how can I blame him?” No matter whose team they are, they are still subjects of the Great Zhou, right?
“By the way, I just saw that Master Zeng looked unwell. His illness…what did the doctor say?”
When Ye Shuo mentioned this, the atmosphere suddenly became gloomy.
Master Zhu was silent for a while, then said, “In reply to Your Majesty, the doctor said that I’m afraid you don’t have much time left.”
Calculating the time, Zeng Mohuai is almost eighty years old. Birth, ageing, sickness and death are the results that everyone must experience.
But Zeng Mohuai had worked hard for many years, and no matter what the other party’s original purpose was, Ye Shuo couldn’t bear it.
“After all, the doctors at the border have limited medical skills. Fortunately, I brought two imperial physicians with me on this march. When I return to the camp, I will send them over to have Master Zeng take a look. Then I will see what medicine the imperial physician recommends, and I will have someone send it over.”
Master Zhu knew that the relationship between the emperor and his teacher was just a transaction, so he didn’t hold out much hope. Who knew that the emperor would actually bring it up on his own initiative? How could he still remain calm?
Master Zhu also had no parents. He had been with Zeng Mohuai for decades, and their relationship had long surpassed that of his biological parents.
“Thank you, Your Majesty. Your Majesty is so kind. I will repay you with my own death!”
“Master Zhu, you are too serious.”
After Ye Shuo returned to the tent, he quickly sent the imperial physician as agreed.
In the next few days, Xu Kui tried his best to show off, but Ye Shuo didn’t mind someone showing off their strengths and abilities in front of him. He even wished there were more such people.
Xu Kui also saw this point, so he showed himself to the fullest. Good wine needs no bush to gain popularity. He finally found a mentor, and there was no way Xu Kui would let go of such an opportunity. He wanted to show off all his abilities. Anyway, if the emperor took a liking to him, he would naturally make arrangements in his mind, and the rest would not be something he could worry about.
The ancients were mostly reserved, and there were few people like Xu Kui. Especially in the eyes of General Xu, his grandson was more than just arrogant.
General Xu was so angry that he almost died, but with Prince Ding and the emperor protecting him, the old general had no way out.
How could my son give birth to such a shameless one!
Prince Ding’s sons and grandsons were not around, but he looked at this young man with a happy face.
“The emperor wants to take a bath. Go and get some hot water.”
It happened that Prince Ding came out of the tent and notified him. After Prince Ding left, Xu Kui, who was left behind, was dumbfounded.
This… should I do this myself or not?
It would be quite awkward to do it, and it was Prince Ding who personally ordered it. If he didn’t do it, it would be nothing if he thought about it carefully. Xu Kui had seen too many such things in the military camp.
In the end, Xu Kui gritted his teeth and went in alone carrying four buckets of water.
“Your Majesty, I am here to help you bathe.”
Ye Shuo rubbed his sore neck and was about to take off his clothes when he heard such a voice. Scared, Ye Shuo quickly tied his belt again.
Just now, Ye Shuo and Prince Ding had just read the secret report from the State of Chen. There was no one left in the tent, and Prince Ding took the initiative to take the job, saying that he would help him call someone to bring in hot water. As a result… the person he called turned out to be Xu Kui?
Ye Shuo cleared his throat and said hurriedly through the curtain: “Pour the water, adjust the water temperature, and then go out. I am not used to being served when I take a bath.”
Xu Kui was still struggling with this, but when he heard these words out of the blue, he suddenly felt as if the clouds had cleared and the sky was shining.
“yes.”
He poured all the four buckets of hot water in his hand into the pot, tested the water temperature, and found it was not enough, so he brought in four more buckets and poured in two more buckets. He felt that this time it was about enough. After Xu Kui finished his report and got permission, he went out happily.
I feel like… He is still a child.
Ye Shuo laughed. After a while, when there was no movement outside, he walked out of the inner tent. Looking at the two extra buckets of hot water and one bucket of cold water on the ground, Ye Shuo was thinking in his heart that although he was young, he was still thoughtful in doing things, not as wild as he appeared. He just didn’t know whether his performance on the battlefield would be as good as it is now.
And such an opportunity will soon arrive.
After resting for seven days, the soldiers finally received the order to attack.
During these seven days, the State of Chen sent envoys several times, but they were all rejected by Ye Shuo. According to the secret reports received earlier, the State of Chen seemed to have chosen to protect the army. The special forces sent out by Ye Shuo and ambushed in various parts of the State of Chen said that they rarely saw trucks escorting food to the disaster area, not to mention that the State of Chen was now overwhelmed and could not send any extra troops to various places to rescue people.
Not only the Great Zhou, but even Beiting is eyeing them covetously. Beiting is short of food and grass this year, so it is inevitable that they will take advantage of the situation to rob when necessary.
There is nothing wrong with Chen’s choice, but since they chose to protect the army, they would inevitably lose their own people.
What’s more, corruption is rampant, and even the Zhou Dynasty was not immune to it. If the State of Chen can make up its mind to make a decisive decision, it will be fine. If not, things will probably become more troublesome.
Now is the best time.
The next morning, Ye Shuo led the three armies, ready to go, and General Xu was among them.
Just when Xu Kui was hesitating about how to deal with the miasma in Chen State, he saw that the emperor and his men actually took a road that Xu Kui had never walked before.
Although Xu Kui was confused, he did not dare to ask too much and just obeyed the order according to military regulations.
Two days later, after hearing Chen Di’s words, Xu Kui realised that they seemed to have successfully crossed the poisonous miasma.
Xu Kui was just a small soldier, his rank was not high enough and he was short of manpower. No matter how smart he was, he could not be truly omnipotent. Looking at General Xu standing next to him, it seemed as if he had expected this and his expression did not change at all.
As a general guarding the border, it is basic for General Xu to keep his eyes and ears open in all directions.
After realising what was happening, Xu Kui couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
Prince Ding, who was standing by, raised his eyebrows when he saw this: “How do you think your grandfather got to this position?”
From the second rank, most people will never be able to sit in this position in their lifetime. When Emperor Jingwen was in power, the entire line of the Duke of Zhen was basically cleared out, leaving only General Xu. How could General Xu not have some real skills?
“You, you still have a lot to learn.”
The moment he finished speaking, Xu Kui couldn’t help but look at his grandfather.
Noticing his gaze, General Xu couldn’t help but cough lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Sick
chapters.content:
“Stop!”
About a few hours later, Dou Pan, the general of the State of Chen who led his troops to support, keenly sensed something and raised his hand suddenly.
Although everything seemed calm all around, Dou Pan stopped in time out of his general’s intuition.
Almost at the moment the words fell, the soldiers stopped.
But it was obviously too late at this time.
A few small stones rolled down, and then there was the roaring boulder.
“There’s an ambush, retreat quickly!”
No matter how fast Dou Pan reacted, there were so many soldiers around him that it was impossible for him to avoid them one by one. As soon as he finished speaking, many people were smashed into meat paste by the huge rocks falling from the sky.
Then came the shouting and killing.
“Go!”At this time, Dou Pan no longer knew that he was ambushed, so he was no longer a general.
At this time, Dou Pan still didn’t understand why this group of people from the Great Zhou were so familiar with the terrain of their Chen State.
It is not surprising that the three countries of Chen, Zhou and Beiting have rough topographic maps of each other, but this is too detailed.
However, now is not the time to talk about this. Dou Pan suffered such a big loss before he even arrived at the place. He did not dare to fight at all and hurriedly led his men to retreat in a panic.
Fortunately, General Tan at the border came to the rescue in time, but when he arrived at Chenju Pass and looked at his remaining troops and waited for the casualties to be counted, Dou Pan could not help but tremble with anger.
Dou Pan was not stupid. When he came here, he saw the bare mountains around him. Now that he had calmed down, how could he not know what had happened?
“May I ask General Tan, where are the trees on the mountain? If General Tan does not explain it clearly to me today, please do not blame me for being rude. I will write a letter to Your Majesty tomorrow to criticise General Tan.”
General Tan was a general guarding the border, and he cannot escape the blame for such a huge mistake that occurred under his rule!
General Tan also knew that he had caused a big disaster, but this was not what he wanted, and he did not expect things to turn out like this.
Especially this earthquake, it came too suddenly.
General Tan did not dare to hide anything. He gritted his teeth and told the whole truth.
“General Dou, to be honest, I discovered this several years ago.” With so many trees floating down the river every day, it would be hard for even General Tan not to notice it. Ꞧ
Dou Pan was startled, then became furious: “Since you discovered it, why didn’t you stop it?”
General Tan said bitterly: “It’s not that I don’t want to, it’s just that… I can’t control it!”
“I have beaten them and killed them, but the logging is still going on despite all the prohibitions. It’s nothing but money that attracts people.”
“We killed them today, and they calmed down for a while, but they came back again not long after. There is no end to this kind of thing. As long as the Great Zhou keeps giving us money, it will be impossible to truly exterminate them, especially… this matter involves the military.”
When Dou Pan heard this, he became even more furious.
“Where is the collaborator now? This general wants to see him now.”
General Tan: “General Dou, to be honest, that man was one of my generals. He was afraid that the matter would be exposed two hours ago, so he committed suicide out of fear of the crime.”
The moment he finished speaking, Dou Pan turned around abruptly, his eyes suddenly becoming sharp.
General Tan’s expression remained unchanged, still filled with grief and regret.
“Now that the evidence is solid, please move forward, General Dou.”
But actually, what’s so good about this? As early as when General Tan said this, the matter had already been decided.
General Tan has been guarding the border for many years and has a deep foundation. It is really not appropriate to conflict with him in the current situation.
Dou Pan gradually calmed down.
General Tan was relieved when he saw this, and handed over the evidence he had collected one by one: “My subordinates privately gave and received the evidence, and as a general, I cannot escape the blame.”
The man in front of him said nice things, but in fact they were just polite words. Dou Pan had nothing to say.
The Great Zhou has now successfully entered the territory of the State of Chen. The situation is urgent, and I am afraid that the logging will have to stop here.
In just an hour or two, the two of them acted as if nothing had happened and put the matter aside without mentioning it again.
On the other hand, what Chen Guo didn’t know was that the people Ye Shuo had sent out to carry out the mission had already been lurking in various places.
From a distance, he used a telescope to observe the large army and the leader in front of him. The two small teams that were ambushing in the nearby mountains and forests appear one after another.
When several people suddenly jumped out from the seemingly peaceful bushes, Xu Kui was almost scared to death. He subconsciously drew the sword from his waist.
“Who is it?!”
“Protect the emperor!”
The specially made camouflage uniforms are simply the perfect hiding equipment in the mountains and forests. Their colour is similar to the surrounding grass and trees, so people with slightly poor eyesight cannot distinguish whether they are tree shadows or human shadows. Even people with excellent eyesight find it difficult to spot them from a distance.
“Stop it!”
“Don’t be nervous, we are on the same side.”
After hearing what the emperor said, General Xu and others on the side gradually relaxed.
As for Xu Kui, he reacted instantly. Such a strange dress, such a unique temperament and posture, could it be… could it be someone from that team?
If Xu Kui was just yearning before, now he was drooling. Especially the crossbow on the other party’s waist, which he had never seen before, made Xu Kui’s heartburn.
Xu Kui dared to swear on his years of experience immersed in weapons that this thing was definitely more powerful than any bow and crossbow he had ever seen, especially the bowstring on it, which Xu Kui had never seen before. It was not made of cow or sheep tendons, but it looked extremely tough.
The visitor did not hesitate, suppressed his excitement and bowed, and said hurriedly: “Your Majesty, the road ahead is blocked, please bring your people and follow me here.”
It turned out that this road was blocked, so someone was left behind to remind people.
After another half day, Ye Shuo finally arrived at a small border town with his soldiers.
The town didn’t even have a decent guard, so how could it be a match for the Great Zhou? It didn’t take long for the whole town to be under control from top to bottom.
The officials in charge of the town naturally could not stay, but the people did not care. Without a leader, the remaining people became a mess.
Noticing the fear and panic in the eyes of the people, Ye Shuo said nothing, but turned around and told his soldiers not to disturb the people.
“Especially the elderly, the weak, women and children. Once discovered, they will be killed without mercy!”
Ye Shuo looked around, and as his eyes gave a signal, all the soldiers felt a chill in their hearts.
After a night of rest, Ye Shuo led his men to continue forward the next morning. As for the small town, it was naturally taken over by the people left behind by Ye Shuo.
The scene of the mayor’s tragic death was still fresh in people’s minds, so the people in the town naturally did not dare to resist. In fact, to them, it didn’t matter who the ruler was. As long as he was not a cruel and bloodthirsty butcher, whoever could feed them would be the emperor.
Although the mayor is gone now, as long as the people under him do not resist, nothing will happen. Under such circumstances, the people’s resistance sentiment is naturally not so high, and they continue to farm honestly as before.
Now the State of Chen had just experienced a great disaster. The relief money and grain from the imperial court had not arrived for a long time. Two whole months had passed. In desperation, the people in many places could not survive any longer and had to pick up their hoes. But when they finally overturned the local county magistrate and rushed into the warehouse where the imperial court stored grain, they found that there was not much rice left in the granary. When they dug up the outermost layer, they found that it was all piled up sand. However, how could the hunger in their stomachs be filled by sand?
Under such circumstances, the soldiers of the Great Zhou led by Ye Shuo naturally made rapid progress. As long as they had food to eat, the people of the State of Chen could also become the people of the Great Zhou.
As for General Tan and Dou Pan, they were naturally defeated one after another.
However, Ye Shuo was not completely defenceless. No matter what, these people in front of him were all people of the State of Chen. Although Ye Shuo gave them food, he only ensured that they would not starve to death. As for the rest… he would have to wait until the State of Chen was truly conquered.
Although many people of the Chen State were able to escape from the predicament thanks to the army of the Great Zhou, they suffered from hunger and satiety in the following days. Under such circumstances, even if someone wanted to cause trouble, they were really helpless and could not cause any major disturbance.
In addition, there are now spies all over the State of Chen, who are torturing the people of Chen almost to the point of madness.
“Okay, now it’s your turn to shine.”
General Xu is now mostly on duty and can no longer lead the troops. Things like encirclement and surprise attacks and food robbery are basically left to his subordinates.
Now General Wei and others were negotiating with General Tan and Dou Pan from the State of Chen, and the situation was at a stalemate. After a little thought, Ye Shuo’s eyes fell on Xu Kui.
Based on Ye Shuo’s understanding of his abilities during this period, he judged that he should be able to lead the troops to rob the food and grass sent by the State of Chen.
Xu Kui also knew very well that this was both an opportunity given to him by the emperor and a test set by the emperor.
If things are done well, then everything will be fine. If they fail…
“Don’t worry, Your Majesty. I will do my best.”
Ye Shuo didn’t pay much attention to his promise. Xu Kui took a deep breath and left with the five hundred people outside the tent.
At the same time, in Shangjing City——
Yao Zhi had finally finished dealing with all the memorials on the table and was just about to go back to Chengming Palace to find Yongning, Dingning and Anning. Calculating the time, it was almost time for the two little princesses to finish school.
As a result, before Yao Zhi could take any action, she received a message from Wu Yi saying that Prime Minister He was ill.
Yao Zhi’s first reaction was, could He Xiang be trying to do something behind her back?
After Yao Zhi carefully asked Wu Yi, she realised that it was not the case. He Xiang was really sick.
He Xiang has worked hard all his life, and now he is suddenly idle. It is like a machine that has been wound up. The energy is gone, and all kinds of illnesses naturally come to him.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but be a little stunned.
Yao Zhi then realised that she couldn’t let He Xiang get into trouble at this time. Putting aside his contributions, He Xiang hadn’t even seen the day when Xiao Shuo would unify the world. Yao Zhi thought about it and decided to go to He’s house in person.
After the morning court session ended the next day, a phoenix chariot stopped in front of the former prime minister’s residence, now the He Mansion.
At that time, Prime Minister He was bedridden. His first reaction after hearing about this was to refuse. Prime Minister He had not yet forgotten how he desperately tried to stop the emperor when he wanted the queen to be regent. Under such circumstances, how could Prime Minister He dare to let her treat him!
However, while Prime Minister He was thinking of a countermeasure, Yao Zhi’s phoenix carriage was already approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Injured
chapters.content:
“Greetings to Her Majesty the Queen, may Her Majesty be well and safe.”
When Yao Zhi approached, there was a chorus of greetings. No matter if they were maids or servants, they were all extremely polite, worthy of being people in the prime minister’s mansion.
Yao Zhi paused, shouted, and went straight to He Xiang’s yard.
“Quick, stop her!”
He Xiang shouted subconsciously, and the eldest master beside him hurriedly took action.
The fifth young lady of the He family, who was also standing guard by the bed, couldn’t help but frown when she saw this. She felt that her great-grandfather seemed to be a little mean.
No matter what happened between the two of them before, the Queen would never harm him at this time.
But in the end, the fifth young lady didn’t say anything. She just looked outside with a slightly tense look.
On the other side, as soon as Yao Zhi stepped into the courtyard, the eldest son came out in a panic. Seeing the extremely noble and elegant woman in front of him, the eldest son, who was nearly sixty years old, lowered his head quickly after just one glance, not daring to look again.
Because the emperor went on military campaigns, the Empress acted as regent on both occasions. As time went on, Yao Zhi’s power became more and more obvious.Nowadays, anyone who has dealt with her will no longer regard her as the helpless woman of the world several years ago.
Then the eldest son hurriedly bowed and said, “I didn’t know that the queen had arrived. I am sorry for not coming to greet you. I hope the queen will forgive me.”
“This place is humble and I am afraid I am neglecting Your Majesty. I hope Your Majesty will move to the main hall.”
Yao Zhi pondered for a moment and figured it out. She didn’t hesitate and said, “I came here today just to visit Old Master He in your house.”
The eldest son’s heart tightened, and then he remembered his father’s instructions. He almost gritted his teeth and spoke: “In reply to your majesty, I shouldn’t have stopped you from coming. It’s just that my father is seriously ill right now, and I’m afraid he will effect you. Please take care of your health…”
“If the queen contracted the disease in He’s mansion, I, the humble officials, would be held responsible even if I were to die.”
Yao Zhi didn’t take it seriously: “I personally went to the epidemic area that year. What’s the point of talking about Old Master He’s minor illness?”
The eldest son suddenly remembered that the reason why the plague was able to subside in time was due to the contribution of the current Queen.
The eldest son wanted to say something when he saw the woman with a phoenix hairpin in front of him glance at him. The eldest son was startled and changed his words in an instant.
“In that case, please ask the Queen to follow me.”
“Thank you, Queen, for your consideration and for taking the trouble to visit me personally. I am very grateful to you.”
This bastard is really useless.
Old Master He watched helplessly as his eldest son started out arguing with reason, but quickly changed his tune later. The whole process took only a few words, and he suddenly felt a lump in his throat.
When the eldest master pushed the door open and Yao Zhi stepped in, He Xiang had no choice but to force himself to salute with the support of the fifth lady.
“I pay my respects to Her Majesty the Queen. May Her Majesty be well and at peace.”
Now that Old Master He has lost his official status, he is no longer a subject of the Great Zhou.
However, before his knees hit the ground, the senior palace maid beside Yao Zhi helped him up with great tact.
“Master He, there is no need to be so polite. I came here today specifically to visit you.”
Not only did Yao Zhi come herself, she also brought two imperial doctors.
Since Prime Minister He resigned, the highest official position in the entire He family is the fifth-rank official held by the eldest son. Naturally, he is not qualified to invite the imperial physician from the palace.
After the two imperial doctors had examined him, Yao Zhi, seeing Old Master He’s flushed face, very naturally took a handkerchief and placed it on the old man’s arm, then reached out to examine him.
This, this, this, how shameful! Especially when the other party is a woman whom he has always looked down upon.
Old Master He is an eighty-year-old man, and now he feels uneasy.
The results of the examination were similar to what Yao Zhi had guessed beforehand. Once a person gets older, all kinds of problems will begin to emerge, but overall it is not a big deal.
Yao Zhi first breathed a sigh of relief, then noticed that Old Master He’s expression was not right. Combined with the eldest master’s attitude just now, what else did Yao Zhi not understand?
I’m afraid I don’t know what Old Master He is thinking at this moment.
Yao Zhi had originally planned to ask the two imperial doctors to take charge, but now she suddenly gave up the idea.
“Bring me my silver needle.”
Hearing this voice, the two imperial doctors were startled at first, but the senior palace maid beside them reacted very quickly and hurriedly took the wooden box that the young eunuch had been carrying all the way.
“Is this…” Not good…
He understood her intention instantly. The eldest son bravely said a few words, and then he saw the queen in front of him holding such a thick needle and stabbing it into his father’s body through his clothes.
The eldest son felt his scalp tingling, and even the fifth lady beside him couldn’t help swallowing.
Old Master He didn’t even dare to move at this moment, and soon he was sweating all over.
Upon seeing this, the two imperial doctors nearby immediately looked away and pretended they saw nothing.
However, in just a short time, Old Master He was pricked like a hedgehog by Yao Zhi. Only then did Yao Zhi slowly exhale, and then began to wash her hands in the basin of water.
“This needle is unique to our sect. It can only be removed after half an hour. It should be used once a day until Old Master He recovers.”
After hearing this, Old Master He felt that she was taking revenge on him.
Yao Zhi still had other government affairs to attend to, so it was inconvenient for her to stay for long. She casually instructed the doctor employed by the He Mansion to remove the needle. She didn’t even wait for half an hour, and was ready to take her people away while everyone in the He Mansion was struggling and hesitant to speak.
The eldest son was anxiously running around, while the fifth daughter calmed down and said, “Thank you, Queen.” on the way to send Yao Zhi off.
The fifth young lady figured it out. If the queen really wanted to do something, there was no need to go to such great lengths.
Yao Zhi paused for a moment after hearing this, then spoke up, “Your thanks are a little too early. Aren’t you afraid that I will tamper with the needle? Look at your great grandfather’s expression.”
“The Empress is kind hearted. Even though my great-grandfather once had a disagreement with her, now that he has resigned from his post, I’m sure the Empress will not deliberately make things difficult for him.”
Even if the Queen Mother really had some resentment in her heart, at this point, she would not bother with her great-grandfather anymore.
Because…it’s not worth it.
Yao Zhi stopped suddenly: “Your name.”
At first, the Fifth Miss didn’t react at all. What did the Queen mean, but she still spoke subconsciously: “To answer your question, my surname is He, and my name is Panfeng.”
Hope for the wind…
Yao Zhi remembered almost instantly that she was the talented woman famous in the capital. The popular “Spring Wishes” and “Spring Night Flowers and Birds” were created by her.
No wonder among so many people in the He Mansion, she is the only junior who can serve the old man of the He family.
It is rumoured that this girl has been known for her talent since she was a child. When Old Master He was still the prime minister, he even expressed his regret in public why his great-granddaughter was not a boy. But I don’t know whether this is a rumour or a true story.
Yao Zhi thought for a moment, and suddenly said, “I am still short of a female official by my side. I wonder if Miss He is willing to enter the palace?”
Female official?
Hearing such a slightly unfamiliar word, He Panfeng didn’t even have time to hesitate, her mouth quickly surpassed her brain and gave an answer: “Thank you for your kindness, Queen. I am willing to do so.”
Yao Zhi nodded without saying anything else. She stepped on the pedal of the carriage and entered the carriage in an instant.
“Let
“Miss He, this is the token to enter the palace. After the morning court tomorrow, you will take the token and someone will take you to the Qinzheng Palace.”
Before the girl in front of her could react, the senior palace maid stuffed the sign into her hand and trotted after her.
He Panfeng was in a trance for a moment and subconsciously put the token into his sleeve. He returned to the courtyard where his great-grandfather was. After a while, the doctor in the mansion hurriedly removed the needle. He Panfeng then discovered that after the ordeal, his great-grandfather had sweated and seemed to be more energetic. His originally sallow complexion was now a little rosier than before.
At this moment He Panfeng realised what she had just agreed to. He Panfeng covered her sleeves, her heart beating wildly out of control.
In the blink of an eye, half a year passed. Every ten days or half a month, there would be war reports coming from the border. From being terrified in the beginning, everyone has now become accustomed to it.
Looking at the map hanging in the Qinzheng Hall, if I am not mistaken, Xiao Shuo should have already reached here.
Yao Zhi pointed in the distance and suddenly realised that most of the territory of Chen State had already fallen.
Yao Zhi couldn’t help but take a deep breath, her heart filled with excitement.
At the same time, Ye Shuo, who was in Chen State, finally encountered new troubles.
General Tan and Dou Pan of the State of Chen had been defeated by their cousins, General Wei Xiao and Xu Kui respectively three months ago. Among them, Xu Kui, the grandson of General Xu Lao, became famous in one battle and is now the fifth-rank General Dingyuan under Ye Shuo. Dou Pan’s death directly promoted Xu Kui three levels, from a small minion to the middle level in one breath. Now he is a member of the emperor’s family. Old General Xu could only watch and was unable to do anything about him.
Young people are bound to become arrogant after they succeed, and even Xu Kui is no exception. After killing Dou Pan, Xu Kui was too radical in his flanking attack and almost wiped out his entire army. Ye Shuo did not take sides. If Xu Kui had not made up for his mistake later, Ye Shuo would have almost fired him. Since then, Xu Kui never dared to act recklessly again, and he grew up at a speed visible to the naked eye.
But now Ye Shuo met a person of the same type as General Xu, General Huo Rong of the State of Chen, who was also very good at defending the city. Ye Shuo and his soldiers had not been able to make any progress for more than two months. Even with sufficient food and grass, the soldiers were still exhausted.
What’s more troublesome is that during the siege, even Ye Shuo suffered serious injuries at his hands.
By chance, an arrow hit his shoulder.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Pulling Out the Arrow
chapters.content:
Prince Ding was originally sitting in the tent, drinking tea leisurely, and did not take this attack seriously at all.
Until there was a burst of noise outside, Prince Ding was stunned for a moment, then he looked up and saw his younger brother walking towards him from a distance surrounded by a group of guards.
Just as Prince Ding was about to speak, he saw the shining arrow stuck in his chest, and his expression changed immediately.
“What’s going on?”
“Where is the imperial physician? Where is he now?!” Ye Shuo was already feeling dizzy due to excessive blood loss, and he felt even more dizzy after he was called like that.
“…Brother, please stop shouting. The imperial physician and the wound doctor are on their way.”
The moment Ye Shuo finished speaking, two imperial physicians and the army’s wound doctors rushed over.
“Greetings to His Majesty, may His Majesty be well and healthy.”
Prince Ding was anxious when he saw this: “It’s already this late, why are you still greeting me? Why don’t you two come over here quickly!”
The two imperial physicians and the wound doctor were busy.With the help of the people beside him, Ye Shuo slowly untied his armour, revealing the undergarment underneath. The undergarment was now stained with blood, which was constantly flowing down. It looked extremely terrifying, and the expressions of several doctors changed drastically.
It took almost half an hour to retreat here from the battlefield. Logically, the bleeding should have stopped. Even if it hadn’t stopped, it shouldn’t have been so much…
The military’s wound doctors were more skilled in treating such injuries. While the doctor was quickly cleaning Ye Shuo’s wound, he was frantically thinking about something in his mind.
Ye Shuo seemed to know what he was thinking, and said with difficulty: “This is a specially made arrowhead, so the bleeding can’t be stopped.”
As soon as he finished speaking, the guard beside him hurriedly took out an arrow pulled out from a dead soldier.
The wound doctor had been on the battlefield for a long time, so he could naturally tell the unusualness of the arrow at a glance.
There are several blood grooves engraved on the tip of the arrow, and there are tiny hooks on it. Once it pierces the body, blood will flow out along the blood grooves. What’s more difficult is that because of the barbs, if you want to pull it out, you have to dig out the entire piece of flesh connecting the chest to the shoulder. Otherwise, the torn wound will be uneven and extremely difficult to heal. Repeated suppuration during healing will also cost the emperor’s life.
On the battlefield, the wound doctor has seen too many such things.
The wound doctor gritted his teeth and made a prompt decision: “The only solution now is to find a way to make the arrow pass through His Majesty’s shoulder.” This may seem scary, but it actually causes the least damage.
But the key question is, who is going to do this? The two imperial doctors and the wound doctor certainly don’t have the courage to do this. Even if they do, they don’t have the ability to do it.
“The person who takes action must be quick-eyed and quick-handed, and must have enough strength. Otherwise, if there is even a slight deviation, His Majesty will have to endure even greater pain.” The wound doctor is slightly stronger than the imperial physician who is weak and cannot even tie a chicken, but he is still a doctor after all. He cannot compare to the soldiers who are really living on the edge of a knife.
It is easy to say that the arrow should pass through the chest, but it is extremely difficult to do it.
Xu Kui, who was standing by, was about to speak when he saw the emperor trying hard to look at his adopted brother.
Prince Ding: “…”
Prince Ding took a deep breath and finally rolled up his sleeves.
“Let me make it clear first, don’t blame me if it hurts.”
Prince Ding came from a military background and was strong enough, so it was absolutely appropriate for him to do the job.
Ye Shuo was extremely nervous, but under so many eyes he still had to pretend to be indifferent. He held a towel between his upper and lower teeth, nodded, and signalled him to move.
At this time, Ye Shuo almost knew that the reason why Guan Gong didn’t even frown when he was scraping his bones to treat the poison was probably not because it didn’t hurt, but because he couldn’t cry out in pain. Even if it hurt, he had to pretend that it didn’t hurt.
Prince Ding was quite looking forward to it at first. After all, it would be a pity to miss such a good opportunity.
But when the doctor tore open his brother’s underwear, completely revealing the wound inside, Prince Ding could no longer laugh.
Prince Ding was experienced and could see clearly that the arrow was only a few inches away from his heart, which was extremely dangerous. If it was a few inches lower, or if he dodged a little slower, the consequences would be disastrous.
And his younger brother has been spoiled since childhood and should not have to suffer like this. If the emperor saw it, he would be extremely heartbroken.
It’s a pity that his father is no longer with us, so he has to bear this kind of suffering alone.
“Brother, what are you standing there for—”
Ye Shuo was already in so much pain that he could hardly speak, and he was extremely nervous. However, the expected severe pain did not come for a long time. He could not help but open his mouth to urge, but the moment he opened his mouth, he heard a light “puff” sound, and the arrow pierced through Ye Shuo’s flesh and showed its head on his back.
At this moment, Ye Shuo almost fainted from the pain.
Prince Ding took the scissors, cut the arrow body very skillfully, and then pulled out the arrowhead completely in a lightning speed.
With a “ding-ling” sound, the arrow fell on the table beside him.
Ye Shuo’s expression twisted for a moment, but before everyone looked over, he forced himself to be rational and returned to his usual calm self.
Everyone’s attention was on the emperor in front of them, and no one noticed that Prince Ding was secretly wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.
I feel like pulling out an arrow for my brother is much more tiring than when he was injured and had his arrow pulled out…
The imperial physician and the wound doctor rushed forward to check, and saw that Prince Ding did not disappoint them. Such a big movement did not hurt the emperor’s bones, so they breathed a sigh of relief.
For a moment, Ye Shuo really wanted to ask them for a packet of Ma Fei San, and then have a good sleep. Maybe the pain would go away when he woke up?
However, Ye Shuo knew in his heart that it was not possible now.
The news of his serious injury must have spread among the army by now, which must be another blow to the already low morale. Ye Shuo thought about it and did not try to cover it up. He just put on a coat and went out. If you look closely, you can see that blood is still oozing from his shoulder.
General Xu and others subconsciously wanted to stop them, but when they saw Ye Shuo’s eyes, they retreated.
In the end, Ye Shuo didn’t even know how he got back to the tent. He only knew that he lost consciousness as soon as he stepped in.
Ye Shuo held on for so long, and after he had almost resolved the problem, he finally couldn’t bear it anymore.
Prince Ding, who was standing by, secretly pulled the imperial physician in, and only after confirming that his brother had simply fainted from the pain did he suddenly relax.
Xu Kui, who stayed outside, suppressed his surging emotions. After the emperor left, he gritted his teeth and shouted to his subordinates, “If the emperor insults me, I will die. As your majesty’s subjects, how can we allow Huo Rong, that villain, to be so rampant?”
Of course not.
Especially since Ye Shuo has been here for more than half a year, almost all the soldiers have seen him from afar. A mysterious and powerful emperor will naturally attract many people to follow him.
What’s more, Huo Rong was clearly attacking by surprise!
I don’t know who shouted first, but soon everyone couldn’t help but shout.
“revenge!”
“revenge!”
“revenge!”
Watching this scene from afar, General Xu felt extremely complicated.
On the other side, in the Qinzheng Hall, Yao Zhi, who was sleeping, suddenly woke up.
He Panfeng, who was standing by, was startled and hurriedly put down the pen and ink in her hand: “Madam, what’s wrong with you?”
Yao Zhi then realised that she had been too tired in recent days and accidentally fell asleep while marking documents.
However, this was not what she cared about. What Yao Zhi cared about was the dream she had just had. She dreamed of a very terrifying scene. Her husband was surrounded by the Chen army and attacked from both sides. Then, the iron hoofs of the Chen army fell heavily without mercy…
Yao Zhi let out a long breath, telling herself that she was just dreaming, but her heart could not calm down.
However, Yao Zhi did not dare to say it out loud. Now there was only her mother and Ding Ning and the other children left in the palace. If she lost her composure, what would they do?
Yao Zhi took a deep breath and forced herself to calm down. However, this was only temporary after all. As long as she didn’t see Ye Shuo, Yao Zhi would not be able to really let go.
Another half a month passed like this, and when the news of Ye Shuo’s injury reached the capital, Yao Zhi could no longer sit still.
At that time, Chen State——
After seven or eight days of rest, although the wound on Ye Shuo’s shoulder had not yet healed, he could move freely.
If this happened in modern times, Ye Shuo would have to stay in the hospital for ten days or half a month until he recovered from his injuries before being discharged, or he would have to invite a private doctor to his home to enjoy professional treatment.
But aren’t there any such conditions now? So many soldiers are still waiting for his orders, especially the crucial Huandu in front of him, no matter what, he must take it down.
As long as Huandu is captured, the iron hoof of the Great Zhou can truly march straight into the heart of the Chen State.
Ye Shuo wiped his face fiercely. After leaving the tent, he couldn’t help but look at General Wei and Xu Kui beside him: “Have you done everything I told you to do?”
General Wei and Xu Kui answered almost in unison: “Your Majesty, everything is ready.”
Ye Shuo nodded, said nothing, and then got on the horse.
About an hour later, looking at the Great Zhou Emperor who was still full of energy in the crowd, Huo Rong on the city wall almost broke the halberd in his hand.
In recent days, there have been all kinds of news. Some say that the emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty was seriously injured and bled to death due to the arrow he shot. Others say that the emperor not only did not die, but was able to get out of bed even after the arrow was pulled out that day.
Although Huo Rong also felt that his arrow should not have hit the vital point, he still couldn’t help feeling disappointed when he saw the emperor of the Great Zhou today.
The dog emperor is not dead, so this battle still has to be fought.
Just when Huo Rong was about to make another move, he heard the young man who killed General Dou Pan Dou holding something and shouting, “Wait a minute, General Huo, look at what this is.”
After he finished speaking, he saw many ragged people walking out from the foot of the mountains on both sides. Under the urging of Zhou Jun, they had to move towards the tall city wall of Huandu little by little.
Perhaps because they have experienced too much in the past few months, these people look extremely numb, like puppets.
On the tower, someone shouted out loud, “I am a citizen of the State of Chen, General Huo. I am a citizen of the State of Chen!”
Huo Rong was startled, and then his heart trembled violently.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: Cruelty
chapters.content:
“That dog emperor wouldn’t want to…”
Suddenly, they thought of an extremely terrifying possibility, and everyone on the city wall fell silent.
Huo Rong almost broke his teeth.
“mean!”
But at the same time, Huo Rong also knew that there was no such thing as fair or unfair on the battlefield. There was only winning and losing.
So even if the dog emperor used the people of Chen to threaten me, I would be helpless.
The other side.
Prince Ding was also startled. He turned his head and asked hurriedly, “You don’t want to…”
Prince Ding has been leading the army for ten years and has used all kinds of tricks. It’s not that he is deliberately doubtful, but Huandu has been under siege for a long time, and as time goes on, it is no longer a problem that can be solved by ordinary methods.
The most important thing is that General Xu had said before that although General Huo of the State of Chen was the most marginalised in the State of Chen, he also loved the people the most, so it was understandable that my younger brother could come up with this idea.Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo neither admitted nor denied it.
“I want to do something with the people.” But it’s not as despicable as he thought.
By the time the people finally arrived at the battlefield one after another, Huo Rong had already quietly prepared for Emperor Zhou to order the shooting of the people of Chen State and force him to surrender.
However, to Huo Rong’s surprise, the dog emperor on the opposite side did not seem to have such an intention.
When the group of people were forced to the city gate, Huo Rong finally realised that the dog emperor was unwilling to do bloodthirsty things, not because he was kind, but because he had a better choice –
The people of Chen State should have been supported by the court of Chen State. Why do they always have to be supported by the Zhou State?
As for whether Chen Guo is willing to support it, that is Chen Guo’s own problem.
It is obvious that the current Huandu simply cannot afford to support so many people. If they are allowed in, Huandu, which is already short of food, will be even more difficult to sustain. The dog emperor has a team under his command, hiding in the mountains and forests of various places in Chen State. They are elusive and have very well-informed information, so it is extremely difficult to transport food and grass from the capital. If more people are allowed in under this circumstance, I am afraid that it will not take long before the entire Huandu will be eaten up. What should we do then? ȑ
But if we don’t take them… once this news gets into the city, it will definitely cause riots.
The soldiers defending the city today can sacrifice the civilians outside for Huandu, but who knows if the defenders will not sacrifice them for Huandu tomorrow? Even ordinary people understand the principle of “the lips and teeth are cold”.
So the only solution now is…
“The dog emperor used the soldiers of the Great Zhou to impersonate the people of our Chen State and disrupt the morale of our army. His intentions are sinister and he deserves death. We must not let the dog emperor succeed.”
“All soldiers, listen to my orders. Kill them!”
The moment he finished speaking, Huo Rong suddenly looked at the deputy general beside him.
The deputy general also looked at him.
“I know that you are kind hearted, General. I’m afraid that the dog emperor also knows your character, so he came up with such a plan. But now is not the time to be soft-hearted, General!”
Then the deputy general lowered his voice again: “General, whether you can get out of your current predicament depends on this time.”
But are we going to kill all these civilians?
Huo Rong lowered his head, a fierce struggle flashing in his eyes.
On the other side, Ye Shuo could not help but frown as he watched the soldiers of the State of Chen on the tower raising their bows and arrows. Just when he thought that Huo Rong’s so-called benevolence was just empty talk, he heard a slight “creaking” sound from afar, and the gate of Huandu was opened a crack.
Almost instantly, Ye Shuo felt that the soldiers of the Great Zhou around him were ready to make a move.
If we could take advantage of this opportunity and rush into Huandu in one fell swoop…
Huo Rong also sensed the commotion in the distance and subconsciously became alert.
However, what surprised Huo Rong even more was that the dog emperor on the opposite side did not seem to be in a hurry. He watched the dog emperor sitting on the horse, slightly raised his hand towards everyone, and then everyone stopped immediately.
