“There’s no need to be so anxious. We are so far away from the other side. Even if we charge on horseback, the gates of Huandu will be closed by the time we arrive.”
Then there are the civilians. Once the siege begins, with guns and arrows flying everywhere, they will inevitably become cannon fodder because they are powerless. So it’s better to just give up.
“I don’t want to provoke the people of Chen to resist yet.”
In ancient times, the common people could not read, so how could they talk about patriotism? The people were ignorant, and as long as the knife did not fall on them and as long as the people had a bite to eat, they would never reach the point where everyone was a soldier.
What Ye Shuo has to do is to never let them unite against the outside world, and try not to hurt the people if possible.
After waiting for more than an hour, the last citizen of the Chen State entered the city of Huandu, but Huo Rong still didn’t wait for that dog emperor to take action.
Huo Rong suddenly closed his eyes, knowing deep in his heart that he would not attack the city today. When he opened his eyes again, he had completely lost the desire to get entangled with the Great Zhou.
“You guys stay here and don’t let your guard down.”
After leaving these words, Huo Rong turned around and was about to walk down. The deputy general beside him gritted his teeth and followed him.
“General, why did you let them in? Since the dog emperor of the Great Zhou has threatened the lives of the people of Chen, how could you not make preparations? I don’t know how many of the dog emperor’s followers will sneak in among the people. If you really let them in, the city will be in chaos, General!”
The deputy general has already made preparations. If the general is not ruthless, the worst that can happen is that he will take the blame himself.
How could Huo Rong not know what the deputy general said? It’s just…
“There are more than 10,000 people. How can I bear this?”
If they were soldiers from the Great Zhou, it would be fine, Huo Rong would not even blink an eye, but these were civilians, the people of his Chen State!
“Huo Wu, don’t forget that you and I are both from commoner backgrounds. We all came from Huo’s Village. What’s the difference between us and them?”
“What’s more, among these more than 10,000 people, how do you know there are no fellow countrymen, clansmen, or even relatives of ours?”
Compared to those who turn against their friends as soon as they become rich and are eager to completely cut off ties with their poor past, Huo Rong has never forgotten that he was just a wild boy who grew up in the countryside.
As soon as these words were spoken, the deputy general was speechless.
They were all ordinary people who had worked hard in the fields like his parents and brothers…
But Huo Rong was not completely defenceless and allowed these people to mingle throughout Huandu. Almost as soon as these 10,000 people entered Huandu, Huo Rong ordered his men to control them, and then found a remote area in Huandu as their settlement.
The other side.
After Huo Rong left, Ye Shuo also left after a while. On the way, Ye Shuo was wondering when the rulers of the State of Chen would respond to Huo Rong’s private release of civilians into the city.
You must know that Huandu is a vital line of defence for the entire Chen State. Once it is breached, it means that the remaining cities will be completely exposed to the attack of the Great Zhou. Under this circumstance, the current emperor of the Chen State will never allow Huandu to be broken.
The main thing is that as long as Huan is not conquered, the State of Chen will not be considered to have changed its owner, and the State of Chen will still be named Chen.
For the ruling class of the feudal dynasty, the life and death of the people have never been so important. Whether to choose the people or Huandu, Ye Shuo can know with his eyes closed what the emperor of Chen will choose in the end. All he has to do is wait patiently.
After thinking for a while, Ye Shuo suddenly realised that he seemed to be a member of the ruling class, and the supreme leader…
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but wonder what he would do if it were him, but he didn’t have the answer in his heart. He just tried his best to find a way to ensure that Da Zhou would never have to make a choice.
Seven days passed in a flash, and with so many mouths suddenly added, the food in Huandu was consumed at a rate visible to the naked eye. At the same time, the current emperor of Chen State finally received the news from Huandu.
The Chen Emperor’s first reaction was to be furious. He valued Huo Rong so much that he had even gone against all odds to let him guard the Huandu City. But who would have thought that Huo Rong would ignore the matter and let those people into the city privately. What was his intention?
The Emperor of Chen State didn’t believe that he didn’t know that there were suddenly so many mouths to feed and Huandu was simply unable to support it. What made the Emperor of Chen State even more furious was that Huo Rong had the nerve to ask him for help and wanted to ask the court for food.
Doesn’t he know how much it costs to transport food and grass to Huandu City every time? It’s really disappointing.
As expected, Huo Rong’s letter for help was not accepted at all.
But the Emperor of Chen was not a fool after all. Although he was dissatisfied in his heart, his words were still gentle. However, no matter how gentle he was, how could Huo Rong not see the indifference beneath his Majesty’s warmth?
It is clear from the words of His Majesty that he is asking him to give up those tens of thousands of civilians. After all, a great disaster has just passed and there is no extra arable land to distribute to them. In this way, those tens of thousands of civilians cannot be quickly converted into labourers. In this case, these tens of thousands of civilians are useless to the Emperor of Chen and his men, and useless people should be cleared out.
Huo Rong was unable to come back to his senses for a long time. After he came to his senses, he couldn’t help but look at his personal soldier who was responsible for delivering the message.
“How is the capital city doing lately?”
The personal soldier was silent for a while, then said, “In the capital, everything is the same as before.”
In other words, within the palace walls, there was still extravagance, singing and dancing.
Huo Rong didn’t say anything else. After his personal soldiers left, only his most trusted deputy general was left by his side.
The deputy general couldn’t help but say, “If the princes and nobles could be a little more frugal, they might be able to support so many people.”
Both he and the general came from poor backgrounds, so they were never well received by the princes and nobles. The deputy general had accompanied the general to a banquet once before, but it was that experience that he would never forget for the rest of his life.
Huo Rong couldn’t help but smile bitterly when he heard this: “How could they agree to that?”
If he had not been given the order in a time of crisis, it would not have been his turn to serve as the third-rank General Anton.
Over the years, Huo Rong vaguely felt that the princes and nobles who kept saying “water can carry a boat, but it can also capsize it” did not take the lives of the people seriously at all. In their eyes, the lives of the people were like pigs, dogs, cows and sheep, which could be killed and eaten whenever needed.
But what Huo Rong did not expect was that His Majesty’s order completely exceeded Huo Rong’s bottom line.
His Majesty issued a secret order, asking him to find a way to use the people in the city to consume the swords and arrows of the Great Zhou army.
As for how the mortal body is consumed, the answer is self-evident.
Since there was no food and the court was unwilling to release it, instead of letting Huandu fall into chaos due to hunger, it would be better to let them make a final contribution to the State of Chen.

chapters.title: Chapter 321: City Fall
chapters.content:
They actually thought of using civilians as soldiers!
Huo Rong naturally could not agree to this. In his opinion, whether for the sake of the State of Chen or for the sake of the people, this was a stupid move.
Your Majesty, those people may have been in high and mighty positions for too long and do not take the lives of the people seriously enough. They have forgotten that pushing people too far will only backfire.
How could Huandu today withstand any more turmoil?
The emperor of the Great Zhou had already placed spies among the disaster victims. They seemed to be behaving themselves now, but in fact they were like haystacks. A slight spark could completely ignite the chaotic situation in Huandu City. As a general, Huo Rong could naturally see it clearly.
Huo Rong was sincere and earnest, and he gritted his teeth and submitted petitions many times, and finally… he managed to attract the envoy.
Probably because the Great Zhou army was approaching along the way, Huo Rong met one envoy after another regarding peace talks, so Huo Rong did not take it seriously at first, and even argued with the envoys sent by His Majesty, hoping to impress His Majesty and make him give up the idea. However, Huo Rong did not notice that although the leading envoy agreed on the surface, the coldness in his eyes grew deeper and deeper.
When Ye Shuo heard the news, he couldn’t help but look at General Xu standing beside him.
“…Luan Qingjian.” “The one following the envoy is Guo Tong?”
General Xu hurriedly saluted upon hearing this: “Your Majesty, it is the Sword Saint Guo Tong.”The famous swordsman of Chen State now appeared in Huandu, and Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think a lot.
After a while, Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said, “Then Huo Rong…I’m afraid he can’t be saved.”
Poor Huo Rong, until now he still hasn’t figured out to what extent the superiors can be arrogant. Compared to the imminent crisis, as an emperor he cannot accept the disobedience of his subjects.
No matter how outstanding a minister is, he will never be better than his king.
“What a pity…”
General Xu standing by was silent, with mixed feelings. As a general, General Xu had lived decades longer than Huo Rong and could see things more clearly than Huo Rong. General Xu couldn’t help but feel sad for Huo Rong.
Or maybe, this is the fate of being a general.
Thinking back to the time when he, the old Duke of Zhen, and the others all went through this…
On the third day, seeing that Huo Rong was still using the same rhetoric, the envoy who was ordered to come finally read out the imperial edict as His Majesty had said. From that day on, Huo Rong and the right-hand man, would be removed and replaced by Guo Zhun and Liao Qing respectively. The implication of power division was not too obvious.
However, until this moment, Huo Rong still couldn’t understand. He thought that even if His Majesty didn’t like it, at most he would just replace the general who guarded the city. It wasn’t that Huo Rong was bragging. He didn’t dare to guarantee anything else. Just in terms of defending the city, Huo Rong dared to say that no one in the entire Chen Kingdom could match him. How could His Majesty be willing to do that?
Huo Rong even thought about it. If the people sent by His Majesty were defeated, he thought in his heart that if the people sent by His Majesty suffered a loss, he would take over later, and it was estimated that there would be no such big obstacles.
Facts have proved that Huo Rong was too naive. He actually thought that seizing power was the end. It was not until he drank a glass of wine and felt unbearable pain in his stomach after a while that he finally came to his senses.
Huo Rong really…underestimated the king’s cruelty.
Looking at the envoy standing beside him with a sarcastic look on his face, how could Huo Rong not understand?
It’s ridiculous that Huo Rong didn’t know his own limits. There were so many people available in the State of Chen, so why would the Emperor of Chen care about him? At most, he could just change him.
The envoy was a eunuch beside the Emperor of Chen. He had seen too many people who relied on their talents and pride over the years, and which of them had a good ending? No wonder Huo Rong was only a fourth-rank official after so many years. If it weren’t for the incident in Huandu, he would probably never be promoted to the third-rank official in his lifetime.
Huo Rong was not made of clay after all. After he felt something was wrong, he subconsciously wanted to fight back. However, a word from the envoy above instantly froze him on the spot.
“General Huo, if you don’t consider yourself, you should at least consider your family.”
“Do you know how many people will be buried with you if you strike with your halberd?”
The envoy was calm and composed, as if he was sure he could defeat him. With a sword master standing behind him, the envoy felt even more confident.
In the end, Huo Rong did not thrust out the halberd in his hand.
Huo Wu, who was standing by, was stunned for a moment, then he slammed the table and stood up: “The wine is poisonous, protect the general!”
Sensing that something was wrong in the tent, Huo Rong’s personal soldiers subconsciously jumped in. Seeing this, Guo Tong, who was behind the envoy, drew his sword without thinking.
However, in just half an incense stick of time, those personal soldiers fell to the ground, and the rest of the people were silent as a mouse, how could they dare to move at all?
Although Huo Wu had some martial arts skills, he was no match for the sword master. He couldn’t even get close to the old eunuch before Guo Tong pierced his chest with a sword.
Huo Wu could never have imagined that His Majesty sent the Sword Saint not to assassinate the dog emperor of the Great Zhou, but to kill them.
With a “clang” sound, Guo Tong put the Luanqing sword bestowed by His Majesty into the scabbard with an expressionless face.
Huo Rong could no longer control himself upon seeing this and spat out a mouthful of black blood. He looked at this, then at that, and suddenly burst into laughter, his face full of sadness.
“Heaven wants to destroy Dachen! Heaven wants to destroy Dachen!”
With such a monarch, how could the State of Chen not perish? !
“Huo Rong, you are so outrageous!”
The moment the words fell, the envoy’s face changed slightly, but before Guo Tong could make another move, Huo Rong had already died.
Looking at Huo Rong, whose eyes were wide open and whose face was ferocious like a demon, even the envoy felt a chill in his heart. He dared not look at him again after just one glance. The envoy hurriedly gave orders, asking his men to quickly get Huo Rong away.
“…What bad luck!”
After the tent was emptied, the envoy’s inexplicable nervousness slowly calmed down, and then Guo Zhun and Liao Qing took over Huandu naturally.
Upon hearing the news, Ye Shuo was speechless for a long time.
It’s ridiculous that such a great general as Huo Rong ended up like this.
As for Huo Rong’s family… since the envoy had already taken action, how could he really let them go as he said?
However, the flaw of Chen State was a real opportunity for their Great Zhou.
Ye Shuo quickly adjusted his mood and launched an attack that night. Without Huo Rong, the huge mountain pressing down on them was no longer there. With the abilities of General Xu and his men, it only took a few days for the Great Zhou to capture Huandu in one fell swoop.
At that time, rumours had already spread in Huandu. With such a big commotion before, how could the people of Huandu not know that the King’s capital was planning to use them as cannon fodder?
In addition, the more than 10,000 victims said that after the Great Zhou conquered the cities, not only did they not kill the people, but they also distributed a batch of seeds. More than half a year had passed, and the first few places that were conquered had already harvested a crop. The yield was unknown how much higher than the seeds on the side of the Chen State. After hearing such things many times, the people in Huandu naturally wavered.
Seeing that the food in the city was getting less and less, and the rumours from above were getting more and more tense, how could the people of Huandu not panic? So after Huandu was captured, the people did not resist, but instead breathed a sigh of relief. After observing for a few days, they saw that the soldiers of the Great Zhou Dynasty really had no intention of attacking them, and even distributed a lot of food to them, so the people in the city became even quieter.
As long as there is food to eat, who would be willing to take risks? The people have lived like this for thousands of years, and they can be satisfied easily. Once Huandu is broken, Ye Shuo has already seen the remaining cities. The rest is just a matter of time.
Now that the Great Zhou is advancing with such force, we can take this opportunity to make a decisive move to avoid any further complications.
However, just after Ye Shuo and General Xu and others had finished looking at the map and discussing the next battle plan, they suddenly heard someone outside reporting that Huo Rong’s body had been discovered accidentally.
It turned out that after Huo Rong’s death, the people in the city were grateful for his kindness, and there were also people in the army who secretly lent a helping hand, so Huo Rong’s body was actually preserved. It was just that because Guo Zhun and Liao Qing were there, others didn’t dare to be so blatant, so it was inevitable that the place where Huo Rong’s body was buried was particularly simple.
General Xu subconsciously looked at Ye Shuo. In General Xu’s opinion, Huo Rong was an extremely difficult opponent, and he had delayed them here for nearly four months. The emperor should hate him very much. Not to mention the emperor, even General Xu sometimes couldn’t help gritting his teeth and wished he could eat him alive. Under such circumstances, it was understandable that the emperor was unwilling to treat him well.
However, what General Xu did not expect was that the emperor was not angry at all. Instead, he ordered people to choose a good place and bury Huo Rong again.
Seeing that everyone looked different, Ye Shuo said very frankly: “Although Huo Rong is an enemy, he is also an enemy worthy of respect.”
“If this man had not been born in an enemy country and was not loyal to the State of Chen, I would have wanted to take him into my account.”
It’s a pity that the emperor of Chen was too ruthless and didn’t give him this opportunity at all.
As for the envoy…Ye Shuo had no good expression at all.
In comparison, the envoy’s attitude was completely different. He was so arrogant towards Huo Rong before, but after being captured, he became so fawning towards Ye Shuo.
This envoy wanted to escape before the city gate was breached and Guo Zhun and Liao Qing were killed in succession. However, before he could get out of Huandu, he was caught by Ye Shuo’s spies hiding among the tens of thousands of disaster victims.
However, the more Ye Shuo did this, the more the envoy feared and fawned on him.
Ye Shuo thought about it and decided not to kill him. It was not because the other party was good at flattering him, but because the other party seemed to be someone close to the Emperor of Chen and knew a lot about the inner workings of the palace. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but be tempted.
If I can get some information from him that I haven’t heard before, it won’t be in vain.
The envoy originally planned to go back on his word and wipe out Huo Rong completely, but he didn’t expect that in just a few days, he would become a part of the game.
Seeing that Prince Ding of the Great Zhou Dynasty patted his chest and assured him that as long as the information he provided was useful, he would certainly plead for him in front of the Emperor of Zhou and spare his life, the envoy no longer cared about so many things at this critical moment. He had no choice but to tell him what he knew in a straightforward manner, without noticing the amusement in the eyes of the generals standing beside him.
At the same time, the Emperor of Chen also received news of the fall of Huandu City, and only then did he realise that some people could not be replaced so easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 322: Escape
chapters.content:
Guo Zhun and Liao Qing were two famous generals of the State of Chen. How could Huandu be captured in less than ten days?
Upon hearing the news, the first reaction of the Emperor of Chen was disbelief, but as the iron hoof of the Great Zhou drew closer, the Emperor of Chen finally began to panic.
The so-called tactics are as fragile as paper in the face of absolute strength, not to mention that the State of Chen is no longer a match for the Great Zhou even in terms of tactics.
Things on the battlefield change rapidly. One wrong step will lead to more and more wrong steps. In the end, the gap will only get bigger and bigger until it cannot be reversed.
Looking back suddenly, the Emperor of Chen was horrified to find that the Great Zhou had grown to such a state without him knowing when.
In just three months, the young emperor of the Great Zhou had already arrived at the city with his troops.
“R
“Your Majesty, the Emperor of the Great Zhou has led his troops towards the capital. They will arrive in three days at the latest. Yancheng… has been conquered.”
After he finished speaking, the spy, who was holding on to his last breath, was completely exhausted and fell to the ground. At this moment, no one in the court was paying attention to him.
As the urgent battle report arrived from eight hundred miles away, the spy’s urgent voice sounded like a death knell, striking heavily in everyone’s heart. Looking at the emperor above, his face was now pale.With the successive deaths of Emperor Jingwen, Emperor Taicheng and the young emperor of the Great Zhou, the orthodox Ye royal family declined, and the most dissolute King Rui of the Great Zhou succeeded to the throne. The State of Chen believed from the bottom of its heart that the Great Zhou was doomed. Unexpectedly, now there was a sudden turn of events. The Great Zhou was not destined to die, and it was able to turn defeat into victory. Instead, they had reached this point step by step. This is what is called the destiny is with the Zhou, not with the Chen.
Seeing that the country’s fall and the family’s demise were imminent, the ministers became panic-stricken and subconsciously looked towards the emperor above them.
In this critical moment of life and death, almost everyone regards Your Majesty as the only lifeline.
The Great Zhou is coming with great force, and with the emperor in person, morale will certainly be boosted. But if their majesty can also make a decision based on this, and Chen is their Chen after all, no matter how many spies there are, they cannot know themselves as well as they do. With the terrain advantage and the home advantage, they may not be without the ability to fight.
However, not everyone has such courage. It is easy to say “leading the army in person”, but swords are merciless on the battlefield and the emperor is born with a noble body. Normally, the emperor of Chen would punish a large number of people if he got hurt, let alone going to the battlefield in person.
Emperor Chen was also full of vigour and vitality when he was young, but now he is over fifty years old and is no longer the same as before.
In the end, Emperor Chen still disappointed his ministers.
Between leading the army in person and escaping, Emperor Chen chose to escape. His retreat meant the complete collapse of the Chen State, causing the already low morale to plummet even further as His Majesty fled.
Now that the emperor has run away, how many people are willing to fight for him?
Even if Emperor Chen was no longer the emperor, the troops and gold and silver he took away were enough for him to live the rest of his life happily. In this case, he thought that there was no need to risk his life. As for the country of Chen… It was going to die, so why bother?
Among the three kingdoms of Chen, Zhou, and Beiting, Chen was always the one who compromised and would only hide behind others to plot and scheme. In this environment, it was natural that there would not be a strong emperor. It was not surprising that Emperor Chen would make such a choice, but the ministers, clan members, and people he left behind were miserable. In just three days, the capital was in chaos.
Crying, despair, misery…all kinds of emotions filled the entire royal capital. Even though there was a city wall between them, the chaos could still be felt in the Great Zhou.
“Oh—”
Ye Shuo suddenly tightened the reins, and when the horse under him stopped obediently, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but look up and look at the person standing on the city wall from afar –
There was another brave general, his name was Pan Zhong. According to General Xu, he could be ranked among the top five in the State of Chen. And as rumoured, Pan Zhong became the last line of defence of the capital of the State of Chen. If Pan Zhong could hold it, the State of Chen would still be there. If he couldn’t, the State of Chen would be completely wiped out in history.
The responsibility of the family and the country fell on one person’s shoulders. In this situation, how could Pan Zhong not devote himself to the cause until his death?
But now that things have come to this, it is not up to him alone. Pan Zhong is not afraid of death, and neither are his soldiers. But there are so many powerful people in the capital. Don’t they fear death? This is no longer a matter of whether Pan Zhong is capable or not, or whether he can turn the tide.
Just when Pan Zhong was on high alert, ready to risk his life and never let the dog emperor set foot into the capital, he suddenly heard the dog emperor spread the news that whoever opened the city gate to surrender first would be made king, the next one would be made marquis, and the next one would be made earl, regardless of their status. The rest of those who resisted without reason would be killed without exception.
“I am writing this letter today as a testimony, and the heaven and earth are my witnesses. This is not an empty statement. I hope you will think twice before you act, and do not persist in your mistakes.”
Upon hearing this, Prince Ding on the side could not help but twitch his lips, thinking that his brother was really becoming more and more sinister. The extremely high reward coupled with the extremely severe punishment, the ups and downs, made people’s hearts beat like drums. Even he, an outsider, couldn’t help but feel his blood boiling, not to mention the people in the city.
To be crowned a king or a marquis… How many people can resist such temptation? Especially for those nobles who have lived a life of luxury, who would be willing to descend from a high position to become a commoner if given the chance? And they are the ones who now control the capital.
However, Prince Ding thought about it and couldn’t help but remind him: “Be careful not to shoot yourself in the foot. The remnants of the Chen Kingdom are not so easy to accommodate.”
Ye Shuo also lowered his voice: “Don’t worry, I know what’s going on. There are so many idle people in the royal family, I will just ask them to take care of it when the time comes.”
Since they were granted titles of kings and princes, it was only natural for them to stay in Shangjing. It was a good way to imprison these capable people in disguise, so that they would not scatter everywhere after the fall of the State of Chen, waiting for opportunities to cause trouble.
After Ye Shuo’s explanation, Prince Ding was completely speechless.
On the other side, after hearing this, Pan Zhong’s heart suddenly skipped a beat and he thought to himself that something was wrong.
Pan Zhong is not stupid. He knows very well that people’s hearts are complicated. Perhaps there are still people in the royal capital who are loyal to the State of Chen, but the thing that is most lacking in this world is traitors. Especially when the number of places is limited, if this person does not do it, there will always be another person who will do it.
Even the most united place will become fragmented due to different divisions of interests, not to mention that the capital city itself is not a solid block, which makes the situation even worse.
“
As Pan Zhong expected, once the news spread, the entire capital was in complete chaos…
At the same time, Ye Shuo urgently sent a message to Lucheng to see if they could find the escaped Emperor Chen from another direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 323: Suicide
chapters.content:
Two days passed in a flash. Although Ye Shuo did not hear any movement, he was not really worried.
The State of Chen is now a spent force and cannot escape the fate of destruction. However, in order to prevent the remaining people from fighting back desperately, Ye Shuo would naturally be happy if the issue could be resolved peacefully with fewer casualties.
The more it is at this time, the more careful we must be. Otherwise, it would be a pity to fail.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath, barely suppressed the restlessness in his heart, and forced himself to calm down.
“Don’t worry, brother. Come drink a cup of tea with me.”
Prince Ding, who was pacing nearby, was startled. After hesitating for a moment, he finally sat down.
On the other side, in the capital city——
Marquis Xiangding was feeling agitated and wanted to go out to relax. Of course, the most important thing was to see what the situation was like outside. However, as soon as he went out, he ran into Marquis Yong’an across the way.
Isn’t this a coincidence?
Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an were neighbours. They saw each other every day and could talk to each other. Marquis Xiangding saw the same anxiety on the other’s face, and he was moved, so he asked, “Together?”Marquis Yong’an did not deny it. He quickly changed into his usual indifferent look and walked out of the alley with Marquis Xiangding.
The two marquises changed into ordinary coarse linen clothes, and if you didn’t look closely, they looked like ordinary people.
Although Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an had anticipated this, they were still shocked by what they saw outside when they went out.
The one guarding the city now is General Pan Zhong, and Pan Zhong’s soldiers are everywhere. The people are in a panic and walk hurriedly, some even carrying their luggage on their backs. It is obvious that they are in a hurry to escape. The whole street is in chaos. The bustling wine shops and tea shops on weekdays are now closed. However, the city has become particularly deserted in just a few days. It really looks like… a country in ruins and chaos.
Even the two marquises felt a sinking feeling in their hearts at this moment.
His Majesty fled secretly, leaving behind a mess. What is the difference between them and the people in front of them? They are just a group of stray dogs.
Xiang Dinghou took a deep breath and spoke casually, “What do you think of what Emperor Zhou said outside the city?”
Yong’an Hou paused and said cautiously: “How can empty words count?”
Anyone who can sit in this position knows that the emperor’s words are the most unreliable. Even if a letter is written as proof, the emperor can go back on his word at any time.
The so-called golden words are spoken to ordinary people.
“We must trust General Pan’s ability. It is better not to disrupt the morale of the army at this time.”
“Of course.” Xiang Dinghou nodded, as if it was a matter of course: “We are the ministers of the Chen Dynasty, so we will not be deceived by the Emperor Zhou.”
They said they would not be bewitched, but ever since their Majesty fled, no one has been calling him the dog emperor anymore.
Sensing this keenly, Marquis Yong’an’s heart paused. Just as he was about to say something, he heard a commotion not far away.
“Surrounded! They surrounded Simon too!”
The South Gate is the main entrance to the royal capital. Merchants usually travel along this road, and dignitaries travel along this road. Naturally, the Great Zhou would choose to attack from here. The West Gate is the narrowest and most hidden of the three gates: south, west and east. Now that the West Gate is surrounded, one can imagine what has become of the other two city gates.
Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an suddenly remembered that although the emperor of the Great Zhou asked them to surrender, he did not specify a date. Now that two days have passed, he must have become impatient. In this case, do the conditions proposed by the emperor of the Great Zhou still count?
Just when Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an were thinking about something, riot broke out at the west city gate.
“Let us out! Let us out!”
All exits were blocked, and there was the threat of a city massacre. Every hour and even every moment was shrouded in death. Under extreme fear, those with less endurance completely collapsed.
As the first person rushed forward, the people following behind him became excited and rushed forward regardless of anything.
However, they had only walked a dozen steps when countless arrows flew at them. The people in the front were immediately shot into hedgehogs. The splattered blood dyed the stone slabs under their feet red, causing the people behind them to stop abruptly, trembling in fear and keeping silent.
How could they, who were unarmed, be a match for the soldiers armed with swords?
Pan Zhong stood on the tower, looked around, and said in a thunderous voice: “Anyone who disturbs the morale of our army will be killed without mercy!”
When the deep voice fell, the people below all felt a chill and dared not stay any longer. The people who had gathered together dispersed in the blink of an eye.
Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an calmed themselves down and did not dare to stay any longer.
When the two men returned to their respective houses and the corner gate was closed, Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an’s expressions changed, and they were no longer as calm as before.
The same thought flashed through the minds of Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an almost at the same time –
We can’t wait any longer. If we wait any longer, the whole family will be trapped to death in the city!
Even though Pan Zhong has managed to control a riot in time, everyone knows that this is just the beginning. Everyone also knows that Pan Zhong does not have the ability to turn the tide and save the collapsing bulge.
After hearing this, the prince standing by couldn’t help but be shocked: “But if we really surrender and leave the capital, won’t we be leaving our lives and property in the hands of others?”
Now at least we still have Pan Zhong and his soldiers to hold on. Even if we really open the city gate, there will be nothing left.
“But if we continue like this, we will surely die. In the entire Chen Kingdom, there is only a capital and a few small cities left. They can no longer cause any trouble. The outcome of the game has been decided and we have no way out.” So now it is a question of whether to gamble or not.
But even if he wanted to gamble, Marquis Xiangding would not be completely unprepared.
After a while, Xiang Dinghou slowly spoke: “Let’s… give it a try first.”
There are three places in total. Marquis Xiangding does not intend to compete for the first place, nor does he want to fall behind others. It would be best if he could keep the title of marquis.
Another three days passed. He didn’t know if it was Pan Zhong’s illusion, but he always felt that the turmoil in the royal capital was getting worse and worse, and more and more people wanted to leave the city.
Pan Zhong sensed that there was something fishy going on, so he sent people to investigate. However, he was shocked to find out that the mastermind behind this was none other than that group of princes and nobles.
The kings and princes were unwilling to take risks alone, so they supported the people in making trouble behind the scenes and made the people their pawns.
It would be fine if the emperor of the Great Zhou rewards them as promised, but if he breaks the promise, they will find other ways. Such sneaky behaviour is really ridiculous.
But even if Pan Zhong found out, what would happen? They were a group of people that even he couldn’t touch.
It’s not that Pan Zhong doesn’t have the courage to kill all these spineless people. Anyway, His Majesty has already fled with his men, and the only person who can give orders is gone. It’s not impossible for Pan Zhong to do the remaining ones by gritting his teeth and hardening his heart. But if he does so, wouldn’t he be playing right into the hands of the dog emperor of the Great Zhou?
He would probably rather see a fight among himself first.
Unlike the ignorant common people, the nobles were not easy to deal with and would definitely not accept death. Both sides would suffer losses and the capital would be destroyed.
While Pan Zhong was hesitating, he had support behind him, and with the help of the people themselves, he finally found an opportunity.
As the leader, how could the people who led them not know that the group of princes were using them to test the emperor outside the city gate? But what could they do?
They had nothing to lose, but if they succeeded, it would be completely different. At least they could get a prince, no matter what kind of prince he was, it would be a world of difference compared to what they have now.
With such thoughts in mind, the leader was particularly brave when he launched the charge again.
“Success or failure depends on this one move. If you don’t want to die, follow me!”
With a roar, the eyes of the people who were already eager to make a move suddenly turned red. They didn’t even have any extra thoughts, they just wanted to live.
Although the soldiers defending the city were Pan Zhong’s subordinates, they were just ordinary people. Only a few of them were cruel enough to attack their own people. A moment of trance caused them to disperse the team and rush to the city gate.
In the king’s tent in the distance, Ye Shuo first heard a loud noise, followed by an unprecedentedly brutal fight.
Prince Ding, who was patrolling outside, was startled, then looked up. In a moment, he saw that the city gate that had been closed was opened.
Countless ragged civilians, some with wounds on their bodies, some even without arms and legs, still ran towards the camp of the Great Zhou regardless of anything.
There was blood all over the ground.
“I am Du You, a humble citizen, and I have come to accept your surrender. I hope that the Emperor will show mercy and spare my life.”
The leader suppressed his nervousness, knelt on the ground and kowtowed heavily. He did not even bother to wipe the muddy ground all over his head. Seeing this, the people behind him hurriedly followed suit.
There was no response for a long while. Just when everyone was so nervous that they almost fainted, the most conspicuous tent not far away was finally opened by a pair of hands. Then there was a young but majestic voice –
“Come here, give them a reward!”
With just one word of praise, Du You, who was just an ordinary citizen, immediately became the dignified Prince of Chen.
Du You was stunned, and then a little dazed.
Just two hours later, the news reached the royal capital, and the city gate that had been barely repaired was once again hit hard.
As expected, Marquis Xiangding ran into his old neighbour Marquis Yong’an at the city gate.
The two men had said before, vowed, that they would never betray the State of Chen, but now they met in such a place. No matter how thick-skinned they were, they couldn’t help feeling a little embarrassed.
But this emotion only lasted for less than a moment. No one who could start from scratch and sit in this position was thin-skinned.
There is only one marquisate that Emperor Zhou promised, and you won’t be able to get it if you go too late.
When they thought of this, several people brought the private soldiers and guards of the mansion and rushed out with all their might. As for the city gate in front of them, since it had been broken once, there would naturally be a second and third time.
After rushing out with Xiang Dinghou, on the way, he was sitting on horseback and looked back for some unknown reason. As luck would have it, he happened to catch Pan Zhong’s eyes.
Pan Zhong is only in his thirties this year, in the prime of his life, but now he is like an old man in his twilight years, without any vitality in his body.
When Xiang Dinghou saw this, a flash of guilt flashed through his heart.
How could Marquis Xiangding not know that his behaviour was tantamount to treason, but… there were about a hundred people in his family, a full hundred people, and they were all waiting for him to life.
Thinking of this, Xiang Dinghou’s heart suddenly made up. He turned around and ran towards the enemy’s camp with his men as if he was risking his life.
As this group of people fled, the gates of the capital of the Kingdom of Chen were opened wide and could never be closed again.
The situation was hopeless, and the mighty Chen State finally perished.
The deputy general next to him wanted to stop them again, but he found that his soldiers had started to run out at some point. The deputy general instinctively wanted to open his mouth to shout, but was stopped by Pan Zhong the next moment.
“Let them be.”
After thinking for a while, Pan Zhong said, “You should also run for your life.”
The deputy general was not without intention, but…
“General, what about you?”
“Of course I will fight for Chen Guo until the last moment.”
Pan Zhong did what he said. When Xu Kui led his men into the city, Ye Shuo saw with his own eyes that Pan Zhong led the remnants of the army like a mayfly shaking a tree. In a short while, the only hundreds of people left were like dead leaves and were devoured by the elite troops of the Great Zhou.
Ye Shuo was silent for a moment, and finally couldn’t help but speak: “If you surrender now, it’s not too late. I will definitely save you and your family’s lives.”
“…You dog emperor, forget it!”
“Even if I die today, I will never surrender!”
The moment he finished speaking, Pan Zhong placed the sword across his neck in front of Ye Shuo.
“I, Pan Zhong, will never be a coward!”
As Pan Zhong exerted force with his hands, the sharp sword immediately cut his neck. In an instant, blood spurted out a full two metres away. After a moment, Pan Zhong died.
Ye Shuo then looked at the generals following him. Before he could say anything, the remaining nearly a hundred people made the same choice almost unanimously.
With a “swish” sound, accompanied by the sound of swords cutting through skin and blood vessels, the remaining people fell down one after another.
Looking at the corpses all over the ground, Ye Shuo slowly closed his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 324: Dealing with it
chapters.content:
But it only took a moment, and Ye Shuo returned to normal.
He had seen too many scenes like this along the way, or rather, he had anticipated all of this since the day he decided to go on the expedition.
In such a huge country like Chen, there were people who threw away their weapons and armour, and naturally there were people who would rather die than surrender. However, Pan Zhong was different from Huo Rong. Huo Rong cared about the people and died for them, but before Pan Zhong died, what he missed most was the Chen State to which he was loyal.
Those who sacrifice their lives for their country are naturally loyal and devoted, and their families are full of loyal heroes. With such a father, his children will not be much worse. As the saying goes, if you don’t uproot the grass, it will grow again in the spring breeze. If it were an ordinary seedling, it would be fine, but if such a strong root system is not eradicated, it may easily cause trouble in the future.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo immediately issued the killing order.
Ye Shuo had not read many history books in his previous life, but he knew that things had come to this point, and any mercy shown to the enemy would turn into a sharp blade that would shoot at him in the future.
Prince Ding, who was standing by, had seen more such things. He saw that his brother seemed to be a little soft-hearted. He was about to persuade him, but he saw that the other party’s words were completely cold and hard, which was completely opposite to the look in his eyes. He was stunned and then Prince Ding felt a little complicated.
After all, it is different from before…
But it is undeniable that while Prince Ding is becoming more and more cautious, he also has admiration that he himself is not aware of.
He was ruthless when necessary and merciful at the same time, and he was becoming more and more adept at his job as an emperor. Prince Ding knew that even if he were to replace the crown prince, he would still be far from being as good as him. The courage of the ninth prince who dared to take the risk of annexing the State of Chen was beyond the reach of them and Emperor Taicheng.After all, if it succeeds, it’s fine. But if it fails, the consequences will be unbearable. Since he has already become the emperor, why should he take such a risk?
The three-way balance of power has lasted for so long that it is not necessarily without such a factor.
After a while, the people below received the order and wanted to leave, but the emperor on horseback did not wake them up, but asked: “Do you know where the general’s mansion is?”
“This…I don’t know.” The man thought about it and couldn’t help but lower his head.
Although they had planted spies in the Great Zhou before, due to the city being closed for several days, information was difficult to pass on and they were basically of no use, let alone the location of the General’s Mansion.
Ye Shuo knew very well that since Pan Zhong had previously shown his determination to defend the city to the death, he would certainly not go back on his word by sending his family away. Otherwise, if other princes and nobles who were also trapped in the city were to notice this, they would certainly not agree. Therefore, Pan Zhong and his trusted family members were probably still stranded in the city.
Ye Shuo thought about it and asked someone to bring Marquis Xiangding, Marquis Yong’an and other surrendered ministers.
Prince Ding couldn’t help but frown when he saw this: “Are you asking them to lead the way?”
Ye Shuo nodded: “Several princes have lived in the capital for many years, so no one knows the layout here better than them. If they can help, things will naturally be much simpler.”
“That’s what I said, but…” Prince Ding hesitated. He felt that Xiang Dinghou and Yong’anhou were from Chen State after all. They had only surrendered for a short time. How could they work for the Great Zhou in a down-to-earth manner? Anyway, if it were him, he would definitely make trouble.
Prince Ding couldn’t help but ask, “Aren’t you afraid that they will pretend to obey but actually disobey, and then let those who shouldn’t be let go escape? What will you do then?”
Even if the Chen Kingdom is destroyed, it would be a big trouble if he seeks revenge on the Zhou Kingdom under the banner of restoring his country.
As soon as he finished speaking, Prince Ding clearly felt that his brother seemed to have glanced at him, and the look in his eyes was simply indescribably strange.
Little did he know that Ye Shuo was thinking at the moment that once a person’s thinking is set, it will be difficult to change it in this lifetime.
In the past few years, this cheap big brother of his couldn’t even tell who his subordinates were truly loyal to, and even now he still can’t understand people’s hearts.
Since Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an have already surrendered, there is no possibility for them to turn back. If they continue to be fickle fence-sitters, their end will probably be even more miserable than it is now. In the end, they will be neither human nor able to be human on either side.
They are smart people. Now that they have made their choice, they know how to assess the situation and what they should do.
Ye Shuo felt that they should understand their current situation and would definitely do the tasks he assigned them to do well without him having to waste his words. ř�
In fact, it was almost the same as Ye Shuo guessed. After Xiang Dinghou, Yong’anhou and others came forward tremblingly, performed the kneeling ceremony, and listened to Ye Shuo’s seemingly casual orders, in an instant, several of them lost control and the expressions on their faces changed to varying degrees.
Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an were not stupid. They naturally did not think that everything would be fine as long as they surrendered with their families. However, they did not expect that the test would come so soon.
Xiang Dinghou and Yong An knew that this was the intention of the Great Zhou Emperor to ask them to submit their names. Since they really wanted to join, how could they not pay a price? There was no such cheap thing in the world.
Several people also knew that once this gap was opened, the situation would only get worse. No matter whether they were willing or not, the final result would only be that it would happen little by little until they were completely tied to the ship of the Great Zhou.
However, what Xiang Dinghou, Yong Anhou and others did not expect was that the young Emperor of Great Zhou was not even satisfied with this. Then, they heard him say: “Since you are so aware of the current situation, the people of Chen should take you as their leader.”
At first, Marquis Xiangding and Marquis Yong’an didn’t understand what was going on, but when they saw Ye Shuo’s meaningful look, Marquis Xiangding, who was the most active in thinking, was startled.
This Emperor Zhou… could it be that he wants to use them to deal with the orphans of the Chen Kingdom? !
Use the people of Chen to fight against the people of Chen, and cancel each other out to minimise the losses of the Great Zhou.
When Ye Shuo saw the right side of Xiang Ding Hou’s face twitch uncontrollably, he knew that he had figured it out, so he said, “The Marquis is indeed smart, not ordinary people can compare to him.”
When the other party is far from threatening him, Ye Shuo still prefers to talk to smart people. As long as they are not pushed to the limit, smart people are the most useful knife.
However, Ye Shuo didn’t know that at this moment, Xiang Dinghou’s mind was blank, and his emotions were surging.
Want to run?
There is no way to run away.
There was no other way except to compromise. Besides, since he had already made his choice and paid such a huge price, becoming a despised vassal, how could he give up halfway? At this point, the old Chen could no longer accommodate him. Only the Great Zhou could preserve the glory of their family.
Ye Shuo noticed that Xiang Dinghou’s gaze seemed ferocious for a moment, but in the end, the other party slowly lowered his head. His respectful attitude at this moment showed his submission.
“I thank Your Majesty for your praise. I will definitely live up to your expectations.”
Ye Shuo was satisfied when he saw this, so he gave them half an incense stick of time to buffer, and then he led his men to continue heading towards the city.
After Ye Shuo left, Xiang Dinghou took a deep breath and slowly told the people around him his guess.
Sure enough, the next moment, the faces of Yong’an and others twitched violently.
Really, what a vicious method.
But they also knew that this was the only way to protect their family. No matter how reluctant they were or how many complaints they had in their hearts, they could not change the situation.
Compared with the only commoner prince, the tolerance of the several marquises is much higher, and their hearts are countless times more vicious than that of the commoner prince. In just half an incense stick of time, after their thoughts are completely changed, they will be even more ruthless than the real enemies of the State of Chen.
Since they knew they had no choice, and they were the targets set up by Emperor Zhou, Marquis Xiangding and his companions knew very well that if they held back at this moment, there would be endless troubles in the future. If they did not take advantage of the protection bestowed by Emperor Zhou to nip the threat in the bud, how would they resist the wave after wave of assassinations from the restorers in the future when they lost their protection and were outnumbered?
The several marquises did not think that the Emperor of Zhou would be so kind as to let the guards guard them every day after they arrived in the Great Zhou.
After figuring out the key, the last trace of kindness in the hearts of Xiang Dinghou and others disappeared in an instant. They themselves did not have the ability to restore the country and stir up trouble, so they had to find ways to find out those who had such ability in the entire capital and kill them all.
Sometimes, when the same kind of people deal with each other, they are more cruel than foreign enemies. This is human nature, this is the human heart.
Just like that, Prince Ding watched helplessly as several people who had just looked indignant and angry regained their composure. From being awkward at the beginning, they gradually became skilled and even a little crazy. The cruelty was so severe that even Prince Ding couldn’t help but feel a chill in his heart.
With Prince Ding’s temperament, he naturally could not imagine that there would be such a cruel thing and such a cruel person in the world.
“Weren’t they colleagues serving in the same court before?” Prince Ding was so shocked that he almost forgot the honorific.
“Precisely because they are familiar with each other and understand each other, they want to kill each other even more…” Ye Shuo watched with cold eyes. After a little observation, he could easily find that those who died at the hands of these people were rare ordinary people. They joined hands and almost killed all the young talents who were considered famous.
As the heads of princes and nobles fell to the ground one by one, the smell of blood spread throughout the entire capital. The royal palace, hidden in the deepest and most mysterious place, gradually revealed its shape like a crawling giant beast.
There was total silence all around, and the palace gate was in great disrepair. It looked as if the eunuchs and palace maids, unwilling to die after hearing the news of the city’s fall, had desperately tried to struggle and escape.
Looking from afar, the bodies of eunuchs, palace maids and soldiers defending the city were scattered all over the ground, almost dyeing half of the moat red.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but frown when he saw this, but before he could say anything, Xu Kui, who was leading the way in front, suddenly pulled the reins, and the horse under his crotch stopped almost instantly.
“Your Majesty, wait a minute.”
Xu Kui looked around carefully, feeling that something was amiss here.
“Your Majesty, please be careful. There may be a trap here.” Almost instinctively, Xu Kui and General Wei beside him looked at each other and said this in unison.

chapters.title: Chapter 325: Fighting
chapters.content:
The stone bridge in front of them is extremely narrow, and there is a river blocking the way. It can only allow one group of soldiers to pass through. It is an excellent place to set up an ambush. Anyone who has led troops can see that something is wrong here. Once they cross the stone bridge, the soldiers will be like turtles in a jar, and it will be difficult to escape at that time.
But if you want to attack the palace on a large scale, this is the only way to go.
In the eyes of Xu Kui and others, the fate of the State of Chen was already determined. Even if there was an ambush here, what would it matter? The imperial palace was only half the size of a county town. What was there to be afraid of?
As for Ye Shuo standing aside, he was thinking more than them, and a certain idea suddenly flashed through his mind.
Secret guard.
Death warrior.
As the emperor, Ye Shuo now almost knows all the secrets of the imperial family. Naturally, he knows how powerful the secret guards under the emperor are. Especially when the country is destroyed and the family is ruined, this group of people will give up everything, even their lives, to retaliate against the enemy, and they will tear a piece of flesh from the enemy even if it means destroying themselves together.
Under such circumstances, even if there are only a few hundred people in total, the damage that can be caused cannot be underestimated.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think of his cheap master Wu Yi. Although Wu Yi didn’t say it explicitly, Ye Shuo estimated that with the other party’s martial arts, it would not be a difficult task for him to fight his way in and out of a small or medium-sized army, and there might be such a person in the Chen Kingdom.
The closer it gets to this time, the more we must not be careless and the more careful we must be.Completely unaware of the emperor’s worries, Xu Kui and General Wei volunteered to go to the front to investigate the situation.
It’s not that they are bold and arrogant, but they have to enter the Palace of Prince Chen. Xu Kui and General Wei are ministers, so they naturally don’t understand the royal family’s trump card. Not to mention them, even Prince Ding, who failed to ascend to the throne, only has a vague understanding of the abilities of the secret guards.
Outsiders only know that the secret guards are powerful, but they don’t know why they are powerful and to what extent.
When Xu Kui spoke to General Wei, Ye Shuo did not nod.
“Wait a minute.”
Ye Shuo raised his hand and pointed at the corpses of the eunuchs and palace servants on the other side of the stone bridge: “Carry a few of them over here for me to see.”
Although Xu Kui and General Wei were puzzled, they subconsciously chose to obey the order.
Both Xu Kui and General Wei have family backgrounds in martial arts, and their skills are considered good even in the martial arts world. Even Ye Shuo’s cheap master Wu Yi finds it difficult to defeat the enemy with one move. Without the burden of ordinary soldiers, the two of them will be able to exert their maximum strength once they encounter danger.
It only took the two of them a few blinks of an eye from stealing the corpse to dragging it in front of Ye Shuo. Ye Shuo was distracted and paid attention to the palace gate, but sure enough, no one showed up. It seemed that the bait was too small, or the other party’s ambition was too big.
When the body was brought in front of him, Prince Ding caught a glimpse of black blood oozing from the palace maid’s mouth, nose, eyes, and ears. He subconsciously glanced at his brother and saw him nod. Prince Ding raised his crutch and saw that the palace maid’s neck was bent in an extremely unnatural posture.
Such a neat method shows that the person who did it is very experienced and must have done this many times before. Prince Ding was not stupid either. He understood in an instant what was waiting for them in the palace. He also understood why his brother was still reluctant to let people cross the bridge even though they had clearly surrounded the imperial city.
“Secret guards and assassins…” Prince Ding knew something about them, but seeing his brother’s current attitude, he felt that he might still have underestimated their abilities.
“Is it difficult to deal with?” Prince Ding asked in a low voice.
At this point, Ye Shuo did not hide anything and said, “These people followed the orders of Emperor Chen and came here only for revenge. They must have stored a lot of food and weapons long before. The palace covers a very large area, and the secret passages are winding. There are only three to five hundred people, and these three to five hundred people have undergone special training. It should not be a problem for them to hide in there for three to five months.”
“Without the blueprint, we don’t know how the secret passages are distributed. Unless someone as skilled as Xu Kui or General Wei can put up a good fight, everyone who enters will die.”
Just imagine, a group of ordinary soldiers are searching the palace, and suddenly a few people jump out from nowhere, kill all the soldiers around them, and then jump into a well and disappear before others can react. You don’t even know how to chase them. How should you guard against such a situation?
In such a large army, how many people are there like Xu Kui and General Wei? With the skills and physical strength of the secret guards, how can ordinary soldiers be their opponents?
The moment the voice fell, Prince Ding subconsciously looked at Xiang Ding and others beside him.
As if he could see what his cheap brother was thinking, Ye Shuo sighed and said helplessly: “These people are not omnipotent. They are just ministers. How can they know the distribution of the secret passages in the palace? If they knew such secrets, the Chen Kingdom would have perished long ago and would not have lived to this day.” ℞
“…That’s right.” Prince Ding immediately realised that he was just daydreaming.
Marquis Xiangding and others, who had just awakened from the frenzy, saw Emperor Zhou and Prince Ding looking away, and after a while, they were no longer as nervous as before.
Fortunately, Emperor Zhou did not really want to force them to death. It would be fine outside, but they could not do anything in this old imperial palace.
However, no one had expected that Emperor Zhou was such a sharp-minded person. He could predict the risks in advance with just a little investigation. It was really shocking.
Without paying attention to what the others were thinking, Ye Shuo pondered for a moment and quickly made a decision in his heart.
Now that things have come to this, since we already know that there is a high probability that this is a trick, setting fire to the palace is an excellent option for now.
Ye Shuo felt that he had done all the bad things he could do on this trip. If he were to go by karma, he would probably go to the eighteenth level of hell after his death.
If there really is a King of Hell and a Judge in the underworld.
Although Ye Shuo thought so in his heart, his hands did not hesitate for a moment, and his eyes were cold.
The bowstring made of twisted steel wire was stretched, and when it was pulled to the full moon, Ye Shuo suddenly let go, and the arrow soaked in oil and burning fiercely immediately broke through the air!
Like the Great Zhou, the old Chen Palace was also built of wood. How could it withstand a raging fire?
As soon as one arrow was shot, thousands of arrows were launched. The arrows wrapped in flames were like meteors. In a short while, the giant beast that had stood for a hundred years in front of them began to burn, and the flames dyed most of the sky red.
Even the surrendered ministers, Xiang Dinghou and others, when they saw this scene, a corner of their hearts completely collapsed, and decades of faith were completely burned away with this fire. Not only them, Ye Shuo also remembered this scene deeply in his heart, not out of guilt, but as a warning.
Today, Zhou is strong and Chen is weak, so the fire will burn the State of Chen. In the future, when Zhou is weak and he is strong, the fire will also burn the Great Zhou.
The fire was blazing and the smoke was billowing. Under such circumstances, no matter how complicated the secret passage in the palace was, the people inside could no longer stay there.
Not to mention the thick and scorching smoke, once the palace becomes a ruin, the people hiding inside will also have nowhere to hide. It would be easier to succeed than to take advantage of the chaos now, with the fire and the fleeing civilians as cover.
Finally, in addition to the panicked eunuchs and palace maids, some agile figures like ghosts gradually emerged.
When seeing this scene, Xu Kui’s admiration for the emperor almost reached its peak.
The emperor had predicted it right again!
Being a subject and following a king who had everything under control was truly the greatest blessing in the world.
Xu Kui rubbed his hands, ready to chop off the heads of these villains in front of him and present them to the emperor as trophies.
Thinking of this, when Xu Kui led his men to rush out, a bright light burst out involuntarily in his eyes.
Ye Shuo looked at it and couldn’t help laughing when he thought of General Xu who was stationed outside the city. Every time he faced Xu Kui, he was so fierce. I guess the old general must have been troubled for a long time…
As more and more ghostly figures appeared around, the soldiers surrounded Emperor Ye Shuo, just as they had done countless times before.
However, this time was very different from the past. Although Xu Kui and General Wei were brave, the martial arts of the soldiers under his command were only mediocre. Even though Ye Shuo had anticipated this and assigned elite soldiers to the two of them, they were still no match for the old Chen secret guards.
Soldiers are only used on the battlefield and win by numbers, but the secret guards only care about killing people. Their agility alone is enough to crush these so-called elite troops in front of them. When this group of secret guards go deep into the team led by Xu Kui and General Wei, it is like entering an empty space. Not to mention that the streets in the city are narrow and there are many obstacles, making it easy for the secret guards to hide their bodies. The soldiers led by the two are no match for them.
In a blink of an eye, a large number of people from the special team that Ye Shuo had trained with great effort fell.
Seeing this scene, Ye Shuo’s hands holding the reins suddenly tightened.
Prince Ding, who was standing by, felt nervous when he saw this, and couldn’t help but stop him, saying, “Your Majesty’s body is precious, you must not put yourself in danger.”
Prince Ding has been fighting with his younger brother for such a long time that he already knows that his martial arts are by no means ordinary. But the situation now is unusual. Faced with so many secret guards with high martial arts skills, Prince Ding just feels his scalp tingling. He knows that this is not the time for him to show off his strength. He just needs to wait patiently and wait until these three to five hundred secret guards are exhausted, then he can drag them all to death.
Ye Shuo also knew the situation in his heart and suppressed it with great effort. But soon, a sword light flashed, and Ye Shuo and Prince Ding’s hearts skipped a beat almost at the same time.
Luanqing Sword!
“It’s Sword Saint Guo Tong!”
The person who came was none other than the master of swordsmanship who took Huo Rong’s life in the battle of Huandu.
I thought the other party must have fled with Emperor Chen. After all, the other party’s martial arts were so strong. How could Emperor Chen let such a guard go under the fierce pursuit of the Great Zhou? Who would have thought that Emperor Chen would leave the other party behind and not take him away at all? It seems that Emperor Chen must have a thief’s heart and is not thinking of using a small force to fight a big force.
Noticing the regret and hatred in Guo Tong’s eyes, Ye Shuo immediately understood who the other party’s target was.
As long as Emperor Zhou is killed, Emperor Chen may still have a chance to restore his country.
Seeing this man suddenly appearing without fear of life or death, with his sword pointed directly at the emperor who was surrounded by everyone, Xu Kui and General Wei almost instantly abandoned their original goals and tried to stop this figure.
But Ye Shuo had said before that with Wu Yi’s martial arts skills, it would not be a problem for him to fight his way in and out of a medium-sized army if he had sufficient physical strength. Guo Tong, who now has the title of Sword Saint, is probably only stronger than weaker. For such a master, it is basically impossible to win by numbers in such a narrow and complex terrain.
Seeing that Xu Kui and his cousin were about to die at the hands of Guo Tong’s sword, Ye Shuo no longer cared about protecting himself and immediately flew over as fast as he could.
“Clang!”
When he heard the sound of a longsword being unsheathed, Prince Ding subconsciously wanted to grab it, but he couldn’t even touch the corner of his brother’s clothes.
For a moment, Xu Kui and General Wei thought they were going to die. All they could see before them was the sky full of sword lights. At the last moment, the same thought came to their minds –
So this is the power of the Sword Saint, it really is like a god descending from heaven.
Then the two men reacted and realised that except for the long sword in their hands that was broken into two, they didn’t seem to feel any pain on their bodies.
Xu Kui and General Wei realised later that someone must have helped them block the sword move. However, when Xu Kui saw the dark suit with dragon patterns embroidered on it, his jaw almost dropped to the ground.
The one fighting with Guo Tong at this moment was actually… His Majesty?

chapters.title: Chapter 326: Help
chapters.content:
Regardless of what Guo Tong had done before or what kind of person he was, his swordsmanship was unquestionable. If Ye Shuo had not been equally skilled, he would have been defeated in the first encounter.
There is no false reputation under a great name, this saying is indeed true.
Noticing that the other secret guards swarmed over like leeches after seeing Guo Tong trapped them, Ye Shuo became more cautious in his actions.
In just a few breaths, the two had already fought several rounds.
When Ye Shuo felt the effort, Guo Tong was also extremely shocked. He had never imagined that the king of a country would have such advanced martial arts. For a while, even Guo Tong could hardly make any progress.
But no matter what, no matter what the cost, he must keep the other party here today!
Guo Tong was obsessed with swordsmanship all his life and had been indifferent to worldly affairs since childhood. When he went to Huandu, Guo Tong thought it was just an ordinary escort trip. At that time, he had been indifferent to worldly affairs for many years and had never participated in those power struggles. It was just that someone from his family came to him for help, saying that his family was now in decline, and the whole family had pushed a distant cousin to join the army, hoping that he could escort him and help him secure the position of a soldier.
After all, they were all members of the Guo clan. How many people in this world could completely give up their clan ties? In addition, the head of the clan spoke sincerely, so Guo Tong softened his heart and agreed. However, he could never have imagined that what he thought was a trivial matter would eventually lead to such a horrific disaster.
But now that things have come to this, no matter how much Guo Tong regrets, it is of no avail. The only thing he can do now is to devote all his energy to make up for it.
No matter how passionate Guo Tong was about swordsmanship, he could not accept the fact that he was one of the people behind Chen’s death.Thinking of this, Guo Tong’s movements became more fierce. He didn’t care whether he would get hurt or not. He was ready to exchange injury for injury, life for life.
Seeing the other side’s intention to fight for their lives, almost all the best soldiers in the army were dispatched. However, since Guo Tong had finally seized this opportunity, how could he be so easily defeated?
After a few rounds, the other leg of Prince Ding was almost cut off by the longsword in his hand. In order to resist the group of elusive secret guards, Xu Kui and General Wei were covered with large and small wounds. The whole body looked like it was fished out of blood. For a while, no one could successfully get close to them.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo probably realised that he could no longer rely on them.
Noticing the regret in Guo Tong’s eyes, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but laugh: “Everyone says that the great Sword Saint is obsessed with martial arts and is extraordinary. Now that I think about it, it’s not the case. He is still just like everyone else, an ordinary person.”
“It seems that even a sword master cannot escape the ties of worldly affairs.”
Guo Tong paused when he heard this and was almost stabbed in the neck by Ye Shuo.
Seeing that he didn’t answer, Ye Shuo didn’t get discouraged and continued, “When Huandu was captured, there was a general who surrendered, named Guo Zhun. I wonder if Sword Saint has heard of him?”
Guo Zhun is Guo Tong’s cousin, and this matter was discovered through interrogation by General Xu. In this way, there is an explanation for Guo Tong’s appearance there.
Guo Tong had only the sword in his hand in his eyes all his life, so he had no idea about the court struggles. He was probably fooled at that time.
After he finished speaking, looking at Guo Tong’s expression again, Ye Shuo became more certain of his guess. He just didn’t know if such a plan could succeed once, but whether it could succeed a second time.
Ye Shuo thought so and asked. However, when Ye Shuo saw that he used Guo’s family as a threat and Guo Tong was not moved at all, he knew that the same trick would be useless against Guo Tong.
Guo Tong has a cold heart and hardly cares about other people’s lives. As long as he has a definite idea in mind, he will kill without hesitation, just like when he faced Huo Rong, a stranger. Similarly, Guo Tong is also persistent and determined. Once he sets a goal, he will never be shaken by external things.
Realising this, Ye Shuo stopped wasting words and his mind became clearer.
Ye Shuo knew very well that he would not be able to escape easily under Guo Tong’s entanglement like a maggot attached to his bones. If he did not fight hard now, he would not have the chance to fight again in the future.   ᚱ
It’s just a fight of life. Guo Tong can do it, so why should I be afraid?
In just a moment, Guo Tong was nearly injured by the sharp sword light. Seeing that Emperor Zhou opposite him was not afraid at all, he felt relieved.
In his opinion, an emperor should be extremely afraid of death, just like Emperor Chen. Before the army of the Great Zhou Dynasty reached the capital, the enemy had already fled in panic overnight. How come the emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty was so tough?
Noticing the madness in Emperor Zhou’s eyes, even Guo Tong couldn’t help but hold his breath.
However, what Ye Shuo was thinking was not as complicated as what Guo Tong saw. There was only one thought left in his mind –
I can’t die yet.
The world was still unsettled at that time, and my mother and Yao Zhi were still in the capital. My three daughters were not yet adults, and I couldn’t die here no matter what.
Guo Tong, who wanted to restore his country, also would not allow himself to lose.
Since neither of them could retreat, the fight between them naturally became more and more intense, with sparks flying when their swords collided.
As the two men suffered more and more wounds, Prince Ding and Xu Kui tried several times to get close but failed. Just when Prince Ding and his companions were extremely anxious, they suddenly heard a whistle in the distance, followed by hundreds of grey shadows flying out. Under the stunned gaze of Prince Ding and his companions, the grey shadows quickly entangled with Jiu Chen’s secret guards. The momentum of Jiu Chen’s secret guards that could create a bloody trend with the swing of their dark short blades was immediately curbed.
Guo Tong’s breathing suddenly stagnated when he saw this. Ye Shuo caught him off guard and seized the opportunity to stab Guo Tong in the heart.
Although Guo Tong revealed a flaw, he was a veteran after all, so he stabbed the person opposite with the sword in his hand without even thinking about it, relying solely on muscle memory.
But after all, there was still a little bit of a difference.
Feeling a sharp pain in his chest, he quickly fought him off. After Guo Tong died and was completely unable to move, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smile.
“I won this battle after all…”
Even though Ye Shuo couldn’t help feeling a little proud at this moment, no matter what, the Sword Saint died in his hands.
However, unexpectedly, Ye Shuo covered his chest which was stabbed with a big wound, turned his head, and then saw the man in gray who was frowning and looking at him with disapproval.
Even though the man in gray was wearing a mask at the moment, Ye Shuo still confirmed his identity at the first moment.
It was my cheap master Wu Yi…
The wild smile on Ye Shuo’s face froze almost instantly. Then, seeing that Jiu Chen’s secret guards had completely fallen into a state of despair, Ye Shuo almost subconsciously closed his eyes and fell down.
Without saying anything more, they carefully brought the emperor to Prince Ding’s care. When he turned around again, Wu Yi’s eyes were like a bone-cutting knife, scraping all the remaining Chen State’s secret guards from head to toe.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Destruction
chapters.content:
When Wu Yi and his men arrived, what they saw was the emperor leading the way and fighting with Guo Tong.
Guo Tong was quite famous, so Wu Yi naturally recognized the iconic Luanqing sword.
For a moment, Wu Yi’s heart was in his throat, until the emperor seized the opportunity of Guo Tong’s arrival and killed him. Only then did Wu Yi breathe a sigh of relief.
His Majesty was reckless and put his own precious life in danger. Wu Yi was naturally very unhappy. But when Wu Yi’s eyes met the blood-red on the emperor’s chest, his gaze was immediately diverted.
In Wu Yi’s opinion, how could His Majesty be wrong? The ones who were wrong were obviously the traitors of the State of Chen. If they hadn’t been ignorant of good and bad and tried to resist stubbornly, how could His Majesty have been injured?
Thinking of this, Wu Yi’s expression became more and more unfriendly, and his attacks became more and more ruthless, which showed the helplessness of the leader of the secret guards since the reign of Emperor Jingwen.
Noticing that his cheap master finally stopped looking at him with that kind of eyes, Ye Shuo finally felt relieved.
Although my cheap master wouldn’t say anything, his silence and silent condemnation made it even more difficult to handle…
After more than a year, nearly two years of training, the secret guards that had become disorganised due to the frequent changes of two emperors have finally taken shape. With the addition of Wu Yi and others, the old subordinates of Emperor Chen who were originally flexibly moving among the army were soon killed. The large army that had become somewhat chaotic due to this wave of attacks quickly regained its composure under the command of General Xu Kui, Wei and others.
The fire in the Chen Kingdom’s palace burned for three days and three nights. Along with the collapse of the tallest building in the palace, the Xingque Tower, the Chen Kingdom, which had stood on this land for more than two hundred years, also completely collapsed.After three days of purge, Marquis Xiangding, who participated in it and had one arm stabbed, looked at the body of Marquis Yong’an beside him, then looked at the towering palace that was burned down in front of him. He seemed to be both sad and happy, and he just stood there in a daze for a while.
