Just when the people of the State of Chen were in confusion, on the seventh day after the capital was captured, a grim-faced general under the command of Emperor Zhou was seen carrying a head from the top of the city to the back. When everyone saw his face clearly, they were all horrified and stood still, unable to move.
This face is so similar to Emperor Chen…
Before the rest of the people of the Chen State could react, the visitor presented the head to the young-looking Emperor Zhou. Then, the Great Zhou announced the death of Emperor Chen.
At this point, the people of Chen, who had already been afraid of the strength of the Great Zhou, no longer had any thoughts of resistance. Seeing that the situation was hopeless, the flames of hope in their hearts were completely extinguished, so they knelt on the ground and surrendered.
As for whether the person brought back the real Chen emperor or a smokescreen released by the other party on his way to escape, who knows in this ancient time without photos? Ye Shuo said he was dead, so he was dead.
Just like that, with the issuance of one transfer order after another, this Western Expedition finally came to an end. As a secret guard, Wu Yi was accustomed to operating in the dark. After everything was over, the gray-clothed men he led quickly disappeared like ghosts, just as they came.
——
Early in the morning, when the sun was high in the sky, Ye Shuo finally woke up from his sleep.
Ever since the Great Zhou army occupied the old capital of the Chen Kingdom and the Chen Kingdom was completely destroyed, Ye Shuo’s originally tense nerves completely relaxed. In addition, knowing that his cheap master was lurking in the dark guarding here, Ye Shuo was finally able to have a good rest. He became lazy at a speed visible to the naked eye, as if he had returned to the period when he was a prince, and relaxed after a long time.
It’s not that Ye Shuo did this on purpose, it’s just that after the great victory, Prince Ding and his people had a very thick filter for him. As the emperor who led the Great Zhou to expand its territory, no matter what Ye Shuo did now, the people below felt that it was meaningful. Even though he didn’t want to use his brain recently because of too much brain power consumption, and even when he was distracted during meals, in the eyes of Prince Ding and others, he was thinking about national affairs. In this situation, how could Ye Shuo resist being lazy? Even if Ye Shuo handed over such an important matter as the arrangement of officials to the people below, the people below felt that this was a test from Ye Shuo to them. Everyone was very motivated, and the answers they handed in were much more reliable than Ye Shuo’s own hard thinking. 𝙍
Leisurely days are rare, and before Prince Ding and the others have used up this layer of filter, Ye Shuo will naturally try his best to avoid working if possible.
Little did they know that Ye Shuo, in order to save energy, had been speaking only half of his sentences recently, which made him seem even more unfathomable in the eyes of General Xu and others.
Facts have proved that human potential is unlimited, especially these ancient workers in front of them. They learn to guess the intentions of their superiors faster than each other. Whenever Ye Shuo shows a little intention, someone below will immediately get the job done.
Seeing this situation, Ye Shuo was thoughtful and felt that he had found a new trick to be an emperor. Since these people’s brains were more flexible than he thought, they probably wouldn’t mind if he assigned them more things to do. After all… the more capable, the more work they should do.
I don’t know if it’s an illusion, but Prince Ding always feels that he has been getting busier and busier recently. But seeing that other people are the same and no one else says anything, Prince Ding feels embarrassed to complain.
Since everyone is like this, it should be normal. After the war, there are a lot of troubles afterwards, so it is normal that he needs to do more than usual.
Moreover, although he was only an assistant in the destruction of Chen, he was still a participant after all. With such an achievement, he would be proud of it even if he met his ancestors in the underworld. If he was lucky, he might even be recorded in the history books with his brother! Even if he could not become an emperor, he still had the opportunity to leave his name in history.
Thinking of this, Prince Ding was suddenly filled with energy.
Ye Shuo watched his eldest brother complain secretly at the beginning, but he adjusted his mind in just half an incense stick of time. He couldn’t help but sigh that his brothers were so positive and enterprising from the beginning to the end…
Seeing that the people under him were so motivated, Ye Shuo felt relieved.
Because of the old Chen Chuping, Wang Du was not very stable, and Ye Shuo was stabbed by Guo Tong at the last moment. Although he was quite concerned about Shangjing, he still suppressed his temper and healed his wounds under the care of Master Wu Yi.
In Ye Shuo’s opinion, health is the capital of revolution, and the situation like Xiao Ming and his son is really undesirable.
It is said that if Xiao Ming knew about this scene in the afterlife, he would probably be so angry that he would die, and there is a possibility that he would jump out of the mausoleum and beat him up.
After being stunned for a moment, seeing that it was time for the daily dressing change, Ye Shuo called over the army’s most gentle doctor to treat his wounds. He looked as careful as he could be.
Ye Shuo would never take risks unless it was necessary. He felt that he might be the emperor who valued his life the most. However, his opponent this time was a sword master after all, and he was still injured. Ye Shuo had been recuperating in Peicheng, the former capital of the State of Chen, now the Great Zhou, for two months. After his wounds were completely healed, Peicheng also stabilised. The officials transferred from Shangjing took office one after another, and after the new garrisons were in place, the matter of returning to Beijing was naturally put on the agenda.
After such a long period of experience, Xu Kui has grown from being immature at the beginning to being able to stand on his own now. In addition, after this battle, General Xu is too old to fight again. But the opponent is an old man who has experienced four dynasties and has devoted his life to the Great Zhou. His six sons have all died on the battlefield. Ye Shuo was afraid that his straightforward statement would discourage the old generals, so after thinking about it, he decided to leave Xu Kui to guard this place.
The situation was exactly the same as that of Ye Shuo’s father, Emperor Jingwen. They were both generals guarding the border. Anyone with a discerning eye could see that the emperor was planning to have Xu Kui take over his grandfather’s job. With the abilities Xu Kui had shown along the way, if he could keep up the momentum in the future, he would naturally have a bright future.
General Xu was already a first-rank general before this expedition. After this battle, he could no longer be promoted to any higher rank. He was too old and no longer able to fight. It would be a great choice for him to retire. Since the emperor has given such respect to General Xu’s grandson, it means that he has no intention of abandoning him and is willing to preserve the prosperity of General Xu’s family. This is a good ending that a soldier could never dream of.
The others in the tent were naturally extremely envious when they heard this. At this moment, they only hated themselves for not being capable enough, hated that their children and grandchildren were not as hardworking as Xu Kui from the old general’s family, and could not ask the emperor to give them the same respect. Thinking this way, these people did not see the sudden change in General Xu’s face after the emperor issued the order.
General Xu had never expected that the emperor would give such grace to their family, and he was almost exposed when he was caught off guard.
Prince Ding on the side was a little confused when he saw this, but Ye Shuo pretended not to see it even though he saw it. He had a faint smile on his face, but he was wondering in his heart if he had gone too far. He was afraid that he would scare the old general to death. But the words were already spoken, and he couldn’t take them back, not to mention that he really thought so in his heart.
General Xu was totally unaware that the emperor was in a bad mood at the moment, and he barely dealt with the congratulations from the remaining generals. Late at night, Ye Shuo, who did not like drinking, returned to the king’s tent first. As expected, General Xu came to him on his own after a while.
Before Ye Shuo could say anything, General Xu knelt down without saying a word and bowed deeply to him.
“This old minister has come to see you late at night and has disturbed Your Majesty’s rest. I hope Your Majesty will forgive me.”
It’s finally here…
Upon hearing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think so.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Cold Sweat
chapters.content:
“General Xu, there is no need to be polite.”
“Come here, please take a seat.”
Seeing the deep wrinkles on General Xu’s face and his face that looked older than people of the same age, Ye Shuo’s heart softened and he subconsciously wanted to shout.
However, General Xu below did not dare to answer at all. In fact, just at the banquet, the moment the emperor issued the decree, General Xu felt as if his life was hanging by a thread.
If some things are not said at the beginning, they will only be delayed again and again, mistakes will be made again and again, and finally they will be completely irreversible.
Thinking of this, General Xu couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. He now only hoped that the emperor would show leniency to him and his family because of their dedication to the country. Otherwise, if the act of deceiving the emperor was proven, it would be a heinous crime punishable by the execution of all nine generations of his family.
Now the Xu family is dwindling and can no longer withstand the turmoil. Its decline is inevitable. After two years of fighting, the emperor has already brought all the generals under his control. Old General Xu wants to take care of things, but he has no strength.
I just hope His Majesty will show mercy, but such a good opportunity, let alone His Majesty, I’m afraid that ordinary people will not let it go…
Thinking of this, General Xu became more submissive and said resignedly, “I dare not. I came here this time to apologise to the emperor for something.”
“Oh? If it’s an important matter, you can just speak frankly.”Because General Xu had his head down, he did not notice the encouragement on Ye Shuo’s face.
General Xu paused, then gritted his teeth, hardened his heart, and told out the secret he had hidden for many years.
“Your Majesty, my grandson Xu Kui…is actually a woman.”
The matter itself was not complicated. It was just that Xu Kui’s father died in battle and did not leave behind any male offspring. In order to protect the family business, Xu Kui’s mother, who was pregnant at the time, was forced to resort to this last resort. This deception lasted for nearly twenty years.
Xu Kui’s mother and servants thought they had concealed the truth very well, but they had not expected that General Xu had fought on the battlefield for many years and had a very sharp eye. Even the spies in the army could not hide from him, let alone the bloodline of his own son.
“At that time, I saw my daughter-in-law was nervous and almost tore her swaddling clothes when she faced me. I thought that she was a new bride who had just married into my Xu family. Her husband died within three months. If she didn’t have a son, her future life would definitely not be easy. I softened my heart at that time, so I didn’t pursue the matter any further and just pretended I didn’t know.”
Who would have thought that his grandson and granddaughter not only replaced the men’s identities, but also went their own way when they grew up, joining the army alone to fight on behalf of their father and uncles.
It was against military law for a woman to enter a military camp and it was a serious crime. Fortunately, Xu Kui knew how to disguise herself and she always did a great job. No one had discovered the woman’s identity for such a long time. General Xu was both relieved and conflicted at the same time. No matter how Xu Kui performed over the years, he was only met with abuse and suppression because of this.
General Xu knew that a woman could not become a general, and he only hoped that his granddaughter would give up when faced with difficulties, get married and have children as soon as possible, and live a peaceful life. But Xu Kui was born stubborn, or perhaps because she was brought up as a man since she was a child. Seeing that her grandfather looked down on her, she thought that she had not done well enough, and instead of backing down, she relied on her excellent martial arts to defeat a group of men and fought her way up from the bottom of the society.
Now, even General Xu felt a headache, not knowing what to do. General Xu hated that she was not a man. If Xu Kui was a man, she could take over the Xu family naturally. Why did she end up in such a difficult situation now?
“I, an old minister, have committed a crime of deceiving the emperor. I hope Your Majesty will forgive me.”
As soon as he finished speaking, General Xu prostrated himself.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh.
Just when General Xu’s heart was about to be in suspense, he heard the man above him say, “General Xu, you are being too narrow-minded. Women have been generals since ancient times. Why can’t women be generals?”
Even though General Xu was born a military general and was not particular about details, he could not escape the trend of the times.
When General Xu heard this, he suddenly became delighted after he realised what was happening. You know, even though Xu Kui was a girl, she was the most promising one among the remaining young people in the family. Over the years, the grandfather and granddaughter had been interacting with each other, and General Xu always had a sharp tongue, but in his heart he was very satisfied and loved her. Ꞧ
Now that His Majesty has said this, does it mean that there is still hope?
He was afraid that he was too happy too soon. The next moment, he suppressed his turmoil and said quickly, “Women are naturally inferior to men. If a woman becomes a general, how can she convince the people in the future?”
“Achievements come first, men and women come second, why do the people below not accept it?” Xu Kui fought his way up with real strength and military exploits, and everyone saw it. No one said anything along the way. If they want to use her status as a woman to attack her later, isn’t it ridiculous? As for the future, I believe Xu Kui can handle it himself.
General Xu was still a little hesitant after hearing this. After all, General Xu was old, and it was normal that it was difficult to change the ideas formed over decades.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo had to remind him again: “My dear, don’t forget that I only have three princesses under my knees now.”
Old General Xu was only thinking about his own affairs. After hearing what the emperor said, he suddenly realised that the emperor now only had three daughters, and there was no prince in the palace until today. He kept saying that women were inferior to men, which was extremely offensive. No wonder the emperor was unhappy.
“The three princesses are descendants of the phoenix and the dragon, so they are not subject to ordinary people. I, an old minister, have spoken out of turn, and I hope Your Majesty will forgive me.” General Xu subconsciously apologised.
Seeing that the other party still couldn’t get round to it, Ye Shuo had to continue to add: “I am now over thirty, not as young and strong as I was before, so I cherish the three princesses the most. I only hope that the three princesses can be like your granddaughters when they grow up, and I will be satisfied.”
Judging from the qualifications of the two daughters Dingning and Anning before the expedition, they should be quite good. Yongning is too young to be clearly seen now, but regardless of whether it is good or bad, Ye Shuo doesn’t really care.
Since the day he became emperor, his family was doomed to have no way out. Dingning and Anning are born smart and intelligent, which is a good thing and icing on the cake. If one of them accidentally gives birth to a son in the future, that’s fine. Even if the three daughters are mediocre, as long as they are not cruel, Ye Shuo will work with Yao Zhi to find a way to recommend one of them to ascend the throne before both of them pass away.
Ye Shuo thought to himself that as long as he could make his family business big enough while he was alive, and as long as his three daughters were not too stupid or spendthrift, they would be able to live a peaceful life. As for the future, no matter how prosperous a dynasty was, there would always be a day when it would perish, and he did not need to worry about what would happen in the future.
There is an old saying that parents who love their children will plan for them in the long run. The first step is to unite all the people who can be united. In the next few decades, he will clear away all the obstacles that stand in the way and hinder his daughter’s future.
In fact, ever since he saw Xu Kui for the first time, Ye Shuo knew that General Xu and Xu Kui were a good choice. As such things happened more often in the future, the three princesses no longer took them seriously.
Ye Shuo was not stupid, so he would naturally not let his three daughters take the lead and fight against the entire dynasty on their own and become the target of public criticism.
If you want to accomplish this, you have to proceed step by step.
Finally figuring out what was going on, General Xu couldn’t help but look up. He saw the emperor, who had just said that he was not energetic, but was actually very vigorous, looking at him with his eyes lowered and smiling. An idea suddenly crossed General Xu’s mind –
His Majesty must have known from the very beginning that Kui’er was a girl.
The second thought was that the emperor was so crazy that he wanted to hand over the country to the princess!
If Emperor Jingwen knew about this… Thinking of this, General Xu suddenly broke out in a cold sweat.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Done
chapters.content:
Shock, horror…all kinds of emotions spread in my heart.
General Xu’s first reaction was that if these shocking words were heard by outsiders, the consequences would be disastrous.
But seeing that His Majesty was so confident, General Xu came to his senses immediately. Even if he told others about His Majesty’s plan, no one would believe him. Everyone would think he was crazy.
After all, there has never been such a precedent from ancient times to the present, and the emperor is simply taking advantage of this almost default rule.
After figuring out the key, Old General Xu cried out in his heart, “My late emperor, when you passed away, you should have left a will and several important ministers in the court. You should not have allowed the current emperor to succeed to the throne.”
During these years, especially the past two years of war, General Xu thought that the formerly dissolute Ninth Prince had turned over a new leaf. However, who would have thought that he had become even more daring and reckless when no one knew about it.
In the past, the late emperor and his elder brother tried to stop him, but now he is the emperor himself, and even if someone still wants to control him, they can no longer do so.
If he was young, General Xu would have been very flustered when he heard this, especially since it concerned the future crown prince, he would not dare to get involved. But now General Xu is old, and he is wise. No matter how incredible the news is, General Xu can calm down in a very short time and then instinctively analyse the pros and cons.
His Majesty’s words may make people feel panic at first, but if you think about it carefully, they are not that dangerous at all, but rather beneficial.
General Xu knew very well that his family could no longer find a male who could support the family. Not to mention that he could not bear to give up his granddaughter Xu Kui. Even if he left her behind on the grounds of gender and found someone else, as long as he died, the Xu family would not be able to hold on for long and would fall into decline.But if Kui’er is supported, it will be completely different. If what His Majesty said is true, then His Majesty just needs such a vanguard now. In the future, when the princess ascends the throne, she will also need military power to protect her. Kui’er is a crucial link among them.
Even if a prince had to fight to ascend the throne, how difficult would it be for a princess to ascend the throne? But precisely because it is difficult and rare, such a subordinate relationship is less likely to be abandoned.
As long as the princess is alive and as long as Kui’er doesn’t make any big mistakes, the Xu family will have a worry-free future in the next few decades.
For General Xu, although the incense is important, the more important thing is the practical benefits. Besides, the emperor is going to hand over all his property to the princess, what else can he, as a general, hesitate about?
General Xu himself is not such a pedantic person. Thinking of this, he suddenly felt a lot more relaxed.
Although the deep-rooted obsession with blood inheritance would not fade away in a short time, when he thought that the one who should be most anxious should be Emperor Jingwen in the underworld, and there was no point in him, as a minister, being panicked, General Xu suddenly stopped being anxious.
Especially when General Xu tentatively asked, the emperor was so decisive, and there might be a bumpy road ahead, after hearing the emperor’s words, “Since I dare to do it, there will naturally be arrangements for the follow-up”, General Xu was completely relieved.
This is the difference between ordinary ministers and close ministers. If there are any disturbances in the future, or if the emperor has any plans, their Xu family will be qualified to get first-hand information.
Seeing that His Majesty was not acting impulsively, but had planned for a long time and had made many back-up plans, and was not just betting on himself, General Xu felt that this move was indeed promising and had a promising future. The last bit of entanglement in his heart was completely dissipated, and instead he felt a faint sense of joy that he had taken advantage of and got on board the big ship of His Majesty.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but add: “In this case, I’ll trouble the old general to worry about the other generals.”
It is not uncommon for a family of military generals to have all six sons die in battle, like General Xu. Moreover, military generals are not always particular about details and are less pedantic than civil officials, so this is a good breakthrough point.
Now that General Xu has boarded Ye Shuo’s ship, he will naturally follow Ye Shuo’s lead and will respond to all requests, even if it is a trivial matter.
It was late at night, and General Xu was about to leave the king’s tent when he heard the leader say one last sentence:
“Although I love my daughter dearly, I don’t want my Ye family to fall into the hands of others, and I don’t want this to end up being used as a wedding dress for others. General Xu, do you understand?”
To put things one thing at a time, if productivity develops to a certain level in the future so that the country can change hands, that would be fine. But if not, then this vast country can only belong to the Ye family.
General Xu saw the dim, flickering candlelight all around him shining on the emperor’s handsome face. Although it was just a light remark, it frightened the knowledgeable General Xu.
Even if the princess ascends the throne, she cannot be childless. Since he wants to leave offspring, the future emperor will have to choose a son-in-law. The best choice is a young man with a good family background, who is loyal to the princess and can fight for the princess against his family. The second best choice is a man of humble origin but quite capable, who can assist the princess wholeheartedly. If the best and the middle strategies are all unavailable, or if he is bewitched by treacherous people at first and becomes greedy, or if he wants to use the princess’ offspring as a threat, then he can only…
Thinking of this, General Xu couldn’t help but flash a hint of murderous intent in his eyes.
Old General Xu understood that the emperor was not only talking about the princess, but also about himself. The emperor was reminding him that there must be no mistakes regarding Kui’er’s future marriage and offspring. The emperor would not allow any accidents to happen, otherwise the entire Xu family would be in trouble.
General Xu’s heart trembled, and he immediately had an idea in his mind.
“Yes, I know what to do.”
Seeing that General Xu really understood and was not pretending to know, Ye Shuo was satisfied, so he waved his hand and mercifully let him go.
General Xu was just digesting the huge news that would shock the government and the country tonight. As soon as he went out, he ran into his anxious granddaughter.
After the emperor gave the order, Xu Kui felt as if a bucket of cold water was poured over her head. The joy of conquering the State of Chen disappeared in an instant and she calmed down instantly. She also knew that concealing her identity as a woman was a great crime of deceiving the emperor and destroying her clan, so she hurried over to confess her crime at the first opportunity.
Xu Kui thought that as long as the emperor did not implicate her grandfather and the Xu family, she would not complain even if he ordered her to be executed. However, she did not expect that her grandfather had entered the royal tent before her. Because the emperor did not order a summons, Xu Kui had been waiting until now. During this period, Xu Kui’s pride and complacency due to his successive great achievements had completely subsided.
The night was getting deeper and the dew was heavier. Noticing that his granddaughter was flustered but also calm, General Xu couldn’t help but sigh. He thought to himself that he had never taught her much in the past, but she still relied on the military books left by her father and the family training to reach where she is now. And it happened that the emperor had an inspiration. General Xu couldn’t help but sigh that perhaps this was God’s will.
General Xu felt that it was time to bring out all his best skills. Although his granddaughter was no longer the same as before, she was still far from being able to become a military commander.
Xu Kui had already prepared herself to be reprimanded after confessing. This was because she was the one who made the mistake first, and she had no intention of escaping anything. However, what Xu Kui never expected was that General Xu’s first words made her stand still.
My grandfather actually knew my identity from the very beginning!
After General Xu selectively revealed the emperor’s plan to her, Xu Kui was stunned. After a while, she couldn’t help but murmured, “The emperor is indeed different from other men in the world.”
Not only has his kung fu reached perfection, but his thoughts are also beyond the ordinary. How can there be such a perfect person in the world? Such a monarch is worth following.
General Xu choked, noticing his granddaughter’s admiring gaze, and suddenly thought of something. General Xu hurriedly said, “Although the emperor favours you, he has other reasons. Don’t let your imagination wander.”
Seeing her grandfather speaking so harshly, Xu Kui was stunned for a moment, then she reacted and also felt it was incredible: “Grandfather, what are you thinking about!” She had never known that under her grandfather’s cold face, there was such a side. Not to mention that the emperor already has a queen, just talking about the love between a young man and a woman, how can it compare to the commander of an army with great power?
The two of them looked at each other, and the grandfather and granddaughter looked at each other in bewilderment. They realised what they had said, and even General Xu couldn’t help feeling embarrassed.
Xu Kui had never seen such an expression on her grandfather’s face before, and she couldn’t help but burst into laughter. At the same time, she knew why she was pardoned. Although Xu Kui had never met the three princesses, she felt three more points of gratitude in her heart.
Xu Kui is not stupid. She is currently borrowing the power of the three princesses and is destined to become a sword in the princesses’ hands in the near future.
General Xu’s old face tensed and relaxed, and after a long while, he finally softened his heart completely.
On the other side, Ye Shuo thought about it for a long time, and finally sat there alone. Under the candlelight, he picked up the pen and wrote the first word.
Everything has two sides, there is nothing in the world that cannot be used, and there is no one who cannot be used, just like nowadays most people look down on women. In this case, it doesn’t matter even if Ye Shuo gives them more benefits. To put it bluntly, in today’s world, Ye Shuo doesn’t have to worry about Xu Kui rebelling. I believe Xu Kui understands in her heart that others would not be so generous.
Ye Shuo didn’t think there was anything wrong with taking advantage of such injustice to achieve his own goals.
Just like that, on the second day Xu Kui’s identity was exposed, and before the other generals could object, the emperor’s decree to confer her a title of nobility arrived. Not to mention the generals under him, even Xu Kui and the old General Xu were shocked by the emperor’s generosity.
Being granted a title of nobility and appointed as prime minister is the ultimate pursuit for a minister.
With a title, it can be passed down from generation to generation. In this way, General Xu will not allow outsiders to take advantage of the opportunity. This real title must fall on the heads of her own family.
Is this the benefit of forming a united front with His Majesty? General Xu suddenly began to feel fortunate that he had known the current situation. He also understood that the so-called life and death was only a matter of His Majesty’s whim. Thinking of this, General Xu became more cautious.
With such a role model, I believe General Xu’s subsequent work will become much smoother.
If it were in modern society, it would be fine. Since Ye Shuo was the emperor of a feudal dynasty, any word he said could be an imperial decree. He didn’t believe that he couldn’t do anything he wanted to do!
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo didn’t delay any longer. With a wave of his hand, he returned to the court with hundreds of thousands of troops.
Just eight or nine days after Ye Shuo took action, people in Beijing received the news.
At that time, the former prime minister was now bedridden, and the newly elected younger generation had not yet come into contact with the centre of power and was not even qualified to attend court. Naturally, news about the war was still blocked.
But the news of His Majesty’s triumphant return was too surprising, and the Queen and Princess Jianjian did not deliberately control it. How could the joyous atmosphere in Shangjing be hidden from the eyes of the Prime Minister’s Office?
Ever since His Majesty went to war, he has been sighing all day long. In recent days, he has been muttering that he is old and useless, and will soon go down to see the late emperor. When the former Prime Minister He heard from his grandson that the entire Chen Kingdom has now been incorporated into the Great Zhou, and that His Majesty will arrive in Shangjing soon, he couldn’t control himself and sat up from the bed.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Worship
chapters.content:
On the day when the emperor led his troops back to the capital, the whole of Shangjing was in an uproar.
He Xiang ignored the objections of his family and, supported by his servants, staggered out to the street.
Feeling the joy of the people around him, He Xiang’s expression was filled with shock, complexity, and deep confusion.
Is all this before my eyes real or an illusion, or is it just a beautiful dream I had when I was seriously ill and dying?
The old prime minister couldn’t help but pinched his thigh hard.
Although the old ministers did not gather together, at this moment, they all did the same thing without any prior agreement.
The facts were before their eyes and they had no choice but to believe them.
Feeling the sharp pain in his thigh, after a brief daze, the old prime minister’s eyes and heart suddenly burst into an extreme enthusiasm, as if he had been chosen by the emperor to be the new top scholar and was paraded through the streets on horseback.
If what His Majesty had said, which they considered to be nothing but nonsense, could really come true, then…
“Help me return home! Also, have Mingxin pass a sign to the palace, begging His Majesty to show mercy and invite an imperial physician to come to our house.”If one day it really came true but he was not able to see it with his own eyes, he would not be able to close his eyes even if he died.
But if you want to see that kind of scene, you must be alive first. At this moment, the old prime minister only hated himself for giving up on himself in the past.
I don’t know if it’s too late for me to take medicine properly and listen to the imperial physician’s advice and maintain my health now that I’m at my age.
In the eyes of everyone in the prime minister’s residence, this scene was like the old man going out for a trip, and when he came back he looked very young, as if he was thirty years old. All his previous illness was swept away, causing everyone to tremble with fear, fearing that the old man was having a last breath. The eldest grandson of the eldest house even prepared a coffin, fearing that it would be too late by then.
Not only was this the case in the Prime Minister’s Residence, the same scene also occurred in the residences of Shangshu Ling and others. All of a sudden, all the funeral supplies shops in the south of the city were extremely busy. After all, they received so many orders from dignitaries at once, and each of them specifically requested only high-quality products. Even for them, they could not finish processing them all in a short time.
Fortunately, after a few days, everyone saw that their old grandfather could still eat and drink normally, and they gradually put their minds at ease.
At the same time, on the other side, a long army was winding its way from dozens of miles outside the city. Ye Shuo was dressed in a dark tight suit and a bright armour. Every scale of the armour was polished like a mirror, reflecting the shining light under the sun, enveloping Ye Shuo as if he were a god descending to the earth.
At this moment, not to mention the common people on both sides of the road, even the royal officials standing at the city gate to welcome them could not help but feel a surge of emotion.
The person before them was the emperor they relied on and followed.
Although Dingning was the oldest of the three princesses, she was still a child after all. She did not want to embarrass her father and mother, so she tried her best to remain calm. However, if you looked closely, you could see that her little fists were clenched tightly under her sleeves.
Seeing that the two sisters were somewhat out of control, especially Yongning who could not speak clearly and actually tried to break free from the wet nurse’s arms, and seeing that her mother and others were not paying attention to this side, Dingning hurriedly stepped over the bewildered wet nurse and took the younger sister out of the wet nurse’s arms, and took the initiative to hold the little sister’s hand to prevent her from moving.
Ye Shuo ordered the troops to stop, and the moment he dismounted, everyone except the empress and the queen mother knelt down and saluted, shouting “Long live the emperor” three times.
“Welcome His Majesty back to the capital. Long live His Majesty.”
Ye Shuo almost subconsciously looked past the crowd, his gaze first fell on his mother. He smiled at her, and then looked at Yao Zhi.
When Empress Dowager Wei saw that her son was fine, she felt relieved. As for Empress Dowager He, although she was still envious, so many years had passed and her mentality was no longer the same as before.
Yao Zhi’s eyes never left Ye Shuo from beginning to end. As she looked at him from afar and their eyes met, Ye Shuo inexplicably felt as if he was dislocated in time.
In the past, as a prince, he was one of those who stood at the city gate with his mother and father to welcome the victorious generals. Now, he has gradually become the one being welcomed.
It’s like a child who originally needed to rely on others, but now has grown into the supreme ruler who is relied upon by everyone and who absolutely cannot fall down.
Time really passes by so fast…
It was just a moment of distraction, and then Ye Shuo noticed several female officials beside Yao Zhi. Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smile even more.
It seems that Yao Zhi has discovered something and is ready to fight alongside him.
Anyway, no one else dared to look up. The expression on Ye Shuo’s face was almost undisguised. Seeing this, Yao Zhi couldn’t help but glare at him.
Compared to the fact that he conferred the title of Marquis upon a female in one breath and took in all the talented women in the capital as his female officials, it was really nothing.
Then the two of them couldn’t help but sigh at the same time, alas, it’s all for the children.
Not only Ye Shuo, Yao Zhi was also afraid that a hundred years later, her three daughters, who were once respected and prized, would be bullied and fall from being the most beloved princesses into the quagmire. Rather than that, it would be better to let them take the position of those in power.
The two queen dowagers standing by were completely confused, not knowing what the young couple had communicated in this short moment. The next moment, they heard Ye Shuo’s voice.
“My dear ministers, you have worked hard. Please stand up.”
Dingning was about to breathe a sigh of relief, fortunately her two younger sisters did not cause any trouble. However, what she did not expect was that although her two younger sisters did not cause trouble, she could not stop her own father from causing trouble!
Ye Shuo hasn’t seen his three little darlings for nearly two years. Now that they are finally back, how can he bear it?
Dingning was distracted for a moment, and when she reacted again, her feet were already in the air.
When she looked up, Dingning saw that her father, who had been very steady just now, opened his arms and hugged the three sisters in his arms like chicks.
Yongning was born not long ago when Ye Shuo went to the war, and he had no impression of his father. He was caught off guard by Zhang Sheng’s face getting so close to him. Dingning was stunned at first, and then he couldn’t help but scream.
“As expected of my daughter, even her voice is louder than that of an ordinary person.”
Seeing that her brother didn’t care and was instead very proud, Jianjian on the side wanted to say something but hesitated. In the end, she turned her head away as if she couldn’t bear it, not daring to look at her nieces’ eyes asking for help.
I’m sorry, but I can’t help you with this matter, because… I went through the same thing back then!
Not to mention Yongning, even Dingning wanted to scream. Really, please, pay attention to the occasion, Dad!
Dingning vaguely saw the censor who came to commemorate the victory on this happy day, and his hand holding the pen was already trembling slightly.
Zhang Yushi, who was on duty today, was originally quite happy that he had caught up with such an important matter, but in the end…
I really shouldn’t have any expectations of His Majesty.
Censor Zhang was unable to put pen to paper and suddenly did not know how to record. If he wrote it down as it was, he would feel ashamed as a member of the Great Zhou Dynasty. But if he did not write it down as it was, he would be unworthy of his identity as a censor.
Censor Zhang felt that his writing skills had improved so much in just a few years that there was really no need to improve them any further.
Looking at the royal relatives standing by, especially the two old princes, their faces turned green.
But… I dare not say it. If I say it, I don’t know what kind of trouble it will cause. It’s a happy day, especially when we have to go to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to worship our ancestors. If the little ancestor in front of us is no longer happy, the old ancestors won’t be happy either. This person is not the kind of person who will save face for the ancestors.
On the contrary, the ministers below, worthy of being the emperor’s students, were much more receptive than others.
Yao Zhi on the side didn’t care. In her opinion, it was natural for a father to be close to his daughter and there was no room for others to interfere.
As for Queen Mother Wei, she has never cared about anything, especially when it comes to her own children. No matter how much she loves them, she never feels it is enough and would never help outsiders.
Ding Ning couldn’t help it and pleaded in a low voice: “Father, can you let me down?”
It would be fine if the two sisters were so young, but how old is she? How could she be embarrassed?
However, Ye Shuo said: “You three are princesses, different from princes. No matter what, no matter what happens, you should be one body, and you must not be separated. Father and mother will not leave any of you behind.”
At that time, Dingning didn’t understand what her father meant. When she understood, she realised the painstaking efforts of her father and mother.
However, before Ding Ning could think about it, he heard his father say in a low voice, “Besides, you should pay attention to what your uncle and his friends do. No matter what you do or how you do it, your uncle and his friends will always find fault with you.”
I haven’t changed in all these years, but I’ve gotten through it, haven’t I? As a human being, you still have to be thick-skinned.
Ding Ning saw that she really couldn’t persuade him, so she could only sigh and resign herself to her fate while softly comforting her two sisters.
After all, Ye Shuo is An Ning and Yong Ning’s biological father. After the initial panic, they gradually adapted to the situation. Of course, this is also related to Ye Shuo’s current mighty and domineering image. After all, although they have no impression of their biological father, they still know what the word “father” means.
With the childish words that made the princes look painful, Ye Shuo soon gained the admiring gazes of the other two little ones.
“Is it true? Father is so awesome!” An Ning, who was a little older, couldn’t help but applaud after hearing the general process of the battle with Jiu Chen.
Seeing her sister’s actions, Yongning also subconsciously started to get busy.
Ye Shuo chuckled and said, “Don’t worry, when little Dingning, little Anning, and little Yongning grow up, they will be as powerful as their father.”
“Really?”
“Of course.”
The two old princes who were listening at the back now had pale faces. If they had experienced modern society, they would definitely curse, using repetitive and disgusting words.
Although their nephew has not reached that level, he has already made these extremely serious and stern patriarchs frown and feel like they will explode at any time.
How shameless!
The two old princes originally thought that this was the limit, but they still underestimated their nephew. When they watched Ye Shuo pulling the three little princesses to kneel upright on the futon in front of the tablet of Emperor Jingwen, they still couldn’t hold it in.
Who can bear to see this scene!!!
From ancient times to the present, when the royal family worships their ancestors, only the Queen Mother, the Empress and the Crown Prince can accompany them. Does he know what this means!!!
He is such a filial son. If my brother knew about this…
Although the tablet is still the same, the two old princes always feel that the tablet is crying at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Change of Name
chapters.content:
Among the three children, only Dingning hesitated for a moment. The remaining two had no idea what was going on. When they saw Ye Shuo’s action, they immediately followed suit.
Seeing that the three had moved and he was the only one still standing, Dingning gritted his teeth, closed her eyes, and knelt down as well.
The dull sound of four pairs of knees hitting the mat made the hearts of everyone present, except Ye Shuo, tremble.
If it were someone else, they would have been warned when they were leading the princesses to the Hall of Supreme Harmony. But what can they say? After all, people cannot be generalised. How can the first-class Emperor Taicheng be compared with this devil? So the two old princes hesitated.
The two old princes thought that no matter how unreliable their nephew was, he would not cause any trouble at this time, right?
Facts have proved that the two old princes have not seen enough of the world, or maybe they have been lax after not seeing him for such a long time.
While everyone was stunned, Ye Shuo had already brought his three daughters to kowtow to his deceased father.
“Dingning, Anning, Yongning, come here and pay your respects to your grandfather.” Ye Shuo signalled the three of them with his eyes, pointing to the tablet not far away, and told them to kowtow quickly and not to delay, lest they act too late and the matter be ruined.
Although Dingning still doesn’t quite understand why her father does this, her keen sixth sense is reminding her to listen to her father.
While others were still not able to react, Dingning remained calm and kowtowed calmly to the tablet of Emperor Jingwen.“Dingning has met the Emperor grandfather and pays her respects to him.”
Remembering what his father had said on the way, Dingning pulled the sleeves of the other two princesses again.
An Ning and Yong Ning were ignorant and followed suit: “An Ning/Yong Ning, pay respects to the Emperor grandfather.”
The two old princes: “…”
I can’t help it, I really can’t help it this time!
This is simply too much!
The clear voices of the three princesses made the atmosphere in the Hall of Supreme Harmony even more strange.
According to the procedure, the emperor knelt first, and the rest of the royal family and ministers followed suit. Ye Shuo’s students who were of high rank and could enter the Hall of Supreme Harmony had already knelt. The rest of the royal family, especially the princes, the fifth prince, and the seventh prince were just hesitating whether to kneel or not, or just pretending not to see it, when the two old princes were already furious and trembling, saying, “This, this is outrageous!”
The two old princes were indeed considering the Ye royal family and had helped Ye Shuo a lot before, but they also paid attention to the rules.
With the two taking the lead, the other originally dissatisfied relatives immediately followed suit, as if they had seen something unclean, and immediately began to speak harshly. However, they did not dare to direct their spearheads at Ye Shuo, the emperor. So they turned their eyes and immediately looked at the three young princesses, accusing the princesses of not knowing the rules, being unstable, and overstepping their authority.
Ye Shuo discovered that no matter whether in ancient times or modern times, different people used the same words, and after translation, it seemed that there was no essential difference.
Ye Shuo didn’t show it on his face and even smiled, but in his heart he was taking a hard note of them, and the ones with more radical attitudes were ranked higher on the list.
Now these people can’t even accept the princess kowtowing to his father, so they will certainly not be able to accept the princess taking power in the future.
Yes, Ye Shuo did it on purpose. It was a desensitisation treatment. Although Ding Ning and the others were still young, they could start now. The earlier they were prepared, the less panicked they would be in the future. Ye Shuo was used to keeping a backup plan. It was the same in his previous life and in this life as well.
Go ahead and curse them all, sooner or later Master Wu Yi will kill them all.
These clan members have been enjoying the tributes from the emperors of their lineage for generations. It would be fine if they could not play any role, but they like to make decisions. Most of them are extravagant and rely on their royal blood to do evil. This is a problem that almost all dynasties will have after several generations. Thinking of some of the things he had heard and seen before, Ye Shuo felt more and more indifferent. Since these people are so ignorant, there is no need to keep them. This way, the national treasury can be relieved of a lot of burden, and the Great Zhou will not have to be dragged down by these parasites. �
Completely unaware that beneath Ye Shuo’s smiling face was hidden a murderous intent, the group of clan members felt a chill down their spines, but they thought it was just an illusion and continued to attack with all their might.
A hint of sadness flashed across Dingning’s eyes at first, but then she quickly perked up when she saw her father, mother, grandmother and aunt standing beside her and her two sisters.
Alas, doing this is really unfair to them.
However, there is nothing we can do about it.
Ye Shuo reached out and touched the heads of his three daughters, then stood up and said casually, “They are just a few princesses. What’s the big deal? I was young before, so I never brought them with me during the New Year’s Day. I thought that on this happy day, I could take this opportunity to add to my joy and bring them to see my father. Why do you have to be so harsh? It’s a bit of an exaggeration.”
Ye Shuo’s nonchalant attitude made the clan members feel as if they were punching cotton. They didn’t know whether to get angry or not.
Indeed, they are just three princesses, and seriously speaking, apart from some of them not following the rules, it doesn’t seem to be a big deal. They are not princes, and the position of the crown prince is not being decided. It is indeed not worth making a big deal about, especially on such a happy day. The two old princes subconsciously don’t want to make things too ugly.
It has to be said that Ye Shuo has a firm grasp of the psychology of the two imperial uncles.
“Since we are here,” “It’s the New Year,” and “It’s a joyous day,” these sayings apply not only to common people, but also to royal relatives and nobles.
After all, my nephew won the battle, a great contribution. It would not be a bad idea to please him a little and make him happy.
Of course the most important thing is that they are used to it.
The two old princes looked at each other. Seeing that the time was almost right, Ye Shuo looked at Prince Ding.
Prince Ding reacted immediately and understood.
He just wanted to give him a way out. Prince Ding’s movements were smooth and skillful, which made the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince blush.
Bah, so spineless!
However, even though they were thinking this in their hearts, the two of them were not slow in their actions. Seeing that Prince Ding, the most honourable prince at the moment, was not going to pursue the matter, the two old princes, as well as the fifth and seventh princes, did the same. After reprimanding them a few more times, the two old princes let the matter go.
By doing this, the two old princes sold out all the people behind them.
The two old princes were totally unaware of the seriousness of the matter, and this group of clan members were even less aware of it. Seeing that the two old princes had already compromised, it was naturally difficult for them to do anything, and in the end, they could only shut their mouths in disappointment and remain silent.
Only then was Ye Shuo satisfied.
Prince Ding, who was kneeling on the futon and listening to what his younger brother was saying, felt that something was not right. He looked at the wisest one, the Seventh Prince, who could rival Emperor Taicheng, and was also frowning and thinking about something. Prince Ding wanted to wait until the worship was over and then go out to find out a little, but the Seventh Prince looked puzzled and said, “What do you mean, my brother?”
That look was so real that it immediately choked back the rest of Prince Ding’s words.
Prince Ding rolled his eyes at him, too lazy to argue with someone as cunning as him, so he turned and left.
The Seventh Prince looked at the eldest brother’s limping back, then looked at Ye Shuo who was walking in the front, and glanced at the fifth brother who had become increasingly stupid over the years. Finally, he couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows with interest.
Ha, things are starting to get interesting.
Afterwards, Prince Ding was not giving up and wanted to discuss it with his sons. However, when he met those pairs of clear and naive eyes, Prince Ding suddenly lost his mood.
Forget it, forget it, why bother to explore so much, what does it have to do with me!
On the other hand, after the celebration banquet in the evening was over, the rewards were given, and the three sleeping daughters were sent to the side hall, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had the opportunity to relax.
“Phew, I’m so tired…” After taking off his Ming Guang armour, Ye Shuo waved away the palace servants, collapsed on the bed like a boneless person, and complained.
Yao Zhi wanted to stop it out of habit, but then she remembered that she was not facing officials from the previous dynasty and palace maids from the harem, so there was no need for her to maintain the majesty of the queen all the time. Thinking of this, she relaxed completely like Ye Shuo.
The two of them were lying there side by side. People who knew them could recognize the faces of the emperor and the empress, but those who didn’t would think they were just ordinary people.
Even ordinary people would not be so intimate.
However, what the two discussed was far from as easy as they appeared.
Yao Zhi had already thought it through. Her origin as a gangster might be a disadvantage in the eyes of court officials, but if it came to actual use, that might not be the case.
Since she is the biological mother of Dingning and the others, Dingning was born with the blood of a martial artist. Although the people in the martial arts world are not as powerful as the secret guards under Ye Shuo’s command, they are still capable of producing many extraordinary people, which is a great help to her three daughters.
After she told him her plan, Yao Zhi asked again, “What about you? What are you going to do next?”
Ye Shuo had already planned this on his way back to Beijing: “Of course, we will build a ship and then go to sea.”
Now that Old Chen has been incorporated into the territory of Great Zhou, and the population has increased so much at once, the rice seeds brought from Lucheng may not be enough. It is time to “invite” those good things that are stranded in foreign lands.
It just so happened that Ye Shuo had previously raided the homes of countless high-ranking officials in the old Chen state, and batches of silver would soon be sent to the capital. It would not be difficult to use part of it as funding for shipbuilding.
However, the candidate for the leader needs to be chosen carefully.
In his heart, Ye Shuo actually favours Jian Jian. Jian Jian’s skills and abilities are more than enough for the job, and Jian Jian is also a princess. However, this matter is dangerous after all, so Ye Shuo can’t help but hesitate.
If everything went well, it would be fine. Bringing back the things he needed would be a great achievement. Even if something went wrong later and his and Yao Zhi’s plan failed, it would be enough to save her life in the end. But then again, if it failed…
“Alas…” Ye Shuo sighed and said, “Forget it, let’s just go with the flow.”
If Jianjian can see something, it proves that she has the ability to participate and can become one of the pillars of the Great Zhou in the future. If she can’t see it, it means that she is still lacking some skills. Why should I drag her into this vortex? I can get out of it while there is still a chance. There is nothing wrong in letting her be a rich and idle person for the rest of her life.
At worst, I can choose a woman with strong martial arts skills from outside. I believe that when the opportunity to achieve success is right in front of us, there will always be someone who wants to seize it.
There is no rush for this matter. It will take at least a year and a half. The most important thing right now is to bring another person in.
Just like that, originally a group of clan members and ministers thought that the emperor had already made a fuss yesterday, and it should be quiet now. However, who would have thought that he only lasted less than a day, and he came again when he went to court the next day.
This time, the posthumous title was changed for the previous little emperor.
Hearing this, the clan members and some ministers all had the same thought in their minds –
Your Majesty, are you okay?

chapters.title: Chapter 332: Weird
chapters.content:
Ye Shuo has known his sixth sister-in-law for quite a while. He first met her in front of Baoyu Pavilion when he was seven years old. It has been more than 20 years now. Ye Shuo can almost be said to have witnessed her entire journey from a young girl, to marrying into the royal family, to now being indifferent to worldly affairs and ashamed of her life.
Ye Shuo didn’t know Sixth Sister-in-law very well, but he knew that his nephew’s position in the Sixth Sister-in-law’s heart was even higher than that of his Sixth Brother. So, Xiao Ming, I have to inconvenience you for the time being.
After silently reciting a sentence in his mind, Ye Shuo casually swept his eyes around, taking in the different expressions of the people below.
The court officials could not figure out why the emperor was going through so much trouble. In their opinion, there was no need for this at all, or perhaps the emperor was having a tantrum again and was just acting on impulse.
It would be fine if the young emperor was the emperor’s elder, but in order to show the tolerance of the later ones, the new emperor had to pretend to be generous and change the posthumous titles of those before him to show his appreciation.
But the key is that Your Majesty is the uncle of the young emperor, and the young emperor has been on the throne for less than a year, so he has no foundation in the court. In other words, the young emperor has long been forgotten by the world. Why does Your Majesty bother to bring up the past? If you don’t do it well, not only will it not generate any benefits, but it will also cause trouble.
Even Wei Wen couldn’t figure out what his cousin wanted to do for a moment. He hesitated for a moment, then took the initiative to step forward and said, “May I ask your Majesty, do you have any ideas in mind?”
“This… let me think about it.”
Hearing the word “think about it”, the two old princes secretly thought that their eldest nephew really acted on impulse.
However, what Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng saw was the smooth movements of the person above. In just a few blink of an eye, the words “Xiao Hui” appeared on the paper without any pause. Who would believe that he had not planned it in advance?However, except for the two people who knew Ye Shuo’s temperament well, everyone else’s attention was attracted by the words “Xiao Hui” themselves.
No matter how long they look at this terrible handwriting, I’m afraid the two old princes will never get used to it.
It’s really strange. After so many years, why hasn’t my nephew made any progress in this area…
Ye Shuo at the top didn’t care. After Xiao Lu finished showing it, he asked directly: “What do you think, my dear ministers?”
Little Ye Jin has respected his father very much since he was young. He was by his side when his sixth brother was seriously ill. He can be said to be a very filial son. It is not an exaggeration to choose these two words as his new posthumous title.
Even if others have opinions, it is useless and they have to keep them to themselves. There is no other way. The little emperor has a powerful uncle, and this uncle is willing to use such great achievements to cover up the little emperor’s early death.
Realising that their cousin/the emperor already had an idea in mind, Wei Wen and Xing Yucheng took the lead in agreeing without hesitation.
The two old princes had nothing to say when they saw this. Prince Ding on the side couldn’t help but mutter in his heart, “I knew that they are the ones you have the deepest feelings for.” But he still accepted it with a pinch of his nose. From Prince Ding’s perspective, he naturally hoped that Ye Shuo would remember their old friendship.
Changing the posthumous title was not a big deal. A living person would not offend the emperor for the sake of a dead person. This matter was quickly settled, or rather, the ministers below soon stopped worrying about it, because their emperor wanted to build a big ship. How big should this ship be? Anyway, with Jiangnan putting all its efforts into it, it would take at least a year or two to complete.
That would be fine, but His Majesty also needs to form a team and then go out to sea.
Some things seem easy when you know them in advance and think about them later, but if you know them in the dark, the action can be as crazy as it can be.
Without knowing what was out there, everyone felt that this move was a sheer waste of time and money and meaningless.
But there was no way, what could they do if they objected? The money was won back by the emperor himself, they had no confidence to object, and besides, when had the emperor ever changed his decision because of their opposition?
The final result was that Ye Shuo had a big quarrel with the opposing ministers. Since the ministers were not as eloquent as Ye Shuo and were too shameless, Ye Shuo finally demanded a large sum of money from them to be used specifically for this matter. Ṛ𝙖
Seeing that Ye Shuo seemed to be serious, the students who were hesitant at first whether to obey suddenly seemed to think of something and immediately changed their attitude.
It was the same in the past. The teacher seemed to know a lot of things that they had never even heard of. If it was not profitable, the teachers would definitely not speak without a purpose.
Thinking of this, Zou Wu and the others immediately felt certain.
However, their behaviour made other ministers think they were complete yes-men, and they didn’t know how the emperor could make them so obedient from beginning to end.
Although this group of students trained by Ye Shuo was able to maintain order in the court when He Xiang and others were dismissed from office, their number was limited after all, and not everyone was suitable to be an official, so there were still ministers from other factions in the court.
However, as the emperor has been in power for longer and longer, other voices have become smaller and smaller, and now they are no longer a big deal.
And with Ye Shuo’s expedition this time, the military power was firmly in his hands.
At this moment, the two old princes suddenly discovered that without them noticing, the entire Great Zhou had become a one-man show controlled by their nephew.
If the plan of building a ship and sailing out to sea is finally accomplished, his brilliance will be unstoppable.
After a long, long time, until the words “dismiss the court” were heard, the two old princes suddenly came to their senses. They were shocked and complicated.
At the same time, in the harem, because Empress Dowager He had not been in charge of affairs for a long time, and because she deliberately avoided the issue, she did not know what happened in the morning court until two hours later.
When she heard the word “Xiaohui”, Empress Dowager He couldn’t control herself and broke the nail on her ring finger because it was too fragile.
However, at this moment, Empress Dowager He didn’t care about it so much. She stood up suddenly and asked anxiously: “Is what you said true?”
“In reply to the Queen Mother, I guarantee with my life that not a single word is wrong.” The little palace maid who delivered the message almost swore to the heavens.
After receiving the affirmative answer, Empress Dowager He couldn’t help but be stunned.
After going through so many things, Empress Dowager He had long since given up on love. Being trapped in the palace every day made her even more disheartened. But even so, the young emperor’s untimely death was still a source of worry for her, which made her so worried that she couldn’t sleep at night.
When Jin’er passed away, the Great Zhou was in turmoil. Because he was young and had not accomplished anything, the ministers naturally did not pay much attention to him. Some even blamed him for passing away too soon, putting the Great Zhou in danger. As for Jin’er’s funeral, it was even more hasty. After a big fire, the child’s life was over.
Empress Dowager He had been quite talented since she was young, and was as knowledgeable as men. She was first the prince’s wife and later became the empress. When she was ruling the country behind the curtain with the emperor who was also the regent, she was even more conscientious and did not dare to make any mistakes. From beginning to end, she was extremely careful and cautious, and did not dare to slack off in the slightest. Therefore, Empress Dowager He had no idea what she had done to anger God and bring such a punishment upon herself.
The emperor once said that if he had the chance, he would clear the names of his brother and nephew, but Empress Dowager He did not take it to heart. She had a deep understanding of the saying that when people leave, the tea gets cold.
However, Empress Dowager He had never imagined that the emperor was not comforting herself at the time. He was indeed concerned about Jin’er and Emperor Taicheng. He had just won the battle and returned to Shangjing, but he put this matter on the agenda the next day. He also went against all objections and chose “Xiaohui” as Jin’er’s new posthumous title.
The emperor was praised for his kindness and love for the people. It was worthy of the title “Wen”. After Jin’er’s death, his body was burned and his ashes were buried, setting an example for the people suffering from the epidemic.
But then Empress Dowager He couldn’t help but wonder, could His Majesty be acting this way for some other purpose?
It wasn’t that Empress Dowager He was mean, but sitting in a position like theirs, no matter what they did, it wouldn’t be as simple as it seemed.
However, Empress Dowager He waited for several more days thinking this, but no one came to visit, as if the matter had just passed.
Although Ye Shuo wanted to ask the Sixth Sister-in-law to help, he was definitely not asking for a favour in return. If the Sixth Sister-in-law was willing, it would be fine. Her ability should not be buried any longer. If she was not interested, it didn’t matter either. Everyone has their own aspirations. There is no need to force it.
Although the will left by his nephew was a huge trouble for Ye Shuo, it was the child’s sincere love after all. Thinking of this, Ye Shuo’s nephew’s smile flashed inadvertently in his mind, and after a while, a trace of melancholy flashed across his eyes.
If little Ye Jin were still alive, he would have been old enough to get married by now.
To clear the names of both the father and son was an agreement Ye Shuo had made with his nephew back then, but it was only today that he actually had the ability and merit to do it.
Empress Dowager He saw that the emperor and the Queen’s family acted as if nothing had happened and the matter passed as usual. Empress Dowager He looked out the window and after a moment, she sighed softly.
At this point, even if the emperor has other intentions, she will accept it.
There is nothing to worry about anymore, so I might as well just let it go.
Empress Dowager He also wanted to see what the seven-year-old child who disguised himself as a beggar, now the emperor, was up to.
However, within just a few days, the news that Empress Dowager He had walked out of Cheng’an Hall spread like wildfire.
Jianjian was originally in her own mansion with a frown on her face, as if she was thinking about something, and she would curse from time to time.
As a princess, the scene in the Hall of Supreme Harmony was always lingering in Jianjian’s mind. Now, when she suddenly heard the news that Empress Dowager He walked out of Cheng’an Hall, coupled with all the previous things, Jianjian didn’t even have time to think carefully. Almost instinctively, a guess suddenly flashed through her mind.
Something seems to be wrong.
I always feel like there’s something odd about my brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: Participation
chapters.content:
From letting the empress sister-in-law govern the country when his brother left the capital, to conferring the title of Marquis of Jing’an against all odds, to the incident in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and finally the emperor’s sister-in-law Liu coming out of seclusion.
My own sister-in-law, three nieces, an old minister who kept giving birth to almost crazy children, and an indifferent and calm brother…
Jianjian, who thought she knew very well how rebellious her brother could be, had a bold idea flash through her mind.
Wait, he doesn’t mean…
Jianjian’s heart was pounding wildly. She could no longer control herself and almost instinctively wanted to verify it.
When Jianjian grew up, she looked almost exactly like the former Concubine Rong. She was not the shy type at all. She did what she said and she handed over the card directly and went straight to the palace.
After all, they were siblings from the same mother. In the entire Great Zhou, they were the only ones who were truly a family. Jianjian didn’t think that given her relationship with her brother, she needed to beat around the bush with him, so after sending away other idlers, she asked directly.
When she saw that her brother’s face was filled with shock at first, and then he looked her up and down with a curious look of “Oh my God, you actually guessed it, you really have grown up”, Jianjian didn’t have time to be shocked by the answer before she felt the veins on her forehead throbbing.
“…Royal brother, what do you mean by this?” Could it be that she had guessed that this answer would be something that was difficult for the royal brother to understand?
Jianjian had a blank expression on her face, feeling offended.Seeing that his sister seemed to be furious, Ye Shuo did not try to comfort her. Instead, he spread his hands and said innocently: “I don’t mean anything else. I just think it’s very novel. You should know that when you were young, you were very simple-minded. Basically, you believed everything I said.”
Thinking of his childhood, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but touch his chin, feeling quite nostalgic.
“I remember that I didn’t like going to the study room at that time, and you helped me write the homework assigned by the master…”
With a dull “dong” sound, Ye Shuo realised that the table in front of him, which was made of very solid materials and was considered to be the most sophisticated and sturdy in the entire Da Zhou, seemed to have a crack. After thinking about it, he finally decided to shut his mouth.
Although Jianjian’s kung fu is far inferior to his own, she has an ultimate trick – tell the parents. Even Ye Shuo can’t stand it.
“How dare you say that? It’s obviously you—”
She gets angry whenever he mentions her past, especially in recent years. The more she thinks about it, the more she feels that her brother is useless.
Jianjian clenched her fists subconsciously, but then she quickly calmed down: “Forget it, now is not the time to talk about this.”
Unlike her brother who is always out of tune, Jianjian is always thinking about serious matters. Although she has talked it out now, she still has some resentment in her heart.
“Why don’t you just tell me directly? Why go through so much trouble?” Judging from herself, Jianjian didn’t think that her brother would keep anything from her. And as long as he needed something, it would be impossible for her to refuse out of habit.
Could it be that the emperor brother felt that this matter was dangerous, so he didn’t want to let herself get involved? If that was the case… Thinking of this, Jianjian couldn’t help but feel a little touched.
However, this feeling of being moved only lasted for a blink of an eye. Almost instantly, Ye Shuo’s slightly surprised voice came over.
“What makes you think that?”
“High risks are bound to be accompanied by high returns. I think this is something that every prince and princess should know from birth.”
Although there were some words in the sentence that Jianjian had never heard before, she had gotten used to him saying some sentences that she couldn’t understand from time to time. After a long time, she could guess most of what he meant.
After understanding what he meant, she expressionlessly extinguished the small flame in her heart. Jianjian took a deep breath, and after regaining consciousness, she raised her head and looked back with a frown.
Ye Shuo did not let her down, and quickly replied with a smile: “Although there are few people who share the same ideals as me, I would rather have nothing than something less than perfect.”
The more important the matter is, the more you should not be anxious or careless, otherwise you will be held back by your teammates.
“I don’t want just anyone.” Just like Jianjian, who seemed smart but naive two years ago, was not very good in his opinion. Fortunately, after two years of experience, she has grown a lot now. Well, she is barely qualified.
Noticing that her brother seemed to have recalled something and a flash of undisguised disgust appeared in his eyes, Jianjian felt like a fool for worrying about him just now.
No matter how many years have passed, my brother’s ability to make people angry to death remains unchanged.
However, Jianjian not only could not be angry with him, but she had to rush to join her brother’s plan. Thinking of this, Jianjian became even angrier.
Damn it!
My brother is really bad, but he has the ability to make them rush to him for help. It has been like this since they were young, and now no one can escape, including my father.
It’s not that Jianjian has any masochistic tendencies and has to take the lead, but in the past two years, Jianjian has experienced almost all the difficulties in managing Shangjing with the empress sister-in-law.
The cold words that the clan members in the Hall of Supreme Harmony said to the three princesses were just the tip of the iceberg. Jianjian was mainly responsible for cleaning up those with ulterior motives, so she was naturally very well-informed. She had heard countless ugly words in the past two years, and the situations she encountered were only more embarrassing than those of the three princesses. This made the flame that had arisen in Jianjian’s heart burn all the time.
Let Jianjian, who was brought up like a prince since childhood, get married and have children like other princesses, be used by the superiors to win over court officials and have no power to resist, and spend her whole life in the palace. This is even more painful for her than killing her.
The more she wakes up, the more pain Jianjian feels. It was not obvious when she was young, but by the time she grew up, the spark had already spread all over the prairie. Even if it means paying a heavy price, she is unwilling to spend her life in ignorance and muddle-headedness.
The more Jianjian thought about it, the more unwilling she felt.
Now that she finally saw hope, Jian Jian naturally didn’t want to let it go. She took a deep breath and asked straightforwardly, “Brother emperor, what do you need me to do?”
Looking at his sister who was full of energy, even Ye Shuo was shocked by her enthusiasm and passion. A drop of cold sweat fell on his forehead. Ye Shuo really couldn’t make up his mind for a while.
After all, he only has this one sister. If anything goes wrong, even if Jianjian is willing, his mother will most likely chop him to pieces.
Seeing that he had been silent for a long time, Jianjian suddenly started to perform exceptionally well at the critical moment, and her brain became unusually flexible.
“Generally speaking, you are not such an indecisive person, unless the situation is special.”
Jianjian narrowed her eyes: “Is it dangerous?”
Although it was a question, Jianjian’s attitude was affirmative.
Combined with the two conditions that had recently happened but were very dangerous… Jianjian suddenly had an idea: “Brother, is your big ship still in need of a leader?”
Ye Shuo felt that Jianjian’s sudden enlightenment was truly remarkable.
Noticing the change in his expression, Jianjian knew that she had guessed right.
“Okay, then this is it.” Jianjian made the decision decisively.
Now it was Ye Shuo who wanted to regret it. This was too hasty. Would this really work?
“Why don’t you… reconsider it? Don’t blame me for not reminding you. This matter is of great importance and must not be missed, even if you are my sister.” At the end, Ye Shuo became serious and even changed his way of addressing himself.
Jianjian made a rough calculation. Although she didn’t know much about going to sea now, there was still at least a year before the ship was built, so she had enough time to prepare.
It’s not that Jianjian is arrogant. She is inherently smarter than ordinary people. This is an indisputable fact, as can be seen from the regrets expressed by her father and the Grand Tutor back then. This means that as long as she studies hard, there are few things that can stump her.
Jian Jian couldn’t help but let out a long breath: “High risks come with high rewards, you just said this yourself, my brother.”
Since the emperor, who always liked to joke, was on high alert, Jianjian was almost certain that there must be treasures beyond imagination overseas.
“Brother, do you already know what’s out there?”
This girl is really too sensitive today.
Ye Shuo paused, then nodded imperceptibly and said softly: “If it succeeds, it can bring peace to the world. Such an achievement will ensure that your name will go down in history and you will have no worries in your life.”
This can definitely be regarded as the biggest golden finger since he came here.
Ye Shuo had already compiled everything he knew into a book, which was guaranteed to be detailed and clear. All that was left was to go to the designated place and retrieve the designated items.
As soon as the words fell, Jianjian couldn’t help but gasp, and her blood instantly boiled over.
If so, what else is there to consider?!
This credit cannot be taken away by any other biological child, and the emperor actually loves her the most.
