Opportunities are rare and will never come back. Fearing that such a good opportunity would be snatched away by others, Jianjian knelt on both knees and performed the etiquette of a subject: “I hope that my royal brother will allow me to go overseas and bring back the lost things of my Great Zhou.”
Ye Shuo didn’t know whether it was a blessing or a curse to let Jianjian receive the upbringing like a prince, or whether it might be better for her to live her life in ignorance like those princesses in the past. But Jianjian herself had no judgement at that time, and Ye Shuo was just leading her onto the right path that he believed was right.
Whether you regret it or not, we can only wait until the future to find out.
At the moment, Ye Shuo was just being extremely cautious and said in a deep voice, “Okay.”
Jianjian breathed a sigh of relief and was overjoyed.
The next moment, Ye Shuo turned back to his frivolous look and came closer, not disguising his eagerness to watch the fun, and whispered, “But my agreement alone is not enough. Have you thought about what to say to the Queen Mother?”
The smile on Jianjian’s face froze instantly.
“Hmph, there’s no need for you to worry about this, my brother.” After being fooled for so many years, Jianjian decided to fight back.
If it were usual, Ye Shuo would not have taken Jian Jian’s threat seriously, but this time…
Seeing Jianjian was nervous at first, and then suddenly laughed out of nowhere, Ye Shuo had an inexplicable ominous premonition.
Facts have proved that Ye Shuo’s premonition was correct. Two days later, under Yao Zhi’s meaningful and amusement-filled expression, Ye Shuo, who had finally had some free time and was sitting in a recliner drinking tea, was suddenly called over by his mother.
Empress Dowager He was busy, Jianjian was busy too, not to mention the Queen, who had been very busy all the time. When Jianjian reminded her, Empress Dowager Wei suddenly realised that she was the only idle person in the entire palace.
Although Queen Mother Wei did not know what these people were plotting, her intuition as a mother made her aware of something unusual, so she felt very involved and looked at her son with anticipation.
Could it be that she couldn’t help at all?
Ye Shuo broke out in a cold sweat almost instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Fight Again
chapters.content:
In the end, Ye Shuo just said: “No matter what others do, mother, you just need to stay the same as you are now.”
Up to now, all people and things have changed. Only with his mother can they temporarily put aside their worries and relax a little.
The former Imperial Concubine Rong, now the Empress Dowager Wei, is like the Big Dipper in the sky. As long as the Big Dipper is there, he and Jianjian will never be lost and will always have a home.
“Of course, it would be even better if you could take good care of yourself and stay with us forever.”
Perhaps it was because her life was going too smoothly, the Queen Mother Wei now no longer had the aggressive attitude she had when she was young. She is more straightforward than when she was young. In addition, she has always been generous and disdainful to argue with the palace servants. Therefore, everyone in the palace actually likes her, who is a little arrogant but very easy to please, including Concubine Sun and Princess Zhaocheng.
When Concubine Sun married Emperor Taicheng as a concubine a few years ago, she had heard of the title of the Imperial Concubine in the palace. She originally thought that she would be a very difficult person to get along with. However, for the sake of her daughter’s future, Concubine Sun felt that it would be okay for her to endure the grievances. It was not until she really met the Queen Mother that she realised that as long as she went along with the Queen Mother, basically nothing would happen.
What the palace lacks the most is people who know how to read other people’s expressions. People with little brains simply cannot survive in such a place, so having a master like Queen Mother Wei who has the highest status and does not like to bully others is undoubtedly a blessing. In addition, all her former opponents who deserved to die are dead. Even with the second master by her side, Queen Mother Wei still often feels lonely, so she is willing to listen to the stories and grievances of the palace people. Over time, this cold and magnificent palace inevitably gave rise to some warmth.
As expected, probably because Ye Shuo hit the nail on the head, the serving maids and eunuchs were fine, as they didn’t even dare to breathe in the presence of the emperor. However, Ye Shuo clearly saw that several of the people who usually served him subconsciously glanced at his mother.
However, Queen Mother Wei did not think it was a big deal. She had enjoyed everything she should have enjoyed in her life, and had obtained everything she wanted. She was not as persistent as ordinary people, so she said, “What does it matter? You are not children anymore.”
There was nothing that could be done when the two children were still young, but now one of them is the emperor and the other is a princess with power, so the Queen Mother Wei really has nothing to worry about.As if he had heard the hidden meaning in her words, the entire hall suddenly became silent almost the moment the words fell. Even the Queen Mother Wei could feel it. She noticed the disapproval and worry in her son’s eyes, as well as the hesitant expressions of other people around him. She was stunned for a moment, and after she reacted, she suddenly felt a little uncomfortable.
“What are you doing? Why are you looking at me like that? Birth, ageing, sickness and death are the laws of nature. I can’t decide…”
Noticing that Ye Shuo and the others’ expressions were getting more and more strange, Queen Mother Wei finally changed her tone: “Alright, alright, I get it. I will definitely take good care of my health in the future. Is that ok?”
Due to her family background, Queen Mother Wei had a preference for heavy taste since childhood, so it was really a challenge to ask her to change to a light taste.
After receiving a positive answer, the hall soon returned to its former warmth and joy, as if the pervasive sorrow of the previous moment had never existed.
For some reason, Queen Mother Wei always felt that they did it on purpose.
A crisis was perfectly resolved. Jianjian on the side couldn’t help but snorted and laughed, seeming dissatisfied, but there was nothing she could do. Her brother was best at deceiving their mother, so it was not surprising that he could get away with it this time.
At noon, Ye Shuo specially had lunch at his mother’s palace. After the meal, while helping his mother digest the food, looking at his sister beside him, Ye Shuo suddenly remembered something, so he lowered his voice and asked: “By the way, have you told mother about the danger of this matter?” Ye Shuo didn’t like to hide things unless it was necessary.
However, the next second, Jianjian nodded very casually, and Ye Shuo was really shocked.
With his mother’s personality, it’s not right to protect them like his own eyes!
Ye Shuo turned his head and looked at his mother, but Queen Mother Wei looked back calmly and had no intention of answering at all.
Queen Mother Wei would never tell him that she almost blurted out the words of rejection at that time. At that moment, she even had the idea of ​​breaking Jianjian’s legs and locking her up to take care of her for the rest of her life. For Queen Mother Wei, fame, wealth, and leaving a name in history were not important. Only her health and safety were the most important.
It was not until Queen Mother Wei met those bright, shining eyes that it seemed to say: How can such a bright pearl be covered in dust?
Even if Queen Dowager Wei never knew what kind of feeling that was in her life, she was still uncontrollably shocked by such strong persistence. At that moment, even Queen Dowager Wei was infected by it. It was a pity that she was born too late and had no chance to experience it personally. It was really a pity.
It’s just that it’s a bit embarrassing to talk about this, so let’s not mention it.
Ye Shuo wanted to ask more, but Queen Mother Wei kept silent. During the stalemate between the two, Xiao Luzi came hurriedly. Ye Shuo and Jian Jian looked at each other and knew immediately that something big had happened.
After suppressing his emotions in time, Ye Shuo walked towards the imperial study.
In less than a moment, Ye Shuo realised that Beiting had attacked again. Judging from the time when the battle report was delivered, Da Zhou should have already confronted Beiting.
Why do we say “again”? Because when Ye Shuo led the army to fight against the old Chen, Beiting often came to disturb them, but the Great Zhou wanted to avoid the war and avoid being attacked from both sides, so the two sides only stayed in the stage of manoeuvring. But this time, I don’t know if the destruction of the Chen Kingdom completely stimulated Beiting, so this time the attack was particularly fierce, and the border couldn’t resist, so the two generals wrote to ask for help.
Ye Shuo himself wanted to get rid of Beiting as well. Even if he couldn’t kill them all, he would expel them from this land completely to prevent them from harassing and looting him every few days. This had been going on for years, making most of the people in the north live in unrest. With old grudges and new ones, Ye Shuo wished he could eradicate this cancer right away.
Putting down the battle report in his hand, Ye Shuo looked at General Xu and others below and spoke directly, asking them to find a way to come up with a practical plan.
General Xu is best at defending the city and is a conservative person. For an enemy like Beiting that is like weeds and will grow again next year even if one is burned this year, he generally prefers to be on the defensive and will never fight to the death with the enemy. When Beiting’s food and grass are almost used up, he will naturally retreat.
At first, General Xu thought that the emperor called them over to ask for their opinions, but he found that things did not develop as he had expected. The emperor directly asked them how to fight, not whether they should fight or not. This made General Xu, who had already analysed the pros and cons in his mind and was about to speak, choked immediately, and the words he had originally organised were instantly invalidated.
However, Ye Shuo knew the talents of this group of people. As long as he gave a death order, they would be able to give a perfect answer.
Sometimes, if you don’t push these people hard, they themselves don’t know how capable they are. Especially for someone like General Xu, whose official career has come to the end and who has returned to Beijing to enjoy his retirement, drastic measures must be taken. Otherwise, if anything really happens, this old man will definitely push it away.
Looking at the other person’s expression, Ye Shuo knew that he might have guessed right.
After a long pause, General Xu finally said, “Beiting comes almost every year. If you are too persistent this time, I’m afraid it will be bad next year.”
Unlike the weak Chen State, although Beiting’s army is small in number, each of them is an elite soldier. However, judging from the combat effectiveness of the team specially trained by the emperor in the past two years when fighting with Chen State, it is not difficult to repel Beiting. But it is extremely difficult to completely defeat Beiting, or to attack Beiting’s capital like they did with Chen State. As for complete destruction, it is undoubtedly a pipe dream. It is not because of their inferior combat power, but because the opponent can migrate. Even if they are driven away now, they can come back after recuperating.
Compared with the price they paid, it was really not worth it, so General Xu did not advocate getting too entangled with the other side.
However, Ye Shuo had already made arrangements for this and was waiting for this day. Otherwise, he would not have dared to make such a bold statement as to destroy Beiting.
“What if I say that I have a way to completely expel Beiting from this land, so that they will not dare to invade again in the next ten, twenty, or even dozens of years?”
Upon hearing this, General Xu’s eyes widened immediately.
If that’s the case…if that’s the case…then it’s indeed worth paying some price.
He knew that His Majesty was not a man who acted without purpose. Although he didn’t know what method His Majesty had, as long as His Majesty had spoken, there must be something he could do. Judging from the results, General Xu really couldn’t think of a reason to refuse.
Seeing that they were finally willing to contribute, Ye Shuo was satisfied.
In just two or three days, the news that Ye Shuo was going to continue attacking Beiting spread completely, causing an uproar throughout the court and the country.
The high frequency of His Majesty’s deployment of troops is not a good sign. Moreover, have the previous losses been made up? It has only been a short time since the battle started again, which directly frightened the others who have not experienced it personally.
The old ministers wanted to stop it, but their voices were no longer heard in the court. As for the royal family, the two old princes wanted to come out of retirement, but they had just walked out of the palace when they were stopped by Prince Ding.
Looking at his two uncles with gray hair, Prince Ding cursed in his heart, knowing that the emperor’s favours were not in vain. When the emperor was a child, he was ruthless when commanding people, and he was even more so when he grew up.
Prince Ding had known that this day would come, and he had been trying his best to avoid conflict with his two uncles. But now there was no way to avoid it, and he had no choice but to go ahead with it.
The three men stood in two different directions and looked at each other. Prince Su and Prince Jin knew immediately that the new and old leaders of the royal family would eventually face off, and the transfer of power on the royal family side was finally coming.
Prince Su and Prince Jin were thinking, the eldest brother is so obedient to the emperor, what will happen if he is allowed to take over the royal family smoothly? When the emperor really speaks, there will be no one to persuade him.
Prince Ding thought that it was fine if he didn’t win the throne, but if he couldn’t become the leader of the royal family, he might as well hang himself with a rope.
While the three princes were fighting in full swing, the army, which had returned to the capital only a month ago, reorganised and left the capital smoothly, completely unaware of the struggle within the royal family.
Upon hearing the news, Prince Su and Prince Jin almost vomited blood.
After sending off the army, Ye Shuo was not idle. Although he did not have to be present in person this time, he obviously had other things to do, especially since there was internal strife in the royal family, and it was easy to fish in troubled waters. It would be a pity not to do something if he missed such a good opportunity.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo raised his hand and called Wu Yi over.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Killing Weapon
chapters.content:
Compared to the turbulent situation in Shangjing, this side of the border is much calmer in comparison.
They are all veteran generals with many years of experience and have gained experience in fighting with the Beiting people. Even if a small-scale battle breaks out from time to time, it is all within the controllable range.
It was not until the emperor’s decree came that Generals Xu and Fang were dumbfounded.
The emperor actually asked them to find a way to take Beiting. Seeing the order from above, Generals Xu and Fang suddenly found it difficult to breathe.
For a moment, the two of them even thought about how to die to atone for their sins without implicating their families.
Then they saw that the emperor had decided to send reinforcements and the reinforcements would arrive soon, and Generals Xu and Fang breathed a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, His Majesty still has some sense of propriety and does not ask them to destroy a country out of thin air. However, how to fight still requires careful planning.
Generals Xu and Fang originally thought so, but when they saw the reinforcements, they felt that there was no need to go through so much trouble.
The reason why Beiting can defeat ten with one is simply because they mainly feed on meat such as cattle and mutton. Eating more meat naturally gives them strength. However, this group of elite soldiers specially trained by Ye Shuo are exactly the same. In terms of comprehensive quality, they are much stronger than Beiting.
With advanced training methods, more advanced weapons, and two full years of experience on the battlefield of Chen State, this team as a whole is like a sword drawn from its sheath, and wherever the blade points, it makes people feel terrified.The present is definitely different from the past. If this knife is used properly, conquering Beiting may not be a foolish dream. Even Generals Xu and Fang were slightly shocked. Then they looked at each other and sighed in their hearts that this was going to be a good show.
This was indeed the case. When this team was fully deployed on the battlefield, Beiting finally understood why the State of Chen had been defeated so quickly before.
But at this time they still did not take the support of the Great Zhou seriously. There was no way. The national conditions of Chen and Beiting were too different. Chen was fixed there, and if its capital was attacked, it would have to be destroyed. Beiting was different. It didn’t matter even if its capital was occupied by others. It could just wait until it had recovered and taken it back.
There were only two things that made Beiting irritated. The first was that the locusts came again. The second was that there seemed to be a few people from the Great Zhou who were holding something unknown and kept aiming at the heads of their generals.
They already knew that the leader of the locusts was one of Emperor Zhou’s men, but they had no idea what that black thing was. They only knew that once they were hit by that thing, they would almost certainly die.
At first, the generals of Beiting thought that they only needed to wear an extra layer of helmet or make the helmet thicker, but they found that the thing could not even protect the helmet. Ordinary iron tools were like paper in front of it and could be penetrated in an instant. Once the general died, the remaining soldiers would be nothing but a pile of scattered sand no matter how brave and good they were.
When the first explosion sounded, even Generals Xu and Fang were startled. What was that so loud? And when Generals Xu and Fang saw that the heads of the bodies being swept up were like exploding watermelons, they were more than just frightened. It would not be an exaggeration to say that they were terrified.
Even crossbows made of fine steel are far from having such an effect. If everyone in the army is equipped with such a thing… they can’t even imagine what the scene would be like.
When they arrived at the battlefield, Generals Xu and Fang wanted to step forward and ask out of curiosity, but they were stopped in time by a man who claimed to be a supervisor.
Generals Xu and Fang then realised that the existence of these four people was top secret. The emperor had issued a gag order, and even they, the highest officials in the army, had no right to interfere. No wonder there was nothing written on the surface of the documents. It can be said that except Ye Shuo, the person who gave the order, and Zou Wu, the person who created it, no one else knew about this.
This can be said to be the second time that Ye Shuo has displayed weapons that are beyond this era. Compared to the previous purpose of deterrence, this time he just wants to reduce his own casualties as much as possible. As long as the enemy dies, won’t there be fewer deaths on their side?
Ye Shuo always felt that since his coming here was an established fact, the things in his mind were also part of him and could naturally be used. However, he had to think carefully about what to use and how to use them.
Ye Shuo never underestimates the wisdom of the ancients. With the current productivity, if the production method of the things he can produce is leaked, State Chen and Bei Ting will also be able to make them. As for the more advanced ones, others cannot make them. Even if there are production methods and drawings, Ye Shuo still cannot make them. 𝘙�
Ye Shuo wanted to achieve peace as much as possible, instead of bringing greater disasters to the people of this era, so he could only be cautious. Because of the absolute confidentiality, even though Zou Wu had worked hard for so many years, only these four people had special weapons, and even the users did not know the specific structure of the weapons. Each part of this thing had a number on it, and with the supervisors watching, it was difficult for such a secret to be leaked.
However, even if the number of people is small, it is enough. In the absence of any cover, it is almost impossible for the target to escape.
As for Generals Xu and Fang, when the supervisor said the words “the emperor’s secret order”, they were tactful and dared not ask any more questions. Even though they were extremely curious, they did not intend to continue exploring.
With various advantages added up, the attack of the Great Zhou was advancing steadily and rapidly. Based on the understanding of Generals Xu and Fang about Beiting, unless the other side had a genius who could achieve a surprise victory, they were all old rivals and would not be able to win the game if they knew each other’s abilities and methods in detail.
However, how difficult is it to expect a genius to come down from heaven and turn the tide? Generals Xu and Fang did not think that Beiting would have such good fortune.
The fact turned out to be just as the two had expected. Once Beiting’s advantage was broken, it collapsed like usual.
It was not until the Great Zhou army headed straight for the heart of Beiting that Beiting launched a counterattack, but it was already too late.
Generals Xu and Fang predicted that by the end of the month at the latest, Beiting would be forced to retreat to the foot of Duanshan Mountains due to the encirclement and suppression from several sides. Duanshan Mountains are high and dangerous, and once they cross it, it would be difficult for the enemy to come back.
Beiting is in the most danger at this time, and success or failure depends on this one move.
In order to prevent the enemy from launching a desperate counterattack, Generals Xu and Fang kept their nerves tense and did not dare to relax for a moment.
Just when Generals Xu and Fang were desperately thinking about how to completely expel the Beiting people from this land, more things were sent over from Shangjing.
In addition to the necessary food and fodder, there were also carts full of things tightly wrapped in oilcloth, of which no one knew what they were.
This was also something that Generals Xu and Fang could not interfere with. When Generals Xu and Fang saw this situation, they felt relieved but also a little nervous.
The dozen or so people escorting these carriages had long breaths and were all wearing masks. I guess they must be the legendary secret guards.
And since the secret guards appeared, it means that the emperor gave the order personally.
Generals Xu and Fang watched helplessly as a dozen people emptied all those carriages in just one night. As for where the things went, they could guess without even thinking.
As for Beiting, they did not expect that the counterattack from the Great Zhou would be so swift and decisive.
Beiting and Chen State had cooperated once before, but they ended up breaking up. It was all because the two sides had completely fallen out at the beginning. Now that Chen State is in trouble, it will be difficult for Beiting and Chen State to join forces again.
There was no other way, Beiting had to settle for the second best and began to plan to reap the benefits. However, who would have thought that the Chen State would suffer a crushing defeat, and after the demise of the Chen State, the Great Zhou State still retained its strength. Now the Great Zhou State was pointing its spearhead at them again, which was really a cause for distress.
Especially the four people in the opposing team, who made them unable to rest in peace. No less than ten generals have died at the hands of these four people. No one knows what material their clothes are made of or how they are made. They can become perfectly invisible just by lying there. Even with an expensive telescope, it is difficult to distinguish them from the surrounding objects. Often by the time they discover them, the opponent has already taken their lives from hundreds of steps away.
King Zuo Xian also tried to force the four men to show up, but he didn’t know how they were trained. Even if the people of the Great Zhou died in front of them, they could remain motionless and hide there for two days and one night.
If it weren’t for these four people, the Great Zhou would not have arrived here so quickly. King Zuo Xian hated them to the core.
However, no matter how angry the two princes and the Wolf King were, it was useless because Da Zhou was still pressing forward step by step, with no intention of giving up.
It seems that the other party has made up their minds to expel them completely.
But what good is that? Once they are given time to recuperate, they will surely come back.
King Zuo Xian thought so until dawn, when the two generals of the Great Zhou launched another surprise attack.
However, before the sun rose as usual, a sound like thunder suddenly rang out, and at that moment the earth shook as if the sky was collapsing.
When the aftermath of the tremor died down, Zuo Xian waved away his guards and took a closer look. He saw that half of the mountain had been destroyed by the sudden loud noise.
This miraculous scene made King Zuo Xian’s pupils shrink sharply.
At the same time, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but reach out and fiddle with the shells on the wind chimes. The shells collided and made a ringing sound, and Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smile.
According to the time, the “gift” he personally supervised should have been delivered. I wonder if Beiting likes it.
The next moment, Zuo Xian came to his senses. After the panic, he couldn’t help feeling a burning sensation in his heart.
Although they didn’t know how Emperor Zhou did it, since the other party could do it, they could do it too. If they could get this thing, what would the current predicament be?
However, immediately afterwards, Zuo Xian Wang was awakened by howling and screaming——
“It’s a punishment from heaven! It’s a punishment from heaven sent down by the gods!”
If they could flatten half of a mountain in an instant, what else could it be but a miracle? They had accidentally angered the gods, so this disaster had occurred.
The Beiting soldiers were defeated all the way. The locusts and the army of the Great Zhou were like steel knives hanging around their necks every day. No one knew if someone would suddenly appear in the next blink of an eye. Their spirits were already on the verge of collapse, and Ye Shuo’s move completely destroyed their remaining sanity.
At one moment, some people knelt down and kowtowed, some burst into tears, but there were more people who threw down their weapons and climbed up the nearby snow-capped mountains as if they were risking their lives.
Compared to half a mountain, they are just like ants.
King Zuo Xian wanted to order people to stop the attack, but he was powerless. Everyone, including the Wolf King, was frightened by what they saw.
Once the seeds of fear are planted, it is difficult to pull them out. And once a person develops fear, he can only exert 10% or 20% of his strength at most.
King Zuo Xian immediately realised that the people before him were useless and could no longer be used. Before a new batch of soldiers grew up, they were no longer able to fight.
If I don’t run away now, I might really be killed by the people from the Great Zhou.
Once an avalanche is formed, it cannot be controlled by one or two people. Seeing that things were impossible to do, Zuo Xian made a choice without hesitation. Since he had to choose, he must choose the best path.
When Beiting was around, it was naturally glorious to be the Zuo Xian, who was second only to the emperor. When Beiting was gone, the so-called prince was nothing more than a stray dog. Instead of having to please others after failure, it is better to just be the one giving orders.
Who knows, will there be a different world behind the broken mountain?
Looking at the panic-stricken Wolf King, a sinister look flashed across Zuo Xian’s eyes. In the shocked and horrified eyes of the Wolf King, Zuo Xian raised his sword and slashed, killing the Wolf King instantly on the spot.
Several personal guards of Zuo Xian first widened their eyes, and then after they realised what was happening, they followed suit and dealt with everyone who saw this scene in the shortest possible time.
Under the Wolf King there is only the Left Wise King. The Huyan clan, the descendants of the Wolf King, have their own hands to deal with by Emperor Zhou. As for the Right Wise King, he is really not a concern, so as long as they are not stupid, they will know what to choose.
Finally, King Zuo Xian took a deep look in the direction of Shangjing, the capital of the Great Zhou Dynasty, and then, under the protection of several people, he walked into the steep snow and wind on the Broken Mountain without looking back.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: Gift
chapters.content:
It was nearly a month later when Ye Shuo learned the news.
As battle reports from the front lines were sent back to the capital one by one, in a total of twelve months, the Great Zhou experienced four failures and nine major victories. Each failure and victory would cause turmoil in the court. Fortunately, Ye Shuo was determined, so these discussions quickly subsided after receiving no response.
After putting down the last battle report, Ye Shuo let out a long breath and then smiled.
Finally, it’s over…
This was the scene that Xiao Luzi saw when he came in from outside.
Xiao Luzi was reluctant to interrupt for a moment, but he didn’t dare to hide it, so he could only say carefully when His Majesty looked over: “Your Majesty, the old Prime Minister passed away two hours ago.”
Ye Shuo paused for a moment, then spoke after a while: “…I understand.”
After all, He Xiang was a close minister of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Even if he was forced to retire, it would still be different.
On the day of Prime Minister He’s funeral, Ye Shuo went to the Prime Minister’s residence with Yao Zhi and Empress Dowager He. When they came out again, Ye Shuo was almost dazzled by the bright daylight, until Empress Dowager He beside him sighed inaudibly: “It’s
He Xiang had been weakened a long time ago, and he was only able to hold on until today on one breath. Almost as soon as the news of the great victory came, He Xiang laughed three times and then died.Although He Xiang is no longer here, at least he was gone after receiving the news.
“I think my grandfather has no regrets in his life.” Empress Dowager He murmured.
And how many people in this world can do this? Shang Shu Ling died before he could wait for the person. In comparison, my grandfather was very lucky.
Ye Shuo couldn’t help thinking when he heard this. Now the Shangshu Ling is dead, He Xiang is dead, Mr. Zeng is dead, and even the Grand Tutor is dead…
When the Grand Tutor passed away, Ye Shuo was still in Chen State. He didn’t even get to see the Grand Tutor for the last time. He was like a feather, floating away.
Old friends have gradually returned to dust and now there are only a few left.
In addition to the Taifu and others, there will also be the First Master, the Second Master, the Third Master, Wu Yi, and even… his mother in the future. No one can escape, just like his father in his previous life. No matter how unwilling Ye Shuo is, he is still helpless. Even though it is still a little early to consider these things now, Ye Shuo has already felt unspeakable panic.
No matter how many times he has experienced this kind of thing, he still cannot accept it or get used to it.
Feeling the hand of the person next to her gradually tightening, as if sensing his mood at the moment, Yao Zhi subconsciously shook it back, as if telling him not to worry.
Feeling the burning heat in the palm of his hand, Ye Shuo’s fingers warmed up after a while. He finally let out a long breath and returned to his previous relaxed state.
No matter what the future holds, Yao Zhi and the children will always be with him.
After returning to the palace, Ye Shuo kissed several little princesses on the face one by one. Seeing their embarrassed and shy expressions, Ye Shuo’s mood completely calmed down.
After the wet nurse took the three princesses away and the imperial study became completely quiet, Ye Shuo could not help but start thinking about offering sacrifices to heaven and Fengshan.
He didn’t really care about this, but it was a rare opportunity and it would be a pity to miss it.
Just like the last ancestor worship, when Ye Shuo proposed the Fengshan ceremony, everyone didn’t think it was a big deal. The emperor unified the Three Kingdoms, and it was not an exaggeration to report such an achievement to the gods of heaven and earth. But when they saw the names of the three princesses on the Fengshan list, many people couldn’t help but frown.
It’s fine to worship the ancestors, but how can such a big thing as Fengshan be taken lightly? Even if they are willing, the scholars in the world are not willing.
And they don’t know if it’s an illusion, but the two old princes Su and Jin always feel that the opposition from the royal family this time seems to be smaller than last time. But it may also be that most of the people have been gathered by Prince Ding, and Prince Ding has always been obedient to the emperor, so it seems that they are weak.
However, Ye Shuo seemed to have guessed what they were thinking and comforted them, “I am just an attendant. Scholars should be broad-minded and would never bother with a little girl. The two uncles are really worrying too much.”
Having said that, the two old princes always felt that something was strange. The same weird feeling as last time when they offered sacrifices to their ancestors came back. However, the emperor’s words were golden, and since he said so, he would probably not cause any more trouble. The request was a bit excessive, but it was not completely unacceptable.
The Prince of Su and the Prince of Jin were relatively good, as they at least noticed something was wrong. As for the Fifth Prince, the Eighth Prince and the Prince of Ding, not only did they not notice anything, they even felt flattered because the Emperor was so merciful and explained a few words to them.
After all, he is now the emperor, and he is much more stable than before. The three of them thought so at the same time.
The only smart man, the Seventh Prince, couldn’t help but twitch his lips slightly.
Seeing that the two uncles were still hesitating, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but sigh: “After the Queen and I left the palace, the three princesses were left unattended. I really can’t feel at ease.”
Prince Su and Prince Jin were about to ask, aren’t there two queen dowagers in the palace? And there are so many palace servants, how come no one is taking care of them?
But when I think about the fact that Empress Dowager Wei was not very popular when she was young, and now she has completely stopped caring about things, Empress Dowager He is a safe choice, but the three princesses are not her biological daughters after all, so it is normal for the emperor to be worried.
Prince Su opened his mouth and couldn’t help saying, “Your Majesty is too doting on the princesses.” This is really not a good sign.
Nonsense, Dingning, Yongning, and Anning are all his own children, if he doesn’t love them, who will?
Although he thought so in his heart, Ye Shuo said lightly: “She is just a princess, it’s okay to pamper her a little more.” Anyway, these people never take princesses seriously.
This was indeed the case. After hearing what His Majesty said, Prince Su subconsciously wanted to refute it, but he felt that it was really nothing. Even he was fond of the daughters in the mansion, and he could understand His Majesty’s love for his daughters. Of course, the more important thing was that it was not worth it to quarrel with His Majesty over this matter.
What a trick of boiling a frog in warm water!
Yesterday was the ancestor worship, today is the heaven worship, what will happen tomorrow? When the frog is really boiled, will they still have room to resist?
The Seventh Prince couldn’t help but shake his head secretly.
Other members of the royal family wanted to make a fuss about this matter, but Ye Shuo immediately brought up something else, and soon no one paid attention to it anymore.
When Ye Shuo said that he wanted to promote Zou Wu to the position of Minister of Works, and to promote the current Minister of Works, who was also Xing Yucheng’s old father, to the position of Minister-General, the court was in an uproar.
It would be fine for Zou Wu’s fellow disciples, because they knew Zou Wu’s abilities and knew that with her abilities, she should have sat in this position long ago. It’s just that both Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng never paid attention to her, so she has been staying in some minor positions until now.
The teacher was the one who proposed that boys and girls study together, so he did not look down on Zou Wu just because she was a girl.
Those who were chosen by Ye Shuo were extraordinary in both ability and character, so when Ye Shuo said this, they only had one thought in their minds –
Ah, this day has finally arrived.
Their mentality, which had been gradually becoming inflated due to the influence of the surrounding environment, was instantly straightened out, and everyone felt an uncontrollable chill in their hearts.
Others don’t know, but they know it very well. Under the same conditions, both of them study and learn calligraphy, women are never inferior to men, and even work harder than men because the road ahead is narrow. Zou Wu is the best among their batch of students, so it should have been like this long ago. In addition, they know their teacher well, so at this moment, none of Ye Shuo’s students objected.
As for the others, there was only one reason for their opposition.
“How can a woman be an official? It’s absolutely ridiculous!”
It would be fine if it was just a small official, but now this is the position of Shangshu, how can they be willing to accept it?
But what’s the point of the remaining people’s opposition? Ye Shuo said, “Zou Wu played a great role in taking over Beiting this time. It’s ok that you are not as talented as her, but are you not as broad-minded as her? If so, it’s disappointing.” He immediately scolded the group of people and silenced them.
There was no way. They really couldn’t refute the real achievements. Their faces turned red and they didn’t want to admit that they were not as good as Zou Wu no matter what.
With all this commotion, everyone forgot about the other person.
Xing Yucheng’s father, the Shangshu, knew very well that he was old enough to retire and he did not have the ability to become a first-rank Shangshu Ling. If he could have made further progress, he would have been there long ago and would not have waited until today.
Although his abilities were limited, Xing Yucheng’s father was not stupid. Having been in official circles for so many years, he naturally knew what was going on.
The emperor wanted to promote the newly appointed Minister of Works, but the Minister of Works was already in office, so he simply promoted him to make room for the newcomer.
In his opinion, how could His Majesty promote him? It was clearly to let him help occupy the position of Shangshu Ling first, otherwise His Majesty should promote someone with outstanding ability and young age.
In the emperor’s heart, the person he really favours should be the newly appointed Minister of Works.
If it were when they were young, Xing Yucheng’s father would naturally be unwilling, but he is already at this age, and his fighting spirit has long been worn out in a low-paying government office like the Ministry of Works. He doesn’t care why he was promoted, as long as he can be promoted.
He felt that his life was fulfilled when he was able to experience the majesty of a first-rank official before he died.
And since the emperor has given me such respect, I must not be confused at this time.
Thinking of this, after realising it, Xing Yucheng’s father almost instantly raised his hands and feet to agree with Ye Shuo’s decision. His voice was the loudest in the entire hall.
After that, Ye Shuo didn’t even need to say anything, as Xing Yucheng’s father took the initiative to help and attack the group of people who opposed it.
How could an old man who could raise a son who was the top scholar be a good person?
Xing Yucheng’s eyes almost fell out when he saw his old father arguing with the scholars. It was because Xing Yucheng had never known that his father had such a rich vocabulary. When he scolded people, even yin and yang were not enough to describe it.
Xing Yucheng’s old father not only cursed himself, but also dragged his son to curse as well. Xing Yucheng really couldn’t resist and could only join in. Now, the opponents who had already shown signs of decline found it even more difficult to cope. However, in the end, it was not them who played a decisive role.
Seeing the Seventh Prince actively standing up to help speak, Ye Shuo was stunned at first, and then narrowed his eyes slightly.
This guy, I’m afraid he has already guessed something.
As expected of his step-brother, each of them is a tough guy, even now.
As for the Seventh Prince, he also guessed that his brother had guessed his thoughts, but so what? The Seventh Prince was sure that he would not expose it just like that.
Ever since his old friends passed away one after another, the days have become really boring. The Fifth king was no match for him at all. As time passed, the hatred in his heart also faded away little by little.
It’s so boring…
The Seventh Prince had seen too much with his eyes, and now he just felt bored, and everything around him was even more boring. After discovering the secret of his younger brother, day after day, he seemed to have seen something incredible and new, and the restlessness that was temporarily suppressed in his heart could no longer be suppressed.
Rather than slowly rotting like Prince Ding and the fifth and eighth brothers under the emperor’s plan, it is better to take a gamble with the emperor at the stake of a few worthless lives.
Thinking of this, the Seventh King looked casually at the Emperor who was sitting high up and looking down at them.
Their eyes met, both of them were full of interest.
At this moment, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but feel curious about what kind of gift his adopted brother had prepared for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 337: Cheap
chapters.content:
Fengshan Ceremony. As the mother of a country, Yao Zhi naturally had to attend.
The Fengshan ceremony has always been solemn and dignified. Although everything is kept simple now because the war has just ended, it still took the Ministry of Rites a long time to prepare.
Two whole months passed, plus two months on the road, and it was already three months later when Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi stood on the altar.
Ye Shuo didn’t know if there really were gods in this world, but if they were, he just hoped that everything would go smoothly.
At this moment, Ye Shuo was particularly pious.
When the two men inserted the incense sticks into the incense burner, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but think that this was a great honour that even his father had never had.
There were also those who accused him of being cruel and merciful, saying that he was a king who loved war and was not a merciful king. However, these voices were too weak and ultimately did not gain any momentum.
After all, the good and the bad are written by the victors.
After offering sacrifices to heaven and earth, another piece of good news soon followed –
The fleet that Jianjian personally supervised has finally been completed.Looking at his sister who had just returned from Jiangnan to report, with dark circles under her eyes, Ye Shuo could not help but laugh out loud.
He didn’t even need to open his mouth to feel the ridicule coming at him. Jianjian couldn’t help but clench her fists until they made a crackling sound.
Who on earth am I doing this for? !
The original plan was to complete it in one and a half to two years, but because the attack from the Great Zhou was too swift and there were so many more mouths to feed, Jian Jian worked almost day and night, rushing to shorten the construction period by so much.
Thinking of this, Jianjian couldn’t help but grit her teeth.
During this year, Jianjian studied hard and almost became a half-expert in ships. However, theory and practice are different after all, so she will have to be assigned a few experienced assistants. There are many such experts among the people, so it is not a difficult task for Azhi. As soon as she spread the news, several well-known figures in the world actively reported their names.
All the preparations have been completed. Ye Shuo raised his head and confirmed for the last time: “No regrets in this move…”
Before Ye Shuo could finish his words, Jian Jian had already knelt down on one knee.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo finally didn’t say anything more.
Compared to the controversial Fengshan ceremony, not many people cared about the voyage. Except for those who knew Ye Shuo very well, no one else thought there would be anything rare on the other side of the ocean.
The Great Zhou is now so vast and rich in resources, why bother? Moreover, the winds and rains are strong at sea, and it is common to lose your life if you are not careful, which is really not a good thing.
Thinking about it this way, anyone with some status would not be very interested in this.
After another six months of training and running-in, the weather was clear and calm on the day Jianjian went out to sea. It was a rare good day. However, the scheduled port was too far from Shangjing, and Ye Shuo had just left not long ago, so he did not go to see her off in person this time. Instead, his mother set off a month in advance and is probably already at the scene now.
On the other side, Queen Dowager Wei was truly shocked when she looked at the vast sea and the fleet floating on the sea.
The Empress Dowager Wei, who had lived in the deep palace for a long time, rarely saw such a grand scene. For some reason, she suddenly remembered an incident before she entered the palace. When the old Duke Zhen was still leading the troops, the Empress Dowager Wei once followed her father to the military camp. At that time, everyone in the entire military camp followed her father’s lead.
Only that one time, when the blurred memory came back to her, did Queen Mother Wei suddenly realise how heart-shaking that scene was.
She used to be a daughter, and now she is a mother. Queen Mother Wei had to admit that she was indeed very majestic, even more majestic than when she was a concubine and a queen mother.
Looking at her daughter standing at the front, Queen Mother Wei could vaguely understand why Jian Jian was so persistent about this matter. Even a bystander like her felt a little excited when facing such a team, let alone Jian Jian as the leader?
After such a long period of training and running-in, Jian Jian had already subdued all the people in front of her. Now, as long as she gave an order, the whole team would respond. How could it be described as high-spirited?
Coupled with the unknown adventure, Jianjian became excited. If what her unfortunate brother said was true, then in the near future all the people in the world would benefit from her, and her influence would even extend to hundreds or thousands of years later.
I am now about to do something very big.
Until this moment, Jianjian had never been so clear-headed, and when she thought of this, the blood in her body began to roar and boil.
The Queen Mother waited until the ship disappeared. She was also ignited by the nameless flame burning on her daughter. She couldn’t come back to her senses for a long time. After she reacted, she couldn’t help but take a deep breath. Then when she returned to Beijing, she went to the Duke of Zhen’s Mansion as soon as possible.
It would have been fine if Queen Mother Wei hadn’t known that women could be like this before, but now that she knows, of course she feels depressed.
How glorious it is to be a female general or a marquis. Why didn’t her father have such foresight?
Poor old Duke Zhen, he is almost ninety years old and still has to be nagged by his almost sixty-year-old daughter, asking why he didn’t train her to be a female general.
The old Duke of Zhen felt aggrieved, but he didn’t say anything.
Female generals were not popular in his time. Now, he heard that there are some signs of this happening, but that was an idea that his beloved grandson came up with in recent years. Even if he was rough, he was not a heretic after all, otherwise he would have rebelled long ago and would not have been tormented like that by Emperor Jingwen.
“Dad, you even refused to teach me the family palm technique.” Queen Mother Wei had a resentful look on her face, otherwise she wouldn’t be so weak now. She also wanted to be like her daughter-in-law and her second master, who could knock people down with just a finger.
At this moment, the old Duke Zhen only regretted that he was in such good health. He was ninety years old and his ears were not deaf. Unlike his old wife next to him, she could hardly hear what others said two years ago. Otherwise, this incident would not have happened.
The old Duke of Zhen hesitated to speak, and finally muttered in a low voice: “How can you blame me for this? Why would a little girl practice palm techniques and make her hands rough?”
Back then, the old Duke Zhen would never have let his daughter suffer like this!
But now, perhaps the concept does need to change.
After his daughter’s disturbance, the old Duke Zhen tossed and turned at night, thinking a lot. It seemed that their family had indeed regained its glory. After Prime Minister He retired, his eldest grandson Wei Wen, as the head of the civil servants, naturally enjoyed great glory. However, behind this glory, there was also unknown sadness.
The old Duke of Zhen had many sons in his life, and his sons gave him many grandsons, and his grandsons gave him a lot of great-grandsons. However, what made the old Duke of Zhenguo despair was that among the nearly one hundred people, there were only a few who could read. Even if they could read, they could hardly be considered proficient. In the end, it was already the best they could do to pass the imperial examination and become a Jinshi, not to mention taking over Wei Wen’s job in the future.
There is only one top scholar among tens of thousands of people, and there are only a few hundred people in their family. It is normal that their great-grandsons cannot become successful.
Now, as the emperor’s grandfather, he does treat the Duke of Zhenguo’s Mansion well, but he is the emperor after all. For the sake of checks and balances, he will not allow the Duke of Zhenguo’s Mansion to produce another brave general. Now, Xiao Shiba’s position in the army has actually reached the limit. Otherwise, with one civil and one military in the court, it will be difficult for their Wei family to avoid problems in the end.
Although his grandson would not say so, the old Duke Zhenguo has always been knowledgeable and interesting, and his feelings are always two-way. Since his grandson does not want to be suspicious, the old Duke Zhenguo will not let him down.
Now the question is, if the eldest grandson Wei Wen retires one day, who will be able to take over the family?
It was obvious that the path of studying was not feasible, and he had to return to the army in the end. But being a male general was not feasible. If he put himself in his shoes, the old Duke of Zhenguo felt that he would lose sleep. But the same could not be said for a female general.
Although the old Duke Zhenguo is old, he is not confused. He knows that although they are both generals, there are great differences. For example, their little Eighteen has a family behind him. Little Eighteen’s starting point is higher than ordinary people because he is the heir of the Duke’s Mansion. In the future, he will naturally put his family first, but the female general… As for the female general, for a long time in the future, the only one she can rely on is the emperor. If someone else comes, even if that person is her father or brother, it will not work and they are not reliable.
Just like how the old Duke Zhenguo loved his young daughter so much, he eventually chose to send Queen Dowager Wei into the palace.
The old Duke Zhenguo doesn’t care whether his daughter is loyal to the family or not, as long as the family can continue. So all he has to do is cast a wide net, just in case he can catch a big fish in the end?
Thinking of this, the old Duke Zhenguo called his daughters of marriageable age to his side the next day and asked them if they wanted to learn martial arts with their brothers or join the army with their fathers and brothers.
The girls were stunned when they heard the news. Except for a few who didn’t understand it for a while, the rest of them signed up immediately after they realised what was going on.
Whether they find martial arts interesting or something else, for now, these girls are very enthusiastic.
Afterwards, the old Duke Zhenguo picked out two people who were indeed ambitious and had relatively clear minds, and immediately delivered the news to the palace.
The youngest of the three princesses is also old enough to go to school, so now is the perfect time to send her over to be a study companion to the other princesses. The friendship fostered in this way will naturally be much stronger than usual.
No matter what His Majesty plans to do in the future, given His Majesty’s temperament, the three princesses will certainly not suffer any loss, and as long as the princesses do not suffer any loss, their family will not suffer any loss.
Even Ye Shuo didn’t expect that his grandfather was so smart, and getting smarter as he got older. He couldn’t help but feel happy.
It is a great blessing for him and the three princesses that their grandfather is so wise.
After the Duke of Zhenguo made this move, the nobles who came to the capital could no longer sit still.
If the female marquis of General Xu’s family was a coincidence, then the behaviour of the old Duke of Zhenguo was more like a signal. Even General Xu was not as close to the emperor as the old Duke of Zhenguo. The old Duke of Zhenguo’s behaviour could almost reflect the emperor’s intention. In addition, Zou Wu was just promoted to Minister of Works half a year ago, and there were several capable female officials around the Empress, so the emperor’s attitude could not be more obvious.
But the emperor did not say it clearly, and he never gave a direct answer when asked, which made it impossible for the court officials who wanted to give suggestions to speak up. After all, they couldn’t control whether the women in the old Duke Zhenguo’s Mansion and General Xu’s Mansion practised martial arts or studied, right? Even though many people guessed that the emperor’s intentions were more than that, on the surface, this matter was very simple.
Ye Shuo is not stupid, how could he say it out loud and set up such a big target for them to hit? As long as he does not make his attitude clear and has no clear target to hit, the opponents will be scattered. After all, those people are guessing among themselves, sometimes they are resolute and sometimes they hesitate with a fluke mentality, and he will kill his own people.
Seeing that they could no longer oppose, and that the emperor had no position to oppose unless he made a statement, they followed the principle of joining if they couldn’t beat him. Smart people had already begun to learn from the old Duke Zhenguo and did what he did. Even if they didn’t gain anything in the end, they wouldn’t suffer any loss by doing so.
In Shangjing, under the emperor’s feet, there is no shortage of people with a keen sense of smell. Once the trend is formed, the radiation area will only expand larger and larger, and in the end, those who do not follow the trend will not be able to integrate into the circle.
A spice or a piece of cloth can start a trend, let alone other things.
Anyway, Ye Shuo’s students are the first batch of followers, because they are almost certain that if they don’t seize the opportunity now, they will definitely regret it in the future.
Needless to say, there have always been families who let their daughters study. The nobles who originally thought it didn’t matter whether their daughters studied or not were not short of money, so they simply invited teachers to come home to teach. As for those who were firmly against their daughters studying, other families’ daughters were studying, and if their daughters didn’t study, wouldn’t it be embarrassing?
The people in Shangjing were even easier to solve. The daughters of the nobles went to study and practised martial arts, proving that studying and practising martial arts were good things, so all the families with extra money followed suit.
Although most people nowadays are just taking shortcuts, even his grandfather only chose the daughter of the mansion because he could not choose a male member of the family, but Ye Shuo did not care.
All things are difficult at the beginning. You have to take one step at a time and eat one bite at a time.
Three years passed like this, and seeing that the time was almost right, Ye Shuo issued an imperial decree on a very ordinary day, during a very ordinary morning court session, which seemed very normal to him –
From now on, if a woman has a certain amount of property under her name, she can set up a female household, and she can also become an official by passing the imperial examination.
As soon as these words were spoken, Ye Shuo’s students all had a feeling that “it is true”, while the others were shocked on the spot.
They guessed what the emperor might do, but they didn’t expect that they were too timid and didn’t think enough.
If it were in the past, they would definitely say, how can women take the imperial examination? It is simply against the will of heaven and is extremely unrighteous!
However, the reality now is that their sisters, daughters, and granddaughters are all studying… If they can catch up with the first batch of women to take the imperial examination, they will definitely be able to take advantage of it.
So now the question is, do they take advantage of this or not? Do they eat the pie that is right in front of their mouths or not?

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Victory
chapters.content:
The people who are least worried now are those who love their daughter. Their daughter has been studying since she was young and is the most competitive among all the people. Since they love their daughter, they naturally hope that their daughter can have a good future.
The second is speculators. But since they are speculators, they are eager to reap the rewards after placing their bets. As for worrying about the outflow of family resources? It doesn’t matter. There is always a way to solve it.
No one present is a good person. When they really make a choice, it means that there will be corresponding countermeasures afterwards.
The most intense reaction among all the people was from those who neither valued the women in the tribe nor took them seriously, and were even unwilling to follow the trend. When they heard such an imperial decree, they jumped up immediately as if their tails had been stepped on. Their tone was extremely angry, but they did not notice that there were only a few responses.
The emperor had spread the word long ago, so who can be blamed for these people not knowing how to seize the opportunity? The two groups of people in front of them didn’t think there was anything wrong with Ye Shuo not making his words clear. If he didn’t even have this kind of foresight, it was natural for him to be eliminated from the team.
It is almost impossible to ask them to take the initiative to stand up and express their support. After all, the decision made by the emperor is unprecedented, and no one will make a decision easily when the future is unclear.
Ye Shuo’s purpose was not to force these people to express their opinions. It was enough for Ye Shuo that they could remain on the sidelines. The rest were the issues that needed to be resolved.
It’s just that without the help of smart people at the top, these people who are left can’t amount to anything. Even their reasons for opposition are so weak and vulnerable. They just repeat two sentences over and over again. The first is that it is the ancestral rule, and the second is that women are born humble, short-sighted, and cannot bear heavy responsibilities. They are so fierce that it seems that if women become officials, the huge Zhou Dynasty will fall apart in an instant. Some people even say such ridiculous words as “women in power is a sign of the country’s demise.”
Almost as soon as he finished speaking, Ye Shuo raised his eyes and looked at Zou Wu who was standing there with his back straight.
Zou Wu walked forward neither humbly nor arrogantly and bowed.She was the most outstanding student in that batch of students. Even though many years had passed, she still had a sharp edge. Now that she is in a high position, she is even more impressive.
The people who followed the emperor’s gaze were choked up like chickens with their necks pinched.
Zou Wu almost existed to overturn what they had just said.
Over the past three years, Zou Wu’s abilities have been obvious to all. Perhaps because she knew that everyone was watching her, Zou Wu needed to work several times harder than others, but fortunately, she did it.
The words of the opponents became intermittent, as if he didn’t notice their ugly faces. Zou Wu said respectfully: “Your Majesty, I have something to offer.”
Zou Wu knew very well that she didn’t need to intervene in this matter. She just needed to do what she usually did.
Ye Shuo had expected this and raised his hand: “Okay.”
When the opponents saw the palace servants carefully carrying several objects into the hall, they suddenly felt an ominous premonition in their hearts.
Soon, the premonition came true.
Zou Wu lifted the red silk covering it and explained to Ye Shuo and everyone else one by one: “This thing is called potato, named after its resemblance to a bell. This thing is called sweet potato…”
“This is Hugua, this is Langtao, and this is Luosu…”
The so-called “hu gua” is cucumber, the so-called “langtao” is tomato, and the so-called “luosu” is eggplant.
After introducing potatoes and sweet potatoes that can be used as staple foods, Zou Wu started to introduce other fruits and vegetables, but everyone’s attention had already been attracted by the thing that looked like a potato.
When they heard that this plant was easy to grow and had a very high yield after being cultivated and improved, everyone was even more shocked.
Everyone knows what this sentence means. It means that once it is promoted on a large scale, the people of the entire Da Zhou will no longer have to worry about food.
If there is enough food, the world will be stable, and if the world is stable, the prosperous times will be stable. In this way, even if the old Chen and Beiting countries are unwilling to resign and look for an opportunity to cause trouble, it will be useless. It is difficult for the world to cause chaos, so naturally there will be no signs of chaos.
Besides, these things in front of us were originally brought back by Princess Jianjian when she went out to sea, and now they have been improved several times by Zou Wu before becoming the edible form they are today. Such an achievement cannot be refuted by anyone in the court or the country.
It seems that the emperor was well prepared, and the others finally understood why the Ministry of Industry had made such a big fuss in recent years. It was just because there were too few people who were proficient in this field. Fortunately, although they were not very proficient in improved breeding, they had a keen sense of political affairs and were not as dumbfounded as the remaining group of people.
Sure enough, once the emperor decides to do something, there is nothing he cannot accomplish, no matter how outrageous it is.
Seeing the opponents gradually starting to talk nonsense and lose their composure because they really couldn’t find any reasons to oppose, the rest of the people couldn’t help but have a glimmer of pity in their eyes. At the same time, they knew in their hearts that the emperor had already won the fight and had beaten the opponents so badly that they had no chance to fight back. It was time for them to stand up and express their stance.
As expected, Ye Shuo’s students were still the first to respond.
What happened today also taught them a lesson. They knew that the competition in the court would become more and more fierce in the future, and the emperor would have more and more people at his disposal. If they continued to indulge in the knowledge bestowed by the emperor in the past and stagnate like they are now, they would sooner or later be replaced by more outstanding successors.
Now that women can also serve as officials, how far will it be to break the aristocratic monopoly and promote universal education? In the past, several people thought that the emperor might not be so determined, but now they think that day is almost certain to come.
Before Ye Shuo’s students could continue to think deeply, his eldest cousin Wei Wen, who was already the head of the civil servants, was silent for a moment, then stepped forward, bowed his head and said, “I agree with your Majesty.”
When he lowered his head, the others who had already been moved seemed to have received some signal and expressed their agreement one after another.
Even if Prince Ding was in cahoots with Ye Shuo, he couldn’t help but frown at this moment. Just as he was about to hesitate whether to speak out his objection, the Seventh Prince beside him woke him up with a word –
“Big brother, if I remember correctly, the futures of my nephews have been arranged, right? If so, why would you bother to get involved in this mess?”
Prince Ding’s sons have almost all been settled, so even if there is trouble in the future, it will not involve him and his sons. In other words, no matter how outrageous Xiaojiu’s current decision is, it has nothing to do with him and his family. The Seventh Prince thinks that it is simply unreasonable for his eldest brother to offend Xiaojiu at this time.
Prince Ding felt that this was indeed the truth, but he also had to consider the future of the Great Zhou, right?
Obviously, Prince Ding is the kind of person who thinks that women can’t accomplish anything great.
However, the next moment, Prince Ding saw that the Seventh Prince seemed to have guessed what he was thinking. He looked at him with a surprised and amused look, as if to say, “I didn’t expect that you, big brother, are so noble and upright that you even disregard your own son’s future and want to oppose this matter.” Prince Ding couldn’t help but feel angry, but at the same time he gave up the idea of ​​opposing it.
Lao Qi was right. If I really spoke rashly, all my previous efforts would be wasted.
Between the future of the Great Zhou and the future of his own son, Prince Ding decisively chose the latter.
His silence caused the two old princes, who had long been deprived of their leadership of the royal family, to get anxious and jump up and down, but it was all in vain.
The Fifth Prince and the Eighth Prince did have something to say about this, but before they could say it, suddenly, something unexpected happened in the hall. It turned out that an old censor saw that the situation was hopeless and that the emperor had made up his mind and there was no possibility of changing his mind. He was so emotional and full of despair that he ran straight into a pillar in a fit of anger.
In an instant, blood splattered everywhere and the whole room fell silent.
The old censor thought he could stop it with his life, and thought he was right. Until the last moment of his consciousness, he was still righteous and unyielding.
Almost instantly, after reacting, everyone subconsciously looked towards the emperor sitting on the dragon throne, only to see that the emperor just sighed, then waved his hand and asked the eunuch beside him to quickly call the imperial physician for treatment. He did not say another word, nor did he show any intention of changing his mind.
The Fifth Prince and the Eighth Prince shut up immediately. Their current status was not much higher than that of the censor, so they decided to just forget it.
The other opponents also realised that without a big shot with decision-making power standing on their side, it would be in vain even if they all died here today. It was possible that their death would make room for others. Thinking of this, the others immediately became obedient.
After the old censor made such a fuss, the matter was settled naturally. If the old censor was still alive, I wonder if he would be completely angry to death when he found out about this matter later.
After the court session ended, everyone walked out slowly. Perhaps knowing that she was now at the centre of controversy, Zou Wu tactfully lagged behind the crowd by a few steps. She did not intend to cause any trouble, nor did she want to hear any discussions that she did not want to hear.
It was this slow movement that caused her to accidentally see this scene when she walked out of the Xuanzheng Hall:
I saw that the emperor who had left long ago was now standing in a corner of the corner tower, looking at this place with his sleeves gathered up, his lips moving as if he was saying something, and standing next to the emperor were… should they be the three little princesses?
Another three years passed, and the three princesses gradually grew up. As they grew taller, their eyes and eyebrows also gradually became more mature. Especially the eldest princess, Princess Dingning, now had the charm of both His Majesty and the Queen.
Zou Wu saw clearly that although the emperor advocated education for all and admission based on merit, and did not care whether the other party was a man or a woman, if it were not for the three princesses, the emperor might not be so decisive.
Zou Wu vaguely guessed the emperor’s thoughts and did not mind becoming a political resource for the princesses. In other words, she was very happy and even honoured to be the sword in the princesses’ hands and the chess piece on the board. She only hoped that the princesses would not let her down.
Perhaps she noticed the gazes of the three princesses, so Zou Wu calmly bowed in the direction of the corner tower.
Except for the two younger sisters who were still confused and hiding in the back of the hall, Dingning, who had heard everything that happened in the court today, was also grateful to this adult. After Zou Wu stood up, Dingning quickly returned the salute.
Although the two have not met formally, they have already kept each other firmly in their hearts.
Half an incense stick later, watching Zou Wu’s gradually disappearing figure, Ding Ning finally couldn’t help but say, “I understand father’s painstaking efforts, and I will never forget what happened today.”
I will never forget that there are people who would rather risk their lives than let women serve as officials.
The road ahead is long and difficult.
Even as an emperor, he was powerless to change this deep-rooted idea, but fortunately his daughter was smart and not stupid. Ye Shuo did not say anything, but just raised his hand and touched Dingning’s head.
This is just the beginning, there will be more troubles in the future.
Ye Shuo sighed in his heart, and at this moment he somewhat understood how his father felt at that time.
An Ning and Yong Ning, who also watched the whole process, felt depressed and uncomfortable. However, before they could figure out what was going on, their eldest sister looked at them with a smile, but her words were so ruthless: “We have played enough today, it’s time to go to school.”
Even though we now have Lord Zou Wu, Young Marquis Xu, Empress Dowager He, the Queen Mother, and my aunt, it is still too few. Before, Dingning had somewhat of the idea of ​​vying for favour with her two younger sisters. Seeing the serious situation today, I think, let’s solve the fatal problem first. The rest are trivial matters. There are so many problems outside that have not been solved yet, so let’s not rush into internal strife.
At first An Ning and Yong Ning were a little flattered, but after they found out that they had been deceived, it was too late to escape.
At the same time, when Ye Shuo’s decree came out and the time for the next imperial examination was calculated, all the educated women in the entire Great Zhou Dynasty became anxious.
They didn’t know what the future would be like, but they knew that changing their minds every day was not a wise move. Thinking that this imperial examination might be their only chance, they were completely determined.
In a small town thousands of miles away from the capital, a woman was lying on a tall tree with her eyes closed, listening to the noisy sounds of people coming and going in the tavern not far away, as usual. After hearing the newly issued decree of the court, she turned over and jumped down from the tree almost instantly.
Seeing the man’s trembling expression, the woman asked him to repeat what he had just said. After making sure that she had not heard it wrong, she could not help but raise her eyebrows.
Being an official…?
It seems like a good idea. I suddenly became interested.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Disgusting
chapters.content:
However, ideals are full and reality is skinny.
After all, it was the first imperial examination, and the preparation time was short, so the result was not as expected. There were only two women in the top ten, and no one in the top three. However, Ye Shuo was already quite satisfied with the result.
Besides, there are many women participating in this martial arts competition…
There is martial arts in this world, and the difference in physical strength between men and women is not as big as the difference in internal strength. It’s just that each family cherishes their own martial arts, and the methods of practice are never passed on to others, let alone circulated among poor people. That’s why the overall situation is like this. As long as the barriers are broken, it will not be difficult to change the status quo.
From this perspective, the future is even more promising.
After Ye Shuo had arranged the top ten in this batch, he knew it was time for him to take the next step.
Zou Wu is now only responsible for scientific research, while others have gradually given up on further exploration after entering officialdom. In this case, there are some things they have to do.
Perhaps they had anticipated this day long ago, so when Ye Shuo summoned Lu Mu and others to enter the palace, Lu Mu and others were not surprised. They just knew that there would be a tough battle to fight, so they were uncontrollably tense.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo didn’t say much. He just lined up the things he had prepared and had people show them one by one.
Lu Mu and the others subconsciously bent down and took it with both hands. The paper they received was not as delicate and soft as rice paper, but it was not very rough either, and it was enough for writing. Looking at the thing beside it… it should be called a pen, right?A few people made a stroke and saw the clear marks left on the paper. The paper would not smudge even if it was slightly moistened, so they knew what was going on.
In order to break the monopoly of knowledge by the aristocratic families, the first thing to solve is the cost issue of paper and pens, so that they are no longer exclusive to the nobles. As expected, the things in front of us are made of cheap materials and have extremely low costs. Even ordinary civilians in Shangjing can afford them. Although the people in other places are not as wealthy as those in Shangjing, their burden is definitely much smaller than it is now.
In addition to this is movable type printing, which is the highlight of today.
When writing is no longer limited to handwriting, the barriers created between the clans will naturally collapse.
Ye Shuo spoke at the right time and said, “Although I intend to establish a school, I do not want to make enemies with the noble families. Do you understand?”
It’s not that Ye Shuo has any good feelings towards those people. Naturally, he can’t have any mercy on local tyrants who sometimes even dare to disobey the emperor’s orders. It’s just that if they make trouble, the people will suffer in the end. Ye Shuo would rather use gentler means. If it is not necessary, Ye Shuo is unwilling to start a war again.
But when Lu Mu and the others heard this, they felt a little troubled.
This is to destroy the jobs of the aristocratic families, but not allow them to resist. This… is really forcing them to do something.
Put yourself in their shoes. If this happened to them, they would definitely refuse to obey and would try every possible means to prevent the emperor from accomplishing his goal, even if it meant resorting to violence or even rebelling against the emperor.
After all, once the school directly under the jurisdiction of the imperial court was built, the noble status of the aristocracy would inevitably fall, which would be more painful for them than killing them. How could they accept it?
Thinking of this, whether they could return alive this time was still a question.
Seeing Lu Mu and the others’ expressions change several times, Ye Shuo seemed to have guessed what they were thinking. He couldn’t help but sigh and said, “You are all my students. I will naturally not let you die in vain.”
They are all rare talents, and we would feel sad if anyone was missing.
Hearing this, Lu Mu and the others breathed a sigh of relief. After pondering for a while, relying on his understanding of the emperor, Lu Mu boldly asked, “Has the emperor made any plans?”
“It’s not a successful plan, it’s just a small plot.” Since the noble families will be a considerable force once they unite, we should find a way to break them up, let them split up on their own, divide and rule, and defeat them one by one, then they will not be able to achieve anything.
