But as I said before, Ye Shuo did not want to use this method unless it was necessary, but at the moment, he had no better idea. He could only solve the monopoly problem first, let most people read the book first, and then make revisions and improvements step by step later.
Ye Shuo took a deep breath and said slowly: “Divide into sections and volumes.”
These four short words made Lu Mu and the other three stunned at first, but they were not stupid after all, and they reacted quickly.
The so-called division should be that the more abundant the educational resources, the more stringent the requirements are. Just like the south and the north today, although there are noble families stationed there, no one would think that the north is stronger than the south. The north has always suffered from the war in the north court. The noble families in the north are naturally inferior to the south, and the students under their influence are not immune. The so-called division of volumes, different treatments for different situations seem reasonable, not to mention that when the situation was the most serious, the north and south volumes were divided, and it seems reasonable to divide them more finely on this basis.
Under such circumstances, Lu Mu can guarantee that the noble families will never unite, and they may even fight each other. You should know that the Lin family of Southern Jiangsu has been the number one family for a long time. At the most glorious time, the top 13 in the palace examination were from their family. Although the new champion was not surnamed Lin, he later joined the Lin family, suppressing the other noble families so much that they could not even breathe. How can such a situation not make people jealous? Even if they are of the same class, they may not be united.
Besides, what choice did they have? Once movable type printing and other things came out, the aristocratic family was doomed. The sooner they surrendered, the more benefits they could get. With this in mind, those people had only one way to go if they wanted to preserve the family’s strength as much as possible.
The emperor’s methods seemed merciful, but in fact they were extremely harsh. They had no choice at all. They had to listen whether they wanted to or not.
Those who obey the emperor will prosper, while those who disobey him will perish.
Even though they had long seen that their teacher was a man of his word, Lu Mu and the others were still frightened and out of control, feeling a sense of panic.
Coupled with the previous incidents, Lu Mu and others couldn’t help but worry that one day the emperor would abandon them.
You must know that once the school is built, the emperor will not only be their teacher, but also the teacher of thousands of students all over the world. What will the emperor do when the day comes when the advantages they have completely disappear?
To put it bluntly, Lu Mu and his companions had been living a good life for too long and had become somewhat addicted to it. In addition, some time ago Ye Shuo issued an order that women could also take part in the imperial examinations and become high-ranking officials. Lu Mu and his companions knew in their hearts that they were not at an advantage and they also knew that they were not irreplaceable. The competitive pressure suddenly increased and they inevitably became anxious and worried.
How could Ye Shuo not guess what they were thinking? As early as the day in Xuanzheng Hall, Ye Shuo had already sensed the hidden worries in their hearts from the fact that they were not lining up as quickly as before.
Even between teachers and students, there are times when opinions conflict. Lu Mu and the others are not complete yes-men. They naturally have their own little thoughts and considerations. What Ye Shuo has to do is to make Lu Mu and the others obey him without any scruples.
Not only the nobles, but even the thoughts of the upstarts in front of us must be taken into consideration… Otherwise, it would be too ridiculous if things were not ruined by outsiders but by our own people.
Ye Shuo then picked up a few books from the desk and motioned for them to look over.
“This is the textbook I recently compiled for use in school teaching. Take a look. Is there anything else you need to add?”
Lu Mu and others thought that these should be the same as what they got that year, but after turning over a few pages, they found that they were completely different. The contents of these books given to them by the emperor were not ordinary simple, but just enough for literacy, which was far from enough to compete with them.
Lu Mu and the others were stunned at first, then suddenly looked up at the man above them.
Ye Shuo sighed and said helplessly: “You have to eat your meal one bite at a time.”
Each era has its own development. Forcing things to grow will only lead to destruction. The development of science and technology must be combined with the development of ideas. It is not something that Ye Shuo can do alone. Moreover, with today’s productivity, everyone goes to school. Who will grow crops in the fields? People will starve to death if they have no food!
Therefore, Ye Shuo did not completely copy the modern system. Even the school was only three years long, which was basically enough for students to recognize words and learn simple addition, subtraction, multiplication and division before they could graduate.
Don’t underestimate such a small thing. In ancient times when illiteracy was widespread, learning to recognize words and basic addition, subtraction, multiplication and division was enough to work as an accountant in an ordinary store, and it was also enough to find a job to support yourself. Only those with outstanding talents could take the exam and continue their studies, but that was a long time in the future. Moreover, after layers of screening, the number of students who could finally enter the imperial city might not be as many as it is now, so it was far from the time to be anxious.
It would take at least ten years to train the first batch of students into talented people. If Lu Mu and his friends remained standing still during these ten years, then they deserved to be eliminated. Even Lu Mu and his friends felt that this was beyond reproach.
Be radical when you need to be radical, and make concessions when you need to, so that things can go more smoothly.
Although Ye Shuo is strict, he always leaves some room for manoeuvre and does not like to kill everyone. But it is precisely because of this that Lu Mu and others feel even more powerless. The result of always leaving them a glimmer of hope is that their hearts will never be united. There will always be people who cannot make up their minds, and there will always be people who will take chances. The result of not being able to work together is that they will be scattered and can only allow the emperor to defeat them one by one.
Today, Lu Mu and others, just like those aristocratic families and He Xiang and others in the past, are being driven step by step to the path that the emperor wants them to take.
Lu Mu could no longer see things so clearly in his heart, but despite this, he sadly found that he could not even feel a trace of resentment in his heart.
The emperor’s skills are so good that they are convinced.
In this case, the affairs of the three princesses will not be a difficult problem for His Majesty, so they should make preparations early.
“Your Majesty is merciful. We have no objection. We are willing to leave immediately to help Your Majesty.”
After hearing this, Ye Shuo naturally would not refuse.
They set off as soon as they said they would. Half a month later, Lu Mu and others arrived at various places with their belongings.
Seeing that the current heads of various families were polite on the surface but could not hide the ridicule in their eyes after learning the purpose of their visit, Lu Mu and others sneered in their hearts at the same time.
This group of people have controlled articles and books for dozens or even hundreds of years, and their behaviour is extremely domineering. Scholars who are not from aristocratic families cannot survive without paying homage to them. They have been rampant for so long, it is time for them to be severely punished.
All I can say is that it was their misfortune to meet His Majesty.
Things developed just as Lu Mu and the others had expected. At first, the noble families did not take these officials seriously. They had deep roots and complicated relationships. How could they be easily shaken? The court wanted to open a school, which was simply a foolish dream!
However, after negotiating with Lu Mu and the others, the heads of the noble families turned green, and only one thought remained in their minds –
Disgusting! This move of the emperor is really disgusting to his ancestors!

chapters.title: Chapter 340: Choking
chapters.content:
The emperor sent these people seemingly to discuss with them, wanting to open schools in places under their influence, but in fact he did not give them any room for choice.
After Lu Mu left, the person next to him couldn’t help but lower his voice and said, “This is too much!”
Who says it isn’t? If this thing is really done, then their current transcendent status will completely cease to exist.
but……
“Now that things have come to this, what can you do? At least they sent someone to inform you. They have already done their best.” Although this was more likely because the current emperor did not want to cause any more disputes, it still gave them time to prepare.
Thinking of this, the head of the Lin family couldn’t help but reveal a slightly sarcastic smile.
“What a great trick.”
Seeing that the head of the family did not seem to be as furious as imagined, perhaps he was quite angry when Lu Mu was there just now, but after such a while, the head of the family had obviously calmed down. He had an inexplicable bad premonition in his heart. He couldn’t help but speculate, the head of the family… wouldn’t he just accept it like this?
“What else do you want to do?” As if he saw what the other party was thinking, the head of the Lin family asked back.
“Of course we should unite with people from other families to resist. If so, even His Majesty will have to retreat.” Everyone in the world knows that at least 60% of the scholars in the entire Great Zhou have direct or indirect relationships with these families. The emperor has taught several good students, but in the end he is weak and cannot completely control all the territories.The man blurted out without thinking.
The head of the Lin family commented on this with just a word –
“Innocent.”
How naive.
He did not say anything else afterwards, but just told the man to call all the other people in the tribe who could be named to the main courtyard.
The man wanted to continue asking, but when he saw the patriarch’s cold gaze, he didn’t dare to say anything and just did as he was told.
When this news was announced, the entire main courtyard was unsurprisingly in an uproar. A large group of people came and went in the main courtyard, making it as lively as a market outside, and they were talking about all kinds of things.
Some insisted on resisting to the end, thinking that if their attitude was strong enough, His Majesty would definitely revoke his order. Some felt that the situation was hopeless, so they might as well take advantage of this opportunity to quickly gain some benefits, at least to properly settle the next generation of the clan. Some were wavering, sometimes thinking that this was reasonable, sometimes that was reasonable, so they kept changing their minds. Some were even more afraid of His Majesty’s power, thinking that they could not fight against him, so they simply gave up and focused on saving their lives…
Scholars are also human beings. As long as they are human beings, they will have selfish desires, will make choices, and their thoughts in their hearts will be different.
Looking at this scene, the truly smart people among them have now closed their eyes and have to accept reality.
There are so many voices within the Lin family alone. It is conceivable that even if several noble families really meet, they will be nothing more than a pile of loose sand. Instead of spending this time, they might as well think about how to preserve the family’s honor to the greatest extent.
Since His Majesty wants to open a school, he must need teachers, right? Although it is frustrating to resist but still try to contribute, this is the only way.
The family heads who responded to Lu Mu and others in this way all had some secret thoughts in their hearts. As the saying goes, Heaven, Earth, the Emperor, Parents and Teachers are the most important. The students taught by them may not be able to be used by them in the future just like they are now.
However, when Ye Shuo saw that they made such a request, he immediately understood what they were planning and couldn’t help but snort in laughter.
In modern times, he has never heard of a few people who can use the word “loyal” to their teachers. Being close is possible, but being loyal… they are probably dreaming.
As each batch of seedlings grows, if a few clans cannot maintain their competitiveness, it is only a matter of time before they are eliminated.
Even if the major families are unwilling, they have to admit that the days when they can get credit for nothing are gone forever.
Then he thought that the establishment of the school had just begun, and Ye Shuo was indeed short of manpower and teachers. Since they all came to his door, he might as well make good use of the free labor.
Thinking of this, Ye Shuo added another condition – rating.
Even teachers are divided into different levels. Otherwise, putting the capable and talented teachers together with those who deliberately lag behind, wouldn’t that be unfair to the capable and good teachers? As soon as these words came out, the heads of the families who had originally wanted to fish in troubled waters and had no intention of teaching their students well gnashed their teeth in hatred.
If they want to be rated, they have to show results. If they want to show results, they have to teach with their heart. If the quality of the students within the influence of their family is not good, it will become their incompetence, and how can an incompetent person have the nerve to take their place?
After fighting with the emperor for a few moves, the heads of the families were completely out of temper. The result of taking a step back is taking steps back. In the blink of an eye, more than ten years have passed. The once extremely glorious family has gradually declined and can no longer be a force to be reckoned with.
As time went by, female officials gradually appeared in the court. Speaking of this, Dingning was still a little dazed. At first, she thought that even if the school recruited female students, the situation might not be optimistic. But what she didn’t expect was that there were indeed not many girls enrolled, but it was much better than she imagined.
Later Dingning discovered that the common people also knew about women becoming officials. The first group, namely Zou Wu and others, were like signposts. With them standing in the court, the common people gradually discovered that daughters were not inferior to boys if they were well educated. As for the issue of girls getting married in the future, it seemed that it was not unsolvable. The female marquis had given birth to two children now. As for the children’s biological father… I heard that he was a capable young man with good looks and intelligence, but I heard that he was not in good health and rarely showed up. He fell ill a few years ago and died without realising it. The marquis was extremely sad and it took her a long time to get over it.
These things are not a secret. Many generals are like this. Looking at it this way, it doesn’t seem to be a rare thing.
At worst, they can just find a son-in-law. As long as there is a promising person in the family, the family will be able to turn around. All they have to pay is three years of tuition. Just three years. If they are talented, they can continue their studies regardless of whether they are boys or girls, and they are blessed by their ancestors. Even if they are not talented, as long as they can read a few words, they will be much better than others whether they get married, have children, or support themselves. It is a good deal no matter how you look at it. As a result, the number of girls enrolled in school naturally increases year by year.
Sure enough, it is always right to follow the nobles above and do whatever they do.
In Dingning’s eyes, all these were linked together, and eventually the current situation was gradually formed.
At first it was just a child’s natural admiration for his parents, but now Dingning admired her father’s calmness and ease more and more. In her eyes, her father and her mother were simply the most powerful people in the world. No one else could be their match. As long as her father and her mother were around, no one in this world could threaten them.
In such an environment, Dingning naturally has the confidence to do anything. She can try out all kinds of threats that she may face in the future without worrying about actually encountering danger. The more she tries, the more she will learn.
Princess Dingning, who was originally restrained by the cold words from outside, has become very different after more than ten years of tempering. Even the old stubborn people in the royal family dare not look her in the face and can only gossip about her behind her back.
There was no way. After all, Princess Dingning was the biological daughter of Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi. Given the genes of Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi, it would be difficult for their child to be unhealthy. In addition, she had been training since childhood, so Dingning’s kung fu was naturally extremely powerful.
But in fact, kung fu is secondary. What the royal family fears most are the eldest princess and important officials such as Zou Wu who have always been standing behind her.
It turns out that the princesses have taken root so deeply without realizing it. When they think about the fact that more than ten years ago, a woman came from nowhere and hit it off with Princess Dingning, who was still a child at the time, even though she did not make the top three in the imperial examination at that time, she later gave up literature and took up martial arts, becoming an extremely rare Confucian general in the army. Now she has become Li Yuheng’s right-hand man, and is about to take over Li Yuheng’s job in the future. Those who are interested in her are naturally anxious when they see that the situation is not good.
But no matter how anxious they were, it was useless. With the emperor in charge, no one dared to say anything.
Over the past decade or so, the emperor’s power has grown and he is no longer what he used to be.
Under such circumstances, on the day when Princess Dingning came of age at the age of sixteen, His Majesty sent her out for training. Even if the royal family wanted to resist, they were powerless. No matter how much they cursed, it was in vain to prevent the princesses from participating in political affairs. However, although they were stopped on the surface, those people were still doing a lot of things behind the scenes.
Ding Ning encountered more assassination attempts than she could count on her hands along the way. Fortunately, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi were well prepared. As parents, they sent several martial arts masters of similar age to their daughter. After several life-and-death experiences, even the most cold-hearted person would have developed feelings for her.
Dingning has good character, has held a high position since childhood, and has a convincing temperament. It does not seem difficult to understand why people follow her.
Seeing that the people he sent out not only failed to eliminate Princess Dingning, but instead gave the other party more assistance, the people who were secretly watching were so angry that they almost vomited blood.
Putting all this aside, Dingning, who has already begun to gain influence in the court, came here today for another matter.
Dingning is already twenty years old this year, but she still has no children. If she does not have an heir, the power she possesses now will be like a flower in the mirror or a moon in the water. Even if someone wants to surrender, they have to consider whether it can last long.
So today, she came here to resolve this matter.
After the palace maids passed the message, Dingning walked into the hall, ignoring his two sisters who were sitting there busy writing government affairs. After Dingning finished her greetings, she looked at her father who was lazily leaning on a recliner while her mother was looking at him with a puzzled look.
Time seemed to be particularly kind to him. Even though more than ten years had passed, Ye Shuo’s appearance had not changed much. He was still the most handsome among the five people. A few scattered fine lines added a touch of depth and charm.
No wonder until now, the Emperor is still able to bewitch the Empress Mother. I heard that the Empress Mother suffered from his beauty at the beginning and has not been able to break free from it for all these years.
Because of this previous experience, Dingning was extremely cautious about this and would never dare to follow in his mother’s footsteps.
Dingning had seen a lot and knew that there were only two men like his father in the world, the one in front of him.
Noticing that his eldest daughter seemed to have come in, Ye Shuo immediately opened his eyes and was about to pick up the fruit in front of him to moisten his throat. However, the next moment, he heard Ding Ning speak and said that she had chosen a man and was going to marry him to the princess’s mansion and try to have a child next year.
“Pfft…cough cough cough.”
Before she could finish her words, Ye Shuo almost choked to death.

chapters.title: Chapter 341: Gambling It was too sudden
chapters.content:
Not only Ye Shuo was shocked by this, An Ning and Yong Ning beside him also raised their heads suddenly, and even Yao Zhi subconsciously put down the pen in her hand.
The four of them looked at the person standing not far away. Facing the gazes of his parents/sisters, Dingning remained calm.
Ye Shuo always felt that his daughters were still young, but now he suddenly realised that the youngest, Yongning, was already eighteen years old, which would have made her an adult even in modern times. As for the oldest, Dingning, if she were in an ordinary family, the child would have been able to go out to buy soy sauce by now.
Ye Shuo is well aware of the harm that early childbirth can cause to women. Dingning, Anning, and Yongning have been deliberately avoiding these things under the influence of this. But now that they have reached that age, they can no longer delay it.
After a while, Ye Shuo finally calmed down his complicated mood, sighed imperceptibly, and asked, “Have you thought about it?”
Dingning nodded, indicating that she did not do it on impulse, but had thought it over carefully a long time ago.
Dingning has been with Yao Zhi since she was a child, and her master Mei Yingzhuo has taught her everything he knows, so she has a relatively good understanding of her body. According to her father, she and Dingning Yongning have perfectly inherited the good genes of their parents. Both her father and her mother are very tall, and her skeleton is naturally not as slender as ordinary people. She has excellent innate conditions, so after careful consideration, Dingning made such a decision.
Without a trace of emotion, it is a completely rational assessment.
Seeing that she had seriously considered it, Ye Shuo stopped trying to persuade her and just asked again: “Then can you tell Daddy who you have chosen?”
When asking this question, a series of lists flashed through Ye Shuo’s mind.The eldest princess of the Great Zhou Dynasty had a cool temperament, extraordinary looks, and power. She was extremely charming and had countless admirers in the capital. For a moment, Ye Shuo really didn’t know who his eldest daughter had set her eyes on.
Just as Ye Shuo was thinking over and over again, he heard Ding Ning utter a name that was neither unfamiliar but not familiar either.
“How could it be him…” Ye Shuo always had a photographic memory and quickly found the other person’s figure in his memory.
The young master of the Xuanping Marquis family, whom I had met once before during a hunting trip, was a little weak, and not as sturdy as a martial artist. It seemed that he did not exercise much, but his handsome face was still presentable. If it were modern times, with good medical conditions, Ye Shuo would naturally not be satisfied with him, but this was ancient times, and if he was just trying to have children, he was a good choice.
Unlike Dingning, the young master must have inherited the small frame of the wife of Marquis Xuanping, and is thinner than ordinary men. If Dingning gets pregnant in the future, it should not be too difficult or hard.
Dingning must have taken these into consideration, so she chose him.
Ye Shuo opened his mouth and said, “I thought it would be Wu An Hou’s…”
Speaking of Marquis Wu’an, it is another story. The old Marquis Wu’an and his wife died early, leaving only this child. Although he inherited the title with a lower status, he was isolated and helpless. Ye Shuo saw that the child was smart and clever, and if Dingning could subdue him, he would surely be a help in the future, so he let Dingning get acquainted with him.
Young boys and girls are childhood sweethearts, so it is normal for them to fall in love with each other. Moreover, as he grows older, Marquis Wu’an becomes more handsome and elegant. Even if he deliberately avoids matters between men and women, Dingning can’t help but be attracted to him.
Ye Shuo had noticed that Dingning’s eyes were different when she looked at the other person, and emotions were extremely difficult to control. Even if one tried hard to hide them, clues would still appear in the corners of his eyes and eyebrows.
Hearing this name from her father’s mouth, Ding Ning was a little stunned. After a while, she said with a mixture of disappointment and regret: “Although Wu’an Marquis is good, I am not a good match for him.”
In Dingning’s opinion, Pei Lang should prefer gentle and considerate women. This was not her random speculation. It was just that a few years ago, when she reached the age to get married, some people in the court guessed that she would find a husband like the Marquis of Wu’an. But there was nothing she could do. After so many years, the emperor only had three princesses, among whom Princess Dingning was the oldest. After she came of age, she entered the court like a prince. The emperor didn’t seem to want to let her go, so how could he let Princess Dingning get married normally?
As soon as this news came out, Ding Ning clearly felt that Pei Lang, who was not yet a marquis at that time, had become much more distant from her, as if he was trying to avoid suspicion. Ding Ning had seen all kinds of tricks since she was a child, so how could she not understand anything? Naturally, she would not have such plans again.
Compared to her, Pei Lang cares more about his future, which is understandable. To prevent power usurpation, Ding Ning will definitely not give him power once Pei Lang becomes the son-in-law of the emperor. Otherwise, when a child is born in the future, there may be a disaster of usurpation of the throne. By then, the Ye family will change hands, and she will be a sinner, and her father’s efforts will be in vain.
Pei Lang, like most men, was unwilling to be inferior to a woman, even if the woman was a princess. If he were asked to marry into the family, he would probably not feel it was an honour, but rather a shame. In that case, why would Ding Ning force it? So she suppressed her throbbing heart and treated him as an ordinary subject.
On the contrary, the young master of the Xuanping Marquis’s family, although not as capable or strong as Pei Lang, only had a better-looking face than Pei Lang, and was lively and cheerful. He was also open-minded and didn’t care about the eyes of others at all.
Dingning has many admirers, but because of all kinds of rumours and the eyes of the world, most of them are secretive. Even if they love her, they will pretend to be disdainful to show that even if they are moved, they will never surrender to a woman and are unwilling to give in for this. Those with bad character will even say bad things about her behind her back. Every time, the young master of Xuanping Marquis’s family will argue with reason, and he will not give up even if his face is red. He does not care about his reputation and the ridicule of others. It can be seen that he is a very determined person.
To be honest, the young master is not very smart, nor brave enough. The only thing he can show off is his unconcealed sincerity.
In addition, Dingning didn’t hate the other person’s bright eyes like a puppy when he looked at her, so she thought of him when making the decision.
Thinking of this, Dingning couldn’t help but curl the corners of her lips.
Seeing this, Ye Shuo couldn’t help but smack his lips. It can be seen that even if the eldest daughter did not love the young master, she still liked him a little in her heart. This seems to be a good idea.
But before making a real decision, Ye Shuo planned to meet him. Ding Ning was not surprised by this and agreed without much hesitation.
However, just because they have no objection does not mean that Marquis Xuanping has no objection.
So far, women have only been serving as officials for about ten years. Sending his son, and a legitimate son at that, to marry into a family is still too stimulating for him. Any family in the capital with a little dignity would not choose to sell their son for fame.
So when Ye Shuo saw the young master, he looked rather dishevelled, and his clothes seemed to have been changed in a hurry, which could be seen from the decoration around his waist.
Ye Shuo had sent secret guards to monitor the situation long before. Naturally, he knew that after Marquis Xuanping got to know the news, he specially asked someone to choose a not-so-remarkable piece of clothing for his son, for fear that his son would be chosen by Ye Shuo as a son-in-law and would be ridiculed by others. But the young master was well prepared. He took advantage of Marquis Xuanping’s carelessness and changed into the most exquisitely made and most suitable piece in the closet. When Marquis Xuanping found out, he was already at the door, and Marquis Xuanping was almost angry to the point of vomiting blood.
The young master knew nothing about these things. Perhaps because he was nervous, he even stuttered when he spoke.
Perhaps because he knew that he had not performed well, the young master almost burst into tears at the end. If he had not been concerned about his demeanour in front of the palace, he would have collapsed long ago. Despite this, his face turned pale at the end.
Ye Shuo pretended not to know, but in the end Yao Zhi couldn’t stand it anymore and pinched him secretly from behind, signalling him not to go too far. Only then did Ye Shuo let him go with a sense of dissatisfaction.
At first the young master thought that his performance was really bad and this matter would never succeed. When he was feeling depressed, he suddenly received the imperial decree granting him marriage.
The young master couldn’t control himself and jumped three feet high, totally ignoring the gloomy face of Marquis Xuanping beside him.
Other girls are outgoing, but why is he the opposite? However, Marquis Xuanping could do nothing about it. He could only watch his son happily running around, as if he couldn’t wait to “marry” the princess tomorrow.
At that moment, Marquis Xuanping really wanted to strangle him to death.
On the wedding day, neither Dingning nor the young master covered their heads with veils, so the joy on the young master’s face was beyond words and easily infected the people around him. Just this purity was moving enough.
Even though Marquis Wu’an’s actions were extremely obscure, Ye Shuo, who was at the top, still noticed the other party’s white knuckles. Ye Shuo realised later that the other party did not seem to be completely without affection for Dingning.
That’s right, my daughter is so dazzling, how could others not be impressed when they see her?
It’s just that the Marquis of Wu’an was too hesitant and couldn’t let go, and Dingning’s eyes couldn’t tolerate too much romance, so the two of them missed each other without paying attention.
Dingning also noticed the stunned gaze of Marquis Wu’an, and she subconsciously wanted to look, but when she felt the sudden tightening force on the back of her hand, and then looked into the slightly uneasy gaze of the person next to her, Dingning finally did not look back.
An Ning and Yong Ning were obviously also insiders. Seeing this, they both curled their lips in disdain in their hearts.
Ye Shuo laughed, and finally drank the whole glass of wine in front of everyone.
Seeing this, the seventh king below finally said in their hearts, “Congratulations.”
With this as the boundary, it is time for him to begin his game with the emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: Blessing
chapters.content:
Although the seventh kings’ actions were extremely covert, as long as they took action, there would be traces to follow. Moreover, Dingning was not a slow person, so she quickly discovered the clues.
Half a year…
Considering the speed of information transmission in ancient times, Dingning’s response was quite timely.
Not knowing what her father was thinking silently in his heart at the moment, Dingning frowned in thought, her expression somewhat solemn.
It is not uncommon for the royal family to try to extend their hands to the court. Over the years, my father has dealt with countless people with ill intentions, making the entire royal family tremble in fear. From being arrogant in the beginning to now not daring to breathe. Therefore, even if a smart person like the Seventh Uncle has any bad intentions, he should not act at this moment.
Ding Ning was puzzled and hesitated whether to take action against the Seventh Uncle and how to do it specifically. After all, no matter how you look at it now, the Seventh Uncle’s current activities in the dark are not what a subject should do.
If possible, Ding Ning did not want to hurt the relationship between her and her uncles, but she thought she would not hesitate to use the knife if the other party crossed the line.
Not to mention that this matter was very unusual, but Dingning found that after she finished speaking, her father did not react at all. He just smiled and told her to just watch.
“Just stand by and watch how your seventh uncle does it.” See how the other party manages, hides, and wins people’s hearts.
Dingning wanted to say something but hesitated. However, due to her long-standing trust in Ye Shuo, she did not say much, but secretly increased her vigilance.The Seventh Prince seemed to have sensed something, and his movements became increasingly covert. Even though Ding Ning tried her best, she could only catch a few clues.
In the past, Dingning had only heard about how fierce and dangerous the fight for the throne was among his uncles. Now she had finally witnessed with her own eyes the true abilities of her uncle.
In comparison, Dingning’s methods are still a little immature.
Dingning remembered that the Seventh Uncle did not seem to hold on to the end and was defeated early. She could not imagine how brilliant and talented the Emperor Taicheng, the final winner, must be.
But in fact, the IQ of his seventh brother and sixth brother is only comparable. There are many factors as to why his seventh brother lost. It is not a matter of ability or brains. It can only be said that it is a matter of time and fate.
However, it is always right to let this girl have more awe in her heart and be more cautious when dealing with the royal family.
Ye Shuo, who had been watching silently from the side, thought so and decided not to explain, and simply let Dingning continue to misunderstand.
After a while, the Seventh Prince saw that his eldest niece seemed to be unable to do anything to him. He couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows, but he forgot that his eldest niece’s situation was very different from theirs back then.
The Seventh Prince is in a competitive relationship with his brothers, and it is almost impossible for them to unite. Even if they join forces, they are worried about stabbing each other in the back. The three Dingning sisters are different. Although they also compete, internal disagreements will only arise when there is no external threat.
You must know that only after the ownership of this world is settled, can they share the share.
Dingning was not the kind of person who wanted to save face even if she was waiting for death. Seeing that she could not defeat the emperor’s uncle, she immediately called her two sisters.
Only your biological parents would leave the kingdom to you, your biological uncle would not be so generous.
An Ning and Yong Ning were not vague when thinking about this. Faced with the pursuit and blockade of the three people, even the Seventh King was a little flustered for a while.
“Oh my, this actually suits his wishes.”
Seeing that his younger brother had been smiling happily during the court sessions for several days in a row, the Seventh Prince resisted the urge to roll his eyes and decided to double the amount of instruction for his most valued son when he returned.
Fathers and sons fight together, and the princesses are brothers and sisters, so they can’t lose, right?
Just when the seventh prince was barely able to settle down in the fight, good news came from Dingning, who had been married for a year.
The moment they learned that the eldest princess was pregnant, the female officials including Zou Wu became nervous. Xu Kui, who was far away at the border, even sent her personal soldiers to guard her safety at all times before Dingning gave birth.
It’s not their fault that they are so nervous. It’s just that the child in the eldest princess’ belly is too important to them. If they can’t protect the child successfully, once the eldest princess is in danger, it will be even more difficult to determine the heir. After all, no one wants an emperor who may die at any time during childbirth.
Once the princesses cannot sit in that position, everything they have gained now will be destroyed, and it won’t be long before they will return to their previous state.
Zou Wu and the others were aware of this matter, and naturally the others could figure it out as well. So it was not surprising that after the imperial physician left the princess’s mansion, Dingning was faced with wave after wave of assassinations that were many times more fierce than before.
Today, the evil spirits hiding in the darkness can no longer be suppressed and have begun to show their heads.
As expected, the ones that were cleared out in batches before were just small minions who couldn’t keep their cool. The ones right now are the real highlight and the biggest obstacle for the three princesses to ascend to the throne.
Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi wrote down their names one by one.
Just when Yao Zhi was thinking about how to take action without appearing abrupt, Ye Shuo circled out a few names. As he moved, Yao Zhi’s brows furrowed more and more.
These are people who cannot be easily moved…
Even if they want to kill someone, they have to give a reason. They can’t be as casual as before. Otherwise, even Ye Shuo will not be able to escape the criticism from people all over the world.
Just when Yao Zhi was in a dilemma, she heard Ye Shuo say in a deep voice: “Don’t pay attention to these people for now, someone will take care of them in the future.”
Yao Zhi was stunned for a moment, then she thought of something and looked at him.
The two looked at each other and noticed the look in the man’s eyes. After Yao Zhi confirmed it, she immediately felt relieved.
So that’s how it is. It seems he was well prepared.
“I understand.” Yao Zhi sighed first, then revealed a faint smile.
As for Dingning, a few days ago, right after the imperial physician left, An Ning and Yong Ning moved into the princess’s mansion. When they came, they only brought two confidants with them respectively, and did not leave any other belongings. They only wore some simple clothes and even threw away the incense they had been using.
The three sisters had a tacit understanding that An Ning and Yong Ning would never ask anyone else to help them with their three meals a day, from shopping to eating, and would never let the food out of their sight. Ding Ning would only eat food that had been handled by An Ning and Yong Ning. Even at night, one of An Ning and Yong Ning would have to stay in Ding Ning’s room to prevent any accidents.
The father of the unborn, the young master of the Marquis Xuanping family wanted to help, but his strength was really not enough. After watching the two princesses An Ning and Yong Ning stab the assassin who sneaked in without blinking an eye, the current prince consort immediately shut his mouth, willingly packed up his things and moved to the side courtyard temporarily.
At night, the two sisters lay on the same bed, back to back, feeling each other’s body temperature. In a trance, they felt as if they were in the mother’s womb, with umbilical cords wrapped around each other and blood mixed together.
In this world, apart from their father, mother and grandmother, the three sisters are the closest people to each other.
Seeing helplessly that ever since his eldest niece became pregnant, the sisters around her became increasingly close and united, protecting her tightly, the Seventh Prince could not help but sigh in his heart, this is not good.
If this trend continues, it will be very bad.
The Seventh Prince did not take action during this period, not because he did not want to, nor was it because he was so noble. Unlike his eldest brother who was a righteous man, the Seventh Prince would not hesitate to use some inferior means. It was just in case something happened to his eldest niece. Even though the emperor was just watching and did not seem to intend to intervene, the Seventh Prince could guarantee that the emperor would always be closely monitoring the movements of the princess’s mansion. Once he encountered a situation that the princesses could not handle, he would definitely take action. If the lives of the princesses were really hurt, the emperor would directly kill those who dared to take action. No matter who they were, they would never escape.
Just like when Princess Dingning was sent down to the underground for training in the past, the dangers that Princess Dingning encountered had all been screened by His Majesty. Only those that His Majesty judged Princess Dingning could handle would be put in front of the princess. Those that the princess could not handle would have been killed by the people arranged by His Majesty in advance.
Without the princesses’ knowledge, His Majesty trained them little by little, and only then did the princesses become capable of standing on their own feet today.
The Seventh Prince had long felt that the Emperor had had too much luck in his childhood. Now that he had seen with his own eyes what he had done, he realized that this man was secretly controlling everything and that all the outcomes were planned by him.
Including myself now, I cannot escape his control.
Thinking this way, the Seventh Prince naturally knew what could be touched and what could not be touched, so he did not dare to do anything about this matter. Therefore, when his most proud son could not help but come to him, the Seventh Prince just shook his head and did not respond.
Seeing that the other party was still unwilling to give in and felt that he could not let go of this opportunity, the Seventh Prince could not help but frown and his expression turned cold.
Although the other party was his most proud son, he was not his only son. It was not his son’s turn to comment on his decisions.
Upon hearing this, Ye Kuan felt cold and dared not mention it anymore.
Under everyone’s strict precautions, Dingning finally gave birth to a baby girl a few months later.
Ye Shuo, who had been sweating profusely when he received the news yesterday, finally breathed a sigh of relief when he heard this. He sat up from the cushion in the Hall of Supreme Harmony and rushed to the princess’s mansion without hesitation.
Although he didn’t think there were gods and ghosts in this world, it wouldn’t be wrong to worship more at this critical moment, so Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi split up early in the morning. Yao Zhi went to the Princess’s Mansion to command, while he came to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to ask his biological father, brother, and ancestors… Forget it, there’s no need to ask for ancestors, after all, there’s no affection for them, and they might even be as stubborn as those members of the royal family. It would be bad if they made things worse.
But he feels that his biological father or brother may not be enough. They are very patriarchal and may not give him this face. At this time, he should find the one who has the best relationship with him, is closest to him, is the youngest and most open to new things.
Therefore, the eleven-year-old young Emperor Xiaohui Ye Jin may become the biggest winner tonight.
Looking at the bustling incense burning in front of the tablet of young Emperor Xiaohui, and then looking at the other deserted incense burners, the young eunuchs who came to clean up the mess couldn’t help but gasp.

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Seventh Prince was ill
chapters.content:
As the princess grew up day by day, the number of female officials in the court gradually increased. During this period, An Ning and Ding Ning also got married. More than ten years passed. Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi had seven granddaughters and two grandsons. With more children, the whole palace became lively.
Perhaps it was because the Seventh King was watching from the side. After several trials and tribulations, Dingning’s skills became more and more sophisticated. As she grew older, the struggle between her and An Ning and Yong Ning became more and more intense.
Seeing that the three princesses, who originally had a relatively harmonious relationship, were now at loggerheads, the man with ulterior motives was naturally ecstatic, and he secretly made small moves one after another, trying to alienate the relationship between the three princesses.
For them, it would be difficult to deal with the three princesses when they were tied together, but not necessarily if they were separated.
The eldest princess Dingning is cautious and steady, and handles things thoughtfully, but because she is too thoughtful, she is naturally lacking in drive. The second princess An Ning is warm on the outside but cold on the inside, and is quite cunning, but the more cunning she is, the more people dare not approach her. As for the third princess Yongning, probably because she is the youngest, she was more favoured by the emperor and the queen when she was young, and she had two elder sisters to protect her, so she is a little spoiled and irritable. However, although she is spoiled, the third princess is the smartest and most perceptive one among the three, and has completely inherited the flexible and intelligent minds of the emperor and the queen.
Princess Yongning was successful at a young age, which resulted in her being arrogant and reckless. However, she had a very flexible mind and was able to avoid trouble every time, making it impossible for others to catch her. If she had not been suppressed by the eldest princess and the second princess, she would have made trouble long ago.
Now that Princess Yongning has a child, she has gradually calmed down.
It can be said that none of the three are perfect. Each of the three princesses has her own shortcomings, but once they join hands, they are watertight and solid as a rock.
Dingning and the others are not fools, so they will naturally not let that group of people succeed.
Therefore, what others did not expect was that these three princesses seemed to be at odds with each other on weekdays, and even could not help but make sarcastic remarks during court sessions. However, once others intervened, the three of them would put aside their past grudges, and no matter how many unpleasant things had happened before, they would quickly adjust and face the outside world in unison.The more times outsiders made trouble, the more they developed a tacit understanding. As time went on, others gradually figured out what was going on. It seemed that the three princesses could do whatever they wanted, even if their heads were broken, but outsiders were not allowed to touch them, right?
How can I put it? Just looking at this point, she is really as unreasonable as the emperor when he was young. She is worthy of being the emperor’s biological daughter.
Compared to Dingning and the others, Jianjian has not yet married. Queen Mother Wei has urged her countless times. At the worst time, Queen Mother Wei almost found a rope to tie her up. However, Jianjian’s words made Queen Mother Wei speechless.
Jianjian said that she was not the crown prince, and she was not competing for the throne, so why bother to make trouble and tie herself up?
Although the customs of the people are gradually opening up, they are not that open after all. Moreover, the three nieces are competing for that position, and they have to pay attention to their private morality. Naturally, they cannot be too romantic, so as not to spread bad news. But she is different. There have been many romantic princesses since ancient times, and one more is not too many. In addition, she has a backer and power in her hands. She can enjoy the happiness of having many ‘wives’, so why should she hang herself on a tree? Jianjian said that she is not the kind of person who will abandon her husband after having sex, so as long as she does not get married, it will not be a disappointment.
Not getting married doesn’t mean Jianjian can’t be happy.
In order to prove that everything she said was true, Jianjian even showed it to Queen Mother Wei.
At first, Queen Mother Wei was wondering where her daughter found these handsome little eunuchs. Even the eunuchs in the palace did not have such good looks. When she learned that these people disguised themselves as eunuchs just to enter the palace, and knew their true identities, Queen Mother Wei was stunned at first, then her old face turned red, and then she couldn’t help but… hit Jianjian.
This damn kid, she really has no shame at all!
However, despite all the allegations, Queen Mother Wei never mentioned the matter of letting Jianjian get married again.
To be honest, if it were her, she would also prefer to live such a carefree and happy life.
The Queen Mother Wei thought that she had gone too far and was arrogant enough when she was young, but she did not expect that she was nothing compared to her children. The hurdle that she had never been able to overcome in her entire life was easily overcome by her children. This was also good.
Later, when he learned about the farce in the Empress Dowager’s palace, Ye Shuo raised his eyebrows and laughed at first, but after he reacted, the smile on his face gradually disappeared.
Wait, is it possible that Jianjian’s current life is what he wanted from the beginning?
Apart from that large number of lovers, Jianjian’s current freedom and ease are all his dreams!
So, Jianjian is actually the biggest winner, right?
Ye Shuo looked at the pile of memorials in front of him and felt that he couldn’t get through the day. Later, when Dingning and the others grew up and saw that the three princesses could share the work for him, Ye Shuo almost immediately got rid of this mess without thinking twice.
But after thinking about it, he still felt unwilling. Ye Shuo couldn’t stand Jianjian being so carefree, so he would assign her some things to do from time to time, which made Jianjian secretly curse him behind his back every day.
Although she is ambitious, she is not that ambitious. The newcomer in the mansion was called away to work before she even had time to warm up to him. Who wouldn’t be angry?
Just when Ye Shuo thought that the days would just pass by one by one, news came from below regarding the Seventh King.
At first Ye Shuo didn’t take it seriously. There had been a lot of news about his seventh brother over the years, so this one wasn’t a big deal.
The only difference from the past was that this time the news came from the Imperial Hospital, saying that the Seventh Prince was ill and the situation was not good.
Ye Shuo paused holding the pen, calculated the time in his mind, and found that although he looked relatively young, he was actually over sixty years old.
And he is now sixty years old, and isn’t Seventh Brother…
Ye Shuo suddenly realised that with such a signal, everything seemed to be coming to an end.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: Ending
chapters.content:
After all, they are brothers. The Seventh Prince is seriously ill now, and Ye Shuo has to go and see him no matter what.
When he arrived, Dingning and the others were already waiting there.
The three princesses all have very complicated feelings towards this uncle. Thanks to the various small actions of the seventh uncle, the three princesses have made great progress, but it is also because of this that the three princesses are more wary of each other.
However, these are not the most important things. The most important thing is why the emperor is reluctant to take action. Now that the seventh uncle is seriously ill, Dingning and the other two have a vague premonition that the matter should have an answer.
Dingning and the others knew that the Seventh Uncle owed their father a lot of favours in the past. Their father even saved the Seventh Uncle’s life. But they didn’t know how much of this favour was left now, or, did affection really exist in the royal family?
Ye Shuo did not communicate much with his daughters. He just nodded slightly and walked straight in.
When the emperor arrived, everyone in the palace naturally came to greet him. When passing by the prince, Ye Shuo’s gaze lingered for a moment.
All I can say is that he is worthy of being the son that the Seventh Prince values ​​the most. He is indeed handsome and heroic.
Looking at the rest of the people, they were much inferior in appearance and demeanour. A glimpse of the whole picture revealed the whole picture, let alone other things. Ye Shuo just glanced at them casually and looked away. However, there were one or two princesses among them who looked full of energy and spirit. He didn’t know if it was intentional by the Seventh Prince. Considering how smart the Seventh Prince was, it must be true.
No matter what the prince was thinking in his heart, he now appeared respectful and humble on the surface. He was neither humble nor arrogant when facing Ye Shuo, and was vaguely familiar but not out of measure. He kept the distance just right, making it difficult for people to feel bad about him.Ye Shuo could see that the other party was indeed a very intelligent person. Although he was not as smart as his father, he was not far behind. It was just a pity…
Ye Shuo seemed to be completely unaware. In a flash, he was led by the prince to the courtyard in the centre of the palace.
When Ye Shuo stepped into the house, he could clearly smell a very strong smell of medicine. He had smelled this smell many times over the years. Similarly, he had seen this scene many times.
No matter who the person is, even if he is an emperor or a prince, he will always look ugly when he is dying.
Ye Shuo seemed not to have noticed the Seventh Prince’s sallow and withered face. He lifted his skirt and sat down in front of the Seventh Prince’s bed naturally, calling out, “Royal Brother.”
Feeling the movement beside him, the Seventh Prince’s eyes moved, and after a while he opened them with some difficulty.
Looking at the still tall figure in front of him, the Seventh Prince suddenly recalled the past in a trance.
Whether it was the generous donation of medicine or “selling himself” to save his brother, it was the greatest favour to the Seventh King who was in a desperate situation at that time.
Perhaps knowing that he didn’t have much time left, the Seventh Prince talked a lot with Ye Shuo.
The past is so heavy that it seems like a lifetime ago.
As early as when the two mentioned Emperor Jingwen, Emperor Taicheng, and even the former crown prince, the prince was very tactful and sent the servants out, including himself, and just waited outside the door to avoid suspicion.
Looking from a distance, Ye Shuo said suddenly: “This kid is not bad.”
He is capable and skillful, and is considered to be the best among the royal family members.
“Yes.” The Seventh Prince did not deny it. After all, this was his most outstanding son. He also followed Ye Shuo’s gaze and after a while, the Seventh Prince said, “It’s a pity that he is not as good as the three princesses.”
Others didn’t know what the Seventh Prince meant by “not as good as the three princesses”. If they heard it, they would just think that the Seventh Prince was being modest. But Ye Shuo could tell that the Seventh Prince was saying that his son was not as lucky as his daughters.
Yes, how many people in the world can be as lucky as the three princesses?
Since the birth of the three princesses, his younger brother had planned carefully, from the beginning, letting the three princesses start to study like the princes, to later on the ancestor worship in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, to the Fengshan ceremony on Mount Tai, the imperial examinations, becoming female officials, entering the court, attending court, and marrying into the emperor’s family… Decades passed in the blink of an eye, after layer after layer of screening and filtering, until the birth of Princess Dingning’s first child, who was given the surname “Ye” by the emperor, the emperor’s purpose was almost obvious, but by this time, there were not many people left who dared to oppose it. Ŗ
How many parents in the world could be so deliberate and cautious? Not to mention that he was the emperor.
Seeing all these things one by one, the more he knew, the more complicated the Seventh Prince’s mood became. If he had a choice, the Seventh Prince would really like to be his son in the next life. Who in the world would not want to be his child? Even if his younger brother liked daughters more, it would not be impossible for him to give up his male body and reincarnate as a princess.
It’s a pity that he was born at the wrong time and had a father like Emperor Jingwen, so the Seventh Prince could only hold his nose and be carried away by fate, step by step to where he is today.
Although the Seventh Prince did not say it out loud, Ye Shuo could not help but shiver when he was looked at by his extremely complicated eyes.
“I always feel that you are thinking about something bad…” Ye Shuo lowered his voice, relying on the fact that Dingning and the others were far away and no one dared to eavesdrop, so his tone became casual.
The Seventh Prince just looked at him with a smile, not caring at all. He also spoke out his innermost thoughts in a voice that only the two of them could hear, with a calm expression.
Ye Shuo: “…”
Looking at his brother with a wrinkled face, Ye Shuo leaned back suddenly.
Swapping Ding Ning and An Ning’s faces with his brother’s… No! Forget it, he really couldn’t bear it.
Dingning and the others watched as the Seventh Uncle seemed to say something, which made the emperor suddenly look terrified, as if he was facing a great enemy. Just as they were secretly horrified and were about to step forward, they saw that the next moment, the emperor returned to normal, as if nothing had happened.
Dingning and the other two paused for a while. After a while, when they realised that they had said everything they needed to say and recalled everything they needed to recall, and that the time was almost up, Ye Shuo finally stood up slowly and prepared to leave.
Although the atmosphere was still relaxed, both of them understood that this might be the last time they would meet.
“Your Majesty, please see me off for the last time in consideration of our past friendship.” The Seventh Prince said this as he leaned on the bed.
Ye Shuo knew that he couldn’t drink alcohol now, so he used tea instead of wine, only poured half a cup, and raised it slightly into the air.
Even though the Seventh Uncle is now seriously ill and dying, the emotion in his eyes when he looks at her father does not seem fake, but Dingning and the other two still remember the things that the Uncle did secretly behind their backs. How can they feel at ease letting the things in the palace enter their father’s mouth?
So after just a slight distraction, Dingning and the others reacted immediately.
However, at this time, Ye Shuo had already drunk up the tea in the cup. Only a soft “dong” sound was heard. When the Seventh Prince looked down, he saw that the cup was already empty.
The thing that the Seventh King least wanted finally happened.
My son is smart, but that’s all.
It still doesn’t work…
Seeing the prince who was watching this scene from a distance, he could hardly hold back the surprise in his eyes. The Seventh Prince knew that he had completely lost this round, so he no longer had any hope. He took a deep breath and said softly, “…I understand.”
Before Dingning could think about what the Seventh Uncle understood, they saw Ye Shuo walking out. Dingning and the other two had no choice but to hurry to follow him.
When they returned to the palace, Dingning and the others immediately called for the queen mother and asked for the imperial physician, for fear that there might be something unclean in the cup of tea that Ye Shuo drank.
However, if the medicine that His Royal Highness had worked so hard to find could be discovered so easily, he would not dare to put it into the teapot so carelessly. Combined with the strong medicinal fragrance, once the two are combined, even a god cannot save him.
So after a few days, the news that Ye Shuo was too worried and caught a cold finally spread.
His Majesty is not young to begin with, and the Seventh Prince is his elder brother after all. His Majesty can’t help but feel sentimental when he sees the Seventh Prince’s current appearance. Besides, it’s just a mere cold, and except Dingning and the others, almost no one takes it to heart.
Dingning and the other two also had no evidence, but their intuition told them that there was definitely something wrong in the palace that day.
Upon hearing this news, the prince was filled with excitement.
Done!
It was worth his efforts to find those two medicines. His father was really seriously ill. No matter how strong His Majesty was, he couldn’t help but soften his heart when facing his dying brother.
Seeing this, the Seventh Prince could not help but think that his son only thought that the emperor was lax for a moment, so he was taken advantage of. Why didn’t he think of another possibility?
It was precisely because the entire palace was under the control of the emperor, and their every move was in his eyes, that the emperor did not need to be on guard at all, so he drank the tea in the cup so happily.
If there are some things that the Seventh King wanted to do at the beginning, then now, he has to do it.
That half cup of tea at that time was a signal and a warning. The emperor believed that he could understand it, and the Seventh Prince did live up to his expectations and understood it.
For a moment, the Seventh King wished he wasn’t so smart.
When the emperor fell ill, all the evil spirits were exposed. In particular, the emperor’s cold not only did not get better, but became more and more serious as time went by. In addition, the emperor preferred Princess Dingning to be the crown prince. After the news spread that the imperial edict had been drafted, the final madness was about to come.
Ye Kuan felt that the time had come, so with the tacit approval of his father, he rebelled as a direct descendant of Emperor Jingwen.
However, this rebellion came and went quickly, and in the riot, swords and knives were merciless, and it was inevitable that some people would die. Even generals and princes were just flesh and blood.
For two whole days, the whole of Shangjing was in panic and blood flowed like a river.
What the prince had not expected was that the three princesses, led by Dingning, actually successfully resisted the rebellion. When he saw Lord Xu Kui personally leading her troops to help, the prince knew that the situation was hopeless. However, he never expected that the person who took action in the end would be his own father.
Although he knew his father was always cold-hearted, when he felt his body slumped uncontrollably in the chair, the prince couldn’t help but ask with red eyes, “Why?!”
However, the Seventh King only spoke, saying, “Everything you desire will be hurt.”
Since he wanted that position, he had to bear the risk of failure. The Seventh Prince, who had experienced the turmoil of the fight for the throne, knew this very well.
However, when the Seventh Prince found out that he was being used by the Emperor, he did not accept it completely. The reason he followed the Emperor’s wishes was just because he wanted to take a gamble.
The emperor needs him, so he will spare his life. This is the opportunity for them, father and son.
If His Majesty wants to use him, he must first lay out bait, which is why he has allowed him to develop his power in secret for so many years. If anything goes wrong with His Majesty, if anything happens, if His Majesty passes away, His Majesty’s plans will fail before the situation is established, and the three princesses will definitely not be able to get what they want.
The Seventh Prince expected that the Emperor had a backup plan, and that it would not be difficult for the three princesses to escape, but that position was unlikely to be achieved.
The Seventh Prince was betting on this accident, and the Emperor was betting that he would take the gamble. However, he never imagined that the Seventh Prince had waited for decades but never saw the accident happen. So now that things have come to this, the situation has become a foregone conclusion, and he has lost.
In the early years, when His Majesty was not yet the emperor, he said that a good body is the greatest asset, and this statement is indeed the golden rule.
The Seventh King is someone who cannot afford to lose. Now, it is time for him to accept punishment.
Thinking so, the Seventh Prince cut off the prince’s head without mercy amidst his horrified gaze and tragic wails, as if that was not his own son.
Even though he was terminally ill, the Seventh Prince’s mind was still clear. He knew very well that taking action himself was the best option. There would be no better way to deal with it, whether for his son or anyone else. Only in this way could his son suffer the least pain.
Then, under the horrified gazes of everyone in the palace, the Seventh Prince forced himself to walk out of the palace.
At that time, Dingning had already brought people to the Seventh Prince. Seeing this scene, even Yongning, who had the most violent personality, was stunned. He couldn’t help but feel frightened by the ruthlessness and decisiveness of the Seventh Prince’s killing of his own son.
Not only that, the Seventh Prince even committed suicide in front of others to atone for his sins of failing to educate his children and failing to supervise them.
The emperor and he had a tacit understanding about what happened today. The Seventh Prince believed that with the emperor’s temperament, he would not kill them all. And the most outstanding prince in the whole palace, who usually suppressed his brothers to the point of suffocation, ended up with such a tragic ending. Killing the chicken to scare the monkeys, the other heirs of the palace must have been frightened after this incident, and would never be able to rise again, and would never dare to have a rebellious heart. Knowing this well, the emperor and several princesses probably didn’t bother to make things difficult for them. In this way, their bloodline could be saved, and their hard work was not in vain.
The Seventh Prince was already seriously ill and would not live long. The price he paid was insignificant compared to what he was planning.
The fact that such an outcome could happen even when the emperor knew full well that he had rebellious intentions shows the skill of the Seventh Prince.
The Seventh Prince has feelings for Ye Shuo, so he is willing to be the whetstone for the three princesses, polishing her carefully, teaching her attentively, and fighting her personally without holding back. The Seventh Prince is also ruthless to Ye Shuo. Once Ye Shuo does anything good or bad, he will be merciless and kill him.
True and false, false and true, even if you are in it, it is difficult to tell them apart.
This was the last lesson Ye Shuo gave his daughters before graduation.
This is the so-called path of the emperor, the way of being a monarch.
No matter what others want to do, as long as you know what you want, that’s enough.
Therefore, when Ye Shuo learned the news that the Seventh Prince had committed suicide, he was not surprised. His brothers always knew what to do and when.
Ye Shuo understood his elder brother’s character. Now it seemed that his elder brother also understood him very well. And since he paid the price of his own life to make Dingning’s ascension to the throne a complete success, Ye Shuo would naturally follow the seventh elder brother’s wishes and ensure the continuation of his bloodline.
With the rebellion coming to an end, all obstacles were removed, and everything was going on track as planned. Ye Shuo could finally put down the burden on his shoulders.
Thinking of this, he extended his hand to Yao Zhi beside him——
“Although it’s a little late after so many years, I still want to ask, Azhi, are you still willing to wander the world with me?”
Yao Zhi is no longer the woman of Jianghu. She is now the queen, holding great power. When Ding Ning ascends the throne, she will be the queen mother, the most noble woman in the world. With such an identity, why would she sleep in the open with Ye Shuo?
So Yao Zhi paused for a moment, and then she asked jokingly: “If I say I don’t want to, will you force me?”
What he wants may not be what she wants.
Yao Zhi thought Ye Shuo would be surprised and question her, but he seemed to have expected it. He just smiled and shook his head: “No, Ah Zhi can do whatever she wants.”
“You walked into this vortex because of me. It was my wishful thinking at the beginning…” That’s why she had to passively accept all these court struggles. So today, how can Ye Shuo blame her for being greedy for power?
However, before Ye Shuo could finish his words, Yao Zhi grabbed his hand tightly.
She was a little hesitant at first. After all, so many years had passed and she didn’t know if she could adapt to life outside the palace. But now, she was suddenly willing.
Today, in this situation, I’m afraid only Yao Zhi would agree.
After receiving a positive response, Ye Shuo was stunned at first, and then completely relaxed.
He thought that if he was reborn in ancient times, he would have made a fortune in this life. He had a father who was not very good at the beginning but was just okay in the end, a mother who loved him very much from beginning to end, a lovely sister who was now old, and a wife who could rely on him and three filial and hardworking daughters.
He has made many choices in his life from the moment he was born until now. Fortunately, he has never made a wrong choice, so he has lived his life smoothly.
That’s great, even if so many people died in the process, even if everyone who could die had died by now, even if he was the only one who made the right choices…
At the very end, Ye Shuo embraced Yao Zhi in his arms, hiding the confusion in his eyes. He slowly closed his eyes and let the past scenes come to his mind.
Ten days later, after recovering from his illness, the emperor felt unwell and felt that he had insufficient energy, so he passed the throne to the eldest princess Dingning.
In March of the following year, it was a beautiful spring day and the eldest princess ascended the throne, naming the reign Ming’an.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Extra 1: Only you can save yourself
chapters.content:
It’s autumn again. Since the death of the Imperial queen mother and several masters, the Emperor and the Queen Mother have become less and less willing to come back. They are both experienced and skilled, and sometimes even the secret guards can’t find their traces.
After receiving the letter, Emperor Ming’an was not surprised. After a little yearning and melancholy, Emperor Ming’an handled government affairs as usual.
Now that the autumn examination has just ended for more than a month, the list of candidates for the palace examination has been presented one after another. Emperor Ming’an took a rough look. Originally, she just wanted to see if she was familiar with it, but she didn’t take it seriously until a name appeared. For some reason, Emperor Ming’an felt a little familiar.
After recalling for a long time, Emperor Ming’an finally remembered who the other party was –
the granddaughter of the Grand Tutor Zhen, Liang Wenyin.
[1] Note: for those with great memory, this Liang Wenyin is the one because of whom Ye shuo became beggar because she and her grandmother felt odd about the cai family. If you still can’t … Continue reading
As for the old Grand Tutor, Emperor Ming’an still remembers the scene when the other party enlightened her. Although it was only a few years ago, it seemed like yesterday.
The old Taifu was probably the first person that Emperor Ming An had ever met who did not look at her with prejudice, except for her parents and relatives. This was especially precious under the circumstances at that time. The old Taifu taught her everything he knew. At first, she did not think it was anything, but as she grew older, she gradually understood. Thinking of this, Emperor Ming An was even more grateful. However, unlike Emperor Ming An’s impression, the Taifu in his father’s mouth was an extremely old-fashioned person. If she had not asked carefully at that time, Emperor Ming An would have thought they were two people.
As for the Taifu’s granddaughter Liang Wenyin, the reason why Emperor Ming An also had an impression of her was because of her former husband, in addition to the fact that his father had a close relationship with her when he was young.
Emperor Ming’an had long forgotten the specific name of that person. She only knew that the other party was involved in a major local case. Coincidentally, half a year before the case, when her father had just issued the decree on female households and female officials, Liang Wenyin decisively divorced that person with her two daughters and set up a new family outside. She, her two daughters and several grandchildren were not implicated. Such a decisive attitude and keen sense of smell made Emperor Ming’an remember her a little. Since Liang Wenyin left, her original husband has fallen from grace. A local official of the fourth rank made a series of stupid moves. In just half a year, he was involved in the major case at that time and completely fell.Now Emperor Ming’an once again recalled the events of the past and felt that there was another hidden story, but Emperor Ming’an did not intend to get to the bottom of it. In her opinion, even if there was something fishy, ​​it would not have much impact. Since the matter had passed, let it go.
Just thinking about it, during the palace examination, Emperor Ming’an still stayed in front of Liang Bing for a while. She was indeed talented and capable, and lived up to her reputation. If nothing unexpected happened, she should be the first this time.
But Emperor Ming’an did not want to be partial, so he waited until the evaluation results came out before he talked to Liang Bing a little more.
Liang Bing was slightly moved to see that the emperor still remembered her grandmother, but it was really difficult to tell others about her grandmother, so Liang Bing only talked about her grandmother’s recent situation and did not mention the past. Seeing this, Emperor Ming’an did not ask any more questions.
When they returned home, after the excitement gradually dissipated, Liang Bing rushed into her grandmother’s yard as soon as possible.
In the blink of an eye, decades have passed. Liang Wenyin is now in her seventies. Although she has experienced a lot, she was still stunned for a moment when she heard Emperor Ming’an mention her.
Emperor Yongxi was affectionate, and so was Emperor Ming’an.
Liang Wenyin felt her eyes warm for no reason. After her grandmother and grandfather passed away one after another, no one would care about her for so many years. As for her previous husband… it’s better not to mention it.
Liang Wenyin thought of the past and felt that there was nothing to say. Looking back, it was all a failure.
Although Liang Wenyin successfully broke off the marriage that year, she soon fell into another trap.
Liang Wenyin thought at the time that since she had to marry and have children, and the rich and powerful families were unreliable, it would be better to find someone from a humble background, so that she could solve the problem once and for all. At that time, Liang Wenyin thought she could grasp her own future, and she was full of confidence and insisted on her own way.
At first, things were indeed as she thought. Relying on the relationship of her grandfather and her own advice behind the scenes, the two of them soon had a better life. But the good times didn’t last long. With the fall of the former crown prince and the ascension of Emperor Taicheng, everything changed. Her husband, who had treated her with respect and dignity, was afraid of being implicated in the matter of the former crown prince, so he immediately cut off ties with her and her grandfather.
At that time, Emperor Yongxi was only the Prince of Rui, and he stayed away to avoid disputes. In addition, she had been married for a long time, and even a prince could not take care of everything. Therefore, Liang Wenyin spent several years living a life worse than death. When it was the most difficult, Liang Wenyin even thought that it would be better to die than to suffer and be bullied. �
If it was just to avoid suspicion, it would be fine. It was human nature. Although Liang Wenyin could not forgive, she could barely understand it. However, the other party’s deliberate humiliation was something she could never tolerate.
At that time, Liang Wenyin realised that in the eyes of the other party, she was giving him advice with all her heart so that he could rise rapidly in the officialdom, but in his eyes it was nothing but humiliation.
Liang Wenyin finally understood how unreliable people’s hearts were. She tried to find another way to control her destiny, but in the end she found that people could only rely on themselves.
