What shocked Liang Wenyin even more was that because of her wrong choice, her grandparents, even at an old age, could not have a moment of peace in their later years. In the end, the little emperor fell ill and died, and Emperor Yongxi ascended the throne. The situation got better, but it was too late at that time. Liang Wenyin had suffered enough of pinning her hopes on others. Even if the situation improved, Liang Wenyin would never forget what it was like to let others manipulate her when the right to choose was in the hands of others.
So Emperor Yongxi later asked my grandfather to go back and open the door for Princess Dingning. My grandfather seemed to have changed and taught Princess Dingning everything he knew. It was also for this reason that Liang Wenyin was so angry after Ye Shuo issued those two decrees.
Liang Wenyin didn’t think so much at the time, but after she realised that her husband was greedy, she knew that he would be in trouble sooner or later. Her grandfather had worked hard enough when he was alive, and his reputation could not be ruined after his death. Fortunately, she made the right choice this time. Liang Wenyin gave birth to two daughters and one son. The two daughters followed her without hesitation after they got married. With such a character, the children she taught were naturally not bad
It was natural for her to raise such an excellent child like Liang Bing.
Looking at her granddaughter who was full of joy at the moment, Liang Wenyin was happy, complicated and disappointed, but finally, she could finally let it go.
She had been helpless for most of her life, but fortunately, her bloodline finally didn’t have to repeat the same mistakes.
After the late autumn of Lisuo, the New Year is finally coming.
On the other side, Ye Shuo and Yao Zhi, who also received the news and were sitting around the stove and charcoal fire, looked at each other and finally put down their worries.
It is true… No matter how much others take care of you, it is only temporary. In the end, only you can save yourself completely.
References
↑1Note: for those with great memory, this Liang Wenyin is the one because of whom Ye shuo became beggar because she and her grandmother felt odd about the cai family.
If you still can’t remember, then she is 3rd Prince’s wife’s sister’s daughter

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Extra 2: The Underworld
chapters.content:
When the crown prince regained consciousness, he found himself sitting on a boat.
But if he remembered correctly, he had clearly…
At this time, the boat just passed a stone bridge. When he saw the word “what” on it, the prince was stunned for a moment, and then he sighed. Sure enough, he was dead. Everything in front of him should be the legendary underworld.
But even if he thought so in his heart, the prince was still a little hesitant when getting off the boat. No matter what happened in the past, he was still attached to the present world.
However, when he saw someone in front of him who was just like him and kept dawdling and refusing to get off the boat, he was beaten up by the ghost. The prince’s expression froze and he had to accept the reality. After crossing the Forgotten River, it means that the past is over and there is no turning back.
Finally, taking a look at the abyss-like river, the prince had no choice but to follow the ghost and continue forward. Fortunately, the underworld is now crowded, and it will probably take a long time to reincarnate again. The underworld is afraid that so many ghosts stranded here will cause trouble. After the trial, they will not restrict them from visiting relatives and friends and looking for their relatives and friends in their lifetime. Let them consume themselves first, and then it will be much easier to manage.
The prince committed a lot of crimes in his lifetime, so after he finished all the punishments, his ghost life was almost half gone.
At this time, he needed the comfort of his family the most, but the prince looked around and found that he died too early. There was no one he knew around him, and he didn’t know where to find a place to stay.
The prince’s first reaction after coming to his senses was to find his deceased mother. Although his mother passed away when he was very young and the prince had long forgotten what she looked like, he still missed her in his heart at this moment.
However, what disappointed the prince was that the former queen had accumulated virtues and done good deeds in her lifetime, and had reincarnated early before, so he couldn’t see her even if he wanted to.Upon hearing this, the prince secretly sighed that he had no chance, and then he remembered the ancestors of the Ye royal family.
Although he had offered incense to them during festivals when he was the prince, he was now deposed after all, and felt ashamed. Naturally, the prince had no face to seek the blessing of his ancestors. However, just as the prince was hesitating and wanted to give up, there was a sudden noise not far away. Because the ancestors’ foothold was nearby, the prince subconsciously looked over.
Then, he saw a scene of an old man being beaten on the ground by a young woman.
The prince felt that the old man looked very familiar, and seeing the old man’s miserable condition, he couldn’t help but feel a little sympathy, but the ghosts around him were not surprised, as if they were used to it. There seemed to be something else going on. Before stepping forward to stop it, the prince naturally had to ask.
Then, he heard a story about a father who pushed his own daughter out to be raped by envoys from other countries, and after his death, the resentful daughter took revenge desperately.
“So, there is no such thing as innocence, they all deserve it.” The ghost next to him couldn’t help but sigh.
If he guessed correctly, the old man in front of him should be his grandfather, and the woman who beat his grandfather was his aunt whom he had never met.
Looking at the miserable grandfather and the fierce aunt, the prince was silent for a moment, subconsciously took a step back, and then left quietly, just pretending that he had never been there, and was somewhat glad that he didn’t make a sound.
The prince suddenly felt that it didn’t seem to be that difficult to set up his own business in the strange underworld. Anyway, it was much better than being accidentally involved in the grievances of the previous generation.
His aunt even beat the previous emperor, so what was this nephew whom she had never met? As for the ancestors before that, after three generations, the relationship has long been weak, not to mention that there are many royal heirs, and they may not take care of themselves when they are alive, let alone after death.
Thinking of this, the prince completely gave up the idea of ​​looking for people of the same clan, and went to apply for a piece of land from the ghost messenger, and built a yard for himself to live in. ř
There is no sun and moon in the underworld. It is unknown how long it has been. The first visitor arrived just after the prince’s yard was completed.
When he saw the fourth prince, the prince was stunned.
The prince had thought that after his death, his brothers would inevitably fight endlessly, and the battle for the throne would inevitably be bloody, but he never thought that the first one to come down would be the fourth prince.
The prince remembered clearly that his younger brother had always been non-competitive and kept a low profile. The other party was so cautious, so he should not be the first to make a move.
Thinking of this, the prince naturally asked.
When the fourth prince first saw the deceased prince, he was still a little unresponsive. Then, when he heard the other party’s question, the fourth prince’s face turned green. It was obvious that the other party must have recalled some very unpleasant memories.
Facing the prince’s inquiring gaze, the fourth prince opened his mouth, and he wanted to say something several times but couldn’t say it.
It was nothing, it was embarrassing! It was really too embarrassing!
No matter what, the prince was fighting with a group of brothers, and he lost because he didn’t check for a while. But he was so good. He finally showed kindness, but he was stabbed to death by a little bastard whose hair had not even grown out. Yes, a strong man in his thirties was stabbed to death by a child of twelve or thirteen years old! Just thinking about it, the fourth prince felt ashamed and really couldn’t show up.
Seeing that he was hesitant and couldn’t say anything, the prince frowned at first, but finally didn’t continue to ask.
It’s not that the prince is not curious, but he knows in his heart that if the fourth prince doesn’t want to say, it’s useless to ask again.
Seeing that he stopped asking questions, the Fourth Prince couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief. Just when the Fourth Prince thought that his secret should be kept, before he could completely relax, not long after, he saw the ghost escorting a familiar figure walking over.
After all, the Thirteenth Prince was young, and even if he became a ghost, he still needed to be taken care of.
He wanted someone to take care of him, but his mother had already left him, and the mother-son relationship had been severed before her death. His ancestors were in such a state, and he could not be trusted. So the ghost messenger found out that the crown prince, the elder brother, was responsible, and sent him here.
Colluding with foreign races is naturally a capital crime, even for the prince, but he did not expect his father to be so decisive.
With just one glance, the fourth prince could not help but rush up.
Then, the prince knew that his upright and strong brother was stabbed to death by another younger brother.
The prince’s mood became complicated in an instant. He was stunned by the misfortune of the fourth prince. He did not expect that the fourth prince would die early because of such an oolong experience. What was more, he was repulsed and disgusted with the thirteenth prince.
The prince did not feel anything about his younger brother. He just thought he did not exist and never regarded him as an opponent. But he did not expect that he would be so cruel later. The prince naturally did not like it and had no intention of taking in the thirteenth prince.
It just so happened that the Thirteenth Prince also disliked them. The Crown Prince and his brothers didn’t look at him straight when he was alive, so there was no need to be involved after his death. Since he was already dead, it would be better to cut off all ties. He didn’t want to contact any of the people he knew in his life after his death, and it was even more so in the next life. Even if he was alone, it would be a hundred or a thousand times better than before.
So after the Thirteenth Prince silently endured a beating and kicking from the Fourth Prince, due to the strong resistance from both sides, the ghost messenger had no choice but to take him back to where he came from. However, when he was leaving, the Thirteenth Prince couldn’t help it. When he passed by the Crown Prince, the Thirteenth Prince quickly kicked him, just on the Crown Prince’s calf.
Before the Crown Prince could react, the Thirteenth Prince ran away quickly.
The Crown Prince was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously stretched out his hand to rub it. After a long while, he sighed deeply and couldn’t help thinking that he hoped he wouldn’t run into him again in the future, and that he would never run into them again.
After the ghost left, for some reason, the atmosphere suddenly became awkward. For a moment, the Fourth Prince felt that living next to the Crown Prince was not a good choice. In the end, the Crown Prince coughed lightly, as if he had not heard the conversation between the two, and asked: “Who do you think will be the next one?” “
“…I don’t know.” The Fourth Prince said this, but he was gritting his teeth in his heart. Since he had lost all his face, others would not have a good life. Anyway, he was already dead, so what was there to worry about?
So the Second Prince was caught by the Fourth Prince who was squatting on the shore before he had time to get off the boat.
To be honest, the Fourth Prince had a general impression of the Second Prince. He only knew that the other party was thoughtful and insidious. If it were in the past, the Fourth Prince would not like to deal with such people, but now they are all dead, so it doesn’t matter.
When the Second Prince heard that the Fourth Prince was now with the Crown Prince, his eyes narrowed, and without saying a word, he immediately followed him.
The fourth prince was still wondering why he didn’t know this man was so easy to talk to before? As soon as he saw the prince, he knew why.
It turned out that the letter the prince received was replaced by the second prince. The prince mistakenly thought that his father had completely abandoned him. In order to save his wife, concubines and children, he tried to call back the last bit of his father’s love, so he committed suicide. But in fact, his father wanted to repair the relationship with the prince.
The warm family letter turned into a death warrant, which was so cruel!
The fourth prince did not expect that there was such a hidden secret. He couldn’t help but look back at the second prince. The second prince didn’t care at all, as if he had been waiting for this day. The sneer on his face couldn’t be concealed, and the words he said were even more sharp-
“Your Highness, Your Highness, you will die in my hands after all.”
After staying in the underworld for a long time, the prince, who had become indifferent again, couldn’t laugh all of a sudden.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Extra 3: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Sure enough, there are reasons why people suddenly become rude. He finally understood why his aunt would completely disregard etiquette.
The prince seemed to be gentle and refined, but in fact, he was well versed in the six arts of a gentleman and had a lot of martial virtues.
The fourth prince had never seen the prince get angry, let alone take action, so he had learned a lot.
The second prince was also unwilling to be outdone. He had been holding back a lot of energy since he was a child and had long wanted to fight the prince with real swords and guns. Now that the person was dead, those rules naturally did not count. Seeing the prince throw a punch, the second prince sneered and immediately went to meet him.
Looking at the two people fighting each other, the fourth prince on the side could not persuade him, nor could he not persuade him.
The fourth prince was originally a little worried that the ghost messenger next to him would be dissatisfied because of this, but unexpectedly, the other party seemed to have seen nothing in the face of such a scene, and stood aside with his hands folded on his chest. Although he looked a little impatient, he did not step forward to stop it.
The ghost messengers have seen a lot of such things. If they are not allowed to vent their anger, who knows what kind of trouble these ghosts will cause.
While the Fourth Prince breathed a sigh of relief, he was also curious about how the Second Prince died and why he was still so angry after his death.
He couldn’t help it, and felt that if he asked, his second brother would definitely not answer truthfully, so he lowered his voice and asked the ghost messenger beside him.
The Second Prince, who was not far away, heard the movement here and subconsciously wanted to stop it. However, before he could open his mouth, the Crown Prince took advantage of his daze and punched the Second Prince in the face with such force that the Second Prince almost died again.The ghost looked at the fourth prince, thought about it, and felt that it was not a secret, so he did not hide it: “He pissed himself off to death.”
After the second prince was demoted to a commoner, the seventh prince did not think of doing anything else.
After all, for a proud person like the second prince, being demoted to a commoner and expelled from the capital was more painful than killing him. The seventh prince would naturally not do anything else. Falling from the clouds to the dust was the greatest punishment for the second prince. And things happened just as the seventh prince expected. Not long after the second prince was demoted, because he really couldn’t stand the blow, coupled with the ridicule of others, the strong resentment in his heart, he pissed himself off to death.
The moment the voice fell, the second prince’s body suddenly stiffened.
The prince also stopped moving, and then, under the gloomy eyes of the second prince, he sneered without giving any face.
“Looking at it this way, you are nothing more than that.”
The second prince was almost pissed off by these words, and he retorted without hesitation: “You are just relying on the favour of the emperor father, and you won’t let anyone live in peace even if you die.”
Although the prince had a smile on his face, his fists were suddenly clenched in his sleeves. He never thought that the truth would be like this, his father…
Seeing the prince’s reaction, the pustules of jealousy in the second prince’s heart surged more and more. He had been brooding over the fact that he had not been favoured by his father all his life, and even after death, he still couldn’t let it go.
It was just that the second prince thought so in his heart, but when Emperor Jingwen really arrived, the second prince, who had been aggressive before, didn’t dare to say a word, and didn’t have the courage to question Emperor Jingwen in front of the civil and military officials in the hall when he was alive. The majesty of Emperor Jingwen was deeply imprinted in the soul of the second prince, so that the second prince didn’t dare to resist at all.
Although they knew that everyone is mortal, when they saw the figure of Emperor Jingwen, the fourth prince and the second prince could not control their hearts and trembled violently. Especially since Emperor Jingwen was thin and sickly, and it was obvious that he died of illness, their emotions were even more fluctuating.
“…Father.” The second prince spoke hesitantly and lowered his head subconsciously. Emperor Jingwen glanced at him, and after a long while, he finally nodded barely perceptibly.
After a bland “hmm” as a response, ignoring the second prince’s suddenly wide eyes, Emperor Jingwen quickly passed the two and walked towards the prince’s courtyard.
After all, the prince was a prince, and he had never done any heavy work before, so the courtyard he built was naturally very simple. Looking at the shadowy figure inside through the thin door panel, Emperor Jingwen’s raised hand suddenly paused.
When he learned from the ghost messenger that most people would stay in the underworld after death, he actually had a lot to say to the prince, especially many words that he could not say before, but when they really met, Emperor Jingwen suddenly could not say them.
This honesty came too late.
Just when Emperor Jingwen hesitated, the person inside seemed to hear the movement and subconsciously opened the door.
The next moment, after seeing the familiar figure, the prince’s hand holding the door frame suddenly tightened, almost crushing the door. When the four looked at each other, both of them were in a complicated mood and difficult to speak. In the end, the prince opened his mouth and called “Father”. Emperor Jingwen seemed to have red eyes, but in a flash, he returned to normal. He was used to hiding when he was alive, and he still couldn’t change it after death. Even though he had thousands of words in his heart before, at this moment, subconsciously, he did it.
The prince seemed to have gotten used to it and didn’t feel disappointed. Just like when he was alive, he respectfully invited Emperor Jingwen in.
After that day, Emperor Jingwen naturally stayed. Although he and the prince were still not completely honest, their relationship eased a lot after the misunderstanding was resolved, and they finally had some pure father-son love that they had never had in their lives.
Seeing this scene, not to mention the second prince who was already resentful, even the fourth prince couldn’t help but feel sour.
Sure enough, he really shouldn’t have lived with the prince and his family!
Compared with the fourth prince and his family, after entrusting the country to someone who could be trusted, Emperor Jingwen, who had worked diligently for decades, seemed to have unloaded a burden. He relaxed all of a sudden, reading books and drinking tea every day, and his life was so happy, even more carefree than when he was the emperor.
“Now I finally understand why Xiaojiu was like that.” Sitting on the rattan chair, the emperor could not help but sigh.
The hand of the crown prince holding the tea cup paused slightly. This was the countless times that his father had mentioned Xiaojiu in these days. His worry and concern were beyond words, but his father seemed not to feel it, and sometimes he blurted it out subconsciously.
Although it was understandable, Xiaojiu was indeed worrying, and the crown prince, as a father, was also very concerned about his son, but in comparison… The crown prince twitched his mouth, silently sipped his tea, and suppressed the embarrassment and shame that surged up.
As for the second and fourth princes on the side, their attention was all on the heir.
I really didn’t expect that in the end, the sixth prince would sit in that position. It was really a bargain for him.
Although the second prince looked down on the sixth prince’s background, he was just the son of a palace maid, but he was still somewhat convinced of his ability. After all, if the sixth prince hadn’t tried his best to deal with it, the country might have changed hands long ago when his father disappeared. Moreover, the father had never been very kind to him. He was able to achieve what he has today because of his own efforts. There was really nothing to say.
The fourth prince had become more open-minded now. He was only slightly surprised, but soon he was relieved.
“It’s the sixth brother…” the fourth prince murmured, and then smiled: “Not bad either.”
The prince was in a complicated mood. After all, the brothers pressed him step by step, and the sixth brother made a lot of effort. In the end, he was forced to take a radical approach. But in the final analysis, this was just a normal method. He was not as skilled as others. Even if he was unwilling, he had no choice. The winner is the king and the loser is the bandit. He had nothing to say.
Several people quickly accepted the reality and unanimously acknowledged that the sixth prince was the final winner. They felt that the Ye family’s kingdom handed over to him would definitely continue the glory of the father’s reign in the future, and if he was lucky, he might even be able to reach a higher level.
As time passed, the few people who felt relieved had even gradually stopped paying attention to the affairs of the human world. After all, they were dead, and their children and grandchildren would have their own blessings. After all, they had been involved in all kinds of intrigues during their lifetime, and after death they could finally put aside their past identities and take a good rest.
After relaxing, the few people found that there were interesting things in the underworld that were no less interesting than those in the human world. The prince even took Emperor Jingwen to secretly take a look at the late emperor. Seeing that the late emperor was beaten and kicked in the street, Emperor Jingwen frowned on the surface, saying that it was so treasonous and unbecoming, but he was secretly happy in his heart, he deserved it! The late emperor was so absurd when he was alive, and he caused him so much trouble, and he deserved it after his death.
As for other ancestors, Emperor Jingwen had made remarkable achievements in his life. When he was in office, the government was clean and the people were harmonious. He was also very respectable in front of the ancestors. Naturally, he was not as ashamed and hesitant as the prince. Emperor Jingwen had a solemn face and met almost all the ancestors. Because of his good vision, even Emperor Taicheng received a lot of praise.
In this way, how can Emperor Jingwen’s life in the underworld be described as happy and proud?
Just as Emperor Jingwen was becoming more and more relaxed, another figure appeared in front of several people.
At that time, Emperor Jingwen was drinking tea under the grape vines, holding a scroll in his other hand, with one leg slightly raised. You could even feel his good mood when the rattan chair was shaking.
Infected by such a relaxed atmosphere, even the prince no longer disliked the second prince as before. Sensing the movement outside, the prince, the second prince, and the fourth prince subconsciously looked up, and then everyone was stunned.
Before he saw the person coming, the second prince was still gloating and wondering who this person was, but now… the second prince suddenly fell silent.
Noticing the unusual movement next to him, Emperor Jingwen put down his book. When he saw the person’s face clearly, he immediately spit out a mouthful of tea. His hands, which were originally quite stable, suddenly trembled violently. His face was full of complete disbelief.
Although there is no sun and moon in the underworld, Emperor Jingwen dared to guarantee that it would definitely not be long before he died.
So…
“So why are you here!?”
Without bothering to wipe off the water stains on his body, looking at the miserable and inexplicably guilty Emperor Taicheng, Emperor Jingwen pointed at him and almost shouted in shock and anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Extra 4: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Oh no, things might be in trouble.
After a while of people falling and horses falling, the few people who were originally very calm could not sit still all of a sudden.
Even if they were all dead, it was after all the Great Zhou, the kingdom of their Ye family! Who could let it go?
Emperor Taicheng knew that he could not hide it, not to mention that the ghost messenger who sent him here had not left yet. When the few people asked, they would know, so he simply admitted it.
When he learned that he died in just two years in office, Emperor Jingwen’s eyes went dark.
Emperor Jingwen had imagined countless possibilities, including that his sixth son’s character became a tyrant after he came to power. Such extreme examples had been taken into consideration by him, but in any case, it definitely did not include the possibility that the prince who had lived to adulthood suddenly died.
Because Emperor Jingwen knew that with the management during his reign, even if the sixth prince’s temperament changed drastically, he would never ruin the country all at once. As for more than ten or twenty years, or even decades later, such a long-term matter would not be his responsibility. But the new emperor died suddenly, and once the remaining princes were caught in internal strife, they would not have to wait for more than ten or twenty years. If the fighting was fierce, no matter how strong the foundation was, it would be completely destroyed by them. In this regard, Emperor Jingwen still believed in the abilities of his remaining sons.
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen could not calm down at all, especially when he learned that Emperor Taicheng only had one prince, Ye Jin, before he came to power. How could he not know that he was deceived?
From then on, Emperor Jingwen was more concerned about his son’s ability to govern the country. After all, in his eyes, how could there be a man in the world who could not give birth to a child? Especially since it was his own son, it was just a matter of taking a few more concubines. If the number was large, there would always be a few who would win.
Emperor Jingwen had never thought about this before, and he never expected that his son would even take this into account. When Emperor Jingwen saw that he had few offspring, he only thought that it was because he had few concubines and had deep feelings for his princess, or because the princess was of noble status. After all, his princess was the direct granddaughter of Prime Minister He, and the entire Prime Minister’s Mansion stood behind her. The Sixth Prince was of ordinary birth and needed to rely on Prime Minister He in everything. Under such circumstances, the Sixth Prince naturally had to respect the princess more. At that time, Emperor Jingwen was worried that he would be constrained by the He family after he came to the throne. Now that he thought about it carefully, he was really too naive.His son had few concubines not because he had many feelings, but because he knew that it was difficult for him to have children, and he was afraid of being exposed, so he tried to take as few concubines as possible, deliberately creating a false impression that he valued love and friendship. He was clearly tricked by his son.
“…Asshole!” Emperor Jingwen was almost laughed at by him, thinking that he was a fool at the beginning. Even the crown prince and others beside him looked at Emperor Taicheng differently.
The second prince now felt wronged. The other brothers thought he was cunning and didn’t like to deal with him. Now look, the one in front of him is the one with the real cunning.
“What a scheming old man, Sixth Prince.” The second prince said with a smile.
However, facing the eyes of the second prince and others, Emperor Taicheng seemed not to see it. It can only be said that he is worthy of being an emperor and has thicker skin than ordinary people.
Anyway, things have come to this point. Not only can the father and others not do anything to him, but they have to work with him to find a solution.
Yes, Emperor Jingwen and others can’t continue to be leisurely now. They must work with Emperor Taicheng to find a solution. You know, Emperor Taicheng left behind an heir who is only ten years old. Under such circumstances, the remaining group of people can’t help but interfere. When thinking of this, it would be strange if Emperor Jingwen and others could sit still.
Just like that, the ghost messenger who was originally quite leisurely was surrounded by several people all of a sudden. However, the ghost messenger who sent people here was just a lower-level member of the underworld after all, and he could not make the decision.
After all, Emperor Jingwen was an emperor during his lifetime, and he was blessed with luck. Emperor Taicheng and others were not ordinary ghosts. Once this group of people started to make trouble, it would be more troublesome for the King of Hell and others than ordinary people. What’s more, even if they got what they wanted, what would happen? Now that their souls have returned to the underworld, even if they know what happened in the human world, they are powerless to change it and can only watch.
With this thought in mind, the King of Hell waved his hand and quickly sent over something called “projection”.
This thing was borrowed from other worlds, and now it is just right to see how effective it is.
However, projection is not something of this world after all, and the ghost messenger in the underworld only has a limited understanding of it. Therefore, after the other party explained it, Emperor Jingwen and his men were also confused. They only knew that this thing could project various scenes in the human world. As for how to operate it specifically… It doesn’t matter. Since the King of Hell trusted them with the thing, there must be no problem. It’s just a matter of trying a few more times.
After the ghost messenger left, Emperor Jingwen originally thought so.
As a result, after the projection was turned on, Emperor Jingwen and his men had not yet had time to be surprised by the sudden appearance of the picture on the wall. Then, the first sound of this thing called projection stunned them.
[“Leaving you three mother and son alone… I… I really…”
“Also, don’t… don’t blame me…”
I can’t leave all the best things to you, don’t blame me.]
Emperor Jingwen suddenly widened his eyes. Wait, why did this thing called projection show the picture before his death? Didn’t he want to see the current situation of the Great Zhou? How could it be something so old? Ɽ�
He immediately realised what his father meant by “Don’t blame me”, and the look in Emperor Taicheng’s eyes when he looked at his biological father suddenly changed.
Although he had long known that Emperor Jingwen was biased and had no expectations after he became an adult, seeing this scene, Emperor Taicheng still couldn’t control his emotions.
“I really wronged my ninth brother by not being able to hand over the country to him…” After a moment of silence, Emperor Taicheng finally couldn’t hold it in anymore and spoke softly for the first time.
Why, are you so reluctant to choose him as the successor?
Don’t say that Emperor Taicheng…
Emperor Jingwen was so angry that even the Crown Prince’s eyes were not right. Didn’t he say that he was the one that his father loved the most? Now, it seemed that this statement was not true.
His father had publicly admitted that he favoured him, but he ended up like that. His father never admitted that he loved Xiaojiu, but he was thinking about these things before he died… At this moment, the Crown Prince’s face began to turn blue, and the Second and Fourth Princes who were sitting next to him were even more upset.
Even Emperor Jingwen felt a little uncomfortable with such a scene, but at the same time, he couldn’t help but feel fortunate in his heart that it was fortunate that they knew about it after they died, otherwise Xiaojiu would definitely not survive.
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen didn’t dare to let them continue watching. Anyway, the thing called the remote control was in his hand. Emperor Jingwen hurriedly began to press the fast-forward button frantically, hoping that this scene would pass quickly.
Emperor Jingwen’s idea was good, but his luck didn’t seem to be very good. When he stopped, the position where the picture stopped was even more exciting than before.
The screen showed a wilderness far away from Shangjing, which looked extremely desolate. Seeing this, Emperor Jingwen had a bad feeling. However, before he could react, the crown prince, who had noticed something was wrong, called him “Father” in a gentle voice.
What else could Emperor Jingwen say? Even if he didn’t let them see it, they could guess it from his evasive attitude. It was meaningless for him to hide it.
Emperor Jingwen coughed lightly and had to put down his hand on the fast-forward button in dismay.
Then, Emperor Taicheng and his men saw a person who was not very familiar, but they could definitely guess his identity.
If it was an ordinary secret guard, it would be fine. Emperor Taicheng and his men would definitely not recognize him, but Wu Yi was different. Wu Yi was the leader of all the secret guards, the number one among the secret guards, and even the crown prince and his men had heard of him.
Emperor Taicheng still remembered that when he ascended the throne, the group of secret guards around him had all been replaced, and Wu Yi was not among them. At that time, Emperor Taicheng only thought that Wu Yi followed the ancestral system and died with Emperor Jingwen. After all, even he did not think that a person like his father would let a secret guard who knew so many secrets continue to live, but Emperor Jingwen did so.
It was really a good way to steal the dragon and change the phoenix!
At this moment, Emperor Taicheng wanted to ask from the bottom of his heart, father, why don’t you just let Xiaojiu succeed to the throne? Why bother to choose him?
Based on what they saw, is there any difference between this and directly choosing Xiaojiu to succeed to the throne?
Although Emperor Jingwen only left Wu Yi, Wu Yi was the leader of the secret guards! Leaving him is equivalent to leaving Xiaojiu a complete team of secret guards. As long as Xiaojiu wants, can’t he train as many secret guards as he wants?
Emperor Taicheng felt that the secret guard team under his command might not be as high in quality as the one trained by Xiaojiu.
However, Emperor Jingwen had something to say about this. First of all, he was not such a willful person. He would not ignore the Ye family’s kingdom just because he favored one child.
Secondly, “Xiaojiu is not that kind of person. If you don’t provoke him first, he will never provoke you.” Emperor Jingwen said so.
Now, not to mention Emperor Taicheng, who was the person involved, even the prince and others gritted their teeth.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Emperor Jingwen hurriedly added: “Besides, the secret guards are not so easy to train. It will take ten or eight years to show the effect.”
In addition to personal ability, they also need to cooperate with each other to exert the true strength of the secret guards. Even with Wu Yi, it is impossible to achieve quick success.
“If you still haven’t sat firmly in the position under your buttocks in ten or eight years, then I have to doubt whether my original decision was correct.”
In other words, if he was not enough to deal with a group of secret guards in ten or eight years, he would be pushed down because of his lack of ability. It was his own problem, right?
Emperor Taicheng took a few deep breaths. He, who had always been introverted, did not curse in public.
If the man in front of him was not his father, Emperor Taicheng really wanted to say, listen to what you said, is this human language?
Anyway, Emperor Taicheng understood that no matter what, even if his father died, he must save Xiaojiu’s life, and he must ensure that he lives a healthy and prosperous life.
After thinking it through, the second prince began to disregard the father-son relationship and cursed his ancestors in his heart, and he didn’t even care if he was scolded.
Fortunately, there was nothing more irritating to their nerves afterwards, but soon, when seeing that Emperor Taicheng urgently recalled Xiaojiu when he was seriously ill, and then intended to make him the regent to help his son sit on the throne, it was finally Emperor Jingwen’s turn to become irritable.

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Extra 5: The Underworld
chapters.content:
“Can he be the regent in this state? It’s just nonsense!”
What Emperor Jingwen didn’t say was that, in addition to thinking that Xiaojiu was not capable enough, he was most worried about Xiaojiu’s future.
Throughout history, how many people who became regents had a good ending? It’s fine that the little emperor has to rely on the adult prince when he is young, but when the little emperor grows up and becomes fully grown, there will be a lot of fighting. It’s just a foolish dream for Xiaojiu to get out of it. Emperor Jingwen didn’t believe that Emperor Taicheng, who was as smart as he was , would not understand this truth.
The sixth son specially selected a stepping stone for his son. Does he really only treat his own son as a son, and other people’s sons are not sons? !
Emperor Jingwen’s eyes suddenly sank.
Emperor Taicheng was unmoved and replied lightly: “But this is the best choice, isn’t it? Father.”
Whether it is for Jin’er or the continuation of the country, it is the best choice.
“If it weren’t for the imperial edict that my father left before his death, which required that the lives of the fifth and seventh princes be saved, perhaps this son would not have made such a choice.” However, the other party had to be soft-hearted before his death. Who can be blamed for this?
If the fifth, seventh, and eighth princes were not watching covetously, only the family of Prime Minister He would be enough. No matter how powerful Prime Minister He was in the court, he had no military power after all. At that time, even if only the eldest prince was left to hinder each other, Xiaojiu would not have to wade into this muddy water.
So this matter was all my father’s fault. I just made the most favourable choice according to the situation at that time.Emperor Jingwen was unable to refute this when he heard this. If he had known that Emperor Taicheng would die so early, he might not have left such an imperial edict. At that time, he expected that his son would settle accounts with him afterwards, and he only wanted to save the lives of the fifth and seventh princes and prevent them from dying. The rest could be left to the sixth prince. It was just such a small request. How could he have thought of so much?
The Crown Prince and the Fourth Prince saw the attitude of Emperor Taicheng at the moment and knew that he would definitely get what he wanted in the end, but they couldn’t figure out why Xiaojiu was so stupid that he was willing to take on this hot potato. If it were them, they would never let Emperor Taicheng get what he wanted.
Although the regent is good, there is no chance on the left, the eldest prince on the right, and the queen mother and the little emperor behind. Isn’t this a living hell? The two can almost guarantee that even if Xiaojiu tries his best to assist the little emperor, he will definitely not get any good in the end.
The Crown Prince didn’t know that after his death, his younger brother seemed to be raised more and more naive by his father.
Originally, the Crown Prince thought so, until he saw the scene on the screen where Emperor Taicheng entrusted his son to his nineth brother before his death. At this moment, even the Second Prince couldn’t help but curse “insidious”.
Emperor Taicheng was sure of Xiaojiu’s temperament and expected that he would not be able to turn a blind eye to everything in front of him. In the end, he even used the trick of self-torture. When seeing his rotten flesh, Xiao Jiu, even if he had a heart of stone, would not be able to resist.
It was indeed as they thought. Knowing that Xiao Jiu would not tolerate hardness, they waited for him to use force. Emperor Taicheng insisted on using his psychological strategy until the last moment.
Emperor Taicheng not only wanted him to assist the little emperor, but also wanted him to assist the little emperor willingly.
“This is Xiao Jiu, if it were someone else… heh.” The prince was silent for a moment, and sneered in a rare way.
Emperor Taicheng did not speak. If it were someone else, he would not use such a trick, let alone make a regent.
Although he thought so in his heart, Emperor Taicheng did not want to see the prince have an easy life. Soon he said, “If it weren’t for Xiao Jiu’s character, your son and your wife and concubine would not be saved either.” If it weren’t for Xiao Jiu’s resistance at the time, Ye Xun and the Crown Princess would have been demoted to commoners long ago, and how could Ye Xun live as well as he does now. ṝ
They are all people who benefit from this, so who is more noble than who?
The Crown Prince, who had already known many matters after his death from the Fourth Prince, fell silent after hearing this. However, despite this, when he heard the words “Actually, more than 20 years ago, I knew about the fake mountain incident”, Emperor Taicheng could not help but clench his palms. No matter how many times he heard this, his heart still trembled slightly uncontrollably, and the guilt in his eyes flashed by, but was soon suppressed back into his heart.
However, things have come to this point, and the matter is done. Emperor Taicheng only hopes that Xiaojiu will be able to get out of this unscathed in the future.
When he saw Xiaojiu holding the hand of the little emperor and walking slowly, step by step, towards the dragon throne in front of the civil and military officials, and when Xiaojiu later warned the Fifth King, Seventh King and eighth king because of the little emperor and directly warned them that if they dared to interfere, they would definitely fight to the death, Emperor Taicheng’s mood became even more complicated.
There was no other reason. Xiaojiu was so dedicated that the usually rational Emperor Taicheng was shaken for a moment. In contrast, facing the posthumous title that a group of court officials had drafted for him after his death, Emperor Taicheng was particularly calm and even indifferent.
What was there to be surprised about when they had already guessed it?
The mood of the second and fourth princes was even more complicated than that of Emperor Taicheng. Looking at the picture, Xiaojiu spent a whole year raising the little emperor to be healthier and healthier. The little emperor finally looked like a child. The two had to admit that it was not completely unreasonable that their father only liked Xiaojiu. Anyway, if it were them, let alone trying their best to raise him, it would be good not to take away the throne of the little emperor. They would have a conscience if they did not directly kill the little emperor.
Emperor Taicheng was even more relieved to see this scene.
Just when everyone thought that the peaceful days would go on like this, a year later, an unexpected plague came quietly.
When Emperor Taicheng saw the scroll on the screen, his heart suddenly sank, and he immediately had a bad premonition.
Emperor Jingwen and his men were not stupid either, and when they heard the word “plague”, their faces changed.
Even Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng were helpless in the face of such a natural disaster, so how could the little emperor…
How can he cope with it when he is only eleven years old?
Fortunately, He Xiang was there to assist, and Xiao Jiu followed to help with the handling of the matter. For a while, the situation was considered good. Even if Emperor Jingwen was resurrected, there was only so much he could do. The rest of the human power was far from enough, and it all depended on God’s will.
Just when everyone couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, the scene changed, and it was a chaotic scene.
The tenth prince, the eleventh prince, and the twelfth prince joined hands and rebelled.
Even the taciturn Emperor Taicheng turned pale when he saw this scene, his thin arms were bulging with veins, and his eyes were filled with murderous intent.
Emperor Jingwen, who was standing by, had no scruples and immediately yelled: “You bastards! You are worse than beasts!”
At such a critical moment, several people did such a thing without caring about the lives of the common people, which completely messed up the originally good situation. Not to mention Emperor Taicheng, who always disliked these brothers, even Emperor Jingwen, the biological father, now had the intention to kill them and wanted to kill these three people who could not see the situation clearly.
Emperor Jingwen originally had no feelings for his sons after Xiaojiu, but now that he saw that they had threatened the stability of the country, he hated them even more.
Since the plague, Emperor Taicheng has been panicking and always felt that something bad would happen. It was only when he saw Xiaojiu protecting Jin’er in a busy schedule that he did not lose his composure.
When he saw that Xiaojiu had to lead troops to rescue the seventh prince because he was ambushed, even Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help thinking that it would only take a day or two and nothing would happen.
Before leaving, Xiaojiu had arranged everything that needed to be arranged, and even Emperor Taicheng could not find any fault with it. However, despite this, the accident still happened.
Xiaojiu had just met the Seventh Prince, and before he even had time to say anything, he suddenly heard the bad news that the little emperor was infected with the plague. The incredulous look when he turned back to look in the direction of the imperial city made even the Fourth Prince, who was outside the picture, feel a jump in his heart.
Emperor Taicheng finally punched the armrest beside him uncontrollably.
As for the Second Prince, after a brief shock, his eyes narrowed, and his mind raced, and he had already crossed over several candidates in his mind.
There were only a few people who could make Xiaojiu unguarded and have such connections in the palace.
Soon, the Second Prince thought of something, and his eyes could not help but drift to the Crown Prince who was sitting there.
Noticing the Second Prince’s strange look, the Crown Prince, who had not thought about it before, felt a jolt in his heart, and thought to himself, no way, could things not be what he thought?
But if he remembered correctly, Xun’er had not appeared on the screen for a long time, which showed how unknown Xun’er was. Even his father almost ignored him. It shouldn’t be that bad, right? What’s more, he was only eleven years old!
The prince suddenly felt a little uncomfortable.
Emperor Jingwen had not spoken since the beginning. Although it was a bit cruel to say so, he didn’t think that little Ye Jin could survive this epidemic.
Although the other party had recovered a lot because of Xiaojiu in the past year since he ascended the throne, he was not as strong as a normal child. In addition to the stimulation of his father’s posthumous title and the hard work in recent days, Emperor Jingwen closed his eyes with a little reluctance. He had already seen the ending, but he didn’t know who the next emperor would be. Would it be the fifth prince? The seventh prince? Or the eighth prince? Or one of the sons of the eldest prince, but thinking about it carefully, it seemed unlikely.
When the fifth prince ascended to the throne, the seventh prince refused to accept it. When the seventh prince ascended to the throne, the fifth prince, the eighth prince, and the eldest prince refused to accept it. The eldest prince’s son had no great ability, so it was obvious that he would not be able to do it either… It was over. His Great Zhou, which he had worked hard to build for his entire life, would not be gone just like that?
While Emperor Jingwen closed his eyes and meditated, he suddenly heard a gasp from the side. He opened his eyes subconsciously when he heard the noise, and saw the sickly little emperor in the picture deliberately avoiding the empress dowager and the palace servants who served him. He was holding on to his last breath, holding a pen, trembling and writing something seriously.
Bright yellow silk cloth, yellow cloth with black words, every word was clear.
Everyone suddenly realised that even though the little emperor was only eleven years old, even though he was still so young, as an emperor, he also had the power to make a will.
But what Emperor Jingwen and the others couldn’t understand was, what was he writing now? Just ask him what exactly he was writing now! ?

chapters.title: Chapter 350: Extra 6: The Underworld
chapters.content:
“No, we have to find a way to stop him!” Emperor Jingwen said decisively.
The remaining few people looked at each other, and now the question came, how to stop him?
The eyes of the prince and others fell on the silent and gloomy Emperor Taicheng. It is true that Emperor Taicheng felt guilty, and it is true that he hoped that Jin’er would show mercy in the future, but not in this way!
Emperor Taicheng’s expression changed, and after a moment, he said: “I’ll try.”
As for the specific method of testing… Although they had never died before, they had heard a lot of rumours about the underworld. If you want to communicate between the Yin and Yang worlds, there is only one way – to send a dream.
However, since the King of Hell dared to let them see what happened in the world, he must have been prepared and would not let them have the opportunity to disrupt the cause and effect of the world.
No matter how strong Emperor Taicheng’s will was at the moment, he tried several times but failed. Just as sweat broke out on his forehead, the little emperor had already made the final move and handed the yellow silk to the empress dowager in person, instructing her not to spread the news and to hand it over to the ninth uncle in person when he returned.
It’s over…
The thought came to the minds of the people who saw this scene.
To be honest, Xiaojiu has been a qualified regent in the past year, but he is only responsible for using his status to threaten others, and then raising the little emperor. The real work is done by He Xiang, the old duke Zhen and others. When thinking of his previous behaviour, wouldn’t Emperor Jingwen be desperate?“Wait.” Emperor Jingwen felt that he couldn’t just give up.
“If I remember correctly, I remember that the sixth’s wife is a steady person.” It’s okay that the emperor is young, but it’s impossible for the empress dowager to follow him in making trouble, right?
Upon hearing this, Emperor Taicheng shook his head slightly heavily, and completely crushed the little hope in his father’s heart without any consideration.
“If it was in the past, it would be fine, but I’m afraid it won’t work now.”
First, he passed away, and then his only child was gone in just a year. In addition, he did not leave any other heirs. No matter what the queen mother did now, she could not save the situation. Moreover, under the current circumstances, letting Xiaojiu ascend the throne was the best choice for the He family and her. The queen mother could not disagree.
Sure enough, the queen mother took over the will without even reading it, and just put it in her sleeve. Whether it was written on it that the regent would succeed to the throne or pass the throne to someone else, she didn’t care. What’s more, the queen mother deliberately gave the regent the opportunity to take the throne. After all, if she didn’t read it, she wouldn’t know what was written on it. Even if it was changed by the regent in the end, it would be a good thing.
Emperor Jingwen, who guessed what his daughter-in-law was thinking at the moment, choked up.
Perhaps they had expected that the little emperor would not survive tonight, so when they saw him convulsed and die tragically, everyone was still calm. Only Emperor Taicheng, as a father, looked at the prince with a look that seemed to be poisoned, scraping across his body inch by inch.
The prince had no choice but to smile bitterly, hoping that it was not done by Xun’er, otherwise when Xun’er came to the underworld in the future, he would have a hard time.
In the picture, Xiaojiu, who had rushed back overnight, was not only unhappy after receiving the will, but also looked like a bereaved mother. Although it can be felt that he was in great pain for the death of the little emperor, he also had despair for the future, which seemed to be not much different from when his father died.
The prince and others thought they had seen it wrong. After all, although Xiaojiu had never intended to seize the throne, it was a pie in the sky after all. It was impossible for him to not feel happy at all this time, right?
However, the facts proved that he was indeed not happy at all. Not only was he not happy, he also cursed.
[“I really owe you two in my last life. You can’t let me rest in peace even after my death. What sin have I committed!”]
Xiaojiu’s expression was heavy with grief, and every word he said was tearful. Emperor Taicheng, who was standing by, almost laughed out of anger.
Xiaojiu couldn’t possibly know that they were watching him in the underworld at this moment, so all his expressions and behaviours were real. He really had no desire for the throne and was very unhappy about it.
The expressions of the fourth and second princes twisted instantly, and they also cursed in their hearts.
But now was obviously not the time to say these things. If they were right, the little emperor would probably come here soon after his death.
So, when the little emperor came to this courtyard, before he could feel happy about the existence of Emperor Taicheng, he met several pairs of fiery eyes. For a moment, the little emperor seriously suspected that he would be torn apart and swallowed by his uncles the next moment.
As early as when he was on the boat, the little emperor had a bad premonition. He did not expect that the underworld actually existed. Now… it can only be said that the premonition has come true.
With a “gulp”, the little emperor swallowed hard, forced himself to calm down, and greeted them one by one in a well-behaved and graceful manner: “Hello, Grandpa Emperor, hello, uncles.”
Emperor Jingwen didn’t care whether it was good or not. He just wanted to know what his grandson was thinking. He was so talented that he passed the throne under his butt to his uncle.
Faced with such questions, the little emperor smiled dryly, but couldn’t help muttering in his heart, he didn’t want to! He thought that when a person died, it was all over, and he didn’t know anything. What does the throne that was passed out have to do with him? He didn’t care so much. Instead of falling into the hands of others, it would be better to pick a favourite person to give it to him.
The little emperor had been forbearing all his life like his father. He finally indulged himself once, but he didn’t expect to be caught.
When he saw something not known in the distance playing the pictures of the present world non-stop, the little emperor was suffocated directly.
“Grandpa Emperor, this… I…”
In the end, Emperor Taicheng couldn’t stand it anymore, coughed, and pulled his silly son to him.
Completely isolate his son from the sight of other people.
The little emperor was deeply moved. He didn’t know if it was his illusion. His father seemed to be much gentler after his death, and he was not as harsh to him as before. However, before he could think about it, he saw the Ninth Uncle in the picture waiting for his body to be burned, then took the will and left the palace.
Emperor Jingwen knew his son well. Seeing his expression now, he knew that the matter was not over, especially for him, it was far from over.
The prince’s face also changed slightly, and his heart was lifted.
Noticing that the atmosphere around him was a little stagnant, the little emperor was a little slow to react. He didn’t know why his father and others suddenly became different. In the end, it was the second prince who noticed his confusion and reluctantly explained: “Your Ninth Uncle went to find the murderer who made you sick.”
Xiaojiu was just a little out of tune, not stupid. There was no reason why Xiaojiu couldn’t see what they could see.
“In the past two days, only a few people knew about the will. Even the empress dowager didn’t see it in person. Whoever attacks him at this time is the one who gave instructions behind the scenes.” Only those who know the movements of the palace well can break through the obstacles and reach the little emperor.
As soon as the voice fell, the little emperor was immediately refreshed and his eyes widened.
So, the ninth uncle is going to avenge himself…
The little emperor’s eyes suddenly turned red and he almost cried. There was a bit of sobbing in his tone, “Ninth uncle, wuwu…”
He died at a young age. The little emperor was not without regrets, but even so, although he was moved, the ninth uncle was too bold. He didn’t even bring a guard and walked out of the palace like this. Although he could understand that he was going to take risks to lure out the person behind the scenes, he was still worried.
This time, even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but frown.
Seeing that the first person Xiao Jiu approached was his own cousin, and that he had stepped into the door of the old Duke Zhen’s house, Emperor Taicheng was startled at first, and then his heart suddenly softened.
Regardless of the outcome, Xiao Jiu’s actions were enough to make Emperor Taicheng feel relieved.
At this moment, everyone held their breath. After Xiao Jiu had spoken to Wei Wen for a few times and confirmed that Wei Wen was not the mastermind behind the scenes, everyone looked at the prince with completely undisguised eyes.
It was not He Xiang, it was not the Five Kings, Seven Kings, or Eight Kings, and the rest of the princes did not even have the chance to get close to the little emperor. It was not the Duke Zhen’s Mansion, and there was only one person left.
The prince could not help but turn sideways, not daring to look at the expressions of the two victims.
The prince had thought that after his death, the entire Prince’s Mansion would surely fall into decline, but he could not believe that such a change would make Xun’er change so much that he could even kill a child, just like he did back then. The only difference was that the prince was not able to be cruel after all, but Ye Xun did not have so many concerns.
The prince thought that this was the limit of Xun’er, but he didn’t expect that Ye Xun would still show no mercy when facing Xiaojiu.
When he saw the scene of Xiaojiu drunk on the table on the screen, the prince’s heart jumped suddenly, and Emperor Jingwen almost stood up and rushed into the screen. He realised that what he saw was just an illusion, so he stopped abruptly, but his hand holding the armrest tightened uncontrollably.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even dare to think about how he would treat the prince in the future if Xiaojiu got into trouble.
The second and fourth princes, who were half outsiders at the scene, noticed something unusual and always felt that things were not that simple.
Until the prince’s former assassins surrounded the entire courtyard, Ye Shuo, who was not very sober, suddenly opened his eyes, and then a stunning knife light flashed by.
In an instant, the cold light was so bright, as if the sky was tilted, and even the second prince couldn’t help but flash a trace of surprise in his eyes.
In shock, Emperor Jingwen stood up with a bang.
Then, Ye Xun, whose soul had returned to the underworld, was greeted with a gaze many times stronger than that of Ye Jin.

chapters.title: Chapter 351: Extra 7: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Ye Xun was standing there in a daze, obviously he hadn’t recovered from the shock of being stabbed through the heart by his uncle.
However, in just a few breaths, Emperor Taicheng and the Second Prince seemed to have reached some agreement and surrounded him. Especially Emperor Taicheng tightly grasped his son’s hand, his expression was tense, leaving no doubt that if Ye Xun had not died, Emperor Taicheng would not mind letting him die again. If I had known this, I should not have spared his life. My hard work throughout my life was completely in vain, and it was all destroyed by him in the blink of an eye.
Emperor Taicheng gritted his teeth.
The prince sat there, wanting to say something several times, but in the end he said nothing.
Even though the prince only knew what happened after his death from a few words, he also knew what would happen to his son if it weren’t for Xiaojiu’s protection when his father was furious. After that, Xiaojiu brought him to his side and raised him personally, fearing that he would die halfway. It can be said that he was very affectionate and treated him as his own son. At least when the prince was alive, he never treated him so carefully, but he didn’t expect that he would end up like this.
And this shouldn’t be Xiaojiu’s responsibility. As the saying goes, people leave and tea gets cold, and the royal family is even more cold-hearted. He was a scapegoat at the beginning, and his death was not clean in the end. If it was someone else, I’m afraid they wouldn’t dare to get involved in it, and it would be good enough if they didn’t add insult to injury. Only Xiaojiu was willing to speak for him at that time.
The prince knew that since he had helped Xiaojiu to be born smoothly in this world, he had never let him down. It was his own son, but now he had ruined all of Xiaojiu’s feelings.
Noticing that the Second Prince suddenly appeared in front of him and blocked his way, the Crown Prince did not resist, but lowered his eyes and said nothing, avoiding his son’s gaze.
The Fourth Prince had no grudge against the Crown Prince, but Ye Shuo had saved the Fourth Prince’s life after all. The Fourth Prince had no chance to repay him when he was alive, and now he was repaying his brother a little. Moreover, Ye Xun’s actions reminded the Fourth Prince of the Thirteenth Prince, who was also repaying kindness with enmity. The Thirteenth Prince had no feelings for him after all, but the Fourth Prince felt that it was not too much to call the man in front of him a beast.
Therefore, when he attacked, the Fourth Prince showed no mercy at all.Emperor Taicheng was not in good health when he was alive, but after his death, all his serious illnesses were cured, and he was not so weak. In addition, he was angry, so he attacked even more cruelly.
Ye Xun was one against two, and his kung fu was average, so he was soon beaten to the point where he couldn’t even stand up.
Emperor Jingwen, who was standing aside, watched coldly. At this moment, he was just glad that his youngest son had found a woman from Jianghu as his princess and learned martial arts from her. Otherwise, he would have been killed by this beast this time.
It would be fine for other people, but if Emperor Jingwen saw his youngest son in the underworld at this moment, even he himself didn’t know if he could still control his emotions.
After venting for a long time, Emperor Taicheng felt that the depression in his heart had dissipated a little. He made a serious note of the other party in his heart. Emperor Taicheng himself was not a generous person. He gritted his teeth secretly and decided that if he had the chance in the future, he would definitely not let him off easily.
Now that he was in the public eye, it was unrealistic for Emperor Taicheng to kill him. Besides, he didn’t know if he could die again after becoming a ghost. If he wanted to strike him down and retaliate, he could only take a long-term view.
The little emperor stood aside and did not do anything. When he saw Ye Xun struggling to stand up, he suddenly said, “Now it’s good. The Ninth Uncle will only like me, and he will never like you again.”
No matter how deep the relationship was when they grew up together, after the other party attacked the Ninth Uncle, especially the person the Ninth Uncle cherished the most, all these friendships were gone.
Ye Xun thought that he didn’t care about these things a long time ago, but what was the bitterness that filled his heart at this moment?
It’s just that the Yin and Yang are separated, and there is no way back.
Ye Xun subconsciously looked at his father. The prince could only smile bitterly and couldn’t say a word of comfort. After a while, Ye Xun finally shed tears.
…
Throwing Ye Xun, who was like a dead dog, aside, Emperor Taicheng took a deep breath, took his son back to his seat, and turned his attention back to the playing screen.
Although the way Xiao Jiu stabbed Ye Xun’s chest with a knife was very unusual, being an emperor was not something that could be done by high martial arts skills, especially since the little emperor had left a will. He could not stop being the emperor even if he wanted to, otherwise, no matter who the next successor was, he would not be able to survive.
… Although, why does it feel so strange?
The second prince seemed to have eaten something unclean, neither up nor down, a little nauseous, a little nauseous, a little irritable, and wanted to hit something. What was going on?
Noticing that the atmosphere around him was starting to get weird again, the little emperor couldn’t help but shrink his neck. Why, why did he have this expression? He thought it was good for the ninth uncle to be the emperor.
As if he had noticed the strange and complicated thoughts of the crowd, the scene quickly switched to other people who had heard the news.
Seeing this scene, Emperor Jingwen was worried that Xiao Jiu would not be able to ascend to this position. If he could not be the emperor, he would have to die. He was also worried that if he really became the emperor, wouldn’t the Great Zhou be finished? With his arrogant, lazy and unlearned appearance, how could it be good?
On one side is his son, on the other side is the country, the fierce clash of emotion and reason, for a moment, Emperor Jingwen’s expression was distorted.
However, to his surprise, what Emperor Jingwen was worried about did not happen, it was just that the situation was confusing, so he could not think calmly as usual.
When he saw the eldest prince discussing with his sons whether to try again, Emperor Jingwen’s heart was slightly lifted, but seeing that the other party gave up in an instant, Emperor Jingwen breathed a sigh of relief, but couldn’t help twitching his mouth.
After the injury of the broken leg, is the eldest prince becoming less and less ambitious?
When the others heard that Ye Yan and the others felt sorry for Xiao Jiu, they wanted to say something, “How did you teach your children, eldest brother/son?” This guy’s elbow was bent to the root of his thigh. He felt sorry for a man who was about to become the emperor. Are you their real father, or is Xiao Jiu their real father?
But looking at the little emperor, the fourth prince didn’t think it was a big deal. After all, the eldest sons only said so, but the sixth son simply gave away the entire country generously. In terms of ruining the family, it has to be the only child of the sixth son.
Oh, that’s okay.
Seeing this, Emperor Taicheng took a deep breath and suddenly felt a little regretful. He should have cared more about Jin’er before he died, otherwise Jin’er wouldn’t have recognized her father everywhere.
Then the scene came to the side of Prince Su and Prince Jin. When they were together, they were much more serious than Prince Ding. They analysed it very well. Although their expressions were also extremely ferocious, they were still rational.
The two analysed it back and forth, and finally concluded in despair that Xiao Jiu was now the most suitable candidate, and there would be no better choice than him.
The despair of Emperor Jingwen and others outside the screen was no less than that of Prince Su and Prince Jin, especially when he heard the two people’s words [“Do you think, if the emperor knew about this…”], Emperor Jingwen’s expression was cold.
There was no “if”, he already knew, and he really wanted to crawl out of the imperial mausoleum.
And the sentence [“Think of the good, at least our nephew is in a very strong body.”] made Emperor Taicheng break his defence successfully, which made him think of Xiaojiu’s earnest advice to him at the beginning, saying that a good body is the foundation, and asked him not to put the cart before the horse.
No way, no way, it can’t be true?
Emperor Taicheng took a breath, as if he had returned to the state of being seriously ill in an instant, and it felt that breathing began to become difficult.
Then there was the fierce opposition, and the Shangshu Ling and others who wanted to pop their eyes out.
Seeing this, the second and fourth princes finally felt a little more balanced. See, God is not so partial to Xiaojiu that he would not let Xiaojiu get what they fought so hard for but couldn’t get so easily.
However… before the two of them had time to be happy for a while, in the blink of an eye, the Shangshu Ling and others were persuaded by He Xiang and Su Wang and Jin Wang.
Emperor Taicheng: “…”
The second prince and the fourth prince: “…”
Emperor Taicheng dared to swear that even after he married He Xiang’s granddaughter, He Xiang had never been so easy to talk to him, not to mention king Su and king Jin who always looked at him with scrutiny and consideration.
The scene ended here, and more excitement was still to come.
After the prince’s chest rose and fell, he soon found that something seemed to be missing in the picture. After careful observation, he slowly and with difficulty said: “… Is Xiaojiu not here yet?”
A group of ministers quarrelled for a long time, and the main person didn’t come at all, right?
The prince and others had been waiting eagerly for He Xiang and others to discuss the result. Sure enough, after the matter was finalised, Xiaojiu showed up, and when the other party showed up, he threw a big trouble to king Su and He Xiang and others in a very impolite way.
Xiaojiu wanted to kill the mastermind of the rebellion, the Tenth Prince. The Prince of Su and his men disagreed. They didn’t want to see brothers killing each other, so they wanted to make peace and get the matter over with. Xiaojiu’s temper naturally wouldn’t give up, and then… he quit.
He quit…
quit… quit
…
Emperor Jingwen, who had worked hard and compromised for decades to ascend the throne: “?”
Emperor Taicheng, who had worked hard for most of his life and gave his all to get recognition: “?”
The Crown Prince, who had a hard time and was finally forced to death: “?”
The Second Prince, who had tried his best but was demoted to a commoner: “?”
The Fourth Prince, who was pierced through the chest by a sword before the fight even started: “?”
The Little Emperor: “Uh…”
That would have been fine, but the key point was that the Prince of Su and his ministers really compromised because of this. Not only that, they also tried their best to keep him. Emperor Jingwen never knew that these people were so good at talking nicely. It really opened his eyes. If you didn’t know, you would have thought that Xiaojiu was a rare and wise lord.
In the Hall of Supreme Harmony, Prince Su and his men cried loudly in front of the tablets of the ancestors of the Ye royal family. In the underworld, next to the projection, the second prince and others also cried loudly.
Even Emperor Jingwen, who loved Ye Shuo the most, couldn’t help but roar in his heart –
Why! I just ask you why! ?
…
…
“…Father, why don’t we shut this thing down?”
After a while, the prince said dimly.
As everyone knows, ghosts who have died will not die again, so the prince suddenly realised what it meant to be worse than death.
I don’t know why, but I suddenly lost interest in the future of the Great Zhou.

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Extra 8: The Underworld
chapters.content:
That’s what he said, but he definitely can’t close it. Everyone took a deep breath at the same time and continued to read with gritted teeth.
After that, it was the coronation ceremony and the selection of the queen.
Seeing this, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but grin.
In the past, he thought that Xiaojiu was just a prince, and Emperor Jingwen himself intended to let Xiaojiu avoid those court fights. Seeing that he liked the Jianghu woman named Yao Zhi so much, he agreed.
Yao Zhi is fine as a princess. Anyway, there are not many people in Xiaojiu’s house, and the imperial concubine will not just watch. At that time, at most, a few more maids will be sent over to help with the housekeeping. I believe there will be no trouble. However, the queen is the mother of a country, and she can’t be decided so hastily.
Emperor Jingwen privately thought of choosing another person. As for Yao Zhi, it would be fair to her to make her a royal concubine.
Anyway, in Emperor Jingwen’s mind, how can an emperor not have three palaces and six courtyards? Even if we look at the entire history, he can be said to be pure and unselfish. Even so, there are already twenty concubines in the harem of Emperor Jingwen.
However, Emperor Jingwen had a beautiful idea, but the prince knew that if Xiaojiu could follow his father’s wishes, he would not be Xiaojiu. In the entire royal family, he was the only one who was rebellious. How could he succumb so easily?
Sure enough, the young man in the picture insisted on taking the pressure from the civil and military officials and the royal family and made Yao Zhi his queen.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t understand it, and Emperor Taicheng couldn’t understand it either. The little emperor did understand it a little, but he was young and his words were not taken seriously, so he thought about it and shut his mouth.Watching his youngest son in a black dragon robe, sitting high on the dragon throne, overlooking the civil and military officials in the palace, Emperor Jingwen felt awkward. He had spent his entire life and racked his brains to imagine that there would be such a day.
But it should be said that Xiaojiu took after himself and his mother, and had a very good appearance. Now he is the emperor, and he looks really noble and heroic.
Wait, is this still the child who made him worry about him? ?
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt that the little prince who made him miss him so much before his death seemed to have grown up.
However, before Emperor Jingwen could finish his sigh, the envoys from Chen State and Beiting came. The expression on Emperor Jingwen’s face, which was originally slightly relieved because of Xiaojiu’s growth, froze.
Emperor Taicheng and others on the side could not help but frown.
Now that the plague has not subsided in the Great Zhou, it is already in a mess. The envoys from the two countries came at this time, and I am afraid they are not here with good intentions.
The complicated mood originally caused by Xiaojiu’s ascension to the throne was diluted a lot. After calming down, he found that the Great Zhou was indeed in internal and external troubles, and the little emperor left a mess for his uncle.
I just hope I can get through it smoothly, even if I suffer some grievances.
This is what Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng thought. After all, they have both been emperors and know how to make choices. They know that now is not a good time, so they choose to endure their anger for the time being, thinking that no matter what conditions Chen Guo and Beiting have, they can try to agree to them under the current situation, even if it means ceding land… R̃�
Just as the two were thinking about something, soon, Chen Guo and Beiting put forward their own conditions on the screen.
Chen Guo chose Princess Zhaocheng of Emperor Taicheng, while Beiting wanted the seventh princess, Jianjian, who was the most beloved by Emperor Jingwen during his lifetime.
“You are going too far, and you have wolfish ambitions!” This time, even the prince, who was always good-tempered, was angry and shouted angrily.
Emperor Taicheng’s face was as gloomy as water. He only had two children in his life, Ye Jin and Zhaocheng. Although Zhaocheng was just a princess, she was his only daughter after all, and she was also his blood. How could Emperor Taicheng not love her? Fearing that Zhaocheng would be wronged after his death, he followed his father’s example and issued a direct decree, prohibiting Zhaocheng from marrying. With Emperor Taicheng’s temperament, his love was already very blatant. Now that he was sitting here and heard Chen Guo’s words with his own ears, he really wanted to tear them apart alive.
The second prince paused slightly with his hand holding the teacup, and commented lightly: “The plan of alienation, choosing one of the two, can’t be said to be not poisonous.”
Xiaojiu encountered such a thing just after ascending the throne. If it was not handled properly, what prestige would he have as an emperor who was originally chosen temporarily?
But these are still trivial matters. What the second prince cares more about is the attitude of the envoys of the two countries. Does the same request mean that the two families have joined forces? If so, I am afraid that Xiaojiu is in danger.
“With Xiaojiu’s temperament, he will not promise both princesses. Although the plague has not subsided in the Great Zhou, it is not so cowardly.”
The problem lies in who to take and who to give up.
Emperor Taicheng knew it in his heart, but it was because he knew it too well that he couldn’t bear to watch it.
