Between his own sister and his niece, any fool would know which one to choose, not to mention Xiaojiu who always regarded the imperial concubines as extremely important.
Despite this, when he saw He Xiang and others in the picture pressing forward step by step and bluntly telling the princess to put state affairs first, Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but clench his fists, his heart was filled with sadness.
When the Shangshu ordered them to take the word “Ping” as their posthumous title, Emperor Taicheng was calm because it was expected. When he forgot about the little emperor who died at a young age, Emperor Taicheng was still calm because it was human nature.
But at this moment, facing Zhaocheng who was frightened, he felt sad and angry, and felt that people had left and the tea had been cold, and he felt that he was incompetent and couldn’t even protect a mere princess.
Zhaocheng is not even eleven years old this year, but they are pressing forward step by step without mercy. How can these people have the heart? !
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but sigh when he saw this scene. He felt distressed for a moment. This was the emperor. When things came to a critical moment, he had to let go even of his closest relatives…
Seeing the depressed atmosphere in the courtyard, the little emperor finally couldn’t help but spoke: “The Ninth Uncle is not like that! He will not send Zhaocheng’s sister out to marry!”
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help laughing when he heard this. It was impossible. No one could not see such a simple thing clearly——
[“Whether it is Jianjian, Zhaocheng, or any other princess, I will not send any of them out.”]
However, what Emperor Jingwen and the others heard was such a resounding sentence.
Emperor Taicheng suddenly raised his head and looked at the young man in the picture with shock.
The fourth prince took a breath of cold air: “Are you kidding me?”
Soon, Ye Shuo proved that there was no joke in this sentence, because then he sent Jianjian with the people of the Supervisory Department to kill all the envoys from Beiting very simply, leaving no one behind. The envoys from the State of Chen who were in the post station and separated by only a wall were frightened to tears and could not stand steadily. They fled from Shangjing.
With such a tough attitude, let alone the fourth prince, even Emperor Jingwen, who had experienced many storms, was shocked by him.
“… What a courage. “The second prince let out a long breath, and for the first time in his life, he showed a different look.
Emperor Jingwen held his forehead with his hand. Although he felt happy in his heart, but… but this is not how the country is governed!
Emperor Jingwen’s mood was almost as furious as He Xiang in the picture.
A total of 218 corpses were laid out in front of them. Now, even if He Xiang and his men didn’t want to go to war with Beiting, it was impossible.
Seeing this, Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help thinking, so there’s this trick…
Anyway, the problem has been solved . In front of him, even if He Xiang and the others cursed him harshly, they still had to do their best.
Emperor Jingwen had a complicated look in his eyes, but soon, something even more complicated happened.
When he heard the words “If they die, I die” and decided to lead the army in person, Emperor Jingwen wanted to rush into the King of Hell’s Palace to discuss returning to the human world with the King of Hell. He didn’t understand what Xiaojiu was showing off. Although Xiaojiu was good at kung fu, it was impossible that the old Duke Zhen didn’t teach him any real skills when he was a child, and then there were the top masters in the martial arts world. The Queen served as his sparring partner, but… on the battlefield, swords and knives have no eyes. No matter how strong one’s martial arts is, how can one defeat thousands of troops?
However, the facts have proved that it really works.
Although Emperor Jingwen and his men did not know what the Lanchester equation was, they had to admit that it was really useful. As long as they knew the number of enemy troops and arranged the battle according to the number of enemy troops, they would be invincible.
Emperor Jingwen could not help but slap his thigh. His first reaction was that if there was such a good thing, why didn’t Xiaojiu take it out earlier? After calming down a little, Emperor Jingwen smiled bitterly. Even if Xiaojiu took it out earlier, he couldn’t believe it.
The matter was of great importance, and Emperor Jingwen would not listen to him. This kind of thing that had not been tested in practice could only be used unhindered when he led the troops.
And no matter how useful the Lanchester equation was, it was not as useful as Xiaojiu/Ninth Emperor’s brain.
He stood at the battlefield. Xia Ying was still there calculating how many people Beiting had sent to fight. Xiaojiu/Ninth Emperor’s eyes scanned a few circles and instantly got the answer.
[“A total of about 28,300 people. From left to right, the first square has 3,400 people, the second square has 2,700 people, and the third…”]
Emperor Jingwen subconsciously pressed the pause button, wanting to count whether Xiaojiu’s calculation was correct. However, when he saw the densely packed people on the screen, he felt dizzy. After trying to distinguish them several times, Emperor Jingwen finally gave up.
There were too many people to count.
So now the question is, how did Xiaojiu know? Emperor Jingwen and others saw it clearly. He rolled his eyes a few times, and then read out a long list. digits.
The young man in the paused screen looked nonchalant, as if these remarks were just casual remarks.
At this moment, all sounds stopped, except for the faint noise and bustle of ghosts on the street not far away.
Emperor Jingwen touched his chin and pulled out a few hairs of his beard. Looking at the hair pulled out by the roots in his hand, Emperor Jingwen fell into deep thought.
Emperor Taicheng and others on the side were also in deep thought.
Everyone was silent for a long time. After a while, the little emperor, who was the youngest and could not hide things the most, raised his hand and said weakly and tentatively: “That…is the ninth uncle…a little too powerful? Does he feel, feel…different from usual?”
Then, the little emperor noticed that the expressions of his grandfather and father suddenly became uglier.

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Extra 9: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Something is wrong, this is very wrong.
Is this really his little son who is ignorant and always makes people worry?
Emperor Jingwen looked at the face on the screen that was exactly the same as the one in his impression, but he couldn’t match it with the person in his memory.
In the end, the second prince said what everyone was thinking: “It seems that our little Jiu has a lot of secrets…”
He said, how could the son born by his father and his brother be a fool? What’s more, Xiao Jiu was feared by both his father and the prince from the beginning, and no one lived as well as he did later. What’s more, he was the only one among all the brothers who received the favour of his father. Even the prince could not reach it later.
How could such a person be able to do it? How could he be deceived by him in the first place? Now thinking about it carefully, it is really horrible and makes people’s scalp numb.
Not only himself, but also looking at Lao Liu and the prince on the side, the second prince felt balanced in his heart.
After a long while, the prince said with difficulty: “Perhaps… Xiaojiu is simply not good at writing.”
Xiaojiu has not shown stupidity since he was a child. He just doesn’t use his mind on the right path. When Xiaojiu is being clever and lazy, he is more powerful than anyone else.
Now these things on the screen don’t really mean anything. Perhaps Xiaojiu is simply better at numerology.After the prince’s explanation, everyone suddenly felt that it was much easier to accept. After all, admitting that Xiaojiu is better than ordinary people in some aspects is much easier than being kept in the dark…
Emperor Jingwen’s face was as gloomy as water, and he gritted his teeth. He wanted to see what else Xiaojiu could do!
The scene not far away continued –
Emperor Jingwen and his men saw that after their side quickly changed their formation, Beiting realised that this was a good opportunity, and took advantage of the time when Da Zhou was issuing orders and rushed up like a wolf.
The people of Beiting were born strong, and nearly 10,000 people were like hungry tigers pouncing on their food, which made them even more fierce. The murderous look made the four princes nervous through the screen, and the little emperor, who had never seen such a scene, clenched the corners of his clothes, and his palms were slightly sweating. He kept praying in his heart, “It must be okay, Uncle Nine!”
The expression of Emperor Jingwen was even more tense. No matter what, he couldn’t help but worry.
Just when the breathing of several people was slightly stagnant, accompanied by General Fang and General Xu shouting “Protect the emperor” at the top of their lungs, Xiaojiu in the picture quickly took down the big bow next to him. His extremely calm expression infected Emperor Jingwen outside the picture, and his eyes followed his movements uncontrollably.
Although several people had not been to the battlefield in person, they were not unfamiliar with this big bow. There was no other reason, this bow was too famous.
This bow weighs seven stones, and the arrow is about as thick as a finger. Normally, it takes four people to pull it together, and it is often used for siege. Now Xiaojiu is alone, but he can pull it to a full moon shape.
The next moment, a loud sound of breaking through the air was heard. The Beiting general Lan, who was originally in high spirits, seemed to have encountered a fatal crisis. He quickly snatched the shield of the soldier beside him, but this extremely solid shield now seemed like paper. The arrow penetrated through it without losing its force, and penetrated all four people until there were no more arrows left, and then it stopped.
Emperor Jingwen and others didn’t know whether the old Duke of Zhen had such strength back then, but looking at the expression of the enemy general Lan Feng, he must have been more than that.
Looking at Xiaojiu in the picture again, his body and hands did not tremble, and he didn’t seem to be struggling. Conservatively speaking, it would not be difficult for him to shoot a few more shots.
In an instant, inside and outside the screen, the expressions of the second prince and others were almost exactly the same as the eldest prince, the same disbelief, the same dumbfounded.
If he said that he killed eighteen assassins in a row because he received guidance from Yao Zhi after marrying her, and that he could tell the number with just one glance, then the prince and others could not be fooled by such a precise arrow. ṜΑ
Once or twice is accidental, but more than once is inevitable.
Only a fool would believe that this little bastard did not hide his shortcomings! As for what Xiaojiu said on the screen, that he practised it after hunting, the second prince and others just sneered, saying that such an explanation could not fool them now.
After thinking that they had seen through Xiaojiu’s true face, the prince and others now just wanted to know how many things he was hiding from them.
Emperor Jingwen fiddled with the teacup beside him, his expression changed several times, and finally he sneered: “Ha.”
Having been an emperor for decades, this was probably the worst time that Emperor Jingwen was fooled, and the key was his most beloved youngest son. Emperor Jingwen was so angry that he couldn’t even describe it.
He was angry and annoyed, but more embarrassed and embarrassed. At this moment, he finally knew what shame was.
The prince: “…”
I always felt that my father was greatly stimulated by Xiaojiu’s performance…
The second prince was watching the fun and said coldly: “Now that Xiaojiu is the emperor, I’m afraid that all his past deeds can no longer be concealed.”
Once the door is opened, the secrets will only be exposed more and more, not to mention that they are all dead, and Xiaojiu has no need to hide it anymore. The second prince is waiting to see the show. What’s more, when he said this, he couldn’t help but glance at Emperor Taicheng next to him. I just don’t know what the other emperor feels after seeing it.
If we talk about poking at people’s hearts, it’s the second prince who didn’t forget to sow discord even after his death.
Emperor Taicheng took a deep breath and pretended not to see it.
The little emperor didn’t care about that. He only knew that when he was alive, his ninth uncle had no bad intentions. He even gave his all to protect and educate him. After his death, he even avenged him personally.
This alone is enough. As for the rest, it is not important.
Seeing the second uncle’s sinister intention, the little emperor could not help but glare at him fiercely.
The second prince raised his eyebrows, not hurt.
Then, Xiao Jiu shot seven arrows in a row, breaking up the 2,000-man team led by Lan Feng, forcing Lan Feng to dodge in a panic. Among them, Lan Feng’s capable subordinate was pierced through the heart by an arrow. Lan Feng saw that the situation was not good and had to retreat.
[“God bless the Great Zhou, long live the emperor!”
General Fang and General Xu suppressed their enthusiasm and knelt on the ground.
“Your Majesty is mighty, long live the emperor!”]
Silence, silence, and silence.
After a long time, Emperor Taicheng sighed, his eyes were complicated and difficult to discern, but in the end, he still spoke: “In terms of marching and fighting, I am not as good as him.”
Emperor Taicheng used to think that Prince Ding was a rare warrior in the world, but now in this scene, Xiao Jiu, who is well-proportioned and far less muscular than Prince Ding, is more ferocious.
It was not visible at all before.
In the picture, the Beiting people abandoned their armour and fled in a panic. Not to mention the soldiers of the Great Zhou, even Emperor Taicheng felt proud. However, the more this happened, the more uncomfortable he felt.
Although the battle in the picture was won, new problems soon emerged.
Xiaojiu actually asked the Ministry of War to transport all the weapons manufactured by the court to the border of Chen State instead of here. Such an order was not understood by Prince Ding, and the second prince and others did not understand it either.
It stands to reason that Beiting is the most critical side. The strength of Chen State is far less than that of Beiting. If all the weapons are sent to Chen State, although it will make it much easier to resist the attack of Chen State, if something goes wrong in Beiting, what is the point of defending the city well?
Several possibilities flashed through the second prince’s mind, but he quickly ruled them out one by one.
“Sure enough, Xiaojiu should have other backup plans.” The prince thought for a moment and spoke with certainty.
At this point, when the prince was trying to figure out Xiaojiu’s behaviour, he was no longer just superficial.
Emperor Jingwen wanted to see what surprises his youngest son had waiting for him.
Sure enough, in the middle of the night, Ye Shuo led 800 soldiers out of the tent, and scared Prince Ding, who had just fallen asleep, so much that he didn’t even have time to put on his clothes and chased him out on crutches.
If it was before, Emperor Jingwen and his men would still be a little nervous, but now… Heh, it’s not so easy for the little bastard to get into trouble.
Then, Emperor Jingwen and his men watched Xiaojiu easily “snatch” a large number of well-made and usable weapons from the hands of the notorious.
To say that it was snatching was actually flattering those locusts, it was clearly a free gift! The group of people symbolically resisted twice and then abandoned the camp and fled. What’s the difference between this and giving it directly to Xiaojiu? What’s more, with so few people, how could they use so many weapons? What to do with the extra weapons, throw them into the pot and stew them? How much of a coincidence would it take for the number of these weapons to match that of the soldiers of the Great Zhou?
Although Emperor Jingwen had not formally met the so-called locusts, he had heard of their names. Even Beiting was afraid of their existence, so how could they be easy to deal with?
However, this group of robbers who plundered Beiting without mercy seemed to be gentle and harmless little lambs when they met Xiaojiu. After fighting for a long time, neither side even broke a bloody skin. No matter how you think about it, it’s not right.
“…If there is no trick here, I will take the surname of Xiaojiu.” The fourth prince, who had completely forgotten that he and Ye Shuo were brothers, pulled the corners of his mouth, smiling.
However, Prince Ding believed it.
Prince Ding not only believed Xiaojiu’s words, but also felt that the locusts would come back at any time. He was afraid that he would be entangled by the locusts. Prince Ding was very happy to pick up weapons. He was as excited as picking up silver, and sweat broke out on his forehead.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
He had never known that his eldest son was so, uh… honest.
Then, the grain and grass of the Great Zhou were intercepted by Beiting halfway and burned completely, but it didn’t matter, it was all a small matter. Sure enough, the locusts quickly helped Xiaojiu to make up for the losses, not only to make up for all the losses, but even more than the lost batch of grain and grass.
Beiting learned from the locusts to launch a fatigue attack on the Great Zhou, but it was okay. The locusts, the real master, soon confronted the group of imposters from Beiting.
In addition, the leader of the locusts came directly to Xiaojiu and bowed to him in front of everyone.
The picture stayed on the expression of Prince Ding who suspected that his brother was actually the father of the locust leader. The prince couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
Emperor Taicheng also twitched his mouth, with a strange expression, which was hard to describe.
Emperor Jingwen shook his head and sighed, unable to bear to look directly.
Is there something wrong with the eldest brother’s brain?

chapters.title: Chapter 354: Extra 10: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Seeing that the eldest brother’s reaction was half a beat slower than theirs, Emperor Taicheng and others suddenly felt less embarrassed.
But at least the eldest brother finally reacted. Seeing this, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, thinking that the eldest brother was not stupid at last and could still be saved.
As for the crown prince on the side, his expression was subtle. He didn’t know if it was an illusion. He always felt that after so many years, the eldest brother had not made any progress, but was getting worse and worse. It would be fine if he was slow to react, but he actually asked so bluntly.
Before he could even breathe a sigh of relief, he saw the eldest brother confronting Xiaojiu on the spot. Seeing this, Emperor Jingwen had a heart attack instantly.
“…He doesn’t want to die, right?” Emperor Jingwen looked incredible, and then uncontrollably brought it into himself. If someone dared to question him like this, Emperor Jingwen narrowed his eyes dangerously, and the answer was self-evident.
Seeing this, the second prince raised his eyebrows slightly, and said with interest: “Oh, oh, it seems that the eldest brother will come down to accompany us soon.”
Peeping into the emperor’s heart, even if the eldest brother had ten heads, it would not be enough to chop off.
The little emperor on the side was not convinced: “Uncle Nine is not that kind of person!” Uncle Nine would not shout for war and killing for such a small matter!
Emperor Taicheng pursed his lips, and also felt that Xiaojiu would not do such a thing, but… if his sudden honesty was not for showing off, he might have had other intentions.
Obviously, if Xiaojiu was a person who would be complacent about his achievements, so many people would not have failed to notice his abnormality.Thinking of this, when Emperor Taicheng looked at the eldest prince again, there was a hint of pity in his eyes.
The scene continued. When the fourth prince heard the eldest prince’s words that seemed to be resentful, angry, wronged and angry [“Your Majesty, you deceived me so hard…”], he couldn’t help shaking his shoulders, with a look of unbearable to look at.
The second prince was not so polite, and his eyes were almost rolling up to the sky.
“How disgusting!”
The prince put his hand on his lips and coughed softly.
As expected, Xiaojiu in the picture also had an expression that he had something to say, but he still held it back.
【“This… I didn’t mean it.” Not expecting him to suddenly react at this time, Ye Shuo coughed lightly.
“You know, I was forced by the situation before, and I had no choice, right?”
Bullshit!
Prince Ding was so excited that he almost cursed. 】
At this moment, the thoughts of Emperor Jingwen and others overlapped with those of Prince Ding.
Looking at Xiaojiu, who almost had the word “perfunctory” engraved on his face, not to mention Prince Ding, even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t control himself and clenched his fists.
Although Emperor Jingwen was old, his martial arts had not regressed at all.
Then when Xiaojiu said that the locusts appeared twenty years ago, Emperor Jingwen said almost without hesitation: “Impossible!”
How old was Xiaojiu twenty years ago?
Emperor Taicheng was also shocked and could no longer maintain his expression.
“Raising private soldiers, what exactly does he want to do?” The second prince was puzzled. If he had bad intentions from the beginning, why did he only reveal it now? But if he didn’t have bad intentions, why would he raise so many private soldiers?
Even the clever Second Prince couldn’t figure out what he was trying to do.
At this time, the Second Prince and Emperor Jingwen no longer despised Prince Ding for being bold. After all, if Prince Ding wasn’t so bold and dared to ask directly, they would never know the answer to this question. With such a question in mind, the Second Prince felt that he would not be able to be reborn.
Emperor Jingwen also sat up straight, and his expression became serious. Obviously, he was also very concerned about the answer to this question.
Soon, everyone’s questions were answered.
[“I originally thought that if a disaster came one day, I would unite with my grandfather and uncles, as well as the family generals and old subordinates of the Duke of Zhenguo’s Mansion to fight out of the siege, and after leaving Shangjing, I would go all the way west and never come back.”
At first, Ye Shuo raised private soldiers just for support. Unexpectedly, it was like a snowball, rolling bigger and bigger, and the number of private soldiers increased, from dozens and hundreds at the beginning to thousands and tens of thousands now.
“And as you can see, it became like this now.”
Oh, so it was used to escape.
Now that Xiaojiu is the emperor, there is no need for him to lie anymore, which means that these are indeed his true words.
For a moment, Emperor Taicheng, who is as thoughtful as he is, didn’t know whether to say that he was prepared for a rainy day or to scold him for being so unambitious, but it can be seen that he expressed his resistance to the throne from his body to his heart and even his behaviour. Emperor Taicheng was puzzled. What was wrong with the throne? Why did he despise it so much?
Emperor Jingwen felt a little uncomfortable. He felt that Xiaojiu was too cruel and said that he would never come back… Emperor Jingwen could see that he was telling the truth, but it was because it was the truth that he felt suffocated.
“Am I that bad to him?” Emperor Jingwen was puzzled. Emperor Jingwen felt wronged. He felt that he almost gave him his heart, so why?
A sincere heart was betrayed, and even the emperor still felt a little sad.
The prince was stunned for a moment, then frowned: “Logically speaking, this shouldn’t be the case.” Although his father was indeed very wary of the Zhenguo family when Xiaojiu was a child, he never showed it, and never implicated the imperial concubine and Xiaojiu. The only traces were the struggles in the court. Things that were only on the surface would not make Xiaojiu so vigilant, unless…
“Unless Xiaojiu knew something else, that’s why he acted like this.” The prince said so.
Something else… After the prince’s reminder, Emperor Jingwen suddenly.
Thinking of something, his pupils shrank suddenly. After realising what that thing was, he didn’t dare to think about it any further.
If Xiaojiu knew it a long time ago, as he guessed, does that mean that from the beginning, he…
No way, no way, how could it be possible?
Emperor Jingwen comforted himself like this, but the expression on his face revealed everything.
No way, is it true? It must not be a trivial matter to make his father so concerned and still worried after so many years…
He vaguely guessed something. Seeing that Emperor Jingwen seemed to be a little restless, his eyes were even more tangled and complicated and difficult to distinguish, the prince, who had never seen his father in this way, felt bitter in his heart. For a moment, he really wanted to let the two of them misunderstand each other like this, but in the end, the prince still spoke.
“It’s been so long, no matter what happened at the beginning, Xiaojiu must have let it go a long time ago, otherwise he wouldn’t be so calm when talking about it.”
Looking at Xiaojiu’s expression on the screen, he looked relaxed and even in a good mood. No matter how you look at it, he doesn’t look like he is brooding over it.
If some things are still in your heart, they can’t be easily said out loud. If you can say something out loud, it means you don’t care about it anymore.
Emperor Jingwen was startled, and suddenly thought of the word “Dad” that he heard like a whisper when he was wandering around his corpse after his death. After a long while, he finally let out a long breath.
Prince Ding didn’t think so much, and when he mentioned that so many people had been deceived by Xiaojiu, including his father, so he felt balanced in his heart, the expressions of Emperor Taicheng and others suddenly became indifferent.
Oh, I’m really sorry for not finding out that something was wrong before I was alive.
How can Prince Ding, with such a brain, have the nerve to laugh at them!
Immediately after Xiaojiu’s words [“You still have the nerve to say that, if there was one of you who was willing to do well, I wouldn’t be like this!”] and [“You all fought fiercely, but in the end it was all just empty talk and internal consumption.”], the prince, who was always good-tempered, suddenly felt his fist hard.
The second prince smiled but didn’t smile, and talked to his brother across the air: “So, it’s still our fault.”
What kind of person is this! Is he speaking human language? ?
The second prince felt his blood boiling, and he was so angry that his teeth itched. Looking at Emperor Taicheng and others, their expressions were not much better.
But before everyone could curse out loud, when they heard Prince Ding’s words [“Besides this, is there anything else?”], everyone subconsciously sat up straight.
Here it comes, the secret hidden by Xiaojiu, which they care about the most, will soon have an answer.
Then, Emperor Jingwen and others heard the young man read out a lot of things that made them breathless like reading out the names of dishes.
【Ye Shuo saw that there was no one around, so he counted on his fingers: “Of course there are. Lucheng is mine now, and the distilled liquor that Beiting relies on is also mine. Commander Li is my man, Zeng Mohuai is a teacher I invited, and I also contributed to the flood that year. Zou Wu is my student, and the disciples of He Xiang and others are also my people, and there is also the current salt transport envoy. By the way, big brother, do you still remember the group of prefects and county magistrates that I asked Yan’er and others to execute on the spot? After they died, most of the people who came to power were my people.”】
Every time Xiaojiu said one, Emperor Jingwen’s breathing became faster, and in the end, he almost couldn’t breathe.
Emperor Taicheng: “…”
So, he was actually a fake emperor, right?
Fortunately, he didn’t force Xiaojiu. As for his sentence [“I’m sorry to disappoint you, I can’t beat Sixth Brother, and I won’t fight with Sixth Brother.”], Emperor Taicheng just took it as a fart. If you want to pretend, just pretend as much as you can!
As for the next words that Xiaojiu forbade Prince Ding to tell anyone, or else they might not try their best, everyone was completely numb.
“So there is such a method…” the little emperor seemed to be thinking about something.
Emperor Taicheng on the side started to cough violently, his expression twisted, and he almost yelled out “Don’t learn everything, this method is only suitable for your ninth uncle and not for you at all.”
The prince was stunned at the moment, he didn’t expect that after his death, it was Xiaojiu who helped him clean up the mess. Not only that, he even saved Prince Ding, otherwise Prince Ding would not just have one leg missing.
Xiaojiu always hoped that everyone would be fine, but in the end, everyone changed except him, and Xiaojiu’s wish finally fell through.
Compared to the others, the fourth prince, who was the least affected at the moment, could no longer hold back and said the truth: “So, the way he protects himself and others is to keep everything firmly in his own hands, right?”
At this point, the fourth prince had completely understood that Xiaojiu seemed easy to talk to, but in fact, he had arranged everything clearly. From the beginning to the end, he did not allow anything beyond his control to happen.
After vaguely seeing through this, the fourth prince could not help but take a breath and asked from the soul: “No, he is sick, right?”
It seems that he is not particularly normal mentally.
In an instant, the few people who were considered by a pervert fell silent, and the whole courtyard fell into a deathly silence.
Soon, something even more abnormal came.
Xiaojiu said that he wanted to unify the world and make the Great Zhou no longer have wars.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help it after all, and covered his chest tightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Extra 11: The Underworld
chapters.content:
“Xiaojiu is always so… uh, unexpected.” After a while, the prince said this dryly.
He always does something more outrageous right after they finally feel at ease. The prince seriously suspects that Xiaojiu has a grudge against a stable life.
Not only the prince can’t understand, but even Emperor Jingwen and others can’t understand. They don’t understand why Xiaojiu would take such a big risk. If it succeeds, it will be fine, and it will naturally be famous for thousands of years, but if it fails, it will be a disaster.
As for Xiaojiu’s constant saying that the current situation is not good, Emperor Jingwen and others don’t think so. It has been like this for thousands of years, what’s wrong?
People who become emperors can’t help but cherish themselves more than ordinary people. Emperors who dare to take risks and have such ambitions are not ordinary people throughout history.
However, it is useless for Emperor Jingwen to oppose. He can’t do anything at all. He can only watch everything happen.
With so many back-ups, Xiaojiu naturally won this tough battle. Not only did he win, but he also won beautifully. Especially the trick of treating people differently and sowing discord made the second prince amazed.
“How insidious…” The second prince couldn’t help but sigh.
It was obvious that Chen and Beiting had joined forces, and Xiaojiu only chased Beiting. No matter how Chen harassed them, he only asked people to defend and never counterattack. Although Beiting knew that Xiaojiu must have done it on purpose, he still felt unbalanced.
This is probably what is called “not worrying about the lack of wealth but worrying about the imbalance”. We are all in the same camp. Why do we lose so much while you are unscathed? How can the always arrogant Beiting swallow this bad breath?In addition, Beiting suffered heavy losses this time, and they would not be able to get any good if they continued to fight. Seeing that the situation was getting more and more serious, it didn’t take long for Beiting to hold on.
Seeing Xiao Jiu extorting a sum of money from Beiting with a tough attitude, and the key point is that Beiting really agreed, Emperor Jingwen was in a complicated mood.
Except for the most glorious days of the old Zhen, even so, everyone was just evenly matched. In the past, he only saw Da Zhou giving money to Beiting, and this was the first time he saw money in return.
“If I had known that Xiao Jiu had such talent…” Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but muttered, and then he reacted and laughed and shook his head.
What’s the use of knowing it earlier? If Xiao Jiu had shown his extraordinaryness early, I’m afraid he wouldn’t have grown up, let alone leading troops to fight.
If they had known that he wouldn’t live to this day, the prince and others wouldn’t have let him live to this day. It can only be said that everything is just right, or he had already anticipated what he would encounter if he was exposed too early, so there was this just right.
Thinking about it this way, is his son too smart?
Emperor Jingwen fell into deep thought, and Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but get goose bumps all over his body.
Emperor Taicheng, who was standing by, saw that Beiting first paid a large sum of money, but in the end, the city occupied by the Great Zhou could not be taken back. Later, the envoys of the State of Chen arrived, but were killed by the angry Beiting. The alliance between the two countries was declared broken. Emperor Taicheng could not help but let out a breath.
Xiaojiu is really… You can’t judge a person by his appearance. He is a master at controlling people’s hearts. He is too good at grasping the opponent’s psychology, even better than himself.
Thinking about it, almost everyone had a good relationship with him in the past, including himself. Even the insidious and cunning second prince had never made a move on him. Emperor Taicheng knew his own character and never opened his heart to others, but Xiaojiu did it. The most incredible thing was that after the other party was exposed, it was reasonable that he should have a gap with him. After all, which emperor could endure it after knowing that his own brother had done so many things behind his back?
But no, he still had no ill feelings towards Xiao Jiu, so that Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but wonder if he had already fallen into the trap he had woven invisibly.
Emperor Taicheng pondered, and when he looked at Xiao Jiu again, a trace of horror flashed in his eyes.
The little emperor who watched the whole process on the side: “…”
Although, he always felt that it was not the case, really not the case.
It is really terrifying to be able to associate so many imperial uncles and fathers in one breath, okay? !
Originally, everyone thought that Xiao Jiu would not be able to hide it this time. Such a glorious military exploit can be seen by anyone who is not blind. As for Xiao Jiu’s idea of ​​letting Prince Ding replace him, He Xiang and others are not fools. How could they be fooled by him?
Once He Xiang and others realised that Xiao Jiu was a “serious” emperor, the little thoughts that had been suppressed in their hearts before would emerge one after another, and it would be impossible for them to be of one mind. In this case, it would be a foolish dream for Xiao Jiu to control this force to work together. In this way, it would become a luxury to want to continue to unify the world with power in a short period of time.
Just as everyone was about to shake their heads and sigh, the scene changed, and the lively Xiaojiu reappeared, his face was pale, and the area around his eyes was unnaturally red. At this time, he held the edge of the bed with one hand and stroked his chest with the other hand, as if he was terminally ill and dying.
Everyone: “?”
Wait, what just happened? How could a healthy person become like this in the blink of an eye?
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but step back and look at it several times, and then he realised that it was because of fear.
… Wait, scared?
“…” After a long silence, the second prince said in a deep voice: “If I remember correctly, he personally ordered the killing of those captives, right?”
So many people, even Prince Ding couldn’t do this at the beginning. Such a decisive and cruel order, it’s not an exaggeration to say that he was a living devil at that time. As a result, seeing him scared like this again in a blink of an eye, several people suddenly felt unreal.
But the little emperor thought it was normal. After all, the Ninth Prince was a very soft-hearted person. If it weren’t for love, and forced by the situation, he certainly would not want to do it.
And everyone who heard the little emperor’s defence said “…” in unison.
Soft-hearted? Is this kid serious?
If the captives who heard this had not been reincarnated, they would have rushed in to shake his shoulders and scream, “Are you serious about this?”
Then the prince couldn’t help but look at Emperor Taicheng next to him, with a sincere attitude and a serious tone: “Although we are all dead now, it is a bit late to say these things, but I still think… a father should take care of his children more and teach them more.”
Don’t be like him, it’s only been a short time since he was separated from his son, and his son, who was originally pretty, has grown crooked.
Noticing the prince’s inadvertent glance, Ye Xun, who had been hiding in the corner and pretending that he didn’t exist, silently lowered his head.
Emperor Taicheng choked, and after a moment of silence, he nodded: “… I will.”
After thinking about it, Emperor Taicheng added: “Thank you for reminding me.”
The little emperor widened his eyes, with a look of disbelief on his face.
Looking at the increasingly weak Xiaojiu on the screen due to the fatigue of the journey, Emperor Jingwen and others had already anticipated what would happen next.
As expected, as soon as the carriage arrived in Shangjing, He Xiang and others chose to ignore the battle report that they had received and read with their own eyes. It was clearly written in black and white on the report that the emperor had made great contributions to the victory of the Great Zhou. However, when they saw Xiaojiu like this, He Xiang and others could not remember anything about it.
The former Ninth Prince is now the emperor, and the achievements of his subordinates should naturally be attributed to him.
For a moment, Emperor Jingwen really wanted to knock open the heads of He Xiang and others to see what was inside. They usually looked smarter than foxes, but why did their brains stop working when they met Xiaojiu?
In the end, the Fourth Prince told the truth: “If we hadn’t witnessed the whole process with our own eyes, I’m afraid we wouldn’t believe it.”
Emperor Jingwen was silent.
It’s all because Xiaojiu’s unreliable image has been deeply rooted in people’s hearts. After more than 20 years, it’s unrealistic to find something all of a sudden.
But Emperor Jingwen could never have imagined that Xiaojiu admitted it in person in the end. Even after he said, “To be honest, I did all the things you said. I not only ordered the killing of that group of Beiting people, but also killed General Lan Feng and the deputy generals around Lan Feng. They were all pierced into candied haws by a few arrows of mine.” He Xiang and the others still thought it was just a joke. Although He Xiang and the others nodded in affirmation on the surface, Emperor Jingwen dared to guarantee that they absolutely didn’t believe it.
Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but feel sour in his heart, but it was not because of whether He Xiang and the others believed it or not, but when did He Xiang and the others learn to coax people? The most important thing is why are they so skilled!
How can there be an emperor in this world who is praised for doing a little work? He is not a child of a few years old!
Seeing how these people treated Jin’er, a real child, and how they treated Xiaojiu, who was almost thirty years old, Emperor Taicheng felt sorry for his son.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath. Before he could be surprised by the three things Xiaojiu took out, namely glass, sugar, and soap, and before he could even think about whether Chen Guo would cut off one of his arms as Xiaojiu expected, he was immediately stunned by the chubby little Dingning that appeared on the screen.
The image on the projection seemed to have sensed Emperor Jingwen’s mood, and it couldn’t help but pull the camera over and magnified it. Little Dingning’s pink and tender little face suddenly occupied the entire screen, making her look even more lovely. She completely inherited the beautiful faces of her father and mother, and you could vaguely see some of Xiaojiu’s shadow on her.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t even react, but his heart softened. Even the usually steady prince and others couldn’t help but lean their heads forward slightly. Emperor Taicheng even thought of the dowry he had prepared for Dingning before his death. Although he had done it deliberately just to make Xiaojiu work for Jin’er, seeing this scene now, Emperor Taicheng suddenly felt that he had made the right choice.
This is Xiaojiu’s first child…
Feeling his slightly accelerated heartbeat and the feeling of blood connection that could be felt across the screen, Emperor Jingwen praised with a little reserve after a while: “Not bad.”
It is also a beautiful thing to bloom before bearing fruit.
But soon, after Emperor Jingwen calmed down, he suddenly thought of one thing-
Besides the queen, are there other women in Xiaojiu’s harem?
Wait, does Xiaojiu have a harem?
And how old is Xiaojiu this year?

chapters.title: Chapter 356: Extra 12: The Underworld
chapters.content:
In the mind of Emperor Jingwen, Ye Shuo has always been a child who never grows up. Now that he has come to his senses, he realises that he is not young anymore.
The prince next to him calculated and said, “He is thirty, right?”
Even if he is less than thirty, it is probably not much different.
However, Xiaojiu, who is nearly thirty years old, now has only one princess. Thinking of this, everyone couldn’t help but be silent, and then they all looked at Emperor Taicheng, who had the most difficult time in terms of offspring.
Emperor Taicheng said that he felt offended.
Although, at this age, he still has one more prince than Xiaojiu. He at least has a son and a daughter. Looking at Xiaojiu, he is still a long way behind him!
The second prince couldn’t help but touch his chin: “Could it be that the feng shui in the imperial concubine’s palace is not good?”
Otherwise, how could one or two of them not give birth to children?
Could it be that the father also did something about this back then?
“If I didn’t miss it, Jianjian is not married yet, right?” This is interesting.Emperor Taicheng, who had also thought of this, seemed to be evasive, but in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, the blatant look made Emperor Jingwen angry all of a sudden. It was true that the Duke of Zhenguo was powerful at the beginning, but he would not be so mean. He continued to make small moves when his two biological grandchildren were there, right?
It was clearly their own fault that they could not have children. It would be too unfair for him to blame it all.
Under the angry glare of Emperor Jingwen, Emperor Taicheng, who had thought too much, coughed lightly and quickly looked away.
He was satisfied in his heart, but then even Emperor Jingwen himself could not help but murmur, could it really be a feng shui problem? Did the Astrology Bureau deliberately choose that place when it was selected?
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen finally worried. What happened to these two emperors who had no offspring?
At this moment, although Emperor Jingwen, the father, was dead, he still couldn’t help but start to worry about the inheritance of his youngest son.
In the heart of Emperor Jingwen, no matter how great Xiaojiu’s achievements were, it was not as important as giving birth to a prince as soon as possible so that the Ye family’s kingdom could continue.
What was wrong with He Xiang and the others? Why didn’t they know they were anxious?
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen looked up and saw the scene of Xiaojiu holding Xiao Dingning to the court. Emperor Jingwen’s heart was immediately choked.
After all, it was the first child, and she was born so good-looking. Emperor Jingwen could understand Xiaojiu’s feelings at the moment. Even he was happy across the projection, but was it too rude to do so?
Emperor Jingwen, the father, frowned when he saw such a scene, but He Xiang and the others were like blind people, turning a blind eye to it.
Are they still the civil officials who would preach a few words when they got the chance?
Without waiting for Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng to express their opinions, Xiaojiu sat down, and then He Xiang and the others immediately solved all the problems that Da Zhou had encountered recently. 𝘙�
So they always say that they must say a few words before doing something serious, and they always beat around the bush and make people guess?
Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng both took a deep breath.
Seeing He Xiang and others again, they even felt upset because Xiao Jiu gave a small pair of glasses to the Taifu instead of them, and even automatically reflected on whether they had done anything to offend Xiao Jiu recently. In the end, they concluded that it was because they disagreed when Xiao Jiu led the army to the capital and left the queen to supervise the country, and Xiao Jiu guessed that they would treat them differently now.
Such a skilled sense of self-management really made the prince and others speechless.
Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng felt that they lost because they gave too much face to He Xiang and others before. So is it true that the emperor is too capable and the result of worrying too much is that the ministers will become lazy?
Then, when he heard the sentence [“Please have mercy on the people of the world and expand the branches and leaves for the Great Zhou to continue the descendants.”], Emperor Jingwen was immediately refreshed.
Here it comes, finally here, He Xiang and the others finally asked for it, if they didn’t urge him, he would be anxious to death.
Then, Emperor Jingwen and others saw Xiao Jiu was furious and scolded the ministers.
Everyone: “…”
“No, he is sick?” The second prince blurted out.
Among this group of people who have seven or eight wives and concubines, Ye Shuo, who only has one queen, seems so out of place. In the eyes of the second prince and others, isn’t he sick?
Asking Xiao Jiu to expand his harem is not to let him die. Even if he misses his queen in his heart, the most he can do is to give him more respect. Why bother to argue with the ministers because of such a trivial matter? Anyway, the second prince can’t understand it anyway.
At this moment, Emperor Jingwen already had a vague foreboding in his heart. After all, Xiao Jiu has done a lot of extraordinary things in recent years, and Emperor Jingwen would not be surprised if he did more extraordinary things.
Seeing that Xiao Jiu’s anger and rejection were almost undisguised on his face, Emperor Jingwen’s heart immediately sank.
You know, he had this expression when he got the will left by Xiao Yejin. In the end, he would not have compromised if there was no other way. But that time, he would die if he did not become the emperor. But now, the ministers can’t strangle him to death just because he doesn’t want to take a concubine, right? Even if He Xiang and others have this idea, they don’t have the ability to do so now!
After the previous battle, the military power of the border is now almost firmly in the hands of Xiao Jiu. His prestige has long surpassed that of Fang and Xu, who are generals. Because of the previous incident, General Fang and General Xu have a knot with Prince Ding. The two can’t rely on others and can only rely on Xiao Jiu. As for General Xu on the border of Chen State, he is a general of the old Duke of Zhenguo and naturally belongs to Xiao Jiu’s faction. In addition to the commander-in-chief Li Yuheng… If He Xiang and others want to force a marriage, they can only wait until the next life. Unless I crawl out of the imperial mausoleum now, there may be some hope.
Others…
…It can only be said that it is not optimistic.
Emperor Jingwen could not help but feel his eyes darkened.
“Is there really no one in this world who can stop him?”
Emperor Jingwen could not help but ask a soul-stirring question, but all he got was silence in the courtyard.
The crown prince has been unable to do anything with his younger brother since he was a child, and Emperor Taicheng even had to ask him for help in the end, not to mention the second and fourth princes. Thinking about it this way, isn’t Xiaojiu living too arrogant?
“In other words, the ninth uncle intends to have only Xiao Dingning as his child in this life.” The little emperor could not help but conclude.
Emperor Jingwen’s originally ugly face now darkened completely as if he had been stabbed by someone again. Such a weird thing would be fine if it happened to someone else, but Emperor Jingwen believed that this was something Xiaojiu could do.
Emperor Taicheng saw that the situation was not good, and hurriedly covered his son’s mouth.
Little Emperor: “Mmmmm–“
The scene in front of them continued. Everyone watched as Prime Minister He and his men were in a state of panic. They kowtowed until their heads were broken, but Xiaojiu did not give in. Prince Su and Prince Jin were even more exhausted.
The two first approached Prince Ding. Emperor Jingwen could not help but show hope on his face, but Prince Ding was frightened by Xiaojiu and did not dare to answer at all.
“Bah, so useless.” Emperor Jingwen could not help but spit on them. Then Prince Su and Prince Jin approached Prince Five, Seven, and Eight. The three of them had watched Xiaojiu grow up since they were young. How could they not know what kind of temper Xiaojiu had? They did not say a word at all, for fear of offending Xiaojiu.
As for the old Duke Zhenguo… As soon as the incident happened, he closed the door on the grounds of illness. As expected of someone who could survive under the hands of Emperor Jingwen, he had a keen sense of smell and did not give the two princes this opportunity at all.
Finally, it was Queen Mother Wei. But for some reason, when Emperor Jingwen saw the scene of Queen Mother Wei getting along with the Queen’s second master, he felt uncomfortable and felt that he was being cheated.
Soon, Emperor Jingwen had no time to think about it. Prince Su and Prince Jin had gone through so much trouble, but as expected, they didn’t get anything.
In this case, you can imagine how He Xiang and others felt when Xiao Jiu said, “You can have a baby, but I will only have one baby with the Queen, and as for taking a concubine, don’t even think about it.”
It was like a long drought meeting a sweet rain. He Xiang and others in the picture seemed to have heard the sound of nature. Emperor Jingwen outside the picture was also very excited, and even the prince and others were slightly shocked.
You know, this is the first time that Xiao Jiu has compromised in her life. Isn’t it worth celebrating?
[“One is one.”] Fearing that Xiao Jiu would go back on his word, He Xiang and others in the picture hurriedly agreed.
Sure enough, Xiao Jiu is still sensible and not the kind of person who likes to do whatever he wants.
Looking at the tearful He Xiang, then at the comforting father, and then at the slightly relieved expressions of others, the fourth prince couldn’t help but slowly thought of a “?” in his mind.
No, are you so easily satisfied?
And father, can’t He Xiang and the others take a look at themselves first!
But obviously, Emperor Jingwen is now focusing all his attention on Xiaojiu’s second child, and has no time to pay attention to other things.
Because Xiaojiu and Yao Zhi are both in their prime, once they have a plan, they will soon have a result.
In the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, it is impossible for his son to not give birth to a son, so this pregnancy is definitely stable, and he didn’t notice the subtle expression of Yao Zhi when she asked her master to diagnose her pulse.
Ten months passed in a blink of an eye, and soon it was time for the fruit to fall.
Emperor Jingwen felt that he had never been so nervous in his life. No matter what, it must be a prince!
Emperor Jingwen almost went to the King of Hell to discuss letting him quickly give birth to a boy.
Well, actually Emperor Jingwen did ask in the middle, but the ghost did not give him a reply, but just said that everything in the world has its own destiny, and told him not to be too anxious, calm down, and the difficulties will be solved.
And such words fell into the ears of Emperor Jingwen, whose mentality was already unbalanced, and meant: Don’t worry, there is no problem, it must be the prince.
Even Emperor Taicheng and others thought so.
Until the final result came out, when they learned that it was another princess, everyone fell silent.
How to say… Xiaojiu really has no fate with the prince.
When Emperor Jingwen saw Xiaojiu, who was beaming with joy and not disappointed at all, he couldn’t breathe and almost fainted.
No, it doesn’t matter, there is still the future, he doesn’t believe that Xiaojiu can really bear it!
Emperor Jingwen tried his best to comfort himself.
But as the picture played, Xiaojiu proved with facts that he could do it, he really could.
Emperor Jingwen’s heart suddenly died.
…
“Don’t look at it anymore. There is no hope for the Great Zhou.” Emperor Jingwen waved his hands. He felt discouraged and there was no hope in his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: Extra 13: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Emperor Jingwen did what he said and immediately turned off the projection.
Emperor Taicheng and others did not dare to disobey. Even if they wanted to continue watching in their hearts, they could do nothing because the remote control was in their father’s hands.
When Emperor Jingwen walked to the street and looked at the lively scene with pedestrians, he felt better.
How could there be an emperor who didn’t like concubines and children?
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t figure it out anyway, and as he walked farther and farther, he met more and more people. He gradually discovered a problem-
except for a few couples who were married before death and reunited after death, most people were alone. Occasionally, two good friends or brothers and sisters and relatives gathered together. When the party was over, they dispersed as they did before death. Only a few could live together forever.
It turned out that so many people had already disliked each other before they died, but they finally realised it after death.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but think of his concubines. Many of them died before him, but now there is not a single one who came to his door. Even his own queen, whom he had been thinking about all the time, had not been waiting for him here all the time, but had been reincarnated a long time ago.
That’s right, they were not in a relationship that had to exist between them. After death, there would naturally be no more ties.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly fell silent.Looking at his ancestors again, there was no need to mention the late emperor. It was good enough that his concubines did not spurn him. Looking above, only the first wife of Emperor Gaozu stayed and was now living with him. The rest… it was better not to mention them.
At this time, a group of new ghosts came to the Forgotten River. The first one was a woman. The ghost saw that she was alone, so he asked her if she wanted to look for her relatives in her lifetime.
The woman was silent for a long time after hearing this, but she finally shook her head, said “no need”, and walked away on her own.
The woman’s parents are still alive, and her children have been well raised by her. Only her husband, who died young, came here a few years ago. They had a good relationship when they were alive, but the woman did not choose to return to him in the end. She thought that since they were dead, all the past things were like clouds and mists, and they should return to dust. Reuniting again would only be a repetition of regrets.
Dust to dust, why should we reunite again?
Emperor Jingwen, who had watched the whole process, was stunned and his heart skipped a beat.
The prince and others saw that his father had not returned for a long time. Originally, the prince was about to go out to look for him. When he looked up, he saw that Emperor Jingwen had returned without saying a word.
Taking a deep breath, Emperor Jingwen turned on the projection again. Although the prince and others were confused, they did not say anything because their father suddenly came to his senses.
When the projection was turned on again, the originally calm picture suddenly jumped into the air, and then the prince and others saw a prosperous picture that they had never seen before.
In the picture, Shangjing has changed a lot –
flat streets, endless markets, and the endless fields outside the city. Although the wheat ears are not so piled up that the wheat stalks are bent, it is obvious that it is much better than the scene of a few grains of wheat on a wheat ear before. The vegetables and fruits are now dripping with water drops because of the previous rain, which makes them look more juicy and plump.
Shangjing is still like this, and it would be even more amazing if we go further south. Emperor Jingwen and others had only heard about the so-called good varieties before, but now they are shocked to see it with their own eyes. With such high grain yields, it is difficult for Dazhou not to be rich. Looking at the population that has skyrocketed in the years after the plague, just looking at the numbers reported below is enough to make people happy. How can such a scene be described as thriving?
As for the grafting and cutting techniques that confused several people, although they don’t know how to do it, looking at the current results, Emperor Jingwen and others are only amazed.
Then came the news that Xiaojiu’s queen was pregnant again.
This was Xiaojiu’s third child. Although Emperor Jingwen had no hope, what if? What if it was a prince this time?
Although a prince was too weak, it was better to have only one child than none at all, right? In addition, Xiaojiu and his wife were strong, so the child born would be very healthy, and as long as it was healthy enough, it would be enough.
But before the answer was revealed, news of an earthquake came from the State of Chen.
Noticing Xiaojiu’s excited eyes, Emperor Jingwen and others outside the screen secretly thought that it was not good. They had not forgotten Xiaojiu’s “ambition”. It was so hard to get the chance, and it would be strange if Xiaojiu let it go.
But He Xiang and his people were a big obstacle. You know, He Xiang felt the same as them, thinking that unifying the world was just a fool’s dream.
Xiaojiu seemed to have expected this, so he asked someone to compile a “report” as quickly as possible. Emperor Jingwen looked at it horizontally and vertically, and it took a long time for him to understand what was written on it.
Emperor Taicheng on the side could not help but say: “From this report, the chances of the Great Zhou winning are still not small.”
Although Emperor Taicheng was in poor health, it did not mean that he did not have the ambition to be an emperor. It can even be said that he was a risk-taker since he was a child.
Therefore, when faced with such practical evidence, Emperor Taicheng still supported a fight.
But He Xiang and others might not think the same as him, especially since He Xiang and others were already old and no longer had the drive they had when they were young.
Emperor Jingwen, who knew his important minister best, saw some clues and could not help but say: “He Xiang is afraid.”
He Xiang and others were also human beings. When faced with the unknown, they would be afraid and retreat. It was normal.
“There will be a good show soon.” There was no one else present who was watching the excitement and not minding the big things except the second prince.
Under the second prince’s interested gaze, Xiao Jiu in the picture…
Sure enough, he had a dispute with He Xiang and the others. Originally, He Xiang and the others tried to reason with Xiao Jiu, but because they really couldn’t win the argument, they soon began to talk about human feelings.
Seeing this, the Fourth Prince knew that He Xiang and the others were going to be in trouble. After all, Xiao Jiu had only compromised once in his life because of the will, and other times it was just others who gave in to him.
But what the Fourth Prince didn’t expect was that Xiao Jiu’s dog-like temper not only did not restrain itself at all, but became worse.
When Xiao Jiu in the picture said that sentence in the hall, “Is there anyone present who is willing to follow me?”, in the blink of an eye, people knelt down in the hall, and even the Fourth Prince and others outside the picture couldn’t help but feel a surge of blood boiling.
The Minister of Punishment, the Minister of Works, the Minister of Honglu Temple, etc., are all young and promising figures. Even if He Xiang and others give up, these people can quickly fill the positions vacated by He Xiang and others, especially many of them are students brought up by He Xiang and Shang Shuling, and they are more familiar with the duties of He Xiang and Shang Shuling.
Seeing this scene, Emperor Jingwen was a little breathless again. You know, many of them were deliberately guided by him, so they could enter the eyes of He Xiang and others so smoothly. It can be said that Emperor Jingwen contributed to this scene.
At this moment, Emperor Jingwen was really in a complicated mood.
Seeing that Xiaojiu not only posed a threat to his rule, but also did not let his father go, Emperor Taicheng calmed down all of a sudden.
Xiaojiu never thought of usurping the throne, he just treated everyone equally.
As expected, hearing about something is different from seeing it with one’s own eyes. Everyone was speechless for a long time. After seeing Xiao Jiu beat He Xiang and his men with a stick very skillfully, he quickly gave them a sweet date, mixed with some intimidation and well-founded alarmism. Even He Xiang and his old-timers couldn’t stand it.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
No, why are his movements so skillful! ?
Always leaving room for manoeuvre, making people feel uncomfortable but not offending them to death, always hovering near other people’s bottom line, does this make him feel more accomplished?
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t understand, and was greatly shocked.
Emperor Taicheng took a deep breath and felt that if he had half of Xiao Jiu’s ability, his reputation would not be so bad.
The little emperor was thoughtful and subconsciously wanted to take a pen and paper to write it down, but then he realised that it was no longer necessary now, and couldn’t help but sigh deeply.
Soon, Xiaojiu led the army to go out again. Emperor Jingwen followed him to see all kinds of thrilling or tragic scenes. This was shocking to everyone who had never been on the battlefield. In particular, Xiaojiu’s hands were stained with blood, and the appearance of holding a sword and standing on the horse was deeply engraved in everyone’s hearts.
“Great, great…”
Looking at the picture, the Ninth Prince had just experienced a fight, and the long sword in his hand was still dripping with blood. There were a lot of blood beads on his face, some of which had already solidified, and those that had not solidified were smudged with his movements. Half of the young man’s face was bloody. From a distance, he looked like a living Shura.
The little emperor’s eyes lit up, his mouth opened wide, and his face was full of admiration.
Emperor Taicheng: “…”
Seeing his son looking at Xiaojiu with a good look, Emperor Taicheng wanted to say something, but in the end he couldn’t say anything. After all, in martial arts, he was not as good as Xiaojiu.
But thinking that everyone present might not be able to beat Xiao Jiu, Emperor Taicheng felt more balanced.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but say “good”. Only then did Ye Xun feel that his death was not unjust. He must have been crazy to attack the Ninth Prince.
Everyone watched the army of the Great Zhou marching towards the capital of the Chen Kingdom step by step. The closer they got, the more complicated their mood became.
It turned out that this could really be done…
Noticing that Xiao Jiu had two more powerful generals around him, Emperor Jingwen, who loved talents, couldn’t help but praise: “These two people are good.”
Especially the young man named Xu Kui, who had the style of his grandfather. If he grew up in time, he would surely be another fierce general.
Emperor Jingwen suddenly felt a little relieved. As the saying goes, those who are righteous have many helpers, while those who are unrighteous have few helpers. Xiao Jiu is surrounded by talented people. Does it mean that everything he does now is destined by heaven?
While Emperor Jingwen was thinking, the crown prince beside him keenly noticed that something was wrong.
This Xu Kui seemed… there was something strange about him.
It wasn’t that Xu Kui was wrong, but that Xiaojiu’s attitude towards him seemed a little strange.

chapters.title: Chapter 358: Extra 14: The Underworld
chapters.content:
But before the prince could think about it, he saw an arrow coming at him. Xiaojiu was unable to dodge and was stabbed.
The prince and others who saw this scene could not help but sweat, but they also knew that swords and knives had no eyes on the battlefield. Even if there were people protecting them, they could not avoid the danger of charging in front of them.
Fortunately, this arrow looked dangerous, but it did not hit Xiaojiu’s vitals. After observing for a long time, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Emperor Jingwen was anxious and angry, but he had nowhere to vent. In the end, he could only say helplessly: “Why are you doing this?”
I don’t know how Xiaojiu, who has been spoiled since childhood, can endure it now.
From childhood to adulthood, Xiaojiu has never suffered such hardship, let alone such serious injuries. This is the first time.
There was so much blood flowing from the wound that it could not be stopped. Emperor Jingwen felt dizzy, so much so that when Prince Ding helped to pull out the arrow, there was a moment when Emperor Jingwen did not even dare to look, but in the end he resisted the desire to look away, as if he wanted to remember this scene firmly.
Seeing that Prince Ding first diverted Xiaojiu’s attention, and then mercilessly shot an arrow through Xiaojiu’s shoulder, Xiaojiu grimaced in pain, but gritted his teeth and endured it in front of the people below. The second prince couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows when he saw this. It was indeed Prince Ding, who was really cruel and didn’t hesitate at all.
Although Emperor Jingwen knew that this was a necessary process for healing, he was still very distressed, especially when he heard Prince Ding say that because everyone who could protect Xiaojiu was dead, no matter what happened, Xiaojiu had to solve it by himself, which made Emperor Jingwen’s heart tremble. At this moment, he really wanted to be resurrected.
Although Emperor Jingwen had been extremely restrained, the change in his expression still couldn’t be hidden from the others who had been paying attention to this side. The prince and others who hadn’t been able to bear to look closely saw this, and their expressions instantly became cold.Ha, father.
And then when they saw that Huandu had been attacked for a long time, everyone couldn’t help but frown. It was also obvious that they couldn’t drag it on, otherwise people’s hearts would be unsettled and they were afraid of losing the battle.
Huandu is the last line of defence of the State of Chen. If Huandu is not broken, the State of Chen will not be destroyed. If it cannot be taken down, the war launched by Xiaojiu will be considered a failure. If he wants to make a comeback next time, it will be even more difficult.
Fortunately, things soon took a turn for the better.
When seeing that the general Huo Rong who guarded Huandu died at the hands of his own people, even the prince and his people, who were from the Great Zhou, could not help but sigh.
For the ministers, it is really an extremely important thing to follow the emperor.
Once Huandu was broken, the soldiers of the Great Zhou almost drove straight in, and no one could stop them. Even when the capital of Chen fell, everyone watched a big drama about human hearts. The surrendered nobles of the State of Chen killed their own people even more cruelly than the army led by Xiaojiu, as if they were afraid of being retaliated, and they directly cut the grass and uprooted it without mercy.
When Emperor Jingwen and others reacted, the entire capital was already in Xiaojiu’s pocket. When the cavalry of the Great Zhou entered the capital of the State of Chen, Emperor Jingwen and others were speechless for a long time.
What they had thought was impossible before, now just… happened?
At this moment, Emperor Jingwen and others seemed to be dreaming.
However, at this moment, something strange happened –
noticing the tragic situation at the gate of the palace of the State of Chen, Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng, two insiders, immediately raised their alarm bells and blurted out: “Be careful, it’s the secret guards!”
However, the people in the picture could not hear their voices. Fortunately, Xiaojiu also noticed the abnormality at the last moment. However, before Xiaojiu could retreat, the overwhelming murderous intent followed.
Sword Saint Guo Tong is a master-level figure of the time. He alone can resist thousands of troops. The roads in the royal city are narrow, not as wide as those outside the city. Whether the soldiers turn around or resist, they will be difficult and weak. In this case, once Guo Tong rushes into the crowd, it will be like a hungry tiger falling into a sheepfold. Even the elite are not his opponents. ℟
Seeing that Xiaojiu had to face this man, Emperor Jingwen and others couldn’t help but hold their breath.
Seeing that hundreds of secret guards were like slaughtering chickens and dogs, the soldiers of the Great Zhou fell down wherever they went, and even Xiaojiu’s situation became precarious. Emperor Jingwen gritted his teeth, fearing that Xiaojiu would make a mistake at the last moment.
Fortunately, what Emperor Jingwen was worried about did not happen.
When he saw Wu Yi, who was already in front of him after a few ups and downs, Emperor Jingwen sincerely thanked his original decision. As for the second prince on the side, he snorted coldly, but in the end, he still put down the teacup that he was holding uncontrollably.
Emperor Jingwen and others couldn’t help but immerse themselves in joy with the others in the picture, but the difference was that Emperor Jingwen and others could see things that ordinary soldiers couldn’t see, so the happiness of several people became extremely short-lived. In less than half a day, Emperor Jingwen didn’t even have time to feel proud of his youngest son’s great achievements, and then Xiaojiu smashed his pride without knowing it.
After the celebration banquet, General Xu found Xiaojiu alone. Without waiting for Xiaojiu’s reaction, he immediately knelt on the ground and began to apologise to Xiaojiu.
It turned out that the grandson of the brave old general, Xu Kui, was actually a woman! The prince didn’t realise it until this moment. He said, if Xu Kui was a man, why would Xiaojiu drive him out when he was taking a bath.
Then, Emperor Jingwen knew that Xiaojiu was going to pass the throne to his daughter.
Emperor Jingwen’s smile froze on his face for a moment. He wondered if he had heard it wrong because of his old eyesight. He even asked the prince and others again, with a hint of uncertainty in his tone: “What did he say? I didn’t hear it clearly.”
The prince and others were also shocked, but they still answered instinctively: “Xiaojiu said that he wanted Dingning and others to be emperors.”
…
…
“It’s simply treasonous!”
“Asshole, how can this be!”
Emperor Jingwen was silent. Emperor Jingwen opened his eyes and was furious.
Emperor Jingwen stood up, controlled his hands not to tremble, and walked straight towards the direction of the King of Hell.
In response to Emperor Jingwen’s rage, no, it was a request, the King of Hell was polite and courteous, but refused.
It is said that everything in the world has its own destiny, and the dead should not worry about these things.
This time, Emperor Jingwen’s hands were not only shaking, but his whole body was shaking with anger.
Although Xiaojiu’s annexation of the State of Chen was worthy of recognition, the crime of wanting to pass on the country to the princess was enough to cover all his achievements so far. Even if his queen ascended the throne and became the emperor after Xiaojiu’s death, Emperor Jingwen would not be so bad, but princess, how could this be done?
However, there was no one in the world who could stop Xiaojiu. If there was anyone who could restrict him, he would not be so lawless.
When Emperor Jingwen thought of this, he became more and more desperate. It can be said that his whole spirit was collapsing, and he felt that the sky was about to fall.
After Emperor Jingwen returned, he happened to see General Xu muttering to himself, saying that if the late emperor knew about it, he would definitely not be happy.
This was not a question of whether he was happy or not. At this moment, Emperor Jingwen wanted to kill his own son.
Seeing that his father was really angry this time, so angry that he wanted to sever the father-son relationship with Xiaojiu, Emperor Taicheng on the side was not so difficult to accept. After all, he had few children and also had a princess. If he had had this wonderful idea at the beginning… Forget it, it’s impossible. Emperor Taicheng was confident in his abilities, but he also knew his own weight. What’s more, this was a matter that could ruin his reputation and even his life if he was not careful. With Emperor Taicheng’s temperament, he naturally would not take such a risk.
So what the Fourth Prince said before was not false at all when he said that Xiaojiu was a lunatic. Even if he was a lunatic, it was rare to be so crazy.
As for the little emperor on the side, he thought for a long time and couldn’t help asking: “If I had written my sister’s name on the will…”
Before the little emperor finished speaking, Emperor Taicheng interrupted him decisively: “Don’t think about it, it’s impossible. If you really wrote that kind of thing, your posthumous title would not be as simple as it is now.”
Without the corresponding strength, the civil and military officials in the court and even the common people would only think that the emperor was crazy. At that time, the throne could not be passed on, and the princess would have to die.
If you want to break this inherent inheritance, it is far from enough to just talk about it.
Thinking of this, Emperor Taicheng suddenly became curious about how Xiaojiu would act next. After all, from the beginning to now, all the words he said had been fulfilled, and he didn’t know if he would fail this time.
Anyway, his only heir had come here to accompany him early, so what else did Emperor Taicheng care about? And if it was the princess, with Xiaojiu being so short of manpower now, he would naturally try to grab everything he could. Presumably, his wife and daughter would also be able to get some light, so it seemed that there was nothing wrong with thinking about it.
As for the crown prince, his other wives, concubines and children have all disappeared, and have nothing to do with the Zhou Dynasty, so he doesn’t care too much.
It doesn’t matter whether Xiaojiu finally passes the throne to the prince or the princess.
As for the fourth prince and the second prince, the two of them are standing up. They don’t seem to be angry, but happy. Especially the fourth prince. Although he died, he didn’t make any mistakes before his death. In this way, the children he left behind are the direct bloodline of his father, and they are of standard orthodox origin. If Xiaojiu has any problems in the middle, maybe his children will have a chance to ascend to the throne. At that time, he will be named the emperor. Thinking of this, it can be regarded as a disguised realisation of his wish that he had no chance to realise.
Although the second prince was demoted to a commoner, if there is no one in the royal family in the future, his children may also be found again. Although the probability is very small, it is not impossible, right? Moreover, being outside without being monitored by Xiaojiu will make it easier for him to raise an army in the future. Who knows, one of his sons might be a genius, and he can defeat the others without doing anything. Why not?
Only a fool would ignore the actual benefits and choose those illusory so-called inheritances.
Only the emperor, the person involved, cares about these things. They just want to watch the fun and see if there are any benefits to be gained, and want to know how the future will develop.
Emperor Jingwen was stunned, not expecting that they thought so in their hearts.
For some reason, Emperor Jingwen felt that he was isolated by everyone.
No, could it be that they have seen Xiaojiu too much, so they finally started to be abnormal? !

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Extra 15: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Facing the Emperor Jingwen’s eyes of shock and anger with a little disbelief, the others couldn’t help but look away.
After all, Xiaojiu is not their child, so why should they care so much.
The only prince who didn’t look away was also embarrassed. After all, Xiaojiu has taken good care of their family. The prince really can’t do such a thing of repaying kindness with enmity, but…
I’m sorry, father!
Seeing that the last person who might stand with him also compromised, Emperor Jingwen’s temples were throbbing. Forced to do nothing, he could only pray in his heart that someone would find out and stop his crazy idea.
But what is certain is that General Xu in front of him is definitely not one of them. General Xu’s sons have all died in the war, and there is only one promising granddaughter, so he naturally stands on the same side as Xiaojiu. Sure enough, although General Xu heard such a big secret, he didn’t dare to mention it to others at all, and he was very tight-lipped.
… There is no need to be so honest at this time, right?
Soon, watching Xiao Jiu generously confer the title of Marquis on Xu Kui, and seeing General Xu’s grateful and thankful eyes, Emperor Jingwen immediately understood that this man had completely changed sides.
As for Xu Kui, let alone, except for Xiao Jiu, which emperor in the world would give her such an honour? Xu Kui would naturally become a supporter of Xiao Jiu and several princesses.
