Emperor Jingwen took a deep breath, and his mood also swayed back to Shangjing with Xiao Jiu.As soon as he returned to Beijing, Emperor Jingwen noticed the three little girls who went to the city gate with Yao Zhi to welcome the three armies. If it were in the past, Emperor Jingwen would only think they were cute, but now that he knew Xiao Jiu’s plan, the more Emperor Jingwen looked at them, the more complicated his mood became.
Not to mention whether the three little girls could support the huge Zhou Dynasty, even if they could, the princess became the emperor, this… wouldn’t it be a mess? Thousands of years ago, there was no such reason.
Although, even though he was extremely repulsive in his heart, when Emperor Jingwen saw the royal family ganging up to bully a few little girls, he still felt uncomfortable. After all, this was Xiaojiu’s child, his own granddaughter, a princess. Those people really didn’t take Xiaojiu seriously. What’s more, Xiaojiu asked the three princesses to enter the Hall of Supreme Harmony to burn incense for him. He, the person involved, hadn’t said anything yet. How could they make comments here?
Speaking of which, this was indeed the first time that the three princesses came to worship him in such a neat manner. Just for this first time, Emperor Jingwen thought about it and felt that it was not impossible. He reluctantly accepted it, but he couldn’t help thinking in his heart that it was only this time and it would not happen again. He didn’t notice the slightly weird looks of the prince and others.
Seeing this scene, Emperor Taicheng could probably guess what Xiaojiu was going to do.
And the matter was not beyond the expectations of several people. After watching Xiao Jiu come out of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, they immediately wrote down the list of people who had just spoken out to stop him. The louder the shouting, the higher the ranking. Emperor Taicheng and others felt that these people might not be able to jump for long.
After successfully incorporating the State of Chen into the territory of the Great Zhou, the next one was Beiting.
Emperor Taicheng and others were not optimistic about this. Although the battle with the State of Chen was quite smooth, the opponent’s combat power was far different from that of Beiting. The most important thing was that Beiting was a nomadic people who were very good at riding and shooting. Even if they were defeated, it would not take long for them to recuperate and then come back again. It would be harder than climbing to the sky to destroy Beiting. Therefore, Emperor Taicheng and others were not optimistic, and even the experienced Emperor Jingwen could not help but frown.
However, they could not decide whether to fight or not, so they could only watch helplessly, relying entirely on Xiao Jiu’s decision. As for Xiao Jiu himself… needless to say, it was obvious.
After all the gold, silver and treasures looted from the nobles and royal family of Chen State were returned, it was time to go to war with Beiting.
In the picture, Xiaojiu knew that if he wanted to completely expel Beiting, he needed to completely suppress them, beat them until they had no way to retreat, beat them until they were afraid, and beat them until they trembled with fear when they saw the soldiers of Dazhou.
It is not true that Ye Shuo is a genius in military affairs. The only thing he can show is the insight and knowledge that far exceeds that of people of this era.
Just when Emperor Taicheng and others were secretly thinking about how Xiaojiu would respond this time, they saw a team of eight people suddenly coming to the border. Several people counted again and found that there were really only eight people.
Seeing Xiaojiu’s cautious attitude, if Emperor Taicheng and others were not wrong, this was Xiaojiu’s trump card.
Emperor Taicheng and his companions looked around, but could not figure out what secrets were hidden in this mixed group of men and women, until six of them hid their bodies and fled in different directions. Then, they opened the box that they had been carrying behind their backs and dared not show it to anyone for a moment. ŗ
Then, a pitch-black weapon similar to that made of fine iron appeared.
Emperor Taicheng was still wondering what this thing was and why he had never seen it before. The next moment, a loud explosion sounded, and then the generals led by the Beiting army fell down without even a chance to struggle.
Seeing this scene, Emperor Jingwen and his companions could not help but shrink their pupils suddenly, and their bodies leaned forward slightly, their eyes like hawks, as if they wanted to see through the weapons in the hands of several people.
However, the six people in the picture did not give Emperor Jingwen and his men any chance. After shooting and killing the enemy generals, their positions were completely exposed. The six people did not linger at all, and were not greedy for more military exploits. As if they had been trained countless times before, they put the wooden box back on their backs before others could react, and disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.
When the people from Beiting arrived, they only saw a few traces left by the few people squatting.
Emperor Jingwen and his men were shocked by this scene and could not speak for a long time. They could not help but feel a strong sense of fear in their hearts.
Fear, Ye Xun, who had the worst psychological quality, even had a faint fear in his eyes.
Fortunately, the Ninth Prince did not use this thing when he took action, otherwise he would not even have a complete body left, and would have been blown into a bloody mess like the general. Now, the last bit of unwillingness and complexity in Ye Xun’s heart also dissipated, and he was only grateful.
In the past, everyone only knew that the crossbow was very powerful, and once it hit the vital point, it would be dead, but now this thing broke their cognition. The power of this thing, even if it did not successfully hit the vital point, just relying on the lethality of the moment when it exploded when it shot into the human body, was enough to kill people, and it had a longer range than the bow and arrow, and it was more unexpected. Even if you want to hide, it is impossible to dodge with the speed of this thing.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but say: “Such a good thing, why didn’t Xiaojiu take it out earlier?”
If it had been taken out earlier, I’m afraid it would be a different situation now.
Emperor Jingwen originally thought so, but as time went by, his expression became more and more solemn, and he began to feel lucky in his heart that Xiaojiu had not taken out this thing until now.
It was just that the small test did not show anything, but as the battle deepened, the horror of the weapon in the box was truly revealed.
Anyone who was targeted by the six men could hardly escape, whether it was an ordinary soldier or a general commanding a large army, they were all treated equally in front of the weapon.
Emperor Jingwen had never known that the human body was so fragile, like a dead branch, which would break at a touch, without even room for resistance. No matter how strong the shield was, it was like paper in front of this thing.
Emperor Jingwen dared not imagine what a tragic scene like hell would be if the Great Zhou really had such a thing and used it on a large scale in the war. At that time, the war would not only not be eliminated, but would be ten times or a hundred times more painful than it is now.
Emperor Jingwen didn’t think that what the Great Zhou could make, Beiting couldn’t replicate it. If both sides had this thing, Emperor Jingwen didn’t dare to imagine what the scene would be like.
No wonder there were two supervisors even though there were only six people acting. At first, everyone thought Xiaojiu was too cautious and it was totally unlike his style. Now they all understood it at once, and even thought that sending two people was too few. One supervisor should be assigned to each person!
Seeing that Beiting’s generals were shot and killed one after another, Beiting’s army was gradually forced into a desperate situation by Generals Fang and Xu. In just a few months, Beiting had no way to retreat. Noticing that Beiting’s soldiers were gradually brewing murderous intentions because of fatigue and despair, Emperor Jingwen and others were sweating and couldn’t help but cheer up. They and Beiting’s soldiers witnessed the scene that seemed like the collapse of the sky.
The huge mountain collapsed by nearly half. Not to mention that the people of Beiting were frightened, even Emperor Taicheng and his men were frightened, and sweat oozed from their backs.
What is this? Did God finally get angry because he couldn’t stand it anymore?
But soon, with the firm voice of king Zuo Xian, Emperor Taicheng and his men understood that this was also the work of Xiaojiu.
So, what kind of monster did he give birth to?
Emperor Jingwen was puzzled. He really couldn’t figure out how he could make so many things. Could it be that Xiaojiu was a god from heaven?
Forgive Emperor Jingwen for being a native of ancient times. The only thing he thought of in his mind was this.
Just when everyone was in doubt, they saw the first Beiting soldier completely collapse and begin to rush towards the Broken Mountain desperately. In their opinion, the Broken Mountain was dangerous, and no matter how many unknowns there were behind the Broken Mountain, they were not as big as the threat brought to them by Emperor Zhou. If they didn’t run away at this time, they would really die.
With the first one, there will naturally be the second, third, fourth… countless, even the Zuo Xian Wang of Beiting, who could only leave with hatred in the end.
After this battle, the frightened Beiting would not dare to come back for at least thirty to fifty years. As for the longer time… it can only be said that the broken mountains are high and dangerous, and it is not easy to climb over.
In this way, the once glorious Beiting was destroyed.
Emperor Jingwen was in a trance, as if falling into a dream.
The second prince put his hand on his lips, pondered for a long time, and suddenly said: “Now, in the future history books, won’t Xiaojiu take the lead?”
Such achievements, the unification of the Three Kingdoms, even the founding emperor of the Zhou Dynasty cannot compare. It is better to say that because there has never been such a scene before, even if we continue to count up and gather all the emperors together, they are still slightly inferior to Xiaojiu. As for the latecomers, no matter what their achievements are, even if they surpass Xiaojiu later, they will become latecomers in comparison.
As the second prince said this, his eyes unconsciously began to glance at Emperor Jingwen.
The second prince thought, if I remember correctly, this is what my father cares about most in his life, right?
But, but, it feels like my father has worked hard and busy for most of his life, but in the end it was all in vain…
After he finished speaking, Emperor Jingwen’s expression froze. Obviously, he had thought of the same thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: Extra 16: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Normally, my father would have been among the best emperors in terms of ability and the living conditions of the people during his reign. Logically, in the distant future, my father would have left a strong mark in history books.
But the problem is, isn’t it just a coincidence that Xiaojiu appeared?
Compared with the achievements of unifying the world, my father’s deeds suddenly seemed insignificant. In addition, it was only a few years between the exchange of power between the two. Xiaojiu is only thirty years old now. He is now as bright as the sun, and my father has suddenly become a star. It’s not that the stars are bad, but the brilliance is not as dazzling as the sun, so it is destined to be covered.
My father worked hard for most of his life, but he was surpassed by others in a short time. All his previous efforts were in vain. It was really tragic…
The second prince had already thought of the picture that when future generations mentioned my father, they would inevitably add the phrase “father of Emperor Yongxi” at the end.
Even the second prince couldn’t help but feel sympathy. Tell me, who could have thought of this?
But this is not the worst. If we talk about the worst, it has to be the father and son sitting not far away. The emperor’s political achievements can at least be shown, but the sixth prince and his unlucky son are only worthy of carrying shoes for the emperor and the ninth prince in the history books.
Noticing the malicious look in the second prince’s teasing, Emperor Taicheng and his unlucky son seemed to have sensed it long ago. They turned their heads and stared at him intently.
Stare –
Emperor Taicheng dared to guarantee that if the second prince dared to say something mean, he would make the other party pay today!He was already suffocating enough being sandwiched between his father and the ninth prince, and the second prince immediately added fuel to the fire. Even Emperor Taicheng, who was a man of clay, could not hold it back, not to mention that he himself was not a good-tempered person.
The little emperor on the side clenched his fists, but then he thought that even his posthumous title was changed by the Ninth Emperor’s uncle against all odds, and that the group of civil and military officials didn’t take him seriously at all, so the little emperor couldn’t help but lose his temper.
Damn it, it’s really unacceptable!
But he also knew that even if he grew up safely, he would just repeat his father’s old path, and it would definitely be impossible for him to take Chen State and Beiting into his pockets as smoothly as the Ninth Emperor’s uncle did. Thinking of this, the little emperor suddenly let it go. Thinking about it carefully, it seems not bad.
The little emperor is probably the one who hopes for Ye Shuo the most out of all people. Even his biological father, Emperor Jingwen, sometimes can’t compare to him. After all, Emperor Jingwen is still upset about Ye Shuo’s desire for the princess to succeed to the throne. The little emperor accepts it well. First, because he is young and has a high degree of acceptance, and second, he simply thinks that as long as the Ninth Emperor’s uncle can get what he wants, it’s enough, and he doesn’t think so much at all. Since the Ninth Prince treated him like that, he naturally had to repay him.
In the end, it was Emperor Jingwen who interrupted the Second Prince who seemed to want to continue saying something: “You are so talkative, just look at yourself!”
Obviously, the father in front of him did not seem to be in a very good mood. After all, anyone who thought he had won the game and was overtaken by someone else would probably not be in a good mood.
But the one who overtook him was his most beloved youngest son. What could Emperor Jingwen do? As an old father, he could only forgive him with tears.
For a moment, there was a mixture of melancholy and pride between Emperor Jingwen’s brows, and there was also a bit of unwillingness and loss of soul… In short, it was quite complicated.
Originally thought that Beiting was destroyed, and now Xiaojiu should be quiet for a while, who would have thought that Xiaojiu was quiet, and Laoqi was causing trouble again.
Every day, no one is worry-free! If I had known, I would not have given birth to so many children!
Emperor Jingwen clearly noticed that the Seventh Prince was hiding, but the sudden change in his gaze made him feel headache and tired. As for Xiaojiu’s sudden announcement that Zou Wu would be the Minister of Works, Emperor Jingwen didn’t even think it was a big deal. 𝔯
How should I put it? Although they were surprised, it was also something that had been expected, so the reaction of the crowd was relatively calm.
The highlight was still the “female households” and “female officials” that Xiaojiu occasionally revealed in his words. Zou Wu was just an appetiser.
With Xiaojiu’s current status and his achievements that could blind people’s eyes, even if he issued such an outrageous decree, it would eventually be implemented smoothly. It can only be said that the timing he chose was really good. It just so happened that his reputation had reached its peak. Even if someone wanted to stop him, they couldn’t beat Xiaojiu’s iron-blooded hand.
Now they just have to wait for the right time.
Emperor Jingwen still remembered that the first thing Xiaojiu did after the fall of the State of Chen was to change Xiao Yejin’s posthumous title. Looking at Xiao Yejin’s bright eyes looking at the screen, Emperor Jingwen suspected that he didn’t hear what Xiaojiu said at all. Now he just blindly supports all his decisions. Even if his father wants to stop him, it’s not working. Emperor Jingwen simply didn’t expect him to speak for him at the beginning, otherwise he would be angry to death after seeing this scene!
As for the seventh son, his son has always been smart and is not inferior to other brothers. He suddenly changed his attitude now. It is estimated that he saw through Xiaojiu’s plan like his other brothers, so he felt that he had another chance, so he was secretly preparing to wait for the opportunity.
Therefore, when he heard that Prince Su and Prince Jin opposed Xiaojiu taking the three princesses to Mount Tai, the seventh prince immediately came out to express his support, and on behalf of Xiaojiu, he refuted Prince Su and Prince Jin. Emperor Jingwen and others were really not surprised at all.
Follow Xiaojiu’s wishes, and then like a poisonous snake lurking in the bushes waiting for its prey, once Xiaojiu reveals a flaw, kill him immediately, right?
Wait, does this strategy look too familiar?
Emperor Jingwen looked at Emperor Taicheng, then at Ye Xun who was silent, and couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
So they were secretly…
They want to learn from each other, right? From Emperor Taicheng dealing with the crown prince, to Ye Xun dealing with Ye Jin, and then the Seventh Prince dealing with Xiao Jiu, they are simply from the same background, and can only be said to be brothers/nephews.
But if you think about it carefully, if you want to seek a high position from a low position, and want to be rich with bare hands, it seems that there is only one way to wait patiently. These people are smart in the same way.
As for why Xiao Jiu can turn a blind eye, it is even simpler. Although the Seventh Prince has the intention of rebellion, hasn’t he really started yet? What’s more, Xiao Jiu knows in his heart that the other party does not have this ability at all. By grasping the Seventh Prince, Xiao Jiu may be able to clear a lot of obstacles.
Sure enough, being smart is still useful. If someone else were to come, such as the Fifth Prince, it would be strange for Xiao Jiu to be so indifferent. First, his personality is not suitable. The Fifth Prince has always acted illogically since he was a child. He is really too uncontrollable. Who knows, one day he might take a knife and fight with the three princesses to decide the winner. Second, his brain is not suitable. Thinking of this, only the Seventh Prince can be chosen among all people.
The Seventh Prince also knows it clearly, so when facing Xiao Jiu, he does not hide it at all.
Looking at the two people who seemed to be walking on a tightrope, Emperor Jingwen was silent, so why bother? Xiao Jiu refused to challenge the difficulty of giving birth to a prince. He likes excitement in this life, right?
While Emperor Jingwen was thinking, Xiao Jiu’s Fengshan ceremony ended very successfully.
Looking at the vast civil and military ministers and the people, although they have seen many such scenes, Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng still couldn’t help but feel sour in their hearts.
It was really grand… a scene that was more grand than the coronation ceremony, which was simply the ultimate dream of all emperors.
As things developed to this point, Xiaojiu had done everything he had done before, and he had also done everything he had not done before. Just thinking about it really made people yearn for it.
Emperor Jingwen sighed deeply.
After the Fengshan ceremony, the next thing was to go to sea.
When Emperor Jingwen learned about this, his first reaction was: How could a weak woman like Jianjian endure this hardship? !
However, when he saw Jianjian again, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but “hiss”. Who is this woman? How come she is as dark as the charcoal sticks used in winter?
After all, they had been training by the water for half a year, and the sun was scorching by the water. As a normal person, it was normal for Jianjian to get tanned.
The skin that was slightly darker than wheat colour was a symbol of health and strength in Jianjian’s eyes, but in the eyes of Emperor Jingwen, who always thought that women with white skin like jade were beautiful, it was simply unbearable.
Strange, it was really too strange.
Seeing that she accepted her current appearance very naturally, Emperor Jingwen could not accept it at all. Noticing Jianjian’s carefree smile that was different from that of ordinary ladies, he felt even worse. Wasn’t it that the beautiful princess he gave birth to with the most beautiful imperial concubine in Beijing? How could she be harmed by her brother like this? ?
If I remember correctly, Jianjian is still unmarried, right? What is Xiaojiu doing?
The prince on the side had a strange look in his eyes when he heard this. As a former prince, he had seen much more than his other brothers when he was young. At that time, many people tried to seduce him to make mistakes with beauty, so the prince was still a little sensitive about love.
The prince had noticed earlier that when the screen switched to Jianjian, there was something wrong with the men in the corner of the screen. If it was just one or two, it would be fine, and the prince would just think it was a coincidence. If there were more, it would be hard to explain. In addition, those men were all good-looking in both appearance and figure, and they were able to get close to Jianjian. Did he need to tell them what they were used for?
Although my father lived much longer than me, his hobbies were always quite normal. Perhaps it was because his hobbies were too normal that the people below never dared to let my father know about those messy things, for fear of making him unhappy. In particular, my father rarely paid attention to other princesses except Jianjian, and the other princesses married and had children normally. It was normal for my father to not guess for a while.
But seeing that the second prince seemed to be about to react, if the second prince reacted and my father was still unaware, I was afraid that my father would lose face.
The prince couldn’t help but cough lightly when thinking this, then lowered his voice, and said something to Emperor Jingwen in a low voice, suppressing his embarrassment.
Emperor Jingwen was stunned at first, then his eyes widened, and then… Emperor Jingwen’s face turned ashen.

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Extra 17: The Underworld
chapters.content:
“This, this, this… How can this be? A girl, simply, simply…”
Emperor Jingwen’s voice was mixed with a hint of shock and shame, but after all, it was his daughter’s private life, so Emperor Jingwen was too embarrassed to finish his words, and just pointed at the screen not far away with a trembling hand.
Thinking that neither he nor the previous two generations had such an extraordinary princess, and recalling the lovely Jianjian at the time, Emperor Jingwen almost couldn’t breathe.
However, the moment the voice fell, Emperor Jingwen saw that other people not only did not agree with his words, but looked at him with a rather strange look.
In the end, it was the second prince who put down the snacks in his hand and said a fair word: “After all, Jianjian is now the eldest princess, Xiaojiu’s only sister.”
The emperor’s biological sister, one of the most noble people in the Great Zhou, in terms of closeness, even Prince Ding had to retreat to a place of one shot. With such an identity, let alone raising a few concubines, as long as she didn’t poke a hole in the sky and as long as Xiaojiu didn’t speak, others would have to hold back even if they were dissatisfied.
Moreover, there are not a few princesses who have been romantic and dissolute in history. With the power held by Xiaojiu and Jianjian’s current status, there is no need to sacrifice herself to win over others. From this point of view, it seems understandable that Jianjian’s daily life is a little bit out of the ordinary.
I just didn’t expect that my father would be such a conservative person. I didn’t see it before.
Noticing that none of them seemed surprised by this sudden speculation, as if all this was taken for granted, even the youngest little emperor nodded repeatedly, thinking that the second uncle’s words made sense, and didn’t think there was anything wrong at all, Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help choking.
Similarly, Emperor Jingwen didn’t expect that his children would play so happily in private.Come to think of it, the prince has been watched by countless eyes since he was a child, and there are countless people who want to pull him down. Although he himself has no preference in this regard, he has seen a lot and has long been accustomed to it. What’s more, this is just the beginning? For him, he doesn’t even have the qualifications to be looked at sideways.
As for Emperor Taicheng, he only has supreme power in his mind. As for how a person is in private, he doesn’t care at all.
The Fourth Prince is a rare serious person, but seriousness is serious, he is not old-fashioned. In the past, he would occasionally play some fun with his wives and concubines, but he died too early, and he didn’t know how he treated his wives, concubines and children now, alas.
The Fourth Prince couldn’t help but sigh.
The words of the Second Prince… Is there any need to say the words of the Second Prince? ! From his words and deeds, it can be known that this guy is probably as unrefined as he is in private. In addition, he has repeatedly hit a wall with the Crown Prince. With nowhere to vent, he probably doesn’t even know the taboos of meat and vegetables.
Seeing that the others subconsciously looked at him, the Second Prince smiled and asked back: “What’s wrong?”
The other party looked confused, as if the rumours they heard were all false.
Noticing his expression at the moment, everyone thought about it. After all, they didn’t tell everyone what they heard when they were alive. Even the emperor couldn’t accept that Jianjian had several concubines. As for the mess that the second prince did in private, they thought it was better to forget it. From this point of view, Emperor Jingwen was the most normal among all the people. Ṙ
When Emperor Jingwen was young, he had to rely on the late emperor to survive. He was walking on thin ice every day. It was difficult for him to survive. How could he have time to do these things? In addition, the late emperor never took his son seriously, so naturally, other people would not take Emperor Jingwen, the prince, seriously. Over time, without anyone teaching him, Emperor Jingwen avoided some things smoothly.
The previous emperor was stupid and fond of beauty. Emperor Jingwen suffered greatly from it and naturally hated it. Under such a rejection mentality, he did not develop any bad habits. On the contrary, his group of sons, no matter how fiercely they fought in private, were much better than the previous emperor. And the good life was too comfortable, so it was natural to think about finding some excitement. Isn’t it natural?
From the crown prince to the sixth, Emperor Jingwen opened his mouth slightly.
For a moment, he began to wonder if he was old and could not keep up with the ideas of young people.
The second prince felt that his father should be content. After all, Xiaojiu had only indulged Jianjian’s little hobby so far, and Queen Mother Wei herself did not have this idea. Otherwise, with Xiaojiu’s feelings for his mother, his father would have been cheated on for many times.
…Wait, did his father really not turn green?
You must know that some things do not necessarily have to happen between men and women to be called out of line, men and men, women and women, men and women, women and men…Ahem, I’m getting off topic.
The second prince fell into deep thought.
Fortunately, the second prince knew the importance of the matter. No matter how stupid he was, he could not say what was in his heart. Fortunately, Emperor Jingwen did not know what his unlucky son was thinking, otherwise he would have been angry to death.
In the end, Jianjian went out to sea under the unfavourable eyes of others.
Seeing that she had grown into a different appearance without his care, he could not help but feel a little lost.
Originally, he had planned to find a good husband for Jianjian…
Emperor Taicheng also suddenly remembered that the dowry he had sent before his death might not be useful.
But then he immediately realised one thing, why was Xiaojiu so sure that there must be something he wanted overseas? It was the same with Lucheng Rice at the beginning. If he was not sure, he would not have spent a lot of money to let people find it.
It seems that his younger brother still has a lot of secrets.
Emperor Taicheng’s eyebrows moved, as if thinking about something.
Soon, the prince and others also began to touch their chins at the same time.
Ye Shuo, who had no idea that his biggest secret was about to be revealed by a certain projection, was currently making plans.
The trip has come to a critical moment.
After Jianjian left, some rumours soon spread in Shangjing City, saying that the Great Zhou’s territory was expanding, there was a shortage of talents, and a large number of fresh blood was needed to fill the vacancies. In this way, the next imperial examination would be crucial.
The ministers who were originally wavering suddenly changed. Smart people have almost guessed the intention of the emperor by now, and naturally want to seize the opportunity.
Soon, there was a wave of women reading in Shangjing and even across the country.
“Ah, it seems that everyone is led by Xiaojiu by the nose.” The second prince couldn’t help but sigh.
The fourth prince pursed his lips, “This can’t be helped.”
If it’s not me, it will be someone else. How can those smart people let themselves fall behind? When it is obvious that they can’t kill Xiaojiu with just this rumoured news, they can only passively or actively let Xiaojiu manipulate them.
Xiaojiu kept saying that she was just a princess, but his actions were completely opposite to what he said.
True and false, false and true, when everyone reacts, it will be too late.
Sure enough, if you want to judge a person, you can’t just look at what he says, but also look at what he does. Words can deceive people, but actions never can.
After the gang of people above had already done enough, the time was almost right. Three years later, Jianjian came back and joined forces with Zou Wu to give opponents a loud slap in the face, which made it impossible to refute. Sure enough, it worked…
From Zou Wu’s assistance in completely defeating Beiting and becoming the Minister of Works, to Jianjian’s return from the sea, Xiaojiu took the two of them as an excuse to propose the female official system, which was progressive and exciting.
Seeing that Prince Ding seemed to be trying to stop it in the picture, Emperor Jingwen suddenly had hope, but… But in the blink of an eye, Prince Ding was persuaded to retreat by Prince Qi, and the female official issue was set in stone.
Emperor Jingwen’s expression froze.
No, what’s wrong with this old seventh? Didn’t you agree to steal Xiaojiu’s kingdom? How can you help so sincerely?
And the eldest brother is the same. After his son has a promising future, he doesn’t care about the lives of others, right? Do you still have any awareness of being the leader of the royal family?
Facts have proved that there is no such thing at all. What does it have to do with them what others do in the future? They just need to get the benefits now.
When this day finally came, Emperor Jingwen gave up completely.
In addition to the female official system, seeing that Xiaojiu seemed to be planning to take action against the aristocratic families, even Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but want to say “you are so brave”. How can the aristocratic families that have monopolised the country for a hundred years be so easy to deal with?
However, Xiaojiu is so desperate almost every time. After so many times, Emperor Taicheng and others are used to it, but they don’t know how he is going to do it specifically.
Soon, Emperor Taicheng and others saw the new paper and pen that Xiaojiu had prepared long ago. Of course, the most important thing is the printing technology.
The reason why the noble families were able to form a monopoly was because paper and pens were expensive and ordinary people could not afford them. As time went by, more and more books flowed into the pockets of the noble families and were firmly held in their hands. It was easy to tamper with them, or to deliberately distort and quote them out of context to control the thoughts of the scholars. As a result, the power of the noble families became increasingly huge and could not be easily shaken.
But now, the monopoly of the noble families on knowledge and learning is finally coming to an end.
Seeing the ugly expressions of the heads of the noble families, Emperor Jingwen and others just found it funny. These people who relied on their own knowledge to enslave the scholars desperately, actually have today.
As the noble families were heading towards the end of their ways, once the barriers of knowledge were broken, it became much easier for ordinary people to read and write.
As the cost of reading and writing decreased, there were more and more female students, which was also very helpful for the system of female officials. In addition, Xiaojiu specially opened a course on kung fu and internal strength, and the physical strength gap between men and women began to gradually narrow. In the blink of an eye, more than ten years had passed. Seeing that there were more and more women in the court, Emperor Jingwen had no choice even if he didn’t want to give up.
Although women only account for 20% of the 100 ministers, it is obvious that the future that Xiaojiu has imagined has already taken shape. In addition, Xiaojiu is still in good health, so waiting for another ten or eight years is not a problem. After ten or eight years, it will be more than that.
Emperor Jingwen watched Xiaojiu kill batches of people over the years, and also mowed down many people by the way, just like pruning a landscape tree slowly and ruthlessly. This landscape tree finally has the look he wants.
Now the voice of resistance is getting weaker and weaker. Seeing that the time is almost up, everyone seems to be looking forward to something. Dingning, who has already grown up, found Xiaojiu and named the young master of Xuanping Marquis’s family, preparing to have a few children with him.
After listening to the many reasons why Dingning chose the other party, Emperor Jingwen immediately spurted out a mouthful of tea.
What skeleton children will also be relatively small and easier to give birth, what obedient and sensible… Listen, listen, does this sound like what a woman should say?

chapters.title: Chapter 362: Extra 18: The Underworld
chapters.content:
Then he thought that Dingning was going to be the emperor soon, so it seemed that it was nothing.
Emperor Jingwen took a deep, deep breath.
Dingning kept her word, and once she had this idea, it would soon come to fruition.
Watching her grow up from a little child to now, and about to get married and have children, the prince and others felt very complicated for a while.
“Time flies so fast…” The prince couldn’t help but sigh.
Everyone was in a trance, and realised that decades had passed in the blink of an eye.
They witnessed Dingning’s wedding ceremony from beginning to end, and then looked at Xiaojiu sitting in front of the hall. They didn’t know when they were no longer young, and the corners of their eyes and eyebrows had added some fine lines with the passage of time. Looking at their very young selves, everyone was stunned for a moment, and then suddenly thought of one thing-
it is known that after death, when you become a ghost, you will always remain in the state of your life. If you die at a certain age, you will become a ghost at that age. Doesn’t this mean that if Xiaojiu and his friends live long enough, when their souls return to the underworld one day, they will probably be older than their father?
Emperor Taicheng couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows slightly, with great interest.
The little emperor smacked his lips, wow, the grandfather version of the Ninth Uncle? It sounds good.As for Emperor Jingwen, he couldn’t help but show his disdain, who would want a son older than himself?
The scene over there continued –
after the wedding ceremony, in just two or three months, Dingning became pregnant smoothly as planned at the beginning. It can only be said that fortunately Xiaojiu was in good health and lived long enough to easily survive Dingning’s delivery period. If any of these were missing, he would not be able to do what he wanted to do. After all, even if the whole court agreed to the princess’s ascension to the throne, they would never allow a princess without an heir to ascend the throne. Otherwise, if the princess encountered an accident later, it would be a disaster for the country.
Therefore, under such circumstances, the child in Dingning’s belly is very important. If the child is born smoothly and the mother and child are safe, it will be fine. If there is any problem in the middle, everything will be over, and all Xiaojiu’s previous efforts will also fail.
The prince saw this and couldn’t help but sweat for Xiaojiu.
The Emperor Jingwen, who also saw the scene, snorted coldly: “Even if there was an accident, it was all his own fault. He deserved it.”
Although he said so, he didn’t even blink when he looked at the screen again, and his fingers kept twisting. Obviously, his mood was not as calm as he showed.
Everyone has long been accustomed to his father’s duplicity.
As everyone expected, since the news of Dingning’s pregnancy spread, she soon encountered waves of assassinations. At the same time, the list that Xiaojiu recorded behind his back became clearer and clearer.
Unlike the vague state before, Xiaojiu’s tendency is now obvious enough. Anyone who is not a fool can almost see it. Then those who have different intentions gradually surfaced.
Even if a person is calm, facing the current situation, I am afraid that he can’t sit still.
When seeing that there were several important figures in Xiaojiu’s records who could not be easily touched, Emperor Taicheng could not help but frown, wondering how Xiaojiu would deal with these people. Unlike those small shrimps before, if these few people were not handled properly, they would probably cause a disaster.
Just when Emperor Taicheng was distracted thinking about these things, the entire princess’s mansion had been quietly guarded by the secret guards. During the period, no one was alarmed, but the princess’s mansion was surrounded like an iron barrel. The leader was Wu Yi’s disciple, the current leader of the secret guards. Such a lineup is luxurious.
Seeing this scene, everyone couldn’t help but twitch their mouths. How could they forget Xiaojiu’s amazing desire for control? It would be strange if he didn’t do something at this time. �
But they didn’t expect that Xiaojiu would not only treat them like this, but also his own children. There was no change at all in all these years. It can be seen that some of a person’s personality is engraved in their bones, and I’m afraid it can’t be changed in this life.
So, without realizing it, Dingning and the others worked together and finally made it to the last moment. Even if Xiaojiu was very capable, he could not do anything under such circumstances.
It was about a woman’s childbirth, even if the other party was his own daughter, Xiaojiu could only watch helplessly.
Just when everyone thought that he should be quiet for a while this time, they saw Xiaojiu pacing around the hall for a long time in the picture, with messy steps. It was obvious that he was not calm at the moment. Then, Xiaojiu seemed to have thought of something, took a deep breath, lifted his robe, and strode out of the hall door.
…No way, can he even think of a good way to do this?
When everyone was hesitating, they saw Xiaojiu walking quickly towards…the Hall of Supreme Harmony?
Everyone: “…”
I understand, this is really because there is no way out, so he came to pray to the gods.
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but snorted coldly: “For all the things he did, it would be strange if the ancestors could bless him. He really has no idea at all.”
However, Xiaojiu is so anxious now, they don’t believe that their father is not moved at all.
After all, that is the youngest son that their father holds in his heart!
The eyes of the prince and others can’t help but shift to the face of Emperor Jingwen, causing Emperor Jingwen’s face to twitch for a while. Guessing what the prince and others were thinking, he immediately said: “Impossible, don’t think about it!”
Impossible is impossible, he will absolutely not agree to this!
Seeing that his father’s attitude is still firm, although the prince and others don’t quite believe it, they still set their eyes on Emperor Taicheng again.
The tablets of the emperors of the Great Zhou Dynasty are enshrined in the Hall of Supreme Harmony. People like them are not qualified to enter at all. Among all the people present, only the tablets of the father and the sixth brother were placed there. Xiaojiu can also ask for help.
There were only the two of them.
The ignored little emperor was hesitant to speak, although, please don’t ignore him so naturally!
However, the little emperor didn’t think that the Ninth Emperor’s uncle would remember him at this time. After all, more than 20 years have passed. He, who has only been the emperor for a year, has been forgotten by others…
Especially since the Ninth Emperor’s uncle is his elder, it is even more impossible for him to ask for help from his nephew. Even if the palace servants and eunuchs go to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to sweep the floor on weekdays, they often forget his existence in the corner.
The little emperor suddenly felt a little discouraged when thinking about this.
Emperor Taicheng, who did not notice his son’s abnormality, didn’t want to care about this at all. His own family affairs were a mess, so how could he have time to worry about others?
Xiaojiu had already walked in front of a group of tablets and called the palace servants to ask for a lot of tributes and incense. Xiaojiu’s eyes first swept through the highest tablets one by one. Perhaps he felt that he was not familiar with them at all, so his eyes quickly moved down and then fell on the tablet he was most familiar with.
When Emperor Jingwen saw that the first person he looked at was him, his heart moved, but he snorted coldly.
Before Emperor Jingwen could speak, he heard him say: “Forget it, if my father knew what I was going to do, he would jump out of the imperial mausoleum.”
He was quite self-aware!
Emperor Jingwen almost laughed out of anger.
In the picture, Xiaojiu shook his head, and then looked at Emperor Taicheng. Emperor Taicheng had never known that Xiaojiu had such deep feelings for him before. Even he couldn’t help but be moved at this moment.
Then, everyone watched Xiaojiu insert the incense stick in his hand into… the incense burner belonging to Xiao Yejin under Emperor Taicheng’s tablet.
Emperor Jingwen: “…”
Emperor Taicheng: “…”
Ah, everyone thought it was wrong…
Noticing that the little emperor’s eyes suddenly lit up, the prince leaned back in his chair and smiled: “As expected of Xiaojiu, you haven’t changed at all.”
This kind of thing, only Xiaojiu can do.
The fourth prince also said, “It seems that Xiaojiu knows you well.”
Knowing that even if there are gods and monsters in the world, his father and the sixth prince will not sincerely bless him, he simply found another way and found Xiao Yejin. And looking at Xiao Yejin’s appearance, he is naturally very happy.
The expressions of Emperor Jingwen and Emperor Taicheng suddenly looked bad.
The little emperor didn’t care about that at all. Seeing that the ninth uncle had never forgotten him, he only asked for his help when something happened. Although he didn’t know whether it would work, he still closed his eyes and put his hands together to pray. That look, even ten Jingwen emperors and Taicheng emperors combined, would not be as sincere as him.
Seeing that Xiaojiu put all the tributes in front of the small tablet in the picture, a lot of gold and silver treasures appeared around Xiao Yejin in a short while.
Looking at the piles of shiny gold ingots and various dishes and cakes, the prince and others were silent.
Suddenly, the youngest child among them became the richest one among all of them.
And it is not known whether it was the prayers of the little emperor that worked, or because Dingning herself inherited his parents’ genes, Dingning’s first child finally came to the world smoothly.
Perhaps it was because the child was born under his own blessing, the little emperor simply liked it more and more. By the way, this should be his first nephew, right? So now he is finally an elder.
Fortunately, the prince and others did not know what the little emperor was thinking. If they knew, they would probably say that they are really grandfather and grandson, and their double standards are exactly the same. In the eyes of the father, the sons after Xiaojiu are not considered sons, and in the mind of Xiao Yejin, other sons and nephews are not considered sons and nephews. The two are simply amazing!
Watching Xiaojiu holding the little baby girl in his arms and giving her the surname “Ye” under the witness of civil and military officials, no matter how dissatisfied he was in his heart, Emperor Jingwen’s face was better than before.
Many years passed like this, and then An Ning and Yong Ning also got married one after another. Seeing that there were more and more children in the palace, they were also competing for the position of heir, but Xiao Jiu never encountered the cruel scene of siblings killing each other from beginning to end, let alone worrying about the position under his buttocks being coveted by others. From this point of view, the gap between the princess and the prince is not small.
Seeing that the three princesses Ding Ning, An Ning and Yong Ning always defended that line no matter how fiercely they fought, Emperor Jingwen and others couldn’t help but feel complicated.
Looking at Xiao Jiu, who was becoming more and more free and stable, Emperor Jingwen and others looked indifferent. Although Xiao Jiu always did things so out of the ordinary, judging from the results, he was indeed the best among all of them, even in the later years of Emperor Jingwen, there was no comparison.
Just when the prince and others were feeling emotional, the seventh prince rebelled.
Everyone

chapters.title: Chapter 363: Extra 19: The Underworld
chapters.content:
“No, Old Seven is crazy?” The fourth prince blurted out, but then he found that something seemed wrong.
The second prince pondered for a moment, his eyes showed understanding, and then he smiled: “I see.”
Even among the brothers, Old Seven’s brain is first-class, he can’t fail to see that it is too late to do anything now, unless… he has a reason to do it.
Sure enough, the scene soon switched to the Seventh Prince’s Mansion. Noticing Old Seven’s obviously abnormal face and the bowl of soup beside him, everyone’s heart suddenly paused.
So that’s it, Old Seven is sick, and the disease is very serious, otherwise he can’t choose to do it now.
Calculating the time, Old Seven is now more than 60 years old, which is considered a long life. After all, his father was about this age when he died. In comparison, those who live to 70 or 80 or even older are very few.
Looking at the white-haired Seventh Prince now, and thinking of Xiao Jiu who is still energetic every day despite being over 60 years old, the more people think about it, the more they feel something is wrong.
Isn’t Xiaojiu’s vitality too strong? He has been tirelessly fond of tossing since he was a child. If they remember correctly, the old Duke Zhenguo lived to be over 90 years old before he died.
Originally, everyone thought that the word “gene” that Xiaojiu said from time to time was just nonsense, and no one took it seriously before. Now it seems that it is not the case.
Is there really such a saying?Among them, Emperor Taicheng frowned the most. Just when everyone was in doubt, Xiaojiu’s carriage finally slowly stopped at the door of the Seventh Prince’s Mansion.
That’s right, the Seventh Prince is Xiaojiu’s brother after all. Now that he is seriously ill, Xiaojiu naturally wants to visit him.
Noticing the strange expression of the Seventh Prince when he saw Xiaojiu, combined with the previous scene of a well-trained soldier pretending to be a bandit, the prince and others couldn’t help but smack their lips, thinking that the son of the Seventh Prince was too arrogant, and he would have a hard time in the future.
Especially the crown prince, who finally met someone who was even more outrageous than his own son, and he felt much better.
Anyone with a discerning eye could see that this was probably the best son of the Seventh Prince. Even his gentle and harmless appearance could not suppress his ambition. He would not give up no matter what when he saw a little hope. It was evident that power could move people’s hearts and make a rational person go crazy little by little, until he would either be successful or fall off a cliff.
The crown prince and his friends felt that this prince was not far from the second possibility.
By the way, this prince would not really think that his father was so powerful, right? He fought back and forth with the three princesses under Xiaojiu’s nose. Did he think Xiaojiu was blind? In this way, he was too careless. Sure enough, since their elders died one after another, it was probably because they had lived a stable life for too long, and the remaining royal children were worse than the previous generation.
Thinking of this, everyone shook their heads.
However, the prince in the picture was completely unaware. After respectfully inviting Xiaojiu into the room, he tactfully withdrew and stood outside the door in a very polite manner.
Judging from his appearance and behaviour, this prince is qualified.
As Xiaojiu and the sick Seventh Prince recalled the past, everyone’s memories were involuntarily pulled back to decades ago. Seeing the two talking about the father and the sixth prince, and finally the prince, they couldn’t help but sigh. ṙ�
“…It’s been so long, it’s hard for them to still remember what I did.” After a while, the prince put down the folding fan in his hand and let out a long breath.
Emperor Taicheng and others looked at him and didn’t say anything. The second prince even showed a smile on his face.
What they didn’t say was that no matter what the prince’s ending was, for a long time, the prince was also a mountain that they yearned for, but they couldn’t get over it anyway.
Even if he finally became the emperor as he wished, Emperor Taicheng couldn’t forget it.
Originally, everyone was just guessing, but when they heard the Seventh Prince’s words [“It’s a pity that he is not as good as the three princesses after all.”], they were almost certain.
Although the Seventh Prince and Xiaojiu had never revealed it, they did reach a certain agreement in silence. As for the content of the agreement, they could almost guess it.
Unfortunately, until now, the prince knew nothing about it, which doomed him to failure.
Regarding the power transfer, the atmosphere in the small courtyard became a little serious as the two people talked more and more tacitly, but soon, the Seventh Prince’s words suddenly broke this seriousness. The Seventh Prince’s words [“If there is a chance in the next life, I really hope to be your child. Even if it is not a prince, I will accept it as a princess.”] can be said to be resounding.
The small courtyard fell into silence in an instant. Even if they didn’t stretch their necks to look forward, several people could probably guess how bad their father’s expression was now.
The prince and the others originally thought it was very funny. After all, it was too funny for the Seventh Prince to say such things with wrinkles all over his face. But after thinking about it for a while, they gradually stopped laughing.
Suddenly, they felt that… what the Seventh Prince said made sense!
From an outsider’s point of view, Xiaojiu might be a weirdo. After all, he would do some jaw-dropping things from time to time, which was really a headache. But from the perspective of the princesses, Xiaojiu was almost doing his best to plan for their future, and polishing them bit by bit, patiently and meticulously. He was neither too relaxed nor too nervous, but enough to make them grow into a qualified emperor. All the things they learned in the past few decades were enough for them to resist most of the risks in the future.
Compared with the Gu-raising model of the old man, the father, it can be said that there is a world of difference. This person is like a biological child.
… Oops, oh no, why am I suddenly a little moved? The Seventh Prince is indeed a little better than them.
Having lived for decades, these eyes can see through everything.
Noticing that the Fourth Prince and the others looked different, Emperor Jingwen always felt something was wrong: “… What are you thinking about?”
Seeing his father looking over, the Fourth Prince and the others shook their heads in unison, saying seriously: “Nothing.”
Fortunately, Xiaojiu refused later. For some reason, the Crown Prince and the others were relieved.
After all, how could such a good thing be monopolised by the Seventh Prince!
Perhaps because he knew that this was the last time the two would meet, the Seventh Prince finally tried to retain him.
[“Your Majesty, for the sake of our past relationship, please send me off for the last time.”]
Faced with the Seventh Prince’s last request, Xiaojiu naturally would not refuse.
And when everyone watched Xiaojiu drink the cup of tea, the reactions of several people were also different.
The Crown Prince and the Fourth Prince frowned subconsciously, thinking that Xiaojiu was too careless. Even if the Seventh Prince was now terminally ill, he should not be so unguarded. After all, the Seventh Prince was still making other plans, wasn’t he?
The Second Prince and Emperor Taicheng were thinking, so that’s how it is. When Xiaojiu drank the cup of tea, the Seventh Prince had to be cruel no matter how reluctant he was.
Both sides spoke almost in unison, but the answers they got were completely opposite. The Crown Prince and the Fourth Prince were stunned, and finally reacted.
“Is Xiaojiu… reminding the Seventh Prince that it’s time to take action?”
Without waiting for the Second Prince and Emperor Taicheng to answer, the Fourth Prince and the Crown Prince already had the answer in their hearts, and then, the two of them twitched their mouths uncontrollably.
How to say it, when it comes to insidiousness, it’s really them!
And Xiaojiu, who unknowingly learned the style of the Sixth Prince and the others. Or maybe he knew it from the beginning to the end, but he just never used it.
This cup of tea is like a signal, indicating that everything in the Seventh Prince’s Mansion is under Xiaojiu’s control. How to say it, it was the Seventh Prince who wanted to make trouble at the beginning, but in the end he was played by Xiaojiu. The Seventh Prince realised that something was wrong and wanted to withdraw, but it was too late.
At this point, the Seventh Prince had no choice but to bite the bullet.
As expected, the Seventh Prince’s son’s rebellion was soon discovered by Dingning and others. The Second Prince seriously suspected that this was actually part of the teaching. Xiaojiu did not intervene directly this time, but watched Dingning and others’ actions very calmly. Until the end, with Dingning and others’ orderly actions, the Second Prince and others clearly saw Xiaojiu in the picture breathe a sigh of relief, as if he had put down a burden, and showed an unprecedented relaxed smile.
As for some people who died inexplicably in the middle, it can only be said that it is no longer important.
The final ending ended with the Seventh Prince killing his own son. Looking at the extremely tragic scene in the picture, even Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help but gasp.
“…It’s really cruel.” Even the Second Prince felt cold in his heart.
Emperor Taicheng knew that if the Seventh Prince did not do this, there would be more people who died in the end. Since it was obvious that he could not get that position, he would pick out the children with delusions and get rid of them, so that the remaining honest and decent children could be preserved.
Having ambition is a good thing, but having ambition without great ability is just a burden, just like a flower that suddenly blooms in the grass. What the Seventh Prince has to do is to take the initiative to pick this flower that should not have appeared.
As for the Fifth Prince and the Eighth Prince who have been watching with great enthusiasm, don’t look at them laughing happily now, as if everything has nothing to do with them. After a few years, they will die one after another. If their sons don’t have such ambitions, it will be fine. If one of them has bad intentions, whether their bloodline can continue to be preserved is still a problem.
Now that Xiaojiu, the biological brother, is still there, everything’s still fine. When Xiaojiu doesn’t care about things, it will be the turn of Dingning and others whose bloodline is even thinner to make the decision. That will not be a problem that can be solved by the death of one person.
However, if the Fifth Prince and the Eighth Prince had this brain, they would not be in such a state now.
Just as Emperor Taicheng shook his head and sighed, the Seventh Prince, who had just committed suicide in an extremely tragic way, appeared in front of everyone.
Looking at the stunned old man in front of him, Emperor Jingwen smiled and said, “You and Xiaojiu are a good match.”
Looking at the brothers who had died many years ago sitting there neatly, and looking at the screen playing in front of them, what is there for the Seventh Prince to not understand?
Could it be that these people have been watching what happened in the world all the time? ?
Thinking of this, the Seventh Prince had no time to feel sorry for his failure. After reacting, cold sweat “swish” came out. If so, doesn’t it mean that they already know what he did?
The Seventh Prince raised his head with a stiff neck, and then heard the prince’s words: “The reason why Dingning was able to ascend the throne in the end was that you, the Seventh Brother, made an indispensable contribution.”
“Good job, really good.”
The Seventh Prince: “…”
With the words of someone unknown on the screen [ In March of the following year, the spring was bright and beautiful, and the eldest princess ascended the throne and was named Ming’an ], Emperor Jingwen could no longer hold back, picked up the broom next to him and beat the Seventh Prince wildly.
Poor Seventh Prince, he is old, but still can’t escape the fate of being taught a lesson by his own father.
Just as the Seventh Prince was unable to dodge and screamed, another familiar ghost suddenly pushed the door open and walked in. Then, his voice like a huge bell echoed in everyone’s ears –
“Decades have passed, everyone, it’s time to reincarnate.”
Everyone’s heart tightened when they heard this.
Although it’s almost time, after all, even if there are many ghosts stranded in the underworld, after decades, it should be their turn, but… the person they have been waiting for has not come yet!
Emperor Jingwen paused, then suddenly turned back to look in the direction of the Wangchuan River –
as expected, there was still nothing there.
Up to now, the group of ghosts who should have swum across the river today have already disembarked two hours ago.
And in the picture, Xiaojiu is still alive and well.
It’s too late…

chapters.title: Chapter 364: Extra 20: Modern
chapters.content:
Emperor Jingwen wanted to ask the King of Hell to be flexible, but the rules of the underworld cannot be broken. When the time is up, those who are stranded here should leave.
Even though Emperor Jingwen and others were unwilling, they had no choice.
After taking back the projection, the King of Hell couldn’t help thinking that this thing was really useful. It could make a group of people who were restless at first glance behave themselves for decades. It seemed that it could be vigorously promoted.
Emperor Jingwen and others had already followed the guidance of the ghost messenger and came to Mengpo Bridge. While waiting, perhaps to relieve the tension, the fourth prince couldn’t help but ask: “Everyone, have you thought about what you want to do in your next life?”
He was afraid that he was confused. How could they decide such a thing?
The prince looked at the fourth prince strangely.
However, unexpectedly, the ghost messenger who had been silent actually answered.
“It’s not allowed, but there are exceptions.”
For example, the ghost messenger’s eyes could not help but fall on the ghosts in front of him. It was because they had a good brother/son. Emperor Yongxi was a person from another world, with deep blessings and immeasurable merits. As the saying goes, if one person gets the Tao, all his family members will rise to heaven. Well, although these people in front of him were not chickens and dogs, it was undoubted that they could be protected by him. In addition, they were not ordinary people. Therefore, as long as they were not from a family with deep blessings, they could choose any ordinary family.
There was only one Emperor Yongxi in this world for thousands of years, so this was the only exception. The underworld has always been tolerant of ghosts whose blessings have not been exhausted. In addition, they would know nothing after drinking a bowl of Meng Po soup. Therefore, the ghost messenger did not care much and answered casually.The moment the voice fell, Emperor Taicheng subconsciously held his son’s hand.
In fact, Emperor Taicheng did not have any hope before, but now if possible, he hoped that Ye Jin could be reincarnated as his son in the next life.
In this life, I really owed him a lot.
The second prince couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows when he heard this: “Even if we want to be born in the same family and continue to be brothers, is that okay?”
The ghost turned over the record book in his hand, and after a moment, he nodded: “Okay.”
Then the ghost added: “If you want.”
Everyone fell silent in an instant. The second prince looked inexplicable, and he didn’t know what he was thinking. After a while, seeing that the team was about to reach the end, he suddenly smiled and said: “In this case, everyone, let’s see each other in the next life.”
Emperor Jingwen calmed down, feeling guilty, and couldn’t help thinking that if he was no longer an emperor in the next life, he would learn to treat them well like the father of an ordinary family, and would never repeat the same mistakes.
The second prince took the lead and wrote down his intentions in the wish book, followed by the crown prince, the fourth prince, Emperor Taicheng and the little emperor.
Just as several people were about to drink a bowl of Mengpo soup, they suddenly felt a violent shaking under their feet. The ghost next to them saw this and his face changed immediately, and his originally pale face became even paler.
“Oh no! A vicious beast is about to escape!”
The underworld is the gathering place of the Yin energy of heaven and earth. There are countless evil beasts imprisoned in it. When the seal of the underworld is loosened, there will naturally be a lot of commotion.
At the very end, Emperor Jingwen and his men only heard this sentence. Before they could figure out what was going on, they saw that the gate of reincarnation, which was close at hand, was shaking violently. The light that was originally shining elsewhere happened to fall on them.
Emperor Jingwen and others only felt a flash of white light, and then it disappeared.
The ghost messenger didn’t even have time to stop it, and saw the intention book fall in with them.
However, after a moment, perhaps because of the unknown powerful force in the depths of the underworld, the earthquake quickly disappeared. Looking at the empty ground, the ghost messenger couldn’t help but sweat from his forehead.
Oh no, they haven’t drunk Mengpo soup yet!
If they are asked to reincarnate with their memories, I’m afraid there will be a big mess.
The ghost messenger who thought so did not dare to hide it and quickly reported it to the King of Hell. The King of Hell was a little nervous at first, but then he hurried to investigate in person. Then the King of Hell found that… this matter seemed to be out of his control.
It turned out that several people had been in contact with people from other worlds for a long time. In addition, the projection was originally a product of another world. Over the past few decades, they have also been stained with a lot of other world auras. Now they are attracted by those auras and are taken away by another world through the connected reincarnation gate in chaos.
The affairs of other worlds belong to the King of Hell in other worlds. In addition, even the underworld occasionally makes operational mistakes. This year’s tolerance quota has not been used up. After thinking about it, the King of Hell decided to let his colleagues worry about this matter, and soon put this little episode behind his mind.
In a blink of an eye, more than 20 years have passed.
In another world, at the door of a hotel –
a black Mercedes-Benz slowly stopped. When the doorman approached, a young man soon walked out of the car. If this was still another world, it would be soon discovered that this young man had a face that looked like Emperor Jingwen.
And the young man with this face was indeed Emperor Jingwen himself.
Emperor Jingwen never thought that he would find himself in another world when he opened his eyes. The reason why he was so sure was because he had never seen any of the furnishings around him! Even at the end of the projection, these things had never appeared.
Emperor Jingwen immediately knew that something must have gone wrong when he was reincarnated, but it was too late to go back now. Emperor Jingwen could only slowly grope his way through this world and grow up.
Although Emperor Jingwen was still unfamiliar with this world at the beginning, he had been learning since he was a baby, and more than 20 years had passed. In addition, he had been an emperor, so he had extraordinary experiences, and finally he made a name for himself.
It was also because of his experience as an emperor, especially as a prince, even if Emperor Jingwen wanted to be lazy, he couldn’t. He worked so hard and finally shined at the age of 26, accumulating enough capital to allow the prince and others to live a wealthy life.
In the past few years since he went to college, Emperor Jingwen was exhausted. He thought that such a developed society would be easier to get ahead than when he was the emperor, but in the end… there was no difference at all, it was just as difficult.
But looking at all this now, he felt it was worth it.
Thinking of this, Emperor Jingwen got out of the car and went around to the other side. After opening the door, he quickly helped a beautiful woman out of the car.
With Emperor Jingwen’s original temperament, he would not condescend to do these things, but there was no way. Modern society is too complicated. A man without gentlemanly manners cannot get a wife. After hitting the wall many times in a row, Emperor Jingwen finally had to compromise with reality, and gradually formed a habit.
The woman’s lower abdomen was slightly bulging, and coupled with the intimate movements of the two, anyone with a discerning eye could tell the relationship between the two at a glance.
Yes, the 26-year-old Emperor Jingwen had been married more than a year ago. At first, he just wanted to meet the princes of his previous life earlier, but as time went by, he slowly developed feelings for the woman in front of him.
As for the woman… She originally had a crush on Emperor Jingwen’s face, but later found that he was capable and had potential. Now his social status has proved that she was not wrong at the time, and the two of them hit it off.
Although woman always feel that her husband is weird in some places, for example, every time he see actors in costume dramas shouting “Long live the emperor”, the other party will always subconsciously respond, or her husband’s extraordinary chauvinism, when she thinks of this, the woman can’t help but want to roll her eyes.
Fortunately, his kind of male chauvinism is different from the common male chauvinism in the market. Ordinary male chauvinism only stays on the surface. In fact, it is to control and restrict his girlfriend/wife everywhere, without any practical benefits. However, the young man in front of him feels from the bottom of his heart that making money to support the family is what he should do. It is even more shameful to eat women’s soft rice and spend women’s money.
The most important thing is that no matter what happens, especially when he falls to the bottom, he will only think that he is incompetent and never blame others. In addition, the other party spends money very generously, as if he thinks it is natural to spend money on his woman. Even if the gift is expensive, as long as she wants it, he will never blink an eye. In the words of the young man, my woman should have the best of everything in the world.
Although women feel embarrassed to the point of numbness when hearing these middle school remarks, thinking about his behaviour… it doesn’t seem to be a big problem.
Although the other party doesn’t like to do housework, he will not force his partner to do housework. On the contrary, if she moves her hands a little, he will feel as if the sky is about to fall. Then he will hire a lot of nannies and drivers at home, as if as long as you are his woman, you should be served by others.
Violence and foul language do not exist at all, which is also extremely shameful for the young man. Especially hitting women and children, he thinks from the bottom of his heart that only incompetent people will use violence to solve problems, but he is never afraid when he really encounters something.
One time, the two of them were walking on the road, and they happened to meet someone rushing into the kindergarten to take revenge on society. The young man immediately rushed forward and subdued the man with a knife in a few moves. At that moment, the woman felt that he was like someone living in another world.
Nowadays, this kind of stupid …ah no, this kind of good man is really rare. Since I have met one, how can I let him go?
Thinking of this, the woman followed the strength of the young man and took her hand up.
In a blink of an eye, Emperor Jingwen seemed to see a familiar figure, but when he looked up, the figure had already disappeared.
Emperor Jingwen thought it must be his illusion. After all, the prince was either in his wife’s belly or on the way here, so how could he appear outside?
Thinking this way, Emperor Jingwen followed the waiter’s instructions and quickly followed the pace of the people around him and walked into the hotel.

chapters.title: Chapter 365: Extra 21: Modern
chapters.content:
Entering the hotel lobby, a cool breeze hit him, immediately dispelling the summer heat.
Emperor Jingwen has never had any social requirements for his wife. After all, the emperor’s woman, even if she is just a concubine, needs to greet her when she meets a minister’s wife of no rank. Even if she is a lady of imperial edict, she only skips the greeting link. There is no reason for the emperor’s woman to please others.
It was fine in the past. As his wife, she may occasionally need to deal with other bosses’ partners, but now it is a special situation, so after considering it, forget it.
Soon Emperor Jingwen called the assistant who had been waiting at the venue. Noticing that his wife had already started to feel uncomfortable after walking such a short distance, he pointed at the assistant and motioned him to help his wife find a place to rest quickly, and asked the assistant to help ask the waiter at the venue for some food and fruit that can suppress morning sickness.
… So, why is he always so confident!
After the young man’s series of actions, the young male assistant who had just graduated a few years ago was embarrassed. For a moment, he stood there, not knowing whether to reach out or not. The woman couldn’t help but twitch her lips.
Let a handsome male assistant who was 180+cm tall help her to rest. He thought of it!
Even if the male assistant could bear it, she might not be able to control herself!
The woman knew that this man had an emperor addiction. He didn’t really regard the female employees around him as palace maids and the male employees as eunuchs, did he? But these eunuchs were not real eunuchs at all!
Is this man so confident that she won’t cheat on him? Or maybe he didn’t think about it at all. In this case, even if she cheated on him, he probably wouldn’t find out in his life…“…Thank you, but no thanks.” Considering that the other party had never done anything to let her down, two seconds later, the woman reluctantly refused to have close contact with the handsome male assistant. After all, if someone took a picture of this, it would be a lot of fun.
The male assistant was also relieved after hearing this.
He searched around for a good seat and found a leather chair a few dozen metres away. The male assistant hurriedly said, “Madam, please come this way.”
Today’s banquet was full of handsome men and beautiful women. Logically, the woman should be worried. After all, her husband is young, handsome, and rich. He is very good at history, well-versed in ancient and modern times, and has a good hand in calligraphy. Even famous calligraphers are full of praise. He can write ancient Chinese and ancient Chinese at will, without being tainted by the vanity of modern society. Even if he wears a suit, he can not hide the elegance of ancient charm. Such a man is a hot commodity wherever he is. Coupled with the hormones during pregnancy, it is inevitable that she will be suspicious.
But the woman didn’t worry about these at all. After all, with the temperament of a young man, if he likes something, he will just say it openly and confidently, and he won’t steal it at all. Thinking of this, she followed the handsome male assistant very simply.
He had no idea what his wife was thinking in this short half minute. After about ten minutes, when Emperor Jingwen was holding a wine glass and chatting with someone, he seemed to see the prince in the meeting hall again.
This time, before Emperor Jingwen could react, there was a commotion at the door of the meeting hall.
“Boss Xun is here!” Someone shouted from a distance. After a small exclamation, Emperor Jingwen saw a lot of people surrounding him.
Judging from the situation, the person who came was probably of extraordinary status.
Just as Emperor Jingwen was constantly filtering various information in his mind, a boss figure at the side couldn’t help but speak up and gave an answer: “It turned out to be him. I didn’t expect him to come today.”
For this lucky man who came out of nowhere ten years ago, almost everyone who had experienced that period was familiar with him.
After all, how many subordinates in this world can get gifts from their bosses? And it was the will that the boss made before his death. Such a large amount made everyone who got the news at that time cry with envy.
Although the pile of numbers may not be a big deal for the person involved, it is enough to make most bosses jealous in the market.
In addition, the other party was able to successfully start his own company with the help of this will. In the blink of an eye, ten years have passed, and the original Secretary Xun has transformed into Boss Xun. The fate of life is really amazing.
“That young master Gu is really generous. I wish I had such a generous boss.” As he spoke, the boss couldn’t help but sigh, and the envy in his eyes almost overflowed. He didn’t notice the sudden tightening of the young man’s hand beside him.
It turned out to be this matter. It turned out that Boss Xun was the secretary at the beginning.
As for the other party’s former boss…
Emperor Jingwen lowered his voice and slowly read out a name – Gu Shao, the young general manager of Gu Group.
If you want to say that what shocked Emperor Jingwen the most in the past twenty years, it was naturally the fact that he was reincarnated into another world, but what bothered him the most was another thing he accidentally discovered a few years ago.
Ever since he decided to do business in this life, Emperor Jingwen could not avoid one person from beginning to end, that is the young man named Gu Shao.
He was also young and talented, but he was involved in a much wider range of fields than him. He was an expert in medicine, experiments, shipping, etc. It seemed that there was nothing in the world that could stump him. Even though he had been dead for five or six years, others were still amazed when they mentioned his name. Emperor Jingwen would never forget the look of the other person in his life.
In addition to doing business, he also made great achievements in academics. He could be called a genius among geniuses.
However, such a brilliant man died of a genetic disease before he was 30 years old. His death was very strange. Logically speaking, with the drugs he developed in foreign laboratories, he should have been able to save ten of them. I have never seen so many big figures in the world suffering from terminal illnesses.
Others can live, but he died quickly, which is too bizarre.
Because he had no chance to see the real person, Emperor Jingwen originally just listened to it as a story, until the person who said this took out the photo he had collected for a long time –
there were three people in the photo, which seemed to be a group photo taken by chance. Although Emperor Jingwen felt that the youngest youth looked familiar, he had never seen him before, but the middle-aged man next to the young man… The moment he saw him, Emperor Jingwen’s memory was suddenly pulled back to the more distant past.
Emperor Jingwen remembered that his youngest son had paid special attention to an ordinary family in Shangjing for a period of time, especially the father of that family.
