Emperor Jingwen clearly felt that his youngest son showed a fleeting strong emotion towards the other party, not to mention that he personally admitted that the reason why he treated the father differently was because he had dreamed that the other party had a very close blood relationship with him.
Now it seems that it was not a dream? It was just that Xiaojiu used the excuse of dreaming to talk about the relationship between himself and his father in the previous life.
As for the young man who looked like a dandy in the photo, when he met the other’s familiar black and white eyes, what else did Emperor Jingwen not understand?
Gu Shao was Xiaojiu, and Xiaojiu was Gu Shao. The other party was just like himself and others, and he accidentally fell into another world. In this way, everything can be explained.
Why did he know what was on the other side of the sea, why did he know that Lucheng had the food that Dazhou had always longed for, and the mysterious weapons in the wooden box… Now there are finally answers.
When the last piece of the puzzle was completed, Emperor Jingwen did not feel relieved, but felt empty in his heart.
Since Xiaojiu travelled from this world, then… will he come back again?
Emperor Jingwen couldn’t help thinking so, but he didn’t dare to think about it further.
At this time, when the boss beside him said, “It would be great if my son and daughter could be as capable as that young Mr. Gu,” Emperor Jingwen finally couldn’t help but said, “Sorry, I have something else to do. Excuse me.”
After saying that, without waiting for the boss’s response, Emperor Jingwen walked straight towards Mr. Xun, who has now become an important figure in the circle.
Xun Jing thought that the young man in front of him was just like the others, trying to get close to him. He was about to send him away with a smile, but suddenly heard the other party say, “Sir, can you please tell me about that young Mr. Gu?”
For some reason, Xun Jing vaguely felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity from the young man in front of him, and subconsciously stopped waving his hands.
When he heard the voice of “young Mr. Gu”, even though Xun Jing had been through many battles in the past ten years, he still couldn’t control his trance. When he came back to his senses, he found that he had nodded without knowing when.
“…Okay.”
After reacting, looking at the young man in front of him, for some reason, Xun Jing seemed to have noticed something and suddenly asked: “You know our young General Gu, right?”
Although this was a question, the man said it in an affirmative tone.
Emperor Jingwen paused when he heard this, and after a while, he almost whispered: “Do I know him…? Maybe.”
It was just a father and son who had known each other for a while, but never opened up to each other until the end.
At the same time, on the other side, at the end of a very remote corridor outside the venue –
when the prince turned a corner, as expected, he soon saw two familiar figures.
The scene he had just seen accidentally was indeed not an illusion, and coupled with the secret code left by the two people, the prince thought about it and came after all.
“It’s you.” As the prince approached, the faces of the two people who had been waiting there for a long time gradually became clear. Who else could these two people be if not the fourth prince and the second prince?
Seeing the prince’s face, the second prince was startled and suddenly laughed.
“So even if it was you, you didn’t choose him…”
The answer to who he was was self-evident.
Before the prince could answer, two more “click” footsteps were heard. When they looked back, they saw a tall young man with a cold face and a familiar yet unfamiliar little girl walking towards them step by step.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: Extra 22: Modern (End)
chapters.content:
The crown prince and others who saw this scene: “…”
The second prince was the first to react, bursting out laughing, he half squatted down and said playfully: “Hey, isn’t this little Ye Jin? How did you become a girl?”
However, before the second prince’s outstretched hand touched the little girl’s face, he was stopped halfway by the young man holding the little girl.
Feeling the strength of the hand holding his arm, the second prince couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows, thinking that after such a long time of not seeing him, the sixth prince’s strength has increased a lot.
After looking at the other person’s current height, the second prince laughed even harder: “So that’s how it is, it turns out that you specially picked a good body for yourself.”
In his previous life, Emperor Taicheng was only more than 1.7 meters tall, and now he is at least 1.8 meters tall. Although his stature is still not very strong, he is visibly flexible and strong, which makes people wonder if he must have referred to Xiaojiu’s genetic theory at the beginning.
Combined with the faint calluses on the other party’s hands, and the faint smell of disinfectant on his body, the second prince immediately analysed his current identity: “I didn’t expect you to become a doctor.”
So the sixth prince, who had suffered a loss in his previous life, was so afraid of death?
“It’s just a family tradition.” Originally, Emperor Taicheng was obsessed with health preservation, so he deliberately chose a family engaged in related industries. Because his parents in this life were both doctors, Emperor Taicheng hesitated for a long time when filling out his application, and finally decided to inherit his parents’ mantle. Facts have proved that with his calm and rational temperament, he is indeed suitable for this line of work.
Except that after he actually became a doctor, he found that this line of work had nothing to do with health preservation, everything else was quite to his liking.Seeing that the second prince finally retracted his claws very tactfully, Emperor Taicheng lightly dropped a bombshell-
“You are the same, you actually ran to become a policeman.”
Speaking of which, if someone like the second prince is allowed to become a policeman, what hope is there for the area under his jurisdiction? And, is this man really not a black policeman?
The Crown Prince and the Fourth Prince, who were watching the excitement on the side, were startled when they heard this, and then suddenly turned back to look at the Second Prince himself, with obvious shock on their faces.
The fact that they, both of whom have higher psychological qualities than ordinary people, can behave like this shows the shock that the Second Prince’s profession brings to people.
The Second Prince’s expression froze, and he immediately understood that when the Sixth Prince followed the secret code to find him, he had already found out his information.
Knowing yourself and the enemy, even in a peaceful society, there is no moment of relaxation. Such caution is worthy of him.
The Fourth Prince was stunned at first, and then he also thought of something, and the whole person became excited.
Isn’t this a coincidence? To be honest, he just passed his lawyer’s licence last month, and it is hot now. I don’t know what it feels like to send your brother in the previous life to prison. It feels very interesting, and I suddenly want to try it.
For some reason, the Second Prince on the side shivered inexplicably.
“Hey, I advise you not to have any thoughts that you shouldn’t have, or I’ll arrest you. I’m a popular person in the bureau now.” Apart from his twisted personality, the second prince’s brain is first-class. In his previous life, he could even swap the emperor’s family letters, which is evident. When it comes to insidiousness and viciousness, ordinary prisoners are really no match for him, so in the past two years, he has been notorious in the bureau. ṙ
Seeing that the second prince’s expression did not seem to be fake, and the crown prince had already searched out a lot of information about him with his mobile phone, including photos and videos of various criminals being captured, the fourth prince finally had to regretfully give up the extremely tempting idea of ​​the last minute.
“In this case, you have to be careful, don’t let me catch your tail.”
Facing the threat of the fourth prince, the second prince didn’t take it to heart at all. Obviously, he now enjoys the process of fighting wits and courage with the prisoners. The second prince is happy when he thinks of being able to openly watch the criminals’ painful and twisted expressions.
